Pad Ubahâh Mabayibok bimpi ambi, mañ ami ba. Pab ketir, 'atku p'â ambi. Pab ketir, p'â 'ag ngub atkibipwepoxo.

Efitwek yi nox pikning pab 'anggur ven p'â kumoxo.
00_aeternum_body_21_01: In forge, in tree, in star, in stone \n\nThe ancient key, the welcome home
00_aeternum_body_21_02: I give my heart to shield my soul \n\nI'm torn apart and remade whole
00_aeternum_body_22_01:
The Curse of the Eldritch continues to plague us here in Brightwood. It has chosen the Brightrest Cemetery as its killing ground. Perhaps it had some connection to the place, in life. 

All my cleverest strategies have served only to lead my soldiers to their repeated deaths. It's as if the creature is laughing at us. 

The people of Brightwood have faith in the Covenant. If they cannot visit the graves of their loved ones, many will fall to despair. We must protect them, as the Spark protects us. 

Please send more troops from the Fourth Battalion. Our need is urgent. 

Lieutenant Templar General d'Aquitane 


I.T.L.O.T.S.
00_aeternum_body_23_01:
To the attention of Templar General Carvalho, 

The bearer of this letter wishes to form a coalition between the factions to fight Corruption. To that end, they have requested that the Covenant attend a parley. 

I believe it is in our best interest to attend. 
  
Our sacred charge is to vanquish the Lost. Our pragmatic need is to battle the other factions. Yet Corruption will consume us all, if we do not act. 

Before we are Covenant, we are human. Grant me permission to attend the parley on behalf of the Covenant. I will represent our faction with honor. 

Lieutenant Templar General d'Aquitane 


I.T.L.O.T.S.
00_aeternum_body_24_01:
We followed the string of strange disappearances here, to the village of Dromgoole. We knew something bad awaited us, but we weren't prepared to find the entire village lost. 

General Carvalho is taking it very hard. Dromgoole was his hometown, and the faces of these shambling corpses must be familiar to him. But there's still no sign of the missing people. 

Wait. I can hear singing coming from inside the church. Perhaps there's still someone left to save.
00_aeternum_body_24_02: As soon as we set foot inside the church, the singing stopped. No sign of the missing people, or anyone else. Who was singing? \n\nThe Lost seem to have fallen back, at least. We can establish a temporary command center here.
00_aeternum_body_24_03:
General Carvalho hasn't slept for three days. His rage seems to be the only thing driving him. He slaughters two hundred Lost a day, but they keep coming back, growing more bold. We've barricaded the doors and windows. 

I haven't slept either, but for a different reason. Every time I close my eyes, I hear the singing. Many voices, singing the same melody that drew us to this church. When I wake, they fall silent. 

I haven't told this to anyone. General Carvalho needs my support, not my formless worries. I just need to get this song out of my head, somehow.
00_aeternum_body_24_04:
The dead claw at our barricades. Sleep deprivation weakens our resolve. All except General Carvalho, who always swore that he would never become Lost. 

Today, we finally found out the true extent of his resolve. To save his soul from being Lost, he sold it to Corruption instead. How many years has he spent preparing for this final stand? 

Now the nightmare is in here with us, roaring rage at the Lost outside. He's tearing down our barricades to get at them. 

It's so hard to think. The singing has started again, rising up from under the ground. Am I asleep, or awake?
00_aeternum_body_25_01:
My colleagues and I have been fascinated for years with the Angry Earth. These creatures abound on Aeternum and appear to serve as guardians and protectors to the native flora and fauna. 

It is my belief that they were spawned here but we have yet to determine the circumstances of their creation. 

If we can discover their origins, we might find a way to avoid conflict and possibly even live harmoniously with them.
00_aeternum_body_25_02:
Some observations on the Angry Earth: 

Their forms seem to follow the shapes of nature. It is easy to see how they could have inspired tales of mythical forest creatures in the Old World.
Does this mean, however, that they may have gotten off the island? Or that humans managed to escape Aeternum at some point in the past? No ship can survive passing through the Stormwall. Do the Angry Earth have a way to do so? 
Discovering more about these creatures may also give us the means to finally escape this island.
00_aeternum_body_25_03:
Our campsite seems to have been surrounded by wildlife sometime in the small hours. They're acting strangely, but haven't moved to attack us yet. 

I've heard my fellow scholars make reference to a phenomenon called 'Blight' that infects Angry Earth creatures in Edengrove. The description seems to fit my observations of the creatures that now circle the ruins. The evidence suggests that the Blight is spreading south. 

Professor Fawn has hired several hunters to guard the camp perimeter from attack. I've persuaded one of them to collect samples from the creatures for me. We'll see what a careful study reveals about this 'Blight'.
00_aeternum_body_25_04:
A closer look at these Blighted samples has revealed both animal and vegetable traits. The ichor has characteristics of both blood and sap. I have so many questions. 

I also took a sample of the red, fungal growths that afflicted the creature, presumably as the result of Blight. Unfortunately, I could not identify the bizarre fungi. 

Meanwhile, the other Angry Earth seem to have become agitated and their numbers have increased. Though whether it's a result of our study or the presence of their Blighted brethren, I cannot tell.
00_aeternum_body_25_05:
The Angry Earth destroyed the Lepus research camp last night. Their attack was furious and relentless. 

I awoke as the attack was underway, and barly escaped with nothing more than my nightshirt. So many of our valuable observations were lost… 

It's my understanding that Professor Fawn, who was killed in the vicious attack, is now recommending against re-establishing the camp. Not to question my colleague's commitment (or her courage), but aren't a few deaths a small price to pay to discover a way off the island? 

I am certain that the Angry Earth are the key to our escape.
00_aeternum_body_26_01:
Human: 

Do not touch the Daughterwell. 

Do not meddle in the affairs of the Angry Earth. 

Leave in peace, and you will be left in peace. 

Upset the balance, and there will be consequences.
00_aeternum_body_27_01:
Dear Marauder lowlifes, 

I've taken your champion's soul. It was easy. Yrsa is mine now. 

Bring me the box, or I'll hunt down every Marauder in Aeternum. 

Don't test my patience. I have none. 


Signed, 

Thorpe, future ruler of Aeternum
00_aeternum_body_27_02:
You are a traitor, a thief, and a coward. I should have drowned you when I had the chance. 

These games have gone on long enough. I'm sick of hearing your name. 

Come to me and let us finish this. 

Bring my box, or leave it with your Soulwarden friends. I can just as easily take it off their corpses. 

Signed, 

Thorpe, future ruler of Aeternum
00_aeternum_body_27_03:
I can shoulder this burden no longer.

These offenses compounded, the Tempest's scorn, the rise of these Soulwardens...

I cannot even escape my defeat in death.

The fire dies, and yet I persist - drifting into the cold and the darkness.

Leaving only a shell of what I once was.


In Perpetuity,

Commander Thorpe
00_aeternum_body_28_01:
My friend,

By the time you read this, I'll be gone. By now, I expect that you'll all be celebrating your victory against Corruption. Pour out one last glass for me. 

There are some things about being a Soulwarden that I haven't told you. At first, it was because I wanted you to just go away. But after a while, it was because I was afraid you would. 

A Soulwarden never knows when the fall will come. We may last longer than most, but eventually we succumb to one of the two great forces that take every soul on Aeternum: Azoth, or Corruption. And when a Soulwarden falls, they fall hard. They put everyone around them in danger. An old Soulwarden like me lives in fear of that every day. 

I can't bear the thought of hurting you, and wrecking what we've built together. I thought of slipping away quietly a dozen times. But I just couldn't bear to leave. That hope you showed me... the courage, and the leadership... that was my weakness. 

I never thought I'd be part of something like this again. These last months, rebuilding the Soulwardens, I've been the happiest I can remember ever being. That's how I know it's time for me to go. 

Seneca said, "Life, if well lived, is long enough." I've lived more than long enough, and I'm not afraid. I'll go somewhere far away, where I can't hurt anyone, and let Azoth take what's left of my soul. I think I'd make a good Lost, honestly. Maybe I could even haunt a spot with a nice river, for fishing. 


Keep the Soulwardens safe. 

Yonas
00_aeternum_body_29_01:
**The bar napkin is covered in scribbled writing. A ring-shaped stain from a beer glass makes it tough to read.**

**A few words stand out from the jumble:**


Captain Isabella and crew 

"No survivors, no prisoners" 

Killed one hundred, no, one thousand, no, TEN THOUSAND men 

Deal with the devil? (Corruption?) 



ARCLIGHT CAVERNS
00_aeternum_body_30_01:
Oh Motherwell 

Please bless our village with health 

Please grant us many fat children 

Please keep the monsters away 

Please watch over us
00_aeternum_body_31_01:
We set forth from Honfleur with a hold full of cargo, and a handful of uniquely valuable items from Paris as a gift to the soldiers at the new fort. These items include a Silver Candelabra from the Court of the late King Henry the Great, a Blessed Chalice from Bishop Richelieu of the Church at Luçon, and an Astrolabe used by Samuel Champlain himself during an earlier voyage across the Great Western Ocean.




-Marcel Dupont

01_demonstorm_proposal_next_b_new: <g id="g_litearmor_crossarmsupset" priority="high" />The poor girl's just survived a shipwreck, and you ask her to face death for a cause she<g id="g_litearmor_whatwantfromme" /> doesn't even understand…?<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" bout="1" /> I don't blame her.

01_getoffbeach_complete_a_new: <g id="g_male_nod2" bin="1" bout="1.1" />Ahh, ha ha! Let the<g id="g_male_spreadarms001" priority="high" /> air fill your lungs, friend. You have conquered death and been<g id="g_female_youknows" bin="1.4" /> born again, like new!
01_getoffbeach_complete_next2_a_new: On a<g id="g_female_smackfist" /> ship, smashed by the stormwall, of course… like everyone else here.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" bin="1.5" bout="1.5" /> Hm. Maybe you forget. Could be a<g id="g_female_taptemple" priority="high" bin="1" bout="2" /> blow to your head killed you.
01_getoffbeach_complete_next2_b_new: <g id="g_male_wavehandpshaw" bin="1.5" bout="1.5" />But it will pass! Your soul is strong, that's what matters.<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" bin="1.5" bout="1.5" /> Most aren't so lucky as we are.
01_getoffbeach_complete_next3_new: They are<g id="g_male_shakehead" /> reborn as something else… the Corrupted, or worse.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Ah. But come. We<g id="g_male_waghand02" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> should not dwell on such dark matters!
01_getoffbeach_complete_next_a_new: No small<g id="g_female_youknow" bin="1.5" bout="2" /> feat! You died, and it won't be the last time… but this is<g id="g_female_notsure" bin="1.5" bout="1.5" /> Aeternum! No one gets away that easy.
01_getoffbeach_complete_next_b_new: The island delivers us to death's door, then steals us back from its embrace.<g id="g_female_shrugshort" bin="1.5" bout="2" /> You get used to it… eventually.
01_getoffbeach_description: Discover the wonders of the new world you find yourself shipwrecked upon.
01_getoffbeach_task: Talk to Aelstrom on the beach
01_grace_bark1: Eat lead, you bastards! You won't be getting a piece of Grace O'Malley that easy!
01_grace_bark2: Well, fancy seeing another clear-eyed sailor amid this rabble! Could you give a girl a hand, maybe? Clear the space so I can jump down?
01_grace_bark3: Ah, back on the sand! You have my thanks. I know a safe spot this way, c'mon...
01_grace_bark_alt1: Stay back, you bastards! Unless you want to be eating lead!
01_grace_bark_alt2: Hey mate, can you give a girl a hand here? These red-eyed rotters have me pinned down!
01_grace_bark_alt3: That's better! Come and follow me this way! I know a safe spot we can talk.
01_grace_goodbye_a: Good old "Watcher Lleyson Reese" says there's a town. I'll head there and sell this loot.
01_grace_goodbye_a_new: <g id="g_grace_pointl" bout="1.5" priority="high" />Your local friends say there's a town a bit up the road. I'll head there and sell this loot.
01_grace_goodbye_b: <g id="g_grace_headnodyes" priority="high" />I'll set your part aside until you get there.<g id="g_grace_chuckle" priority="high" /> For my part, I'll be saving up for a ship to escape this hellish island.
01_grace_goodbye_next2_a: <g id="g_grace_salutefingers" />Have it your way, hero. I just hope you don't end up as<g id="g_grace_goaway" /> one of those monsters yourself.
01_grace_goodbye_next2_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturerights" />Don't worry about me burning you on the loot.<g id="g_grace_yes" /> You did me a favor, and I'm good for it.<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> As long as you survive, that is… I'll be there.
01_grace_goodbye_next2_prompt: "I'll meet you in town, at least."
01_grace_goodbye_next_a: Oh, I heard a lot of stuff from "Watcher Lleyson Reese," but I don't believe even half of it.
01_grace_goodbye_next_a_new: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" bout="1.5" />Bah! Those two say there's some kinda "Stormwall" out there,<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> but they say a lot of things, and I don't believe a word of it.
01_grace_goodbye_next_b: <g id="g_grace_welcome" />Besides, Captain Grace O'Malley never met a storm she couldn't navigate. I'll find a way. You<g id="g_grace_yes" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> can come with me, if you like.
01_grace_greet_01_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />This isn't my first shipwreck, you<g id="g_grace_flirt" bin="1" /> know? One thing I've learned, you have to always think ahead, keep an eye on the horizon.
01_grace_greet_01_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturel" bout=".5" />And there's booty to be had here, countless treasures<g id="g_grace_consider" priority="high" bin=".5" /> captain and crew had stashed onboard, if you know<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> where to look.
01_grace_greet_02_a: <g id="g_grace_upset" />Unfortunately, I didn't have as much luck as you did. Those damn red-eyed rotters are swarming all over the wreckage of my ship.
01_grace_greet_02_b: <g id="g_grace_disappointed" /> I worry it's bad luck leaving behind my own treasures, but I can't get through the bastards.
01_grace_greet_02_b_new: <g id="g_grace_disappointed" />I hate to leave my own hard-won treasures behind, but I can't get through the bastards.
01_grace_greet_03_a: <g id="g_grace_bowhead" />Look, I'm as grateful as can be that you reclaimed my flag and all.
01_grace_greet_03_b: <g id="g_grace_crossarmsinsulted" bout=".5" />But don't ask me to go on a fool crusade against those red-eyed demons. I don't need a medal of valor.<g id="g_grace_dismiss" bin=".5" bout=".5" /> Just the coin for me, thank you very much.
01_grace_greet_04_a: <g id="g_grace_sympathy" />I may not be going with you, but it doesn't mean I don't wish you luck.
01_grace_greet_04_b: You seem to have a solid share of it, so we'll<g id="g_grace_yes" /> see each other again. I'd wager money on it.
01_lore_manifest_03: We set forth from Honfleur with a hold full of cargo, and a handful of uniquely valuable items from Paris as a gift to the soldiers at the new fort. These items include a Silver Candelabra from the Court of the late King Henry the Great, a Blessed Chalice from Bishop Richelieu of the Church at Luçon, and an Astrolabe used by Samuel de Champlain himself during an earlier voyage across the Great Western Ocean.
01_msq_gracesflag_description: A pirate flag taken from the ship Satisfaction on behalf of the Captain Grace O'Malley.
01_pillageship_complete_a: There<g id="g_grace_greethead" bout=".5" /> you are - I was starting to worry. More<g id="g_grace_liftbothhands" bin="1" /> importantly, though - what did you find?
01_pillageship_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_takeitem5s" priority="high" />Let's see here... Ooh, yes, these are definitely worth a coin or two. Soon as we find a town, we'll sell them and split the profit.
01_pillageship_description: Search the shipwreck for a manifest and locate the valuable items on the list. Find and speak to Grace O'Malley when you're done.
01_pillageship_incomplete: <g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" />My first mate went that way, but something happened to him.<g id="g_grace_secret" /> Don't let it happen to you. Get the ship's manifest, any valuables, and meet me on the other side.
01_pillageship_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Of course. Not like these rotters care a damn for it, and I'll be needing a new ship, a new crew…<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" bin="1" bouth=".5" /> that takes coin.
01_pillageship_proposal_b: In fact,<g id="g_grace_convince2" /> if you want to partner up, I'll split the loot 70-30,<g id="g_grace_greethead" /> or what the hell, 60-40 even!<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> What do you say? Then we can go head to that watchtower of yours.

01_pillageship_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_yes" />That's the spirit! It's<g id="g_grace_sorry" bout=".5" /> a deal! I need to circle back to my own ship to grab what I can,<g id="g_grace_pointl" bin=".5" /> but there's a wreck over there I haven't searched yet.
01_pillageship_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Find the manifest first, then look for whatever's listed. I'll meet you over there. Fortune smile on you, mate.

01_raisealarm_complete_06_a: Hold up there, what business do you have in Corinth? A report from the Watcher, eh? OK, I'll take that.
01_raisealarm_complete_06_a_new: <g id="guard_nod" />You there... new to Corinth, are you? <g id="guard_headshakeno" />Last thing we need's another mouth to feed. <g id="guard_headshakeno" />No bread to spare for traveling vagrants! <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Go back to where you came from.
01_raisealarm_complete_06_b: So it was Corruption causing that hellish storm. Merde! Don't we have enough problems?
01_raisealarm_complete_06_b_new: <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />Did you, then? Does that mean you've got news of the storm? <g id="guard_nod" />Heard rumors there's Corrupted swarming all over down there.
01_raisealarm_complete_12_a: Welcome to Prydwen, founded during the reign of the High King, a legacy honored to this day!
01_raisealarm_complete_12_a_new: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Welcome to Prydwen, traveler! <g id="male_nodunderstand" />The greatest kingdom on Aeternum… well, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />to be precise, it's a regency, currently, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but that will change!
01_raisealarm_complete_12_b: Ah, a report from Watcher Reese? Thank you! Hm. So it was foul Corruption behind the storm? Very well. I will dispatch a Knight straightaway.
01_raisealarm_complete_12_b_new: <g id="male_realize" />Have you come from the beach, then? We've had disturbing reports. <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Not just the self-proclaimed king squatting down there… <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but something even worse.
01_raisealarm_complete_12_c_new: So it's true, then? <g id="male_darnit" priority="high" />God's ears! Why must every day bring such foul tidings! <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Derelict knights, greedy farmers… it never ends. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />And now the Corrupted, too.

01_recoveritems_incomplete_new: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" />Yer big pal there would really like a word with ya. You should probably talk to him first, he seems like the impatient type.
01_recoveritems_proposal_a: Now,<g id="g_grace_flirt" bout="1.5" /> there's a good mate. Tough one too, if you're so confident. No complaints, though.
01_recoveritems_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_convince2" />Tell you what, if you can get my stuff back, I'll give you a greater share of our profits, 40-60... or what the hell?<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" bin=".5" /> 30-70. What do you say?
01_recoveritems_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_cantremember" bout=".5" />Most of our cargo was lost at sea, and I got my captain's log on the way out.
01_recoveritems_proposal_next_b: What's burning me now is leaving behind my ship's flag and my lucky wheel - get those, and then maybe we meet at that watchtower. Works for me!

01_reese_greet_04_b: But now the storm is growing stronger, reaching further, calling to them… bringing them here.

01_solesurvivor_desc: On approach to the legendary island of Aeternum, the ship of Captain Aldous Thorpe is consumed by a storm of Corruption, and the Captain himself becomes possessed with evil. Your only hope is to escape the burning ship, make your way to the shore and then attempt to get your bearings in this strange, new world.
01_solesurvivor_gotopoint0: Search the Ship Graveyard for Captain Thorpe's Box
01_solesurvivor_incomplete: Find out what happened to Captain Thorpe.
01_solesurvivor_openuiscreen: Retrieve the Items from Captain Thorpe's Satchel
01_solesurvivor_proposal_a: I think so... I could've sworn I saw one of the swabbies, but it was one of those... creatures.
01_solesurvivor_proposal_b: Damned priest! I never should've trusted that bastard - all his talk of legends and power, treasures... nothing but lies. And the box he gave me…
01_solesurvivor_proposal_next_a: I-I don't know. I lost it when the ship went down, but this voice… she says I need to get it back!
01_solesurvivor_proposal_next_b: You... I order you! Search the beach... if we don't recover the box... No! Wait...! I will find it! No, please... I can't die here... not like this!
01_survivors_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_handheart" bin=".5" bout=".5" />Well now, can't tell you what a relief it was seeing someone who was still human.
01_survivors_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_cantremember" bin="1" />I was beginning to think I was all alone out here… the rest of the world had gone<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> mad.
01_survivors_complete_next_a: Perfect, I was betting there'd be some kind of town nearby. Thinking I'd go look for it after I'm done out here.
01_survivors_complete_next_a_new: <g id="g_grace_greethead" bout=".5" />Perfect, I was betting there'd be some kind of folk somewhere on this rock.<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" bin=".5"/> Figured I'd go look for it after I'm done out here.
01_survivors_complete_next_b: But I'm not about to go walking away from a fleet of freshly crashed boats, not if I have a choice in the matter.
01_survivors_complete_next_b_new: <g id="g_grace_gesturearound" priority="high" />I'm not about to go walking away from a whole fleet of fresh salvage, not if I have a choice in the matter.
01_survivors_description: Search the shipwrecks for survivors and take out as many Corrupted as you can. Report back to Aelstrom and Urda's camp when you're done.
01_survivors_incomplete_a_new: <g id="g_female_headnodding" />Watch your back out there. These Corrupted bastards can be sneaky.
01_survivors_incomplete_a_new_mb: <g id="g_female_headnodding" />Watch your back out there. These Corrupted bastards can be sneaky.
01_survivors_proposal_a: The intentions of this island have always been a mystery… but someone, or something, has clearly changed our course.
01_survivors_proposal_a_new: <g id="g_male_goodnews" />I agree. There are many shipwrecks, but if we move fast, we can<g id="g_female_youknows" /> cover them all by the day's end.
01_survivors_proposal_a_new_mb: <g id="g_male_goodnews" />I agree. There are many shipwrecks, but if we move fast, we can<g id="g_female_youknows" /> cover them all by the day's end.
01_survivors_proposal_b: I remember when we would see one, maybe two ships in an entire season! And the survivors… so many new faces back then.
01_survivors_proposal_b_new: <g id="g_female_impatient" priority="high"/>Stop being so thick-headed, Aelstrom! Those ships will just be followed by more. Until you find the cause of the Corruption,<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> it will only get worse.
01_survivors_proposal_b_new_mb: <g id="g_female_impatient" priority="high"/>Stop being so thick-headed, Aelstrom! Those ships will just be followed by more. Until you find the cause of the Corruption,<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> it will only get worse.
01_survivors_proposal_next2_a_new: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> I suspect you do not fully grasp the dangers you face… but<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> you are brave if nothing else.
01_survivors_proposal_next2_a_new_mb: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> I suspect you do not fully grasp the dangers you face… but<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> you are brave if nothing else.
01_survivors_proposal_next2_b: It is good you do not fully grasp the dangers you face. It's done wonders for this one - it keeps you sane on this island.
01_survivors_proposal_next2_b_new: Bah!<g id="g_male_darnit" /> I am sorry we cannot venture forth together! But while<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" bin="1" /> you search for survivors, I will find our<g id="g_female_cheerfistpump" /> next challenge! I will<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> meet you back here!
01_survivors_proposal_next2_b_new_mb: Bah!<g id="g_male_darnit" /> I am sorry we cannot venture forth together! But while<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" bin="1" /> you search for survivors, I will find our<g id="g_female_cheerfistpump" /> next challenge! I will<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> meet you back here!
01_survivors_proposal_next2_c: Bah! I'm sorry we cannot venture forth together, my new friend! But while you search for survivors, I will find our next challenge! I'll be back!
01_survivors_proposal_next_a: It is probably too late for that now… anyone out there will undoubtedly have fallen Lost or Corrupted by now.
01_survivors_proposal_next_a_new: Aha!<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> Yes, we will spread out!<g id="g_male_pointsoutthere" /> You can search for survivors, my friend. As Urda reminds me, I must search<g id="g_female_explains" /> for the source of this menace.
01_survivors_proposal_next_a_new_mb: Aha!<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> Yes, we will spread out!<g id="g_male_pointsoutthere" /> You can search for survivors, my friend. As Urda reminds me, I must search<g id="g_female_explains" /> for the source of this menace.
01_survivors_proposal_next_b: Now who's beeing grim? There's a chance some survived with souls intact, but searching the wreckage is risky. Out there, you're on your own.
01_survivors_proposal_next_b_new: <g id="g_male_dontknow" />I'm not sure which undertaking is the greater risk, but it's<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> no matter to me. I will remain<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> here at the camp.
01_survivors_proposal_next_b_new_mb: <g id="g_male_dontknow" />I'm not sure which undertaking is the greater risk, but it's<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> no matter to me. I will remain<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> here at the camp.
01_survivors_proposal_next_c: Nonsense! I can go along to aid in the search. My sword thirsts to slice open more Corrupted throats!
01_survivors_proposal_next_c_new: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Aelstrom means well, but death takes its toll… even here.<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> You should be careful with the lives you have left.
01_survivors_proposal_next_c_new_mb: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Aelstrom means well, but death takes its toll… even here.<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> You should be careful with the lives you have left.
01_survivors_proposal_next_d: And it will be slaked, you brute! But your task is finding the source of the storm. The newcomer seems perfectly capable to search for survivors.

01_urda_convomb_01: TempMB - Welcome, traveler, to this isle - equally wondrous and accursed.
01_urda_convoww_01: TempWW - Welcome, traveler, to this isle - equally wondrous and accursed.
01_urda_default_00: Always<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> a surprise what washes up on the beach.
01_urda_greet_01_a_mb: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" bout="1" />Bah! More likely a<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" bin="1.1" /> natural, this one.<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> That's good, stranger.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Now you will need wit and skill if you would not languish on Aeternum.
01_urda_greet_01_a_ww: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" bout="1" />Bah! More likely a<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" bin="1.1" /> natural, this one.<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> That's good, stranger.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Now you will need wit and skill if you would not languish on Aeternum.
01_urda_greet_01_b_mb: <g id="g_female_gestureright" priority="high" />The town of Prydwen up the road is… mostly safe. But<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" bout="1.5" /> out here, we are on our own.
01_urda_greet_01_b_ww: <g id="g_female_gestureright" priority="high" />The town of Corinth up the road is… mostly safe. But<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" bout="1.5" /> out here, we are on our own.
01_urda_greet_02: <g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />Think before agreeing to any of Aelstrom's ideas.<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> He's been known to have some bad ones.
01_urda_greet_03: There<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> is no shame in staying here in camp.<g id="g_litearmor_headshakeno" /> Don't let Aelstrom lead you to yet another death so soon.
01_urda_greet_04: Rest by<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> the fire and restore your energy if you need.<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> We are safe here… for now.
01_urda_greet_05: It takes more than courage to keep your soul on this island. Your<g id="g_male_explain" /> friend's using her wits. You should do the same.
01_urda_greet_06: This<g id="g_litearmor_think" /> is a reprieve for today, but I have seen this before…<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> it does not bode well.
01_urda_greet_07: We will meet again. Large as it may be, the island is actually a small place to spend eternity.
01_whisper_beach_01: And they shall ruthlessly strike down their fellows… their path to Corruption begun...
01_whisper_beach_02: This is only the beginning, all these sailors join our cause... soon, it will be all of humanity.
01_whisper_beach_03: And they shall steal from one another… like rats fighting over scraps…
01_whisper_beach_04: What's begun… cannot be stopped, not by the people of this island… and not by you…
01_whisper_beach_05: And they shall witness the power manifest… the true future of the human race…
01_whisper_beach_06: You steal that which is mine… you assault my followers… and now you disrupt my plans… this is personal…
01_whisper_beach_07: Come closer… it is time you know the whole truth…
01_whisper_beach_caveapproach: You are drawn to the power like a moth to flame. Come, and meet my allies.
01_whisper_beach_cavecomplete: You are stronger than I first realized… this is good. When you submit to me, we will be unstoppable.
01_whisper_beach_caveinterior: And they shall witness the power manifest… the true future of humanity…
01_whisper_beach_pillageship_new: You scurry about like rats searching for scraps… while I can offer you more wealth and power than you can possibly imagine.
01_whisper_ftue_01: You wash up on my shore exhausted and weak... and I welcome you home...
01_whisper_ftue_02: You are strong, yes... but you need not fear death... for I am with you...
01_whisper_ftue_03: Return to me what was lost... share in my blessings... and join me in everlasting glory.
01_whisper_ftue_04: What have you done...?! The source... It was my destiny to claim that!
01_whisper_ftue_05: You had the choice... you forced my hand... your soul is now mine.
0202_0101_inquisitorstools_description: Specialized tools used by Inquisitor Lucia.
0202_0102_azothstainedamulet_description: Worn by the Anointed who supported the Inquisition.
0202_0102_brackwaterritebook_description: Barely legible lists of Brightwood's residents, homes, and property.
0202_0103_soulcandle_description: Candles used by followers of Inquisitor Matthias to mark those whose souls were deemed strong.
0202_0104_matthiassmedallion_description: The medallion worn by a notoriously sadistic Inquisitor.
0202a_00_magistrate_defaultdialogue: Well then, welcome to Brightwood, I suppose. Mind your soul around these parts - they tend to get Lost.
0202a_01_magistrate_defaultdialogue_a: Don't know what you've heard about Brightwood, stranger, but it may well be true.
0202a_01_magistrate_defaultdialogue_b: We've been dug in here battling the soulless Lost for centuries.
0202a_02_magistrate_defaultdialogue_a: As difficult as it may be to accept the truths you exposed, I think we made a difference in the fight against the Lost here.
0202a_02_magistrate_defaultdialogue_b: I've heard Weaver's Fen still has its fair share of challenges as well.
0202a_03_magistrate_defaultdialogue_a: I heard you eventually made your way out to the Fen!
0202a_03_magistrate_defaultdialogue_b: I've also heard the Lost there are even worse than they are here. I can't imagine.
0203_0101_fragrantsatchels_description: A satchel of some earthy-smelling substance carried by the Dryad warriors.
0203_0103_hopecatalyst_description: A powerful catalyst for healing magics.
0203_0103_lushancientpeatmoss_descriptio: A secondary component that Eclipse Warriors used in forging Dryad armor.
0203_0103_menderscloth_description: Bloody cloth with imprinted memories of past menders.
0203_0103_mercysbreath_description: A mysterious flower known for its curative properties.
0203_0103_soothsayersalve_description: A pure white, powder salve formulated by soothsayers on Aeternum.
0203_0103_verdantancientpeatmoss_descrip: Another component that Dryad warriors used in the forging of armor.
0203a_00_survivalist_defaultdialogue_a: I see you, stranger, and I see your soul.
0203a_00_survivalist_defaultdialogue_b: Strong it may be, but is it strong enough?
0203a_01_survivalist_defaultdialogue_a: Brightwood is no different than anywhere else on Aeternum.
0203a_01_survivalist_defaultdialogue_b: We see the Lost as enemies, but we don't realize what terrible suffering they endure.
0203a_02_survivalist_defaultdialogue: What you have brought me is powerful, but it is not enough. We need something to refine the moss spores.
0203a_03_survivalist_defaultdialogue_a: I will remain, to observe the Angry Earth and Lost.
0203a_03_survivalist_defaultdialogue_b: With time and patience, I hope to have a talisman that can hold the Lost at bay without violence. There has been enough suffering in Brightwood.
0204_0101_eerilyglowingfertilizer_descri: Old, rusty, bent nails from a coffin suggesting it was broken open after being buried underground.
0204_0101_soilcoveredbones_description: Partially decomposed bones coated in dry dirt.
0204_0102_sinanovicsoil_description: These human bones appear to have been broken and reformed many, many times.
0204_0103_twinklingmetalshard_descriptio: Specific type of Starmetal, a Starmetal that seems to twinkle even in daylight.
0204_0104_bladebrute_description: Blades once used by those not afraid of stabbing a friend in the back.
0204_0104_bucaneersplank_description: A plank some unlucky pirates were once forced to walk.
0204_0104_hangmansbinding_description: Bindings to cruelly restrain prisoners, used by a notorious hangman.
0204_0104_infernalcoagulant_description: A mysterious liquid that instantly coagulates spilled blood.
0204_0104_madalchemistscribbles_descript: Scraps of writing from a mad man.
0205_0101_corruptedtools_description: Assorted tools used by the Corrupted for gathering lumber and mining.
0205_0101_emptyazothapplicator_descripti: Old twine and chain that appears to have been used to restrain one of the Lost.
0205_0101_inhumaneworkorder_description: Military orders from Reida's Burrow targeting the Lumberyard to serve as a bulwark against the Lost.
0205_0102_baneseedoil_description: Makes armor last twice as long.
0205_0102_evershinepolish_description: One use will last for years.
0205_0102_hammeredmetal_description: Worked and reworked for maximum strength.
0205_0102_heavypadding_description: Strong protection for lining a helm.
0205_0102_metalbanding_description: Reinforcing metal, made to withstand the worst.
0205_0102_refinedbalefire_description: Ore infused with the heat of battle.
0205_0102_ruggedvarnish_description: For weatherproofing all types of surfaces.
0205_0102_shardsbattle_description: Pieces of the original Battle's Embrace.
0205_0102_stalwartrivets_description: Their shine may have faded, but they won't fail in battle.
0205_0102_stouthides_description: Nice and thick, protected against everyday wear.
0205a_00_artificer_defaultdialogue_a: You've done Brightwood a kindness, traveler. We've finally gotten a chance to catch our collective breath…before the next threat looms.
0205a_00_artificer_defaultdialogue_b: You've done Brightwood a kindness, traveler. We've finally gotten a chance to catch our collective breath…before the next threat looms.
0205a_01_artificer_defaultdialogue: You've done Brightwood a kindness, traveler. We've finally gotten a chance to catch our collective breath…before the next threat looms.
0207_00_commander_defaultdialogue: Move along. I won't go so far as to draw steel against you, but it doesn't mean I have time to waste bandying about.
0207_01_commander_defaultdialogue: Duty has called me to Brightwood, where strength and valor are truly tested. I am at home here. We shall see if you have equal mettle.
0207_01pre_commander_defaultdialogue: Duty has called me to Brightwood, where strength and valor are truly tested. I am at home here. We shall see if you have equal mettle.\n[ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
0207_02_commander_defaultdialogue: No book can prepare you for Brightwood. There are things lurking there that must be seen with your own eyes.
0207_03_commander_defaultdialogue: You light-bringers bore me. If you truly knew the way, then why does darkness remain here? Save your breath.
0207a_01_commander_defaultdialogue: Duty calls me to Brightwood, where strength is truly tested.
0207a_01pre_commander_defaultdialogue: Duty calls me to Brightwood, where strength is truly tested.\n[ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
0207a_02_commander_defaultdialogue: Those books can't prepare you for Brightwood.
0208_00_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_think" />Wandering without knowledge of your destination? How curious.
0208_01_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_explain" />The quest for knowledge and understanding is our sworn duty. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />How may I service you, fellow erudite?
0208_01pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_explain" />The quest for knowledge and understanding is our sworn duty. Return when you understand more.\n[ Level 20 required for "Trial of the Scrivener"]
0208_02_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_applaud" />Oh this will be fascinating! A Marauder brute here in the Enclave. <g id="male_waghand01" />I look forward to learning from your blunders.
0208_03_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Yes, come hither my senseless friend. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Tell me again how belief in fairy tales helps to solve all of mankind's ills. <g id="female_suppresslaugh" />I never tire of it.
0208_04_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ah, a fellow ponderer of perpetual mysteries. And an accomplished one at that!
0208_04_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Yes, I know about you, {playerName}. You are here to face the trial for the rank of Scrivener?
0208_04pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ah, a fellow ponderer of perpetual mysteries. <g id="female_bowHead" />And an accomplished one at that!
<g id="male_headNodYes" />Yes, I know about you, {playerName}. You are here to face the trial for the rank of Scrivener?\n[ Level 20 required for "Trial of the Scrivener"]
0208_05_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Mark my words, {playerName}! You will be famous for assisting in my experiment! Imagine what we can accomplish by harvesting soul traces!
0208_05pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Mark my words, {playerName}! You will be famous for assisting in my experiment! Imagine what we can accomplish by harvesting soul traces! \n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Chronicler"]

<g id="male_spreadarms001" />Imagine what we can accomplish by harvesting soul traces!\n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Chronicler"]
0208_06_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I see you have returned, my brightest pupil! <g id="male_applaud" />Yes, we have much to do. It is time to find the true essence of the Lost!
0208_06pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I see you have returned, my brightest pupil! <g id="male_applaud" />Yes, we have much to do. It is time to find the true essence of the Lost! \n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Chronicler"]
0208_06pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I see you have returned, my brightest pupil! Yes, we have much to do.
<g id="male_headNodYes" />It is time to find the true essence of the Lost! \n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Chronicler"]
0208_07_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />You are back? Good, yes! I still have many thoughts on the Lost. There is so much we do not understand. Yet I feel closer than ever to a breakthrough!

0208_07pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />You are back? Good, yes! I still have many thoughts on the Lost. There is so much we do not understand.
<g id="male_headNodYes" />Yet I feel closer than ever to a breakthrough!\n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Chronicler"]
0208_08_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_explain" />More traces. Yes, that is what I need. If I could only get more of them to bind in a catalyst that would be… Ah, hello! I did not see you there, my friend!
0208_08pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_explain" />More traces. Yes, that is what I need. If I could only get more of them to bind in a catalyst that would be… Ah, hello! I did not see you there, my friend! \n[ Level 43 required for "Trial of the Cabalist"]
0208_08pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="male_explain" />More traces. Yes, that is what I need. If I could only get more of them to bind them in a catalyst that would be…
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ah, hello! I did not see you there, my friend! \n[ Level 43 required for "Trial of the Cabalist"]
0208_09_alchemist_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="male_headNodYes" />They've told me I've reached too far for too long. I'll show them what the Lost have to offer. I mean, er-- theoretically of course. Yes, nothing to worry about my friend!

0208a_00_alchemist_defaultdialogue: What mysteries lie in wait for us to uncover? What secrets of this island lurk phantasmal at the edges of our understanding?
0208a_01_alchemist_defaultdialogue: The quest to know and understand is our shared duty. How may I service you, fellow erudite?
0208a_01pre_alchemist_defaultdialogue: The quest to know and understand is our shared duty. Return when you understand more. [ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
0208a_02_alchemist_defaultdialogue: Oh this will be fascinating! A Marauder brute here in Brightwood. I look forward to learning from your failures.
0208a_03_alchemist_defaultdialogue: Yes, come hither my senseless friend. Tell me again how belief in fairy tales helps to solve mankind's ills. I never tire of it.
0209_00_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />My child, not choosing a path is still a choice. It's never too late to leave darkness for the light.
0209_01_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />You carry the light with you, my friend. It will be my sacred honor to assist you.
0209_01pre_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />You carry the light with you, my friend. It will be my sacred honor to assist you.
0209_02_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />Well you certainly look strong! But in our Enclave, we prefer strength of character. Choices do have consequences, and I'm afraid you've chosen unwisely, Marauder.
0209_03_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />So much rushing about, trying to learn everything. Some things must be taken on faith, friend. All you need is belief in the Spark.
0209_04_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Initiates are always eager to prove their worth. Though I must say you seem unusually well prepared.
0209_04_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="female_explainS" />The task at hand may demand much of you. Are you prepared to face your trial and become a Templar?
0209_04pre_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v: <g id="female_headnodding" />Initiates are always eager to prove their worth. Though I must say you seem unusually well prepared.
<g id="female_explainS" />The task at hand may demand much of you. Are you prepared to face your trial and become a Templar?\n[ Level 20 required for "Trial of the Templar" Quest ]
0209_05b_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />Luca has given in to Corruption. She has lost her senses!
0209_05b_adjudicator_playerresponse: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Thank you, you've done well at dispatching our Corrupted former comrade. I'll get clear of this place. Be safe.
0209_06_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />Speak with Lethold. I've much to consider. Though, I would be remiss if I did not thank you for your help. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't been there.
0209_06pre_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v: <g id="female_headnodding" />Speak with Lethold. I have much to consider. Though, I would be remiss if I did not thank you for your help.
<g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I don't know what would've happened if you had not been there.\n[Level 56 required for "Trial of the Adjudicator" Quest]
0209_07_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />I did what I must, but… I regret how things turned out for Luca's family. No parent should outlive their child. Regardless, you did your part and acted with honor.
0209_07pre_adjudicator_defaultdialogue_v: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />I did what I must, but… I regret how things turned out for Luca's family. No parent should outlive their child.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Regardless, you did your part and acted with honor.\n[Level 63 required for "Trial of the Paladin" Quest]
0209a_00_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: My child, not choosing a path is still a choice. It's never too late to leave darkness for the light.
0209a_01_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: Ah, a fellow seeker of justice. It will be my sacred honor to assist you.
0209a_01pre_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: Ah, a fellow seeker of justice. It will be my sacred honor to assist you. [ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
0209a_02_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: Well aren't you a strong-looking one! Not that it'll do you much good here in Brightwood. But then, choices do have consequences, and I'm afraid you chose unwisely, Marauder.
0209a_03_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: Oh my dear, so much rushing about, trying to learn everything. Such a pointless waste, when all we need is belief in a just cause.
0209b_00_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: I can see the shadows part as you approach, friend. There is a shimmering Spark inside you. The Covenant can help you tend the fire within you!
0209b_01_adjudicator_defaultdialogue: There is much darkness on this island. You must be the light of virtue to those in peril.

0210a_01_barkeep_defaultdialogue_a: I trust you've heard at least some of the history of Brightwood?
0210a_01_barkeep_defaultdialogue_b: I only know a little myself, but it seems clear the territory is haunted in more ways than one.
0210a_02_barkeep_defaultdialogue_a: You know, I've come to the conclusion that you and I - we have a lot in common.
0210a_02_barkeep_defaultdialogue_b: We're both newcomers to Brightwood, and I want to follow your example.
0210a_03_barkeep_defaultdialogue_a: Welcome, welcome! Thank you again for finding that Locus.
0210a_03_barkeep_defaultdialogue_b: Using it safely has been tricky, but I promise, I'm taking every precaution.
0222_0001_cleavedispatch_description: A dispatch sent from Eastburn Outpost that never arrived in Brightwood.
0222a_00_innkeep_defaultdialogue_a: Oh dear, you startled me! The spooks and spirits of this town have got me on edge.
0222a_00_innkeep_defaultdialogue_b: Well, let me welcome you to the Vigil's Rest. We guarantee that our guests will rest in peace. Ha.
0223_0101_barbedcatfish_description: A barbed catfish with particularly nice whiskers.
0223_0101_fq07_complete_available_respon: A new way to salvage Catfish and Squids? Why, this is brilliant news! Thank you for coming all this way to inform me of Park's findings.
0223_0101_fq07_incomplete: Alchemy in Aeternum is a delicate science that often relies upon elemental reagents. Fishing can help acquire them.
0223_0101_fq07_objective_desc: Collect one Squid Ink and one Catfish Whisker after salvaging Squid and Catfish for Master Fisher Park and deliver them to Master Fisher Agarwal in Weaver's Fen.
0223_0101_fq07_prompt: "Can you teach me about fishing and alchemy?"
0223_0101_fq07_proposal_a: Various fish, when properly salvaged, have parts that can be used in Alchemy.
0223_0101_fq07_proposal_b: The whiskers of the Catfish and the ink of the Squid most particularly. Could you collect some and present them to Agarwal in Weaver's Fen?
0223_0101_fq07_proposal_next_a: Everything on this island thrums with the power of azoth, the fish included.
0223_0101_fq07_proposal_next_b: Making use of all parts of water creatures is both responsible and pragmatic.
0223_0101_hookedsquid_description: A hooked squid known for its potent ink.
0223_fisher_explainhotspots_response: You can tell a fishing hotspot is active when you see fish jumping out of it. While it's active, landing your cast within the hotspot will yield quicker bites and rarer fish. When you place your line correctly, you'll see a small alert telling you you've hit the hotspot. After enough fish are caught at a hotspot it will become depleted. You can tell a hotspot is depleted when there are no fish jumping. A depleted hotspot will become active again after some time has passed. As your fishing skill improves, you will be able to find more and better hotspots.

0223a_01_fisher_defaultdialogue: Salutations. I'm Master Fisher Park! Fishing and Alchemy are my trades.
0223a_02_fisher_defaultdialogue: My research is going along well, thanks to you.

0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_00: <g id="grace_crossarms" />When I heard the rumors from Everfall, I knew it wouldn't be long.<g id="grace_lean" /> The Corrupted have come to Brightwood in full force.
0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_01_a: <g id="grace_consider" />I had thought to seek support from rangers in other territories,<g id="grace_convince" /> but I think you and I can handle this.
0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_01_b: I<g id="grace_fistchest" /> do the reconnaissance, you carry out the assault.
0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_02: <g id="grace_embarrassed" />I can't dwell on past failures. The present peril is too great. The Corrupted still have a major presence<g id="grace_gesturebothhands" /> at Reida's Burrow.
0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_03_a: <g id="grace_worry" />I will remain and keep an eye on the Corrupted operations here.
0230a_ranger_defaultdialogue_03_b: <g id="grace_think" />Though I suspect it will be some time before their supply lines are back in order,<g id="grace_yes" /> thanks to you.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_00_a: They<g id="male_compliment" /> really should advertise the beauty of Greyvale.<g id="male_clasphandsgrateful" /> There is something marvelous about the ancient trees and the sparkling water.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_00_b: <g id="male_gesturehereweare" />Don't you find all this nature inspiring?
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_01_a: <g id="male_gesturehereweare" />Have you seen, really seen the landscape of Greyvale?<g id="male_gestureup" /> The light falling through the leaves, or dancing across the lakes.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_01_b: Oh,<g id="male_darnit" /> if only I had time to paint everything here!
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_02: <g id="male_converseright" />There’s something to be said<g id="male_converseleft" /> about the energy in moving water, the way it draws<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> your eye and catches it. The power<g id="male_nod1" /> that just leaps off the canvas and fills a room.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_03_a: <g id="male_think" />Waterfalls are thrilling indeed,<g id="male_lookdownohmy" /> but I also like to paint more tranquil landscapes.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_03_b: <g id="male_nodmild" />There’s nothing quite as<g id="male_handheart" /> soothing at staring at a placid lake, don't you agree? It’s almost magical.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_04_a: <g id="male_nodproud" />Thanks to your help, my name<g id="male_fistraiseleft" /> shall be known in every household in Aeternum.
0231a_painter_defaultdialogue_04_b: <g id="male_gesturehereweare" />My paintings shall grace the walls of everyone<g id="male_handheart" /> who longs for a slice of nature to call their own.
0232_0201_postrehkinleaves_description: A sheaf of leaves that can be brewed into a Tea the Angry Earth Dryads imbibe.
0232_0202_sweettreesap_description: A sugary substance harvested from Young Trees in Lush Hideway.
0232_0203_adelphiantuber_description: A handful of stems collected from Bronzeroot Shamans in the Verdant Cavern.
0232_0204_ceranousachene_description: A handful of spores collected from the remains of Ceran.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_00: Trees<g id="grace_consider" /> live for so long, and experience so much. I wish I could know what they know.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_01_a: <g id="grace_consider" />Do you sense it, traveler? The force of life rides on the breeze from the south -<g id="grace_bowhead" /> the only vibrant flora remaining in these dead lands.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_01_b: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />If you are headed that way, I could use a favor.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_02: <g id="grace_lean" />Now it is time for you to repay my generosity. The secrets of the Angry Earth are<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> not lightly shared, and I have need of your strength.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_03_a: <g id="grace_dismiss" />Begone, human. As<g id="grace_fistchest" /> I resume my place among the Angry Earth, I <g id="grace_headshakeno" />cannot guarantee your safety.
0232a_naturalist_defaultdialogue_03_b: <g id="grace_doubt" />Your generosity, however, we will remember, for all time.
0233_0202_holtsring_description: A fine golden ring, slightly tarnished from a long period in a bear's digestive tract.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_00: <g id="male_darnit" />If you're headed into Greyvale, I'd offer you one piece of advice.<g id="male_scoldfingerwag" /> Don't feed the bears! Especially not with your own flesh and blood.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_01_a: <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />Say there, are you headed across the river, into Greyvale?
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_01_b: <g id="male_apologize" />That's bear territory. I know that<g id="male_guiltylookdown" /> firsthand, because for me, it was also my home.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_02_a: <g id="male_darnit" />If I'm being completely honest, though, I really<g id="male_throwarms" /> don't know what I'm supposed to do.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_02_b: <g id="male_hanghead" />With Susan gone, and the bears turned on me,<g id="male_converseleft" /> I don't have anywhere else to go.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_03_a: <g id="male_hanghead" />Still working up the nerve. This is<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> harder than I thought.
0233a_hunter_defaultdialogue_03_b: <g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" />It's funny, those bears are the only family I've ever known -<g id="male_wavehandpshaw" /> not sure if I'll ever feel completely comfortable with them, though.
0234_0201_megaramomentos_description: A keepsake from Megara's once-happy life which is almost certain to make her sad.
0234_0202_journaldespair_description: The journal of Megara Pantasazi from the happiest times in her life.
0234_0203_megaragoodbye_description: A letter from Megara's Lost Husband, saying he's giving up so he won't bring her down.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_00: <g id="litearmor_dismissgetlost2" />If you're looking for the Brightwood settlement, it's to the north.<g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> Nothing to the south, except for lost love... and remorse.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_01_a: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />It may seem hard to believe, but this<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> was once one of the safest and liveliest parts of Brightwood.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_01_b: <g id="litearmor_darnit" />All that remains now are my memories,<g id="litearmor_worry" /> very sad ones, I'm afraid. And now, even those are starting to fade.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_02_a: <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />Reading this is like visiting an old friend -<g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" /> it's very… emotional.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_02_b: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />But rather than making me sad,<g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" /> it's making me angry. You see,<g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" /> when the truth came out, everyone in town turned on me.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_03_a: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />It just goes to show, life is only<g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" /> for those bold and courageous enough to truly live it.
0234a_mourner_defaultdialogue_03_b: <g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" />Thank you for reminding me of that,<g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" /> in my darkest hour. I think maybe now, I can start over.
0238_00_alchemist_defaultdialogue: What mysteries lie in wait for us to uncover? What secrets of this island lurk phantasmal at the edges of our understanding?
0238_01_alchemist_defaultdialogue: What mysteries lie in wait for us to uncover? What secrets of this island lurk phantasmal at the edges of our understanding?
0238_01_alchemist_defaultdialogue_b: I have many an enigma for you to decipher, friend. Tread lightly, and always bring your vials.

02_00_outfitter_defaultdialog: Heh. This place isn't as bright as the name suggests. Want to survive? Keep your guard up like the knights of yore did. I can help you.
02_00_outfitter_transmog_response: The ghosts whisper to the cloth through me. We make the fabric do our bidding.
02_brightwood_body_04_01:
It is said that there is a catfish whose skin is lined with Azoth.

Dubbed 'Egede Serpe' after a traveler who saw it, to catch a serpe is to peak as a fisher here in Brightwood. If only I could reel in this mysterious creature and perform experiments...

-Park
02_brightwood_body_04_02:
Mercury, what can't it do? Used in skin treatments and mood tinctures in the Old World, it can also most readily be extracted from the swordfish that circle Aeternum. Used ubiquitously by healers across the globe, mercury can be administered in its liquid or solid salt form. The mercury content of the Aeternum swordfish seems irregularly high, but I cannot compare it to an Old World fish without returning home, which is impossible with the storms that haunt the coast.

For now I must rely on anecdotal evidence from the other alchemists who have seen Old World swordfish, as unreliable as those observations can be.

-Park
02_brightwood_body_06_01: The Commander handed me an envelope. I tore through the red wax seal and unfurled the page. Emilia Smythe– my daughter. \n\nPerhaps expecting a response, he raised a hand and said, “There is no mistake. Your relationship, while troublesome, also affords you the highest chance of success. We need your help on this mission, John.”
02_brightwood_body_06_02: There are two ways to eliminate someone permanently on Aeternum. Kill them until they become Lost, or confine them and let despair do the work. But please don’t misunderstand, I wasn’t simply going to torture my daughter. The truth alone would guide me.\n\nStill, it came as a surprise when I discovered Emilia was not a simple scribe. She performed magical research for a misguided group called the "Illumen." Even worse, she had discovered our most guarded secret: the magic we use to fix the point of recall after death.
02_brightwood_body_06_03: The abandoned barn was dark when I killed the Illumen leaders. When Emilia first arrived and saw their bodies, she did not cry out. But then she called a name in despair, and rushed to the side of a young man. I spoke her name in the darkness. As she turned, I saw something new in her eyes. Fear.\n\nShe thrust a small knife into her throat, and she was gone. She’d broken through the recall restraints.
02_brightwood_body_06_04:
I drew her out by letting her think I would end her lover’s torment. “Why?” she asked, never taking her eyes off the young man. I had filled his veins with slow, agonizing poison 

Against my better judgment, I tried to reason with her. “We save lives, Emilia. We remove those who cause terror—” 

“You cause terror!” she cried. My heart sank. She was beyond reason or salvation.

“What now?” she asked. “Give us your research and we will let you go,” I said. And as she reached into her satchel, I struck her unconscious.
02_brightwood_body_06_05: She was chained in the narrow wooden box when she woke. She screamed and cried, sobbed and begged. “Father, it’s me, your Emilia! I promise, I won’t tell a soul about what I learned! Don’t let me die in the darkness! Don’t you love me?” \n\nI showed not a hint of emotion, or so I thought, until I felt hot tears roll off my face. To hurry her demise, I told her that we had ended her lover, and he was now one of the Lost. She howled, lunging against her chains, and I nailed the box shut. The others bent to help, but I shoved them aside and lowered her coffin into the freshly dug grave. A father’s lonely burden.
02_brightwood_body_06_06:
Two years later, we unearthed her coffin to confirm her fate. None last that long. Most turn in a year, succumbing to the madness of being buried alive. I struggled with my own madness. Emilia visited my dreams, as a Lost, as a Corrupted, as a spy. In the worst nightmare, she was my daughter. As the nails came out, I tore off the lid. 

Empty. 

Had she escaped? Had she been rescued? Turned into a vengeful spirit, or something worse? I knew she would never forgive me. Nor would I. Ten years have passed and I know only despair. Fear pushes me forward, but never lets me live.
02_brightwood_body_07_01:
I have done a terrible thing. And yet, I know, given the opportunity, I would do it again. My heart is heavy with the weight of my transgression, yet it also yearns to be free!

Dear Lord, how can it be that I am flush with the desire for sin? Can a man so good and decent and kind truly be forbidden from love by your laws and covenant? Is it your will that a simple farm girl journey alone through a world of wickedness? If I am to live forever, cut off from the light of your grace, am I to deny myself when love and kindness offer succor in this unnatural place?

I refuse to believe that you, in your mercy, would choose to lead me astray. I shall listen to my heart, and trust that I hear your wisdom in my dreams.

-Megara
02_brightwood_body_07_02:
To those who stand vigil,

How far we have fallen when our defenders turn on those they have sworn to uphold. When a man, reeling from loss can find himself suspect, not of any great sin, but of losing himself to grief. Has the drive to live truly driven us to such extremity?

What is my crime? If it is to wish to live when what I held most precious has been taken away, I confess it. If it is to cling to faith in a world of horror, I confess it. If it is to love my family, and go on for their sake, I confess it. I am a proud man, yet I am prepared to beg for the salvation of all I have left. If you swear before almighty God, that my daughters will be unharmed, then I will surrender without rancor.

Otherwise, I will do all that that I can to escape your grasp.

-Adalbert

02a_side01_reaperslocus_complete_a: Oh, it's about time. You're such a talent, I frankly expected you to return much sooner.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_complete_b: But don't get me wrong-- I'm very grateful. I'll take the Locus, and you can have this.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_complete_next_a: Use it! Not to collect more Azoth, the very thought turns my stomach.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_complete_next_b: But this Locus contains enough Azoth to boost plant growth and enhance potions. The possibilities are endless!
02a_side01_reaperslocus_complete_prompt: "What are you going to do with it?"
02a_side01_reaperslocus_incomplete_a: Before you go marching into the Shattered Obelisk, I'd suggest finding some friends.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_incomplete_b: The Reaper isn't the only horror prowling those ruins.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_proposal: Because I plan on staying here! And that means I should make this town a better place. But unlike you, I'm no warrior.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_proposal_next2_a: Like so much else in Brightwood, though you've done much to remedy that.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_proposal_next2_b: The Reaper would've used some kind of Locus to collect Azoth-- that's what I need.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_proposal_next_a: Ah, thank you for catching my meaning. There is a terrible creature that haunts the Shattered Obelisk, so you'll need friends.
02a_side01_reaperslocus_proposal_next_b: A Reaper who once culled creatures to collect their Azoth.

02a_side02_01_secrets_complete_a: These satchels... their scent... do you smell it?
02a_side02_01_secrets_complete_b: It makes sense, does it not? That which withers with half-death is susceptible to the energy of fresh life.
02a_side02_01_secrets_description: Collect spores from Bronzeroot Warriors in Pendle Hollow and bone dust from the Lost at Pendleton. Return to Embalmer Bankole when the task is complete.
02a_side02_01_secrets_incomplete_a: The Bronzeroot Warriors are a new expression of the Angry Earth, but they know the old ways.
02a_side02_01_secrets_incomplete_b: I only hope my efforts do not add to the suffering of the Lost.
02a_side02_01_secrets_proposal: Of course. I have been here longer than these others, long enough that no one listens to old Bankole any more.
02a_side02_01_secrets_proposal_next_a: Then heed this: the Angry Earth's Bronzeroot Warriors seem to naturally repel the Lost.
02a_side02_01_secrets_proposal_next_b: With spores from them, and bone dust from the Lost, I could create a talisman to repel the Lost without violence.

02a_side02_02_earthprovide_complete: A potent alkahest? Perfect, perfect. I did not think anyone else would consider the plight of the Lost. But you have. Thank you.
