02a_side02_02_earthprovide_proposal_b: There may still be rare reagents in the ruins, though you will have to cut a path through the dryads.
02a_side02_02_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to acquire more potent reagents
02a_side02_bonedust_description: Barely there, just like the tormented spirit from which it came.
02a_side03_01_infernal_complete: <g id="grace_defiant" />Well done. They still control both locations, but it<g id="grace_crossarms" /> won't do them much good. But you look troubled. Did you discover something?
02a_side03_01_infernal_complete_next_a: <g id="grace_disappointed" />Oh no. Master Smith McCoy?<g id="grace_shrugdontcare" /> He went missing weeks ago.
02a_side03_01_infernal_complete_next_b: <g id="grace_disapprove" />I called off the search for him<g id="grace_crossarms" /> when it became too dangerous, but I never dreamed….
02a_side03_01_infernal_description: Disrupt the Corrupted war effort by defeating their leaders at Corlew's Mine and Shervey's Lumbermill. Then meet with Ranger Shui Tijong outside of Calvary.
02a_side03_01_infernal_incomplete: We cannot let them keep extracting resources from the land. There is barely enough to sustain the people of Brightwood as it is.
02a_side03_01_infernal_proposal_a: <g id="grace_convince2" />The main thrust of the Corrupted operations here is the mission to supply their forces with armaments.
02a_side03_01_infernal_proposal_b: <g id="grace_gesturer" />They have a start-to-finish process under way,<g id="grace_gesturerlow" /> mining the ore and forging the weapons.
02a_side03_01_infernal_proposal_next_a: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />The core of the operation is<g id="grace_gesturelefts" /> here in the mines,<g id="grace_greethead" /> and around the mill to the south.
02a_side03_01_infernal_proposal_next_b: <g id="grace_pointf" />If you can cut the heads off both snakes, so to speak,<g id="grace_yes" /> they will be crippled.
02a_side03_01_infernal_task_goto: Sabotage the Corrupted mining operation at {POITags}
02a_side03_01_infernal_task_goto2: Investigate the Corrupted logging operation at {POITags}
02a_side03_01_infernal_task_mccoy: Defeat {targetName} to disrupt the Corrupted's weapon supply
02a_side03_02_belly_complete_a: <g id="grace_salutefingers" />Well done, friend.<g id="grace_proud" /> With their rations stolen and their hunters compromised, the Corrupted will be hungry.
02a_side03_02_belly_complete_b: <g id="grace_shrugdontcare" />Hungry soldiers are desperate soldiers and<g id="grace_dismiss2" /> desperate soldiers are sloppy.
02a_side03_02_belly_description: Sabotage the food supply chain for the Corrupted at Reida's Burrow. Talk to Ranger Shui Tijong near Calvary when the task is done.
02a_side03_02_belly_incomplete: <g id="grace_threatenl" />If we destroy the hunters and claim all their rations,<g id="grace_shrugdontknow" /> the Corrupted forces' supply lines will be in dire straits.
02a_side03_02_belly_proposal_a: <g id="grace_defiant" />My thoughts exactly - we can warn the settlement later.<g id="grace_smackfist" /> We must strike hard and fast.
02a_side03_02_belly_proposal_b: <g id="grace_proud" />I have been watching the Corrupted forces' movements since they arrived.
02a_side03_02_belly_proposal_next_a: <g id="grace_headnodyes" />Yes. They<g id="grace_convince" /> seized this area to use it as a critical part of their supply chain for<g id="grace_gesturerightm" /> food and weapons.
02a_side03_02_belly_proposal_next_b: <g id="grace_worry" />An army marches on its belly, so let's strike their food supplies first,<g id="grace_fistchest" /> and destroy their hunters.
02a_side03_02_belly_task_goto: Sabotage the Corrupted Supply Chain at {POITags}
02a_side04_01_location_complete: Marvelous!<g id="male_applaud" /> The rushing water,<g id="male_compliment" /> the way the sunlight glints through the trees.<g id="male_nod2" /> Yes, yes! I can work with this.
02a_side04_01_location_complete_next_a: <g id="male_clasphandsgrateful" />Now that you’ve marked these locations in my map,<g id="male_handheart" /> I have to get my paints in order.
02a_side04_01_location_complete_next_b: <g id="male_crossarmsno" />But, it wouldn't do to get all ready to start,<g id="male_waghand03" /> only to be missing the correct shade of blue.
02a_side04_01_location_description: Search for vibrant waterfalls for Wolcott to paint and place an easel at each one. Talk to Painter Wolcott in Brightwood when the task is done.
02a_side04_01_location_incomplete: I need some inspiration, something that jumps out of the landscape and onto a canvas! Go on, I'm counting on you to find it!
02a_side04_01_location_placeeasel1: Scout Northern Greyvale for a waterfall
02a_side04_01_location_placeeasel2: Scout South of Greyvale for a waterfall
02a_side04_01_location_placeeasel3: Scout North of Lake Genevieve for a waterfall
02a_side04_01_location_proposal_a: <g id="male_hanghead" />Sadly, I don’t have time to both find<g id="male_handheart" /> all the beautiful locations and paint them. <g id="male_waghand03" /> Searching cannot be rushed, and it takes me so<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> long to get my paints arranged just how I like them.
02a_side04_01_location_proposal_b: But<g id="male_pleadhandsclasped" /> perhaps you could help!
02a_side04_01_location_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_pleadhandsopen" />You could go and find the most beautiful locations for me to paint.
02a_side04_01_location_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_realize" />You will save me a lot of time if<g id="male_pointblame" /> you set up an easel at each waterfall you find, then<g id="male_beckonbored" /> come back and tell me about them. It will be perfect!
02a_side04_02_reflection_complete_a: <g id="male_handheart" />These are magnificent!<g id="male_clasphandsgrateful" /> Thank you for marking their locations on my map.
02a_side04_02_reflection_complete_b: <g id="male_hopeless" />I can only hope my waterfall paintings are able to<g id="male_guiltylookside" /> compete with what is already out there.
02a_side04_02_reflection_complete_next_a: <g id="male_lookdown" />Ugh. I’m not the only landscape painter on Aeternum.
02a_side04_02_reflection_complete_next_b: <g id="male_throwarms" />Painter Cole is already famous for her<g id="male_compliment" /> ‘Bear in Meadow’ and ‘Mountain Dawn’ paintings which are popular in the settlements.
02a_side04_02_reflection_description: Search for dynamic waterfalls for Wolcott to paint and place an easel at each one. Talk to Painter Wolcott in Brightwood when the task is done.
02a_side04_02_reflection_incomplete: <g id="male_goodnews" />You were such help before that I need your help again.<g id="male_compliment" /> Search for energetic waterfalls I can use as reference.
02a_side04_02_reflection_placeeasel1: Scout Southern Greyvale for a waterfall
02a_side04_02_reflection_placeeasel2: Scout Northern Greyvale for a waterfall
02a_side04_02_reflection_placeeasel3: Scout Western Greyvale for a waterfall
02a_side04_02_reflection_proposal_a: How<g id="male_compliment" /> dynamic it makes an image. How alive<g id="male_pleadhandsopen" /> you feel when seeing it. How it moves, even when still.
02a_side04_02_reflection_proposal_b: Hmm.<g id="male_explain" /> I can already tell these waterfalls will be best sellers.<g id="male_nod1" /> I’m going to need more locations!
02a_side04_02_reflection_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_fistraiseleft" />Yes! There are so many located in Greyvale.<g id="male_headnodyes" /> It is a painter’s paradise.
02a_side04_02_reflection_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_flirt" />I could use your discerning eye to find more waterfalls for my paintings.
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_complete_a: <g id="male_gestureup" />Ah! Superb! The locations<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> you have chosen fit perfectly within the landscape,<g id="male_converseright" /> like a slice of sky fallen to the ground.
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_complete_b: <g id="male_handheart" />Painting these lakes will be a joy.<g id="male_leanforwardinspect" /> And Cole hasn’t painted anything like them yet!
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_complete_next_: <g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" />Hmm. No, I will be the first to paint these lakes!<g id="male_itsokay" /> Soon my name will be known as the painter of lakes and waterfalls.
<g id="male_goodnews" />Thank you for marking these in my map. I can’t wait to get to work!
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_description: Search for picturesque lakes for Wolcott to paint and place an easel at each one. Talk to Painter Wolcott in Brightwood when the task is done.
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_incomplete_a: The waterfalls you found before were just lovely.
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_incomplete_b: Now I need three lakes for my next paintings!
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_placeeasel1: Scout Central Greyvale for a lake
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_placeeasel2: Scout Northern Greyvale for a lake
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_placeeasel3: Scout Eastern Greyvale for a lake
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_proposal_a: <g id="male_nod2" />I’ve decided that my next collection<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> of paintings will be of the local lakes.
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_proposal_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Something restful to the eye, and<g id="male_handheart" /> calming to the soul. They are certain<g id="male_headnodyes" /> to be popular!
02a_side04_03_masterpiece_proposal_next_: <g id="male_agree1" />I’ll paint them too!<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> I need to paint all of them in order to keep up with that overachiever Cole.
<g id="male_convince01" />Please find three inspiring lakes where you can place my easel.
02a_side05_01_tea_complete_a: <g id="grace_greethead" />Ah, do you have them, then? Yes, these leaves are perfect!
02a_side05_01_tea_complete_b: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />The tea I can brew from these leaves, well,<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> I am not even sure of all of its properties.
02a_side05_01_tea_description: Collect Undefiled Tea Leaves from Verdant Cavern and Lush Sugarsap from the Lush Hideaway. Bring them back to Naturalist Khunbish in Brightwood.
02a_side05_01_tea_incomplete: I do not only ask for tea ingredients for myself. Collect the leaves and honey, and I will share my recipe with you.
02a_side05_01_tea_proposal_a: <g id="grace_crossarms" />The soullessness of the Lost has ravaged Brightwood for centuries. Some say the land is cursed.
02a_side05_01_tea_proposal_b: <g id="grace_chastise" />But the Angry Earth thrive down there, despite all the death around them.
02a_side05_01_tea_proposal_next_a: <g id="grace_gesturelefts" />The Angry Earth have many secrets, but<g id="grace_consider" /> the one I seek is related to a tea they drink.
02a_side05_01_tea_proposal_next_b: <g id="grace_gesturerightm" />The Bronzeroot of the Verdant Cavern carry special tea leaves,<g id="g_grace_gesturerlow" /> and there is a particular sap they use as sweetener.
02a_side05_01_tea_task_gather_leaves: Collect {itemName} from Angry Earth chests in {POITags}
02a_side05_01_tea_task_gather_sap: Harvest {itemName} from the Young Trees in {POITags}
02a_side05_02_achene_complete: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Ceran is gone, and you have restored the true order here. If you wish it,<g id="grace_headnodyes" /> you have earned the whole truth.
02a_side05_02_achene_complete_next_a: <g id="grace_crossarmsinsulted" />Mind your manners, human. Before<g id="grace_stop" /> Ceran, I was guardian of the Azoth Tree.
02a_side05_02_achene_complete_next_b: <g id="grace_defiant" />With him gone, and a powerful brew of tea, I can assume my proper form and place.
02a_side05_02_achene_description: Defeat the Angry Earth Leader Ceran at the Azoth Tree and collect his Achene. Talk to Naturalist Khunbish in Brightwood when the task is done.
02a_side05_02_achene_incomplete: Ceran… how long has it been? He hoped I had forgotten. But I do not forget, and I do not forgive.
02a_side05_02_achene_proposal_a: <g id="grace_smackfist" />No? Do you not wish to slash, burn, and loot? Is that<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> not what your kind does?
02a_side05_02_achene_proposal_b: <g id="grace_shrugdontknow" />No matter. You must defeat<g id="grace_gesturer" /> a dryad named Ceran.
02a_side05_02_achene_proposal_next: <g id="grace_sorry" />It's a long and tiresome tale. But if you insist, I will tell it to you--<g id="grace_wagfinger" /> after you have fought Ceran and brought me his Achene.
02a_side05_02_achene_task_goto: Defeat the Angry Earth Leader at {POITags}
02a_side06_01_bears_complete: <g id="male_nod2" />I heard those bastards snarling and growling all the way down here.<g id="male_dismissgetlost2" /> Why, we're only giving them what they deserve.
02a_side06_01_bears_description: Help Hunter Hutchison in Brightwood get vengeance against some savage bears in Greyvale that destroyed his family.
02a_side06_01_bears_incomplete: I still can't get over it. Out of nowhere, they just turned on us. Help me get my vengeance, and I'll be in your debt.
02a_side06_01_bears_proposal_a: <g id="male_dontknow" /> No. They don't want me.<g id="male_shakehead" /> They've made that painfully clear.
02a_side06_01_bears_proposal_b: <g id="male_guiltylookside" />My wife Susan and I lived among them for decades, in perfect harmony.<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> Until a few months ago.
02a_side06_01_bears_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_hopeless" />One day they turned on us,<g id="male_wipetear" /> tore us both apart and feasted on our flesh. Susan… she became Lost after that.
02a_side06_01_bears_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_dismissregal" />I don't know why I'm still here, except for revenge.<g id="male_clenchfistsgetpumped02" /> In fact, destroy a few of those beasts for me, and I'll reward you.
02a_side06_02_papabear_complete_a: <g id="male_realize" />It's done then?<g id="male_pointblame" /> That monstrosity of a bear gone?<g id="male_nodproud" /> You're a brave soul, and a hardy one too.
02a_side06_02_papabear_complete_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Alright. I’ll<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> work up the nerve and go back home.<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> They turn on me again…<g id="male_shakehead" /> I don’t know. Guess I’ll end up like Susan.
02a_side06_02_papabear_description: Hunter Hutchison has asked you to destroy Gren, the massive bear who killed his wife, and reclaim his wife's ring. Bring the ring back to Hunter Hutchinson in Brightwood.
02a_side06_02_papabear_incomplete: <g id="male_shakehead" />It was that monster Gren that ate my sweet wife.<g id="male_leanforwardinspect" /> Destroy him, and then I can return to the family, those I have left.
02a_side06_02_papabear_proposal_a: <g id="male_crossarmsno" />Nah, Susan and these bears are the only real family I ever had.
02a_side06_02_papabear_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />Living out there, foraging for honey,<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> hibernating…<g id="male_shakehead" /> it's the only life I know, the only place I feel at home.
02a_side06_02_papabear_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Angry as I am,<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> it's the only thing that feels right.<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> I guess I could try.
02a_side06_02_papabear_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_ragepoundfist" />It was the patriarch, Gren, that turned on us.<g id="male_pointblame" /> If you can destroy Gren and recover Susan's ring,<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> I might have a chance. Be careful, though.
02a_side06_02_papabear_task_goto: Track down the Alpha Bear at {POITags}
02a_side07_01_memories_complete_a: <g id="litearmor_realize" />I'm amazed.<g id="litearmor_youknow" /> You managed to find all these pieces of my past,<g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" /> even my old diary.
02a_side07_01_memories_complete_b: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />It's sad, isn’t it? Or it<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> should be.
02a_side07_01_memories_description: Megara Pantazis lived in the Walsham area many decades ago. She's asked you to retrieve her mementos from the town and return them to her in Brightwood so she can relive her past.
02a_side07_01_memories_incomplete: Those years in Walsham were the best I had. If you could recover those mementos, it would mean a lot.
02a_side07_01_memories_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_gestureleft" />The town of Walsham fell to the Lost…<g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> it's been more years than I can count.
02a_side07_01_memories_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Believe it or not, the wedding was on this very spot--<g id="litearmor_think" /> a moment I never want to forget. He was the love of my life.
02a_side07_01_memories_proposal_next_a: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Yes, he fell to despair. I had too much pride for that--<g id="litearmor_sighrelief" /> I picked up and started over, many times since.
02a_side07_01_memories_proposal_next_b: <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />Now, I just want those memories. If you venture into town,<g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" /> I'd love you to recover some of my old keepsakes.
02a_side07_02_death_complete: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Tell me, did you see him? Did he<g id="litearmor_whatwantfromme" /> seem miserable as a Lost, or actually at peace?<g id="litearmor_realize" /> What did you find? What is this?
02a_side07_02_death_complete_next_a: <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />Let me see it then… what's this? He became Lost to avoid facing me?!<g id="litearmor_hopeless" /> Apparently, he couldn't bear the town's shame and scorn.
02a_side07_02_death_complete_next_b: <g id="litearmor_dismissgetlost2" />The coward! Well,<g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" /> Pastor, maybe you have convinced me to live!<g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" /> Thank you!
02a_side07_02_death_description: Megara Pantazis has admitted the love of her life was actually Pastor Prewitt. She's asked you be sure nothing of his human nature remains. Talk to her in Brightwood when the task is complete.
02a_side07_02_death_incomplete: My love was a formidable man in life. I suspect he will be difficult to defeat. Do take care.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_lookdownguilty" />The truth about my true love. I didn't tell<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> you the whole story.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />The wedding that took place here, it wasn't where I married my true love,<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> it's where I met him.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_next2_a: <g id="litearmor_sighrelief" />Yes. No? I don't know any more.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_next2_b: <g id="litearmor_think" />If you could confront him, and see if there is any humanity left in him,<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> I might be able to make my choice.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_next_a: <g id="litearmor_whatwantfromme" />Oh, it was mine, but<g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> my betrothed was dull as dirt.<g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> I don't even remember his name.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_next_b: <g id="litearmor_worry" />Ah, Pastor Prewitt was the one who married us. He… became the love of my life.
02a_side07_02_death_proposal_prompt2: "Do you want to see him again?"
02a_side07_02_death_task_goto: Confront Pastor Prewitt at the Walsham Congregation
02a_side08_01_treasures_complete_a: <g id="female_worry" />You made that look easy.<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> Have you been treasure-hunting before?
02a_side08_01_treasures_complete_b: <g id="female_youknows" />The handwriting in these records is awful,<g id="female_nodconsider" /> but I can puzzle it out.<g id="female_youknow" /> Then it's just a matter of matching up names with graves!
02a_side08_01_treasures_description: Aethelwynn, a self-proclaimed treasure hunter, needs help finding lucrative graves in Brightwood. Find records of Brightwood's residents, then return to Aethelwynn near Deggendorf.
02a_side08_01_treasures_incomplete_a: Do you think the Lost remember anything they did when they were alive?
02a_side08_01_treasures_incomplete_b: <g id="female_throwarmsfrustrated" />Hmm… no, forget it. Just thinking<g id="female_shakeheadno" /> about it gives me the shivers.
02a_side08_01_treasures_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />You don't need to tell me twice.<g id="female_worry" /> The Lost get violent when you poke through their houses.
02a_side08_01_treasures_proposal_b: <g id="female_notsure" />Oh, don't look at me like that.<g id="female_shakeheadno" /> Everyone has to make a living.
02a_side08_01_treasures_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_shrugdontcare" />Reclaiming treasure!<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> Brightwood's so full of graves, it's hard to know where to start.
02a_side08_01_treasures_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_thinking" />Say, if you're heading into the villages, could<g id="female_spreadarms" /> you thin out the Lost and look for any records?<g id="female_nodyes" /> They might contain clues, and I'll share anything I find with you.
02a_side08_01_treasures_task_goto1: Search {POITags} to help Aethelwynn find treasures left by the Lost
02a_side08_01_treasures_task_goto2: Search {POITags} to help Aethelwynn find treasures left by the Lost
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_complete_a: <g id="female_lookconcern" />Is that a basket? Oh… the color's still as bright as a robin's egg.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_complete_b: <g id="female_nodconsider" />Mmm… Fair's fair, and I<g id="female_salute2finger" /> promised to split the treasure with you.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> You keep the coin, and I'll take this basket.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_complete_next: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />W-well, you've been really helpful,<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> and I'll want your help again in the future.
<g id="female_shrugdontcare" />Brightwood's overflowing with<g id="female_waveoffdisdain" /> abandoned cemeteries. I'm sure<g id="female_nodyes" /> I'll find something I like.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_description: Aethelwynn has identified two promising graves that might contain treasure. Scatter the lost defending the coffins, and investigate each grave. Then, return to Aethelwynn with your spoils.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_incomplete: The coffins should be pretty old by now, so a good push will force their lids off. Don't ask me how I know.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_proposal_b: <g id="female_disagreerighthandout" />Some coffins in Brightwood weren't… buried properly, if you catch my meaning.<g id="female_youknow" /> Let's start with the easy pickings and see what we find.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_proposal_next: <g id="female_explains" />The coffins should be pretty old by now,<g id="female_smackfist" /> so a good push will force their lids off. Don't<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> ask me how I know.
02a_side08_02_lostreturned_task_goto1: Venture into {POITags} to search for treasure
02a_side08_03_music_complete_a: <g id="female_loveyou" />What an adorable flute! May I?
02a_side08_03_music_complete_b: <g id="female_nodrelieved" />I'll bet it plays the sweetest songs.<g id="female_youknows" /> Can I keep this, for my share? And the<g id="g_female_youknow" /> whittling knife, in case I want to add any carvings to it.
02a_side08_03_music_complete_next_a: <g id="female_shrugdontcare" />Maybe not in coin, but I love music.<g id="female_tiltheadremember" /> My father used to play for us in the evenings, to drown out the sound of--<g id="female_waveoffdisdain" /> ah, never mind.
02a_side08_03_music_complete_next_b: <g id="female_gesturerightm" />I'll meet you at the southern crossroads<g id="female_lifthandsxs" /> a bit later!
02a_side08_03_music_description: Though nervous about its fearful reputation, Aethelwynn still wants to see if there's treasure in the old Cathedral and its neighboring village. Investigate each location, then return to Aethelwynn.
02a_side08_03_music_incomplete_a: I heard that a fire-spewing demon lives under the floorboards of the cathedral.
02a_side08_03_music_incomplete_b: It's probably not true. Right? Right, definitely not true.
02a_side08_03_music_proposal_a: <g id="female_lookdownsorry" />Meh… Nervous? Me? I suppose it's<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> pretty obvious.
02a_side08_03_music_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Ah, the next spot for buried treasure is the old cathedral north of the town.<g id="female_lookaroundshifty" /> But I've heard terrible tales about it for years. Howling Lost,<g id="female_startledhandmouth" /> shadows that strangle intruders...
02a_side08_03_music_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />Heh. You're either the bravest<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> or craziest person I've ever met.
02a_side08_03_music_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_explains" />If the cathedral looks too dangerous,<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> you could try the village of Morgenstadt.<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> Might be easier pickings.
02a_side08_03_music_task_goto1: Search {POITags} for clues to more treasure
02a_side08_04_legacy_complete_a: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />O-oh. It's y-you.<g id="female_shrinkembarrassed" /> S-sorry I didn't meet you like I said I would.
02a_side08_04_legacy_complete_b: <g id="female_notsure" />I promise I didn't forget, I've<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> just been… it's not important.<g id="female_youknows" /> Anyway, did you find anything good in the cemetery?
02a_side08_04_legacy_complete_next: What?! Then you must've gone to… I…
02a_side08_04_legacy_complete_next2: <g id="female_whattheheck" />I c-can't! I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!<g id="female_crying" /> You've been kind, truly, but I can't face this now…
02a_side08_04_legacy_complete_prompt: "A grave. With your name on it."
02a_side08_04_legacy_description: Though Aethelwynn said she would meet you later, she is nowhere to be seen. Mortemer's Manor and Brightrest Cemetery seem to be the most likely locations to find her.
02a_side08_04_legacy_incomplete: (The dog looks at you with plaintive eyes. It seems like he wants to come with you to Mortimer's Manor, but fears the Lost.)
02a_side08_04_legacy_proposal: (The dog perks up and sniffs your clothes. He swings his snout around, pointing toward the cluster of houses around Mortimer's Manor.)
02a_side08_04_legacy_task_coffind: Look for coffins with potential treasure
02a_side08_04_legacy_task_goto1: Search {POITags} for any sign of Aethelwynn
02a_side08_04_legacy_task_goto2: Search {POITags} for any sign of Aethelwynn
02a_side08_05_reunion_complete_a: <g id="female_shocked" />That's Roderick's shield. But you found no other trace of him?
02a_side08_05_reunion_complete_b: <g id="g_female_sobbing" />Then at least I can hope that he left the Vigil behind, and found a better life elsewhere.
02a_side08_05_reunion_description: Aethelwynn is finally ready to face her past and tell you what she's been seeking. Help her track down her brother-in-law by searching nearby villages, then return to her at the spirit shrine.
02a_side08_05_reunion_incomplete_a: Roderick used to fight for the Bright Vigil. I never heard what happened to him.
02a_side08_05_reunion_incomplete_b: I hope… no, maybe it's best not to hope at this point.
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_a: <g id="female_fingerwagno" />It's no different from any other sorry tale of Brightwood.<g id="female_shrinkembarrassed" /> My mother succumbed to despair first and then the Vigil put my father "under guard."
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_b: <g id="female_gesturearoundroom" />By the end… they were ready to bury all of us alive.
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_next2_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />You mean, you'll keep helping me? I don't know what to say.
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_next2_b: <g id="female_sighrelief" />I suppose I never found any trace of Roderick,<g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" /> my brother-in-law. I know his family came from a village to the west,<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> but that's all.
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Thanks to Baldr. He<g id="female_smackfist" /> chewed through the ropes the same night they dug my grave.<g id="female_shakeheadno" /> After that, I ran.
02a_side08_05_reunion_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />It took me years to work up the courage to come back.<g id="female_lookdownsorry" /> The basket, the flute and knife, all the things you found belonged to my family.
02a_side08_05_reunion_start_prompt: "I just want to know the truth."
02a_side08_05_reunion_task_kill: Defeat the {targetName} and look for any signs of Roderick
02a_side08_06_heart_complete_a: <g id="female_youknow" />You really did it. Emmeline's necklace.<g id="female_crying" /> See the little charm at the end?
02a_side08_06_heart_complete_b: <g id="female_salutefistchest" />At first, I regretted coming back.<g id="female_shakeheadno" /> So many old ghosts. But I can<g id="female_spreadarms" /> start putting them to rest, thanks to you.
02a_side08_06_heart_complete_next_a: <g id="female_shrugdontcare" />Hmm. I'm not<g id="female_thinking" /> much of a treasure hunter. I should<g id="female_youknow" /> leave that to someone like you.
02a_side08_06_heart_complete_next_b: <g id="female_sighrelief" />But traveling's been nice, and<g id="female_youknow" /> I think Baldr might like a chance to stretch his legs.<g id="female_nodding" /> Wouldn't you, old boy?
02a_side08_06_heart_description: Aethelwynn suspects that her sister's necklace is in the greedy hands of Archminister Havelock. Destroy him, find the necklace, and return to Aethelwynn at the spirit shrine.
02a_side08_06_heart_incomplete_a: I thought I'd feel better by now, but I'm just nervous. And more than a little scared for you.
02a_side08_06_heart_incomplete_b: Please be careful. You're a good person, and I don't want to see you hurt.
02a_side08_06_heart_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />And a bit of revenge. If<g id="female_rightfistthreaten" /> Havelock suffers for what he did to my family,<g id="female_nodrelieved" /> so much the better.
02a_side08_06_heart_proposal_b: <g id="female_thinking" />He'll be holed up on the island.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> The Vigil kept their treasury there.
02a_side08_06_heart_task_goto: Journey to {POITags} and Destroy Archminister Havelock
02a_side08_basket_description: Fingernail scratches mar the beauty of this painted basket.
02a_side08_flute_description: It produces a mournful yet sweet sound when played.
02a_side08_knife_description: Dusty with disuse but clearly well-loved.
02a_side08_necklace_description: A delicate and valuable necklace, once owned by Aethelwynn's sister.
02a_side08_pouch_description: Filled with a mix of tarnished silver coins.
02a_side08_quilt_description: The name "Emmeline" has been stitched into the corner.
02a_side08_shieldpiecea_description: Torn from the back of a shield, the letters 'Rode…' are barely visible.
02a_side08_shieldpieceb_description: No one has used this shield in years.
0312_0101_patriciascloak_description: A tattered and rumpled cloak, bearing the Soulwarden insignia.
0312_0101_patriciasheartgem_description: A piece of polished jade. When viewed closely, you can faintly make out the name "Patricia".
0312_0101_patriciaskeys_description: A set of rusted keys to a chest in Slumbering Echoes.
0312_0101_shadowscastfinalsalute_complet: Patricia's Heartgem…See Corruption swirling inside it?
It finally feels real. She's really gone. She was once a fine Soulwarden, and someone very dear to me.
Thank you, but she knew the risks. We all do.
We Soulwardens sometimes forget that we are only protected against Corruption, we aren't immune to it. Patricia was overcome, and we all paid the price.
0312_0101_shadowscastfinalsalute_incompl: Patricia has become twisted with Corruption.
0312_0101_shadowscastfinalsalute_objecti: Defeat Captain Patricia to recover her Heartgem. Then retrieve her cloak of office from Slumbering Echoes. Talk to Watcher Sexton in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
Shadows Cast By A Final Salute
0312_0101_shadowscastfinalsalute_proposa: I was hoping to see Captain Patricia, but I knew it would be too good to be true.
She was in charge of the rearguard at Cleaves Malice before the fort was overtaken.
She betrayed us! By the time we realized what was happening, our friends and families had been Corrupted.
We need you to recover her Heartgem, and reclaim her cloak of office from her estate in Slumbering Echoes.
0312_0101_shadowscastfinalsalute_travel_: Travel to {POITags} to recover Patricia's Cloak
Travel to {POITags} to recover Patricia's Heartgem
0312_0103_dryadbowyerrubble_description: A collection of the stones that Dryad Archers integrate into their bodies.
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_complete_ava: You were able to recover some of the supplies? That's a load off my mind.
The world might be ending, but at least we won't go hungry.
Someday, I think. Right now…I just have to take things one fight at a time. That’s how she would have wanted it.
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_incomplete_a: Think of it! Dried fruit, or perhaps even dried fish... New weapons, more armor, fresh shot...!
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_objective_de: Recover the Stolen Supplies from Sunderfort and deliver them to Soulwarden Phan in the Eastburn Outpost.
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_objective_ti: All That's Left Not Torn Asunder
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_proposal_a: Right before Patricia’s betrayal, a shipment of our supplies was stolen by Corrupted and taken to Sunderfort.
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_proposal_b: You’ve been such a good distraction, they might not have had time to unload it yet.
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_proposal_nex: We had other things on our minds at the time. Everything happened so fast…
Would you be willing to go to Sunderfort and recover the supplies if they’re still there?
0312_0201_allnottornasunder_travel: Travel to {POITags} to recover the Stolen Supplies
0312_0201_forgottensupplies_description: A sack of supplies, stolen by the Corrupted from the Soulwardens.
0313_0101_descentfrostedslumber_complete: Nicely done! War is just as much about swinging hammers as swinging blades.
Now that you’ve taken out the Foreman, their defenses are vulnerable. We can exploit that.
Thanks, me too. Still hoping to retire there someday with my family…what's left of it. Just gotta chase all the Corrupted out first.
0313_0101_descentfrostedslumber_incomple: We need you to defeat the Foreman and his work crew. Our best strategy is to keep them from expanding their construction.
0313_0101_descentfrostedslumber_objectiv: Slow the Corrupted by defeating Foreman Robertson and his Icefield workers. Talk to Watcher Chang in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
0313_0101_descentfrostedslumber_proposal: We were expanding the village of Slumbering Echoes…that's where I'm from.
When the Corrupted overran it, it was almost too easy for the Corrupted to come and take the lumber.
We need to stop the construction before it becomes impossible to break their defenses.
Foreman Robertson is the key there. Take him and his work crew out, and we'll finally have the edge we need.
0313_0101_descentfrostedslumber_travel: Travel to {POITags} to slow down the Icefield workers
0313_0102_corruptcatalyst_description: A vial containing a thick black fluid. Smells awful, and no one should taste it.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_complete_a: You're back! Strange, this ore seems perfectly fine. Strong, even.
And you say you found these vials throughout the mines? I wonder what happens when I pour it on the ore…
Yes, just as we thought. Now it’s as weak as the rest.
Why would the Corrupted do this? Why would they need this shoddy iron dust? There must be something else we're missing.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_incomplete: If that ore is iron, it's the worst iron I've ever seen.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_objective_: Slow the Corrupted war effort by defeating the Molderpick workers at the Defiler Excavation, and uncover the secret of the Corrupted ore. Talk to Watcher Chang in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_proposal_a: The Molderpick Corrupted have captured the old iron mine to the west. We’re calling it ‘Defiler Excavation’ now.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_proposal_b: But the weird part is, we got our hands on some of the ore they’re mining there, and it’s...
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_proposal_n: It’s terrible. You can crush it in your fist, like dirt. The iron we used to mine there was perfectly usable; something weird is going on.
Go to the Defiler Excavation and see what you can find out about this ore.
0313_0102_transmuteirontodust_travel: Travel to {POITags} to uncover the secret of Corrupted ore
0313_0102_untaintedore_description: A chunk of high quality ore from the Defiler Excavation.
0313_0201_azothremnant_description: A splinter of Azoth, recovered from a broken Ancient statue.
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_complete_: Oh, my, impressive! You've manage to gather all the materials we need to purify the Heartgems.
Those Guardians didn't give you too much trouble, did they?
That’s what I figured. You’re strong, {playerName}, in more ways than one.
I hope that if I ever fall to Corruption, there will be someone like you around to do this ritual for me.
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_gather_fr: Extract Azoth from the fallen Ancient statues
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_incomplet: Catara Falls, Gelida Pillars, and Concretus Steps all have what we need to purify the Heartgems.
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_objective: Collect Azoth Infused items from Catara Falls, Gelida Pillars, and Concretus Steps
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_proposal_: Is this your first cleansing ritual? I envy you. Cleansing a Heartgem consumes Azoth… a lot of it. But with all the Corruption here, there’s not enough ambient azoth to pull it off.
That’s what I like to hear. We can use Azoth-infused items for the ritual.
We’re running low on them - and everything else - but you may find what's needed in the remains of the fallen Ancient statues.
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_travel_a: Travel to {POITags} to extract Azoth from Ancient statues
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_travel_b: Travel to {POITags} to extract Azoth from  Ancient statues
0313_0201_redefiningboundaries_travel_c: Travel to {POITags} to extract Azoth from Ancient statues
0314_0101_blacktalisman_a_description: A blackened talisman of unknown origin, bearing a simple symbol.
0314_0101_blacktalisman_b_description: A blackened talisman of unknown origin, bearing a simple symbol.
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_complete_: Ah! You're back! Will Herald Abraxas help us in the fight against the Corrupted? Did you discover how the hilltop is protected?
Oh… I see. They’re protected from Corruption because they became Lost. In any case, thank you. I’ll destroy these talismans.
I guess some legends are better off staying legends.
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_find_clue: Search for '​Pictures On The Wall' entry
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_incomplet: If it's true, and the Herald's sacred power truly does protect his village from Corruption, perhaps we could use it across the island!
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_objective: Discover how Herald Abraxas blessed Misty Borough, and determine if the Heralds will aid the Soulwardens. Talk to Watcher Magoro in the Cleave's Point Outpost when the task is complete.
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_proposal_: It does, doesn’t it? I’ve been hearing stories about the Misty Borough and Herald Abraxas since I was a child. He’s something of a hero to me.
If only we had someone like him on our side in this fight… the war would be over tomorrow!
That's him! The legends say that he and his followers arrived in Misty Borough, seeking paradise.
I wouldn't be surprised if they were still there. How wonderful that would be! Maybe they could even fight with us!
0314_0101_blessingsofthefallen_travel_to: Travel to {POITags} to determine if Herald Abraxas will aid the Soulwardens
Travel to {POITags} to stop Herald Abraxas
0314_0102_thebestofus_complete_available: That's Dimka’s Heartgem. It's hard to believe that she's gone…
She was brilliant, kind, vibrant... and now, she's some twisted and Corrupted thing. Is this the fate that awaits us all?
Yes… you’re right. This is why it’s so important for us to keep our spirits as high as we can, because if we don’t…
Thank you. I’ll lay Dimka’s purified Heartgem to rest next to Sexton’s… and Patricia’s.
0314_0102_thebestofus_incomplete_a: I’m sorry to ask for your help once again, but… you seem so strong. And you didn’t know Dimka like we did. Maybe that will make this easier.
0314_0102_thebestofus_objective_desc: Defeat former Soulwarden Sauquillo Dimka, and return her Heartgem to Watcher Magoro in the Cleave's Point Outpost.
0314_0102_thebestofus_proposal: Ever since you brought the news of Sexton’s death… and, um, romantic betrayal… Dimka couldn’t take it. She was so sad, and angry, and embarrassed. In her despair, Corruption took her.
0314_0102_thebestofus_proposal_next_a: When she realized what was happening, she fled north. She didn’t want to hurt us.
0314_0102_thebestofus_proposal_next_b: We think she got as far as Sever Castra, before she fell. Oh, Dimka… I wish I could have helped her.
0314_0102_thebestofus_travel: Travel to {POITags} to defeat former Soulwarden Sauquillo Dimka
0315_0101_aburningquestion_complete_avai: The lanterns... There's no light, no glow, not even a flicker! Yet they don't appear to be broken...
Whatever causes them to glow must come from the Ghouls themselves...
I plan on taking the lanterns apart to see how they work, of course. Perhaps if we find a way to light them, they'll still hold the Corrupted at bay.
0315_0101_aburningquestion_incomplete_a: Return the lanterns to me, so I can uncover their secrets.
0315_0101_aburningquestion_objective_des: Recover Azoth-Infused Lanterns from Miststride Ghouls in the Eeriedune Graveyard and Misty Borough. Talk to Watcher Owens in the Cleave's Point Outpost when the task is complete.
0315_0101_aburningquestion_proposal_a: Have you heard of the ghost lights, the ignes fatui, the lanterns that flicker in the Eeriedune Graveyard? Never filled, never fueled, always burning?
0315_0101_aburningquestion_proposal_b: I need to learn more about their properties!
0315_0101_aburningquestion_proposal_next: The Corrupted don't go near them. If we can find out why, maybe we can harness their protection as well!
You can find the lanterns at the Eeriedune Graveyard and in Misty Borough. Please, hurry back!
0315_0101_aburningquestion_travel: Travel to the {POITags} to recover Azoth-Infused Lanterns
0315_0101_azothlantern_description: A lantern from the back of a grave digging Ghoul. Formerly burned with the light of azoth, but is now dark.
0315_0102_corruptedheartgem_description: A Heartgem from a Corrupted Soulwarden, stolen by a Cultist to use in their rituals.
0315_0102_twistedmetamorphosis_complete_: You’re back! Did you recover the Heartgems? Or were we too late?
Oh, thank the Spark. Yes, they’re all here… my old friends. I’d recognize them anywhere.
Thank you so much, {playerName}. I will be having serious words with whoever was storing all these Heartgems in one place.
0315_0102_twistedmetamorphosis_incomplet: We can't let the Gravespoil Vicars use those Heartgems in their rituals.
0315_0102_twistedmetamorphosis_objective: Defeat Gravespoil Vicars in Capitulum Prime, and return the stolen Heartgems to Watcher Owens in the Cleave's Point Outpost.
0315_0102_twistedmetamorphosis_proposal_: Yes, both! Rangers have reported the theft of a cache of Corrupted Heartgems. The same Heartgems you recovered from our former comrades at the fallen forts!
I knew we shouldn’t have kept them all in one place…
The Gravespoil Vicars who haunt Capitulum Prime… los odio, I hate them. We think they’re using them in some kind of ghoulish ritual.
I’m sorry to ask you recover the same Heartgems twice, but… please get them back!
0315_0102_twistedmetamorphosis_travel: Travel to {POITags} to recover stolen Heartgems
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_complete_av: You caused a real commotion at Cleaves Malice, {playerName}! A few of our Rangers were able to slip through and deliver the supplies we needed.
It’s not a permanent fix, but it means we can keep fighting tomorrow!
Wars take time to win. It may not seem like much to you, but for us, it's the difference between a hot dinner and a cold stomachache. That’s worth a lot to my people here.
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_incomplete_: Help us break through the defensive line at Cleaves Malice.
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_objective_d: Break the defenses of the Corrupted by attacking Cleaves Malice. Talk to Warden Phan in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_proposal_a: I hope that one day this wretched war with the Corrupted will end!
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_proposal_b: It's really taking a toll on us. The sooner we break their defenses, the sooner we can all get back to what really matters in life.
0316_0101_maliceaforethought_proposal_ne: The eager type, are you? I like that! Have you talked to Warden Sexton? He's also looking for someone to travel to Cleaves Malice.
Food, friends, family, life! Take your pick, they're all under threat! The Corrupted have cut off one of our major supply routes.
We need you to punch a hole in the guards' defenses at Cleaves Malice. Can you do that?
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_complete_availab: You have letters for me? Odd, I've never met you before and I think I would have remembered you.
Oh, James, no… how could this have… wait. These love letters are not addressed to me. They’re all addressed to Patricia.
So he really did love her… Spark, I feel like such a fool right now.
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_find_clues_at_po: Search for traces of Warden Sexton
Search for more traces of Warden Sexton
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_incomplete_a: With the losses we've suffered, every person is vital.
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_objective_desc: Locate the missing Soulwarden Sexton, and report his whereabouts to Warden Dimka in the Cleave's Point Outpost.
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_proposal_a: Can I just say again how much I love your can-do attitude?
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_proposal_b: Anyway, Warden Sexton went to deliver a message to Cleave’s Point, and he hasn’t come back. It’s not like him. Could you go find him?
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_proposal_next_a: Oh, not me. It’s Dimka. She’s devoted to him, and she’s been so worried. Won’t eat, won’t sleep… I’m more worried about her than him, to be honest.
0316_0201_tiesthatblind_proposal_next_b: Please, find Sexton and help me put Dimka’s mind at rest.
0317_0101_forarainyday_complete_availabl: What’s that? Oh, the ammunition. Sorry, I was miles away.
Yes, this is it. This ammunition should carry us through the next few raids. Thank you, Soulwarden.
I… don't know. I need to think. Thanks for everything, but… this is something no one can help me with.
0317_0101_forarainyday_incomplete_a: Breakaway Fort and Acedia Bastion have secret ammo caches located in false containers, and have likely buried some already.
0317_0101_forarainyday_objective_desc: Recover the Secret Caches at Breakaway Fort and Acedia Bastion. Talk to Soulwarden Dimka in the Cleave's Point Outpost when the task is complete.
0317_0101_forarainyday_proposal_a: Please, don’t. You mean well, but the last thing I need right now is pity.
0317_0101_forarainyday_proposal_b: James…Warden Sexton…his letters weren’t all love letters. There’s a report in here that says that the Corrupted are stockpiling ammunition.
0317_0101_forarainyday_proposal_next_a: Yes, you absolutely can. That ammunition would be far better off in our hands. The report says they’re smuggling it in fake barrels and burying them at Breakaway Fort and Acedia Bastion.
0317_0101_forarainyday_proposal_next_b: If you find the ammunition, bring it here.
0317_0101_hiddenammo_a_description: A container bearing shot and powder, hidden from the Corrupted at Breakaway Fort.
0317_0101_hiddenammo_b_description: A container bearing shot and powder, hidden from the Corrupted at Acedia Bastion.
0317_0101_travel_corrupted_fort_40315: Travel to {POITags} to recover the Secret Caches
0317_0101_travel_corrupted_fort_40317: Travel to {POITags} to recover the Secret Caches
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_complete_availa: Your compass is backwards if you're heading for safety. You want safety, head for the coasts!
Ah, I see, orders from Soulwarden Owens? Let's have a look then…
Says you've bested a good measure of those Corrupted in Great Cleave, and you're here to help.
We could use the help, sure enough. Let's find something for you to do!
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_objective_desc: Deliver Orders to Soulwarden Ducquet of Valor Hold Outpost in Edengrove. Talk to Warden Yseult in Shattered Mountain when the task is complete.
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_proposal_a: If you're willing to continue helping the Soulwardens, there's another place that could really use it.
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_proposal_b: In Edengrove is the Valor Hold Outpost. They’re in the belly of the beast over there.
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_proposal_next_a: So much. Food, arms, reinforcements. Above all, they could use some good news. That’s you.
0317_0201_windingmtnpath_proposal_next_b: Take this letter to Warden Ducquet in Valor Hold. Stick to the roads, though they're not much safer. Auf wiedersehen, my friend.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_complete_a: Yes, I recognize these Heartgems. I’ll give them to the Wardens for purification.
As for me, it’s enough to know that they’re no longer tools of the enemy. That’s the best I can do for them now.
This page you've found... this is written in whatever tongue the Corrupted share. I can’t read it, but I may know someone who can.
Maybe we can learn something from all this. Thank you, Soulwarden.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_incomplete: Aside from recovering those Heartgems, we need to find out what the Corrupted are doing at Sunderfort.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_objective_: Recover Heartgems from the Valleyrend Corrupted in Sunderfort, and find clues about Corrupted activity in the area. Talk to Ranger Knatchbull in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_proposal_a: We paid a steep price in the battle for Sunderfort. Many of our friends fell, and Corruption still has them.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_proposal_b: I see them when I scout the fort: puppets with the faces of my comrades.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_proposal_n: So many Soulwarden puppets in one place means that they’re planning something. I’d like you to search the fort for clues. While you’re there, please lay my friends to rest and recover their Heartgems.
0318_0101_facetslightdarkness_travel: Travel to {POITags} to discover clues about Corrupted activity
0318_0101_sunderfortheartgems_descriptio: A piece of polished amber. It has been scuffed and scratched, and is now unreadable.
0318_0201_ramcormaterials_description: A bundle of materials collected to craft the Rampant Conviction.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_complete_ava: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Didn't get too lost out there, I hope?
<g id="male_spreadhands" />Let's take a look at what you brought me, hm? <g id="female_headnodding" />Oh, yes... these will do nicely for what's needed.
<g id="male_compliment" />Indeed. A beautiful weapon. It needs a name...
<g id="female_smackfist" />I've got it! <g id="male_explain" />The Rampant Conviction of Hope. A little long, but I like it. Take it, and show those Corrupted just how strong our hope is.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_incomplete_a: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Be watchful, stick to the shadows, and don’t move until you need to. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />This tactic has served me well over the years.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_objective_de: Recover the components needed to create the Rampant Conviction, then deliver them to Ranger Madaki in Mountainhome.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />I've received her instructions, and have set my efforts to stopping the production of Corrupted weapons.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_proposal_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />To that end, I've compiled reports to track the weapons that have recently passed through the valley.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_proposal_nex: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You're welcome. I shall continue my efforts to stop the Corrupted here.
<g id="male_spreadhands" />I leave the rest in your capable hands. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Best of luck.
<g id="female_headnodding" />It needed to be done. <g id="male_explain" />It's safe to assume that most, if not all, of the items are related to the creation of this Hammer.
<g id="male_explain" />I've organized them into a list for you, to aid you in your endeavor.
0318_0201_rampantconviction_questtrack_b: Complete Quest: Bones of the Past
0318_0201_rampantconviction_questtrack_i: Complete Quest: Into the Burning Depths
0318_0202_goldsteinscales_description: A case holding Goldstein's weighted scales, which always tip in their favor.

0318_0206_starmetalspall_description: A spall of charged Starmetal Ore, brimming with energy.

0318_0209_livingcrystal_description: A warm, pulsating chunk of amber, taken from the heart of Malevolence.
0318_0209_rampantconviction_thelivingcry: Obtain the {itemName} from the Dryad Beast, {targetName}
<g id="female_salute2finger" />Great work, {playerName}. I haven’t been idle either.
<g id="male_explain" />Eight caravans attempted to bring additional supplies through the valley…<g id="male_dontknow" />they will not reach their destinations.
<g id="male_spreadhands" />Some items were clearly to be used for this Hammer, among other weapons.
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />No matter. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Return these components to Ranger Madaki, and she will work to create a weapon of note.
Obtain the Living Crystal from the monstrous Dryad at the peak of Malevolence
Obtain the Living Crystal from the monstrous Dryad at the peak of Malevolence. Talk to Ranger Knatchbull in the Eastburn Outpost when the task is complete.
0319_0101_acediaheartgem_description: A piece of polished amethyst. Letters can be faintly made out, but nothing else.
0319_0101_breakawayheartgem_description: A piece of polished aquamarine. It has been scuffed and scratched, and is now unreadable.
0319_0101_hollowingheartgem_description: A piece of polished citrine. Appears as though it was beaten against rocks.
0319_0101_nullcavityheartgem_description: A piece of polished lapis. Has been damaged beyond readability.
0319_0101_rainbowheartshadowintent_compl: You brought back the Heartgems! Oh, wonderful. Now my friends won't be tortured anymore.
You also found… symbols? I’ve seen these before… the Corrupted carve them on the floating obelisks.
The Heartgems, we will purify. It’s really quite a beautiful ceremony.
As for these papers, I’ll send them along to my friend. She’s working to crack the code, you see. Someday, she’ll succeed. Thank you so much.
0319_0101_rainbowheartshadowintent_incom: Please, return with any Heartgems you can in Acedia Bastion, Breakaway Fort, Hollowing Fort, and Nullcavity.
0319_0101_rainbowheartshadowintent_objec: Recover Soulwarden Heartgems from the Corrupted. Search for clues about the Corrupted plans in Breakaway Fort, Acedia Bastion, Hollowing Fort, and Nullcavity. Talk to Ranger Law in the Cleave's Point Outpost when the task is complete.
0319_0101_rainbowheartshadowintent_propo: It’s… not ideal, no. It’s also not great that those forts are full of Corrupted Soulwardens.
Our comrades and friends, who fought and fell beside us… They and the forts both belong to Corruption now.
Ah, but now, things are different. Now, we’ve got you.
Could you please try and recover Heartgems from my Corrupted friends at the forts? And while you’re there, keep an eye out for clues, weaknesses, secrets.
0319_0101_sauquilloheartgem_description: A piece of polished moonstone. When the light strikes it, you can easily read "Sauquillo" across the front.
0319_0101_swirlingstaffbase_description: The thick, curled base of what is to be a mighty staff.
0319_0102_pulsingstaffstem_description: A narrow stem on which components can be added.
0319_0103_curvedstaffhead_description: A curved staffhead meant to channel fire.
0319_0104_blisteringreagents_description: A collection of blisteringly hot flammable powders.
0319_0105_flintflamestarters_description: The flint ingredients to start a flame.
0319_0106_vortexfunnel_description: A device that concentrates forth whatever it is attached to.
0319_0107_orichalcumflintlock_descriptio: The component that controls the flamethrower ability.
0319_0108_azothconcentrator_description: A thin metal barrel forged with azoth to concentrate flames.
0319_0501_b_description: Gather supplies for Ranger Law to make Prime Resolve.
0319_0501_c_proposal_a: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Here in Aeternum, where doom haunts our every move, <g id="male_nodProud" />we must hang on to the things that make us feel alive.
0319_0501_c_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />To that end, there is a legend we tell in Great Cleave that warms our hearts.
0319_0501_c_proposal_next2_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />Yes, if you make it so! <g id="female_order" />Go forth and gather the parts needed to build this legendary weapon!
0319_0501_c_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Setting things on fire, what a wonderful way to remind yourself you're truly alive.
0319_0501_c_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_explain" />There is a powerful fire staff, called Prime Resolve. <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />The legend goes that it can turn a Corrupted enemy to cinders in a flash.
0319_0501_c_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_nodProud" />I’d call that heartwarming, wouldn’t you?
0319_0501_d_01_01_01_task_goto: Seek a stem for your staff at {POITags}
0319_0501_d_01_02_01_task_goto: Venture to {POITags} in search of a Vortex Funnel
0319_0501_d_01_containter_weaponwrapperq: Complete Quest: Growth From the Stem

0319_0501_d_02_02_01_task_goto: Climb the tower {POITags} in search of a base for your staff
0319_0501_d_02_04_01_task_goto: Delve into the {POITags} in search of an Azoth Concentrator
0319_0501_d_02_containter_weaponwrapperq: Complete Quest: Head of the Pack
0319_0501_e_incomplete_a: <g id="male_nodProud" />Isn’t fire wonderful? It keeps us warm, cooks our food, burns away the darkness and the filth and the pain…
0319_0501_f_complete_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />At last, Prime Resolve is completed. It’s beautiful. <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Truly a force to be reckoned with!
0319_0501_f_complete_b: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Knowing you wield it will keep me warm during my cold patrols.
0319_0501_f_complete_next_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />You're too kind. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />May Prime Resolve turn you into a beacon of fiery hope.
0319_0501_f_complete_next_b: A burning flame that refuses to go out as it purifies Corruption.
0319_0501_f_complete_prompt: "I'll burn a few in your name."

0320_0101_brokentalisman_description: A talisman once held by Joan the Faithless. Though broken, the talisman still contains the essences of her prayers and will heal once more.
0320_0101_corruptedrune_description: A runestone once held by S'ylanx. Once purified, this evil stone can be a powerful catalyst for life magic.
0320_0101_corruptedtalisman_description: A talisman dropped by an unholy priest. giving them protection. With some manipulation, the protection can be extracted.

0320_0101_elementalcrystal_description: An elemental crystal infused with life magics by the shamans of Edengrove.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_complete_avail: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />So, you've learned the Symphony of Mercy? I won't pretend to know the work of musicians, <g id="female_headnodding" />but I can at least whistle a tune as I work.
<g id="male_explain" />Give me a moment to extract the essences I need, and I'll finish crafting the Mercy.

<g id="female_headnodding" />Yes, this is a fine Life Staff. Just seeing it glimmer puts my heart at ease. <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Wielding the Mercy in battle will inspire awe in your allies and fear in your enemies.
<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" />Take it, in your hands I know this staff will do some good.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_incomplete_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Getting lost in song is quite easy, which explains Rochford. <g id="male_listenforward" >Maybe I myself should follow his tune a little more!
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_objective_desc: Gather the parts, wholesome and true, for a life-giving staff made whole. Glittering, gleaming, restore and renew the Glimmering Mercy's soul. Talk to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain when the task is complete.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />That place has eaten many careless Soulwardens. <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Your accomplishment is impressive… to some.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_proposal_b: <g id="female_shrugShort" />But no one triumphs alone, do they? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />I’ve heard you’ve been getting help from my friend Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_proposal_next2: <g id="male_explain" />The plans are a collection of short bits compiled into a poem called the "Symphony of Mercy."
<g id="female_gestureForward01" />If you're serious about practicing Life Magic, follow these lyrics to get your hands on the Glimmering Mercy.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_proposal_next_: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Some of us. Madaki said you've made a discovery about the Corrupted's weaponry. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Let's see the pages you've found.
<g id="male_goodnews" />Oh! The plans for this staff, Glimmering Mercy, are actually a song. <g id="male_nodProud" />That’s whimsical.
0320_0101_glimmeringmercy_proposal_promp: "We all need help, now and then."
0320_0101_infernalwood_description: Fragments of wood taken from corrupted acolytes. Cursed, but sturdy enough to be used as staff.
0320_0101_perfectwyrdwood_description: High quality Wyrdwood Tears gathered by Dryad soldiers. Its energy is a catalyst for life magic.
0320_0101_shamanincense_description: Incense that Dryad Shamans burn to improve their focus. Do not ingest, consult a shaman if visions last for more than 6 hours.
0320_0101_stoneskullwine_description: Wine crafted by the Stone Skull pirates. Please ingest responsibly, consult a pirate if vision doubles for more than 6 hours.

0320_0102_prelude_objective_desc: Blood-stained robes and cursed staves, nefarious acolytes raise their minions forth. Find them in the heights west by north, and send them to their cursed graves.
0320_0103_adagio_objective_desc: Weeping trees, they be not willow nor withe, growing wild in the winding way. Survive the wanton whaling of the forestwalkers, and your woes be rewarded with the trees' blue tears.
0320_0103_d_02_container_adagio_task_02: Collect Perfected Wyrdwood Tears from {targetName} Dryads

0320_0104_scherzo_objective_desc: Another place, another body, another time, the wisest of shamans are not of here but a reality that bends. The myrrh they carry is their vehicle, the key to a magic that transcends.
0320_0105_d_02_container_shanty_task_02: Collect Stone Skull Port from {targetName} Pirates
0320_0105_shanty_objective_desc: One swig for courage, two swigs to sleep, three swigs to settle your strife, and four swigs when under the knife. Give me that bottom of the barrel wine, freshly butchered swine, and a wench for a good time.
0320_0106_zarabanda_objective_desc: The red eye of the bay, the red eye of the bay, the tower calling sailors to their doom. Deep in the tower, hidden away, an ancient and powerful rune.
0320_0107_d_02_container_requiem_task_02: Defeat Joan the Faithless for her Broken Talisman
0320_0107_requiem_objective_desc: Temporary forms made immortal and pinned to the earth in sorrow. The faithless turn their back on the path.

0320_0108_d_02_container_passepied_task_: Search chests within {POITags} for Elemental Crystals

0320_0108_passepied_objective_desc: In the heart of the craters, the soul of Aeternum, climb towards the sky. Peek into the mirror and learn the ways of those that defend the tower.

0320_0109_d_02_container_sonata_task_02: Defeat a Myrkgard Priest for their Talisman of Protection
0320_0109_sonata_objective_desc: Dive into the belly of the beast, and the heart of Corruption. Though light may cast out the darkness, it in turn casts a shadow.
0321_0101_azravmaterials_description: A bundle of materials collected to craft the Azure Ravager.
0321_0101_azureravager_complete_availabl: <g id="male_compliment" />Glad you made it back. Wow, some of this stuff must have been hard to find. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Nicely done.
<g id="male_explain" />Give me a bit to integrate these last components you've brought, and we'll see what we end up with.
<g id="female_headnodding" />This is no ordinary hatchet! Whoever designed it was a master smith.
<g id="male_rememberBig" />A name is coming to me: Azure Ravager, the slayer of Corrupted. <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Yes, that’s got a nice ring to it!
0321_0101_azureravager_incomplete_a: I’d love to join you, but I have other duties. I have to try and stop any more of those supplies from reaching the forges in Caminus.
0321_0101_azureravager_objective_desc: Recover the components needed to create the Azure Ravager, and deliver them to Ranger Madaki in Mountainhome.
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I know. I started seeing the influx of strange items coming into the forts nearby, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />and I didn't question her any longer.
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />Something unusual was going on, so I started to look into it.
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_next2_a: <g id="male_explain" />I've put together a list of everything that matches up with this new Hatchet design.
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You'll have to search across Aeternum for some of the items, <g id="female_headnodding" />but I'm certain you can do it. You found me up here, after all.
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_listenforward" />There is an amazing hatchet, I'm sure Madaki showed you. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I can imagine the way it handles in a fight!
0321_0101_azureravager_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />We can't let the Corrupted make it first!

0321_0104_azureravager_sampleofevil_obje: Locate Corruption Breaches throughout Aeternum, and cut down the hordes of Monstrous Corrupted who gather there.
0321_0104_potentcorrichor_description: Globs of concentrated Corruption, from those fresh from a portal.

Deep within Scorpius, take back the Desecrated Azoth Crystal from S'ylanx the Unseen.
0321_0105_desecratedazothcrystal_descrip: A formerly pure Azoth crystal, now tainted by Corruption.
0321_0106_azureravager_shardsaboveandbel: <g id="male_compliment" />It looks like you've made a lot of progress already!

<g id="male_explain" />I've been working to alter this recipe to channel Azoth instead of Corruption... and with what you've brought me, <g id="female_headnodding" />I think I'll be able to make this work.
<g id="male_pointsoutthere" />By the time you bring back the rest of the components, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I'll have most of the critical pieces complete.
<g id="female_smackfist" />Then we'll get to see what this design can really do.
Obtain Everburning Embers and Tainted Orichalcum samples from {POITags}
Find samples of Tainted Orichalcum and collect Everburning Embers from Ambusti Superior. Talk to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain when the task is done.
0321_0106_everburnember_description: The heart of a Hellfire, burning long after having been removed.
0321_0106_taintedorichalcum_description: Chunks of pure orichalcum, covered in Corruption slime.
0321_0107_azureravager_woodenheartsironh: Gather {itemName} from Wyrdwood trees across Aeternum
<g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You bring me the components, <g id="female_crossarms" >and I'll get this thing made.
Collect Corrupted Iron Hammerheads from the Elite Southguard Forgers of Svikin's Stand.

<g id="male_explain" />There are still a few more items on Fowler's shopping list, and I still have a lot to do to make sure this Hatchet won't do anything crazy, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />like try and suck your soul out.
<g id="male_dontknow" />Honestly, I'm not entirely sure what will happen when this weapon is finished.
<g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />All I do know for certain is that we'll have it and they won't... and that'll hurt them in more ways than one.
0321_0107_corrironhammer_description: A chipped and broken iron hammerhead, crafted from Corrupted iron.
0321_0107_wyrdheartwood_description: A strip of glimmering heartwood, pulled from within a Wyrdwood tree.
