Seek out Unstable Azoth Shards and Ethereal Adhesive from the Lost of Periville.
0321_0108_ethadhesive_description: An incredibly sticky, almost invisible substance left behind by apparitions.
0321_0108_unstazothshard_description: A sliver of unstable azoth, burning with a bright blue flame.
0321_0109_azureravager_gleamingedge_comp: <g id="female_salute2finger" />A great haul, wonderfully done! <g id="male_explain" />While you've been out, I was able to stop three other shipments from making their way to the forges of Caminus.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Felt good to be up and active, you know?

<g id="male_rememberBig" />Oh, Ranger Madaki sent a runner earlier, in case you stopped by. She's almost completed the Hatchet, and it looks like with what you have, she'll have the final pieces she needs. <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Hurry up there!
0321_0109_azureravager_gleamingedge_obje: Collect Drowned Silver Coins hoarded by the Skullworm Pirates of Stone Skull Fort. Talk to Ranger Fowler in Great Cleave when the task is complete.
0321_0109_starmetalwhetstone_description: A strange whetstone with notable starmetal streaks throughout.
0322_innkeep_title: Innkeeper of the Hound and Hammer
0324_0101_d_01_taskfishingcatchweight: Catch fish with a weight greater than 30 pounds
0324_0101_fq12_complete_available_respon: Ah, I assume you're the new fisher who Master Fisher Davies has sent my way? That is a strange fish you carry there.
0324_0101_fq12_incomplete: Don't be discouraged if you haven't yet caught an Azoth Tinged fish, those things are slippery and ephemeral at best.
0324_0101_fq12_objective_desc: Catch an Azoth-Tinged Fish in Shattered Mountain and deliver it to Master Fisher Bernard.
0324_0101_fq12_prompt: "What else is in the water besides fish?"
0324_0101_fq12_proposal: There are mythical creatures as well, like The Azoth Tinged Fish.
0324_0101_fq12_proposal_next: A fish whose entire essence has been possessed and imbued with the magical powers of azoth, of course! Catch one for Bernard in Shattered Mountain.
0325_0101_chilledfungi_description: A batch of everchilled fungi that never lose their cold, even after being picked.
0325_0101_corruptedbindings_description: Corruption-infused silks taken from the body of a Legatus General.
0325_0101_d_01_container_rl_questpush_1: Complete Quest: Blood in the Snow
0325_0101_everbiteectoplasm_description: A thick, gooey substance that leaves the hands with frostbite if touched for too long.
0325_0101_frostbittenvine_description: A rimed vine that pulses with the energy of the Dryad it was once a part of.
0325_0101_frostfrogedgrips_description: Gauntlet grips cold-forged to perfection that are pointed at the tips for extra piercing.
0325_0101_frozenorichalcumplating_descri: Shimmering plating of the finest material quality, frigid to the touch.
0325_0101_heartofeverchill_description: A twisted, gnarled heart of ice that still beats out of the chest of its Corrupted master.
0325_0101_icyshot_description: Bullets filled with a blast of cold that can be manipulated into gauntlet parts.
0325_0101_rl_00_complete_available_respo: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />What a resounding success! I present to you: <g id="female_giveitem" />Rimelash, the instrument of icy destruction that will freeze and fell your enemies before they even know what's hit them!
<g id="female_headnodding" />It is a great boon to have this weapon in the hands of someone so capable.
<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />The Corrupted will shatter under its power.
0325_0101_rl_00_incomplete_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />This land is full of shifting forces greater than all of us. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />But we won’t be afraid. We will master them, in time.
0325_0101_rl_00_objective_desc: Gather components to make the Legendary Ice Gauntlet Rimelash.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Just think of it, holding the power of a snowstorm in one's hand.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />There's a weapon that allows for this and more, the gauntlet Rimelash. <g id="female_smackfist" />With it you can freeze enemies and shatter their frozen forms.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_next2_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Great Cleave is a wonderful place, if you seek the power of winter. The creatures here have ice in their veins – <g id="female_smackfist" />take it from them.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_explain" />Once you get the pieces, Madaki can help you put them together.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />It is! <g id="male_explain" />Rimelash's cold seeps into the very marrow of an enemy, freezing them from the inside-out.
0325_0101_rl_00_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />This is exactly the kind of weapon we could use,<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> if you're willing to take on its construction.
0325_0101_rl_01_objective_desc: Gather the Corrupted Bindings that will hold together the gauntlet from Legatus General Patrick at Svikin's Stand. Talk to Ranger Madaki at Shattered Mountain.
0325_0101_rl_02_objective_desc: Gather the Frozen Orichalcum Plating from the frozen crown of North Myrkgard, Greater Tribulation.
0325_0101_rl_03_objective_desc: Gather the Chilled Fungi that grow upon the Elite Alcazarian Guardians of Malevolence for an extra kick of frost.
0325_0101_rl_04_objective_desc: Kill Corrupted on the way to gather S'ylanx the Unseen's frozen, twisted heart to make a core for the gauntlet.
0325_0101_rl_05_objective_desc: Gather Frostforged Grips to make up the hand of the gauntlet from the Corrupted of Infernal Host.
0325_0101_rl_06_objective_desc: Gather Everbite Ectoplasm from the wraiths of frigid Periville, their cold everlasting in undeath.
0325_0101_rl_07_objective_desc: Gather Icy Shot from the Skullworm Pirates of Stone Skull Fort, a special ammunition they keep on them for inflicting maximum pain.
0325_0101_rl_08_objective_desc: Defeat Dryads and their leader Parthenocissus for his Frostbitten Vine that will wrap around the core of the gauntlet.
0325_0102_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Infiltrate {POITags} in search of Corrupted Bindings
0325_0103_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Seek out Frozen Orichalcum Plating from {POITags} in Myrkgard
0325_0104_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Gather the Chilled Fungi that grow upon Dryad Guardians of {POITags}
0325_0104_rl_task_02c_taskgameevent: Tear down Enchanted Vines along the walls of Malevolence
0325_0105_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Search {POITags} for a core for the gauntlet
0325_0106_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Claim Frostforged Grips from the Corrupted of Infernal Host
0325_0107_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Gather Everbite Ectoplasm from the wraiths of Periville
0325_0108_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Delve into {POITags} in search of Icy Shot
0325_0109_rl_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Infiltrate {POITags} and slay its leader for a Frostbitten Vine
0326_prospector_talk_response: Outpost Rush is a 20 vs 20 match that takes place on an island with 3 Outposts. Competitors fight to capture and hold them for as long as possible, increasing their team's score.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_complete_availa: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />You have the look of someone who has good news!<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> I take it others survived the attack?
<g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Things are looking up! <g id="female_smackfist" />Three are more than enough to start a new bastion, or at least a watchtower.
<g id="male_nodProud" />We'll build it at a strategic location to continue to spy on the Corrupted.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_incomplete: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Please look for any surviving rangers. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />It would be heartening to know I wasn't the only survivor, this time.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_objective_desc: Find Ranger Heo Do-yun's previous associates. Once found, let them know Heo Do-yun is still alive.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />I had the "good fortune" to be off scouting when the Corrupted struck.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />I was cut off from the others, but I was able to track them here. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />If we don't find them soon, I fear they may fall to Corruption.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Then the situation is more dire than I thought. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />We rangers are a hardy lot, but some things no one should endure.
0330_0101_asgoodasmyword_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_convince01" />If you find them before I do, let them know I survived.
0330_0101_d_01_talktosurvivors: Find and talk to Ranger Jasvir Tenavan
0330_0101_d_02_talktosurvivors: Find and talk to Ranger Marikit Rizal
0330_0102_d_01_mapa: Map the landscape to the west
0330_0102_d_02_mapb: Map the landscape to the east
0330_0102_mappingtheedgeofdespair_comple: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You, my friend, are an extremely competent mapmaker. <g id="male_spreadhands" />I know it couldn't have been easy to write in the cold, <g id="male_nodProud" />but this linework is excellent!
<g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Now let me compare these to our older maps.
Hmm… <g id="male_headShakeNo" />not as much as I expected. <g id="female_crossarms" />And that troubles me.

<g id="female_thinking" />It could mean their attention is elsewhere, somewhere we can't see. <g id="female_crossarms" />We'll have to look into this when we can, <g id="male_nodProud" />but something else needs my attention first.
0330_0102_mappingtheedgeofdespair_incomp: <g id="male_explain" />We need accurate maps if we are to track what the Corrupted are up to. <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Each piece of new information brings us closer to victory!
0330_0102_mappingtheedgeofdespair_object: Find the best locations to map out enemy camps in northern Great Cleave. Then bring your notes back to Ranger Heo Do-yun.
0330_0102_mappingtheedgeofdespair_propos: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Yes. I was sent to map the supply lines of the Corrupted. <g id="male_gestureAhead" />With you here, we could cover more ground.
<g id="male_explain" />I scouted out several promising locations, but I didn't have time to make maps, <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />not before the bastion was destroyed.
<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />I've set up telescopes and map paper at sites that overlook key Corrupted locations.
<g id="male_gestureAhead" />If you could travel to each one and make a fresh map to bring back to me, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I would appreciate the extra help.
0330_0102_mappingtheedgeofdespair_start_: "Is that why you are still here?"
0330_0103_d_01_findhelm: Search {POITags} for Topalian's Helm and Kaipo's Axe
0330_0103_d_01_findshield: Search {POITags} for Mardea's Shield and Hanu's Spear
0330_0103_hanuspear_description: Flashed in battle like a rallying cry.
0330_0103_kaipoaxe_description: Was famed for never missing a foe on the battlefield.
0330_0103_mardeashield_description: Held aloft, it shone like the sun on the field of battle.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_complete_av: <g id="male_explain" />Mardea's Shield, as good at absorbing blows as she was hardship. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Hanu's quick wit, as sharp as the spear she fought with.
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />Topalian's Helm, as bright as their personality. And Kaipo's Axe, as large as his generosity.
<g id="male_headNodYes" />They were. And with these items, <g id="male_spreadhands" />it's as if they're standing right beside me.
<g id="female_leanforwardListen" />I can hear their voices now, laughing about my luck. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I'll toast their bravery later.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_incomplete: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Their warrior spirits will live on forever, <g id="male_explain" />but those of us who didn't fall would be reminded about their strength and courage if we had something to remember them by.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_objective_d: Recover weapons and armor from Ranger Heo Do-yun's fallen companions. Recover Mardea's Shield, Hanu's Spear, Topalian's Helm, and Kaipo's Axe.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />When we build a new bastion, I plan on putting their prized weapons and armor on display <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />so that we never forget their sacrifices.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_proposal_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Each of them left something behind. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Until now, I haven't had the time to recover them.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_proposal_ne: <g id="male_explain" />Mardea never had time to recover her shield. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Hanu went down with her spear. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Topalian's helm was knocked off during the attack.
<g id="male_explain" />And Kaipo's axe whirled through many before he fell. With those, I can honor my lost friends.
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_proposal_pr: "What do you need me to find?"
0330_0103_pickingupthepieces_start_promp: "How do you plan on honoring them?"
0330_0103_topalianhelm_description: Turned aside many a dangerous blow.
0331_0101_beastclues_displayname: Follow Clues from the Balemaw Beast
0331_0101_d_01_find_clues: Follow clues to the Balemaw Beast
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_complete_avail: From your expression you have discovered something… <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Please let it not be another body. Tell me truthfully, I can handle the worst.
<g id="male_quidproquo" />So, the dreaded Balemaw Beast was just a person out for a bit of fun. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />What kind of fool thinks that's a good idea?
<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Great Cleave is full of real terrors, there's no need to add imaginary ones!
"The beast was a man named Bob."
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_incomplete: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Have you discovered any clues to the whereabouts of the Balemaw Beast?
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_objective_desc: Find the notorious Balemaw Beast which has been preying on travelers in the region.
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_proposal_a: <g id="female_smackfist" />The Balemaw Beast is taller than a person and covered in fur! <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It has glowing eyes that pierce through the snow and claws as long as daggers.
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />It jumps out from behind the trees and vanishes into the woods just as quickly.
0331_0101_thebalemawbeast_proposal_next_: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />That's where the tale gets muddy. <g id="male_quidproquo" />Some say it attacked them, others say it runs off without a fight.
<g id="male_explain" />Either way, it's a menace and I'd appreciate it if you tracked down the truth behind the rumors.
0331_0102_d_01_goto: Discover what manner of beast lives at {POITags}
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_complete_availa: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You look like you've been in quite a fight. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Was it with the Yeti? Have you banished it?
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Ah, those rimewolves are vicious. <g id="male_explain" />Clearing them out certainly helps protect the travelers in these woods.
<g id="male_dontknow" />I wonder if having them around means we're less likely to have Yetis move into the area?
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_incomplete: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Have you checked the nearby ice caves? What about the ones farther away? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />We have to be sure they aren't spreading.
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_objective_desc: Track the beasts that have been attacking travelers to their lair and defeat them.
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />The color of the eyes, along with their ability to manipulate ice, leads me to believe that these creatures aren't natural.
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_proposal_b: <g id="female_smackfist" />We can't allow them to make a home here in Great Cleave!
0331_0102_wolvesofwinter_proposal_next: <g id="female_thinking" />There are a number of caves where they might have made a home for themselves. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />I suggest you check them to make sure.
0331_0103_beastclues_description: Clues left by the Balemaw Beast.
0331_0103_d_03_01_taskgotopoi: Travel to {POITags} to find clues about the real Balemaw Beast
0331_0103_d_04_01_taskgotopoi: Travel to {POITags} to find the Balemaw Beast
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_complete_avail: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Has it been taken care of? Has the beast been destroyed?
<g id="female_headnodding" />Let's hope that is enough to make those roads safe again. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Though I fear Mozrul will be back again in the future.
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_incomplete_a: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />These are dark days indeed if such beasts wander the land.
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_objective_desc: The Balemaw Beast struck again! Track the beast up Mangled Heights and defeat it!
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />It wouldn't hurt. <g id="female_crossarms" />Though I can't imagine Bob has a hand in this, unless we were vastly mistaken about the nature of his character.
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_proposal_b: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" >He seemed harmless. Misguided and foolish, but harmless.
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_proposal_next_: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />The tales tell of horrors up in Mangled Heights. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Sadly, this is nothing new.
<g id="male_dontknow" />All news from the heights are filled with tragic stories of travelers who got in over their heads.
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_proposal_promp: "Other than Bob do we have a lead?"
0331_0103_thebeastreturns_start_prompt: "Do I need to check on Bob again?"
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_complete_availab: <g id="female_headnodding" />You found me, good! With you helping to procure the bobcat pelts…
<g id="male_explain" />I felt I had to scout out what I simply needed to collect next. <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />But first, let's take a look at those pelts.
<g id="male_compliment" />Divine, simply divine! <g id="female_headnodding" />I do so love the feel of fresh pelts. <g id="female_chuckle" />There's something so vital about them. So intense.
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_incomplete: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />I must have those spotted pelts! Do hurry back soon!
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_objective_desc: Gather beautiful Spotted Pelts from Bobcats to add to Rue Horne's collection.
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_proposal: <g id="female_salute2finger" />I could tell you were one with a fine eye for fashion. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Really, your outfit, superb! I couldn't design something better myself.
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Don't think, be! Fashion is all about being. <g id="male_explain" />And being covered in spots is going to be so in next year!
0332_0101_aspotofluxury_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />Do be a dear and kill some bobcats to bring me their spotted pelts, would you?
0332_0101_d_01_goto: Hunt Bobcats in Frosted Floe to gather Spotted Pelts
0332_0101_spottedpelts_description: Animal pelts covered with the most wonderful spots!
0332_0102_d_01_goto: Hunt Snowy Cougars in the Braided Hills to gather Red Striped Pelts
0332_0102_d_03_goto: Hunt Tainted Stags in the Icy Wilds to gather Blue Striped Pelts
0332_0102_fabulousfurs_complete_availabl: <g id="male_leanbackCovermouth" />Oh. My. They are even better in person than from afar. Oh, and so soft. So supple.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Everyone will be clamoring to wear these, <g id="male_compliment" />and it's all possible because of you.
<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Good fashion is never easy. That's what makes it so good. <g id="male_compliment" />And you, dear, are one of the best. I can just tell.
0332_0102_fabulousfurs_incomplete: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Those colors! They make me weak just thinking about them! <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />I must have them!
0332_0102_fabulousfurs_objective_desc: Gather fantastically colored pelts from local cougars and elk to add to Rue Horne's collection.
0332_0102_fabulousfurs_proposal_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />More than unusual, they are extremely profitable! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Those hues will mean I save a fortune on dyes!
0332_0102_fabulousfurs_proposal_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />The stripes are quite striking too. <g id="female_smackfist" />I simply must add them to my collection.
0332_0102_redstripedpelts_description: Animal pelts covered with fantastic stripes!
0332_0103_bluestripedpelts_description: Animal pelts covered with marvelous colored stripes!
0332_0103_d_01_goto: Hunt Alabaster Wolves in the Icy Wilds to gather Pure White Pelts
0332_0103_puredelight_complete_available: <g id="male_leanbackCovermouth" />Oh, what a wonder! Imagine enfolding yourself in these furs! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Why, you'd sink into them and give up wearing anything else.
<g id="male_compliment" />Such fine work, it's like you were born to be in fashion.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Everyone does! <g id="male_explain" />But fascinating hobbies are what keep the best designers inspired.
<g id="female_salute2finger" />Should you ever want to focus on fashion, do come back and see me!
0332_0103_puredelight_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />Those pelts are a blank slate just waiting to be gobbled up by fashion.<g id="female_gestureForward01" /> Do be hasty in bringing them back!
0332_0103_puredelight_objective_desc: Gather brilliant Pure White Pelts from wolves to add to Rue Horne's collection.
0332_0103_puredelight_proposal_a: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Your concern is touching. <g id="male_explain" />But trust me, anyone buying pure white pelts are not worried about how to keep them clean!
0332_0104_purepelts_description: Beautiful pelts that are just waiting to soak up unique dyes!
0333_0101_ancientivory_description: You'd think ivory this old would be brittle, but it is strong as steel.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_complete_available: These bones, so old, and yet they have not faded away.
Something makes these Ancient bones special. Something I hope will imbue this spell with longevity and strength.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_incomplete: I need bones of the Ancients to make this work.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_objective_desc: Collect Ancient Ivory for Valta so she can add it to a poppet.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_proposal_a: I have not seen children either, but I have listened long to tales older than this island. And I am certain there is a way.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_proposal_b: All I need are some components to place into a poppet.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_proposal_next_a: A doll, yes, but so much more. For like calls to like, and once complete it shall call forth a child.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_proposal_next_b: Could you bring me some bones to place inside? I have already tried snow, but it does not last long enough.
0333_0101_whiteasbone_proposal_prompt: "A poppet, you mean like a doll?"
0333_0101_whiteasbone_start_prompt: "But I have seen no children here."
0333_0102_firebrightruby_description: These rubies glisten in the light like fresh drops of blood.
0333_0102_redasblood_complete_available_: How deep their color, like blood that has been caught and frozen in time.
See how they catch the light? These are perfect to capture the spirit of survival anyone on Aeternum needs.
0333_0102_redasblood_incomplete: I need bright shining rubies to make this spell work. I tried blood and dye before, but those didn't last long enough.
0333_0102_redasblood_objective_desc: Collect blood red Firebright Rubies from the mine for Valta so she can add them to a poppet.
0333_0102_redasblood_proposal_a: I tried dyes before, sadly they all failed. This time I shall try rubies, blood red in color. They don’t fade with time, always staying bright.
0333_0102_redasblood_proposal_b: There’s a mine not far from here where rubies can be collected.
0333_0103_blackasebony_complete_availabl: Perfect, perfect. The bones are inside, with rubies for the heart and eyes, and charred pieces of ebony to hold it all together.
No, making the poppet was just the first step. Now it is time to visit the Wishing Tree.
"Is that all that must be done?"
0333_0103_blackasebony_incomplete: All I require now are charred pieces of ebony. Soon, my child soon, you shall know peace in my arms.
0333_0103_blackasebony_objective_desc: Collect night black pieces of Charred Ebony for Valta so she can add them to a poppet.
0333_0103_blackasebony_proposal_a: I have heard rumors that someone brought ebony furniture to one of the forts. You could search there and see what you could find.
0333_0103_blackasebony_proposal_b: I fear the worst, as the rumors also told of the forts being overrun.
0333_0103_blackasebony_proposal_next: Thank you. Please hurry. The poppet is almost done, and I can feel my child calling to me.
0333_0103_charredebony_description: The dark wood is made even darker from the stains of ash and fire.
0333_0104_anofferingforoffspring_complet: Something is different, I can feel it. The air has a hint of warmth to it. The wind holds fewer sighs.
These things take time. We must be patient.
The tales did not say how long it would take for the offering to be accepted, only that given time, it would.
0333_0104_anofferingforoffspring_incompl: Please take the poppet to the Wishing Tree. I can hear the voice of my child even now.
0333_0104_anofferingforoffspring_objecti: Travel to the Wishing Tree and leave the Poppet as an offering so that Valta may one day have a child of her own.
0333_0104_anofferingforoffspring_proposa: I don't know. What I do know is that none of my previous offerings worked. The poppet of snow and blood and ash barely lasted a day before it melted away.
The poppet of paper and dye didn't fare much better.
Bones of Ancient guardians, rubies, ebony… if the offering is not sufficient this time, I do not know what I shall do.
Please take it to the tree for me. I do not think I can bear to go through with it again.
"What makes you so sure this time?"
0333_0104_creepypoppet_description: Made with bone, rubies, and charred wood; it holds the hopes for a child inside it.
0333_0104_d_03_interacttree: Place Valta's Poppet at the Wishing Tree
0333_0104_wishingtree_displayname: Place Poppet near the Wishing Tree
0334_0101_crumblycheese_description: This cheese has been forgotten so long that it has aged to perfection.
0334_0101_d_03_goto: Collect Tenderized Meat from Tainted Stags in {POITags}
0334_0101_drieddill_description: A milder flavor than fresh dill, but it lasts much longer.
0334_0101_perfectpiroshkis_complete_avai: You did it! I almost can't believe it, it's been so long since I've seen something other than potatoes to eat! Tell me I'm not dreaming.
Piroshkis! I have the flour for the dough, the onions, and so many potatoes.
But now I can make them truly delicious with the dill, cheese, and tender meat. We'll be feasting soon!
0334_0101_perfectpiroshkis_incomplete: What I wouldn't give for some spices, cheese… anything to brighten the potatoes and onions I already have on hand.

03_greatcleave_body_06_01:
To the attention of: General Alazar
Name: James Sexton, Soulwarden
Current post: Eastburn Outpost, Great Cleave
Requested post: Anywhere else

Add'l. Notes:
I'll take whatever we've got. Send me to the front lines in Shattered Mountain, if that's what it takes. No battle can be more painful than the memories I have here, with her.
-J.S.
03_greatcleave_body_06_02:
Patricia, my love,

The tincture isn't working. My leg is turning black, and the ice is creeping toward my heart. I was in such a hurry to leave this place, I got sloppy. I let the Corrupted overwhelm me. Now, it seems, I'll never leave.

How ridiculous, to lie in the snow and wait for the end, to scribble my last words in the dark! I wish you'd ran away with me, all those times I asked. If only I'd found the right words then. 
Maybe this is for the best. When they recover my Heartgem from my corpse, they'll lay it next to yours.

I'll be with you soon.
-James
03_greatcleave_body_07_01:
My followers have completed construction of the village, under my guidance. I have spent much of my time planning our future, and one thing concerns me: the Corruption to the north, past the Ancient gate. And while some called me a fool to do so, I set forth to see this evil for myself.
I ventured north of the gate, able to avoid the attentions of the demons long enough to learn what I needed to. But, fate decided to set me on a new path. Climbing through the mountain passes, I slipped and found myself in a ruin of the Ancients. Inside, artifacts and riches filled the cave to the brim, but what drew me in were the murals on the wall. I did not recognize something specific in them at first, but having studied the spiritual paths of many, I should be able to recognize a ritual!
From my loose understanding of the murals, I believe the Ancients had a way of sanctifying areas on the island, explaining why the settlements to the south are protected from attack. These murals showed me how to do the same! This may be the best way to protect my flock, to give them the peace that so many of them deserve.
I claimed the artifacts in the cave, bringing back as many as I was able to carry, and have matched many to the murals. I must determine how this ritual was done so that I may perform it here for the village, and will not rest until I do!
03_greatcleave_body_07_02: I have done it. I now understand how the Ancients performed their wonderful, terrible, ritual. I have already taken the first steps, distributing the tokens to each of the townsfolk. No, I mustn't! It is wrong, it is foolish, it is evil! Their wills exterminated! I don't... I need, I must... As the Herald of this flock, it falls to me to make the hard decisions for everyone. I held a meeting at the church and explained that the ritual would protect this hilltop... and all in attendance agreed that we must do whatever we can to protect ourselves... Something in those ruins, unclear how... I am fighting for control, but I feel it winning. I have given my most trusted follower specific instructions on what to do. Being near the stone lends me strength, but I know it must be consumed in the ritual. This... will be the last time I have control, and I cannot stop the ritual. But... my flock, they will not be taken by Corruption. Their souls, their minds, will be freed. It is the only way.
03_greatcleave_body_08_01: There is a creature, a blue winged serpent that lurks in the Great Cleave's waters. Some don't believe it exists, but I've had it on my line more than once and that is one tricky beastie.\n\nI've heard it roaring in the night, breaching the water like a dolphin to let loose its terrible cry. One day it shall be mine, and then no one will doubt me.
03_greatcleave_body_08_02:
The Soulwardens, a noble order of Aeternum, are at times all that stand between the southern settlements and complete Corruption.

They operate in Corruption-heavy areas and dish out punishment towards those who would attack innocents and spread their Corrupted filth whether by offering power or force.

They may have just arrived but they're already doing some good for this island, so I've thrown my support behind them. Will you help me as well, Machera?

03_greatcleave_body_10_01:
Hey Bart, hope business is good. I just got myself a real nice job in Great Cleave. A hundred gold a week to guard a big empty house. What am I gonna guard it from? A snowman?

The guy who hired me, Iki, he’s a weird get. But then he gives me my advance—a bag of gold as big as my head! Remember when we only made two coins a month, and that to fight for our lives every day? 

-Corey
03_greatcleave_body_10_02:
I finally got so bored, I started making conversation with Iki. “Whattya need twelve rooms in this house for?” 

“Thirteen, not twelve.” He puts down his book like I’m bothering him, and he stamps on the floor. It sounds hollow, and that’s when I see the trap door. I go to open it. But the guy is fast, and he’s in front of me somehow. He moves his armchair over the trap door, so I can’t get to it anymore. 

I think his gold’s down there. I’m getting in if it kills me.
03_greatcleave_body_10_03: I ain’t sleeping right. I mean, I sleep on the job, if you can call a job sitting on a red fluffy chair thing with no arms. But at night, I hear things. Like rats, only this sounds a lot bigger than a rat. Something’s walking around on the ceiling, in the room down below.\n\nI’m gonna stay awake and see if I hear it again.
03_greatcleave_body_10_04: I heard that sound again. Got outta bed and knocked on the floor three times. Here I am, grown man, knocking on the floor.\n\nBut then I heard it. Three knocks, right under my feet. It wasn’t Iki, I checked, and he was asleep in his chair. I ain’t religious, but I prayed to anything that’d listen. I didn’t want to go back into my room. So I’m sleeping out here tonight in the big room.
03_greatcleave_body_10_05: I got in. Just like I thought, Iki goes out to the privy at night. \n\nIt was wide and dark down there, a cellar that covered the whole house. But it wasn’t empty. One corner was all tidy and decorated like a little girl’s room. I felt like something was watching me, so I got up the ladder and shut the trap door behind me. I’ll bring a lamp tomorrow night. I don’t think I’ll sleep.
03_greatcleave_body_10_06:
This time, candles were lit in the cellar. I heard a noise behind me–a little girl. Only her eyes and mouth, they’re sideways of what they should be. She starts screaming something fierce about Iki, her father.

The bastard himself drops down from the trap door, yelling “Stay away from her!” 

I saw her smile, right before she bit into my neck. I clawed up the ladder and ran to my room for my sword, thinking I’d cut their throats and be done with it. But in the steel, I saw it. My eyes, my mouth– they’re sideways now, just like hers.
03_greatcleave_body_10_07: I just felt it under my feet. Three knocks.
03_greatcleave_body_11_01:
The Ancients knew very well the power of Corruption far outstripped their own, but such gifts were reserved for humanity, and they brought only disaster upon themselves.

This is the hour long awaited, this is the moment we marshal the resources promised us, and assume command of the greatest military force the world has ever known.

(There is a rough sketch of the ruins, highlighting a fountain on the rise to the east.)
03_greatcleave_body_11_02: Here I come full circle, from laboring in the mines on behalf of our mistress, to now being in command of the entire operation. \n\nI shall bring new purpose to this enterprise as well. To the mistress, the motes of that infernal Azoth, but to me, the materials to construct the designs of the Ancients. History will be made here in Great Cleave.
03_greatcleave_body_11_03: The mistress is displeased with the fact we've found so little of the pure Azoth she seeks, but when I shared of our accomplishments towards my plan, I could see that I have once again proved to her that I am the one who can deliver this victory.\n\nShe's wisely committed even more of our forces to the cause. The ore flows like a river up to the summit. I will soon bask in the glory of my success.
03_greatcleave_body_11_04: Isabella has now become extremely interested in our enterprise here in Great Cleave, and where I hoped to only construct a handful of the Felportals, she has expanded the plan to include many more.\n\nThe final stonework for our first structure at the summit nears completion, and I will now leave this operation to my lieutenants and ascend to ensure the rituals are planned to perfection. The strength and pride I feel for this work makes up for whatever regrets I may have for my time in the Old World. This was my destiny all along.
03_greatcleave_body_11_05:
The priests tell me they have seen visions of the realm of Corruption, and though a hellscape it may be, I've come to see the truth of the Tempest's faith.

She says this is the birthright humanity was denied at the dawn of time, that the Ancients here expelled us from this Eden and planted the false mythologies in our minds to keep us in the dark.

The so-called Corruption is not some fiendish terror but rather the gift of godhead that we will now share across this island, and across the Earth.
03_greatcleave_body_11_06:
The time of confluence draws near. The portals are almost done. 

They have been placed all around the heights, and shall turn the land red with their glow. It will be glorious, a triumph of engineering and skill, of conquest and battle. 

We shall bring forth reinforcements that this land has never seen. At the highest point to the west shall we rise, and our power will flow out across the land in a crimson wave. 

Never again will we be lost, for we are united in our purpose.
03_greatcleave_body_12_01:
This journey will be the greatest test of the Soulwardens have ever undertaken. Not since we disbanded eons ago have we faced so great a peril. The stakes are high, for if we are to be able to fulfill our great purpose, and vouchsafe the people of Aeternum against threats lethal to even those who cheat death, we must be ready and able to meet such grave enemies head on. I only wish we had more time!

Our steadfast ally Grace is ready, but I sometimes fear her mission is her own, and that she lacks the commitment of those who have fully embraced our banner. Galahad’s faith has sustained him through so much already, and I suspect it shall continue. But the others… they are brave and committed, but may lack the strength and experience necessary to carry the day. I have no doubt that some day they would make excellent Soulwardens, but the crisis is here now, and we must fight or risk being swept away in the tide of coming Corruption.

Even more than Grace or Galahad or even me, there is one among us whose resolve and courage will be most pivotal to our success. One who began life on this island as a lowly castaway, but has become a pivotal force in all our struggles. Perhaps that is enough. In all my years, I have seen the power of one brave soul standing against many, and the power it can have to bend the shape of history. Perhaps that will be enough. Only time will tell.
03_greatcleave_body_12_02:
We have lost so much already. And yet I fear I we must press on. The consequences of defeat are too horrifying to contemplate. A good general knows to put his warriors’ needs before his own, and when to make hard choices, sacrificing even the security of those he protects if it means preserving the hope of a greater victory. Perhaps it is my own pride that spurs me forward, for I continue to gamble our very souls upon this gambit.

Fear grips me. I feel its icy grip upon my heart. All this time, as each of my old friends and allies faded to oblivion, unable to muter the will to even exist any longer, I clung to this plane through the belief that I was preserving something necessary. A last, fool’s hope for salvation against the myriad of strange and eternal forces arrayed against us.

Whether or not I succeeded, only time will tell. But I begin to suspect that I may no longer be here when the question is answered. For I am weary now, and doubt has begun its crippling march through my mind. And while it’s true that our hero’s arrival reignited my hopes, it has also made me yearn for the end of my journey. For the knowledge I carried is now in safe hands, and the need this old soul is no longer existential.

My old bones ache, and my fighting spirit stills with every passing hour. I have, perhaps one last war left in me, before I must rest. Long life on Aeternum always has a price, and, in the end, this land will have her ransom. One way or another.
03_greatcleave_body_13_01:
The loathsome Corrupted seem to have found something of value beneath the earth. Its nature, I can only guess, but I hold no doubt as to its consequence. If it can distract the Corrupted from their endless campaign against the people of Aeternum, then it can only spell disaster for the future of this New World.

This new leader among the Corrupted legions is cunning. He has shown not only the tremendous brutality expected from one possessed by malign forces, but also a willingness to bide his time and search out strategic advantages. If his arrival signals a shift in strategy away from raw, relentless attrition, I shudder to think what comes next. Our position against his hordes was already precarious. We can ill afford a redoubled effort.

Whatever they believe they have uncovered within these vast, Ancient ruins, one thing is sure: they cannot be allowed to retrieve it. The consequences for the balance of power in Aeternum could be calamitous. The Soulwardens must intervene before it is too late. I pray my pleas for aid reach Jonus and his brethren in time.
03_greatcleave_body_13_02:
I have learned that this new agent of the Corruption, this Captain Thorpe, is known to us. A new arrival here on Aeternum, he was in command of the very same ship that bore our hero across the Stormwall. A strange coincidence, to be sure. But I cannot help but see the hand of providence upon it.

The will of God is a mystery, even to those of us whose devotion remains pure. If our nemesis Thorpe came among us at the very same time as the one who has so often become our deliverance, perhaps it is wise to greet his ascendancy as a test. A test not only of our faith and will, but of our hero’s perseverance.

I am a warrior. I fight so that my body may act as a shield for those less able to stand against the forces of darkness. And even if is His will that I should fall, I shall embrace my destiny on the battlefield as God demands it. But I cannot help but think that it is not by my sword that this threat shall be vanquished. Our hero’s fate has come full circle, and that circle must close. One way or the other.

May we meet this challenge with God’s grace. And with all the courage and valor we can muster.
03_greatcleave_body_14_01:
I remember stepping onto the deck of the ship for the first time. The wind on my face felt like freedom. But… like anything else, it wasn’t everything it seemed.

Captain Grace was everything I dreamed of in a commanding officer. Fearless. Ambitious. Firm, but fair. When she chased those pirates into the storm, we all stood at our stations, sure she would bring us through to the other side. We were wrong.

Now we’re here, in a strange New World, where even death will not grant release. And what’s worse: danger lurks ‘round every corner. But There was work to be done, and so I traded my sailor’s smock for a pair of traveling boots and found something useful to do. Then I saw that bulletin in town. I’m not sure what I was expecting when I rallied to the banner of the Soulwardens, but the work is hard, and the danger is great.

Still, the people here have many burdens, and if I can ease some of them, that’s something. Even if it means my own burdens are endless. When I stepped onto her ship, I knew my ordinary life was over. But even in my wildest dreams, I never could have imagined this.

-Yash Zafar
03_greatcleave_body_14_02:
It turns out unending life means only unending tragedy. This place – this cruel New World – is a deranged farce. While it is true that Death has lost its teeth, there are a thousand ways the island will take from you. From the cracked and broken minds of those unfortunate enough to suffer the ages to the fraying souls of the Lost, one thing is clear: nothing lasts forever. Not even here. And worse still than any other doom is the Corruption: a parasitic curse that saps the will, dominates the mind, and steals the body.

Yet there is one advantage to a life made hollow: fear has abandoned me. Whatever comes; whatever torments await me at hands of the Corrupted, it will no doubt be a welcome reprieve from the ever-present yearning for what I once possessed. Love. Family. Honor. Dignity. Peace. All gone. All ripped from me like coins by a cutpurse.

When Yonas made his offer, I knew: it was my last chance to save what’s left of my soul from oblivion. To keep my body from wandering this God-forsaken land, an endless torment for those still clinging to what remains of their humanity. But I wonder how long my hate can keep me bonded to this cruel world. I suppose time will tell, for it is all that I have left to give.

-Judithe Owens
03_greatcleave_body_14_03:
The longer I linger here in this quixotic place, the more aware I become of the many ironies of old age among immortal kinsmen. In a life not to far past, I had begun to fear the uncertainties that come from the knowledge I might soon come face-to-face with my maker. So when I heard tales of a mystical island where time stands still, I leaped at the chance to stave off divine judgment. It was a foolish gambit if ever there was one, for I am certain the burden of my sin is no greater than that of any ordinary man. And eternity, as it turns out, is better weathered by the strong back of a young man.

Now, this aging, wretched body, wracked with the aches and pains of a life of hard work, is mine forever, and the relief which might have come from God’s forgiveness shall perhaps never be achieved. Therefore, if this place is to be my purgatory, I will pay the price for my hubris. When I heard the man, Yonas, had called on those brave enough to stand against the Corruption, I volunteered. Let this old man die, so the young may live another day. I can only hope that the wisdom of a long life has lent strength to my soul, and that our merciful Lord shall one day see fit to grant me clemency for subverting his divine provenance.

-Pedro Carillo
03_greatcleave_body_14_04:
Though my long life has been dedicated to the Flow, I confess, I find no stillness in this place. The relentless march rattles my bones and beats like a drum upon my heart. Though I came to Aeternum place by happenstance, I have come to believe that I was brought here to master serenity. To live in harmony with a place where time has ceased? Where the practicalities of life and the satisfaction of time well-spent are moot? That is a true challenge from the Way.

But now, something not of the Dao has come to this land. Something that seeks to pervert all that balance that the ebb and flow of Azoth has worked eternally to maintain. I can hear its pain and rage, roaring through the space between dimensions, calling out for a completeness it can never obtain. There is no harmony in this endless hunger.

The Corruption represents an end to all that is good and natural in this world: the consumption of that which time forsook, and its perversion as a thirst that cannot never be quenched. And so, against this damnation, I shall become the river, and ensure its advance proceeds upstream, against the current.

-Matsui O-fusa

0404a_constable_comment_rumors_a_new: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Ah, always good to welcome a guest to Oxboro, and one who appears to have means. <g id="female_youknows" />The signs are auspicious today, you know!

0404a_constable_comment_rumors_b_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Whatever you came to our fair city looking for, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'm happy to help. You've only to ask.

0404a_constable_comment_rumors_e_new: <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />In Oxboro? Don't be absurd. This city was founded by the Roman Legion centuries ago, <g id="male_willcoverit" />including yours truly and my valiant husband, Centurion Maecia.
0404a_constable_comment_rumors_f_new: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />In all this time, the city has never fallen. Yonas means well, but his fears are unfounded. <g id="male_shakehead" />That said, I don't know where he is. Ask Atticus at the inn. He'll know.

<g id="female_headnodding" />Now, you must play for the masses! To the tavern with you!
0404a_constable_tasktopic_returnstaff: Well that’s a serious face if I've ever seen one. Is anything amiss? Do I need to summon a guard?
0404a_constable_tasktopic_returnstaff_ne: <g id="female_youknow" />Hello, my busy friend! The signs are good today. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I feel quite certain today's the day Centurion Maecia will finally return home!
0405_0404_glowingore_description: An ore sample so brilliant it almost emits a soft glow. Gem shards can be seen within.
0405a_00_artificerpetrowski_comment_lock: My soul<g id="female_nodding" /> feels less heavy, less prone to the madness of being Lost. Thank you again for all you've done for Audrey and me.
0405a_00_artificerpetrowski_tasktopic_ad: <g id="female_recoilDisgustSmall" priority="high" />You smell of perfume. Have you been to see Huntsman Lee? <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />What does he want now?
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_commentscout: I assume<g id="female_thinking" /> you informed the Captain of the Guard about the Corruption, and he did nothing?
Typical.<g id="female_thinking" /> Everfall is blind to anything that doesn't glitter.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_init: Hmm,<g id="female_beckon" /> I have not seen your face around Everfall before. Tread carefully, adventurer. Danger lurks outside of the settlement.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offerflowers: That locket<g id="female_crying" /> reminds me of happier days.
Days when<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> we would go to Meadowlake Fishery to gather her favorite flowers, and watch the sun set across the water...
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offerkillnam: These foul<g id="female_smackfist" /> Corrupted will suffer as I have. I'm sure they can still feel pain. I'm sure they can howl with anguish.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offerpoisonc: I assume<g id="female_thinking" /> you informed the Captain of the Guard about the Corruption, and he did nothing?
Typical.<g id="female_thinking" /> Everfall is blind to anything that doesn't glitter.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offerreturnh: You have<g id="female_nodding" /> been a balm to my weary heart, {playerName}, but I…<g id="female_disappointed" /> I need some time alone.
Lee must<g id="female_nodding" /> be worried sick by now. You can go put his mind at ease.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offerscoutco: Hmm, it<g id="female_nodding" /> is fortuitous we've run into each other again. Tread carefully, adventurer. Danger lurks outside of the settlement.
0405a_01_artificerpetrowski_offertohunts: If you're<g id="female_nodding" /> still keen on destroying Corruption, go back to the settlement and update Huntsman Lee with our progress.
He will<g id="female_nodding" /> want to know what we've done.
0405a_02_artificerpetrowski_init: These foul<g id="female_smackfist" /> Corrupted will suffer as I have. I'm sure they can still feel pain. I'm sure they can howl with anguish.
0408_0101_ancientorb_description: A sphere crafted by the hands of the Ancients.
0409_0101_mixedseeds_description: A collection of pulsing red seeds that have been tainted by Corruption.
0410_00_barkeep_comment_savebar_a: I've been toying with the idea of renaming my bar. Perhaps after that fortuitous bottle of Commandaria.
0410_00_barkeep_comment_savebar_b: Or maybe after you, {playerName}? How'd you like your name on a pretty painted sign?
0410_00_barkeep_defaultdialog: Oh hello there! You are most welcome to the Everfall tavern. Sit down, imbibe, take a moment to enjoy life.
0410_01_barkeep_defaultdialog: Hello! Are you new in town? I think you must be. That's good, you know. Fresh faces, confidence.
0410_02_barkeep_defaultdialog: Can you believe it? Constable Maecia actually came down and drank an ale with me earlier. You and I - we made a difference!
0410_0408_tavernsupplies_description: Small river stones with superstitious etchings carved into them.
0410_0414_luckyrabbitsfoot_description: A fluffy foot of a rabbit who might not consider the encounter to be a lucky one.
0410_barkeep_taskconversation_playfortow: A bard? Good. I could use someone to liven up the place a bit.
Take your place by the fire, love.
0410_barkeep_tasktopic_playfortown_a: Oh. A shame the usual crowd wasn't here to enjoy that, but I'll be singing your praises.
0410_barkeep_tasktopic_playfortown_b: I hope you can come back and play another night.
0410_barkeep_tasktopic_playfortown_respo: Is that their name? I'll be sure to ask other bards if they know any of Marsyas's songs.
I appreciate you breaking up the quiet with that bit of joy.
0410a_barkeep_tasktopic_savebar_response: Jacob? Jacob Evans? Good gracious, that poor kind man.
He's suffered so, yet he still thinks of me and my humble little establishment.
0411_00_stranger_defaultdialog: Yes. I can see that you're new to Aeternum. Strong arms though - a warrior. Probably some heads for you to bop somewhere then. Good day!
0411_0101_dracodisk_description: A flat clay disk with a rendering of the night sky.
0411_0101_oriondisk_description: A flat clay disk with a rendering of the night sky.
0411_0101_perseusdisk_description: A flat clay disk with a rendering of the night sky.
0411_01_stranger_defaultdialog: I already know what Magistrate Clark hopes for - my help in defending against the Corruption. I just have to decide whether that interests me.
0411_02_stranger_defaultdialog: You know, we're capable of doing great things together. Your brawn, my brain. Nothing can stop us.
0411_03_stranger_defaultdialog: I've been waiting for you some time, you know. Quite a compliment, I should say.
0411_0409_astrolabeleo_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0409_astrolabelupus_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0409_astrolabenorma_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0410_canisstarchart_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0410_herculesstarchart_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0410_ursastarchart_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0411_carinavolvelle_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0411_lacertavolvelle_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0411_monocerosvolvelle_description: An Ancient device used to make astronomical measurements.
0411_0412_armillarysphere_description: A model of the heavenly bodies consisting of several concentric rings to represent orbital patterns.
0411_0413_b_description: Collect the Foreman's Ledger in Amrine Excavation. Report back to William Heron in the Everfall Settlement when your task is complete.
0411_0413_c_proposal_a: Simon led the expedition into the Amrine Excavation of Windsward many years ago, and never returned.
0411_0413_c_proposal_b: I still say the real genius behind Simon was his Foreman, who mapped every Ancient Ruin in all Aeternum.
0411_0413_c_proposal_next_a: Who knows? He never returned from the Excavation either. I assume they're both dead... or worse.
0411_0413_c_proposal_next_b: Say though, if some bold soul such as yourself were to get me the Foreman's Ledger, I would offer a handsome reward.
0411_0413_e_incomplete_a: The Amrine Excavation is a dangerous digsite, so you will likely need friends to safely explore it.
0411_0413_f_complete_a: Is that it? His ledger? Fantastic! With this, I can learn a great deal!
0411_0413_f_complete_b: Some of the notes he made here… fascinating. Who knew?
0411_0413_foremansledger_description: A ledger containing maps and information about Amrine Excavation.
0411_0414_b_description: Collect the Starstone Diadem from Greundgul the Regent inside the Shattered Obelisk. Report back to William Heron in the Everfall Settlement when your task is complete.
0411_0414_c_proposal_a: Yes, the Foreman's notes suggest the existence of a side entrance that could actually allow a small group to get inside.
0411_0414_c_proposal_b: Can you imagine the secrets hidden in there? You must go there for me! You must!
0411_0414_c_proposal_next_a: The ledger speaks of a Starstone Diadem, apparently an artifact from the Ancient ruling class.
0411_0414_c_proposal_next_b: The power of such a thing would only be surpassed by its value to my research. Recover the Diadem for me, and I will give you its equivalent in exchange.
0411_0414_e_incomplete_a: Oh, the possibilities! We could be unearthing an artifact that helps us fight the Corrupted, or at the very least gives us insight into the Ancients.
0411_0414_f_complete_a: This is truly a momentous find. This Starstone Diadem seems to have denoted an Ancient Guardian of incredibly high ranking, a ruler of some sort!
0411_0414_f_complete_b: A regent, perhaps? Oh, I simply must get to studying it further.
0411_0414_starstonediadem_description: A sparkling crown with a Starstone in the center.
0411_04_stranger_defaultdialog: This is truly groundbreaking work we're accomplishing here. Stay at my side, and the power of the stars will soon be at our disposal.
0411_05_stranger_defaultdialog: It all makes sense now. The towers, the stars, the guardians. The question is simply - what changed?
0411_06_stranger_defaultdialog: Now, if I can just figure out how to activate this sphere. It won't take long! Not for me!
0411_07_stranger_defaultdialog: Now, if I can just figure out how to activate this sphere. It won't take long! Not for me!
0411_08_stranger_defaultdialog_a: You've done so much for me and my research, friend.
0411_08_stranger_defaultdialog_b: You remind me of one of my former colleagues, Simon Grey. We had a bit of a rivalry, as you might imagine.
0411_09_stranger_defaultdialog_a: Based on the Foreman's Ledger you recovered, it's clear that the Amrine Excavation delved into an underground network of ruins that actually led to the Shattered Obelisk!
0411_09_stranger_defaultdialog_b: I knew there was more to that place!
0411_10_stranger_defaultdialog_a: Together, we have uncovered more insights into the Ancients than anyone else in Aeternum history.
0411_10_stranger_defaultdialog_b: Hear that, Simon Grey? Oh sorry, that's disrespectful, isn't it? But who cares? I don't!
0411a_00_williamheron_01_offerobeliskdef: Since you are clearly no ordinary muscle for hire, would you be interested in collaborating with me?
Think about the possibilities. Your brawn, my brain, and a host of mysteries to solve.
0411a_00_williamheron_02_offerlightbeaco: Let us assume that the Ancients were not wasteful in what they built.
Here's a tentative hypothesis: the towers only function when they are activated. The guardians merely deter intruders from tampering with them.
0411a_00_williamheron_03_commentlightbea: At the very least, lighting up the towers proves they have some active function.
They are more than mere monuments to the Ancients' power, and all my efforts haven't been a waste of time.
0411a_00_williamheron_04_comment_placesp: It wasn't all in vain. With a working armillary sphere, I can start making sense of the Ancients' view of the heavens.
Or trying to, at any rate. It may take me several more lifetimes.
0411a_00_williamheron_04_comment_yonas_a: You are acquainted with that elderly chap, Yonas? He had some choice words about my "meddling" with the obelisk.
0411a_00_williamheron_04_comment_yonas_b: Who would have suspected he could shout with such force?
0411a_01_williamheron_00_init_a: Towers in the earth, constellations above, a universe of endless void…
0411a_01_williamheron_00_init_b: Something is missing... Some piece that I've carelessly overlooked. What is it?
0411a_01_williamheron_01_offercollectazo: Hmm. Perhaps it's time to try a different approach. Gather information from a different source.
What have you been doing with the Ancient guardians who try to attack you?
0411a_01_williamheron_02_offerplacespher: Now, the moment of truth, when all my theories are put to the test.
Tell me, have you ever heard of an armillary sphere?
0422_00_innkeep_defaultdialog: Welcome to 'The Autumn Rest'! Always a colorful place to be. You here to check in? Be my guest… literally!
0422_01_innkeep_defaultdialog: You've become a real regular around here, haven't you? Hope this place is starting to feel like home. Say though, are you more of a townie? Or do you venture out into the great beyond?
0422_02_innkeep_defaultdialog: Now that you caught a glimpse of Windsward, I trust you see why Everfall is a damn nice place. The Autumn Rest is the place you can fall like a leaf into your bed anytime!
0422_03_innkeep_defaultdialog: One of these days I'm going to take a vacation, maybe even go as far south as First Light. I've been squirreling away Azoth and gold for years. I've earned a vacation, I think.
0422_04_innkeep_defaultdialog: You know, I'm never one to turn away a good paying customer. But you been here long enough - might want to look into buying a house, putting down roots.
0423_0101_catchclam: Catch a Clam in Salt Water
0423_0101_catchsnail: Catch a Snail in Fresh Water
0423_0101_d_01_taskfishingcatchfish: Catch a Snail in Fresh Water and salvage it to create {itemName}
0423_0101_d_02_taskfishingcatchfish: Catch a Clam in Salt Water and salvage it to create {itemName}
0423_0101_fq03_complete_available_respon: Did Ruby put you up to this? Bah! I don't know why she thinks I need the help...
Don't get too cocky just because you got some bait.
0423_0101_fq03_incomplete: Master Fisher Clemenson can be a bit rough around the edges but I consider her one of my closest allies in this strange land.
0423_0101_fq03_objective_desc: Catch one Snail in Fresh Water and one Clam in Salt Water to salvage them for bait for Master Fisher Ruby and deliver them to Master Fisher Clemenson in Monarch's Bluff.
0423_0101_fq03_prompt: "Yes. Master Fisher Shields sent me to you."
0423_0101_fq03_proposal_a: In fresh water the more common baits you can acquire are Snails and in ocean water, Clams.
0423_0101_fq03_proposal_b: My colleague in Elysian Wilds, Master Fisher Clemenson, would greatly appreciate this ocean water bait being delivered to her.
0423_0101_fq03_proposal_next: Don't tell her I said this, but she's been having some trouble getting bites lately.
0423_0101_fq03_proposal_prompt: "Why am I fishing for a Master Fisher?"
0424_00_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1: Winter Convergence is upon us. You lack the strength of heart to be able to assist me, but if you come back stronger, I have a request for you.
0424_0104_d_01_havegleamite1: Gather a fallen Gleamite Crystal from a Gleamite Shower at night, or investigate the site mentioned by the Winter Wanderer
0424_0105_d_01_havepresent1: Gather a Lost Present from around Aeternum, or investigate the site mentioned by the Winter Wanderer
0424_0108_d_01_haveyetihorn: Locate and put an end to the Winter Warrior's Forever Winter in Great Cleave, Ebonscale Reach, or Brimstone Sands and retrieve his Hailspikes as proof of victory
0424_01_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_a: Once again we see the two sides of winter converging: the warmth of kinship and the bitter cold of ice.
0424_01_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_b: Imagine Aeternum, covered in rime and frost in every corner… This could be our fate in the Forever Winter.
0424_02_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_a: Yeti use winter magic to spread ice and snow. This ice comes alive, steals presents from humans.
0424_02_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_b: Without joy, how will we fight off Forever Winter?
0424_03_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_a: Many ways to get to Aeternum, but no way out.
0424_03_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_b: At least here we have Gleamite Crystals. They radiate warmth without burning, and are the bane of the Winter Warrior.
0424_04_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_a: Each time Warrior is brought down he is weaker.
0424_04_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_b: The weaker the Warrior is, the better for Aeternum. This I know from my Mirgos memories, my human memories you helped bring back.
0424_05_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_a: Your triumph over Winter Warrior keeps back the fate of Forever Winter.
0424_05_yeti_ww_npc_defaultdialog1_b: Save presents, mine Gleamite Crystals, and challenge Warrior for the sake of warmth, light, and all that is good.
0424_2022_wc_01_complete: This year has much waiting for you if you bring warmth back to Aeternum. Winter, cold, and eternal darkness can be held back by you.
0424_2022_wc_01_description: Welcome to the Winter Convergence! Check out the Holiday Huts in the Winter Villages to see what items can be crafted there.
0424_2022_wc_01_incomplete: Village here has huts. Huts have shiny coins. Trade coins for goods. Many, many goods! They will help your journey.
0424_2022_wc_01_proposal: We must chase away cold. First, by warming hearts. {playerName}, are you prepared to do whatever it takes to save Aeternum?
0424_2022_wc_01_proposal_next: Make yourself at ease in this village. Remember what you fight for. Holiday Huts will have shiny coins to give warmth to island.
0424_2022_wc_02_complete_a: This gift… makes me remember… I was lost on a mountain, in a terrible winter storm.
0424_2022_wc_02_complete_b: A bright star led me into a cave. When I came out the other side, I was here in Aeternum.
0424_2022_wc_02_description: Find one of the many Lost Presents around Aeternum and return it to the Winter Wanderer in the Winter Village.
0424_2022_wc_02_incomplete: Have you found wayward presents? Some suspend in air, locked into place by winter magics.
0424_2022_wc_02_proposal: Collect presents taken by other Yeti and their ice creatures. Devious minds scatter presents all over the island.
0424_2022_wc_02_proposal_next: Winter Warrior, one of dread, commands it so. Warrior does all he can to usher in Forever Winter. Must be stopped.
0424_2022_wc_03_complete: Thank you, {playerName}. You have done much, but I am afraid I must ask for more help still. The Winter Warrior must fall.
0424_2022_wc_03_description: Mine a fallen Gleamite Crystal and return it to the Winter Wanderer in the Winter Village.
0424_2022_wc_03_incomplete_a: I have marked on your map where a Gleamite Crystal can be found.
0424_2022_wc_03_proposal: Tinkling, ringing with the sound of laughter are these crystals. Their heat harms the Winter Warrior as they fall from the sky to light the land.
0424_2022_wc_03_proposal_next: I do not know. Heavens? Clouds? Who is to say? All that is important is gathering crystals to weaken Warrior's grip on island.
0424_2022_wc_04_complete: He is defeated! Oh joy, oh beautiful day! A peaceful Convergence is possible now. Should he appear again, you know what to do.
0424_2022_wc_04_description: Locate the Winter Warrior's spread of the Forever Winter and collect his Hailspikes as proof of victory against the chiling threat.
0424_2022_wc_04_incomplete_a: The Winter Warrior is formidable foe. Take friends, allies, and all you can to defeat him.
0424_2022_wc_04_proposal: Perhaps. Do not fret. Beast or man, The Winter Warrior must be taken down. Are you willing to accept the challenge?
0424_2022_wc_04_proposal_next_a: Ice magics allow for Warrior to travel this year.
0424_2022_wc_04_proposal_next_b: You will know him by icy winds and massive spikes. Bring one back to me so heart can be put to ease.
0425_0101_truffle_description: A heavy, fragrant mushroom that is used for a variety of delicious purposes.
0425_0101_truffles_complete_a: Here's<g id="g_female_takeitem5s" priority="high" /> my new friend, right here! All the truffles I lost and then some!<g id="g_female_youknow" /> I hope it wasn't too hard!
0425_0101_truffles_complete_b: Keep<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> that sickle for your troubles, and if you make a habit of Harvesting herbs and such, we'll cross paths again, no doubt.
0425_0101_truffles_desc: Collect any Truffles you can find in the forest and bring them to Hapless Howe in the settlement. Look for any Herbs or Berries you can gather as well.
0425_0101_truffles_equip_sickle: Equip the Sickle from Herbalist Howe
0425_0101_truffles_incomplete_a: Sad<g id="g_male_hopeless" /> days are these when a traveling Herbalist has to rely on the goodwill of a stranger to make ends meet.
0425_0101_truffles_proposal_a: How<g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" /> should I know? Do I look like some<g id="g_female_taptemple" priority="high" bin="1" bout="2" /> kind of "boar-mind-reader"? Not me. I'm just a simple Traveling Herbalist.
0425_0101_truffles_proposal_b: Tell you this much, however, the beasts<g id="g_male_dismissgetlost1" /> have ruined me for the season.
0425_0101_truffles_proposal_next_a: You mean...<g id="g_male_convince01" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> you'd help old Hapless Howe?<g id="g_male_nod2" /> Why yes! You're a saint! Take my<g id="g_male_itemgiveright" priority="high" /> sickle, hunt up some Truffles, and bring them to the settlement.
0425_0101_truffles_proposal_next_b: Gather<g id="g_male_convince01" /> any herbs or berries you see for yourself as well - they'll fetch a gold or two at the Trading Post!
0425_herbalist_greet_00_a: Did you<g id="g_female_youknow" /> see my cart? The wilds of Aeternum have never been safe,<g id="g_male_throwarms" /> but the roads?
0425_herbalist_greet_00_b: Never<g id="g_male_hopeless" /> seen anything like this before today! Vicious<g id="g_male_clenchfistsangry" /> boars came out of nowhere - ate all my truffles!
0425_herbalist_greet_01: Oh,<g id="g_female_nodshrugokay" /> I think we'll be seeing more of each other down the road a piece. Yes, indeed. Always down the road a piece.
0428_jones_house_response: Dare I say three is not enough? I long for a house in every territory, so that my trading empire can flourish to its fullest extent, but I have been told time and again that I simply must abide by the current laws…
0428_jones_market_response: The joy of speculation! The ups and downs of the market! The thrill of finding out how much solvent is worth today! Trade is the lifeblood of Aeternum, if you don't have your finger on its pulse, you just aren't living!
0428_jones_tips_response: Buy low, sell high. If at all possible discover what people want before they want it and buy it all up, thus creating a shortage in the market that only you can fill. That one's a bit trickier though...
0430_0101_b_description: Maximus Marcellus invites you to participate in a team versus team extravaganza. \nUse the Activities Menu to queue for a match
0430_0101_c_proposal: What is the Arena? Why, it is in the grand tradition of my motherland of Rome, it is a battle spectacular of two teams going head-to-head in combat! It requires skill, coordination, and an unshakable mettle to participate.
0430_0101_c_proposal_next: You can sign up for the Arena grounds whenever you like, fight head-to-head for everlasting glory! \n[Use the Activities Menu to queue for a 3v3 match]
0430_0101_d_01_enterarena: Enter the Arena via 'Activities' in the Menu
0430_0101_d_02_arenawin: Win an Arena Match to prove your valor
0430_0101_e_incomplete: What are you waiting for? Get out there and pummel!  [Use the Activities Menu to queue for a 3v3 match]
0430_0101_f_complete: What a show! I was on the edge of my seat the entire time! You, my friend, are a sure addition to the Arena roster. Return to fight any time, you are always welcome here my fearsome champion!
0436a_00_tamraayad_01_offerrecovervase: I've gone and spoiled everything, absolutely everything with my clumsiness. Have you also come to laugh at me?
0436a_00_tamraayad_02_comment_vaserecove: This vase is even grander than the one I broke. Priceless, even.
And those fascinating symbols must mean something. They can't merely be decorative…
0436a_01_tamraayad_00_init: Just look at them, shoving tentpoles into the ground and tearing up the earth! Have they no respect for this ancient place?
0436a_01_tamraayad_01_offerancienttalism: Hello again, friend. Imagine meeting you here.
I found some antiquarians to help me assess the vase we found, and… well... they convinced me to join them. I'm working on some field studies here.
0436a_01_tamraayad_02_comment_ancienttal: Without your aid, I never would've had the courage to pursue my true passion.
Perhaps with the passage of time, my family will finally understand what they have overlooked all these years. I am my own person.
0437a_00_felixlivius_comment_bragtown: There you are, my bear-hunting friend! Up for another round?
0437a_00_felixlivius_offerbragtown_a: Ha ha! The second best part of being mauled, right after the thrill, is the bragging rights! You know who this will really impress? Huntsman Lee.
0437a_00_felixlivius_offerbragtown_b: Odnell's an odd man but he appreciates a lurid story.
0437a_00_felixlivius_offerdefeatbear_b: Ha ha ha ha! Death escapes us on this island, so why not go up against a bear? Can you<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> prove yourself tough enough to withstand the razor sharp teeth and claws of a killer?
0438a_00_jacobevans_01_offergetmead_a: Leave me be. What's the point in dragging myself down the road?
0438a_00_jacobevans_01_offergetmead_b: It'll be the same no matter what I do. Thieves, pirates, and murderers without a scrap of mercy for a poor soul.
0438a_00_jacobevans_02_offergetwine_a: Since you seem to have a shred of kindness, I thought maybe… you could find my missing wine shipment?
0438a_00_jacobevans_02_offergetwine_b: It was stolen weeks ago. Probably gone or drunk now, but I thought I'd ask.
0438a_00_jacobevans_03_offergetport_a: I remember a face, and a laugh crueler than the Devil's. Admiral Arias, at the Arias Encampment.
0438a_00_jacobevans_03_offergetport_b: He was the first to come after me on the road. I hear he's Lost now, but it's a cold comfort.
0438a_00_jacobevans_04_offersavebar_a: I dare not risk so valuable a vintage. If I tried to carry it, with my luck? Something terrible would happen.
0438a_00_jacobevans_04_offersavebar_b: Can you bring this priceless treasure to Polly? By itself, it'll erase all her debts!
0438a_00_jacobevans_init_a: Polly's saved, my wares are restored, and Admiral Arias hasn't been scouring the roads of late.
0438a_00_jacobevans_init_b: All of this may seem a small kindness to you, friend. But to me, it meant everything.
0439a_00_anwirhughes_01_offergetreagents: Twenty coin, only twenty coin for a bottle of Anwir's Elixir. Thirty-five for two, even cheaper for repeat customers.
You, there! How would you like to feel younger, stronger, and better looking today?
0439a_01_anwirhughes_01_offersecretingre: My perceptive friend, fancy meeting you again. Do you remember my Ancient Miracle Elixir?
0439a_01_anwirhughes_02_offerdeliverpoti: Finally, we reach my favorite part. Distributing free samples to needy townsfolk.
Once they've had a taste, they'll be throwing coin at me for more! Do let me know how it goes.
0439a_01_anwirhughes_init_a: Ahh, the irreplaceable smell of nature. It always puts pep in my step and makes me feel young again.
0439a_01_anwirhughes_init_b: If I could find a way to bottle that scent, I'd make a fortune!
0439a_02_anwirhughes_init_a: What next? Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir is all very well and good, but customers crave novelty.
0439a_02_anwirhughes_init_b: Crystals and gemstones, perhaps? Everybody loves a big, sparkling rock.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_comment_chooseins: I must ask your patience while I compose. My process can be a lengthy one, and I wish to do so in solitude.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_comment_earnaudie: Saira winked at me as I walked past. She knows something, and she seems very smug about it.
I confess, I am having difficulty containing my eagerness.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_comment_earnpatro: Thank you, my dear friend. Our mutual efforts have succeeded. I stand poised on the precipice of greatness, with my patron at my back.
Rest assured, I will not forget your part in this. I shall see your name praised.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_comment_playforto: I hope we have done enough to spread my fame. Without that reputation, I fear I will never earn a proper patron.
My duty to my Mistress is wearing me thin.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_offer_chooseinstr: Hmm, hmm hmm… No, more lilting. Perhaps with a key change. No, let it breathe. Oh! You caught me unawares. How may I be of assistance?
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_offer_earnaudienc: This is terrible, my friend. I heard that my Mistress was interested in backing my pen name and revealed to her that it was me. I had expected…
At any rate… my pay has been docked, and I am not to speak of it again.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_offer_earnpatron_: Look at this… the embossed wax seal, the heft of the paper… even the ink is gilt in gold. Every detail screams affluence, and yet it is hardly overt.
This letter summons me to Lord Shen's side.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_offer_playfortown: Ah! There you are. My magnum opus is complete! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I shall call it… Winds of Autumn!
Now I must ensure it is heard far and wide. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Without popular excitement, I will never gain the favor of a suitable patron.
0440a_00_atticusdelphi_tasktopic_msqrumo: If you are looking for my proprietors, I am afraid they are not taking appointments today. Unless there is something else I can assist you with?
Or perhaps you're looking for something a little more nuanced? Do tell.
If you're here to request a ballad dedicated to your family's glory, you'll have to get in line. Half of Oxboro is acting on that craze just now.
0440a_01_atticusdelphi_init_a: Oh, I cannot bear the thought of facing Lady Sacco myself. Lord Shen reassured me that there would be no need.
0440a_01_atticusdelphi_init_b: What if she chooses not to part with me? Will she truly stoop to quashing my life's ambition?

<g id="female_nodYes" />That skill may very well come in handy in this town.
0441a_00_sairayangandul_comment_earnaudi: You best<g id="female_headnodding" /> believe I am going to dangle that little favor over Atticus for a good while yet.
