04a_side04_04_killnamed_proposal_next_a: I searched<g id="female_disappointed" /> for weeks, but she never returned to me, and no one could find any trace of her.
04a_side04_04_killnamed_proposal_next_b: Defeating<g id="female_disappointed" /> the Corrupted that did this to her won't bring her back, but I<g id="female_smackfist" /> don't care. I want those monsters to feel even a sliver of my pain.
04a_side04_05_getlocket_complete: What are<g id="female_lookforwardWonder" /> you holding? Could it be…? I thought the locket was lost forever. <g id="female_sobbing" />Thank you for finding it. Oh, my Audrey...
04a_side04_05_getlocket_desc: Return the Lost Locket to Tekla Petrowski.
04a_side04_05_getlocket_incomplete: [The locket is dusty and lonely. Perhaps it will find a new home with Tekla Petrowski.]
04a_side04_05_getlocket_proposal: [You pocket the locket with the intent of showing it to Tekla Petrowski.]
04a_side04_06_getflowers_complete_a: Your willingness<g id="female_nodding" /> to help a stranger has taught me much.
04a_side04_06_getflowers_complete_b: It's not<g id="female_nodding" /> just about hating the Corrupted, it's about loving the living while you can.
04a_side04_06_getflowers_desc: Touched by your return of the locket, Tekla Petrowski wishes for you to gather a bouquet of Meadowlake Flowers at Meadowlake Fishery to remember Audrey.
04a_side04_06_getflowers_incomplete_a: I have<g id="female_nodding" /> already asked so much of you, but here I am, asking for the tiniest bit of comfort.
04a_side04_06_getflowers_proposal_a: No.<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> It is too painful. But if you find yourself heading in the direction of Meadowlake Fishery perhaps you could gather a bouquet for her? He he!
04a_side04_06_getflowers_proposal_b: No matter<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> where she is, what became of her… I think Audrey would like that.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_complete_a: You're back!<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" /> You must've done something incredible to soothe the tempest in Tekla's heart.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_complete_b: Losing Audrey<g id="male_wipetear" /> nearly destroyed her, and I felt so damn helpless watching it happen. Thank you. <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Because of you, I didn't lose another friend.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_desc: Relay what has happened with Tekla Petrowski to Odnell Lee in the Everfall Settlement.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_incomplete_a: Lee is<g id="female_nodding" /> a kind man, and he's fussed over me ever since I lost Audrey to the Corrupted.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_proposal_a: Hmm…<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> Not today. But perhaps tomorrow, or the day after that.
04a_side04_07_tohuntsman02_proposal_b: You needn't<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> worry about me. You've done enough, and I promise not to forget your kindness.
04a_side05_01_01a_talktomagistrate: Ask to borrow an instrument from Magistrate Clark
04a_side05_01_01b_talktoconstable: Ask to borrow an instrument from Constable Maecia
04a_side05_01_01c_searchinn: Search the tavern for an instrument
04a_side05_01_02_container_playinstrumen: Play A Song on Each Instrument:
04a_side05_01_chooseinstrument_complete_: Ahhh… there it is. The flute produces the most whimsical sound. I can elicit soul-stirring melodies from such an instrument.
Yes, this will do nicely. You hold onto it, for now. We will return it later, along with the rest.
04a_side05_01_chooseinstrument_desc: Longing to rise above his station as a butler, Atticus Delphi wishes to share his musical talents with the world. With so many instruments to choose from, he is struck with a moment of indecision.
04a_side05_01_chooseinstrument_incomplet: A guitar may very well be suitable, but I will know the true voice of my work when I hear it.
04a_side05_01_chooseinstrument_proposal_: Alas, I should have chosen a more private locale for this.
Could you kindly forget what you saw and heard? My mistress would be quite irate, if she learned I've been sneaking away to work on such a frivolous pursuit.
Excellent. I have a guitar in my possession, but there may be a more fitting instrument for my work.
The townsfolk have instruments we can borrow. Would you be so kind as to procure a handful, and play them for me?
If only my duty to my mistress did not prevent it. To be free of her, I must earn another patron.
To complete my greatest work, I first need to hear it aloud. Which means, I must select an instrument! Can you play?
04a_side05_02_playfortown_complete_a: How did it go? Did they like it? Did their eyes shine? Perhaps shed a tear?
04a_side05_02_playfortown_complete_b: I wish I could have seen their reactions for myself, but there are more important things. <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Did it make an impact? Is there now a reputation I must uphold?
04a_side05_02_playfortown_complete_next_: What a relief. Even though I find great joy in composing, there is always a moment where I fear I am simply a butler, and nothing more.
I will approach Mistress Sacco now, I think. Maybe she will offer to sponsor my music!
04a_side05_02_playfortown_complete_promp: "I'd say so. They loved the song."
04a_side05_02_playfortown_desc: What good is a composition if it goes unheard? Play the Magnum Opus throughout the town in a grand debut as a composer!
04a_side05_02_playfortown_incomplete_a: If you want to embellish a little, perhaps you could also mention how prolific my work is.
04a_side05_02_playfortown_proposal_a: I cannot be the one to deliver my work unto the world. To gain a reputation for being a GREAT composer, we must create the impression that my music has spread far and wide.
04a_side05_02_playfortown_proposal_b: In this business, as in many others, reputation is everything.
04a_side05_02_playfortown_proposal_next_: Very astute! I would like you to play the part of a traveling bard. Find individuals of influence throughout the town and play my melody before them.
Ensure that you mention my pen name: Composer Marsyas.
04a_side05_02_playfortown_proposal_promp: "So this is where I come in."
04a_side05_03_01_talktosaira: Speak to the Ou Family maid
04a_side05_03_03c_craftitem: Repair the Broken Pocket Watch at a Workshop
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_complete_a: I detect triumph in your demeanor. I do not know what you had to do to secure this opportunity for me, but I suspect victory is close at hand.
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_desc: With his reputation growing with each passing day, now is the time to seek a patron. One does not simply approach the patriarch of a great house on a whim, however…
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_incomplete_a: There are other avenues, but they are less socially acceptable.
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_proposal_a: Find a patron without her, obviously. She does not own me.
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_proposal_b: I did some sleuthing and discovered that the Ou family recently lost a musician in their employ. If we tread carefully, I can present myself to the patriarch.
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_proposal_next: One never approaches a noble personage without an introduction. There are only a handful of people who can arrange one. We need to find out who they are.
Start with their maid, Saira. She always has her ear to the ground.
04a_side05_03_earnaudience_start_prompt: "Harsh. What are you going to do?"
04a_side05_04_00_task_approachoushen: Attend an audience with Lord Shen
04a_side05_04_01c_talktoconcetta: Ask Lady Sacco for her terms
04a_side05_04_02a_talktooushen_02: Relay her response to Lord Shen
04a_side05_04_02c_talktoconcetta_02: Return to Lady Sacco with the offer
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_complete: You return. Well? Shall I deliver the good news to Atticus?
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_complete_next_a: Impertinent, but I am in a pleasant mood. I will divulge.
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_complete_next_b: I gave her a handsome estate in Windsward and her pick of personal attendants. A balm to her wounded pride, and I can dismiss one of my more irksome charges.
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_desc: The great family Sacco will not be humiliated so easily. With Atticus bound to his contractual duties, his patron may be the only one who can set him free to practice his craft.
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_incomplete_a: I am so nervous I could sweat through my socks. How humiliating would that be?
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_proposal_a: Thank you… my heart is all aflutter. Perhaps you could act as my associate and accompany me?
04a_side05_04_earnpatron_proposal_b: I know this may be beneath you, but think of how it will reflect on the reputation we worked so hard to build!
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_complete_a: Haha! You've done it! Good for you, showing some true brawn.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_complete_b: Next time? Try fighting it with no weapons at all. Bare fists versus bear fists. <g id="male_laughCocky" />Ha ha ha! You'll never know a sweeter victory.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_desc: Felix Livius challenges you to "wrestle" a bear for the raw thrill of it all.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_incomplete: Still hanging around here? You ought to be wrestling a bear, and we both know it. Scared?
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_proposal_a: Almost every day! It's a great way to wake yourself up, squaring up with a fuzzy behemoth of nature.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_proposal_b: Doesn't even hurt after awhile. All I can feel when I bring a beast down is the sting of victory.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_proposal_next_a: Ha ha! Yes, that's the spirit! There is one who patrols his territory northwest of here, and he's a fearsome bugger.
04a_side06_01_defeatbear_proposal_next_b: So, what are you waiting for? Get out there and have the battle of your immortal life!
04a_side06_02_townbrag_complete: You did<g id="male_whattheheckBig" /> what, with a WHAT?! A bear! Now, that takes serious guts. Did you wind up spilling yours in the fight?
04a_side06_02_townbrag_complete_next_a: You bet! Good news<g id="male_goodnews" /> is sparse these days. Tell me everything. Every crunch of bone and spray of blood, and I'll make sure the people of Oxboro hear it all.
04a_side06_02_townbrag_complete_next_b: Maybe<g id="male_smile" /> with a few small embellishments, if you catch my meaning.
04a_side06_02_townbrag_desc: Talk to Huntsman Lee in the Everfall Settlement about your bear experience.
04a_side06_02_townbrag_incomplete: Lost, are we? Huntsman Lee is in Oxboro, so he shouldn't be too hard to find. Go report your victory!
04a_side06_02_townbrag_proposal_a: Ha ha! I'm just an enthusiast. Odnell, though? Cares too much about appearances. But Aeternum's full of all sorts.
04a_side06_02_townbrag_proposal_b: Go tell him you defeated a bear, and he'll make sure everyone in Oxboro knows it.
04a_side07_01_getmead_complete_a: My… mead? I can't believe my eyes.
04a_side07_01_getmead_complete_b: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. I really did think you were having a laugh at me earlier. But you meant every word you said.
04a_side07_01_getmead_desc: The Lost Pirates of the Riverworn Grotto have stolen Jacob Evans' last shipment of mead, driving him to the brink of despair.
04a_side07_01_getmead_incomplete_a: Polly deserves better than me. Someone strong, brave, and true of heart.
04a_side07_01_getmead_proposal_a: I should. I would, if not for dear Polly. Her business depends on the mead that I bring, but I'm just a porter.
04a_side07_01_getmead_proposal_b: I can't stop those wretched pirates from taking everything and stabbing me through. I've lost count...
04a_side07_01_getmead_proposal_next_a: Hope's cruel on Aeternum, stranger. If you don't learn that now, you will soon.
04a_side07_01_getmead_proposal_next_b: Go, do whatever folly strikes your fancy. Maybe I'll still be here when you return.
04a_side07_02_getwine_complete_a: Oh my… That's almost every missing bottle. I don't know what to say.
04a_side07_02_getwine_complete_b: I haven't much to repay you, not after what you've done for me.
04a_side07_02_getwine_complete_next_a: Humph. Only some wine to you. To me, it's hope! To my dear Polly, a chance to keep her head above water.
04a_side07_02_getwine_complete_next_b: God, it hurts to hope after so long. Like putting a chilled hand too close to the flame.
04a_side07_02_getwine_desc: With his mead returned, Jacob Evans turns his attention to his next source of woe: a shipment of missing wine.
04a_side07_02_getwine_incomplete: Please, if you can't find the wine, just… leave me to my fate. The mead's not enough to save Polly's bar. Nothing I do is ever enough.
04a_side07_02_getwine_proposal_a: Look at me, friend. A lonely man with his wits barely about him, marching from one town to the next on his own two legs.
04a_side07_02_getwine_proposal_b: I'm an easy target no matter how careful I am, or which road I take.
04a_side07_03_getport_complete_a: Um… Let me see the label on that old bottle. It's covered in dust, but this writing… could it be?
04a_side07_03_getport_complete_b: Ha ha ha ha ha ha... It is! The wine of kings, the king of wines, the Commandaria of Cyprus! The knights Templar once sold this wine.
04a_side07_03_getport_complete_next_a: Ha ha. Smiling? My friend, I could dance for joy! This is a vintage only grown on the island of Cyprus.
04a_side07_03_getport_complete_next_b: There's nothing like it on Aeternum, no substitute. The nobles would sell the very clothes off their backs for a mere sip!
04a_side07_03_getport_desc: Jacob Evans has remembered the name of one of his tormentors. Help him get some revenge on Admiral Arias.
04a_side07_03_getport_incomplete_a: What do the Lost want with my wares? Can they even taste the sweetness of mead?
04a_side07_03_getport_proposal_a: This time, it's not about my goods. Someone ought to teach him a lesson.
04a_side07_03_getport_proposal_b: He's a coward, preying on decent folk who can't fight back. But he won't expect anybody to march up and thrash him.
04a_side07_03_getport_proposal_next_a: Don't be rash, friend. If something happened to such a charitable soul because of me…
04a_side07_03_getport_proposal_next_b: No, no, you gave me hope, and I'll have faith in you. Godspeed!
04a_side07_04_01_talktopolly: Talk to Polly the Everfall Barkeep
04a_side07_04_savebar_complete_a: Let's see what we have here. Commandaria? From the island of Cyprus?
04a_side07_04_savebar_complete_b: This is enough to save my bar, and then some! I could even buy a nice little cottage with what's left over.
04a_side07_04_savebar_desc: Jacob is entrusting you with delivering the priceless bottle of Commandaria to Polly's bar, in the hopes that it will save her business.
04a_side07_04_savebar_incomplete_a: Polly's livelihood depends on that bottle. Wrap it up, and make sure the label's covered.
04a_side07_04_savebar_proposal_a: Certain. I would love to deliver it myself, but I'm content knowing Polly's saved.
04a_side07_04_savebar_proposal_b: Be careful. Don't wave that bottle around, or anyone who knows its value will be after your blood.
04a_side07_04_savebar_talkto_polly: What's all this, now? A bottle of wine? I didn't order this. It's a generous gift, but what's all this about?
04a_side08_01_01_task_gotowilderness: Search the wilds for cougars and rams
04a_side08_01_05_task_findhughes: Meet Anwir Hughes near the Covenant Enclave
04a_side08_01_getreagents_complete_a: A fine piece of liver and a perfect ram's horn. You sure you haven't done this before?
04a_side08_01_getreagents_complete_b: Now, we shave off a bit of the horn, grind up some liver, and there it is. A healthy addition to Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir.
04a_side08_01_getreagents_complete_next_: My great-aunt always said liver was good for you. Though I admit, you're right about the smell.
It could use some work. Nobody wants to buy an elixir that smells foul.
04a_side08_01_getreagents_desc: The wares that Anwir is hawking seem a little suspect. Nevertheless, he's happy to pay for help "improving" them.
04a_side08_01_getreagents_incomplete_a: I need a better name for the product. Anwir's Elixir just doesn't sound impressive enough.
04a_side08_01_getreagents_proposal_a: Shh! Not so loud! Are you trying to bring the guards down on my head?
04a_side08_01_getreagents_proposal_b: Listen, a man has to make a living. And it's all harmless, I promise. I wouldn't sell anything that would hurt a fly.
04a_side08_01_getreagents_proposal_next_: I'll let you in on how I brew the elixir. You can see for yourself.
Just need a nice, solid ram horn and a fresh liver. Come now, it’s not too much to ask, and you can even have a tidy share of my profits.
04a_side08_02_01_task_gotonettlerest: Explore Nettlerest Graveyard for Anwir's secret ingredient
04a_side08_02_secretingredient_complete_: Such lovely hydrangeas. You, my friend, have a knack for spotting good potion ingredients.
Look, they even improve the elixir's color, not just the scent. I think we have gold in a bottle here.
04a_side08_02_secretingredient_desc: Anwir Hughes is back, with another scheme to "improve" his Ancient Miracle Elixir.
04a_side08_02_secretingredient_incomplet: Unfortunately, we'll need many flowers for just one bottle of elixir.
04a_side08_02_secretingredient_proposal_: You wound me! Yes, the latest version of the elixir was pungent, but I know how to solve that little problem.
Hydrangeas.They were my grandfather's favorite blossom. They'll do the trick, I just know it.
04a_side08_03_01_gotopoi_settlement: Deliver Anwir's potions to the citizens of Oxboro
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_complete_a: As of today, I've sold at least a dozen orders of Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir. They're going faster than I can make them!
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_complete_b: And of course, I would never forget to pay my best friend in this endeavor.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_complete_ne: Of course it did. Hope is more potent than any potion.
Though we live forever, ailment, despair, and darkness still plague us. <g id="male_explain" />Sometimes, all we need to step back from the brink is a small sip of hope.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_desc: Nothing can go wrong with distributing Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir to the people of Everfall, right?
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_incomplete_: If you get cold feet, just remember: there's coin in it for you too.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_proposal_a: Who better than you? You've got that heroic look, and you radiate a certain aura of… trustworthiness.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_proposal_b: It's a gift that not all of us have. Especially not me.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_talkto_atti: Any packages meant for the household can be given to me. What's this? Anwir's Ancient Miracle Elixir? What a bizarre name.
The label says it cures all aches, ailments, and heartaches? How could a potion cure heartache?
Mmm, I do feel less tense after a few sips. That's a pleasant surprise in these trying times. Thank you.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_talkto_fran: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />We have new cause for hope in you, my friend. And I am now spreading the word.
<g id="male_headNodYes" />The man's mostly harmless, but if I have to listen to you read one of his sales pitches, you can keep walking.
<g id="male_why" />Hey! Keep your nose out of trouble, traveler. I do not need another problem on my plate.
<g id="male_smile" />Well, now. My legs don't feel as stiff. I never thought I'd see the day Anwir Hughes turned over a new leaf.
04a_side08_03_deliverpotions_talkto_odne: What's that<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> you're holding? I could use a good strong brew before me next hunt.
Let me guess,<g id="male_smile" /> one of Anwir's? Don't look surprised, I've lived in Everfall at least as long as that old rascal.
<g id="male_chuckle" />Well, nothing from Anwir's killed me yet. Bottoms up, and give him my regards, will you?
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_complete_a: Hm? What's that you've got? "Superiora de inferioribus, inferiora de superioribus."
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_complete_b: Do you have any idea what you've found? This recipe may reveal the very nature of the cosmos to us!
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_complete_next_: I would not expect the casual observer to recognize the import of Hugo of Santalla's writings.
Hmm… From what I can discern, this potion should "call down cosmic starlight" upon its imbiber. Here you are.
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_desc: Try to piece together the strange alchemical recipe, then bring it to a Syndicate alchemist for further study.
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_incomplete_a: [By itself, this scrap of paper is useless to you. The glass bottles scattered around it may contain some clues.]
04a_side09_01_lostalchemy_proposal_a: [You carefully copy down the legible text from the paper fragment, but it's meaningless on its own. You need more information to make sense of it.]
04a_side10_01_01_task_mineseam: Find and mine the abandoned claim
04a_side10_01_copperseam_desc: One ill-fated miner's find is another better-fated miner's treasure.
04a_side10_01_copperseam_incomplete_a: [The dusty, smeared, badly crumpled parchment appears to be a hand-drawn charcoal map of north-western Everfall.]
04a_side10_01_copperseam_incomplete_b: [A section of rocky valley is circled several times, indicating a significant find.]
04a_side10_01_copperseam_proposal_a: [The dusty, smeared, badly crumpled parchment appears to be a hand-drawn charcoal map of north-western Everfall.]
04a_side10_01_copperseam_proposal_b: [A section of rocky valley is circled several times, indicating a significant find.]
04aside01_01_backpack_description: All that remains of Huntsman Lee's ill-fated porter.
04aside01_01_crops_description: Stalks of corn just on the far edge of ripe without farmers to take them to market.
04aside01_02_finefur_description: Free of blemishes, stains, and tears, this length of fur is supple enough to adorn even the most expensive of garments.
04aside02_01_dracodevice_description: A strange orb that occasionally glows with points of lights arranged across its surface like a constellation.
04aside02_01_oriondevice_description: A strange orb that occasionally glows with points of lights arranged across its surface like a constellation.
04aside02_04_guardianazoth_description: Astonishingly brittle, given the strength of the Guardian it fell from. Flecks of blue and teal glitter throughout the material.
04aside02_05_armillarykey_description: The back is smooth and flat. The center depicts a series of circles overlapping one another in a sphere.
04aside02_05_armillarysphere_description: Inert, heavy, and sturdy despite its complexity, six star-shaped impressions adorn its central ring.
04aside03_0101_ancientvase_description: A high-quality craft from a time long before yours on Aeternum.
04aside03_0201_ancientscroll_description: A tattered but legible scroll full of runes and glyphs.
04aside03_0301_ancienttalisman_descripti: An idol of a long-lost civilization. There's no telling how many of these still exist.
04aside04_02_teklaspoison_description: A special earth salting poison developed by artificer Tekla Petrowski.
04aside04_05_teklaslocket_description: Carved into the metal are the initials 'AK+TP'.
04aside04_06_flowers_description: Blue flowers that Audrey Kelleher used to love collecting.
04aside05_01_guitar_description: Though the wood has lost some of its luster, it is a well maintained instrument.
04aside05_01_mandolin_description: Its strings thrummed by many fingers, the belly of this instrument has stayed true to form over the centuries.
04aside05_01_ubr_description: A well-cared for instrument that may be more for looks than music.
04aside05_03_brokenwatch_description: Dented, cracked glass, and immobile hands suggest this item was treated carelessly.
04aside05_03_delivery_description: Right where Saira told you it would be. You probably shouldn't open this.
04aside05_03_laundry_description: Back-breaking work resulted in clean linens and undergarments.
04aside05_03_repairedwatch_description: Saira's patron surely won't notice it was ever broken.
04aside05_03_workorder_repairwatch_descr: An obscenely intricate diagram of the inner workings of a pocket watch.
04aside05_04_sealednote_02_description: Sealed with wax and embossed with gold-leaf lettering on crisp, quality parchment.
04aside05_04_sealednote_description: A hand-addressed note from one priveleged individual to another.
04aside07_01_mead_description: A sweet honey brew made by the Everfall Barkeep.
04aside07_02_wine_description: A dark red wine made by the Everfall Barkeep.
04aside07_03_dustybottle_description: A mysterious bottle of mysterious origins. Unassuming, but full of a delicious liquid.
04aside07_03_port_description: A hearty sake made by the Everfall Barkeep.
04aside08_01_liver_description: What could Anwir want this for?
04aside08_01_ramhorn_description: You're not sure what they're for, but they're heavy.
04aside08_02_hydrangea_description: An unusually strong-scented specimen that only grows in this particular graveyard.
04aside08_03_potioncase_description: For all you know, every single vial is full of colored water.
0501_0101_01_response: Withered are souless creatures that have overtaken many farms nearby.
0502_00_magistrate_defaultdialog: Reekwater is not a territory for the unprepared, traveler. I suggest you be extremely careful if you venture outside the settlement.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_complete_availa: Aha! Did I mention I'm a scholar of the Ancients' language? I've spent centuries studying - let's see what we can decipher here...
Hm. Yes, as elsewhere, it's clear they forced humans into servitude - the Guardians.
That is the question, isn't it? And the answer varies. In Brimstone Sands, the Guardians served entirely defensive purposes.
But here, it seems the Ancients were using some kind of... technology.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and seek out the writings of the Ancients
0502_0101_ancientscholar_incomplete: I've only just learned of these tablets, but I have high hopes. Bring back the tablets and charcoal rubbings and I'll share whatever I can translate.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_objective_desc: Collect Ancient Stone Tablets and Rubbings from any Ancient Plaques within Sunken Aspect, and return them to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_proposal_a: A question I ask myself every day, but of course, the answer is that it's my duty, as a citizen of New Corsica and of Aeternum.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_proposal_b: I believe there are secrets stirring in the primordial waters of this land.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_proposal_next2_: Then perhaps you'd assist me? An opportunity's arisen but my antiquarian has vanished.
Ancient Tablets from the overgrown ruins nearby, and charcoal rubbings from Ancient Plaques. If you collect these, I'll reward you.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_proposal_next_a: Well, it's no secret that there's power here - power beyond human imagination.
0502_0101_ancientscholar_proposal_next_b: The Ancients certainly knew how to harness it - but for what purpose? Don't you want to know?
0502_0101_impressionkit_description: A pouch filled with paper and a supply of charcoal, used for taking impressions.
0502_0101_stonetabletrubbing_description: The charcoal rubbing of a large Ancient plaque, found in Sunken Aspect.
0502_0102_ancientmap_description: A deft copy of a broken Ancient map, found at the top of Skyview Repose.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_complete_av: Aha, you've returned! Unlike Abbington... at any rate, let's see what you found.
Hm. It appears the site was dedicated to a ritual of creation, involving... yes, some kind of devices.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_find_lore_p: Search for any notes or clues about the Ancient Guardians
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_goto_poi: Investigate {POITags} for any clues about the Ancient Guardians
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_incomplete_: Healing waters in the mountains… why would the Ancients sends their servants there?
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_objective_d: Investigate the Ancient ruins of Skyview Repose, and return to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_proposal_a: I absolutely agree. There's only one additional clue I can decipher from the writings you procured.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_proposal_b: It seems the humans made some sort of pilgrimage to a primordial spring in the northwest mountains.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_proposal_ne: Excellent. With Abbington at large, I'm quite stuck here and can't visit the spring myself.
There's a symbol suggesting the waters there might have some healing power - I look forward to hearing what you discover.
0502_0102_hopespringseternal_retrieve_it: Investigate the top of the Skyview Repose tower
0502_0102_medicusorb_description: A globe filled with energy, acquired from the Guardian known as The Surgeon.
0502_0103_bagofguardianhearts_descriptio: A bag of Ancient Guardian hearts, collected from a pile of Ancient rubble.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_complete_available: Thank the gods you've returned! I was beginning to worry! And what are these...?
Oh... the Guardian Hearts we've seen in other places? This suggests the ritual at the spring was... perhaps where these were... Implanted?
I knew some Guardians were human and others were constructed, but this suggests… some were both, in fact.
Even more thought-provoking - these hearts are incomplete, lifeless.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_goto_poi: Seek out any remnants of the Ancients in {POITags}
0502_0103_pathsunseen_incomplete: Be wary in the caves. I've heard the Lost have domain there. But if it gives us clues about the Ancients' technologies, it's worth any risk.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_loot_officer: Search the Marooned officer for any evidence of the Ancients
0502_0103_pathsunseen_objective_desc: Colllect any remnants of the Ancients you can find in Rackham's Hollow. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_proposal_a: Well, the map you recovered seems to locate the source of the devices used in the rituals.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_proposal_b: It appears to be an underground facility hidden in the caves the locals call Rackham's Hollow. That, is where we search next.
0502_0103_pathsunseen_search_for_item_in: (Optional) Search the rubble for any evidence of the Ancients
0502_0103_pathsunseen_trigvol_enter: Seek out any remnants of the Ancients
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_complete_ava: You have proven quite capable, my friend, and helpful too. Let me see what you've recovered.
Indeed, a functioning Guardian Heart... and opened? What's this inside? An Azoth crystal, and... vines? From a Dryad, no less.
That is... not what I expected. The Ancients combined their Azoth technology with the living essence of the Dryads... madness.
These tablets suggest the Dryad essence came from a… 'timeless pool'. Interesting.
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and locate any remaining Ancient artifacts
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_incomplete: The ruins of Sha Makogai have been explored before, but perhaps something remains there of interest.
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_objective_de: Search for any remaining Ancient artifacts within the ruins of Sha Makogai. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_proposal_a: The ruins of Sha Makogai - they appear to have been the seat of the Ancients' power in this region.
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_proposal_b: If you're willing, and very careful… any artifacts remaining there may tell us more. Mars protect you, my friend.
0502_0104_anatomyoftheheart_search_for_e: Search for clues about the creation of the Ancient Guardians
0502_0104_unlockedguardianheart_descript: An unlocked - and reclosed - Ancient Guardian heart.
0502_0105_seekandhide_complete_available: Stellar timing! I knew Fulvius would eventually send someone. But I couldn't leave behind this artifact I've discovered… of course, I can't seem to collect it, either.
0502_0105_seekandhide_goto_poi: Search {POITags} for any evidence of Abbingdon's whereabouts
0502_0105_seekandhide_incomplete: Please, make haste. If Abbington has not returned by now, it could be bad. We need him, or his work, at least.
0502_0105_seekandhide_objective_desc: Uncover the whereabouts of Antiquarian Abbingdon, last sent to Syleio Seko.
0502_0105_seekandhide_proposal_a: It means we need to find Abbington - he knows more than I do about this business.
0502_0105_seekandhide_proposal_b: He was last out at the ruins of Syleio Seko - please, you must go find him… or his notes, if that's all that remains.
0502_0105_seekandhide_trigvol_enter: Enter the ruins and search for Antiquarian Abbingdon
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_complete_avail: You survived the Lazarus Well? After you left, I deciphered clues suggesting it was even more dangerous than I knew.
But you did it! And more importantly, the Eye! Yes, this... is quite a prize!
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_incomplete: If you can get me the eye of that Original Guardian, this journey won't have been a waste after all.
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_objective_desc: Collect the Guardian's Eye from Chardis in the Lazarus Well Expedition. Then report to Legatus Fulvius in the Reekwater Settlement.
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_proposal_a: I'm not entirely sure, but some of the glyphs show images of a massive, many-eyed Ancient Guardian.
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_proposal_b: Something like this has never been seen, of course, so one would assume it is very dangerous.
0502_0106_primevalcyclops_proposal_next_: Very well. You certainly seem capable enough to me, but you might want to bring allies.
Defeat this… Original Guardian Chardis in the Lazarus Well and bring me his eye. You will be well-rewarded.
0502_01_magistrate_defaultdialog_a: It always gives me some comfort to see another warrior sent out to this gods-forsaken swamp.
0502_01_magistrate_defaultdialog_b: Never thought I'd miss the deserts of Brimstone Sands, but I certainly do.
0502_02_magistrate_defaultdialog: Yes, this is exactly what I was hoping to find. Don't you see? The Ancients forced their human subjects here to work on some type of… machinery.
0502_03_magistrate_defaultdialog_a: Damn it, but I wish Abbington was here! Who knows? The old fool may have become Lost or Corrupted.
0502_03_magistrate_defaultdialog_b: Without him, I'm afraid I have to continue to entrust you with this work.
0502_04_magistrate_defaultdialog: One thing Is certain - the Ancients were not benevolent rulers. However horrific it is, the mystery of what powered the Hearts remains.
0502_05_magistrate_defaultdialog_a: I have to tell you, though, the source of the Dryads' essence is not the real mystery here.
0502_05_magistrate_defaultdialog_b: It's this Azoth crystal - it is not natural, but rather… crafted somehow.
0502_06_magistrate_defaultdialog_a: There may be one thing, however, that could redeem this entire initiative.
0502_06_magistrate_defaultdialog_b: Among the tablets you gathered, I've seen reference to a place known as the Lazarus Well.
0502_07_magistrate_defaultdialog_a: I cannot express what a difference you made. Without you, this entire effort would've been wasted.
0502_07_magistrate_defaultdialog_b: Now I will return to New Corsica with pride... and years of research ahead of me.
0503_00_survivalist_defaultdialog: The marshes of this land are like no other in all Aeternum In the Old World, it was life that made nature so spectactular. Here, it is death
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_complete_availab: Oh praise the Earth mother you've returned! These journals are everything to me.
I hope my work might help us placate the Angry Earth in this turmoil and someday bring us back into harmony with one another.
I believe it is… no, I know it is. Marsh Walker Afolabi will tell you otherwise, but she is stuck in the old ways of thinking.
Let me study my journals, then I hope you'll return so we can discuss this further.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and search for the missing journals
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_incomplete: My journals contain decades of insights regarding Reekwater and the Angry Earth. They must be reclaimed or all my work will have been in vain.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_objective_desc: Retrieve the Dryad journals dropped by Herbalist Langlais in the Glimmerfen. Then return it to her in the Reekwater Settlement.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_proposal_a: These lands are sacred to nature, and any affront to nature on Aeternum will cause a reaction here.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_proposal_b: The relentless spread of Corruption has imbued the Dryads with unnatural strength, strength that threatens the balance.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_proposal_next_a: I am unsure. I have studied the lifeforms of Reekwater for many years, collecting observations.
0503_0101_onfloralfauna_proposal_next_b: But I lost my journals in Glimmerfen recently when the Dryads became hostile. Would you mind reclaiming them?
0503_01_survivalist_defaultdialog: Greetings and welcome to Reekwater, traveler. I hope you have not brought trouble with you. We have trouble enough here already.
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_comple: Good to see you back in one piece. Let us hope that your actions today helped curb the Blight. It is a great relief to learn it hasn't spread to Fisher's Glory.
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_goto_p: Travel to {POITags} and stop the spread of the Blight
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_incomp: Blight cannot be allowed to take hold here in Reekwater. The stakes are too high.
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_kill_t: Defeat the {targetName} Dryads to ensure the Blight has not spread
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_object: Hunt down The Blight Bringer and any Blight Nodules in Lambent Muskeg, then travel to Fisher's Glory to ensure the Blight has not spread. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
0503_0201_excisingtheblightedroot_propos: The greatest factor in the destabilization of nature now is of course the Blight.
I suspect you have seen it elsewhere, but the threat is greater here, because the gathering of Dryads could cause it to spread.. well, everywhere.
Exactly. The infected Dryads must be destroyed, particularly one large one in Lambent Muskeg.
Destroy it and retrieve any Blight nodules. Then  please also make sure it hasn't spread to Fisher's Glory.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_complete_ava: Ah, I can sense some measure of serenity returning to the marshes. You have done the right thing, regardless of what anyone else says.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_defend_wave_: Complete the Dryad's Trial of Penance
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_incomplete: I appreciate you humoring me with this penance. Marsh Walker Afolabi would say we're wasting our time, but time will tell.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_interact_io: (Optional) Place the Dryad Offering on the Mysterious Altar
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_objective_de: Take the Dryad Offering to the Mysterious Altar in Fisher's Glory as an apology. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_proposal_a: It is not difficult. Place this offering on the altar at the foot of Fisher's Glory, so they all can see it.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_proposal_b: Just... be on guard. One of the large dryads might come to forcibly extract your amends.
0503_0202_burdenofatonement_return_poi: Travel to {POITags} and make an offering at the Dryad's altar
0503_0202_dryadoffering_description: A selection of gently harvested flowers, doused with Azoth Water.
0503_0203_dryadanatomytablet_description: The writing is illegible, but the images of the parts of a Dryad are clear enough.
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_complete_ava: So you found something then? Let's see... oh dear, this is quite dreadful!
The Ancients dissected the Dryads for some nefarious purpose... I wonder if that's related to them coming here. Perhaps some cycle of vengeance?
This isn't of Ancient design... this is something else. Much simpler. Perhaps a child's drawing?
And what is this body of water? It appears to be a sacred place to the Dryads.
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_goto_poi: Explore {POITags} for any clues to the Dryads' presence
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_incomplete: I'm convinced that the Ancient ruins will give us insights. If you don't find anything at first, just… keep trying.
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_interact_io: Search for further clues connecting the Dryads to the Ancients
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_objective_de: Search Sha Makogai and the fallen lighthouse, Hingatirn, for any clues on the Dryads' presence in Reekwater. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_proposal_a: For the water, you say? She really believes it's to bathe themselves in the Azoth-infused waters here?
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_proposal_b: I simply cannot imagine their motive to be so self-centered, so... self-indulgent.
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_proposal_nex: Not to the Marsh Walker's mind, I suspect. But let's try to prove her wrong.
The Ancients knew such matters. Would you indulge me and search some of the older ruins for clues to why the Dryads gather here?
0503_0203_wardensofthegreen_trigvol_ente: Search the lower ruins for clues to the Dryads' presence
Investigate the fallen tower of Hingatirn
0503_02_survivalist_defaultdialog: Ah, it's you. I am pleased you have returned. I have studied my journals and reminded myself of all things relevant to restoring harmony here.
0503_0301_ancientazothreservoir_descript: A small Ancient metal container holding a few drops of pure azoth.
0503_0301_theeternalpool_complete_availa: You... returned. I can't even imagine what you must've witnessed there. The pool is pure Azoth, isn't it?
Yes, I've spent more time studying the sketches you recovered. The pool is the reason the Dryads come to Reekwater.
Yes, just as Afolabi hinted, they give their life energy to the water, returning the Azoth back to Aeternum. It's inspiring.
I have learned more today about the Angry Earth, about nature, and most of all, that I have more to learn.
0503_0301_theeternalpool_get_key_from_bo: Collect {itemName} from the Pride of the Trees
0503_0301_theeternalpool_incomplete_a: There could be anything waiting for you up on the plateau. Best gather some friends and watch yourself.
0503_0301_theeternalpool_objective_desc: Investigate the Eternal Pool and face whatever challenges lie within. Then report to Herbalist Langlais in the Reekwater Settlement.
0503_0301_theeternalpool_proposal_a: Absolutely. It appears to be on the northern plateau, and that is indeed a place the Dryads protect quite fiercely.
0503_0301_theeternalpool_proposal_b: I'm sure it's where we'll learn the truth about them. Go if you dare, but I suggest you don't go alone.
0503_03_survivalist_defaultdialog_a: Of course, necessary as it may have been, killing the Dryads in Fisher's Glory will be an offense to the Angry Earth.
0503_03_survivalist_defaultdialog_b: If we mean to restore harmony, we will have to atone for that.
0503_04_survivalist_defaultdialog_a: Now, I hope you'll help me resolve one other point of contention with Afolabi.
0503_04_survivalist_defaultdialog_b: She insists the Dryads gathering here from across Aeternum is not to protect Reekwater.
0503_05_survivalist_defaultdialog: Ah, yes… of course! There are legends about a place called the Eternal Pool. With this drawing, we may finally have discovered the pool's location.
0503_06_survivalist_defaultdialog: Thank you, {playerName}, for helping me finally learn the truth about the Dryads… and myself.
0504_00_overseer_defaultdialog: This settlement is facing hard times. Traveler. You are welcome here, but I cannot vouch for your safety.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_find_final_j: Seek out any remaining journal pages from the questioning Pirate
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and investigate the activities of the Pirates
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_incomplete: Go on now, go to Maria's Rest and see for yourself. Defeat as many pirates as you can, but it will not be enough.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_objective_de: Investigate the Lost Pirates at Maria's Rest. Then report to Headmen Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_proposal_a: The Lost, the empty vessels… the Siren Queen. I told them, but others here are only concerned with the Angry Earth.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_proposal_b: Now it's Corruption everyone fears, but soon, the Siren Queen will come for us all.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_proposal_nex: Most Lost, they lack purpose; but the Siren, she has much purpose, dark purpose.
See for yourself - go to Maria's Rest - see how the Pirates' numbers grow. Destroy those you can, and you will see. Yes, you will see.
She leads the Lost Pirates here, but she is not content with that, believe me.
I was Headman of my village and watched it fall, and since then, I have watched her rise.
0504_0101_anexpandingthreat_search_pages: Collect clues about the Pirates activities
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_complete_avai: Don't kill me, please! Mercy! I'm not… not with them. Not anymore! Not for a long time really…
I didn't know! She was once not so bad, a good leader, brave, inspiring even…
The... the Siren Queen, as she's known now. When we first came though, she promised a free society, all of us equals.
But then she changed... became that... serpent, started turning everyone Lost.
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_goto_poi: Seek out the Pirate deserter in {POITags}
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_incomplete: Shipflight Comb was once a bustling town, full of energy and life. What changed there, no one knows. No one, except the spirits that remain.
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_objective_des: Track down the Pirate deserter, possibly hiding out in Shipflight Comb in Reekwater.
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_proposal_a: This final note mentions a town to the northwest. From Maria's Rest, that would be Shipflight Comb. I would start there.
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_proposal_b: Be careful… the spirits of that place rest uneasy, and may not take kindly to your intrusion.
0504_0102_defianceanddoubt_trigvol_enter: Search for the Pirate deserter's hideout in {POITags}
0504_01_overseer_defaultdialog_a: What have we here? Someone finally comes to help us? The Legion came, but they do nothing.
0504_01_overseer_defaultdialog_b: I have sounded the alarm in Reekwater for months, but no one understands the danger.
0504_01a_overseer_defaultdialog_a: Now you can see. They spread like a plague, cobbling together flotsam into landlocked monstrosities. But you have found something more?
0504_01a_overseer_defaultdialog_b: These notes… they were all penned by the same hand, one that has experienced the cruelty of the Siren Queen firsthand. You must find her. We must know what she knows!
0504_0201_wordsofpower_complete_availabl: Bless the winds that brought you back. Let me see, what clues did you find at the Lighthouse?
Hm. These notes suggest her 'machine' has the power to steal souls from the living and channel them into another vessel…
0504_0201_wordsofpower_find_journal_page: Collect notes relating to the Ancient 'machine'
0504_0201_wordsofpower_goto_poi: Investigate {POITags} for clues about the Siren Queen's plans
0504_0201_wordsofpower_incomplete: We must know what the Siren Queen ultimately seeks to accomplish before we attempt to confront her.
0504_0201_wordsofpower_objective_desc: Search Syleio Seko for clues about the Siren Queen's plans. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
0504_0201_wordsofpower_proposal_a: Yes, and we must find out what that is. You have learned of this Ancient 'machine' she took from the ruins, yes?
0504_0201_wordsofpower_proposal_b: That antiquarian - Abbington - he said her crew has been scavenging more such relics as well.
0504_0201_wordsofpower_proposal_next: And so you must go, across the bay to the Ancient Lighthouse. Somewhere there, we will find evidence of what the Siren Queen's ultimately seeks to accomplish.
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_complete_: You have done well. There are already reports that there are fewer of those cursed banners.
Let us hope that this will arrest or at least very much slow down the Siren Queen's efforts. This settlement may well be spared.
Indeed, at some time, I suspect we will have to confront the Siren Queen herself.
But for now, you have done a tremendous service for all of Reekwater. Take this as a token of our thanks.
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_goto_poi: Search {POITags} and destroy any Ancient relics found
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_incomplet: I believe the Siren Queen's crew is using the relics to create more of these banners they put up across the territory. You must put a stop to this.
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_interact_: Seek and destroy the twisted Ancient Relics stored in Mistywater Thorp
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_objective: Destroy the twisted Ancient relics in Mistywater Thorp. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_proposal: Before now, I would not have thought so, but it does confirm my suspicions. The Siren Queen has the potential to become an even greater threat than the Corruption.
0504_0202_aplansdeconstruction_proposal_: I only hope we're not too late. This is why her crew was bringing those relics into my old village - Mistywater Thorp.
You must go there and recover or destroy these devices - whatever they are - to stop her from gaining more power.
0504_02_overseer_defaultdialog_a: I know that her ambitions know no bounds, but I do not know what she truly seeks to achieve.
0504_02_overseer_defaultdialog_b: Is it dominion over all Aeternum? How would that be satisfying to one of the Lost?
0504_03_overseer_defaultdialog_a: Now, it all makes sense - her crew, my village, any other power she can draw - the Siren Queen wants to regain her soul.
0504_03_overseer_defaultdialog_b: And it would seem to empower her even further in the process.
0504_0401_gunpowdercask_description: A small cask of gunpowder, primed and ready for ignition.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_collect_arena_k: Loot the {itemName} from one of the Siren Queen's lieutenants
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_complete_availa: We saw the plume of smoke from here, and heard the lightning strikes of the Siren Queen's fury! Since you made it back... can I assume she has been dealt with?
I've spoken with Nelda at the bar - she'll keep her ears open for word of the Siren Queen's return and let you know if and when it happens.
But for now, please take these as thanks and a reward for all of your assistance.
Even if she may return and reclaim her fortress, you removed the greater threat of her machine – something the island can’t restore!
You've given us a respite from the threat, and that’s worthy of praise, {playerName}!
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_goto_poi: Venture into {POITags} and put a stop to the Siren Queen's plans
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_incomplete_a: After you light off that gunpowder, the Siren Queen won’t be pleased at all. You and your allies will need to be ready for the fierce battle ahead of you.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_incomplete_b: I’ve heard the Siren Queen has control over storms. Be careful.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_objective_desc: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants, destroy the Ancient Machine, and defeat the Siren Queen. Then report to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_a: Ha! Well said! Now, the Siren Queen’s lieutenants have spread throughout that hodgepodge 'fortress' to the south.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_b: One of whom holds the key to her sanctum... but we've been unable to discover which one.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_next2_: Exactly. You'll need to find a way to deal with that infernal machine the Siren Queen has cobbled together. A few well-placed casks of gunpowder should do nicely.
Then, you'll have to confront the Siren Queen herself.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_next_a: Yes, to cause the greatest impact – and to succeed, you’ll need allies by your side.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_next_b: Without her lieutenants enforcing her orders, her grip may loosen for a time. But that's not the only goal to keep in mind.
0504_0401_thequeenisdead_proposal_prompt: "So I’ll need to find them all."
0504_04_overseer_defaultdialog_a: Your efforts have been noticed by the Siren Queen, and she has deployed her trusted lieutenants to the front in an attempt to stall any attack.
0504_04_overseer_defaultdialog_b: The time for a direct confrontation is upon us, whether we wish it or not.
0504_05_overseer_defaultdialog_a: My old village cannot be avenged until the Siren Queen herself is defeated, for good.
0504_05_overseer_defaultdialog_b: I also fear that every moment she may be finding other ways to increase her power.
0505_00_artificer_defaultdialog: Tread carefully in the swamps of Reekwater, wayfarer. Nature is beautiful, but it is also quite treacherous.
0505_0101_freshdryadsample_description: Vines, freshly pruned from a Dryad.
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_complete_: Thank you, child. Some might shy away from the Dryads when they seethe as they do. You are brave.
And indeed these samples prove that the Dryads in Glimmerfen come from all over the island.
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_get_gathe: Collect {itemName} from Azoth Springs throughout Reekwater
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_get_token: Collect {itemName}s from the Dryads of the {POITags}
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and gather the items for Marsh Walker Afolabi
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_incomplet: The fresh Dryad samples and Azoth water will give us greater insights. Trust the process, young one.
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_objective: Provide Marsh Walker Afolabi with her requested fresh Dryad Cuttings from the Glimmerfen, and Azoth Water from Azoth Springs.
0505_0101_pruningandirrigation_proposal_: Because she has much to learn, and her growth can only be accelerate by adversity… but you have done no harm.
Perhaps there is another way we might hasten her enlightenment?
Madilon believes the Dryads come from across Aeternum to protect and care for nature here. I suspect otherwise.
Collect fresh Dryad samples and water from the Azoth springs in Glimmerfen. Then we will know more.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_complete_ava: Your return warms my blood, young one. Let me see these crystals.
Azoth indeed, and most peculiar to be growing there. I will have to study them, but I think I promised you something in return… what was it?
Of course. You'll also remember the question of why Dryads come to Reekwater.
I will tell you this much - it is 'for the water' that they come. The rest, you'll learn in time. Oh, and here's your gift.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_goto_poi: Seek out the Azoth Crystals within the {POITags}
0505_0102_downstreameffects_incomplete: The Dryads in the grotto are enraged to a degree unlike any time I've seen in the past. Do take care collecting the crystals.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_objective_de: Search the Virid Grotto for Azoth crystals, and bring pieces of them back for Marsh Walker Afolabi in the Reekwater Settlement.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_proposal_a: I am, but first, I ask your assistance in addressing a concern of my own.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_proposal_b: While Madilon has walked these waters for decades, I have done so for centuries, but I have never seen pure Azoth crystals here... until now.
0505_0102_downstreameffects_proposal_nex: I saw them in the Virid Grotto, but the fury of the Dryads in the area was fierce - I could not reach them.
If you can collect these crystals from the grotto, I will grant you both knowledge and a rare gift.
0505_0103_cooldown: Reekwater is the end of the cycle of life for the Dryads, but balance is still not restored.
0505_0103_thedryadpromenade_incomplete: To defeat the Protector of the Source, I would suggest you bring allies.
0505_0103_thedryadpromenade_objective_de: Follow the Dryad Promenade path into the depths of the Eternal Pool, and lay the Protector of the Source to rest.
0505_0103_thedryadpromenade_proposal_a: The Protector of the Source exceeds his mandate - the pool belongs to all life forms.
0505_0103_thedryadpromenade_proposal_b: Like other Dryads, he too must return his essence to the waters. Do what must be done, young one.
0505_01_artificer_defaultdialog: Greetings, young one. I have seen you speaking with Herbalist Langlais. I believe you helped her retrieve her journals, yes? A kindness, indeed.
0505_02_artificer_defaultdialog_a: The question that remains to be answered is the Dryads' motivation for coming to Reekwater.
0505_02_artificer_defaultdialog_b: Is it that they come to serve and protect the nature here, or another reason?
0505_03_artificer_defaultdialog: I have told you all I can for now, young one. Speak to Herbalist Langlais, and I feel certain you will learn more together.
0505_04_artificer_defaultdialog_a: Greetings again, young one. You have been to the Eternal Pool and seen the truth.
0505_04_artificer_defaultdialog_b: Reekwater is the end of the cycle of life for the Dryads, but balance is still not restored.
0507_00_commander_defaultdialog: I haven't the patience to entertain commoners. Begone.
0507_01_commander_defaultdialog: Good health to you, Marauder. What is your request?
0507_01pre_commander_defaultdialog: Good health to you, Marauder. What is your request?\n[ Level 56 required for Reekwater faction missions ]
0507_02_commander_defaultdialog: Spare us both and move on, genius.
0507_03_commander_defaultdialog: Save your good words. I need them not.
0508_00_alchemist_defaultdialog: You were helplessly drawn to me, no? You think it is my charisma?
0508_01_alchemist_defaultdialog: It is your pleasure to conversate with me, yes? How might I satisfy your wants, my friend?
0508_01pre_alchemist_defaultdialog: It is your pleasure to conversate with me, yes? How might I satisfy your wants, my friend?\n[ Level 56 required for Reekwater faction missions ]
0508_02_alchemist_defaultdialog: After all... Your primitive mind is fascinated by me, right, Marauder? How could it not be so?
0508_03_alchemist_defaultdialog: Do you find a crisis of faith in my eyes, devotee? Perhaps the doubt is now creeping in?
0508_04_alchemist_defaultdialog_a: Ah, {playerName}! I'm afraid I have some very bad news for you.
0508_04_alchemist_defaultdialog_b: It would seem that Alchemist Krockes became a victim of his own ambitions - he has become Lost.
0508_04pre_alchemist_defaultdialog_a: Ah, {playerName}! I'm afraid I have some very bad news for you.
0508_04pre_alchemist_defaultdialog_b: It would seem that Alchemist Krockes became a victim of his own ambitions - he has become Lost.\n[ Level 56 required for Reekwater faction missions ]
0508_05_alchemist_defaultdialog: Now we must move on to more imporant questions. How was it that Krockes was able to absorb those soul traces? Did he become Lost on purpose?
0508_05pre_alchemist_defaultdialog_a: Now we must move on to more imporant questions.
0508_05pre_alchemist_defaultdialog_b: How was it that Krockes was able to absorb those soul traces? Did he become Lost on purpose?\n[ Level 56 required for Reekwater faction missions ]
0509_01pre_adjudicator_defaultdialog: May the Spark carry you.\n[ Level 56 required for Reekwater faction missions ]
0509_02_adjudicator_defaultdialog: Do not be so bold, warrior.
0509_03_adjudicator_defaultdialog: You seek knowledge. I have advice. Forget your experiments and leave Reekwater while you can.
0510_00_barkeep_defaultdialog_a: Just in case you were wondering - all the drinks I serve are clean.
0510_00_barkeep_defaultdialog_b: I run all the water I use through six layers of cloth, then triple distill it. Purest water you ever drank.
0510_0101_cooldown: Go on, off with you. You’ve things to do, I’ve things to do, and standing around won’t make any of them happen faster.
0510_0101_longlivethequeen_incomplete: Go on, off with you. You’ve things to do, I’ve things to do, and standing around won’t make any of them happen faster.
0510_0101_longlivethequeen_objective_des: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants, acquire a key, and defeat the Siren Queen.
0510_0101_longlivethequeen_proposal_a: Sadly, no. Elsewhere on Aeternum, could take a week to come back... around here, it's always faster. Must be something in the water.
0510_0101_longlivethequeen_proposal_b: Anyway. Are you and your friends ready to tangle with her again?
0510_0101_longlivethequeen_proposal_next: Glad to hear it! Now, that machine may be destroyed, but her crew still holds the keys to the kingdom.
You'll need to hunt down the key again, then deal with the Siren Queen. You already know the way up. Good hunting!
0510_01_barkeep_defaultdialog_a: Oi! Over here! Headman told me to keep an eye out for you, let you know if that Siren tart showed her scaly bum again.
0510_01_barkeep_defaultdialog_b: Looks like she and those barnacles she calls her 'crew' are back and trying to start trouble again.
0511_00_stranger_defaultdialog: If you see any artifacts in these ruins, hands off! I've already claimed anything in this place in the name of research. I'm not leaving, either.
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_complete_avai: What news, my friend? I feel we are close to finding the secrets of the Ancients here. Tell me, did you find Abbington? What happened to the old fool?
Blast it! I needed that bastard, and his research! Bah, I've had it with this place!
Sorry, I do appreciate your help. But next chance I get, I'm going back to Brimstone Sands!
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_incomplete: Distract the Starvault Guardians downstairs, and I'll pry the relic loose. We can do this - we have to.
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_interact_with: (Optional) Activate the Device in the lowest level of Syleio Seko
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_objective_des: Distract the Starvault Guardians while Antiquarian Abbingdon frees the Ancient artifact.
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_proposal_a: Because THIS is what he's after - an artifact the Ancients used to extract souls and turn them into Azoth!
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_proposal_b: Power beyond comprehension! I need to get it out of here… it belongs in a museum!
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_proposal_next: You… you'll have to throw him off my trail. Tell him I became Lost!
But first, distract the Guardians so I can finally extract the artifact. I promise I will hide this damn thing. Then, who knows? Perhaps we'll meet again!
Good, because these Guardians are determined to stop me.
There's an Ancient device below - if you'll activate it and distract the Guardians, I'll pry the artifact loose and take it somewhere the Legion will never find it.
0511_0101_aguardiansplight_wave_event: Provide a distraction for Antiquarian Abbingdon
0511_0102_aguardiansplight_fail_proposal: Bah! I didn't have enough time to work it loose! Please, let's try this again. We have no choice. It must be done.
0511_0102_cyclopseye_description: An ever-burning eye that stares deeply into your soul.
0511_01_stranger_defaultdialog: This artifact, it's… well, it's a power no being should wield. And no matter what, we can't let it fall into Fulvius's hands!
0511_0201_umbrasreach_complete_available: A pleasure to see you, as always! Now, how goes the progress on our little shopping list? Have you found everything I needed?
Perfect! Here, let me... yes, these will do nicely. I've prepared what I could while you were out, so these repairs shouldn't take long at all.
... tighten this like so, and... there! Finished! A shame... this should be in a museum as well, but with all that's going on, it would just go to waste there.
There were notes found nearby, but everything was in Gaelic! Likely a name in there as well, but I think I'll call it "Umbra's Reach". Catchy, isn't it?
0511_0201_umbrasreach_incomplete_a: I'll wait here for your return, don't worry.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_objective_desc: Gather the components needed to reconstruct Umbra's Reach.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_proposal_a: A weapon which channels the power of... I'm not entirely certain, actually. The one I have is broken.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_proposal_b: It looks akin to those other gauntlets I've seen, the ones that channel the darker energies of the island, though we won't know for sure until it is fixed.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_proposal_next_a: Spot on! From those other gauntlets, I was able to pull together a list of what should be needed to fix it.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_proposal_next_b: One of the few powerful items from the past constructed by our hands, not the Ancients! So, help me fix it, and the gauntlet is yours.
0511_0201_umbrasreach_proposal_prompt: "So you need my help to fix it?"

0511_0201_umbrasreach_questtrack_holdbac: Complete Quest: Hold Back the Night
0511_0201_umbrasreach_questtrack_powerof: Complete Quest: Power of the Void

0511_0206_umbrasreach_indarkestshadow_ob: Gather Void Crystal Fragments from Blightcrag deposits throughout Aeternum.
0511_0206_voidcrystalfragment_descriptio: Drained chunks of Void Crystal, awaiting an infusion of dark energy.

0511_0207_umbrasreach_powerofthevoid_obj: Empower the Void Crystal Fragments by assaulting Corruption Breaches throughout Aeternum

0511_0209_resinhardenedleather_descripti: Hardened and reinforced with the powers of the Protective Resin, this leather will protect the user from dark energy.

0511_0209_umbrasreach_holdbackthenight_o: Collect Protective Resin from the most ancient Angry Earth in Reekwater, then create Resin-Hardened Leather.
0511_02_stranger_defaultdialog: Thank you for what you did out in those ruins. I promise you - I'm putting that relic somewhere the Legion will never find it.
0511_03_stranger_defaultdialog_a: Good to see you again, {playerName}! I hope Fulvius didn't hassle you too much for not bringing back that artifact. Thank you for keeping the secret.
0511_03_stranger_defaultdialog_b: As thanks, I have something you may be interested in.
0511_04_stranger_defaultdialog: Ah, Umbra's Reach. On anyone else's hand, it would actually give me cause for concern, but not so with you. Wear it well, and in good faith, friend.
0522_00_innkeep_defaultdialog: Here is what I wish to know - why do they call this place Reekwater? It's not like there is a bad odor… or is it just me?
0523_00_fisher_defaultdialog: You must be one with the fish, one with the waters… If you wish to be a Grand Master Fisher like me.
0523_0101_d_01_taskhavelevel: Reach Level 100 in the Fishing Skill
0523_0101_fq15_complete_available_respon: At last you are one with the fish. You have earned the title Master Fisher, and the respect of all the fishers on Aeternum.
Go forth and fish and be well, friend.
0523_0101_fq15_incomplete: You are not yet one with the fish. Keep training, my minnow, and you will be rewarded for your efforts.
0523_0101_fq15_objective_desc: Reach Fishing Level 100 and talk to Grand Master Machera in Reekwater.
0523_0101_fq15_proposal_a: You must learn to think like a fish if you are to catch fish of greater sizes and legendary species. Beside me I have a list of the legendary fish you can acquaint yourself with on Aeternum.
0523_0101_fq15_proposal_b: Reach your peak mastery of fishing and return to me.
0523_0101_fq15_proposal_next: Listen to the fish. Hear what they have to say, and understand what the water replies in turn. …Most practically, you must practice.
0523_01_fisher_defaultdialog: You must be one with the fish, one with the waters… If you wish to be a Grand Master Fisher like me.
0523_02_fisher_defaultdialog: Greetings, fellow Grand Master. What news do you bring?
0524_00_stranger_defaultdialog: Shhh! Don't let them know I'm here. Please, please… anything but that.
0524_0101_ahungerforfreedom_complete_ava: Oh, sweet mother ocean... praise you! This'll keep me fed for... I don't know how long.
Alright then, I guess one good turn deserves another and all that bilge... I'll tell you about the Siren Queen.
0524_0101_ahungerforfreedom_incomplete: I'll tell you what the Siren Queen's all about, but you gotta get me some grub first. Berries, hardtack, an old shoe - I'll eat anything at this point.
0524_0101_ahungerforfreedom_objective_de: Find, craft, or purchase Meager Meals and Fresh Water for Katring Sanders in Reekwater.
0524_0101_ahungerforfreedom_proposal_a: Oh, because she's gonna take the whole island. I mean, she's... wait - you're working me!
0524_0101_ahungerforfreedom_proposal_b: Look, I'll tell you things, but only if you get me food and water first. I've starved to death many times hiding here. It hurts!
0524_0102_queensgambit_complete_availabl: Well now, look who's played the odds and lived to tell! You're pretty mean scallywag, aren't you? Not as mean as the Queen, mind you, but you got salt.
And she's already putting up more, I bet. I was thinking back to when this started...
It was after some of the crew brought back this weird magic-machine-thing from the ruins down the coast.
0524_0102_queensgambit_destroy_target: Destroy Cursed Banners wherever Pirates may be found
0524_0102_queensgambit_incomplete: Good luck tearing down those banners. I mean it may be the only hope, but don't ask me to do it.
0524_0102_queensgambit_objective_desc: Destroy the mysterious Cursed Banners throughout Reekwater, then return to Katring Sanders.
0524_0102_queensgambit_proposal_a: Harnessing the island's magic, I figure. She's made these strange... 'banners' outta flotsam and relics.
0524_0102_queensgambit_proposal_b: It's like they suck the life out of you and give it to her. Ever since she put 'em up, she gets stronger.
0524_0102_queensgambit_proposal_next_a: You got a death wish, friend? You want to tear down the Siren Queen's banners, be my guest.
0524_0102_queensgambit_proposal_next_b: Just don't say I didn't warn you. You tear those down, my old crew will be hoppin' mad.
0524_0103_primedpowderkeg_description: A powder keg set with a fuse, ready for detonation.
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_complete_avai: At long last, you return! I was beginning to think you might've joined the Siren Queen's crew!
Now you have seen it with your own eyes, haven't you? She's as much a threat as this Corruption, I tell you.
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_defend_wave_e: Defend against the Pirate salvage crew's assault
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and stall the Pirates' salvage operations
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_incomplete: I think I'll be staying here. Like I said, it's safer. I mean you got salt, but if I was a betting woman -  and I am - I'd bet on the Siren Queen. No offense!
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_interact_with: (Optional) Place Primed Powderkeg at the designated spot, then stand back
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_objective_des: Put a stop to the salvage operations at Scavenger's Shore and Bleachwood Coast, and report back to Headman Onizuka in the Reekwater Settlement.
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_proposal_a: That's when I hid, but they started getting salvage for those banners from all the wrecks on the shoreline.
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_proposal_b: If you really want to gum up her plan, you should strike those salvage operations. Don't come back here, though.
0524_0103_shiveringtimbers_proposal_next: Because you're drawing attention to my hiding spot! But thanks for the grub - it'll keep me from starving for a while, I reckon.
Oh, and good luck against the Siren Queen! You'll need it!
0524_01_stranger_defaultdialog: I mean, what was I to do? I didn't want to let her suck out my soul. So I've been hiding here… like for a REALLY long time. Safer here than anywhere out there.
0524_02_stranger_defaultdialog_a: The thing you gotta get is that the Siren Queen may have lost her soul, but she's gained something else.
0524_02_stranger_defaultdialog_b: I don't know what exactly, I mean this island's got all kinds of magics, and she's been scooping them up.
0524_03_stranger_defaultdialog_a: After that, she holed up in her cabin with the thing, and started inviting crew members in one-by-one.
0524_03_stranger_defaultdialog_b: When they came out, they were Lost… mindlessly doing her bidding.
0524_04_stranger_defaultdialog: Come on now. We had a moment there, but it's not like we're friends. This is my hiding spot - you go find your own.
0525_00_druid_defaultdialog: Flee this place while you still can, stranger. It's an insult to the natural order.
0525_01_druid_defaultdialog: Turn back, stranger. You are about to set foot in the most unholy place in all our strange land. Leave and preserve what remains of your soul.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_complete: Yes, I believe these hearts are exactly what I needed… they stink of the foul magics the Ancients used for their... historic atrocity.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_complete_2: At long last, there is hope that I will find true rest... so long overdue. When I am done with these, all on Aeternum who wish, can finally find their way to oblivion…
0525_exp_ancienthearts_cooldown: The earth hums in gratitude for your services. I am studying the hearts you have retrieved but their lifeblood is finite. Come back later and I'll have another task for you.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_desc: The druid Eoin Dornoll seeks help in retrieving 3 ancient hearts of enemies within Lazarus Instrumentality  so that he can study how the Ancients corrupted the natrual order and created immortality.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_incomplete: For the sake of all those eternally suffering on Aeternum, I need those hearts.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_proposal: It is said this is where the Ancients committed their most egregious crimes against the natural order. This is where they broke the cycles of life and death.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_proposal_2: Exactly. The Ancients harnessed the energy of this place… they transformed the ignorant humans who worshipped them into eternal soldiers…
0525_exp_ancienthearts_proposal_3: This blasphemy set the stage for the endless misery that plagues us all on Aeternum, robbing us of a peaceful hereafter… imprisoning us on this violent island for all of eternity.
0525_exp_ancienthearts_proposal_4: And for their sake, we must expose the accursed evils committed here. Bring me hearts from the Guardians, and I'll study them for clues to whatever heinous magic the Ancients employed.
0525_heart_desc: This Ancient Heart pulses with pure Azoth. As you stare into it you hear a faint whisper. It sounds both familiar and haunting.
05_00_outfitter_defaultdialog: Use the fog to your advantage, tomodachi. I could create an outfit for you, that stands out and blends in. Just ask.
05_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: Ha! I craft my own indigo with Azoth and a plant I shall not name.
05_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: Old world indigo can give you flame resistance. Matsukura's indigo can give you any power you choose.
05_reekwater_body_01_01: The Glowing Guardfish understands the importance of being one with the fish but goes perhaps too far. These men and women of the seal-folk shed their pelts to come walk upon the shore as humans, it is said. They are people so in-tune with the ocean that they can quickly transform if given their pelt into something more seal than human. I refuse to catch them, as I admire them immensely. Perhaps one day I shall meet one properly, and we might talk the ways of the seas.
05_reekwater_body_01_02:
The Merrow in Cutlass Keys

The Angler Fish in First Light

The Bishop Fish in Windsward

The Morag in Monarch's Bluffs

The Selkie in Reekwater

The Mandje Mandje in Everfall
