06_windsward_body_19_01:
I have set out for the western reaches of Windsward to make a study of what the locals call “the buffalo.” Although by their description, I suspect they are more likely a species of bison. When I arrive, I will be sure to correct this misconception. Regardless, more curious than the name, is their presence here on the island. 

Mother says that buffalo are a poor subject for a historian. As usual she does not appreciate the peculiarities of my craft. These creatures’ presence here is as queer an anomaly as I have ever discovered. 

If they are indeed bison, they certainly are not native to the old world, and are neither a favored dairy animal nor beast of burden. What’s more they are enormous, ornery, and temperamentally unsuited to long journeys by sea. And since it’s rather doubtful they swam the Stormwall to get here, I can scarcely fathom what poor soul managed their transport.
06_windsward_body_19_02:
This morning I awoke to some strange snorting noises. In my befuddled state, I confess I at first believed it to be mother’s snoring. But as I recovered my wits, I realized I was far from the settlement, and that the grunts were clearly animal in nature. It became clear that one of the bison was sniffing at the door to my tent.

I sat perfectly still, fearing I would disturb the beast and squander this opportunity for up-close observation. He poked and prodded at a few loose sundries, then mouthed the tentpoles for a bit before he wandered off. When I finally deemed it safe to venture out, I realized the beast had made off with my bag of rations!

I was able to follow at a safe distance, and snatch back my stolen property when it went for a drink in the river. I can hear it groaning in the distance, as if to lament the loss of my bushel of apples and mother’s elderberry pie. It might sound crazy, but I can’t shake the feeling its huffing has a familiar rhythm to it…
06_windsward_body_19_03:
Further investigation is required. But for now, I must return to town, I'm out of pie!

Eureka! Today I made a most dazzling discovery!

Near my campsite, I stumbled upon a large sphere not unlike those famously found at the Amrine Temple. I confess, at present, I know not its purpose, but the bison certainly seem perturbed by it. They will not go near the thing, so I sat atop it to finish my lunch safe from their thieving mouths.

It was there, eating the last of mother’s elderberry pie, that I listened to the bison once more, as they huffed and puffed their annoyance at my presence. Seated atop the sphere I realized where I had heard the rhythm of their panting before: at the Amrine Temple.

There, if you stand amidst the other spheres on a particularly still day, you can hear the sound of the old machinery groan and settle in the soil. There is an audible rhythm to the place—the same familiar drumbeat of the bison’s every breath. They are repeating the song of the spheres! I don’t know what this means, but it is a link between the beasts and the ancient peoples of this land.

I must return to the settlement immediately and document what I have learned. Further investigation is required, and, what’s worse—I am out of pie!
06_windsward_body_20_01:
A warrior’s honor is worth more than the coin in his purse. 

He holds grace with his weapons subordinate to grace with those in his charge. 

His tongue is as true as his blade, and his valor burns as a beacon for those in his shadow. 

We are not sellswords or mercenaries. We serve no purse or purser. 

We are the bringers of order, and the keepers of peace. 

We wield the might of our weapons in defense of the meek and the helpless, 

And uphold the justice of our forefathers, in this life and all our lives thereafter.
06_windsward_body_20_02:
The Creed is not a polite suggestion. It is a code of behavior that every man of every faith must know and respect. I expect you to learn it; to believe it. And if you don’t, you can pack up your iron and go straight back to peddling your swordarm in the local marketplace. 

Any company can teach you to kill – without mercy and without exception. In the Iron Rose we hold ourselves to a different standard. A better standard. One of fair, but firm, adherence to the laws we are sworn to uphold, and above all, to the Creed. THAT is what our clients pay for.

If I ask you to recite the creed at any time, you DO IT. I don’t care if there is a knife at your throat or an enemy at the gates, if you fumble or stammer in any way, you WILL BE out of the company. Is that clear?

-Commander Elaina Merrill
06_windsward_body_20_03:
Valor burns as a beacon in the dark. And Commander Merrill’s fire burns brightest. I know, for I have witnessed the white-hot flames of his glory. 

With a hideous crack, I watched as the cyclops wrenched my arm free of my body. I opened my mouth to scream, but my air rushed from my lungs. My vision rippled, as though I gazed through water. The beast roared and flecks of spittle splattered across my face. As if in answer, I heard the shout of his command—“Halt!” 

The cyclops’ resolve shook at his beck, and it bared its teeth for another attack. As it raised up its arm, I watched Sir Merrill leap high into the air and drive his weapon deep into the cyclops eye. As it doubled over, crimson streaming from the wound, he readied his attack once more, and clove the beast in twain at the waist. 

As he lifted my broken body, cradling my dying form in his blood-soaked arms, he whispered words of comfort into my ears: “Be at peace, son of eternity. May your blade light up the darkness of our land, in this life and the next.”
06_windsward_body_20_04:
Take heed, citizens of the realm! 

We of the Iron Rose seek to bolster the ranks of our brotherhood. 

If you have skill with blade or with bow or with flintlock, pack up your gear and assemble at the Iron Keep for the lists before the waxing of the moon. Of your number, at least two shall be selected, and as many more as attendance shall merit, if valor of arms should justify your commission. 

Salary shall be room and board, alongside a standard wage of two coins per cycle of the moon. For those on deployment, combat pay shall be dependent on station, with additional compensation for grievous injury or death under the banner. 

All those who seek honor, your time is now! May your blade shine as a beacon in the darkness!
06_windsward_body_21_01: Chorus:   Skipping daily on she goes Dark as night and bright as stars She’s a velvet winter’s rose She’s my darling El-la…   Verse:   She’s a girl with skin so fine, Kisses sweet as Cretan wine! Bless my heart, she must be mine! Oh, my darling El-la…
06_windsward_body_21_02: Verse:   Sweet as your intentions are She’s a heart as black as tar! Better men have fallen far, All for the sake of El-la…
06_windsward_body_21_03: Verse:   Plenty fools have felt her sting, Of her fallen angel’s wing. Pure misfortune she shall bring! Mercy, darling, El-la!
06_windsward_body_22_01:
At night asleep, alone in my bed, I whisper… 

Remember a time back before you went away. 

We speak of these things, and in my heart, I ask you: 

Please tell me the things that made you go astray? 

  

Your pain and my loss bind you to me, forever. 

If only you could see just what you left behind. 

Who better to trust but those you love and treasure? 

Where did you go and what did you hope to find?   





“Do you know, sweet love, why people don’t live forever?” 

I ask you to speak by still there is no answer…

  

Your loving daughter, 

 Roya
06_windsward_body_23_01: The Power chooses those it deems worthy. That was what my grandmother told me. That is why she called me Kabir – a name that means “great” in her mother tongue. She was Persian like me, and sent me away to the Druids, in hopes the Power would find me one day. It didn’t. The Druids were strong in the power. But any god of wisdom or kindness would have found them wanting. Unfit for their order, I washed their cloaks, cooked their meals, and tended their fires, all for a few scraps of food and a bedroll. And in return, they gave me a new name: mud boy. “Look at him,” they’d jibe, “The ash of the fires will not wash out.” Duncan, the elder, always laughed hardest at that one. And so I made sure that he was the first to scream.
06_windsward_body_23_02:
I ran then. I ran with my heart thumping to escape my chest. And suddenly it was quiet.  

Under Duncan’s scream, I heard the cries of another. The screams of the very earth. This land was bound to the druids by the Power, and her torment echoed through my mind like the peals of a hammer. I fell to my hands and knees and retched, spitting my noon repast into the soil. 

Then something impossible happened. Duncan got back up, his neck bent to one side where I had cracked it. His bulging dead eyes fixed on me, and he opened his mouth as though to accuse me. But what poured out were not words. All manner of insects and vermin spilled forth from the hole—flies and worms and beetles! 

And endless stream, they poured onto the floor, crawling over the grass and leaves like a flood. I ran, but all around I could see them, the other Druids, bent and stooped and broken. They were… like him. Like Duncan…
06_windsward_body_23_03: I used to call her Auntie, for she was from Persia, too. I helped in the summers for some spare coin. She had been good to me; tending to the cuts and scabs I received from the Druids. She took me in and comforted me as I sobbed, not bothering to ask what had upset me so. I wanted to rest, but I couldn’t. Not after what I have seen. So I have scribbled this warning to any who would dare to do as I have done. In the distance I hear thunder. It’s getting dark now – perhaps the rain will lull me to sleep. Then, in the morning I can— Not rain. Not rain… it’s vermin. I can hear them, buzzing at the glass and the chimney. They are here. He is here! He has found me… There is a bloodstain with a crushed beetle on the bottom of the page.
06_windsward_body_24_01:
My dearest Millicent,  

Nessa! Nessa! Apple of the teacher’s eye. That worthless orphan they scrounged up from the gutter. Does she actually believe herself my better? 

“Maestro Ovate, I know this! Let me perform the ritual!” Well of course you do, you witless, friendless wretch! Alone with your books in the woods and hollows with only the critters for comfort. 

I bared my teeth at her today. Let the wriggling pup tremble in fear. 

-Millicent Taylor
06_windsward_body_24_02:
Dearest mother, 

I trust you must be watching from heaven, for I can scarcely believe my good fortune. I have made… and I dare not utter the words: a friend! A companion out here, in this enclave out here in the woods! 

Since you passed, and the druids carried me off to this place, I have kept to myself. To my studies of nature and this land and its spirits. But, mother, poor mother, you cannot believe how lonely it’s been for me out here alone. 

But today, I met her! Her name’s Millicent—and we’re just thick as thieves! She’s as cute as a princess, and kind as can be. She must have seen how lonesome I was, for she smiled brightly at me straight away. Her big blue eyes, they lit up like stars in the night, as she showed her big teeth to me! 

Oh my dearest new friend! You’re such a warm welcome sight! And soon we’ll be druids – keepers of this place, together! 

Oh mother! Dear mother! Farewell! 

-Your Nessa
06_windsward_body_24_03:
Dearest Millicent, 

At first, I regarded Nessa as nothing more than an irritating weed, but now I see she is a blight on the landscape. And we druids cannot abide such foul contagion. Better to purge the sickness with fire! 

Today, before Master Ovate she claimed: “Oh Millicent, you’ve mixed too much tincture of Hyssop in your brew. Now the wounds will not mend. It shall be thick as common ointment!” 

Common?! Common like her cheap robes and pauper’s smile? Be still, my heart, I shall see her downfall! I swear it! 

-Millicent Taylor
06_windsward_body_24_04: On the page is a stick figure drawing, scrawled by the hand of child. Two girls hold hands under the shining sun, their names – Millicent and Nessa – inscribed underneath. Millicent has large teeth, her head adorned by the crown of a princess. Nessa carries a druid’s staff with flowers tucked in her hair.

06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_a: Ask five people, you'll get five theories. Some say we've been cursed, others blame the local Druids.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_a_new: <g id="guard_laughmed" />Well, isn't that grand? People starving in the streets, everyone whispering the Sorceress Medea's cursed us, <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />and now tidings of evil. What's next?
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_b: Some are even calling for the town's leader, the Speaker of the Winds, to step down. But he's doing what he can.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_b_new: <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Look, the Speaker of the Winds is in charge. <g id="guard_nod" />Talk to him if you like, but <g id="guard_headshakeno" />don't expect some kind of welcome banquet. Corinth's gone from feast to famine.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_next_a: Oh right, the hero. Hate to break it to you, hero, but eternal life on Aeternum means eternal trouble.

<g id="guard_shrugbrief" />Ask five people, you'll get five theories. <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Some say we've been cursed, others blame the local druids. <g id="guard_headshakeno" />Don't make a damn bit of difference, if you ask me.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_next_b: But if you want to help, speak with Quartermaster Agrawal. Who knows? Maybe you two can fix everything!

<g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Go see the Speaker in the Town Hall if you want to gab any more. <g id="guard_nod" />That bastard loves to talk. After that, I suggest <g id="guard_nod" />you be moving on.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_proposal_next_p: "Is there anything I can do to help?"
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_response_a: Spoken to the Captain, have you? He's normally not quite so dour. Although I suppose he was never a particularly charming man.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_response_a_new: <g id="litearmor_gestureright" />You see this poor, wretched thing? A month ago, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />my friend Winston here baked the best bread in Corinth! Now… this is his fate for all eternity.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_response_b: It's just that Windsward has just experienced a bit of bad luck recently.
06a_msq_01_quartermaster_response_b_new: <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />The Lost… we call them, and their numbers <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />grow as ours dwindle… all across Windsward.
06a_msq_01_talkfrancis_a_new: <g id="sit_headshakeno_francis" />See now, why <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />spoil our pleasant conversation with such dark business? <g id="sit_laughmed_francis" />You're new to Corinth! You should check in at the inn! <g id="sit_nod_francis" />Yes, put your feet up!
06a_msq_01_talkfrancis_b_new: Whatever you do, <g id="sit_headshakeno_francis" />please don't go worrying everyone about the Corrupted! <g id="sit_nod_francis" />I'll deal with that problem when it comes! <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />Or Elder Saatvik will, he seems to enjoy it.
06a_msq_01_talkfrancis_next_a_new: <g id="sit_nod_francis" />By all means! See if you can help the man come to his senses… <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />before he worries so much he falls Lost himself. <g id="sit_laughmed_francis" />Good luck! You'll need it with Saatvik!
06a_msq_01_talktospeaker_talk_francis: Speak with Francis Turner, Speaker of the Winds
06a_msq_02_visitinn_desc: Visit the Inn and speak with Innkeep Verildis Jannsen to check in. Discover an old friend at the Inn.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_incomplete_a: I really do appreciate your offer to help, but I must decline.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_incomplete_b: Check yourself in at the inn and eat a warm meal. Assuming you can scrounge one, that is.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_incomplete_new: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Please, speak with the inkeep at the Southern Breeze. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Even travelers need a place they can call home for a night!
06a_msq_02_visitinn_interact_inn: Check in with the Innkeep at the Southern Breeze Inn
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_a: He broke a centuries-old tradition and stopped paying tribute to the Sorceress Medea.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_a_new: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />That's a long and sordid tale… suffice to say - Medea hasn't been seen here in decades, <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />but Corinth pays regular tribute to the Sorceress.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_b: She hasn't been seen or heard from in decades, so many have questioned whether she even exists. Seems the Speaker decided to find out.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_b_new: <g id="litearmor_darnit" />Of course, the Speaker insists the tribute was sent and that the druids invited this disaster. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Either way, the situation is dire, and growing worse.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next2_a: Absolutely not, you're a guest! I insist you check in at the inn. You came ashore in that terrible storm, I'm sure you need rest.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next2_a_new: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Thank you. Nice to speak with someone not miserable or insane. <g id="litearmor_think" />There's another newcomer, a rather feisty young woman. <g id="litearmor_agree1" />You'll likely see her at the inn.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next2_b: In any case, it's my duty to talk to the man. This is my burden to bear.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next_a: It can’t simply be a coincidence. And I've heard the stories of Medea. She's not someone you cross.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next_a_new: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I prefer not to recruit a newcomer for such a dangerous enterprise, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but the truth is, if we don't salvage what we can from the farms, starvation will bring more Lost.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next_b: The question is why the damn Speaker took it upon himself to cancel the tribute without consulting anyone.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_proposal_next_b_new: But please, before you do anything else, <g id="litearmor_gestureright" />check in at the inn. Take what time you need. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />And then I'll be calling a meeting in the tavern. If you're inclined.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_response_a: <g id="grace_welcome" />Where've you been hiding? I was afraid I'd have to go back to the beach and search for you.
06a_msq_02_visitinn_response_b: <g id="grace_secret" />Not that I wanted to stay here, mind you! This hamlet's ready for a bloody wake!
06a_msq_02_visitinn_response_next_a: <g id="grace_chuckle" />Problems? I've raided tombs more lively than this place!
06a_msq_02_visitinn_response_next_b: <g id="grace_shifty" priority="high"/>I don't plan on hanging around here long, not when the winds are shifting the way they are. <g id="grace_no" />It's bad business.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_desc: Visit the Trading Post and one of the Storage Sheds in Corinth. Then speak with Grace at the Inn.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_incomplete: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />You have all that coin jingling in your pockets. <g id="grace_convince2" />Go and spend it! And you never know when someone might steal it when you're not looking.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_a: <g id="grace_gestureL" />There's a trading post here. Not exactly thriving, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />but you could at least get yourself some new clothes.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_b: <g id="grace_lean" />I'm telling you this as a friend - you smell like something that washed in with the tide.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_next_a: Well there you go! You can always count on me to tell it to you straight.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_next_a_n: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Well, there ya have it then! You can always count on your pal Grace <g id="grace_headnodyes" />to give it to you straight.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_next_b: Get yourself on to the Trading Post. And if you need to stash anything, there's a storage shed as well. I'll be getting the lay of the land.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_proposal_next_b_n: <g id="grace_gestureLeftM" />Go on to the Trading Post and get yourself some gear. <g id="grace_gestureBehind" />Then meet me in the tavern. Must be at least some action over there. <g id="grace_headnodyes" />We'll see, won't we?
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_response_a: See, doesn't spending coin make you feel more alive? Glad one of us got what they needed.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_response_a_new: <g id="grace_doubt" />Well there's a pretty little ditty for you… some romanticized notions of Aeternum, I'd say. <g id="grace_headshakeno" />Grace O'Malley won't be calling this place home. I'll tell you that.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_response_b: I'm gonna have to find some richer places to plunder before I can get myself a boat and get off this damned rock.
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_response_b_new: <g id="grace_secret" />The real tragedy of Corinth is there's no way a girl can make some quick money around here!
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_trigger_whispers: Return to the Inn to speak with Grace
06a_msq_03_visitmarket_whisper_text: Even on Aeternum, civilization is built on a foundation of lies. Together, you and I can tear it down and rebuild…
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_desc: Speak with the Speaker of the Winds at the Town Hall in Corinth
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_incomplete_a: I won't be staying here long, but I'll make sure to leave a message when I head out.
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_proposal_a: He said your heroics on the shore got the attention of this so-called "Speaker of the Winds."
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_proposal_b: Sounds like a right charlatan to me. He's waiting for you in the town hall.
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_response_a: So here's the one Watcher Reese lavished such high praise on! A real charge-in-and-hit-'em-where-it-counts kinda fighter!
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_response_b: We need more newcomers like you in Windsward. Everyone around here's gone so damn soft!
06a_msq_04_seespeaker_transport_npc_note: Speak with the Speaker of the Winds
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_desc: Visit Golden Fields to gather food to resupply Corinth.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_goto_farm: Help Quartermaster Saatvik salvage Supplies from the {POITags}
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_incomplete_a: Look for Quartermaster Agrawal on the road out by the farms.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_incomplete_new: <g id="grace_understand" />Like I said, I'll be seeing you around. Long as you don't go losing your soul somewhere. <g id="grace_frustrated" />Ah here... I can't believe I'm even saying these things.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_interact_cart: Fill the Cart with Grain and Vegetables
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_prompt: "You don't think this is about the tribute?"
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_a: Of course not! That damned sorceress doesn't deserve our hard-earned goods. But that was a misunderstanding. We sent the damn tribute!
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_a_new: <g id="grace_pshaw" />Hah! That'll be the day! I'm no farmer, and besides, <g id="grace_lean" />I caught wind of a pirate hideout not so far from town. Thinking maybe there's some loot there.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_b: No, I think this curse was brought on by the Druids. They were the first to transform into soulless Lost.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_b_new: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />But you're the hero, right? Just like old… whatever-his-name-was at the beach. <g id="grace_yes" />If you want to give a hand to old Saatvik, I'm sure he'll make use of it.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next2_a: Now that's the spirit! We need fighters, not whiners and nay-sayers!
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next2_b: Just now, Quartermaster Agrawal's headed to the farms to salvage what he can, but he's no warrior. Go and see if you can help.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next_a: Aye! Can you imagine such a tragedy? The very people we trusted to care for our crops became monsters and started this damn plague!
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next_a_: <g id="grace_pointL" />To the farms north of town. He was practically begging folks to go with him, so <g id="grace_yes" />I'm sure he'll be damn glad to see you.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next_b: Now entire farms and villages are falling Lost - half of Windsward at this point!
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_proposal_next_b_: <g id="grace_handheart" />I'll linger here a bit, and then check out these pirates. <g id="grace_sympathy" />Don't get yourself into trouble. I'd hate to lose the only other sane person on the island.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_response_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, it's not as much as I'd hoped, but it's certainly better than nothing. <g id="litearmor_agree1" />This grain will keep us fed for a few more days at least.
06a_msq_05_fixwindmills_response_b: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />With the windmills turning again, at least there's hope for the future.
06a_msq_05_grainsack_description: Grain freshly milled from the windmills at Golden Fields.
06a_msq_05_veggiecrate_description: The last vegetables harvested from Golden Fields.
06a_msq_06_druidnessa_bark: About time someone came to help! Meet me at the edge of the farm - we should talk!
06a_msq_06_druidnessa_bark_new: <g id="male_shocked" />It is? Oh, well, I would've figured it out soon enough, <g id="male_willcoverit" />but thank you nonetheless. Meet me at the edge of the farm. We should talk.
06a_msq_06_farmerlijsbet_bark: Oh, bless you, my friend! I felt my hope fading away! I almost became Withered!
06a_msq_06_farmermichael_bark: Thank you. My family, my farm, all Lost… I'm the only one left.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_desc: Rescue and talk to farmers who survived what happened at Golden Fields.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />If there are any farmers, or Druids, I hope they can give us some insight into exactly what transpired here.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto2_a: I've never heard of anyone who could snap their fingers and turn people Lost. If such magic exists, I'd like to know more about it myself.

<g id="female_shakeheadNo" />Not likely. <g id="female_fingerwagNo" />I've never heard of anyone who could snap their fingers and turn people Lost.<g id="male_agree1" /> If such magic exists, I'd like to know more about it myself.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto2_b: No, this is something else, something related to the land itself.

<g id="female_spreadarms" /> Do you know the history of this region? Ah, well, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'm something of an expert on Windsward. It's a bit of a tale, but I think it'll help you understand…
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto2_c: <g id="male_explain" />I realize that sounds a bit dour, but it is the truth of it. <g id="male_converseleft" />The question now is what's behind all this mess and how we go about cleaning it up.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto3_a: <g id="female_disagreecrossarms" />Not intentionally. It certainly didn't turn out well for them, did it?<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> But it's possible some unfortunate effort to bless the land went astray.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto3_b: <g id="female_whattheheck" />Ah... that blowhard Speaker of the Winds is pushing that theory, isn't he? <g id="female_disappointed" />Buffoon. At least we have Elder Saatvik. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />It's good of you to help him.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto4_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I commend your attitude. I'm sure whatever you accomplish with Elder Saatvik will be worthwhile. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I do hope we meet again. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Until then, fare thee well!
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto_a: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I've only just returned from completing my druidic studies at another warren in the north. <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />Whatever happened here, I missed it.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_nessa_talkto_b: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" />It appears all the other druids fell Lost from one day to the next! <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />If I didn't know better,<g id="female_smackfist" /> I'd say this is some kind of curse.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_prompt: "I'll check the rest of the farm."
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Your confidence seems matched by your skill, so I welcome the help. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Indeed, if you rescue anyone you can find, <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />we might be able to get some answers.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal_a: Your confidence seems matched by your skill, so I welcome the help.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal_b: Indeed, if you rescue anyone you can find, we might be able to get some answers.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal_next_a: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Oh… Good thinking! This farm produced a bountiful crop of fruits and vegetables as well.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The fields are cursed now, but <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />there are crates of food that have already been harvested. <g id="litearmor_gestureright" />Go on then, I'll wait here.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_proposal_prompt: "I can search for more food too."
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_response_a: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />That, my friend, was most impressive! These vegetables may make all the difference.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_response_b: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I spoke to the farmers you rescued. They said you also rescued a druid? <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />What did she say?
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_response_next_a: <g id="litearmor_think" />Hm, she must be an initiate. They train up north.
06a_msq_06_rescuefarmers_response_next_b: <g id="litearmor_converseleft" />Perhaps she can help us make sense of all this. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I don't think the Speaker is on the right track, not at all.
06a_msq_07_armband_description: A symbol of camaraderie too important to be left behind.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_desc: Visit the Iron Rose Garrison and find out what happened to the Sorceress Medea's Tribute.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_find_clues: Search for Clues to the Missing Tribute at the Iron Rose Garrison
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_incomplete_a: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Uh, while I appreciate your help gathering food for Corinth, we need to know why the Company of the Iron Rose wasn't here to protect the farm.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Yes, they were hired by Medea herself, to protect and transport the tribute, <g id="litearmor_converseright" />but the town had engaged them for security as well.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I haven't seen a single member of the Iron Rose Company since this whole thing started.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_proposal_next_a: <g id="litearmor_gesturebackthere" />The Iron Keep lies to the northwest. If you can go and find out about the Tribute, <g id="litearmor_agree1" />it may help us solve this dilemma.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_proposal_next_b: <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I should get these goods back to town where they're desperately needed. Good luck!
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_response_a: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />I don't understand, my comrades were hardened soldiers.<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Tough bastards, one and all.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_response_b: <g id="female_youknow" />We've all died a time or two. What soldier hasn't on this island? <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />How could every one of them have become Lost?
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_response_next_a: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />We heard the farmers' cries and rushed to help, but the beetles were on us the moment we emerged from the garrison.
06a_msq_07_meetironrose_response_next_b: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />No, we, we, we fought bravely. <g id="male_willcoverit" />But when my comrades began to fall,<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" /> I realized they were returning as Lost.
06a_msq_08_medealetter_description: This letter is from Medea to the Company of the Iron Rose and expresses her displeasure over not receiving any tribute.
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_desc: Rescue any surviving members of the Company of the Iron Rose and discover the fate of Sergeant Cotheran, then meet Leovix Silva at the Iron Keep.
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_goto_campsite: Establish a Camp near the Iron Rose Garrison
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />I just need a moment before I go and face Commander Merrill. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />She will no doubt order me to recount every tragic detail.
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_makecamp: Make a camp or bind to an existing camp to set a respawn point near the Iron Rose Garrison
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes, but I can’t be the only one! <g id="male_dontknow" />I've fought alongside these soldiers against impossible odds!
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_proposal_b: <g id="female_whattheheck" />Now they become Lost fighting some damn bugs? <g id="male_righthandAngry" />Sergeant Cotheran, tough as orichalcum! She must be here somewhere.
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Would you do that? I can't bear to face my former comrades. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Not again!
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_compliment" />Find Cotheran, then meet me at the Iron Keep to the west. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I must report this to Commander Merrill, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />though I dread doing so.
06a_msq_08_rescuegideon_response: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />What a relief to see you again! <g id="male_shakehead" />I'm afraid that the same curse that befell the garrison has struck the Iron Keep as well! <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high"/>It's swarming with my Lost brethren!
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_desc: Search Iron Keep to find any information about the missing tribute to Medea. Bring anything you find back to Leovix at the tavern in Corinth.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_goto_estate: Search Iron Keep for Clues to the Missing Tribute
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_incomplete: Do you have any information about the tribute? Commander Merrill would keep his correspondence on his desk.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_incomplete_ne: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You're a brave soul to go charging in to fight the members of my order. Even Lost, they will be formidable.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_proposal_a: No, we received a missive informing us that Guard Captain Dupont had already taken Medea's tribute.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_proposal_a_ne: <g id="female_notsure" />It could be, but I can't imagine why. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />We've delivered her damn tribute for more years than I can count. <g id="male_crossarmsupset /> It makes no sense she'd turn on us.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_proposal_b: It was highly irregular. Of course if Cotheran had gone, she might still have her soul…
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_proposal_b_ne: <g id="female_thinking" />Although... Cotheran was on the rotation to escort the tribute this season… and if she was still at the garrison… <g id="male_guiltyLookside" priority="high" />well, I don't know.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_proposal_next: I cannot raise arms against my fallen comrades. You must fight your way into the Iron Keep alone. I must see the Speaker.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've got mettle, I'll give you that. <g id="female_nodding" />You'd have made fine addition to the Iron Rose… <g id="male_shrugBrief" />if all this hadn't happened.
Find what you can, then use the Spirit Shrine to meet me in Corinth. Valor is a beacon, friend!
<g id="male_compliment" />But yes, go look for the tribute. And search Commander Merrill's office, too. <g id="female_gestureLeft" />He managed correspondence with Medea, so you might find something.

<g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll head to Corinth and see the Speaker of the Winds. Meet me there after the keep. <g id="male_pointRight" />There's a shrine nearby to speed you on your way. <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Good luck, soldier.
Are you suggesting the curse is Medea's doing? Dear god, I hope not. Commander Merrill stayed in close communication with the Sorceress.

<g id="female_youknow" />There's only one way to know for sure. <g id="male_pointLeft" />The staging area is inside the keep. Either the wagons are there... <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />or they aren't.
If she failed to receive tribute, the Commander would've received a very prompt letter.

<g id="male_willcoverit" />Now listen, I want the truth and to prove <g id="male_nodunderstand" />the Iron Rose didn't fail in its duty, <g id="male_righthandNodeal" /> but I can't raise arms against my fallen comrades again. Not yet.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_response_a: You made it-- I almost called you comrade. Did you find anything in the Iron Keep? Ah, so there was correspondence from Medea.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_response_a_ne: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />It's good to see you… heh, <g id="male_chuckle" />almost called you 'comrade'! I'm glad you made it safely. <g id="female_spreadarms" />It seems this disaster has spread all across Windsward.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_response_b: Good heavens! She never received the tribute. She is most displeased.
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_response_b_ne: <g id="female_takeAndGiveItem8s" priority="high" />What did you find in the Iron Keep? A correspondence from Medea…? Let me see. Ah, god's blood, she is not happy!
06a_msq_09_defeatcommander_search_clues: Search Iron Keep for Clues to the Missing Tribute
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_desc: Find out what really happened to the tribute to Medea by talking to the Speaker of the Winds and the Captain of the Guard.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_incomplete: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />I swear, if the Speaker doesn't own up to his mistake, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />you'll have to extract my sabaton from his arse.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_a: I don’t know. But this is precisely why Medea entrusted the Iron Rose with the responsibility for the tribute.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_a_new: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />That beady-eyed little bastard! I'll see <g id="male_righthandAngry" />him tarred and feathered if this is his fault, <g id="male_realize" />but wait… if Dupont took the tribute, <g id="male_pointleft"/>the Speaker would've known.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_b: The Company has never failed to honor a contract, and now the damned Speaker has tarnished our reputation.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_b_new: <g id="female_youknow" /> This explains why he wouldn't see me - the rotten scoundrel! <g id="male_pointblame" />They can't dodge this, though! You've got proof, right?
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_next_a: No, the bastard wouldn't see me, of course. And now I'd only bash his face in.

<g id="g_male_headnodyes" />That's good. I'd join you, but <g id="male_shakehead" />I'm not sure I could resist the urge <g id="female_smackfist" />to bash their faces in. You'll <g id="male_nodunderstand" />do better alone.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_proposal_next_b: This is all the proof we need, however. You should confront him. If he denies it, call me for the bashing.
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_response_a: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />You don't have to tell me, I already heard - <g id="male_righthandAngry" />that weasel Dupont let the tribute <g id="male_converseleft" />get stolen by pirates!
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_response_b: <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />Never would've happened with the Iron Rose! Now we're all paying the price, aren't we?
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_talk_francis: Confront Speaker of the Winds Francis Turner with Medea's letter
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_talk_marcel: Speak with Captain Marcel Dupont about Medea's Tribute
06a_msq_10_talktospeaker_whisper: "And then their betrayal was exposed to the world..." Empires decay. But the righteousness of our cause endures.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_desc: Travel to the camp site by Buccaneer Creek. Talk to Grace. Then look for Pirate Treasures at Buccaneer Creek.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_goto_pirates: Search {POITags} for Clues to the Stolen Tribute
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_incomplete_a: <g id="female_youknow" />Don't forget to set yourself a campsite. <g id="male_shrugBrief" />If you get in over your head, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />it's a safe place to go back to.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_proposal_a: I don't know, but it can't hurt. If Medea's not responsible for the curse, we could use her help.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_proposal_a_n: <g id="male_nodproud" />I think the Speaker and that fool Dupont are hiding something, and when I find out what it is, <g id="female_smackfist" />they'll answer for it. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I promise you that.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_proposal_b: But truth be told, I need a drink and about a week of sleep. I wouldn't make a good comrade-in-arms right now.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_proposal_b_n: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />Still, if the tribute can be reclaimed, it's worth trying. But going up against the Buccaneer Creek Pirates… <g id="male_shakehead" />that will be ugly. Won't find many volunteers.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_proposal_nex: We've tangled with the Buccaneer Creek Pirates - they're crafty. If you're going alone, always smart to set up a camp. There's a good spot near the pirates' den.

<g id="male_chuckle" />I knew you'd say that. Just be careful. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />Those brigands are crafty as hell. I'd come, but I've got to find <g id="female_nodyes" />someone in this damn town I can trust first…
I'll be at the tavern. Strength be with you, soldier.
<g id="male_agree1" />Alright, I know Saatvik. I'll go see him right away. <g id="female_salute2finger" /> Godspeed to Buccaneer Creek, my friend. Scout the camp carefully before charging in.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_rescue_nessa: Open the cage to rescue Nessa
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_a: I see by your expression you realized the same thing I did. Didn't want to discourage you, but your tribute was all gone.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_a_n: <g id="female_youknow" />Well, this was a fortunate coincidence. For me, at least. <g id="male_shakehead" />I wasn't exactly thrilled with the prospect of spending eternity in a cage. <g id="male_willcoverit" />So thank you… again.
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_b: But tell me you at least found something of value!
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_b_n: <g id="female_nodyes" />I had an inkling the Pirates had fallen Lost, like so many others, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but I was a little clumsy in my attempt to verify that fact. <g id="female_nodyes" />Now we know, though, don't we?
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_nex: Have I told you lately how much I like you? You got a hero's heart, and a clever mind. And you're a trusty mate.
We should partner up for a little more looting. Maybe even find something to help the town.
Well now, that's right devious. Not sure if I'm disappointed or impressed with the bastard.

<g id="female_thinking" />I'm not quite sure yet, but I'm curious if the pirates ventured into the nearby ruins, <g id="male_converseleft" />which is where one of Medea's Verdant Gemstones was placed.
But don't judge me, I'd never betray and steal from innocents. I just steal from those who deserve it. Speaking of which...
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_response_pro: "Yes, the pirates' deal with the Speaker."
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_smash_crates: Smash Crates to collect Consumed Tribute Supplies
06a_msq_11_lootpiratecrates_trigger: Scout out the Buccaneer Creek Pirate Camp
06a_msq_11_piratecontract_description: This contract goes into detail of how the pirates will steal Medea's tribute and in return will be paid with the location of jewels provided by the Speaker of the Winds.
06a_msq_11_pirateloot_description: The interior is mostly crumbs of former feasts. The ghosts of meals already eaten.
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_desc: Find evidence that Marcel was here with the pirates. Recover the stolen Verdant Gemstone.
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_incomplet: Think of that precious gemstone, all alone in that hostile place. It's a right heartache!
<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> How ironic would it be if it was the pirates' greed that caused this mess? I suppose it's always something unexpected, though.
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_proposal_: If we find this so-called “Verdant Gemstone,” we could always sell it back to the town.
<g id="female_leanpointconvince" />Get yourself into the Captain's quarters within the camp. I'd like to know if he has the Verdant Gemstone stashed somewhere.
Oh, don't look at me like that! Fine! I guess if you're the one going in, it'll be your call. Surely, we'll get something for it.

<g id="male_explain" />If my suspicions are true, and they usually are, this could be the cause of Windsward's ills. <g id="female_nodyes" />So check for the Gemstone and then come to the ruins. Good luck.
Aye, and if you're going in, I'd recommend the bold approach myself. Just blast through the gate like you own the place!
But don't get cocky, that captain fights with a right nasty boat anchor.
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_response_: I must say, I'm quite happy to find someone here other than those foul pirates.

<g id="male_apologizesmall" />I'm sorry to dash your friend's dreams of wealth, <g id="female_nodyes" />but she should know, it's quite impossible to leave the island. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />The stormwall is… a force of nature.
And Grace mentioned a letter that referred to a priceless "Verdant Gemstone?" I don't suppose you found such a thing, did you?

<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />More importantly however, that Verdant Gemstone must be <g id="male_pointLeft" priority = "high" />returned to the ruins if we're to have any hope of cleaning up this horrid mess.
I can't believe it! Please, may I see it? Amazing...
<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />I'm glad to hear that. Especially because I'm about to ask you for yet another favor… <g id="male_willcoverit" />I do hope you'll be amenable.
It's both ironic and incredibly lucky that you found this. You see, I'm convinced Medea did not cause this curse. I believe it's this Verdant Gemstone.
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_trigger: Search captain Dauti's Redoubt for the "Verdant Gemstone"
06a_msq_12_defeatpiratecaptain_trigger_n: Meet with Nessa near the Ruins
06a_msq_12_marcelhat_description: This looks exactly like Marcel's Hat... not to mention it has 'Dupont' embroidered on the interior lining.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_desc: Climb Mirador Shrine, complete the ancient puzzle, restore the gemstone, then speak with Nessa.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_goto_ruins: Face the Ancient Guardians at Mirador to restore the Verdant Gemstone
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_incomplete: Are you bolstering your courage? I find it helps to imagine something inspiring, like a big slice of lime and elderberry pie. Mmm...
<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />If that Gemstone isn't restored soon, I'm afraid the situation could get even worse.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_interact_p: Rotate the Glyphs to restore power to the Mirador Shrine
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_nessa_prom: "I agree. Did you talk to Moira?"
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_nessarespo: Oh! You did it! I may have sensed some kind of change in the flora here. Of course, I'm just an apprentice Druid.
<g id="female_nodyes" />I did, and she understands the urgency of the situation. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The problem is that we don't even know the location of the other shrines.
Oh. Your friend Grace seems a little disappointed. I think she had other plans for the gemstone.
<g id="female_explains" />Moira is scouring her scrolls in an attempt to find us some answers.<g id="male_compliment" /> In fact, you should go and meet her, and see if there's been any progress.

<g id="male_willcoverit" />I will join you shortly. As much sacrifice as it may require, I want to talk to Elder Saatvik about resuming tribute… <g id="male_righthandAngry" />whether the Speaker agrees or not.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_proposal_a: There are four altogether. One is safe in the warren of Thornhall. We will need to find and restore the other three.

<g id="male_waghand01" />Oh no! I promise you! I'm not just saying this so you'll help. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I think you'll agree, the situation is a bit desperate here, and you are capable.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_proposal_b: But first, this gemstone must be returned to its place in the Mirador Shrine. There is a catch, however.

<g id="female_explains" />The Verdant Gemstone must be restored to the ancient shrine, or Windsward will continue to suffer. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I can ask around town for volunteers, I suppose.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_proposal_n: <g id="female_nodyes" />Perfect. I suppose <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />you'll want to speak to your friend, here. But don't take too long. <g id="male_pointLeft" />Replace the Gemstone and then come to Corinth. See you there.
Mirador is a ruin that dates back to the time of the Ancients. It's quite likely protected by Ancient Guardians.
<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Thank you. Replacing the Gemstone may require some manipulation of the ancient mechanisms in the shrine, <g id="male_compliment" />but I'm sure you'll figure it out.
But if you can get past them and solve the shrine's puzzle, the rest is easy. And I believe in you!

<g id="male_willcoverit" />I must go and speak with Sage Moira in Corinth. There are two more shrines like this one, <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />and if those Gemstones are missing… well, we're just getting started.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_response_a: Oh, I understand all right! The two of you have decided to play noble heroes and save the land. And I'm leaving here nearly empty-handed.

<g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Well met, newcomer. It's rare to see someone who's just arrived become such a pivotal figure in Corinth, but <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Nessa speaks very highly of you.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_response_b: I'm the one who scouted out the Pirates, you know! I deserve something for my troubles.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_response_p: "The Speaker owes us all a debt"
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_talkgrace: <g id="grace_frustrated" priority="high"/>Well, when you put it that way, no... It's just, well, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I guess this means we've gotta find our fortune somewhere else. <g id="grace_headshakeno" />I'm not giving up.
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_talkgrace_: <g id="grace_crossarmsInsulted" />I suppose I'll make my way back to Corinth and see if I can stir up something. What about you? <g id="grace_yes" />You're putting that Gemstone back, aren't you?

<g id="grace_fistchest" />Then I'm sure I'll bump into you there. I'll probably be in the tavern. <g id="grace_lean" priority="high"/>God knows I deserve a drink after all this. Come by and have one with me, why don't ya?
06a_msq_13_returnmiradorjewel_whisper_te: Friends and allies vanish when facing a great challenge, don't they? You and I never hesitate… we share a great destiny.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_desc: Explore the Oracle Therismos to find the Ancient Map leading to the other Verdant Gemstones.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_goto_breakwate: Explore {POITags} to find an Ancient Map
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_incomplete: I must say, I'm feeling much better now that we have a plan. And I think this has at least some chance of being successful.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_incomplete_new: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />We're very fortunate you came to Aeternum when you did. <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />I have a feeling historians of the future will be studying records of your feats.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_interact_puzzl: Obtain a rubbing of the map
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_map_climb_trig: Ascend the Ruins to find the Shrine Map
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_a: Oh, so now you want to recruit me into your charity project. I'd refuse but I'll enjoy this.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_a_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Mostly just how little we truly know.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> I've dedicated several lifetimes to studying Aeternum's history, but much of it remains a mystery.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_b: That Captain Dupont was a right arsehole to me. I'll hang 'em both out to dry. I'll see you back in town.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_b_new: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Before we discuss the shrines, I should share what knowledge I have. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />You might even find it interesting…
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_next2: There's one of those Spirit Shrines over that way, if that's your fancy.

<g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Yes, it does. There's <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />a monument to one of the Ancients on the coast. <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />Within it, a map is engraved with the shrine's locations. I need a rubbing of that map.
I prefer an honest walk myself. Either way, I'll race you. I'll have that Speaker strung up before you even get there!

<g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />While you acquire the map, Nessa and I <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />will continue to learn what we can from these scrolls, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />however little that might be.
"I can do that, if it helps."
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_proposal_next_: My thoughts exactly. I'll visit the library in Corinth to try and find the location of the other shrines.
Honestly though, I’d love to see the expression on Francis Turner's face. Talk about priceless.

<g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />I believe you saw the Guardians yourself at Mirador, so you know the danger. <g id="litearmor_converseleft" />To learn the locations of the other shrines, we must venture again into the ruins.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_response: Once again, you show up just in time! Can I see the map rubbing? Ah, yes, I can see the locations of the two other shrines quite clearly.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_response_new: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Excellent! I'm afraid we've not had much luck with these scrolls, <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high"/>but let's see what you brought back… ooh, yes this is clearly some sort of map.
06a_msq_14_solvemappuzzle_talk1_nessa: Speak with Nessa in the Corinth Tavern
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_desc: Join Saatvik and Leovix in the Town Hall to confront the Speaker of the Winds with proof of his crimes.
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_incomplet: Part of becoming a Druid is taking vows of non-violence. If removing the Speaker really requires bloodshed, I'll be staying out of the fray.
<g id="female_nodyes" />I do hope you can resolve the situation with the Speaker peacefully and quickly. We have much work to do.
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_interact_: Collect the Verdant Gemstone from the Speaker's Chest
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_proposal_: Yes, of course, we all can. But we need the information the Speaker possesses.
<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />After you left, frustrations boiled over. Elder Saatvik insisted they wait for your return, <g id="female_nodyes" />but Leovix was quite past the point of reason.
You'll have to convince Leovix to wait until we know where the other gemstones are. In any case, I'm in favor of justice but against violence.
<g id="male_pointLeft" />They marched off to the Town Hall just a short time ago. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />If you go quickly, you might be able to avert a violent episode.
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_response_: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />So the Speaker himself had the second gemstone. How did I not see that coming?
<g id="female_nodshrugokay" />Saves us some trouble, I suppose. We can just take it directly to one of the shrines. <g id="female_spreadarms" />Oh... What about the third gemstone?
<g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high"/>Another pirate, then? Seems those are Francis Turner's <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />closest friends and confidants.
Oh by the way, we'll need to escort Francis and Captain Dupont out of town without Leovix seeing.
06a_msq_15_recoverspeakerjewel_trigger_i: Join Saatvik and Leovix to confront the Speaker of the Winds
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_climbing: Ascend the Ruins to replace the Verdant Gemstone
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_desc: Return the Verdant Gemstone to Eldergate by climbing to the top of the ruins.
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_goto_rui: Travel to {POITags} with the Verdant Gemstone
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_incomple: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Is that something new I hear on the wind? I believe it's the sound of… <g id="male_nodunderstand" />yes, it's the sound of procrastination!
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_proposal: <g id="female_nodding" />That does seem to be the next logical step, so you have my support. <g id="female_spreadarms" />We'll continue with the map. The shrine is to the <g id="female_pointRight" />southwest of the city.
<g id="male_handheart" />Do be careful if you run into any Ancient Guardians there. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've become quite indispensable at this point.
06a_msq_16_returneldergatejewel_response: <g id="grace_welcome" />Well, look at you, breathing life back into this wee, sad town. <g id="grace_headnodyes" />You almost make me want to pitch in.
<g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />But I've been anchored here too long. <g id="grace_sorry" />It's time to catch some wind and find more favorable surroundings.

<g id="grace_gestureBehind" />I'll be heading up north. I hear there's a bigger town up there, more modern, much wealthier. <g id="grace_secret" priority="high"/>Sounds like a place a girl can make some real coin.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_desc: Talk to Nessa near the Pirate Den known as Hecker's Haven. Then enter the Den and challenge Captain Korrapati to recover the third Verdant Gemstone.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_goto_pirat: Travel to {POITags} to find Captain Korrapati
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_haveitem_j: Obtain the Verdant Gemstone from Captain Korrapati's Chest
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_incomplete: <g id="grace_goaway" />Go on, then! You better not be getting sentimental on me.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_proposal_a: <g id="grace_convince1" />You've got it covered. And I’m starting to grow moss on my backside.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_proposal_b: <g id="grace_gestureL" />You'll need to be going after that third gemstone! <g id="grace_headnodyes" />That pretty little Druid wants you to meet her to the east. She's scouting out that pirate den.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_proposal_n: <g id="grace_laughcocky" priority="high"/>Oh, we'll cross paths again, as surely as day follows night. <g id="grace_convince1" />You're a restless spirit, same as I.
<g id="grace_goaway" />Go help the Druid girl, then catch up with me in the north. <g id="grace_salutefingers" />Until then, keep your eyes on the horizon!
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_response_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Splendid! You clearly weren't eaten by the alligator. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />And you don't even have any rips on your clothes.
<g id="female_spreadarms" />Splendid work! In and out in a flash and I suspect Korrapati and her crew never knew what hit them.
06a_msq_17_recoverstolenjewel_talk_nessa: Speak with Nessa Harrower outside the Pirate Base
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_desc: Return the third Verdant Gemstone to Sirius and solve the ancient puzzle.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_goto_ruins: Travel to the {POITags} with the Verdant Gemstone
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_incomplete: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />It's very exciting, isn't it? <g id="female_spreadarms" />Once we've restored the jewel at Sirius, things will get better. You'll see.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_interact_pu: Complete puzzle to restore power at Sirius
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_prompt: "Just glad this is the last one."
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_proposal_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Agreed! While you head to Sirius, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll visit town and make sure preparations are under way to resume the tribute.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_proposal_b: I'll meet you back here once I'm done. I can't wait until the land is restored. It's going to be marvelous!
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_proposal_b_: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Just think, we'll soon be able to tell all the people of Corinth the good news. <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />The protections are back in place and the land can heal.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_response_a: Did you manage to restore the third Verdant Gemstone? Strange, I thought I would sense something, but it's very faint.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_response_a_: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Well, so much for my theory that Medea would be understanding, <g id="male_explain" />but of course… keep in mind, she doesn't have all the facts.
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_response_b: Could it be because I'm still just an apprentice? I have much to learn…
06a_msq_18_returnsiriusjewel_whisper_tex: Be careful you're not celebrating a false victory. If you join me, you'll never have to worry about such a thing.
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_desc: Return to Corinth and speak with the the New Speaker of the Winds.
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_incomplete_a: When I see you in town, we'll celebrate with a slice of lime and elderberry pie.
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_proposal_a: You definitely should. But now that we've restored the third gemstone, I'm going to visit the Druidic Warren of Thornhall.
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_proposal_b: I'm hoping by some miracle my fellow Druids are restored as well. I'll see you in town after!
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_response_a: Thank the stars you've returned! If the final gemstone has been restored, then that should mean we will soon have reprieve from the famine.
06a_msq_19_talktonewspeaker_response_b: I fear that hunger is quickly eroding the townspeople's patience with their new Speaker.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_desc: Track down the missing tribute for Speaker Saatvik.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_goto_bulrush: Travel to {POITags} to find the missing tribute
06a_msq_20_losttribute_incomplete: Please talk to Captain Leovix and do whatever is necessary to secure the tribute. We can't afford another disaster right now.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_incomplete_new: X_Please talk to Captain Leovix and do whatever is necessary to secure the tribute. We can't afford another disaster right now.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_proposal_a: Sadly no. He's overwhelmed with the duties of Town Guard Captain, so he sent some of his new recruits.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_proposal_a_new: X_Sadly no. He's overwhelmed with the duties of Town Guard Captain, so he sent some of his new recruits.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_proposal_b: Captain Leovix should be down at the gate. Please find out if anything can be done.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_proposal_b_new: X_Captain Leovix should be down at the gate. Please find out if anything can be done.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_response_a: Every time I have to see the terrible fate that's befallen my fellow Druids, I shudder at the horror.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_response_b: After all our work restoring the Verdant Gemstones, this is enough to make even me lose hope.
06a_msq_20_losttribute_talk_leovix: Speak with Leovix Silva in Corinth
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_desc: Infiltrate Thornhall, the most holy site of Windsward's druids, and find Medea. Convince her to give the region a second chance.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_goto_thornhall: Confront Medea in the Fallen Druid Grove at Thornhall
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_incomplete: You are beyond brave to challenge Medea. Her power is truly staggering.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_incomplete_new: <g id="female_worry" />Though I'm extremely nervous about encountering Medea, I have to confess, I'm also a bit excited to finally meet her.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_outrocinematictrig: Leave the Grove and head back to Nessa
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_prompt: "So she's mad about tribute and the shrines?"
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_a: Yes, and now she's the one preventing the land from healing. There is a fourth Verdant Gemstone within Thornhall, you see.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_a_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, we have to at least try, don't we? <g id="male_handheart" />Or perhaps as the last druid, I should be volunteering as tribute. <g id="male_shakehead" />Can't say I'm too excited about that.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_b: She has taken the warren for herself and removed the gemstone to ensure the curse cannot be lifted.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_next_a: She may not listen to reason, but she must be confronted. My powers pale compared to hers, so I’d be of little help.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_next_a_ne: <g id="male_waghand01" />You're not thinking to do battle with her, are you? <g id="female_explains" />Medea's been on Aeternum for millennia. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />She's insanely powerful.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_next_b: But if anyone can defeat a powerful sorceress like Medea, it will be you. My last hope goes with you.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_next_b_ne: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />If you could just get her to hear us out, however, I feel certain <g id="male_nodunderstand" />she'd be open to some effort at amends on our part. Don't you think?
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_proposal_next_c_ne: <g id="female_nodyes" />Very well. She mentioned seeing the fallen druids, so she must have occupied Thornhall, <g id="female_pointRight" />our warren to the west. Go there, <g id="male_handheart" />and I will soon follow.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_a: You'll have to forgive me. I've just spoken with the Sorceress Medea herself. I'm at a loss for words.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_a_new: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Behold, the gifted warrior who bested me approaches. <g id="grace_convince" />I am sorely tempted to test you once again, <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />but your friend Nessa has now shared the whole story.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_b: I still can't believe that you defeated her, that this is happening.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_b_new: <g id="grace_defiant" />My time as protector of Windsward has come to an end, it seems. <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />And to be honest, I never needed the tribute anyway.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_a: She said that you've proven the people here are worthy, and that she allowed you to restore the final Verdant Gemstone.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_a_ne: <g id="grace_think" />Let's see… well, I don't know. Should it be you...? <g id="grace_pointL" />Or perhaps your precocious friend here… the last druid standing.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_b: I think she wishes to speak with you now. I need to find somewhere to sit down…
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_b_ne: <g id="male_willcoverit" />About that… with all respect, Sorceress, <g id="female_spreadarms" />I cannot help but notice that druidic magic was insufficient to protect these lands.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_c_ne: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />I would ask you to instruct me in sorcery, take me as your apprentice. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Then I could proudly serve as protector alongside my friend.
06a_msq_21_defeatboss_response_next_d_ne: <g id="grace_think" />Hm. You are as bold and presumptuous as they come, aren't you? Ambitious too… and possibly bright. <g id="grace_yes" />Very well, I will at least consider the possibility.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_desc: Travel north to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Medea believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_incomplete: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />There is nothing more for either of us here. Our destinies lie elsewhere, but we may cross paths again.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_proposal_a: No, but it would be diverting. You possess a rare power not found among newcomers to Aeternum.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_proposal_a_n: <g id="grace_sorry" />There is a much greater battle brewing, one I can take no part in. But you… <g id="grace_convince1" />you are destined to play a role in it, for good or for evil.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_proposal_b: Another possesses this power, but I will not speak her name. She’s the Herald of Corruption, and far more dangerous than you.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_proposal_b_n: <g id="grace_liftbothhands" />I sense within you a presence I am all too familiar with. Corruption has its<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> hooks in you and seeks to claim your soul.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_proposal_nex: There's an old man fishing the river not far from here. His simpleminded demeanor belies great wisdom. Seek him out if you would fight Corruption.

<g id="grace_secret" priority="high" />There's an old man fishing the river not far from here. His simpleminded demeanor belies<g id="grace_yes" /> great wisdom, particularly <g id="grace_convince1" />when it comes to Corruption.
As for me, I will bid you farewell… for now.
<g id="grace_handheart" />As for me, I will bid you farewell… for now.

<g id="female_sympathyHandsheart" />I am so sorry to hear of your torment. You must do as Medea says and find this old man, <g id="female_nodyes" />and save yourself. Then, come and visit us in Corinth.
Oh… Then Corruption already has its hooks in you. Hm... They will be extremely difficult to remove.
<g id="grace_yes" />Ah, the herald of Corruption herself. <g id="grace_handheart" />I will not speak her name, but know this, she will not relent until she has tormented you into madness.
It would be foolish for me to take a stand. I'll simply wait for this tempest to blow over.
<g id="grace_yes" />You must find some way to cleanse yourself of her influence, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />or you will become Corrupted.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_response: Away with you, ghost. You'll scare away the fish. I remember you not and care not to, even if I could.
06a_msq_22_talktosoulwarden_talk_yonas: Seek out the Old Hermit\nfishing on the East River
06a_msq_verdantjewel_description: Pulsing with Ancient power, this gemstone is brimming with vitality.
06a_p_01_recovertools_desc: Collect any remaining tools of the Ancients from Fallswatch Overlook and Mirador, then return to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
06a_p_01_recovertools_goto_fallswatch: Investigate {POITags} for any remaining tools of the Ancients
06a_p_01_recovertools_goto_mirador: Investigate {POITags} for any remaining tools of the Ancients
06a_p_01_recovertools_incomplete: This view is magnificent, isn't it? How they built such wonders is beyond me. If you'll recover any tools you can find, I might have a better idea.
06a_p_01_recovertools_proposal_a: Oh, well, I am an Antiquarian. Yelena Pajitnova. Nice to... meet you.
06a_p_01_recovertools_proposal_b: I collect tools used by the Ancients - construction tools - whatever they used to build these magnificent towers. Only, I've met some resistance.
06a_p_01_recovertools_proposal_next_a: Oh, would you? Those Guardians are... well... pesky. So I'd reward you handsomely.
06a_p_01_recovertools_proposal_next_b: Any tools you can recover, I'm most interested in those two sites. Oh, and thank you in advance!
06a_p_01_recovertools_response_a: You have a gleam in your eye... you've found something? Let me see!
06a_p_01_recovertools_response_b: Yes, these are precisely the types of things I'm looking for. The Ancients did not share our methods of construction at all.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_desc: Defeat Kisare the Taskmaster to acquire the Taskmaster's Heart. Then report back to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_goto_temple: Travel to {POITags} to locate the Taskmaster's Heart
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_incomplete: Whatever elements you can recover from the corpse of the Taskmaster would be of greatest interest to me.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_proposal_a: The kind you do with your hands. The funny thing is that we still don't even know what the Ancients look like.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_proposal_b: Two hands? Four hands? No hands? But I believe it was not the Ancients themselves who did the work.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_proposal_next_a: It's not clear, but probably some type of thralls who served the Ancients.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_proposal_next_b: In Amrine Temple, I've heard speak of an "Ancient Taskmaster." If you can defeat it and bring me a piece of it, that would be an interesting find.
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_response_a: Did you defeat the Taskmaster? Amazing! Let me see what you found…
06a_p_02_defeatkisare_response_b: Yes, the very heart of this being, clearly not biological, but was he once human? This is the perfect addition to my collection! Thank you!
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_desc: Collect the Antiquarian's Eyepiece from Simon Grey in Amrine Excavation for Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_incomplete_a: You must think me callous, wanting Simon's Eyepiece, but I have already mourned Simon's loss.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_proposal_a: Simon. Simon Grey, one of the most brilliant researchers on Aeternum.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_proposal_b: He disappeared some time ago in the Amrine Excavation. It's sad for many reasons. Especially for the loss of his equipment.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_proposal_next_a: Yes. Simon carried the legendary "Antiquarian's Eyepiece", allowing the wearer to inspect the smallest of details.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_proposal_next_b: In fact, if you were to find such a thing in the Excavation, I'd reward you handsomely for it.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_response_a: So it's true then? Simon Grey became Lost, his soul never able to be repaired. Very sad.
06a_p_03_recovereyepiece_response_b: His research was groundbreaking, and I will use the Antiquarian's Eyepiece to honor his legacy. Thank you.
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_desc: A group of archeologists have gone missing near an ancient tomb. Follow their trail and discover what has happened then report back to Elric Chapman.
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_goto: Explore {POITags} and Search for the Missing Antiquarians
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_havenote1: Read the journal entry 'The Dig Site: Day 1'
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_incomplete: No luck yet? Oh dear. Could be they are lost to time - just like my mother's affection. Buried under sand and dust…
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_proposal_a: Pardon me, I was mostly thinking aloud. Just north of here there's an ancient tomb with strange spheres around it.
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_proposal_b: We sent a team of antiquarians to investigate but they have yet to return.
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_proposal_next: I would greatly appreciate that. But be cautious, the Ancients wielded powers we don't fully yet understand.
My team are rigorous note takers. If you discover any of their journals, please collect them. Best of luck!
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_proposal_prom: "I can go find them for you."
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_response: You've survived! I was beginning to worry. What did you find?
06a_s_01_findarcheologists_response_next: I… I had feared that may have happened. Thank you for your efforts. I'll inform their families.
The secrets of Aeternum yet elude me. But still, I feel as if we are on the verge of a breakthrough.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_desc: Elric has some interesting theories about the spheres. Follow his instructions and set them in place. Then report your findings back to him.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_incomplete: We'll discover the secrets of the Ancients, you and I. That'll prove my worth. Maybe then my mother will say something nice to me.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_proposal_a: The spheres seem to store power. I believe that if you infuse them with enough azoth, they should be able to interact with other spheres nearby.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_proposal_b: You'll have to find one that's more well preserved than those at the tomb.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_proposal_next: I'd recommend Amrine Temple. Its architecture dates back to the same period as the tomb, but the spheres there are in better condition.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_response: You've returned! Were you able to get a reaction from the spheres?
06a_s_02_powerspheres_response_next_a: Hmm… Curious… I've been hypothesizing that the spheres were either a tool of creation or transportation from the Ancients.
06a_s_02_powerspheres_response_next_b: I'm not sure what determines what is conjured. I wonder if that's how the buffalo got to this island…?
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_desc: Complete Tsui Fen's task to collect meat and fur from the Puma population in Eldergate then return to Tsui Fen's camp.
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_goto_eldergate: Travel to the Eldergate region to begin your hunt
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_incomplete_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I have mixed feelings about hunting puma, to be frank.
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />You'd be surprised at how much meat I can get out of one puma!
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_proposal_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Don't slaughter indiscriminately, we need the local population to be healthy. Just a few will do.
06a_t_01_defeatpumas_response: <g id="female_takeItem8s" />Wonderful! This will make a pleasant change from all the wolf meat we've been eating. A little variety is good for morale.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_desc: Hunt Pumas in the area and bring down the bear of Scratchrock Burrow. Report back to Tsui Fen when the task is complete.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_goto_eldergate: Hunt Pumas and look for signs of the Bear's Victim
06a_t_02_defeatbear_incomplete_a: <g id="male_shakehead" />This bear is unnaturally savage. It has plenty of natural prey, so it shouldn't keep mauling passersby.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_interact_clothtraila: Follow trail of Bloodied Cloth to the Bear's Den
06a_t_02_defeatbear_interact_clothtrailb: Follow trail of Bloodied Cloth to the Bear's Den
06a_t_02_defeatbear_interact_clothtrailc: Follow trail of Bloodied Cloth to the Bear's Den
06a_t_02_defeatbear_interact_clothtraild: Follow trail of Bloodied Cloth to the Bear's Den
06a_t_02_defeatbear_interact_clothtraile: Follow trail of Bloodied Cloth to the Bear's Den
06a_t_02_defeatbear_proposal_a: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Another hunter, Albrekt. He was doing the same thing you were, trying to get more food for everyone.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_proposal_b: <g id="male_converseleft" />I imagine he got a bit too close to the bear den, but that's just speculation.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />You might want to bring a few friends.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_shakehead" />I don't know where the lair is, so you'll have to track the bear down. I guess that means looking for… for whatever remains of poor Albrekt. Try looking near the lake.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_response_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Taking down that bear was no small feat. It's such a relief to hunt in the area, knowing it will be a while before the bear comes back.
06a_t_02_defeatbear_response_b: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Though I'm still going to avoid its den, and so should you. No sense tempting fate.
