06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_desc: Craft tools, then gather and refine the materials requested by Talesa Serrano.
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_haveitems_rawh: Gather {itemName} by Skinning Boars and Wolves
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_incomplete_a: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />Our stores are as barren as a gravedigger's prospects.
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_make_axe: Craft a {itemName} to help chop down trees
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_make_pickax: Craft a {itemName} to help mine stone from boulders
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_proposal_a: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Tell that to the annual tribute. <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />That last collection was a kick in the nethers.
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_proposal_b: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />Our stores have shriveled up like apples in winter. <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />And it's not exactly safe to go collect more, is it?
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_proposal_next_: <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />Timber, cut stone, and leather. After all, folks need homes, clothes, and shoes. <g id="sit_nod" />We have a little food left but could always use more.
<g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Honestly, anything you could bring back would help. <g id="sit_dismissLeft" />Except dung. We got dung aplenty.
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_response_a: Hey, look at this! <g id="sit_nod" />Something approaching an actual stockpile, I haven't seen that in months!
06a_ts_01_gatherandrefine_response_b: <g id="sit_headtilthmm" />Keep up the good work. We have other empty spots where goods should go.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_craftrecipe: Craft an Iron Longsword at the Forge
06a_ts_02_forgesword_desc: Craft an Iron Longsword at the Forge and bring it to Mason Zhang Haoyu in Corinth when you have completed your task.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_gather_ore: Open Heavy Satchel from inventory to gain Iron Ore
06a_ts_02_forgesword_incomplete_a: Open the satchel of ore I gave you, smelt it, then hammer out an iron sword.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_proposal_a: There's trouble with the tribute? I hadn't heard that. I was talking about the Lost overrunning the farms.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_proposal_b: Something happened out there. It's not safe to leave unless you know how to defend yourself.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_proposal_next_a: A solid start. But you should also learn how to make weapons. No blade lasts forever.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_proposal_next_b: Here's some ore to get you started. Then, you should try to make an iron sword.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_response_a: Now, let's see your handiwork… impressive. Quite impressive. Either you've done this before, or you've got a knack for it.
06a_ts_02_forgesword_response_b: We could use someone like you in Corinth, should you decide to stay.
06a_ts_03_learntownboard_desc: Check the Corinth Town Board to discover more ways to help Corinth prosper
06a_ts_03_learntownboard_openboard: Open up the Town Board to find more ways to help Corinth!
06a_w_01_finefabric_description: With bold colors and sharp designs, still strong after all these years.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_desc: Collect Loom Patterns and Fabric Samples from Sirius and Stoneview Seabreak.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_goto_sirius: Travel to {POITags} to collect Loom Patterns
06a_w_01_getpatterns_goto_stoneview: Travel to {POITags} to collect Fabric Samples
06a_w_01_getpatterns_incomplete_a: Every second you stay here is another thread frayed, another shirt torn, another cloth dirtied.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_proposal_a: Oh let me tell you. Crafting takes time, and my method would be a bit faster.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_proposal_b: Ha ha ha! I propose we go in and steal the pants off of those ancient guardians. Well, perhaps not exactly pants, as they don't seem to wear pants, but you get the idea.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_proposal_next_a: Hmm… Since you asked, any loom patterns you find will help immensely!
06a_w_01_getpatterns_proposal_next_b: I'll be able to get our production up and running with the new patterns without having to come up with the designs myself. That will save so much time!
06a_w_01_getpatterns_response_a: Oh. My thanks! How utterly divine! Look at this cloth! It has withstood the centuries and yet looks freshly made.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_response_b: Oh. If only I knew the secrets of those ancient dyes… Such vibrant colors, they’re even more impressive up close!
06a_w_01_getpatterns_response_next_a: Oh you are a dear, but not yet. First I need to get these to the people of Corinth.
06a_w_01_getpatterns_response_next_b: Once the settlement is reclothed, then perhaps then I'll have time to pursue my studies into ancient dyes.
06a_w_01_loompattern_description: For weaving complex patterns on Ancient looms.
06a_z2_wyrdsprig_description: A small part of a Wyrdwood tree. Holding in your hand gives a calming sensation. Its stem sparkles in the light.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_desc: Margot is researching strange things in Aeternum. She wants to know why there are Buffalo here. Investigate the area and gather samples and any notes you find regarding them.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_goto: Go to {POITags} and search for info on the buffalo
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_incomplete: <g id="female_thinking" />Haven't discovered anything yet? That's okay. Take your time. The wonders of the world unfurl slowly in our fragile hands.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" /> They are a species from a completely different part of the world from all others on Aeternum. There must be a reason.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_proposal_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />If you head out to the west of Windsward you will find a herd of them. Collect what you can and bring it back.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_proposal_next: <g id="male_bowShallow" />You have my gratitude. It's unlikely that they fell here out of the sky. I'm sure they are just as confused as I am about the whole ordeal.
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_response: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />What have you uncovered about our furry friends?
06a_z_01_getbisonnotes_response_next: <g id="female_thinking" />Interesting. I'll have to chat with Elric. I believe he has been researching those. There is so much to uncover about this strange and bounteous land. Its mysteries entrance me.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_desc: Margot has discovered a plant that seems to have strange properties. Gather sprigs of it and present them to people around Windsward to see what their reactions are.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_incomplete_a: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Wonder is a clandestine thing. It seldom shows its face to those who are in a hurry.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />More people around here would be if they glimpsed the glory of Wyrdwood trees. Their beauty is trascendent.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_proposal_b: <g id="female_explains" />If you find someone who is down, take them a Wyrdwood sapling. They contain the sparkle of starlight in their branches.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />They mirror the viewer's intent. If you pause and appreciate them with true wonder, they'll shimmer the lights of heaven back at you.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_nodyes" />They will hold your intent and reflect it in response so others may feel that same awe in kind.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_response_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I see smiles on faces that were once dour because of you. To know that even one person breathes easier because of us is to have suceeded.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_response_b: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />I hope you remember that whenever you look on the potted saplings. That is true magic.
06a_z_02_spreadjoy_response_next: <g id="female_nodding" />That's exactly right! Gods be damned - to be present for another human being is to share in their divinity. To be kind is to perform miracles.
0712_0101_carverarmorscraps_description: A collection of armor plates and scraps pulled from the remains of Rockruin Carvers.
0712_0101_layerspastandpresent_complete_: Aha, a successful mission, I presume? Yes, Dau-Shin defeated and these armor scraps will do nicely.
I will see them broken down and used to reinforce the Warden's armors. Then, my friend... then we will be ready for anything.
0712_0101_layerspastandpresent_incomplet: If we can get some of the armor from Limbus Cavatus, it will help us withstand the Corrupted.
0712_0101_layerspastandpresent_objective: Defeat Dau-Shin and recover Armor Scraps from the Rockrift Carvers in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Fayed in Shattered Mountain.
0712_0101_layerspastandpresent_proposal_: I'm glad you agree. Before we can do so, however, we have to make ourselves less vulnerable.
The weapons the Corrupted wield seem to slice through our armor like it's not even there.
What a thought! The armor of the Ancients Guardians in Limbus Cavatus - that might hold.
But the ruins are defended by a Guardian known as Dau-Shin. Face Dau-Shin, collect whatever armor scraps you can and return. Our smiths will ready.
0713_0101_explorerift_complete_available: I'll be a weathered knob on an Angry Spriggan's arse! Someone finally made it through!
First one to come in from Clarion in quite some time, and through the Illurmin Rift, to boot!
0713_0101_explorerift_goto_poi_eastiillu: Proceed into {POITags} and continue scouting the Corrupted
0713_0101_explorerift_incomplete_a: The things coming out of the Rift are scary enough to make you mess your smallclothes if you're not prepared.
0713_0101_explorerift_objective_desc: Explore the deadly Illurmin Rift and deliver your discoveries to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
0713_0101_explorerift_proposal_a: Yes, but I wouldn't take the road.
0713_0101_explorerift_proposal_b: There's some vile Corrupted down in the Illurmin Rift, like something straight from hell, and I worry they're prepping to attack both here and the Soulwarden War Camp.
0713_0101_explorerift_proposal_next_a: Certainly brave of you - I just hope you can get through without becoming Corrupted yourself.
0713_0101_explorerift_proposal_next_b: Collect whatever you can from these hellish minions in the Rift and get to Warden Linch. Go quickly.
0713_0101_explorerift_trigvol_illurminbc: Continue reconnaissance of the Illurmin Rift
0713_0101_explorerift_trigvol_illurmine: Ascend from the Illurmin Rift and travel to the Soulwarden War Camp
0713_0101_hellfireembers_description: Everburning embers that generate no heat or smoke.
0713_0101_hellionsparks_description: Still pulsing with energy, waiting to come back to life.
0713_0101_tendrilfibers_description: Fibrous material, stronger than any crafted rope.
0714_0101_anticorruptionbomb_description: A powerful explosive, charged with the power of azoth. Ignite, then stand back!
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_complete_availabl: That was quite impressive, but somehow I'm not surprised. Now we can finally re-establish supply lines with Clarion.
And Charity's been hoping to recover some of this Orichalcum and Starmetal.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_goto_poi_a: Travel to {POITags} and strike a blow against the Corruption
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_goto_poi_b: Continue your attack on the Corrupted in {POITags}
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_incomplete_a: Weaken the Corrupted's position in the forts so we can get supplies through to Clarion.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_objective_desc: Eliminate the Corrupted in Weeping-and-Gnashing and Corpus Angoris, and recover any supplies left behind. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_a: It feels like the Corrupted keep getting stronger - I'm not sure how much longer we can defend this spot.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_b: Every day, they push us farther from the mountain, and any chance of striking at the source.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_next2_a: We don't need to retake the forts - just weaken the Corrupted enough so supplies can get through to Clarion.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_next2_b: Blast the hell out of them… and try to recover some of the supplies we left behind. We need them.
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_next_a: That is true. You've brought fresh spirit! And maybe now really is the time to push even more weight behind that momentum…
0714_0101_fieldsoffire_proposal_next_b: If we're going to strike back, first place to start is the two forts they've captured to the south.
0714_0101_liquidorichalcum_description: A small vial of fluid with flecks of bright orichalcum floating within.
0714_0101_pwdrstarmetal_description: A finely ground powder of starmetal shards, for some unknown purpose.
0714_0105_baetylusheadpiece_complete_ava: Welcome back to the front, {playerName}. Wait, the Lazarus Instrumentality? You can't mean…
Well I'll be a sea turtle's nephew… you got the Naga Headdress too? I guess we'll have to get this looked at. Amazing work!
0714_0105_baetylusheadpiece_incomplete_a: Are you really going to venture into the Lazarus Instrumentality…?
0714_0105_baetylusheadpiece_objective_de: Defeat the Cilla in the Lazarus Instrumentality Expedition and Collect the Naga Headdress. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
0714_0105_baetylusheadpiece_proposal_a: Definitely a dodgy place, in Reekwater. If you can find others as mad as you, it might be worth it.
0714_0105_baetylusheadpiece_proposal_b: Legends say there's some Naga in there, headpiece made of Baetylus… could be quite useful.
0714_0105_goto: Venture into the Lazarus Instrumentality Expedition
0714_0105_nagaheaddress_description: A shimmering headdress full of gems and unknown powers.
0715_0101_mirespiceblend_description: A heavy, musky spice blend popular with the former residents of Desolate Cliffs.
0715_0101_salsnailessence_description: Said to make you as hearty as the gators it comes from.
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_complete_avail: <g id="female_notsure" />I may have had… second thoughts… <g id="male_lookDown" />while you were away.

<g id="female_thinking" />But we've all been subsisting on dry rations around here, <g id="female_headnodding" />so I'll… I'll… I'll prepare it, at least. <g id="female_smackfist" />Yes, I am very confident in this recipe! Ahem.
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_get_item_from_: Collect {itemName} from the Alligators of the {POITags}
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_goto_poi: Enter the {POITags} and seek out the ingredients
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_incomplete: <g id="female_headnodding" />Shattered Gator Meat and Mirespice Blend, and then we'll be cooking… <g id="male_patience" />or is it better to eat it raw?
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_objective_desc: Hunt Shattered Alligators for Gator Steaks and seek out bundles of Mirespice Blend held by the Desolate Scroungers. Then report back to Warden Douglas in Shattered Mountain.
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />I've been trying to think of a way to cheer people up, <g id="male_giveup" />but it's just not a cheery place.
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_proposal_b: <g id="male_convince01" />But doesn't a hearty meal always help? <g id="male_rememberBig" />Maybe we could try those weird steaks the Rangers eat… <g id="female_headnodding" />Add a good spice…
0715_0101_varietiesofheat_proposal_next_: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />That's the enthusiasm we need here! Yes! Gator meat: <g id="female_nodYes" />delicious. Probably? And how dangerous can Shattered Alligators actually be? <g id="male_lookDown" />For you. Ahem.

<g id="female_thinking" />Mix in some Mirespice Blend, and who knows? Something tasty. <g id="male_convince01" />Uhh… surely. Yes... Yes! <g id="female_headnodding" />You gather it, I'll cook it. Deal?
0715_0102_luckonlylends_complete_availab: Ah, thank goodness... You made it back! That bony wretch didn't give you too much trouble, I hope?
And what are these? Baetylus Luckstones? I wonder if that's what repels the Corruption. William Heron, never around when you need him.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_goto_poi: Delve into {POITags} and seek the Ancient Guardians' secrets
0715_0102_luckonlylends_incomplete: Limbus Cavatus is certainly a hike, I know... but it's worth a shot.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_objective_desc: Defeat Guardian Tzi-Wang, recover Baetylus Luckstones, and defeat Rockruins Guardians in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_proposal_a: Well, I'm no bookish researcher like William Heron, but you have to admit - those Ancients knew some things.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_proposal_b: The Corrupted actually give some of the old ruins a wide berth.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_proposal_next_a: One would hope. I tried to check the Limbus Cavatus but there's a big bugger of a Guardian called Tzi-Wang.
0715_0102_luckonlylends_proposal_next_b: If you can defeat the Guardian and look for anything that might repel Corruption, it would be... glorious.
0715_0201_ancientdraught_description: A leather draught bottle, its content long turned to dust. Smells vaguely of vinegar.
0715_0201_baetylusluckstone_description: A round baetylus stone with worn grooves, from the hands of an owner long perished.
0716_0101_corrbindingclaw_description: A huge claw covered in deep and bright etchings. Holding it seems to attract Corruption.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_complete_a: Finally, an end to those infernal rituals! I can feel the difference already. We all can.
Whatever they were doing, it was driving us mad. You've saved our forces from certain doom, I tell you.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_goto_poi_a: Assault {POITags} and smite the servants of the Corrupted Vicars
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_goto_poi_b: Put an end to the rituals in {POITags} and strike down the Corrupted Vicars
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_incomplete: Whatever it takes, break up those rituals, destroy the Vicars, and take the implements of their evil.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_objective_: End the rituals in Hewn-from-Hell and Mantled-in-Nettles by eliminating the Corrupted Vicars, their guards, and their Corruption Barbs, then reclaim their Corrupted ritual implements. Then report back to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_proposal_a: Aye, and now we fight for our very souls, and those of every living creature on the face of the Earth.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_proposal_b: The Corrupted here are practicing dark magics that we can't comprehend... but we had better put a stop to that immediately.
0716_0101_malevolentofferings_proposal_n: The Corrupted Vicars are working some kind of rituals.
Every pulse, it's like a wave of temptation mixed with rage. Whatever they're doing, you've got to stop it... while you still can.
0716_0101_sacrificialmask_description: A dark mask of some unknown material. Blood has caked the inside.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_incomplete_a: <g id="male_explain" />Make sure to rally some other Wardens to your side, and then collect the Orbs from the Monoliths.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_objective_desc_a: Travel to Myrkgard and destroy the Corrupted Monoliths and Portals, collecting the Orbs hidden at each. Combine the Orbs with Captain Thorpe's Corrupted Aura to form the Myrkgard Arena Key, unlocking the Arena behind the Myrkgard Cathedral.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_objective_desc_b: [This Quest can be shared and repeated.]
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Indeed. We believe the Tempest is down beneath the ruins of Myrkgard,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> but getting in there won't be easy.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />We believe the only way to enter the portals from which we see the Corrupted emerging.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_listenforward" >We believe they can only be unlocked by taking the Orbs from the Corrupted Monoliths near the Cathedral.
0717_0101_myrkgardarena_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_thinking" />What you'll face when you go through,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> I tremble to imagine. I suggest you gather other Wardens before you go. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />All hope goes with you…
0717_0101_subtask_1: Collect Orbs from Corrupted Monoliths and Portals
0717_0101_subtask_2: Defeat Captain Thorpe at the Myrkgard Cathedral
0718_0101_faybriars_description: Briars broken from Fay, the Last Protector.
0718_0101_guardian_complete_available_re: Wait, you faced down Fay and survived to return? I must confess, I had my doubts.
I am very happy to see they were unfounded. Now, let's see what we can learn from what you've recovered.
Ah… yes, indeed. Fay's briars are resistant. Now, if I can synthesize this substance into our gloves…
I have much work to do, but I am confident this will help us wield the Blight as a weapon.
0718_0101_guardian_goto_poi_a: Travel to {POITags} and collect the Blight Sample
0718_0101_guardian_goto_poi_b: Continue to {POITags} and seek out Fay, the Last Protector
0718_0101_guardian_incomplete_a: Fay and his band of Dryads are a force unto themselves.
0718_0101_guardian_objective_desc: Collect a Blight Sample from the Baleful Lair and defeat Fay, the Last Protector. Bring a piece of his remains to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
0718_0101_guardian_proposal_a: Ah, now that you mention it, I did notice some Angry Earth in the region that seem impervious.
0718_0101_guardian_proposal_b: They are led by a particularly fierce Dryad simply known as Fay - I suspect he would be trouble, even for you.
0718_0101_guardian_proposal_next_a: Very well. Bring me back some piece of Fay himself and I'll need another Blight Sample from closer to the Mountain.
0718_0101_guardian_proposal_next_b: Then we might be able to learn the secret of their resistance.
0718_0101_moblightsample_description: A sample of the Blight found in Shattered Mountain.
0718_0102_corruptessence_description: A concentrated piece of Corrupted flesh. Handle with care.
0718_0102_cystblightsample_description: A blight sample from the Pox Cyst.
0718_0102_humble_choose_poi: Locate a gathering of Putridspore Cultivators
0718_0102_humble_complete_available_resp: Aha, the procurer of the ingredients for my experiment!
Let us see how these elements interact… yes, the Corruption certainly can't take hold, and in fact, it is weakened. This will work.
0718_0102_humble_goto_poi_a: Travel to {POITags} to obtain the Corrupted Essence
0718_0102_humble_goto_poi_b: Venture into the {POITags} and seek out a Blight Nodule
0718_0102_humble_incomplete: If you can get me fresh Blight samples, I can do the rest.
0718_0102_humble_objective_desc: Get a fresh blight sample from a Blight Nodule in Wanhope Wold. Then report back to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
0718_0102_humble_proposal_a: We know some of the Corrupted in Edengrove have proven susceptible to the Blight.
0718_0102_humble_proposal_b: The Corrupted near the Mountain are of a different class altogether, but perhaps they suffer from the same weakness.
0718_0102_humble_proposal_next_a: I already have a sample of Corruption, but I'll need fresh Blight samples collected nearby.
0718_0102_humble_proposal_next_b: With fresh samples I can begin investigating further. Be careful when collecting some!
0718_0103_d_01_transport_npc_note: Venture into the Garden of Genesis
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_complete_avail: Well, this is truly beyond the pale - you're the first I've seen venture into the Garden and return.
You got the Alluvium spores as well? These… now these will give us the upper hand. Well done!
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_incomplete_a: The Alluvium Marl in the Garden of Genesis, I have no idea what to expect…
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_incomplete_b: other than it being likely one of the most dangerous creatures in all Aeternum.
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_objective_desc: Defeat the Alluvium Marl and Collect Alluvium Spores for Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_proposal_a: Yes, a sacred place for the Angry Earth, perhaps the most sacred.
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_proposal_b: There is said to be a… "thing" there, so organically potent, its spores can protect against anything.
0718_0103_ultimatedefense_proposal_next_: Please, do not be overconfident. I've never seen anyone return from the Garden of Genesis.
If you go, take friends… and seek out the Alluvium Marl - its spores are said to have primal defenses. Go in strength, friend.
0719_0101_iratusheartgem_description: A piece of hand-polished jasper. The word "Soulwarden" can barely be seen amidst a shattered core.
0719_0101_lapsusheartgem_description: A piece of hand-polished carnelian. Chips have been taken from the stone, rendering it unreadable.
0719_0101_odiumheartgem_description: A piece of hand-polished topaz. Deep gouges have been ground into the stone.
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_compl: Well I'll be damned, you got more Heartgems than I expected. Sad is what that is.
But let's see these writings... hm, this is interesting - it's written by a Warden as he was falling to the Corruption.
I'm not sure, but I might be able use this to finally decipher the Corrupted language.
This is going to take some time... but already I see some things quite clearly.
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_goto_: Travel to {POITags} and search for Soulwarden Heartgems
Continue your search for Heartgems at {POITags}
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_incom: Get me as many Heartgems as you can find and any Corrupted Writings.
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_kill_: Determine if fallen Soulwardens are present
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_lapsu: Search for 'A Sinister Intent' journal entry
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_objec: Search for Soulwarden Heartgems across the five forts in Shattered Mountain, and search for any Corrupted writings. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_propo: Bah, same as they do in the Cleave and everywhere else - they turn our own against us.
That's right, every time a Soulwarden falls, a Corrupted rises in their place. We're fighting our comrades out there.
Not against this… whatever it is. But maybe we can figure it out by venturing back into our forts.
Help me recover some of the Corrupted Wardens' Heartgems, and any Corrupted writings you find. I'll at least try to translate 'em.
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_pullu: Search for 'Duality of the Word' journal entry
0719_0101_reflectionsmountainheart_vehem: Search for 'Pruning a Twisted Vine' journal entry
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_complete_avai: You've returned. I'm impressed and cautiously optimistic. You found the crucibles?
Amazing. With these, we can forge a great variety of weapon types. I will share them amongst all the Rangers and Wardens.
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_incomplete: If it is possible to use these Ancient forging techniques, that is an advantage we need to deny the Corrupted…
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_objective_des: Search the forges of Infernal Host for any weapon molds or crucibles they might be using to forge weapons of great power. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_proposal_a: Possibly. My study has indicated they need unique molds to properly complete each weapon.
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_proposal_b: If the Corrupted are attempting to forge such things, it would be deep within Infernal Host. Someone will need to go there.
0719_0201_madakisstratagem_proposal_next: Even you might face some challenge in there... I suggest you find some allies before departing.
If you are able to reach the forges, search for any molds or crucibles they're using. Bring them back and we'll see…
0719_0201_weaponcrucible_description: A block crucible, used for smithing weapons.
0720_0101_d_01_container_hs_questpush_1: Complete Quest: Recollection of a Journey
0720_0101_hs_00_complete_available_respo: Ah, the elements needed to forge the revered spear. A beautiful poem, wasn't it?
Very well, this shall be a weapon above all others. Behold… the 'Heavensplitter'! Even the skys cannot hold you down, now.
0720_0101_hs_00_incomplete_a: The Heavensplitter, could it be from the Heavens? Or the deepest pits of the Underworld?
0720_0101_hs_00_objective_desc: The odyssey of an unnamed Ancient Guardian, trace their steps and find clues for the Heavensplitter.
0720_0101_hs_00_objective_title: A Spear to Pierce the Heavens
0720_0101_hs_00_proposal_a: Indeed, it is the story of an Ancient Guardian who undertook an odyssey for this weapon.
0720_0101_hs_00_proposal_b: Follow the poem wherever it leads, and bring what you find to Madaki, and earn yourself a spear that will pierce the sky.
0720_0102_hs_01_objective_desc: I saw in the sky the beauty of the heavens, marveling at the sight of stars and the dance of lights. As I drew lines between the heavenly bodies, I split the heavens with my finger. I shared with my comrades the stories of these beings in the sky, as well as my own story. Such stories precede my birth, and will survive me for ages.
0720_0102_hs_item1_description: No matter the position, the attached spear feels utterly weightless in your hand.
0720_0103_hs_02_objective_desc: As I began my journey, I found first myself searching in the cays at the foot of the island. It took me to the top of a magnificent tower, and I pondered how our yearning for the sky drives the construction of these towers. To Holm, I entrusted my post, and visited the caverns south.
0720_0103_hs_item2_description: Embracing the temerity of the Ancients is only possible with their spirit.
0720_0104_hs_03_objective_desc: The stars above the caverns pointed me northeast. There, I found an isle that was closer to the Underworld than anything I ever seen. I descended into a realm where my soul was torn asunder by Hades himself. There, I fought his hellhound, and from that frothy maw stole a gem sky blue. I knew it was a sign.
0720_0104_skygemfragment_description: A fragment of a Skygem. It shines a magnificent sky blue, and is aptly named.
0720_0105_hs_04_objective_desc: As I trekked the Underworld, I found myself in its swamps. The chorus of voices crying out rang through the fog. I could sense the souls of those around me, and yet I could do naught but listen. Phantoms calling out in song, not unlike the Kokytos. I knew that I must transport this gem as a trial, and succeed where others have failed.
0720_0105_hs_item3_description: That it survived both the violence of your acquisition and its time in Periville speaks to its superior craftsmanship.
0720_0105_hs_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Explore {POITags} for a haft for your spear
0720_0106_azothtear_description: A tear of purified azoth. Applying this is a quick way to infuse some power into gear.
0720_0106_hs_05_objective_desc: I waded through the swamps and, like a siren's song, I again found myself at another tower. I saw beings of the earth, the dryads, patrolling Eridanus that was entrusted to them. At its humble base, I shared the gem with these primordial protectors. They anointed it with a tear of Azoth whose purity was unmatched. What a brilliant sight.
0720_0106_hs_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Seek a Purified Azoth Tear from Eridanus
0720_0107_hs_06_objective_desc: My journey was becoming clearer to me. To pierce the sky, the fates were bringing me to the many towers that dot the island. It brought me then to a tower in the valley of mourning. The tower stood like a solemn watcher. I met with the soldier at the top, and shared with him my story. To find a kindred soldier on this island is rare.
0720_0107_hs_item4_description: It is impossible to say just how old they are, and yet they show no signs of wear.
0720_0107_hs_task_01_taskgotopoitag: Ascend the tower Vela in search of wrappings for your spear
0720_0108_blesseddryadwood_description: Tendrils of vine blessed into peculiar shapes by the Dryads of Malevolence.
0720_0108_hs_07_objective_desc: The final tower the fates brought me to was one ruled by the earth, and the dryads that protect it. In a land that birthed life here on this island, I climbed the tower searching for guidance. The guardians there tested my strength, and rewarded my spirit with a spearshaft made of an ancient, blessed wood.
0720_0109_hs_08_objective_desc: My journey was coming to a close, my ultimate test was found the badlands choked by red: the Mangled Heights. I stood at the summit. I fastened sharp tendrils to the spearshaft, and affixed the skygem to purify my spear. I took my spear and leapt to the heavens, splitting them in pieces. Day shattered, giving its fractured lights to the Night sky, and I rested among the stars.
0720_0109_infernaltendrils_description: Tendrils from the Corrupted monsters in the Mangled Heights. Though Corrupted, their sharpness is second-to-none. Perfect for a spearhead.
0721_0101_bw_00_complete_available_respo: You're back, good. With these materials I can forge the strongest shield in all of Aeternum.
There…. Boundless Ward. This will defend against Corruption, and anything else, for that matter.
0721_0101_bw_00_incomplete_a: A longsword without a sister shield is like a missing limb.
0721_0101_bw_00_objective_desc: Recover the components needed to forge Boundles Ward and deliver them to Ranger Madaki in Mountainhome.
0721_0101_bw_item1_description: Suddenly the quality of the Myrkgard’s weapons and armor makes more sense.
0721_0101_bw_item2_description: Very effective in scouring away impurities. Try not to get any on your hands.
0721_0101_bw_item3_description: Durable, strong, and perfect for affixing a shield to one’s arm or hand.
0721_0101_bw_item4_description: The parts that survived are all the stronger for it.
0721_0101_bw_item5_description: Said to protect the wearer from certain death. Perhaps it will fare better in your hands.
0721_0101_tf_00_complete_available_respo: Ah, I see you've taken over Ranger Demir's work, acquiring the elements for Twilight's Fall.
Yes, this is the blade of champions. Wield it with pride. It suits you well. But you will want a shield to accompany it, yes?
Perfect, we've taken to calling this design 'Boundless Ward.' It will be the strongest shield ever forged.
Acquire the elements for me and I will forge it and strap it on your arm myself.
0721_0101_tf_00_incomplete_a: You have undertaken a long journey, my friend.
0721_0101_tf_00_incomplete_b: But I believe Twilight's Fall will be a weapon fit for a warrior-poet. Godspeed.

Take it; go forth and send the Corrupted to an icy hell colder than the broken mountain they occupy.
0722_0101_fl_00_incomplete_a: Never look down upon the noble career of a dancer as frivolous, for you must become one to flourish and twirl this tempered orichalcum razor.

0724_0101_corruptiontingedfish_descripti: A fish touched by the powers of Corruption.
0724_0101_fq13_complete_available_respon: What is that you bring with you, traveler? It reeks of Corruption... Mercy me, is that supposed to be a fish?
Master Fisher Bernard was right to send you my way.
0724_0101_fq13_incomplete: If Corruption seeps down the mountain and into the southern settlements, then all the fish in Aeternum will be affected.
0724_0101_fq13_objective_desc: Catch a Corruption-Tinged Fish in Shattered Mountain and bring it to Master Fisher Chang in Ebonscale.
0724_0101_fq13_proposal_a: Yes. Help me prove something to my fellow Master Fishers.
0724_0101_fq13_proposal_b: Like the land here, the waters are tainted by Corruption. I believe the fish are affected, as well.
0724_0101_fq13_proposal_next: Yes, I suppose so. Interesting observation. But indeed, catch a Corruption-Tinged Fish and bring it to Master Fisher Chang in Ebonscale - he likely can find the same thing there.
0725_prospector_talk_response: <g id="male_explain" />Outpost Rush is a 20 vs 20 match that takes place on an island with 3 Outposts. Competitors fight to capture and hold them for as long as possible, increasing their team's score.
0726_0101_mightytempest_complete_availab: So it is true…<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Isabella de Leon is no more. <g id="male_lookDown" />This is only the beginning.
<g id="female_thinking" />To fully understand how a god-fearing, upstanding citizen of Spain could become such a monster will require delving deeper into Isabella's reality.
0726_0101_mightytempest_incomplete_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I have found accounts scattered across this island by those who had contact with Isabella. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />The story they tell is grim.
0726_0101_mightytempest_objective_desc: Enter Tempest's Heart and Defeat Isabella de Leon.
0726_0101_mightytempest_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />Precisely. <g id="male_patience" />You have no doubt heard of the Tempest and have come seeking her ruin. But what do you know of Captain Isabella? <g id="male_spreadhands" />What does anyone know?
0726_0101_mightytempest_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I intend to discover what madness drove her to this point.
0726_0101_mightytempest_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_gestureBehind" />This place is not just a fortress, it's a window into the mind of Isabella de Leon. <g id="male_explain" />Inside you will find a phantasmagoria, a construct that the sane would find impossible.
0726_0101_mightytempest_proposal_next_b: This is where the waking world and nightmares combine. <g id="female_explainS" />Where Isabella's mind and memories shape reality. Enter and you will see what I mean.
0726_0101_mightytempest_proposal_prompt: "How do you intend to do that?"
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_complete_availa: <g id="female_nodYes" />Ah, so Philip and Cosimo squandered their fortune and family name away. <g id="female_thinking" />It's no wonder Isabella became so isolated and desperate.
<g id="male_patience" />I had hoped she would've found some comfort in family. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />Perhaps I was naïve. It would not be the first time.
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_incomplete_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I am curious to know whether our ill-fated Captain had help or hindrance from her brothers.
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_objective_desc: Find out about Isabella's past in Spain with her brothers. Then defeat Isabella de Leon again with this new knowledge in mind.
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_proposal: <g id="male_explain" />We all have family. She also had brothers. <g id="female_thinking" />Could they have stopped Isabella's descent into madness?
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_proposal_b: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I myself am an only child. I often wished for the love and comfort of a sibling, to help ease my woes. <g id="female_nodConsider" />Were her brothers of any help?
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />Yes, that would seem the case.
0726_0102_isabelladeleon_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />But we must learn more to be sure. <g id="female_touchhands" />Please, enter once more into Isabella's mind. Perhaps there we can find something new.
0726_0103_d_02_taskachievement_lorenote2: Read Lore Note 'The Offering of the Apple'
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_complete_a: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It was a swift downfall then. Isabella ate the forbidden fruit with no remorse. <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />This is... disheartening.
<g id="male_spreadhands" />I had heard so many stories of her kindness, <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />her nobility, her courage in the face of adversity.
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />I left my convent to discover all I could about Isabella. The rumors of her fate frightened me. <g id="female_thinking" />But they also piqued my interest.
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_objective_: Find out about how Isabella was offered the mantle of Corruption. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_proposal_a: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />But how can we know for sure?
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_proposal_b: <g id="male_patience" />I used to be a sister of the cloth before my arrival on Aeternum. If there is even the slightest hope for Isabella's soul, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />then I must know if she resisted the Heretic.
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_proposal_n: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />No, I do not have that power. I am not God. <g id="male_patience" />She must face Judgement Day like all the rest of us. <g id="female_crossarms" />I simply wish to know if there is any hope for her.
0726_0103_isabellascorruption_proposal_p: "You think you can save her soul?"
0726_0104_d_02_taskinteract_grave: Honor the Grave of Isabella's buried crew.
0726_0104_riseofisabella_complete_availa: <g id="female_worry" />She buried them alive? Oh God, she condemned them to the earth,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> a terrible fate on Aeternum.
<g id="female_lookConcern" />How could she have done this?
0726_0104_riseofisabella_incomplete_a: <g id="male_convince01" />Please discover more about Isabella's trek across the island.
0726_0104_riseofisabella_objective_desc: Find out about Isabella's descent into cruelty with her crew by investigating the graves where they were buried alive. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
0726_0104_riseofisabella_proposal_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Still, I must believe that some part of the noble woman remained.
0726_0104_riseofisabella_proposal_b: <g id="male_think" />Surely there must have been a place in her heart for someone? <g id="female_nodConsider" />A person dear to her?
0726_0104_riseofisabella_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />I would like you to search for any trace of mercy, any sign of concern for the souls she brought to Aeternum. <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" />A grave marker, perhaps? Something to show she remembers them?
0726_0105_deathofheretic_complete_availa: <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" />You bring me a name I have never heard before: Nedenyek. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It chills my very soul.
<g id="female_thinking" />Is that the Heretic's true name? It must be the name of the Devil himself!<g id="female_covermouthShocked" /> The Beast!
0726_0105_deathofheretic_incomplete_a: <g id="male_rememberBig" />Aunt Isabella was as beautiful as an angel. <g id="female_bowShallow" />She was devout and prayed at Church often.
0726_0105_deathofheretic_objective_desc: Find out about the Heretic's true power and talk to the Heretic. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
0726_0105_deathofheretic_proposal_a: <g id="female_shocked" />She was misled! That much I know for sure. Is the Heretic the source of Corruption? <g id="female_nodConsider" />That would explain it.
0726_0105_deathofheretic_proposal_b: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />That is the only way to explain my aunt's transformation! <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />The monster in these tales does not match the woman I knew.
0726_0105_deathofheretic_proposal_next: <g id="male_nodProud" />Yes, yes, I am Mara de Leon, Isabella's niece. I knew her when I was a child. <g id="male_rememberBig" />She was so kind and good.
0726_0105_deathofheretic_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />To think that my father may have driven Isabella to desperation pains me. <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Please, bring me proof it was the Heretic's fault.
0726_0106_d_03_taskachievement_lorenote4: Read Lore Note 'Father Russo and Isabella'
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_complete_ava: <g id="female_lookConcern" />So she turned away from Father Russo, who loved her with all of his heart.
<g id="female_lookdownSorry" />My aunt is truly lost to me. <g id="female_touchhands" />I will say a prayer for her soul.
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_incomplete: <g id="female_lookforwardWonder" />In another life, perhaps Father Russo and Isabella could have been together. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />We will never know.
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_objective_de: Find out the truth about Isabella and Father Russo, and what is to come, and talk to Father Russo. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_proposal_a: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />I do not know. Perhaps it is as you said <g id="male_spreadhands" />- Isabella had no one.
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_proposal_b: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />What a tragic possibility. To feel utterly alone in the world...
0726_0106_possessionofrusso_proposal_nex: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />No, it doesn't. But it also doesn't change who she once was.<g id="female_nodYes" /> Kind, gentle, intelligent, someone curious about life.
<g id="female_beckon" />Please, try to contact the Father Russo that may still exist in her heart. <g id="male_spreadhands" />Perhaps she wasn't utterly alone.
0726_0107_repeatable_complete_available_: <g id="male_explain" />This Shard of Madness is full of pain. I shall store it with the others.
<g id="male_wipetear" />Perhaps one day, Aeternum shall have a full portrait of the woman I knew. <g id="male_nodProud" />The captain, the legend, the terror: Isabella de Leon.
0726_0107_repeatable_cooldown: Aunt Isabella rests peaceful for now, <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />but I fear in time the corruption will rise again.<g id="female_saluteFistchest" /> On that day, I pray you come to our aid yet again.
0726_0107_repeatable_incomplete: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Have you collected another Shard of Madness? <g id="male_think" />Perhaps these memories will help point a way toward her salvation someday. We must always have hope.
0726_0107_repeatable_objective_desc: Recover a shard of Isabella's madness in the ashes of her defeat for Mara Rosa to study.
0726_0107_repeatable_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />My Aunt Isabella deserves to have her story told and understood in its entirety. <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />We must leave nothing out.
0726_0107_repeatable_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_explain" />Every time you defeat her, a Shard of Madness will remain.
0726_0107_repeatable_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Bring me these Shards and I will reward you.
0726_0107_shardofmadness_description: A pulsating shard from the twisted mind of Isabella De Leon, a tangible piece of her madness.
0728_kesava_1: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />So you come seeking the lost?\n<g id="male_explain" />When the mind is unbound, there are no limits to its sight.
0728_kesava_default: <g id="male_nodProud" />I have seen mysteries far beyond your ken {playerName}.
07_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_a: Did you know you can win battles even before stepping onto the field?
07_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_b: Study your enemy's weaknesses, tell me the strengths you need and I will give you robes for victory.
07_00_outfitter_transmog_response: I soak the hemp in Azoth before stitching it into the fabric. There are a few more steps, but no wise person gives all their secrets away.
07_shatteredmountain_body_01_01:
**A page written in the Corrupted language, with sketches of Dryad bodies. Circles have been drawn around their hearts, heads, and hands.** 

Ubahâh Mabayibok ñâv ba kepo mixanfep kengâmbi, fa paitkâ ubatânfâp yi uwâ'abto 'ag ambi. 'Aktâ, ngek mambetu mikor yâk'upambi ngo pa xa miwod mi a. Ngo imi yâk'upambi kuguok ebikning vebambi.
07_shatteredmountain_body_01_02: **Covered in the illegible, but unmistakable, language of the Corrupted, the images sketched here show the Corruption pillars being tended to, almost akin to gardening, with parts being trimmed, pruned, and harvested.** \n\n'Anggur ñirok atwakambi. Ñirok abdâxab ambi. Yi if 'ag ubaban deñâna uwâgap'a 'ufoxo axo. Fif 'ag 'ung p'âyi kâka, xak'ufâ af mi ba.
07_shatteredmountain_body_01_03: **The text of the Corrupted fills most of the page, save for an image drawn in the center: a crystal or gemstone of some kind, sparkling on a Corrupted altar.** \n\nUbuwâveti guf xa p'âta pad xañir wobi pinviñ dâ Aeternum deñ pa pad dewif migana p'ânduxo mi a. Fiv kâme ekâi pad tid uwâyâr ru panuxo xanfep kuñ midewif ambi, veg pagmax kâx 'ag ambi.
07_shatteredmountain_body_01_04:
I have remained here, hidden, writing all I can while I am still able to do so. A sound fills my mind at times, and images as well... they seem familiar, but I cannot understand them. I fear this Corruption is overtaking me. Perhaps, in my writings, I will find a way to stop it. Perhaps I will find a way to save myself from ubapampu he dekâp'ux mipung pad Euwâveti miñ vob romena mad pad mabayib mingoñ. Eâbtakendu ven a Eâbtativ, mah ven kidebu a.… with the powers they have at their disposal. I am no closer to discovering their long-term goals, but in the short term, it seems as though Isabella has returned from her travels around the island, bringing a number of new converts with her. She seems to be important to the plans underway here. Some of those she has brought may be only to increase their numbers, but others seem specially selected. Experienced smiths, alchemists, men and women of science... it may be that there are plans for some kind of profane construction.

Mah, 'ung, kepo kia. Mah uako 'ung ki xa degi t'onag. De axo depwang hemakte yi tânfâp a. Guf mibtâxo, pap'âyi ru Magmebeg. 

... I am unsure how much time has passed, how long I have held myself in this place. My stores are nearly depleted, and the time for escape has long since passed. My only solace is that somehow, whoever finds this may glean some new information from it. I have seen all manner of oddities brought through here in the recent days: hundreds of trees brought from all around this land, carts of ore placed around the base of the Thorn with the Cultists chanting incessantly, boxes and bins and bags stuffed full of unknowable items. Something is happening. Something dreadful. Something... I am powerless to stop. 

A axo ketir. Guf mibtâ. A axo ketir. Guf mibtâ. A axo ketir. Guf mibtâ.
07_shatteredmountain_body_01_05: **A dirty and splattered page, covered with the language of the Corrupted. A drawing of a large blade divides the page, wicked and powerful. While not understanding the words, the writing seems emphatic, eager, almost desperate somehow.** \n\nFiv bingu guf hemaktexo axo. Ngoñ uwâtânfâp kuk anggidambi mab bingu bip a. Miwod pad pab Magmebeg mab mideh pad pab Magmebeg igambi ambi. Kuñ miwod ig, k'okti, he 'abto.
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_01:
These aren't my mother's poodles.

In the Great Cleave leading to that ominous city of corruption prowl dogs of unnatural color and ferocity. I have taken to calling them Corrupted Hounds for the red veins of Corruption visible and accompanying abhorrent behavior. These aberrations can unhinge their jaws of gnashing teeth wide enough to swallow a turkey whole.

Still, they are kind of cute from a certain angle, aren't they? Mum back home raised bigger dogs--how hard could it be to domesticate one of these? A puppy of one would look just darling in a bow. A gift for a beloved, perhaps?
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_02: I have not yet been able to locate a pup no matter how deep into this crevasse of corruption I delve. All are full-grown, and fully trained to follow their shambling Masters. Do these Hounds not need to whelp? Do they just regenerate fully-grown as everything else on this strange continent? Further research required.
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_03: After a grueling battle I managed to slay a red-eyed houndsman in attempts to capture an adult specimen of the beast.\n\nMy arms are covered in at least two layers of bandages from wrestling the dog into a makeshift trap and my blood surely left a trail from the snowy pass, but my efforts are not in vain. I sit writing this in incredible pain and incredible pride, gazing upon my new captive before turning in for the night to rest. She's restless, obviously unused to being confined by walls and too strong to remain in the trap for long. I think I shall call her ‘Molly'.
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_04:
Molly is still ruthlessly vicious around me.

I present her with raw meat at feeding time and this seems to quell some of her rage, but not her distrust. She drags the scraps from the wooden bowl I made her in favor of eating in the corner of the wall enclosure. From this vantage point she can keep her eyes on me at all times--always red, always wary.

Food motivation can only take us so far, and ultimately winds up being more dangerous than it is worth to feed her from my own hand.
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_05: Her behavior still proves too aggressive to let out of the walled-in enclosure. I write now with my left hand as my right has been requisitioned by dearest Molly as a chew toy.\n\nResearch into leather leads required—if I could ever get close enough to her neck to sling one around. The dog looks at me with such disdain and disgust, as if I were the one with red fissures and eyes glowing like The Devil.
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_06: What joy! I woke this morning to find Molly sans her characteristic growling and snapping. She took food more gently from the bowl, obviously cowed by my superior animal handling skills. There is a strange intelligence in her eyes, as if she is beginning to understand the situation.\n\nCould this be how the first man felt taming a wolf?
07_shatteredmountain_body_02_07:
That damnable dog, she was figuring things out--but not in my favor!

I have never seen such intelligence in a canine, to feign docility long enough to convince even an experienced handler like me. Molly did not as much as whimper when I put the leather lead on through the fence. I spoke sweetly to her, told her it was time for a walk, hoping a lack of captivity would bring out her personality. It turns out her personality is evil, and the second she realized she was no longer contained, my dear Molly mauled me, draining me to my last before I woke up in bed again, alone. She ran back North to her true master, I can only imagine.

There are better ways to make profit on this lush continent than lying with the dogs. On a related note, I now certainly have fleas. Corrupted Fleas, at that. A Corrupted Flea Circus, yes, now that could work...
07_shatteredmountain_body_03_01: Armed with horns and teeth sharper than the average straight sword, the Lava Barb makes a life for itself here in Shattered Mountain. It is not a glamorous life by any means, swimming around in Corrupted waters, but it is a life nonetheless.\n\nShould you go swimming and feel something slice into your ankle, it is already too late.
07_shatteredmountain_body_03_02: The other Master Fishers call me 'paranoid' and 'prone to conspiracy' but they're not the ones who chose to live life next to a giant half-floating mountain.\n\nThey have no idea what it's like fishing in my waters, getting smaller and weaker catches depending on how Corrupted the waters are. I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that it is not my fishing skill or bait that attracts these small fish, but the water itself working against me! I continue to eke out surviving here on my meager fish, meeting with the Greyjacks every so often to discuss how we can cleanse the waters. Even they think I'm overreacting. Life near the crown of Aeternum is an endless slog, made worse by the creeping red tide.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_01: On the seventh day of snow, there came a dainty tapping on me door. I sat breathing, for I feared it were that pig-faced Lieutenant Hadar come to drag me back to the Hell I ran from.\n\nBut if it weren’t a lady with raven dark hair that fell down to a tiny waist. Skin white as the snow. Only slippers on her feet, and robed in fine white linen. But I didn’t touch her, not on this day, I swear it on cold iron.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_02: Twelve days, and naught but two words. “You key.”A key to what? But her lips smiled faint like I should know. She must be some royal runaway Princess! The way she looks at me like I’m special. \n\nShe don’t like fire. Stares at it like it were a smoking gateway into Hell. But water. She drinks it never-ending, like a dirty cup of melted snow got the taste of roast horse.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_03: I been dreaming. She lays on me like a cool blanket. But my breathing, it comes harder and harder ‘til I can’t move or cry for mercy. When I wake up, she’s just laying in the corner. These dreams got me tired.\n\nI’m taking the cart to town tomorrow. She ain’t eating nothing I put afore her. But she don’t complain. That’s how you tell a royal apart. They don’t bang knives when they hungry, but they wait all patient for the pig knuckles to come out.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_04: Who’s that boy? I don't remember no boy. I only remember coming back from town, the lady still in me cabin and looking better somehow, cheeks pink like bloody meat.\n\nI was screaming then, staring at the boy’s eyes. Empty holes, cut up jagged like with a knife. I reached out to cover those eyes but she grabbed me. Cold and strong, like she were steel inside. I kicked the boy into a wolfskin rug. Rolled him into the storm and that was that.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_05: We got married! We crowed our vows to the wind, didn’t we? Well I did, and you said too without a word wasted between those pale lips. And then I kissed your mouth so cold, but I had plenty of fire in me to warm you. Here on this mount, looking over blue seas of ice. I stripped off me furs and ran naked, and the snow didn’t bother me even.\n\nLast night, you called me to the bed. Called me like whispers of the dead. And I answered your call, many a time I did.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_06: How did I forget? She chose the boy like a nice lamb at market, but it were me that brought him back. My promise of coin weren’t needed, the way his eyes were all on top of her. \n\nSo I carved the bastard’s eyes while he was kicking, screaming. While she watched, waiting.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_07:
She left the door open, like she wanted me to see. It was the moon’s third hour, and she hunched over the dug up grave. Mouth full of icicle teeth slicked dark with blood. Gnawing on his fingers. 

And then I remembered. What happened after I killed him.

It was when he stopped kicking. A light come up from below, into his throat. She shoved me aside, and kissed his mouth. Drank deep from his soul. And I felt only a great rage. But now I hear her laugh like the cracking of finger bones, and there’s nothing in me but fear.
07_shatteredmountain_body_04_08: She found me again. She lets me go, hunts me down, eats. Eats another part of me, with that laughter on her lips. Be with her forever, didn’t I wish it? \n\nI’ll bury this under cold iron. If ye read it be warned. Don’t let her into your house. Don’t give her no water. If ye see her, run while ye have feet to do it. I hear it. Crawling under the branches. And just now it come upon me like a terrible wave. I’m the pig knuckles she been waiting for.
07_shatteredmountain_body_05_01: After a century of being away from this infernal island, I had forgotten the tension that permeates the air on Aeternum. It's invigorating, but there's also a cloying quality to it. It feels like one's constantly trading clarity and hope for this gift of eternal life. Perhaps this is why mankind was never worthy of such a thing. In the decades since I departed, Isabella has been busy and her demon armies now dominate the land. My plans may have been hindered upon arrival, but I will find a way to make amends for my sins... or let me be damned as well.\n\n- Russo
07_shatteredmountain_body_05_02: Again, repetition of similar phrasing! Always conjugation of "to give" or at times imperative! "For by grace you are saved through faith: and that not of yourselves, for it is the GIFT OF GOD." The Ancient Glyphs in another passage are marred, but the translation could very well be: "GRAIN OF GOD" or "WINE OF GOD". Dative cases and other related forms seem the most prevalent! Cross-check the subject, is it always divine? Is the divine ever accusative? Clearly the path to Isabella De Leon!\n\n- Russo
07_shatteredmountain_body_05_03:
As the Soulwarden and Isabella knelt before each other, there was a silence unlike any I have ever known. It reminded me of the first time I administered Holy Communion: the silent acknowledgement of Divine Love. But the moment ended abruptly. Here in this foul place, that silence has been shattered forever. It is accomplished and the tomb is empty… but She is not here. She is not here. She is not here. There is no redemption.

- Russo
07_shatteredmountain_body_06_01:
Exhibit cooperative reactions clear to not commune communicate on deep.
AE drive away. Cull the herd no actual culling heard. Hard to say.
Zero violence AE to B. Much violence B to C. Rabid dogs to starving cat.
Powerful ally allaying no discernable however.
Near dusk fungus Blighted congregate. At fungus? Are fungus? Near!
At seems time insensate. Whispering? Recharging? Myrddin was right.

- Morgaine

08_ebonscalereach_body_01_01:
ACT I SCENE II - THE EMPRESS' JOURNEY

(The darkened stage is set with a lone throne and the Empress sitting upon it.)

Empress Zhou: Half-brother! What brings you to the throne room at such an hour?

Shang Wu: I could ask you the same, sweet sister. Your coronation is set for tomorrow and yet you've already taken your perch.

Empress Zhou: Soon, it will not matter. Tomorrow, I shall be Empress.

Shang Wu: We shall see about that...

(The stage lights up fully to reveal Shang Wu's forces in hiding ready to strike.)

Shang Wu (to the audience): My long-despised enemy shall be forced to flee, and I shall be the Emperor of China!

(Lights out.)
08_ebonscalereach_body_01_02:
ACT II SCENE III - THE EMPRESS' JOURNEY

(Half of the stage is covered in sand to represent the beach the Empress and her forces washed up upon.)

Retainer 1: Your Highness, this island was not on any of our maps. And those distant mountains... red and ruined by some terrible force... they portend disaster.

Empress Zhou: We will make camp here. There is a power in this place. An old power. It may be the key to returning home and retaking my throne.

Retainer 2: It is an ill-omen, your Grace. I do not trust it...

Empress Zhou: Do you not trust me? Your paragon, who led you from persecution by the forces of Shang Wu the Usurper.

(Retainer 2 falls prostrate upon his face.)

Retainer 2: Forgive me, Empress. I forgot myself. Of course, we trust in you, our beloved leader.

The Taiying Empress: Then all is not lost. We will learn the secrets this place holds. So that we might grow strong enough to one day return to our ancestral homeland.

(Lights out.)
08_ebonscalereach_body_01_03:
ACT III SCENE I - THE EMPRESS' JOURNEY

(A darkened palace set with a new throne. The Empress paces in front of it.)

Empress Zhou: Am I a good ruler, Admiral?

Guard 1: Yes, your highness. I will follow you anywhere.

(The Empress stops in her tracks and looks up.)

Empress Zhou: And yet I am unable to return my people to their home. To even leave the shores of this very island.

Guard 2: You have built us a new home Empress. Your people thrive!

Empress Zhou: Is this a home? This place belongs to the past. It is a place of ghosts and ruins and mysteries. There is no future here. Only an unending present and the whispers of a bygone era.

Guard 1: I still hope, Empress. After all these years, I still believe it is you who will guide us back to our homeland. 

Empress Zhou: Then I will be strong. In recognition of your steadfastness.

(Lights out.)
08_ebonscalereach_body_01_04:
ACT IV SCENE V - THE EMPRESS' JOURNEY

(The Empress is surrounded by retainers.)

Retainer 1: Empress... the people are concerned. Concerned that the child has not aged.

Empress Zhou: He is a stubborn boy. He does not wish to leave the comfort of his mother's embrace.

Retainer 2: But so long an infancy? It is unnatural. Even here, in this strange place.

Empress Zhou: I share your worry. But I fear the days do not pass as we have come to expect in this unsettling place.

Retainer 1: Poor soul. What cruel fate awaits a child reared in a place forsaken by time?

Retainer 2: Hush, fool! You forget yourself! How dare you--

(The Empress raises a hand.)

Empress Zhou: Enough. He gives voice only to the thoughts we all bear. But my son's fate is in my hands. And I intend to do my duty. As both Empress and mother.

(Lights out.)
08_ebonscalereach_body_02_01:
I have served the Empress since she was a little girl hiding behind her mother's skirts, playing with her dragon dolls. I have done it with loyalty and with joy, in recognition for the majesty of her lineage and the wisdom of her young heart.

But the ages have visited hard times upon that wise little girl. I only pray that she possesses the constitution that will be required to weather an eternity of challenges. That she will continue to be wise and measured through the ages, despite all the challenges of leadership. Time will never relent, and so she must resist its endless tides if there is to be any hope for our people.

After ages on Aeternum, I see that we shall never return home. Yet I do not dispair. For I still have faith in my Empress.

-ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_02_02:
The shrines that the Empress built around Ebonscale Reach each correspond to a different element important in Wuxing philosophy.

Our ancestors claim that the Old World was shaped by dragons. Long serpents lay down to form the rivers, while mountains were made by great leviathans finding their rest. Even the hardened metal ore beneath the earth was once dragonscales, and the reaching treetops of forests once formed their their long beards and manes. Their gift of fire is the most obvious elemental connection of all. Dragons are all around us, if one only knows where to look.

Perhaps our Empress Zhou has the ability to awaken these preternatural creatures. But will she wield the power of dragons, or will the power wield her?

-ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_02_03:
The Old World was ordered, but this strange new land of Aeternum pure, primordial chaos. The five elements (wood, metal, fire, water, earth) are present here in Aeternum, but their essence is scrambled. Here we have plants made of spirit or currents of air. Or even more curiously, of life and death. 

I know the heavenly force that ordained my beloved Empress Zhou, but there are other, darker forces at play on this island. So many that I often lose sight of what I once knew. The roiling, crimson force of Corruption is the most frightening of all. 

I wonder how long our people can remain steadfast in the face of such overwhelming turmoil.

-ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_02_04:
Heaven and Hell are natural consequences of life on earth. Or, perhaps they were, before Aeternum. Heaven is the divine ruler of the skies who bestows eminence to the royal bloodline. Hell, in its ten courts, is the darkness pervading the earthly prison that traps human souls below.

But there are no courts or judges here. Only untamed and uncaring wilderness. This cannot be Hell, for it is far to erratic in its tortures. Seeing such injustice visited upon the innocent is far worse than any Hell of iron beds or oil cauldrons.

At night sometimes, I hear my mistress crying. Whether she weeps for herself or for the cruel fate of her people, I can only wonder.

-ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_03_01:
A thousand curses upon the head of Shang Wu, usurper of our Empress' throne!

A thousand curses upon all the men who aided this betrayer, driving the ruler ordained by Heaven from the throne and into exile!

A thousand curses upon this island, where our ships crashed in the flight from our homeland!

Curse its 'mysteries' and 'secrets' and all this bloody irritating sand. Nothing good will come of staying here long. I can feel a stale evil in the air of this place, and at night I can feel the weight of that broken mountain in the distance bearing down upon me. Tomorrow, I am summoned to the Empress' chambers. I will explain my concerns to her then. She will see reason. She must. Or we are all doomed.

-Zhi
08_ebonscalereach_body_03_02:
Today, I witnessed something disturbing.

A petitioner came to the Empress, in her makeshift palanquin on the beach, and decried this land of Aeternum. He claimed it would only lead to our doom. I found myself nodding in agreement, for I, too, sense the pall that hangs over this place.

Her guards and attendants sprang into action at the sight of his insolence, but our soverign commanded them to halt. Then she got down from her throne and helped him to stand, whispering to him in reassuring tones. I know not what she spake, but her words seemed to steady his convictions, and he departed renewed in his steadfast service to her.

The sight left me deeply ashamed. I am lucky that the Empress did not witness my moment of weakness. Even shipwrecked in this strange, forsaken land, we are better off here, under the rule of our beloved mistress than we would be bound under the yoke of the usurper. For the comfort of a warm, familiar hearth is rendered as cold and oppressive as the endless sea by the machinations of a tyrant.

-Jing
08_ebonscalereach_body_04_01: The water levels around the house have been slowly but steadily rising. I see the dark, pregnant clouds in the distance, ready to release their rain upon us once more. I fear the house shall not survive it. We've taken everything we can off the floor, stacking it upon the furniture, but now the water completely encircles our little hovel. Is this our punishment for following the Empress? We stand together and pray for the water to recede, for prayers are all we have.\n\n-Yang
08_ebonscalereach_body_04_02:
Waves now crash upon the site where my house used to be. I never considered it a home, not after fleeing our true country in the Old World, but it did offer me respite, and I will miss it dearly.

Our misfortune is nothing compared to that of our neighbors, the Chens. The floodwaters came so quickly I saw the father of the family swept away in the blink of an eye. The body has not been found.

The Empress promises we will recover. That she has a plan to restore us to an even greater glory than our realm in the Old World. Standing at the edge of the dirty, treacherous water, I cannot see how it could be possible.

-Yang
08_ebonscalereach_body_05_01:
Q: What goes up, but never comes down?

A: Age.


Q: I am not alive, but I grow. I have no lungs, yet I need air. I have no mouth, but I can drown. What am I?

A: Fire.


Q: Who makes it has no need of it. Who buys it has no use for it. Who uses it can neither see nor feel it. What is it?

A: A coffin.


Q: Poor people have it. Rich people need it. If you eat it, you die. What is it?

A: Nothing.


Q: You are always heading toward it, but can never reach it.

A: The future.
08_ebonscalereach_body_05_02: I have heard it said that all our island, Aeternum is a prison. That none would make a life here, given the choice to leave. But here life goes on, whether you choose to live it or not. Even those who give in to despair and think to end their own suffering find no escape from these shores.\n\nAnd so, here more than ever, it is important to choose to live. True humility means knowing the limits of your capabilities, and choosing to do good within your own boundaries. There is still life to be made, and if you embrace your destiny you may even make it worth living for yourself and others. It is a long march to eternity, and it is important that meet it head on and do your duty. The alternative is a most terrible fate, locked for all time in a circle of endless suffering, visiting suffering upon others.
08_ebonscalereach_body_05_03:
Life is change. Even in a place of eternity, where the end is not the end, it is still so. Each day when you rest your head upon your pillow, you will not be the same as when you awoke that morning. This is true of us, and of nature as well. For all things are arranged in an endless state of dynamism that is never ceasing, ever changing. The character and state of these elemental forces is arranged thusly:

Wood-- growth, rising, development, expansion.

Fire-- energy, action, inspiration, ambition.

Earth-- transformation, conversion, change.

Metal-- sinking, contracting, declining.

Water-- contemplation, consideration, serenity.

We are many things before we become like water, and then from serenity, we learn how we must grow to achieve our full potential.
08_ebonscalereach_body_05_04:
In addition to the five elements that make up all things, there are five virtues that live within all of us. Holding to these virtues means becoming a person of character, and of benefit to your family and community. To live for oneself and oneself alone is a meager existence. So hold to the five virtues, and transcend yourself.


Benevolence-- the act of forming one body with those around you, providing for mutual benefit.

Righteousness-- doing what is proper and showing good judgment, even when it is hard.

Propriety-- showing respect for those who came before you, and the knowledge they earned over a lifetime.

Wisdom-- understanding virtuous behavior, and knowing how behave with dignity without the need for a teacher.

Faithfulness-- understanding commitment, so that others might rely upon you, even in times of great trouble.
08_ebonscalereach_body_06_01:

The Dragon Shrines are now complete. Please reference this note on their maintenance.
