08_ebonscalereach_body_06_02:
Listen, Zhang. No one said your dancing had to be any good. You just need to dance with the incense to properly cleanse impurities from the Shrine. I don't care how stupid you think you look.

I can tell if you do it without dancing, we all can! Suck it up and start moving those hips, this is for the safety and piety of our Empress!

-Long
08_ebonscalereach_body_07_01:
We have witnessed that Corruption is a source of despicable evil, but how much do we really know of its origins? I know a Corrupted soldier could strike me down in a single blow, but why are they so powerful? Does the Corruption affect the muscles and sinews of the body? Or how hot the blood runs in the rage of combat?

And what on earth causes that stench? Can they smell the reek of brimstone on each other? I can't imagine it makes for pleasant company.

-Bao
08_ebonscalereach_body_07_02: Trees come to life on two legs. Or so Artificer Long tells me. She calls them Dryads. I think she must have lost her wits, for I cannot imagine that it is truly so. With the rate the trees are cut down and grow anew on Aeternum, you'd think they'd all turn to screaming monsters seeking revenge on the denizens of this land. So if they're not trees, and they're not people, what are they?\n\n-Bao
08_ebonscalereach_body_08_01:
The elemental dragon shrines are my finest achievement! The Empress was most impressed, and offered me a place of honor at her table tonight. Such a rare gift for a common-born woman like me. I will have to brush up on my table manners. As the final descendent of the Long family, I'd hate to embarrass my ancestors with poor etiquette.

I wish Lian was here. She was always the graceful sister. Her death at sea was a huge loss for us all.

-Long
08_ebonscalereach_body_08_02:
The Empress' invitation was not solely about gratitude...

At first all was pageantry, with her attendants engaging in the usual pleasantries one could expect from a royal court. But I soon found myself alone in a private dining hall. I had expected to be one of many guests and courtiers at a great celebratory feast, but when my mistress appeared, it was clear this was a private affair.

She asked me initially about my family and lineage, perhaps to ascertain if my loyalty could be brought into question. I assured her that my family had been faithful to her throne -- her true throne -- for generations. It was then that the true agenda for this meeting became clear.

She asked me to construct a secret chamber within the shrine dedicated to the element of wood. One for use only by her family and closest confidantes. More strangely, she insisted that I render it invisible to casual observers and as impregnable as a fortress.

For my own part, I of course agreed. How could I decline the honor of serving my Empress once more. But the strange nature of the request, I confess, filled me with dread. I know not the purpose of this place, but I trust in the goodness and benevolence of my sovereign. For she has not led us astray yet.

-Long
08_ebonscalereach_body_08_03:
The work is progressing slowly, owing to the secrecy of my task. I have been forced to utilize only a skeleton crew so as not to draw attention to our work. Moreover, it has been my experience that secrecy is better preserved when the circle keeping it is small. The Empress is impatient, but my assurances that such delicate and important work must not be rushed seemed to placate her somewhat.

Whatever purpose compelled her to request the creation of a secret vault within this place of worship, it clearly weighs heavily upon her. We shall redouble our efforts. I do not like seeing my Empress beset by such burdens. The sooner my quest is complete, the better.

-Long
08_ebonscalereach_body_08_04:
The Empress arrived today to survey the final construction. But she did not bring her usual retinue. She was accompanied only by her handmaiden and a slight, hooded figure. There was an oppressive darkness about him, and although he never set foot in the lamplight, I knew immediately that something sinister lurked beneath the cowl.

My mistress led him to the threshold with the tenderness of a child, watching intently as he hurried into the darkness within. Then her face darkened. She approached me, reminding me sternly of my vow. I reaffirmed my commitment to keeping her secret and she softened once more, thanking me for my service and leading me away from that place.

I do not know what I have just witnessed, nor what price she would have exacted for any sign of infidelity. But I am afraid. Afraid for my people, for my Empress, and for myself. For responsibility for whatever secret lies within those walls now also lies squarely on my shoulders. I can only pray that I have done my duty well.

-Long
08_ebonscalereach_body_08_05: The Empress has commissioned a series of shrines, each dedicated to one of the five elements of Wuxing philosophy. Tradition suggests that they should be arranged on the point of the star, to represent the endless cycle of change. But here, on this island, where the primal forces roil and spill forth onto the land as if they had life and agency of their own, I have devised a different proposal. \n\nI suggested to the Empress that we place each shrine atop a site whose energies nourish and compliment its associated element. Where the endless, tranquil flow of water can echo in the stones of its holy place, or the deep-rooted foundations of the earth hold fast to the stones of the reliquary. Where the raging eternal flames of the Zhou spirit burn bright, or the living wood of the tree trunks reach high toward the heavens, or the lustrous sheen of precious metals shines like an offering in the sun. If we honor the primal forces in this way, we can rest assured that the spirits of the natural world will hear our prayers, and preserve us in the turning of the coming cycles.
08_ebonscalereach_body_10_01:
Magistrate Redridge - No outstanding balances.

Survivalist Hopkins - Copy of The Epic of Gilgamesh lent.

Artificer Long - Three units of classics owed, when will she get back to me?

Trader Xian - Still obsessed with Commentaries of Zuo, I almost can't bring myself to take it away.

Commander Hartford - Still refuses to speak to me after the bear incident.

Alchemist Lane - All favors paid off, steady requests for poetry about fishing.

Adjudicator Wen - No outstanding balances.

Barkeep Bao - The rotten git won't return Tristan and Iseult. Deny all his building requests.
08_ebonscalereach_body_10_02:
Bao,

It is in your best interest to return my copy of Tristan and Iseult.

It would sure be a shame if your request for a new expansion to the bar got denied. Or if it burned down.

All the best,

Elder Danya
08_ebonscalereach_body_11_01: From the library of Chang's fishing scrolls:\n\nShould you ever see a spout of water emerge from the sea of Ebonscale Reach, know you have seen the Aquanaja. This rotund, flesh-like serpent dwarfs all other serpents, for it is at least the length of a galleon. It expels spouts of water out into the air for reasons unknown. Perhaps it is playing, toying with onlookers? Either way I dream of capturing it one day, and feeding the settlement with its bounty.
08_ebonscalereach_body_11_02:
From the library of Chang's fishing scrolls:

The people of Ebonscale Reach have been through so much. Flooding, starvation, shipwreck...

I just want to make things easier for them. I once had a dream. A dream that there could be a grand competition between fisher folk whose catch would earn them great renown. The fish collected during this tournament would go towards feeding the settlement in the end, and it would be a great chance to get the fishers of Aeternum to work together.

Perhaps in time, I shall discover an appropriate reward that could inspire such a feat. One day, one day...
08_ebonscalereach_body_12_01:
The Empress met with a strange man today, one hooded and reeking of death. The floods have taken a great deal from us all, most notably in the Empress’ spirits, but I warned her right away this man was not to be trusted.

Still they had a meeting in her palace, my treasured ruler ignoring my counsel. When the two emerged from their meeting the stink of death was on my Empress too, and no matter how many times I bathed her it would not come off.

I asked her what the man offered, to which she replied: “Everything we lost. But the price was too high.”

I asked her what she was to give in return and she paused before whispering: “Everything we might become.”

ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_12_02:
We are to receive a special guest today. The Empress is fraught with nerves, which is deeply unlike her. Her usual grace holds us all together as a court as we are reminded by our shining example of how we are to conduct ourselves.

This guest is referred to in whispers as The Tempest, and the other servants say she leaves scarlet death in her wake. If my mistress makes an accord with her, I fear the consequences may be more than we can bear. The very notion fills me with dread, as the many hardships that have befallen us since we came to these terrible shores weigh heavily on her, and are compounded by the awful fate of her poor son. 

I cannot say this, though. She has becoming increasingly unreachable, pulling away from even me as The Tempest draws closer. Each day brings new calamities, and all I can do is pray this Tempest does not unsettle my lady’s mind any further.

ZL
08_ebonscalereach_body_13_01:
The endless day with no hope of dawn
Witnessed over one-hundred years of love
And at daybreak I will become myself once more
Remaining the loved and loving son of Dearest Mother

- Liang
08_ebonscalereach_body_13_02:
My body falls from this shadowed pinnacle
With a step taken into the rush of wind
Swaddled newborn it will bear you up
To rebehold the rising sun in heavenly ascension

- Empress and Mother

08_sq_artificerlong_greet_00: I designed our shrines by pushing the paradigm. You will notice each one makes you feel different based on its element.
08_sq_artificerlong_greet_01: Ebonscale Reach needs everyone to play their part in the war against the Corrupted. I will craft. What will you do?
08_sq_artificerlong_greet_02: The Corrupted tide will wash over Aeternum if we don’t stop them.
08_sq_artificerlong_greet_03: I trust Liang won't repeat the mistakes of his mother. Only time will tell if he deserves my support.
08_sq_bardroy_greet_00: It's a blessing we can't get more wee ones on this island. I have two. Two barrels of misfortune I wouldn't wish on any sod.
08_sq_bardroy_greet_01: I do treasure my boys, even if they've forgotten that they're family. I'll figure this out, you'll see.
08_sq_bardroy_greet_02: There are three worthy things in this life - guts, glory and rum. And the third is the sweetest.
08_sq_beacher_greet_00: You've got battle scars. You know the joy of pain! Give acupuncture a go. It opens up the muscles, makes you feel alive…
08_sq_beacher_greet_01: Heard you helped Enlai get his red string. If you find an acupuncturist, the needles are on me!
08_sq_elderkemba_greet_00: Life went by so quickly when I had adventure in me. Now, all I can do is watch the leaves fall from the Ironwoods.
08_sq_enlai_greet_00: My sweetheart is so beautiful, the moon and flowers feel embarrassed when compared to her.
08_sq_enlai_greet_01: Ah, the things we do for love. I've known Yue since we were children. She's always wanted what she's wanted.
08_sq_enlai_greet_02: When Yue accepts, I'll be a very happy man. And when we get married, you'll be our guest of honor!
08_sq_er_avengeplay_complete: The Corrupted deserved everything you gave them and more. They will rue the day they hurt our Empress and my play!
08_sq_er_avengeplay_desc: Sabotage the Corrupted operations as payback for spoiling Redridge's play.
08_sq_er_avengeplay_incomplete: Let's teach the Corrupted it's NEVER a good idea to mess with the arts!
08_sq_er_avengeplay_proposal: Yes… Yes! We've been gentle with the Corrupted for too long. Think therefore on revenge and cease to weep!
08_sq_er_avengeplay_redridge_start_greet: The Corrupted have dealt us a mighty blow by taking Empress Zhou Taiying. They've sabotaged my play and all it stood for!
08_sq_er_avengeplay_redridge_start_playe: "Theatre goes only so far. Sometimes, we need to fight with more than just words."
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_artificerlong_sta: My sources told me you burnt an incense for the Prince?
"Zhou Liang has a tragic tale. Of course I'd help him."
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_complete: You saw the shrine overrun with all manner of Corrupted horrors? I was afraid of that. Without cleansing, the Corrupted must have taken it over.
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_desc: Cleanse Skysong Temple for Artificer Long.
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_incomplete: Sigh. I knew it. You really didn't intend to help me either, did you? My poor shrine wilts! From the inside out!
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_proposal: Cure the abominable royal child while Corruption infects the land. My shrine needs cleansing and nobody offers to help!
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_proposal01: Burn this incense in the sanctum. My incense should drive away the evil spirits, including the Corrupted.
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_proposal_player: "Let me help. Is there some ritual or item I need to use to purify it?"
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_proposal_prompt: "I will. How would I cleanse it?"
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_yue_talkto01: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Ha. She lost the few friends she had by spouting nonsense against the Empress. <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I'd be wary of her if I were you.
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_yue_talkto01_play: "I'd look at her deeds, not her words. She asked me for Dryad Wood in order to build defensive equipment for everyone."
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_yue_talkto02: <g id="litearmor_concerns" />What deeds? <g id="litearmor_youknow" />If you saw the armory, the citizens, you'd see how little she's actually crafted since the shrines fell.
08_sq_er_cleanseshrine_yue_talkto_start_: <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />Is everything alright? <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I saw you talking to Artificer Long… who is very animated today.
"It is. Or it will be. She's worried about the shrines and nobody in the settlement seems to be helping her."
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_artificerlong_: Ah, you've met the Empress. Sufficiently impressed by her achievements, I'd assume.
"The Empress carries the weight of her people's burdens and does so gracefully."
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_complete: Oh, I was right about you! Capable indeed - not many make it back alive. This wood will do nicely... The Empress thanks you!
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_desc: Acquire Dryad Wood for Artificer Long to craft robust armor against the Corrupted.
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_incomplete: Well? Don't you have the Dryad Wood yet? I am waiting.
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_proposal: Everyone says the same. Yet where would she be without the throne she sits on, the shrines she commands? I built them all.
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_proposal01: Why do I expect an amateur to see my genius? No matter. You seem capable, perhaps you can do the Empress a favor. I need Dryad Wood to craft her people armor.
08_sq_er_collectdryadwood_proposal_playe: "The Dragon Throne is defined by the ruler, not the seat itself. I suppose she'd move again if necessary."
08_sq_er_collectfungus_complete: Splendid! With this, I can complete 'The Empress's Journey' — my script! For the Empress. And her people!
08_sq_er_collectfungus_desc: Get black ink from Void Pitchers so Magistrate Redridge may complete her play about the Empress.
08_sq_er_collectfungus_incomplete: Pray tell, did you get that fungus yet? The theatre eagerly awaits your contribution!
08_sq_er_collectfungus_obj_getfungus_des: Collect {itemName} from Void Pitchers around Ebonscale Reach
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal: No, no, no, that's not the answer. We give the wide-eyed masses an idea. A belief. We are more than a community. We are a symbol against darkness!
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal01: Theatre educates! Imagine: the Life of Our Empress. A force in China and our guardian on Aeternum. If only I had the ink…
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal01_player: "Do you have an ink in mind? Something specific to help your creativity flow?"
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal01_prompt: "What sort of ink do you need?"
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal02: The black dye from the eponymous fungus that gives Ebonscale Reach its name. Nothing else will do for our Empress!
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal_player: "Will the masses understand that lofty concept?"
08_sq_er_collectfungus_proposal_prompt: "How can we show this to everyone?"
08_sq_er_collectfungus_redridge_start_gr: What a craven lot the Corrupted are, exploiting the weak to increase their numbers. We must arm the innocent against them!
08_sq_er_collectfungus_redridge_start_pl: "Don't they have weapons? I could train them to use the equipment in combat."
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_complete: <g id="litearmor_compliment" />You did it! Please, let me see. <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" priority="high"/>Hm… According to this, a perfumer called Muthalaly was on the same journey.
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_desc: Collect Passenger Scrolls from the Corrupted for Yue to study.
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Could the other passengers tell me about my life in China? <g id="litearmor_worry" priority="high"/>Oh! Don't let them be Corrupted or Lost!
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_proposal: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Exactly! Apparently, the cabin would have had a list of passengers. <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" priority="high"/>I may find other people who traveled with me!
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_proposal01: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />You are very kind! The shipwreck is crawling with the Corrupted. Return safely. <g id="litearmor_compliment" />I'm starting to like you.
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_proposal_player: "I know my way around a ship. I'll look for your list and bring it back."
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_yuelai_start_gre: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />After digging through a Corrupted campsite, I discovered there may still be artifacts on the ship that brought me here!
08_sq_er_collectscrolls_yuelai_start_pla: "This shipwreck could contain important clues of your circumstances and how you arrived."
08_sq_er_collectstatues_complete: I'll store these statues carefully. We don't want them to break and unleash... whatever Corruption lies within.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_desc: Collect four Statuettes as told by handmaiden Zeng, to disrupt the Corrupted ritual.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_incomplete: Hurry and gather the other statues before it is too late. We can't let the Corrupted get a hold of such power!
08_sq_er_collectstatues_obj_collectstatu: Collect the {itemName} from the Metal Shrine
Collect the {itemName} from the Water Shrine
Collect the {itemName} from the Earth Shrine
Collect the {itemName} from the Fire Shrine
08_sq_er_collectstatues_proposal: Master Qi has said every soul that enters a temple leaves an imprint upon the place.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_proposal01: A temple is not only of stone, or wood, or other materials. The larger part is an unseen energy imbued by our souls.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_proposal01_playe: "If the Corrupted found a way to tap into the power of souls, it would devastate Ebonscale Reach and beyond."
08_sq_er_collectstatues_proposal02: There is no precedent for interfering with such power, but the consequences of our inaction may be far worse.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_zeng_start_greet: I recovered a Corrupted dragon statue from the Wood Shrine… and I fear this dark power within could be used to siphon souls.
08_sq_er_collectstatues_zeng_start_playe: "How would that even work? And how do the shrines fit into this?"
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_artificerlong_st: The Empress was more mother than ruler. The Corrupted multiplied with no one to rein them in. Thus we're here, in this mess.
"Regardless, where's the fine equipment you said you were crafting? What have you been doing all this time?"
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_complete: The Empress's mind was clouded. I can see that yours is much clearer. I do value everything you've done for me.
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_desc: Destroy Corrupted forces at Serenity Monastery. Then report back to Artificer Long.
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_incomplete: Did you disrupt the meeting, or were you too busy thinking about what I should and shouldn't have done?
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_proposal: Gathering intelligence for when the time is right to use it.
08_sq_er_disruptmeeting_proposal01: I hear there's going to be an important Corrupted meeting at a monastery, if you’d care to disrupt it.
08_sq_er_endempress_complete: News of your valor has reached us! It was a sad thing to ask of you… but I am grateful. The shipyards are safe. For now…
08_sq_er_endempress_desc: Defeat Empress Zhou Taiying and her Captains. Then report back to Zeng Lingyun in the Ebonscale Settlement.
08_sq_er_endempress_incomplete: I will wish you good fortune. Empress Zhou Taiying was always formidable. Perhaps even more so now in her Corruption…
08_sq_er_endempress_proposal: I'd ask Liang for help, but his wounds are too fresh. Corrupted Empress Zhou besieges the docks with her 'loyal' handmaidens.
08_sq_er_endempress_proposal01: I beseech you to stop her. You'll need these statues to guide you; they now have a strange power over the Corrupted.
08_sq_er_endempress_proposal01_player: "Didn't we retrieve these statues from the shrines of the five elements? You told me they channel souls."
08_sq_er_endempress_proposal02: They will lure out powerful Corrupted, like our Empress. I served her for so many years. And now I... ask you to defeat her.
08_sq_er_endempress_proposal_player: "Then Corruption has eroded what little of her spirit remained. She is no longer the woman we once knew."
08_sq_er_endempress_zeng_start_greet: Poor Liang! To lose a mother and assume the Dragon Throne at the same time. All while our people suffer still...
08_sq_er_endempress_zeng_start_player: "Everyone has suffered a terrible loss. Empress Zhou was a good ruler. She will be sorely missed."
08_sq_er_fightivan_complete: Ah! You've done us all a service. The reprobate made a habit of robbing graves before he lost his soul.
08_sq_er_fightivan_desc: Defeat Ivan The Scourge for Elder Danya.
08_sq_er_fightivan_incomplete: WANTED by Order of Elder Danya: IVAN THE SCOURGE, Grave-Robber, now Lost Behemoth and Utter Nuisance, must be eliminated.
08_sq_er_fightivan_start_prompt: WANTED by Order of Elder Danya: IVAN THE SCOURGE, Grave-Robber, now Lost Behemoth and Utter Nuisance, must be eliminated.
08_sq_er_fightivan_wantedposter_start_gr: WANTED by Order of Elder Danya: IVAN THE SCOURGE, Grave-Robber, now Lost Behemoth and Utter Nuisance, must be eliminated.
08_sq_er_fightivan_wantedposter_start_pl: "Ivan sounds like a menace. I'll look into this when I'm in the area."
08_sq_er_freetigers_complete: The little ones roar their thanks. You have my gratitude, along with this humble reward.
08_sq_er_freetigers_desc: Free the baby tigers for Ma Xinyi.
08_sq_er_freetigers_incomplete: Those predators! These cubs are only their most recent victims. But imagine if we could free them all…
08_sq_er_freetigers_maxinyi_start_greet: The darling cubs who used to roam my area have disappeared. What if... they're being turned to Corruption as we speak?
08_sq_er_freetigers_maxinyi_start_player: "I'd hate to think so, but that's a sad possibility."
08_sq_er_freetigers_proposal: Even if the babies make it out alive, I doubt their minds will be intact. The innocent animals. We must help them!
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_complete: The Red Claw! Defeated? You're brave, like Yue. I hope she likes the red string and says 'yes'. Then we'll be married!
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_desc: Collect a Crimson Paw from Redclaw for a red dye for Xiang Enlai.
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_enlai_start_gree: I will spend the rest of my life with Yue. But first, I need to find the perfect red strings for her.
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_enlai_start_play: "Red strings are an unusual request. Do they have some significance?"
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_incomplete: You will keep the details of this task between us, correct? I want Yue to think I fought the Red Claw myself.
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_proposal: They're used in the Hair Combing ceremony. And that will protect us as a couple… if she'll have me.
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_proposal01: Yue is a romantic. She loves the idea of me fighting a Red Claw for the red string… but I can't do that alone.
08_sq_er_getpawfromclaw_proposal_player: "Dying a string shouldn't be too difficult. I could find some red flowers for you."
08_sq_er_getstringfromcorrupted_complete: These are the perfect strings. I can't wait to show them to Yue. She'll say 'yes' to me now!
08_sq_er_getstringfromcorrupted_desc: Retrieve red strings from Dynasty Corrupted for Xiang Enlai and Yue.
08_sq_er_getstringfromcorrupted_enlai_st: I'm sorry to disturb you, but our plan didn't work. A Red Paw doesn't make a red dye. Yue wants different red strings now.
"I suppose the danger must be sufficient, and the red strings magical enough to be considered romantic."
08_sq_er_getstringfromcorrupted_incomple: Once Yue and I are married, we'll spend our honeymoon in Everfall. I hear they have a never-ending banquet there.
08_sq_er_getstringfromcorrupted_proposal: Not quite. Yue wants the red strings the Imperial Guards use for their armor. It is tangible fabric. Could you help me once again?
08_sq_er_kembafriends_complete: You're back at last! Did you place the flowers safely? Did they bloom? How are my friends? Tell me everything!
08_sq_er_kembafriends_complete01: That is sad news. They were good people… Perhaps one day they'll have the quiet slumber they deserve.
08_sq_er_kembafriends_complete_player: "They are not resting, I'm afraid… and I doubt they ever will."
08_sq_er_kembafriends_desc: Place the flowers at Skysong Crypt to check if Elder Danya's comrades have found peace.
08_sq_er_kembafriends_elderkemba_start_g: Would you place these flowers at the altar and hear if they tell of my comrades' salvation?
08_sq_er_kembafriends_elderkemba_start_p: "What do you mean? I know of no flowers that can do such a thing."
08_sq_er_kembafriends_incomplete: Have you placed the flowers at the crypt?
08_sq_er_kembafriends_obj_placeflowersat: Place the flowers at the altar
08_sq_er_kembafriends_proposal: It's an ancient rite. Put a flower on a gravestone and if it blossoms there, the soul underneath lies peacefully.
08_sq_er_killtigers_complete: Tigers will always have a special place with me…
08_sq_er_killtigers_desc: Defeat the group of Corrupted tigers for Ma Xinyi and end the cycle.
08_sq_er_killtigers_incomplete: Did you put the darlings to rest?
08_sq_er_killtigers_maxinyi_start_greet: A Corrupted tiger returned to the area yesterday. I was happy, at first, because I thought she'd regained her senses.
08_sq_er_killtigers_maxinyi_start_player: "Could she have followed the scent of her children? Intending to be with them?"
08_sq_er_killtigers_maxinyi_start_prompt: "Did she come back for her cubs?"
08_sq_er_killtigers_proposal: Wishful thinking! The Corrupted forced her here to lure the cubs back to them. How do we break this cycle?
08_sq_er_killtigers_proposal01: That is true, but I will miss seeing them near here…
08_sq_er_killtigers_proposal_player: "The Corrupted will stop hunting tigers if there are fewer around to find."
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_complete: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Ah, wonderful! Time to study this stone and understand how the Corrupted think…
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_desc: Help Yue study the Corrupted nodule at Imperial Army Campsite.
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />So, what do the Corrupted see in that that nodule?
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_proposal: <g id="litearmor_shocked" />I have no desire to get closer to Corrupted slime. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />But perhaps you could examine it? I have a few coins that I can offer.
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_yuelai_start_gree: <g id="litearmor_gestureforwardrighthand" />Can you see that pustulous ball? <g id="litearmor_youknow" />The Corrupted have been guarding it watchfully for some time now. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I wonder why…
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_yuelai_start_play: "Whatever it is will be hard to study from this distance. You'll discover a lot more about it if you get closer."
08_sq_er_knockdownidol_yuelai_start_prom: "Why don't you take a closer look?"
08_sq_er_retrievepuzzlebox_bardroy_start: I miss my oafs… I discovered what they were fighting for before. Trying to inherit my puzzle box. And now that they’re Lost… it’s the last connection we share.
"The box must be valuable for them to fight over it so. What does it contain?"
08_sq_er_retrievepuzzlebox_complete: So, the contents of this box? Rum aged one-hundred years. A legend of the seas! Caramel. Smoky. As smooth as a lady's glove.
08_sq_er_retrievepuzzlebox_desc: Return the puzzle box to Bardroy and discover the prize his sons were fighting to own.
08_sq_er_retrievepuzzlebox_incomplete: Did you find my puzzle box yet? You wouldn't be able to open it without me, mind. In case the greed got you too…
08_sq_er_retrievepuzzlebox_proposal: You helped me previously. I don't mind sharing what’s inside… if you retrieve it. Deal? Still in some cargo the pirates filched from me long time back.
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_complete: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I was an infant when I got here, and I know nothing of my old home — except from stories. <g id="litearmor_handheart" />This will help me learn of it!
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_desc: Recover Chinese heirlooms from the Corrupted and give them to Yue so she can discover more about her past.
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_incomplete: Any luck with the artifacts? Or are the Corrupted impossible to overcome?
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_proposal: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Not even close. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />The Corrupted take over our land, our people and now our memories. <g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />Why'd they need those artifacts, anyway?
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_proposal01: <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />The Empress brought that, and other artifacts, from the mainland. <g id="litearmor_handheart" />MY land! We really need to recover them. <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />It's OUR history.
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_proposal_pla: "It sounds like your idea of their having a culture isn't true then. That stone was merely stolen?"
08_sq_er_stealbackartifacts_yuelai_start: <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />You know what infuriates me about the Corrupted? <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />They raid and take whatever they want.
<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />	"It's not like we're innocent. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />We broke their nodule and took their stone, remember?"
08_sq_er_teachidiots_bardroy_start_greet: The name's Bardroy Byrne. I'd introduce you to my sons, Bartolome and Bartholomew, but they are driving me mad.
08_sq_er_teachidiots_bardroy_start_playe: "That can happen. And brothers can be hot-tempered too. What did yours do?"
08_sq_er_teachidiots_complete: Those reckless loons. My plan didn't work! They're still at each other's throats. But I'll find a way to make them see reason… despite this being Lost business.
08_sq_er_teachidiots_desc: Help Bardroy's sons, Bartolome and Bartholomew see sense and stop fighting each other.
08_sq_er_teachidiots_incomplete: I pray my boys are not too far gone. They may be addlepated idiots, but... they are mine.
08_sq_er_teachidiots_proposal: I don't even remember what they're fighting over, and I doubt they do either. Killed each other repeatedly! I've had it. Go knock sense into 'em.
08_sq_guanyu_greet_00: No Corrupted going in. No Corrupted going out. Ebonscale Reach is safe.
08_sq_gwendolyn_greet_00: Yongtai will say she has 'silks as rich as those of the Empress' and then peddle her lower weaves to you. Don't be fooled.
08_sq_jiahao_greet_00: The trick of the market is you need to buy low and sell high. There are gullible fools at both ends.
08_sq_maxinyi_greet_00: Even timid animals are at risk of being turned into Corrupted weapons. But tigers... tigers are another matter entirely.
08_sq_maxinyi_greet_01: It warms my heart to see the precious creatures roaming freely again. You did a noble thing, adventurer.
08_sq_maxinyi_greet_02: Sometimes doing the right thing hurts. I'll miss the tigers. What a shame this had to happen…
08_sq_muthalaly_greet_00: One must not only look beautiful, one must smell beautiful. Appeal to all the senses of the observer. Like our Empress does.
08_sq_muthalaly_greet_01: You saw the ship? It brought me here with the Empress. I was selling perfumes in China, when she made me part of her retinue.
08_sq_muthalaly_greet_02: A few peasants sent their children with us. They hoped for better lives with the Empress, than at home. Could Yue be one?
08_sq_na_greet_00: You know even if I die, I'll be reborn. So will you. I don't know what I'm guarding. The royal order? An accepted story?
08_sq_redridge_greet_00: Small cheer and great welcome makes a merry feast. And you've come to a bounteous meal indeed!
08_sq_redridge_greet_01: Keep fighting the good fight, dear patron of the arts. And, please, spread word of my magnificent production!
08_sq_redridge_greet_02: Rehearsals of my new work 'Furious Fist' have begun. It's loosely based on what you've accomplished here in Ebonscale Reach.
08_sq_rong_greet_00: Guanyu is a turkey with his head in the dirt. The Corrupted have overrun the shrines, the roads, any camp they could find!
08_sq_tai_greet_00: Does Prince Liang really look like... a monster? I guess no one can have it all.
08_sq_tai_greet_01: On the positive side, Prince Liang looks prettier. On the negative side, I'll have even less luck with the girls.
08_sq_yongtai_greet_00: Craving silk like the Empress wears? The royal silk is reserved for her, but I know how to get one just like it.
08_sq_yongtai_greet_01: Magistrate Redridge needs to write a new play? I can share stories of my life with her... for a price.
08_sq_yuelai_greet_00: Do you think the Corrupted have their own culture or are they too barbaric?
08_sq_yuelai_greet_01: <g id="litearmor_realize" />These clay relics show the value my ancestors placed on beauty and simplicity. <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I'll do my best to perserve their feelings!
08_sq_yuelai_greet_02: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />You are a good friend. Let's trounce these Corrupted together. And let me know if you see a Muthalaly?
08_sq_zeng_greet_00: The Empress needs all the allies she can get in these trying times.
08_sq_zeng_greet_01: Despite the dangers, I hope you can find some measure of peace and comfort in those shrines. They are beautiful.
08_sq_zeng_greet_02: Every day I teach Liang more about statecraft. But alas! Nothing can fill the void left by a mother.
08_sq_zuma_greet_00: Admiring the tiles? Do you know each one is shaped on a wooden mold?
08_sq_zuma_greet_01: Long called them HER shrines? Ask her who created the tiles. Sure, she designed them but a team of us built them TOGETHER.
0901_0104_shipsflag_description: A flag torn from a forlorn wreck. [Mission Item]
0902_0502_driedrations_description: A bag of dried fruit, nuts, and trail bread.
0902_0502_sailingcharts_description: A collection of star charts used for navigation at sea.
0902_0502_securedtoolbag_description: A tightly bound toolbag, filled with quality construction tools.
0902_0503_claystatue_description: A crude, but expressive, clay statue.
0902_0601_captainsorders_description: A (formerly sealed) page of orders, hinting at dark deeds done in Letum's Pick.
0903_0301_gunpowderhorn_description: A small cask filled with gunpowder.
0903_0401_lynxpelt_description: The heavy pelt of a Warden Lynx, with soft and luxurious fur.
0903_0401_rabbitpelt_description: The pelt of a Brown Rabbit, cleaned and ready to be used.
0904_0201_batchcharcoal_description: A pile of charcoal, used to stoke a forge fire.
0904_0201_freshcaughttrout_description: A small trout, a vital ingredient in making Forellac's jerked fish.
0904_0201_jerkedfish_description: An aromatic jerked fish, great for travel rations.
0904_0303_sailorlocket_description: A simple locket to hold a keepsake. On the front is the finely wrought image of a black hawk.
0905_0301_corruptedblood_description: A glass vial holding a sample of the blood of a Corrupted.
0905_0302_magnetite_description: A hunk of grey ore related to iron, but perfect for creating magnets.
0905_0303_witheredflesh_description: A hunk of rotting flesh, stripped from the back of a Withered.
0905_0304_ancientcloth_description: A folded length of cloth, possibly made by the Ancients. It appears undamaged by time.
0905_0304_guardiancloth_description: A scrap of cloth pulled from the bones of a Guardian.
0905_0305_pirateblood_description: A vial holding a sample of blood from an Undead Pirate.
0905_0306_crystalprism_description: A four-sided crystal pyramid that appears to trap light instead of dispersing it.
0905_0306_guardiancrest_description: A token claimed from Guardians depicting the Ouroboros, the serpent eating its own tail.
0905_0307_ectoplasm_description: A strange gel that appears to be the remains of a Ghost.
0907_0101_flawedfreshpearl_description: A low-quality pearl, gathered from the Hatchburg Fishery.
0907_0101_silverflask_description: A silver-lined flask, supposedly meant to change colors when exposed to poison.
0908_0101_azothsplinter_description: A sliver of stone, dimly glowing with the blue light of azoth.
0908_0101_herbsatchel_description: A collection of locally grown herbs, intended for healing purposes.
0908_0101_researchnotes_description: Syndicate journals filled with research on a number of topics, from azoth to zoology.
0909_0101_blessedironblank_description: An iron blank for arrowheads, blessed by a variety of religious leaders.
0909_0101_spoiledrations_description: A hunter's traveling rations , spoiled by the touch of Corruption.
0909_0101_taintedflesh_description: The remains of a hunter's quarry, tainted by the touch of Corruption.
0910_0101_dayspringbarley_description: Freshly harvested barley from the fields of Dayspring Mills.
0910_0101_heirloomcharm_description: A simple silver charm, with the image of a lighthouse engraved on the front.
0910_0101_heirloomgem_description: A cut semi-precious gem. Along the edge is carved, "For my love, for all eternity.
0910_0101_heirloomlocket_description: An old locket, holding a cameo and a twist of hair.
0910_0101_heirloompomander_description: An ornate pomander, holding the pleasant scent of vetiver and rose.
0910_0102_girouxbrewrecipe_description: The recipe for a very special brew, held by Chef Paul Giroux.
0910_0102_hilltophops_description: A sack of quality hops, grown and harvested near the Hilltop Encampment.
0910_0102_portabledistillery_description: A small and portable distillery, covered in an odorous black sludge.
0910_0102_strangedistillation_descriptio: Flasks holding a thick black liquid. A scrap of paper tied around the neck of each reads "Paul's New Brew."
0910_0201_cannonparts_description: A collection of tools and parts necessary to keep a cannon functional.
0922_innkeep_default: Welcome to 'The Everlasting Torch'! We're always burning for you. You here to check in? Be my guest… literally!
0923_0101_fq04_complete_available_respon: A note from Master Fisher Clemenson? Please, put it down right there. No, my hands are too dirty to touch it right now, but... thank you.
0923_0101_fq04_incomplete_a: Having trouble finding Hotspots? Look along the coast or at inland lakes and rivers. Hotspots can be found in any kind of water and anywhere.
0923_0101_fq04_objective_desc: Catch fish from a Hotspot three times for Master Fisher Clemenson and deliver a note to Master Fisher Warwick in Monarch's Bluff.
0923_0101_fq04_proposal_a: Here's a lesson: Have you ever seen a spot in the water that looks like it would be prime for fishing? These are called Hotspots.
0923_0101_fq04_proposal_b: Try your luck in these Hotspots and then take this.
0923_0101_fq04_proposal_next: It's a message from me to Master Fisher Warwick. It is imperative that you do not open this note!
09_firstlight_body_01_01:
Some perished during the voyage, others while breaking through the storms surrounding the island.
Our ship was damaged, but limped onward, and found a friendly settlement to take us in. Dayspring Mills was a bustling village, everyone contributing their work and production to carve out a new life in this land.
Crops would mature seemingly overnight, animals brought down in the hunt would seemingly repopulate within just a few days... here, in Aeternum, the days of hunger, of famine, of hoarding food to make it through the winter are all long gone.
We are the lucky ones.
09_firstlight_body_01_02: These things, the Withered... they do... not... die!\nRather, they do, but they come back more mindless and ravenous than before. The bounty of this land means that fewer are required to farm, true, but even more are needed for defending the village. When one is brought down, it vanishes quickly — the island reclaims its own, it seems — but returns within just a short time. We do not have the manpower to encircle the village with a sturdy wall or even a defensive palisade. Their number continue to grow and I fear we will be pushed aside 'fore too long.\nI can only hope the settlement has space enough for us to return, when that day comes.
09_firstlight_body_01_03: I write this in the hopes that it will never be read, that our defense will prove sufficient against the Withered. They do not sleep, they do not think, they only charge mindlessly toward us.\nI feel as one of Leonidas' men must have, defending against the unending attacks at Thermopylae. The only difference is that for us, there is no end in sight, no limit to the numbers we must attempt to cut down as our own numbers dwindle.\nWe prepare to flee back to the settlement, bearing only what we can carry on our backs, with the hope that we will one day return and reclaim our homes... our memories... our lives.
09_firstlight_body_02_01: Trappers brought in a good haul today: turkeys, rabbits, even an elk that happened by. Just waiting for the skinners in the upper camp to finish their work before I start breaking down the bits and pieces. Should have plenty set out to cure and smoke by the evening.\nA trader down from Edengrove passed by and brought a couple of new recipes to add to my book, so it's a good thing I was able to convince Rost to let me borrow his distillery. Probably could've set one up with the bits around here, but his kit is better than anything I could rig together. Some of these ingredients are strange, but the trader said they're pretty popular recipes in that area.\nNever thought of adding meat to a distilling process, but... I'll try anything once.
09_firstlight_body_02_02: This brew is... odd. Not bad, but has a strange aftertaste. Like drinking whiskey with a pat of butter in it, leaves a bit of a film in your mouth.\nIt certainly does the trick though, so I've started bottling up this first batch for the boys here. "Paul's New Brew" seems to be a hit with everyone who's had it so far. Once we pack up camp, maybe I'll start a bigger business with Rost, send it out to all of the settlements for everyone to enjoy!
09_firstlight_body_03_01:
Sent the last 80 tons of stone down to the settlement to the south for them to finish constructing additional houses, and just received an order from the northwest for around a thousand tons more.
The men need a few days off, and then we can get started on that order. I think we'll pull most of the men back into the camp and run skeleton crews in the mines, let everyone have a bit of rest before moving on.
Maybe I'll even get a break, go down to Forellac and talk to that fine lass that makes the fish for us.
I'll have to take a bath.
09_firstlight_body_03_02: The charcoal pits are finally taking off! We've mainly been using them to keep heat in the bunkhouses, but it turns out that it's a pretty hot commodity.\nMost of the wood around here is too wet to work with right away, so it takes time to dry out for burning... else it fills the house with smoke. But this charcoal can be used right away, so Forellac has been trading their jerked fish in exchange for weights of the charcoal. Since otherwise, we'd be living on hardtack and whatever meats are shipped up from the Encampment, it is a welcome change.\nPlus, the smiths at the south settlement have been taking all the extra to use in their smelting process, so we can keep the rest of our supplies covered. We may have the start on real industry here!
09_firstlight_body_03_03:
Ah, that foreman from the mines is so nice! When I brought the last shipment of fish to Letum's Pick, he had picked flowers for me and had a wonderful picnic set up for the two of us.
I didn't have the heart to tell him that I'm sick of fish... but the bread and fresh rabbit was wonderful.
He is a kind man, and he treats his men well and I have no doubt that he would treat me the same. His look is craggy, like the stone he works with, but I have grown fond of him.
Perhaps when I next see him, I will suggest that he speak with Father about courting me officially.
09_firstlight_body_03_04:
It has been too long since I've been well enough to write, Four days since my fever broke. I've just left my home for the first time in what seems to be two full weeks... everything has changed.
There are only a handful of us that survived this illness... Father and Mother are both gone. My brothers are gone. Our neighbors, gone.
I attempted the walk to the mines earlier today, but stopped short when I saw the state of things. No longer is it a well-run place, bustling with purpose... now, it is a foul place, tainted by Corruption. I tried to find my foreman, my heart, but it seems he succumbed as well.
I was not spotted, and left quickly. We have gathered what little we can carry and will move toward the settlement to the northwest, to sanctuary.
09_firstlight_body_04_01: As my full treatise of De Magnete successfully made the journey to Aeternum with me, and having no knowledge of others with copies of their own, it falls to me to continue Gilbert's investigations on the nature of the magnet. As he states, knowledge of magnets is present across all of the world, from the earliest Greek and Jewish and Egyptian scholars to far and distant China, with many years of study being dedicated to their effects. Here, in this Terra Aeternum, I may unlock a new path of research.\nMight Azoth influence these magnets in some way? Will they redirect the needle to a new North? Will they improve and enhance the capabilities of magnets? Only time, and experimentation will tell.
09_firstlight_body_04_02: In Gilbert's final book, he makes reference to a mysterious fifth essence, one that links all bodies together in harmony — for the heaven of philosophers, as of theologians, must be gentle, happy, and tranquil, and not at all subject to changes. I seek to discover whether Azoth might be the universal aether on which magnets interact, that invisible yet measurable force. Or is azoth a new tool for the aforementioned interaction, granting the bearer a new form of manipulating this aether which was otherwise hidden?\nPerhaps the properties of magnets crafted from Aeternum-mined material are different in their effects. The miners at Letum's Pick have spoken of quality ores from their mines... I must inquire further.
09_firstlight_body_05_01: To Whosoever Finds This:\nWe are abandoning this place, perfect as it is, for betrayal is in the air. Our three families have loaded what we can carry, and will make the trek to the settlement in Cutlass Keys, as it is closest. Normally, we would go south to our friends in Dayspring Mills, but we have seen the fires from that direction, the miners now attack us on sight, and we dare not risk travel through the wilderness. We can only pray for their safety.\nYou are free to whatever you may find here. We have left with what is most important.
09_firstlight_body_05_02: Lost another pig this week, 7th for the month. We've been trying to keep ahead of those Withered things, make sure we can still get the crops in and the animals fed, but they keep coming.\nThey killed Wulfgang two nights ago. I hope he returns intact, and not as one of those things...\nI don't know how much longer we'll be able to remain here or at Nyhart's... but I'll keep fighting for this place. Built it with my own hands, and won't let some shambling horde take it away from me.
09_firstlight_body_06_01: Another day, even more sifting through dirt.\nWe've been in these ruins for near two weeks now, and this fool has us searching for bits of pottery and scraps of fabric. Where's the gold? Where are the jewels? Where are the treasures that will make us all wealthy, like he promised?\nShould never have left the Kannan Tomb site... Once this place is a bust, I'll head back there. At least they had those big ruins nearby. Some nice pieces in there, fetched a fine price.
09_firstlight_body_06_02: A fine day, indeed! The men have recovered a handful of pottery shards, which I believe to have come from some form of sacrificial bowl, indicating the Ancients may have engaged in some form of ritualistic sacrifice. The silly arguments by the other researchers here stating that the shards were a part of a common eating bowl are absurd, particularly given the other pieces found there: a chipped knife blade, a long metal spike used for the execution, and a metal grate over the firepit that must have been used to preserve the sacrifice after death.\nI have also uncovered crude drawings that may indicate a powerful relic being held here. The relic may be a piece of importance to the Ancients, a religious statuary of some kind? I shall continue to search for it, as long as is needed.
09_firstlight_body_07_01:
The Captain found some kind of book when we were last ashore. He believed it contained the answer we needed to leave this cursed island. The Ebony Hawk’s a fine ship and many believed she would survive the journey. Despite tales of the doomed Vendetta, most of the crew felt it was worth the effort.

After spending hours going over that book in his cabin, the Captain finally stormed up to the deck in a state. He claimed he’d discovered some kind of ritual that would grant us safe passage. He insisted we would have no need to fear the Stormwall. But it would require a sacrifice of some kind. When pressed on this, he grew silent and retreated to his cabin.
09_firstlight_body_07_02: We brought Klaus's body back to the village... or what was left of it. He didn't disappear right away, so we may've been too far from the island for the magics to work right. All seemed normal until the black clouds rolled in. Middle of the day, and not a drop of sunlight to be found... like this place wasn't fit to be warmed no more.\nThe wolves came with the darkness, and... It was like they knew who were in the crew! They attacked them, tore them to pieces! Then, they started on our families...\nHave to get out of here. Think the wife and I will make a dash for it, over the rocks... toward the light...
09_firstlight_body_07_03:
A black wind howls. Screams echo against the rocks. For all I know, I'm the last left alive. This is my punishment for trifling with forces beyond my ken.
I turned us into the storm. I lashed Klaus to the mast and performed that blasted ritual. There was naught else to try. I vowed that we would escape this godforsaken place. I believed any sacrifice was worth our freedom.
This blasphemous ritual should’ve appeased a monster. Instead, it created another.
If I still had the book, perhaps I could find a way to undo this. Or some way to control whatever poor Klaus has become. But the sea claimed the book, washed it overboard during my failed attempt.
The screams have stopped. But now something pounds at my door. I shall let it enter and end this terrible nightmare…
09_firstlight_body_07_04:
What have we done? We knew this was blasphemy but none dared speak out. Some power seemed to still our voices. But we heard the screams when the Captain began the ritual. They will forever haunt me!
And it was all for naught! The storm did not abate! The monster was not appeased! We were forced to turn back! None of us could bear to look at what remained of our first mate.
We are returning home, sworn to secrecy. But our sin will not be cleansed. We must surely pay for what we have done…
09_firstlight_body_08_01: Seventeen Drowned today. Minor damage to my armor, will need to repair after this report. Spotting more of them grouping together, may indicate a change in their tactics?\nMore today than yesterday, but the same routine.
09_firstlight_body_08_02: If I didn't know better, I'd think something was controlling those storms... as if they know when a ship is approaching. Being stationed on this beach, I've seen dozens of them spin up out of a clear blue sky. Something mighty strange is going on here.
09_firstlight_body_08_03: I'm staying at the Docket for now, trying to figure out what to do next. It doesn't seem like anyone else made it to shore.\nThe leg is slowing me down less and less each hour, and if it keeps healing like this, I'll be walking by this evening, and running by morning. Unbelievable.
09_firstlight_body_08_04:
Watcher Linch -
Thank you for your meticulous reports regarding the Drowned situation, and if the situation is as dire as it sounds, we may need to investigate the possibilities of training additional Watchers for patrols. Your actions have been exemplary, and I appreciate your commitment to duty.

Magistrate Bond
09_firstlight_body_09_01: Biwa has done it! Took a bit of time and tinkering, but he finally managed to get some of those lake mussels to produce pearls. They're not as fine as ocean pearls, but this is just the start!\nImagine the looks on the faces of those in the Old World when the first ships back from Aeternum are laden with chests full of pearls... We'll be richer than we could've ever asked for! Have to work out that part about getting off of this island, sure, but that's someone else's problem.
09_firstlight_body_09_02: In my time here, hundreds of samples and artifacts have been gathered for research and study. One, however, has eluded us until now. Azoth has been found, so far, in a liquid form that can be added to items during the creation process, enhancing their abilities. During one of my excursions to the north, deep within a cave structure, I found what I had long theorized existed: solidified azoth! Imagine what could be done with this!
09_firstlight_body_09_03: From the settlement, we have received 3 wagon loads of wood, 4 crates of tools (assorted), 2 crates of fresh clothing and boots. Additionally, Adjudicator Jeffrey has included a shipment of Consecrated Iron Blanks to be fashioned into arrowheads or musket balls as needed. If functional, this should help against some of the more unsavory things that have been found near the camp.\n \nThis week's losses are worse than last week, I am afraid. The meat from 4 elk, and one too-curious wolf, turned almost overnight, becoming a blackened and sickly mess. Happens more and more frequently now, and we may have to start packing up if no fresh meat can be collected.
09_firstlight_body_10_01: I think I've figured out the key to catching more fish.\n\nIf you've got a keen eye and some fishing sense you can spot them: Hotspots. Hotspots are places in the water teeming with fish, and you'll get better and better at recognizing them as you develop your sense for fishing. The trick to it is landing your bobber within the Hotspot and then you can reap the benefits of whatever rarer fish are toiling there. You can exhaust these spots, so don't be surprised if it disappears after you and other adventurers plunder it for its fish.
09_firstlight_body_10_02: I've spent the last few years watching Warwick cast with the utmost awe. The way he arcs back the pole and releases the line is like poetry. You can tell the strength behind those casts is from the musculature of the whole body being put into them. He doesn't much like to talk about his days in the wars on and off Aeternum, but I can tell he was a magnificent warrior from his casting alone.\n\nMachera, have you been in contact with Warwick lately? I'm just wondering if he ever mentions me...
09_firstlight_body_10_03: I see the glow of her incandescent head bulb floating up towards the surface, towards my pole, and then quickly away. The female Albenaja glows with the light of Azoth on her bulb, and can only be found in First Light from what I've seen. She yields a hefty chunk of meat, but perhaps the bragging rights are even bigger and better.

09_firstlight_body_11_02: Captain's Log, Day One:\n\nToday we set sail for what may be but a legend. The land of Aeternum, spoken about in whispers, has long fascinated me. The crew knows what they're getting into with this expedition, and that is that we may never find the island at all. We have enough provisions to last us several months at sea which will allow our search to go unfettered. Skies are clear today, and morale is good.
09_firstlight_body_11_03:

- Fifteen muskets

09_firstlight_body_12_01:
Albert,

I won't be returning to the settlement, and I suspect everyone will be relieved… my own mother most of all. But you know that in the decades since we arrived on these accursed shores, my burden has been by far the worse to hers.

It's damned unnatural for a child to watch a parent remain young as they grow old. Why I'm one of the handful here cursed to continue aging, I will never comprehend. I tried to accept mother's youth, but after she became Constable, it was impossible. Watching her take command with such vigor has only hastened my decay. Even today, I listened as she and Artificer Kim made plans for some bright future. They don't realize how stupid they sound.

Whether we grow old here or not, whether we suffer or thrive, none of us will get the peace of eternal slumber. And without the promise of death, I simply do not see the point in pretending that we are living.

I thank you for your friendship, Albert, but I must now turn my back on First Light and embrace the darkness… whatever that may bring.

Aethelgard Oakes
09_firstlight_body_12_02:
March Eighteenth,

I've long since lost track of how long I've been on Aeternum, and other than the vague recollection of bearing children, I can't even remember my life in the Old World. I don't know if it's time that's taken the toll on my memory, or all the lies. Each year, they've piled higher, and I can no longer sort the truth from the false.

Watching Aethelgard slowly shrivel in body and spirit, I forced myself into the habit of putting on a hopeful smile no matter how I felt inside. Saints know, I tried. For his sake, I risked everything in a desperate bid to escape this island, but as with everything else here, it ended with disappointment.

For some reason, I still remember the smell of his skin when he was a newborn, but in the years before he left, Aethelgard smelled like a sick, old man. It reached the point where I couldn't even get close to him. I'll never forgive myself for that. I only hope where he is now, he's found some measure of peace.
09_firstlight_body_13_01:
Right Honorable Sir:

Captain Tavares of the Vendetta has tasked me with finding a Northman shipwright named Didrik Gundersen. It is my understanding you may be familiar with this man.

I believe the rumors claiming that this Northman had become Lost are entirely false. I have spoken to a quartermaster who saw him drinking in this very establishment. A queer thing for a Withered to do, wouldn’t you agree?

If I may impose upon you, I would request that you send immediate word to Captain Tavares’ camp should you see this Northman. The Captain would make it worth your while.

Indebted to you,

Duarte Pontes, Shipwright
09_firstlight_body_13_02:
The old Northman was clearly mad. Pale as a Withered, I was stunned he could utter anything other than crazed curses. I saw no evidence of the gifted shipwright he had once been. All I could see was a haunted corpse. 

He gibbered about a monster that lurks in the heart of the storm. “Kraken” he called it, a beast like the biblical Leviathan. After uttering its name, he seized me with an iron grip, pleading with me as if his soul depended on it. “Do not attempt to leave! Do not enter the storm!”

I left the poor wretch with a bottle of rum. I hope never to see him again.

DP
09_firstlight_body_13_03:
My desperate pleas fall on deaf ears. 

Captain Tavares will not be swayed from his mad plan. I insisted that no ship can resist the ravages of the Stormwall. No amount of armor will protect the hull. No cunning configuration of sails will weather this storm. This is sheer folly!

But I owe the Captain my life. I am compelled by honor to obey his command. 

I fear we are damned. I can only pray that the Vendetta will serve as a warning to others. 

May God have mercy on our souls!

DP
09_firstlight_body_13_04:
By God, the Northman was right! Those who doubted now reside in the murky deep. And I shall join them soon enough. I cling to what is left of our once proud ship.

At long last, I have set eyes upon it. The beast that lurks in the heart of the storm. Just as Didrik had warned, a kraken of the Old World. Its baleful gaze illuminates the water like the spectral moon. This demon is the true guardian of this accursed island!

There is no escape from Aeternum. The Stormwall will see to that. 

There is no escape…

DP
09_firstlight_body_14_01:
I saw the ghostly lights last night. 

The mist had thinned, allowing a view further out to sea. My mates insist it was naught but moonlight on the waves. But I swear I could make out her masts, glimpse her tattered sails. 

And could that simply have been the moaning wind? Or the distant wailing of the cursed crew? Those poor souls bound to their mad captain and his ship. The Withered also haunt the seas. The thought makes me shudder.

Giuseppe
09_firstlight_body_14_02:
Of course, I know of the Flying Dutchman. I always considered it a fanciful tale intended to liven dreary voyages. But here on Aeternum, the mysterious power of Azoth changes everything. 

Whispers of the doomed ship that attempted to leave Aeternum long ago cannot be dismissed as mere folklore. I have never seen it but I do not doubt that it exists.

I shall gather what knowledge I can of this phantom vessel. Is it crewed by Withered? Or have those poor souls become something else entirely? In a land where life and death have lost meaning, I cannot imagine what new horrors await us.

Zachariah the Scrivener
09_firstlight_body_14_03:
“Tis better to be Lost on land than Withered at sea.”

I heard a local fisherman say this today. His fellows nodded in agreement. I believe this is a reference to the ghost ship that blessed few have seen. I have spent hours scanning the far horizon but have never caught so much as a glimpse.

When I tried to question the fisherman, he simply muttered: “Our lives are here now. Nothing else is real.” A surprisingly profound observation, to be sure. I wonder who this fisherman was in the Old World.

Zachariah the Scrivener
09_firstlight_body_15_01:
Hail to you, Mother of the Deep. Hear our prayer and grant us your protection. As above in Aeternum, so below in your kingdom. Yours is the hand that guides. Yours is the breath that restores. We beseech you, lead us into the Eternal Light. Though we are unworthy, grant us your loving grace. Amen. 

Melanthe
09_firstlight_body_15_02:
I have witnessed a miracle. While fishing for bluegills near Clearwater Bend, a horde of Withered descended upon us. We retreated into the water, having no other escape. The relentless Withered pursued and I feared we were doomed to join their ranks. 

Then the sea pulled back. We found ourselves surrounded by flopping fish. We heard a mighty roar before the sea crashed upon us. The waves pulled me under, tearing my breath from my body. My sight darkened…

I awoke on the beach, surrounded by my stunned companions. Of the Withered, there was no sign. The beach had been cleansed. All that remained was the cries of gulls and the gentle murmur of the surf. 

Caliban
09_firstlight_body_15_03:
I have heard a few coastal fisherfolk refer to something they call the “Mother of the Deep.” Aeternum, like other lands of this world, has its own unique folklore. Such tales are common, especially among seafaring people. But here, it is no easy feat to separate myth from reality.

This entity is also sometimes known as Lady Fathom. Like Poseidon, Lir, or Njord of the Old World, her realm is the sea, and she is offered gifts in exchange for pleasant weather and bountiful fishing. It is said she is benevolent and protects those who call upon her.

I wonder if such an entity could truly exist. I suppose there is no reason to doubt it. Not here, anyway. But thus far, I have discovered no reason to believe such stories either. It remains a mystery.

Zachariah the Scrivener

I went along with Riches to investigate, and what I saw... I cannot describe. The Huntress was there, and another woman, but then she wasn't. After that, we ran back home.
09a_firstlight_body_01_02: They're closing in. The last few of us are holed up in the tavern... though Gunter is gone. I hope he made it out. The vines crept into our homes at night, and then... the screams. I saw Gladis... crying for help as she was dragged into some kind of pod. There was nothing I could do.
09a_firstlight_body_01_03: The settlement has fallen! I ran. I had no choice. We thought we were safe... but then she was there, and everything went mad! I can only hope Kim and Riches were able to get away. Perhaps, if I search... yes.
09a_firstlight_body_01_04: It was a mistake to go back, to see… what I struggle to even explain. Watcher Linch… it was horrible. There's no hope for her… nor for me, I suppose. I should go, but I don't know where. The lake, perhaps. It's nice this time of year.
