09a_firstlight_body_02_01:
These sprig-heads in Dayspring have no idea what fury Albert Riches is about to unleash on them.

Huntress thinks she's getting over on us, teaming up with snake-women and bull-men, but when you're all human, you learn to live by your wits, and I'll bet my survivalist soul on being harder, scrappier, and a good bit smarter than a bunch of juiced up weeds!

If they're borrowing from mythology, I think I'll remind them what mankind's famous for... we make FIRE.
09a_firstlight_body_03_01: Please help! They haven't noticed me writing yet. I don't know why they are taking me. But they also took some of my tools, so they must need me to fix… or make something. I'll try to drop notes as I discover more.
09a_firstlight_body_03_02: They took my quill but I made another. I don't have much time, I overheard mention of taking me to Medusa for instructions, but that can't be right, can it? I'll write more when I can.
09a_firstlight_body_03_03: This is my last piece of paper. I've come to realize we're not headed to Saircor. If we were, we would have turned by now. Where are they taking me? And why?
09a_firstlight_body_04_01:
I thought it would never end.

Jeoffrey and I were out checking our snares, as we do every evening. Tonight, we were the prey.

The night air was damp, and stank of moist fronds – the usual bouquet of this oppressive jungle. As we approached our favorite trapper’s hole, Jeoff spied movement in the undergrowth. Excited by the prospect of fresh meat for the markets, he rushed on ahead. Weary from the day’s labors, I lagged behind. Trapped on this island for so many years, I find I can no longer muster the enthusiasm of a fresh castaway.

As he reached the edge of the briars, a shadow fell across him. Terrified, I cried out in warning! But I knew as soon as the words left my lips, I was already too late. The brush parted, and standing in the gap was a gigantic creature, with a face not quite like a man’s. Shocked and confused, poor Jeoffrey did not even scream. His breathless, terrified gasp was likely the last sound he made as the beast took hold of him.

I am ashamed, but I made not even a token attempt to save him from oblivion. Unmanned by my fright, I scrambled off the path until I found a bolthole within a hollow tree. There, I listened. To the sound of bones and sinews snapping. To the rustle of brush and pounding of earth, as my friend’s body was rent apart. And to the sharp, shallow rhythm of my own breath, as I prayed the musk of the junk would mask my own scent and spare me the cruel fate of my fellow.
09a_firstlight_body_05_01:
Dear reader: 

I know not whether you are an explorer or graverobber, a soldier or looter. Whatever misfortune brings you to this forsaken place: turn back! 

This land is cursed. It was once our home, but it will suffer our presence no longer. Cunning beasts conspire against us, and the very ground beneath our feet plots our destruction. I implore you: whether it is duty or greed that brought you to this place, flee! There are fates far worse than the agony of death, and a great many of them await you on the shores of First Light. 

May your gods have mercy on you and light your way to safer ground, stranger!
09a_firstlight_body_05_02: We cannot get out! Some dark twisted magic has perverted the Earth Mother and turned her against her children. At all the far-flung corners of First Light, the thorns and thistles and brambles have sprung up with such ferocity, they are thick and dense as any barrier wrought by builder or mason. We tried everything—from axes and fire to prayers for forgiveness—but nothing, nothing, will make the wall of thorns give way. Poor Brandon even tried scaling the damn thing. He got less than half way before his grip failed him, and he crashed back to the earth, hands bloody and teeming with vermin and poison. He died not long later, screaming and feverish. He still hasn’t returned, so I can only assume that some other doom has already found him. Whatever his fate, he’s trapped here with the rest of us, poor bastard, perhaps for what’s left of eternity. As for me? I’m going back home. If I’m going to die, at least it’ll be defending my own hearth. Not out here on the road like a tramp or a vagabond.
09a_firstlight_body_06_01:
We lost another today. One of our best. I’ve had Cedrick tracking the mammoth herds since their erratic behavior began. When he stopped giving reports, I sent some of the other scouts off looking for him. They found only the bloody wreckage of his evening campsite, trod deep into the earth by many rampaging feet. The herd may have become reckless and wild, but this is the first time I’ve ever heard of a mammoth committing a deliberate act of murder. They swept the surrounding area, looking for some evidence of a new incarnation, but returned to me when they found none. 

I spotted him late this evening along the riverbank, near the northern border. He did me the courtesy of a friendly nod, but I sensed it was useless to approach any further. His mind was set, and his life among our scouts was at an end. I bear him no ill will. He was a good man, and any settlement would be lucky to have him. It is up to each of us to determine what horror we can endure in this forsaken place. At least I was able to learn his fate.

Dario and Clara are still missing, seemingly without a trace. I can only assume they finally lost their battle with the wages of eternal life, and that the next time we meet will be at he end of a sword. I can only wonder how many of my Lost friends I will encounter this way before I too am claimed by madness. 

-Magistrate Gladis Bond
09a_firstlight_body_06_02:
I saw something tonight that I cannot explain. While on the road, I sensed a presence—at once familiar and alien to me. I hid myself within the gloom, hoping whatever followed after me might reveal itself. A short time later, I saw a silhouette in the moonlight, picking its way along the trail I my wake. 

Perhaps sensing that it had become the prey, it stopped, eyes fixed on my hiding place. I kept perfectly still, hoping it would draw close enough I could perceive more than its vaguely humanoid shape. But it broke off its pursuit and withdrew back into the forest. Realizing I was now alone, I returned to where I lost sight of my quarry, hoping to pick up a trail to follow. But when I arrived, I found no trace of a human or animal presence. 

I have not yet met a creature I could not track, and yet… I cannot convince myself that what I witnessed was a trick of the light. And with the recent behavioral changes among the wildlife here, I fear this incident portends nothing good for the future.

-Magistrate Gladis Bond
09a_firstlight_body_06_03: I am as without hope as I am without words, and yet I recognize that I must record what happened. Whoever finds this… if someone finds this… I beg you – fight! The people of First Light trusted me and my scouts to hold such dangerous, wild forces at bay. And I have failed. It now falls to you to protect this land. I was out walking last night, crossing over the trail by the South Gate as I had done many times since that night, hoping to repeat a chance encounter I had earlier in the month. That night I got my wish. For as I walked, I felt the strange presence once again. And this time, my shadow made itself known. What I saw defies imagining: it was Clara, sure as the night is long. Or rather, some monster that had borrowed her shape. Her body was fibrous and wooden; her skin, a course layer of tree bark. Her face, features I had witnessed a thousand times before, was a tangle of brambles and thorns, blank and expressionless. I hesitated, stunned to inaction by what I saw. It was a grievous mistake. Roots sprung from the earth, wending and winding their way about my limbs and torso. I struggled vainly, unable to scream as the air was crushed from my lungs. As vision failed me, I knew that death would be the price for my bewilderment. But I was wrong. I awoke, held fast in a cage that burst forth from the very ground. Around me, similarly restrained, were many of our missing neighbors. I know not where we are, nor what fate awaits us, but the twisted simulacrum of Clara still stirs, somewhere off in the dark. -Magistrate Gladis Bond
09a_firstlight_body_06_04:
They took him. They took him, and then they brought him back. But he’s no longer him! He’s… like them! 

The night before I called out to my fellow captives, hoping to glean a greater understanding of what fate had befallen us. Perhaps roused by the sound of a familiar voice, Dario shouted back, his panicked cry as horrifying as it was familiar. For a moment, a familiar presence gave me hope, that is, until, I realized what a broken thing he was. He spoke in stammers separated by gasps, spouting a flood of borderline incoherent half-sense. What little I could decode from his deranged ramblings chilled me to my core. But it was as music compared to what I witnessed then. 

Perhaps roused by his tantrum, our captors dragged him from his cage, screaming and spitting with terror. As he disappeared somewhere into the gloom, the character of his cries changed, from fear to outright anguish. Then all was silence, and the silence was worse. I beat my hands against the prison barrier and cried out in defiance! The prisoners around me admonished the outburst, cautioning that they might claim me as well. I didn’t care! Anything was better than languishing here awaiting some unknown doom. 

But I was wrong… because from the shadows, Dario returned. His flesh and sinews were replaced by trunks and branches. His hair was leaves, and skin was cracked bark like the others. And his face – that cruel twisted parody – was vacant and unknowing. Unknowing and unmerciful. 

This is what it means to die on Aeternum. To truly die. To face annihilation and be twisted into what you are not. This must not be my fate. It must not. Let me shimmer and fade away to nothingness, but not this! Not as a weapon of torment against those I once loved. Please, God, not this!

-Magistrate Gladis Bond
09a_firstlight_body_06_05:
The screams are nearly constant now. Each night they take more, dragging them off to whatever horror awaits them within outer darkness. As their ranks swells so too, it seems, does their appetite. Most no longer struggle, having long ago resigned themselves to this grisly end. The suffering and agony seem almost quaint when weighed against our isolation and dread. 

But I will not go quietly. I swore an oath to protect this land, and wish that I could claim that my sense of right and duty sustained me. But my motives are far simpler now. 

Hate. 

I hate Clara for what she did to us, and Dario for what was done to him. I hate this place of dirt and bugs and coarse, restraining branches. I hate knowing what’s coming, and knowing I am powerless to stop it. And I hate myself, for allowing this fate to befall me. 

So when they open this cage, I will fight. I will strike out at their sneering, stolen faces and hope to smash the effigy of my fallen friends. I will tear their bark with teeth and nails, clawing and screaming like the dying animal I have become. I will make it hard and dirty. I will make them rip the breath from my body. 

And when it is over, if any trace of my soul remains, I will channel all my hate, and rend my new, twisted body limb from limb.

-Magistrate Gladis Bond
09a_firstlight_body_07_01:
If you’re reading this it’s because you’re alive and you’re still human. That means you’re either here to affect a rescue, or by some miracle, you’re a survivor, like us! Either way, praise be to whatever merciful power has spared you. 

So stranger, come find us! Those that remain have found a cavern to hide in, away from the prying eyes of the jungle. For now, we are safe, but for how long I cannot say. Move east! Due east! Until you find our hideaway. We need you and whatever aid (and hope!) you can offer. 

-Albert Riches
09a_firstlight_body_07_02:
For the moment, we are safe! For how long, I can only speculate. But the circumstances are far beyond my hopes. Scores of adventurers have flooded into First Light to confront the great evil that has infected our land. Those of us that remain have even returned to our homes, trusting to the great host of new warriors that have entered this domain can keep the wilds at bay. So far, we have lost no more of our citizens. 

Still, whatever dark power twisted this place is not finished, and against anything with such arcane power, victory cannot be assured. I have advised our citizens to pack all their essentials, to stay ready in case of another retreat. If we must flee this place once more, we must have what we need to make a fresh start in a new place. 

For now, though, I shall try to have hope, and to spread confidence among the weary citizens of First Light.

-Watcher Nora Linch
09a_firstlight_body_08_01:
My mistress warned me there would be a price. That mankind had been judged and found wanting, and that to truly serve the gods, I would have to shed the trappings of humanity. I held fast to my faith and agreed to her bargain. I can scarcely believe the gift I have been given. 

I had thought the loss of my natural form weighs heavily on me. That the sight of my gleaming fangs or the rattle of my tail would vex and torment me. But I see now the perfection of the gods’ plan, and I like what I have become. 

I will do my duty and aid my mistress in her holy mission to return this land to the sole dominion of holy nature. I will purge this place of human civilization and all its earthly trappings. A plan takes shape in my mind’s eye, to use the unholy form of our fallen predecessors to further my mistress’ agenda. 

I will turn all their scheming, all their guile, all their greed and avarice, and bend it to the service of Mother Nature. Mankind, whose petty squabbles and endless appetites once ravaged our land, shall once again become her stewards.
09a_firstlight_body_08_02:
The earth has heard our call, and offered up a solution to the plague of humanity upon our land. 

Today I brought one of the captives before my mistress, and invoked the power of the gods. I watched as the wretch was granted absolution, her human form purged away by the embrace of the land. She rejected her gift at first, raging against the transformation of her profane flesh. But in the end, her defiance proved futile. No one of mortal stock can withstand the will of the gods. 

What remained was pure. A merging of the guile of mankind with the majesty of nature. These hercyne shall be our heralds to the remaining human bastions on Aeternum, harbingers of nature’s great displeasure. They shall carry the wrath of Artemis to all the corners of this land, purging the stain of humanity and sowing the seeds of cleansing and renewal. 

And when it is finished, all will be as our Mother Earth intended – free from the insatiable desires of humanity. Balanced. Unspoiled. Perfect.

09a_gauss_01: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Fascinating. The surrounding flora rapidly withers when the energy is in close proximity.
09a_gauss_default_a: <g id="male_lookUpAround" />The storm is transforming! I’ve never seen the skies of Aeternum look so bafflingly arcane.
09a_gauss_default_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I must capture this energy to study its composition. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />But I wouldn’t stand a chance against all the beasts and monstrosities within the tower.
09a_hargest_lc_02: <g id="male_explain" />Hopefully we won’t need to use that much firepower again. But if we do, I know who to call upon. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Until then, keep well my friend.
09a_hargest_lc_default: <g id="male_explain" />We have sacrificed much to get here. We need to fortify this position or it will all be for nothing. <g id="male_convince01" />Help us establish a perimeter or we're done for.
09a_hargest_ne_a_default_a: <g id="male_fistRaiseLeft" />Feels good to get out and swing my blade. <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Been sitting on my hands in the camp too long!
09a_hargest_ne_a_default_b: <g id="male_lookaroundWorried" priority="high" />Now, where the hell are the rangers I sent to secure this position? They can't all have been captured!
09a_hargest_ne_c_01_a: <g id="male_explain" />This might actually be a good strategic position. We know something's going up at Light's Crown, <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />and I'm betting it's going to be quite a battle.
09a_hargest_ne_c_01_b: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I've sent for reinforcements. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Keep me posted if you learn anything new.
09a_hargest_ne_c_default_a: <g id="male_explain" />Some kind of survivalist named Riches, <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />sounds like he's waging a one-man war against the Angry Earth.
09a_hargest_ne_c_default_b: <g id="male_nod1" />My kind of guy. He hasn't been seen for days, so his plans may have gone awry.
09a_hargest_wc_01_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Ah, the hero Morgaine predicted would come! And is that the inoculate she promised? I'll take it, though I trust little from that Sorceress.
09a_hargest_wc_01_b: <g id="male_gestureAhead" />I'll be anxious to see if you're as strong as she claims. <g id="female_lookaroundScared" priority="high" />Our need is dire.
09a_hargest_wc_02_a: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Ah, the hero of Aeternum! Morgaine predicted you'd come, though I'm skeptical of the claims the sorceress makes with such<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />… certainty.
09a_hargest_wc_02_b: Nonetheless, I welcome any capable combatant. We're <g id="male_spreadarms001" />spread thin as gossamer down here.
09a_hargest_wc_02_inprogress: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />If we lose an entire patrol, <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />we'll have barely enough to defend this place.
09a_hargest_wc_03_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Hail, the conquering hero! <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />My returning scouts are singing your praises.
09a_hargest_wc_03_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />But no medals just yet, we need to push south, <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />and we've no more time for Trahern's experiments.
09a_hargest_wc_default: <g id="female_explainS" />The flora and fauna of this region have fallen completely under Artemis's influence. <g id="female_smackfist" />If we are to prevail, we must master nature itself.
09a_innkeep_default: Come on in! We've everything you could need, just try not to make a mess of things.
09a_james_default: <g id="male_apologize" />Sorry, matey! Nothing to spare. I did not have the time to consider visitors during my spirited relocation. <g id="male_spreadhands" />All I can offer you is pleasant company!
09a_james_rr_default_a: <g id="female_theseidiots" />I bet those fools who gave me the boot would regret it if they were still alive! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I could be the governor, couldn't I?
09a_james_rr_default_b: <g id="male_chuckle" />At least I'll have a stately mansion owing to the drop in property value!
09a_johannes_01_a: Ach! Don't sneak up on me like that. Can't you see I’m deep in thought?
09a_johannes_01_b: I've been trying to find a way to gather Hercyne samples without suffering grievous bodily harm. I don't suppose a warrior like yourself would be interested in helping?
09a_johannes_02_a: Ah. I have more work for my favorite living assistant. It involves your specialty - brutal carnage!
09a_johannes_02_b: We will be meddling with the gorgon's magic, so I hope you're prepared for a grand scientific achievement.
09a_johannes_default_a: The Syndicate said my scientific pursuits were too extreme. They called me unhinged. Can you believe it?
09a_johannes_default_b: It's slander! And all because I refuse to allow a silly thing like ethics to hold back progress.
09a_johannes_talkto: You have been instrumental in this endeavor. The honor of pulling the lever should go to you. I won't take 'no' for an answer.
09a_josephine_00_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Leave it to the Covenant to unleash a plague. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Can't say I'm surprised with how they touch everything.
09a_josephine_00_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Awakened loads of Ancient Guardians - <g id="male_spreadarms001" />wrecked our gear! <g id="male_headShakeNo" />No pylons, no control of defenses.
09a_josephine_01_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Thanks again for helping me back there, <g id="female_explainS" />sometimes I let my curiosity get the better of me, which is probably why I joined the Syndicate.
09a_josephine_01_b: <g id="male_explain" />I'm here studying how the Ancients powered this place. Have you seen their wiring schematics? <g id="male_fistpumpLargeRight" />They're wild!
09a_josephine_02_a: All fixed? <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Us too. With the pylons repaired, <g id="female_explainS" />our expert in Ancient machinery can attempt to gain control of the defenses.
09a_josephine_02_b: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />He’s a Marauder, so make sure his soldiers aren’t breaking the machines. <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />We can’t afford any more repairs.
09a_josephine_default_a: <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />You can move along. Nothing to see here. <g id="male_quidproquo" />The Covenant bogged down the work to the south. <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Now we don't have power.
09a_josephine_default_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />The group up north needs us to finish here if they'll have any chance of affecting those defenses.
09a_josephine_rescue_01: <g id="male_salute2Fingers" />Oh thank you! I should have never gotten so close to the ruins, <g id="male_explain" />but I just had to study the lights! Have you ever seen such contraptions before?
09a_kievan_01_a: With what you have accomplished here, we should be able to contain the beasts of this island.
09a_kievan_01_b: We will next turn our attention towards our siege on Hornhold.
09a_kievan_default_a: I fear no man! But the army of beasts forming on that mountain below? They scare me. It will be a colossal relief when these defenses are ours.
09a_kievan_default_b: If only the sluggards below could finish the mission.
09a_kievan_talkto_01_a: I've unlocked some rooms but we need more. These runes seem to indicate danger. I need to maintain control of this apparatus.
09a_kievan_talkto_01_b: Go and repair what you can. And if it's not too much trouble… bring me a drink, da?
09a_kievan_talkto_02_a: Ah, delicious water. Friend, you are carrying this mission on your back.
09a_kievan_talkto_02_b: Our enemies will know our location the moment we take control of these devices. When you are ready, we will humiliate them on both fronts.
09a_kim_01_a: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />It wasn't here - it was up on the mountain, where they're channeling energy from the tower, and taking the captives in their pods…
09a_kim_01_b: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />The screams, the roars… and the Hercyne that emerge,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> I cannot think about it.
09a_kim_default: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Fates align! Break these bars and get me out of here!
09a_kim_sc_01_a: <g id="female_explainS" />I overheard much conversation between Artemis and Medusa while I worked.
09a_kim_sc_01_b: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Their hatred for humanity knows no bounds, and indeed, <g id="female_lookConcern" />they seem to relish whatever suffering they can impose up on their captives.
09a_kim_sc_default: <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Whatever happens, you must destroy that machine on the mountain. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />Medusa's experiments cannot continue.
09a_kurok_01_a: The Mammoth Lord is oldest amongst us, and anger smolders in his heart for what became of his kind.
09a_kurok_01_b: He is also the guardian of the Tear of Gaea, so his participation in the Tribunal is of highest importance.
09a_kurok_02: Our brother… we shall not let him fall to this affliction.
09a_kurok_default: I would crush you, but the howls of war have yet to sound and my tribe likes the sport.
09a_kurok_talkto_a: What business does a little hairless human have with the mighty Lord Kurok?
09a_kurok_talkto_b: I sense the energies of both Taurus and Shirzad upon you, but I know you have not bested them, so why do you travel this land, consorting with beasts?
09a_kurok_talkto_next_a: And Shirzad has agreed to convene one on your behalf? Grr. The Lion Lord presumes much of me!
09a_kurok_talkto_next_b: I must see your strength, human. Do you deem yourself a champion of your tribe?
09a_kurok_talkto_topic_a: Very well. My brothers are restless in this land and clamor to attack. Since you ask us to delay, they will want sport.
09a_kurok_talkto_topic_b: Fight my patriarchs, human. If you live, which I doubt, return to me.

09a_m11_completed_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Soulwarden! How long has it been? Much has transpired since you left, and the magic in this land swirls into a maelstrom.
09a_m11_completed_b: Artemis has begun some ritual at the Tower. Ready or not, <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />the time to fight is here.
09a_m11_completed_next_a: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />… The Tear of Gaea? THE Tear of Gaea? <g id="female_lookConcern" />It is real? It is in the hands of our enemy? Dear gods, if any defy my knowledge, I pray this is somehow untrue!
09a_m11_completed_next_b: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />What FOOL allowed the relic of creation to fall into the Huntress's hands? Bah!

09a_m11_description: Kurok has accepted our bid of peace for now, and is willing to reconvene with Shirzad over their fate on Aeternum. He now worries for his kin Mahantaram, the final Lord. Head east to the Trampled Lands, and face the mammoth.
09a_m11_incomplete_a: I sense strange changes within Mahantaram's soul, and I hear the thunder of his tribe resounding in the earth.
09a_m11_mahantaram_combat_1: I will you crush you human, leaving but the stain of your soul!
09a_m11_mahantaram_combat_2: Earth belongs to us now, humanity has no place!
09a_m11_mahantaram_combat_3: Humankind hunted our tribe to near extinction. Now it's our turn!
09a_m11_proposal_a: Go quickly, for even as we speak, I stretch out to commune with him, and Mahantaram does not respond.
09a_m11_proposal_b: The Mammoths have begun to rampage, and I fear something transpires beyond our awareness.
09a_m11_proposal_next_a: Only Mahantaram has the power to summon it from its vault. Let us hope he has not already done so.
09a_m11_proposal_next_b: If Artemis truly seeks to betray us in this bargain, and if she acquires the Tear of Gaea, then even the Beast Lords cannot stand against her.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_a: Human! I felt your battle, and the unseating of Manhantaram’s soul… shifted to the caverns south of here.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_b: Do you mean to tell Shirzad that YOU have bested a Beast Lord?
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_next_2_a: It is more dire than you can imagine. The Tear of Gaea harbors the power to recreate this island and the world beyond.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_next_2_b: If Artemis achieves Ascension, then no power can stop her.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_next_a: Then we have truly been betrayed by Artemis and undone by these alien spores that clog the air.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_next_b: And this means our primal oath is broken, and the Huntress has now in her possession the Tear of Gaea.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_topic_a: You need to hurry, human. My duty is to the Tribunal, and I must convene with Kurok over Mahantaram’s fate.
09a_m11_shirzad_talkto_topic_b: If Fate opposes the Huntress's bid for Ascension, then surely, you are its champion. Go and lead your tribe to victory.
09a_m11_taurus_talkto_a: Mmm. Your words proved true, and will now echo across the ages in legend.
09a_m11_taurus_talkto_b: It was the gorgon, Medusa, who poisoned Mahantaram's spirit, and I go now to crush the snake. Will you fight at my side, human?
09a_m11_taurus_talkto_topic_a: Rally your people first, for the beasts are not with us, and we need every soul we can muster. Then join me to attack Medusa's vile den.
09a_m11_taurus_talkto_topic_b: Do not delay, for my axe thirsts to cleave the gorgon's skull, and I have never been one for patience.

09a_m13_description: Trahern and Morgaine believe they may have devised a means of capturing Artemis and securing the Tear. Meet Morgaine up the road in the high mountains of what is now Scalefang Enclave to see what magic she has in mind.
09a_m13_incomplete: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Go swift and stay strong. We will need your abilities in the battle to come. Defeating Artemis will take great effort.
09a_m13_proposal_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />I hope so. We can only sow the seeds of possibility; nature must determine whether we harvest good fortune.
09a_m13_proposal_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Go and seek Morgaine within the enclave. If you clear the way, I will join you shortly to do my part.
09a_m13_task_placestaff: Place Your Azoth Staff in the Light
09a_m13_trahern_hg_delivery_a: <g id="male_explain" />The sorceress claims there may also be a way to harness the energies channeled here to bolster our chances against Artemis.
09a_m13_trahern_hg_delivery_b: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />Morgaine's magical theories sound far-fetched to me, but my purpose and my part are clear enough.
09a_m14_artemis_cutscence_ascenscion_1: This is my last warning to you, human. Come no further.
09a_m14_artemis_cutscence_ascenscion_2: Dare to interrupt my efforts and your suffering will be spoken of in legend.
09a_m14_artemisascenscion_igc_01: This is my last warning to you, human. Come no further.
09a_m14_artemisascenscion_igc_02: Dare to interrupt my efforts and your suffering will be spoken of in legends.
09a_m14_artemisascenscion_igc_artemis:
This is my last warning to you, human. Come no further. 
Dare to interrupt my efforts and your suffering will be spoken of in legends.
09a_m14_completed_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />This goes beyond anything Myrddin ever attempted. <g id="male_nodProud" />I am proud to have assisted you.
09a_m14_completed_b: <g id="male_patience" />The staff is but an implement, however. <g id="female_order" />You will need to weaken Artemis greatly to have any chance of unleashing the staff's new potential.
09a_m14_description: Morgaine directs us upward to the bloom above. With our Azoth Staff now empowered by the arcane energies channeled from Elafry Pyrgo we have but one more component to secure. Fight with Trahern, claim it, and finish the spell.
09a_m14_incomplete: <g id="female_crossarms" />Do not concern yourself. I am more than capable of battling my way safely to the tower.
09a_m14_morgaine_lc_talkto_a: <g id="male_chuckle" />Heh. It turns out the Archdruid can move rather quickly when he senses a threat to his beloved trees.
09a_m14_morgaine_lc_talkto_b: <g id="female_explainS" />He is prepared even now to infuse your staff with the lifeforce of the seed you acquired. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />Let us hope that is enough.
09a_m14_morgaine_lc_talkto_next_a: <g id="male_explain" />Artemis cannot be destroyed, so our only hope is that your imbued staff will be capable of imprisoning her.
09a_m14_morgaine_lc_talkto_next_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />But there is no time. Follow Trahern's instruction… this will work, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />trust me. It had sure better.
09a_m14_morgaine_se_delivery_a: Not only is Artemis an Ancient, but if she also draws on the power of the Tear of Gaea,<g id="male_hopeless" /> I fear this may be hopeless.
09a_m14_morgaine_se_delivery_b: The one chance we have is to turn her ambition into a vulnerability, <g id="female_smackfist" />and that is what we prepare for.
09a_m14_prompt: "So the staff will be the key."
09a_m14_proposal_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Precisely. Unlike the Archdruid, <g id="female_suppresslaugh" />your skills in comprehension are intact. Trahern does have a role to play however.
09a_m14_proposal_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Artemis twists the flora of First Light with a transformative lifeforce, and the druid can harness this.
09a_m14_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_chuckle" />Heh. You are ever the generous one, but it's true, we cannot accomplish this without him.
09a_m14_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_explainS" />He will need your assistance. Of that, I am certain. <g id="male_convince01" />Find him on the Bloom above and do whatever it takes. I will meet you at the approach to Light's Crown.
09a_m14_task_goviewcinematic: Scout Out the Elafry Pyrgo Tower
09a_m14_task_placestaff: Place Your Staff in the Circle
09a_m14_trahern_lc_talkto_a: The <g id="female_explainS" />Tear of Gaea contains the legacy of great natural power, and from this seed's lifeforce, your staff will be attuned to it.
09a_m14_trahern_lc_talkto_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />All things converge upon this moment. Are you ready to infuse your staff and face the Ancient?
09a_m14_trahern_lc_talkto_next_a: <g id="male_explain" />Place your staff over the circle when you are ready and we will finish the final enchantment.
09a_m14_trahern_lc_talkto_next_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I hope the sorceress's plan is sound, and you have the prowess to carry it out. The hope of the druids goes with you. Be strong.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_2_a: <g id="male_salute2Fingers" />Well done! Yes, <g id="female_headnodding" />this is a beautiful seed, brimming with a powerful lifeforce.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_2_b: I can extract this energy as Morgaine has requested, but the <g id="female_gestureForward01" />rest will be up to you and her.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_2_prompt_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes. Let us hope Captain Hargest and her rangers have cleared the way, and that Morgaine has made preparations.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_2_prompt_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I sense a pressure quivering in the trees like the anticipation of something terrible. We should hurry.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_a: I had hoped to finish this task more quickly. <g id="female_disappointed" />Unfortunately, I was forced to hide myself away.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />It appears our recent actions have greatly antagonized the local flora and fauna. <g id="male_dontknowS" />Artemis throws everything at us now.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_next_a: <g id="male_explain" />What we seek is nearby, a seed from a bloom that originated in the initial blast of Artemis’s transformational ritual. As you can see by the area, much power was focused here.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_next_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Those seeds clustered atop the bloom appear quite potent.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_next_prompt: "What is it that we need to do?"
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_topic_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />I agree. I will try to prevent you from being flanked from behind.
09a_m14_trahern_se_talkto_topic_b: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />The beasts that ambushed me earlier were more of those abominations. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />Prepare for a fierce battle now that Artemis is aware of our presence.
09a_m14_trahern_se_taskcomplete: <g id="male_crossarmsNo" />Worry not, I will meet you at the rally point. I happen to know<g id="female_explainS" /> an old and powerful enchantment that will let me make it there swiftly.
09a_m15_2hbow_t5_description: A relic of another Era. One filled with courage, pride, and rage.
09a_m15_artemis_combat_1: Fitting that you are here to witness my Ascension.
09a_m15_artemis_combat_2: The age of humanity comes to an end.
09a_m15_artemis_combat_3: Your evolution will be a new beginning!
09a_m15_artemis_combat_4: You cannot stand against the power of an Ancient!
09a_m15_artemis_ep_talkto_a: You have no idea what you’ve wrought. My vessel is fit to wield such power as the Tear of Gaea, not yours.
09a_m15_artemis_ep_talkto_b: In fear and pride, you humans grasp beyond your reach. You would be wise to entrust the artifact to me.
09a_m15_artemis_ep_talkto_topic_a: Enjoy your temporary victory. But know that you've doomed us all. And humanity will face the coming darkness more alone than ever.
09a_m15_artemis_ep_talkto_topic_b: Come, step closer, and I will give you a glimpse of your fate.
09a_m15_artemisdeath_igc_artemis: Once again, the pride of humanity invites doom to the shores of Aeternum.
09a_m15_ascendtower_trail: Ascend the Tower and stop Artemis before it's too late
09a_m15_completed_a: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />We have averted the ascension of an Ancient, and yet there remains more to do. <g id="female_worry" />I fear what could befall the Beast Lords following their affliction.
09a_m15_completed_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />You should consider returning to the region, they may need further assistance.
09a_m15_container_05: Speak with your companions and allies
09a_m15_description: Morgaine puts forth her final plea - capture Artemis and secure the Tear of Gaea from her grasp. With your allies at your back, ascend Elafry Pyrgo and battle the Ancient Artemis for the fate of the region, Aeternum, and the World.
09a_m15_entertrial: Confront Artemis and disrupt her horrifying plans
09a_m15_hargest_lc_sendoff: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />You’ve fought through fields of beasts and deadly plants, what’s one more strand of wheat? <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />	Come back in one piece, and human.
09a_m15_hargest_wc_end_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />This is a fitting land for me and my people, I vow to guard Artemis's prison with my life. <g id="female_salute2finger" />My rangers won't be forgetting you any time soon. Nor will I.
09a_m15_imprisonspell: Unleash the power contained in your Azoth Staff
09a_m15_incomplete: Even if we fail, Soulwarden, <g id="female_salute2finger" />I am proud of what we have accomplished together…<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" /> in scholarly terms, at least.
09a_m15_kim_wc_end_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />We have you to thank for all of this. Not only have you defeated Artemis and ended the invasion, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />you have unwound the consequences of my mistakes.
09a_m15_kim_wc_end_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I will stay here, and do what I can to aid in the restoration efforts.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_delivery_a: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I have no inspiring words with which to send you off, young one.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_delivery_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />We must prevent Artemis's ascension, or humanity will surely be destroyed.<g id="female_clasphandsConvince" /> Do whatever you must to stop her.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_leaving_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />No, it's better I don't. Even your mind could be twisted by such temptation.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_leaving_b: <g id="female_explainS" />There are mysteries still yet to unfold, and many beings who would use this for dark purposes. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Be on your guard. We will meet again.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_2_a: <g id="male_explain" />This crystal contains the essence of a powerful Ancient. One with a great legacy, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />who sacrificed herself long ago to form the fundamental magic of Aeternum.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_2_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />With it, Artemis would have rewritten humanity's story.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_2_topic_a: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />Not while this savagery has a grip on them; <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />they simply cannot be trusted with such power.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_2_topic_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />No, I will take it to a place long lost to most, <g id="male_spreadhands" />where it can be safely hidden.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_3_topic_promp: "Are you going to tell me where?"
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have done what even Myrddin could not. It seems every time, <g id="female_salute2finger" />you prove to have new strength that wells up from some unseen source.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_b: <g id="male_lookaroundSmall" />But there is the matter of the<g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" /> Tear of Gaea… we must act quickly.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_topic_a: <g id="female_lookConcern" />This artifact is too powerful for an Ancient and certainly beyond anything mortal minds can even grasp.
09a_m15_morgaine_ep_talkto_topic_b: <g id="female_order" />Get it and bring it to me quickly. We must ensure these incompetent druids don't walk away with it.
09a_m15_prompt: "What do I do with the Tear?"
09a_m15_proposal_a: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Heh. That is an excellent question, and I will need to think on it, <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />but it should not delay us now.
09a_m15_proposal_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Captain Hargest will harry her forces from the ground. Trahern and I will do what we can to slow the ritual. <g id="female_order" />Go.
09a_m15_riches_wc_end_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Seeing Kim lightens my heart. Thank you for fulfilling my last request, and thank you for saving us all at the end.
09a_m15_riches_wc_end_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I will return to the settlement, and try to begin rebuilding. <g id="female_lookConcern" />I sense a darkness that we must be prepared for.
09a_m15_task_morgaine_talkto2: Give the Tear of Gaea to Morgaine
09a_m15_taurus_wc_end_a: These events have given me a great deal to consider, human, especially my long-held distrust for your kind. Ha!
09a_m15_taurus_wc_end_b: You are a great and honorable warrior, and you are my friend. I owe you a great debt. Fate will bring us together again.
09a_m15_tearofgaia_description: The power emanating from the crystal feels untamed in your hands.
09a_m15_trahern_lc_sendoff_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />You have my gratitude for all that you have done here. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I can feel the Azoth flowing through the vines.
09a_m15_trahern_lc_sendoff_b: Whatever power I can harness, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I shall channel to support you.
09a_m15_trahern_wc_end_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Congratulations on your victory. The people of Aeternum will hear of the great deeds you've accomplished. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />And perhaps one day, the wider world.
09a_m15_trahern_wc_end_b: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Please, go speak with everyone, they will be eager.
09a_m15_triggerarea_ep_top: Reach the pinnacle of Elafry Pyrgo
09a_m15_triggerarea_warcamp: Return to the Last Light Encampment
09a_m1_armorbox_description: Dismantle for 1 Armor Piece at 625 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_m1_blossom_description: A vibrant glow pulsates throughout each petal in rhythm with a tranquil hum.
09a_m1_completed_a: <g id="male_lookLeftBody" priority="high" />So you've heard the ominous words of the Huntress, have you? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Somehow, she sounds different, knowing she's an Ancient.
09a_m1_completed_b: <g id="male_dismissRegal" priority="high" />Hmph. No matter, the content of her message is the greater concern.<g id="female_youknowS" /> I trust you agree.
09a_m1_completed_next_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I fear discovering the answer to that question will do little to increase our morale, <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />which is already sapping in this place.
09a_m1_completed_next_b: Nonetheless, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />we must learn all we can of Artemis's plans and how we might stop this madness.
09a_m1_container_02a: Extract seeds from the Angry Earth
09a_m1_container_05: Enter Elysian Wilds and find the Druids' Camp
09a_m1_description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
09a_m1_eg_task_gotopoi: Search {POITags} for seeds for Morgaine’s inoculate
09a_m1_eldred_talkto_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, yes, yes! Morgaine mentioned you'd be coming, and that you can help me with this.
09a_m1_eldred_talkto_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I believe I've uncovered a vulnerability in the Angry Earth's campaign - <g id="female_explainS" />a way to eavesdrop on Artemis's intentions.
09a_m1_flailt5_description: A brilliant flash of light that caused the darkness to shrink, but only for a moment.
09a_m1_flask_description: A highly resilient flask created by Theodore Eadred. He has requested its return upon no further use. It's claimed to be made of a rare material he has yet to reveal.
09a_m1_getseeda: Collect Verdant Seeds from Angry Earth
09a_m1_incomplete: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
09a_m1_proposal_a: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It's often acts committed in desperation that lead to even more desperate consequences, but we console ourselves thus.
09a_m1_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />And now we must arrest the Angry Earth's vengeance, else First Light is only the beginning.
09a_m1_proposal_next2_a: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Bah! Parting the brambles is easy! <g id="male_explain" />But the air beyond is befouled with noxious spores, and we must prepare.
09a_m1_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_explain" />The Angry Earth nearby carry the key element of the inoculate - <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />gather their seeds while I prepare the brew.
09a_m1_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Aye, a horrific transformation unfolds beyond the Bramble Wall.<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" /> I accompanied the druids to witness it myself.
09a_m1_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_theseidiots" />But they are too busy looking at trees to see this goes beyond any forest. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />We need you there, Soulwarden.
09a_m1_proposal_next_prompt2: "How do I get past the brambles?"
09a_m1_rw_task_gotopoi: Search {POITags} for seeds for Morgaine’s inoculate
09a_m1_seeda_description: The residue coating from this seed is cooling to the touch and numbs your skin.
09a_m1_seedb_description: The sudden warmth of the seed fills you with a moment of rage.
09a_m1_seedc_description: A magically infused seed that oscillates as if it's ready to burst.
09a_m1_seedcontainer_description: Break it open to extract the seeds.
09a_m1_sm_task_gotopoi: Search {POITags} for seeds for Morgaine’s inoculate
09a_m1_task_gotocamp: Travel to the Last Light Encampment
09a_m1_topic_eldred_talkto_next2_respons: <g id="female_explainS" />More like... "feel." Touch the roots on the embankment,<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> and you'll understand what I mean.
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />I have shared this insight with Morgaine as well. You <g id="male_gestureAhead" />should discuss the implications with her after you experience it for yourself.
09a_m1_topic_eldred_talkto_next_response: <g id="female_explainS" />We've known for centuries the Angry Earth share <g id="male_hivemind" />a sort of hivemind, communicating with one another through roots and spores.
<g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />It seems the strength of Artemis's emotions makes her messages comprehensible.
09a_m1_topic_hargest_prompt: "Can you give me a status report?"
09a_m1_topic_hargest_response_a: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />There's little to say. <g id="female_explainS" />We know Artemis is here, the plants mutate rapidly and the beasts grow more savage.
09a_m1_topic_hargest_response_b: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />Alchemist Eadred claims some discovery, but I'll be damned if I understand it. <g id="female_explainS" />You should speak with him.
09a_m1_topic_morgaine2_prompt: "We still need to work with them."
09a_m1_topic_morgaine2_response_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Aye, we must humor them for the time being, at least. <g id="female_explainS" />Share the inoculate with Archdruid Trahern first, we need him healthy.
09a_m1_topic_morgaine2_response_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Then speak with Alchemist Eadred. <g id="male_headNodYes" />He has more sense than the others.
09a_m1_topic_morgaine_prompt: "After this, I can pass through the wall?"
09a_m1_topic_morgaine_response_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Aye, and breathe freely within! <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />I shall go ahead and mark the way, and you can meet me at the encampment just within the territory.
09a_m1_topic_morgaine_response_b: <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />We'll have to endure the insufferable druids together, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />they're all we have for support.
09a_m1_topic_trahern_prompt: "She wanted you to have it first."
09a_m1_topic_trahern_response_a: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />That is a... surprise, but I must refuse. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />There are others whose need is far greater. Seems everyone has a different tolerance to these spores.
09a_m1_topic_trahern_response_b: <g id="male_convince01" />Please, if you will, share the inoculate with those who've fallen ill.
09a_m1_triggerarea_enter_firstlighta: Travel to the Southern Border of Monarch's Bluff and enter Elysian Wilds
09a_m1_triggerarea_enter_firstlightb: Travel to the Southern Border of Windsward
09a_m1_useshrine: (Optional) Teleport to Wild’s Gateway Spirit Shrine
09a_m1_vector_morgaine_start_greet: <g id="female_sighBigRelief" priority="high"/>I was looking forward to spending weeks poring over these dusty tomes. Seems that will have to wait for some time <g id="male_throwarms" />now. Feh!
09a_m1_vector_morgaine_start_greet_b: <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />After hearing from Imhotep what transpired here, I now realize what's happening in First Light<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />… the vengeance of Artemis, it seems.
09a_m1_vector_proposal: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />To think that one of the Ancients walked among us all this time! Huh! And you managed to prevent her awakening Sutekh! <g id="male_ragepunchfistsdown" />Such chaos!
09a_m1_vector_proposal01: I was a fool to ignore signs<g id="male_quidproquo" /> Adiana wasn't merely an aloof Huntress making veiled threats.
09a_m1_vector_proposal02: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />Defying an Ancient's will to tap the Motherwell against Corruption has kindled her wrath, <g id="female_fingerwagNo" />and First Light pays the price.
09a_m1_vector_proposal03: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It's often acts committed in desperation that lead to even more desperate consequences, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />but we console ourselves thus.
09a_m1_vector_proposal04: <g id="male_explain" />And now we must arrest the Angry Earth's vengeance,<g id="female_fingerwagNo" /> else First Light is only the beginning.
09a_m1_vector_proposal05: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Aye, a horrific transformation unfolds beyond the Bramble Wall.<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" /> I accompanied the druids to witness it myself.
09a_m1_vector_proposal06: <g id="female_theseidiots" />But they are too busy looking at trees to see this goes beyond any forest. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />We need you there, Soulwarden.
09a_m1_vector_proposal06_prompt: "How do I get past the brambles?"
09a_m1_vector_proposal07: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Bah! Parting the brambles is easy! <g id="male_explain" />But the air beyond is befouled with noxious spores, and we must prepare.
09a_m1_vector_proposal08: <g id="male_explain" />The Angry Earth nearby carry the key element of the inoculate - <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />gather their seeds while I prepare the brew.
09a_m2_bootst5_description: Reinforced boots perfect for working your way through dense foliage and animal dung.
09a_m2_cine_oakesmemory: Join Morgaine to peer into Oakes's mind
09a_m2_completed_a: <g id="female_lookConcern" />That was… frightening. Images of terror and evil creatures of legend... <g id="female_thinking" />were they hallucinations? Let us hope.
09a_m2_completed_b: <g id="male_explain" />Either way, Artemis's intentions clearly go beyond the extermination of humanity. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />She forges a new natural order.
09a_m2_container_03: Find the person the Scouts spotted
09a_m2_container_04: Burst Vile Pods to save the rangers
09a_m2_description: Morgaine requests that you travel west in search of survivors and Hargest's rangers. Help whoever you can, bring back any survivors, and if possible find a means to investigate the horrors beyond the inner bramble walls.
09a_m2_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We must discern the Huntress's full intentions, <g id="female_lookConcern" />however depressing that may be.
09a_m2_investigatebarrier: Assess Enemies in the Garden below
09a_m2_morgaine_talkto_a: <g id="female_throwarmsFrustrated" priority="high" />Bah! The survivor's mind is gone beyond recall, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />and there's nothing be done for it.
09a_m2_morgaine_talkto_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />She saw something, but she can't tell us anything useful. <g id="female_crossarms" />I shall have to delve into her memories and attempt to make sense of them.
09a_m2_morgaine_talkto_topic_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />It's an enchantment I learned from my brother long ago. It will be fragmented in there, but I am practiced in such things.
09a_m2_morgaine_talkto_topic_b: <g id="male_gestureAhead" />Stand the other side of her and we'll explore her memories together.
09a_m2_page_1: For as far back as I can remember, the tower on the mountain has been dark, but last night, we saw its light burst forth into the sky. I went along with Riches to investigate, and what I saw... I cannot describe. The Huntress was there, and another woman, but then she wasn't. After that, we ran back home.
09a_m2_page_2: They're closing in. The last few of us are holed up in the tavern... though Gunter is gone. I hope he made it out. The vines crept into our homes at night, and then... the screams. I saw Gladis... crying for help as she was dragged into some kind of pod. There was nothing I could do.
09a_m2_page_3: The settlement has fallen! I ran. <g id="male_lookawayGuilty" />I had no choice. We thought we were safe... but then she was there, and everything went mad! I can only hope Kim and Riches were able to get away. Perhaps, if I search... yes.
09a_m2_page_4: It was a mistake to go back, to see… what I struggle to even explain. Watcher Linch… it was horrible. There's no hope for her… nor for me, I suppose. I should go, but I don't know where. The lake, perhaps. It's nice this time of year.
09a_m2_page_5: [Drawings depict a horrific female visage wreathed in snakes, a giant bull man blowing a horn, and a bird walking on human legs covered in blood.]
09a_m2_proposal_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, particularly with this revelation that Artemis may have some twisted intent for them.
09a_m2_proposal_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />The rangers have searched fruitlessly so far, but that is no surprise. If you wish to help them,<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> speak to Captain Hargest.
09a_m2_rangerlocation: Travel to the location mentioned by Hye-Jin Yoon
09a_m2_returntocamp: Return to the Last Light Encampment
09a_m2_task_oakes_talkto2: Return the pages to Sylvia Oakes
09a_m2_topic_hargest_prompt: "Can you give me a status report?"
09a_m2_topic_hargest_response_a: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />There's little to say. We know Artemis is here, <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />the plants mutate rapidly and the beasts grow more savage.
09a_m2_topic_hargest_response_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Our scouts face peril whenever they leave camp. Just now,<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> the last patrol has even failed to report back in.
09a_m2_topic_hargest_response_next_a: <g id="male_fistpumpLargeRight" />There's some pluck! I'll take it. <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />We've lost scouts, but an entire patrol… this is worrisome.
09a_m2_topic_hargest_response_next_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />They ranged out by the lake at Forellac, so check there first, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />and be vigilant - the land itself strains to destroy us.
09a_m2_topic_oakes2_response_a: <g id="female_lookaroundConfusedSharp" />Where? Where is it safe? The Town Hall… <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />NO, not there! I can't go back, <g id="female_wavehandPshaw" />anywhere but there!
09a_m2_topic_oakes2_response_b: <g id="male_pleadHandsopen" />If I agree to go with you, at least give me a moment to get my notes in order. <g id="female_headnodding" />Yes, just a moment... and I will be ready. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I promise.
09a_m2_topic_oakes_response2_a: <g id="male_dazed" priority="high" />Yes, would you do that… for me? I-I know I must look a mess, <g id="male_lookaroundWorried" priority="high" />but there's a reason.<g id="female_saluteFistchest" /> I have a plan, <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />I just don't remember it.<g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" /> I need those notes!
09a_m2_topic_oakes_response2_b: <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />Watch out for those... whatever's out there. <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />They're not human! Be careful!
09a_m2_topic_oakes_response_a: <g id="male_lookdownOhmy" />Safety? Safety? <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />It's a little late for that! Besides, I have to stay in the Town Hall. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I'm the constable…
09a_m2_topic_oakes_response_b: <g id="male_why" />But something happened, didn't it? Yes,<g id="male_agree1" /> it's in my notes. Others must know! <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />I can't leave without my notes.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_a_response: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, the trees and plants assailed us as we ran, <g id="female_explainS" />and we got separated. I must search for them. But Hargest said survivors were top priority.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_a_response_next_a: <g id="male_nod1" />That makes sense. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />I think she's hiding out in one of the hovels at the lake.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_a_response_next_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Her eyes were wild, like she may be infected with some strange Angry Earth madness. <g id="female_lookConcern" />I suggest approaching with caution.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_b_response_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />We don't know. Every scout who's ranged down there hasn't returned. <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />It may be a lost cause, or at least, <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I don't have the heart for it.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_b_response_b: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />I'm bruised and scratched, and my head is spinning. <g id="female_lookaroundConfusedSharp" />I-I don't know what to do.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_b_response_next_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Oh, thank you. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />There's a rock formation down there, if you climb up you might catch sight of them.
09a_m2_topic_yoon_b_response_next_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />But I should warn you, there was howling that way unlike any wolf I've heard.<g id="male_dontknow" /> So… be careful,<g id="male_salute2FingersFast" /> and I'll see you back at camp.
09a_m2_triggerarea_oakes: Search the hovels in Forellac for the person spotted by the scouts
09a_m2_triggerarea_southforellac: Save the wildlife south of Forellac
09a_m2_yoon_for_default: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Whatever's out there, it's not natural. <g id="male_dontknow" />I can tell you that much.
09a_m3_chestbox_description: Dismantle for 1 piece of Chest Gear at 630 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_m3_completed_a: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Luck was with us! I found a few rangers dazed by the spores, and I saw you helping one yourself… <g id="female_lookConcern" />I just hope they get back to camp.
09a_m3_completed_b: <g id="female_leanforwardListenNod" />Poking around this site, seems we might have an ally lurking around these parts.
09a_m3_description: Morgaine once again needs our assistance breaking through into the lowland jungles for Captain Hargest, so that we can investigate the destroyed settlement of First Light. Help Hargest and her rangers make it down safely.
09a_m3_foulplant: Plant the Reekpods to Repel the Gorillas
09a_m3_headt5_description: A nice shiny skull that looks pretty on your head.
09a_m3_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />If the survivor's memories are to be believed, atrocities beyond imagination are under way in the old settlement. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />We must get there, and with haste!
09a_m3_proposal_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, you do that. I must consult Myrddin's tomes. Minotaurs, gorgons, massive beasts... this is unprecedented.
09a_m3_proposal_b: <g id="male_gestureAhead" />Help these bumbling fools get a foothold to the south, and learn what you can. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />And be quick, for hope's sake.
09a_m3_reekpod_description: Contains large pungent smelling seeds created by Glendyn Trahern to deter hostile wildlife. Try not to inhale when opening.
09a_m3_signalwagon: Create a Large Signal Fire for the Rangers
09a_m3_survivalistriches_volorenote: These sprig-heads in Dayspring have no idea what fury Albert Riches is about to unleash on them. Huntress thinks she's getting over on us, teaming up with snake-women and bull-men, but when you're all human, you learn to live by your wits, and I'll bet my survivalist soul on being harder, scrappier, and a good bit smarter than a bunch of juiced up weeds! If they're borrowing from mythology, I think I'll remind them what mankind's famous for... we make FIRE.
09a_m3_topic_hargest2_response_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Alright. The rangers may be incapacitated by these damn spores. Let's hope that's the case, anyways.
09a_m3_topic_hargest2_response_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Either way, see any plants exuding spores, <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />hold your breath, and crush them with your boot, then meet at the bottom of the hill.
09a_m3_topic_hargest_response_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Heh. Be my guest, plant them as you go, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />but we need to push on, especially against these monster gorillas.
09a_m3_topic_hargest_response_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />Five times, I've sent rangers south to secure a position. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />At this point, I'm going myself.
09a_m3_topic_hargest_response_next_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Well, alright then! <g id="male_explain" />We'll split up and battle our way through the gorillas, and you can plant Trahern's pods.
09a_m3_topic_hargest_response_next_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />There's a broken down wagon on a ridge not too far -<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> we meet there and light a signal fire.
09a_m3_topic_trahern_response_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, and I pray it's reversible, <g id="male_explain" />or Hargest will destroy every beast she can. I've germinated seeds for a vine that will at least repel the creatures.
09a_m3_topic_trahern_response_b: <g id="female_giveitemFromside" />Here - take these pods and if you head south, plant them. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />That's all I ask.
09a_m3_triggerarea_hargest: Rejoin Captain Hargest to establish a secure location
09a_m3_triggerarea_wagon: Search for the wagon Hargest described
09a_m4_2hmusket_t5_description: Scrape and Claw. Tear and Chew. These are your defenses, use them as you can.
09a_m4_completed_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Welcome to the settlement of Elysian Wilds, <g id="female_shrugShort" />or what's left of it. <g id="female_bowDeep" />Constable Magistrate Riches, at your service... <g id="female_shrugShort" />whatever title you prefer.
09a_m4_completed_b: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />Now you've seen for yourself what it's like out there. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />It's not pretty.
09a_m4_container_main: Search Dayspring Mills for Survivalist Riches
09a_m4_description: Hargest thinks we should investigate Dayspring Mills on our way to the settlement, and evidence suggests that Albert Riches may be fighting back. Travel into the overgrown village and search for whatever clues you can find.
09a_m4_goto_richesredoubt: Travel to the Old First Light Settlement
09a_m4_incomplete: <g id="female_cheerFisthigh" />We've got a foothold, and that's progress! <g id="female_crossarms" />Wouldn't be surprised to get a cheer when I tell everyone back at camp.
09a_m4_proposal_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Sure enough, and he may have a grip on the situation at the settlement.
09a_m4_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I've been chewing on a plan since we set out on this mission, <g id="male_explain" />a way we might be able to retake the settlement and free any captives.
09a_m4_proposal_next_2_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Had a feeling you'd say that… least I got to see a little action, eh? <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Alright, I'll head back and get everyone ready.
09a_m4_proposal_next_2_b: <g id="male_gestureAhead" />You find this survivalist fellow, infiltrate the settlement, and get that shrine repaired. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Stay strong, friend.
09a_m4_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Spirit shrine at the settlement's clearly broken, <g id="male_explain" />but if we can repair it, we can summon rangers right into town.
09a_m4_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />Now, that's a big IF, and one of us would need to go back to prepare, but I think it's worth a shot.
09a_m4_riches_talkto_a: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Woo! About time the cavalry arrived! <g id="male_spreadhands" />Feared I was the last skin and bones left in the territory.
09a_m4_riches_talkto_b: <g id="male_explain" />And with the sprig-heads closing in, I decked this place out with enough boom powder to send <g id="female_gestureUpward"  priority="high" />us all sky high! <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I was ready, I tell you!
09a_m4_riches_topic_2_a: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Aye, maybe those who fled early-on, but the Huntress is raining terror down from above, <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />and everyone got pulled into a pod, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />except for yours truly.
09a_m4_riches_topic_2_b: <g id="male_outfitproud" />I turned the tavern into a bunker <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />and held out until they forgot about me.
09a_m4_riches_topic_3_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />Hah! <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />You're serious? Not much to retake, but if you got the guts to try, <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />I say why-the-hell-not!
09a_m4_riches_topic_3_b: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Come to my little hidey-hole in the tavern. <g id="male_explain" />You'll have to chop some weeds on the way, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />but you're clearly the capable sort.
09a_m4_riches_topic_a: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I got a few resurrections left in me. <g id="male_explain" />Besides, it's better than getting thrown into one of those pods!<g id="male_headShakeNo" />
09a_m4_riches_topic_b: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />Folks go in, but don’t come out… drains the Azoth right out of them!<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> It's nasty business at the settlement these days.
09a_m4_riches_topic_prompt: "You were going to blow yourself up?"
09a_m5_completed_a: <g id="male_laughCocky" />Well, that was a fight for the ages! I'd say after today, <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />we won't give the leaf lady another inch of this land!
09a_m5_completed_b: <g id="male_outfitproud" />Huntress thinks nature's on her side, but she forgot about human nature! <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />The good, the bad, <g id="female_smackfist" />and the vengeful!
09a_m5_craftglue: Craft Pitch at an Arcane Repository or Camp
09a_m5_defenseencounter_description0: Blow the Horn located on the Tavern roof!
09a_m5_defenseencounter_description2: Dryad Prowlers on our flanks! Crush them!
09a_m5_defenseencounter_participate: Prepare for the Angry Earth attack
09a_m5_defenseencounter_title0_descripti: Protect Last Light from the oncoming Angry Earth!
09a_m5_description: Albert Riches needs reinforcements! Travel northwest to Tanglesnap Hollows where Taurus disposed a chunk of the spirit shrine, destabilizing its effectiveness. It may be a longshot, but forage for ingredients to repair the shrine and correct its power to allow our allies safe passage.
09a_m5_glovest5_description: Perfect for pruning flowers and ripping out all of the weeds around the Elysian Wilds.
09a_m5_glue_description: "Aye laddie, it's gotta be Angry Earth. I've tried this with normal plants and they're just not mad enough to be glue."
09a_m5_incomplete: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I have to admit, things were starting to get a little dark both outside... and inside my head at one point. <g id="male_handheart" />It's been better since you arrived. Much better.
09a_m5_mulchinnards: Collect Mulchy Innards from Hollow Corvids
09a_m5_mulchinnards_description: Angry Earth excrements that is filled with rot and decay.
09a_m5_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Ah, now there's smart thinking! <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I like it! <g id="male_explain" />The Huntress's pet minotaur smashed the shrine good though,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> sent stone work flying way out!
09a_m5_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />But if you can recover the stone, <g id="male_explain" />and mix together a little pitch, you might repair it.
09a_m5_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />Ah, now we get creative - <g id="male_explain" />get our ingredients from the sprig-heads and their pets. Resin, filler, fat, that'll do it.
09a_m5_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_explain" />Mix that, find the shrine-stone northwest of town, and usher your friends in. <g id="female_crossarms" />I'll make preparations here.
09a_m5_ratfat: Collect Fatty Glands from the Hollow Rats
09a_m5_ratfat_description: It looks like normal glands, but with a far more pungent odor.
09a_m5_repairshrine: Place fragment on the Spirit Shrine
09a_m5_riches_combat: <g id="female_order" />We'll cover you from in here! Go!
09a_m5_riches_talkto_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />You're not a moment too early, friend! Did you hear the roars and howls? <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />The beasts will attack any moment!
09a_m5_riches_talkto_b: <g id="female_chuckle" />And bless my hide if I don't smell a entire hunting pack headed this way! <g id="female_smackfist" />Tell me your friends are coming from the shrine!
09a_m5_riches_talkto_topic_a: <g id="male_outfitproud" />Then let us stand together against whatever she sends our way, <g id="female_smackfist" />and prove that humanity will not be turned into plant food!
09a_m5_riches_talkto_topic_b: <g id="male_enraged" />Let's decorate this tavern with the innards of the monstrosities who trespass in our town!
09a_m5_sap_description: A cloudy sap with a highly viscous texture that makes it perfect for adhesion.
09a_m5_shrinefragment_description: A broken piece of the spirit shrine with signs of faint magical energy flowing across it.
09a_m5_task_gotopoi: Travel to Tanglesnap Hollows to search for pitch ingredients
09a_m5_trahern_fl_combat: <g id="female_smackfist" />We shall release these poor creatures <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />from their malice. If but for a moment.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_default_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You are a force of nature. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />You should push on ahead.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_default_b: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I will get things settled here and then begin my investigations into the beast encampment to the east.<g id="female_worry" /> I sense terrible power there.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_talkto_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Our champion delivers - as sure as day follows night! <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Some had doubts, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />but I knew you would pull through.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_talkto_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Morgaine won't join us <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />- she's lost in some old tome, <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />muttering about the gorgon who serves at Artemis's side.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_topic_2_a: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Then go and begin the battle whenever you're ready. <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />We'll match the fury of nature with a fury of our own,<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> and restore balance here.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_topic_2_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Then we must start looking to Light's Crown.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_topic_a: <g id="male_explain" />Gorgons of old could turn someone to stone with a look, and the sorceress seeks protection.
09a_m5_trahern_fl_topic_b: <g id="female_explainS" />But the gorgon commands from the rear, and on your order, we have rangers ready to <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />come through and fight for this ground. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Say the word.
09a_m5_windowboard_1: Nail planks to reinforce first window
09a_m5_windowboard_2: Nail planks to reinforce second window
09a_m6_1hgauntletvoid_t5_description: "There must be a way to combine the properties of this infernal growth with the abyssal energies in this ring."
09a_m6_breakbars_task: Destroy the bars on Jihoon Kim's Cell
09a_m6_completed_a: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />Even when I heard the sounds of battle, I hardly believed it possible. <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />I have been down here more days than I can count.
09a_m6_completed_b: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />The things I witnessed… <g id="male_guiltyLookside" >the things I helped <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />create… tell me, are we too late? Have they taken over?
09a_m6_completed_next_a: <g id="male_enraged" />The Hercyne… horrific hybrid abominations made of man, plant, and beast. <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />They made me do it.
09a_m6_completed_next_b: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />The gorgon, Medusa, she forced me, but if I had known what that machine did, I <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />would've refused, whatever suffering they imposed on me.
09a_m6_description: Survivalist Riches implores us for aid, saving his kidnapped friend Jihoon Kim. Kim was captured by Medusa in the initial invasion, but Riches recently spotted him being dragged east to Saircor, go rescue the Artificer if you can.
09a_m6_findnotes1: Examine a note dropped along the road
09a_m6_findnotes2: Find another note dropped by Jihoon Kim
09a_m6_findnotes3: Read another note dropped by Jihoon Kim
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_next_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I guess not, or so everyone's saying. <g id="male_explain" />Archdruid Trahern made our Adjudicator swear to the truce before letting us through the spirit shrine.
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_next_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Seems all three factions made a beeline for this island, however.
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_topic_2_a: <g id="male_listenforward" />There were? That must've been before I was here, <g id="female_lookConcern" />and they may well have been consumed by these beasts.
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_topic_2_b: <g id="female_order" />You should look for Adjudicator Ramla up ahead though, she might know something more. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Watch your back, friend.
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_topic_2_prompt: "I heard prisoners were taken this way?"
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_topic_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Oh, I don't know... <g id="male_explain" />rumors of Ancient ruins no one's seen, bursting out of the ground? <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Our intentions are good, but the other factions? <g id="male_forgetit" />Forget it.
09a_m6_fionn_talkto_topic_b: Beasts gave us all pause, though, <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />so now I'm guarding the road.
09a_m6_incomplete: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I'm not the most trusting man. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Artificer Kim is the best friend I have. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You have to get him out of there.
09a_m6_josephine_rescue_response: <g id="male_dontknow" />No, but I'm not the only prisoner here. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Good luck finding him, and thanks for the help!
09a_m6_proposal_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Not sure, but it didn't sound good. Jihoon Kim - <g id="male_explain" />the town artificer a mechanical genius - Artemis said she had a special project for Kim, and that's all I know.
09a_m6_proposal_b: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />That sweaty Minotaur knocked him flat and carried him away.
09a_m6_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Hoping you'd volunteer, <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />of anyone here, you're the only one who could go toe-to-toe with the Bull-man.
09a_m6_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_explain" />They took Kim east to the Ancient ruins of Saircor - something strange going on there.<g id="female_lookConcern" /> I'd proceed with caution.
09a_m6_ramla_talkto_topic0_a: I had thought those supplies lost when our people went missing along the way. It will be good to have them, especially this close to Saircor.
09a_m6_ramla_talkto_topic0_b: Whatever is going on over there is unpleasant, to say the least.
09a_m6_ramla_talkto_topic_a: Minotaur, no, thankfully. Prisoners... maybe. There's someone in the ruins in an awful lot of pain.
09a_m6_ramla_talkto_topic_b: He's in deep though. If you're staging a rescue, you're going alone. We have our hands full up here.
09a_m6_ramlassupplies_description: Full of useful tools and supplies, these were dropped while Ramla traveled quickly to secure a safe location.
09a_m6_rescuepeople: Search the ruins for Angry Earth captives
09a_m6_vachon_rescue_response: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />No, we followed him here but were captured before we found where they're holding him. <g id="male_lookaroundWorried" />I'd help you look, but I need to tell Trahern what we saw.
09a_m6_zayden_rescue_response: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Yes, they're holding him in the central area. <g id="female_explainS" />He's heavily guarded because he tried to escape.
09a_m7_beastlordemblem_description: A sign of their pack and power. Not something they would give away willinging - unless it was stolen.
09a_m7_completed_a: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Well done. You are indeed a formidable warrior, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />and I am deeply in your debt for my liberation.
09a_m7_completed_b: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />It seems Aeternum is not yet overrun with Hercyne,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> and there is yet hope.
09a_m7_container_02: Create a Distraction to Cover Kim's Escape
09a_m7_description: Jihoon Kim believes Medusa and Artemis stole an item of importance and stashed it at Portico Tideswallow. If the item is recovered, it may convince the Minotaur there is something sinister going on with Artemis and the Beast Lords.
09a_m7_gototideswallow: Find a way into Tideswallow to recover what Medusa stole
09a_m7_incomplete: <g id="male_hopeless" />I had given up hope of ever seeing a human face again. <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />I will never forget what I have endured.
09a_m7_josephine_thanks_response: <g id="female_waverightNoway" />Not yet! I'm hoping to learn from the best and one day take that title! <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Good luck, and I hope what I found will help end the hostilities here.
09a_m7_josephine_wires_prompt: "You're who I need to talk to."
09a_m7_josephine_wires_response: <g id="male_bowDeepHandsfolded" />I'll gladly answer any questions you have about Ancient wiring, or anything really. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I owe you after Tempestas Custodia.
09a_m7_josephine_wires_response2_a: <g id="female_explainS" />Any locks in this place are based on weird energy. <g id="female_order" />You'll need to fix and power up the pylons in order to get access to it.
