09a_m7_josephine_wires_response2_b: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I'll go and rewire sections of the ruins while you reconstruct the pylons.
09a_m7_kill_ancientslarge: Summon and defeat the Prime Automaton
09a_m7_kill_ancientsmedium: Summon and defeat Ancient Automatons in Tideswallow
09a_m7_kill_ancientssmall: Destroy Ancient devices to draw out Guardians
09a_m7_proposal_a: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, please don't ask for any more details. I worked on the machine for weeks, <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />and then I saw… only the beginning.
09a_m7_proposal_b: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />Medusa brought me back down to these ruins,<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> leaving the Minotaur as my jailer.
09a_m7_proposal_next_2_a: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Be wary if you do for his temper is short, and his loyalty is to the Beast Lords. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I can help you with him.
09a_m7_proposal_next_2_b: <g id="male_explain" /> I overheard Medusa mention an item that was taken from the Beast Lords and kept nearby. <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />If you bring it to the Minotaur, <g id="female_shrugShort" />perhaps he’ll listen.
09a_m7_proposal_next_3_a: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Somewhere secure. <g id="female_explainS" />There was another captive, a Syndicate scholar named Josephine. She might’ve escaped.
09a_m7_proposal_next_3_b: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" /> Find Josephine. If anyone understand the Ancient wards in these ruins, it would be her.
09a_m7_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_shrugShort" />He left.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> He is not like Artemis and Medusa. He does not relish this, and he spoke to me, with compassion.
09a_m7_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_explain" />Upon my return, I told him what I saw, and he seemed stricken. <g id="female_lookConcern" />He said he needed time to think, and he left.
09a_m7_weaponbox_description: Dismantle for 1 weapon of any type at 635 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_m8_completed_a: So you see, I swear no allegiance to the Huntress, and I do not war with humanity, unless provoked.
09a_m8_completed_b: I have also recently learned of… strange rituals the gorgon Medusa stages in her guarded glade. Very strange.
09a_m8_completed_next_a: Mmm. This I still find hard to believe. Why would the Huntress engage in such atrocities? She is enraged, but... I do not know.
09a_m8_completed_next_b: I admit my instincts tell me something is amiss. The Beast Lords are not themselves.
09a_m8_description: Kim asks that we boldly brave the Labyrinth of the minotaur Taurus, Northeast of the Ancient ruins, so that we may speak to him. Survive the deadly challenges within, and parley with the beastman if you can.
09a_m8_incomplete: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />I… am so sorry… for my hand in aiding them with that Ancient device. <g id="male_outfitashamed" />I didn't know the purpose they intended until it was too late. It must be destroyed.
09a_m8_proposal_a: <g id="male_think" />These Beast Lords with whom Artemis has forged an alliance would seem to be the final part of her plan.
09a_m8_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />Whatever power they bring to her cause is primal, and in exchange she promises the beasts a share in her new order.
09a_m8_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />Hm. Perhaps not, and perhaps this is what caused concern for the Minotaur. <g id="female_nodConsider" />Yes, you should seek him out.
09a_m8_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_patience" />I believe he has taken the fortress to the northeast as his home. <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Approach him there, but be cautious!
09a_m8_proposal_prenext_a: <g id="female_explainS" />The Beast Lords are even older than the Ancients, perhaps as old as the Earth itself, <g id="female_nodConsider" />and they have elemental powers.
09a_m8_proposal_prenext_b: <g id="male_explain" />They are the original progenitors of the beasts we see today, and they have come to negotiate on the beasts' behalf.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_a: Hail, warrior! You are brave like the heroes of old. And smart enough to navigate my labyrinth, so I salute you.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_b: If you come seeking battle, then let us battle, and allow fate to decide who is more deserving of victory.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_next_a: Mmm. Very well, but know this: I have no patience for dishonesty, and I am no fool. Speak plainly and truthfully, or battle we will.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_next_b: I am Taurus, the Wild, the Bull, the Minotaur of Crete, and I have no love for mankind.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_next_prompt: "I come to talk, not to fight."
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_topic_a: I've known the Huntress for centuries beyond count and have fought by her side. But I do not fight in this war.
09a_m8_taurus_talkto_topic_b: I serve as emissary to the Beast Lords, to whom I've sworn eternal allegiance. Strike my drum, and I will tell you more.
09a_m9_completed_a: You stood your ground with honor and fought with skill. Shirzad shall grant you an audience.
09a_m9_completed_b: It will be difficult to compete with the Huntress's bargain, but we will hear your offer.
09a_m9_description: To forge an alliance with the Beast Lords we will first need to prove ourselves to them. Taurus suggests that we begin with the Lion Lord Shirzad to the north in Shirzad's Pride. Complete his challenge and gain an audience.
09a_m9_incomplete: Shirzad will grant you audience, but be wary on approach. His Pride will not tolerate trespassers.
09a_m9_meleeweaponbox_description: Dismantle for 1 melee weapon at 635 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_m9_proposal_a: The Beast Lords are primal powers, far beyond anything you or I can imagine. If they war, they will win.
09a_m9_proposal_b: Of equal concern, the Tear of Gaea, a relic of this island's creation safekept for millennia, but now part of the Huntress's bargain.
09a_m9_proposal_next_a: Then you must approach the Beast Lords and strike your own bargain, human. I cannot do so on your behalf, and I need to investigate these claims.
09a_m9_proposal_next_b: Approach the Lion Lord, Shirzad, in his Pride to the north. Tell him you have my blessing.
09a_m9_proposal_next_prompt: “She can’t get the Tear of Gaea."
09a_m9_speart5_description: A fine weapon fit for felling Ancients.
09a_m9_task_talktoshirzad: Speak with Shirzad the Lion Lord
09a_manmosu_01_a: I fear our immediate threat is not inside the cavern, but above it.
09a_manmosu_01_b: This sinister magic has seeped through rock and soil to infect the beasts that claim the Highmound. We must clear the area before it’s impossible to contain.
09a_manmosu_default: This foulness twists and turns more than a dryad lost in a thicket.
09a_manmosu_sd_01: Mahantaram will return, which means we must remain true to our convictions. His link to the tribe must be severed completely.
09a_manmosu_sd_default_a: Whatever Mahantaram succumbed to has enraged him beyond the point of return. He has become a major threat to my kind... and yours.
09a_manmosu_sd_default_b: We must sever his connection to the herd, even if that means destroying him.
09a_marwa_01: Taurus once lived among the beasts before becoming an outcast. He yearns for the respect of all his kind, both beast and human.
09a_marwa_default: Do not believe what you hear about the minotaur. He is a noble soul who has endured great trials.
09a_morgaine_01_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />I was a fool to ignore signs Adiana wasn't merely an aloof Huntress making veiled threats.
09a_morgaine_01_b: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" />Defying an Ancient's will to tap the Motherwell against Corruption has kindled her wrath, <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />and First Light pays the price.
09a_morgaine_02_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Aha! I forgot how refreshing it is to work with one so efficient. <g id="male_dismissGetLost1" priority="high" />A day's work with those incompetent druids takes a full week.
09a_morgaine_02_b: <g id="male_gestureBackThere" priority="high" />The seeds you gathered are for them; I already had enough for your inoculate. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Here… quaff it quickly.
09a_morgaine_default: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />The furious vengeance of the Angry Earth has ravaged First Light. <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />We should have seen this coming. I should have seen this coming.
09a_morgaine_se_talkto_a: <g id="female_bowHead" />Ah, there you are, Soulwarden. As you can see, I warded this area, quite effectively, I might add.
09a_morgaine_se_talkto_b: <g id="female_explainS" />We will use this rune circle to siphon the energies here and bolster the strength of your Azoth Staff.
09a_morgaine_se_talkto_topic_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Place it in the light when you’re ready.
09a_morgaine_se_taskincomplete: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Please, let us focus on the task at hand.
09a_morgaine_wc_01_a: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Heh. You've been inoculated against the noxious spores, but I have <g id="male_waghand03" />nothing to ward off the ignorance of fools.
09a_morgaine_wc_01_b: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />Be wary; some in this camp cannot grasp how little they know, nor will they welcome your counsel.
09a_morgaine_wc_01_inprogress: <g id="male_gestureAhead" />Speak with the others in the camp, as well.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> You'll see why we've made little progress.
09a_morgaine_wc_02_a: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />With these savage beasts and even the plants aligned against us, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />there is no safe place for any in this region.
09a_morgaine_wc_02_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I had hoped the settlement to the south would still be standing,<g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" /> but I fear otherwise.
09a_morgaine_wc_03_a: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />And what's this I hear about scouts being trapped inside of pods? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Could this be why Artemis seeks captives?
09a_morgaine_wc_03_b: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Whatever purpose she plans, it must not be realized. We need<g id="female_smackfist" /> to get to the old settlement as soon as possible.
09a_morgaine_wc_default: <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />This encampment sits at the edge of an unfolding apocalypse, <g id="male_dismissRegal" priority="high" />but I'm the only one who seems to realize that.
09a_morozov_default: Ah, finally someone who looks competent enough to use these masterfully crafted arms. I’ll be sure to save the good stuff for you.
09a_murrow_01: Aeternum is filled with many creatures that yearn to speak with us. If only we would listen...
09a_murrow_default_a: The rampant growth of this strange vegetation jeopardizes this fragile ecosystem.
09a_murrow_default_b: I've seen animals fall prey to prodigious plantlife. Some spew suspicious fumes while others constrict and consume!
09a_mysteriousaxe_default: A carefully-written note is pinned by a large axe.
09a_nakamura_default_a: I've heard there's game the size of three bisons not far from here.
09a_nakamura_default_b: Sure it'll take a wagon load of spices to season the meat properly, but you'll get to enjoy it for weeks.
09a_oakes_for_01_a: <g id="male_lookaroundWorried" priority="high" />Are you the messenger? You must be looking for one of the others... <g id="male_dazed" priority="high" />but they're not here. <g id="male_lookawayGuilty" priority="high" />No. No, they're... <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I can't recall.
09a_oakes_for_01_b: <g id="male_lookaroundWorried" priority="high" />It's just me now. I wrote it all down, but where? <g id="male_lookdownOhmy" priority="high" />Where are we even? <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />This is not the town hall!
09a_oakes_for_01_inprogress: <g id="male_pleadHandsclasped" />My notes… I must have them!
09a_oakes_for_02_a: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Are those… yes, those are my notes! <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Thank the heavens! This is all I had! <g id="female_nodRelieved" />It's my story, you see?
09a_oakes_for_02_b: <g id="male_noway" priority="high" />Wait, don't look, don't even read them, it's a curse! <g id="female_impatient" priority="high" />She could be coming for us even now!
09a_oakes_for_default: <g id="female_blameLong" />You-you can't be here! Oh, I pray you're not real… are you? <g id="female_yourecrazy" priority="high" />Run then! Nothing can save us. Nothing! She will use you to make more of those horrors. Go!
09a_oakes_wc_default_a: <g id="male_outfitashamed" />You… you're the one who got my notes… you didn't read them, did you? <g id="male_lookdownAshamed" />Trust me, you don't want to.
09a_oakes_wc_default_b: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />It's better I don't remember. I just want to… take a nap. Yes,<g id="male_agree1" /> a nap would be nice.
09a_owusu_default: I admit this is different from healing a rabbit's wound, <g id="male_explain" />but my experience tending to animals seems to be effective on the human body as well.
09a_ramla_01_a: The collaboration in Saircor is not unprecedented. No one has the manpower or the knowledge to tackle this mission alone.
09a_ramla_01_b: The factions moving as a unified entity is always a sight to behold.
09a_ramla_default_a: The Ancient Guardians are nothing new. I run into them a lot working in ruins like this.
09a_ramla_default_b: There are monsters I've never seen before west of the bridge we're on. Watch yourself out there.
09a_ramla_talkto_a: If Archdruid Trahern sent you, tell him I'm honoring my word, observing the truce... as long as everyone else does.
09a_ramla_talkto_b: We're making progress and setting up safe camps to the benefit of all.
09a_ranger_bark_1: Be wary warrior! Unseen beasts stalk these lands.
09a_ranger_bark_2: Thank you. Oh, my head… I must return to the camp.
09a_ranger_bark_3: Those creatures... They were going to eat me if not for you.
09a_ranger_ep_default: (This ranger has a steady aim and looks ready to pull the trigger at any moment.)
09a_rangerguard_default: Stay vigilant! The growth seeks to destroy us if we are not careful.
09a_rangerrescue_bark_1: I cannot believe you found me. Please, save my friends.
09a_rangerrescue_bark_2: Gah! This goop burns terribly. I fear I must leave with haste.
09a_rangerrescue_bark_3: Thank you! So embarassing… nearly taken out by a plant.
09a_rangerrescue_bark_4: I thought I could trust my eyes. Alas, this land is quite deadly.
09a_riches_default: <g id="male_explain" />Look, mate! I got boom stashed<g id="female_spreadarms" /> ALL OVER this little town. All over Dayspring Mills. <g id="male_nod1" />Aye, small stash in Forellac too.
09a_riches_m5_01_a: <g id="male_explain" />Now I got boom stashed all over this town, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />so we can definitely give the sprig-heads what for, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />but I'm not sure this'll ever be a town again.
09a_riches_m5_01_b: Not unless you got an army of reinforcements you failed to mention.
09a_riches_m5_02_a: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Now to the less pleasant part of this whole deal… <g id="male_hanghead" />my friends and neighbors from this fair town, taken captive.
09a_riches_m5_02_b: <g id="male_explain" />We can keep busting people out of pods,<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> but one friend was hauled off for other purposes, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />perhaps even darker.
09a_riches_note_default_a: If you are reading this, I am holding Elysian Wilds however I can against the invasion. I know you'll make it soon, I can feel it.
09a_riches_note_default_b: If you've found these plans it means I wasn't able to finish my work. Please, complete it.
09a_riches_waiting: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />If you're not a mirage, mate, and those sprig-heads are dead… <g id="male_gestureForwardLefthand" />ya mind snipping that wick? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Not my first grand escape, but my hand's still a wee bit shaky.
09a_rousseau_default: I have seen many types of magic during my time on Aeternum.<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> This one stretches beyond my knowledge.
09a_s0_completed_a: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Look at that, you’re glowing... <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />I jest, of course. Remember to keep your flask in tip top shape.
09a_s0_completed_b: <g id="male_explain" />More Sandstone should enhance it and improve the elixir's capabilities. <g id="female_headnodding" />You’ll need all the help you can get out here.
09a_s0_craftpotion: Craft Weak Boon of Demeter Potion at an Arcane Repository or Camp
09a_s0_description: Master Alchemist Eadred has made a revolutionary discovery critical to the invasion. Investigate the strange spores blooming in the region and learn how you can use them to your advantage.\n(Requires: Harvesting 100)
09a_s0_flask_description: A resilient glass bottle capable of containing potent solutions.
09a_s0_incomplete: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />It seems everything in this land wants to kill us. <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I suppose that shouldn't be so surprising.
09a_s0_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />I believe I have devised a method to render the toxic effects beneficial to us. <g id="male_gestureDownRight" priority="high" />It requires ingredients gathered from the plants themselves.
09a_s0_proposal_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I’ll prepare a special flask while you gather the spore caps. They can be found<g id="female_gestureLeft" /> in abundance west of the camp.
09a_s0_sporecaps: Gather Spores from plants in Mosswater Bend
09a_s0_sporeelixir_description: Consuming this potion attunes you to the Spores. Clears the Spore Drenched Affliction on contact and lasts for {[1200.000000 / 60]} minutes. After clearing affliction, take 12% less damage and gain increased resources when Harvesting Sporeplants for {[45.000000]} seconds.
09a_s0_sporepod_description: Spore samples attuned to the Angry Earth inhabitants in Elysian Wilds.
09a_s0_task_eldred_talkto: Speak to Master Alchemist Theodore Eadred
09a_s0_task_gotopoi: Travel to Mosswater Bend to collect spore samples\n(Requires: Harvesting 100)
09a_s0_topic_eldred_response_b: <g id="male_explain" />If your body accepts the elixir, not only will you be rendered temporarily immune to the bloom’s toxins, they should also strengthen your senses.
09a_s0_usepotion: Drink the Weak Boon of Demeter Potion
09a_s10_completed_a: Taurus… Minotaur… Enkidu... he has gone by many names. I healed him after he was attacked in Weaver’s Fen decades ago. Now we fight side by side.
09a_s10_completed_b: He seeks a life undisturbed, but I fear the serpent woman has other plans for him.
09a_s10_description: Pinned beneath a mysterious, rusted axe lies a note - addressed to you. It asks that you hold your judgment of the fabled Minotaur until you learn his story. Collect relics lost in the labyrinth, then speak with Marwa.
09a_s10_incomplete: The note instructs you to find three relics within the labyrinth and deliver them to Marwa.
09a_s10_minotaurrelica_description: This horn has been painstakingly carved by steady hand. Akkadian script is scrawled across its surface. A horned figure and warrior are depicted side by side.
09a_s10_minotaurrelicb_description: A very hefty set of irons. Some form of magic destroyed the integrity of these bindings.
09a_s10_minotaurrelicc_description: On closer inspection, only one of the rings is broken and the other has been reforged. The shattered ring contains an inscription that reads: "May our love be eternal."
09a_s10_proposal_a: “The Minotaur could be a force of wanton destruction, but he chooses not to be. He is hunted purely due to lies and falsehoods.
09a_s10_proposal_b: The labyrinth contains relics that hold the truth. Bring them to me and I shall reveal his legacy.” -Marwa
09a_s11_completed_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Masterfully done. You have no doubt gained favor with Taurus. <g id="female_giveitem" />Here is your reward.
09a_s11_completed_b: <g id="male_quidproquo" />Return again to test yourself further. Maintaining this routine will keep your edge sharpened for battle. <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />But for now, rest.
09a_s11_cooldown: Back so soon? <g id="female_headnodding" />I admire your dedication, <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />but it is important to let your body fully recover.
09a_s11_description: Marwa Shaheen has heard of your recent exploits, and knows more trials lie ahead. She wishes to offer a challenge to bolster your resolve. Visit Marwa and complete the time trial that she has prepared.
09a_s11_incomplete: <g id="female_order" />Your flame dwindles. Hasten to the braziers!
09a_s11_marwa_delivery_01_a: <g id="female_crossarms" />Taurus has informed me of Mahantaram's fate, and how Kurok has followed him down <g id="female_gestureDown" />into the caverns below the mountain.
09a_s11_marwa_delivery_01_b: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />You must steel yourself for the trials that lie ahead. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Might I offer a challenge to test your strength of character?
09a_s11_marwa_delivery_02: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Traveling through this land is grueling task, even for the strongest among us.<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> Do you wish to train again. Keep up your strength?
09a_s11_proposal_a: <g id="male_itemGiveRight" />Take this torch and light the braziers I have placed across this land.
09a_s11_proposal_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Start south past Saircor, then follow the course to the southern goal. <g id="male_explain" />The path will test your strength, agility, and cunning. Be prepared.
09a_s11_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />All the braziers must be lit before the flame dies.
09a_s11_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Prove that you have the skills to survive this unforgiving place and I will have something for you when you return.
09a_s11_ringt5_description: A token bestowed on the champion of Marwa's Time Trial.
09a_s12_completed: Once again you prove yourself a mighty warrior. Perhaps you have the soul of a lion? You have my boon, human. Be welcome in my domain.
09a_s12_cooldown: You are a mighty soul indeed. Rest, now upon the rocks. Soak in the sun and remember why you fight. You may brave the gauntlet again tomorrow.
09a_s12_description: Shirzad believes you must increase in strength if you are to quell the rage of the tainted Beast Lords and their tribes. Return to his den at Shirzad's Pride and once again brave the grotto below.
09a_s12_earringt5_description: For those who complete the King's Gauntlet.
09a_s12_incomplete: The idle are not fit to lead.
09a_s12_prompt: "No beast or man will stop me."
09a_s12_proposal_a: Then descend once more into the caverns of my kin, and defeat any who stand in your way. Do not relent and you shall be victorious.
09a_s12_proposal_b: Prove yourself worthy to defend those in your charge!
09a_s12_taskmammothshrine: Visit the Shrine of the Herd
09a_s13_completed: My thanks, human. I offer you our boon. We weep for the Lords that are lost, and hope they may return to us in time. We need their guidance now more than ever.
09a_s13_cooldown: You fought boldly. But other champions can hold the line for now. Go. Rest. Help yourself to something to eat.
09a_s13_description: Barug of the Gorillas now stands in Kurok's stead, but without their Lord the tribe is in grave danger. Rally your fellow warriors to help the Gorilla tribe fight off an incursion by a champion of the Lizard Lord.
09a_s13_incomplete: I struggle to maintain order in Nyhart's without Kurok. If Sirrussu spreads his malign influence here, others of their kind will surely invade.
09a_s13_proposal: With most of our allied Lords sequestered in the cavern, our tribe remains in great danger. Fight Gazsala in the bay. Fight with everything you have.
09a_s14_completed_a: Impressive. I wish more within the herd had your conviction. It’s time to face the Lords within their new domain.
09a_s14_completed_b: I grieve that it has come to this, but… they can be allowed to disrupt the primal flow no longer.
09a_s14_description: Manmosu, the new matriarch of the mammoth tribe, has taken refuge in a cave near the Tribunal Highmound to prepare for battle. Speak with her, and then prepare to assault the Highmound and its leaders.
09a_s14_incomplete: Maintain dominance or this land will dominate you.
09a_s14_proposal_a: You think as I do, human. Focus on eliminating the leaders. Their contagion spreads quickly if they are left to prowl.
09a_s14_proposal_b: Do this, and you will stop it long enough for us to deal with the greater threat.
09a_s15_completed_a: You have an uncanny aptitude for dissection. These samples are perfect! By studying these component parts I'll learn the intricacies of merging with Angry Earth.
09a_s15_completed_b: Return when you're ready and we'll investigate Hercyne memory loss.
09a_s15_description: Johannes Metzger needs assistance investigating the sinister magic Medusa had been channeling in Scalefang Enclave. Reach out to the rogue scientist, help him gather samples, and work with the mysterious technology there.
09a_s15_hercynebrain_description: Neural pathways infested with choking ivy.
09a_s15_hercyneguts_description: Smells like cut grass in front of a butcher's stall.
09a_s15_hercynelimb_description: Sturdy branch grown around human bones.
09a_s15_incomplete: You will not find the Hercyne by nettling me further, assistant. Get moving!
09a_s15_proposal_a: Limbs. Guts. Brains. What else? You've skinned a deer before, yes? It's like that, but keep the bits you'd throw out.
09a_s15_proposal_b: I just need a few more of each, then we can move on to the next phase. Do this and I'll mention you in the treatise I'm authoring!
09a_s15_sporesresourcebox_description: Dismantle for a collection of Spores. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_s16_armorbox_description: Dismantle for 1 Armor Piece at 645 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_s16_completed_a: My Syndicate cluster warned me not to rush progress… I believe I understand now.
09a_s16_completed_b: It was presumptuous of me to assume a Hercyne with human memories could maintain mental stability. My thanks. Your services are no longer required.
09a_s16_container_01: Participate in the grand scientific achievement
09a_s16_container_02: Participate in The Grand Scientific Achievement
09a_s16_description: Johannes Metzger has even grander ambitions. Too grand to accomplish alone. Find him in the dark village and Help him with his final tasks, and he promises to share part of the credit for whatever he learns.
09a_s16_incomplete: Hop to, assistant! You know what they say about idle hands…
09a_s16_prompt: "I'm as ready as I'll ever be."
09a_s16_proposal_a: That's the spirit! There are pylons like mine scattered around Scalefang Enclave.
09a_s16_proposal_b: If you modify them to my exact specifications, no one will notice the slight decrease in power. But we will have access to Medusa's streams of magic!
09a_s16_warhammert5_description: A brutish weapon, surely this is the one that will help you crush your foes.
09a_s17_completed_a: <g id="male_compliment" />Excellent work! We've got a much stronger foothold here now. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Your quick thinking saved the day.
09a_s17_completed_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />This new position should discourage hostile movement through the region.
09a_s17_description: Ranger-Captain Hargest has advanced into inner Light's Crown to establish a perimeter, but she needs assistance. Help the rangers restock their munitions, bolster their defenses, and fend off attacks.
09a_s17_encounter_complete: Help with repairs and protect Ranger Treadwell
09a_s17_encounter_participate: Help with repairs and protect Ranger Treadwell
09a_s17_incomplete: <g id="male_convince01" />Once this cannon is operational, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />we will command the battlefield.
09a_s17_proposal: <g id="female_gestureLeft" />We can use these barricades to create a choke point. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />We need to funnel the enemy into cannon range.
09a_s17_proposal_next2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />You'd better, or this is going to be a long night.
09a_s17_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_explain" />Come back to me after you've fixed the barricades and supplied our rangers, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />and I’ll be sure to have the cannon ready when you return.
09a_s17_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />The cannon needs to be assembled first, but that firepower along with my rangers should be-
09a_s17_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_lookaroundStartled01" priority="high" />Wait, where is the supply wagon? We can't hold for long without ammunition.
09a_s17_topic_hargest_response: My scouts spotted forces heading this way. <g id="female_order" />Open fire!
09a_s17_topic_treadwell2_response: Help yourself. It’ll lighten the load.
09a_s17_topic_treadwell_response: Thanks, friend. I’m better with a bow than I am with a wrench, but I’ll make it work.
09a_s17_wagonsupplies_description: A container full of ammunition of various types.
09a_s18_amulett5_description: A beautiful trinket once stowed in secret in Elafry Pyrgo.
09a_s18_arcaneweaponbox_description: Dismantle for 1 Arcane Weapon at 650 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_s18_completed: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Were you successful in collecting the… <g id="female_lookConcern" />you look like you’ve seen a ghost. What happened up there?
09a_s18_completed_next: <g id="female_notsure" />Spirits? Let me see those readings… <g id="female_lookConcern" />This is something new indeed. The energy is dark and cold in nature. Just being near it saps the life right out of me.
09a_s18_completed_next2_a: <g id="female_notsure" />I’m not certain. I’ve never seen anything like it. Further examination is required...
09a_s18_completed_next2_b: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Thank you for your efforts, I will be sure to mention you when the chronicler documents this new discovery.
09a_s18_container01: Reach the Second Floor of Elafry Pyrgo
09a_s18_description: Heinrich Gauss has been dispatched to investigate the dark energy pouring out of Elafry Pyrgo and assess its potential danger to the humans of Aeternum. Help him to gather samples using his proprietary capture devices.
09a_s18_incomplete: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />You mustn't linger long. I want to capture the storm's full ferocity.
09a_s18_killboss: Defeat the Scourge of the Storm
09a_s18_proposal_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />You are far better equipped for the job…<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" /> Take my latest creation with you.
09a_s18_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />Place it in energy rich regions atop the tower and buy some time for it to capture the storm's essence. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Be careful. The power will coalesce around it.
09a_s19_completed_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I’m glad you made it back safely. The seeds should prevent new infections from spreading.
09a_s19_completed_b: I hope our paths cross again… under less dire circumstances. May the wilds<g id="male_salute2FingersFast" /> always guide you, friend.
09a_s19_cooldown: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Ah, you have done well, child of dust… <g id="female_lookConcern" />though I fear evil will soon bloom again within these walls… <g id="male_outfitproud" />on that day, I hope you rise to defend the green once more.
09a_s19_description: Archdruid Trahern has been hard at work researching methods for combating the magical plants spreading throughout the Savage Divide. He needs your assistance planting his newly created seeds within the depths of the cavern.
09a_s19_incomplete: <g id="female_disagreeRighthandout" />Be careful, there are many infected creatures inside the cavern. If at all possible, try to give them a swift end. <g id="male_shakehead" />They've already suffered enough.
09a_s19_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />We use Medusa’s magic against her. These seeds will absorb the taint and purify it before bursting into pristine flora.
09a_s19_proposal_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Simply place them where the contagion is most concentrated and allow nature to take its course.
09a_s19_rapiert5_description: When you're out of options, turn to your trusty rapier.
09a_s1_completed: All is calm now. The animals sing with gratitude for their freedom. Thank you for giving them a second chance.
09a_s1_description: The Druid Keira implores you to aid the wildlife native to the region. The cries of animals call out from the depths of the jungle, and she feels their fear. Do what you can to keep them from becoming food for some new monstrosity.
09a_s1_incomplete: We don’t know what other horrors were spawned by the transformation of this land. Be cautious.
09a_s1_proposal_a: If we're quick about it. I have a special connection to the wild things. Their cries… they’re coming from the south.
09a_s1_proposal_b: Free our animal friends and purge any fiendish flora that's disturbed the natural order.
09a_s20_completed_a: I can feel his grip weakening on the herd. With time, the power he holds over us will diminish.
09a_s20_completed_b: It still shocks me to fight alongside a human, but you have proven yourself a priceless ally. You have my gratitude.
09a_s20_container_02: Destroy the afflicted Beast Lords in the Savage Divide
09a_s20_description: The time has come to face the Beast Lords lost within the Savage Divide. Manmosu asks that we act as her champion, lest she risk infection by going herself. Gather your greatest allies, descend into the Divide, and defeat the Lords.
09a_s20_incomplete: Stay vigilant. You may have defeated Mahantaram before, but the foulness festering within him makes him unpredictable.
09a_s20_mahantaram_combat_2: The age of humanity is over!
09a_s20_mahantaram_combat_3: Your bones will crack beneath me!
09a_s20_mahantaram_combat_death: One day... I will revive... my people.
09a_s20_proposal_a: Unfortunately, he isn’t the only Beast Lord within the depths of the Highmound Caverns. The gorilla lord Kurok is inside as well.
09a_s20_proposal_b: I’d die protecting my herd, but I fear contracting their disease.
09a_s21_artifacts_description: Pottery and trinkets bearing the face of Medusa thought to be protective, now turned to stone.
09a_s21_completed_a: <g id="male_compliment" />Splendid work! Just splendid! Imagine, this vase, if it hadn't been turned to stone, would have been as fragile as an eggshell.
09a_s21_completed_b: <g id="male_secretive" priority="high" />Now I can study the intricate design without fear of it shattering. Or Bloodgood's bumbling.
09a_s21_description: Dame Edith Henrietta Shackleton has gotten herself into a bit of a situation in the maze. She requires help acquiring antiquities that have been turned to stone.
09a_s21_incomplete: <g id="female_impatient" />Have you recovered those artifacts yet? I'm getting tired from holding this position.
09a_s21_proposal_a: <g id="male_nodProud" />I'm no dunce. I studied the Classics, and have an encyclopedic knowledge of mythology.
09a_s21_proposal_b: While I may have been surprised to see it was real, I know how to use a hand mirror. <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />But I could use some help.
09a_s21_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />Heavens no! I cannot leave without the intriguing artifacts I came for. If I left without them, I'd never hear the end of it from Bloodgood, curse him.
09a_s21_proposal_next_b: With so many adventurers turned to stone here, <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" />this is the perfect area to recover artifacts from all sorts of fascinating cultures.
09a_s2_2hlifestafft5_description: Water my garden with your blood.
09a_s2_armorbox_description: Dismantle for 1 Armor Piece at 625 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_s3_completed_a: You have the brain? Let me examine it…
09a_s3_completed_b: Strange… it almost seems like two different beings. One is a stag, but the other… feels strangely familiar? It can’t be. I must inform the archdruid!
09a_s3_description: Sebastian Vachon is pursuing a dangerous beast and needs your help finding it so he can study its origins. Follow its tracks through the region, defeat it, and bring its cerebrum back to the Druid.
09a_s3_gorillabloodtraila: Find the first sign of tracks
09a_s3_hercynecerebrum_description: It resembles a typical brain, but something about it looks unnatural.
09a_s3_incomplete: Some rangers claim to have encountered a creature such as this near the overgrown barrier deep within the mining town.
09a_s3_proposal: I can find out. If you wish to help, slay the beast and bring me its brain. With that, I can divine the answer.
09a_s3_proposal_next_a: Excellent. It appears to have wandered off toward the mining town. The trail of fresh elk remains should guide you.
09a_s3_proposal_next_b: I must return to camp and inform the others of this situation. Meet me there when you have the brain.
09a_s4_2hblunderbusst5_description: Takes seeds instead of bullets and packs quite a punch.
09a_s4_completed_a: <g id="male_wipetear" />Scuse me, lad. Think I got something in my eye. <g id="male_ragepoundfist" />We lost a lot of good people when those leafy bastards showed.
09a_s4_completed_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />If the thorns and vines didn't get you, it was the Angry Earth. <g id="male_compliment" />Good you arrived to give them a proper sendoff.
09a_s4_container02: Gather Ingredients for the Pheromone Lure
09a_s4_description: Albert Riches, the survivalist of First Light left behind some battle plans and a note. How did he know we would be coming? In any case, we should help. Go into Charlottesburgh and complete the Survivalist's bombastic plan.
09a_s4_incomplete: There is a hastily sketched diagram of a farmhouse surrounded by explosives. Stick figure Angry Earth are rushing towards it.
09a_s4_lureswarm_displayname: Wait for Angry Earth to Swarm the Lure
09a_s4_lureswarmpin: Flee the Swarm and Wait by the Detonator
09a_s4_lureswarmpin_displayname: Wait for Angry Earth to Swarm the Lure
09a_s4_proposal_a: The plant-men made a home of Dayspring. Dragged townsfolk there when it started… into the pods.
09a_s4_proposal_b: I've been planting explosives there for weeks. The barrels seem to confuse them. Collect the rest and blast those greeny gits to Hades.
09a_s5_brokenarms_description: A collection of rusted, worn down armaments.
09a_s5_completed_a: <g id="female_notsure" />I'm not seeing things? I thought I'd die here on this God-forsaken island. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You have my eternal thanks, mate!
09a_s5_completed_b: <g id="female_smackfist" />I'm getting off this rock and damn the consequences. If you've<g id="male_gestureForwardRighthand" /> a mind to brave the Stormwall, you're always welcome in my crew.
09a_s5_completed_next_a: <g id="male_wipetear" />Are you sent from on high? I will meet you there, fast as a whistle. <g id="male_laughBig" />There's nothing that steadies an old sailor's legs like the promise of grog.
09a_s5_depletedmedicalsupplies_descripti: Medical supplies with little use remaining.
09a_s5_description: Another potential survivor, James Oxen, appears to have dropped a check-list of supplies. There is a crude drawing of a cave on the back. Collect the supplies, find the cave, and protect the survivors.
09a_s5_gotocave: Travel to the cave from the note
09a_s5_incomplete_a: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
09a_s5_incomplete_b: On the back is a list of supplies, and a crude map to a cave southwest of here.
09a_s5_proposal_a: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
09a_s5_proposal_b: On the back is a list of supplies, and a crude map to a cave southwest of here.
09a_s5_rottenreserves_description: Reserves that are starting to spoil.
09a_s6_1hgauntleticet5_description: With every winter comes a spring bloom.
09a_s6_completed_a: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />How was the investigation? You look like you ran into something dangerous.
09a_s6_completed_b: <g id="female_explainS" />If they're headed up north, that means they'll spring the Marauders' trap. They were bound to be right sometime.<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> Many thanks!
09a_s6_description: The Knight-Errant Fionn hopes we can render some assistance investigating the migratory behavior of the beasts moving between the nearby territory and the northern beastlands. Follow the clues and report back.
09a_s6_fionn_delivery_a: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />I wager you have many daunting concerns, but clearly you're more cut out for this sort of thing than I am.
09a_s6_fionn_delivery_b: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />So far, all I've accomplished is fleeing from certain death. <g id="male_gestureAhead" />If you could help, I’ve been tasked with observing the beasts and collecting information.
09a_s6_incomplete: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Travel south along the coast and try not to get spotted. These beasts are just like the rest of Aeternum's wildlife -<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> vicious and territorial.
09a_s6_meinteractable: Collect a sample of beast droppings
09a_s6_migrationevidence: Search for Migration Evidence Along the Coast
09a_s6_migrationevidence2: Search for Migration Evidence Along the Coast
09a_s6_migrationevidence3: Search for Migration Evidence Along the Coast
09a_s6_migrationevidence4: Search for Migration Evidence Along the Coast
09a_s6_migrationevidence5: Search for Migration Evidence Along the Coast
09a_s6_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />Migratory patterns to confirm they're heading for a choke point the Marauders picked out.
09a_s6_proposal_b: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />I'm spent from running for my life.<g id="male_pleadHandsclasped" /> If you could check the coast for tracks, I would appreciate it.
09a_s7_completed_a: An alchemist told us our "curse" was some Ancient defense mechanism, but I dismissed the idea until the sickness faded.
09a_s7_completed_b: Now I owe the Syndicate up north an apology.
09a_s7_container04: Put a Stop to the Curse
09a_s7_description: Ramla and her crew have come down with a mysterious illness. Something dangerous has awoken in these ruins and someone tough will be needed to investigate. See if you can solve the mystery.
09a_s7_incomplete_a: The Syndicate are held up here instead of setting up power for the Marauders.
09a_s7_incomplete_b: The whole project could fall apart if we don't find an answer to this blasted plague.
09a_s7_proposal_a: I would prefer the surprises to stop. The symptoms are nothing particularly unique, but no treatments are working.
09a_s7_proposal_b: I know you're capable of facing whatever's out there. Finding the source could save my team.
09a_s7_ramla_delivery_a: My expedition team fell ill after scouting these ruins. The Syndicate won't move until the "curse" is investigated and the Marauders won't risk sending soldiers here.
09a_s7_ramla_delivery_b: We're stuck tending to the ill. Do you have the courage to investigate?
09a_s8_armorbox_description: Dismantle for 1 Armor Piece at 635 Gear Score. Rewarded for completing a quest.
09a_s8_completed_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />All fixed? Us too. <g id="male_explain" />With the pylons repaired, our expert in Ancient machinery can attempt to gain control of the defenses.
09a_s8_completed_b: <g id="female_explainS" />He’s a Marauder, so make sure his soldiers aren’t breaking the machines. <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />We can’t afford any more repairs.
09a_s8_container01: Defeat Anubian Guardians to Retrieve Ancient Conduit
09a_s8_description: Josephine and her Syndicate specialists were ambushed when they set off some form of automated defense system within Tideswallow. Now they need someone to deal with the Ancient Guardians and finish the repairs.
09a_s8_incomplete_a: <g id="female_explainS" />I don't mind waiting, but I can't say the same for the Marauders.
09a_s8_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Got a knack for this do you? <g id="female_explainS" />If you gather up enough Ancient scraps, maybe you can fix the pylons. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Then you may need some Ancient tomes, for setting the runes.
09a_s8_proposal_b: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />We're busy trying to keep what we have safe.
09a_s9_completed_a: Haha! Run, cowards! Though I take great pride in Marauder victory over the Ancient Guardians, I am even more impressed by the strength of Aeternum united.
09a_s9_completed_b: We could not have done this without you and our allies.
09a_s9_container03: Assist Kievan with Breaching the Device
09a_s9_container04: Complete the Quest Encounter "Breaching the System"
09a_s9_defense_description0: Activate the Device in the Quest "Factions United"
09a_s9_defense_description1: Defend Kievan Sidorov from the Anubian Guardians
09a_s9_description: The flow of power has been restored to the Marauders at Saircor, and Kievan needs help with the final step of the operation. Fight off the Ancient Guardians and assist with the repairs so he can gain control of their defenses.
09a_s9_hatchett5_description: Modern medicine is fantastic! I can cut straight through a mammoth femur in less than 3 minutes.
09a_s9_incomplete_a: Every moment we delay, our foes continue their relentless advance. The man-beast to the north must not be allowed to amass his armies unchecked.
09a_s9_kievan_delivery_a: The Ancient Guardians gave our little friends trouble with sickness and sabotage, but now they once again face the might of the Marauders!
09a_s9_kievan_delivery_b: If you can aid me while I study this mechanism, Saircor and its defenses will be ours.
09a_s9_killtask: Complete the Quest Encounter "Breaching the System"
09a_s9_proposal_a: Looks can be deceiving, da? This will not be easy, friend. You have demonstrated mastery over Ancient Guardians. Show us Marauders another performance!
09a_s9_proposal_b: If you help us repair this Ancient device, we will be ready to proceed.
09a_s9_tools01: Collect Kievan's tools from the West of the Orrery
09a_s9_tools02: Collect Kievan's tools from the South of the Orrery
09a_s9_tools03: Collect Kievan's tools from the East of the Orrery
09a_shawforth_default: My soldiers and I are here to keep the invaders at bay. We heard about the demise of the First Light settlement and we can't allow that to happen to the others.
09a_shirzad_01_a: You know Artemis and her tribe as Ancients, but we were here aeons before, and we know them as invaders.
09a_shirzad_01_b: But she builds a great army and promises us dominion over great swaths of Earth. Why would we refuse?
09a_shirzad_02_a: Kurok went below Highmound, certain he could pull Mahantaram up from the depths. Neither has returned.
09a_shirzad_02_b: If rage has consumed them, they need to be dealt with, lest their malevolence seep into the land around them.
09a_shirzad_02_next_a: I do not wish this fate upon them, but the natural cycle must be restored. You will need to be stronger than ever.
09a_shirzad_02_next_b: Brave my gauntlet once more. Prove yourself against not only beast, but your fellow man, and I will grant you my boon.
09a_shirzad_03: Come to brave the gauntlet again, little lion?
09a_shirzad_default: Move swiftly, cub, lest my children use your bones to sharpen their fangs.
09a_shirzad_talkto: Shirzad smells Taurus upon you, yet you are not dead. Curious. What could compel you to so brazenly stand before the Lord of Lions?
09a_shirzad_talkto_next: <Roars!> Presumptuous! What could we possibly speak about?
09a_shirzad_talkto_next_prompt: “He gave me his blessing to come."
09a_shirzad_talkto_topic_a: Hah, why would the Beast Lords strike a bargain with humanity? You are but evolved amoeba adrift in the cosmos.
09a_shirzad_talkto_topic_b: Prove to Shirzad you are worthy. Survive my den in the rocks below. Then shall you have your audience.
09a_shirzad_talkto_topic_prompt: "I hope to strike a new bargain."
09a_soldierguard_default: We are here to defend the warcamp. Nothing will get past us.
09a_taurus_01_a: I am the one who summoned the Beast Lords, and it was on my word that they agreed to bargain with the Huntress.
09a_taurus_01_b: If I have misled them, I am ashamed; and if they succumb to her influence, the danger is great.
09a_taurus_default: There are yet more Lords to attend to. Their plans will not wait for you. Go.
09a_taurus_gp_default: She will face my boundless rage!
09a_taurus_hg_default: We will meet again, friend. I will not allow my debt to you to go unpaid.
09a_taurus_hg_talkto: I was a fool… blinded by rage. I allowed myself to fall victim to the vile gorgon's gaze and nearly lost all. Thank you, human. I am in eternal debt.
09a_taurus_hg_talkto_next_a: You have my support, but you will not have my axe. I shall not raise it against one who once fought with honor at my side.
09a_taurus_hg_talkto_next_b: I will remain here and ensure the gorgon and her vile creations are kept at bay.
09a_trahern_sd_01: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />We have made progress towards restoring the balance of this land, but much more remains to be done. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />	I look forward to more partnerships, dear friend.
09a_trahern_sd_default_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />I’ve been so focused on reversing the effects of Medusa’s putrid magic that I overlooked a basic principle of nature.
09a_trahern_sd_default_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />There can be no growth without decay and vice versa.
09a_trahern_wc_01_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Hail, Soulwarden. Deep peace to you. Your arrival is a healthy wind in this struggling encampment.
09a_trahern_wc_01_b: <g id="male_itemTakeRight" priority="high" />Is that the inoculate Morgaine promised? <g id="male_laugh" />Well now, that's the first kindness from her since we met.
09a_trahern_wc_02_a: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />You've brought a measure of health and hope to the camp, <g id="female_lookConcern" />but I fear the roots of this vile catastrophe go much deeper.
09a_trahern_wc_02_b: <g id="male_explain" />Before you venture forth again, I would speak with you about this rabid frenzy that affects the beasts here.
09a_trahern_wc_default: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />This is wild nature magic. The power Artemis must wield... A foul wind blows over from the southeast. I fear Light’s Crown is the heart of this travesty.
09a_treadwell_01: Almost got it! Just keep them off me a bit longer.
09a_treadwell_02: Even with the repairs, this wagon can’t make it up there. I’ll have to return to camp and find another way to resupply our troops.
09a_treadwell_03: I need to get out of here before more show up.
09a_treadwell_default: These wagons weren’t built for this blasted terrain. The wheel's broken. I need someone to cover me so I can fix it.
09a_vachon_default_a: This poor creature suffered a gruesome fate. It strayed too far from its kind, and fell prey to a monster that roams this vicinity.
09a_vachon_default_b: I have peered into its eyes. It wasn’t a creature born from nature.
09a_vachon_rescue_01: <g id="male_explain" />We were tracking the Hercyne when we fell into their trap. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I had to know more about how they were made.
09a_vachon_wc_01: It seems the horrific fiend was created by some twisted magic. I fear we haven't seen the last of its kind.
09a_vachon_wc_default: What we have discovered is deeply disturbing. I must consult with Trahern, there is still much to learn here.
09a_yoon_a_default_a: Did Hargest send you? <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />It's about time! Something strange is afoot here - <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />it may be the spores…
09a_yoon_a_default_b: <g id="female_explainS" />We all lost our bearings! We spooked a ragged-looking woman by the water, and we went after her... <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />and then I was alone.
09a_yoon_a_default_inprogress: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />I hope you find the woman. Whether she's gone mad or not, she deserves our help.
09a_yoon_b_default_a: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />You found her! And she's willing to come back to the camp? Hargest'll be happy, but not if we can't find my fellow scouts.
09a_yoon_b_default_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />I searched north, called out, no answers. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />If they wandered south, that would be bad.
09a_yoon_wc_default_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I can't believe it. I didn't even recognize her. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />That woman is Sylvia Oakes, former constable of First Light.
09a_yoon_wc_default_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Whatever she witnessed, it's scrambled her mind something awful. <g id="male_dontknow" />Just talking to her… I need to take some time.
09a_zayden_default: I swear, I should have stayed back north, <g id="male_forgetit" />and never come to this place.
09a_zayden_rescue_01: <g id="female_startledHandmouth" />How did you make it through? There were so many of them… <g id="female_lookConcern" />too many for Sebastien and I to fight through.

1007_00_commander_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="grace_proud" />Winifred Silas, Commander of the Marauders. In this harsh place, only the strongest will survive.
1007_01_commander_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_youknow" /> Every second is a struggle here. There are frequent attacks from the Corrupted and an endless supply of pirates seeking to pilfer our supplies.
1007_01pre_commander_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="female_youknow" />Every second is a struggle here. There are frequent attacks from the Corrupted and an endless supply of Lost pirates.\n[ Level 20 required for the "Trial of the Gladiator" Quest ]
1007_02_commander_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="grace_proud" />You only have the luxury to keep your nose stuck in your books because we Marauders have the courage to spill blood.
1007_03_commander_defaultdialogue_v2: <g id="grace_proud" />You cultists always seem to scarper when the Corrupted are at our gates.
1007_04_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />More meat for the grinder. You've built quite a reputation around here. We'll see if it's well-deserved.
1007_04_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />So you think you're ready to advance? Not sure I should even allow you the chance.
1007_04_commander_defaultdialogue_v3_a: <g id="grace_proud" />Winifred Silas, Commander of the Marauders. In this harsh place, only the strongest will survive.
1007_04_commander_defaultdialogue_v3_b: So many heads to bash. So little time. Stop wasting my time and go out there and stake a claim for yourself!

1007_04pre_commander_defaultdialogue_v3_: <g id="grace_proud" />Winifred Silas, Commander of the Marauders. In this harsh place, only the strongest will survive.
So many heads to bash. So little time. Stop wasting my time and go out there and stake a claim for yourself!
1007_05_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />You think just because you've crushed one Lost captain and his lackeys you're ready to lead Marauders?
1007_05_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />Feh! You've earned a new rank, but it'll end here. You'll see.
1007_05pre_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />You think just because you've crushed one Lost captain and his lackeys you're ready to lead Marauders?
<g id="grace_proud" />Feh! You've earned a new rank, but it'll end here. You'll see.\n[ Level 20 required for the "Trial of the Gladiator" Quest ]
1007_06_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Back in one piece? Pity. I was sure you'd be Lost by now. No matter, this next task will choke the life from you. This trial should prove far tougher.
1007_06_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />I doubt you're up for the challenge.
1007_06_commander_defaultdialogue_v3: So many heads to bash. So little time. Stop wasting my time and go out there and stake a claim for yourself!
1007_06pre_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Back in one piece? Pity. I was sure you'd be Lost by now. No matter, this next task will choke the life from you. This trial should prove far tougher.
<g id="grace_proud" />I doubt you're up for the challenge.\n[ Level 24 required for the "Trial of the Ravager" Quest ]
1007_07_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_shocked" />Another fluke! It has to be. Your luck will run out eventually. And when it does, your death will be on your own conscience!
1007_07_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />Now get out of my sight, go bother somebody who cares.
1007_08_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_a: <g id="female_applauseMocking" />What are you expecting, a salute? You think because I've been reprimanded by Gladiator Strou'dahia that I'll buckle that easy?
1007_08_commander_defaultdialogue_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />You'll find out how a real Marauder fights soon enough.

1039_druid_00_defaultdialog: I fear we shall find no respite. As long as Medusa still roams this land, nature will not be appeased.
1039_druid_01_defaultdialog: No doubt you've seen the remains of poor Oxen's crew. I don't blame him for fleeing. Had he not, he would share their fate.
1039_druid_02_defaultdialog: You've done well for the land and its people, my friend. Nature sends her thanks. The flowers bloom a little brighter because of you.
1039_raid_eggs_complete: You have my thanks, hero. I only pray that I have the knowledge and intellect necessary to decipher the mysteries of those who came before.
1039_raid_eggs_complete2: It doesn’t look like much, but the secret to returning the spirits of the Angry Earth to their proper repose may be locked within these very eggs.
1039_raid_eggs_incomplete: Make haste! The longer we dally, the more of her brood will spill forth to contaminate this land!
1039_raid_eggs_proposal: Just the attitude Nature needs from the Hero of Aeternum! There's an antidote I can brew. The ingredients can be found in the Hive beyond.
1039_raid_eggs_proposal_2: Be wary, they say Medusa has impregnated herself, and is breeding a new army of Hercyne aberrations within the hive…. I shiver to think of it.
1039_raid_eggs_proposal_3: I admire your bravado. But even if we succeed, her defeat is only the beginning. Unless we return Nature to rest, the fruit of her womb will stalk these lands for eternity.
1039_raid_eggs_proposal_4: Search within and bring the ingredients. If I can learn what foul magic birthed such horrors into our world, perhaps I can devise a way to extinguish them.

10_cutlasskeys_body_02_01:
Perhaps Warwick may have had a point about rigorous storage cleanliness.

Today I went to the settlement to get another pole from storage, only to find it had tangled itself up with a spear! It took hours to untie, being that fishing line is precious and I did not want to cut it free. Missed the perfect golden hour for fishing, so the day's wasted now. What a mess.

-Perchal
10_cutlasskeys_body_02_02:
I remember my mother had a chair in our old home that no one else was allowed to sit in. She never explicitly told us this, but it was understood that mother's chair was a sacred place.

That's how I feel about my spot, my secret fishing spot here in Aeternum. None are to disturb me there.

When I walked out to the spot with my gear last night, though, I saw a man fishing there I had never seen before. We got into a row about whose spot it was, and thanks to the rapier I have on me I won that one. Saw him again the other day in the settlement grumbling about dying. Serves him right.

-Perchal
10_cutlasskeys_body_02_03:
I saw something the other day that no one will believe. It has begun to drive me mad.

I thought at first someone was trying to steal my fishing spot again, but upon closer inspection this 'someone' wriggled off into the water with a screech. It was using a tool to get chunks of loose earth from my spot, I know it to be true. I will see you again, Glowing Gnufish, and next time you will be mine.

-Perchal
10_cutlasskeys_body_03_01:
Note from Sailing Master Trost

Taking this coin was a terrible idea. 

We've had nothing but bad luck ever since it came aboard our ship.

First we had a month with no merchant ships crossing our paths. 

Then we lost our captain to a storm that came out of nowhere.

And now the Vernal Bounty has crashed into this place.

If only we'd never seen the Touched Coin.
10_cutlasskeys_body_03_02:
Note from Boatswain Gibbons

Trost keeps muttering on about that stupid coin.

I, for one, don't put much stock in superstitions, but maybe he's on to something.

There is something wrong with the crew, they are forgetting themselves.

I think it is this place, but Trost is convinced it is the coin.

Said he was going to do something about it.
10_cutlasskeys_body_03_03:
Note from Gunner Marlowe

That blasted coin keeps reappearing. 

Trost swears he threw it into the bay, but it's back.

I thought someone is playing a prank on the poor fellow. 

Following him, retrieving the coin when he isn't looking, that sort o' thing.

Except, today I was walking along the beach and saw it myself.

There is something wrong about that shiny piece o' metal, make no mistake.
10_cutlasskeys_body_03_04:
Note from Boatswain Gibbons

A fight broke out over the coin this morning.

Trost wasn't involved, which surprised me, but then I realized he was gone.

Searched his quarters and found a note, something about leaving this cursed place.

I think he may have the right idea.
10_cutlasskeys_body_03_05:
Note from Gunner Marlowe

Rumors of the coin seem to be spreading.

Another group o' pirates came to take it from us.

We didn't stand a chance, they had some big brute of a fellow, that one enjoyed doling out pain.

Benjamin I think his name was. I remember he used to sail on the Fair Weather Friend.

He took the coin and set out across the water.

Good riddance, I say. Maybe we can finally get some peace.

10_cutlasskeys_body_05_01:
By order held of the Skullworm Court
Abided by the Thalassocratic Captain-in-Command
Enforced by the Dispenser of Justice

Let it be known
The Stone Skull Charter hereby is decreed Code of the Law:

(1)    " Cruel and unjust treatment shall be punished. Crew or Captain, all those against whom worthy Complaint was made shall be executed. Any honest Fellow that never abused any Sailors shall be freed. 

(2)    Plunder and loot shall be divided equally amongst those judged Honest and Fair.

(3)    Authority of the Captain-in-Command only be challenged by a Common Cause, delivered and judged by a Court of elected officers.

(4)    All those who seek to join the Crew shall be given the opportunity to do so, at their Peril and the Judgement of the Captain-in-Command.

(5)    The Dispenser of Justice shall be an elected officer appointed by the Captain-in-Command, and whose duties be the Fair and Swift distribution of Justice.

(6)   Any and all those who oppose the Code of the Law are as flotsam on the sand, and their Souls shall be scattered midst the four corners of Aeternum. So be it. "

As Decreed, and Duly Signed,
Goldstein the Equalizer, Captain-in-Command!
