1102_01_magistrate: Unless you're carrying a message from our scouting party, I'm afraid I've got not time for pleasantries, newcomer.
1102_0201_b_description: Defeat the former Watcher Antonio Guerra, find any scouting reports at his camp, and put his soul to rest. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in the Mourningdale Settlement.
1102_0201_c_proposal_a: Is that so? Well you certainly look capable enough, and I’m in no position to turn away an able body.
1102_0201_c_proposal_b: One of my best scouts, Antonio Guerra, took a party north to observe the movements of the Corrupted force gathering there. They haven’t reported back.
1102_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: I would appreciate that. Start at the watchtower, and see if you can retrace their steps. I fear the worst, and Antonio is… dear to me.
1102_0201_d_01_task: Search for signs of Antonio Guerra and retrieve his scouting reports
1102_0201_d_03_task: Search the camp for Guerra's Scouting Telescope and field reports
1102_0201_e_incomplete: Time is of the essence, friend. The Corrupted are gathering strength, and who knows what other forces array against us. Hurry!
1102_0201_f_complete_a: So… this is it then? Antonio… lost to us. I suppose once this is all over, I will have eternity to mourn his loss.
1102_0201_f_complete_b: Still, knowing is better. And there is some solace in knowing he gave his last life protecting us from harm. It’s how he would have wanted it.
1102_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: Not the Corrupted, it seems. From these reports, it appears that our troubles continue to multiply. The Lost are also arrayed against us.
1102_0201_f_complete_pt2_b: I will need time to study his field reports before I am certain what to do next.
1102_0201_spyglass_description: Detailed notes on his studies of constellations. As the notes continue his thoughts become more and more sullen until they stop completely.
1102_02_magistrate: Damn it, Antonio! Where are you?
1102_02_magistrate_deprecated: Damn it, Antonio! Where are you? Oh, sorry! I didn’t see you there. Apologies, but… I am quite busy planning the defense of the settlement. If you’ll excuse me…
1102_02_magistrate_next: Oh, sorry! I didn’t see you there. Apologies, but… I am quite busy planning the defense of the settlement. If you’ll excuse me…
1102_0301_b_description: Defeat Musslebeard and the Seasong pirates in his charge. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
1102_0301_c_proposal_a: Yes, of course. Our scouts. Antonio's notes say the pirates found themselves a new leader. A brute they call Musslebeard.
1102_0301_c_proposal_b: His actions suggest this Musslebeard retains some sense of purpose and deploys his pirates accordingly. Their goal likely is Grayvale.
1102_0301_c_proposal_pt2_a: Agreed. We won’t survive an attack from both the Lost and the Corrupted. But all my resources are dedicated to fortifying the town. That just leaves you.
1102_0301_c_proposal_pt2_b: If you can slip into the pirate camp and kill Musslebeard, that should hopefully leave the pirates disorganized enough to eliminate them as a threat.
1102_0301_d_01_task: Defeat Musslebeard and the Seasong pirates of {POITags}
1102_0301_e_incomplete: Hurry, friend. Musslebeard must be defeated. We can’t afford any distractions.
1102_0301_f_complete_a: It’s done then? Musslebeard is destroyed and my Antonio avenged? Good. There is some solace in that.
1102_0301_f_complete_b: He may be gone, but fate, it appears, has delivered you to ensure his life’s work continues. You have my thanks.
1102_0301_f_complete_pt2_a: I see that now. I was a fool to lose focus. Antonio would be ashamed of me.
1102_0301_f_complete_pt2_b: I will harden my heart. I will not let Grayvale fall to her enemies, Lost or Corrupted. Not while life still stirs in my soul!
1102_03_magistrate: Tony's spyglass… it's a reminder of the man he was.
1102_03_magistrate_next: Time is of the essence, friend. The Corrupted are gathering strength, and who knows what other forces array against us. Hurry!
1102_0401_b_description: Investigate key locations to the north that have been taken by the Wardogs. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
1102_0401_c_proposal_a: One faction of Corrupted known as the Wardogs, they gather their forces up north. Make no mistake. They formulate strategy to march on us here in Grayvale.
1102_0401_c_proposal_pt2_a: Yes, that cannot hurt, but more importantly, we need to know their plan of attack. Search for any documents that might expose their strategy.
1102_0401_corruptedcompass_description: This compass' needle seems to move with some dark energy that is certainly not magnetism.
1102_0401_corruptedore_description: An ordinary chunk of ore that has been touched by the Corrupted. It pulsates with a dark power.
1102_0401_d_01a_task: Investigate locations that have been taken by the Wardogs
1102_0401_d_02a_task: Travel to {POITags} and disrupt the plans of the Wardogs
1102_0401_e_incomplete: Fortune favors the prepared, friend. If we’re going to stop the Corrupted, we need to know precisely what they’re planning.
1102_0401_f_complete_a: Aha! Ore from the mines and maps plotting the Corrupted’s movements. It seems like they’ve stopped to equip themselves for a long fight.
1102_0401_f_complete_b: And now we know where they’re going to be, and how to counter their movements. If we can delay their southward march long enough, we may have a fighting chance.
1102_0401_f_complete_pt2_a: It helps to hear you say that. I need to deliver my report to the Constable. You’ve proven yourself a hero to this town, friend.
1102_0401_f_complete_pt2_b: If we survive this, know that you’ll always have a place here among us in Grayvale.
1102_04_magistrate: I'm afraid that Musslebeard is not the last of our problems here in Mourningdale.
1102_05_magistrate: If I can muster even an ounce of the valor you've shown us stranger, I may be able to protect this settlement. And Antonio's legacy. You have my gratitude.
1103_01_survivalist_a: This is not what I signed up for… lurching from one crisis to another, while the towns leadership falls all to pieces.
1103_01_survivalist_b: If there's ever a time to buckle down, it's when there's lives hanging in the balance!
1104_01_overseer: This is too much trouble for one man to handle. The town needs leadership! It's so hard to find good help these days…
1104_01a01_b_description: The Mourningdale settlement has been struck by tragedy and is in disarray. Constable Bayles will fill you in.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_a: Disaster on top of disaster. The northern settlements have fallen, and a steady flow of refugees has us spread increasingly thin.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_b: And to cap things off, my two most important advisors both say they're too busy attending to other matters to help.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_pt2_a: Magistrate Wallace says she’s still waiting on a scouting report, but her chief scout - Antonio Guerra - and she have an entanglement. She’s too close to this.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_pt2_b: As for Gildon… well… this may sound a bit off, but she’s the town seer. Her second sight has saved us many times past. Unfortunately, she’s… not herself.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_pt3_a: Anything you could do to return them to duty would be appreciated. The town’s in peril, and preparations will require their undivided attention.
1104_01a01_c_proposal_pt3_b: I’d speak with Survivalist Fletcher first. She’s close with both of them and might have better advice for you. Now, regrettably, I have a town to defend.
1104_01a01_e_incomplete: If you want to help us, speak to Fletcher. She'll know all the latest developments.
1104_01a01_f_complete_a: The Constable sent you? I’m not sure what we can do. Magistrate Wallace is being completely irrational, won't do a thing until she gets news about Antonio.
1104_01a01_f_complete_b: As for Gildon… well… it’s probably best if you just talk to her. It’s not something one can really put into words.
1104_01a01_f_complete_pt2_a: It's worth a try, I guess. Gildon and the Magistrate are the only reason Grayvale has survived this long. We need both of them in top form.
1104_01a_overseer_a: Greeting, stranger. I hope you're not here seeking comfortable shelter from the rains. Grayvale can offer few comforts these days.
1104_0201_b_description: Clear Weeper enemies from Porridgepot. Then report back to Constable Bayles in the Mourningdale Settlement.
1104_0201_c_proposal_a: You’re a true friend. A man’s home is his castle, but my first duty is to the citizens here. Keeping them safe is the priority.
1104_0201_c_proposal_b: I'm just trying to ensure I'll have something to go back to when this is all over.
1104_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: So old, I cannot remember... or even think clearly. I just need a quiet place to retire.
1104_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: There's a cottage in Porridgepot with a beautiful waterfall. If you could clear out the Weepers, it might be perfect for me.
1104_0201_e_incomplete: Is something keeping you, friend? I’m eager to learn what’s become of my home in my absence.
1104_0201_f_complete: You’re back? How fares my estate? Tell me it's not overrun with the Lost…
1104_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: Ugh, the entire estate? This is terrible, terrible news… I guess Grayvale is the only home I have left now. I'll have to make the best of it.
1104_02_overseer_a: I wonder if I could enlist your help for a personal matter. With everything going on here in Grayvale, I haven't been able to check in on my personal estate.
1104_02_overseer_b: Would you be willing to pay a visit to Porridgepot, and make sure my property hasn’t come to any harm in my absence?
1104_03_overseer_a: I used to wonder how someone could fall Lost. Now… some days I feel like I'm on the verge of despair myself.
1105_01_artificer_a: I need to find my way out of this mess. This place has always been nothing but trouble.
1105_01_artificer_b: What sad fate is this? Penniless and dispossessed on the long march south.
1105_0201_b_description: Defeat Spirits at Stephen's Claim to Collect Teardrop Gems. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
1105_0201_c_proposal: Bad? More like non-existent! I don't craft things so they can rot on the shelf!Art is only useful when it's being used, when it's being purchased!
1105_0201_c_proposal_a: Money. What else? I’m aware of how foolish it sounds, but I once had a lot invested in this place, and I can’t just leave empty-handed.
1105_0201_c_proposal_b: You look capable… maybe we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement. I know a lot about this place, and I think I have a plan to make some coin.
1105_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: Splendid. I may not look like much, but I’m a master jeweler. Believe it or not, the sort of trinkets I fashion travel better than cash.
1105_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: You can always hawk one to keep the rain off your head on a long march. I know where we can get some stones of truly haunting beauty. There’s only one problem…
1105_0201_c_proposal_pt3: Indeed! The stones are held by the Lost. The wraiths atop the mountain have them... beautiful, clear as teardrops! Get them and we'll share the reward.
1105_0201_d_01_task: Collect Teardrop Gems from spirits at Stephen's Claim
1105_0201_d_03_task: Defeat {targetName} to Collect a Teardrop Gem
1105_0201_d_04_task: Defeat {targetName} to Collect a Teardrop Gem
1105_0201_d_05_task: Defeat {targetName} to Collect a Teardrop Gem
1105_0201_e_incomplete_a: Scared of ghosts, stranger? Can’t say I blame you. But there’s no reward without risk!
1105_0201_f_complete: Well, aren’t you a marvel. I’ve been trying to get my hands on these gems since I first set foot in Mourningdale. They should fetch us a king's bounty.
1105_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: Not right away, but I can incorporate them in jewelry and other trinkets that will sell when this all blows over.
1105_0201_f_complete_pt2_b: Here, I think this is fair reward for your work in acquisition.
1105_0201_teardropgems_description: A raw gem naturally shaped like a teardrop. A few of them will fetch a high price once refined.
1105_0202_b_description: Recover the gold medallions from Padre Nuñez at his Mansion. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
1105_0202_c_proposal_a: You're clearly not afraid of a few Lost. And, in this case, you’ll be doing the world a favor. Who doesn’t love an altruist?
1105_0202_c_proposal_b: Our gems need a proper setting. I need gold bullion if these stones are going to fetch the price they're worth.
1105_0202_c_proposal_pt2_a: Not long ago, some silver-tongued Padre named Nunez got his town involved in some twisted cult. Convinced them to turn over all their treasures to the church.
1105_0202_c_proposal_pt2_b: Had them melted down into these gaudy medallions for his most zealous followers. The whole town’s fallen Lost, now. I doubt they’re going to miss them.
1105_0202_d_01_task: Recover gold medallions from Padre Nuñez at the {POITags}
1105_0202_d_04_task: Retrieve medallions from the Padre's chest
1105_0202_e_incomplete: Just one more errand and we’ll have all the money we need to make ourselves scarce.
1105_0202_f_complete_a: I think you’re my new best friend! Not only did you deliver the goods, but you punished that old snake Nunez.
1105_0202_f_complete_b: Afraid I wasn’t entirely up front with you. That town you ransacked; it was my town. And that bastard Nunez led everyone I love to ruin.
1105_0202_f_complete_pt2_a: Partly. I do need the gold to set these gemstones, but it was also vengeance. Mind you, this was gold that belonged to the town, myself included.
1105_0202_f_complete_pt2_b: Now, there’s your cut. A pleasure doing business with you. If I were you, I’d get gone before the Corrupted arrive.
1105_0202_goldmedallions_description: Medallions of pure gold with a simple inscription: Lacrimosa dies illa.
1105_0202_medallioncofferkey_description: A golden key used to unlock the Padre's hoard of golden medallions.
1105_02_artificer_a: You must have made a wrong turn somewhere, stranger. There’s nothing but misery here. I’m heading south soon as I can. Grayvale be damned.
1105_03_artificer_a: Of course… every jewel needs a fitting presentation. If you want to make some real money, there's one more thing we need…
1105_04_artificer_a: Heh, heh, heh, it was a pleasure doing business with you, friend. Me? I'll be heading south… just as soon as I can find a buyer…
1107_00_defaultdialogue_commander: If you know what's good for ya, you'll pack it in.
1107_01_defaultdialogue_commander: Flippin' 'eck. Aren't you a sight for these paggered eyes! What do you need?
1107_01pre_defaultdialogue_commander: Flippin' 'eck. Aren't you a sight for these paggered eyes! What do you need?[ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1107_02_defaultdialogue_commander: You think you're so clever. Well you ain't seen nowt what I have.
1108_00_defaultdialogue_alchemist: Oh wait, I almost have this solved.
1108_01pre_defaultdialogue_alchemist: At last! [ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1108_02_defaultdialogue_alchemist: I would comment on your lack of… a certain something between the ears, but that's wouldn't be proper, now would it?
1108_03_defaultdialogue_alchemist: I am so close to unveiling the secret to Azoth.
1108_04_defaultdialogue_alchemist_a: Mourningdale can be a dour place, but there is opportunity here for the inquisitive.
1108_04_defaultdialogue_alchemist_b: Like you, {playerName}. Your work with Krockes is quite famous, and now you are ready to advance in rank once again?
1108_04pre_defaultdialogue_alchemist_a: Mourningdale can be a dour place, but there is opportunity here for the inquisitive. [ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1108_04pre_defaultdialogue_alchemist_b: Like you, {playerName}. Your work with Krockes is quite famous, and now you are ready to advance in rank once again? [ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1108_05_defaultdialogue_alchemist: I predict these Psychokinetic Trace Absorbers will be literally full of traces soon.Imagine what we can learn!
1108_05pre_defaultdialogue_alchemist_a: I predict these Psychokinetic Trace Absorbers will be literally full of traces soon. Imagine what we can learn! [ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1108_05pre_defaultdialogue_alchemist_b: Imagine what we can learn! [ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1109_00_defaultdialogue_adjudicator: When you are prepared to embrace the truth, the Covenant will be here.
1109_01_defaultdialogue_adjudicator: Welcome, friend. I am here to serve our followers here in Mourningdale. Light the way.
1109_01pre_defaultdialogue_adjudicator: Welcome, friend. I am here to serve our followers here in Mourningdale. Light the way.[ Level 43 required for Mourningdale faction missions ]
1109_02_defaultdialogue_adjudicator: Savage. I believe you must be lost, yes?
1109_03_defaultdialogue_adjudicator: With your nose buried in books all the time, your eyes have become accustomed to the darkness.
1110_0101_greetlerato: Welcome Lerato to Mourningdale with a sample of Harunobu's roast pork.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers2_complete_av: Oh hello, what have you brought me? Ah, bless that Harunobu, he is so kind to me.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers2_description: Bring a sample of Harunobu's roast pork to Lerato.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers2_incomplete_: Hey {PlayerName}! Get that meat to Lerato while it's still hot!
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers2_proposal: I was at the brink of despair for a time there. But, that woman from the crossroads, Lerato? She was kind enough to travel here with me.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers2_proposal_ne: Now, I'm doing much better. I may not be a hog farmer anymore, but I am a great hog roaster!
Do you mind bringing some of this to good old Lerato? She's here in town.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers_complete_ava: Hey, it's {PlayerName}! Great to see you again. Want to try some of this pork? The facilities here are top-notch!
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers_incomplete_a: Have you checked in with those newcomers yet? Don't want them feeling left out after all that's happened to them.
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers_proposal: So I've heard. More and more people falling through here lost their livelihoods. Some lost worse!
1110_0101_greetthenewcomers_proposal_nex: No use in dwelling on it. Instead, why not go greet a couple of them, welcome them to their new home?
1110_01_barkeep_b: Don't get too hungry, angry, lonely, or tired… or you might make a mistake.
1110_02_barkeep_a: What with the Corruption up north, refugees are filtering in every day!
1110_02_barkeep_b: Shame they lost their homes, but at least they made it here safely. Best we can do is help 'em start again.
1110_03_barkeep_a: Stay a while, friend. Even in the hard times, we must take care of ourselves.
1110_03_barkeep_b: Don't get too hungry, angry, lonely, or tired… or you might make a mistake.
1111_01_stranger: You were called here for a reason stranger. Your fate has not yet revealed itself to me, but that much is certain.
1111_0201_b_description: Investigate the ruins in the Flooded Plains, and return found artifacts to Gildon in Mourningdale.
1111_0201_c_proposal_a: Probably not. The visions do not lie. But are they omens of the future or mere echoes of the past? I cannot be certain…
1111_0201_c_proposal_b: Perhaps… sometimes a talisman from a vision can serve to focus my gift. The Ancients had the gift of second-sight. Their ruins may hold answers.
1111_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: I see a stone that tore open the sky, leaving a scar upon the earth. A beacon, still burning across ages. An edifice cracked by time, but also marred by violence.
1111_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: Bring me a token of each of these, and I may be able to learn what darkness haunts my sight.
1111_0201_copperorb_description: A smooth orb, made of copper. There are ancient glyphs drawn on the surface.
1111_0201_d_01a_task: Search for artifacts in the ruins of {POITags}
1111_0201_d_02a_task: Search for artifacts in the ruins of {POITags}
1111_0201_d_03a_task: Search for artifacts in the ruins of {POITags}
1111_0201_e_incomplete: I must find my center, stranger. Without a center, there is only chaos and imbalance. Help me!
1111_0201_f_complete_a: What you carry has brought clarity across time and space, stranger. These are artifacts from a lost age, but also omens of coming strife.
1111_0201_f_complete_b: I fear what I have seen is what has happened, and what may still happen if we do not prevent it.
1111_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: In the ages past, our forerunners battled a timeless enemy. They defeated them, but the stakes were existential.
1111_0201_f_complete_pt2_b: Brothers and sisters fought and died at each other's hands. The ruins are the legacy of that great conflict.
1111_0201_marbleorb_description: A polished orb, made of silver. There are ancient glyphs drawn on the surface.
1111_0201_stoneorb_description: A rough orb, made of stone. There are ancient glyphs drawn on the surface.
1111_02_stranger_a: Get back, Child of Ruin! I see fire in your eyes! Fire that would consume this place in violence and madness. Red waves crashing upon this land.
1111_02_stranger_b: I-I am sorry, stranger. My thoughts are not my own… the visions overwhelm my senses. I must focus! And yet, they are beyond control…
1111_0301_b_description: Defeat Novaguard foot soldiers in the lookouts along the Ancient Road, and give their armor scraps to Gildon in Mourningdale.
1111_0301_brokenmail_description: Golden mail from the armor of Ancient Guardians.
1111_0301_c_proposal_a: I must see more. The Guardians are the ones who once did battle with our insolent foe. They employed protections we might yet recover.
1111_0301_c_proposal_b: Bring me scraps from the armor of a few who shed blood in the conflict, and perhaps I can see a path forward to our survival.
1111_0301_c_proposal_pt2_a: Look along the mountain road. Though their armor lies in tatters, I can see its shine in my minds eye.
1111_0301_d_01_task: Collect cloth scraps from Novaguard foot soldiers at {POITags}
1111_0301_d_03_task: Collect armor scraps from Novaguard foot soldiers at {POITags}
1111_0301_e_incomplete: My vision remains hazy, stranger. Bring me what I need, or I fear history may repeat itself…
1111_0301_f_complete_a: Yes. Yes! I can see it now, blood and flame and the roiling red wrath of the Corruption, scourging its way across the land!
1111_0301_f_complete_b: These Guardians, some of the first granted immortality, giving their lives over and over again to stem the tide.
1111_0301_f_complete_pt2_a: I believe so… in the service of the Ancients themselves. But others defected to the side of evil. It was a war of annihilation.
1111_0301_tatteredcloth_description: Tatters of cloth from the armor of Ancient Guardians.
1111_03_stranger_a: What was past may be returning again, stranger. An old sin revisited upon a new generation.
1111_03_stranger_b: If we cannot stem the Red Tide, we too shall be swept away. A mystery pondered by the next cohort of martyrs and castaways.
1111_0401_ancientspyglass_description: A very ornate spyglass that seems Ancient in origin. It's infused with Azoth.
1111_0401_b_description: Defeat Fineseer foot soldiers while climbing to the top of Vela, and show its treasure to Gildon in Mourningdale.
1111_0401_c_proposal_a: A Watchtower, ancient and powerful, is your next destination. Vela. Your quarry stands proud and tall upon its peak.
1111_0401_c_proposal_b: Bring me the Watchman's spyglass. With such a talisman, perhaps I can see what he has seen, and in so doing, divine whatever future awaits us.
1111_0401_c_proposal_pt2_a: An object from a darkened sky, akin to night, stars above, and a blinding light…
1111_0401_c_proposal_pt2_b: Go to the top of Vela, and bring me any relic of the Fineseers you find there.
1111_0401_d_01_task: Claim the relic hidden atop Vela
1111_0401_e_incomplete: The Watchers in the Tower… against what did they stand guard? Is it the same now as it was then?
1111_0401_f_complete_a: Yes! Can you feel it, stranger? This is the moment. When I gaze through this glass, I look back across the ages to the time of… Ah!
1111_0401_f_complete_b: I see only darkness… a sky torn asunder. Strange alien landscapes despoiled by bile. The anguish of souls dispossessed…
1111_0401_f_complete_pt2_a: The depths are fathomless… blackness so deep it buries the spark of your spirit within its gloom. And at its center: rage! Endless burning rage!
1111_0401_f_complete_pt2_b: It is… the enemy! They are close. I believe that I glimpsed for a moment what will happen if we do not act quickly. The town must be prepared.
1111_0402_b_description: Defeat the Redeyes and destroy Spewspitter's emblem in New Balefire, then return to Gildon in Mourningdale.
1111_0402_c_proposal_a: An Ancient Lighthouse by the sea, calling like a siren. I believe the place is called “Bahia”. There is a totem there, screaming at its heart.
1111_0402_c_proposal_b: Silence its call. Before any more of our people are deceived.
1111_0402_c_proposal_pt2_a: My sight is limited by a pervasive influence, attempting to seal our fate in Mourningdale.
1111_0402_c_proposal_pt2_b: It's a Totem at the Bahia, a nexus of evil. It is your destiny to destroy it, {playerName}. Go and do so, with haste.
1111_0402_corruptedtotem_description: A wooden totem emanating a dark energy. It was held by the Corrupted.
1111_0402_e_incomplete: The scream still echoes through the souls of our neighbors, stranger. Make haste. No more may fall into the Corruption’s grip.
1111_0402_f_complete_a: The fog has lifted from my eyes. The blur of past, present - all run together - no longer haunts my waking hours. There is clarity, but also still questions.
1111_0402_f_complete_b: You have struck a blow against a powerful enemy this day. I only pray that it is enough. Return to Constable Bayles and tell him I am recovered.
1111_0402_f_complete_pt2_a: In time, I will recover. But time is a luxury we do not have. I must be strong. For all our sakes.
1111_0402_f_complete_pt2_b: Should my gift give me foreknowledge of the Corruption’s plans, the Constable will be the first to know.
1111_04_stranger_a: Within the visions, I saw a glimpse of something. A Watchman atop an Ancient Tower, ready to sound the alarm of the inevitable march.
1111_04_stranger_b: Yes… I sense that his watch never ended. Perhaps, like his brothers and sisters in arms he is still waiting. Waiting for the inevitable return of his foe.
1111_05_stranger_a: I think I have glimpsed something the enemy did not intend…
1111_05_stranger_b: There is a place not far from here… a place where the Corruption draws the unwary into their grasp, whispering false promises and seductions.
1111_06_stranger_a: You have my thanks. Not many would go to such lengths to aid a stranger.
1111_06_stranger_b: May your courage and perservence stand as an example for us all.
1122_00_innkeep: Welcome to the Weeping Pillow. This is the best place to stay when enjoying the Azoth-infused streams here in Mourningdale.
1123_0101_fq10_complete_available_respon: Hello there. Master Fisher Klaus at your service. You've got to be strong to take on the fish in these parts.
They learn to fight in these cold mountain waters, and you have to be ready for them.
1123_0101_fq10_incomplete: The coin is appreciated, but it is the transformative properties of azoth here that I believe make the fish of Aeternum more intelligent.
1123_0101_fq10_objective_desc: Catch a Treasure Chest for Master Fisher Abebe and present it to Master Fisher Klaus in Great Cleave.
1123_0101_fq10_proposal: In this land where rain pours eternal, there are many opportunities for fishing. There is something of greater value than the fish themselves lurking in the depths, though: Treasure chests.
1123_0101_fq10_proposal_next_a: Coins, jewels, and all kinds of precious artifacts.
1123_0101_fq10_proposal_next_b: Take your findings to Master Fisher Klaus in Great Cleave to remind him there's more to life than helping the Soulwardens.
1123_01_defaultdialogue: I'm Master Fisher Abebe of Mourningdale. I can train you in the ways of fishing.
1123_02_defaultdialogue: I'm Master Fisher Abebe of Mourningdale. I can train you in the ways of fishing.
1123_03_defaultdialogue: Greetings, friend. May your casts be far and your hook be true.
1124_0101_enpleinaire_complete_available: Ah, you're back! I'm burning with anticipation to read your contributions! Leilani's stories are wonderful, but she's retired. I yearn for new tales!
So you have! C'est bon! Now if you'll excuse me, it's time to drink in the sweetness of your poetry!
1124_0101_enpleinaire_description: Pierre Auguste would like new tales of Aeternum, but is too timid to travel himself. Write a collection of odes to the scenic locations described in Pierre's guidebook.
