11_mourningdale_body_01_01:
The legend that launched a thousand ships... So many have crashed on these shores in search of Azoth, with their crew cursed to live on this island...

Or, perhaps they aren't truly alive. Their souls, torn asunder, are absent from their bodies. They shuffle on the beach in a blue haze.

It's my duty to protect the people of Mourningdale from them, to keep us safe. And so, I watch.

-Antonio Guerra
11_mourningdale_body_01_02:
The pains of my soul are compounded here. I stand here, alone, against the waves of the ocean and the waves of the Drowned.

I know I must stand alone, at this tower, to keep our settlement safe. But this island... it tears my soul apart.

-Antonio Guerra
11_mourningdale_body_01_03:
I can feel my soul slipping from my being. It's a haunting feeling, one I've never experienced before.

Each time I wake, I feel my mind falling apart. My body grows sluggish, with the cats posing more of a threat. My watch of the beaches is beginning to see a bleeding red from the port. Maybe my entire watch may soon be for naught.

I can feel my body failing, and my soul drifting. I feel I may not be long for this world.

Wallace, forgive me. I've failed.

-Antonio Guerra
11_mourningdale_body_02_01: I've braved quite a number of skeletons while exploring here. I have to rest here to catch my breath. Most notable so far is the ruins of a statue in the middle of these ruins. Its face is split down the middle with a fine precision. Who could have had the ability to carve stone so precisely?\n\n-A.A.
11_mourningdale_body_02_02: Marvelous... This old fountain is no longer active, but its design is an enigma. There are clear signs that this was once used to dispense water: the stone that composes the spout is eroded in a pattern that suggests water flowed through it and into the basin, but the fountain itself does not seem to be connected to any aqueduct or water source of any kind. Most curious...\n\n-A.A.
11_mourningdale_body_02_03: Though its creators have seemingly long abandoned this structure, the lantern I've come across still glows an eerie blue. It should have expended its fuel ages ago. An energy swirls around it, an energy I've felt all over this island.\n\n-A.A.
11_mourningdale_body_02_04: The stones that make up this road are very similar to the stones that make up the various ruins in the Flooded Plains. They seem to be brimming with an energy that I've learned is called "Azoth." Now, when on a road, it matters less where you are and matters more where you are going. This road seems paved to go to the port in the northeast. What could the people who used this road intended it for?\n\n-A.A.
11_mourningdale_body_02_05: The skeletons that guard the road, and many other areas on this island, are quite curious. Though eternal life seems the blessing of anyone on this island, it seems we always revive with our bodies intact. These skeletons do seem to have an air of life about them, but they are all bone and no flesh. Even the tattered rags and armor they have may have outlasted their flesh. Just how old are they?\n\n-A.A.
11_mourningdale_body_03_01: get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out get me out
11_mourningdale_body_04_01: The ship crashed on the island after the Captain drove us directly into a storm. His eyes had a madness to them, darting back and forth, and he accused us of mutiny if we dared question him. He shot Christopher in the arm for speaking out of turn, and sent him back to work.
11_mourningdale_body_04_02: Shortly after we crashed, I witnessed a sight I hope to never see again. Lewis was impaled, thrown on a wooden plank that had splintered from the ship. He was writhing in pain, moaning for death, until he finally quieted down and expired. His body then... melted back into the sands. I felt mad just looking at it. Later that day, we found Lewis, guts intact, as if nothing had happened. Where the hell are we?
11_mourningdale_body_04_03: The crew needs me. For leadership, for guidance, to help them survive the sins I've committed. The promise of wealth on this island, it drove me mad. Though I have wronged my crew, I'll do right by them here. This beach shall be ours.
11_mourningdale_body_04_04: Some of us have decided to stay here, on the beach, in hopes that a ship may one day rescue us. The Captain remains hopeful, and fuels our will to survive. Some of us have decided to brave the perils of the island. Some come running back from the mainland, screaming of skeletons, and freaks with red eyes. Though we may waste away on this island, at least we do so with a sense of purpose and duty to each other...
11_mourningdale_body_05_01: I am left without my crew, without my vessel, and not a penny to my name. This island has taken everything away from me, but I'll be damned if I don't get it back. I came here for riches, and I'll get them.
11_mourningdale_body_05_02: My trek across the island has left me further debased, but I've found a group of missionaries here. Of all places? Missionaries? They speak of being blessed, that some god may have led me here. To their safety. Maybe so. But, I'm certain whatever led me here enticed me with the gold crosses they bear.
11_mourningdale_body_05_03: A few fake visions, some prophetic words, and speaking in tongues apparently a frenzy makes. The missionaries, and their followers, are all falling in line. I speak of the weird statues and gold on the island, and they practically throw the gold at me. I'm making them press them into medallions so that, when I get off this forsaken rock, I have a stock that only I can use. I just have to keep an eye on these simpletons. One wrong move and my con is over.
11_mourningdale_body_06_01: I've ventured away from my tower. The skeletons that occupy this tower may have the answers I seek. Why the beaches? What pulls boats to our shores, and with such severity that we Watchers exist? What role do I play in this grand scheme? Some may keep to their duty endlessly, even these skeletons do so. But, I must know.\n\n-Watcher Ronen
11_mourningdale_body_07_01: We angered the wrong people. These red, glowing freaks cornered us, and the little ammunition we brought didn't hold them off. They flayed Stanley right in front of us, and as he lie dying, his eyes turned red just like them. It's only a matter of time before they do the same to the rest of us.
11_mourningdale_body_07_02: The plan was to use this port to get some Azoth from the red-eyes and escape. We didn't know how quickly they'd find us, and how merciless they'd be. Maurice must be long gone, the lucky bastard.
11_mourningdale_body_07_03: Maurice, we'll use the boat to escape. Stay here until daybreak, not a moment later. We leave anyone who doesn't make it behind.
11_mourningdale_body_09_01:
There are fishing poles out there that can do incredible things, but none will ever be as lucky as mother's pole. I keep her, the pole I mean, in excellent repair and try my best not to die when I carry her with me. She has seen the walk from the settlement to my fishing spots more times than I can count, my constant companion both steadfast and true.

Mother withered long ago, but her last gift to me was the fishing pole she'd used to 'catch' father in the Old World. The bond between my parents was an unbreakable one, forged in fishing. When mother and I came to Aeternum after father's death she was never the same, losing herself death after death. She put herself in dangerous situations on purpose, and died more often than I could save her. Now she babbles nonsense and has joined the ranks of the withered. All I have left of my parents is this pole, and I treat it well.

I suppose you wouldn't care about this though, would you Davies? No, I don't think I shall send this letter.
11_mourningdale_body_09_02: The constant rain of Mourningdale makes for slippery, uneven ground. Grass often shifts under my boots, squelching and squishing in the mud.\n\nA Master Fisher needs a pair of sturdy, water-proof boots. I wear my late father's, though they are a size too big and often fill with rainwater around my ankles. No craftsperson in Aeternum could ever match the Old World stitching on these, and when I close my eyes it is as if father is with me. I fish in silence, guarded by memories and protected by my parents' last gifts to me.
11_mourningdale_body_09_03:
Have you ever stepped on a stone near the water only to have it slink away out from under you?

You may have encountered Hafgufa, then. This gigantic breed of fish uses the rock-like structures on its back to float near the surface and fool travelers into thinking they've stepped on steady ground. With how slippery the rocks are here in Mourningdale I must catch this Daemonaja before someone slips and breaks a neck.

Machera, do you have any thoughts on this?
11_mourningdale_body_10_01:
I've made good time on my first day on the road! I've found a nice campsite, and am enjoying my tea by the fire. 

What a life! I feel the vagabond life may suit me! The stars above are a million diamonds on a velvet sky. 

Tomorrow I shall visit the town of Amphus, famous for it's fudge!

Adventure, here I come!

Pierre-Auguste
11_mourningdale_body_10_02:
The dawn came with no fanfare, the sky is red with Corruption.

Everywhere that I have gone to the north here the Corrupt rule. They have driven the rest out.

It is a little concerning how pervasive they are. I came to visit a village, and found instead a warzone.

It would have put a damper on my walkabout, but I've found that most of these Corrupted are dimwitted and easy to evade.

The hounds sure keep me on my toes though! Tomorrow, the town of Ceremony!

Yours in adventure,
Pierre-Auguste
11_mourningdale_body_10_03:
It seems the whole of the north is spoilt!

So much that I came north to see is already lost to those Corrupted, I've been lucky to escape their grasp!

At first, they were a mere annoyance, but the farther north I travel, the worse they become.

They seem to be planting red pods all around, and where they are placed, the land is poisoned.

I've only one more stop on my trip planned, the great tree in the north! But by now, I fear I will be disappointed.

Yours in adventure,
Pierre-Auguste
11_mourningdale_body_11_01:
Hard working newcomer to town seeks employment in hospitality, scullery work, or security.

No housekeeping, laundry, or handmaidenry. 




Short-term, schedule should allow for daily workouts and sword training.

Inquire at the Inn.

L. Molefe
11_mourningdale_body_11_02:
Our hogs enjoy a special diet, receive daily deep-tissue massage, and enjoy a lullaby before bed each night to cultivate the most tender, succulent pork ever to be slow roasted over hardwood coals.


Nothing beats it after a long day on the road or hard at work! Try some today at your local kitchen!


Ask for Harunobu.
11_mourningdale_body_11_03:
Here's to the brave soul that helped me to find my way on the roads north of the Settlement!
You're a real inspiration. The muse will favor you, and in the end, I may write a song just about your great deeds!

There are still heroes in this world!

J. Jaanse
11_mourningdale_body_11_04:
Dear friend in song,

Thank you for all that you've done.

While you were away, I figured out a fundamental truth about the song I'd been hearing, and it has set me free.

Listen closely, perhaps the music will save you too.

J. Jaansen.
11_mourningdale_subtitle_10_01: Found at an old campsite along the road.
11_mourningdale_subtitle_10_02: Found in the town of Amphus
11_mourningdale_subtitle_10_03: Found in the town of Ceremony
11_mourningdale_subtitle_11_04: I've found the message in the song.
11_mourningdale_title_07_01: Between a Statue and a Hard Place
11_mourningdale_title_11_02: A New Flavor from the North!
1201_0104_shipsflag_description: A flag torn from a forlorn wreck [Mission Item]
1202_0403_factionhandoff_faction_board_o: Talk to your Faction Representative and View the Faction Board
1202_0403_factionhandoff_faction_mission: Complete One Faction Mission from the Faction Board, then report to the Magistrate
1202_0501_piratedweapons_description: A chest of well-used weapons that are waterlogged and falling apart.
1203_0301_healthysquash_description: Despite a little dirt and the stench of the Withered, this squash appears to be perfectly healthy.
1203_0302_bilegland_description: A foul-smelling gallbladder that still contains some bile.
1203_0302_healthycorn_description: A perfectly healthy ear of corn. Looks delicious.
1203_0401_tatteredsilk_description: Pieces of silk fabric that have been ripped in a struggle. They're perfect for crafty patchwork.
1204_0201_prizesquash_description: A crate of squashes that are unblemished and glowing. Who says you can't keep the rest for yourself?
1204_0202_farsidejam_description: The shade and soil of Arruda Ranch makes the best rhubarb jam. It is a treat in Monarch's Bluffs.
1205_0301_brokenweaponry_description: Low quality weapons that, despite light use, are completely destroyed. To have used them in battle would have been a death wish.
1205_0302_savillesbrooch_description: A weathered brooch adorned with precious gems. This belongs to a prominent family in Windsward.
1205_0303_bloodyheart_description: A large ruby known as a Bloody Heart. It throbs and pulses rhythmically.
1205_0501_ancientart02_description: An artifact of the Ancients. Artificer Gomes will be interested in it greatly.
1205_0501_ancientart_description: An artifact of the Ancients. Artificer Gomes will be interested in it greatly.
1207_0101_bloodore_description: A chunk of ore that has been soaked with blood. This will certainly pique Commander Purcell's interest.
1207_0101_seawater_description: Sea water tinted with trace amounts of azoth. A reminder of the sea that has a kick.
1208_0101_alchemycatalyst_description: A fine powder that's often used in alchemic experiments. Like salt, just a pinch goes a long way.
1208_0101_azothoil_description: Oil infused with Azoth that's often used in alchemic experiments. Alchemist Tuit will be glad to see this.
1209_0101_azothcrystal_description: A crystal cluster, tinted by azoth, that has a brilliant shine. Adjudicator Owgan will be pleased with these.
1209_0101_siltbootkeys_description: A rusty ring of keys claimed from a Siltboot Grenadier.
1209_0101_weatheredcharm_description: A charm once held dearly. The memories tied to this charm must be bittersweet.
1210_0101_devilhoney_description: Honey taken from Devil's Quarry. They say a spoonful satisfies the body and sunders the soul.
1210_0201_daggerwine_description: A flask of wine made to be concealed like a dagger, used often by the crew of The Dagger.
1210_0201_mistwine_description: Wine concealed in a gourd-shaped jug. The sailors of The Grey Mist used these jugs to represent luck.
1222_00_innkeep: Welcome to 'The Regent's Rise'! Sleep here and wake up feeling like a king! You here to check in? Be my guest… literally!
1222_03_innkeep_a: I've heard the talk around town, people saying things are safer around here.
1222_03_innkeep_b: Not sure I believe it. I might just pick up and head south one of these days.
1222_04_innkeep_a: You know, I'm never one to turn away a good paying customer.
1222_04_innkeep_b: But you've been here long enough - might want to look into buying a house, making this permanent.
1222_innkeep_whyhouse_response_a: I mean, you're always welcome here in the inn, but a house offers some amenities.
1222_innkeep_whyhouse_response_b: You can furnish the place, of course, and if you get yourself killed somehow, you can be resurrected right in the comfort of your own home!
1223_0101_fq05_complete_available_respon: Aha! Did you see that? I just fished up my biggest yet!...What's that? Oh, fish for food rations? I am a bit peckish.
1223_0101_fq05_incomplete: Don't give up now, recruit! Er, I mean, student!Catch fifteen fish for Master Fisher Perchal. She needs to eat!
1223_0101_fq05_objective_desc: Catch fifteen fish anywhere for Master Fisher Warwick and deliver to Master Fisher Perchal in Cutlass Keys.
1223_0101_fq05_proposal: The best training is hard, focused doing. You've fished up some bait and a few meager samplings of fish, but I want you to fully commit to catching fifteen fish.
1223_0101_fq05_proposal_next: Master Fisher Perchal can be distracted easily, and forgets to eat. Take your fish to her and she will be grateful.
1223_0101_fq05_proposal_prompt: "What should I do with all these fish?"
1225_00_giacomo_defaultdialog: Who knew that getting stabbed would hurt so much! Even on this island where death holds no sway, the dying still hurts!
1225_0101_downpayment_campsitelorea: Search for the 'Traitor's Path' journal entry
1225_0101_downpayment_campsiteloreb: Search for the 'Burning Greed' journal entry
1225_0101_downpayment_complete_available: Is that my notebook? Oh, grazie! And what of those bastardi who stabbed me and stole it?
The one who had it was Corrupted! Hah! A fitting end to his greed and treachery!
Now the work begins! The safety of a Traveler's Rest will welcome those weary from their journeys.
My goal is for everyone on Aeternum to have a home of their own. And to that end, take this for your own home, friend.
1225_0101_downpayment_goto_campsite1: Search for the traitors first campsite
1225_0101_downpayment_goto_campsite2: Continue tracking the traitors to the second campsite
1225_0101_downpayment_goto_chasoncamp: Search for the traitors camp in Chason Steep
1225_0101_downpayment_goto_chasonsteep: Follow the traitors to Chason Steep
1225_0101_downpayment_incomplete: Your aid is welcome, friend. Once we have my notebook, I have such plans. It will change all of Aeternum! And you will be greatly rewarded, fear not!
1225_0101_downpayment_interact_chasoncam: Investigate the chest in the abandoned camp
1225_0101_downpayment_objective_desc: Track down the workers who betrayed Giacomo
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_a: A place of rest for weary travelers, of course! I am Giacomo Altoviti, architect. Perhaps you have heard of me? No?
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_b: Well, you would have if my workmen hadn't stabbed me in the back - literally - and run off with my design notebook and tools.
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_next2_a: The bastardi left me with nothing. But you're here, so there's hope! The Innkeep saw workers a few days ago discussing a notebook of 'secrets.' Suspicious, no?
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_next2_b: If you begin the hunt, I'll finish business here and follow!
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_next2_pro: "Is that why your workmen betrayed you?"
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_next_a: So many survivors on this island have no home, no roots. I long to provide that for them.
1225_0101_downpayment_proposal_next_b: Safety is always the biggest concern. I can create that safety, on a much smaller scale.
1225_0101_giacomonotebook_description: A notebook filled with complex calculations, notes, and architectural sketches.
1225_01_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: Miserable thieves! Killing me is one thing, but stealing my life's work? Idioti! It was my own fault. Foolish, Giacomo! Curse my trusting soul! This means no Traveler's Rest…
1225_01_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: It was my own fault. Foolish, Giacomo! Curse my trusting soul! This means no Traveler's Rest...
1225_0201_majorpurchase_complete_availab: Good friend, you have returned! And looking stronger and more prosperous than before. You have made your purchase, yes?
Bravo! Now you see that everything is better with a home. With that understanding, we may continue our relationship.
Oh, and here's a little housewarming gift. Congratulazioni!
"It took some time, but I now have a home."
1225_0201_majorpurchase_incomplete: Raising the capital for your first home may not be easy, but I promise you, the benefits are worthwhile.
1225_0201_majorpurchase_objective_desc: Purchase a home, and place some decorations within
1225_0201_majorpurchase_proposal_a: It is sanctuary! A haven that beckons after a long day. It anchors you to the land. And spirit shrines can deposit you gently inside from anywhere on the island!
1225_0201_majorpurchase_proposal_b: To truly understand, you must purchase a home of your own.
1225_0201_majorpurchase_proposal_next_a: Friend, opportunity abounds here! Look around and you'll find prospects for coin.
1225_0201_majorpurchase_proposal_next_b: Once you have a home, use the furniture I've given you. Create your own space. Then return, for more work remains to be done!
1225_0201_majorpurchase_purchase_house: Buy a house and raise your decoration score above 1
1225_02_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: You're cunning and resourceful. I like that. But do you truly understand my work? Four walls, a roof? That's not a home! Safety, warmth, comfort. Now that's a home!
1225_02_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: Four walls, a roof? That's not a home! Safety, warmth, comfort. Now that's a home!
1225_0301_freshwitheredblood_description: A flask of fresh Withered blood.
1225_0301_freshwitheredbones_description: A long bone, pulled from the body of a defeated Withered.
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_complete_a: Welcome to the site of the first Traveler's Rest! It may not seem much right now, but I promise you... it will be! Now, have you gathered those grisly bits I needed?
Perfetto, grazie! Wait, this is my recipe... how did this...? It must have fallen from my notebook during my retreat.
Thank the Madonna you found this! Eh, it seems the recipe requires more than just the blood and bone.
"I have what you needed, and more."
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_goto_orcha: Travel to {POITags} to collect Fresh Withered Bones for Giacomo
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_goto_shatt: Travel to {POITags} to collect Fresh Withered Blood for Giacomo
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_incomplete: To be honest, I'm not entirely certain how the bones and blood will work, but my Survivalist friend swears by it. I figured better safe than sorry, no?
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_objective_: Travel to Shatterwall and the Fong Family Orchard to collect fresh Withered blood and bones for Giacomo
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_proposal_a: Eh, of a sort. I have selected the site to prepare the foundation, but I'll need a few things.
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_proposal_b: An associate in First Light gave me a recipe to work the blood and bones of those Withered... things... into the mortar.
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_proposal_n: It acts as a repellent. I tried getting these items myself but an architect has limits. I'm certain you're up to the task!
Nearby are two locations that should suffice. Meet me at the site when you've acquired what's needed.
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_proposal_p: "Why in the world do we need that?"
1225_0301_insuringinvestmenta_search_for: Search the farmhouse for the "Defense Against the Withered" journal entry
1225_0302_gravenettles_description: A bundle of nettles retrieved from the dirt of a gravesite.
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_complete_a: See my accomplishment? Amazing progress, no? The foundation is almost finished.
I even had time to add storage for supplies! Did you recover the Grave Nettles?
Bravo! Perfetto! Working these into the floor and walls should keep those terrible spirits from intruding on our guests.
Oh, and the storage I mentioned? You can add this to your own home! Try it with this!
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_goto_nettl: Travel to {POITags} to harvest Grave Nettles for Giacomo
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_incomplete: Scuse, I do not mean to impose on you, but I am certain that when you see the result, you will be amazed.
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_objective_: Gather Grave Nettles from Nettlerest Graveyard, and bring them back to Giacomo
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_proposal_a: Si, a plant that grows on and around gravesites. Some people still go through the ceremony for those who have become Lost.
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_proposal_b: There is a graveyard east of here that should have what we need.
1225_0302_insuringinvestmentb_proposal_n: Eh, no, my talents lie in building not fighting. Besides, I should prepare the foundation and have it ready for your return.
1225_03_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: Now, on to business. Walls are simply not enough to provide safety here. The ruins on this island are a testament to that. For the Traveler's Rest to be successful, there must be more.
1225_03_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: For the Traveler's Rest to be successful, there must be more.
1225_0401_giacomocompass_description: An ornate compass with silver inlay, engraved with the letters 'GA'.
1225_0401_siteinspection_build_structure: Complete the construction of Traveler's Rest
1225_0401_siteinspection_complete_availa: Magnifico! Now, travelers have a haven from the dangers and horrors of this island. This is my dream: a home for all who need it.
Which we must share! My part is to build more homes as soon as I restock. As for you, my thanks are insufficient. Take this, please. It's the least I can do.
If I may, I will seek you out again if I need assistance.
1225_0401_siteinspection_goto_highpassca: Travel south and search for the traitor
1225_0401_siteinspection_incomplete: I've almost exhausted my stockpile. But I have confidence you'll handle matters swiftly, and return with good news and packs of supplies!
1225_0401_siteinspection_objective_desc: Gather the construction materials for Giacomo, and investigate the information on the next traitor
1225_0401_siteinspection_proposal_a: Si, si! I'm also running short of materials. I had planned this project with a work crew behind me, but we saw how that turned out.
1225_0401_siteinspection_proposal_b: Well, until it is completed, someone must remain here to defend the site. I have a list of what I need, if you're willing?
1225_0401_siteinspection_proposal_next_a: Grazie mille, friend! Here is the materials list, along with information about that miserable thief.
1225_0401_siteinspection_proposal_next_b: Perhaps this one will sing, and reveal their motives, as well as where they've taken my tools!
1225_0401_siteinspection_search_for_note: Search for the "Voices in the Wind" journal entry
1225_0401_siteinspection_talkto_giacomo2: Those idioti are after money? That's all? Money was never the goal! I'm doing this for everyone on Aeternum! Not just the wealthy!
In any case, would you help me with the last stages of the building?
1225_0401_siteinspection_talkto_giacomo_: Bentornato! You come with many gifts! And you faced that scoundrel and recovered my compass! Sei magnifico!
Ah, my mamma gave me this compass when I embarked on my voyage... I wish I could see her again…
1225_0401_siteinspection_tracker_talkto_: Return to Giacomo with the materials and his compass
1225_04_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: Thanks to your keen eye, I can get started. Eh dannazione! According to this, blood and bones will only defend against the Withered's physical forms. There are still spirits to address. Eh, Grave Nettles would do the trick.
1225_04_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: There are still spirits to address. Eh, Grave Nettles would do the trick.
1225_0501_ancientprotectstone_descriptio: A small stone that soothes, calms, and protects.
1225_0501_defiantichor_description: A thick ooze that resists even being placed in a container.
1225_0501_etchedguardiangem_description: A gem once held by an Ancient Guardian, etched with a protective sigil.
1225_0501_mandatoryimprovements_complete: Bentornato! And just in time! This road is well-traveled. I've had my hands full keeping the less friendly sorts away.
Were you able to create the stones as I asked?
Bravo, amico! If only I'd found you instead of those idioti, this would've been done months ago.
Again, grazie, . You are a blessing to all good souls. Per favore, take this as a small token of thanks.
1225_0501_mandatoryimprovements_craft_it: Craft the Ancient Protection Stones at an Arcane Repository
1225_0501_mandatoryimprovements_incomple: Because I am cautious, there are a few steps not in that recipe that I'll keep secret… at least for now. But in time, I'll share my knowledge. But not for a profit!
1225_0501_mandatoryimprovements_objectiv: Collect the materials for Giacomo's recipe, then craft the Ancient Protection Stones at an Arcane Repository
1225_0501_mandatoryimprovements_proposal: Listen carefully - I've rediscovered how the Ancients protected some of their sites. Ah! Ah!
This secret could better safeguard the Traveler's Rest! It could change the future of Aeternum!
Certo! You see, the Ancients created protection stones for their sites. Unfortunately, I used the last of mine to surround the first Traveler's Rest.
If I give you this recipe, would you craft more for me?
1225_0501_startouchedwater_description: A vial of water collected from pools near starmetal deposits.
1225_05_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: Ah, my good and dear friend! You have returned at the perfect time! I continue to make progress, but two problems have arisen: I received word from Cutlass Keys that another of my treacherous workmen was spotted in the area.
1225_05_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: I continue to make progress, but two problems have arisen: I received word from Cutlass Keys that another of my treacherous workmen was spotted in the area.
1225_0601_closingcost_complete_available: Friend! Any news? You found him! What did that scoundrel say when faceded with his crimes? E fatta. He got what he deserved.
My plumbum! I'm surprised that he kept it. This was a gift from my good friend and teacher, Giulio.
Grazie. You have been more than a friend. These trophy pieces may not be much, but they are given with affection!
1225_0601_closingcost_find_lorepage: Search the campsite for the "Chasing the Ancients" journal entry
1225_0601_closingcost_goto_sunadire: Seek any signs of Airic Niclisson in {POITags}
1225_0601_closingcost_incomplete_a: Just preparing for the road, then I'm on my way. I hope to find Airic myself. But I'm uncertain what to do then.
1225_0601_closingcost_incomplete_b: At least find out what happened to the rest of my tools... beyond that, who knows? Good luck to you, friend!
1225_0601_closingcost_investigate_io2: Search the abandoned pack near the edge of Hibbotsfeld
1225_0601_closingcost_objective_desc: Track down Airic Niclisson, the leader of those who betrayed Giacomo
1225_0601_closingcost_proposal_a: Si, Airic Niclisson, the foreman of my treacherous crew. I'm certain he was the mastermind of their scheme.
1225_0601_closingcost_proposal_b: The trouble is, I've received no word of him, which means the scoundrel is hiding.
1225_0601_closingcost_proposal_next_a: I've put the word out for any information. But this time, I must be involved. I'll travel north and try to find anything there.
1225_0601_closingcost_proposal_next_b: You should check with Innkeep Lam in Mourningdale. She'll know of anyone strange in the area.
1225_0601_closingcost_talkto_innkeep: Speak with Innkeep Lam in the Mourningdale settlement for any information about Airic's whereabouts
1225_0601_closingcost_talkto_innkeep_res: I wondered if he'd come himself. Glad he was smart and sent someone more capable.
The man he's searching for passed through recently. Said he was looking for Ancient artifacts for some project. He headed northeast.
1225_0601_closingcost_talkto_innkeep_sta: Welcome to Lam's Retreat. This is the best place to stay when enjoying the Azoth-infused streams here in Mourningdale.
1225_0601_giacomoplumbum_description: A lead weight on a line, used to ensure proper vertical lines on structures.
1225_06_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: We've done something wonderful here, you and I. I'll tell others and invite them to rest. Then the work continues! The future of this island will improve. You have the word of Giacomo Altoviti!
1225_06_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: Then the work continues! The future of this island will improve. You have the word of Giacomo Altoviti!
1225_07_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: Bravo! You've found me again! As you can see, I've found another location.
1225_07_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: This time I planned ahead and brought everything I needed... except... well, I will trust you with this revelation.
1225_08_giacomo_defaultdialog_a: For now, two sites for the Traveler's Rest will have to do. I've delayed dealing with Airic long enough. It's time he answers for his betrayal. You've already dealt with two of the traitors... I ask for your help with their leader.
1225_08_giacomo_defaultdialog_b: You've already dealt with two of the traitors... I ask for your help with their leader.
1225_09_giacomo_defaultdialog: The problems with my treacherous workmen are finished. But the journey toward Aeternum's future is just beginning!
1225_giacomo_housinggeneral_prompt: "What's so great about owning a house?"
1225_giacomo_housinggeneral_response_a: Mah! Now, what kind of question is that? What's not great about homeownership?
1225_giacomo_housinggeneral_response_b: A place to store your belongings, a reliable place to fast travel and respawn. Why, it's simply madness not to own a home if you have the gold.
1225_giacomo_housingstorage_prompt: "What did you mean about storage for my home?"
1225_giacomo_housingstorage_response_a: Storage? You know, places to store your things?
1225_giacomo_housingstorage_response_b: When you place that chest I gave you into your home, you'll have even more room to store whatever you need - armor and weapons, furnishings, herbs and spices… whatever you fancy!
1225_giacomo_housingtrophy_response_a: I can't make them all that well, but with some effort on your part, you should be able to.
1225_giacomo_housingtrophy_response_b: They provide a link to the island itself, and provide benefits that you can't otherwise obtain. Even better, the benefits follow wherever you are!
12_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_a: Ever wonder why they say 'knight in shining armor'? They could have said 'knight in broken armor', 'knight with rusted sword'.
12_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_b: No, to be a hero, you've got to dress like one. Let me help you.
12_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: A true diva never reveals their secrets, honey. Especially to strangers, no matter how cute the strangers are.
12_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: Visit me more and then maybe I'll tell you how I do this.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_01_05: Our crops continue to rot as villagers leave one by one. Those who were stubborn enough to stay are now too stubborn to leave. Those foolish enough to eat these crops turn gravely ill. All our harvests fail, what did we do to deserve this blight? \n\n- F. Sneed
12_monarchsbluffs_body_01_06: I sense that the lightning storm was merely the beginning of the end for our lives here. We've had vicious attacks from these... monsters. Husks that seem human, but only ravage and destroy. The remaining families have lost members in the attacks, and we survivors are now forced to flee this area. We have no choice but to leave. \n\n- F. Sneed
12_monarchsbluffs_body_01_07: We've had some luck to move farther north. We've found fertile land and decided to rebuild. Nestled within the crags that surround it, we soon saw a small lake as a respite in our journey and replanted our crops. Scorching our tools, we found that fire cleansed them of the stench of the blight. We remain vigilant in how we use the soil. But, we are unsure if those freaks with the red eyes will find us here, too. Mayhap it is only a matter of time...\n\n-F. Sneed
12_monarchsbluffs_body_01_08:
No matter how far we go, the monsters do not leave us. They’ve taken to attacking in hordes, storming the farms, wasting everything in their wake. 

But the fates aren’t entirely cruel. We have the support of a knight. He tells us how to hide and how to ambush them. He holds them back with his trusty cannon. 

We will work together and we’ll all live to see another day. We will not succumb. 

– F. Sneed
12_monarchsbluffs_body_01_09:
The attacks begin again, but none of us were under the naive impression that those fiends would leave us alone. 

Those of us that have survived these attacks have decided to make for the settlement of Prydwen. It is the last judgement for us, and this may be our only salvation. 

- F. Sneed
12_monarchsbluffs_body_03_01: I don't think I can take much more of this. I try my best to craft weapons for these insolent pirates, and all I am met with are more demands from this mad Captain! All he wants is more shine, more gilded handles... I am collecting my due fees, and quite a handsome pay at that, but I shall decidedly not put my mark on these weapons. In fact, I would be ashamed to admit these trinkets are my own work!\n\n-L. Harrison, Master Artificer
12_monarchsbluffs_body_03_02: The damn weapons won't even fire! What use are these damn things if they're nothing but pretty toys!
12_monarchsbluffs_body_04_01:
The Master Builder is depending on us for ore. The settlement won’t be able to defend itself without a timely supply. 

We scraped together what iron we could and sent that with a few of our brothers. But the way that the Lost are crowding the mines? They may not be able to make it. 

Whatever Gods there are on Aeternum, I hope they guide their way! 

– Elias
12_monarchsbluffs_body_04_02:
Quite curious is the case of the creatures in this mine! As some lucky adventurers have discovered, these fiends do in fact eat any gems they find. One could hypothesize that in life they worked these mines, once a rich source of precious stones on Aeternum. However, one must ask, why do they eat them? The idea I propose is based on their patterns of hoarding! They must have some semblance of the value of these stones and, in a lust to hoard wealth, they put such small stones into the safest place they can muster: their own bodies!

Finding precious gems in the belly of these poor wretches is still rare. Some guess that only one in a group of ten Withered may have a gem in their belly. With that in mind, good luck! You may need it.

-Dr. H. Garrison
12_monarchsbluffs_body_05_01: Some madman attacked me! He was crazed and wild, with red eyes that struck fear in my heart. I held him back with my pitchfork, and he ran away. The stink coming off of him is one I will not soon forget. Now, that stench won't come off my pitchfork no matter how many times I wash it.\n\n- M. Barovier
12_monarchsbluffs_body_06_01: Now I see what Thorton was talking about in her last letter. These Ancient Guardians are ferocious, suspended in undeath to guard the ruins of a society we may never understand. Well, out with the old and in with the new as I always say. I will try to cull as many Ancient Guardians as I can while out hunting so that Survivalist Thorton might have some relief from their blockades. If only I had someone to help with this...
12_monarchsbluffs_body_06_02: Those bastards! Those dastardly, villainous fiends! The mace-wielding miscreants of Archernar killed me, and even worse, they damaged my pants! This is Azoth-infused silk, and incredibly hard to come by. It isn't easy being the most fashion-forward Survivalist of all the settlements but it's a title with which I find immense pride. I will have my revenge for this affront to my aesthetics.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_07_01:
Coming to this island was a mistake. I came to this island seeking fortune and riches. But, I was misled. This place is no heaven...

As I lie here, dying, I feel my soul leaving this husk. Ah, is this how it felt Faustus? To have body and soul ripped to pieces by the claws of fiends?

Maybe, like Faustus, my fate was sealed when I signed to come to this place. Maybe coming to this island was both my sin and my punishment.

Oh, Margarete...

- N. Leevs
12_monarchsbluffs_body_08_01: I hear his footsteps coming closer, his boots booming against the wooden planks beneath me... He'll make quick work of the flimsy door and barricade I've created. Montore has gone mad. He's slaughtered his own crew as we crashed on the island. But, more terrifying than that, the dead sailors around me seem to come back to life. Their eyes are empty, twisted by Montore's madness. I hide here, but I know that I too will meet the same fate. This entire expedition was doomed. - Helvan
12_monarchsbluffs_body_12_01:
Out by the coast she still lurks, evading me at every turn. I know I had her on my hook once or twice, for her favorite bait is glowworms and I have them in great supply.

I know it's the same Ray-Finned Barb. I've taken to calling her 'Nibbler' for the way she toys with my bobber before I can properly hook her. This one is too smart for her own good. Nibbler must be a lady, for you see it is the female Barb who hulks over the male in size, and her wit is mighty quick.

But I shall not let her outswim or outsmart me. I'll get her one day, and mount her on my home wall. One day, Nibbler, you shall be mine... - Q. Warwick
12_monarchsbluffs_body_12_02:
If you give a man a fish you feed him for a day, but if you teach a man to fish you feed him for a lifetime. Or at least that's what Papa said.

That is why I taught all my subordinates in the army the essential skill of fishing. It's why I continue to teach fishing even in my retired living. It is not only a pleasurable hobby but a means of survival here in Aeternum. Fish are food, and food is life.

- Q. Warwick
12_monarchsbluffs_body_13_01:
Stinky,
We were hoping you'd join our hunt, but your odor is spooking all the game. So we're heading out on our own.
Don't know what you've got spoiling in them guts of yours, but you can expel it in solitude. We've had enough of it!
Once we've bagged a bear or two, we'll be back to let you out. Hopefully, your arse will have said its piece by then.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_14_01:
Captain Capili
First Mate Tupu
Chief Technical Officer Salesa
Second Mate Hoapili
Navigator Eketone
Boatswain Arona
Rigger Hamakua
Surgeon Kekai
Engineer Lavea
Gunner Fiso
Quartermaster Sapani
Cook Rata
Messman Pihopa
12_monarchsbluffs_body_14_02:
- Three crates of bullion
- Hardtack rations
- Two reels of parchment
- Thirteen hatchets
- Fifteen bows
- Five crates of arrows
12_monarchsbluffs_body_14_03: Day 13:\nMutiny is upon us. Boatswain Arona has gotten it into everyone's heads that the ship would be better run by him and the whispers of dissent have grown to a dull roar belowdecks. I will have to reinstate my authority by any means necessary if we are to reach our destination in time.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_15_01: In th' beginning, there was naught but formless energy. A material energy, though sublime. An ethereal fire. Within the fire was contained all life, every thought, every impulse. When bullet or lead ball be fired, therein do an infinite power of impulse reside. A single second, betwixt thy click of a hammer and thy mighty spark's ignition be where secrets of the universe hide. The Island has given me sight. Every death and every return, I see our purpose yet clearer. Listen to me true story, and believe! - Captain L. Wright
12_monarchsbluffs_body_15_02: In the Before, was I a humble pirate warlord. My ships numbered hundreds and every nation was afeared. How little did I know, me true path had yet been revealed. Me First Mate, family on th' high seas, had raised mutiny. I had no choice. So sadly, had I no choice but to execute the poor soul on sight. Without a sea breeze of a second, I barely thought and fired. A click. An explosion. The cool sizzle of th' exhausted barrel. Saw the universe explode before my very eyes! That was the day, I always say, that I became a Master Cannoneer. - Captain L. Wright
12_monarchsbluffs_body_15_03: I once felt the life in my veins. Was electric. But to be truly Lost... is electricity and a strange numbness at the same time. With every death, me spark mixes with something alien and divine. And when the dream ends, ye wake up on th' shores of yer long-lost passing. Again and again and again. Every journey be breathless and infinite! Every moment awake is a gift! And a poisoned fruit. I've seen the end though! I've seen when the spark gives up! There be nothing left but formless energy! Ethereal fire! It only takes time! And time, I think, is all we have. - Captain L. Wright
12_monarchsbluffs_body_15_04: Loyal comrades! Faithful friends! Join! Submit to the Cannon. Submit to th' bullet, gunpowder, and musket. Join and be shown yer truest path. Path to enlightenment, and th' only way we ever escape this godforsaken Island. Join and I shalt carry ye beyond thy veil. Through dusk and moonlight's peak, where we may all rest… Join me and find eternal freedom! - Captain L. Wright
12_monarchsbluffs_body_16_01:
Laikina,

I left town at twilight, to avoid a scene with Constable Saville. But she was there, waiting at the gate, like she knew my thoughts. “Such a shame to see you go,” she said. “Monarch's Bluffs will surely miss you.”

A perfectly normal thing to say. For the hundredth time, I wonder if the things I saw Saville do that night were just a nightmare. I can hear your voice, telling me that I'm being too paranoid.

I find myself watching her. She seems so normal, wrapped up in the petty concerns of the settlement. But sometimes…I catch a flash of it in her eyes, when she looks at me. Maybe it's always been there. Or maybe she sees me as a threat, now.

I'm coming to Windsward. If I head straight east all night, I should be able to get there by daybreak. The terrors of the nighttime wilds are nothing, compared to what I'm leaving behind.

I'm looking forward to a fresh start.

-Christopher
12_monarchsbluffs_body_16_02:
From the desk of Constable Saville:

Christopher Ward has vanished from Monarch's Bluffs. His house was found emptied of all belongings. His soul has not returned home. None of the other settlements, nor any of the Watchers, have seen hide nor hair of him. 

I must note Christopher had been acting strangely in the days leading up to his disappearance. He seems to have fallen victim to some kind of paranoid delusion. I even caught him peering into my window late at night.

Disappearances are, of course, nothing new in Aeternum. There are many dangers that await the underprepared and the overly-curious. Still, as the Constable of this settlement, I feel somewhat responsible. In the end, Christopher simply wouldn't heed my warnings.

Unless further evidence turns up, Mr. Ward is presumed Lost or Corrupted. I'll ask Adjudicator Owgan add his name to the Covenant prayer list of wayward souls.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_17_01:
--gave me news of this “High King’s” arrival. I am told it was nothing short of miraculous. His vessel seemed undamaged and of a strange design. It was said to shine with a blinding light. I doubt this to be true but these stories are spreading.

Whoever he fancies himself to be, he will no doubt prove a threat to your lordship’s dominion over these lands. I counsel you to gather your warriors and go to meet this potential usurper. I shall send word to the other lords. Perhaps united we can prevent calamity-- 

(No signature but the author was a high-ranking military officer who served a noble named Darius a thousand years ago.)
12_monarchsbluffs_body_17_02:
The High King’s magician has knowledge of an incantation that gives him mastery over the strange power of this land. I have never witnessed such a thing. Could he have discovered the secrets of the Ancients? How did he accomplish this so quickly?

Only a few words are known to me. It’s ancient Celtic. It speaks of a “serpent’s breath” and a “twilight realm” and of “folk of light and shadow.” 

I must learn the secrets of this charm. With its power I could change our fortunes.

Amaranth the Raven-Haired
12_monarchsbluffs_body_17_03:
I held the Eternal Blade in my hands. I could not identify the metal. It was lighter than steel and glittered like polished silver. I would swear it hummed. 

The High King bid me strike an old anvil with the edge. I dared not until he commanded it. Gripping it firmly, I smote the anvil and sheared away its heel in one stroke.

The Eternal Blade bore no mark. Its edge remained keen as a razor. By God, I will never see its equal. 

Master Auric
12_monarchsbluffs_body_17_04:
Dearest Maeve, 

It is my hope that this finds you in good health.

The High King’s call has gone out. He summons all to his banner, to build a great kingdom where all may prosper.

Even though I possess no great strength of arms or cunning with magic, even the mightiest warriors and wisest wizards will have need of tables, chairs, and beds when they are weary from their toil.

If the High King can keep us safe from the horrors that roam this land, I will gladly pledge myself to him.

It is my fervent desire, my beloved sister, that you will choose to join me in this worthy cause.

Cullum
12_monarchsbluffs_body_18_01:
Our work on the Great Wall continues. I have met master masons from every known land. The collection of knowledge and skill assembled here astonishes me. 

The High King’s wizard uses his craft to help us rebuild and fortify these ancient stones. He speaks of an evil that gathers in the north. We have seen more of those crimson demons. We must be ready for what is coming.

Connor Hewer, Master Mason
12_monarchsbluffs_body_18_02:
The High King’s wizard fancies himself Taliesin of the old legends. He is cunning to be sure, and possesses knowledge of the Ancients unknown to us. He wields a staff of intricate design that allows him to manipulate the magic of this land. He claims he will pass on this knowledge to others. He has already taken on many apprentices. 

I believe he harbors a secret desire in his heart. The people give him their trust but I feel this wizard will bring doom to us all. The evil of this land will taint him. I must learn his secrets before it is too late.

Amaranth the Raven-Haired
12_monarchsbluffs_body_18_03:
The High King has commanded that the stars be carefully measured and charted. I will do my part in this endeavor for I believe the answers to this world’s mysteries can be found in the heavens. The Sumerians, Greeks, and Persians knew this to be true. The Ancients knew this as well as evidenced by their study of the stars.

But Myrddin advises caution. He claims that just as we gaze out into the vast darkness, so too does it gaze back at us. He warns us to be forever vigilant for evil does not sleep.

Estere
12_monarchsbluffs_body_19_01:
Myrddin cast me out of the Order. He accused me of deceit and of sowing the seeds of discord. But I have spoken the truth. I know the evil that has taken root in his mind. I see what he is becoming. 

The others will not heed my warnings. Fools! The fall of the High King will be on their heads! I do not possess the strength to challenge Myrddin directly, but I must try to foil his purpose for the sake of us all. 

I will plead my case directly to the High King. I have found the “Folk of Light and Shadow.” They may prove to be allies. It is my fervent hope the High King is as wise as they say.

Amaranth the Raven-Haired
12_monarchsbluffs_body_19_02:
God’s blood! Waves of demons crash upon us with the fury of a storm. They strike where we are weakest. We cannot hold them! Our fortifications crumble!                                                                                                       

We’ve been betrayed! The Crimson Sorcerer has revealed himself. It is said he commands the infernal hordes. God in heaven, we are lost!

The High King has retreated to the shore. They say the Raven-Haired fights by his side. May God see him safely away from this accursed island! And may He have mercy on our souls…  

Captain Ulfric
12_monarchsbluffs_body_19_03:
The demons have overrun the land, slaughtering every living soul. A lucky few may have found the peace of eternal death. The rest have joined the ranks of the Withered or been twisted into fell shapes.

We have taken refuge here but it’s only a matter of time before we are discovered. Even if we are not, our stores of food and water dwindle. A few of us shall have to venture out in a few days.

How could we have come to this? The High King’s promise of a fair world has been shattered. This land exists under a curse which cannot be lifted. I dared to hope and dream. Now, I pray I can forget…  

Cullum
12_monarchsbluffs_body_20_01:
These altars in Khalladan, seem to have some power over the Lost. “Power” might be the wrong word. But definitely some kind of influence.

I can use Younge Geiser’s notes to figure out how to channel their essence. And if I can’t tap into their magic, maybe I can convey them to where they’ll be most useful.

I must think this plan through to support my True King in the way he deserves. Only then, can I join him.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_20_02:
The Ancients clearly had ways of controlling the Guardians. I wonder if it’s the same magic that powers the altars.

I found runes here that light up when the Lost come near them. Maybe there are more objects like these within the nearby ruins of Antares, so I shall continue my search there.

For the true heir and the restoration of Prydwen's glory, we will find a way to unite behind the royal bloodline once again.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_20_03:
The legends are true! I just needed to replicate that stone tablet.

I had to bind and kill the poor young squire nearly a dozen times before he finally surrendered his soul, but after he fell... he was easy to control. He will walk to wherever this replica is placed.

And this sphere, a tiny thing with tremendous power! Having this power in the palm of my hand will be an immense boon to my objective. I will make myself a staff from it, a fitting accessory for the right hand of the True King.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_20_04:
The knights are loyal to the True Heir. He was after all, Artorius’ most trusted knight and nephew, the one who the High King himself put in charge of the circle.

Ser Gawain looks at me, now, trusting me with his power. He commands me without words.

Our path is set. He will be crowned with the Circlet of Swords, and watch as the Lost multiply and submit to his glory.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_21_01:
You’ve caused me so much worry, Olive. I near fainted when your mother told me she was having you. I panicked when you first became a woman. I still remember the red everywhere. I couldn’t sleep all night when you stayed at the house of that fellow you were smitten with.

You stole my heart, when you first clutched my thumb as a baby. Your eyes spoke volumes even then. They spoke to me when you didn’t know words. Later, they spoke to me when you didn’t have the right ones.

Your eyes were always a stormy blue sky. I’ve tried to capture their color in my final glasswork. There’ll be no more after this.

- M. Barovier
12_monarchsbluffs_body_21_02:
I miss my little Olive. I hope you’re happy. Are you taking care of your health? Are you earning well? You should come home if you need money or food. This house is yours as well.

When did you grow up so much that you forgot me? You could come home, greet your poor old father, ask me how I am doing. I am not doing well. How could I be happy when you’re not with me?

- M. Barovier
12_monarchsbluffs_body_21_03:
I’ve not been a good father, Olive. I never should have raised my hand to you. I’d cut off that hand if it meant you’d forgive me, come back to me.

Life hasn’t been easy without your mother. She was always the smart one. Every decision I make without her scares me.

But I don’t love crafting glass more than I love you. Crafting glass was just easier. And I am a lazy fool. I took the easier path. Maybe you were right to leave. But would you come back and forgive your ailing father?

- M. Barovier
12_monarchsbluffs_body_22_01:
Darling Edda,

You know I hate writing but I thought this would be a nice surprise. You’re a strong, kind, wonderful woman and I feel stupidly lucky that I can call you mine. 

Do you remember when we first came here? You got so excited by the silkweed and wirefiber! You made so many garments, I barely had any place to sit. 

If I could gift you anything, it’d be that excitement again.



Your Loving Husband,
Edwyn
12_monarchsbluffs_body_24_01:
Greetings, my beautiful wife. I'm enjoying another sunny day by the farms. The haunted Lost and the groaning beasts are keeping me company. The guys and I joke and lollygag while we wait for the uglies to show their faces. We can hear them from a mile away.

I’m eating well and I’m healthy as a horse. The farmers are taking good care of me. The only downside is not having you here in my arms but I’ll rectify that soon.


All My Love,
Symon.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_24_02: Today is the 3rd day of winter. The Lost aren’t receding. They do not sleep and they do not die. They’re slowly wearing out the men. If even Symon can get turned, what hope is there for any of us? \n\nI wish I could see Marietta again, even if just one more time. We had a hasty marriage, sanctified by a cleric named Dayo. I promised her we’d have a huge celebration at Geertie’s when I got back. Ach, the universe must be laughing.
12_monarchsbluffs_body_25_01:
Minister Lochnir,

Why aren’t you responding to my missives? We’re being overrun by the Lost! My miners are not equipped enough to fight all of them off. We need help immediately or we will LOSE the mines.

Send every knight available and hasten to the mines.


-	Foreman Allya
12_monarchsbluffs_body_26_01:
It’s hard to come by trustworthy friends in Aeternum. Someone who won’t try to offer you as a sacrifice to the Lost, who won’t try to wheedle an extra penny from you for a meal. 

Olaf is a good friend. He’s steadfastly and honorably by my side, come hell or high water. 

When the two of us mount our defense together, the Lost will be severely disadvantaged. With a lit fuse and a boom, we’ll lay them all to waste.
 - Ser Tenny
12_monarchsbluffs_body_27_01:
Tenny came to me this evening. He wore not his usual livery, but a plain tabard that made him seem somehow unclothed. His eyes were downcast. 

“Captain. I heard Minister Lochnir will speak to Ser Dubois,” he said.

“Yes,” I replied. “The four seals are needed to retrieve the crown for the True Heir.” I saw a doubt in his eyes. I hid my own, and waited.

“The True Heir- has changed.”

I felt a righteous anger enflame my face. “He has sacrificed!” I met his fearful stare and realized that I stood, sword drawn, as if I would hew him down.

I tossed aside the weapon and took his shoulder. “Tenny! The heavens have granted us the greatest honor, to follow Ser Gawain. Wear joy in your heart, and don his colors proudly.” I saw his face flush and his eyes kindle with renewed life. “Captain,” he said.
 - Captain Hugh Ainsley
12_monarchsbluffs_body_28_01:
You are more than you’ve been. You’ve grieved over King Danjong’s untimely death. You’ve escaped the horrors of Empress Taiying. And you’ve stayed strong. You’ve abided by Confucius’ teachings and found yourself here, a land once ruled by an English king. 

Lochnir is giving you a path, a way to care for the people and keep the place pure as Knight-Regent. You worry if you can do all that is needed. But you’ve learnt much from the rulers you’ve supported since you’ve been a child. Even Percilla says, “If anyone can do it, you can”. 

So, arm yourself in mail and make your hair as a Joseon woman. Make Prydwen prosperous and peaceful for when the True Heir returns.

12a_chandu_response2_a: Oh, yes! The mysteries of a land are in its dirt. How does Azoth travel? What remains of the people who lived here once?
12a_chandu_response2_b: I’ll solve the mysteries of this island one mineral vein at a time. It’s a most fascinating conundrum!
12a_chandu_response_a: Who doesn’t like her? She used to visit the mines weekly before people started turning into the Lost.
12a_chandu_response_b: She probably spends entire nights trying to figure out why this is happening. It's like the puzzle of the rocks.
12a_don_response_a: It's been my lifelong dream! Being a knight in a mystical land full of monsters and magic!
12a_don_response_b: I’m going to look for some exotic flowers soon. Then I can gift them to a fair maiden and fight in her name!

12a_encounter_helvan_boss_obj_journal: Helvan guards an ancient altar in Traitor's Hold. Tread carefully, for Helvan's deceptive ambushes are known far and wide, upon the seas.
12a_encounter_sirgawain_boss_obj_enc_tit: Ser Gawain, the True Heir, is Lost! Vanquish him and reclaim the Circlet of Swords.
12a_item_msq_08_runeshards_desc: The remains of the smashed runed tablet. The stone is brittle, like a sandstone.
12a_item_msq_15_altarshards_desc: A chunk that fell off the mysterious altar in Traitor's Hold. The altar seemed to have lost its power, but this piece still resonates with a faint energy.
12a_item_msq_15_pirateblunderbuss_desc: This weapon seems exceptionally well-made, with treated wood and polished bronze adorning the chassis.
12a_item_msq_20_ebonbadge_desc: An ornate seal, emblazoned with a gold etching. This one is of a crane.
12a_item_msq_20_hawkbadge_desc: An ornate seal, emblazoned with a gold etching. This one is of a hawk.
12a_item_msq_20_sparrowbadge_desc: An ornate seal, emblazoned with a gold etching. This one is of a sparrow.
12a_item_msq_24_gawainsword_desc: A simple but beautiful crown. It looks like it is made with pure iron with gold lining the top.
12a_item_msq_24_lochnirstaff_desc: This staff is made from a single piece of shaped wood with some small runes etched along the side. The top of the staff appears to have been added on more recently.
12a_item_side_01_avalonlily_desc: A beautiful white lily with a brilliant yellow plume inside.
12a_item_side_02_keepsakekey_desc: A small silvered key. It's slightly scuffed, as if its owner kept it with them all of the time.
12a_item_side_03_minepicks_desc: This pick looks weathered and worn, but it is incredibly sturdy. The tip seems sharp in spite of the scuffs and scratches.
12a_item_side_05_artifactshards_desc: A sliver of a blackened mirror.
12a_item_side_06_glimmeringjewel_desc: A sparkling jewel. It needs some work to really bring out the beauty hidden inside.
12a_item_side_06_glitteringstone_desc: A glittering stone. If you look closely, you can see small sparkling reflections within.
12a_item_side_07_nabisnotes_desc: A set of scribbled notes, signed by Nabi.
12a_item_side_07_softgoldring_desc: A fairly plain golden wedding ring.
12a_item_side_08_sharpcanine_desc: A strong wolf canine. It seems incredibly sharp.
12a_item_side_09_fathersletters_desc: Although written on a flimsy parchment, the words in this letter appear to be meticulously written.
12a_item_side_09_glassitem_desc: A beautiful glass ornament, carefully crafted by skilled hands.
12a_item_side_11_clericsamulet_desc: A symbol of faith, intended to protect the bearer.
12a_item_side_13_devilhoney_desc: Special honey, made by bees who live up on Hiraeth Peak.
12a_item_side_14_mistwine_desc: Where this wine is brewed is something of a mystery, but the citizens of Prydwen consider it to be a delicacy.
12a_lakesidefarm_lostattack_unload_desc_: Unload Preiddeu's supplies from the cart
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_desc: Ser Payne Bennett has requested you to meet the Minister of Monarch's Bluffs in his office.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_incomplete: Minister Lochnir has been managing affairs in this town longer than most of us have been here. He's someone you simply must meet. Don't dally, now!
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_proposal_a: Why, we have just learned the True Heir to the throne is returning to the region!
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_proposal_b: This is a day we have been awaiting for centuries, and a sign of new hope even during these troublesome times.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_proposal_nex: I could recount the legends for days, but I must dispatch someone to the shore now.
The Knight-Regent is indisposed, but Minister Lochnir runs day-to-day affairs in Prydwen.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_response_a: Well now, two new faces to Prydwen in one day - many a year since I've seen that. But these are special times.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_response_b: After centuries, the True Heir returns, and the royal bloodline will once again sit upon the throne.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_obj_response_nex: Forgive me, I take it for granted all are aware. The heir is Ser Gawain himself, most gallant of the High King's knights.
You will have the honor to see his homecoming, and the return of Prydwen's glory after many dark years.
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_takenote: Find Minister Lochnir in his office
12a_msq_01_speaklochnir_talk_lochnir: Talk to Minister Lochnir, of Monarch's Bluffs
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_desc: Check in at the Regent's Rise Inn, and keep an eye out for the pirate captain from the beach, Grace O'Malley.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_incomplete: The hour of the True Heir's return approaches quickly, and I have much to do. You are welcome at the inn.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_incomplete_ne: <g id="female_lookaroundShifty" priority="high" />It's a long day at this post with no relief. If someone doesn't show up soon, I'm afraid <g id="female_nodyes" />I'll have to go off into the bushes for a minute or two.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_proposal_a: Only a matter of days. I am personally attending to preparations even now, as is my duty.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_proposal_a_ne: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Why nothing less thrilling than the return of the 'True Heir'! Ser Gawain is coming home after centuries to finally claim the throne of High King Artorius!
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_proposal_b: Tradition is everything, wouldn't you say? One such custom I've established is that we offer our guests a complementary room at the inn.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_proposal_b_ne: <g id="female_explains" />Of course, however, Knight-Regent Jin Jae is officially still in charge of our fair town. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />As a matter of fact, she'll want to hear your account from the beach.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_proposal_next: <g id="male_chuckle" />Hmmph! <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Sounds like her. A sailor's tongue, alright! <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Probably someone you shouldn't consort with! Appearances, you know.

So again, <g id="male_complimentplayer" />welcome to Prydwen! Check in at the inn, see the Regent when you can, and <g id="female_nodyes" />join us in celebration when the True Heir returns. Jolly good!
You'll find the inn quite hospitable. I hand-selected the innkeep a few decades ago.

<g id="male_waghand02" />Don't feel you have to rush, of course! <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Welcoming those who've just washed ashore is a Prydwen tradition. <g id="male_gesturebackthere" />Free room and board at the Regent's Rise Inn.
So by all means, check in and have a warm meal by the fire. I must attend to other matters now, but we will speak again.
<g id="male_think" />I just sent another newcomer from the beach that way… shady sort. Couldn't take her word for anything, as you might imagine.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_response_a: <g id="grace_cajole" priority="high"/>Now there's a familiar face! About time you caught up.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_response_b: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Here we find ourselves in a little village pulled straight from the Middle Ages. <g id="grace_secret" />Is it me, or does nothing on this island make any sense at all?
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_obj_response_next: <g id="grace_yes" />No doubt, for a place where everyone gets eternal life, you'd think it'd be more… calm, dull even. <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />Not saying I'd like that, mind you.
<g id="grace_welcome" />One thing that is the same though is cold, hard coin. You have it or you don't, <g id="grace_yes" />makes all the difference.
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_openinnuiscreen_d: Check in at the Regent's Rise Inn
12a_msq_02_inntutorial_talk_innkeeper: Check in at the Regent's Rise Inn
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_desc: Grace O'Malley has given you the coin she owes you. Look for bargains at the Trading Post and store the excess at the Storage Shed.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_incomplete_: <g id="grace_secret" />You're in a new town, and you have some coin now - I'd get to spending it or stashing it myself.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_proposal: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Well, you got that coin I just gave you so I'd suggest you get to spending it. <g id="grace_gestureL" />Buy yourself a new blade, some new boots, whatever suits your fancy.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_proposal_a: Well, you got that coin I just gave you so I'd suggest you get to spending it.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_proposal_b: Buy yourself a new blade, some new boots, whatever suits your fancy.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_proposal_ne: <g id="grace_yes" />Ah yeah, there's a trading post out there, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />livelier market than I would've expected.
You should check out the Trading Post yourself and if you need to stash anything, there's a Storage Shed too. Go on, I'll be here.
<g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />You should check out the Trading Post and the Storage, and then what do you say? Let's meet in the tavern. <g id="grace_salutefingers" />Alright see you there!
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_response_a: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />Look at you! Here just a few hours and you're already the most popular person in town. You had a caller while you were out.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_response_a_: <g id="grace_chuckle" />Lively little ditty there, kinda oversells the place, don't you think? <g id="grace_headshakeno" />I sure won't be calling this place home. <g id="grace_shrugdontcare" />But hey, aren't you popular?
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_response_b: That overly chipper knight from the town gate dropped by, says he wants to have a word with you.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_obj_response_b_: <g id="grace_gestureLefthand" />Messenger from the Knight-Regent herself was looking for you. <g id="grace_yes" />Getting fancy, aren't we? <g id="grace_pointr" />She's keen to have a word with you up at the keep.
12a_msq_03_vaulttutorial_vault_desc: Check out the local Storage Shed
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_meetregent: Meet with Knight-Regent Jin Jae at the Prydwen Keep
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_desc: Grace O'Malley says a messenger came from the Knight-Regent who's requested you come see her at the keep.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_incomplete: One of the fellas in the tavern told me Ser Payne's two hundred years old! It's going to take me a while to get used to this place.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_incomplete_new: <g id="grace_shifty" priority="high"//>Apparently that Knight, Ser Payne, he's about five hundred years old. I guess that explains why he's such an uptight bastard.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_proposal_a: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Sounds like some kinda plague - people turning on their friends and neighbors <g id="grace_headshakeno" />with cold murder in their eyes.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_proposal_b: <g id="grace_liftbothhands" />Unlike those red-eyed bastards on the beach, these folks aren't possessed. <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Seems like they don't have any souls at all.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_proposal_next_a: I didn't trust all the shite coming out of that Watcher's mouth, but maybe there was some truth to it.
<g id="grace_doubt" />I didn't trust all the shite coming out of that oaf's mouth, but maybe there was some truth to it.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_proposal_next_b: Ask Ser Payne about these soulless Lost outside town. Maybe get a more honest idea of what's happening here.

<g id="grace_cajole" priority="high"/>I'll be more interested to hear what the Knight-Regent has to say! Particularly if there's mention of coin! <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I'm right here if you need me.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_a: Come in, and be welcome. I will never forget the way this island tested me when I first arrived.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_a_new: <g id="female_lifthandsxs" priority="high" />Ah, you must be the one from the beach. Ser Payne believes<g id="female_clasphandsrequest" bin="1" /> you to be honorable, and I trust his judgment, but I like to hear reports first-hand.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_b: I strive to ensure we are patient with newcomers, and in these times, our customs are even more difficult to observe.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_b_new: <g id="female_explains" />We saw signs of Corruption by the shore, but we believed it was<g id="female_apologetic" bin=".5" bout="1" /> isolated and that no one had actually become Corrupted. Did you see them yourself?
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_next_a: That is good to hear. I believe Ser Payne represents us well, and the spirit of everything Prydwen stands for.
That<g id="female_headshakesmall" priority="high" bout=".5" /> is… not what I wanted to hear,<g id="female_nodconsider"  bin="1" bout=".5" /> but I see the sincerity in your eyes.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_obj_response_next_b: However, with all the anticipation surrounding Ser Gawain's return, we risk letting our optimism turn into denial.

You should know<g id="male_willcoverit" bin=".5" bout=".5" /> that we normally go to great lengths to make newcomers feel welcome in Prydwen. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" bin=".3" />I am sorry if I seem impatient just now.
12a_msq_04_meetpayne_talkpayne_desc: Meet the friendly knight, Ser Payne again in Prydwen
12a_msq_04_talktopayne2_a: Yes, well… I hope… I mean, I have the utmost confidence this will be cleared up before the heir arrives.
12a_msq_04_talktopayne2_b: I think the Knight-Regent simply wants to take precautions. Please, speak with her when you can.
12a_msq_04_talktopayne_a: Oh? So you have heard the unfortunate news from outlying areas…
12a_msq_04_talktopayne_b: I'm sorry to hear that. We try not to worry newcomers with such things, but we've even had some knights who've failed to report in.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_gotomine_desc: Check on Cynefin Mine for Knight-Regent Jin Jae
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_desc: Knight-Regent Jin Jae, knight in charge of Monarch's Bluffs, has asked you to help Allya Musa at Cynefin Mines.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_incomplete: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />Foreman Musa usually sends regular status reports. I hope all is well, but we need to be certain.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_a: We offer shelter, comfort, and we dispatched knights to secure the roads, but many never returned.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_a_new: <g id="female_nodyes" />Minister Lochnir has sent scouts, but they've not returned as<g id="female_disappointed" /> of yet, and now I fear they are missing as well. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Still, he counsels patience!
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_b: Minister Lochnir counsels patience. He believes the royal bloodline will solve all problems. But I feel I must act.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_b_new: <g id="female_impatient" />Lochnir believes the return of the royal bloodline will solve all problems. I feel strongly that we cannot afford to wait for Gawain.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next2_a: <g id="female_shrugshort" />That's just it. We don't know. The foreman there - Allya Musa - is a personal friend, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and she usually visits once a week, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />but it's been a month.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next2_b: <g id="female_lifthandsxs" />If you're truly willing, I would ask you to check on Foreman Musa and report back… oh, <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />and please inform Minister Lochnir of your mission, just so he's aware.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next_a: The mines are the backbone of Prydwen, where many townspeople earn their livelihoods. I've had no reports in days.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next_a_: <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />Oh, I'm sorry. This is poor form on my part, dropping all my<g id="female_apologetic" bin=".5" /> troubles on your boots. I would not impose on someone who just arrived.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next_b: I simply ask you visit and confirm with Foreman Allya that all is well. Then report back to me, please.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_proposal_next_b_: <g id="female_thinking" />Still, with the remaining knights spread thin, you're probably able to get me answers faster than they can. Hm... <g id="male_shrugbrief" />the mine is not so far away either.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_response_a: <g id="male_waghand02" />Whoah, you. If you thought you were going to the mines, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />think again.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_response_b: <g id="male_handheart" />If you have loved ones in there, I don't know what to tell you. Almost everyone's fallen Lost, and no support from Prydwen in sight.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_response_next_a: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />Oh, so NOW she sends someone? And a stranger who's not even a knight?
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_response_next_b: I've sent missive after missive to the Minister, and I think I said: "send every knight available!" Doesn't look like that's what's happening.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_obj_response_next_b_: <g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high"/>I sent dispatches, informing the Regent of what happened and I even said: "send every knight available!" <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Doesn't look like that's what's happening.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_talk_foreman: Check if Cynefin Mine is alright by asking Foreman Allya about it.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_talklochnir2_a_new: <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />Well, aren't we proving our value quickly? <g id="guard_nod" />I'm sure the king will also be grateful for those who willingly submit to his guidance.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_talklochnir2_b_new: <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />It's not my place to countermand the Knight-Regent's orders, <g id="guard_headshakeno" />but I would hate to see a prospective resident waste their time. <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />The tavern is open, you know.
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_talklochnir_desc: Speak to Minister Lochnir before venturing to Cynefin Mine
12a_msq_06_tomiclot_talklochnir_new: <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />For now. But she would do well not to concern herself with matters our new king can better adjudicate. <g id="guard_headtilthmm" />Tell me, has she enlisted you in one of her endeavors?
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_desc: A worried Allya Musa wants you to rescue any surviving miners at Cynefin Mine.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> You may not be a knight, but you got courage. And if that translates into some of my miners getting out of there, I sure as hell won't complain.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_proposal_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You're brave, I'll give you that. But we're not talking about a handful of Withered, <g id="male_converseleft" />we're talking about the whole damn mine.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodding" />Look for that stubborn Elias Derit, and anyone else who's not fallen, and then get them - and yourself - out of there quickly.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_response_a: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Finally, a sign of hope! A brave warrior battling their way through the Withered.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_response_b: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />It's beyond a relief to see you up here. <g id="female_nodyes" />Now maybe we can find a way to reclaim the mine.
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_response_next: And for that I'm mighty grateful, sure enough! But I believe I may have found the source of this terrible curse. You've got to see for yourself!
12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_response_next_: <g id="male_willcoverit" />And for that I'm mighty grateful, sure enough! <g id="male_shakehead" />But we can't go without dealing with that infernal relic that caused this disaster.
