12a_msq_07_freeminers_obj_response_promp: “I'm just here to get you out."
12a_msq_07_freeminers_talk_eliasderit: Look for Elias Derit at Hiraeth Peak
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_destroyrune_desc: Destroy the Mysterious Tablet and Collect Fragments
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_findcannon_desc: Hint: Might need to Blast your way into the mine
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_gotopeak_desc: Look for the strange Tablet at Hiraeth Peak
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_desc: Elias Derit believes a strange magical tablet is causing the trouble at the mines. Destroy the tablet and the Lost Pirates who guard it.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_incomplete: <g id="male_pointBlame" />You said you'd shatter that damn tablet, and I'll be holding you to it!
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_proposal_a: I'm sure of it! The damn thing was making some unearthly sound. Not a one of us would touch it.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_proposal_a_ne: <g id="male_righthandNodeal" />Nah! I told the crew no one was to touch the damn thing… it was thrumming with some unholy energy. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />I wanted to get the Sage Moira out here to study it.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_proposal_b: The next day, we had Lost pirates jumping down from the rocks, and then everyone started falling Lost.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_proposal_b_ne: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Of course, never got the chance... Next morning, the first of the miners fell to the curse, <g id="female_smackfist" />and then the Lost Pirates attacked - hunting for that tablet, no doubt.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_proposal_next: Sure enough! I'm not looking to linger here with pirates and Withered swarming all over.
<g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />You're clearly capable, and I won't complain. I'd go with you, but I'm plumb exhausted from this ordeal, <g id="male_willcoverit" />and I'm not much of a fighter.
Break that tablet and who knows? Maybe all those Lost will disperse. Either way, I'll go. You have my word.

<g id="male_compliment" />But don't forget! Sage Moira needs to see what started this. Smash the tablet and collect the fragments, <g id="female_nodding" />and then bring them back. We'll leave together, or not at all.
Well I'm no sorcerer, but that tablet's what started all this, no doubt about it.

<g id="female_nodyes" />Yah, and they're guarding the tablet like it's some kind of treasure! <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />If we don't destroy that damned thing, I fear the curse will spread beyond the mine!
We need to destroy the damn thing… and maybe gather any fragments and take them back to Prydwen. There's smart people there.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_response: God's blood! I didn't think you could actually pull it off, but you did! Though it seems my hope of the Lost leaving the mine won't be happening anytime soon.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_obj_response_new: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />You did it, then? Shattered the tablet? God's blood! I'm glad <g id="male_shrugBrief" />I didn't send you in there to your doom. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I'd have felt bad about that.
12a_msq_08_destroyrune_talk_eliasderit: Report the Tablet's Destruction to Elias Derit
12a_msq_09_returnregent_container_desc: Return to the Knight-Regent to Report the Disaster at Cynefin Mine
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_desc: Elias Derit wants you to take back news of Hiraeth Peak to Knight-Regent Jin Jae at Prydwen.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_incomplete: A deal's a deal. You said you'd take whatever's left of that tablet back to Prydwen. So get to it, then.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_incomplete_n: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Bring the news of what happened here to Prydwen and get Sage Moira to study those fragments. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Don't waste time, now.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_proposal_a: You did all the work, so I'll let you have the honor of bringing whatever remains of that tablet back to Prydwen.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_proposal_a_n: <g id="male_goodnews" />Ah, Musa. She's a stubborn one, alright. I'll wager she's still waiting at the mine's entrance. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll go and try to convince her to come back to town.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_proposal_b: There's sages and people of that sort who can make sense of them. Oh. Ask the Knight-Regent, she'll know.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_proposal_b_n: <g id="male_compliment" />But you my friend, you must make haste back to Prydwen. Tell the Knight-Regent what happened here, <g id="male_converseright" />and give the tablet fragments to Sage Moira.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_proposal_nex: The Foreman's a stubborn one, and I'll wager she's still waiting at the mine's entrance.

<g id="female_nodyes" />Aye, let's hope. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If anyone will know what in tarnation that thing is, it'll be Sage Moira. <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Let's hope it's not related to those rumors from the southern farms.
I'll go tell her there's none left to save, and then I'll see you in town. I'll even buy you a round at Geertie's!
<g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll go and round up Foreman Musa and the others. <g id="female_gestureRight" />Meet me back in town when this is over and the first round at Geertie's is on me!
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_a: I'm glad to see you've returned safely. Not long after you departed, I finally heard the news.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_a_n: <g id="male_goodnews" />You return. Excellent. Minister Lochnir said I sent you on a fool's errand, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but I can see from your expression you bring dark tidings.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_b: Tell me though, is it as bad as they say? Surely some of the miners made it out?
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_b_n: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" /> What did Foreman Musa say? Tell me the miners are all right.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_nex: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> I can't tell you how disappointed I am to hear that. <g id="male_guiltyLookside" priority="high" />I have failed in my duty to protect the people of Prydwen.
<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />The warnings were there, and I allowed them to be ignored.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_obj_response_pro: "A few, but most have become Lost."
12a_msq_09_returnregent_talk_regentjinja: Inform Knight-Regent Jin Jae about the Lost at the mines.
12a_msq_09_returnregent_talktoregent_des: Talk to Knight-Regent Jin Jae, the knight who looks after Monarch's Bluffs
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_collectnotes_: Search for Evidence of Missives in Lochnir's Office
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_obj_desc: Knight-Regent Jin Jae asks you to bring the recovered tablet fragments to Sage Moira so she can study them for answers and to ask Minister Lochnir about the reports from the mine.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_obj_incomplet: I can't think of any reasonable explanation why Lochnir would keep the Foreman's missives from me. I am anxious to hear what he has to say.
<g id="male_realize" />At this point, we know there is a curse out there. It's time we got some answers.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_obj_proposal_: A mysterious tablet, in the mines? Hm... These fragments appear to be Ancient in origin. I'm no expert, but I will consult the sage, Younge Geiser.
<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Such relics are better left in the earth. The ruins of Aeternum hold dangerous secrets <g id="male_nodunderstand" />that are best left uncovered.
In the meantime, I need to know how the mine fell without my knowledge.
<g id="male_think" />We'll need to have Sage Moira study this tablet for answers. If it can even be recovered, I suppose.
That's a very good question. Perhaps it slipped his mind with all the preparations for Ser Gawain? I should allow him to clarify this point.

<g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high" />But I received no dispatches at all. <g id="male_shakehead" />This makes no sense… unless, well… <g id="male_think" />perhaps Minister Lochnir will be able to surmise how this occurred.
Would you mind seeking him out? Then perhaps we'll all talk.

<g id="male_apologizesmall" />I'm sorry to impose further, but after seeing Sage Moira, <g id="male_compliment" />could you look for the Minister in the town square? <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Tell him I require his counsel… urgently.
Really? She said that? There's only one conceivable explanation for me not receiving the missives.

<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Excellent! Then please, do me one additional favor, and bring them to Sage Moira. <g id="female_explains" />She knows this island and its secrets far better than I do.
Minister Lochnir must have been keeping such reports from reaching my desk.

<g id="male_handheart" />But before you go, what of Foreman Musa…? <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I fear to ask after my dear friend. Is she alright? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Did she try to send for help?
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_obj_response_: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />You return, but without Minister Lochnir. I assume he claimed he was too busy with his preparations?
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Perhaps it's just as well. As Knight-Regent, it may be best if <g id="male_willcoverit" />I handle matters personally going forward.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talklochnir_d: Ask Minister Lochnir about the missives from Cynefin Mine
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira2_a: <g id="male_explain" />On the precipice of Ser Gawain's return to claim the throne, you should learn the significance of this event. <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Let me tell you the full story…
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira2_b: Now, <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />perhaps you understand how momentous Gawain's return really is… <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and why it's so worrisome to hear this news from the mine... and from the farms.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira3_a: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Though Minister Lochnir has been keeping it quiet to avoid a panic, <g id="female_nodyes" />we've had quite a few refugees claiming their farms are overrun with Lost.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira3_b: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />But Lochnir assures me it's under control. If you have further questions, ask him. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I must get to studying these fragments. Let's hope they yield answers.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira_a: Hm. <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high" />Very… interesting. Elias said they unearthed this tablet, but it has signs of extensive weathering. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Yes, it has clearly been exposed to the elements.
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira_b: <g id="male_think" />I will have to study these fragments more closely. In the meantime, <g id="female_spreadarms" />you are new to Prydwen, are you not? Quite a moment to arrive. Do you know our history?
12a_msq_10_confrontlochnir_talkmoira_des: Speak to Sage Moira about the tablet fragments
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains2_a: <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />With all the preparations for the return of the True Heir, we simply <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />can't dispatch our knights everywhere they're needed.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains2_b: <g id="guard_nod" />I was preparing to send a few knights, but then I was told that you had been given the task.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains3_a: <g id="guard_nod" />Oh, by all means, tell her I will come as soon as I finish my vital work on behalf of the True Heir. <g id="guard_nod" />Which was proceeding apace before I was interrupted.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains3_b: <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Tell her it won't be long. And thank you for your service to Prydwen.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains_a: Oh yes, I am well aware. I received those missives myself.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains_a_new: <g id="guard_headtilthmm" />She said that, did she? Well yes, <g id="guard_nod" />I do recall receiving at least one dispatch, <g id="guard_headshakeno" />but her demands were absolutely out of the question.
12a_msq_10_lochnir_explains_b: <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />The Foreman wanted us to send all our knights to help defend the mines, but that was, <g id="guard_nod" />of course, impossible.
12a_msq_11_reportregent_takenote: Return to Knight-Regent Jin Jae in Prydwen
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_campingtutorial_: Make a camp or bind to an existing camp to set a respawn point
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_gotocorsairs_des: Join Ser Payne Bennett at Brysedd Shore to Confront the Lost Pirates
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_desc: Knight-Regent Jin Jae is beginning to trust you. She's asked you to join Ser Payne Bennett in challenging the Pirates encamped at Brysedd Shore.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_incomplete_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You are eager and courageous, and it is most welcome.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_incomplete_b: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />My hope is that you and Ser Payne can deter the pirates from further incursions and discover what drives them. <g id="female_gestureRightM" />May fortune go with you both.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_proposal_pro: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I have already dispatched Ser Payne to the north, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />which is my duty as Knight-Regent.
<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />Lochnir will not be pleased, but perhaps he will now deign to pay me a visit.

<g id="male_pointsoutthere" />These pirates could only have come from the Brysedd Shore to the north. <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />There was a den of brigands there, and now they are apparently Lost.
<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />This seems to be an alarming trend, and we must find the source of it.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_response_a: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />Ah, you're back! I'm at a bit of a loss here. A few months ago, <g id="male_gestureright" />this barren beach had nothing but a smattering of pirates.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_response_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Now it appears to be a war camp,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> with more pirates and supplies arriving by the minute.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_obj_response_nex: <g id="female_nodyes" />Indeed. It’s going to take an army to drive them out, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />and we currently lack an army.
<g id="male_think" />Perhaps we should pursue a more honorable approach to resolving this conflict.
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_talkto_response_: <g id="male_explain" />Before you do anything else, you must build yourself a campsite. <g id="male_nodunderstand" /> It's the wise move when we're this far from Prydwen.
<g id="g_male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" />There's a splendid spot nearby. Set your tent,<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> relax a bit if you like, we'll be here!
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_talkto_start_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" /> Good of you to join us, my valiant friend! <g id="male_compliment" />I heard about your heroics at the mine. You definitely have the makings of a knight!
12a_msq_12_camptutorial_talkto_start_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />For now, we are simply grateful to have your support. <g id="male_gestureHereweare" priority="high" />Not quite a full contingent here, I'm afraid.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_container_desc: Work with Ser Payne to drive back the invading pirates in Brysedd Shore
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_destroycrates_desc: Knock Supply Crates into the water
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_gotobeach_desc: Assault the Pirates' Supply Lines on the Brysedd Shore
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_desc: Ser Payne has asked you to use unusual methods to fight the filthy Lost pirates. Cut off their supplies and set their boats adrift!
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_incomplete: <g id="female_smackfist" /> Strike a blow to the pirates' supply lines. <g id="female_nodyes" />That'll shake them up! Honor and duty, my friend, honor and duty!
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_proposal_a: <g id="male_realize" />Oh, well, yes, good point. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I suppose our options will be more limited, then.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_proposal_b: <g id="female_thinking" />I'm afraid I'm not much of a strategist in a scenario like this. <g id="male_converseright" />What do you think would be most prudent?
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_proposal_next_: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />That's a grand idea! They've been unloading cargo using the smaller rowboats.

<g id="male_compliment" />If you can destroy their rowboats and all the cargo they've dropped, <g id="female_nodyes" />that would slow them down. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll stay and keep an eye out for their leader.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_response_a: Bravo, my bold friend! I feared the pirates would overwhelm you, but it seems you are nigh unstoppable.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_response_a_new: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Bravo, my bold friend! <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I feared the pirates would overwhelm you, <g id="male_complimentplayer" />but it seems you are nigh unstoppable.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_response_b: With their supplies cut off and boats adrift, their ability to wage war will be severely diminished.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_obj_response_b_new: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> And I suppose, if you're willing to vouch for Miss O'Malley, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />we'll give her the benefit of the doubt. <g id="male_shrugBrief" />For the moment, at least.
12a_msq_13_stormbeach_talk_serpaynebenne: Report back to Ser Payne Bennett
12a_msq_14_talkgrace_takenote: Talk to Grace O’Malley at Corsair's Rise
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_collectshard_: Collect Fragments from the Shattered Altar
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_entertraitors: Venture into Traitor’s Hold to Find and Destroy the Altar Grace witnessed
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_obj_desc: Grace O'Malley knows what's summoning the Lost. Go into the Pirates' den and destroy the evil altar.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_obj_incomplet: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Charging into the pirates' compound could very well be a foolhardy notion. <g id="male_compliment" />I trust your judgment, however.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_obj_proposal_: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Very well, then. If she's to be believed, <g id="male_converseright" />the source of this plague on our lands may well be inside. You'll have to hear her account yourself.
She insisted she was here scouting the place for her own ends.
I find that extremely hard to believe. Look at her, looking all suspicious. But I suppose if you're willing to vouch for her, we should at least hear what she has to say.

<g id="male_compliment" />If you're willing to venture into the den on her word, then so be it. <g id="male_willcoverit" />We'll hold this position. But be wary! <g id="male_nodunderstand" />The pirates were fierce... even before becoming Lost.
I'll tell ya, but if you go in, I'm expecting some loot.
There's some kind of altar in there, glowing like a beacon. The bastards are drawn to it like flies to a carcass. I'd wager they'll wander off if you smash the damn thing.
I've watched these rotters, I know what's driving them, making them go mad.
If this sod didn't have his head up his arse, I could've already told you everything you need to know.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_obj_response: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" priority="high"/> No surprise there. Miss O'Malley gets what she wants and disappears. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />I do hope your courage accomplished more than padding her coin purse.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_obj_start_pro: "She's not a spy. She with us."
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkgrace_des: Talk to Grace O’Malley at Corsair's Rise
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkgracepre2: <g id="grace_gestureR" />I'll tell ya, but if you go in, I'll be expecting some treasure in exchange for my information.<g id="grace_yes" /> I worked hard for it after all!

<g id="grace_secret" priority="high" />So here it is: there's a glowing altar in there, and the bastards are drawn to it like flies to a carcass. <g id="grace_smackfist" />Smash the damn thing, and I bet they'll all buzz off!
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkgracepre3: <g id="grace_secret" priority="high" />For someone like you, maybe. Not for me! But hey, don't forget our deal! <g id="grace_gestureRighthand" />Snatch me up some valuables in there, and we'll be that much closer to getting a ship.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkgracepre_: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Not spying so much as taking a measure of the place. <g id="grace_sympathy" />Heard there were pirates up here, and thought they might be sitting on some valuable loot.
<g id="grace_convince2" />And they've got some loot sure enough, but they don't even seem to care about it. <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I guess that's what happens when you lose your soul.
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkto_respon: <g id="grace_takeItem5s" priority="high"/>Now that's a right decent friend! This'll get me a bit closer to securing my ship!
Ser "Pain-in-my-Arse" here tells me the Knight-Regent might be hiring new scouts as well, so I'll be heading back to Prydwen. See you there!
<g id="grace_gesturer" />And Ser Pain-in-me arse let slip that the Knight-Regent wants to hire scouts. <g id="grace_handheart" />I'd say that job has my name on it, so I'll see you back in Prydwen.

<g id="grace_clenchfists1" />See there, we make a good team! <g id="grace_handheart" />I go in first, all sneaky like, and get the lay of the land. <g id="grace_smackfist" />Then you follow up with force, taking care of business.
<g id="grace_consider" priority="high" />Of course, for a partnership, it's vital all parties profit in a venture…
12a_msq_15_defeatnavigator_talkto_start_: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Well now, look who made it in and out of the pirates' den safely! <g id="grace_yes" />I knew you could do it, <g id="grace_gesturer" />unlike this sod.
<g id="grace_secret" />Tell me, did you find that glowing altar?
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_container_desc: Report back to the Knight-Regent with news from Brysedd Shore
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_fasttraveltutorial: Use the Spirit Shrine at Corsair's Rise to return to Prydwen
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_desc: Ser Payne Bennett has asked you to use the Spirit Shrine to get to Prydwen quickly and warn the Regent about the Lost Pirates.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> I’ll stay here to contain these foul brigands. <g id="male_compliment" />You take word to the Knight-Regent. Good fortune to you, my stalwart friend!
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_proposal_a: <g id="male_think" />Interesting. Perhaps that's why we're seeing even fewer of the scoundrels coming ashore than before.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />This revelation should be taken back to the Knight-Regent with all haste!
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_proposal_next_: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I must keep vigil here, ensure these scoundrels don't attempt any further incursions to the south.
<g id="male_compliment" />You must go alone, and go quickly! Use the Spirit Shrine to return to Prydwen. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />It's a bit jarring, but time is of the essence!
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_response_a: It is most excellent to see you return in good health. You are one of the few I can trust in these strange times.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_response_a_new: <g id="male_willcoverit" />Hm. I have to confess, seeing you return brings me a great deal of relief. <g id="female_nodyes" />I need people I can trust… now more than ever.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_response_b: Your… enterprising friend Grace left just moments ago. She said some foul altar was rallying the pirates?
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_response_b_new: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />In fact, your… enterprising friend Grace O'Malley was here. She drives a hard bargain, but I am <g id="female_nodding" />strongly considering her offer.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_obj_response_next_: I think it is natural to assume this strange altar was somehow related to the tablet you found at Hiraeth Peak.
My sage, Younge Geiser, has been studying the fragments you brought back. He believes they are Ancient in origin.
12a_msq_16_fasttravel_talktoregent_desc: Bring news of the Lost Pirates to Knight-Regent Jin Jae
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_fttoarchenar_de: (Optional) Fast Travel to Khalladan from a Spirit Shrine
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_gotoarchenar_de: Investigate the ruins of Khalladan as advised by Sage Moira
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_gotosage_desc: Consult with Sage Moira about the Ancient Tablet and Altar
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_gotoyounge_desc: Find Younge Geiser, the Knight-Regent's sage in Prydwen
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_desc: Regent Jin Jae has asked you to work with Sage Moira to determine if there is any connection between the tablet from the mine and the altar in the pirate's den.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_incomplete_: Please exercise discretion in speaking of these matters around town.
The people are excited about the Heir's return; I would not dampen their spirits.
<g id="male_secretiveshort" />Please. For now, let's keep this talk of Minister Lochnir between us. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Don't even speak of it to Moira.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_proposal_a: Many have sought answers to such questions, but few can claim to have reliable knowledge.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_proposal_a_: <g id="female_nodyes" /> Exactly. She's been studying the fragments you brought back from the mine for a while. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Surely, she's learned something.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_proposal_b: One thing I do know however, is that the Lost usually stay away from the ruins of the Ancients.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_proposal_b_: <g id="male_nodSympathySmall" /> If so, I would ask you to work with Moira to follow up on any leads. I, unfortunately, must attend to less pleasant matters.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_proposal_ne: It certainly appears that way, though Sage Geiser insists this tablet was not buried at the mine, but rather planted there.

<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Yes, you've earned that right. I must soon deal with Minister Lochnir's disrespect head-on. <g id="male_righthandAngry" />He's avoiding me, and there are things he must answer for.
You should converse with the sage yourself. This new information may yield new insights.
<g id="male_willcoverit" />I must handle this myself, though. <g id="male_compliment" /> You should seek out Moira straightaway. Dealing with this plague of Lost is the kingdom's highest priority.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_response_a: There you are! I started to venture into those ruins after you, but I lost my nerve when I caught sight of those Guardians.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_response_a_: <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I'm thankful to have found you, young one. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I fear I may have missed some additional clues on the fragments. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />I came after you right away.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_response_b: I hope you found something in there to make it worth your while.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_response_b_: <g id="litearmor_think" />Before I speak further, however, did you find anything of interest in the ruins of Khalladan, anything at all?
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_response_ne: Ha! I'd wager it'll be the first and last time you hear Grace O'Malley say this, but just now, I'm on official business.

<g id="litearmor_shocked" />Lochnir, out here? Studying the ruins? <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Why, that makes no sense at all! <g id="litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high"/>Let me see these notes you found...
The Knight-Regent sent me to track you down. She says we need your help figuring out what's going on.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_obj_start_promp: "Is that where the Lost came from?"
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_playcinematic:
[Play 2.5 D Cinematic - Ancients of Aeternum]
Script: https://confluence.collab.games.aws.dev/display/JAV/Ancient+Aeternum
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_speakyounge_des: Talk to Younge Geiser about the Altar and the Tablet
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_talklochnir_pro: "She asked me not to speak of it."
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_talklochnir_res: <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />You presume much, page. I simply wish to convey <g id="guard_nod" />any pressing matters to the True Heir when he arrives.
<g id="guard_shrugbrief" />Keep your secrets, but know this - Prydwen will be united as never before to honor the royal bloodline. <g id="guard_headshakeno" />Nothing else matters.
Hmm... <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />the Knight-Regent should not be conducting affairs she <g id="guard_headshakeno" />can't reveal to her people, wouldn't you agree?
<g id="guard_nod" />I've served as Prydwen's Minister since before her birth. I should be informed of this matter.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_talkto_response: Yes!! Only, Minister Lochnir forbade me from going there. It's very dangerous, of course.

<g id="male_complimentplayer" />Of course, and you are better suited than I am. Before you go, however, <g id="male_explain" />let me tell you what we do know of the Ancients that once walked these lands...
But you! Yes, you can go! Start with Khalladan, look for anything recently disturbed. Oh, and don't tell Lochnir!

<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Now you know why most on Aeternum avoid ruins at all costs. I myself have only visited Khalladan once, <g id="female_nodyes" />but if we're to find answers, that's where they'll be.

<g id="male_compliment" />You're a brave soul, but don't go too deep. There are unspeakable dangers down there. <g id="male_spreadhands" />Stick to the surface, that's where our tablet came from. Go, now.
An altar? Related to this tablet, then? Fascinating! It couldn't have been there for long.
<g id="male_think" />Well, it's hard to say for sure, but it's possible it comes from the same place - <g id="male_nodunderstand" />the Ancient Ruins of Khalladan in the eastern wood.
There's only one possibility - all of this came from the Ancient ruins of Khalladan and Antares in the eastern wood.
<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Khalladan, and indeed all the ruins of Aeternum are shrouded in centuries, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />if not millennia, of unsolvable mysteries.
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_talkto_start_a: Yours is a face I've not seen before... Aha! You're the newcomer who recovered these fragments from the mine!
12a_msq_17_lochnirsnotes_talkto_start_b: I am very excited to speak with you! This material is definitely Ancient! Was there more in the pirate den to the north?
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_gotoanteres_des: Search Antares for Clues to the Tablet's origins
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_desc: Moira now believes the Ancient tablet was taken from the ruins of Antares. She's asking you to search for any clues relating to the tablet, the Lost, or Minister Lochnir.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_incomplete: Whatever that Minister Lochnir's up to, it's well scary. I'd say let's finish our work here as quick as we can and get going.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_incomplete_: <g id="litearmor_think" />Controlling the Lost, why would Lochnir want to do such a thing?
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal2: <g id="litearmor_sighrelief" />Whatever you find, come back, and then <g id="litearmor_gestureleft" />we will return to Prydwen, inform the Knight-Regent, and confront Lochnir. <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I will wait here. Do hurry.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_a: I'd say there's no doubt about that! I tailed the bastard and his entourage. They marched straight into a crowd of the Lost.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_a_: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Yes, that much is clear. But we cannot leave yet. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />In my further study of the fragments, <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I saw new clues - the tablet's not from Khalladan, but rather Antares.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_b: The Knight-Regent says Lochnir's gone mad. She wants you to come help as soon as you're done here.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_b_: <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I know I've already asked much, and offered poor direction, but Antares is close. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />I'm pleading with you, please investigate before we return to Prydwen.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_ne: Then I suppose I'll be waiting for you. The Knight-Regent told me not to return without you.
Get on with whatever you're doing, and if you find any treasure in the ruins, don't forget your dear friend Grace.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_proposal_pr: "I need to search the ruins first."
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_response_a: Well, you were gone long enough, I was starting to worry you'd fallen to those Guardians.
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_response_a_: <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Your friend Grace has come with dire news from Prydwen, but first, <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />you have to tell me what you found. Any further clues to Lochnir's plans?
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_response_b: Did you find anything else in there relating to the Minister's plans?
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_obj_response_ne: Well, I'll be damned if that doesn't explain a lot of the queer happenings around here.
<g id="grace_throwarms" priority="high"/>Is that what the bastard's up to? That's more twisted than even I imagined. <g id="grace_yes" />But it might explain what happened back in Prydwen.
I suppose that's how he's able to walk freely among the those blue-eyed rotters as well.
<g id="grace_convince2" />The Knight-Regent went to confront the good Minister and instead, she found him leading a crowd down south to welcome the "True Heir."
12a_msq_18_inspectstatue_tablet_desc: Find where the Tablet came from
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_container_desc: Travel to Preiddeu Farms to join Knight-Regent Jin Jae
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_gotofarm_desc: Join Knight-Regent Jin Jae at Preiddeu Farms
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_desc: Grace O'Malley has asked you to share the truth about Lochnir with the Knight-Regent at Preiddeu Farms.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_incomplete: Keep your eyes on the horizon, my friend, and always stay upwind of your enemies.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_incomplete_n: <g id="grace_stop" />Don't be worrying about your pal, Grace. I can take care of myself. <g id="grace_secret" priority="high" />You just hang on tight to your soul, you hear? See you soon.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_a: She left Ser Payne in charge of Prydwen's defenses. She wanted to see to these troubles personally.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_a_n: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I don't know she's thinking that far ahead, yet. She just hopped on her horse and rode off, <g id="grace_handheart" />shouting at me to find you and meet her at Preiddeu Farms.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_b: I suspect the Knight-Regent's looking to draw steel against Lochnir herself. You best get going.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_b_n: <g id="litearmor_think" />Ah, then she's expecting a fight. Going to find Ser Percilla, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />a fellow knight and confidant who hasn't come to Prydwen in many moons. <g id="litearmor_worry" />This is serious.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_c_n: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Though my scrolls may not have all the answers, I <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />might find a way to counteract this sorcery Lochnir seeks to employ. <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I should return to town.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_proposal_nex: The Knight-Regent asked me to circle down to the pirate dens further south, see what's happening there.

<g id="litearmor_agree1" />Very well. If Ser Gawain doesn't arrive soon, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />there may not be a kingdom left for him to rule. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />I hope this all starts making sense soon.
I'll catch up with you at the farm soon enough.
<g id="grace_proud" />The Knight-Regent asked me to scout the eastern farms on the way, so I'll mark Ser Percilla's place on your map and meet you there. <g id="grace_yes" />Good winds to us both.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_response_a: Well met, stranger. The Knight-Regent said you have been her only reliable counsel in recent days.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_response_a_n: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />If you're expecting to have more luck plying me for answers than the Knight-Regent, think again. <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />I don't know you and <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I sure as hell don't owe you anything.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_response_b: For your service to her, and to Prydwen, I salute you. I was a knight myself, not long ago.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_response_b_n: Truth be told, <g id="female_notsure" />I don't owe her, either. I've foresworn my oath. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The politics of Prydwen are no longer my concern.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_response_nex: Um… yes. When the farms in these parts started falling to the Lost, the town's supplies were threatened.

<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> I'm perfectly capable of defending my land and estate. Outside of that, <g id="male_shakehead" />it's none of my business what goes on, who falls, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />and who doesn't.
I... volunteered to take over this farm to ensure Prydwen did not go hungry. It was… a difficult decision.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_obj_start_prompt: "What does she want us to do?"
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_takenote: Talk to Percilla Wallen at Preiddeu Farms
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_prompt2: "Is this related to the True Heir?"
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_prompt2_n: "Is it because of the True Heir?"
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_response2: I question everything the Minister said now, but apparently the Knights at Teyrnon Keep met Ser Gawain.

<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I don't know. <g id="male_think" />I now question everything the Minister said, but the Knights at Teyrnon Keep did meet Ser Gawain… <g id="female_youknow" />Percilla did tell me that much.
Percilla here was a knight there herself, until recently. I believe she's hiding something. You should speak to her.

<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> Percilla was there, in fact, but she won't talk about it. <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />It's infuriating! I need a moment to collect myself. If you are so inclined, <g id="male_converseleft" />you should try and talk to her.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_response3: I fear what Lochnir's ultimate intentions could be. I probably should return to Prydwen to bolster the town's defenses.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_response_: Is that what you discovered in the ruins? Was Lochnir behind the strange tablet at the mine? The pirates, too?
<g id="male_shocked" />Is that what you discovered in the ruins? <g id="female_spreadarms" /> Was Lochnir behind the strange tablet at the mine? The pirates, too?
I am having trouble understanding what his ultimate goal is, or if he even has one.
<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I am having trouble understanding what his ultimate goal is, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />or if he even has one.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_start_a: I cannot express how reassuring it is to have your presence down here.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_start_a_n: <g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high"/> I cannot imagine what's come over her! Ser Percilla was Prydwen's most honorable knight, <g id="male_converseleft" />and now, when we need her most, she refuses my orders!
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_start_b: As much respect as I've always had for Minister Lochnir, it is painfully clear that he's suddenly gone quite mad.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talkto_start_b_n: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />Everyone seems to think Gawain's already assumed command! Lochnir's in outright defiance. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />He's changed… I don't even know him any more.
12a_msq_19_meetpercilla_talktoregent_des: Tell Knight-Regent Jin Jae about Lochnir's Studies
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_container_desc: Travel to Teyrnon Keep and search for Answers
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_findsword: Search for Clues to what happened here
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_gotolightshope_d: Enter the Main Hall in Teyrnon Keep
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_inspectbanner_de: Search for Evidence for where the Circlet of Swords might have gone
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_inspectcrown_des: Search for Clues to what happened here
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_inspectnote_desc: Search for Evidence for why the Circlet of Swords is missing
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_inspectrobe_desc: Search for Evidence for who might have taken the Circlet of Swords
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_desc: The former knight Percilla Wallen suggests you investigate Teyrnon Keep to learn more about the return of the true heir, Ser Gawain.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_incomplete_a: Again, I would urge you to reconsider this course of action.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_incomplete_b: My fellow knights are formidable combatants. Getting their seals will be difficult.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_incomplete_n: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />To be perfectly clear, I'm not advising you to visit Teyrnon Keep. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />It would be much better to walk away, find another place on Aeternum where you can be safe.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_proposal_a: That… explains much. I know the Minister had planned to claim the Circlet of Swords, the royal crown of Monarch's Bluffs, from Teyrnon Keep.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_proposal_a_n: <g id="female_nodyes" />I believe that to be the case, though some may remain. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I left one day, and I haven't gone back.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_proposal_b: If he can control the Lost Knights there, I suppose that's how he'll do it.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_proposal_b_n: <g id="female_explainS" />If you want to know what's happened at Teyrnon Keep, I suggest you go and have a look for yourself. <g id="male_compliment" />Then you can try to explain it to the Knight-Regent.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_proposal_nex: No, I will not raise my blade against my fellow knights, even in the state they're in.
I will give you this seal, however. You'll also need the seals of the other knights to access the sacred chamber inside the Keep.
I suspect it’s already too late, and my fellow knights still defend the Keep as firmly as ever.
<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> I've said as much as I'm going to say. <g id="female_spreadarms" />You and the Knight-Regent are welcome to shelter here, but I'll answer no more questions.
I’d advise against going - there's nothing there but death and grief. But… perhaps you may discover more of Lochnir's plan.

<g id="male_pointBlame" />If you are going to venture into Teyrnon Keep, I suggest you don't tell the Knight-Regent. <g id="male_shakehead" />It's better she doesn't go there. There's nothing left… <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />for any of us.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_a: You ventured into Teyrnon Keep and returned with your soul intact? You are indeed as worthy as the Knight-Regent claimed.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_a_n: <g id="male_pointBlame" />Are you happy now? If you've been to Teyrnon Keep, I'm assuming you know the truth. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Ser Gawain is Lost, and he and Lochnir <g id="male_nodunderstand" />intend to rule a Lost kingdom.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_b: I trust you discovered that Lochnir had already taken the crown? I suspected as much.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_b_n: <g id="female_takeItem" priority="high"/>Thank you... I suppose, though I have no further need of it. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />My days as a knight are done.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_c_n: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> I fought honorably to protect Artorius and his legacy for several lifetimes, but I will<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" /> not follow the heir down this path. Nor will I stand against him.
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_obj_response_nex: He… oh, God's blood! I cannot bear the burden of this dark secret any more!
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Prydwen is Ser Gawain's right by blood, and though I've foresworn my duty to the bloodline, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I will not oppose him, even if he is Lost.
I was there, and I witnessed when Lochnir brought Ser Gawain for us to swear loyalty!
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_seals_container_: Collect the other Knight’s Seals to open the Crown Chamber
12a_msq_20_collectcrown_talktopercilla_d: Return to Percilla's Farm to Confront her with the Truth
12a_msq_21_findgrace_container_desc: Ask Grace O’Malley if she has anything new to report
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_desc: Percilla Wallen has advised you meet Grace and stay informed of her latest findings at Deadman's Shrine.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_incomplete: I believe the Knight-Regent said this new scout was a recent arrival, like yourself. I think her name was Grace.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_incomplete_new: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It's too much to bear. If I dwell on all this, I'll lose hope, and then fall Lost. That may well be the fate of all on Aeternum, in the end.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_a: The Minister reminded us of our sworn duty to the royal bloodline. He told us the sacrifice of becoming Lost was noble and right.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_a_new: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Heh, there are some benefits to being new to the island, aren't there? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Maybe fate has ordained you to be the one to shoulder this burden.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_b: Then he lined us up, and killed us one-by one. I… faltered. I couldn't do it, so I... fled.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_b_new: <g id="male_compliment" />If you fought your way into Teyrnon Keep and returned with your soul intact, you are valiant, at least. <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />If Jae wishes to fight, she's fortunate to have you.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_next2_: I… alright, it is my duty. The Knight-Regent has returned to Prydwen, but we can try to stop Lochnir down here.

<g id="male_nodSympathySmall" />Thank you for understanding, and for your support of the Knight-Regent.<g id="male_converseleft" /> You should go to her now. I wish… <g id="male_willcoverit" />I hope you both find your way forward.
A scout was sent southward, you should seek them out. Once I dig up my armor, I will join you. And friend… thank you.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_next_a: I was ashamed, unwilling to join them in soullessness, but also unwilling to betray my comrades and the bloodline.

<g id="male_crossarmsNo" />That's… it's not what I'm going to do. I cannot… <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" /> I cannot fight in this battle. I-I buried my arms and knight's armor. <g id="male_righthandNodeal" priority="high"/>My fighting days are done.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_proposal_next_b: I regret it now… I should've come to the Knight-Regent sooner. Perhaps I could've prevented all this…
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_a: Thank goodness I found someone I can report to! And better it's not the Knight-Regent.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_a_new: <g id="grace_welcome" />About time I got some reinforcements down here! <g id="grace_convince2" />Remember that Lost pirate den in the north? That's a small affair compared to this place.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_b: Remember all those Lost pirates swarming around that den to the north? That was a small affair compared to this place.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_b_new: <g id="grace_headnodyes" />Our good friend Minister Lochnir was here, too. <g id="grace_sympathy" />Those eejits who followed him are all Lost now and under his command. What about you? Learned anything new?
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_next_a: Good old Minister Lochnir was here sure enough. There's another one of those glowing altars.

<g id="grace_throwarms" priority="high"/>What? Ah, you're joking me! This "True Heir" everyone's so excited about <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />is actually a soulless ghoul…? <g id="grace_yes" />Aha, I guess now the Minister's plan makes sense!
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_response_next_b: But this time, I don't think he's meaning to draw the pirates in, but rather send them forth.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_obj_start_prompt_ne: "I'm sure it's hard for you both."
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent2_a: <g id="female_youknow" />First priority is ensuring Prydwen is prepared to defend itself against whatever threats emerge. Second, we must look south… <g id="male_lookdownOhmy" priority="high" />oh… what have I done?
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent2_b: <g id="male_rememberBig" priority="high"/>I just realized I sent Grace to scout the southern shore with no idea what she's walking into! <g id="male_pointBlame" />You must go after her, with great haste, lest she walks right into a trap.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent3_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Thank you. I will return to Prydwen. As regent, <g id="male_willcoverit" />that's where I belong whether the city stands or falls. I will rally whatever knights remain to our defenses.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent4_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />She'll have to make her own choices.<g id="female_nodyes" /> I must collect myself before I head north. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll say our farewells. You should leave now.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent4_b: <g id="male_compliment" />Find Grace and ensure she's safe. If possible, get a sense of what we're up against and <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />then return to Prydwen and we will make our stand. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Godspeed, my friend.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent_a: Yes, <g id="female_nodding" />as Knight-Regent, it is my duty to defend the kingdom against all threats. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Lochnir may believe the kingdom is the bloodline, <g id="male_willcoverit" />but I know it to be the people.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talkregent_b: <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />And I will fight for the people of Prydwen until the last shred of my soul is forfeit. <g id="male_compliment" />You have no such duty, but I welcome the support, if you will fight at my side.
12a_msq_21_findgrace_talktograce_desc: Look for Grace O’Malley in the Southern Bluffs
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_beach_container: Assault the Pirates' Fortifications in Southern Bluffs Bay
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_cove_container_: Search Deadman’s Cove for the Enchanted Altar
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_gotobeach_desc: Sabotage the Pirates' Operation in Southern Bluffs Bay
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_desc: Stop the Lost fleet from leaving Scallywag Bay. Start with their explosives and then destroy their altar.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_incomplete: <g id="grace_consider" priority="high"/>I'll be heading north, and I hope you'll follow soon. I look forward to hearing your stories at the Prydwen tavern.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_proposal_a: <g id="grace_proud" />Well, we've discussed this partnership before, haven't we? I get the lay of the land, and <g id="grace_smackfist" />you do the battling part.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_proposal_b: <g id="grace_secret" />You'll be facing long odds, but you're like a lucky anchor. <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />I'd consider making a wager <g id="grace_yes" />on you, regardless.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_proposal_ne: <g id="grace_relief" />Now there's an order I don't mind following. <g id="grace_secret" priority="high" />I could use a cup of mead after all this crawling around.
<g id="grace_handheart" />I'll go and tell the Knight-Regent what's what, but my hopes go with you. <g id="grace_yes" />It's better if these bastards never set sail.
<g id="grace_spreadarms" />Not a problem, I'll always tell it to you straight.
<g id="grace_smackfist" />I'd suggest you destroy as many explosives as you can and take out that glowing altar too. <g id="grace_crossarms" />Now, what would you have me do?
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_a: So she spoke the truth after all? That Grace character told me you'd gone in there on your own, but I had to see it to believe it.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_a_: <g id="yonas_spreadarms002" />Surprised to see me, are you? Brushing the dirt from my armor was no easy task, <g id="yonas_noddingSlow" />but after your friend Grace told me you were here alone, I had to come.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_b: I heard the ruckus and saw the smoke. Am I to assume that means your mission was a success?
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_b_: <g id="yonas_noddingheadApproval" />My heart was conflicted, but in the end, <g id="yonas_saluteFistchest" />I took an oath as the protector of the kingdom, not a single ruler. <g id="yonas_shakehead" />I won’t forget that again.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_c_: <g id="yonas_shrug" />Of course… it seems I arrived too late. <g id="yonas_thinking" />Hearing the ruckus and seeing the smoke, I assume you succeeded in disrupting their war preparations?
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_obj_response_ne: Well, there's cause for celebration! It's even tempting to take the good news to Prydwen right away.
Well, <g id="yonas_rightfist" />there's something to be grateful for, even if I am a little disappointed I missed all the action. <g id="yonas_explain01" />Perhaps we don't stop there.
But I believe there's an opportunity to strike a critical blow against the enemy, here and now.
12a_msq_22_destroyshrine_talk_percillawa: Report back on the sabotage of the Pirates' assault preparations
12a_msq_23_totower_container_desc: Rejoin Ser Percilla Wallen at Corbenic Castle
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_desc: Percilla Wallen suspects Ser Gawain, the True Heir and Lochnir, the scheming minister, have gone to Corbenic Castle. Meet her there.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_incomplete: Meet me at Corbenic Castle. We'll put an end to all this madness!
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_a: Yes, though we need a plan. They have the Circlet of Swords and an army of Lost has already fallen under Ser Gawain's influence.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_a_new: <g id="yonas_nodBig" />I thought you might. It is indeed best for Prydwen that the Knight-Regent is safe and fortifying the keep. <g id="yonas_handHeartLove" />You and I are more… expendable.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_b: Defeating a knight of legend will be hard enough, but won't he just return to command them again?
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_b_new: <g id="yonas_crossarmsShakehead" />Make no mistake, Gawain is every bit a knight of legend, and Lochnir's a diabolical snake. <g id="yonas_shakehead" />This will not be an easy fight, but it is a <g id="yonas_fistsmack" />necessary one.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_next2_a: Yes, let's do just that. I will mark the spot on your map where we can set up a defensive position and plan our attack.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_next2_b: I will meet you there, and if the hand of justice is with us, we will prevail.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_next_a: Is that how that craven madman controls the Lost? Yes, it makes sense now.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_next_a_n: <g id="yonas_chuckle" />Hah, then let's get on with it, shall we? <g id="yonas_spreadarms002" />Corbenic Castle is just across the water to the west. <g id="yonas_bowShallow" priority="high"/>I will go ahead and scout the castle's defenses. Don't take long.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_next_b: I thought perhaps it was Gawain's royal blood, but now I see, this whole thing is a contrivance of Lochnir's.
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_proposal_prompt2: "Let's go and put an end to it."
12a_msq_23_totower_obj_response: <g id="yonas_gesturebothhands" />Here we are, home to one of King Artorius's greatest knights, and his heir. <g id="yonas_nodSlight" />It was a bastion of valor back then… today, <g id="yonas_shrug" />it's a monument to darkness.
12a_msq_23_totower_talktopercilla_desc: Rejoin Ser Percilla Wallen at Corbenic Castle
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_container_desc: Defeat Minister Lochnir and Ser Gawain in Corbenic Castle
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_defeat_gawain_de: Fight through Corbenic Castle to reach Gawain's Hall
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_desc: The time of judgement is nigh. Confront Ser Gawain, the True Heir and the pestilent Minister Lochnir at Corbenic Castle.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_incomplete: Do what must be done. You're the only one who can stop them!
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_incomplete_n: <g id="yonas_nod" />Do what must be done. You're the only one who can stop them!
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_proposal_a: Your courage is unquestionable, and I've witnessed your prowess in battle. You're a force to be reckoned with.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_proposal_a_n: No, but I do. <g id="yonas_rightfist" />This is my duty, and I am sworn to it. <g id="yonas_explain01" />You can attack from the gate, and I will use a hidden entrance on the other side of the castle.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_proposal_b: But if I'm being honest, I'd prefer not to take up arms against my former comrades nor the heir of Artorius.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_proposal_b_n: <g id="yonas_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Your courage is unquestionable, and I've witnessed your prowess in battle. I will fight my way up from below and we will <g id="yonas_fistsmack" />confront Gawain together.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_proposal_nex: Thank you. I will defend this position to ensure none come to the castle's defense and that Lochnir does not escape.
<g id="yonas_nod" />Gawain and Lochnir must be defeated, whatever it takes. <g id="yonas_saluteFistchest" />Godspeed to us both, friend.
Defeat those villains, destroy that damn staff, and reclaim the crown. I look forward to your triumphant return!
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_response_a: I think I've been holding my breath since you departed, or at least it feels that way.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_response_a_n: <g id="yonas_explain01" />I am sorry I arrived late to Gawain's hall. The Lost knights fought fiercely, and with cold resolve. <g id="yonas_noddingSubtle" />I arrived only in time to see Lochnir fall.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_response_b: Tell me, did you defeat Ser Gawain and destroy Lochnir's infernal staff?
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_obj_response_nex: Praise to whatever gods are at your back! I feel like I'm waking from a long nightmare.
My thrill at learning of the True Heir's return was only matched by the horror of learning what he had become.
12a_msq_24_defeatgawain_tower_container_: Find Ser Gawain and Minister Lochnir
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_desc: Ser Gawain and Lochnir have been vanquished. In the absence of the True Heir, find a True Ruler for the crown.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_incomplete: Now that we have the Circlet of Swords, we need to convince Jin Jae to take the mantle of leadership.Hopefully, she'll accept the crown.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_incomplete_ne: <g id="yonas_shakehead" />Do not tarry here long, my friend. The Lost will return, and even if they're less driven, they will be a threat in numbers.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_a: Yes, though Jae is bound by her duty. She'd make an excellent queen but she can't even imagine such a thing.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_a_ne: <g id="yonas_noddingheadApproval" />Of course. She has led us admirably for many decades now, <g id="yonas_lefthand" />and the people adore her, probably even more after this.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_b: I suspect the court training of her youth is to blame. Her humility will be yet another formidable foe.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_b_ne: <g id="yonas_shrug" />With Gawain exposed and defeated, however, the question of the True Heir is settled. <g id="yonas_thinking" />It might clear the way for a new monarch.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_next: Yes. We’ll speak to the people. We’ll tell them the truth about Lochnir and the heir.
Now that… <g id="yonas_nodBig" />is an excellent idea. I can think of no one more deserving. <g id="yonas_rightfist" />A new queen to lead us into a new age, with new hopes and vision for the future.
The crown deserves to be worn by a noble ruler, a ruler like Jin Jae. I'll see you in Prydwen, comrade.

<g id="yonas_handHeartLove" />I will go to Prydwen to share Gawain's sorry end, and I will discuss your suggestion. <g id="yonas_gestureLeftM" />You must come, too. If there is to be a coronation, <g id="yonas_noddingheadApproval" />you must attend.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_proposal_prom: "Queen Jin Jae has a nice ring to it."
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_response_a: Word of your victory has already breached the walls, and we are extremely grateful.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_response_a_ne: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />I'm glad you made it. We waited as long as we could. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I think the people of Prydwen <g id="female_nodyes" />wanted to ensure all the preparations for Gawain were put to use.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_response_b: I welcome you back to Prydwen as a hero. I can never repay the debt this town owes to you.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_response_b_ne: <g id="male_shakehead" /> But it wouldn't have felt right without you. <g id="male_compliment" />This victory really belongs to you… truly, and <g id="female_nodyes" />Percilla's account of your heroics only reinforces that.
12a_msq_25_crownregent_obj_response_next: We were in the tavern after word of your success, and someone mentioned a ship builder in Oxboro.
She was so eager to meet this person, she left right away. She did ask me to tell you, of course.
I… am not sure. I do not have royal blood… but I suppose we've learned that the bloodline is now cursed.

<g id="female_chuckle" />Hmmph. I'll take the compliment. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I'll need all the confidence I can get if I'm to rule this land as a monarch. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I still haven't quite got used to the idea.
Strangely enough, your friend Grace suggested the same thing just before she left.
<g id="male_lookaroundBored" priority="high" />I was hoping your friend Grace would make an appearance today, but I guess <g id="female_nodyes" />she meant it when she said she was heading north.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_findyonas: Seek out the Mysterious Old Man Fishing on the River
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_desc: Travel east to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Jin Jae believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_incomplete: If anyone can help you, it would be that old man. He's often fishing on the river to the east. Look for him there.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_incomplete_new: If anyone can help you, it would be that old man. <g id="female_pointleft" />He's often fishing on the river to the east. <g id="female_nodyes" />Look for him there.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_a: Yes, after careful consideration, I realize it is the honorable thing. It is the ultimate requirement of my sworn duty.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_a_new: <g id="female_shocked" />You hear the voice of Corruption? I've heard legends of its insidious torment... <g id="female_sympathyHandsheart" />What an awful burden you must bear! I had no idea…
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_b: Will you stay then and serve Prydwen at my side? Or do voices call you elsewhere?
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_b_new: <g id="female_thinking" />In the days of Artorius, they say it was the voice of Myrddin that called knights to evil. It drove them mad…
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next2_a: I know of no cure, but there's an old man who comes to Prydwen now and then. He warns about Corruption.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next2_b: Some say he's deranged, but I see wisdom in his eyes. He fishes the east river. You should seek him out.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next_a: You hear the voice of Corruption? There are legends of its insidious torment. You must be bearing such a burden!
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next_a_n: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I know of no cure, but there's an old man who comes to Prydwen now and then. <g id="female_shrugShort" />He goes on and on about Corruption.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next_b: In the days of Artorius, they say it was the voice of Myrddin that called knights to darkness. It drove them mad.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_next_b_n: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Some say he's deranged, but I see wisdom in his eyes. <g id="female_pointleft" />He fishes the east river. Perhaps if you seek him out, he will help you.
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_prompt2: "Is there any way to fight it?"
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_proposal_prompt_n: "Is there any way to fight it?"
12a_msq_26_toyonas_obj_response: [Yonas's lines are in 99A_Objectives.loc. The data sheet points there.]
12a_msq_26_toyonas_speakyonas: Tell Yonas Alazar of the voices in your head
12a_msq_26_toyonas_talk_yonas: Seek out the Old Hermit fishing on the East River
12a_npcgreet_moira_00: <g id="female_youknow" />History is being made in Prydwen, visitor. The return of Ser Gawain to claim the throne is an event we've awaited for centuries.
12a_npcgreet_moira_01: <g id="female_nodyes" />I've just seen Elias and learned of the tragedy at the mine. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Are you the one who recovered the fragments of this tablet they stumbled onto?
12a_npcgreet_moira_02: <g id="female_thinking" /> There's simply no way this tablet was buried for any length of time… perhaps I can discern where it came from.
12a_npcgreet_moira_03_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Ah, just the person I was hoping to see. Comparing the tablet fragments to other stonework from the region,<g id="female_youknow" /> I believe I've found where it came from.
12a_npcgreet_moira_03_b: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> I know you've just returned from the north… if it's true that the pirates are <g id="male_secretiveshort" />indeed all Lost, did you see anything similar to the tablet?
12a_npcgreet_moira_04: <g id="male_handheart" />I will inform the Knight-Regent of what we've discovered. <g id="female_gestureRightM" />Learn what you can from the ruins and return. I know she will be anxious to hear what you find.
12a_npcgreet_moira_05: <g id="litearmor_worry" priority="high"/>These notes are… very troubling. It's hard to say exactly what Lochnir seeks to achieve, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but it does not seem like it's for the good of Prydwen.
12a_npcgreet_moira_06: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Now that's not so strange. If Gawain has arrived, it makes sense. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Perhaps this is a misunderstanding, and <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Lochnir's simply trying to lead the Lost away…
12a_npcgreet_moira_07: <g id="litearmor_concerns" priority="high" />I pray that this business turns out to be less worrisome than it seems. <g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />So much hope in the air of late, I'd hate to see it dashed.
12a_npcgreet_moira_08: <g id="litearmor_think" />Isn't it exciting when historyan unexpected turn? <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I think Queen Jin Jae may prove to be the best ruler Prydwen's ever known.
12a_shae_response_a: A stranger promised me shelter in exchange for information about a knight.
12a_shae_response_b: They did the unspeakable and didn't even live up to their promise. Everyone’s going to turn Lost soon and there’s nothing anyone can do about it.
12a_shazaan_response2_a: Mineworks Advisor for the Regent. She’s upset about what happened to us at the mines.
12a_shazaan_response2_b: She’s going to make sure the mines are safe for all hardworking miners. And she wants my help to do it!
12a_shazaan_response_a: I thought it would be adventurous. I didn’t want to sit by a lake all day.
12a_shazaan_response_b: Well, I’ve had my fill of monsters, funny rocks, and illusions caused by foul air. I wanted a new job! And I got one!
12a_side_01_placeflowers_collectflowers_: Gather Avalon Lilies for Artorius' True Heir
12a_side_01_placeflowers_container_desc: Collect Avalon Lilies for Pendragon Landing
12a_side_01_placeflowers_gotokingslandin: Go to Pendragon Landing, the place where Artorius first arrived
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_desc: The True Heir is returning to Monarch's Bluffs! Fiona Murphy has asked you to bring Avalon Lilies to Pendragon Landing as a tribute.
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_incomplete_: No tribute too large, no deed too small, when the fated ship comes home.
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_proposal: Mountain and dale speak the tale, a warrior of wit and renown. Artorius raised them strong and brave, a True Heir for his crown.
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_proposal_ne: For the Heir, bring flowers fair, that we may build a path of blooms. May they know their people care, it is them we choose.
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_response_a: The True Heir sought to save us once, and now, the answer they’ll bring.
12a_side_01_placeflowers_obj_response_b: The Lost will learn, be forever turned. They’ll know them as Our One True King!
12a_side_01_placeflowers_placeflowers_de: Place the Avalon Lilies on Pendragon Shrine
12a_side_01_placeflowers_talktofiona_des: Tell Fiona in Prydwen you've paid a tribute to the True Heir
12a_side_02_gathergift_collectkey_desc: Find the key to Edwyn's lockbox in Cynefin Mine
12a_side_02_gathergift_container_desc: Search for Eddie Koning at Cynefin Mine and remind him of his Anniversary
12a_side_02_gathergift_gotomiclot_desc: Go to Cynefin Mine to look for Eddie Koning
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_desc: Edda Koning wants you to remind her husband, Eddie Koning it's their anniversary. Carry the message to Cynefin Mine.
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Did you find my Eddie yet? Ask him to stop working and get here quickly!
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_proposal_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Yes, my foolish heart can't help long for my Eddie. He toils too hard in the mines.
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_proposal_b: This is the first time he’s missed our anniversary!<g id="female_explainS" /> I’d go to the mines myself but his favorite turkey is roasting away.
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_proposal_next: That’d be lovely! <g id="female_salute2finger" />Tell that oaf he has a wife who loves him more than the mines do.
<g id="female_explainS" />And then, gently remind him that it’s our anniversary today. And I’ll be very cross if he doesn’t have a gift for me.
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_response_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Oh dear, he’s not with you. That can only mean…
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_response_b: <g id="male_ragepoundfist" />Blast that domkop! I-I- told him to stay with me today. But, no! He had to go to the mines and pick at another rock.
12a_side_02_gathergift_obj_response_next: <g id="female_explainS" />I am sorry too. There will never be another Eddie. <g id="male_patience" />I remember the first time he handed me his coat in the rain. Our first…
<g id="male_spreadhands" />Thank you for bringing me the news, even if it wasn’t what I expected.
12a_side_02_gathergift_openbox_desc: Open Edwyn's lockbox and check if there's a gift for Edda
12a_side_02_gathergift_talktoedda_desc: Return to Edda Koning with Eddie's anniversary gift
12a_side_03_collectpicks_adamant_contain: Collect Picks in Hiraeth Peak for the Master Builder
12a_side_03_collectpicks_collectpicks_ad: Gather Picks from the Miners' Supply Crates
12a_side_03_collectpicks_container_desc: Collect picks from Cynefin Mine and Hiraeth Peak
12a_side_03_collectpicks_gotoadamant_des: Go to Hiraeth Peak and look for the Picks
12a_side_03_collectpicks_gotomiclot_desc: Go to Cynefin Mine and look for the Miners
12a_side_03_collectpicks_miclot_containe: Collect Picks from Cynefin Mine for the Master Builder
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_desc: Prydwen is short on resources. Cemal, the Master Builder has asked you to retrieve the miners' picks so that he may melt them into iron.
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_incomplete: Did you get all the miners' picks? Each one is an heirloom which cuts through rock with ease. It will be simpler to train you people with them.
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_proposal: I wish that you could retrieve the miners, such hard workers all of them, all equipped with picks that date back to Artorius's reign. Maybe you could retrieve the heirloom picks? I'd be most appreciative.
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_response_a: …8, 9, 10. The miners' heirloom picks are all here, all accounted for and in good condition.
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_response_b: This will be a big aid to building our defenses. How can I thank you for this?
12a_side_03_collectpicks_obj_response_ne: Hah. You have my friendship, rajal sadaq. And my time. And an odd job if you ever have need of one.
We are always on the lookout for honest, hardworking people. And you strike me as being one.
12a_side_03_collectpicks_talktocemal_des: Return to Cemal in Prydwen and give him the Picks
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_container_des: Seek and destroy the explosive barrels in Traitor's Hold
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_destroybarrel: Destroy the explosives and make the Pirates suffer
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_gototraitors_: Go to Traitor's Hold which is crawling with Pirates
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_desc: Squire Ashe needs your help to blow up a bunch of pirates at Brysedd Shore.
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_incomplet: What are you waiting for? Blow up the pirates, already!
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_proposal_: I was a baby. And an absolute terror. Folks here say I used to leap out from behind trees and startle them.
My bag had a fleur-de-lis. And I spoke a little French back then.
Hah! What a good way to turn the barrels on them! Sneak up on the pirates, light their barrels, and then BOOM! Pirates blown to pieces!
I’ll keep watch here and make sure no one foils our grand plan!
Royal? Hah! Hardly. I just want to make these pirates cry for their mothers.
If only they didn’t have so many weapons and barrels of gunpowder…
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_response: Hah! That was magnifique! You're handy with gunpowder barrels! Had Ser Payne witnessed this, he might have even made you a squire!
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_response_: Oui! Ser Payne sees the spark of a knight in me. I have to train more. And fight more. And impress the Regent...
But, you’ll see! I’ll become a knight soon! Then everyone will call me Ser Ashe!
“Is that how you became a squire?”
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_obj_start_pro: “When did you come to the island?”
12a_side_04_explodebarrels_talktoashe_de: Tell Ashe Dubois in Brysedd Shore you've taken care of the explosives
12a_side_05_artifactshards_container_des: Search the ruins of Khalladan for shards of Fatimah's mirror
12a_side_05_artifactshards_gotoarchenar_: Go to Khalladan and inspect the ruins there
12a_side_05_artifactshards_obj_desc: A wistful Hugo Molina has asked you to help him find the missing fragments of his Lost wife's mirror.
12a_side_05_artifactshards_obj_incomplet: Did you have any luck with the missing fragments of Fatimah's mirror?
12a_side_05_artifactshards_obj_proposal_: It is when you’re the reason your woman is no more. Even the moon burns you. Fatimah’s soul gave up on me.
She came to me in a dream the other day and asked me to piece together this mirror. But I don’t have all the fragments.
Would you? Fatimah said if I piece this mirror for her, she'll finally find peace, the peace I stole from her.
We were so happy once, but all the sacrifices we made... Have you ever been with someone and yet felt so alone?
12a_side_05_artifactshards_obj_response_: Gracias, kind soul! Fatimah always loved her mirrors. With this last fragment, she can have her final one.
She said mirrors have a certain magic to them. And I can sense the energy in this, almost a strange calling…
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_archenarcollect: Collect Glittering Stones and Crystalline Tears
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_collectjewels_d: Collect Crystalline Tears from the Celestials
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_collectstones_d: Collect Glittering Stone to make the memorials shine
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_container_desc: Enter Khalladan to collect memorial crafting materials for Olde Geiser
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_gotoarchenar_de: Go to Khalladan the place of the Ancients
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_desc: Help Olde Geiser provide the families of the Lost with some peace. Collect Crystalline Tears and Glittering Stones for him to build memorials with.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_incomplete: Did the ruins reveal their secrets and shed their tears for you? Not yet? Well, may your sight be sharp and your pick be purposeful.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_proposal_a: I craft Lost memorials from Crystalline Tears, to soothe grieving families.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_proposal_b: Peace is always in demand. Many ask me for my services. But, the Crystalline Tears are over and so, the tears of people must wait.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_proposal_ne: Hmm. You look more limber than me. You may have luck with these ruins.
If you can brave the eldritch dangers and gather some Crystalline Tears for me, I’ll give you a good portion of what I got from the families.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_response_a: So many tears, such little time. You've done well by bringing these Crystalline Tears.
12a_side_06_gatherjewels_obj_response_b: You will be in the thoughts of many families when they say the final prayers for their kin.
12a_side_07_forgering_collect_container_: Search Shatterwall for memories of those who've lived here
12a_side_07_forgering_collectnotes_desc: Collect Memoirs to show that some Lost had wives
12a_side_07_forgering_collectrings_desc: Collect Wedding Bands from Lost who were married once
12a_side_07_forgering_container_desc: Go to Shatterwall and collect evidence of some Lost being wedded
12a_side_07_forgering_craftcharm_desc: Craft a protective charm from the Lost wedding bands
12a_side_07_forgering_gotolakeside_desc: Return the wedding bands and memoirs to Jeong Iseul in Preiddeu Farms
12a_side_07_forgering_gotoshatterwall_de: Go to Shatterwall once a territory of King Artorius
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_desc: Nabi has asked for evidence to prove getting married is not the answer to turning Lost. Hopefully, this will get her meddlesome marriage-minded mother off her back.
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_incomplete_a: Do you think there's a way you could bring back artifacts to prove some Lost used to be married?
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_proposal_a: Yes. Once upon a time, I was even destined to be queen. But I lost my betrothed to the sea on our way to the island.
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_proposal_b: My mother hasn't given up hope I will be married one day. She fears the worst if I don't.
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_proposal_next2: My mother will have your ear off with all her arguments. For now, I'll surrender to the shadow of her blind belief. Unless-
Do you think there's a way you could bring back artifacts to prove some Lost used to be married?
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_proposal_next_: That I'll turn into a Lost, like the ones who haunt this island, a creature with no purpose but to haunt women with better prospects.
Mother grew up with tales of the virgin ghost. It's hard to shake her out of her belief.
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_response_a: A talisman? To protect me from evil and lower my chances of turning into a ghost?
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_response_b: Does this mean my mother no longer believes marrying is protection against turning into the Lost?
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_response_next_: And my mother will always want that.
