If she ever turned into a Lost, which I hope she never does, she'd follow me around with the sole purpose of getting me married. And probably scare all my suitors away!
12a_side_07_forgering_obj_response_promp: “She still wants you to be married.”
12a_side_07_forgering_talkto_prompt: “No, but you could make a charm.”
12a_side_07_forgering_talkto_response_a: A talisman to ward off evil spirits? What a clever idea! Why don't you use the wedding rings?
12a_side_07_forgering_talkto_response_b: Maybe they'll influence Nabi and she’ll want to get married sooner.
12a_side_07_forgering_talkto_start_a: Wedding rings and love letters, hmm... So, some of the Lost used to be married once? That makes no sense.
12a_side_07_forgering_talkto_start_b: And you're saying that even getting married doesn't keep you from turning into one of these creatures? How disturbing!
12a_side_07_forgering_talktoiseul_desc: Show the evidence you've collected to Jeong Iseul
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_collectteeth_des: Collect wolf fangs from the beasts that prowl here
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_container_desc: Travel to Silverclaw Cave and collect wolf fangs
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_gotosilverclaw_d: Go to Silverclaw Cave, home of the wolves
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_desc: Hamza Killic's brain is dancing with a new idea. Collect wolf fangs so that he may bring his invention to life!
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_incomplete: Did you get the six wolf teeth like I asked? I’ll be able to complete my brilliant invention then. Trust me, you've never seen anything as daring as this!
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_proposal_a: More days than a snail has teeth. I left to pursue my great ideas in my reckless youth.
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_proposal_b: I still feel as reckless and almost as young. And if I can get enough wolf teeth, I'll finally be able to craft my invention!
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_proposal_nex: I already have twenty-six pearly white wolf fangs. I need six more, just like them.
They should be from robust middle-aged wolves, warriors, if you can spot them. Could you get the teeth for me? I'll be grateful!
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_proposal_pro: “How many wolf teeth do you need?”
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_response_a: You spotted the wolves well - middle-aged, strong, aggressive fighters most likely.
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_response_b: These are the perfect fangs. They're sparkly. They're white. They can cut through meat!
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_obj_response_nex: The first-of-its-kind dental weapon for the toothless elderly among us, those who have the punch but lack the bite.
One chomp from these pearly beauties will make an attacker regret their choices. Brilliant, no?
12a_side_08_gatherfangs_talktohazma_desc: Give the wolf fangs to Hamza at Preiddeu Farms
12a_side_09_collectglass_archenarcollect: Search Arruda Ranch for the glassworks and letters left behind by Olivia's father
12a_side_09_collectglass_collectglass_de: Collect the glassworks made by Olivia's father
12a_side_09_collectglass_collectletters_: Collect the letters written by Olivia's father
12a_side_09_collectglass_container_desc: Travel to Arruda Ranch and collect the glassworks made by Olivia's father
12a_side_09_collectglass_gotoarruda_desc: Go to Arruda Ranch, Olivia Barovier's old home
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_desc: A grieving Olivia Barovier has asked you to retrieve her Lost father's glassworks from Arruda Ranch.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_incomplete: Were you able to enter the house? Did you find my father’s glassworks?
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_proposal_a: Scars. My father's mistakes wore him down till he broke. He always thought the world was better... He shattered when he saw the truth.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_proposal_b: He lost himself in making glassworks. People came from all over the island to buy them.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_proposal_ne: Would you? I can’t step foot in that house. There, there are too many memories…
It isn't easy to be second place in your father's eyes. Please just get the glassworks, if you can.
He had a deep relationship with glass, knew exactly which mineral would elicit the color he desired.
His works were treasures that brought hope. But now they're lost in a house filled with horrors.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_proposal_pr: “I could get his things for you.”
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_response_a: Getting into the house must not have been easy. I am grateful for your courage.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_response_b: These are the last things I have of my father. At least he got to spend his last days with his precious work.
12a_side_09_collectglass_obj_response_ne: He wrote me letters? I'll read his words, although I am fearful of what they may reveal.
Isn't it ironic that my emotions are as fragile as his glass? At least his works have value.
12a_side_09_collectglass_talktoolivia_de: Return to Olivia Brovier and share her father's letters with her
12a_side_10_breakcurse_container_desc: Travel to Deadman's Cove and find the source of Hugo's torment
12a_side_10_breakcurse_defeatselina_desc: Defeat Fatimah Molina so that Hugo can finally let go
12a_side_10_breakcurse_destroydevice_des: Destroy the Scrying Device to keep Fatimah from haunting Hugo
12a_side_10_breakcurse_gotodeadmans_desc: Go to Deadman's Cove to look for the scrying device
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_desc: Fixing the mirror for Hugo worsened matters. He needs your help breaking the large mirror at Deadman's Cove, so that he can finally let go of his Lost wife.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_incomplete: Were you able to destroy the mirror or did Fatimah's voice get to you too? My Fatimah can be quite compelling.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_proposal_a: I had to. Her words are still pounding in my head.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_proposal_b: I broke her heart. And now I've broken her mirror. Maybe that's why she won't stop haunting me.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_proposal_next: You are right. She speaks through another large mirror in the cove that's filled with pirates.
I'll need your help to break it. But I must get her taunts out of my head.
Si! I do. Fatimah was the joy of my soul once. I left Spain, left my family because of my love for her.
I loved my querida even when we fought. Even when her cloudy gray eyes turned into a storm.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_proposal_prom: “Do you have happy memories of her?”
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_response_a: How is it that you can love someone and yet living with them can slowly destroy you?
12a_side_10_breakcurse_obj_response_b: This island didn’t help. But oh, Fatimah, I miss you so much.
12a_side_10_breakcurse_talktohugo_desc: Return to Hugo Molina in Preiddeu Farms
12a_side_11_clericamulets_collectamulets: Collect the Protective Amulets Dayo had given these Lost
12a_side_11_clericamulets_container_desc: Travel to Brigand's Bastion and collect the protective amulets
12a_side_11_clericamulets_gotobrigands_d: Go to Brigand's Bastion to find Dayo Musa's Lost congregation
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_desc: Dayo Musa's hopeful plan went horribly wrong. Retrieve the amulets from the Lost to put them at ease and return the amulets to him.
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_incomplete: The journals of Dayo Musa should really be discussed with him.
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_proposal_a: I tried to guide the people towards their faith, by giving them something tangible to focus on.
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_proposal_b: I made sure each of them had an amulet to see them through. Like the stories of old, we’d weather this plague together.
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_proposal_n: They trusted me and I let them down.
I should have gone into this with clearer eyes, and because of my failure, they have all fallen. I, Dayo Musa, must find someone strong to gather their amulets and give them proper rites…
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_response_a: Hello, friend! I hope this day is treating you with kindness.
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_response_b: Would you have time to help a fellow? Regrettably, the people I was trying to protect have turned into the Lost…
12a_side_11_clericamulets_obj_response_n: Thank you, friend. You have put my mind at ease.
The problems on this island are larger than those I've experienced. And one can't use their hand to force the sun to set.
May fortune be with you! I'd come to the settlement to find help. But no one had time to listen.
It takes a special person to go out of their way to help someone else. Did you find everyone's amulets?
12a_side_11_clericamulets_talktodayo_des: Return the amulets to Dayo Musa in Prydwen
12a_side_12_knightscrest_container_desc: Take the proof of the Dubois Knighthood lineage to Ashe in Prydwen
12a_side_12_knightscrest_gotoashe_desc: Inform Ashe Dubois about her knighted ancestor
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_desc: Ashe Dubois, Ser Payne's squire, has always longed to be a knight. Give her the proof that someone in her family used to be a knight once.
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_incomplete: The proclamation concerning the Dubois Family Crest should should be taken to Ashe Dubois.
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_proposal_a: The helm, the bow, and the crest of Margot will mark the Dubois family history.
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_proposal_b: Through generations, the Dubois name will be welcome in the halls of Artorius. They must be informed that they can uphold this honor.
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_response: Really? You found something that belonged to my family! What is it? Who are they? Where can I meet them?
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_response_ne: Ooh! Give me that! She was a prestigious knight in the time of Artorius himself. I can’t believe it.
This knight business runs in my blood! Thank you for bringing this to me. I’m going to keep it as a reminder.
12a_side_12_knightscrest_obj_response_pr: “A Dubois lady was a famous Knight.”
12a_side_13_devilhoney_container_desc: Travel to Hiraeth Lookout to find Devil Honey for Geertie Lother
12a_side_13_devilhoney_gatherhoney_desc: Collect Devil Honey for Geertie, the Prydwen barkeep
12a_side_13_devilhoney_gotogeertie_desc: Return the honey to Geertie in Prydwen
12a_side_13_devilhoney_gotopit_desc: Go to Hiraeth Lookout to look for honey reserves
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_desc: Get combs of Devil's Honey from Geertie Lother's private reserve at Hiraeth Lookout and return them to her in Prydwen.
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_incomplete: You’ll find the honeycombs at Hiraeth Lookout. Just wait until you taste this honey!
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_proposal_a: They say you've been quite a help, and I was like, "Well, why haven't they helped me?"
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_proposal_b: But then I realized, silly Geertie, it's because you haven't asked!
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_proposal_next: Yes! Honey! Honey so delicious it's called "Devil's Honey." I have a special reserve up on Hiraeth Lookout.
Collect my honeycombs, and I'll give you some to taste.
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_response_a: Aha! There's my honey! Er, I mean my honeycombs. I wasn't calling you "my honey." That would be... absurd.
12a_side_13_devilhoney_obj_response_b: But yes, this is fantastic! I'm going to whip us up some honeycakes right away.
12a_side_14_collectwine_container_desc: Travel to Brysedd Shore and collect bottles of Old World wine from the sands
12a_side_14_collectwine_gatherbottles_de: Collect bottles of Old World wine
12a_side_14_collectwine_gotogeertie_desc: Return the Old World wine to Geertie
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_desc: Celebrate while you still can. Collect jars of Old World wine from Brysedd Shore and share them with Geertie Lother.
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_incomplete: Stars above! The Old World wine from Brysedd Shore! I can't wait. Pirates sure have all the best stuff!
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_proposal_a: Seeing as how everyone is talking about "battening down the hatches" here to protect against the Lost, I think we need to stock up on spirits.
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_proposal_b: And I think I might know a spot to get our hands on some perfectly aged wine from the Old World.
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_proposal_nex: Brysedd Shore! Grab as many jars of wine as you can find there.
We'll celebrate a little, while we still have the time. Who knows what will happen tomorrow?
12a_side_14_collectwine_obj_response: Oh yeah, I can feel the party coming on already! We got wine and honeycakes - it's gonna be a feast!
12a_side_15_collectresources_container_d: Collect and refine raw resources for Prydwen
12a_side_15_collectresources_gather_cont: Collect raw resources from Monarch's Bluffs
12a_side_15_collectresources_gatherrawhi: Gather {itemName} by Skinning Wolves and Boars
12a_side_15_collectresources_gotocemal_d: Provide the collected resources Cemal in Prydwen
12a_side_15_collectresources_obj_desc: Collect Stone, Wood and Leather for Cemal Qadir, Prydwen's Master Builder, so that he can build good defenses for Prydwen.
12a_side_15_collectresources_obj_incompl: Did you get everything? Not one hair of leather should be missing. Every resource counts towards fortifying Prydwen’s defenses.
12a_side_15_collectresources_obj_proposa: Well, I've run into some supply troubles. I was expecting a shipment of stone, timber, and leather this week.
Nothing’s turned up yet. I fear the poor souls I found to help me may have turned into the Lost.
Oh! Would you? That’d be most excellent!
You’d need to cut trees to gather wood, and crush rocks to extract stone - there’s a lot to teach you. But you seem up to the task.
12a_side_15_collectresources_obj_respons: Great! You brought exactly what I needed, the right type and the right amount. Were you always this resourceful?
Haha! You’re a good person, rajal sadaq. You're going to do very well here on Aeternum. I hope to see more of you.
“I've been told I can be handy.”
12a_side_16_togooduse_collectore_desc: Collect unrefined ore from iron veins in Monarch's Bluffs
12a_side_16_togooduse_container_desc: Gather and refine materials to craft your own sword
12a_side_16_togooduse_craftsword_desc: Craft an iron longsword at the Forge
12a_side_16_togooduse_gathersword_desc: Gather the longsword from the Forge
12a_side_16_togooduse_gotocemal_desc: Show the sword you've crafted to Cemal
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_desc: Cemal Qadir is very happy with the work you've done and wants to do something for you in turn. Learn how to build a sword with his guidance.
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_incomplete: Craft me the best sword you can! I want to see what you’re capable of!
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_proposal_a: Words to live by, rajal sadaq! You could be knight material and I want to see you make it through a few more summers, at least.
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_proposal_b: Has anyone taught you how to make a sword?
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_proposal_next_: I suppose I must do everything around here. I'm sure that once I teach you to make a sword, you’ll be able to supply armories.
You have that industrious look about you.
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_response_a: That's a fine-looking sword, rajal sadaq. It would almost rival the swords in Syria.
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_response_b: I'm not surprised. It’s what I've come to expect from you.
12a_side_16_togooduse_obj_response_next: Hah! Drop by at the tavern, anytime you want a drink, alright? I'll tell you stories of the High King Artorius you wouldn’t believe!
12a_side_16_togooduse_refineingot_desc: Refine ore into ingots at the Smelter
12a_side_17_marketboard_obj_desc: Visit the Town Project Board of Monarch's Bluffs and find tasks to help the people of the settlement.
12a_side_17_marketboard_openboard_desc: Visit the Monarch's Bluffs Town Project Board
12a_tomira_response_a: Well there's so much uncertainty when faced with the soulless. I don’t know how the Regent does it.
12a_tomira_response_b: She's normally so good at making decisions for all of us. It puzzles me why she didn’t get to us sooner.
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_01: Corruption will claim them all. Warning them is a futile effort. They are blind to the real danger all around them...
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_01_sub_01: Corruption will claim them all. Warning them is a futile effort.
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_01_sub_02: They are blind to the real danger all around them…
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_02: You see? They are all corrupt in their own way. Whether they know it or not, they are already welcoming my embrace…
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_02_sub_01: You see? They are all corrupt in their own way.
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_02_sub_02: Whether they know it or not, they are already welcoming my embrace…
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_03: Look how they fall in line when they realize something greater than them is at their doorstep. It will be the same with Corruption…
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_03_sub_01: Look how they fall in line when they realize something greater than them is at their doorstep.
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_03_sub_02: It will be the same with Corruption…
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_04: So, you've stopped the Lost's conquest of this kingdom. I have to wonder - are you sure you've really helped these people?
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_04_sub_01: So, you've stopped the Lost's conquest of this kingdom.
12a_whisper_monarchsbluffs_04_sub_02: I have to wonder - are you sure you've really helped these people?
1302_1304_ancientherbs_description: Sealed for hundreds of years, these herbs are florid and off-color from the rest of the herbs on the island.
1302_1305_ancienthealerskit_description: A kit containing crumbling bandages and aged tinctures that the Ancients once used.
1302_1306_fungalspores_description: Spores collected from Alluvium Marl in Garden of Genesis.
1303_1310_sweetincense_description: Fragrant and sweet-smelling incense used in ceremonial honorings.
1303_1311_ancientarmorscraps_description: Still good after all these years.
1303_1311_burnishedbuckles_description: Buckles make to outlast both salt and sea.
1303_1311_infusedlining_description: For an extra layer of protection.
1303_1311_reinforcedweave_description: Durable fabric that stands the test of time.
1304_1301_musiccompositions_description: Compositions of sheet music made for lute, harpsichord, and vocal accompaniment.
1305_1315_heartofallflame_description: A chalice for holding offerings to a flame demon, once held by Falmea.
1305_1315_singedbranches_description: Branches stained by fire's deadly kiss.
1305_1315_unhallowedwater_description: Water made unhallowed by an unspoken ritual. It bubbles faintly.
1305_1315_wyrdwoodashes_description: Pure white ashes made by a ritual involving burning Wyrdwood.
1310_1306_debtorspurse_description: A full coin purse stolen from the residents of Weaver's Fen by those who tried to flee the village.
1310_1306_metalworkingsupplies_descripti: Various tools and instruments used to shape metal.
1310_1314_ancientwood_description: Wood from time immemorial, and trusted for ages.
1310_1314_hawkfeathers_description: Feathers for the hawks whose keen eyes see their prey below.
1310_1314_luckyrabbitsfoot_description: A rabbit's foot once carried by the Huntress herself.
1310_1314_wyrdwoodresin_description: Resin derived from Wyrdwood trees on Aeternum.
1323_0101_fq08_complete_available_respon: I love to fish more than I love to fight nowadays, though I still do a fair bit of the latter.
1323_0101_fq08_incomplete: Five boots, out of the water, and then visit Master Fisher O'Connor. Good luck!
1323_0101_fq08_objective_desc: Catch three Slimy Boots in Weaver's Fen to clean up the waters for Master Fisher Agarwal and deliver a new line to Master Fisher O'Connor in Restless Shore.
1323_0101_fq08_prompt: "What kind of fish are abundant in the Fen?"
1323_0101_fq08_proposal: Shoes are most often lost to the swamp's pull, and if you could fish up five Boots that would at least be a start in helping clean up the pollution in the area.
1323_0101_fq08_proposal_next: Once you've helped clean up the Fen, go see Master Fisher O'Connor. They're a spritely one and will likely have a grander task for you.
1323_0101_fq08_proposal_prompt: "What should I do when I'm done?"
1323_0101_slimyboot_description: A battered, oil-soaked scrap of a boot that reeks of death.
1330_0201_startingthefireitem_descriptio: A torch that burns with a bright azure flame.
1330_0202_burningfromtheinsideitem_descr: Essence found on the bones of the Ancient Guardians that contributes to their eerie glow.
1330_0203_contraption_description: The recipe calls for a small amount of duck and a large amount of flame.
1331_0201_ravagerdrop_description: Huge, heavy, and proof that you killed something enormous and humanoid.
1331_0202_joanemblem_description: The inner surface of this crude silver ring is etched with a tiny skull with an arrow through it.
1331_0202_markusemblem_description: The inner surface of this crude silver ring is etched with a tiny skull with an arrow through it.
1331_0203_ruizemblem_description: The inner surface of this crude silver ring is etched with a tiny skull with an arrow through it.
1332_0201_alligatortooth_description: A sample of the thick, scaly hide from a Weaver’s Fen alligator.
1332_0202_boartusk_description: A tusk broken from the snout of a Weaver's Fen boar.
1332_0203_wolffang_description: A paw hewn from the carcass of a Mallory Wolf.
1332_0204_alphafang_description: A large wolf paw, taken from the carcass of the Packleader. A fine trophy indeed.
1333_ancientstonesample_description: A chunk of oddly heavy stone.
1334_0201_elkgland_description: You don't want to contemplate what you had to do to acquire this.
1334_0201_laudanum_description: The smell isn’t wholly unpleasant, though it does tend to linger in the back of the throat.
1334_0201_perfume_description: Perfectly captures the smell of the Fen.
1334_0201_spores_description: Smells strongly of decay and sticks to practically any surface, including hands.
1335_0201_canopuscoin_description: An old coin made of blue metal.
1335_0202_lasluswellcoin_description: An old coin worn down by the currents.
1335_0203_scrapofclothing_description: A quick sketch of a path leading back out of the ruins, drawn on a scrap of parchment with what appears to be charcoal.
1335_0204_token_description: Each charm is a different kind of coin.
1345_partyguest_01_tasktopic_response_a: Well, I need a full-time assistant. But I can see you're not volunteering for that.
1345_partyguest_01_tasktopic_response_b: You know, if you could give my flowers some water, I might be able to slip away to the Medleyfaire.
1346_partyguest_02_tasktopic_response_a: The… Medleyfaire? But there are so many people there! And I… I have cleaning to do.
1346_partyguest_02_tasktopic_response_b: But you asked so kindly, I feel awful saying no. If… if you help me clean, maybe I could come?
1347_partyguest_03_tasktopic_response_a: Don't apologize, you just had the unluckiest timing. My carpenter's bench is in need of repair.
1347_partyguest_03_tasktopic_response_b: Tell you what, traveler. Help me fix it, and I'll consider it payment for my services at the Summer Medleyfaire.
1348_partyguest_04_tasktopic_response_a: Oh, stranger, please inspire me! I am listless, without purpose or flow in my works.
1348_partyguest_04_tasktopic_response_b: Do something beautiful! Show me how you would dance at the Summer Medleyfaire.
1349_partyguest_05_tasktopic_response_a: Really? Then I hope you aren't frightened of bees.
1349_partyguest_05_tasktopic_response_b: Mine are normally quite gentle, but these damn Maudlinbugs get the bees all riled up. A little smoke should fix it.
13_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_a: The Weavers believe they're the best thing that happened to cloth after weaving was invented.
13_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_b: Sure, they can stitch a flawless seam. But can they grant an outfit magical powers like I can?
13_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: I don't do it. My pet weaverbirds do. Poor things dipped their beaks in Azoth a while ago. But it gave them magical powers.
13_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: And no, I'm not going to show you the birds! I don't let the babies out of my house!!
13_summer_01_questreward_description: A starter Guitar and music for The Maudlinbug Haze.
13_summer_01_welcome_complete_a: Yes, now you're ready to revel! I've always loved music, but the magic of the island breathes fresh life into my tunes.
13_summer_01_welcome_complete_b: Especially this time of year, when the Aeternum Sturgeon returns to our shores.
13_summer_01_welcome_description: Welcome to Summer Medleyfaire! Interact with the Summer Deposit Boxes and collect the instruments placed around the Summer Village.
13_summer_01_welcome_giveinstruments: Return instruments to Master of Ceremonies
13_summer_01_welcome_incomplete: Come one, come all, to the Summer Medleyfaire! Ah, dear friend, are you still without an instrument? Don't be shy, select any you wish!
13_summer_01_welcome_obtainbass: Collect Upright Bass in Summer Village
13_summer_01_welcome_obtainflute: Collect Azoth Flute in Summer Village
13_summer_01_welcome_proposal_a: Tsk, such flattery! We're going to be fast friends, you and I. But where are my manners?
13_summer_01_welcome_proposal_b: I'll be your Master of Ceremonies during this joyous time. Music, fishing, dancing, feasting--you'll find my Summer Villages full of revelry!
13_summer_01_welcome_proposal_next_a: Oh, of course! I've expanded festivities to Everfall, Monarch's Bluffs, Brightwood, and Weaver's Fen for your celebratory convenience!
13_summer_01_welcome_proposal_next_b: Find an instrument, any instrument, and help me fill the air with music!
13_summer_02_maudlinbugs_complete_a: Let's see. Maudlindust, bags of bait, and… hmm… festive spirit. My dear friend, you are finally ready for the main event!
13_summer_02_maudlinbugs_complete_b: Angling for the largest, fairest, most impressive fish in all creation: the Aeternum Sturgeon!
13_summer_02_maudlinbugs_description: Travel to a Maudlinbug Swarmand perform the Maudlinbug Haze with a guitar equipped to collect Maudlinbug Bait and Maudlindust.

13_weaverfen_body_11_01_lorenote:
The flowers referenced in the Ancient tablets quickly proved a waste of time. Whatever reason the Ancients cultivated them, it was not to defend against the Crimson Madness. 

Conversely, the mushrooms seem to offer some promise. I was able to infuse them with the Azoth from the ruins, and the mushrooms' luminescence dims when in the presence of Corruption. 

Desperate as they are, it was not difficult to convince the villagers here to drink the mushroom concoction I prepared, though I did leave out the fact that they were gathered from the ruins. Whether the serum is effective remains to be seen.
13_weaverfen_body_11_02_lorenote:
Finally, my efforts have yielded results. I have exposed several volunteers to Corruption and while the mixture may still require some fine-tuning, it's clear that it works... with some caveats. 

Unfortunately, I noticed right away that the cure somehow "deadened" the volunteers' senses, and a short time later, they seemed to lose their ability to communicate. Later, their eyes began to glow with a chilling Azoth blue, and they eventually became completely non-responsive. The villagers have taken to calling them "Lost," and the condition seems to be irreversible. 

I am convinced that with a few more tests, I can eliminate these disappointing side effects, but of course, I am now having great difficulty recruiting more volunteers. Even Brytmar is having doubts.
13_weaverfen_body_11_03_lorenote:
Damn it all, the situation here in Periville is deteriorating by the hour! It seems one of the "Lost" somehow passed their condition on to a family member who had not been a volunteer. I offered to assess and treat the poor woman, but I was met with nothing but anger and fury. 

Everyone seems to have forgotten that this effort is in pursuit of protection against a far greater evil! With a few further tests... I am certain I can perfect the cure, and perhaps even find a remedy. If I am to find more volunteers, however, it will not be here. 

Brytmar is helping to pack up all my equipment and research, and we will leave this town of fools in the morning. Good riddance.
13_weaverfen_body_11_04_lorenote:
Let it be hereby known that the Shadow Hunters of Karburg are offering a reward for anyone providing information that leads to the capture of the Corpse Crone. 

The foul sorceress has dark hair and a pale, violet scar in place of a missing eye. She was last seen fleeing her home in Periville, but it is believed that she remains in hiding somewhere in Weaver's Fen. 

Let it be further known that anyone who harbors or abets the Crone shall be held to equal account for her crimes and shall be subject to the same sentence.
13_weaverfen_body_11_05_lorenote:
I've translated the glyphs on the bridge, and it's clear this passage was once a major supply route. Just as with the obelisk, the bridge was protected by magical devices strategically placed to ward away some danger, almost certainly the Corruption. 

If I could find one of these devices, I had hoped to deconstruct it and determine what energy powered the Ancients' wards.

However, I've searched the length of the bridge, and whatever devices the Ancients' placed have long since been looted or destroyed. The only possibility is that one remains somewhere in the bridge's upper framework... if, if I can get up there.
13_weaverfen_body_11_06_lorenote_a: At last! ! I've found one of the Ancient devices on top of the bridge, and there is even a flicker of power lurking inside it. This is the key to the answers I've been seeking. The list of experiments I can conduct with this is nearly endless.
13_weaverfen_body_11_06_lorenote_b: Hopefully, this will renew Ser Brytmar's resolve. She recently declared her intent to abandon this endeavor, but even she should realize the potential of this... apparatus. If not, I will have to convince her, because I will most certainly need help getting it down from here and hauling it to Karburg.
13_weaversfen_body_01_01:
Fen of folly, Fen of sorrow 

With no promise of tomorrow 

Fen, beloved, Fen, our home 

Morning swamplight, how it shone



Sunrise light my lady love 

Song that’s sweeter than a dove 

Fen of folly, Fen of sorrow 

How I long to see tomorrow
13_weaversfen_body_01_02:
Lady Love, once fair and fertile 

Hair adorned with sheaves of myrtle 

Skin so fair with pox now riven 

Faithless scourge beyond prescription





Lady love, once bound together 

Love eternal lost forever 

Bliss unending, mine to lose 

A dismal fate that none would choose
13_weaversfen_body_02_01: As if there isn’t enough danger on this God-forsaken island, the alligators, it seems, have developed a new appetite – for us! Once, they were content to share the bounty of the Fens with us, but now they are creeping ever closer to our fishery. Last evening one of our fishing boats was attacked, and poor Johnson barely escaped with his life. His wife has begged him not to return to work, and I can’t say I blame her for it. \n\nI’ve heard stories of a strange sickness creeping over the land, driving the wildlife into a frenzy. I wrote it off as mere hysteria – another superstition formed in a place that defies explanation. But now I am not so sure. If something has tainted he alligators’ food supply, they’ll turn on whatever’s still unspoiled. After all… to them, we’re just meat…
13_weaversfen_body_02_02: My darkest fears are realized. The fish of the fens have become jaundiced and sickly, and many of the townsfolk have become ill eating them. This must be the pestilence that’s driving the alligators closer to town. Without their usual food source, they’ll turn on anything they can sink their teeth into, including settlers. \n\nFor now, the town has enough provisions on hand to keep everyone fed. But those pickled gar and catfish were meant for trade with the neighboring townsfolk. Deprived of our primary food source, the town will surely wither away. And who would wish to stay, with ravenous alligators prowling about, raiding our stores?
13_weaversfen_body_03_01:
Dear Kemal, 

Have you seen the blue flames in the distance? As Overseer, I know you have other duties to attend to, but I find their unnatural beauty equal parts eerie and captivating. Since nothing in this strange place seems to be benign, I fear dangers they may portend. I am putting together an expedition to the ruins of Canopus to the east, in the hope I might divine their origins. It is my wish that you will sanction our journey, and offer what assistance you can. 

Your friend, Yusuf
13_weaversfen_body_03_02:
Day 16— 

Our expedition to this ancient site has proven 

The Ancient Guardians that haunt this place are single-minded and relentless. Regardless of how many times we strike them down, they rise again and redouble their attack. What’s more their desiccated bodies seem immune to the strange contamination sweeping over this land. We have no such luck. 

I lost three men today, attempting to explore the ruins: Carl, Vincent, and Amadeus. Each one returned, but they are somehow slower, and duller in wits. I can only assume they are sick with whatever malady is sweeping through the Fens. I myself am developing sores where one of the devils cut me. My throat is dry and I fear I have a fever. If I should fall, will I meet the same fate they have, returned to life, but somehow lesser? We are no closer to understanding the source of the mysterious blue flames. Only closer to death. May God have mercy on our souls.
13_weaversfen_body_04_01: I am finally finished repairing the plank walkways that span the collapsed portions of the disjointed Vega Bridge. I pray this will make it easier for travelers to venture home along this ancient, hallowed route. Unfortunately, the Ancient Guardians have also taken to traveling along the span. I had to kill countless of their number just to make the repairs, and I fear that a less well-prepared traveler will simply be overwhelmed. These timelost creatures resurrect as we do, reborn in a cloud of Azoth smoke.
13_weaversfen_body_04_02: The Ancient Guardians who watch over this bridge seem somehow bound to this place. Perhaps their Ancient masters charged them with watching over the site. What a cursed existence… forced to patrol the same stretch of stone for all time, in defense of a long-lost civilization. I wonder how these poor conscripts were chosen. Were they cruelly pressed into service, or did they volunteer for eternal service to their masters? How I wish these old bones still held the power of speech, for who knows what secrets they might divulge, had we the power to ask.
13_weaversfen_body_04_03: Vega, the brightest star of the constellation Lyra, shines brightly over the bridge tonight. I asked you to meet me here, but you have not come. Have you forgotten me? Or worse yet, do you no longer remember me fondly? I will wait here until the moon is at the zenith, praying to look upon your face once more.
13_weaversfen_body_04_04: The moon over the Vega Bridge tonight is a sight to see, it pales by comparison to your comely face. There is acrimony between our people, the denizens of Periville and Taryville, but here on this bridge between our two townships, we free from the trappings of name and clan and creed. Here is a place where, despite its dangers, we can live and love freely.
13_weaversfen_body_05_01: Those Periville miscreants got one over on me again last night. We were betting on the turkey races down at the local tavern, and I placed a bet on the local hen. Unfortunately, ma caught that one. I warned her not to be so rough with the bird, but she always has been overzealous. The poor bird couldn’t even run a straight line, and it was squawking and flapping all over the main hall. After paying those swine what I owed them, I borrowed Gertrude’s old blunderbuss to put the damn thing out of its misery. \n\nI’ll not make this mistake again. The next time Periville comes to town, I’ll catch the turkey myself. And slip it a little something from the alchemist for good measure… That ought to lay this little rivalry to rest, once and for all.
13_weaversfen_body_05_02: I think our little town rivalry is starting to make Flores batty. I see it on his face when we come to the bar. He's a decent fellow, and a good barkeep to boot. Best ale in the Fens! He even lets us take our drinks on credit. But I fear his patience is wearing thin. Last night’s brawl between the Periville boys and us locals ended in a broken chair and half-dozen shattered bottles. Now Flores expects us to cough up for the damage and the spirits. Where does he expect us to scrounge up the coin? \n\nHe's a good man, I swear! But he's tired of the fighting. We better win big on the next Turkey race, or I fear my bar tab has come due.
13_weaversfen_body_06_01: In the evening, if you keep very still and listen, the Fen speaks will whisper its secrets. These settlers, I fear, lack the will to har them, just as those who came before that I fear will not hear it.
13_weaversfen_body_06_02: I met a settler who spoke to me in the tongue of my people, but I pretended not to understand. That life feels far away now, and they are my family no longer. I believe he knew that I understood, yet respected my silence.
13_weaversfen_body_06_03: I happened upon another lost in the Fen. I cannot say I pitied him, but I did resolve to help him. I placed a small sack of food and medicinal herbs along his path, so that he might find it. Then I piled rocks in such a way to point the way to the Ancient Road. He should soon find his way home, has he the wits to decipher the sign.
13_weaversfen_body_06_04: Weeks have passed since I guided the wayward settler back to the path. At first, I thought he had come seeking another gift, but instead he lay down a satchel of his own, nestled atop a ring of flowers. I am almost moved by the notion he would risk the journey back through the swamp simply to thank me.
13_weaversfen_body_06_05: Today I spied a hunter. A woman bound for the lakefront. I offered her no aid, as she had no need of any. I wonder what creature she hunted out here amongst the trees and brambles that encircle the crater.
13_weaversfen_body_06_06: I saw the banners of a king held high by his soldiers as they marched along the ancient road. Each tradesman and fisherman they passed, they greeted kindly. They did not seem to be marching to war, but rather to tour the settlements Fen. \n\nThough they appear to be men of honor, I fear what acrimony they may bring to this land. Time will tell.
13_weaversfen_body_06_07: Hunters of the Fen and those from west of the isle seek to capture the ridge at the top of the hill. I see that now. They move quietly through the swamp, and while I have no wish to see more blood spilled, I left gifts and markers to aid them on their path. While I am hesitant of their intentions, I have more to fear from those they call their enemies.
13_weaversfen_body_06_08: I saw a man of the South today. There was no mistaking him: thick beard and eyes full of fear. He came not seeking something, he was running from it. \n\nAs he ran, he cast off his garments, as if they were somehow contaminated. I thought for a moment that he might be mad, until I saw the golden crest upon his discarded trappings. I knew, then, that he was shedding any trace of his homeland, just as I had.
13_weaversfen_body_06_09: I traveled North long ago, to a mountain that was tainted by poison. The great peak loomed over all, and within its long shadow, umbral forces toiled. \n\nI believed it must be some realm of the dead, where those on this isle go to die – but it was the mountain itself that I feared most. I dared not return there for many years, fearful of what terrible revelations might follow.
13_weaversfen_body_06_10: When I had gathered my courage and I returned to the mountain many years later. Perhaps ten summers had passed. Perhaps a hundred. And in that time the mountain had grown angry. \n\nNow, a great stone crown that rested in the air above it. And in its shadow labored a greater collection of shades than ever, industrious as insects upon a corpse. What power they served, I could not see, for I dared not draw any closer.
13_weaversfen_body_06_11: The Lost, their eyes roiling with grim despair, have come to plague the denizens of the Fen. We shall never be rid of them – another malediction of this forsaken swamp – as if our troubles were not already legion. Time has not been kind to our land. And each day it becomes harder and harder for those who call this place their home.
13_weaversfen_body_06_12: Today something happened that I did not expect. \n\nTucked into the pocket of a desiccated corpse, I found a peculiar talisman. Squared corners, shaved bezels. An evil visage glared back at me as I wiped away the muck and grime. I cast it deep into the mire, where I prayed none might find it.
13_weaversfen_body_06_13:
It appears I have made a terrible mistake. For the hillock where I discarded the talisman has begun to change. A strange, red moss has begun to sprout from the mud, as if the symbol itself had struck deep into the earth and it was now bleeding. 

Yet when I prodded the growth with a stick, countless holes opened, like small, hungry mouths, each one seeking to drink in all that was around it. 

The talisman had given birth to a new stain upon the marsh. I lit a fire using the oils of the Fen and watched the evil smoke rise into the air as the moss twitched and writhed.
13_weaversfen_body_06_14: The journey back to the lake was a mortal, but necessary risk, for I needed to heal the child. Hiding from torchlight behind narrow trees, I narrowly avoided the patrols of these strange and evil-looking men.
13_weaversfen_body_06_15: The Fen waters run red, and these evil-looking men trudge through them without a care. Countless battles rage, yet they seem only strengthened by this senseless loss of life.
13_weaversfen_body_06_16: The moon is radiant tonight, reflecting on the perfect stillness of the lake. I found the otherworldly plants needed for my oils, but lingered to take in the splendor of the blue lit cliffs dancing above the water.
13_weaversfen_body_06_17: The battle rages on in the pass. Traveling back to the Ancient Capital will require crossing through the desert now. A much more dangerous path for any still determined to reach this sacred site.
13_weaversfen_body_06_18: The soldiers threw themselves upon the demon, dying in multitudes as his mystical fires engulfed them. Their sacrifice was perhaps too great for this forsaken marsh.
13_weaversfen_body_06_19:
So strange. Though my eyes are as sharp as the day I first stared out across the sea, and my legs are as strong as the day I first walked these shores, I feel the weight of an old woman’s heart. I have seen so much I cannot unsee across the centuries, and the gravity of eternal youth begins to wear upon me. The Fen is drenched in blood. And though more settlers have come. I know they will only know peace for a single beat of this island’s remorseless heart. 

I could leave again, for elsewhere, but I sense that nowhere I could go would offer any lasting peace. 

It is not a sad thing. A pitiless thing. The only place I wish to dwell is here, upon Aeternum, yet it will not accept me. I shall sleep and dream of its shores, its waters, and the songs in the Fen. And I shall hope that others come to hear it as I do, and finally, embrace tranquility.
13_weaversfen_body_07_01: Pa says don’t play pirates by the water. By the water? There’s water everywhere! He might as well say don’t play pirates at all. \n\nAll the grownups are scared because the fish look weird. So they’re yellow! So what? I ain’t scared of no yellow-bellied fish! I never liked them anyway. Give me a good pig or a turkey. No self-respecting farm boy loves fish!
13_weaversfen_body_07_02: It has been three days since the boy's disappearance and his father remains inconsolable. We have organized search parties throughout the Fen, day and night, but to no avail. It's as if the waters themselves swallowed the boy up, leaving neither body nor soul behind. We are running dangerously low on cured meat supplies and may be reduced to eating the diseased fish lest we go mad with hunger. I am almost grateful the boy isn't here to see this, but nothing breaks the heart quite like hearing a father cry.
13_weaversfen_body_08_01:
Farewell to all ladies, out there on the isles 

Farewell our sweet angels with heavenly smiles, 

Farewell to all widows, alone in their vigils, 

Farewell tax collectors and customs officials! 

  

Bid hello to the sea, and her sweet salty spray, 

Head for the horizon, our anchor’s aweigh! 

For the treasures we’ve won, and the bard songs we’ve sung, 

We’ve set sail for Aeternum where ever we’re young! 

  

Chorus 

So it’s heave-ho! Steady we’ll row! 

Through the wind and the rain and the ice and the snow, 

And it’s heave-ho! To and fro! 

Where the siren, she sings, and the Stormwall will blow!
13_weaversfen_body_08_02:
REPORT AND MANIFEST of the Cargo laden on board the Nimphet 

Seth MacInty is Master, burthen 400 tonnes, bound from Chalottesburgh for Gracewater 

Sea Freight 

40 tonnes Gold Ingots 

60 Tonnes of Silver Ingots 

100 Tonnes of Iron Ingots 

Provisions 

32 barrels Fresh Spring Water 

24 crates of Hardtack 

12 crates of Salted Cod 

4 crates of Cured bacon 

16 buckets of Lard 

12 bushels of Fresh Limes 

Keep a close eye on the kegs. Mattheson has been known to filch, and I’ve seen him dallying about the hatch down to the hold. He’s a capable cobbler, and it would be a shame to have to have to string him up as an example to the others.
13_weaversfen_body_10_01: With so many families displaced by disease and withering, Twillen sees a great deal of unfortunates. These poor souls have not the coin for a home of their own, but still manage to scrape by with a room at the inn or by camping within the settlement wall. While hardly ideal, the town offers some refuge from the dangers of the outside swamp. \n\nIt is for them that I fish. Each night I haul my catch into the town square to distribute to the crowds. There is no higher calling than helping those in need.
13_weaversfen_body_10_02:
Feeding the displaced masses of Weaver’s Fen is of great necessity. But it is only a temporary solution. If any settler is to call these swamps home, we must find a way to arrest the slow march of the withering. This starts by purifying her waters. 

As they march, the many evils of this place leave behind their taint, causing the waters to putrefy and the surrounding wildlife to rot. I suspect the ships that wrecked here may be the source of the disease, as even the brackish areas are contaminated. 

With so many contaminants threatening the water supply, I pray I have the endurance necessary to make a difference. For I long to see these murky waters clear and blue for the first time since ancient times.
13_weaversfen_body_10_03: Today I caught a glimpse of something while casting my rod— just a peep, before it disappeared in the murky swampwater. For some reason, I could not get the image out of my mind. \n\nIt was only after I returned to my perch in the marketplace that I recalled the tale. A myth. A great serpent of legend that a woman among the refugees once spoke of encountering: the Varanus Mandje. This infamous sea snake is said to have mystical properties. I know not if it poses a danger to the town, but its arrival can portend nothing good. I must catch it before its too late.
13_weaversfen_body_11_01:
The flowers referenced in the Ancient tablets quickly proved a waste of time. Whatever reason the Ancients cultivated them, it was not to defend against the Crimson Madness. 

Conversely, the mushrooms seem to offer some promise. I was able to infuse them with the Azoth from the ruins, and the mushrooms' luminescence dims when in the presence of Corruption. 

Desperate as they are, it was not difficult to convince the villagers here to drink the mushroom concoction I prepared, though I did leave out the fact that they were gathered from the ruins. Whether the serum is effective remains to be seen.
13_weaversfen_body_11_02:
Finally, my efforts have yielded results. I have exposed several volunteers to Corruption and while the mixture may still require some fine-tuning, it's clear that it works... with some caveats. 

Unfortunately, I noticed right away that the cure somehow "deadened" the volunteers' senses, and a short time later, they seemed to lose their ability to communicate. Later, their eyes began to glow with a chilling Azoth blue, and they eventually became completely non-responsive. The villagers have taken to calling them "Lost," and the condition seems to be irreversible. 

I am convinced that with a few more tests, I can eliminate these disappointing side effects, but of course, I am now having great difficulty recruiting more volunteers. Even Brytmar is having doubts.
13_weaversfen_body_11_03:
Damn it all, the situation here in Periville is deteriorating by the hour! It seems one of the "Lost" somehow passed their condition on to a family member who had not been a volunteer. I offered to assess and treat the poor woman, but I was met with nothing but anger and fury. 

Everyone seems to have forgotten that this effort is in pursuit of protection against a far greater evil! With a few further tests... I am certain I can perfect the cure, and perhaps even find a remedy. If I am to find more volunteers, however, it will not be here. 

Brytmar is helping to pack up all my equipment and research, and we will leave this town of fools in the morning. Good riddance.
13_weaversfen_body_11_04:
Let it be hereby known that the Shadow Hunters of Karburg are offering a reward for anyone providing information that leads to the capture of the Corpse Crone. 

The foul sorceress has dark hair and a pale, violet scar in place of a missing eye. She was last seen fleeing her home in Periville, but it is believed that she remains in hiding somewhere in Weaver's Fen. 

Let it be further known that anyone who harbors or abets the Crone shall be held to equal account for her crimes and shall be subject to the same sentence.
13_weaversfen_body_11_05:
I've translated the glyphs on the bridge, and it's clear this passage was once a major supply route. Just as with the obelisk, the bridge was protected by magical devices strategically placed to ward away some danger, almost certainly the Corruption. 

If I could find one of these devices, I had hoped to deconstruct it and determine what energy powered the Ancients' wards.

However, I've searched the length of the bridge, and whatever devices the Ancients' placed have long since been looted or destroyed. The only possibility is that one remains somewhere in the bridge's upper framework... if I can get up there.
13_weaversfen_body_11_06: At last!! I've found one of the Ancient devices on top of the bridge, and there is even a flicker of power lurking inside it. This is the key to the answers I've been seeking. The list of experiments I can conduct with this is nearly endless. \n\nHopefully, this will renew Ser Brytmar's resolve. She recently declared her intent to abandon this endeavor, but even she should realize the potential of this... apparatus. If not, I will have to convince her, because I will most certainly need help getting it down from here and hauling it to Karburg.
13_weaversfen_body_12_01:
The old lady in the swamp took pity on me. She shared a secret for creating life on Aeternum. Dare I try it? How could I not? When I’ve longed for a child for so long. When this could be the answer to my prayers. 

Sweet doll, the things I will show you on Aeternum! I’ll teach you to fish, to weave, to hunt wolves...

- Hazel
13_weaversfen_body_12_02:
Ancient alchemy suggests the binding of certain animal parts can manifest into a child. I have no choice. I hope you understand, Mama... I’m doing this for our happiness. So that we may do more than just survive. I’m tired of just surviving. 

I want more. I want to feel my baby growing inside me, the way you described it. You had such a light in your eyes. I want to see you so joyful again.

- Hazel
13_weaversfen_body_12_03:
Damn this abominable island! Damn, that a simple thing like being a mother is something I cannot do. Why would the island make a woman suffer so? I won’t be pushed around by Aeternum any longer. 

I will get what I seek. I will infuse the spirit inside me. By the light of the altar and the rock of my will, I will make this happen.

- Hazel
