13a_agnes_prompt: "Maybe you haven’t met a good man?"
13a_agnes_response_a: After 500 years, you gotta face the possibility that there may be no such thing. There are plenty of oversized children, loudmouthed braggarts, and the eternally confused, however.
13a_agnes_response_b: Take home a candle instead. It's warmth, no drama.
13a_maria_response_a: A time of much sorrow, when the world was trampled by the Lost.
13a_maria_response_b: The Corpse Crone still haunts the southwestern fen. Don’t bother with the silkweed there. You’ll be better off gathering hemp from the western fields.
13a_niall_response1: How could I not? She’s adorable. Look how she waddles into the river. She needs me. If I don’t protect her, who will?
13a_niall_response_a: Haha, this darling should stick to rabbits. But she's got a taste for humans. Imagine someone chasing you for your skin.
13a_niall_response_b: The poor darling probably gets scared. She just shouldn't eat me again, silly girl.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_complete: What did you find in Hakenstadt? I miss that place. My husband and I taught Hazel to sew there. She loved making little dresses for her dolls.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_complete_next_a: What?! Surely, Hazel couldn't have written these notes.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_complete_next_b: Why would my daughter dabble in life magic? She knows nothing of such things. Magic on this island can be dangerous!
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_incomplete: Any word on my Hazel? She's a tall, smiling brunette with dancing eyes. Always happy, no matter what challenge comes her way.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_objective_desc: Primrose has asked you to find her darling daughter, Hazel. Your search starts at her childhood home in Hakenstadt.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_potion_desc: Whatever foul life magic existed in that diabolical fog.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_proposal_a: Hakenstadt. It's where Hazel grew up, where she said "mama" for the first time. Have you ever experienced a child's first word? It's utterly delightful!
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_proposal_b: Please, find my baby girl and bring her back to me.
13a_sq_01_hakenstadtdoll_task_dispelfog: Dispel the remnants of Hazel's experiment
13a_sq_02_krummholmtransmutations_comple: You're back! What news of Hazel? Wait. What do you mean she wasn't at Krummholm?
13a_sq_02_krummholmtransmutations_incomp: Any news on my Hazel? I've been worried sick. I couldn't bear losing her as well. She's the sunshine of my soul.
13a_sq_02_krummholmtransmutations_object: Hazel has been experimenting with forbidden life magic. Continue your search further east in Krummholm.
13a_sq_02_krummholmtransmutations_propos: My poor girl! I knew she longed to experience motherhood. I'd speak often of the joy I felt carrying her, feeling her grow inside me.
Seeing her excitement as she experienced this mysterious new world was an indescribable joy.
Yes, a few months after we arrived. Little Hazel brought such happiness to me and my husband. When Corruption tragically claimed him, Hazel saved me from falling to despair.
Please find my daughter and bring her back to me!
13a_sq_03_freehazel_complete_a: No! Hazel! Why did you do this to yourself? This is my fault… I drove her to this…
13a_sq_03_freehazel_complete_b: I'm sorry, you did all you could, stranger. Leave this old woman to her tears...
13a_sq_03_freehazel_incomplete: Please find Hazel and tell her to come back home. Tell her the two of us are enough. We have to be.
13a_sq_03_freehazel_objective_desc: Primrose fears what her daughter may have done. Find Hazel and bring her safely back home.
13a_sq_03_freehazel_proposal_a: I only sought to comfort her. And she knows this island can be cruel. I love my Hazel, the woman she's become. She's brave and beautiful.
13a_sq_03_freehazel_proposal_b: Please find her. Say her mother misses her terribly.
13a_sq_03_freehazel_task_freehazel: Defeat Hazel and collect her Wicker Doll to free her from her torment
13a_sq_03_freehazel_toy_desc: The last piece of Hazel's aspirations to be a mom.
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_complete: He was once our brother. Alas, this terrible fate so often awaits the Crone's many victims. Here. Your bounty, as promised.
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_incomplete_a: Just so we're clear, I am not responsible if The Denier kills you as well.
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_objective_desc: Travel to Periville, slay the Denier, and bring proof of its demise to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_proposal_b: My companions and I are shadow hunters. We formed a band called the White Skulls to hunt the Corpse Crone and her many abominations. We were chasing such a monster when my companions and I were slain.
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_proposal_next_a: A brute known as The Denier. He's easily twice my height and thick as a bull!
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_proposal_next_b: I would not dare face him again alone, but there is a bounty to collect if you are brave enough to bring back proof of his demise. Interested?
13a_sq_04_monsterbounty_task_kill: Defeat {targetName} and bring its {itemName} to Evelyn Van Heck
13a_sq_05_findhunters_complete: I am at a loss for words, traveler. This emblem was a bond of brotherhood. It is a symbol of our commitment to the hunt.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_incomplete: Hope for the best, prepare for… well, I would rather not think about that.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_objective_desc: Travel to Periville and find Joan and Markus. Report back to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen with news of their fate.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_proposal_a: Unfortunately, I must assume the worst. Joan and Markus had only recently joined our hunt. It's possible they lacked the fortitude to withstand such a harrowing death.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_proposal_next_a: Blood and toil have a way of bonding people. Search Periville for any sign of their resurrection or… unfortunate demise.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_proposal_next_b: Return them to me, if you can. And if the worst has happened, reclaim their White Skull Bands for me.
13a_sq_05_findhunters_task_goto: Search for Joan and Markus in Periville
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_complete_a: Am I truly all that remains? Ruiz and I had such plans. We intended to hunt terrors in the shadow lands of Durevos.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_complete_b: How cruel is fate, that I should live to see him become a monster like those we fought so hard to destroy?
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_complete_next_a: Time will tell, traveler. They found their final death. And yet I survive.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_complete_next_b: I will never forget what you did today. I'll try to rebuild the White Skulls to carry on in their memory. Take care, friend.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_incomplete: I pray I am wrong. I do not think I am, but I must cling to hope. Too much despair and we lose ourselves. Just like they did.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_objective_desc: Travel to Karburg, slay Ruiz Velazquez, and bring proof of his demise to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_proposal_a: You have already risked so much. It pains me to ask for your aid again.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_proposal_b: For what's it worth, I know where to find him: at the site of his most grim demise.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_proposal_next_a: Karburg. It was there he sought to pass judgment over the Crone herself. And paid for it with his life.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_proposal_next_b: Without hope, only horror remains. When you enter the town square, you'll know where to find him.
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_start: “Do you want me to find him, too?”
13a_sq_06_karburghunters_task_goto: Return Ruiz to his rest in Karburg
13a_sq_07_studyruins_complete_a: Look at this beautiful basalt you’ve brought me. I wonder where the Ancients sourced it from?
13a_sq_07_studyruins_complete_b: Now, let’s see about that aging… huh. Wait…that can’t be right.
13a_sq_07_studyruins_incomplete: Do you have those stone samples for me? They are vital to my research.
13a_sq_07_studyruins_objective_desc: Gather stone samples from rubble in the nearby ruins. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_07_studyruins_proposal_a: Yes, exactly! These stones have been here as long as anyone can remember. If we can learn how the Ancient architects reinforced these structures, imagine what WE could accomplish!
13a_sq_07_studyruins_proposal_next_a: If my assessment is correct, this bridge is over ten THOUSAND years old! I simply must get my hands on some samples to prove it.
13a_sq_07_studyruins_proposal_next_b: Could you help me with that?
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_complete: Great, you’re back. Let’s take a look at these new samples you've found. Interesting… these are less weathered, but only just. Fascinating.
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_incomplete: I hope to have answers for us soon, my friend. And if I am right, then we might see some NEW wonders in Aeternum.
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_objective_desc: Gather stone samples from rubble at South Vega Bridge. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_proposal_a: I need another sample from a newer site to be certain. Master Ting Long once theorized that the bridge that spans the marshes was built in a more recent era.
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_proposal_b: Could you bring me samples from South Vega Bridge for comparison?
13a_sq_08_bridgestones_task_goto: Gather stone samples from South Vega Bridge
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_complete_a: You and I will be friends, after this. Perhaps I will carve your name into the aqueducts of the future. Or would you prefer a temple? Maybe a stone garden?
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_complete_b: I am certain I can extract their secrets, thanks to you.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_complete_next: Old. Impossibly old. Old enough that I am questioning my methods, but since you asked… somewhere in the realm of twelve million years. Ha!
Insanity, I know. Perhaps I will send you a letter when I can confirm my findings.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_incomplete_a: Let me know when you've got those Andrometus samples.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_objective_des: Gather stone samples from rubble at Andrometus. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_proposal_a: It does, doesn’t it? So many questions, but we must resist the temptation to draw conclusions. Stone dating is far from an established field of study, after all.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_proposal_b: Regardless, I am looking toward the future, today.
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_proposal_next: Yes. I do. While I respect Master Ting Long’s work, I can see beyond it.
There is one structure here that predates all the others, according to my mentor’s study. Can you visit Andrometus and collect samples for me there?
13a_sq_09_andrometusstones_start: "Are the Ancients are also that old?”
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_complete: You’re back! And in one piece! Do you have the clue? It could be a coin, a note, an etching…Oh, give it here. The suspense is killing me.
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_complete_next: A coin!! Oh, I just love solving her puzzles. Though it is markedly less stressful when she is not potentially hurt or in danger.
All the same… let’s see what the coin has to say…
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_incomplete: This game was much less stressful when it took place in EMPTY ruins, you see. I do hope she's alright.
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_objective_des: Search chests at North Vega Bridge for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts. Then report back to Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_proposal_a: Likewise. I was wondering if you might be able to help me?
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_proposal_b: You see, Nora and I like to play a little game to pass the time. She hides herself and leaves clues for me to find amongst these relics. Brain teasers, and the like.
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_proposal_next: Yes! But not how you imagine.
I was looking for her latest clue at North Vega bridge when something awoke the Guardians. I don’t fight. Could you find the clue and bring it back to me? Check inside the coffers and chests.
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_proposal_prom: "Do you need help with a clue?”
13a_sq_10_findspousebridge_task_goto: Search chests at North Vega Bridge for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_complete: Another coin! Wonderful, hand it over, let’s see what she has to say…
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_incomplete: As thrilled as I am, her long absence is truly starting to wear on me. Could you hurry with that clue? It would put me at ease to finally find her.
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_objective_de: Search chests at Canopus for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts. Then report back to Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_proposal_a: Something about the iconography she used… It suggests half of a whole. Aha!
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_proposal_b: She means to have me combine two clues to find her, but this tells me the second clue is at Canopus. Very clever. Care to help again?
13a_sq_11_findspousecanopus_task_goto: Search chests at Canopus for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_complete: I see you found my note. Did Dr. Leonie send you?
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_complete_: Yes, I'm Leonie's wife! I am so pleased she solved it.
Thank goodness she had the sense to send someone like you, though, these Ancient Guardians are not ordinarily part of our game.
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_incomplet: Hopefully we near the end of our chase, my friend. Nora can handle herself… right?
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_objective: Follow Nora's trail to Aqua Acadia and search chests for the final clue.
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_proposal: Nora thought she could stump me, did she? Me, the greatest coin collector in Aeternum? Come on, give me a tough one, ha!
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_proposal_: I do! But Nora might be dead. That makes this less fun.
Aqua Acadia is crawling with some truly nasty Ancient Guardians. Last time we were there, we had an armed guard of twenty soldiers… but you’re super strong, right?
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_task_goto: Follow Nora's trail to Aqua Acadia
13a_sq_12_findspouseaquaacadia_task_kill: Search chests for the final clue
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_complete_a: You’re back! Nora told me everything. I am SO relieved.
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_complete_b: I’m going to have a talk with her about taking some precautions next time. But this was a fine game, and you were an enormous help. Thank you!
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_incomplete: I'll meet you and Leonie back on the road. I'll sneak out while you're distracting them.
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_objective_desc: Return to Dr. Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_proposal: Yeah, no wonder. When those Guardians appeared, the only two things I could think about were "I'm going to die" and "Leonie will be so worried".
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_proposal_next_a: Oh, I was, fortunately, already well in hiding when the Guardians started swarming the place. Thank goodness you came along! I was starting to get hungry.
13a_sq_13_spousereunion_proposal_next_b: Anyway, let’s head back. I’m eager to see Leonie after this.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_complete_a: Oh, yes. Don't you see? The light, the color… it is truly beautiful.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_complete_b: I will study these and see if I might discover how they burn so long and so bright.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_incomplete: Be on the lookout for the strange, ghostly torches. And try not to get burned too badly.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_objective_desc: Gather strange torches from Richmire region and bring them to Torchy Cabrera in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_proposal_a: Ah well, if you have not heard anything, then perhaps it is best we keep it that way.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_proposal_b: Suffice to say that I am no longer welcome in the Restless Shore settlement. It's really because of my research.
13a_sq_14_gettorches_proposal_next_a: I do. I am on a quest to discover a way to create an "Eternal Flame!" Perhaps you would help me?
13a_sq_14_gettorches_proposal_next_b: Scattered around Richmire there are strange, long-burning torches. Get some of these for me, and I will reward you.
13a_sq_15_getilluminationessences_comple: Perfect… perfect! This illumination essence is the missing link!
Combined with the substance in the torches from Karburg, I feel certain we have found the secret!
13a_sq_15_getilluminationessences_incomp: Amid the ruins of Aqua Acadia to the north, you will see for yourself.
The Guardians there glow more than anywhere else. Gather their essence, my friend.
13a_sq_15_getilluminationessences_object: Collect Perpetual Illumination Essences from Ancients at Aqua Acadia and bring them to Torchy Cabrera in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_15_getilluminationessences_propos: I believe the Ancients knew the secrets of Eternal Fire and Eternal Light as well.
Have you ever noticed the perpetual glow that clings to the walking corpses of the Ancient Guardians?
Indeed, they are imbued with some luminous magic, and in the ruins nearby, the bones glow even more than usual.
Yes. Aqua Acadia to the north. Gather some of the Guardians' essence, then we will know.
13a_sq_15_getilluminationessences_task_g: Collect Perpetual Illumination Essences from Aqua Acadia
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_complete_a: He still had it, didn't he? Yes… yes! This proves that HE was the one who started the fire!
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_complete_b: Thank you, my friend! I cannot thank you enough for helping me get back home.
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_complete_next_: Oh, believe me! We will have that burning in no time! With everything you acquired and the black powder in my hovel, we will show them all a REAL FIRE!
I mean... the good kind, of course.
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_incomplete_a: Chef Navarro's Kitchen is not far, and I feel certain he still carries his "Flaming Duck Recipe."
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_objective_desc: Travel to Navarro's Kitchen and defeat Chef Navarro and collect "Navarro's Flaming Duck Recipe". Then bring it to Torchy in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_proposal_a: You must help me clear my name so I can go home. You see, I was exiled from the settlement for starting a fire…
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_proposal_b: But for once, it was NOT me who ignited the flame. I was framed, you see!
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_proposal_next_: By that greedy bastard, Chef Navarro! He was trying out his new "Flaming Duck" recipe and burned down half the settlement!
He became Corrupted, of course, but his "Kitchen" is nearby. Defeat him and get that recipe as proof of his guilt!
13a_sq_16_navarroskitchen_task_goto: Defeat Chef Navarro for "Navarro's Flaming Duck Recipe" at Navarro's Kitchen
13a_sq_17_killgators_complete_a: Ah, you have returned! I was beginning to wonder. Now, let me see your trophies.
13a_sq_17_killgators_complete_b: Yes... thick, unblemished, and as hard as anything. These are certifiably the remains of several fine beasts. Well done!
13a_sq_17_killgators_complete_next_a: Ah… well, you see, I was waylaid almost the moment you departed. A lone damsel walked the roads alone and I simply had to escort her to the hamlet. You would understand.
13a_sq_17_killgators_complete_next_b: All the same, I am TERRIBLY impressed.
13a_sq_17_killgators_incomplete: I shall make my own way into the stinking bog. You go on ahead. I suspect you will need the head start, after all.
13a_sq_17_killgators_objective_desc: Collect alligator scales from Gators in Weaver's Fen and return them to Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_17_killgators_proposal_a: A hunt, of course! You and I shall venture forth into the marshes in pursuit of the most ferocious, cunning, and formidable beasts this festering land has to offer!
13a_sq_17_killgators_proposal_b: Just as my forebears have done since time immemorial!
13a_sq_17_killgators_proposal_next_a: Aha! Excellent! To begin, we will make trophies of the largest predators these foul marshes have to offer!
13a_sq_17_killgators_proposal_next_b: Bring me the hides of any Gators you find in the Fen. And as I have said many times: Let the hunt begin!
13a_sq_17_killgators_task_killtoken: Defeat Gators to Collect {itemName} in Weaver's Fen
13a_sq_18_killboar_complete: The prodigal hunter returns! You truly are a fellow after my own heart. Let us see your fine trophies. Hand them over, I say!
13a_sq_18_killboar_complete_next_a: Ah! Naturally! Let me see… I had the tusks just here, in my satchel.
13a_sq_18_killboar_complete_next_b: OH! IMPOSSIBLE! Look at this! Their sheer size and sharpness must have punctured a hole in my bag. Alas, I fear this contest is a draw once more!
13a_sq_18_killboar_incomplete: Ah, yes, I shall be along promptly! Uh, once I have finished oiling my musket, of course.
13a_sq_18_killboar_objective_desc: Collect boar tusks from Polder Boars in Weaver's Fen and return them to Hunter Samuel just north of the settlement.
13a_sq_18_killboar_proposal_a: Boars! No ordinary boars, but boars the size of three men! We will not waste our skill on mere pigs!
13a_sq_18_killboar_proposal_b: Bring me the largest tusks you can find, and we shall compare trophies. They're a plague to this region!
13a_sq_18_killboar_task_killtoken: Defeat Polder Boars to collect {itemName}s in Weaver's Fen
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_complete_a: You are simply not going to believe this. My musket was ready, my boots laced, my satchel patched, and a COURIER found me on the road! There was urgent business in the hamlet to attend to.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_complete_next_a: Hmm, I understand, and I do not blame you. One excuse, understandable. Two! Difficult, but you gave me the benefit of your doubt. But this? Reprehensible.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_complete_next_b: Please, accept this reward by way of apology.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_incomplete: I relish the end of our contest. Go on. I am right behind you!
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_objective_desc: Collect wolf paws from Mallory Wolves, found north of Fenton's Hamlet, and return them to Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal: How can you have won if there has been no contest? Nay, we shall have to settle this once and for all.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal_next: Do you doubt me? ME?! Samuel Worthington Bloodgood THE THIRD?! Now this is a matter of honor. I demand satisfaction!
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal_next2_a: My word is my BOND, stranger. If I say I shall hunt, then I shall HUNT!
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal_next2_b: Is it not my name, my legacy, my REPUTATION that demands that we should finish this contest? Do you know nothing of honor?!
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal_next3_a: Haha! You ARE a noble soul, after all. Let us hunt!
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_proposal_next3_b: To the north you will find a pack of wolves known for their size and cunning. Claim their paws, and we shall compare to see who has killed the greatest beast.
13a_sq_19_killwolfpack_task_killtoken: Defeat Mallory Wolves to Collect {itemName}s in Weaver's Fen
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_complete_a: Ah, well, there it is. She was enormous, wasn’t she? I, uh, I wish I could have seen it myself.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_complete_b: As promised, here is your bounty. And a tip. Your… continuing discretion is appreciated.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_incomplete: I will not pretend that this arrangement pleases me, my friend, but I am grateful that you have chosen to take pity on me.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_objective_desc: Defeat the Werna Packleader at Dusty Paw Burrow, far to the north and west of Weaver’s Fen Hamlet, and collect a trophy from your kill for Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_proposal_a: Do you know what it's like, being saddled with a legacy like mine? Why, if people only knew how incompetent I really am, my family name would be utterly ruined.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_proposal_b: That is why I need your help.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_proposal_next_a: Well, the hamlet here demanded my aid. A large white wolf called Werna and her pack have been wreaking havoc on travelers wandering the northern roads.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_proposal_next_b: If you can kill her and bring me proof, I shall give you the bounty.
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_task_goto: Track down the Werna Packleader at Dusty Paw Burrow
13a_sq_20_killwolfleader_task_killtoken: Defeat the Werna Packleader to Collect {itemName}
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_complete_a: Hmm, yes… decadent, musky, with a sulfuric accord that resonates right through to the top notes… you’ve captured Weaver's Fen perfectly.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_complete_b: You may be a genius, my friend! Ah, my eyes are watering with emotion!
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_complete_next_a: Is it so shocking? Hah! If only the ladies of New Corsica knew what they daubed upon their wrists.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_complete_next_b: The art of perfume is like life: the whole is larger than the sum of its parts. Thank you for your contributions.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_incomplete: Can the unique fragrance of Weaver’s Fen truly be replicated by human hands? I await your return with bated breath.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_objective_desc: Gather materials in Weaver's Fen and then visit an arcane repository to craft a perfume for Tullius Volusus in Weaver's Fen.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_proposal_b: That scent, it is primal, inescapable. It reaches down through your nose, through your lungs, into your very soul. With every breath, it commands, "Be awake! Be alive!”
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_proposal_next_a: So? How much of life you miss, if you seek only inoffensive things.
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_proposal_next_b: Please, I must capture this fragrance. Bring me the aromas of the Fen, brew them and bottle them, and I’ll reward you handsomely, hmm?
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_task_gather_spore: Gather {itemName} from Bumbleblossom in northern Weaver’s Fen
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_task_loot_chests_: Gather {itemName} from chests in Fenton Hamlet
13a_sq_21_swampperfume_task_skin_elkglan: Gather {itemName} from stags in northern Weaver’s Fen (Skinning Skill 50 Required)
13a_sq_28_bearurine_complete_a: Oh, you're back? Do you know much about urine?
13a_sq_28_bearurine_complete_b: I can't figure out where I've gone wrong! Not enough sulfur? It certainly smells bad enough already…
13a_sq_28_bearurine_complete_response_a: And gave it to my team, too? Thank you! I didn't think to ask the hunters. Perhaps I underestimated the value of folk wisdom.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_complete_response_b: You've done a service for science today. You and I, we should continue this partnership!
13a_sq_28_bearurine_gatherurine: Gather ingredients to craft bear repellant from Ursus Hortus
13a_sq_28_bearurine_incomplete_a: The phosphorus in these urine samples is elevated…it even glows in the dark. Fascinating.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_objective_desc: Find someone who can make bear repellent, as a favor to Dr. Theophrastus. Then, distribute the repellent to the researchers in the field.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_a: Hmm, yes, well. This has been a stimulating conversation, but I must get back to work.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_b: With this news of Corruption spreading southward, I may need to relocate soon.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_next2_a: Now that… is funny. I do love a good hypothetical, but right now, I need bear repellant for my research team.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_next2_b: I swear this urine should work... but who knows? Indeed, discover the cure for bears, and we'll talk!
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_next_a: Hm. I've more a mind to study Corruption, rather than fight it - the way hosts are controlled… it's like a fungus.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_proposal_next_b: Besides, the Syndicate has its hands full fighting the other factions.
13a_sq_28_bearurine_tasknoseknows2: Provide Bear Repellent to Researcher Piper
13a_sq_28_bearurine_tasknoseknows3: Provide Bear Repellent to Researcher Ling
13a_sq_28_bearurine_tasknoseknows4: Provide Bear Repellent to Researcher Rinde
13a_sq_28_bearurine_tasknoseknows5: Provide Bear Repellent to Researcher Lubin
13a_sq_28_bearurine_tasknoseknowshunter: Locate someone who can teach you more about Bear Repellent
13a_sq_28_hunterjulio_response_repellent: Bear repellent? Sure, easy enough. There's an old recipe that hunters here have used for ages. Here, take it.
Those Syndicate folk… if you ask me, they're so concerned with being logical they forget to be practical.
13a_sq_28_researcherling_response_repell: Did Theo finally figure out the formula? Thank science for that…
Wow! That's… pungent! You know who else would love this formula? Rinde. Definitely.
13a_sq_28_researcherlubin_prompt_repelle: "Use the repellent. It's for the best."
13a_sq_28_researcherlubin_response_repel: Ah, it's almost a shame. I think the bears were about to accept me, maybe.
You're probably right. Maul me twice, shame on me… Go and tell Theo I'll try it his way, then.
13a_sq_28_researcherpiper_response_repel: Wow, urine! Just what I needed!
My fellows researchers are also in the field, studying these bears.You should bring them some repellent, too. Share the pain… I mean, the wealth.
13a_sq_28_researcherrinde_response_repel: Ugh, this smells terrible. The things I do for data...
Get some of this to Lubin. She's like to get herself mauled out here.
13a_sq_28_theo_response_factionrival_a: I see. I suppose we must fight. It would be quite inconvenient for me to die right now.
13a_sq_28_theo_response_factionrival_b: If you must kill me, could you monitor my experiment until I return? Oh, you won't attack? Then there is no problem!
13a_sq_28_theo_response_factionsame_a: Wunderbar! A fellow seeker of truth! In my opinion, the Syndicate is the only rational faction choice.
13a_sq_28_theo_response_factionsame_b: Though, I do wish we could devote more resources to research, and less to warfare…
13a_theuderic_response_a: Yes, very. Catch it and you’ll turn Lost in a week. Luckily, I have found a cure.
13a_theuderic_response_b: Theuderic Julietti at your service! For only 100 coin, I’ll sneak you the right card in this game of life.
1403_01_defaultdialogue: Beware the Blight, stranger. The forests of Edengrove are hazardous enough during normal times.And to be clear, these are not normal times.
1403_0201_b_description: Clear Dryads in the Tarrthail Terrace, and clear Blight Fiends at the Afallach Byre. Then report back to Survivalist Ellwood in Edengrove.
1403_0201_c_proposal_a: Yes, that’s the question on everyone’s minds, isn’t it? Edengrove is a place of vast natural magic, the Angry Earth’s ancient home.
1403_0201_c_proposal_b: If the Blight can spread this fast, even here, maybe nothing can stop it.
1403_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: Ah, well, there are many theories, but I prefer facts. Will you help me find some?
1403_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: I need samples from both the Dryads and the Blight Fiends. That will at least be a start.
1403_0201_d_01a_task: Clear the road of Dryads along the Tarrthail Terrace
1403_0201_e_incomplete_a: The Angry Earth Dryads are deadly enough already, but the Blight makes them even worse.
1403_0201_f_complete_a: Ah, thank you, these will do nicely.
1403_0201_f_complete_b: It feels odd, trying to help the Angry Earth. My old instructor would have told me off for sympathizing with the enemy instead of taking advantage of their weakness.
1403_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: Survival, brave one. Living humans have always been the most endangered species on Aeternum.
1403_0201_f_complete_pt2_b: Personally, I’d like to try and find a way to live in harmony with nature. But the Angry Earth are… angry.
1403_0201_f_complete_pt2prompt: "Why do you fight the Angry Earth?"
1403_0202_b_description: Craft or procure a Concentrated Blight Tincture, and then report back to Survivalist Ellwood in Edengrove.
1403_0202_c_proposal_a: I thought so too. Some of the dryads seemed amiable, but after the Blight emerged, communication broke down.
1403_0202_c_proposal_b: If we purge the Blight from the Grove, they might come around… I hope.
1403_0202_c_proposal_pt2_a: I'll study these samples you've recovered. In the meantime, you should learn how to protect yourself against the Blight's effects.
1403_0202_c_proposal_pt2_b: Use this recipe to craft a protective tincture, and then return.
1403_0202_e_incomplete: If you do not have the resources to craft a Blight Tincture, you'll have to gather or purchase them from the Trading Post.
1403_0202_f_complete_a: Ah, yes. Well done! This can save you from great suffering.
1403_0202_f_complete_b: More than a few have limped into the outpost covered in red fungus. They beg for death even as it saps away their strength.
1403_0202_f_complete_pt2_a: We grant their wish. What else can we do? They die, and don't seem to resurrect.
1403_0202_f_complete_pt2_b: I fear their true fate may be darker than death, but let's not speak of such things. Just… use the tincture wisely, brave one.
1403_0203_b_description: Defeat Denmen at the top of Tor Fearg tower, and bring his remains to Ellwood in Edengrove.
1403_0203_blightvines_description: Vines from Denman, pieces of his Dryad body. They seem alive with his energy.
1403_0203_c_proposal_a: There is a tower known as Tor Fearg. The tower itself has become Blighted, but some within have resisted.
1403_0203_c_proposal_b: There's one dryad in particular named the "Denmen." Bring me samples of its vines if you can.
1403_0203_d_01_task: Defeat Denmen atop the tower of {POITags}
1403_0203_e_incomplete_a: The tower is a rough gauntlet, and the dryads are formidable.
1403_0203_f_complete_a: Ah, indeed, a fine specimen. The wood and earth that compose Denmen's vines flow thick with old azoth.
1403_0203_f_complete_b: This supports my theory. Did you know Edengrove is the source of all Angry Earth on Aeternum?
1403_0203_f_complete_pt2_a: Yes, it's their home. I theorize that newborn Angry Earth creatures are more susceptible to Blight.
1403_0203_f_complete_pt2_b: Older creatures like the Denmen are better able to resist, but without more data, a theory is just a theory…
1403_02_defaultdialogue_a: Welcome, brave one. Edengrove is a place of great beauty, but it's not for tourists.
1403_02_defaultdialogue_b: It's one of the most deadly territories in Aeternum, especially now with the Blight having taken hold.
1403_0301_b_description: Go to the ruins of Finnabair Allure and investigate the hidden Blight at its heart. Then report back to Survivalist Ellwood in Edengrove.
1403_0301_blightsample_description: A sample of blight taken from the outbreak at Litheltop.
1403_0301_c_proposal_a: I'm not sure yet. There's a fresh outbreak of Blight deep in Elysian Falls, at Finnabair Allure.
1403_0301_c_proposal_b: The dryads there are old and experienced, and they may be able to resist it… for now.
1403_0301_c_proposal_pt2_a: Yes, and be wary - even if they are not Blighted, the dryads will consider you a foe.
1403_0301_c_proposal_pt2_b: But a fresh outbreak means fresh Blight samples. The fresher the sample, the more it may reveal about its origins.
1403_0301_d_03_task: Defeat the Blight Fiends for a sample of Blight
1403_0301_e_incomplete_a: We aren't the dryads' true enemy, but they don't make that distinction.
1403_0301_e_incomplete_b: You will undoubtedly have to fight them when you go to collect those Blight samples.
1403_0301_f_complete_a: So the dryads at Finnabair Allure have held out so far? That's good. Supports my theory.
1403_0301_f_complete_b: Let’s see these fresh Blight samples then… hmmm. Oh. This one is old growth, and yet still infected…
1403_0301_f_complete_pt2_a: It certainly contradicts it. If it’s not the age of the Earth specimen that determines its vulnerability to Blight, then what?
1403_0301_f_complete_pt2_b: I… I must think on this.
1403_03_defaultdialogue: I actually believed we made some diplomatic progress, before the Blight cropped up. It threatens all life in Edengrove, human and Angry Earth alike.
1403_0401_b_description: Go to the Blightcrown to investigate the movement of the Blight beyond Edengrove.
1403_0401_blighttincturebomb_description: A powerful explosive, packed with bottles of Blight Resistance tincture.
1403_0401_c_proposal_b: Blight is apparently a threat to all life forms, but what if that’s the entire point? What if it's actually a mechanism of self-defense?
1403_0401_c_proposal_pt2_a: Exactly. We know it's infected Edengrove, but where else has it spread?
1403_0401_c_proposal_pt2_b: Shattered Mountain, I suspect. If you're willing, visit the Blightcrown and Fierna Pass to make sure.
1403_0401_d_01_task: Investigate the presence of Blight at {POITags}
1403_0401_e_incomplete_a: Beyond the Pass is in the Shattered Mountain, where I'm told the Corrupted have amassed in great numbers.
1403_0401_f_complete_a: Then you've confirmed it, have you? The Blight extends towards the Shattered Mountain.
1403_0401_f_complete_b: The final question remains only; how is the Blight affecting the Corrupted?
1403_0401_f_completept2_a: Aha! Just as I suspected! It’s as much a threat to the Corrupted as it is to rest of us.
1403_0401_f_completept2_b: The Blight is an attempt by Aeternum itself to fight against the Corruption.
1403_0401_f_completept3_a: Yes, exactly. It must be a last-ditch effort by the land to purge itself of Corruption’s poison.
1403_0401_f_completept3_b: But this cure will also kill every living thing in Aeternum. We need to remove the poison ourselves before that happens.
1403_04_defaultdialogue_a: While you were mixing that tincture, I studied the samples you recovered.
1403_04_defaultdialogue_b: I begin to see a pattern, but I need to study an Angry Earth specimen that's resisted the Blight.
1403_05_defaultdialogue_a: You've been critical to my efforts thus far, though I know your true aim is to battle Corruption.
1403_05_defaultdialogue_b: I do believe this is all somehow related however, brave one, if you'll humor me.
1403_06_defaultdialogue: I've only just arrived here. I need to get my bearings before I start work. I hope you'll excuse me, for the moment, at least.
1403_07_defaultdialogue_a: I studied the samples you brought me for hours, trying to force them to make sense. I had a revelation!
1403_07_defaultdialogue_b: I believe I finally understand the Blight's origins, and perhaps its ultimate purpose.
1403_08_defaultdialogue: I believe our work together has yielded great benefits, brave one.Together, perhaps we can turn the tide against the Blight and this foul Corruption.
1403_09_defaultdialogue: Hm... expensive kit, air of determination in your eyes, naïve ‘I-can-change-the-world’ look about you – wouldn’t happen to be an adventurer would you, friend?
1403_10_defaultdialogue: Hey, it’s you again! Still lurking around these parts? I’m midway through cataloging the goods you brought last time. Talk to me later and I’ll have more work for you.
1403_ancientdevice_description: This is a tool of the ancients, what it does is any man's guess. A slight humming seems to come from its core.
1403_chest3: Search the Heart of Genesis Chest
1403_oddcontraption_description: It appears that this ancient device was a power source of some kind.
1403_strangetablet_description: This ancient tablet has glowing glyphs written on each face in a forgotten language.
1403_topic1_response: The Blight is a curse of earth, and being of the earth also makes it a curse of the body as well. The fiends in Edengrove are infected by it, but the Blight infects the human body as well. It weakens you, pulling you closer to death with every breath. Be careful, you must prepare a proper defense against it when in Blighted areas of Edengrove.
1403a_0301_b_description: Percy Ellwood is searching for valuable Ancient Artifacts from Garden of Genesis
1403a_0301_c_proposal_a: Name’s Doctor Percival Ellwood. Call me Percy. I’m a collector of sorts. And you’re just the sort of folk I’ve been waiting for.
1403a_0301_c_proposal_b: The Ancients built this temple for their rituals. But now it’s crawling with Angry slumgullions all woken up on the wrong side of the flower bed.
1403a_0301_c_proposal_c: Still, there’s plenty relics in store for the intrepidly minded.
1403a_0301_c_proposal_pt2_a: No no. I’m a documentarian of Ancient baubles and contraptions! I have my credentials, got a certificate in Archeology from – look, does it really matter?
1403a_0301_c_proposal_pt2_b: Here’s the deal, if you head in and bring out any relics you find, I’ll compensate you graciously for your troubles… What say you? Partners?
1403a_0301_c_proposal_pt2_c: That’s the spirit! I’ll be here picking the muck out of my fingernails if you need me.
1403a_0301_cooldown: Good work on that latest haul! After I get things appraised I'll have another task for you.
1403a_0301_e_incomplete_a: Returning empty handed? Well, can’t say I blame you. Not everyone has the gumption to brave the unknown.
1403a_0301_f_complete_a: Smite my bones! You made it through! What did you find? I’ll sort and label everything, take them back to the institute in London once I escape this place.
1403a_0301_f_complete_b: I'm setting up a little museum, the souls of this island are immortal, figure the artifacts should be as well. Best not to ask how I got them all though.
1407_00_defaultdialogue: You should have chosen the Marauders, friend. Unless you happen to like being chained down. Some people do.
1407_01_defaultdialogue: Hey, pal. I can tell just by looking that you're a person who appreciates life's true joys. That's why you're a Marauder.
1407_01pre_defaultdialogue: Hey, pal. I can tell just by looking that you're a person who appreciates life's true joys. That's why you're a Marauder.\n[ Level 49 required for Edengrove faction missions ]
1408_00_defaultdialogue: Oh, you're not in the Syndicate? I think I'm supposed to shun you. Yeah, I think I remember that from the orientation.
1408_01_defaultdialogue: When we pull together, we can do anything! We're the Syndicate!
1408_01pre_defaultdialogue: When we pull together, we can do anything! We're the Syndicate!\n[ Level 49 required for Edengrove faction missions ]
1409_00_defaultdialogue: You know, it's not too late for you. It's never too late to embrace the light of the Spark.
1409_01_defaultdialogue: What? Oh, hello. I assume you're here to embrace your sacred duty to the Covenant? Good, good.
1409_01pre_defaultdialogue: What? Oh, hello. I assume you're here to embrace your sacred duty to the Covenant? Good, good.\n[ Level 49 required for Edengrove faction missions ]
1412_01_defaultdialogue_a: I've heard this place was the seed of all life on Earth, that it was a paradise at some point.
1412_01_defaultdialogue_b: Dangerous as it may be, I think I kinda get that.
1413_01_defaultdialogue_a: You want to know what I think? I think the Angry Earth are just biding their time.
1413_01_defaultdialogue_b: Soon as we defeat the Corruption, they'll come for us. I trust these tree-things any farther than I can throw 'em.
1413_0201_key_goto: Search the ruins of {POITags} for a key to enter Zygoramet's Grove
1413_0201_spriggan_b_description: Watcher Lin has asked you to find a key to enter Zygoramet's Grove and destroy the dangerous creature inside. Then report back to Watcher Lin in Edengrove.
1413_0201_spriggan_c_proposal_a: There was a naturalist here a few decades ago who disappeared after falling to the Blight.
1413_0201_spriggan_c_proposal_b: She had discovered that there is an Angry Earth specimen here capable of replicating itself an infinite number of times... in the blink of an eye!
1413_0201_spriggan_c_proposal_next_a: Yes. As soon as the Corruption abates, this creature will duplicate itself until it's taken over all of Aeternum.
1413_0201_spriggan_c_proposal_next_b: The creature abides in Zygoramet's Grove to the south. Search the ruins there for a key, then enter the cleft and destroy it. Please... you must believe me.
1413_0201_spriggan_e_incomplete_a: I am not exaggerating. The creature inside Zygoramet's Grove will consume us all.
1413_0201_spriggan_f_complete_a: Oh, you've returned? The creature is slain then? Damn, you're the first who's actually believed me.
1413_0201_spriggan_f_complete_b: People might not realize it, but we're all a lot safer now.
1413_0201_spriggan_f_complete_next_a: Not at all. In fact, I suspect that it will, given everything the naturalist said.
1413_0201_spriggan_f_complete_next_b: If the vile creature returns, however, we must be prepared to destroy it again. As many times as it takes.
1413_02_defaultdialogue_a: Survivalist Ellwood is telling everyone now that the Angry Earth can help fight the Corruption, and the Rangers actually seem to be falling for it!
1413_02_defaultdialogue_b: No one wants to see the truth - the Angry Earth is FAR more dangerous in the long run.
1413_03_defaultdialogue_a: Even with the creature diminished, we must be vigilant with these botanical fiends.
1413_03_defaultdialogue_b: Mark my words - as soon as the Corruption is truly subdued, the Angry Earth will emerge as the greatest threat we've ever known.
1414_0101_b_description: Speak to Aulus Fulvius in Reekwater.
1414_0101_c_proposal_a: You will? Excellent. Although, It is a bit of a trek. But! If you're sure...
1414_0101_c_proposal_b: This message is for the local Magistrate, Aulus Fulvius. He will have need of your talents beyond the lightness of your feet. Of that, I am certain.
1414_0101_e_incomplete: Just head south for… ages, really. Make sure you have plenty of rations for the journey.
1414_0101_f_complete_a: Ah… What's this, then? A message all the way from Edengrove? I don't know many who could make that trek in one piece. Consider me impressed.
1414_0101_f_complete_b: Since you're here, I believe I can make use of a hardy traveler like yourself.
1414_01_defaultdialogue: Don't tell the other Wardens, but I think we've been getting a little Blight in our rations. I just hope it doesn't make us all sick.
1414_02_defaultdialogue: You there! I have need of someone light of foot. I have an urgent message bound for Reekwater to the South.
1415_01_defaultdialogue: Sometimes at night, the forest will suddenly get so quiet that it's almost impossible to sleep. I like some kind of background noise, you know.
1416_01_defaultdialogue: Well now, I hope you haven't come to Edengrove to enjoy the seasonal foliage.This is not a season for such pleasures.
1416_0201_b_description: Sabotage the Corrupted miners in the Grimman Chasm by raiding their supplies and thinning their numbers. Then report back to Warden Ducquet in Edengrove.
1416_0201_c_proposal_a: We've been waiting for the right opportunity, of course. Like your arrival.
1416_0201_c_proposal_b: This would seem to be the right moment, if you're willing to lead the charge.
1416_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: Perfect. The Corrupted have been setting mine-camps in the Grimman Chasm.
1416_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: Strike their positions there, disarm them if you can, and we'll soon know their strength.
1416_0201_d_01_task: Sabotage Corrupted miners in the Grimman Chasm
1416_0201_d_02_task: Defeat the {targetName} in the Grimman Chasm
1416_0201_d_03_task: Loot {itemName}s from chests in the Grimman Chasm
1416_0201_e_incomplete_a: Have you been to the Grimman Chasm yet? The fiends think that hiding among the crags will keep them safe.
1416_0201_f_complete_a: Success! You're quite the warrior, aren't you? Assaulting their camps and striking without mercy.
1416_0201_f_complete_b: Perhaps that will slow their supply chain from Great Cleave and Shattered Mountain, as well.
1416_0201_profaneore_description: Ore mined by the Corrupted in the Profane Seam.
1416_0202_a_title: Gutting the Guard, Firing the Foreman
1416_0202_b_description: Destroy Elite Guard Philippe and Foreman Harold in the mines in the Grimman Chasm. Then report back to Warden Ducquet in Edengrove.
1416_0202_c_proposal_a: Perfect. The Rangers have identified the commanders.
1416_0202_c_proposal_b: Elite Guard Philippe and Foreman Robertson - destroy that pair, and we'll have all the Corrupted in Edengrove running scared.
1416_0202_e_incomplete: The Rangers say Philippe and Robertson are running operations from within the mine. Good luck, Warden.
1416_0202_f_complete_a: Cut off the head and the body will fall! Dealing with those two will bring their operations to a standstill.
1416_0202_f_complete_b: That should have the Corrupted questioning their strategy here.
1416_0202_start_prompt: "That sounds like a plan to me."
1416_02_defaultdialogue_a: Always good to see a fellow Warden walk through those gates.
1416_02_defaultdialogue_b: We've been watching the Corrupted make advances into the forest, but we've yet to stop them.
1416_0301_b_description: Meet Survivalist Ellwood in Edengrove's northeast Outpost.
1416_0301_c_proposal_a: He was in quite a hurry. His mission to combat the Blight drew him to the northeast Outpost.
1416_0301_c_proposal_b: He asked if you would meet him there. I told him I would relay the message, and so I have.
1416_0301_e_incomplete: The journey northeast will be a difficult one. That I can assure you.
1416_0301_f_complete_a: Ah, brave one, I see you have made the journey safely. I am glad to see your face.
1416_0301_f_complete_b: Forgive my rush, but I believe that here in the northeast, we will find the answers we seek.
1416_03_defaultdialogue: My hope is that we hit these crimson-eyed bastards so hard that THEY have nightmares about US. What do you say we take down their leaders?
1416_04_defaultdialogue_a: Oh yes, I'm already hearing reports of the Corrupted withdrawing from some sectors.
1416_04_defaultdialogue_b: Way to show them what for, Warden! You've turned things around.
1417_01_defaultdialogue: I joined the Soulwardens to battle Corruption, not dither about in some forest.
1418_0101_corruptedgreatswordshards_desc: Shards of a once-great Great Sword that hum with Corruption.
1418_0101_corruptedshieldlining_descript: Soft leather lining that wraps around the inside of a shield.
1418_0101_ensouledwoodenbase_description: A wooden base containing the spark of life that makes a Dryad animated.
1418_0101_glowingplantcores_description: Cores of plant creatures that shine brilliantly in the light.
1418_0101_ironplating_description: Plating for the exterior of a shield.
1418_0101_orichalcumstuds_description: Studs of pure orichalcum that are meant to jut out from a shield for maximum damage.
1418_0101_rd_00_complete_available_respo: A masterful game you've played, acquiring these components.
You've earned Rook's Defense, and will doubtlessly wield it with the same impressive valor. Checkmate, indeed.
1418_0101_rd_00_incomplete_a: There is no shield I have ever seen as formidable as the Rook's Defense will be.
1418_0101_rd_00_objective_desc: Gather components to create the legendary tower shield Rook's Defense.
1418_0101_rd_00_proposal_a: I do. Using a shield, and one like this in particular, requires a strategy all of its own.
1418_0101_rd_00_proposal_b: It's like a game I once played called 'Chess'; this shield is like the Rook to defend your King.
1418_0101_rd_00_proposal_next_a: Find these components and bring them to Madaki. She is the master of the Forge, of course.
1418_0101_rd_00_proposal_next_b: With these elements, she'll be able to grant you the 'Rook's Defense'.
1418_0101_rd_01_objective_desc: The classical opening and setting of the board from the Indian game Chatur that would later inspire Chess. Your opening lies in Malevolence.
1418_0101_rd_02_objective_desc: In this deadly game of Chess, the ivory pieces move first. Your first move is to Scorpius.
1418_0101_rd_03_objective_desc: The ability of the Pawn to dash forward to the front lines in its first play is a formidable move. Your next move takes you to Eridanus.
1418_0101_rd_04_objective_desc: The Persian story of Shahnameh, the reenacting of an epic battle on a Chess board. Your battle continues in Periville.
1418_0101_rd_05_objective_desc: Once a piece has been touched on the Chess board it must be moved. Your next move takes you to Stone Skull Fort.
1418_0101_rd_06_objective_desc: Should a Pawn make it to the other side of the board alive it will be crowned a Queen. Your crowning comes in Infernal Host.
1418_0101_rd_07_objective_desc: Castling is a move in Chess wherein the King moves two squares towards a Rook, and then the Rook moves to protect their King’s flank. Castle yourself in Mangled Heights.
1418_0101_rd_08_objective_desc: An announcement that the other player's King has been placed in a position of peril. Check the Corrupted of Opulence.
1418_0101_rottingleatherstraps_descripti: Some fetid leather straps that will take a steady hand to attach to a shield.
1418_0101_twistedheraldry_description: The inscribed artistry of a shield showing one's allegiance.

1418_01_defaultdialogue: If you have no business with me, then move along.
1418_0201_b_description: Investigate the Ancient Guardians and their movements in the Primal Lochan. Then report back to Ranger Wardell in Edengrove.
1418_0201_c_proposal_a: Well, in most territories, they are charged with simply securing certain ruins.
1418_0201_c_proposal_b: Here, however, it seems they are charged with securing all of Edengrove.
1418_0201_c_proposal_pt2_a: Oh, yes. We Rangers have been fighting them back for years.
1418_0201_c_proposal_pt2_b: I fear with all the attention on the Corrupted and the Blight, we've let them regain their strength.
1418_0201_c_proposal_pt3_a: Yes, the Guardians typically launch their attacks from a place called the Primal Lochan.
1418_0201_c_proposal_pt3_b: If your offer is sincere, then attack them there and weaken their forces.
1418_0201_d_01_task: Repel the Ancient Guardian threat at {POITags}
1418_0201_e_incomplete_a: It seems there was a time when the Ancients considered this territory to be exclusively theirs.
1418_0201_e_incomplete_b: The Guardians still seem dead-set on enforcing this mandate.
1418_0201_f_complete_a: Ah, there you are. I hope you dealt them a blow from which they won't soon recover.
1418_0201_f_complete_b: The last thing we need right now is to fall under attack from the Ancient Guardians.
1418_0201_f_complete_pt2_a: Back to their patrol, then. Funny, isn't it? That my duty is the same as theirs.
1418_0201_f_complete_pt2_b: Will I also someday lose all but bone to my duty? I suppose such philosophical questions are pointless, when the duty remains.
1418_0202_b_description: Collect Wyrdwood Tears from the dryad soldiers in the Wyrdwood Twists area. Then report back to Ranger Wardell in Edengrove.
1418_0202_c_proposal_a: I do, so listen well. Edengrove is abundant in wyrdwood trees, which have a beautiful glow.
1418_0202_c_proposal_b: The sap from such trees can be refined into what we call Wyrdwood Tears - sacred to the Rangers.
1418_0202_c_proposal_pt2_a: The Tears benefit one's health, but in truth, we do not refine them ourselves.
1418_0202_c_proposal_pt2_b: Our secret is that we earn them by battling the dryads of the Wyrdwood Twists. Gather some and I will reward you.
1418_0202_d_01_task: Collect Wyrdwood Tears from the Dryads of {POITags}
1418_0202_e_incomplete_a: Collecting the Tears will support the Rangers out in the wilds.
1418_0202_f_complete_a: Ah, these Tears have saved my life more than once when I was alone in the wilds.
1418_0202_f_complete_b: These will be much appreciated by the other Rangers, as well. We are, again, in your debt.
1418_0202_f_complete_pt2_a: We are whispers in the forest, eyes in shadows... You may not see us, but we will still be watching your back.
1418_0202_f_complete_pt2_b: I hope you'll come to appreciate our help as we've come to appreciate yours.
1418_0202_wyrdwoodtears_description: Droplets of wyrdwood sap that have been refined and taken the shape of a teardrop.
1418_02_defaultdialogue_a: I know the Soulwardens are here because of the Corrupted.
1418_02_defaultdialogue_b: But you should also know that here, perhaps more than other places, the Ancient Guardians are a threat as well.
1418_03_defaultdialogue_a: Unlike these other Wardens, you've proven that you're not just here to battle the Corrupted. There are many threats to humankind.
1418_03_defaultdialogue_b: Perhaps that means it's safe to share some of the Rangers' secrets with you.
1418_04_defaultdialogue: The Survivalist, Ellwood, made mention of your bravery. It seems he's taken such a shine to you that he left a message for you when he left.
1418_05_defaultdialogue: The Rangers will always be at your back, even if you turn and see nothing.
1418_06_defaultdialogue: I heard about what you achieved with Madaki, you know. She even sent me some of the designs to decrypt - an impenetrable Tower Shield, in fact.
1419_01_defaultdialogue: Though the forest is sacred to both the Angry Earth and the Rangers, it is no crime to chop down a tree.
1419_0201_reformation_complete_available: Here we are, you've acquired the components for the Great Axe.
Well done, this is an axe destined to fell many Corrupted. Wield it with savage fury, {playerName}. Give them something to fear.
1419_0201_reformation_incomplete_a: Have you ever noticed how the Corrupted smell?
1419_0201_reformation_incomplete_b: It's like some kind of sulfuric body odor mixed with spoiled fruit. Dreadful.
1419_0201_reformation_objective_desc: Recover the components needed to create the Great Axe called Reformation, then deliver them to Ranger Madaki in Mountainhome.
1419_0201_reformation_proposal_a: I do. The Corrupted call this design 'the Reformation', and though I despise them, I like the name.
1419_0201_reformation_proposal_b: Gather the components on this list and bring them to Madaki. Then the Reformation will be yours to wield.
1419_0201_reformmaterials_description: A bundle of materials collected to craft the Great Axe, Reformation.
1419_0202_corraxehead_description: The broken head of an axe, forged from Corrupted iron.

1419_0204_wirefiberstalk_description: The central stalk of a Wirefiber plant, flexible yet resilient.

1419_0205_reformation_wieldertested_obje: Locate Corruption Breaches throughout Aeternum, and cut down the hordes of Monstrous Corrupted who gather there
1419_0206_alligatorhide_description: A leathery chunk of Alligator hide, hard won from its past owner.
1419_0206_ancsilverband_description: A band of bright silver, crafted by the Ancients long ago.

1419_0207_grizzbearclawb_description: The paw of a great Grizzly Bear, with claws still intact.
1419_0207_guardribbone_description: The dusty rib bone of an Ancient Guardian.

1419_0207_reformation_firesstoked_object: In Mourningdale, obtain Ancient Silver Bands from chests within Scorpius.

1419_0208_ironwoodbranch_description: A straight branch from an Ironwood tree.
1419_0208_reformation_hafthewn_gather_it: Gather {itemName}es from Ironwood Trees throughout Aeternum

1419_0209_fineleatherwrap_description: An embossed strip of quality leather.

1419_0209_reformation_gripsecured_object: Obtain Fine Leather Wrappings from the Dryads of Eridanus.
1419_02_defaultdialogue_a: Ah, you are the one who decrypted the Corrrupted's weapon recipes with Ranger Madaki.
1419_02_defaultdialogue_b: I was actually able to translate the formulation for a massive Great Axe.
1420_0101_azothcore_description: A glowing, sticky, and malleable substance used for binding and sealing.
1420_0102_goldenflintlock_description: A fire-striking mechanism of a gun emblazoned in gold.
1420_0103_glisteningbarrel_description: The Myrkgard were once known for their superior weaponsmiths. A finer rifle barrel has yet to be made.
1420_0104_ramrod_description: A sturdy, unyielding metal rod used for ramming down the charge of a muzzleloading firearm.
1420_0105_hairtrigger_description: Suitable for those who fire first and ask questions later.
1420_0106_seakissedwood_description: Strong, hardy wood from Dryads long exposed to sea air.
1420_0107_twistedstock_description: Ordinary vines are neither this light nor this strong, but this mysterious growth will make an excellent stock for a rifle.
1420_0108_heavybase_description: Many riflemen simply learn to tolerate recoil, but this firearm base promises to keep your shots steady and your shoulder from aching.
1420_01_defaultdialogue: There is no natural system more complex nor more mysterious than the human mind.
1420_02_defaultdialogue_a: As much as I have a deep appreciation for nature, I believe human ingenuity is a miracle in its own right.
1420_02_defaultdialogue_b: Think of all we've accomplished across history. It's magnificent.
1420_0501_b_description: Collect the pieces to Clamorous Vox for Ranger Madaki to assemble.
1420_0501_c_proposal_a: There's no better feeling than a musket in your hands, the power of fire, steel, and science.
1420_0501_c_proposal_b: There might even be an opportunity to craft a wholly unique firearm, if you're interested.
1420_0501_c_proposal_next_a: I've been calling this design the "Clamorous Vox", for how loud its gunfire will be.
1420_0501_c_proposal_next_b: Bring Ranger Madaki the parts and we'll be able to make you a musket beyond compare.

1421_01_defaultdialogue: I've walked this territory for more years than I can count, but I've never seen the Grove in such chaos. Be careful as you wander this place.
1421_0201_azothwood_description: Wood to be used for the core of a bow. Its hints of azoth give it a strength beyond regular wood.
1421_0201_b_description: Gather the materials necessary to create Torrent, the legendary bow.
1421_0201_bewitchedbone_description: Bones taken from the Ancient Guardian skeletons in Spilaio Cavern. It seems to have a faint pulse of azoth.
1421_0201_blacksinew_description: Strands of sinew that are jet-black with corruption and a grisly red. Its otherworldly flexibility makes it perfect for a bow.
1421_0201_c_proposal_a: Yes, well, if you have sharp eyes, and indeed, you must, if you spotted me here.
1421_0201_c_proposal_b: This bow is the mighty Torrent, a bow of legend among the rangers. Acquire these items and it shall be yours.
1421_0201_cbleather_description: Leather that once bound evil codices. It can hold large amounts of magical energy.
