1421_0201_e_incomplete: The Torrent would be the envy of any archer in Aeternum. A weapon without equal, I think.
1421_0201_f_complete_a: You've got it all, eh? Otherworldly sinew, ancient bone, an oil coat, and a perfect string for a perfected draw.
1421_0201_f_complete_b: Take this bow, the Torrent, and wield it with pride. It's in a class all of its own.
1421_0201_pallidash_description: Wood from Periville in Weaver's Fen. It's quite strong despite its paleness.
1421_0201_phempstring_description: Hemp string spun by Dryad Bowyers for bowcrafting. It's quality is unmatched, and provides a smooth draw.
1421_0201_skoak_description: Oak wood repurposed from a dilapidated ship.
1421_0201_svoil_description: A dark oil that is perfect for finishing and protecting wood.
1421_0202_b_description: Travel to Periville and collect pieces of Pallid Ash Wood from the Undead.
1421_0203_b_description: Travel to the Spilaio Cavern and collect fragments of Bewitched Bone from Ancient Guardians.
1421_0204_b_description: Travel to the Stone Skull Fort and collect pieces of Seakissed Oak Wood from Pirates.
1421_0205_b_description: Climb the tallest tower in Edengrove, Malevolence, and collect Perfected Hemp String from Alcazarian Archers.
1421_0206_b_description: Brave Scorpius in Mourningdale and collect a piece of Codex-binding Leather from S'ylanx.
1421_0207_b_description: Travel to the Scorched Mines and collect Scorchvein Oil from Corrupted mineworkers.
1421_0208_b_description: Travel to the Mangled Heights and collect pieces of Blackened Sinew from Unhallowed Tendrils.
1421_0209_b_description: Travel to Eridanus and collect pieces of Enchanted Azoth Wood from Eridanite Yeoman.
1421_02_defaultdialogue_a: You're the one who's worked with Madaki, aren't you?
1421_02_defaultdialogue_b: Yes, I've heard all about you. I also managed to discover a design for a legendary bow, if you're interested.
1422_00_innkeep: Ah, you picked a wonderful time to visit! Nature is at it's most beautiful right now.Please come in and make yourself comfortable.
1422_01_innkeep_tasktopic: Fine day out, isn't it? A little humid, but fair weather for Edengrove. How can I help you?
1423_00_innkeep: Welcome to the Dusty Coin. I'm the purveyor of this luxurious establishment. Our one and only room features four plush cots, some with "vintage" blankets. At least one of them has been laundered. Take your pick.
1423_00_innkeep_a: Welcome to the Dusty Coin. I'm the purveyor of this luxurious establishment.
1423_00_innkeep_b: Our one and only room features four plush cots, some with "vintage" blankets. At least one of them has been laundered. Take your pick.
1424_0101_azothtingedfish_description: A fish touched by the powers of Azoth.
1424_0101_fq11_complete_available_respon: Aye, that's it… Come to Papa wee little fishes… oh! I didn't see you there. Singing while I fish calms me.
You've come with the loot of a lifetime for the hungry Soulwardens here.
1424_0101_fq11_incomplete_a: I mark my days with three square meals, mostly fish, of course.
1424_0101_fq11_objective_desc: Catch five fish heavier than 30 pounds for Master Fisher Klaus and deliver them to Master Fisher Davies in Edengrove
1424_0101_fq11_proposal_a: The Soulwardens are hearty eaters, and need large fish to supply their rations with.
1424_0101_fq11_proposal_b: Could you catch five large fish and deliver them to Master Fisher Davies? We both oversee the supply of food for the Soulwardens.
1424_0101_fq11_proposal_next: You would be hungry if you were fighting Corruption the way the Soulwardens do, too. Even though we don't need food to survive on this island it certainly is one way to keep from going insane and losing track of time.
1424_01_defaultdialogue: Doo doo doo, I'm Master Fisher Davies…
1424_02_defaultdialogue: Ach, very well, very well. I guess this is supposed to prove a point that there's more to find in the water than just fish?
1424_03_defaultdialogue: Thank you. Your help has been invaluable, friend. I'd say you're ready to catch most any fish in Aeternum.
1425_00_defaultdialogue: There's a place I know that might interest a glory-seeker like you.
1425_prospector_talk_response: Outpost Rush is a 20 vs 20 match that takes place on a large island with three Outposts. Players compete to capture and hold these Outposts for as long as possible, increasing their team's score in the process.
1426_00_defaultdialogue: If you're headed up to the Seam, give those Corrupted a good thrashing for me.
1426_0101_01_taskgoto: Storm into {POITags} and disrupt their operations
1426_0101_moresabotage_complete_a: I see the smoke on the horizon. Warms a soul, it does.
1426_0101_moresabotage_complete_b: It doesn't balance my ledger, but at this point I don't think anything will. I'm a well and truly ruined man. Maybe I'll take up lumberjacking.
1426_0101_moresabotage_complete_next_a: This? I'm inclined to tear it up. Or keep it for a souvenir. Either way, it's useless.
1426_0101_moresabotage_complete_next_b: Here's my last coin, more a keepsake at this point… not even enough to buy bread.
1426_0101_moresabotage_description: Wreak havoc on the Slag Mines operations by burning key operational equipment and recover a set of survey notes for Foreman Gowering.
1426_0101_moresabotage_incomplete: I want to see smoke on the horizon. I want to hear them screaming.
1426_0101_moresabotage_proposal_a: Start over? To hell with THAT idea. No. In theory I can make more coin. What I can't replace is my dignity.
1426_0101_moresabotage_proposal_b: I'll play it straight with you. If I can't have this mine and all its riches, no one can.
1426_0101_moresabotage_proposal_next_a: Oh, aye. Absolutely. First, I need you to recover the results of a survey I did. Not something I want in the hands of the Corrupted.
1426_0101_moresabotage_proposal_next_b: For the rest? Here's a torch. Burn. It. Down.
1426_0101_moresabotage_start_prompt: "It must feel awful, starting from nothing."
1426_0101_surveynotes_description: A set of diagrams, maps, and notation all describing the size, shape, and depth of a hidden underground chamber just beneath the mines.
1426_0102_01_taskgoto: Enter {POITags} and bury Foreman Gowering's discovery
1426_0102_02a_weakenwall: Strike the scaffolding to weaken the structure
1426_0102_02b_collapserubble: Strike the final blow to bury the ancient door
1426_0102_collapsevault_complete_a: Oh, I heard. A fine collapse! Did you take the rest of the mine with it? Probably not, but a man can dream of a sweeter revenge.
1426_0102_collapsevault_complete_b: I already gave you my last coin, but here. A little keepsake of your own.
1426_0102_collapsevault_description: Find the entrance of the underground chamber in the Upper Slag Mines. Bury it in rubble so the Corrupted cannot access the contents of the chamber.
1426_0102_collapsevault_incomplete: I'm proper pleased that we have this understanding. Let me know when you've rescinded their invitation to invade my cavern.
1426_0102_collapsevault_proposal_a: Just so. If my equipment worked and my surveyor is to be trusted, it was the entrance to a massive underground chamber. Ideally full of treasure.
1426_0102_collapsevault_proposal_b: The Corrupted CANNOT have it. Is that clear?
1426_0102_collapsevault_start_prompt: "'It' being the contents of the survey?"
1426_01_defaultdialogue_a: What a mess. All my miners, chased off or Corrupted. My foremen turned on me. All that I invested to get this operation up and running-- gone!
1426_01_defaultdialogue_b: Makes a man feel proper powerless, it does.
1426_02_defaultdialogue: Ah, you're back. Just in time, too. I heard some rumbling from the mines and if I know my business-- and I do-- they found it.
1426_03_defaultdialogue: Don't fret on my account. I arrived on this island dressed in rags and penniless, just like everyone else. It's as you said-- I can start again.
1426_foreman_title: Head Foreman of the Slag Mines
1427_00_defaultdialogue_a: There is something strange going on over there, traveler. My daughter spent mere minutes among them and now will not stop talking about this cult of theirs.
1427_00_defaultdialogue_b: For shame, preying upon a lonely young woman.
1427_0101_01_triggervol_culthq: Seek out the Cult of Renewal
1427_0101_04_triggervol_returntomother: Share what you learned with Han Fang
1427_0101_anointedseed_description: A pouch of seeds bathed in the waters of Gaol Creag.
1427_0101_joinedacult_complete: You return! Did they speak to you? I cannot fathom they would turn you away as well. You do not have that "hovering mother" look about you.
1427_0101_joinedacult_complete_next_a: When I was young, I thought the notion of mother's intuition was pure superstition. But I was right… and it is a truly terrible feeling.
1427_0101_joinedacult_complete_next_b: I did not act, and now she is gone. Can she be saved?
1427_0101_joinedacult_complete_prompt: "I think you were right to be worried."
1427_0101_joinedacult_description: Speak to members of the Cult of Renewal to learn what happened to Han Fang's daughter, Han Liu.
1427_0101_joinedacult_incomplete: I know I ask a great deal of you, stranger. You have my family's gratitude. Please bring my daughter back to me.
1427_0101_joinedacult_proposal_a: How embarrassing. Yes. This is all so personal, and you a total stranger, but my daughter Han Liu has vanished.
1427_0101_joinedacult_proposal_b: She was invited to share a meal with some strangers in white robes and simply did not come home.
1427_0101_joinedacult_proposal_next_a: I do not know what they are, but when I asked about her, they turned me away. They seem to think I will "interfere with her journey."
1427_0101_joinedacult_proposal_next_b: Maybe they will speak to you. I just want to know that she's safe.
1427_0101_joinedacult_proposal_prompt: "White robes? What are they, a cult?"
1427_0101_talkto_cultist01_response: Another newcomer! Between you and ah... Miss Liu, was it? I do not feel quite so out of sorts.
1427_0101_talkto_cultist02_response: I hear the High Sage is due to make an appearance today. You will not want to miss it!
1427_0101_talkto_cultist03_response: I know that look. A little overwhelmed, a little uncertain. There is no need. You will find only kindness here. How can I put you at ease?
1427_0101_talkto_cultofficer_response: Ah, Miss Liu. A promising young spark, that one. She walks the path of truth now. If she returns, I am sure she will be glad to see you after such a trial.
1427_0101_talkto_cultofficer_response_a: We all eagerly await the outcome of her communion.
1427_0102_02_gotopoi: Enter {POITags} in search of a sacred pool
1427_0102_03a_killdryads: Defeat {targetName} to protect Han Liu on her journey
1427_0102_03b_anointseed: Anoint the Seeds in the sacred pool
1427_0102_04_triggervol_daughter: Find Han Liu on the road
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_complete: I cannot tell you what a relief it is to see another on the road. I was truly beginning to worry I would need to continue on alone!
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_description: Find Han Liu by joining her on the Cult of Renewal's so-called "Path of Truth."
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_incomplete_a: I only hope we are not too late.
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_proposal_a: They would. How like a cult to both prevent me from speaking to her after she was in their clutches and then immediately send her away to prove herself.
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_proposal_b: And how very like Liu to leap to impress…
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_proposal_next_a: Why would they… she could die? She cannot even wield a sword.
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_proposal_next_b: Stranger, I do not know how to ask this of you, but you must save her. I do not care how. Lie to them. Follow her. Bring her back to me.
1427_0102_pilgrimmage01_proposal_prompt: "They said she might not return at all."
1427_0102_talkto_cultofficer_pilgrimmage: I can tell you, or you can see for yourself. Follow the path to the north as it mounts the peak.
Imbue these seeds in a pool's waters and plant them in soft soil. If you are swift, you may join Miss Liu.
1427_0102_talkto_daughter_umbrage_prompt: "I'm not sure I am ready for this."
1427_0102_talkto_daughter_umbrage_respon: I can't put it to words, truly, but there is… something grand here. A universal truth. A great knowing. That sounds ridiculous, but perhaps you felt it too?
The High Sage tells me he has some lessons planned for us. I cannot wait!
1427_0102_talkto_oath_response: "I stand before my fellows, humbled by nature's majesty. I came with many questions, and I seek only answers."
1427_0102_talkto_oath_response_a: "I give myself to the unknown, in hopes of renewing my body and soul. What may be, will be."
1427_0103_01_gotopoi: Follow the Path of Truth into the Wyrdwood Twists
1427_0103_02a_killdryads: Defeat {targetName} to protect Han Liu on her journey
1427_0103_02b_01_plantseeds_01: Plant a seed at Twisted Roots
1427_0103_02b_03_plantseeds_03: Plant a seed at Beinn Creagg
1427_0103_02b_container_plantseeds: Plant Seeds at Angry Earth Shrines
1427_0103_03_triggervol_cultofficer: Return to the enclave of the Cult of Renewal
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_complete_a: Forgive me for being so cryptic before. This trial is certainly not for the faint of heart, but it does help us find those who truly think and feel as we do.
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_complete_b: I'm eager to hear about your journey.
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_description: Complete your own Path of Truth by planting an imbued seed at each of the Angry Earth shrines within the Wyrdwood Twists. Help Han Liu do the same by clearing the path of Angry Earth.
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_incomplete: I can climb well enough, but I am afraid I am rather useless in a fight. I hope for both our sakes that you are equipped to handle this.
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_proposal: My mother? She truly cannot mind her own affairs, can she? This is MY choice. Those people were kind to me. All I want to do is learn more about them!
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_proposal_next: I'm not sure I believe you, but would you help clear the road ahead? These creatures frighten me, I feel as if I have come as far as I can on my own.
1427_0103_pilgrimmage02_proposal_prompt: "I want to learn more about them, too."
1427_0104_01_talkto_hanfang: Relay this information to Han Fang
1427_0104_oath_complete_a: Welcome to the Cult of Renewal, my friend. I now name you Initiate, and soon all of our knowledge will be yours.
1427_0104_oath_complete_b: Enjoy the grounds. Celebrate. Rest. You will be called upon when you are ready for the next step.
1427_0104_oath_description: Talk to Han Fang about taking the oath to officially join the Cult of Renewal.
1427_0104_oath_incomplete: The High Sage spoke those words to me when first we met. I felt them so stark, so prescient, that I saved them for all to come.
1427_0104_oath_proposal_a: You have, but in deed only. I have seen your commitment to understanding what it is we are doing here and it has been noted.
1427_0104_oath_proposal_b: But here, we believe words hold power as well. Miss Liu has already spoken hers.
1427_0104_oath_proposal_next_a: Ah! Nothing so formal as that. This is but the first step you will take with us.
1427_0104_oath_proposal_next_b: There is a tome before the High Sage that contains the binding words that unite us. Speak them to him, and we will call you ours.
1427_0104_oath_proposal_prompt: "Is there some sort of ceremony, then?"
1427_0104_talkto_cultmother_prompt: "She lived, but chose to join them."
1427_0104_talkto_cultmother_response: I only hope we are not too late.
1427_0104_talkto_cultmother_response_a: What on Aeternum is this cult after? It feels to me as if they are trying to get their followers killed. Oh Liu… why won't you listen?
1427_0106_03a_killdryads: Defeat {targetName} Dryads to clear the way for Han Liu
1427_0106_03b_reachtop: Prove your worth by reaching and touching the Umbral Orb
1427_0106_04_triggervol_cultofficer_01: Speak to High Seer Agnes at [PH]Cult Camp
1427_0106_umbragetrial_complete_a: What a triumph. In so little time both you and Miss Liu have not only demonstrated a willingness to learn, but also a deep, abiding respect for the denizens of Edengrove.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_complete_b: For this, we place our full trust in you.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_description: Try to talk Han Liu out of undergoing a difficult rite and help her succeed if she insists on going anyway.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_incomplete: What on Aeternum is this cult after? It feels to me as if they are trying to get their followers killed. Oh Liu… why won't you listen?
1427_0106_umbragetrial_proposal_a: She mentioned yet another trial, this time to one of those dryad-infested towers! I need not remind you how utterly defenseless she is!
1427_0106_umbragetrial_proposal_b: I pushed too hard to keep her here, to stop her. She told me to stay away.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_proposal_next_a: Would you? If you think it will work… I think we both know how this will end.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_proposal_next_b: If you can safeguard her as you did before, it will add to this considerable debt I owe you. Please go where I cannot, my friend.
1427_0106_umbragetrial_proposal_prompt: "I can try and talk her out of it."
1427_0107_01_gotopoi: Seek calming herbs from the denizens of {POITags}
1427_0107_herbaltea_complete_a: This is a fine bundle of herbs. I hope you did not have a great deal of trouble acquiring them- it is a tricky task at best.
1427_0107_herbaltea_complete_b: And I have never met a dryad that gave them willingly. I will brew the tea, now.
1427_0107_herbaltea_description: Venture to Buggane Hedge and harvest herbs for a calming tea from the hides of dryads.
1427_0107_herbaltea_incomplete_a: I find a calming tea helps center them, opens their mind to the experience they are about to have.
1427_0107_herbaltea_proposal_a: Like myself and the High Sage, and the scores of Exalted, they will have gained the deepest, most complete understanding of our way of life.
1427_0107_herbaltea_proposal_b: They will then go forth into Aeternum and tell others what they found.
1427_0107_herbaltea_proposal_next_a: No, but I think bearing witness will prepare you. For your part, there are some ruins to the north where dryads grow a specific herb on their bodies.
1427_0107_herbaltea_proposal_next_b: Collect some for our rite-goers. That will help see them off.
1427_0107_herbaltea_proposal_prompt: "I take it Han Liu and I are not ready."
1427_0107_herbs_description: A vivid violet flower with five bright yellow stamen.
1427_0108_flowers_description: A brightly colored, pleasantly scented flower with a long stem, perfect for braiding into a wreath.
1427_0108_wreathes_complete: You have a fine eye for color. Yes, these will do nicely. I will save the extras for another time, perhaps dry them. That seems appropriate.
1427_0108_wreathes_description: Venture into the verdant forests of Edengrove to harvest colorful flowers in celebration of the returning cultists.
1427_0108_wreathes_incomplete: I find a nice flower wreathe to heighten any bright and cheerful moment. And their return shall be so!
1427_0108_wreathes_proposal_a: Ah… I would prefer not to darken the mood with that discussion. I will, but not now. In this moment I would like to assume they will succeed.
1427_0108_wreathes_proposal_b: Can you procure some bright flowers, so we can make wreathes for them?
1427_0108_wreathes_start_prompt: "What happens if they do not return?"
1427_0109_03_talkto_cultofficer: Deliver the recovered items to High Seer Agnes
1427_0109_belongings_description: Well, the Followers don't need these anymore, do they?
1427_0109_charm_description: Made of silver, a sun and a moon dangle from a slender chain. The moon charm has an inscription the back written in Chinese characters.
1427_0109_coins_description: The Withered have no need for currency. The Cult will put this to better use.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_complete: Why is my mother here? What did she say? I hope she does not mean to lecture me AGAIN.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_complete_next_: This belonged to my father. The inscription means "Where you go, I will follow." To give it to me now...
I suppose it is time for my mother and I to have a long, honest talk. Thank you… for everything.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_description: Help Han Fang reunite with Han Liu.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_incomplete: I hope she will hear me out, this time.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_proposal_a: I think you are right. I have a terrible choice to make. I can continue to beg her to leave.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_proposal_b: She will push me away, perhaps forever. Or… I can let her be, and risk her enduring the same fate as the others.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_proposal_next2: I do not want to approach her now. She may think I am snooping again. Here. Give her this trinket. She will know what it means. It belonged to her father.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_proposal_next_: Join them? But the things they expect, the risks… But I could be near her. I can care for her. I can hold her hand, even to an unspeakable end.
… And, perhaps, I can ease her away, but slowly. Over time.
1427_0109_daughterschoice_proposal_promp: "Or you could join them, like I did."
1427_0109_daughterschoice_start_prompt: "I do not think she will leave them."
1427_0109_daughterschoice_title: Where You Go, I Will Follow
1427_0109_talkto_cultofficer_gold_respon: Thank you. I have asked a great deal of you. It is time now for you to rest. Go now and meditate on all that you have seen.
1427_0109_wastenot_complete: You went into the forest? Oh, this curiosity of mine is consuming! Tell me, tell me, what did you see? What happened to them?
1427_0109_wastenot_complete_next_a: Lost? Mindless… things?! How tragic! And what do you mean by 'stealing'? Do we not share all that we have?
1427_0109_wastenot_complete_next_b: I can see how you might THINK that, but maybe you need to spend more time studying their ways.
1427_0109_wastenot_complete_prompt: "They are Lost, and we are stealing their gold."
1427_0109_wastenot_description: Retrieve the fallen belongings of cultists who have failed their final rite.
1427_0109_wastenot_incomplete: Everything we do is to strengthen the cult. No one individual rises above that goal. Not even myself. Not even the High Sage.
1427_0109_wastenot_proposal_a: Not as themselves, no. They likely still linger in the forest in a more… lacking state. A soulless state, one could say.
1427_0109_wastenot_proposal_b: If you want to see for yourself, there is more you can do.
1427_0109_wastenot_proposal_next_a: Not for them. For us. Our cult grows every day. We must feed, clothe, and shelter all who come to us.
1427_0109_wastenot_proposal_next_b: Those who left us would want us to use their belongings for good. You can recover what they no longer need.
1427_0109_wastenot_proposal_prompt: "What can I do for them, now?"
1427_0109_wastenot_start_prompt: "Is that it? They just… don't come back?"
1427_01_defaultdialogue_a: I knew I should have kept a closer eye on her… Oh! Apologies, I did not hear you approach.
1427_01_defaultdialogue_b: If you have come to inquire about fine silks, I am afraid I am unable to take new requests at this time.
1427_02_defaultdialogue: When you say I should be worried… the mind can conjure up any number of things. I need you to be specific and honest with me. Where is my daughter?
1427_03_defaultdialogue_a: Liu came to me just now, positively bursting with news. I cannot even tell if the cult allowed her to speak to me, but I think I may have only made matters worse.
1427_03_defaultdialogue_b: I do not know what to do.
1427_03_tasktopic_defaultdialogue: You made it back! Quickly- is my daughter with you? Is she well?
1427_04_defaultdialogue_a: Your presence is… something. This is not a favor I would have ever dreamed of asking, but you have exceeded every hope and expectation I have had. For that, I am in your debt.
1427_04_defaultdialogue_b: For now… we watch. We wait.
1427_05_defaultdialogue: Judging by your demeanor, you do not have bad news for me. I will take that small comfort. Continue doing what it is you are doing. Where my daughter goes, walk with her in my stead.
1427_06_defaultdialogue_a: I came as soon as I heard about this 'final rite' of theirs. I had to see myself, and I feared Han Liu may try it.
1427_06_defaultdialogue_b: I am immeasurably grateful that she did not, but…
1427_07_defaultdialogue_a: At least she is speaking to me again. It is a small consolation, but perhaps in time I will get through to her.
1427_07_defaultdialogue_b: And if not… I will see this cult dismantled, even if I have to do it myself.
1428_00_defaultdialogue: I can't put it to words, truly, but there is… something grand here. A universal truth. A great knowing. That sounds ridiculous, but perhaps you felt it too?
1428_01_defaultdialogue: I did not expect to see anyone else on the road. I admit, it gives me comfort. These creatures make me nervous.
1428_01_tasktopic_defaultdialogue: Look at my arm. See how the hair stands on end? I am RADIATING energy! Are you bound for Umbrage as well? Are we to travel together once more?!
1428_02_defaultdialogue: Wait… those seeds in your hand. Are you also walking the Path of Truth?
1428_03_defaultdialogue: It is such a comfort to have another traveler beside me. This is my first adventure on my own, truth be told.
1428_04_defaultdialogue: My heart and mind are full to bursting and there's still so much left to learn! So much of it is… intangible. I feel I am connected to something greater than myself, but what is it?
1428_05_defaultdialogue_a: There is so much we do not know about this place, its denizens, and our role among them.
1428_05_defaultdialogue_b: The High Sage tells me he has some lessons planned for us. I cannot wait!
1428_06_defaultdialogue_a: We did it! I was terrified the whole time. I searched for dryads around every corner, but mysteriously there were none.
1428_06_defaultdialogue_b: I am not one to spit a blessing in the face. We are here now and our future is bright!
1428_07_defaultdialogue_a: While you were fetching herbs, I was given the privilege of washing the rite-goers feet! It was terribly formal and grave. Significant.
1428_07_defaultdialogue_b: It gives me chills, and I hope to stand where they do some day.
1428_08_defaultdialogue_a: Perhaps the other two are merely delayed…? At least one returned.
1428_08_defaultdialogue_b: Judging by his demeanor, it must have been a deeply meaningful experience. Oh, I cannot wait for my own!
1428_09_defaultdialogue_a: Try not to tell the others what you told me, about the gold. They may think you are not dedicated to the cause.
1428_09_defaultdialogue_b: I would hate to see you excluded after all we have accomplished together. Have faith, my friend!
1428_10_defaultdialogue_a: As complex as our relationship may be, I am glad my mother is here. She and I have been through so much together.
1428_10_defaultdialogue_b: Eternity would be rather lonely without her. Thank you for this gift.
1428_cultdaughter_title_initiate: Initiate of the Cult of Renewal
1428_cultdaughter_title_member: Follower of the Cult of Renewal
1429_00_defaultdialogue_a: You have a look about you. A certain… hunger.
1429_00_defaultdialogue_b: Far be it from my place to presume but if it is purpose you desire, I encourage you to speak to the High Sage. He is just inside.
1429_01_defaultdialogue: I regret that you could not see Miss Liu off. I hope she returns to a familiar face like yours. There is no greater pleasure after a long journey.
1429_01_tasktopic_defaultdialogue: Ah, a fellow seeker. Welcome to the home of the Cult of Renewal. The High Sage will be among us shortly. In the meantime, how may this High Seer be of service?
1429_02_defaultdialogue: Until you have planted the seeds, I am afraid we cannot continue to discuss your inclusion into our enclave.
1429_02_tasktopic_defaultdialogue: I see you have chosen to return to us. I speak for all of when I say how glad we are. Now, how can this High Seer help you?
1429_03_defaultdialogue_a: I see Miss Liu has found her way back to us. I do not suppose you had anything to do with that?
1429_03_defaultdialogue_b: Do not worry. A shared trial is quite in the spirit of our ways. Now, however, we stand at another crossroads.
1429_04_defaultdialogue: How fare your studies? Have you gained a better understanding of our ways?
1429_05_defaultdialogue_a: The High Sage is a very busy man. I would not dream of discouraging you from speaking to him; he is the source, after all.
1429_05_defaultdialogue_b: But do bear in mind that I am also equipped to answer any questions you may have.
1429_06_defaultdialogue: These three to my left stand on the precipice of the final rite.
1429_07_defaultdialogue_a: They are soon to depart, once they have taken their tea and had a moment to meditate. I feel strongly that this group will succeed.
1429_07_defaultdialogue_b: You can help me prepare a small celebration for their return.
1429_08_defaultdialogue_a: As you have likely noticed, only one of our rite-goers has returned. This does happen, and more often than not.
1429_08_defaultdialogue_b: Do not mourn them. Their convictions carried them to the end. Their sacrifice is not in vain.
1429_08_tasktopic_defaultdialogue_a: As grave as this task was, I hope you found the significance of what we are trying to accomplish.
1429_08_tasktopic_defaultdialogue_b: Only the most devoted ever seek to undertake this rite, and so they would not want us to waste their efforts.
1429_09_defaultdialogue: Rest, contemplation, and meditation is in order for all of us. Our most recent Exalted will need time to recover from their ordeal, after all.
1429_10_defaultdialogue_a: Miss Liu brought us not only herself, but three new members of our order. An auspicious start.
1429_10_defaultdialogue_b: And you. Your contributions are to be noted. Your future is bright indeed.
1429_cultofficer_title: High Seer of the Cult of Renewal
1430_00_defaultdialogue: Welcome, traveler, to the home of the Cult of Renewal. You will notice we have little to offer, but you may make yourself at home.
1430_01_defaultdialogue: The High Seer told me you were hovering about. Do not be shy. We are all equals here.
1430_02_defaultdialogue_a: While the High Seer will almost assuredly push you toward this trial or that, I want to remind you that you may undertake this journey at your own pace.
1430_02_defaultdialogue_b: Why rush? Enlightenment cannot be forced.
1430_03_defaultdialogue_a: You delivered the oath well, strong and true, but I see in your eyes that some uncertainty about us and our cause lingers.
1430_03_defaultdialogue_b: That is normal, at this stage. I hope in time you will grow to feel welcome here.
1430_04_defaultdialogue_a: You are advancing with auspicious speed, my friend. Is it hunger for more, or are you driven by the idea of earning your place here?
1430_04_defaultdialogue_b: If it is the latter, I encourage you to relax. You are one of us.
1430_05_defaultdialogue_a: While I mourn each soul that we lose, I cannot help but feel my heart swell with pride at every individual that returns to us.
1430_05_defaultdialogue_b: Just look at him. He is transformed. I wish this for all of us, including you.
1430_06_defaultdialogue_a: With each sacrifice, we gain more in trust, purpose, and understanding.
1430_06_defaultdialogue_b: It is a long road to comprehending all that we hope to be, but I am glad that you have chosen to join us on this journey of ours.
1430_cultleader_aboutcult_prompt: "Can you tell me more about this cult?"
1430_cultleader_aboutcult_response: If I were to write a pamphlet, I would wax eloquent about balance, simplicity, a life free from greed.
1430_cultleader_aboutcult_response_a: But you are here, among us. Stay. Share our meals. Listen to our stories. Our ways are open to any and all.
1430_cultleader_aboutmask_response: I have a profoundly ugly face. No, pardon my jest. I chose this mask to reinforce that I am nothing, indeed I am no ONE, but a conduit for the ethos of the Cult.
1430_cultleader_aboutmask_response_a: It matters not who I am, only what I may offer.
1430_cultleader_highsage_response: I am, though it is not a title I would have chosen for myself. I was drawn here, just like the others, but I feel I have come closest to articulating why.
1430_cultleader_highsage_response_a: Perhaps that is why they chose me.
1430_cultleader_title: Eminence of the Cult of Renewal

1431_01_defaultdialogue: Greetings, my fine friend. You seem like the sort of person who might take on a task for a humble mycophile. Do you have a moment?

1431_03_defaultdialogue_b: I am inspired, and do you know why?
1431_04_defaultdialogue_a: I am still pondering the mystery you uncovered. I will know the truth myself, once my stew has finished cooking.
1431_04_defaultdialogue_b: Thank you, and I hope you find your own mystery to enjoy.

1435_05_defaultdialogue_b: Return to wherever it is you have come from.
1436_00_defaultdialogue: Here I stand, in the cradle of creation, amongst the beings arisen from mother Earth itself. It is awe-inspiring.
1436_01_defaultdialogue: Hello, stranger! Have you come to learn from the High Sage as well?
1436_02_defaultdialogue_a: Another newcomer! Between you and ah... Miss Liu, was it? I do not feel quite so out of sorts.
1436_02_defaultdialogue_b: I am eager to learn what comes next. This place is so very mysterious!
1436_03_defaultdialogue: You made it! Look at us! Did the High Seer say the trust thing to you as well?
1436_04_defaultdialogue: I'm told there will be tea. It is all so grave and ceremonial. I am trying not to smile too much. Very serious.
1436_cultist_exalted_title: Exalted of the Cult of Renewal
1436_cultist_generic_title: Follower of the Cult of Renewal
1437_00_defaultdialogue: If you can, you must listen to one of the High Sage's sermons. The way he sees life… our purpose… it changed me. Perhaps it will change you too.
1437_01_defaultdialogue_a: Yours is not a face I have seen before, but I will let you in on a little secret.
1437_01_defaultdialogue_b: I hear the High Sage is due to make an appearance today. You will not want to miss it!
1437_02_defaultdialogue_a: I will not lie to you. I was not certain if you or Miss Liu could complete the Path of Truth. It turns a great many away, but those who return? Well.
1437_02_defaultdialogue_b: You are one of us now. Be welcome.
1437_03_defaultdialogue_a: I remember my own Umbrage trial. Would you believe it if I said I perished during it?
1437_03_defaultdialogue_b: Only on my third attempt did I reach the summit and depart unscathed. Consider me impressed.
1437_04_defaultdialogue: Now that I stand here, peering into those dark trees, I feel a terrible sense of dread. This fear is a mere distraction. Surely the tea will help, as intended.
1438_00_defaultdialogue_a: Do not let the robes deter you. They are quite comfortable.
1438_00_defaultdialogue_b: Others think us strange, but if there is anything I have learned on my journeys, it is to listen first, and judge later.
1438_01_defaultdialogue: I know that look. A little overwhelmed, a little uncertain. There is no need. You will find only kindness here. How can I put you at ease?
1438_02_defaultdialogue_a: I heard that you and Miss Liu took the oath! I am very pleased. One of the greatest pleasures in life is sharing what one has learned with others.
1438_02_defaultdialogue_b: If you have questions, please do not hesitate to ask.
1438_03_defaultdialogue: Each trial marks our achievement among the cult, this one second only to the rite my fellows and I are about to endure. I consider it a privilege to stand here, don't you?
1438_04_defaultdialogue: I am ready, come what may. The tea may help, but I do not need it. No, my heart is already open. Let there be more for the others.
1438_05_defaultdialogue: I cannot put into words what I saw, what I felt. I see, now. I understand our purpose.
1439_00_defaultdialogue: The glossy, thick pages are well preserved. The thick tome rests open on a page with an embossed title: "The Oath of Renewal"
1439_01_defaultdialogue: The glossy, thick pages are well preserved. The thick tome rests open on a page with an embossed title: "The Oath of Renewal"
14_00_abiathar_defaultdialog: Help, oh god, please help me.
14_00_andeolus_defaultdialog_a: You look learned. I humor Milosh but he has to work on himself and ahem…his poetry, a bit more.
14_00_andeolus_defaultdialog_b: Luckily for him, I've read Meditations and learnt how to accept the shortcomings of those who aren't as gifted as I am.
14_00_babak_defaultdialog_a: Do you know how to escape the island safely? I've heard stories of storms at sea and cursed ships, how no one survives.
14_00_babak_defaultdialog_b: I can't stay here without my wife. Everything reminds me of her. How do I heal when I can't let her go?
14_00_eva_defaultdialog_a: Have you seen Auberon? He's a good man. Was a good father.
14_00_eva_defaultdialog_b: We lost our sons to the Angry Earth. He blames himself for not being able to buy them the armor they needed.
14_00_faramarz_defaultdialog_a: Isn't Yadira divine? Her smile is like the sun bordering the horizon. Fleeting, but it fills my soul with joy.
14_00_faramarz_defaultdialog_b: To see her is to experience God. To kiss her is to be reborn.
14_00_gwen_defaultdialog_a: Stay wary of Auberon. He is a conniving snake who has fooled my sister.
14_00_gwen_defaultdialog_b: The Angry Earth wouldn't have attacked the mines, if he hadn't agitated them. The Corrupted? Ask around and you'll find the truth about that.
14_00_joan_defaultdialog_a: Can I trust you or will you disappear as soon as you get what you want from me? Like my family did.
14_00_joan_defaultdialog_b: Milosh wants me to hear his poetry. Andeolus wants me to make him look smart. I'm just looking for people who won't leave me.
14_00_milosh_defaultdialog: Can I read you my latest poem? It's only 200 lines. Andeolus says my skills are improving. But Joan says she'd rather lose her right arm than hear another line.
14_00_outfitter_defaultdialog: Have you heard music soothes the savage beast? So does style. I can help you sing the Angry Earth a sweet lullaby.
14_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: Mon cherie, breathe in the nature around you. How could one not be inspired to do more?
14_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: I found my calling in the magic of the thread. Now, it's your turn to surprise us.
14_00_tello_defaultdialog_a: If you see an Auberon Gowering, tell him Tello is onto him and won't rest till he avenges his friends.
14_00_tello_defaultdialog_b: He sold the mine to the Corrupted to line his pockets. And now he cries over what happened? He's a damned fool!
14_00_yadira_defaultdialog: Who needs a husband when you have wealth of your own? A few gems to buy a house, a few more to hire a pair of handsome guards. Life is good.
14_00_yazdan_defaultdialog_a: Yadira is a practical woman. And my brother is a dreamer. The two would never work out.
14_00_yazdan_defaultdialog_b: What she needs is a strong man. A man of the earth. Like me. If only my brother would admit it and get out of our way.
14_00_zhao_defaultdialog_a: If everything is an illusion, why do we make an effort to hide the truth?
14_00_zhao_defaultdialog_b: I used to make wigs to cover up baldness once. Mousy brown. Now? I help people express who they truly are; every color of the rainbow.
14_00_zorzi_defaultdialog_a: Hellooo! Are you paying attention? I am looking for an adventurer to write songs about, one that doesn't hunt dryads, like my last one did.
14_00_zorzi_defaultdialog_b: Dryads are such exquisite creatures. To hurt one is nothing short of uncultured.
14_01_farmequipment_description: The remnants of a broken dream.
14_antara_t1_prompt: "Can you talk to the plants too?"
14_antara_t1_response_a: Yes, the plants are speaking, even though I can't understand their words. Maybe their emotions?
14_antara_t1_response_b: Haha. If we can talk to plants, can we talk to anything? And if we can talk to anything, are we ever alone?
14_antara_t2_response_a: My mum probably wanted me to feel how we're all connected.
14_antara_t2_response_b: Edengrove can feel a bit cold and distant. But here, with these talking plants? It's almost like we're friends. We are friends!
14_edengrove_body_01_01:
Myrddin's Research Notes on Edengrove, part one

The truth of the origins of the Angry Earth eludes me, but evidence indicates they only appeared some time after the Ancients disappeared. Curious.

Perhaps more importantly, their bonds to the natural world, the true natural world, are complex, and if my theory is correct, there may be some fundamental aspect of the Angry Earth that is related to the insidious influence of Corruption. There is much for me to learn here...

Perhaps like us, resurrected from some other place? Fascinating.\nThis is not the only sacred location here, however. The dryads guard these massive towers with furious intent. Many secrets must lie hidden within. I must find a way in.

Myrddin's Research Notes on Edengrove, part three
I passed through the Towers surreptitiously and found the knowledge I have long sought, the process of sundering one's soul.
If I'm correct, I may have unlocked the ability to hide away a portion of my soul so that I might risk exposure to Corruption. 
If I'm wrong, then I suppose this is both a letter of goodbye and one of apology for what might ensue. I hope I am not wrong.

14_edengrove_body_01_05:
Myrddin's Research Notes on Edengrove, part four
I leave this final note for my liege and my sister, the only two with whom I would entrust the sanctity of my soul.
I have hidden here a bastion of my own undoing, a stronghold against time and space, a place where I leave a part of myself for safekeeping.
My soul is dear to my heart, and thus, the keys to veil are those things closest to the hearts of those I love. 
I now step into possibilities of futures I cannot foresee; many of them dark, and though I consign myself to whatever fate my choices lead to, I do this that the small knowledge and insight I have gained can still be reclaimed if the need is dire.

14_edengrove_body_03_01:
A scrap of notes from Master Fisher Davies' Journal:

In the fresh waters of Edengrove lurks a sea monster rarely sighted near the surface.

Horned-Tooth Mandje, the mythical eel of legend, swims through fresh water undulating its long, slimy body through the waters.

Its legend states that those who would harm the Horned-Tooth Mandje's waters would face her wrath, a massive tide coming to wash away the perpetrator. This is how Edengrove stays so clean, or at least one would imagine.
14_edengrove_body_03_02: A scrap of notes from Master Fisher Davies' Journal:\n\nThe crystal blue water of Edengrove is inhabited by any number of fish who've mutated thanks to Azoth's transformative powers. Fish with two heads, two hearts, and four fins aren't uncommon here, and fish in these waters often share traits. Just the other day I caught an Azoth-Tinged Fish whose dorsal fin was that of a swordfish and the pelvic fins were that of a bass.
14_edengrove_body_05_01: They who believe, open themselves to the knowing. They who drink the sacred water take part in the knowing.\n\nHeat a handful of Minthe leaves with water from a natural spring. Say the Chant Of The Dryads and drink the water so formed.
14_edengrove_body_06_01:
In spite of all we have done, the Earth still cries out in fury and anguish. All our efforts to quiet the rage of nature across the island have been unable to return the land to its natural state. If we are ever to find peace here, the balance must be restored.

I have heard of place in the shadow of the mountain, where they say that the entities known as the Angry Earth first sprang forth. Morgaine believes her brother may have returned to this “Edengrove” after his disappearance. Perhaps if I accompany her, I can unravel the mystery of what has made the land itself hostile to our presence. If this is truly the origin of the land’s displeasure, I may be able to help put right what unsettled these normally tranquil forces.

I can only pray that my interference there does not further upset the strange and delicate forces endemic to the Edengrove. But given the strife and upheaval that haunts Aeternum’s natural world, I cannot help but feel the greater sin is to do nothing.
14_edengrove_body_06_02:
This Blight that consumes the land continues to defy my expectations. Although it is one of the few ostensibly natural forces that seems to afflict the Angry Earth, I have come to carry grave doubts as to its origins.

While it clearly afflicts the body and nature of the host, if the sickness were of ordinary stock, I would expect the afflicted specimens to spread their infection to one another. And yet no such transmission occurs… I can only conclude the infection must be introduced by a carrier from some foreign environment.

Whatever its origins, it is clear the consequences are dire. The deranging effects, in addition to rendering the specimen dangerous and volatile, appear to be terminal. Even if I can formulate a cure, it will do nothing to return these creatures peacefully to the Earth. For whatever imbalance has roused them from their rest still eludes me.
14_edengrove_body_06_03:
I came to this place to restore the balance, and yet now I am forced to consider the unthinkable… It may be that in order to fight the Corruption, perhaps the greatest threat to the flow of the Dao here on Aeternum, we must make a sacrifice of the natural world here.

My heart is weary with even the consideration of such blasphemy. I feel the anguish of the healer, hot knife poised to sever a tainted limb from the patient, in the hope of preventing it from spreading its poison to the rest of the host body. For I know that if the weapons of the Crimson Sorcerer were to fall into the hands of the Corruption’s chosen, they might truly be unstoppable.

Perhaps I must place my faith in the hero that has led us this far, and hold fast to the notion that if they truly believe this is our only route to victory, then it truly must be done. Time will tell, and history will no doubt make its judgment.
14_edengrove_body_07_01:
There are days when the love I bear for my brother seems too heavy a burden to bear. Today is one of them.

I warned him that he was meddling with forces far beyond his comprehension. That he would not be ready when they became cognizant of his curiosities, and started to scrutinize him in return. It now appears that he believed my warnings were correct, and forged onward regardless.

Knowing he was hurtling headlong to his own doom, it appears he took precautions. Of the most abjectly reckless kind imaginable. To prepare a ritual to rend apart his own soul? Stark derangement. Even if he could be sure that inaction would yield even more damning consequences, there is no way he could possibly anticipate the cost to his being.

And so, here we are, chasing after what’s left of him. Even if we manage to uncover his resting place, there are simply no guarantees there will be anything left to find. And yet, my quest continues. The bonds of blood run deep, and though I am loathe to admit it, I find I am not truly whole without him.
14_edengrove_body_07_02:
I warned my brother. I warned him! I foretold that this would happen, ages ago, when he set off on this ridiculous quest…

The forces that course and surge across this island cannot be tamed, and we manipulate them at our own peril. Any meddling that we perform should be done with care, and only in response to the most dire of circumstance. And yet it was his casual intercourse with arcane forces brought the Corruption down upon us all!

And now, he has saved himself from Corruption. Saved by tearing apart his very essence and remanding all that remains of his being into a prison of his own making. I would sooner have seen him dead than trapped and mutilated.

A Myrrdin without his magic is not my brother. And yet this simulacrum that wears my brothers face, and speaks with his wisdom is all I can ever hope to regain of his love and companionship. I have been cheated by the hope within my heart. All that remains now is penance. Penance for the sins of my brother, and his hubris. I will save this land, and ensure my brothers folly does not deliver us all into the arms of damnation. I will do this for him, and for all the love I bear him. For there is no one else left to carry the burden.
14_edengrove_body_07_03:
My brother has left us with a heavy burden. The Corruption it seems spread not only through his mind and body, but also through all the implements and trappings of his power. His staff, an artifact of great magic potential, is as infected as a festering wound.

But this wound has an agenda. A yearning. It longs to return to the agents of the Corruption, and bring with it the doom my brother promised them when his mind was overthrown. And so, in this thing he abandoned, his transgression yet remains.

And so we must choose. I can take possession of this tainted staff and pray that its temptations for eternity. This, of course, would require that my will and resolve be even greater than that of my fallen brother – a fool’s hope if ever there was one. Or I can choose to make a sacrifice of this place’s natural energies to draw the poison from his artifact.

Much to my chagrin, it seems that fate forces my hand. I can only hope that this craven act will be vindicated by the turning of the hourglass. And that the salvation of Aeternum and its people is worth the contamination of this land and its magical lifeforce.
14_edengrove_body_08_01:
What point or purpose is there to a life unending? Simply to survive? To live on interminably?

It is not enough.

I lament that here, in this place, I have witnessed the death of heroics and martyrdom. Of icons ready to lay down their precious lives for country, family, or belief. Here, where death itself is cheap, there can be no notion of such noble sacrifice.

Oh, how I long to return to my beloved Rome to live out whatever few years remained of my natural life amongst the gallant bones of these brave lions of the Republic. These idols made flesh. These gods of the mortal realm. Instead, these old joints remain lashed to this place, aching and bent, too aged and brittle to be useful to anyone. Gods of my homeland, I beseech you: carry me back to my beloved city on the Tibur, or grant me the release of a dignified death. That I may witness the great feats of heroes once more in the fields of Elysium.

-Andeolus Flavius
14_edengrove_body_08_02:
Fie that I ever discovered what it is to love!

My dearest Katalina and I were meant for one another. Even in this place of horror and unnatural foes, we everything we needed to weather an eternity of struggles: love. Love everlasting. Love without end. But now she is gone, and I am alone. Woe that such a dark fate should befall me. For over 100 years had we roamed this land together. A stranger could be forgiven to think me fortunate. Do not think it so, for now, every blade of grass, every rock and tree, every cloud in the night sky, reminds me of her dark eyes and shining smile.

It is all a memory! Were I not immortal, I would incontinently drown myself. And now, here I am, without even the silence of death to comfort me. I pray now only that whatever dark forces besiege this place should triumph, and do so quickly. Perhaps, when it is over, the endless torment of this bleak existence will finally cease and trouble me no longer.

-Babak Rahbar
14_edengrove_body_08_03:
I came here to atone.

I swore before to the Most High and to my family that I would always be honest and faithful to my husband. And when I swore it, God be my witness, I meant it. With all my heart, I meant it.But I swore a lie, for when I landed on the shores of this godless place, and the time of my life stretched on forever to eternity, I came to resent the vows of love. Perhaps there are those, better than I, who loved more purely or swore with more intensity. Those whose vows and affections can bear the endless march to the end of time, never doubting, never ceasing. But I was not one of them.

When I dishonored my marriage, the weight of my sin was suffocating. It dragged like an anchor on my heart, to what I thought were ceaseless depths. So I swore I would seek forgiveness. I traveled here, to this strange land, hoping to claim the riches of the dryads and return them to my husband. I thought that if he saw the extremity of my penance, that I might be forgiven.

But I feel the weight of no sin here, amongst these eternal cliffs and groves. Here, the great responsibilities of my past life seem but a distant memory. So perhaps a memory is what they should become, and I should remain here, a creature of the present.

-Yadira Ahmad
14_edengrove_body_08_04:
You came to me, sweet child of another world, as if in a dream. Thy bright eyes shown like fiery stars in the bleak night sky. Your voice like a flowing stream rang out like tinkling bells in my ears. And yet, I know, my life and thine shall ne’er truly be one flesh. For her graceful form was meant for woods and wilds and not the rank banality of civil streets and thoroughfares.

And yet, I confess, my mind will not forget how she hath touched me so. And thus, I wait, to guard this place on the promise of her swift return. I can only pray that she will not forget, and leave my heart forlorn and longing for a jaunt through lonely woodlands. Until then, I shall carry her with me in my dreams. For they are the only consolation for a heart cleft in two by fate and circumstance.

-Faramarz Hakimi
14_edengrove_body_08_05:
I once considered the Earth my mother. A caregiver whose tenderness yielded up the bounties that sustain her many children across the long nights and turn of seasons. But I know now that I was deceived. For the Earth’s bounties have come with a terrible cost.

In recompense for all she has given me these long years, she has demanded all that I held dear. Like thieves in the night, her most perverse and terrifying creations – those who wear the form of man, but whose flesh is formed from bark and bramble – stole into our home with craven intent. And from their beds they dragged my family off to some wretched doom beyond comprehending.

To this day their fate remains a mystery, so it seems not even the long kiss of immortality has the power to return them to me. How could a mother be so cruel? Did I raise up my children so that, when they were grown, I could strip from them that which they held most precious. Never could I consider such a thing!

I know now that nature is a witch. A demon in the night. A cruel, inhuman thing that understand neither love nor mercy. And so I shall fight with all my dying breath to keep its grasp from the hearts of my brothers and sisters, that they may be spared the pain and longing that so haunt my dreams and waking thoughts.

-Eva Gowering
14_edengrove_body_09_01:
We should never have come to this miserable place. Lord Varrick’s obsession with the Crimson Sorcerer has driven him to such extremity, he has his best knights skulking through the woods, scrounging about for some baubles from lost antiquity.

Such stupidity… the people of this island are soft, and their goods are ripe for the taking. Yet here we are beating the bushes in a place where every rock or shrubbery is a potential monstrosity. Whatever great weapons he seeks are unnecessary. We can easily cast aside whatever pathetic defense these weaklings can muster to take what’s theirs. At least then I’d be risking my neck for proper riches. Not out here chasing ghosts in service of some madman’s vanity.

Already I have had two search parties fail to return from patrol. That ought to alarm anyone in a land where no one has the temerity to stay dead. Whatever secrets are locked away in these rocks had better be worth it, or that thrice-damned fool Varrick will be hearing my challenge when I finally make it back to civilization!
