14_sq_artsuffer_complete_a: All gone? Thank the Muses! Someday I shall memorialize your deeds in marble.
14_sq_artsuffer_complete_b: I’m in my “Contra-Formic, Manneristic-Deconstructivism” period, so expect to see an arbitrary number of limbs and a loose sense of shape.
14_sq_artsuffer_description: Deface an avant-garde sculptress's embarrassing early work.
14_sq_artsuffer_incomplete_a: Dispose of some poorly aged sculptures from my formative years.
14_sq_artsuffer_proposal: Ahem. Like all great artists, I was in a state of deep meditation. Creativity means surrender, not control. It took me centuries to learn that.
14_sq_artsuffer_proposal_next_2_a: I make art, not war. But you have the look of one who’s dealt their share of violence.
14_sq_artsuffer_proposal_next_2_b: Might I trouble you to spare my reputation and thrash up some old sculptures? It could be rather fun for you.
14_sq_artsuffer_proposal_next_a: Truly. I’ve found my artistic calling, but it took centuries of chiseling out dross. Pity that marble is such a timeless medium.
14_sq_artsuffer_proposal_next_b: I’d destroy my early work if I could, but my old work space is teeming with Angry Earth now.
14_sq_hearthate_complete: You have the heart, do you? Very resourceful. Look at that, pumping rage and venom. Once I distill it I’ll be capable of the same.
14_sq_hearthate_complete_next_a: Oh, yes. It’s for a rage potion of my own. Why else would I be wanting his heart, now?
14_sq_hearthate_complete_next_b: I just need to figure how to brew it without blowing myself to bits in the process. Wish me luck.
14_sq_hearthate_description: Harvest the heart of Aeternum's angriest Dryad Brute, for science.
14_sq_hearthate_incomplete: There’s a Dryad Brute called Balor the Belligerent. I need his heart. His beautiful, hate-filled heart. Kill him and bring it to me, if you would be so kind.
14_sq_hearthate_proposal_a: Ay, look at yon Dryad Brute. Just stares at that tower all day, seething. Fascinating. ‘Balor the Belligerent,’ I call him.
14_sq_hearthate_proposal_b: I’ve never seen a creature so consumed with hatred. How I’d love to peek into his heart.
14_sq_hearthate_proposal_next: It would tell me a great deal about what makes the Angry Earth so damn angry. Think you could manage such an excision?
14_sq_pioneerlament_complete: You found my equipment, thank god. But what’s this? A letter from my son? He says he’s raising a farm in Ebonscale Reach, the brave, resourceful lad.
14_sq_pioneerlament_complete_next: All is not lost! I shall reunite with him straight away. Thank you for delivering this news, you have saved me from the brink.
14_sq_pioneerlament_description: Help a doomed farmer move on with his life.
14_sq_pioneerlament_incomplete: Go to my farm, fight off the Angry Earth who have claimed it, and retrieve my farming equipment. And perhaps some token of my family. I am a broken, lonely man.
14_sq_pioneerlament_proposal_a: Forgive me, I’ve made a horrible, horrible mistake. I tried to start a farm in Edengrove. I moved my family here. We were to harvest paradise. Fool!
14_sq_pioneerlament_proposal_b: The Angry Earth didn’t take kindly to their new neighbors.
14_sq_pioneerlament_proposal_next_a: We were overrun. My entire family rendered Lost. All my fault. If I don’t get back to work I fear I will share the same fate.
14_sq_pioneerlament_proposal_next_b: But all my equipment is back at the farm, and I haven’t the mettle to return. Could you recover it?
14_wolcott_t1_response: Maybe someday. When I have ascertained you've reached the desired artistic level. To start, could you bring me a blue to match the surreal cerulean of Edengrove?
14ac_edengrove_malev3_01_title_descripti: End the angry shadows of Malevolence
1502_1501_b_description: Defeat Seele's Withered at the Decayed Campsite for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1502_1501_c_proposal_a: Indeed. The Lost Buccaneers have been fighting the Withered and vice versa.
1502_1501_c_proposal_b: To see the Lost with such focus and intention is disturbing, and the worst part is that Constable Muller won't even acknowledge it!
1502_1501_c_proposal_next2_a: Because the victor will turn on us, and we can't have that.
1502_1501_c_proposal_next2_b: Right now, the Withered have the upper hand. If you'll destroy as many as you can, I'll see you well-rewarded, {playerName}. You have my word.
1502_1501_c_proposal_next_a: The woman is in denial, I tell you. She prefers to believe that everything is normal, well, as normal as it gets.
1502_1501_c_proposal_next_b: We have no time to convince her, however. We need to maintain the balance out there.
1502_1501_c_proposal_prompt2: "Why not let them destroy each other?"
1502_1501_e_incomplete_a: I tell you - I've fought them myself - I've seen the look in their eyes and the way it's changed.
1502_1501_f_complete_a: You've seen for yourself now, haven't you? They fight with increased ferocity, with more precision, with purpose.
1502_1501_f_complete_b: Striking a blow to the Withered was the perfect thing. Thank you.
1502_1502_b_description: Kill Eastshore Forces at the Eastshore Pier and Gather Fishing Supplies for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1502_1502_c_proposal_a: Yes! You get it, right? It sounds harmless in a way, but it's further evidence that they are more and more sentient.
1502_1502_c_proposal_b: I swear by the Ancients, this is the most terrifying thing I have heard yet.
1502_1502_c_proposal_next_a: We need to fight them while they are weak, and discourage them from advancement.
1502_1502_c_proposal_next_b: Eastshore Pier, that's the place. Go and strike down the soggy bastards... and confiscate their fishing supplies.
1502_1502_d_01_task_goto: Exhaust Eastshore forces and supplies at {POITags}
1502_1502_e_incomplete: There was a time I used to fish from the Eastshore Pier myself.That was back before it fell to the Lost in the first place.
1502_1502_f_complete_a: Hah! No more fishing for the Lost! That should stop them from getting ideas.
1502_1502_f_complete_b: I just hope it's enough. Artificer Taethen and I are still trying to get Constable Muller to come around.
1502_1502_fishingsupplies_description: A collection of old bait, nets, lures, and tackle from the Eastshore Pier.
1502_1503_priesthead_description: The head of a Corrupted Priest.
1502_1511_b_description: Collect the head of Archdeacon Azamela in The Depths for Magistrate Gurkin.
1502_1511_c_proposal_a: You’re damn right, there is! The Corrupted! The Shattered Mountain?
1502_1511_c_proposal_b: Just when we thought we'd earned a reprieve, now the Corrupted have a foothold, right here in Restless Shore.
1502_1511_c_proposal_next_a: Coming from you, I believe it. They're in a place called "The Depths."
1502_1511_c_proposal_next_b: A Corrupted Warlord's taken charge there, but the architect is called Archdeacon Azamela. Destroy the bastard, and I'll heap rewards on you.
1502_1511_d_01_task_goto: Defeat the architect of {POITags} within its halls
1502_1511_d_03_task_gethead: Defeat Archdeacon Azamela and Collect His Head
1502_1511_e_incomplete_a: Who knows what darkness this Archdeacon Azamela is cooking up in the Depths.
1502_1511_f_complete_a: Is that it? You destroyed the Archdeacon, didn't you? There's another blow for righteousness and the good of humanity!
1502_1511_f_complete_b: Well done, {playerName}, and as promised, here is your reward.
1503_1504_b_description: Defeat Fangsnap in Fangsnap's Den for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1503_1504_c_proposal_a: Animals talking, walking on two legs, and at least one of them is even taking on human form.
1503_1504_c_proposal_b: My theory is that Angry Earth's infected them with lycanthropy - we have ourselves a legitimate werewolf!
1503_1504_c_proposal_next2_a: Yes, it's the only choice we have, it seems. I tried, but the beast got the better of me.
1503_1504_c_proposal_next2_b: If you're the hunting type, keep a lookout for Fangsnap, and if you find it, destroy it fast.
1503_1504_c_proposal_next_a: More like wolf to human, and frankly, becoming human's driven the wolf mad, rabid.
1503_1504_c_proposal_next_b: Fangsnap is the name of the beast, and it's slain several travelers out toward the coast. I don't know what to do.
1503_1504_e_incomplete_a: If my suspicions are correct and animals really are taking on human form, things are gonna change.
1503_1504_f_complete_a: You did it then? You hunted down the monstrous beast, Fangsnap?
1503_1504_f_complete_b: I'm guessing he didn't take on his human form, but I swear it's true. I've seen the tracks. Either way, the damn thing needed to be destroyed.
1503_1505_b_description: Visit Rabbit Island and if you can find any signs of a curse then deal with them and then return to Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1503_1505_c_proposal_a: This request is a bit more... unconventional. There is a small island nearby I would like you to investigate.
1503_1505_c_proposal_b: Rabbit Island is a great source of meat and fur but recently the hunters of the settlement have been avoiding it, claiming it to be cursed.
1503_1505_c_proposal_next_a: I don't know how a bunch of bunnies like friendly ole Stanley could be cursed, but many now refuse to visit.
1503_1505_c_proposal_next_b: Go to Rabbit Island and see what all this fuss is about, would you?
1503_1505_e_incomplete_a: A man used to live on that island all by his lonesome, kept to himself and his rabbits well enough.
1503_1505_e_incomplete_b: Perhaps you could ask him about the rumors of a haunting of the island and see what he makes of all of this?
1503_1505_f_complete_a: So the Harekeeper passed on? I'm glad you put him to rest. His furry friends will flourish with or without him, I suspect.
1503_1505_f_complete_b: But I imagine they'll miss their kindly caretaker. Maybe I'll miss the Harekeep a little myself, as well.
1503_1506_b_description: Defeat Boars and Tuskgore at Boarsholm for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1503_1506_c_proposal_a: I am quite certain that the boar in question is responsible for slaying a traveler to the north.
1503_1506_c_proposal_b: Even more concerning - I've come to believe that this lycanthropy is contagious, too.
1503_1506_c_proposal_next_a: No, but I think it can spread among the wildlife. We just get the were-boar and any boars who've had contact.
1503_1506_c_proposal_next_b: Tuskgore is the beastly creature's name. Destroy it, and any other boars nearby.
1503_1506_e_incomplete_a: If we let this strange new mutation from the Angry Earth spread, our days our numbered.
1503_1506_f_complete_a: The deed's done then? Tuskgore is no more? That is a big relief.
1503_1506_f_complete_b: That boar was a monster and if my theory about Lycanthropy is true, the danger was even greater still.
1504_1503_b_description: Defeat Neptunite Pirates and collect Pirate Booty from chests for Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1504_1503_c_proposal_a: Rilette Wilson's claiming there's a werewolf stalking the shore, and others say the Lost have gone to war.
1504_1503_c_proposal_b: The soulless, aimless Lost fighting each other - it makes no sense. I don't buy it.
1504_1503_c_proposal_next2_a: Why yes. About time someone wants to get to the solution. The Buccaneers are out at the wreck of the Neptune's Fury.
1504_1503_c_proposal_next2_b: Give the bloated fiends a taste of their own medicine - raid them, and steal THEIR booty.
1504_1503_c_proposal_next_a: Oh, don't you start in on me, too. Sure, the Lost Buccaneers have been raiding, but that's what they did in life - typical Lost behavior.
1504_1503_c_proposal_next_b: I think once we get our stuff back this'll blow over.
1504_1503_c_proposal_prompt2: "Is that something I can help with?"
1504_1503_d_01_task_goto: Defeat Neptunite Pirates and collect Pirate Booty at {POITags}
1504_1503_e_incomplete: I mean, how long have the Lost pirates of Aeternum been raiding the supplies of the living?It's normal Lost pirate behavior, nothing more.
1504_1503_f_complete_a: Haha! You gave those damn buccaneers a little payback, didn't you? Let's see the spoils!
1504_1503_f_complete_b: Perfect! This should make everyone happy, get things back to normal. Thank you, {playerName}.
1504_1503_piratebooty_description: An assortment of gold trinkets from cups to earrings that look to be stolen from someone of great wealth in a pirate's career.
1505_1509_b_description: Confiscate grenades from chests and destroy Ching Shih the Shark for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1505_1509_c_proposal_a: Those blasted Lost Buccaneers are arming themselves, even developing new weapons.
1505_1509_c_proposal_b: It's unheard of for the Lost, and we need to disarm the soulless bastards before it catches on.
1505_1509_c_proposal_next_a: They're stockpiling grenades at an old wreck known as the Minnow's Revenge.
1505_1509_c_proposal_next_b: Ching Shih the Shark is their ringleader - take him down and confiscate the grenades and that'll put an end to it.
1505_1509_d_01_task_goto: Defeat and pilfer from Lost Buccaneers at {POITags}
1505_1509_e_incomplete: Watch yourself out there. Rumor says the pirates' grenades are enhanced with Azoth. Never thought I'd see the day.
1505_1509_f_complete_a: Took down Ching Shih the shark, did you? And you got the grenades? Well done, {playerName}.
1505_1509_f_complete_b: That'll cut a hole in their sails, I tell you. Let's hope the Lost Pirate forget all about their ambitions.
1505_1509_grenades_description: A bundle of explosive devices that activate when lit with blue azoth flames.
1505_1510_b_description: Kill Erika the Shadowslayer in Solitude Cemetery for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1505_1510_c_proposal_a: Exactly. With the Pirates pushed back, the Withered are now on the offensive.
1505_1510_c_proposal_b: It's their leader we need to deal with - the Shadowslayer - she's been a dark threat here for decades, and even darker now.
1505_1510_c_proposal_next_a: You'll find her in Solitude Cemetery, but be careful, she's made many Lost from those who crossed her path.
1505_1510_c_proposal_next_b: When you've done that, I'd ask you to take a shot at convincing Muller of what we're up against.
1505_1510_d_01_task_goto: Put an end to the story of the Shadowslayer at {POITags}
1505_1510_e_incomplete: Destroy the Shadowslayer, {playerName}, whatever it takes.Then go and try to convince the Constable to finally acknowledge our plight.
1505_1510_f_complete_a: So you went out and dealt with the Shadowslayer? It's about time someone did that.
1505_1510_f_complete_b: I know you've been working with Gurkin too, but come on, you aren't buying into this idea of the Lost being more advanced, are you?
1505_1510_f_complete_next_a: Dammit, I was afraid you'd say that! Why can't the Corrupted just stay up at the mountain and the Lost stay lost?
1505_1510_f_complete_next_b: Don't even get me started about the Angry Earth - Wilson's about driven me insane.
1510_1507_b_description: Destroy Channelview Pirates in Channelview Post and Oceanview Pirates in Oceanview Post and look for anything suspicious. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1510_1507_c_proposal_a: That's the fort up on the hill. Once upon a time, that's where the region was governed from.
1510_1507_c_proposal_b: A naval force from the Arabian Sea reigned supreme - then they all became Lost.
1510_1507_c_proposal_next_a: Nothing, we hope, but maybe you should check it out. Steer clear of the Fort itself - let's not stir things up.
1510_1507_c_proposal_next_b: Confront the Lost in the east and west lookout camps and see if there's anything suspicious.
1510_1507_e_incomplete: The more I think about this, the more I start to worry. Maybe I should've listened to Gurkin from the start.
1510_1507_easternrunestone_description: A runestone that pulses with light and warmth whenever it is brought near drink.
1510_1507_f_complete_a: Thank the stars you're back! What did you find? Runestones... what the heck?
1510_1507_f_complete_b: Maybe it's some kind of Ancient magic that's giving the bastards this renewed sense of purpose?
1510_1507_westernrunestone_description: A runestone that pulses with light and warmth whenever it is brought near drink.
1510_1508_b_description: Defeat Admiral Reis in the center ship of Fort Damnation. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
1510_1508_c_proposal_a: Launch a frontal attack on Fort Damnation? Are you out of your mind?
1510_1508_c_proposal_b: Wait, don't answer that. Here's the thing, it's not the fort itself that's the problem, it's the fort's commander, Admiral Reis.
1510_1508_c_proposal_next_a: Probably one of the most dangerous fleet commanders of all history - literally thousands killed in his name.
1510_1508_c_proposal_next_b: If you're going up there, you gotta get the Admiral to make it count. Oh, and take friends - you'll need them.
1510_1508_e_incomplete: I'll give you this much - you've already proven to have the strength to back up your bravado - but if you're going to take on Admiral Reis, you'd best be prepared.
1510_1508_f_complete_a: Well, I thought I'd see the sun rise in the west before I saw anyone take down Admiral Reis.
1510_1508_f_complete_b: I gotta hand it to you - you are a force to be reckoned with. I think it only fitting you receive a proper reward.
1510_1512_payingrespects_b_description: Travel to Mourningdale and convey Barkeep Andris's respects to Barkeep Brewell.
1510_1512_payingrespects_c_proposal_a: The Watcher there, Guerra - he fell to the Lost. Quite a hero, I understand.
1510_1512_payingrespects_c_proposal_b: In fact, if you pass through Mourningdale, please offer my condolences to Barkeep Brewell. We go back a ways.
1510_1512_payingrespects_e_incomplete: The news from Mourningdale is tragic, indeed.It almost make me feel guilty that things are going so well here.
1510_1512_payingrespects_f_complete_a: Come and sit down and have a drink on the house, traveler.
1510_1512_payingrespects_f_complete_b: We all mourn the passing of a hero today - Watcher Guerra - did you know of him?
1510_1512_payingrespects_f_complete_next: Ah, old Andris is still keeping bar out there. Good for her.
Kind of you both, of course, but it is our Magistrate for whom we should all feel bad. She is quite beside herself.
1523_0101_fq09_complete_available_respon: Hail, adventurer. I'm guessing O'Connor sent you my way to settle another one of our disputes... By Jove! Actual weapons fished from the water!
1523_0101_fq09_incomplete: While perhaps not the mightiest weapons, the Fish Sword and Fish Head Hammer sure are great conversation starters! 'Where'd you get such a nautical weapon?', people will ask, and you can reply: 'I fished it up myself!'
1523_0101_fq09_objective_desc: Catch a Fish Sword and a Fish Head Hammer for Master Fisher O'Connor and present them to Master Fisher Abebe in Mourningdale.
1523_0101_fq09_prompt: "Agarwal said you had something for me."
1523_0101_fq09_proposal_a: The Fish Sword and the Fish Head Hammer are folk legends here - said to have been lost in these waters, long ago.
1523_0101_fq09_proposal_b: They're certainly rare finds. So rare that Fishing Master Abebe doesn't believe me when I say they're out there and itching for a hand to wield them once more.
1523_0101_fq09_proposal_next_a: I may have dashed my credibility by talking about sea monsters in the Restless Shore.
1523_0101_fq09_proposal_next_b: But I stand by both my sea monster sighting and the existence of these weapons, though.
1524_1514_b_description: Discover Santiago Salazar's past by confronting members of his former crew and tracking down a ship manifest and their journal entries.
1524_1514_c_proposal_a: I have flashes of a ship voyage, but that doesn’t say much. Who here hasn't arrived by boat? But there's more...
1524_1514_c_proposal_b: The answers I need lie on that island across the channel. Without answers, I fear I may slip away…
1524_1514_c_proposal_next_a: Gasp! I feel the cold even now... Cross! Yes, that was the captain's name! Her crew manifest may have the answers I seek.
1524_1514_c_proposal_next_b: But be wary! For Cross succumbed to the deathless despair that seeks me. Good luck!
1524_1514_d_01_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to defeat Santiago's former crewmates
1524_1514_d_03_talktosantiago: Tell Santiago what you have discovered
1524_1514_d_04_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to defeat Santiago's former crewmates
1524_1514_e_incomplete: I appreciate your help. I'd forget my own head if it wasn’t attached. What was I was looking for? My name on a manifest, right?
1524_1514_f_complete_a: You're back! I feared you’d end up a soulless Withered, wandering the beaches like old Captain Cross.
1524_1514_f_complete_b: But you seem troubled. What did you discover?
1524_1514_f_complete_next_a: Hmm, that's odd. Who did I sail under then? More unanswered questions...
1524_1514_f_complete_next_b: At least we've removed those ships as possibilities. I can focus my search on a new area.
1524_1514_f_complete_prompt: "You were not part of Captain Cross’s crew."
1524_1515_b_description: Retrace Santiago Salazars steps to find what he placed in a chest and recover Rosario's Manifest from one of his previous crewmembers.
1524_1515_c_proposal_a: You’re too kind. But I’m certain the answer lies on these shores. At the bar in the settlement, I heard from Niki Andris that I sailed on the Rosario.
1524_1515_c_proposal_b: That feels right. Now I recall I lost something precious there.
1524_1515_c_proposal_next_a: Aye, gifts from loved ones. Pieces of jewelry, I think. A ring or perhaps a necklace?
1524_1515_c_proposal_next_b: Although I was mistaken before, I'm certain I was a member of the Rosario’s crew. Would you help me recover these priceless mementos?
1524_1515_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to find items from Santiago's past
1524_1515_e_incomplete_a: When I think of all my precious keepsakes scattered on these shores, I wonder what more I’m missing?
1524_1515_f_complete: You’ve returned! And look at that! You found my missing jewelry! That ring! That brooch! And how could I forget that solid gold locket!
1524_1515_f_complete_next_a: Salvator's a nickname, you see. Alice was... my wife. Oh and my dear daughter Gemma gave me this brooch for safe keeping. I’ll never forget it.
1524_1515_f_complete_next_b: Ah, how these mementos draw me back from the brink of despair!
1524_1515_gemmasbrooch_description: A poorly carved cameo of what could be a cluster of grapes, or perhaps a diseased cabbage.
1524_1515_heartshapedlocket_description: The inscription inside reads, "To my beloved Alice, may she always rest close to my heart."
1524_1515_rosariosmanifest_description: This manifest contains a full list of all the crew sailing under Captain Cross. And more importantly, it doesn't mention anyone by the name of Santiago Salazar.
1524_1515_salazarsring_description: One stone to remember, and two for a promise never broken. \nBut what did this ring promise?
1524_1516_a_title: The True Terror of the Seas
1524_1516_b_description: Confront Santiago Salazar's previous captain Scurvyhook, and extract revenge to put Santiago's mind at ease.
1524_1516_c_proposal_a: He now goes by Scurvyhook. Never was there a captain more cruel!
1524_1516_c_proposal_b: Managed to kill a crew member every day we were at sea. Not to mention taking all our fine cargo for himself!
1524_1516_c_proposal_next_a: He was! Is! And now you can help me set things right!
1524_1516_c_proposal_next_b: Give our poor crew the justice they deserve! Teach Scurvyhook that wickedness has a price!
1524_1516_e_incomplete_a: I finally understand why I tried so hard to forget my past.
1524_1516_e_incomplete_b: Help me lay my personal demons to rest by taking on Scurvyhook. His reign of terror must end!
1524_1516_f_complete: Is the deed done? Have you destroyed those bilge rats and their vile captain? Has Scurvyhook been sent to the abyss?
1524_1516_f_complete_next_a: Ah, there’s no greater salve for the mind than the peace that comes from finally getting revenge… That is to say, justice.
1524_1516_f_complete_next_b: And Scurvyhook's demise has jogged even more memories.
1524_1517_b_description: Follow a trail of Doubloons to reclaim the treasure Santiago's old crew had stashed away years ago.
1524_1517_c_proposal_a: Oh, right. We were merchants. But we took what we were owed! The crew hid Scurvyhook’s prized golden stash as payment for our suffering.
1524_1517_c_proposal_b: If you find it, I can guarantee a cut. We’ll split it three ways, Niki, you, and me.
1524_1517_c_proposal_next_a: Ha ha ha ha! Now that's the attitude! Plenty, but I need your keen mind to find where the treasure is located.
1524_1517_c_proposal_next_b: I remember the crew left a trail of doubloons, starting in Cutthroat Cavern. Follow the gold and you can’t go astray!
1524_1517_e_incomplete_a: Yeah… There's more to life than mourning what was lost.
1524_1517_f_complete_a: You look like you need a drink. Hoodwinked by Salazar, were you? You weren't the first, and won't be the last.
1524_1517_f_complete_b: Did he give you the whole 'woe is me, I'm becoming Lost' tale?
1524_1517_f_complete_next_a: That one seems to get the best results. Makes you feel like you’re helping someone, you know?
1524_1517_f_complete_next_b: At least you returned, most who are tricked by him don’t. Sadly, men like him never stay down long.
1524_1517_f_complete_prompt: "Uses that one a lot, does he?"
1524_1517_piratedoubloons_description: Twice stolen, these coins attract more trouble than shoals attract shipwrecks.
1524_boatswain01_talk_response: That's a shame. I was really hoping to find out more about my past. I also had no luck with Niki Andris at the settlement. With any luck, the second ship holds more information about my past.
1525_1518_b_description: Recover Myrtilus's Bow from the Angry Earth at Pisces.
1525_1518_c_proposal_a: Aside from one who is blind to the land talking with us? The seasons are amiss in Verdant Ascent.
1525_1518_c_proposal_b: This is not widely known, but we have lost contact with our brethren in Edengrove. It is troubling.
1525_1518_c_proposal_next_a: No! Outsiders are not welcome in our affairs.
1525_1518_c_proposal_next_b: No, we need help with a matter closer to the taproot. In our haste to travel to Edengrove, our bow was left behind. And we cannot go back for it.
1525_1518_c_proposal_prompt: "Perhaps I can help discover the reason."
1525_1518_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to recover Myrtilus's Bow
1525_1518_e_incomplete_a: Our bow was left where the fish swim across the sky.
1525_1518_e_incomplete_b: It is likely one of our siblings picked it up, if only to prevent us from leaving so easily. They were against us sprouting out on our own. Please return our bow.
1525_1518_f_complete_a: Impressive! We did not expect much. All you did at first was stare.
1525_1518_f_complete_b: Oh, you’re still staring. Are you not aware that different petals may grow from the same plant? So too do different plants serve different purposes.
1525_1518_f_complete_next_a: It would be easier if you were part of our mind.
1525_1518_f_complete_next_b: Still, we thank you for aiding us. While our minds are divided, it is best for the branch to remain separate from the tree, however difficult. Their reproach is strong.
1525_1518_myrtilusbow_description: Grown to fit Myrtilus's hand, the strength of oak mixed with the flexibility of willow.
1525_1519_b_description: Recover Myrtilus's Quiver and Thornpoint Arrows from the Angry Earth at Fornax.
1525_1519_c_proposal_a: If we returned, it would be like an early winter frost. There would be long discourses about the merits of staying secure at Eridanus.
1525_1519_c_proposal_b: Which would be as good as never leaving at all. We cannot sit by and allow that.
1525_1519_c_proposal_next_a: That is the heartwood of the matter. While we are most appreciative to have our bow back, it is like a spiny branch stripped of its thorns.
1525_1519_c_proposal_next_b: We remember leaving a quiver behind at Fornax. Please return our arrows to us.
1525_1519_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to recover Myrtilus's Quiver and Thornpoint Arrows
1525_1519_e_incomplete_a: The Thornpoint arrows were made specifically for use with this bow. Like a layer of strong bark, they protect against all sorts of dangers on the road.
1525_1519_f_complete_a: Once again you do not disappoint. These arrows shall do nicely.
1525_1519_f_complete_b: Now we are adequately protected against any dangers that would endeavor to stop us along the road. If only all humans were this helpful.
1525_1519_f_complete_next_a: Perhaps. We are rather isolated in Eridanus. We are insular, perhaps too insular.
1525_1519_f_complete_next_b: When we return from our journey, we should discuss opening our borders more often. Different perspectives may do us some good.
1525_1519_f_complete_prompt: "Perhaps you haven’t met the right people."
1525_1519_thornarrows_description: It is said that once the arrows are embedded, they put down roots, becoming impossible to remove.
1525_1520_b_description: Recover Nutrient Stalks from containers at Eridanus for Myrtilus.
1525_1520_c_proposal_a: When times are good, a pleasant rain and warm sunlight is enough.
1525_1520_c_proposal_b: But in times of high stress, and indeed when we sustain heavy damage, we require more than what the earth can provide to set things right and speed our healing.
1525_1520_c_proposal_next_a: We hear of Corruption spreading like strangling ivy. We cannot count on the earth providing us with what we need.
1525_1520_c_proposal_next_b: We can take no chances, not when the soil could be contaminated. Please bring us nutrient stalks.
1525_1520_c_proposal_prompt: "Can’t you get that from the ground?"
1525_1520_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to collect Nutrient Stalks for Myrtilus
1525_1520_e_incomplete: It is best to rely on sustenance untouched by foulness. Please bring us the nourishment we need to begin our journey.
1525_1520_f_complete_a: We can smell the freshness of the nutrient stalks from here. We relish the chance to have a taste while on the road.
1525_1520_f_complete_b: There is nothing quite like the taste of home to restore all balance and mend all ills.
1525_1520_f_complete_next_a: An ancestral recipe of spring and fall. One we do not share with outsiders. If humans knew what was in them, they would figure out how to contaminate them.
1525_1520_f_complete_next_b: We are sorry, but we cannot take that risk.
1525_1520_nutrientstalks_description: Filled with everything a growing dryad needs to survive out in the wilds.
1526_1521_b_description: Search Clawpoint Ruins for any clues as to why there are lynx in the area.
1526_1521_b_start: "It's not like we can just leave."
1526_1521_c_proposal_a: True. We're trapped on this island. Just like those poor lynx.
1526_1521_c_proposal_b: You know, someone brought those animals into Restless Shore. They aren’t native to this part of the island.
1526_1521_c_proposal_next_a: Snow-filled forests, not ruins. There are clues at Clawpoint Ruins. Would you search them for me?
1526_1521_c_proposal_next_b: I have a lead I need to follow before it grows cold. There's a camp of poachers not too far from here.
1526_1521_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to find clues about the lynx
1526_1521_e_incomplete: The clues are out there, I know it. I can feel the answer is at Clawpoint Ruins. Search the ruins and let me know what you discover.
1526_1521_f_complete: Let me guess – you found cages, didn’t you?
1526_1521_f_complete_next: The damn poachers did this. I found them at their camp. But I feel like I missed something. They were messing with more than just lynx, I'm sure of it.
1526_1522_b_description: Search the poacher's camp for any letters about their activities.
1526_1522_c_proposal_a: When I visited the poachers camp, I was able to get answers to some of my questions, but it was clear there was more to their plans.
1526_1522_c_proposal_b: I didn't find all their notes. I'm sure there is more information hidden around their camp.
1526_1522_d_01_task_goto: Travel to the poacher's camp to discover their plans
1526_1522_e_incomplete_a: I need more information about what those poachers were doing. The lynx were just the smallest part of their plan.
1526_1522_f_complete: Something has changed. Don’t tell me they've returned! Blast it, I should have burned that place to the ground when I had the chance!
1526_1522_f_complete_next_b: Good lord! They've been feeding the wolves dangerous concoctions! They've infected them! How could they do such a thing?
1526_1523_b_description: Right the wrongs done to the local wolf pack.
1526_1523_c_proposal_a: Our choices are limited. The damage has been done. And we don't have anything that can counter what they did.
1526_1523_c_proposal_b: It's a hard choice, but I think the only humane thing is to put the wolves down.
1526_1523_c_proposal_next_a: None that I know. Perhaps in the future, we could find a way to counter the effect.
1526_1523_c_proposal_next_b: But now there's no time. We have to act fast, before the wolves travel and infect other dens.
1526_1523_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to put down the tainted wolves
1526_1523_e_incomplete: You go on ahead, I'll be right behind you. The wolf cave isn't that far away, you can't miss it.
1526_1523_f_complete_a: So, you met the mad Caryn Berzs. She’s an odd one, I’ll give you that. She’s wanted for freeing the local dogs.
1526_1523_f_complete_b: Said we were monsters for locking them up. I bet she expects us to pay you for your work.
1526_1523_f_complete_next_a: Off raising hell no doubt. She’s as slippery as an eel, clever as a fox, and mad as a badger. I’m sure we’ll get word of her next exploits soon enough.
1526_1523_f_complete_next_b: Still, we appreciate what you did with the wolves.
1527_1524_b_description: Search for treasure at Poseidon's Plunder for Wafa Keles.
1527_1524_c_proposal_a: What do I have to offer? I’m good at spearfishing. And few can climb sea-slick rocks as well as I can.
1527_1524_c_proposal_b: But I'm not rich. I have nothing that would interest Xue.
1527_1524_c_proposal_next_a: He’s only in Restless Shore to find some treasure. Maybe if I had some, he’d be interested in me.
1527_1524_c_proposal_next_b: I’ve heard there's treasure in the wreck of Poseidon’s Plunder. Would you help me recover it?
1527_1524_d_01_task_goto: Search the chest at {POITags} for treasure
1527_1524_d_02_task_gatherchest: Recover Poseidon's Goblet from the chest
1527_1524_e_incomplete_a: I don't have much, but what I do have I'm willing to share with Xue Tian.
1527_1524_f_complete_a: Is that what you found? Impressive! Xue will be thrilled to see this!
1527_1524_f_complete_b: You know, he’s afraid of the water. He puts on a brave face about it, but that’s why he won’t go out to the submerged shipwrecks.
1527_1524_f_complete_next_a: I hadn’t thought of that! I love the ocean, the sound of the waves.
1527_1524_f_complete_next_b: I could search the water for treasures while he stayed on shore. We’d make the perfect team!
1527_1524_poseidonsbounty_description: A golden goblet from the deepest depths of the sea, locked in a chest, then forgotten on a lonely spit of land.
1527_1525_b_description: Bring a letter from Wafa Keles to Xue Tian
1527_1525_b_start: "You could ask him to appraise it."
1527_1525_c_proposal_a: Yes! I could say I found this goblet, and ask him to take a look. I like it! But I’m so nervous! Just the thought of talking to him makes me weak-kneed.
1527_1525_c_proposal_b: Could you take him a message asking him to check it out?
1527_1525_c_proposal_next_a: Yes! No! There is so much I could say. But I don’t want to scare him away!
1527_1525_c_proposal_next_b: Just give him a message about Poseidon’s Goblet. That will be enough for now. Or so I hope.
1527_1525_c_proposal_prompt: "Is that all you want to say?"
1527_1525_e_incomplete_a: I know I’ll have to talk to Xue on my own someday… but could you ask him to stop by for me?
1527_1525_f_complete_a: A message from Wafa Keles asking me to appraise something called Poseidon’s Goblet? Sounds intriguing…
1527_1525_f_complete_b: But I must ask – are they still standing out in the water?
1527_1525_f_complete_next_a: They’re so brave to face the terrors of the ocean like that. I’ve seen many a man lost to the dangerous riptides.
1527_1525_f_complete_next_b: I can’t believe they’re so calm about standing in the sea.
1528_1526_a_title: Not Another Fish in the Sea
1528_1526_b_description: Recover Xue's Sea Glass Charms from the Treetop pirates that stole them.
1528_1526_c_proposal_a: I needed some space. And had to get away from my overbearing family.
1528_1526_c_proposal_b: I came here to find peace of mind. Then I saw Wafa, and I knew I found what I'd been looking for.
1528_1526_c_proposal_next_a: They do? I thought they... Oh! They thought I’d only be interested if they had treasure! I need to get them a gift to show that’s not true.
1528_1526_c_proposal_next_b: I made some Sea Glass Charms to protect against the sea, but pirates stole them.
1528_1526_d_01_task_goto: Travel to {POITags} to recover Xue's Sea Glass Charms
1528_1526_e_incomplete: Those Treetop pirates stole my Sea Glass Charms. They would be a perfect gift for Wafa. Please get them back.
1528_1526_f_complete: Those are perfect! Can you imagine them hanging from their hair, catching the sunlight as they dance through the waves?
1528_1526_f_complete_next_a: What about me? Do you think I’m properly dressed?
1528_1526_f_complete_next_b: I don’t know what I should wear for a meeting like this. It’s all so exciting. I hope they like the charms.
1528_1526_seaglasscharms_description: Polished by the sea, these charms chime in the breeze, bringing luck enough to weather any storm.
1529_00_malebeekeepercultist1: Can you hear it? The laughter? The music? It’s sublime, isn’t it?
1530_00_femalebeekeepercultist1: It’s a dream, to live without fear of Corruption or of becoming Lost. Knowing the path brings tranquility and joy.
1530_01_spring_spritz_01_taskinteract: Check out the Springtide Crafting Stations to see how to craft Wispy Spritz bombs
1530_01_spring_spritz_02_givespritz: Visit the Wispy Spritz Crafting Station in the Springtide Village and craft a Wispy Spritz bomb
1530_01_spring_spritz_complete: You’ve crafted the spritz, well done! Now you are ready to take the next step toward enlightenment.
1530_01_spring_spritz_complete_next: And yet within your grasp. Once you conquer your fears, the way will be revealed to you. That is the only true path to freedom.
1530_01_spring_spritz_description: The Bloom Herald offers to share the secret to true freedom if a rare blossom, the Wispy Bloom, can be safely collected.
1530_01_spring_spritz_incomplete: Craft the Wispy Spritz bombs. Only with this item will you be able to collect the Wispyblooms and discover a secret world.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_a: It can be yours. Let Hashiki Kimani, the chosen Bloom Herald, guide you.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_b: The key to this power can be found in the delicate petals of a flower, the Wispybloom, which only blossom during Springtide Bloom.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_next2_a: Not if you have the proper tool - Wispy Spritz. You must craft this item before you attempt to collect the flowers.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_next2_b: Gather the proper ingredients and be sure to make plenty for those wasps are relentless.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_next_a: Ah, but swarms of fierce insects guard this miraculous flower. These Wispy Wasps are drawn by the bloom’s enchanting scent.
1530_01_spring_spritz_proposal_next_b: To collect the petals, you must first conquer the wasps.
1530_02_spring_bloom_01_collecttoken: Collect a Spingtide Token from a Primabloom
1530_02_spring_bloom_complete_a: You bring me the keys to bliss! You are an exceptional Truth Seeker and worthy of being a Child of Bloom.
1530_02_spring_bloom_complete_b: But the mysteries of the Bloom run deep. You must dedicate yourself to embracing the Others.
1530_02_spring_bloom_complete_next: The Folk, teachers and guides, those who watch and wait. They are curious, they are cautious, they know their time is coming.
1530_02_spring_bloom_description: Armed with the Wispy Spritz bomb, the Bloom Herald has requested that the precious petals of the Wispyblooms be collected and brought to her in order to further the quest for harmony.
1530_02_spring_bloom_incomplete: Bring me the petals of the Wispybloom, Truth Seeker. I can help you achieve peace and harmony.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_a: You must plant the traps on the ground then cleverly lure the wasp swarms to them before they explode.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_b: They will be most eager to kill you so luring them should be easy.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_next2_a: The Wispyblooms are much more than that. Their essence allows us to see an invisible realm.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_next2_b: If you are lucky, you may catch a glimpse of that ethereal beauty, or hear the enchanting music.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_next_a: You are in no danger unless you are a Wispy Wasp.
1530_02_spring_bloom_proposal_next_b: Make sure to collect the insect residue. It is filled with Wispybloom nectar, which is precious indeed.
1530_02_spring_bloom_start: “How exactly do I use the Spritz?”
1531_00_malebeekeepercultist2: Flow as the waves do. Be shaped by the world, but never lose your essence. Be free like water.
1532_00_femalebeekeepercultist2: Flowers, the truth is found in petals of flowers. Is there anything more perfect?
1533_00_bloomherald_a: We are the Children of Bloom. We celebrate the beauty of the world, we harmonize with its heartbeat, we revel in its truth.
1533_00_bloomherald_b: Everyone on Aeternum can experience this, if they also seek truth.
1533_01_bloomherald_a: Many sinister forces plague this island: vile Corruption, the soulless Lost, the dark legacy of the Ancients.
1533_01_bloomherald_b: It seems an inescapable prison. But the Children of Bloom have the power to break free.
1533_02_bloomherald_a: Now that you are properly prepared to deal with the wasps, you must take the next step.
1533_02_bloomherald_b: Locating the patches where the Wispybloom Flowers blossom.
1533_03_bloomherald_a: You are doing well, Truth Seeker! Continue to craft Spritz and find Wispybloom patches.
1533_03_bloomherald_b: Remember, true freedom lies in the delicate petals of that ethereal flower.
1599_1513_b_description: Collect Hunks of Meat for Nekumanesh the alligator from Corrupted Leaders in The Depths Expedition.
1599_1513_c_proposal: The alligator snaps at you, clearly offended by the insinuation that he isn't big enough.
1599_1513_c_proposal_next: Nekumanesh pants like a dog and licks his sharp teeth. Who could have left him here?
1599_1513_c_proposal_prompt: "Maybe I can help you get bigger."
1599_1513_cooldown: Nekumanesh fidgets slightly, looking satisfied. He may be hungry for more later.
1599_1513_d_01_task_goto: Venture into the Depths Expedition for Nekumanesh
1599_1513_e_incomplete: Nekumanesh looks at you suspiciously. He had been expecting you to return with food.
1599_1513_f_complete: With a snap of his jaws, Nekumanesh hungrily devours the meat. As he looks up at you for more, you wonder: Did he just get a little bigger...?
1599_1513_hunkofmeat_description: A juicy hunk of meat sourced from a Corrupted. Perfect for an Alligator.
15_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_a: Hmmm. Ever fancied yerself a pirate? A guy I know used to tie dynamite sticks to his beard to scare people off.
15_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_b: A bit extreme and I don't do hair. But I can create a very special, highly magical garment for you.
15_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: The Goddess of the Sea showed me how to do this.
15_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: I slept a while in her fragrant lap and she whispered the words to me. When I woke up, I could transform the cloth I wore.
15_restlessshore_body_01_01: Is there a more beautiful view than the sunrise on Aeternum? Spent beside my family there is no place I would rather be than sitting on the docks with our feet dangling off over the water. I close my eyes, feel the warmth of the sun upon me, and I pray we stay forever this fortunate.
15_restlessshore_body_01_02: Last night at sunset Bobby says he saw one of those grenadiers wandering the coast and killed it. I highly doubt his story. No undead pirates dare come so close to the settlement and Bobby is known to be a boastful man. He once 'wrestled' an alligator in an attempt to impress me and was promptly chomped in half by the gator. So no, I do not believe we are in any danger of being encroached upon. Tell that to your mother, and set her heart at ease for me.
15_restlessshore_body_01_03: Those settlement people with their houses and workstations think they've conquered the land, but I am not here to conquer. I am here to coexist, to live off the bounty of Aeternum without creating structures more permanent than a watchtower. I see their chimney smoke on cold nights and shiver next to my campfire, but I would never trade my morals for a little warmth. How weak-willed my husband was to move in to the settlement overnight without as much as saying goodbye. I will never end up like him.
15_restlessshore_body_01_04: The lake nearby gives us fresh water and fish, and the wolf population of the island gives us furs and meats. We are truly blessed to be here on Aeternum where nothing truly dies, assuring a steady supply of food without having to wait for repopulation or worry about overhunting. The settlement is a luxury we do not need. Aeternum provides all on its own.
15_restlessshore_body_02_01: Matis and Chekov and I will distract the Captain. You, Anne, and Henry sneak into his quarters and use Anne's lockpicking skills to get into the red cabinet on the left of the room. Grab the Port, pour it into a flask and replace everything you took with seawater. This won't deter him long but it'll give us a few precious moments between him pouring the Port and realizing that some of it has been replaced. Return with the flask and Henry will give the all-clear signal and boom, we're swimming in quality drink. There's no way this plan could go wrong.
15_restlessshore_body_02_02: Stay out of the Captain's Quarters if you value your sorry lives. I know at least one of you scoundrels has been helping themselves to my bottles of Port I keep locked up within, and I will find out who it is. When I do, they're getting the plank! Your days are numbered, thief, for only a fool robs a robber.
15_restlessshore_body_02_03: Bets are placed on numbers two to twelve, those two being the rarest scores. Two six-sided dice are rolled, and their sum is the winning number. Whoever gets closest to the winning number gets the pot, and no two players can bet on the same number. If there is a tie, the pot is split in half favoring the higher number if the pot is uneven.
15_restlessshore_body_02_04: Jackson's got loaded dice, I can tell. There's no way in hell the winning number is always seven. He's not even subtle about it! Those wooden monstrosities need to be tested before our crew loses the whole haul to him. Gonna talk to the Captain Flotsam about it tomorrow morning, and anyone who agrees can come with me.
15_restlessshore_body_02_05: The man we took hostage is proving to be more profitable in our brig than it ever would be to ransom him. His knowledge of magic and runestones is plentiful. If we, with enough supervision, give him the materials to attune new runestones to something valuable, say a kind of drink, then the runestones can guide us towards it. We've seen how it works for gold and silver, just look at our stores! This wizard has more than proved his worth to us, and the only thing we have to worry about is him escaping.
15_restlessshore_body_02_06:
Yo-ho, Yo-ho

Runestones, runestones!

They pulse and quake

They shudder and shake

Leading us to liquid gold!

Yo-ho, yo-ho, now everybody yo-ho!
15_restlessshore_body_03_01: Today I begin my hunt for Fangsnap. I am loaded with steel arrows and my trusty sword. This beast has terrorized the coast for far too long, and it is up to me as Survivalist of the settlement to put the matter to rest.
15_restlessshore_body_03_02: My body and spirit feel broken. My arm tingles where Fangsnap last closed his fangs around it, tearing flesh from bone that has now healed, but still the ghost of the injury lingers. I make my retreat today back to the settlement to regroup and possibly ask for assistance. But who would be fool enough to go into this cave after all the horrors that have occurred here at the claws and teeth of such a rabid beast? Perhaps an adventurer from the new shipwrecks down south might come along. I can only hope they do.
15_restlessshore_body_04_01: Today we have a new addition to our family, a pair of spotted rabbits I rescued from Windsward where adventurers were killing them nonstop. I will call them Romeo and Juliet after the recent play of fame in the Old World.
15_restlessshore_body_04_02: I don't pick favorites, but if I was to pick a favorite, it would have to be Stanley. He is the crown jewel of my rabbit collection, stolen from up north where the Corrupted hunted him for meat. He is a beautiful snowshoe hare with the softest fur I have ever had the pleasure of feeling. I hold him close to me at night when I am coughing and cannot sleep, and he seems to understand my plight. He stays at my side, and I could not ask for a more loyal companion.
15_restlessshore_body_05_01: The funniest thing happened to me when I was setting up my tent. I could have sworn, out of the corner of my eye, I saw something of about knee-height rustling in the bushes. Figuring it to be a boar, I aimed my musket and fired into the brush, but whatever was there was gone when I went to find my kill. That was strange, but just an hour later, when I had finally set up the campfire, did I feel eyes on me again from the same bush. Was this boar watching me? Or am I going insane?
15_restlessshore_body_05_02: They came at nighttime, and there were too many of them to fight off. They swarmed McFarland first, all grunts and oinks as they ripped him to shreds. He was resurrected just a few feet to the left in his campsite and when he reappeared those crazed boars killed him again! It took him three more deaths and took me two more just to get out of the campsite boundary. Tomlinson says we should try and reclaim the camp on sunrise, but I say we abandon this venture. I've never seen the yellow eyes of a boar look at me with such malice, such hatred. Something is not right here, and I am not sticking around to find out why.
15_restlessshore_body_06_01: I swear, if I hear one more prayer out of Captain Bubblebeard, I am going to lose my mind. He prays before battle, he prays after battle, hell, he prays during battle! We're the ones carrying this crew to victory every time we have to raid a ship or a supply line! The man's more cowardly than even some of the green young lads we take on, and that's saying something with how Katsuki acts whenever we fire a cannon.
15_restlessshore_body_06_02:
May Providence bless the ship

May Providence bless the crew

Bless the bow, the stern, the aft

Bless me and bless you

Bless each all cannon fodder, bless all the swords and shields

For we will need every blessing when we are in the field.
15_restlessshore_body_07_01: Here lies a soul taken from us far too soon. A young soul, a brave soul, one who spent their life on Aeternum fighting for the good of others. They deserve more than this shallow grave in a dilapidated cemetery, but this is the best I can do. Rest well, dearest. I will visit you again soon.
15_restlessshore_body_07_02: WARNING: Do not proceed! There is a dangerous individual inside of this pavilion who has lost all sense of conscience and morality. She is no longer the woman she once was, and must be avoided at all costs!
15_restlessshore_body_08_01: My colleagues, the Master Fishers, are an eclectic group of individuals with not very much in common if you were to line us up and inspect us. But if you were to weigh our hearts, they would all have the same lightness when it came to fishing. Some fish for the food to feed others, some fish for bragging rights, and some like me fish because it's the most thrilling thing on Aeternum.\n\nThe battle one is locked in when reeling in a fish is a hard-fought one on both ends, and coming out of that victorious will never cease to amuse and amaze me. Grand Master Fisher Machera has reigned as our leader long enough. My secret desire is to out-fish him and everyone else, and take the title for myself. Now that would be truly thrilling.
15_restlessshore_body_08_02: I fished up the most curious thing the other day. It was an oar, one from a rowboat that might have been attached to one of the larger ships that crashed here. When I held the splintering wood up to the light I had an idea: why not use this as a weapon? I only killed a few rabbits on Rabbit Island with it before I angered the Harekeeper's wraith, but overall not a bad run for a piece of wood. I think I shall keep this oar, and use it to hit things far away from me.
15_restlessshore_body_08_03: Blue-blooded Barb, oh love of mine, behemoth of the deep. One day you shall be mine, and on that day I will take your corpse to Grand Fisher Machera and show him what I've learned, challenge him to a fish-off. Once I have you, I shall rule the fishing world on Aeternum.
15_restlessshore_body_09_01:
I tell you Ambeline, we're going to strike it rich! 

We've finally hit upon a scheme to make a lot of money for very little effort. It's perfect!

We farm the lynx, harvest their furs, and sell them up north. They always need more furs up north, and there is a lady who is willing to pay top dollar for 'em! 

No more hunting expeditions ranging up and down the coast, we'll never have to leave our camp. 

We've got the cats, and a good location. Now we just need more meat.

With any luck, we'll be home sooner than expected, and with more wealth than we'll know what to do with.


Lots of love, 

~Your Dearest Geoff
15_restlessshore_body_09_02:
My dearest Ambeline, you were right, it was too good to be true. 

Just when we thought things were going so well, Caryn showed up. 

Who is Caryn? Good question. We soon found out. 

Some crazy lady who believes animals shouldn't be hunted! Who believes that? 

Said we better stop what we were doing and move along, or there'd be real problems. 

I told her it was too late. We weren't leaving, we had a good thing going here! 

That's when she told us what she did to Reynard. Pushing him into the lynx den. She wasn't messing around. 




Hope to get out of this mess,

~Your Dearest Geoff
15_restlessshore_body_09_03:
Hah! Caryn has no idea the scope of what we did. 

Sure, she took out Benet, and Piers. But she still doesn't know about the wolves. 

Oh, she suspects something, but she's so short sighted, not like us. 

 We weren't only here for lynx fur. We've been flooding the local wolf den with alchemical concoctions to make them more violent. 

They were already getting that way from having to compete with the lynx for food, but now they are a real menace. 

They are so dangerous, people pay us to kill them. So we get paid twice, once for their deaths, and then again with their furs. 

Wait, I hear something outside. Is it the snarl of a wolf? Did Caryn lure one here? 

Forgive me, my love, but I have to check.


 I hope this letter makes it to you someday if I do not return. 

~Your Dearest Geoff
15_restlessshore_body_09_04:
If you have found this note, you have my thanks. What you have done was not pretty, indeed, it should not have happened at all. 

But there are some people in the world who only know how to take, and never to give. 

It was a hard mercy you gave those wolves, a mercy I couldn't give them myself. 

The balance of Restless Shore has been restored. Now I am off to see justice done in the jungles to the northwest. 

Think of me, someday, when the alligators of Reekwater run free. 


~Caryn Berzs
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_complete: Reinforcements? Thank the stars! I had almost given up hope.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_complete_next: Everyone else has fled or become Lost. I’ve managed to keep out of sight, scouting the enemy’s position. It doesn’t look good for us.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_description: Speak with Ariel Gideon about the plan to fight the 19th Legion, then find Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_goto_poi: Travel to the Scorched Battlefield to assist Alaina in the fight against the Legion
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_incomplete: If you truly wish to help New Corsica, seek Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_proposal_a: Yes, most of our citizens have fled. A brave few volunteered to fight against Crassus.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_proposal_b: Tribune Alaina Kraus reports our prospects are grim. We are outnumbered and the Corrupted legionaries are merciless.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_proposal_next2: It turned Crassus and his legion to stone. Several New Corsicans as well. But Crassus and his men freed themselves through an unholy pact with Corruption.
Perhaps you could help Tribune Kraus stop the 19th Legion?
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_proposal_next_: The feud with General Crassus started centuries ago, before my time here. It is said he committed sacrilege by invading sacred Akhet, the temple of the gods.
This act unleashed Medusa’s Curse upon the land.
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_proposal_promp: “How long has this been going on?”
1601_0101_cursedcenturies_start: “Is that why the city is barren?”
1602_0101_legionreport_description: A military report detailing the logistics and troop dispensation of the Legion.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_complete: You have the reports! Excellent! Hmm, it seems someone has made an impression on them. I take it that was you?
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_complete_ne: You’ve certainly had that effect on Drusilla. She’s determined to discover who you are. But even more importantly, you’ve made her nervous.
I believe I see an opportunity to strike at her.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_container: Search the camp for any vital correspondence
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_description: Evandrus has asked that you infiltrate the Corrupted Legion camp and steal their communications.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_goto_poi: Infiltrate the Corrupted Legion camp at {POITags} and locate any correspondence
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_incomplete: The sooner we can get those deployment reports, the sooner we can formulate our plan.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_proposal_a: The power of that insidious sickness is unknown to me. Charmion insists it was my father's blasphemous pact that freed the Legion.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_proposal_b: But I cannot believe that is true. My father is a good man.
1602_0101_ultimateintentions_proposal_ne: My father always said that knowing your enemy’s mind is vital to devising a stratagem.
Their courier camp should have their deployment reports. If you acquire them, they could reveal their intentions.
Yes, you speak true. Corruption has infected Drusilla and the centurions under her command. There is no denying that.
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_complete_a: By the helm of Mars! I can hear the chaos you've unleashed on the camp from here!
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_complete_b: Drusilla must be feeling the cold touch of the Underworld without Magnus to protect her!
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_complete_n: As she said in her letter, she'll take shelter with one of her trusted tribunes. The question is which one?
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_descriptio: Destroy the 19th Legion's supplies and slay Centurion Magnus.
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and destroy the Legion's supplies, then slay Centurion Magnus
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_incomplete: Give my regards to that brute Magnus, would you?
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_proposal_a: I never did like that brute. I’d be happy to have him sent to the Underworld.
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_proposal_b: But it will not be enough. We need to cripple the Legion’s ability to fight a prolonged conflict.
1602_0201_strengthandweakness_proposal_n: That is a fact. Destroying their supplies and armaments would have a significant impact on their fighting strength.
Set fire to the camp supply depots and cut that oaf Magnus down to size.
1602_0301_tribunetime_complete_a: Five Tribunes of the 19th Legion felled in battle! Even the mighty Achilles would be impressed!
1602_0301_tribunetime_complete_b: Now Drusilla will take shelter in the Legion’s headquarters, I’m certain of it.
1602_0301_tribunetime_complete_next: Yes, precisely so! If I had a cohort of centurions such as you, I could dictate the fate of New Corsica.
1602_0301_tribunetime_complete_prompt: "I'll draw the wolf from its den."
1602_0301_tribunetime_description: In order to weaken Drusilla, you must take out her tribunes, one by one.
1602_0301_tribunetime_goto_poi1: Travel to {POITags} and seek out Tribune Ciara and Gladiatrix Ursula
1602_0301_tribunetime_goto_poi3: Locate and defeat the twins, Castor and Pollux, in {POITags}
1602_0301_tribunetime_incomplete: Eliminating five highly trained tribunes would be too great a task for most, but I feel you are different.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_a: Mark Antony made her a tribune because he needed commanders against Octavian in Egypt. Drusilla’s ruthless tactics seemingly impressed him.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_b: My father promoted her to prefect when we arrived on Aeternum to reward her loyalty.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_next2_a: Ciara, a Celt Horse Master; Elias and his wolves; Ursula the Gladiatrix; and the Greek twins, Castor and Pollux.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_next2_b: End them and Drusilla’s strength will crumble.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_next_a: An able military commander requires more than brutality. She’s ill-suited to strategy.
1602_0301_tribunetime_proposal_next_b: Even after Magnus’s defeat, she seeks to shield herself behind her tribunes? So predictable.
1602_0401_2hbow_t5_description: A distinguished looking bow once owned by Druscilla.
1602_0401_crassusletter_description: A letter to Drusilla, on the current and future plans of Crassus and the 19th Legion.
1602_0401_headofsnake_complete: By Jupiter, you’ve done it! Drusilla’s defeat has already begun to scatter the Legion’s forces. In salute of you, noble hero!
1602_0401_headofsnake_complete_next_a: Merciful Juno, these are the words of... of a mad tyrant. Now, this cannot be the noble Roman Legatus I once knew.
1602_0401_headofsnake_complete_next_b: But I recognize his hand, his bold script I… Father… what has become of you…?
1602_0401_headofsnake_description: Destroy the Legion’s command tents and defeat Prefect Drusilla.
1602_0401_headofsnake_drusilla_combatbar: You are the cause of my woes! I'll skin you alive!
There's no stopping the might of Rome! Die, barbarian!
Your tactics are laughable! You fight like a bloody Pict!
After all the trouble you caused me, I expected more!
I'm done toying with you! Your carcass will feed the wolves!
1602_0401_headofsnake_drusilla_defeat: Impossible… you are no one… nothing…
1602_0401_headofsnake_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and burn the command tents of the Legion to draw out Drusilla, then defeat her
1602_0401_headofsnake_ignite_banner: Ignite the Legion banner to draw out Drusilla

1602_0401_headofsnake_proposal_next2_a: Yes, terribly wrong. And we must put things to right starting here.
1602_0401_headofsnake_proposal_next2_b: Burn the command tents and set the 19th's banner ablaze. We will smoke out Drusilla and end her threat.

1602_0401_headofsnake_proposal_next_b: But my father knew it was dangerous. He sought to prevent anyone from tampering with unknown forces.
1602_0501_gloriamundi_complete_a: You allowed Evandrus to live? Your victory against Drusilla proves nothing!
1602_0501_gloriamundi_complete_b: He simply wanted to remove a rival for his father’s affections. Now you have joined in his betrayal!
1602_0501_gloriamundi_complete_next_a: The gods will return and deliver their divine judgement! They cursed this land once and will do so again! I swear it!
1602_0501_gloriamundi_complete_next_b: Osiris calls to me... Can you not hear his sublime voice? My ascension awaits...

1602_0501_gloriamundi_proposal: I am grateful, my friend. I must think only of my duty to New Corsica. Her safety is all that matters now.
1602_0501_gloriamundi_proposal_next2_a: Charmion believes it is the power of the gods themselves. Myself, I am not so certain.
1602_0501_gloriamundi_proposal_next2_b: Return to New Corsica and inform Charmion of Drusilla’s defeat. I will join you as soon as I am able.
1602_0501_gloriamundi_proposal_next_a: He dreamed of bringing the peace and order of the Republic to Aeternum. But not like this.
1602_0501_gloriamundi_proposal_next_b: He wanted to secure the power of the Ennead, to keep it safe, not to claim it for his own.
1602_0601_secretssands_complete: My relic-builder! It’s so good to see you again!
1602_0601_secretssands_complete_next_a: She stripped me of my rank and expelled me from the Order, so there’s that. She said I had lost my faith.
1602_0601_secretssands_complete_next_b: I’m now an apostate. Although I have not lost my faith. I simply wish to search for truth.
1602_0601_secretssands_description: Speak to Pontiff Nuru at the Ancients' Rise and help her uncover the secrets of the Ennead.
1602_0601_secretssands_goto_poi: Speak to Pontiff Nuru in the Ancients' Rise
1602_0601_secretssands_incomplete: What has Pontiff Nuru discovered at the Ancients' Rise? Her findings may be our salvation.
1602_0601_secretssands_proposal_a: Severan warned me that her mind was slipping. I will have to ask him to have her watched.
1602_0601_secretssands_proposal_b: We must continue our mission to discover what my father and the First Cohort seek in the Ennead.
1602_0601_secretssands_proposal_next_a: If the Ennead unleashed Medusa’s Curse, that threat must be taken seriously.
1602_0601_secretssands_proposal_next_b: Pontiff Nuru is at the Ancients' Rise, looking into the Ennead’s mysteries. See what she has discovered and aid her if you can.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_complete_a: Hail, hero of New Corsica! The people have named me their new Legatus.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_complete_b: As my first official duty, I welcome you home. So, what news do you bring?
1602_0701_mightymustfall_complete_next_a: Forgive my tears, dear friend… I shall honor his memory by devoting myself to New Corsica’s prosperity.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_complete_next_b: It’s what the noble Lucius Decimus Crassus would have done. We sincerely thank you, for everything.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_complete_prompt: “Crassus spoke of you at the end.”
1602_0701_mightymustfall_description: Evandrus has asked you to go to the Ennead and confront his father General Crassus.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_enter_expeditio: Venture into the Ennead Expedition to confront General Crassus
1602_0701_mightymustfall_incomplete: Release my father from his torment, I beg you. His threat to New Corsica must be ended.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_proposal_a: I was hoping that terrible plague could be resisted by someone with a noble heart and a strong mind.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_proposal_b: But how could Charmion not have fallen to Corruption after all these centuries?
1602_0701_mightymustfall_proposal_next2_: It was her doing? Great gods! We cannot risk such a thing happening again. You must stop my father from unleashing more horrors upon us.

1602_0701_mightymustfall_proposal_next_a: Yes, one would think such an affliction would hasten the process. But in any case, New Corsica is free of her. Charmion has fled the city.
1602_0701_mightymustfall_proposal_next_b: The people have rallied behind me, thanks to you.
1602_0801_evandrusletter_description: A letter from Akila Nuru to Evandrus, regarding the mysteries of Akhet and the reforged Prime Key.
1604_0101_powerofgods_complete: The Pontifex sent you? Oh, praise the gods! I cannot possibly accomplish this task on my own.
1604_0101_powerofgods_complete_next: Yes! My fervent prayers have been answered. The gods are indeed merciful. Our work can finally begin.
1604_0101_powerofgods_description: Pontifex Charmion has requested that you seek out Pontiff Nuru in the Cradle of Nu and offer her aid.

1604_0101_powerofgods_proposal_b: May Atum strip the flesh from his bones!
1604_0101_powerofgods_proposal_next_a: Have the gods sent you? Let me look upon you… Yes! Praise Osiris! I can see it!
1604_0101_powerofgods_proposal_next_b: Go to the Jagged Ridge. My acolyte Nuru seeks the gods’ protection there. Aid her however you can! New Corsica needs you!
1604_0201_heronomore_complete: It is good to see a familiar face! What news do you bring?
1604_0201_heronomore_complete_next_a: She's convinced I'll betray New Corsica. She's lost her mind. There was no time to debate her.
1604_0201_heronomore_complete_next_b: I must learn what these legionaries plan to do. If they mean to invade New Corsica, I must try to stop them.
1604_0201_heronomore_description: Inform Evandrus that Charmion commands him to return to New Corsica.

1604_0201_heronomore_proposal_b: You had a hand in releasing the traitor Evandrus! Confess your sin before the gods!
1604_0201_heronomore_proposal_next2_a: See for yourself! He has gone to the windswept highlands where our enemy makes their camp.
1604_0201_heronomore_proposal_next2_b: Find Evandrus and order him to return to New Corsica! If he refuses, then prove yourself worthy and slay him!

1604_0201_heronomore_proposal_next_b: His only loyalty is to those Corrupted legionaries and their vicious master!
1604_0201_heronomore_proposal_prompt: “I was told he was a hero.”

1605_0101_sleepingvessels_complete_next: Well, in truth, no. But the Pontifex gave me detailed instructions. She consulted her sacred texts brought from Egypt. She is very wise.

1605_0401_insufficientfaith_complete_a: Nuru failed?! That is a great disappointment and it will cost New Corsica dearly.

1605_0601_hieratictruth_proposal_b: She attempted to open some sort of gate in the Ennead without the proper key. The Curse was the result! It was her...
1605_0601_hieratictruth_proposal_next2_a: It was called the Prime Key and it was broken into pieces. Guardians collected the pieces to protect them.
1605_0601_hieratictruth_proposal_next2_b: The Pontifex narrowed the locations down to a specific section of the highway. Let’s pray she was right.
1605_0601_hieratictruth_proposal_next_a: She believes it is the 12th Gate, which opens to the home of the gods. The Pontifex sought to bring them here.
1605_0601_hieratictruth_proposal_next_b: I don’t believe the Ennead leads to the gods. And I fear Crassus may unleash something truly horrific.
1605_0701_2hstafffire_t5_description: The ancient staff of Kheperkare. It emanates a gentle warmth.
1605_0701_brokenkey_collect_item: Collect the {itemName} and use it to start the forge
1605_0701_brokenkey_complete: You’re alive! Thank the gods! And you’ve reforged the Prime Key!
1605_0701_brokenkey_complete_next: Barely a hint of it, really. But I’m glad it was completely unfounded!
1605_0701_brokenkey_description: Destroy the Lore Keeper and reforge the Prime Key.
1605_0701_brokenkey_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and defeat the Lore Keeper, then reforge the Prime Key
1605_0701_brokenkey_incomplete: Did you reforge the Prime Key? I can’t wait to see what it looks like.
1605_0701_brokenkey_interact_forge: Reforge the Prime Key with the Forge of Ptah
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_a: Yes, but we were using an Egyptian text to try and control powers on Aeternum.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_b: These instructions were written by the ancient people who built Akhet and who actually used the Prime Key.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_next2_a: Not according to the Codex. Just place the pieces inside the forge and enter the code on the dials.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_next2_b: Here’s hoping for more success than last time. I’ll whisper a prayer for good luck. I figure it couldn’t hurt.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_next_a: The forge is protected by an entity called the Lore Keeper. He sounds ominous.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_next_b: He guards a vault-like chamber where the ignition code for the forge is kept. You’ll definitely need that.
1605_0701_brokenkey_proposal_prompt2: “What do I do with the fragments?”
1605_0701_primekey_description: A strange Ancient key, reforged at the Forge of Ptah.
1605_0801_timecircles_complete: The hero of New Corsica returns! And bearing gifts! What is that strange device?
1605_0801_timecircles_complete_next: I believe that is you, my friend. Only the crisis at the Ennead remains to be dealt with. It is time we confronted the sins of our past.
1605_0801_timecircles_description: Report what you have discovered about Akhet and the reforged Prime Key to Evandrus.
1605_0801_timecircles_goto_poi: Return to Evandrus in New Corsica with the news of Akhet and the reforged Prime Key
1605_0801_timecircles_incomplete: Tell Evandrus what we’ve done. Tell him there is hope for New Corsica!
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_a: The Codex mentions glyphs in the Forge of Ptah that speak of the Key’s function.
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_b: Now that you’ve destroyed that monstrous Lore Keeper, I can go there and study them.
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_next2_a: If it can open the gate, perhaps it can also seal it. Crassus was right about one thing; the Ennead is too dangerous to tamper with.
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_next2_b: Tell Evandrus what we’ve discovered. I’ll join you in New Corsica after I decipher these glyphs.
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_next_a: With the help of the Pontifex’s notes, I believe I can.
1605_0801_timecircles_proposal_next_b: Despite her actions and current state, none of this would have been possible without her knowledge.
1605_0801_timecircles_start: "How do we use the Prime Key?”
1605_0901_finalseal_activateglyphs: Activate the six Glyph Consoles throughout the Ennead
1605_0901_finalseal_bosstease: Confront whatever lurks in the heart of the temple
1605_0901_finalseal_complete: That beam of celestial light is the most beautiful thing I’ve ever seen! Could this have been how the builders of Akhet spoke with their gods?
1605_0901_finalseal_complete_next_a: I never stopped believing. And since Evandrus named me the new Pontifex, belief is a crucial requirement.
1605_0901_finalseal_complete_next_b: Thank you, friend. You’ve transformed this land. May the gods smile upon you. Always.
1605_0901_finalseal_container: Activate the Prime Key in the Ennead:
1605_0901_finalseal_description: Enter the Pyramid of Akhet and seal the Ennead with the Prime Key to protect the people of Aeternum.
1605_0901_finalseal_enter_expedition: Venture into the Ennead Expedition to activate the Prime Key
1605_0901_finalseal_incomplete: You must insert the Prime Key into the Ennead. Its power is too dangerous to leave uncontained.
1605_0901_finalseal_insertprimekey: Insert the Prime Key in the Ancient Console
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_a: Thank you! Charmion was wrong. The Ennead is not a gate to be opened. It must be sealed.
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_b: When Charmion attempted to use the Ennead without the Prime Key, she unleashed calamity.
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_next2_a: There is no other choice. Another curse could spell doom for everyone on Aeternum. It’s a risk we must take.
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_next2_b: Go to the Ennead, insert the Prime Key. This time, we both must have faith. Good luck!
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_next_a: Honestly, I don't know. The builders of Akhet may have been gods. Or perhaps just humans.
1605_0901_finalseal_proposal_next_b: In any event, the Prime Key was vital to the Ennead's proper function. It could prevent further curses.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_collect_trophy: Gather the Stinger of the 'Manticore' as evidence
1606_0101_lost_manticore_complete: Jupiter's balls! Look at the size of that stinger! Oh, see! I told you he was telling the truth! Tell me, what did the beast look like?
1606_0101_lost_manticore_complete_next_a: Preposterous! I heard its monstrous roar echoing on the dunes.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_complete_next_b: Oh, wait, wait, perhaps the wily beast could shift forms? In any case, I’ll speak to Prefect Severan and request Praetorians be sent to patrol this road.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_description: Inside the Acropolis, investigate the threats that plague the trade route.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and investigate the rumors of a 'manticore'
1606_0101_lost_manticore_incomplete_a: Have you had a change of heart? I can't blame you.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_incomplete_b: Although someone will have to deal with that monster or New Corsica’s trade will be ruined.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_a: This caravan was due to deliver vital supplies from New Corsica to the outpost near The Acropolis.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_b: I found it like this! Everyone dead, save for one poor, deranged peddler. He said it was a manticore!
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_next2_: If you are so brave as to risk traveling into the monster's den to meet your doom, I won't stop you!
Rather, I will pray to the gods that the manticore does not devour your soul.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_next_a: Do not dismiss my words! The wretch was dying of thirst and exuded a nauseatingly pungent odor, but he was certain.
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_next_b: He looked into my eyes and whispered the horrid tale. The hellish stinger, the demonic roar. It was a manticore!
1606_0101_lost_manticore_proposal_prompt: “This I have to see for myself.”
1606_0101_scorpionstinger_description: A potent weapon, even in death.
1606_0101_travellersnotes_description: Hastily-written journals of the recently deceased.
1612_0101_praetorians_complete_a: So my suspicions were correct? I prayed it would be otherwise. Those Praetorians were brave soldiers… and good friends.
1612_0101_praetorians_complete_b: But you have brought me only three insignias. Emiliano’s insignia is missing.
1612_0101_praetorians_complete_next_a: I meant Praetorian Malatesta. He was their leader, the most capable of their number, and exceedingly clever.
1612_0101_praetorians_complete_next_b: I can’t imagine he would’ve deserted his comrades. Perhaps he’s still alive.
1612_0101_praetorians_description: Captain Andrea Clermont has asked you to find her fellow Praetorians. If they've become Lost, help them find peace and bring back proof of their defeat.
1612_0101_praetorians_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and search for the missing Praetorians
1612_0101_praetorians_incomplete: Those missing Praetorians were my responsibility. I'm ultimately to blame for their fates.
1612_0101_praetorians_proposal_b: But our enemies have left hordes of Lost in their wake. I fear my Praetorians may have joined their soulless ranks.
1612_0101_praetorians_proposal_next_a: A most noble offer, friend. Normally I would never accept such help from a non-Praetorian.
1612_0101_praetorians_proposal_next_b: If you find them and they've become Lost, I implore you to put them to rest and return their insignias to me.
