1612_0201_1hroundshield_t5_description: This shield has not been used for some time.
1612_0201_malatestaletter_description: A confessional letter, written by Malatesta to Andrea Clermont.
1612_0201_personaldemons_complete_a: A letter from Emiliano? He was... robbing the evacuating citizens?
1612_0201_personaldemons_complete_b: Oh, Emiliano, you struggled so hard to do what was right. I was certain you were a changed man...
1612_0201_personaldemons_complete_next: Yes, and it cost the lives of his comrades. I am grateful for all of your help. If only Jupiter would send me fifty more like you.
1612_0201_personaldemons_description: Discover if Praetorian Malatesta still lives. If he has become Lost, defeat him and retrieve his insignia
1612_0201_personaldemons_findtarget: Discover the fate of Praetorian Malatesta in the ruins of {POITags}
1612_0201_personaldemons_goto_poi: Search for Praetorian Malatesta in the ruins of {POITags}
1612_0201_personaldemons_incomplete: Please, I must know the fate of Praetorian Malatesta. It's important to me.
1612_0201_personaldemons_malatesta: Defeat Praetorian Malatesta and Collect his Insignia.
1612_0201_personaldemons_proposal_a: He had a... regrettable past. I can't speak further without betraying his confidence. What’s important now is that we discover his fate.
1612_0201_personaldemons_proposal_b: He was... dear to me. Forgive me, it’s not fitting for a Praetorian to show such emotion.
1612_0201_personaldemons_proposal_next_a: You speak from experience? Then you understand.
1612_0201_personaldemons_proposal_next_b: Please discover if Malatesta still lives. If he’s like the others, then I beg you to grant him final peace.
1612_0301_clermontreport_description: A thoroughly detailed report on the missing Praetorian Guards.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_complete: Praise Jupiter! Captain Clermont still lives! Her loss would’ve been a great blow to New Corsica.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_complete_next: The Praetorians who remain are spread very thin, but I will send reinforcements to Captain Clermont when I can.
I'm glad you found her. I sent her to check on the status of the city's evacuation days ago, and had no word from her until now.
I warned her about Malatesta. I never understood what she saw in that scoundrel.
You have done a great service for the city and we humbly thank you.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_description: Take Captain Clermont’s reports back to Prefect Severan in New Corsica.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_goto_poi: Take Captain Clermont’s reports back to Prefect Severan in New Corsica.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_incomplete: I pray the Prefect is able to find recruits for the Praetorian Guard. We are in desperate need.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_proposal_a: The roads must be guarded, no matter the circumstances or the cost. That was Praetorian Malatesta’s mission. And now it’s mine.
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_proposal_b: The Prefect will send reinforcements when he can. Oh, will you take these reports back to him?
1612_0301_dutiesmaintained_proposal_next: My thanks. I hate to impose on you further. You’ve already done so much.
And, by the way, I'd appreciate you keeping what you learned about Emiliano between us.
1613_0101_2hspear_t5_description: A regal spear once believed lost to the sands of time.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_complete: That was most impressive! While you were engaging those legionaries, I managed to get a closer look.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_complete_next: The situation is even more grim, I'm afraid. I spied a large number of siege weapons. I’m certain now they intend to attack New Corsica.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to defeat 19th Legion troops in their war camps.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_incomplete: We must thin out the 19th Legion’s numbers.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_proposal: They seem to be preparing a strike against New Corsica, but I can’t be sure. There’s too many of them and I can’t get a closer look.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_proposal_next_a: That would be helpful in many ways. The fewer Corrupted, the greater the chance that New Corsica can be saved.
1613_0101_assaultlegion_proposal_next_b: But be careful, those are trained Roman legionaries fueled by Corruption.
1613_0201_grecianscroll_description: A lengthy scroll covered in letters, possibly in Greek.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_complete: Excellent work! With the power of Hydra’s Breath in our possession, we now have a fighting chance.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_complete_next: Good! I’ve seen that man burn New Corsican soldiers alive. That monster deserved to be sent to hell.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to steal Hydra’s Breath from the 19th Legion to help destroy the enemy's siege weapons.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and search for Hydra's Breath, then eliminate the Legion's Alchemist
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_ignatius_combatba: You should have a taste of my Hydra's Breath! It's sure to leave a lasting impression!
There's nothing like the smell of burning flesh! It's invigorating!
I'll watch you roast! By Hades, I swear it!
How dare you rob the world of my genius! You deserve to burn!
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_incomplete: Without casks of Hydra’s Breath, we have no chance of destroying those siege engines.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_a: They’re Crassus’s army, formed by Mark Antony in Egypt during Cleopatra’s rebellion.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_b: They were sent by Antony to find the secret of immortality in the land of the gods. That’s how they came to be here.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_next2_a: I know how we can do it. Raid the enemy’s camp and return with Hydra’s Breath.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_next2_b: This incendiary weapon should do the trick. If you can, eliminate their alchemist Ignatius and destroy his tools. He’s a brutal animal.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_next_a: Oh, I’m not a native New Corsican. Only Crassus, the 19th, the Pontifex, and a few others came from Egypt.
1613_0201_hydrasbreath_proposal_next_b: Most of us settled here over the years from other parts of Aeternum. It’s my home now and I intend to defend it.
1613_0201_strangevial_description: A vial filled with a mysterious liquid, unknown to you.
1613_0301_2hgreataxe_t5_description: “Victory is claimed by a long reach and a strong grasp.”
1613_0301_blazeofglory_complete_a: Ah, what a victory! New Corsica shall be spared destruction by fire. We are in your debt.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_complete_b: Ah and I finished the translation. The substance in the vial is an elixir called Panacea.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_complete_next_a: Good guess! It can reverse Medusa’s Curse. I wonder if that’s how the Legion freed themselves from their petrification?
1613_0301_blazeofglory_complete_next_b: But now that you possess a vial, I believe you can help New Corsica further.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to destroy the 19th Legion's artillery and defeat Primus Vespasian.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_goto_poi: Hunt down Primus Vespasian in {POITags}, then destroy the Legion's artillery
1613_0301_blazeofglory_incomplete: If Ignatius’s words are true, our time is short. You must destroy the artillery.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_proposal: Hmm, I’ve never seen anything like the substance in this vial. It’s very strange. The scroll is written in Greek. It’s a formula for something.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_proposal_next: The vial does give off an unusual glow, but it’s not Hydra’s Breath. It's infused with Azoth. I’ll need time to translate the Greek.
1613_0301_blazeofglory_proposal_next2: Approach with caution! Primus Vespasian guards the siege weapons. He’s a former gladiator and his skills are legendary. Best of luck, hero!
1613_0301_blazeofglory_start: “I found this vial and a scroll.”
1613_0401_lastcenturion_complete: Uhhh… my vision swims with shadows… am I still dreaming…? What has happened?
1613_0401_lastcenturion_complete_next_a: Who? Where is my father? The other centurions?
1613_0401_lastcenturion_complete_next_b: I recall a blinding flash in the sky… then a thunderous roar… then… then darkness.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to find and restore the New Corsican hero Evandrus.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_goto_poi: Travel to {POITags} and search for the statue of Evandrus Crassus
1613_0401_lastcenturion_incomplete: Restore Evandrus! He is the ally we need!
1613_0401_lastcenturion_interact_statue: Find and restore Evandrus using the Panacea
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_a: He is Crassus’s son! Turned to stone all those centuries ago. His petrified body rests at the Legion’s old fort.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_b: Tales of his noble deeds are legendary. New Corsicans lay wreaths at his feet for good luck.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_next2_a: I dare not contemplate such a horror! Not for a noble soul like Evandrus.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_next2_b: But if such is his fate, please release him from that hellish torment.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_next_a: If so he would’ve come to New Corsica by now. He loved his people. And if anyone would know the mind of General Crassus, it would be him.
1613_0401_lastcenturion_proposal_next_b: Please find him. If he is still stone, restore him, I beg you!
1613_0401_panacea_description: A rare and powerful curative that can even cure Medusa's Curse.
1613_0501_legendrestored_complete: Evandrus has been restored? Praise be! Our fortunes are certain to change! Where is he? What does he intend to do?
1613_0501_legendrestored_complete_next: Good! I’ll return to defend the city as soon as I’m able. It would be an honor to fight alongside the noble Evandrus. Thank you, hero!
1613_0501_legendrestored_description: Inform the newly awakened Evandrus of the current invasion then report back to Tribune Kraus.
1613_0501_legendrestored_goto_poi: Report the news of Evandrus's return to Tribune Kraus.
1613_0501_legendrestored_incomplete: I shall return to New Corsica as soon as my head has cleared. There is so much to consider…
1613_0501_legendrestored_proposal_a: How? Were we attacked? I recall my father was marching to Akhet. He left me and a small garrison to guard the fort.
1613_0501_legendrestored_proposal_b: Did he and the Legion suffer a similar fate?
1613_0501_legendrestored_proposal_next: No, no, that cannot be! My father and the proud 19th Legion? Claimed by Corruption?!
1613_0501_legendrestored_proposal_next2: Great gods! This is too much! I must go to the city at once! If Tribune Kraus fights for New Corsica, return and report what has happened here!
1613_0501_legendrestored_start: “You were stone for a long time.”
1624_0301_ancientfocus_description: A strange device used to direct energy into the seed of an Azoth tree.
1624_0301_talk_ghazi: Meet Ghazi and Imhotep at the Shrine of Thoth
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_complete_a: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah, there you are! No doubt you’ve witnessed all manner of fascinating events and faced innumerable perils.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_complete_b: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />And bearing gifts, I see! What is that device?
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_complete_next: Feeding, you<g id="g_female_takeitem8s" priority="high" /> say? Most intriguing. This will certainly merit further study. Hmm, yes, most intriguing indeed…
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_description: Recovered from his kidnapping, the Great Sage Imhotep has told you of the strange seed carried north by the Angry Earth, likely to the Oasis Spontanea. He and Ghazi will await you at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_disruptpower: Destroy the Angry Earth Power Sources:
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_gotopoi: Investigate the {POITags} for clues to the Angry Earth
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_incomplete: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />Have you been to the Oasis Spontanea? We must discover what nefarious scheme the Angry Earth is seeding.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_investigateare: Search the ruins for signs of the Angry Earth
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_01_cue: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Words fail me. How can I ever thank you for saving this old goat?
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_02_cue_n: <g id="g_female_headnodding" />Yes, this "goat" owes you a tremendous debt. But I’m<g id="g_male_concerns" /> afraid we may not yet take our rest.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_03_propo: "You need me to find the Seed."
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_04_propo: <g id="g_female_youknows" />You see what I said about our friend here?
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_05_propo: <g id="g_female_nodyes" />Indeed! Most impressive. Your presumption is correct; we must<g id="g_female_pointthreaten" /> retrieve the seed of the Azoth Tree.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_06_propo: It seems the Angry Earth have re-awakened just for the seed- but we must learn what they plan to do with it.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_09_propo: <g id="g_male_think" priority="high" />Yes. Of course. To grow the seed, they'll need water, and plenty of it.<g id="g_female_nodding" /> Now I understand Ghazi’s embarrassing obsession with you.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_10_propo: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />Do remember, Imhotep, that I'm much more handy with a sword than you.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_11_propo: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Thank you for your help. I would join you, but I felt an evil presence on my journey, near the Shrine of Thoth.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> One which Ghazi and I must investigate.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_multi_12_propo: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Recover the Seed if you can, and meet us at the Shrine.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_proposal_a: A most excellent question! It’s one I have no answer for… yet.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_proposal_b: But while captive, I saw them take a seed from the Azoth tree and feed it vast quantities of life energy.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_proposal_next2: Hmm? Oh, yes! Excellently reasoned! The Oasis Spontanea would provide such an aqueous bounty.
Go there and investigate. We will meet you at the Great Shrine of Thoth. Together, we will solve this conundrum!
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_proposal_next_: An excellent guess. But why? I doubt it means something salubrious for humanity.
They carried the seed away to parts unknown. However, it will require a steady source of water. That’s rare in a desert…
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_talkto_ghazi_a: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I'll never forget your help in rescuing Imhotep. I’m in your debt.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_talkto_ghazi_b: <g id="g_litearmor_worry" />Although Imhotep's putting on a brave face, I still have worries. He's a tough old buzzard but<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> even he has limits.
1624_0301_wateringtheseed_talkto_ghazi_n: <g id="g_female_headshakesmall" />It gives me little comfort. Take Aban, for example. He’s not returned.<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> And I knew he wouldn't. Whatever killed him terrified him enough to prevent his resurrection.
<g id="g_litearmor_handheart" />I can’t imagine poor Aban as a Lost…
<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" />He was like a brother. I remember when he came to Imhotep, seeking to learn.<g id="g_male_nodsympathysmall" /> He seemed so frail.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Imhotep turned him away, but I changed his mind. Aban had the soul of an explorer.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> I hope he can forgive me...
<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />It appears stable… for now.<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> But I will watch him closely.

<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" priority="high" />Something's still amiss. And my instincts are rarely wrong, remember?<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> It can happen but it's as rare as an eclipse.
1624_0302_2hspear_t5_description: Blessed by Bast, and consecrated in the Temple of Shu, this legendary artifact was thought to be lost to graverobbers forever.
1624_0302_ancientkey_description: A simple key, carried for centuries. The lock should be nearby.
1624_0302_ancientouroboros_description: A sealed canopic jar, topped with a stylized cobra.
1624_0302_ancientspearhead_description: A sealed canopic jar, topped with a fierce hawk head.
1624_0302_engravedaltar_description: A flat clay slab, etched with an Ancient glyph meant to seal or bind.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_complete_: No, this cannot be! The demon has been unleashed. After all these centuries...
<g id="g_female_lookaroundshifty" priority="high" />But that's impossible- for it to re-awaken after all these centuries!<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> Was it the ritual?
<g id="g_male_shocked" />No! It cannot be- we have unleashed the demon!
The nightmare takes shape once again. This will be our doom!
<g id="g_male_clenchfistsangry" />Yes! Swaddled in arrogance, I have<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> brought doom upon us all!

<g id="g_male_noway" priority="high" />No, no! No, NO! I must do something. I must stop him!<g id="g_male_clutchheadcrouch" /> Ahh! My mind darkens. I drown in shadows! I am lost.<g id="g_male_clutchheadcrouch" /> Lost! ARGH!
Address me as ‘Great Pharaoh.’ That demon is Apophis, and his presence proves our dilemma is most dire.
Address me as ‘Great Pharaoh.’<g id="g_female_pointthreaten" bin="2" bout="2" /> I appoint you as my Sword to defeat Apophis, our eternal foe.
You will defeat this nightmare. I appoint you to this task. You will become my Sword.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_container: Collect the Artifacts for Imhotep's Ritual:
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_descripti: Unable to breach the magic of the Ancient focus, Imhotep knows of a powerful spell which may provide answers. Relics from Aqua Anuket, Arit-en-Geb, and Anhur's Pride should empower his magic enough to succeed.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_gatheralt: Unlock the Sealed Coffer to Collect the {itemName}
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_gatherour: Ascend to the top of {POITags} to find the {itemName}
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_gotopoi_k: Search the Ruins at {POITags} for an Ancient Key
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_gotopoi_o: Climb to the top of {POITags} and search for a Canopic Jar
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_gotopoi_s: Explore {POITags} and search for a Canopic Jar
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_incomplet: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you collected the components I need to unlock the Ancient device?
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_placealta: Place the Ancient Seal for the ritual
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_placeouro: Place the Uraeus Jar for the ritual
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_placespea: Place the Horus Jar for the ritual
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_proposal_: Oh, I knew them.<g id="g_male_nod2" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Well enough to worry about a device like this.
<g id="g_female_explains" />It’s protected by an arcane lock that prevents me from discerning its nature.<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> I’ve encountered such locks before.
<g id="g_male_nod2" />Hah! Your eagerness and acumen are commendable.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> You remind me of Ghazi.
<g id="g_female_giveitem" priority="high" />Here is the list of components and where to acquire them.<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> I’d warn you of the danger, but I believe you’re up to the task.
<g id="g_female_spreadarms" />That remains to be seen. This one seems especially complex.<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" priority="high" /> The design is familiar, though…
<g id="g_female_leanforwardlisten" />Fortunately, I happen to know a spell that can open Ancient locks. But I will require<g id="g_male_spreadhands" /> certain rare components.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_ritual_ap: Imhotep! I have been freed from the sands! Our masters grant us their power! The Ancient fires will be rekindled!
You will wither! Your flesh food for worms! Ravenous Death will have her feast! Hahaha!
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_stand: Step away and allow Imhotep to begin the Ritual
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_talkto_im: <g id="g_female_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high" />These items are fine specimens. You have an eye for this sort of work, youngster.
<g id="g_female_gestureforward01" />Place the items in the conjuring circle in the areas I’ve marked. Then for your safety,<g id="g_male_converseleft" /> step away. I shall begin the incantation.
<g id="g_male_dontknow" bout="2" />Too much like us in some ways. And yet not enough like us in others.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> The specter of Aeternum is their legacy. Never forget that.
<g id="g_male_itsokay" />But now I must concentrate. Stay close to Ghazi.
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />It is indeed. A sorcery taught to me by one of the Ancients themselves. My mentor.

<g id="g_female_explains" />It isn’t what we thought, by the way. The Ancients.<g id="g_male_waghand03" /> They were not gods. Though they<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> wielded power as if they were.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_topic_pos: <g id="g_female_clenchfistssuffer" />Oh gods, it’s happened! Just as I feared it would! His state of mind was far more fragile than he had let on. My poor master…
<g id="g_female_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Imhotep's mind has shifted. The gentle soul of the Great Sage is gone.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Another has arisen in his place…
<g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Yes, we stand in the presence of the Great Pharaoh Imhotep, Son of Ptah, High Priest of Heliopolis.
We must speak to him accordingly.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> We must not stress him further.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_topic_pre: <g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />You may witness all manner of sanity-bending events in Imhotep's presence.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />He knows ancient secrets and magics that have not been witnessed by anyone for millennia.
<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Yes, I noticed. You're as solid as the firmament. And I thank Isis for that.
1624_0302_unravelingthemystery_whisper_1: Imhotep! I have been freed from the sands! Our masters grant us their power! The Ancient fires will be rekindled!
You will wither! Your flesh food for worms! Ravenous Death will have her feast! Hahaha!
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_complete: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />My mighty Sword returns! You shine with the light of Ra. What<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> mysteries have you uncovered in the vault?<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Speak to your pharaoh!
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_complete_next2: <g id="g_male_nodunderstand" />So it is. I must decipher these scrolls.<g id="g_male_concerns" /> There is foul alchemy at work here.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_complete_next_: <g id="g_female_takeitem8s" priority="high" />Hmm. These scrolls are written in Ancient script. There are few in Aeternum who can read them. I am one of them.
<g id="g_female_takeitem5s" priority="high" />And that strange jar. Something floats within…
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_description: Apophis's remarks have Imhotep worried about a grander machination involving Ancient technology. He suggests investigating an undisturbed Ancient vault in Hermopolis, where Apophis may have found materials for his plans, while he and Ghazi return to New Corsica.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_entervault: Use the Platform to access the Ancient Vault
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_evidencevault: Search the Vault for evidence of Apophis's greater plan
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_gotopoi: Search the ruins of {POITags} for the Entrance to the Ancient Vault
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_incomplete: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Go to Hermopolis and find a way to access the Ancient vault. We must discover Apophis’s plan before it’s too late.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_investigatepor: Investigate the Ancient architecture for the Entrance to the Ancient Vault
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_proposal_a: <g id="g_male_converseright"  bin="2" bout="2"/>The Ancients awakened the Angry Earth to battle Corruption.<g id="g_female_fingerwagno"  bin="2" bout="2"/> But their deadly weapon perceived us as a threat as well.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_proposal_b: Millennia ago, Apophis led the Angry Earth in a campaign of genocide against my people.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_proposal_b_gha: <g id="g_female_youknow" />It was millenia ago, but the horror is still fresh. Apophis led the Angry Earth<g id="g_female_disappointed" /> in a war of genocide against our people.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_proposal_next2: It could mean calamity but we must know for certain. We may find answers in an Ancient vault in Hermopolis.

<g id="g_male_headshakeno"  bin="2" bout="2" />I know not. But there is a vault in Hermopolis, where many records were kept.<g id="g_male_pointsoutthere" /> Seek, my Sword, and meet us anon in New Corsica.
You must find a way to access it. I do not have that knowledge. When done, meet us in New Corsica.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_proposal_next_: Only because they ceased their attacks and returned to the earth. What power compelled their retreat is unknown.
<g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" />Only because they ceased their attacks and returned to the earth. We never discovered why.
But the demon has returned, spewing disturbing words of rekindling the Ancient fires.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_returnlibrary: Meet Ghazi and Imhotep at the Library in New Corsica
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_searcharea: Continue searching for any clues about the Ancient Vault
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_topic_ghazi_a: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Being named the Great Pharaoh's Sword is an immense honor.<g id="g_female_youknows" /> He seems to have complete confidence in you.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_topic_ghazi_b: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />If we are careful and make use of his will and determination, we may yet prevail here.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_topic_ghazi_ne: <g id="g_litearmor_agree1" />The Great Pharaoh may seem different, but he’s still Imhotep the Wise.<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> He and Apophis were enemies, which makes us his allies.
<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" />Stay safe, and I'll see you in New Corsica.
<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />I know the vault the Great Pharaoh speaks of, but I've<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> never ventured there myself.
<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />It’s a cursed place filled with dark secrets and the specters of a violent past.
1624_0303_accursedalchemy_useactuator: Input the correct glyph sequence, then use the Actuator
1624_0303_ancientscrolls_description: A bundle of fragile scrolls, covered with Egyptian and Ancient glyphs writings.
1624_0303_handinjar_description: A sealed canopic jar, bearing the visage of the jackal-headed god, Anubis.
1624_0401_atumdevicefragment_description: A fragment of the Ancient device found in the midst of the Pools of Orcus, glowing with an inner light.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_complete_a: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Is there no task that you cannot accomplish? Ptah has crafted me a very fine weapon indeed.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_complete_b: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />But I sense something strange, a familiar power…
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_complete_nex: <g id="g_litearmor_handshipsconsider" />Could Apophis simply be creating an army of chimeras? That would take time. And it seems too simple a stratagem.
<g id="g_male_dontknows" />There is more here that we are not seeing.
<g id="g_litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high" />It’s a piece of a Disk of Atum! It pulses with quintessence, a potent energy from the stars the Ancients used in their magics.
<g id="g_male_headshakeno" />Why was this at the Pools of Orcus?
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_description: Imhotep's translation speaks of a method to merge two beings together, a practice thought long lost. The sulfurous jar indicates a visit to the Pools of Orcus to the west, and he asks your help in searching for clues to Apophis's plans.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_goto_poola: Search for clues near the bubbling pools
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_goto_poolbc: Continue searching the pools for anything out of place
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_goto_poolfin: Search the remaining pools for any evidence of Apophis' involvement
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_gotopoi: Seek out the source of the sulfurous fluid in the {POITags}
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_incomplete: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Have you been to the Pools of Orcus? We must know what manner of abomination Apophis is creating.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_interact_shi: Use the Azoth Staff to drain the barrier's energy
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_proposal_a: <g id="g_male_shakehead" />I did not think it possible. But perhaps I was mistaken.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_proposal_b: <g id="g_female_youknow" />This strange jar is not centuries old, it’s new.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> Someone recently visited the vault.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_proposal_nex: <g id="g_male_rememberbig" />I recognize the pungent scent and sickly color of the jar’s fluid. It comes from the sulfurous Pools of Orcus.
<g id="g_male_converseleft" />Go there and see what you can discover. But<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> be on your guard. A great evil lurks in the shadows.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />I do not think so. Such craft seems beyond that demon’s temperament and skill.
<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" />There’s another mind at work here. One that is far more cunning.
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_returnlibrar: Return to the Library to report on your findings
1624_0401_thedemonscauldron_topic_ghazi_: <g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />The Pools of Orcus are a foul place.<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> The fumes there sicken even the heartiest of individuals.
<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />Tread carefully, Sword of Imhotep.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> The less time spent there, the better.

<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />And I have faith in you. You remind me of someone<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> I knew, long ago. Another brave and noble soul.<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> Together, we will win the day.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />Honestly, I’m worried. I’ve made more elixir, which helps to control his affliction.
<g id="g_litearmor_worry" />I fear Imhotep's formula is not strong enough. I could potentially devise a new one but<g id="g_female_shrugshort" /> my alchemy skills are not the equal of his.
1624_0501_1hgauntletvoid_t5_description: A mysterious glove recovered from the land of Black Sands.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_akhet_adiana:
I'm not sure why you've come here. You cannot stop what I have begun.

The threat of Corruption was dire, but the toll you exacted from the Motherwell, the damage you wrought... it will take generations to heal.

I foolishly came to the aid of humanity, and once again, this is how we were repaid.

It is proven again, Humanity is the true source of all evils, a vessel for Corruption, a plague to nature, and you are a prime example.

Another of my kind lies dreaming in these sands, but he will soon be awakened.

And together, we will purge this island of your kind and restore Aeternum to the paradise it was meant to be. Begone from here. There is nothing you can do.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_climbstairs: Climb the broken staircase to the upper level of the Pyramid
1624_0501_powerofthegods_complete_a: <g id="g_female_explains" />Even here, I sensed the surge of power from Akhet!<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> The earth hums with the energized blood flowing through her veins.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_complete_next2_: <g id="g_female_nodconsider" />Ah, so she keeps that a secret these days, does she?<g id="g_male_handshipsconsider" /> There is much significance to that fact, much I will need to consider.
<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />But if she has reactivated the Ennead, then she has something quite catastrophic in mind.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_complete_next3_: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Here? In Brimstone Sands? She could only mean… Sutekh, the very Ancient who taught me the mysteries of Aeternum.
<g id="g_male_spreadhands" />My... master will return then! But Artemis will need the Eye of Horus…<g id="g_male_wavehandsnobig" /> only the Eye can awaken my master…
1624_0501_powerofthegods_complete_next_a: <g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" />Adiana...? It has been many long centuries since I heard that name. I thought her gone, like the others.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_complete_next_b: <g id="g_female_explains" />You do realize she assumes that name only to masquerade in human<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> form? She is an Ancient we knew as Artemis.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_defeattarget: Defeat the {targetName} in the depths of the Pyramid
1624_0501_powerofthegods_description: Imhotep is intimately familiar with the fragment of the Ancient power source, having designed the Pyramid of Akhet to house it. He suggests searching near Diospolis for an entry point to the pyramid's interior, the origin of the fragment.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_gotoadiana: Search for the disturbance on the upper terrace
1624_0501_powerofthegods_gotopoi: Search for the Diospolis entrance to the Pyramid of Akhet
1624_0501_powerofthegods_incomplete: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />Find your way into Akhet via the Diospolis entrance. We must know what Apophis intends to do with the Ennead’s power.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />When active, it powered the Ancients’ great machines throughout the island.<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> Hm. Apophis did boast he had been granted power.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_proposal_b: <g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />Akhet houses both wonders and horrors. It has weapons capable of terrible devastation.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_proposal_next2_: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />I’ll enhance your Azoth Staff to detect the precious energy.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Seek out the Diospolis entrance to the pyramid. It’ll give you the access to the inner workings of the temple, to its deepest secrets. Go with the light of Ra!
1624_0501_powerofthegods_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_male_think" />They would certainly suit that demon’s lust for destruction. And it's clear he’s been to the pyramid.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />My Sword must investigate Akhet to determine if the flow of quintessence has increased.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_topic_adianaakh: <g id="g_female_crossarms" />I'm not sure why you've come here. You cannot stop what I have begun.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />The threat of Corruption was dire,<g id="g_female_yourecrazy" /> but the toll you exacted from the Motherwell, the damage you wrought… it will take generations to heal.
<g id="g_male_willcoverit" />I foolishly came to the aid of humanity, and once again,<g id="g_male_hopeless" /> this is how we were repaid.

<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" />It is proven again, Humanity is the true source of all evils, a vessel for Corruption, a plague<g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" /> to nature, and you are a prime example.

<g id="g_female_gesturearoundroom" priority="high" />Another of my kind lies dreaming in these sands, but he will soon be awakened. And together,<g id="g_male_clenchfistsgetpumped02" /> we will purge this island of your kind and<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> restore Aeternum to the paradise it was meant to be.
<g id="g_female_dismissregal" />Begone from here. There is nothing you can do.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_topic_ghazi_a: <g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />So you intend to enter Akhet? Imhotep built the great pyramid.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_topic_ghazi_b: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Whatever happened there, it was enough to ensure he would never return. The Corrupted Legion seeks to claim its power.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_topic_ghazi_nex: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />Many have coveted the Ennead's dangerous power over the centuries. And they’ve been punished as a result.
1624_0501_powerofthegods_unsealglyph: Use Your Azoth Staff to unseal the Glyph
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_combat1: Insignificant worm! Does the presence of the master fill you with dread? With awe? His return is inevitable!
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_combat2: Your kind should never have had the power of Azoth! You corrupted what was once pure!
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_combat3: I hunger for destruction! But my appetite pales in comparison to humanity's gluttony!
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_combat4: We have suffered your presence long enough! Die, worm! Be buried by the sands! Hahaha!
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_combat5: My master will awaken soon! You will bear witness! Prepare to face judgement! Kneel, worm!
1624_0801_agodawakens_apophis_defeat: Impossible! Argh! You are nothing! The masters will return! They will revoke their gifts! You will wither…
1624_0801_agodawakens_complete_a: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah. The Sword of Brimstone returns! You have defeated a mighty demon and brought order to this land.
1624_0801_agodawakens_complete_b: <g id="g_male_spreadhands" />I will be forever grateful for the great service you have done for my people.
1624_0801_agodawakens_complete_next_a: Hmm. A fair question.<g id="g_female_explains" /> I am now a reflection of all my past lives. But<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> they are in balance, thanks to your tasty elixir.
1624_0801_agodawakens_complete_next_b: <g id="g_male_lookupsmall" />If I am to choose a title, then I choose Imhotep the Physician,<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> for the time has come to heal the land.
1624_0801_agodawakens_defeatapophis: Defeat Apophis and prevent him from awakening Sutekh
1624_0801_agodawakens_description: With the Eye of Horus in hand, Imhotep has given you the location of the Necropolis of Sutekh, the resting place of an Ancient. Adiana and Apophis must not be allowed to rouse Sutekh from his slumber!
1624_0801_agodawakens_enternecropolis: Enter the Necropolis of Sutekh and face Apophis
1624_0801_agodawakens_finalteleport: Complete the Ordeal of the Nine Gates
1624_0801_agodawakens_incomplete: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />You must stop Apophis from awakening Sutekh! An Ancient of his power would wreak havoc on this land!
1624_0801_agodawakens_interactteleport: Enter the Ordeal of the Nine Gates
1624_0801_agodawakens_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_pointthreaten" />That must not happen! You must prevent Sutekh’s return at all costs!
1624_0801_agodawakens_proposal_b: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />But be prepared for a great battle. Apophis may already be there,<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> and that monster’s power is terrifying.
1624_0801_agodawakens_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_male_spreadhands" />I will be fine. Thanks to you, my dear friend.
1624_0801_agodawakens_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_male_spreadarmscalm" />Please come back to us. Ghazi and I have become quite fond of your striking visage.<g id="g_male_hopeless" /> And she would be most distraught to lose another loved one.
1624_0801_agodawakens_returnimhotep: Return to Imhotep to report your success
1624_0801_agodawakens_returnlibrary: Return to the Library in New Corsica
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_ghazi: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />Bring your beautiful visage here and let me gaze upon you for a few moments!<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> It is so good to see you.
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_ghazi_next: <g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />The flush of color would suit you. I knew you would do it.<g id="g_female_spreadarms" /> My instincts are never wrong, remember?
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_ghazi_next2: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />I hope we’ll be seeing much more of each other.<g id="g_male_sighrelief" />  Under far less nerve-wracking circumstances.
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_ghazi_promp: “It’s good to see you, too, Ghazi.”
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_imhotep_a: <g id="g_male_clenchfistright" />Yes! Blessed be the Light of Ra! I sensed the<g id="g_male_nodmild" /> foul presence of Apophis banished to the sands!
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_imhotep_b: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />I was hoping I would not have to confront the demon myself.
1624_0801_agodawakens_talkto_imhotep_nex: <g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />She’s spent far too many years looking at this weary, old face.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> It’s you she will be eager to see.
<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />And I will be glad to see the two of you reunited.
<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />I was cautiously optimistic. And<g id="g_male_compliment" /> you are not my sword, you are the Sword of Brimstone Sands!
<g id="g_female_youknows" />Please return to New Corsica. Ghazi will be<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> worried sick and will be delighted to see you.
1624_0901_royalvestments_description: A well-preserved bundle of quality ancient Egyptian garments straight from a noble's wardrobe.
1624_0901_secretindesert_complete: Perhaps we’ll get a proper library now— what’s this? Where did you get this?
1624_0901_secretindesert_complete_multi_: <g id="g_female_takeitem5s" priority="high" />Ah, our precious parcel. Thank you. I knew we would need this someday.
<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />Imhotep! You told me they were destroyed!
<g id="g_male_laughcocky" />Ha! Good or not, depends largely on the<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> owner. And her heart.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />They are robes of state. For someone long gone- and<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> we are better off for it.
1624_0901_secretindesert_complete_next: I never thought I’d look upon this again… Oh, Isis, why do you punish me so?
1624_0901_secretindesert_complete_next2: Imhotep! You swore a vow! Before all the gods! You oath-breaking, old goat!
1624_0901_secretindesert_description: With Apophis no longer a threat, Imhotep has turned his attention to matters closer to home. He has asked assistance in recovering a precious and mysterious parcel, buried long ago.
1624_0901_secretindesert_gotopoi: Search for the strange parcel buried at the {POITags}
1624_0901_secretindesert_incomplete: <g id="g_male_leanforwardinspect" />Have you acquired my parcel? It contains something of great value to<g id="g_male_converseleft" /> all of Brimstone. Please retrieve it.
1624_0901_secretindesert_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />There is a parcel I wish recovered. You may find it buried to the south,<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> near a place sacred to Sobek.
1624_0901_secretindesert_proposal_b: <g id="g_female_nodconsider" />This parcel is very precious to me. I beg you to guard it closely.
1624_0901_secretindesert_proposal_next_a: Ah…<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> It could decide the<g id="g_female_gesturearoundroom" /> future of New Corsica and affect the direction of all of Brimstone Sands.
1624_0901_secretindesert_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_female_explains" />When you return with it, I shall reveal what it contains and explain everything.
1624_0901_secretindesert_talkto_imhotep: Ah, the precious parcel. I knew I would need this again someday. And now you deserve to see what it contains.
1624_0901_secretindesert_talkto_imhotep_: Robes of state. This is the raiment of a noble ruler from a great land. There is so much history in these threads and these jewels.
Hah! No, they are not. Could you return them to their owner? To Ghazi.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_complete_a: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />You’ve returned! I would guess a confrontation with Artemis did not occur then?
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_complete_b: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Did you learn anything more regarding her ambitions?
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_complete_next: <g id="g_male_shakehead" />Blessed Ra! An end to immortality is an end to humanity on Aeternum.<g id="g_female_youknows" /> It is a Great Purge after all, the final one.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_complete_next2: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />Great Ptah, I hope not. But I intend to find out. This will require much research.
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />Our work continues, Sword of Brimstone. I fear we may eventually have to confront Artemis,<g id="g_female_explains" /> and we will need much help if we are to do that.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_description: With the immediate threat stymied and Imhotep stabilized, he has recalled long forgotten memories about a shrine to Artemis somewhere in the northern reaches of Everfall. Visiting it may provide a clue to Adiana's - Artemis's - next move.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_gotopoi: Return to the {POITags} and search for answers
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_incomplete: <g id="g_female_gesturerights" />Have you traveled to the Daughterwell? You may learn more of Artemis’s true intentions.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_investigatevin: Search the area for any hidden markers or shrines to Artemis
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_nodding" />I fear that is what the signs do clearly portend. Though Artemis was known to take human form, her hatred for our species was legendary.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_proposal_b: <g id="g_male_itsokay" />I am not surprised she invested much of her power in the Angry Earth, but where<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> that leads us, I am not sure.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_proposal_next2: <g id="g_male_nod2" />Yes! Yes, that's it! That's the name. Go to the Daughterwell. You must! There may be answers there.

<g id="g_female_leanforwardlisten" />But be careful, if the wrath of an Ancient has been stirred, I pray the<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Light of Ra protects you.<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> Protects us all.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_proposal_next_: <g id="g_female_nodconsider" />Hmm, the Ancients often had shrines they favored, where they received guests.
<g id="g_male_pointrealize" />I recall hearing her shrine featured a small fountain, or a well of some sort. It's likely long gone now.
1624_1001_thewildhuntress_returnlibrary: Return to the Library in New Corsica to warn Imhotep
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_aidlysandra: Aid Lysandra in her investigation of the tremors
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_complete: You found spines? Good gods... I will study these and see what I can glean.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_complete_next: There were stories of colossal elder things that gnawed at the roots of the island. I had believed them to simply be stories.
It does seem to be the source of endless horrors, doesn't it? Thank the gods we have heroes like you.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_complete_prom: "This place never ceases to amaze me."
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_description: One of Imhotep's allies, Lysandra, has sent warning of strange events in the sands. Imhotep has asked you to seek her out and assist her in determining their cause.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_incomplete: <g id="g_female_youknow" />Have you spoken to Lysandra about those strange tremors in the desert?<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> We need to know what is causing them.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_proposal_a: By Ra's Light, let's hope not! I was hoping you could investigate.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_proposal_b: It's impossible to know exactly what Artemis set into motion with her actions at the pyramid. This could be related.
1624_1101_tremorsinthesand_proposal_next: Go and speak to Lysandra. See what she knows.
If this is another one of Artemis's weapons, it's best we know it and find a way to counter it.
The Ancients spawned all manner of terrible things in aeons past.
When I first arrived, there were already legends of monstrous beings that once threatened the very existence of Aeternum.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub01: I'm not sure why you've come here. You cannot stop what I have begun.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub02: The threat of Corruption was dire, but the toll you exacted from the Motherwell, the damage you wrought...\nit will take generations to heal.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub03: I foolishly came to the aid of humanity, and once again, this is how we were repaid.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub04: It is proven again, Humanity is the true source of all evils, a vessel for Corruption,\na plague to nature, and you are a prime example.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub05: Another of my kind lies dreaming in these sands, but he will soon be awakened.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub06: And together, we will purge this island of your kind and restore Aeternum to the paradise it was meant to be.
1624_adianaakhetse_sub07: Begone from here. There is nothing you can do.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_complete_a: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ha! You’ve done it! My instincts are never wrong!<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> Well, not when it’s important.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_complete_b: He he!<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> You will be envied by many, admired by all, and desired by an obsessive few.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_complete_n: <g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />Upon a closer inspection of such a striking visage, I amend that to many!
Now that you’ve proven yourself,<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> I am compelled to ask for your help again.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_defeatlegi: Defeat the waves of Legion attackers
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_descriptio: A troubled woman at the Refugee Caravan has warned of an impending attack by the Corrupted Legion, and has asked for your help to defend the civilians.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_gototrigvo: Engage the Legion before they reach the refugee camp
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_incomplete: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" priority="high" />These people are refugees, not soldiers. They can’t repel an assault by the Corrupted Legion.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> Please stop those vicious murderers!
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" bin="1" bout="2" />When I want something. We’re in desperate need of capable warriors!
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_worry" />A terrible enemy, the Corrupted Legion, lays siege to this land. These people are trying to<g id="g_female_gesturelefts" /> flee the conflict and get to safety.
1625_0100_brimstoneundersiege_proposal_n: Ah, we’re in luck then! I feel<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" bin="2" bout="2" /> an attack on this camp is imminent. They're<g id="g_female_gestureforward01" bin="2" bout="2" /> likely to come from the northwest. Could you scout the sands in that direction?
I pray you're as<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" bin="2" /> capable as you look!
<g id="g_male_headshakeno" />No, I’m just helping however<g id="g_litearmor_handheart" /> I can. I am Ghazi Laghmani, a scribe and scholar.
<g id="g_litearmor_concerns" priority="high" />We have no way to fight these fearsome<g id="g_female_handsforwardrequest" /> foes. But I’m hoping you do. Can you help us?
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_complete_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />You’ve returned! To be honest, I wasn't sure if you would.<g id="g_litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high" /> What’s this? A journal page?
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_complete_b: Imhotep<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> took Aban with him! He’s a fellow scribe and dear friend. Where could they have gone?
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_complete_nex: I must find out! But there’s a looming crisis we must deal with first. I<g id="g_female_apologetic" /> hope I'm not becoming a burden but heroes are hard to find.
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_description: Ghazi Laghmani has asked for any possible assistance in finding her teacher, the Great Sage Imhotep, last seen near The Acropolis.
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_findpath: Find the path to climb and reach the journal page
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_incomplete: <g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />Have you found any sign of the Great Sage Imhotep?<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> We desperately need his wisdom.
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_interact: Follow the trail of the discarded Legion equipment
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />The Great Sage of Brimstone! Oldest<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" /> living soul on Aeternum, friend to the Ancients, architect of the Great Pyramid at Akhet!
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />He is more valuable than the Library at Alexandria!
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_proposal_nex: <g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />Heh. Am I that transparent? You’d be doing Brimstone Sands a great service.
He was<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> traveling to The Acropolis and was supposed to send word when he arrived. But it never came. Start your search there.
<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" />He’s also committed to stopping the Corrupted Legion. If anyone can do it, it’s him.
But he’s gone missing.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> He does this occasionally. Well, frequently, actually,<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> but this time I feel something terrible has happened!
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_proposal_pro: “You want me to search for him?”
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_read_lore: Read the journal entry, 'A Mysterious Threat'
1625_0101_thegreatarchitect_searchclues: Search for any signs of Imhotep
1625_0102_1hlongsword_t5_description: Recovered from the grasp of Corrupted Legionnaires.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_complete_a: I was<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" bin="1" bout="1.5"/> hoping to see your striking visage again! And your aura of<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> confidence has grown. That can only mean victory, yes? Well done!
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_complete_b: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />The Corrupted Legion will think twice before attacking innocent refugees again.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_complete_next: <g id="g_litearmor_realize" />You read my mind, you wily oracle! Imhotep's wisdom may be the only thing<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> that can save us from this relentless foe. I pray he’s safe and sound.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_description: Ghazi has received word that the Corrupted Legion is preparing an even larger assault on the Caravan. While she heads north to search for Imhotep, she has asked you to attack the Legion directly at their garrison of Crassus's Rise.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_gotopoi: Strike the Legion at {POITags} to prevent the attack on Wikala al-Waha
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_incomplete: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />If you thin the ranks at the Legion garrison, that might take the fight out of those vicious brutes.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> And believe me, they have it coming.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Noticed that, did you? They’re the original Romans who<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> founded New Corsica centuries ago.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_proposal_b: They were once Brimstone’s noble protectors. But after a terrible<g id="g_male_dismissgetlost1" /> tragedy, Corruption turned them into a scourge.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_proposal_next: Your guess is<g id="g_female_nodshrugokay" bin="1" /> as good as mine. Not even Imhotep knows. But let's focus on the matter at hand!

<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />The Legion fortress lies to the northwest.<g id="g_female_smackfist" /> Hit it hard. I’ll try and pick up Imhotep’s trail. I'll<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> meet you outside the fortress. Good luck!
<g id="g_male_whocares" priority="high" bout="1.5" />Don't get me started! It has been a blight on this land for thousands of years.
It was a plague<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> even to the Ancients when they walked these sands. It unleashed a terrible cataclysm.
1625_0102_preemptivestrike_proposal_prom: “Is that why the Ancients are gone?”
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_carthagoene: Assault the Lost Bandits in Carthago:
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_complete: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You’ve returned! By Isis, you're tougher than old crocodile leather.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> But your look is so grim. I’m afraid to ask…
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_complete_ne: <g id="g_female_lookconcern" />Oh no, my poor, sweet Aban! What happened to him?<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> Did he say anything?
<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" bout="1.5" />What the hell does that mean?<g id="g_litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high" /> And what’s this? Another journal page?
<g id="g_litearmor_worry" />Oh my dear master! What could’ve befallen him?<g id="g_female_smackfist" /> Damn my eyes, I should’ve been by his side!
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_defeatambus: Survive the ambush by the Angry Earth
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_description: Imhotep continues to investigate a new threat, heading west toward Carthago. Once found, Ghazi anxiously awaits news of his return at Cavalier's Rest.
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_gotonewrhac: Follow Aban's instructions and continue on toward {POITags}
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_incomplete: <g id="g_female_clasphandsconvince" />Have you searched Carthago for any signs of Imhotep and Aban? We must find them!
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_investigate: Search Carthago for any signs of Imhotep
Search New Rhacotis for Imhotep's whereabouts
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_leavenewrha: Follow the northern road out of New Rhacotis
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />I’m afraid it’s… complicated. You see, when someone lives as long as Imhotep, their mind can become<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> full and sometimes spill, like a vessel holding too much water.
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_proposal_b: Thoughts, ideas,<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> they can all become jumbled.
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_proposal_ne: Of<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> course! He holds more knowledge than anyone else in the world.<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> We just have to be patient with him.

<g id="g_litearmor_gestureforwardrighthand" />There's an outpost that way called Cavalier's Rest. Please<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />, search Carthago. Find Imhotep and bring him there.<g id="g_male_convince02" /> I've come to rely on you. Don't let me down.
<g id="g_male_waghand01" />No, he’s not! His mind has simply had to contend with<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> so much. Centuries and centuries of memories.
We were<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> never meant to live this long. Imhotep has said so on many occasions.
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_read_lore: Read the journal entry, 'The Malevolence Grows'
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_rhacotisene: Eliminate the threats within New Rhacotis
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_searchtempl: Investigate the temple for signs of Imhotep
1625_0103_stirringinthesands_talkto_aban: My master Imhotep… gone to New Rhacotis… I was to collect Ghazi… meet him there… I didn’t see them… didn’t hear them…
Those things! *cough* Those horrible things… You must warn Imhotep… the sands… have come alive…
1625_0201_2hstafflife_t5_description: This weapon thrums with a seething intensity.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_collectitem: Defeat {targetName} and collect the {itemName} to free Imhotep
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_complete_a: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You made it! You're becoming as reliable as the dawn!
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_complete_b: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Imhotep arrived a short while ago. He was quite impressed with his gallant rescuer.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_complete_nex: <g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />Oh, I could kiss your striking visage! Repeatedly! Thankfully Imhotep was still in one piece.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_description: With the ambush by the Angry Earth, Ghazi is certain they are responsible for Imhotep's disappearance. She knows the Angry Earth have been seen around Jupiter's Grove, and asks again for your continued help in finding Imhotep.\n\nGhazi's scouts have reported that you will need a ranged weapon to complete this task.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_destroynodul: Destroy the exposed nodules of the driftwood cage with a ranged weapon
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_findimhotep: Search for the captive Imhotep in {POITags}
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_gotolibrary: Seek out Ghazi and Imhotep in New Corsica
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_gotopoi: Search for Imhotep among the Angry Earth in {POITags} [Ranged Weapon Required]
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />Angry Earth? They must have attacked Imhotep. I’ve never heard of them wandering that far.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_think" priority="high" />What could they have wanted? There are few Angry Earth here and they normally gather at Jupiter’s Grove.
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_proposal_nex: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Oh, I'm really developing an affection for you! Go and see what you can find.<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> I'll head to New Corsica to see what I can find.
<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" />I feel terrible about sweet Aban's fate...
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_returnimhote: Return to Imhotep and free him
1625_0201_ablossomingthreat_talkto_imhot: <g id="g_male_compliment" bout="2" />Ah. Brilliantly done, youngster! I could tell by your show of martial prowess that you are highly trained.
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />Now, let me guess – Ghazi sent you. Am I right?
<g id="g_male_nodunderstand" />Remarkable woman! A brilliant mind for one so young.
<g id="g_male_shakehead" />But we mustn’t waste any time. Something evil stirs in the sands.<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> I’ll meet you both in New Corsica. There’s much to do!
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Well, you certainly seem to have stirred up this hornet’s nest, youngster!
<g id="g_female_nodshrugokay" />Sadly, I find myself a prisoner of these elemental beings or else I’d offer my assistance.
Then this is a fortuitous day for us<g id="g_male_handheart" priority="high" /> both for I am he!
<g id="g_female_gesturedown" priority="high" />There’s a sandy monstrosity that seems to have a way to release these unusual bonds.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> But I doubt it’ll simply hand it over.
1625_0201_animatedsands_description: A handful of strange sand, moving under its own power.
1625_0202_imhotepscroll_displayname: Read the Legacy of the Ancients
1625_0202_pastprologue_complete_a: Ah, my skilled and cunning rescuer! Ghazi has regaled me with accounts of your valorous deeds. I found them most engaging!
1625_0202_pastprologue_complete_multi_01: <g id="g_male_why" />I am NOT BEING LOUD! I'm simply worried about you-<g id="g_litearmor_whatwantfromme" /> think about Aban!
1625_0202_pastprologue_complete_multi_02: <g id="g_male_righthandangry" />Do you think I could ever forget Aban?
1625_0202_pastprologue_complete_next: I would imagine so. But I’m afraid those must wait for now. There is grim work ahead and much to do!
1625_0202_pastprologue_description: While Imhotep recuperates from his recent tribulations, Ghazi has suggested you read Imhotep's 'Legacy of the Ancients' and learn of the impact the Ancients had on Brimstone Sands.
1625_0202_pastprologue_incomplete: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Have you looked at Imhotep’s scroll? I think you’ll find it illuminating.
1625_0202_pastprologue_interact_cinemati: Read the tome, 'Legacy of the Ancients'
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />The Pontifex Charmion, a spiritual leader here for many years.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> She was once very wise, but she’s lost her way.
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Unfortunately, New Corsica has suffered under her guidance.<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" /> Guard your words carefully in her presence.
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_next2_a: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />I’ve never seen him so troubled. Honestly, it scares me.
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_next2_b: <g id="g_litearmor_realize" />Oh, he wanted you to consult a scroll. He said it would<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> shed light on our current situation.<g id="g_litearmor_gestureright" priority="high" /> It’s just there on the table.
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />He’s recovering from his ordeal. Although relatively unharmed,<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> it had a greater impact on him than he was willing to say.
1625_0202_pastprologue_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />He’s taking restorative elixirs to help him focus his mind.
1625_0502_alligatorteeth_description: Teeth pulled from the mouth of an angry alligator.
1625_0502_aquabittern_description: A bitter solution remaining after salt has been removed from sea water.
1625_0502_imhotepremedy_description: A concoction from local herbs, created by Ghazi to aid the symptoms of Aeon Madness.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_complete: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Oh great Osiris! Imhotep is gone!
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_complete_ne: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />He started ranting about saving us! He raced out the door! I couldn’t stop him!
<g id="g_female_notsure" />I was going to go after him but I knew it was wiser to wait for your<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> return. I'm no warrior.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_craftremedy: Craft Imhotep's Remedy at an Arcane Repository or Campsite
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_description: Adiana's revelation at the pyramid has caused Imhotep's Aeon Madness to assert itself, and Ghazi has asked for help in gathering local herbs needed to treat the Great Sage. She will attempt to calm Imhotep while you prepare the recipe.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_gatheringre: Gather the ingredients to create Imhotep's Remedy
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_incomplete: <g id="g_male_why" />Imhotep's mind teeters on the edge! We need the improved elixir to heal him!
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_incomplete_: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />Imhotep says the Ancients are not gods! Not in the sense that we think of them, anyway.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />But I share your concern, for there is no doubt they wield power like gods.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_ingredientc: Gather {itemName} from Cacti throughout Brimstone Sands
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_ingredientt: Collect {itemName} from {targetName}s north of New Corsica
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />I devised a more potent formula but I’ve run out of the materials to create it.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />I don't even know if it'll work. But I can't leave his side. Not now!
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_proposal_ne: <g id="g_litearmor_itemgiveright" />I have it here, along with the formula!
<g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Please prepare it and return as quickly as possible. I’ll try and keep Imhotep calm.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> I can see he’s barely hanging on.
1625_0502_scourgeaeonmadness_talkto_imho: <g id="g_female_leanbackdrugged" />When he returns, we will suffer his wrath!<g id="g_male_wavehandsnobig" /> He will punish us!<g id="g_male_noway" /> I must intercede! I must save the people!
<g id="g_male_nodproud" />The Lord of the Red Land will awaken… His wisdom and power are vast…
<g id="g_female_sympathyhandsheart" />This need not be our ruin… this could this be our salvation!
<g id="g_male_spreadhands" />I am no pharaoh! I am the Keeper of Mysteries, Guardian of Secrets, Steward of Dreams!
<g id="g_female_explains" />I obey the masters in all things… I am but a humble servant...
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_adjustprojector: Adjust the position of the projector
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_complete: Retrieve the Eye of Horus! Use your staff! Track its potent quintessence!
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_complete_next: I’m with you… I’ll guide you if I can… Go, quickly!
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_description: A golden Eye of Horus, covered in a thin sheen of azoth quintessence.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_details: Ghazi's concern at Imhotep's flight is evident, and she begs your assistance in chasing him down. He ran toward the Gates of Sutekh, ranting about the Eye of Horus and the return of the gods.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_entervault: Pass through the Ancient Glyph door and explore the sealed chamber
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_incomplete: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" /> Go to the Gates of Sutekh. Imhotep is there searching for the Eye of Horus. You must find it before he does!
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_investigateprojecto: Investigate the strange energy source on the wall
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_investigatevault: Investigate the building indicated by the beam
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_a: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />He must be headed to the Gates of Sutekh. They lie to the west.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_b: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />Many believe that site to be both cursed and sacred. Imhotep's looking for the Eye of Horus.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_next2_a: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />You have the new elixir! Perhaps it can soothe Imhotep’s raging mind.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_next2_b: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />Whatever happens, please remember that the good, gentle man is still there.<g id="g_male_why" /> You just have to find him again!
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />I’ve never seen it, but Imhotep’s mentioned it a few times.
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />It’s a key of some kind. Whatever it is, if<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> Imhotep wants it so badly, it’s vital that we find it first!
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_proposal_prompt2: “What if Imhotep is too far gone?”
1625_0601_eyeofhorus_rotatereflector: Rotate the reflectors to project the beam of Azoth forward
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_climbpillar: Search for a path up the pillars to reach Imhotep
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_codepillar: Use the Eye of Horus on the Ancient Code Pillar
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_complete_a: <g id="g_male_compliment" />You have the code! Excellent! Ghazi’s faith in you is not misplaced.<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> Her instincts are never wrong.
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_complete_b: <g id="g_female_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I wish she could see how she would benefit the people of New Corsica.<g id="g_male_spreadhands" /> She must stop hiding.
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_complete_ne: <g id="g_male_waghand02" />Nothing to be concerned over. You have far more important matters to worry about at the moment.
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_description: The Eye of Horus has been taken, but droplets of quintessence form a path to follow. Imhotep, or perhaps something worse, must be at the end of the trail.
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_imhotep_com: Witness the power of the Ancients! Feel their wrath!
I am the Keeper of Mysteries! Guardian of Secrets!
Even you cannot stand against the Ancients! Stop fighting me!
End this pointless battle! Join me! You can aid my efforts to appease the gods!
Aeternum belongs to the Ancients! Let them reclaim it! It has been nothing but a curse on our people!
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_imhotep_tau: You are making a grave mistake! You do not understand what is happening here! Leave now and pray for Sutekh’s mercy!
You are making a grave mistake! You do not understand what is happening here!
Leave now and pray for Sutekh’s mercy!
I do not wish to hurt you! Abandon this course of action! I will stop you if I must!
I was mistaken! The Ancients are gods! We must appeal to their benevolence! Go back!
Ghazi needs you! Return and protect her! She is far more than she seems! I beg you to see reason!
This is your last warning! I will unleash the fury of the Ancients! Don’t force my hand! I beg you!
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_quinttrail: Use the Azoth Staff to follow Imhotep's trail
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_reachimhote: Ascend the ruins to confront Imhotep
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_readlore: Read the journal entry, 'The Book of Gates'
1625_0701_challengingpharaoh_talkto_imho: <g id="g_female_leanbackdrugged" />I am lost in<g id="g_male_clutchhead02" /> darkness... The abyss swallows me…
<g id="g_male_itemgiveright" />Oh. Here, take it. It's the key to unlocking Sutekh’s Necropolis.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> We must hope he's not yet been reawakened.
<g id="g_female_explains" />You will also need a code to enter the Necropolis. Place the Eye on the<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> pedestal further on. It will reveal the code.
<g id="g_male_chuckle" />*cough* Ah, thank the Powers it’s you.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> Please forgive me. I was not myself.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Ra’s Light, this elixir is most potent. And tastes<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> wonderfully of cinnamon. Well done!
“I need the Eye of Horus, Imhotep.”
1625_0701_imhotepsstaff_t5_description: Taken as a trophy from a bout with the darker side of a Great Pharaoh's personality. It seems to be a reflection of something, as if it doesn't feel like it quite belongs here.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_complete: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Have you spoken with Evandrus? What did he say?<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> Do not spare my feelings. Well, maybe spare them<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> just a little…
1625_0902_queenrevealed_complete_next: <g id="g_litearmor_shocked" />Did he really say that? He always was such an idealistic young man.<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> So much like his<g id="g_litearmor_handheart" /> father… His words touch me deeply.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_description: Ghazi's true identity has been revealed - Cleopatra VII Thea Philopater, Queen of Egypt! Her return would bring hope to the people of New Corsica, but Evandrus may have other ideas. Speak with him to determine his feelings.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_incomplete: <g id="g_female_nodshrugokay" />I am still pondering your words. There is so much to consider.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> I thought I had escaped the past.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_a: Yes, but she died long ago. And another woman took her place. A better woman, wiser, stronger, more gentle.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_b: Besides, New Corsica has Evandrus now. The people have no need of a queen.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_delete_: I’m sorry, I should have told you sooner. I wanted to. But I’ve been Ghazi for so long…
My actual name, the one I was given at birth, is Cleopatra.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_multi_0: <g id="g_female_gestureforward02" />Yes, our dear Ghazi is indeed Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt.
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />But a wiser woman took her place.
One with<g id="g_male_why" /> no desire to lead. And New Corsica has Evandrus now.
<g id="g_female_explains" />Evandrus means well, but he lacks experience. He needs your wisdom.
<g id="g_female_headnodding" />An excellent suggestion! Speak with Evandrus. See what he<g id="g_male_spreadhands" /> thinks of Queen Cleopatra’s return.
<g id="g_female_spreadarms" />If both you and Imhotep feel it's for the best- I will consider it.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_multi_1: <g id="g_female_pointthreaten" />But that's the most I'll promise!
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_next: If both you and Imhotep feel this is for the best, then go. I will consider your words, though they weigh heavy on my heart.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_next2_a: No, she's being stubborn! Ghazi, it is time for you to take up the mantle of leadership and guide your people once again.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_next2_b: Evandrus means well, but he’s young and inexperienced. He’ll need your wisdom and infallible instincts.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_proposal_next3: Another excellent suggestion! Go and speak with Evandrus. See what he thinks of Queen Cleopatra’s return. Assuming she consents.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_start_cue: <g id="g_female_notsure" />Our people need Cleopatra, now more than ever.
1625_0902_queenrevealed_talkto_evandrus_: Hail, Hero of New Corsica! Always good to see you.
Forgive me if I seem preoccupied. I am finding the business of running a city a bit overwhelming.
Oh gods! Such an event would be a blessing by Jupiter himself!
The wise queen of Egypt returned to her people. If only this fantasy could be made reality!
I would welcome any help, my friend!
I was trained in weapons, tactics, and military strategy. But I’m afraid I have little experience with politics and governing.
1625_0903_thecoronation_citizenbark1: The Queen has returned? This is a blessing from the gods themselves!
1625_0903_thecoronation_citizenbark2: Queen Cleopatra would certainly liven things up. I wonder if that's a good thing…
1625_0903_thecoronation_citizenbark3: Is this a jest? It isn't? Well, I suppose she couldn't possibly make things worse.
1625_0903_thecoronation_citizenbark4: Queen Cleopatra and Evandrus ruling side by side? You’re describing a dream!
1625_0903_thecoronation_complete: Well, that’s done. Now the real work begins for us.
1625_0903_thecoronation_complete_next2_a: Oh, I'm sure we can come to some mutually beneficial arrangment.
1625_0903_thecoronation_complete_next2_b: But for now, relax and enjoy yourself. You’ve certainly earned it.
1625_0903_thecoronation_complete_next_a: You didn’t think you were going to simply walk away into the sunset, did you?
1625_0903_thecoronation_complete_next_b: You’re the Sword of Brimstone, remember? And I'm now the Queen of Brimstone.
1625_0903_thecoronation_coronationbark_i: We beseech Ra to witness this day! We call upon Cleopatra Thea Philopator, Daughter of Ptah, to be invested with the power to govern.
May she lead the people with wisdom and love. May her reign be a blessing to the land!
1625_0903_thecoronation_coronationevent: Observe the Coronation of New Corsica's ruler
1625_0903_thecoronation_coronationstart: Take your position for the Coronation to begin
1625_0903_thecoronation_description: With Evandrus's support, Cleopatra has consented to retake her position of power. Inform all of New Corsica of her return, then attend her coronation at the Royal Pavilion.
1625_0903_thecoronation_eventbark_evandr: I still can’t believe Queen Cleopatra’s alive. The city rejoices at her return!
I wish my father could've been here to witness this moment.
1625_0903_thecoronation_eventbark_imhote: This is a great day for Brimstone Sands, and you have made it possible. I am glad the gods led you here.
1625_0903_thecoronation_gotopavilion: Rendezvous with Ghazi and Imhotep at the Royal Pavilion
1625_0903_thecoronation_incomplete: <g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" />Have you spoken to the people? I<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> must know how they feel about my potential return.
1625_0903_thecoronation_minglewithnotabl: Mingle with the notables of New Corsica
1625_0903_thecoronation_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />It’s not the challenge that worries me. I’ve faced<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> many perils in the service of Imhotep, as you have seen.
1625_0903_thecoronation_proposal_b: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />I worry that I will fail my people. Again.
1625_0903_thecoronation_proposal_next: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />You sound like Imhotep. He says<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> our mistakes become wisdom and should strengthen us. Do you<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> think I’d be a good queen?
1625_0903_thecoronation_proposal_next2_a: <g id="g_female_waveoffdisdain" />You’re just biased. I still want to know how the<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> people of New Corsica would feel about my return.
1625_0903_thecoronation_proposal_next2_b: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Could you speak with the citizens and learn what’s in their hearts?<g id="g_female_youknows" /> When you’re done, meet us in the Royal Pavilion.
1625_0903_thecoronation_speakgroups: Inform the citizens of New Corsica of Cleopatra's return
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_cleo: So, what did the people have to say?
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_cleo_next: I’m nervous, oddly enough. It’s been so long since I found myself in circumstances like these.
Facing hordes of Angry Earth seems easier at the moment. Please stay close by.
