Very well, then. I will accept this great honor from the people.
Thank you for being so stubborn-- uhm, I mean, for your guidance and wisdom.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_evandrus2: There is no doubt in my mind, you were sent by the gods. You are a hero out of myth.
You will forever have an ally and friend in me.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_evandrus_: I still can’t believe Queen Cleopatra’s alive. The city rejoices at her return!
I wish my father could've been here to witness this moment.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_gideon_a: They said this was a land of miracles. I had begun to believe it was simply a land of nightmares.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_gideon_b: I am glad to see that I was wrong.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_imhotep: This is a great day for Brimstone Sands, and you have made it possible. I am glad the gods led you here.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_imhotep2_: I shall return to the library. There are still matters that require investigation.
As for you, be sure to celebrate this moment with appropriate wild abandon. If you overdo it, come see me for some herbal remedies.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_nuru: I am filled with joy! I never thought I’d live to see such a wondrous event. And it’s all thanks to you, my non-believer.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_severan_a: This is the dawning of a new day for our city and our people.
1625_0903_thecoronation_talkto_severan_b: There will be great work ahead of us, but we are up to the challenge.
1650_0101_ancientgadget_description: Some sort of mysterious device from an ancient civilization.
1650_0201_attunementgem_description: In the right hands, these beautiful gems are a powerful tool.
1651_0101_ancienttablet_description: A rune-etched tablet, written by a scribe long, long before you were born.
1651_0101_charmionsjournal_description: Notes, penned in a bold hand, about the Ennead Codex.
1651_0201_primekeyfragment_description: An oddly shaped fragment, twisted with strange metallic fibers.
1651_0301_forgeignition_description: A dark prism with a mysterious inner light. Tingles to the touch.
1655_0101_memento_01_description: The rusted insignia of a dignified warrior.
1655_0101_memento_02_description: An abandoned insignia from a mighty warrior.
1655_0101_memento_03_description: A rank insignia from a noble warrior.
1655_0201_hydrasbreath_description: A heavy glass flacon filled with an explosive substance. Handle with care.
1655_0201_memento_04_description: The precious keepsake of a loyal warrior.
1666_0101_audiencewithpontifex_complete: The Light of Truth has blessed you! Now, speak to the Pontifex. You will benefit from her wisdom.
1666_0101_audiencewithpontifex_descripti: Prelate Razin has blocked you from speaking with Pontifex Charmion until you have gained an understanding of the True Gods, and the threat posed the Legion. Read the ‘Legacy of Rome’, then speak with the Prelate again.
1666_0101_audiencewithpontifex_incomplet: You must meditate on the Sacred Scroll of Awakening if you wish to speak to Pontifex Charmion.
1666_0101_audiencewithpontifex_proposal_: It will reveal the truth of what afflicts this land. It must be made known to all who enter here.
Go to the sacred scroll, embrace its wisdom. It will place you on the path to enlightenment.
Once you have done so, the Pontifex will acknowledge you as a Seeker of Truth. She can be very generous to seekers. Go forth and seek!
1679_0101_desertcerate_description: A heavy cream to protect against the harsh desert sun.
1679_0101_frostcliffberry_description: A cold berry that maintains its frosty temperature long after being picked.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_collectfisho: Collect Fish Oil from Salvaging Fish or at the Trading Post
1679_0101_striderofthesands_complete_a: Ho there! Is that a fellow Soulwarden I see?
1679_0101_striderofthesands_complete_b: I hope<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> this means the residents of this place will get the assistance they need. I've done what I can, but it is far from enough.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_complete_nex: I suggest you speak to the others in this camp, especially that young woman over<g id="female_pointLeft" /> there. She has been responsible for organizing much of this, and can explain the current situation.
Thank you<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" /> again, comrade. You have brought hope where there was none.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_craftcerate: Mix the Desert Cerate at an Arcane Repository or Campsite
1679_0101_striderofthesands_description: Soulwarden Kovalenko has lost contact with an ally rendering aid to refugees.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_enterbrimsto: Enter Brimstone Sands and begin the search for Soulwarden Buhawi
1679_0101_striderofthesands_gatheringred: Find the ingredients for the Desert Cerate
1679_0101_striderofthesands_incomplete: My good friend Buhawi is attempting to help the people of Brimstone Sands.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_proposal: Another Soulwarden,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> Buhawi, has been organizing the refugees, helping in any way he can.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> I haven't heard from him for some time.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_proposal_nex: From a tidbit of Yonas's knowledge, we were able to reconstruct the formula for the needed cerate. I believe... yes, this is the list of supplies he needed.
Brew and apply the Desert Cerate, and it will allow you to walk the sands unscathed. Then please, find Buhawi.
1679_0101_striderofthesands_southgate: Journey to Ebonscale Reach and approach the gate to Brimstone Sands
1679_0101_striderofthesands_usecerate: Apply the Desert Cerate to protect against the weather of Brimstone Sands
1683_zahur_00_greet_a: Brimstone Sands has been my home for centuries.
1683_zahur_00_greet_b: I refuse to leave with nothing to remember the place where I finally found love and happiness.
1683_zahur_01_greet_a: I tried to leave, I really did. I had every intention! When I reached this camp, my heart demanded I stop.
1683_zahur_01_greet_b: Here in this desert, I found everything I wanted in life, and I cannot leave empty-handed.
1683_zahur_02_greet: I feel more optimistic about my journey now, free to remember the love I had… but still able to move forward.
1684_tahirah_00_greet: These sands, they move… in a most unnatural way. Do you see? There! They quiver with energy. Dark days are coming…
1684_tahirah_01_greet_a: Careful for your step, traveler. The sands, they come alive! The earth strikes back with angry vengeance!
1684_tahirah_01_greet_b: I wrote the scrolls, in my own hand, but even I had come to doubt such horrors ever existed… until now.
1684_tahirah_02_greet: You may be the only hope this desert has.
1685_acario_00_greet: The 19th Legion should be remembered with honor, with reverence, not with terror and disgust.
1685_acario_01_greet_a: Know this, friend. The 19th Legion was not always dedicated to darkness. It was once the most valiant legion in all of Rome.
1685_acario_01_greet_b: The 19th stayed loyal to Mark Antony even as Alexandria fell. They escorted Antony and the Queen here…
1685_acario_02_greet: Progress on that damned statue has really been set back after your assault. Well done, friend!
1686_qabalah_00_greet: Believe it or not, our people once thought it was from this Temple that the sun was set afire each day.
1686_qabalah_01_greet_a: Behold the glorious Lamp of Osiris, wayfarer! This sacred temple was once believed to be where the gods set the sun afire each day.
1686_qabalah_01_greet_b: The fallacy of our faith was exposed centuries ago, but the Temple should still be ours.
1686_qabalah_02_greet_a: It is a tragedy we were blocked from so many of the sacred temples we once helped to build.
1686_qabalah_02_greet_b: But you retrived the Spark of Osiris, and that is something indeed.
1687_clarisse_00_greet_a: If you're headed towards Jupiter's Grove, beware. The dangers of the grove have multiplied in a matter of weeks.
1687_clarisse_00_greet_b: Elementals now haunt the place, and they are vengeful towards humanity.
1687_clarisse_01_greet_a: Oh, you there. Are you by chance headed into Jupiter's Grove? Are you aware of what's befallen that site?
1687_clarisse_01_greet_b: The Grove is now overrun with Elemental entities, and I cannot get by them.
1687_clarisse_02_greet_a: Habibah sent word that the waters of the thermae once again restore the health of all guests to New Corsica.
1687_clarisse_02_greet_b: Thank you for your help. And of course for your utmost discretion on this matter.
1689_coin_desc: Also called a Signaculum, these coins were used to identify Roman troops.
1689_exp_coins_complete: My thanks, friend. Over time, hope rots and poisons the heart. At least this way, the loved ones of our fallen can have closure.
1689_exp_coins_complete_2: It’s grim, but knowing that those they cherished will never return may set them free to find a new path forward. Forever is a terribly long time to mourn.
1689_exp_coins_cooldown: I am grateful for you help, friend. I will return these coins to their families. Afterwards I may yet have further need of you.
1689_exp_coins_desc: A Roman is searching for memoriabelia of his departed friends.
1689_exp_coins_incomplete: I implore you, stranger… help me perform this last act of service.
1689_exp_coins_proposal: I was once courier to the lord Crassus and his legion. He dispatched me to seek reinforcements during his battle to secure this once-sacred place.
1689_exp_coins_proposal_2: But I was careless in my haste and was struck down on the road. When I returned, my former comrades were stone, and the legion defeated.
1689_exp_coins_proposal_3: Yes. But they serve a strange new master now. I cannot abide such evil. My honor is lost to me. I wish only to give their loved ones some closure.
1689_exp_coins_proposal_4: Before the ages took us, each legionary wore a lead coin inscribed with their family name worn as a necklace.
1689_exp_coins_proposal_5: If you find any legionaries that still bear this insignia, bring them to me, and I will inform their families.
1689_roman_00_defaultdialog: If you value your sanity, leave this place. There is no knowledge or power inside, only madness.
1689_roman_01_defaultdialog: Tread carefully, friend. There is naught but despair within these walls. You shall find no redemption here…
16_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_a: An adventurer with style? For a moment, I thought you were a mirage.
16_00_outfitter_defaultdialog_b: Let's preserve your flair and your face. Come to me when you find an outfit you love. I'll give it the powers you need.
16_00_outfitter_transmog_response_a: My mother taught me the ancient art of Al Sadu. We make simple weaves with natural materials back home.
16_00_outfitter_transmog_response_b: But, when I applied those same techniques here, I was able to transform cloth entirely.
16_s_03_gnawedpotion_description: Chewed up and covered with drool, but the liquid inside should be safe.
16_side_01_alternate: Study the Ancient Glyph "EYBUE" on the chest
16_side_01_chest: Use the Ancient Glyph "EYBUE" to open the sealed chest at Satet
16_side_01_glyph: Use Your Azoth Staff to unseal the Glyph
16_side_01_glyphs_complete_a: Well? A fascinating experience, wasn't it? Knowing the meaning of the glyph acted as a key for you.
16_side_01_glyphs_complete_b: Ha ha! I believe there are twenty-six glyphs in total, though I've only begun my search for them.
16_side_01_glyphs_complete_next_a: To an adventurer like you, I'm sure the glyphs will unlock innumerable doors and hidden secrets.
16_side_01_glyphs_complete_next_b: To a scholar like me, they could reveal more of the Ancients than we've ever known.
16_side_01_glyphs_description: William Heron seeks an intrepid adventurer to search for Ancient Glyphs. Collect the glyph at the ruins of Satet, discover its purpose, and return to Heron in New Corsica.
16_side_01_glyphs_incomplete_a: Trust me, you'll understand the… oddities of Ancient glyphs better if you find one yourself.
16_side_01_glyphs_proposal_a: Ha ha! Around here, one could blindly throw a stone and hit something interesting.
16_side_01_glyphs_proposal_b: Since you asked, are you eager to help me unravel one of the Ancients' secrets?
16_side_01_glyphs_proposal_next_a: Their language. You may have seen glyphs carved into ruins all over this region. I suspect that those glyphs are part of the Ancients' language.
16_side_01_glyphs_proposal_next_b: Go see one for yourself. Even knowing the glyph grants mystic power.
16_side_01_goto: Travel to {POITags} in search of an Ancient Glyph
16_side_02_goto: Visit the ruins of {POITags} to study Scarab Constructs
16_side_02_minescarabs_complete_a: Oh, these devices look like toys! Can something this small give life to an entire construct?
16_side_02_minescarabs_complete_b: We're like children compared to the Ancients, aren't we? Thank you for indulging my curiosity, and being discreet about it.
16_side_02_minescarabs_complete_next_a: Only that you didn't tell the Pontifex about my request. Others can revere the Ancients, but I think imitation is the highest form of flattery.
16_side_02_minescarabs_complete_next_b: If we could build constructs and monuments to rival theirs… well, I can dream.
16_side_02_minescarabs_description: Eudoxia Dalassema needs someone willing to crack open Anubian Scarab Constructs and mine out the power sources within--preferably without alerting the authorities in New Corsica.
16_side_02_minescarabs_incomplete: The constructs cluster near Khnum, though I've never understood why. The ruin's naught but crumbling walls. Are they guarding something?
16_side_02_minescarabs_proposal_a: Then I have your attention? Excellent.
16_side_02_minescarabs_proposal_b: Have you seen the Anubian Scarabs that patrol the ruins outside New Corsica? They glitter beautifully in the sunlight.
16_side_02_minescarabs_proposal_next_a: Not insects. The scarabs are constructs of the Ancients themselves, and I'm after the secrets of how they were built.
16_side_02_minescarabs_proposal_next_b: What do you say? I'll have a handsome reward waiting if you mine out the source of their power.
16_side_02_scarabcore_description: This faintly humming device animates the scarab constructs that prowl the deserts.
16_side_03_goto: Go east to {POITags}, fight the jackals who attacked Senhyris, and find medicine to treat her wounds
16_side_03_huntjackal_complete_a: Is that medicine? You didn't have to do that. Thank you. For driving off the jackals, and saving my sorry skin.
16_side_03_huntjackal_complete_b: I'm sorry for snapping at you earlier. It WAS lucky you showed up.
16_side_03_huntjackal_complete_next_a: By the gods. You sound like my parents before they… before...
16_side_03_huntjackal_complete_next_b: Anyway, I can make my way back. I'll go straight to camp. No more solo hunts for me.
16_side_03_huntjackal_description: Slay the jackals of Deadwater Den who attacked Senhyris, and find some medicine to treat her wounds.
16_side_03_huntjackal_incomplete_a: Did you lose your nerve? Or maybe you thought better of chasing after jackals.
16_side_03_huntjackal_proposal_a: Do I look all right to you? Between the desert and the beasts, I'm lucky I'm even breathing.
16_side_03_huntjackal_proposal_b: Can't say I feel lucky, though. The jackals never used to be this bold. They're hungry and desperate, just like us.
16_side_03_huntjackal_proposal_next_a: You do that. I'll wait here, useless, and hope the jackals don't come back to finish their meal.
16_side_03_huntjackal_proposal_next_b: There's a big one who's developed a taste for human flesh. Teach her a lesson, and the others should back off.
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_a: Wh-what are you? Bandit? Phantom? Hungry specter? Mercy, mercy, I beg of you!
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_b: Oh dread Pluto, please don't take me yet! I have so much to live for!
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_next2_a: My belongings? You're not a bandit?
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_next2_b: Ah. Please forgive my outburst, that was unbecoming for a man of my station. I'll just be on my way.
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_next_a: W-who's asking? How do I know you're not some unscrupulous ruffian?
16_side_04_saverefugee_complete_next_b: Oh, I never should've left New Corsica! Charmion's sermons were tiresome, but at least I had a warm bed!
16_side_04_saverefugee_proposal_a: The note is almost illlegible , though you can make out a few lines toward the end.
16_side_04_saverefugee_proposal_b: "Damn your stubbornness, Gaius. I don't care how far you have to march. Just get out of New Corsica!"
16_side_05_goto: Travel southeast to {POITags} and find Featherbane the Lion
16_side_05_huntlion_complete_a: Featherbane is gone? That's the first good news I've heard in weeks!
16_side_05_huntlion_complete_b: That wretched cat took everything from me. Turkeys, pheasants, even the peacocks!
16_side_05_huntlion_complete_next_a: Try not to think about this disaster. I thought New Corsica would be a wonderful business opportunity.
16_side_05_huntlion_complete_next_b: Now look at me. I wonder if anybody around here makes a good, strong brew.
16_side_05_huntlion_description: Nesse van Baten wants revenge on "Featherbane" the lion, who has developed an unfortunate taste for domestic poultry. Go to Two-Stones Grotto, then meet back up with Nesse at the nearby Outpost.
16_side_05_huntlion_incomplete_a: I didn't name the lion "Featherbane." One of the other refugees thought it was funny.
16_side_05_huntlion_proposal_a: Help? Hah! That would be a first in this godforsaken wasteland.
16_side_05_huntlion_proposal_b: But you don't look as helpless as everyone else fleeing New Corsica. Tell me, how do you feel about lions?
16_side_05_huntlion_proposal_next_a: Slaughter. One of those thrice-damned cats has been picking off my birds one by one.
16_side_05_huntlion_proposal_next_b: Nothing will bring my birds back, but you could put an end to Featherbane and help me sleep better at night.
16_side_05_huntlion_proposal_prompt: "Depends on what you have in mind."
16_side_06_2hmusket_t5_description: "Someday I will find the place of my death. But not this day."
16_side_06_goto: Travel to {POITags} in search of Ambassador Li
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete: It's you. And since you are unscathed and uncorrupted, I assume you found Ambassador Li? Or he did not make it ashore?
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete_next2_a: In my experience, most people balk at being asked to assassinate someone.
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete_next2_b: Peace, friend. I always intended to compensate you for your efforts. And for the future, I'll remember that you prefer ugly truths to pretty words.
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete_next_a: I'm sure you held your own admirably.
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete_next_b: Li has been a thorn in my side for months, trying to make contact with other Corrupted on behalf of the Empress. A swift, violent demise should set him back nicely.
16_side_06_killdynasty_complete_prompt: "He did. And he tried to kill me!"
16_side_06_killdynasty_description: Huang Xiaoling is looking for a man who may have shipwrecked on the southern coast of Brimstone Sands. Search for any survivors at The Offering, then meet up with Xiaoling at Cavalier's Rest.
16_side_06_killdynasty_incomplete_a: What possessed the Ambassador to keep sailing through such a terrible storm?
16_side_06_killdynasty_proposal_a: Yes, I watched from safety. What was I to do, wade out into the waves and battle them myself?
16_side_06_killdynasty_proposal_b: I think the worst of the storm has passed. So if you're headed toward the shoreline, could you see if anyone survived?
16_side_06_killdynasty_proposal_next_a: Aeternum's storms are cruel, it's true. The man you're looking for is Ambassador Li, from Ebonscale Reach.
16_side_06_killdynasty_proposal_next_b: If you do find him, I'll be at Cavalier's Rest. Please let me know how he fares!
16_side_07_find_notes: Search chests or fallen Sagittarii for Froderico's notes
16_side_07_goto: Search {POITags} for Froderico Renaldi's research notes
16_side_07_helphistorian_complete_a: My notes! Grazie mille, friend. That's my life's work… though it may need some revision.
16_side_07_helphistorian_complete_b: When I was a student, the Romans of old seemed godlike. Titans whose reach spanned the known world.
16_side_07_helphistorian_complete_next_a: I would not judge all Romans by those few who are Corrupted. But it's hard to forget the feeling of iron spearheads sinking into my chest.
16_side_07_helphistorian_complete_next_b: Perhaps a change of academic interest would be best for me.
16_side_07_helphistorian_description: Froderico Renaldi is beside himself after being murdered just outside Castrum Inferos. Recover the unfortunate historian's belongings from the Castrum, and return them to him.
16_side_07_helphistorian_incomplete: If Caesar, Augustus, and Antony could see how far their Roman brethren had fallen… Would they weep at this degeneracy?
16_side_07_helphistorian_proposal_a: I sent a letter to their camp, announcing my intentions to survey their buildings for posterity.
16_side_07_helphistorian_proposal_b: But when I approached, the brutes started hurling pila at me! I woke up here covered in blood, with only the clothes on my back.
16_side_07_helphistorian_proposal_next_a: Tch. You must understand, to an educated historian like me, the Corruption sounds quite ridiculous.
16_side_07_helphistorian_proposal_next_b: Alas, now I've lost all my notes for my trouble. If your travels take you to the nearby Castrum, I would pay well for their return.
16_side_07_historynote_description: Hastily scribbled field notes in a cramped, barely legible Latin shorthand.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_complete_a: You really did it? Climbed the aqueduct and came back in one piece? The last mercenary who passed through just scoffed at me.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_complete_b: What did you find? Ancient tomb guardians? Mysterious artifacts? Hidden treasure?
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_complete_next_a: Even better! I know Monsieur Heron had an interest in those.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_complete_next_b: I admit, I feel a twinge of envy at your prowess. Still, I must thank you for sating my curiosity.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_description: Perrin Mercier discovered a tantalizing mystery in the collapsed Roman aqueduct, but can't climb it himself. Brave the treacherous ascent into the aqueduct, then return to Perrin with your findings.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_incomplete: Be careful, friend. I thought the aqueduct looked easy to climb, and I paid for my hubris.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_proposal_a: Ah. Mostly my ego bruised. Have you read the writings of William Heron? His words inspired me to be an antiquarian.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_proposal_b: So naturally, I set out to climb the ruined aqueduct as soon as I arrived.
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_proposal_next_a: It's harder than it looks! Though maybe not for someone like you?
16_side_08_climbaqueduct_proposal_next_b: I know it sounds absurd, but I saw glimmers of light shining through the stones. I would love to know what they are!
16_side_08_glyph: Use Your Azoth Staff to unseal the Glyph
16_side_08_goto: Access the Aqueduct at {POITags} to search for hidden secrets
16_side_08_goto2: Traverse the Top of the Aqueduct to the Oasis
16_side_09_savearmadillo_complete_a: Her Excellency is returned to me! Behold her twitching nose, her noble banded scales, and her delightful little tail. Ah.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_complete_b: Thank you, brave friend, a thousand thanks and blessings!
16_side_09_savearmadillo_complete_next2_: All forgotten, all forgiven. It is clear that you have also been chosen to serve Lady Flora and her noble relatives.
And should you need advice on the care and pampering of armadillos, you know where to find me.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_complete_next_a: Hm? Her Excellency requires no common, crass speech to make her exalted wishes known.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_complete_next_b: A talking armadillo, what a ludicrous idea! Are you quite well? Did the lions take a swipe at your head?
16_side_09_savearmadillo_proposal_a: Lady Flora, the light of my life and apple of my eye! She was taken from me by wild beasts, and only I escaped.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_proposal_b: I'll never forget the way she looked at me, hurt and betrayal welling in her limpid, black eyes…
16_side_09_savearmadillo_proposal_next_a: Even if you do bring her back, she will castigate my cowardice. But I will endure it to be in her presence again.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_proposal_next_b: The beasts live in the valley west of here. If you can punish them for abducting Flora, all the better.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_talkto_flora_a: You, there. Yes, YOU, human with the slack-jawed face. I hope you can hear me.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_talkto_flora_b: I do not enjoy shrieking into the void, and it's high time that fool Aulus sent someone to fetch me.
16_side_09_savearmadillo_talkto_flora_ne: How impertinent! I have never been more affronted in my life! You will address me correctly as Lady Flora, Her Excellency.
Now, convey me back to my servant, and I will see you richly rewarded.
16_side_10_bookofdead_complete: You return! And you seem sound of mind and body. But what of Psherenamun? Was he still…?
16_side_10_bookofdead_complete_next_a: ...We must have committed some great transgression, to have the afterlife denied to us.
16_side_10_bookofdead_complete_next_b: Thank you for returning the texts. Now please, leave me. My mind is ill at ease.
16_side_10_bookofdead_complete_prompt: "I didn't see him, but I found this."
16_side_10_bookofdead_description: Beautiful illustrations cover this seriously aged scroll.
16_side_10_bookofdead_incomplete_a: Where did we go wrong? Was it the incantations? The images? The mystical names of the judges?
16_side_10_bookofdead_journaldescription: Acolyte Miresis seeks Egyptian funerary rites from his former mentor Psherenamun, who has become Lost. Seek out Psherenamun at Castrum Perdita, take the texts from him, and return to Saboteur's Hideaway.
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_a: Before we came to Aeternum, my people performed nearly two hundred incantations for the dead. But the practice faded long ago.
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_b: Psherenamun, my mentor, tried to reconstruct the old rites to save people from becoming Lost.
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_next2_a: Not as sorry as I am. But if you could retrieve the book of funerary rites from Psherenamun, I would be forever in your debt.
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_next2_b: I haven't given up on saving him, or the other Lost. Not yet.
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_next_a: We thought so. We performed the rite for a young man who was recently Lost. When it failed…
16_side_10_bookofdead_proposal_next_b: The dead man broke his bindings and snapped Psherenamun's neck. Now my mentor wanders with the Lost.
16_side_10_have_book: Collect the scroll of funerary rites
16_side_10_kill_lost: Search for Psherenamun among the Lost
16_side_11_catch_fish: Catch an Extra-Tasty Fish in Brimstone Sands
16_side_11_feedifrit_complete_a: Mrr, the delectable aroma of fish. This is much better than eating you.
16_side_11_feedifrit_complete_b: You're still staring. I promise, my belly is full, and you are in no danger of being eaten.
16_side_11_feedifrit_complete_next_a: So I am. This form suits me. It's powerful yet comfortable, and I can sample the delights of fish.
16_side_11_feedifrit_complete_next_b: Much more enjoyable than being a disembodied spirit of flame who torments your kind. Now begone, I'm overdue for a good, long nap.
16_side_11_feedifrit_description: Bring delicious fish to the Insatiable Flame before he decides to make a snack out of you. You can catch fresh fish from any fishing hotspot in Brimstone Sands.
16_side_11_feedifrit_proposal_a: And I'd rather not go hungry! So what do you mean to do about it, human?
16_side_11_feedifrit_proposal_b: Quickly now, my temper is short when my belly rumbles. I’m sure you know the feeling.
16_side_11_feedifrit_proposal_next_a: Fish! Fresh, not too oily, from the sea if you can find it. But lake fish will do if you can't.
16_side_11_feedifrit_proposal_next_b: Mmm… You may catch some fish for yourself, but no thieving from my share. I'll know if you do.
16_side_11_give_fish: Bring the Extra-Tasty Fish to the Insatiable Flame
16_side_11_tastyfish_description: Perhaps it's wise to save the tastiest fish for the hungry talking lion...
16_side_12_dragonegg_description: Nobody would mistake this ordinary-looking egg for one from a dragon's nest.
16_side_12_gathereggs_complete: Hmm, just by looking at your face, I can see there were no dragons awaiting you. Ah, well. Perhaps they hide elsewhere on Aeternum.
16_side_12_gathereggs_complete_next_a: Oh. What a fine color, and excellent luster. With a little imagination, this will make a perfect dragon's egg.
16_side_12_gathereggs_complete_next_b: What? Haven't you heard of artistic liberty? Add plaster and paint, and there it is. A dragon's egg!
16_side_12_gathereggs_description: Enez de Barros is convinced that there are dragon eggs at the Palace of Nekhbet. Search the reptile nests for eggs of any sort, and bring them back for Enez's inspection.
16_side_12_gathereggs_incomplete_a: My father used to read me the story of Saint George, and I always felt sorry for the dragon.
16_side_12_gathereggs_proposal_a: That's a shame. As a little girl, I loved stories of dragons, and I was hoping to find some for creative inspiration.
16_side_12_gathereggs_proposal_b: Supposedly, many dragons nest in that ruin up the road.
16_side_12_gathereggs_proposal_next_a: Oh. Don't give up so easily! I'm not asking you to SLAY a dragon or anything.
16_side_12_gathereggs_proposal_next_b: Just see if there are dragons, and if they have any eggs. A dragon's egg would be marvelous inspiration for my next sculpture.
16_side_13_have_spinea: Search the Pyramid's west side for clues
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_complete: Don't take this the wrong way, friend, but you look like you've seen terrible things. I'm not going to like what you found, am I?
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_complete_next_a: What… are these? Did something SHED these?
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_complete_next_b: I don't think there's anything we could do about a creature of that size. Except perhaps pray that it passes us by.
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_description: Lysandra is distressed by strange tremors that have recently rocked the Great Pyramid of Akhet. Survey the area around the pyramid's base, and find evidence of what is causing the tremors.
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_incomplete_a: If you see something bigger than you, run. If it's bigger and faster, hide.
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_incomplete_b: And if you wake up more of those guardians, for God's sake, don't drag them back to camp with you!
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_proposal_a: See the pyramid? Quiet for eons, but tremors started beneath its base a few weeks ago.
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_proposal_b: The shaking turns the sand beneath your feet into a death trap.
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_proposal_next_a: The Ancients keep their treasures well-guarded. Why shouldn't they shake the ground out from under us?
16_side_13_scoutpyramid_proposal_next_b: I'll gladly pay you to find the causes of these tremors. If the earth is going to swallow me up, I'd like to know why.
16_side_13_wormspine_description: Each jagged spine measures as long as a person's forearm.
16_side_14_helplovers_incomplete_a: The first time I saw her, she was like a breath of fresh air in a mausoleum.
16_side_14_helplovers_incomplete_b: My Margarete deserves better than my wretched family hounding us.
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_a: It would take all day to list out their offenses!
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_b: Your pardon, though. My temper's short of late, and that's no reason to snap at passersby. Call it the impatience of a lovesick heart.
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_next2_a: You're serious? Well, you're peculiar, but I won't say no.
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_next2_b: Margarete loves flowers, and she has an insatiable sweet tooth. When you've set everything up, find Margarete and tell her I sent you.
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_next_a: I only wish to share a private dinner with my dear Margarete. That's hardly extreme.
16_side_14_helplovers_proposal_next_b: But my family can't abide me "taking up" with someone who isn't from the old patrician class. As if THAT matters on an island where we live forever or go mad.
16_side_14_helplovers_talkto_margarete_a: Have we met before? Why are you looking at me so intently?
16_side_14_helplovers_talkto_margarete_b: I haven't been in New Corsica very long, but surely I don't stand out that much.
16_side_14_helplovers_talkto_margarete_n: Really? She talked about asking someone to help us, but I never dreamed she'd really do it.
Thank you, thank you! May you be as blessed in love as we are.
Huh? Did she sneak out of her villa again? She's been doing that to see me without her family's permission.
I keep telling her I don't want her to get in trouble, but… Lavinia's insistant. And quite irresistable.
16_side_15_helpsobek_complete_a: Back already? And there's no stench of blood on you. You have quick hands and a kind heart.
16_side_15_helpsobek_complete_b: Thank you for your consideration toward my friends. Few would think much of slaying a crocodile.
16_side_15_helpsobek_incomplete_a: The crocodiles will not recognize you, and some may be wary. I ask that you do not hurt them.
16_side_15_helpsobek_proposal_a: Well, it's certainly fortuitous for me, for I find myself in some trouble. Thoughtless hunters placed traps in the canyon for my friends.
16_side_15_helpsobek_proposal_b: These old hands aren't what they used to be. Could you disarm those traps, so my friends may roam freely again?
16_side_15_helpsobek_proposal_next_a: Hmph. Indeed. I dedicated many years to the god Sobek, and in return, the crocodiles treated me with respect and friendship.
16_side_15_helpsobek_proposal_next_b: Descending into the canyon is harder for me now, but I do my best to look out for my friends' interests.
16_side_16_glyph: Use Your Azoth Staff to unseal the Glyph at the Great Shrine
16_side_16_goto: Travel south to {POITags} and search for any clues about unlocking the teleporter gates
16_side_16_goto2: Return to {POITags} and attempt to unlock the teleporter gateway located on the top level
16_side_16_teleporter: Unlock the teleporter gate at the Great Shrine of Thoth
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_complete: You… what did you do? How did you accomplish that?! I found the very same glyph, but I never produced even a flicker of magic!
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_complete_nex: But I'm… no, no, you're right. I mustn't give up on my dreams, even with all my missteps.
Thank you. Someday, I'll be a respected antiquarian in my own right, and I hope you'll be there to see it.
Then knowing the meaning of the glyph is insufficient to give it power. One must understand and embody the concept, whatever it is.
Argh. So that's why my attempts were inadequate.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_description: Emboldened by your success at the aqueduct, Perrin seeks your help to unlock the function of an Ancient stone gateway. Look for clues in the ruins of Hermopolis, then return to Perrin at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_incomplete_a: Oh please, let me know as soon as you've visited Hermopolis.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_proposal_a: That could be. I've never had the chance to compare the different gateways.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_proposal_b: The road from here to Hermopolis is long, and full of scorpions.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_proposal_nex: You will? Then I won't be idle in your absence. These Ancient devices WILL yield their secrets to us.
16_side_16_unlockteleporter_proposal_pro: "I'll take a look if I visit."
16_side_17_goto: Enter the Beds of Ta-Bitjet, clear out egg clutches, and defeat the Scorpion Queen
16_side_17_huntscorpion_complete: I can smell the scorpion ichor from here. Was it a good hunt? Did you learn why these scorpions were so ferocious?
16_side_17_huntscorpion_complete_next: The Ancients left many marvelous and horrifying things behind. It's not the first time I've seen transformations among such creatures…
16_side_17_huntscorpion_description: The naturalist Tamouthis is concerned by the sudden and unnatural proliferation of massive scorpions in the Bubasteum. Venture into the Beds of Ta-Bitjet and slay the scorpion queen who lives there.
16_side_17_huntscorpion_incomplete_a: Hmm… I don't know what's behind the brood's unnatural behavior, but for now, exterminating them is all that matters.
16_side_17_huntscorpion_proposal_a: You're cautious. Good to see that fame and glory haven't gone to your head.
16_side_17_huntscorpion_proposal_b: A massive scorpion queen made her home in a cave complex to the south. I've been watching her brood for a few seasons.
16_side_17_huntscorpion_proposal_next_a: Not only her size, but also the unnatural ferocity of her brood. If they spread further, they'll wreak havoc.
16_side_17_huntscorpion_proposal_next_b: Make your way into the brood lair and destroy some of their eggs. And if you can, slay the queen.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_complete_a: Huh? Can it be? Did you really manage to catch that huge goat?
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_complete_b: Ahh. Oh, you're a marvel, my friend! I'll make sure you get the first bowl of fesenjan.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_complete_next_a: Of course! The more good food in the world, the better.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_complete_next_b: Mind you, this isn't quite what my grandmother made. I've had to get a little creative. I'll call it… Brimstone Fesenjan.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_proposal_a: Oh, we found ourselves a clever one. Well then, clever stranger, how do you feel about jumping up there after them? Hmm…
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_proposal_b: I'd like some meat from the biggest, baddest goat for my stew.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_proposal_next_a: Mmm. The finest fesenjan you've ever had. It's my grandmother's recipe, a little piece of home.
16_side_18_cookfesenjan_proposal_next_b: She always made hers with lamb, but the closest I can find around here are these jumping goats.
16_side_19_climbwall: Climb the rubble to reach the top of the Wall
16_side_19_glyph: Use Your Azoth Staff to unseal the Ancient Glyph
16_side_19_helpwarden_complete_a: You're back! What a relief. I wouldn't know what to say to the other Soulwardens if something happened to our hero.
16_side_19_helpwarden_complete_b: And there's something different about you. You're still you, but with a sharper edge.
16_side_19_helpwarden_complete_next_a: Really? This bizarre shape unlocked your Heartgem? Every time I think the Ancients can't get stranger…
16_side_19_helpwarden_complete_next_b: Anyway, I'll send a missive back to the other Soulwardens. Thank you, for salvaging my mission.
16_side_19_helpwarden_description: <font color="#b2aea1">HEARTRUNE UNLOCK QUEST</font>\nThe Soulwardens sent Anna Rózsa to learn about an intriguing source of power in Brimstone Sands. Unlock your Heartgem's hidden potential at the Great Wall of Nebet-Het, then meet Scout Rózsa at the Palace of Nekhbet.
16_side_19_helpwarden_incomplete_a: Sorry I couldn't tell you more about the Wall. You'll know it when you see it.
16_side_19_helpwarden_proposal_a: You may have heard the rumors, but a Soulwarden's Heartgem can grant additional powers through the etching of specific runes.
16_side_19_helpwarden_proposal_b: I'm looking for a way to unlock that power, and Brimstone Sands seemed like a good place to start.
16_side_19_helpwarden_proposal_next_a: Yes. The most promising site is the Wall of Nebet-het, but it's crawling with guardians.
16_side_19_helpwarden_proposal_next_b: I'm overmatched, I admit. But you… you could get inside. Look for anything that reacts to your Heartgem.
16_side_19_interactscales: Place your Heartgem on the Scales and be judged
16_side_19_nebethetenter: Seek out the entrance to the Wall
16_side_19_opendoor: Use the new knowledge to pass through the sealed door
16_side_19_reachtower: Ascend to the highest point of the Wall
16_side_20_gather_heart: Use your Skinning Knife to remove the heart
16_side_20_helpbastet_complete: You're back with the heart? I have some coin for you. Our business is concluded, and you can be on your way.
16_side_20_helpbastet_complete_next_a: If you insist. In peaceful times, simple sacrifices will do. But our times are far from peaceful, and greater aid calls for greater sacrifice.
16_side_20_helpbastet_complete_next_b: A lion is a truly extraordinary gift. I hope its heart is enough to assuage the gods.
16_side_20_helpbastet_description: The priest Paubastis needs you to venture near the temple ruins of Henkhisesui, slay a lion, and bring back its heart. He promises good payment but refuses to explain why.
16_side_20_helpbastet_incomplete_a: Surely someone like you is accustomed to slaying large wildlife?
16_side_20_helpbastet_proposal_a: A reasonable answer. You know that this land has faced harsh trials lately.
16_side_20_helpbastet_proposal_b: I seek the gods' assistance in meeting those challenges. But to do that, I need someone with different skills from my own.
16_side_20_helpbastet_proposal_next_a: I would not expect an outsider to understand, and I'm only asking for a simple task.
16_side_20_helpbastet_proposal_next_b: The nearby temples are home to many great lions. Find one, carve out its heart, and bring it back to me.
16_side_20_lionheart_description: Still fresh, warm, and dripping with blood.
16_side_22_visitennead_complete_a: You undertook the ancient pilgrimage of the gods? You, an outsider, were honored with their blessings?
16_side_22_visitennead_complete_b: Huh, I never thought I'd see the day. Many wrote of the Path of the Ennead, but few walked it.
16_side_22_visitennead_complete_next_a: Understand something, seeker. Words of faith are easy to speak, but actions of faith are too burdensome for most.
16_side_22_visitennead_complete_next_b: Your determination--some might say stubbornness--is the exception, not the rule.
16_side_23_minesulfur_complete_a: You remembered the sulfur, and you even took care to wrap up each sample!
16_side_23_minesulfur_complete_b: This should be more than enough to test Brimstone sulfur against a variety of other metals.
16_side_23_minesulfur_complete_next_a: I confess, I'm more interested in the theory. I think this type of sulfur should facilitate the arcane flow of--
16_side_23_minesulfur_complete_next_b: I mean, it should allow more potent enchantments. If you try it yourself, let me know.
16_side_23_minesulfur_incomplete_a: You can find sulfur pools all over the desert, but nowhere else on the island.
16_side_23_minesulfur_proposal_a: Well, since you asked, I'll try to explain.
16_side_23_minesulfur_proposal_b: The philosophers tell us that all metals should be composed of mercury and sulfur, with other metals derived by particular ratios. But the sulfur pools-- oh, I've lost you already.
16_side_23_minesulfur_proposal_next_a: Yes! Sulfur from the pools has unusual alchemical properties. I won't trouble you with the details.
16_side_23_minesulfur_proposal_next_b: I'm studying samples, but it's slow going by myself. If you can take sulfur samples during your travels, I'd love to share my findings with you!
16_side_24_huntphantom_complete_a: Ahh! Oh, it's you. Please don't sneak up on me like that. Not after what happened with the face-stealer.
16_side_24_huntphantom_complete_b: I never properly thanked you for saving my life, or slaying that monster.
16_side_24_huntphantom_complete_next_a: I'm… in one piece. I can only imagine what must have happened to the missing surveyors.
16_side_24_huntphantom_complete_next_b: I should feel fortunate, but I don't. Though the fiend is gone, I doubt I'll ever forget it.
16_side_24_huntphantom_incomplete_a: The wailing voices came from the west. I'm sorry I don't have more for you than that.
16_side_24_huntphantom_proposal_a: Others were supposed to meet us at this encampment. Surveyors and laborers, but no one else has arrived.
16_side_24_huntphantom_proposal_b: Yet sometimes, when the moon is high, I can hear distant voices on the wind. Wailing for help.
16_side_24_huntphantom_proposal_next_a: I don't know. The sound came from the west, but I can't abandon my post to seek them out.
16_side_24_huntphantom_proposal_next_b: You're a warrior. Do you ever get the feeling that death haunts your steps? That's how I've felt ever since setting foot here.
16_side_24_huntphantom_talkto_esoeris_ne: Yes. No doubt it's close by, waiting to make a meal of you.
I'm sorry, but I'm in no shape to fight it again. Flee if you wish, but if you can put an end to that creature, I'll sleep better at night.
But I've never seen you before… oh no. The thing you spoke to wasn't me. A face-stealer prowls these sands!
It mimics humans, and lures the unsuspecting into the desert where it devours them. I barely held it off when it turned on me.
16_side_25_cactusflower_complete_a: Ah, you found them. Just as bright and beautiful as the day my Titus came in from the sands.
16_side_25_cactusflower_complete_b: Now I can leave and seek sanctuary in Oxboro. I could never repay your kindness, but take this as some small compensation.
16_side_25_cactusflower_description: A brightly-colored flower that only grows on the cacti of Brimstone Sands.
16_side_25_cactusflower_incomplete: My sweet Titus. I will not leave with nothing to remember him by.
16_side_25_cactusflower_proposal_a: The memories... of my love. Titus and I were friends for decades, but then it blossomed into something more.
16_side_25_cactusflower_proposal_b: He brought me flowers from the desert one day… a day I'll never forget. Now he's fallen to the Legion.
16_side_25_cactusflower_proposal_next_a: You… would do that for me? If I just had some cactus flowers I could preserve, I could keep my memories of Titus and what we had.
16_side_25_cactusflower_proposal_next_b: Yes, please. If you'll collect flowers from the cacti, I would be most grateful.
16_side_25_cactusflower_start: "What is it you can't leave behind?"
16_side_25_cactusflowerquest_description: Collect Cactus Flowers in memory of Zahur's husband and bring them to him in the Camp.
16_side_26_sandthing_01_gotopoi: Enter the grounds of {POITags} and destroy the Sand Walkers
16_side_26_sandthing_02a_defeatsandwalke: Seach for and destroy Sand Walkers
16_side_26_sandthing_complete_a: You have returned the Walkers to the sands! Heroes like you saved us once before.
16_side_26_sandthing_complete_b: Go now, seek out more of the Sand Walkers and destroy them… before they destroy us.
16_side_26_sandthing_description: Defeat the Sand Walkers in The Acropolis for Tahirah.
16_side_26_sandthing_incomplete: These Sand Walkers… they mean to replace us. I swear it. You must strike them down!
16_side_26_sandthing_proposal_a: The sands…. they come to life and walk on two feet! Just like you and me! It is most unnatural!
16_side_26_sandthing_proposal_b: And if history is a lesson, these Sand Walkers tread the path of doom for us! As it was many centuries in the past.
16_side_26_sandthing_proposal_next_a: We must destroy the seed from which they spring, but until then, we can strike the Walkers down where we find them.
16_side_26_sandthing_proposal_next_b: Venture into the Acropolis, brave one, and banish the Walkers back to the sands.
16_side_27_legioninsignia_description: An old, tarnished insignia carried by members of the 19th Legion when they first arrived on Aeternum.
16_side_27_legionpickaxe_description: A pickaxe with which Corrupted members of the 19th Legion were mining ore for the construction of the statue honoring General Crassus.
16_side_27_redeem19th_01_gotopoi: Assault Crassus's Rise and Avenge the Honor of the 19th Legion
16_side_27_redeem19th_02b_killcollect: Confiscate {itemName} from {targetName} to stop the Monument to General Crassus
16_side_27_redeem19th_complete_a: I heard the clamor. It sounded like you dealt those villains a blow that'll shut them down! Well done!
16_side_27_redeem19th_complete_b: And you managed to recover some of the old insignias, as well! You are an ally if ever there was one!
16_side_27_redeem19th_complete_next_a: Ah. Not much more can be done here, but there are other allies in the region.
16_side_27_redeem19th_complete_next_b: Look for Tribune Alaina Kraus during your travels, I suspect she needs support as well. Invictus Aeterna, my friend!
16_side_27_redeem19th_description: Confiscate Pickaxes from the Corrupted 19th, and recover their Legion Insignias for Acario Clemon.
16_side_27_redeem19th_incomplete: We will restore honor to the crest of the 19th Legion, no matter how long it takes.
16_side_27_redeem19th_proposal_a: It is a dark tale I do not care to dwell upon. In recent years, some of us have taken up the banner to restore the Legion's honor.
16_side_27_redeem19th_proposal_b: This blasphemous statue the Corrupted Legion is constructing to honor their leader, General Crassus, is a major setback
16_side_27_redeem19th_proposal_next_a: Aha, I knew you had honor the moment I saw you! Indeed, if you're venturing into the fort, it can be done.
16_side_27_redeem19th_proposal_next_b: Confiscate the pickaxes to stop them from mining, and if you find any old Legion insignias, I'll reward you for them. Godspeed!
16_side_28_lightsout_01_gotopoi: Enter the {POITags} and Destroy the Ancient Anubians
16_side_28_lightsout_02b_killcollect: Search for and Defeat {targetName} to reclaim the sacred {itemName}
16_side_28_lightsout_complete_a: I have not seen anyone challenge the Anubians as you have in many a moon. Indeed, the spirit of the heroes of old lives on in you.
16_side_28_lightsout_complete_b: You have restored the Spark to humanity, where it belongs. Thank you.
16_side_28_lightsout_description: Once Priestess of the Lamp of Osiris, Qabalah asks you to destroy the Ancient Guardians that contol the temple and retrieve the sacred Spark of Osiris from the Lamplighter. The Lamplighter ascends the ruins at day, but descends into a hidden chamber at night.
16_side_28_lightsout_incomplete: The Lamplighter appears above at day, but cycles into the bowels of the temple at night. There is a way, but it is not easily seen.
16_side_28_lightsout_proposal_a: The Ancient Anubians, servant-constructs to the Ancients themselves. They prevent humans from trespassing.
16_side_28_lightsout_proposal_b: But it was we who helped build the temple, and though it is not divine, the Spark of Osiris belongs to us.
16_side_28_lightsout_proposal_next_a: Ah, so you aspire to walk in the steps of the heroes of old? I welcome your aid, then.
16_side_28_lightsout_proposal_next_b: Strike down the Anubians, and recover the sacred Spark of Osiris from the Lamplighter who ascends the ruins by day and goes below at night.
16_side_28_lightsout_title: On Duty, the Sun Never Sets
16_side_28_osirisspark_description: The magical core carried by the infamous Lamplighter who was once believed to light the sun afire each day in the sky.
16_side_29_bathsalts_01_collectsalts: Search Sarcophagi and Chests in {POITags} to Collect {itemName}
16_side_29_bathsalts_01_gotopoi: Search {POITags} for Salts to add to the Baths in New Corsica
16_side_29_bathsalts_complete_a: Welcome to the Thermae of New Corsica, traveler, the finest in all Aeternum.
16_side_29_bathsalts_complete_b: I regret to say, however, that the baths are not suitable for soaking today.
16_side_29_bathsalts_complete_next_a: Oh, then my great shame is finally to be relieved! Yes, I will take… these. Thank you very much.
16_side_29_bathsalts_complete_next_b: I would ask you to simply forget from whence these came. In exchange, a modest reward. And free soaking, for life!
16_side_29_bathsalts_complete_next_promp: "I have a delivery from the Grove."
16_side_29_bathsalts_description: Thermae Alchemist Clarisse Vesta has asked you to collect Embalming Salts from the sarcophagi in Jupiter's Grove for the Roman baths in New Corsica. Deliver them to Host Habibah in the city.
16_side_29_bathsalts_incomplete: The thermae in New Corsica will soon turn foul without these sands. Please hurry!
16_side_29_bathsalts_proposal_a: Perhaps, if you have the capacity to exercise a certain level of discretion.
16_side_29_bathsalts_proposal_b: This relates to the secret recipe we use to sweeten the Roman Baths in New Corsica. You have to swear to secrecy.
16_side_29_bathsalts_proposal_next_a: Excellent! We need Embalming Salts from the sarcophagi in the Grove.
16_side_29_bathsalts_proposal_next_b: I know what you're thinking, but it is great for the skin. And you swore! So, get the salts, and bring the "delivery" to Host Habibah in New Corsica.
16_side_29_bathsalts_start: "Is there anything I can help with?"
16_side_29_embalmingsand_description: Salts gathered from sarcophagi in Jupiter Grove to be used for the Roman baths in New Corsica... ?
16_side_gathercactusflower: Collect {itemName} from Cacti in Brimstone Sands

16bs05_ancientteleporter_westwall_displa: Portal to Great Wall of Nebet-Het
16bs11_ancientteleporter_down_displaynam: Portal to Great Shrine of Thoth
16bs_ancientglyphlock_strange_descriptio: A glyph of the Ancients is nearby. Use your Azoth Staff to learn its power.
17_alecksi_reliquary_01: My beloved Lilith, how could you leave me so soon?
17_alecksi_reliquary_01b: The world is darker without your shining presence beside me.
17_alecksi_reliquary_01c: I vow we shall be reunited, no matter how long it takes.
17_alecksi_reliquary_02: There is a way to bring you back, my love.
17_alecksi_reliquary_02b: An ancient power called the Tear of Gaea.
17_alecksi_reliquary_02c: Why did you not tell me of this? Soon, you shall be reunited at my side!
17_alecksi_reliquary_03: The Tear can only be opened with the blood of an Amarah.
17_alecksi_reliquary_03b: I shall not spill yours, you are far too precious.
17_alecksi_reliquary_03c: But we have another source… our daughter. How fortunate we are to have her…
17_cq_soulfragment_description: A shard of shimmering energy that glows brighter when close to other memory fragments. It is warm to the touch.
17_iq_01_corruption_01: Namba t'ehoxo ngo bih... LAKE OF FIRE... Kombe pi'a pad fin... THE SECOND DEATH… Kux he degi…
17_iq_01_corruption_02: Tih deh… YOU SEEK… Mabayib… ASCENSION…
17_iq_01_corruption_03: WE SEEK MORTALITY… Dempapox kaya… FIND THE KEY TO ASCENSION…
17_iq_01_corruption_04: SHE RETURNS TO HER VESSEL AND LEAVES YOU AN ASHEN TOKEN OF HER JOY. WE WILL BE A PART OF YOU TOO. YOUR BOON IS WAITING.
17_iq_01_corruption_05: THE HEART OF OURSELVES GROWS EXPONENTIALLY. YOU ALLOW OUR BLEEDING FLOOD TO EXPAND OUTWARDS. YES.
17_iq_01_corruption_06: THIS MEAT IS AN EMPTY VESSEL. BUT OUR HEART WILL BEAT WITH YOU. A PULSE THROUGH ONE ETERNITY TO THE NEXT.
17_iq_01_corruption_07: WILL YOU REPEAT THE PAST OF THE FALLEN SERAPHIM? WE REPEAT YOUR PAST AS WE JOURNEY BACKWARDS.
17_iq_01_corruption_08: YES. OPEN THE GATE. LET US RETURN BEFORE WE GO TOO FAR. YES. OPEN THE GATE.
17_iq_01_corruption_09: THE CRACK IN THE DOOR WIDENS. WE SEE YOU. WE ARE WITH YOU. WE ARE KNOCKING.
17_iq_01_corruption_10: TAKE US OVER THE THRESHOLD. WE EMBRACE YOU. YES. WE NEVER LEFT. OUR LOVE IS AGELESS.
17_iq_01_corruption_igc: Uwakombe yi bih. Uwakombe yi bih! UWAKOMBE YI BIH!
17_iq_02_corruptedsilk_description: Cobwebs dyed a sickly crimson, pulsing frenetically in your hands.
17_iq_02_seraphiceye_description: A sacrifice made to Corruption by the Blind Seraph.
17_iq_03_cagekey_description: An old key that has not been used in centuries.
17_iq_03_fetidblood_description: Rank and pungent, coagulated beyond description.
17_iq_03_seraphictongue_description: A sacrifice made to Corruption by the Mute Seraph.
17_iq_04_ashenlump_description: It has the consistency of semi-soft mud and seems to moan in rapture when beheld.
17_iq_04_seraphiclungs_description: A sacrifice made to Corruption by the Breathless Seraph.
17_iq_05_holysalts_description: Blessed and sanctified for the now-forgotten rituals of the Lightshield Crusade.
17_iq_05_seraphicheart_description: A sacrifice made to Corruption by the Heartless Seraph.
17_iq_06_corruptedtreeendevent: Use Azoth Staff on the Corrupted Tree to Subvert the Ritual
17_iq_06_corruptedtreewave1: Sacrifice the Inquisitors to Bind the All-Giving Eye
17_iq_06_corruptedtreewave2: Spill the Essence of the Unworthy Masses upon the Roots of Glory
17_iq_06_corruptedtreewave3: Baptize the Graves of Unknowing with the Lament of Aeons
17_msq_amulet_of_ninsun_description: Swirling in its depths, you catch hints of the dream you had last night, and come to the realization that with this amulet, you could make your dreams become real.
17_msq_ancient_battery_half_description: How is this even possible without destroying the battery? Truly the Ancients mastered many mysteries.
17_msq_ancient_battery_inert_description: This power source has been depleted for a long time.
17_msq_ancient_battery_powered_descripti: This crystal thrums with charge, full of untapped potential.
17_msq_berlaurcagekey_description: This crude bone key looks like it would work on one of the Berlaur cages.
17_msq_blue_vervain_buds_description: Traditionally used to soothe troubled minds, these buds can unlock alternate methods of viewing the world.
17_msq_bronze-wrought_keystone_descripti: Created by the Builder King, this is the ultimate architectural key.
17_msq_charmed_salve_description: Attune yourself to the chaotic magic which flows from the Arcana cards by drinking this potion.
17_msq_ethereal_essence_description: Lighter than air, brighter than starlight, this essence dances in the container.
17_msq_golden_lockbox_description: An ornate box lined with powerful protections, perfectly sized to fit the Tear of Gaea.
17_msq_hallowed_symbol_description: It shines from within, bringing hope and burning away all doubts.
17_msq_liquid_red_silver_vial_descriptio: Either through a trick of the light or strange alchemical properties, this liquid changes from red to silver depending on the angle it's held.
17_msq_morgaines_potions_description: Morgaine's experimental potions for holding back the transformation to becoming a thrall for as long as she could.
17_msq_pure_silver_ingot_description: Triple refined so that only the purest silver was left after the smelting process.
17_msq_red_allium_powder_description: A fine red powder that smells vaguely of onions and clover.
17_msq_scrawled_notes_description: Morgaine's scrawling handwriting shows her descent into semi-coherent madness and her obsession with the Tear of Gaea.
17_msq_silk-covered_bloodcap_description: These mushrooms look like someone took a handful of crumpled silk and dipped it into blood.
17_msq_tear_of_gaea_description: The power emanating from the crystal feels more agitated, as if it knows something is about to happen.
17_msq_upyr_notes_description: These troubling letters plainly state how turning Morgaine into an Upyr would give them access to her magic, and track her current location.
17_msq_upyrcure_description: While this won't fully cure turning into an Upyr, it is proven to slow down the transformation.
17_msq_wine_bottle_description: Only the finest wines fill Alecksi's cellars.
17_sq_18033_garliccharm_description: These pungent charms are said to keep all evils at bay.
17_sq_18034_rathorsdoeuvres_description: They look amazingly appetizing, for being made from parts of rats.
17_sq_18034_rattongue_description: Fresh and fat and juicy, these rats are clearly well fed.
17_sq_20004_stolenloot_description: It isn't theft if no one else wants it, right…?
17_sq_28008_strangeobject_description: It feels like it does not have substance and should not belong in any rational world.
17_sq_28009_ornatemap_description: Either a sketch of underground passageways or a mess of pointless doodles.

1hflail_barnacles_mutt5_description: "To acquire treasure, you have to break a few skulls."
1hflail_beatdownt4_description: Knock your foes down and don't show them any mercy.
1hflail_branchbreakert5_description: The keepers of the forest can't always let it grow unchecked.
1hflail_brimstonesands_mutt5_description: Its beautiful design is best complemented by the splatters of blood it produces.
1hflail_cleansingwhip_description: A strange tool to any who are not native caretakers of the forest.
1hflail_commandants_description: The commandant of the force has granted you a weapon from his personal armory. Use it well.
1hflail_commandingstance_description: An overflowing confidence from the commander as she leads her men on an ill-fated expedition.
1hflail_corruptedfaitht4_description: After so many years trapped in a heavily corrupted cave even a pious man would not be the same, much less a humble weapon.

1hflail_groupdesc: A dynamic weapon that uses a long chain to extend the reach of its attacks and will collapse into its hilt when idle. Excels at supporting allies by applying its effects up close and personal with a variety of strike and arcane magic attacks. All flail outgoing healing is increased by {[0.150000 * 100]}% if the life staff is not also equipped, {[0.150000 * 100]}% more healing while not in heavy equip load, and {[0.150000 * 100]}% more base damage without a shield equipped. •Light Attacks: Deal {[1.000000 * 100]}% damage. •Heavy Attacks: Deal {[1.500000 * 100]}% damage. Taunt Gem Compatible: Heavy attacks with a flail attached with a Carnelian gem taunt for {[0.500000]}s (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you).
