1hthrowingaxe_accursedendt4_description: "Your destiny was never your own. From the beginning my curse was upon you."
1hthrowingaxe_adjucatorofpaint4_descript: "Who shall my axe strike? Why must I choose but one of you."
1hthrowingaxe_agonizert5_description: "They will suffer, just as I have."
1hthrowingaxe_alakazhamsincantationt5_de: "The mythical wizard was said to have blessed this Hatchet with his power before bestowing it on a brave Ranger."
1hthrowingaxe_amrinesforgottenaxet3_desc: "This axe seems to have been left behind long ago."
1hthrowingaxe_ancienttacticst3_descripti: "Slashing at a hamstring is far more effective than slashing at an arm. If your enemy cannot move, they cannot fight."
1hthrowingaxe_anuketskeyt5_description: Flows like a waterfall, flooding your foes.
1hthrowingaxe_arbiratorswisdomt2_descrip: "The difference between life and death is but a swing."
1hthrowingaxe_archmagesassistantt4_descr: "The mages historically have favored staves and enchanted gauntlets. But some problems require a bit more force."
1hthrowingaxe_aristocratsfinehatchett2_d: "While the high born rarely do phyiscal labor, they do enjoy tossing the occasional axe at a stuffed target."
1hthrowingaxe_articulont5_description: "Look no further if you hunger for the sight of blood. With this in hand you shall feast your eyes."
1hthrowingaxe_artisansaxet3_description: "This weapon was the mangum opus of a great smith who resided in Windsward."
1hthrowingaxe_ashenvictoryt3_description: "When the pillaging was over, the bandit's axe was covered in ash and blood."
1hthrowingaxe_atrickofthemindt4_descript: "Watch more closely now, for if you blink, you will miss it."
1hthrowingaxe_atrickofthemindt4_transmog: A Trick of the Mind Hatchet
1hthrowingaxe_avaricet2_description: "Look upon others and want not. Or do. No one can stop you."
1hthrowingaxe_avaricet3_description: "Look upon others and want not. Or do. No one can stop you."
1hthrowingaxe_avaricet4_description: "Look upon others and want not. Or do. No one can stop you."
1hthrowingaxe_avaricet5_description: "Look upon others and want not. Or do. No one can stop you."
1hthrowingaxe_axeoftheabysst5_descriptio: "Many souls are lost as they try to harness the power of Corruption. To do so is to lose oneself."
1hthrowingaxe_axeoftheeldergodst3_descri: "The first humans thought the Ancients to be gods. They forged weapons and armor in the name of their new deities."
1hthrowingaxe_axeofviolencet4_descriptio: "For those who think violence is the answer, this axe is their ultimate goal."
1hthrowingaxe_azothcrystal_description: Crystallized azoth contains a great deal of power, take these mutated relics for yourself and grow your strength.
1hthrowingaxe_azureravagert5_description: Blazing a trail of both fire and hope.
1hthrowingaxe_balanosscrystalbattleaxet5: "The great shaman Balanos was gifted a Hatchet when he overtook control of the Lush Hideaway."
1hthrowingaxe_baldwynesraget3_descriptio: Never step between a forgemaster and their work. You're liable to lose a limb.
1hthrowingaxe_bannermansbanet4_descripti: "Loyalty to the wrong house is such a petty reason to lay down your life."
1hthrowingaxe_beakt5_v2_description: Sharp keratin can split flesh and crush bone.
1hthrowingaxe_berserkersbanet2_descripti: "For all his ferocity, it was his own axe that doomed him."
1hthrowingaxe_bestwishest5_description: "Sometimes the things we're looking for show up when we least expect it."
1hthrowingaxe_beyondreasont5_description: "Abominations such as this really prove the point of 'Just because you can, doesn't mean you should.'"
1hthrowingaxe_bilelasht4_description: "A never ending stream of poison oozes from the head of the hatchet."
1hthrowingaxe_blackguardshatchett5_descr: "Many a limb has been taken by this one. I keep them as trophies on my mantle."
1hthrowingaxe_bloodlettert4_description: "One swing from this and your humours will settle."
1hthrowingaxe_bloodshotreavert2_descript: "The town bells rang as the barbarians descended upon the village, ready to plunder and pillage."
1hthrowingaxe_bonechoppert2_description: "The first living thing I killed was a chicken. I was about six or so. My dad gave me his handaxe and told me to get started on dinner."
1hthrowingaxe_bonechoppert3_description: "The first living thing I killed was a chicken. I was about six or so. My dad gave me his handaxe and told me to get started on dinner."
1hthrowingaxe_bonechoppert4_description: "The first living thing I killed was a chicken. I was about six or so. My dad gave me his handaxe and told me to get started on dinner."
1hthrowingaxe_bonechoppert5_description: "The first living thing I killed was a chicken. I was about six or so. My dad gave me his handaxe and told me to get started on dinner."
1hthrowingaxe_brawlingaxe_description: A weapon more suited to a tavern brawl than a proper duel.
1hthrowingaxe_breachinghatchett4_descrip: "Into the breach I shall go. Waht awaits me on the other side, I do not know."
1hthrowingaxe_brittlebonest5_description: “A hatchet made from the bones of fallen enemies. Clearly these enemies were weak as bits and pieces of the hatchet break off with each swing.”
1hthrowingaxe_brittlefuryt2_description: “Great for hacking at flesh, quite terrible at culling trees.”
1hthrowingaxe_buccaneersbountyt5_descrip: "When the pirates sacked the great coastal cities, a buccaneer was particularly enticed by this axe. They brought it with them, and in their misfortune it washed ashore in Aeternum."
1hthrowingaxe_buccaneersbulwarkt4_descri: "Traditionally footsoldiers have used a shield. But to defend themselvs, the greatest pirates would wield only axes."
1hthrowingaxe_cactuscarvert5_description: Able to cut through all obstacles while avoiding any annoying thorns.
1hthrowingaxe_calcifiedcleavert3_descrip: "Eons of sediment has built up to hide the true nature of this axe. What remains is a razor sharpe edge that is sure to leave an infection alongside a wound."
1hthrowingaxe_calmingraget5_description: This weapons almost seems to be meditating in your hand.
1hthrowingaxe_cardinalsint4_description: "When the Ancients first awoke the Azoth, they brought forth a power they could not understand."
1hthrowingaxe_cauterizinghatchett5_descr: "It's not sterile, and it just may kill you. But in a pinch this hatchet will close any wound that it already opened."
1hthrowingaxe_censuret4_description: "For your punishment you shall receive three strikes of my hatchet. Should you survive, you shall receive three more."
1hthrowingaxe_ceremonialcleavert2_descri: "Syndicate archaeologists suspect this axe was used for Ancient rituals. What those rituals were is still unknown."
1hthrowingaxe_charbladet3_description: "Dipped in the fiery heart of Vesuvius."
1hthrowingaxe_chillwindhatchett5_descrip: "The cold blast of wind chilled the warrior to the bone, freezing her in her place."
1hthrowingaxe_ciradulthelazarinewardent5: "The Lazarus pits are sacred to the Dryads. To defile them is sacrilege."
1hthrowingaxe_commandants_description: The commandant of the force has granted you a weapon from his personal armory. Use it well.
1hthrowingaxe_concubinet4_description: "While I love my wife and my children, my hatchet is my one true love."
1hthrowingaxe_conquestt5_description: "We are constantly at war with the forces of the island, and yet we still find time to war against one another."
1hthrowingaxe_contingencyplant4_descript: "As far as plans go, this wasn't the worst. It wasn't the best, either."
1hthrowingaxe_corpsebridescleavert5_desc: "On the day of her wedding she sliced off her husband's hands so that he could never grasp another woman again."
1hthrowingaxe_corruptedchoppert5_descrip: "The pursuit of power has led many to tamper with forces they do not fully understand."
1hthrowingaxe_corruptedremnantt3_descrip: "After the breach closed, this axe is all that remained. The corruption upon it appears to sing as you wield it."
1hthrowingaxe_corruptprogenitor_descript: First on the lands and first to touch the corruption. The early visitors don't remain as anything more than a shell of what they were.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantadjudicatorshatche: "A Hatchet reserved for the glorious adjudicator's of the Covenant."
1hthrowingaxe_covenantdefendershatchett2: A Hatchet reserved for newcomers to the Covenant.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantdefendershatchett3: "A Hatchet reserved for followers of the Covenant who have proved themselves loyal to the cause."
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank1_description: A well-made Hatchet for newly-inducted Covenant Initiates.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank2_description: A well-made Hatchet for Covenant Templars.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank3_description: A well-made Hatchet for Covenant Excubitors.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank4_description: A well-made Hatchet for Covenant Lumens.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank5_description: A well-made Hatchet for Covenant Adjudicators.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank6_3_descriptio: An exceptionally-made Hatchet for Covenant Paladins.
1hthrowingaxe_covenantrank6_description: A well-made Hatchet for Covenant Paladins.
1hthrowingaxe_covenanttemplart4_descript: "A Hatchet reserved for devoute followers of the Covenant whose actions have brought glory to the cause."
1hthrowingaxe_covenanttemplart4a_descrip: A Hatchet reserved for Covenant who have reached the rank of Templar.
1hthrowingaxe_crawlerscleavert5_descript: "Crawling through the caverns beneath Aeternum is not for the faint of heart. Carry a big torch and a sharp edge to ward off whatever you might find."
1hthrowingaxe_crowsnestt3_description: "The lookout was the first to set her eyes on the mythical island. After months battling the waves at sea, the crew would now turn their eyes towards a new foe."
1hthrowingaxe_crystalcarvert4_descriptio: "Pickaxes are so old school. Just slash off a chunk of a rock with your axe!"
1hthrowingaxe_cullingburnt5_description: "A controlled burn keeps the forest healthy."
1hthrowingaxe_cultistscleavert5_descript: "Dozens of hooded figures appeared in the Brightwood's mist, each of them wielding a starmetal hatchet."
1hthrowingaxe_daedalust5_description: "Fly to close to the sun and your wings shall be scorched."
1hthrowingaxe_daemonheel_description: A raving madman has warned you this was made with the heel of a Demon. There's no way that's true, right?
1hthrowingaxe_darkquandaryt2_description: "If your opponent falls in a forest, and no one is around to hear it, did they really die?"
1hthrowingaxe_darkwidowt5_description: "The hooded figure appeared as if out of nowhere. They raised their axe and struck silently and viciously. Dark magic poured from the wound and flowed towards the axe."
1hthrowingaxe_dealwiththedevilt4_descrip: "Forged in Hell itself, this axe promises immense power at the price of one's soul."
1hthrowingaxe_deepriver_description: Lost in a river at a depth beyond the understanding of dry beings. It's incredible that a relic such as this can be seen again.
1hthrowingaxe_depths_mutt5_description: The avarice of the night grasps them tight.
1hthrowingaxe_desecratedceremonialhatche: “The sacred runes on the side of the hatchet have been defiled by blight.”
1hthrowingaxe_desecratedloggert2_descrip: "Honest work won't save you from the darkest calling."
1hthrowingaxe_diamondheadt5_description: "Pure diamond encases the edge of the hatchet, sharpened to the finest point you have ever seen."
1hthrowingaxe_doomsedget5_description: "Death is far closer than any of us realize."
1hthrowingaxe_dragonsbloodt2_description: "Let this token remind you of your history. You are one of us."
1hthrowingaxe_dreadwaket4_description: “The feared pirate commander succumbed to the corruption. His ship would appear around the shores of Aeternum, his axe in hand, and all that followed was death and destruction.”
1hthrowingaxe_dreamhackert4_description: "I live more in my dreams than I do in my life."
1hthrowingaxe_driftwoodt5_description: Brittle and infectious. I wouldn't use it personally, but to each their own.
1hthrowingaxe_dunwealdt4_description: "There are many places that remain sacred to the Dryads. Defending these holy sites is of the utmost importance to them."
1hthrowingaxe_dynastysdemiset4_descripti: "The vision of the Empress must be fulfilled, no matter the cost."
1hthrowingaxe_edenilt5_description: "From the earth we came, to the earth we shall return."
1hthrowingaxe_encroachingcorruption_desc: You can feel the corruption seeping through you as you wield this hatchet.
1hthrowingaxe_eunuchssaviort4_descriptio: "This is a tough world for a eunuch. One must carry a weapon to defend oneself."
1hthrowingaxe_evisceratort2_description: "It's famously difficult to bisect a person. Unless of course you have this."
1hthrowingaxe_evisceratort3_description: "It's famously difficult to bisect a person. Unless of course you have this."
1hthrowingaxe_evisceratort4_description: "It's famously difficult to bisect a person. Unless of course you have this."
1hthrowingaxe_evisceratort5_description: "It's famously difficult to bisect a person. Unless of course you have this."
1hthrowingaxe_excavationhatchett3_descri: A reward from William Heron for recovering the Foreman's Ledger.
1hthrowingaxe_fallowfieldst5_description: "No crops again this year, we'll starve through the winter."
1hthrowingaxe_feastofbloodt4_description:
Geri and Freki
the war-wont sates,
the triumphant sire of hosts;
but on wine only
the famed in arms,
Odin, ever lives.
1hthrowingaxe_fiendishslicert5_descripti: "This battlescarred piece of steel is coated in layers of blood that no one has attempted to clean."
1hthrowingaxe_fireofbattlet5_description: A desire for combat wells up within you as you wield this weapon.
1hthrowingaxe_firstlightexp_mut_descript: Hatchet scavenged from a terrible beast.
1hthrowingaxe_firstlightrevampt5_descrip: Hatchet found in the Elysian Wilds amidst the invasive growth.
1hthrowingaxe_fleetingrealityt3_descript: "The weapon seems to shift in and out of this plane of reality. It's neither entirely here nor entirely not."
1hthrowingaxe_fleshwrappedhatchett5_desc: “The handle is clearly wrapped in human flesh. The tension on the flesh makes you think it may not be that old...”
1hthrowingaxe_floodwatersgiftt5_descript: Crafted from the silt of the Nile.
1hthrowingaxe_foulmoutht5_description: "Speak the words of power and receive my gift."
1hthrowingaxe_freshforgededget5_descript: "This axe is newly crafted from the forges of Everfall. A fine finish and a razor sharp edge makes this formidable against any foe."
1hthrowingaxe_fromonhight4_description: "The hatchet glows with an otherworldly iridescence."
1hthrowingaxe_frostfangt4_description: "The biting cold is surely the worst way to die."
1hthrowingaxe_furiousfuryt5_v2_descripti: The untamed fury of the wilderness will drive away all but the bravest souls.
1hthrowingaxe_furyt2_description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."
1hthrowingaxe_furyt3_description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."
1hthrowingaxe_furyt4_description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."
1hthrowingaxe_furyt5_description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."
1hthrowingaxe_gaiasjusticet3_description: “When the Angry Earth arose from the depths of Aeternum, they brought with them ferocious weapons of imbued wood.”
1hthrowingaxe_graverobbert5_description: "Stealing from the dead is risky business."
1hthrowingaxe_greaterpurposet5_descripti: "Where does mankind come from? You shall find out."
1hthrowingaxe_greenkeepersaxet5_descript: "Mythical figures to most, the Dryad Greenkeepers were fierce defenders of Aeternum's land."
1hthrowingaxe_hatchetofthearcanetowert5_: "The mages buried their noses in books while the world around them changed. But their research led to an enchanted hatchet capable of great destruction."
1hthrowingaxe_hatchetofthecorruptedfront: "The Corrupted continously push south, seeking to corrupt all in their path and expand their reach."
1hthrowingaxe_hatchetoftheenchantedwoods: "Legends say this axe once belonged to a great Elf woodsman. But of course, those are just legends..."
1hthrowingaxe_hatchetofthefirstscoutt4_d: "The elite guardian scouts kept their city safe for generations, forewarning of any impending assault by enemy forces."
1hthrowingaxe_hauntedhackert3_descriptio: "Forged in a soulfire smithy, the axe holds a shard of the smith's tormented soul."
1hthrowingaxe_hercyneraid_description: A piece of powerful gear rightfully claimed by a conqueror of dangerous foes in the Hive of Gorgons Raid.
1hthrowingaxe_highpriestsceremonialhatch: "The high priest kept a hatchet next to his altar, using it for a wide variety of ceremonies and sacrifices. Little did he know he would one day become the sacrifice."
1hthrowingaxe_hoplite_description: A piece of powerful gear rightfully claimed by a conqueror of dangerous foes in the Hive of Gorgons Raid.
1hthrowingaxe_horrificbeautyt3_descripti: “For all of the evil wrought upon the world by the Corrupted, there's a certain beauty in the chaos.”
1hthrowingaxe_horrificslashert5_descript: "The original owner of this axe was responsibile for the death of a cabin full of people prior to his disappearance."
1hthrowingaxe_horsecatchert5_description: Four legs cannot run faster than this can fly.
1hthrowingaxe_howlingwindt2_description: "A sound like the cry of a wolf can be heard when this axe is thrown."
1hthrowingaxe_hulkinghatchett5_descripti: "Far too large to truly be an effective throwing axe, but just too small to qualify as a battle axe."
1hthrowingaxe_humminghatchett4_descripti: "The corruption hums within the weapon, a low eerie vibration that never ceases to stop."
1hthrowingaxe_imbuedhatchett5_descriptio: "Raw magical energy courses through the hatchet, empowering each and every swing."
1hthrowingaxe_ironjawsbitet4_description: "As sharp as Ironjaw's teeth, it strikes as fast as Ironjaw's bite."
1hthrowingaxe_jaggedamethystcleavert2_de: "The beauty and the brutality of this weapon are not lost on you."
1hthrowingaxe_jawbreakert3_description: "Nothing says 'stop talking' like a hatchet to the jaw."
1hthrowingaxe_kentsgravetrowelt2_descrip: "Technically the bodies don't decompose, but the Azoth residue is quite healthy for the gravebloom."
1hthrowingaxe_keratin_description: Bits and pieces have fallen off of many monstrous creatures over the years, and the dense magic in the sands has pulled them together into strange shapes.
1hthrowingaxe_kerys_description: A powerful hatchet belonging to a lost civilization, rightfully claimed by the conqueror of dangerous foes in the Isle of Night Raid.
1hthrowingaxe_lazarinecleavert5_descript: "The weapons found in the vaults of the Lazarus Pits seem to inherit some of their former master's energy."
1hthrowingaxe_legacyt5: You may perish in battle, but your legends shall be passed on for generations."

2hspear_abyssalstriket4_description: "A weapon of justice and holy intent turned into a weapon of malice."
2hspear_acidictipt2_description: A little bit of acid goes a long way in softening up a dangerous target.
2hspear_alchemistspotstirrert5_descripti: "Just how big is the alchemical pot that requires a stirring rod this large? And why does this spear seem to soak up half of the reagents?"
2hspear_anarchyt5_description: "Come, the revolution has begun! Grab your spears and pitchforks and let us storm the keep!"
2hspear_ancientproblemsolvert4_descripti: “Throughout history we have seen one continued method of solving all problems. Violence.”
2hspear_ancienttidingst5_description: "Welcome to Aeternum, where your demise is just around the corner!"
2hspear_angryearthexterminatort5_descrip: "Killing Dryads is oh so fun. And now with this spear you can do it faster than ever!"
2hspear_appointednegotiatort2_descriptio: "Karl never gave orders without having his Appointed Negotiator around. It never failed to stop arguments before they started."
2hspear_archaelogistsdefendert5_descript: "Aeternum is an archaeologist's paradise with ruins galore to explore."
2hspear_archonsfrozenspeart5_description: "Mages specialize in a variety of magics, but those who favor frost have found spears to be an effective conduit for their spells."
2hspear_azothcrystal_description: Crystallized azoth contains a great deal of power, take these mutated relics for yourself and grow your strength.
2hspear_azothimbuedspeart5_description: "Brimming with pure azoth infusion, this spear is bursting at the seams with raw energy."
2hspear_balanceofduatt5_description: The difference between living and dying is as thin as the tip of the spear.
2hspear_barnacles_mutt5_description: It doubles as the world's most expensive walking stick.
2hspear_biggust5_description: The complex hieroglyphs have been scratched out by a graverobber, and this name was in their place.
2hspear_blackguardsspeart5_description: "...So I turned around and pinned him to a wall with this!"
2hspear_blazingbushhookt5_description: Built to blaze a path through even the most dense jungles.
2hspear_blazingbushhookt5_v3_upgrade_nam: Blazing Bush Hook Upgrade At the Gypsum Kiln
2hspear_blightsspiket5_description: "Blight is the Dryad's most hated enemy. Let this weapon guide you to their death."
2hspear_bloodeaglespeart5_description: "A cruel ceremony, the blood eagle is fit only for the lowest of the low."
2hspear_bloodrightt4_description: "I never wanted this, and yet I was born to rule. So rule I shall."
2hspear_boardingharpoon_description: A dangerous, but invaluable, tool for any scourge of the high seas.
2hspear_boneshattersthirdarmt4_descripti: "The ancient Javelineer moved his spear so effortlessly it was like a part of his body."
2hspear_bracet5_v2_description: Dig the haft into the ground, point the spearhead up as the bear falls upon it.
2hspear_bramblebranch_description: Jagged and drought-like to the touch. You wonder if it was meant to harm the victim or the wielder.
2hspear_breachforgedspeart3_description: "This spear was crafted by dark engineers on the other side of the veil."
2hspear_brightclawt3_description: "The tip glistens beautifully when it catches the light."
2hspear_brimstonesands_mutt5_description: Held by members of an elite guard unit.
2hspear_brittlelongspeart5_description: "It seems as if it will break the second you strike something with it."
2hspear_broadsidestickert5_description: "Hit their ship from the side! Thrust your spears into the wood of their ship, board it, and slay them all!"
2hspear_brokenmastt4_description: "The ship crashed into the rocky shore of Aeternum shattering the hull and the mast. Survivors quickly scrambled to gather whatever weapon they could as they faced the Drowned on the shores."
2hspear_burialspeart3_description: "It was once tradition to bury the dead with a weapon so that they could defend themselves in the afterlife. Of course, that tradition stopped once the dead would get right back up and begin fighting you with that weapon."
2hspear_callousjavelint5_description: "Throw me and see where I land."
2hspear_caudanthefangofserpenst5_descrip: “The monster lashed out, striking its creators down with a single blow.”
2hspear_ceremonialranseurofsacrificet4_d: "Far more than a ceremonial weapon, this ranseur was honed sharp and used often."
2hspear_chaosspeart5_description: "Every strike causes confusion. Every use leads to upheaval."
2hspear_chargeoftheempresst5_description: "My royal subjects, I ask that you assist me in the conquest of this land in the name of the Tempest."
2hspear_charont5_v2_description: Remember to bring an obol, as a toll for the ferryman.
2hspear_cindersweept5_description: Witness the beauty of the flames, streaking across the sky with each swipe.
2hspear_commandants_description: The commandant of the force has granted you a weapon from his personal armory. Use it well.
2hspear_conquerorsspeart5_description: "Shatter the walls and storm the keep, this city shall fall."
2hspear_corruptedcaptainspiket5_descript: "A brave captain, beloved by all who knew him. Like all the others, he too succumbed to the alure of corruption."
2hspear_corruptedskewert2_description: "The corrupted do not treat us as humans. They see us only as pigs to be slaughtered."
2hspear_corruptionsrebirtht5_description: "Your dark rebirth shall grant you powers beyond your comprehension."
2hspear_corruptprogenitor_description: First on the lands and first to touch the corruption. The early visitors don't remain as anything more than a shell of what they were.
2hspear_covenantadjudicatorsspeart5_desc: "A spear reserved for the glorious adjudicator's of the Covenant."
2hspear_covenantdefendersspeart2_descrip: A Spear reserved for newcomers to the Covenant.
2hspear_covenantdefendersspeart3_descrip: "A spear reserved for followers of the Covenant who have proved themselves loyal to the cause."
2hspear_covenantrank1_description: A well-made spear for newly-inducted Covenant Initiates.
2hspear_covenantrank2_description: A well-made spear for Covenant Templars.
2hspear_covenantrank3_description: A well-made spear for Covenant Excubitors.
2hspear_covenantrank4_description: A well-made spear for Covenant Lumens.
2hspear_covenantrank5_description: A well-made spear for Covenant Adjudicators.
2hspear_covenantrank6_3_description: An exceptionally-made spear for Covenant Paladins.
2hspear_covenantrank6_description: A well-made spear for Covenant Paladins.
2hspear_covenanttemplarsspeart4_descript: "A spear reserved for devoute followers of the Covenant whose actions have brought glory to the cause."
2hspear_covenanttemplarsspeart4a_descrip: A Spear reserved for Covenant who have reached the rank of Templar.
2hspear_cutthroatsjavelint3_description: "Give me a name and I shall deliver you a skull."
2hspear_daemonforearm_description: A raving madman has warned you this was made with the forearm of a Demon. There's no way that's true, right?
2hspear_deepriver_description: Lost in a river at a depth beyond the understanding of dry beings. It's incredible that a relic such as this can be seen again.
2hspear_diamondsheadt2_description: "The head of a spear is an odd use for such a precious gem, though I suppose it is rather sharp."
2hspear_dirtnapt4_description: "Spar with me and I will let you rest for eternity."
2hspear_djaofbest5_description: A sturdy spear any soldier can rely on.
2hspear_doubloonshopnamedt5_description: This spear has a long reach. Too long, and bothersome.
2hspear_dryadwalkingstickt2_description: "Useful for climbing steep hills or fending off unwanted companions."
2hspear_dynastyshipyard_mutt5_descriptio: The serrated edge helps to rend the tough hides of large foes.
2hspear_dynastysriset4_description: "The truly elite soldiers of the Dynasty forces are their spearman. Their agile movements and unbreakable will made them a deadly force poised to conquer any who stood in their way."
2hspear_earthspiket4_description: "Coated in a fine poison. Pain is all your enemies shall know."
2hspear_edmandsfishingspeart3_descriptio: "Perfect for spear fishing against small fish, sharks, and whales. Though maybe don't try to take down a kraken with this."
2hspear_empyrean_mutt5_description: The barbed edge makes such a weapon well suited for hunters, though whether they hunt beasts or men may not matter to the weapon...
2hspear_encroachingcorruption_descriptio: You can feel the corruption seeping through you as you wield this spear.
2hspear_envyofbelamt4_description: "Many a hunter tried to take down Odious Belam, but only one came close, armed with this spear."
2hspear_eternal_mutt5_description: Due to the time spent within eternal voids, this weapon has mutated to better suit its eternal prison.
2hspear_faedragonsclawt5_description: "If dragons ever did exist in their land, then surely this weapon is forged from one of their claws. The sheer size of such a claw speaks to the possibility."
2hspear_faefolksspeart2_description: "Beautiful flowers and vines adorn every corner of this weapon. It is as enchanting as it is deadly."
2hspear_fallenfriendt4_description: "I lost most of my crew when I came to Aeternum. But the loss that hurt the most was that of my dear dog. While she came back like all things do here, she was... different."
2hspear_farmershopet5_description: "Bandits descended on the farm, prepared to steal all the farmer had worked to grow. She gripped her trusty friend and prepared to fight."
2hspear_farseersspeart4_description: "Gaze into my crystals and see your future."
2hspear_firepoker_description: A useful tool in the forge to stoke the flames. It will probably serve well enough as a weapon.
2hspear_firestartert5_description: A simple spear, with a simple name. It saw more use as a tool than as a weapon.
2hspear_firstlightexp_mut_description: Spear scavenged from a terrible beast.
2hspear_firstlightrevampt5_description: Spear found in the Elysian Wilds amidst the invasive growth.
2hspear_flawlessgrandmastersspeart5_desc: "To become a grandmaster spearman requires decades of training and dedication. When one achieves such an unparalleled feat they are given a spear crafted by the finest artisans of Aeternum."
2hspear_footmansroyalpiket3_description: "A standard issue pike for the royal guard, the craftsmanship of this weapon is immaculate."
2hspear_foresterspiket4_description: "Snap a Dryad in half, sharpen it to a point and you have made yourself a pike!"
2hspear_forestsguidet3_description: "Keep the Dryads at an arms reach, for they are lethal creatures."
2hspear_forgottenvirtuet3_description: "Do not let this land rip from you who you are."
2hspear_forklightningt3_description: "Lightning cracks from the spear as it is thrown, jutting out in every direction."
2hspear_forwardprogresst4_description: "Ancient scientists cared little for conflict, but they found weapons useful to further their research."
2hspear_galleonsspearheadt5_description: "Ripped from the front of a crashed galleon, this spearhead is perfect for boarding ships and slaying enemies."
2hspear_gardengenesis_mutt5_description: This branch was torn from the tree before it could finish blossoming.
2hspear_gemencrustedpiket3_description: "This pike seems more focused on appearing beautiful than it does being an effective weapon."
2hspear_gnarledrootspeart4_description: "The shaft of this spear is covered in gnarled roots, perfect for the harsh starmetal tip to embed itself in."
2hspear_grandarchmagemorigossancientspea: "The inscription is muddled but you can make out the words "Morigos" and "Archmage". When you wield the spear it seems to speak to you."
2hspear_graverobbersspeart4_description: "Graverobbing, ever the risky business. If you aren't well equipped, surely the competition will be."
2hspear_gutskewert2_description: "The executioner jammed the spear into his prisoner's abdomen, ripping out his entrails."
2hspear_halloweent5_description: If you should die before you wake...
2hspear_halloweent5_gs600_description: If you should die before you wake...
2hspear_havoct5_description: A whirl of sharp points and dangerous slashes.
2hspear_heavensplittert5_description: An odyssean spear whose form was handed down by the Ancient Guardians. Wrought from the Underworld, it is the spear that pierced the heavens.
2hspear_heirsdomaint5_description: "To learn to rule is no easy task."
2hspear_hellfire_mutt5_description: Due to the time spent within hellfire, this weapon has mutated to better suit its hellish prison.
2hspear_hellsplittert5_description: "Free us from the bonds of hell and give us life anew."
2hspear_hercyneraid_description: A piece of powerful gear rightfully claimed by a conqueror of dangerous foes in the Hive of Gorgons Raid.
2hspear_hiddentruthst5_description: "Look beyond the curtain, not all is as it may seem."
2hspear_hoplite_description: A piece of powerful gear rightfully claimed by a conqueror of dangerous foes in the Hive of Gorgons Raid.
2hspear_horrorofthenightt5_description: "For all the horrors the townsfolk may see during the day, what comes at night is far worse than what they can imagine."
2hspear_hubrisofholmt3_description: "The great Sentinel Holm kept watch over the revered tower Malocchio for generations, and it was the pride of the sentinel that led to the towers stagnation."
2hspear_hulkingspeart4_description: "The massive size of this weapon makes it unwieldy to wield for humans, yet perfect for the forces of the Corrupted."
2hspear_hummingcrystaljavelint5_descript: "The spearhead vibrates as you move the spear from side to side."
2hspear_ice_mutt5_description: Due to the time spent within frozen worlds, this weapon has mutated to better suit its frostbitten prison.
2hspear_icepickt2_description: "The glacial freeze is difficult to break up. In my years of exploration I've found that quick and powerful jabs yield the most consistent results."
2hspear_invaderswillt4_description: "I shall ascend the ramparts or I shall perish. There is no other choice."
2hspear_irreverentedget4_description: "The tip of the spear is coated with broken shards of glass, creating a mean and vile weapon that seeks to inflict pain more than it seeks to kill."
2hspear_isomirtheblightedtendersspeart5_: "The Greenkeeper was charged with guarding the most sacred of places to the Dryads. The spread of blight into such a sanctuary does not bode well for their kind."
2hspear_jaggededgedjavelint2_description: "Hooks adorn the edge of the spear's head, allowing it to remain stuck inside any victim."
2hspear_javelinofdryadicempowermentt5_de: "Imbued within this weapon is the memory of a thousand Dryads. Their knowledge is now yours to command."
2hspear_javelinofjustintentt4_descriptio: "Weather the storm in your heart and find peace within."
2hspear_javelinofthecorruptedmaident4_de: "Before she was turned by the power of corruption, she was a warrior of great renown. After she was turned, her visage imbued fear into the hearts of all who had the misfortune to come upon her."
2hspear_javelinofthecorruptedvanguardt3_: "The vanguard of the corrupted forces are a fearsome lot. When they descend upon an army, none are left alive."
2hspear_journeymanspracticelancet2_descr: "Jousting is an older art, but it still requires years of training before you have any shot of competing in a tournament."
2hspear_jungleguidet3_description: "How do you find out what rustles in the brush? Stab it."
2hspear_junglestriket5_description: "The jungles are my domain. Enter if you dare."
2hspear_keratin_description: Bits and pieces have fallen off of many monstrous creatures over the years, and the dense magic in the sands has pulled them together into strange shapes.
2hspear_kerys_description: A powerful spear belonging to a lost civilization, rightfully claimed by the conqueror of dangerous foes in the Isle of Night Raid.
2hspear_khnumskeyt5_description: And with this spear the waters flow, pouring over the land.
2hspear_lastlightt3_description: "The world changes when the sun dips below the horizon. Things that sleep during the day begin to lurk at night. Carry this weapon with you so that you might see the sun rise again."
2hspear_lazarus_mutt5_description: Taken from the bones of fallen beast, and used to slay its kin.
2hspear_leafwrappedspeart3_description: "The cycle of life binds us all."
2hspear_leandrasdemiset4_description: "Slain by her own spear, Leandra would rather die than serve in the corrupted legions."
2hspear_lieutenants_description: A memento taken from a fallen Lieutenant of an opposing faction of Aeternians.
2hspear_lifering_description: Warm and hopeful energies loop throughout this spear.
2hspear_lightningrodt2_description: "In the heart of a storm, lightning seems drawn to this weapon."
2hspear_lightningscallt5_description: "Your enemies will be shocked by your power."
2hspear_lightningstriket5_description: “Perhaps if you infuse this weapon with enough shadow energy it will transform.”
2hspear_lithespeart5_description: An important piece of a long forgotten dance, yet lethal it remains.
2hspear_livingspeart4_description: "This weapon has a mind of its own, wriggling and writhing as the life inside it hungers for flesh."
2hspear_longforgottenpiket5_description: "Dusty and crusty, this spear was left in a Guardian armory for centuries. Despite the wear and tear, the point of the spear is as sharp as ever."
2hspear_longreacht3_description: "Nothing in this life is beyond your grasp."
2hspear_magmaquaket5_description: "Thrust the spear into the ground and let loose the fires of hell."
2hspear_manaconduitt3_description: "Flowing with pure magical energy, this spear draws power from the sources around it."
2hspear_maraudercommandersspeart5_descri: "A spear reserved for feared commanders of the Marauders."
2hspear_maraudergroundbreakersspeart2_de: A Spear reserved for newcomers to the Marauders.
2hspear_maraudergroundbreakersspeart3_de: "A spear reserved for soldiers of the Marauders who have proved themselves loyal to the cause."
2hspear_marauderrank1_description: A well-made spear for newly-inducted Marauder Soldiers.
2hspear_marauderrank2_description: A well-made spear for Marauder Gladiators.
2hspear_marauderrank3_description: A well-made spear for Marauder Ravagers.
2hspear_marauderrank4_description: A well-made spear for Marauder Destroyers.
2hspear_marauderrank5_description: A well-made spear for Marauder Commanders.
2hspear_marauderrank6_3_description: An exceptionally-made spear for Marauder Champions.
2hspear_marauderrank6_description: A well-made spear for Marauder Champions.
2hspear_maraudersunderersspeart4_descrip: "A spear reserved for devoted soldiers of the Marauders who have proved themselves fit to lead others."
2hspear_maraudersunderersspeart4a_descri: A Spear reserved for Marauders who have reached the rank of Sunderer.
2hspear_maroonedmarinersspeart4_descript: "Left on a deserted island with nothing but the clothes on his back and the spear in his hand, he was left to fend for himself against the dangers that awaited."
2hspear_meltingpointt5_description: Its heat will be comforting in the Deep.
2hspear_monarchraid_description: An impressive spear belonging to a lost civilization, rightfully claimed by the conqueror of dangerous foes in the Isle of Night Raid.
2hspear_myrkgard_mutt5_description: Used by many vile fiends to hold down their prey so it can be corrupted for evil benefits.
2hspear_nature_mutt5_description: Due to the time spent within nature, this weapon has mutated to better suit its natural prison.
2hspear_nguyensnotchedspeart5_descriptio: "What is yours shall soon belong to The Taker."
2hspear_olcottcuttert2_description: "Originally used for hunting animals, over time it became something that struck fear into the hearts of people and animals alike."
2hspear_olympiant5_v2_description: The body of a god, the willpower of a demon, the luck of a damned soul.
2hspear_oranathspearofthecorruptedservan: "The Corrupted Keeper kept watch over this citadel for generations. Thousands felt his wrath."
Oranath, Spear of the Corrupted Servant
2hspear_oversizedwandt2_description: "An overconfident mage once tried to teach an ogre to use a wand. The ogre quickly discarded the wand and killed the mage, but what remains seems to be functional as a spear."
2hspear_pestillentshortspeart5_descripti: "May this spear be a plague upon those who would do you wrong."
2hspear_phoenixsflightt5_description: "When thrown this javelin appears as if a flaming phoenix soaring through the sky."
2hspear_pigstickert2_description: "Perfect for hunting boar and roasting them afterwards."
2hspear_pikeofthegrandduelistt4_descript: "Duels are a popular past time in Aeternum. The impermenance of death allows fighters to give each duel their all without a regard for their life."
2hspear_pikeofthewoodmistresst4_descript: "She wanders the wilds with a spear at her side, though she dares not draw it unless challenged."
2hspear_plaguehuntt5_description: "The hunt is on, and the cure is gone."
2hspear_poseidonsinheritancet5_descripti: The strength of an ocean storm will ravage all that is around the wielder.
2hspear_pvp_named_description: The proverbial spearhead of the formation cannot breakdown.
2hspear_pvp_namedt51_description: "The banner may be gone but the war's still going strong."
2hspear_pvp_prestiget2_description: An ancient weapon that any soldier can rely upon.
2hspear_pvp_prestiget3_description: An ancient weapon that any soldier can rely upon.
2hspear_pvp_prestiget4_description: An ancient weapon that any soldier can rely upon.
2hspear_pvp_prestiget5_description: An ancient weapon that any soldier can rely upon.
2hspear_pvpt2_description: One of the oldest and most reliable forms of weaponry still holds its worth.
2hspear_pvpt3_description: One of the oldest and most reliable forms of weaponry still holds its worth.
2hspear_pvpt4_description: One of the oldest and most reliable forms of weaponry still holds its worth.
2hspear_pvpt5_description: One of the oldest and most reliable forms of weaponry still holds its worth.
2hspear_questl24_description: A well-made weapon. It will serve you as well as it served its previous wielder.
2hspear_questreward_constable_descriptio: This modified hunting spear provides a deceptive sense of security in a dangerous land.
2hspear_renewedfaitht5_description: "I had lost hope in humanity, but you have restored it."
2hspear_riptide_description: You feel a tug towards the coast trying to drag out as you wield this spear.
2hspear_ritualistslancett3_description: "Apostate Luca created this spear to lance all impurities out of the world."
2hspear_romandisciplinet5_v2_description: "Keep formation, guard your neighbor, trust your commander."
2hspear_rumblingdemiset5_description: "When the earth quakes my fury shall come for you."
2hspear_seasonedoakskewert3_description: "Every jab imparts a unique flavor of pain, carefully procured by Corlew."
2hspear_secondwind_description: The second wind is where champions and warriors are made. Usually because that's when people end up dead, and you can't be a winner if you lost.
2hspear_sentinelcaptainsspeart4_descript: “Previously wielded by the elite Sentinel Captain of the Ancient Guardians.”
2hspear_shardofamemoryt5_description: "Despite all of the atrocities she has committed, Isabella was once human like us."
2hspear_sharpenedogrefemurt3_description: "Dents and cracks line the bone of this once great beast, yet the tip is sharpened to a fine and lethal point."
2hspear_shatteredobelisk_mutt5_descripti: Blue as the sky lit by azoth lightning.
2hspear_shatteredshaftt4_description: "The shattered husk of a once venerable weapon, this spear has been reforged anew. Though it has lost some of its power, your foes would still be wise to fear you."
2hspear_shizaruslancet3_description: A sturdy Lance, wielded by Shizaru The Storm.
2hspear_shizarussorrowt3_description: "As a pirate I visited a thousand evils on my prey. On this forsaken island a thousand deaths I suffered in pennance."
2hspear_shizarut3_description: "As a pirate I visited a thousand evils on my prey. On this forsaken island a thousand deaths I suffered in pennance."
2hspear_shortstickt5_v2_description: "The name is crudely engraved on the pommel. I can only imagine what "Long Stick" might look like."
2hspear_singedpiket2_description: "At one point or another this weapon was thrust into a fire leaving a long charred scar across the shaft."
2hspear_sirenqueenssparringspeart5_descr: "To spar with the Siren Queen is the highest honor she grants to her subjects. Few are invited, and fewer leave her arena alive."
2hspear_soulforgedspeart5_description: "How many countless souls were stolen by this weapon and damned to a torment worse than death?"
2hspear_soulshroud_description: While originally intended to protect its bearer from the rampant corruption in these lands, its extended stay in the cloying corruption of the shattered mountain has rotted it to the core.
2hspear_spearofeternaltormentt5_descript: "Suffering does not stop when you die. You are simply reborn to suffer all over again."
2hspear_spearofhadest5_description: "The realm of death is mine to command, but its denizens are yours to do with as you will."
2hspear_spearofhauntedmemoriest3_descrip: "Every time you die in this strange land a piece of you fades away. Die enough times... well, all that remains at that point is the memory of what you once were."
2hspear_spearofshatteredsoulst5_descript: "First she broke my heart, then she ripped out my soul."
2hspear_spearofthecorruptedassaultt5_des: "They came for us as the sun dipped below the horizon. The red glow of their priests danced upon the trees. When night finally came, they descended upon our walls."
2hspear_spearofthecruelmaget5_descriptio: "The mage toyed with me for hours, experimenting with all forms of magic to torture me. When he let his guard down for but a moment, I seized my opportunity and thrust my spear into his heart."
2hspear_spearofthedefender_description: A protector is a valiant warrior indeed. For what could be more noble than protecting the weak?
2hspear_spearoftheeldershamant4_descript: "Magic is not limited to the arcane. What strange magics the Dryads of Reekwater wield is just as potent as that of the Ancients."
2hspear_spearofthefirstsnowt5_descriptio: "The first snow of each year is the most beautiful. A shame it needs to be coated with your blood."
2hspear_spearofthegreathuntt4_descriptio: "Ride atop your horse and seek out your prey."
2hspear_spearofthelostqueent4_descriptio: "For ages kings and queens have sought power. When news of Aeternum began to circulate the Old World, some rulers were bold enough to venture to this new land themselves. Their subjects never saw them again."
2hspear_spearoftheouterislest5_descripti: "The outer isles of Aeternum are rich in Azoth making them a desired destination for would-be explorers."
2hspear_spearofthepraetorianguardt5_desc: "Few souls have ever wileded a spear like the Praetorian Guard. Their talent was unmatched and their fervor was relentless."
2hspear_spearofvolcanicresolvet3_descrip: "Let the rage course through your veins."
2hspear_sporelight_description: The quiet light of the mossborne spores will guide your way.
2hspear_spreadofmalicet3_description: "Darkness spreads across the land slowly but steadily, corrupting whatever may be in its path."
2hspear_sprigganstriket5_description: "A well placed spear can strike between the warped and tangled wood that spriggans use for armor.
2hspear_sqrewardbrimstonet5_description: "The black shadow brews, full of menace"
2hspear_stormboundconduitt5_description: "Why bring the storm to others when you can bring the storm to you?"
2hspear_stormsongt5_description: "A haunting melody that makes your hair stand on end, your mouth taste of metal, and your skin tingle."
2hspear_subzerospeart5_description: "Even in the heat of the sun this spear remains frozen solid."
2hspear_sunrisekisst5_description: "May my point strike as true as the first drops of sunlight on the morning dew."
2hspear_sunrisespeart5_description: With a new day come new radiant possibilities.
2hspear_syncretic_description: A strange combination of past and ancient past in a land lost to time.
2hspear_syndicatealchemistsspeart5_descr: "A spear reserved for the most cunning alchemists of the Syndicate."
2hspear_syndicatechroniclersspeart2_desc: A Spear reserved for newcomers to the Syndicate.
2hspear_syndicatechroniclersspeart3_desc: "A spear reserved for agents of the Syndicate who have proved themselves loyal to the cause."
2hspear_syndicateexemplarsspeart4_descri: "A spear reserved for respected agents of the Syndicate who have proved useful in carrying out the will of the Alchemists."
2hspear_syndicateexemplarsspeart4a_descr: A Spear reserved for Syndicate who have reached the rank of Exemplar.
2hspear_syndicaterank1_description: A well-made spear for newly-inducted Syndicate Adepts.

2hspear_taiyi_description: A perfect union has fallen upon the earth.
2hspear_tanglevine_description: The writhing roots will grasp tightly on you to grant you their power.
2hspear_taskmastersmotivatort3_descripti: "You don't feel like working? Perhaps a little prod will quicken your pace."
2hspear_temperedexpectationst5_descripti: "I urge you my friends, do not get your hopes up. This island has a way of crushing them."
2hspear_tempertantrumt5_description: "Throw ration and reason out the window and let passion make your choices for you."
2hspear_tempestswhirlingfuryt5_descripti: "The song of the Tempest lures many to this land. Her unbridled fury is what keeps so many here."

2hspear_templeexplorerspiket5_descriptio: "When delving in ruins it is wise to carry a large weapon."

2hspear_timberleecht5_description: Subtle hints of life crawl all across the wood.
2hspear_tipofthemorningstart3_descriptio: "The fine point shines in the light of the stars."

2hspear_trial_s5_namedt5_description: Instills a chill in its user, and a dread in its target.
2hspear_trial_s5_t5_description: The cold steel used to forge this weapon gives it a chilling aura, you can feel its power just by holding it.

2hspear_unjustexecutert5_description: "What are you being executed for? Nothing more than my pleasure."

2hspear_viciousslayer_description: Powerful thrusts to turn your foes to dust.

2hspear_waverusht5_description: "My power shall rush over you as a wave rushes over a shell."

2hstafffire_arcanefiret2_description: "Master magicians all start somewhere. The poor soul who lost this is probably still being scolded."

2hstafffire_articulont5_description: Though you can see it is plainly made of wood and does not move, when you hold it you are certain you feel it writhing in your hand.
2hstafffire_ashencurset5_description: "Bound by fire to forever walk this land."
2hstafffire_ashendarkstafft5_description: "When the lights go out, who will be your ally?"
2hstafffire_ashenwaket3_description: "To ash with them. They will burn here and in the afterlife."
2hstafffire_ashtodustt5_description: "Your remains shall be scattered to the winds. You shall be forgotten."
2hstafffire_aterriblethoughtt4_descripti: "I spoke my mind and they recoiled in horror. Then, one by one, they agreed."
2hstafffire_awokenashstafft5_description: "Dark ash covers the light wood creating a messy appearance."
2hstafffire_azothcrystal_description: Crystallized azoth contains a great deal of power, take these mutated relics for yourself and grow your strength.
2hstafffire_baricssunstafft4_description: "The light and power of the sun are yours to control."
2hstafffire_blackfiret4_description: "The dark fire coven is a collective of some of Aeternum's most powerful pyromancers. To wield the black flame is to know true power."
2hstafffire_blackguardsfirestafft5_descr: "This old girl has seen some good use. I lost count of the number of villages she's burned."
2hstafffire_blazet5_v2_description: Fields of fire, as far as the eye can see. Only blood will pay for this.
2hstafffire_blisteringheatt4_description: The handle gets a little too warm when you cast a lot of spells in a row with this staff.
2hstafffire_bloodboilingfirestafft4_desc: "A slow death is much worse than a quick death."
2hstafffire_boltofflamet5_description: Like a bolt from the sky you strike your foes.
2hstafffire_breachfiregreatstafft4_descr: "Control the flames of the breach so that your allies do not get burned."
2hstafffire_breachhuntersfirestafft3_des: "Find the breaches into this world and close them."
2hstafffire_breathofsekhmett3_descriptio: "Like an inferno, when she opened her mouth to speak, the world burned with each word."
2hstafffire_brevist5_description: Its molten core is primed for devastation.
2hstafffire_burningfaestafft2_descriptio: "The staff is clearly crafted by the faefolk, with an enchanted flame adorning the edges."
2hstafffire_burningvoidt5_description: "Do not let the darkness fool you. The void burns all the same."
2hstafffire_burningvoidtendrilt2_descrip: "The void burns all that it touches as it corrupts the weak of heart."
2hstafffire_bushfiret5_description: "All it could do was spread and consume."
2hstafffire_cannonlightert4_description: "Light the fuse and let our enemies feel our wrath!"
2hstafffire_caputahgazeofserpenst5_descr: “Alone, enraged, and afraid it wandered the halls following the scent of arcane power."
2hstafffire_ceremonialdarkstafft4_descri: "A runic shaft coated with dark ash, this weapon is hauntingly beautiful."
2hstafffire_chandrasfireboltt5_descripti: There's more than one way to keep warm.
2hstafffire_channelersfirestafft4_descri: "Summoning a meteor requires discipline, will and focus. Master this art and great power can be yours."
2hstafffire_chaosflamet5_v2_description: An impossible flame. It seems to burn without a source, all-consuming, and without relent.
2hstafffire_chokinggaspt4_description: "Smoke is a temperamental thing, always wafting this way and that. Learn to control it, and you can control the battlefield."
2hstafffire_cindert2_description: "Know that, in this moment, you and the fire are as one."
2hstafffire_commandants_description: The commandant of the force has granted you a weapon from his personal armory. Use it well.
2hstafffire_corruptedmagesspellstafft5_d: "Forbidden magic is imbued heavily into this staff, enchanted by a rebellious sorcerer eons ago."
2hstafffire_corruptionsflamet5_descripti: "We shall wash over this world like a raging wildfire. Nothing will be left when we are finished."
2hstafffire_corruptprogenitor_descriptio: First on the lands and first to touch the corruption. The early visitors don't remain as anything more than a shell of what they were.
2hstafffire_covenantadjudicatorsfirestaf: "A Fire Staff reserved for the glorious adjudicator's of the Covenant."
2hstafffire_covenantdefendersfirestafft2: A Fire Staff reserved for newcomers to the Covenant.
2hstafffire_covenantdefendersfirestafft3: "A Fire Staff reserved for followers of the Covenant who have proved themselves loyal to the cause."
2hstafffire_covenanttemplarsfirestafft4_: "A Fire Staff reserved for devoute followers of the Covenant whose actions have brought glory to the cause."
2hstafffire_covenanttemplarsfirestafft4a: A Fire Staff reserved for Covenant who have reached the rank of Templar.
2hstafffire_crystallightstafft3_descript: "An unwavering glow shines forth from the staff."
2hstafffire_daemonblood_description: A raving madman has warned you this was made with the blood of a Demon. There's no way that's true, right?
2hstafffire_darklightt3_description: "A peculiar staff that seems to emit darkness rather than light."
2hstafffire_darkpyromancersspellstafft4_: "The coven's pyromancers were among the most powerful beings on Aeternum, controlling forces that were not meant to be controlled."
2hstafffire_deepriver_description: Lost in a river at a depth beyond the understanding of dry beings. It's incredible that a relic such as this can be seen again.
2hstafffire_dragonsbreatht5_description: "Dragon fire is among the most potent magical elements in the world."
2hstafffire_dualityt5_description: "Fire and ice, one complements the other."
2hstafffire_elegantlamplightert5_descrip: "Light the village and keep the dark things away."
2hstafffire_emberstonepromiset5_descript: "When Giada Emberstone swore she would avenge her husband's killers, she had no idea what it would entail."
2hstafffire_enchantedflamestafft5_descri: "Chaotic magic flows through the staff, ferociously seeking an outlet."
2hstafffire_encroachingcorruption_descri: You can feel the corruption seeping through you as you wield this fire staff.
2hstafffire_enmityt5_description: "We look upon each other as enemies, but it goes deeper than that. It is a deep, seething darkness that knows no measure."
2hstafffire_eruptiont4_description: "My rage boils within me. Do not tempt me to let it loose."
2hstafffire_eternalflameofosirist5_descr: We light the way for those who are lost, immortal, yet destitute of spirit beyond compare.

2hstafflife_staffofthefirstsint5_descrip: "You dishonor all mankind with what you have done."

9401_approachhorse: Search for horse to bond with
9401_befriendhorse_complete_a: <g id="male_pointblame" />Do you realize what we’ve done, stranger?<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> This changes everything. Look here,<g id="male_gestureup" /> spirits of my ancestors: we have brought the horse to Aeternum!
9401_befriendhorse_complete_b: <g id="male_clenchfistsangry" />May the blood of my father ride forever beneath the Eternal Blue Sky!
9401_befriendhorse_description: The son of a legendary warlord has built a stable in hopes that the return of the Beast Lords will mean he can put his horse training skills to use.
9401_befriendhorse_incomplete: Scared? If you’re afraid, don’t go. But if you’re going, don’t be afraid.
9401_befriendhorse_proposal: <g id="male_pointblame" />I knew you had a warrior's heart. Long ago, my brothers stole my inheritance from me.<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> On that day, I swore I would prove the<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" />  blood of my father flowed through my veins by taming the Takhi-- the ancient spirit horses of heaven.
9401_befriendhorse_proposal_2_a: <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />I found this land where no one had mounted a horse in millennia.<g id="male_pointblame" /> I came here to tame what is untamable.
9401_befriendhorse_proposal_2_b: <g id="male_handshipsconsider" />There was a cult of the Beast Lords near Walsham.<g id="male_think" /> Perhaps they left some clue there. Will you aid my search?
9401_befriendhorse_proposal_3_a: <g id="male_patience" />It will take more than keen senses to conquer this mystery, stranger.
9401_befriendhorse_proposal_3_b: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />The bond between horse and rider is sacred.<g id="male_willcoverit" /> One soul, two bodies. Remember this when you search.
9401_commune: Commune with the Beast Lords at the mural
9401_craftmountvittles: Craft Mount Vittles at the Camp
9401_craftmountvittles2: Equip Vittles then mount and feed your Horse
9401_efcircuit_complete: <g id="male_agree1" />You've returned! And I can already see a stronger rider before me.
9401_efcircuit_desc: Jochi Khan has asked me to build a bond between me and my horse by completing the Warrior's Path Circuit.
9401_efcircuit_incomplete: Don't be intimidated by the tracks. They are meant to be difficult, but that difficulty will make you both stronger. Show me you can do them.
9401_efcircuit_proposal: <g id="male_nod1" />They will. The times<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" /> I've posted are challenging, but pushing youself<g id="male_compliment" /> and your steed to beat them will forge trust between the two of you.<g id="male_nod1" /> Good luck.
9401_firsthorse_00_dialogue: This appears to be a horse. One can never be sure though…
9401_firsthorse_01_dialogue: The horse is calmly licking its lips looking for a snack. Perhaps if you offer it something…..
9401_firsthorse_start: The horse takes the oats and whinnies gratefully. It nudges your hand sniffing you. You feel a bond forming with it.
9401_firstrace_complete_a: <g id="male_pointblame" />I knew you had it in you! Push<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> your limits and your skills will continue to grow.
9401_firstrace_complete_b: <g id="male_pleadhandsopen" />Now that the bond between man and beast has been rekindled,<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> you'll find challenges from other racers. Be prepared.
9401_firstrace_complete_next_a: <g id="male_patience" />In the wild, horses eat grass. A racing horse is a rare breed.<g id="male_nodproud" /> The importance of this bond must be recognized.
9401_firstrace_complete_next_b: <g id="male_leanforwardinspect" />Craft the right vittles and you'll soon<g id="male_spreadarmscalm" /> find your horse swift and eager as wildfire.
9401_firstrace_complete_prompt: "How can I keep my horse strong?"
9401_firstrace_description: Jochi has set up a practice race to test the mettle of your steed. Go to the starting location and leap over the crate to begin the race.
9401_firstrace_incomplete: You have already done the impossible, my friend. Do not begin to doubt yourself now. It is no matter if you fall seven times, so long as you have the strength to rise eight.
9401_firstrace_proposal_2: <g id="male_converseleft" />This type of race is called a 'rally':<g id="male_converseright" /> a short-distance course meant to test your speed. There<g id="male_crossarmsdoubt" /> are a hundred roads to glory, if your horse is fast enough.
9401_firstrace_proposal_3_a: <g id="male_explain" />Stay aware of your surroundings and use your map to determine a swift route.<g id="male_headnodyes" /> Any spirit travel will disqualify you.
9401_firstrace_proposal_3_b: <g id="male_converseright" />You may find shortcuts and<g id="male_leanforwardinspect" /> hidden paths, if your eyes are keen enough.
9401_firstrace_proposal_4: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Good luck, my friend. Fate is kinder to the bold.<g id="male_nod2" /> If you want to build high, first dig deep. I’ll<g id="male_headnodyes" /> see you when you’re finished.
9401_firstrace_proposal_a: <g id="male_gesturedownright" />My people learn to ride at age two,<g id="male_apologizesmall" /> and start racing at age six. I hope<g id="male_dontknow" /> you're at least as skilled as our children. Let's find out.
9401_firstrace_proposal_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I have arranged a practice race for you.<g id="male_pointangry" /> Head to the starting line to test your skills.
9401_goto: Investigate the area by the lake for signs of the Beast Lords
9401_hint_response: You can summon your mount with (xxx) Sprinting costs mount stamina. Falling from great heights and being hit by enemies reduces its stamina. You can replenish stamina by feeding your mount. If its stamina gets too low you will be dismounted.
9401_jochikhan_00_dialogue_a: <g id="male_dismissgetlost2" />There is nothing here for you, stranger.<g id="male_crossarmsupset" /> A stable without a horse is like a garment without buttons.
9401_jochikhan_00_dialogue_b: <g id="male_clenchfistright" />But one day soon, this<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> paddock will swell with the sound of hoofbeats.<g id="male_salutefisttochest" /> I swear it, by the banner of my father.
9401_jochikhan_01_dialogue_a: <g id="male_goodnews" />Do you sense it, stranger? Something changed.<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> I can feel it in the beat of the horse hooves.
9401_jochikhan_01_dialogue_b: <g id="male_think" />The primal spirits of this land are returning. They were once called “Beast Lords.”<g id="male_converseright" /> And I believe with their return, what was<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> impossible is now possible.
9401_jochikhan_01b_dialogue_a: <g id="male_nod2" />The bond between horse and rider is sacred.<g id="male_willcoverit" /> Treat it well, and it will carry you far, across many battlefields and to many victories.
9401_jochikhan_01b_dialogue_b: <g id="male_goodnews" />But forging such a bond takes time and effort.
9401_jochikhan_02_dialogue_a: <g id="male_applaud" />Your skills are impressive.<g id="male_willcoverit" /> I have nothing more to teach.<g id="male_nodproud" /> Now experience will be your tutor.
9401_jochikhan_02_dialogue_b: <g id="male_pointblame" />There is a man called “François” who also keeps a stable.<g id="male_gesturehereweare" /> Challenge him and you will learn what you have not yet learned.
9401_jochikhan_03_dialogue_a: <g id="male_pointblame" />You’re improving. Your horse trusts you.<g id="male_converseright" /> I see it in the calm of his breath and the snap of his gait.<g id="male_crossarmsdoubt" /> But it takes much to impress me, my friend.
9401_jochikhan_03_dialogue_b: <g id="male_handshipsconsider" />Seek out more challenging races, and<g id="male_spreadarmscalm" /> soon I’ll think you were born in the saddle.
9401_jochikhan_efcircuit_default: <g id="male_applaud" />You've shown a rare aptitude for horsemanship, I think even<g id="male_laughcocky" /> my forefathers would be impressed. But trust<g id="male_pointblame" /> between horse and rider is something that is built over time.

9401_tutorialfood_00_a: <g id="male_gesturehereweare" />You can conquer the world from the back of a good horse, brother.<g id="male_nod2" /> Take care of your mount, and it will take care of you.
9401_tutorialfood_00_b: <g id="male_explain" />Here is a recipe my father taught me.<g id="male_nod1" /> It will keep your mount strong for the racing season.
9401_tutorialfood_complete_a: <g id="male_nod2" />Well done! Your horse<g id="male_pointblame" /> looks strong and eager. But a bond<g id="male_agree1" />  is forged through many hours in the saddle.
9401_tutorialfood_complete_b: <g id="male_gesturehereweare" />I have posted races at notice boards throughout the area.<g id="male_leanforwardinspect" /> These will push the limits of your potential.
9401_tutorialfood_description: Jochi has given you the ingredients to make Basic Mount Vittles. Craft them at any kitchen or campsite.
9401_tutorialfood_incomplete: <g id="male_dontknow" />A lazy rider wins few races, my friend.<g id="male_crossarmsjudge" /> See to it that your horse is fed, and then we’ll talk.
9401_tutorialfood_proposal: <g id="male_think" />In the wild? Yes. But a racing horse is a special breed.<g id="male_agree1" /> With proper care, a good mount will carry you swiftly past the horizon.
9401_vectorwf_complete: <g id="litearmor_whatwantfromme" />Well well, what have we here? A dusty rider on a broken mare?<g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" /> Or are you something more? I think<g id="litearmor_think" /> I know who you are. Jochi's new friend, no?
9401_vectorwf_description: Seek out François De La Rama in Weaver's Fen for additional races.
9401_vectorwf_gotofrancios: Find François de La Rama in Weaver's Fen (Rec. Player Level: 35)
9401_vectorwf_gotofrancios2: Return to François de La Rama
9401_vectorwf_incomplete: Keep an eye on François when you find him in Weaver's Fen. He is talented, but he may be a little… hard to trust.
9401_vectorwf_proposal_a: <g id="male_shrugbrief" />François is a… <g id="male_think" />unique individual, from what I understand.<g id="male_scoldfingerwag" /> But his horsemanship is second to none, and he likes to prove that with difficult races.
9401_vectorwf_proposal_b: <g id="male_leanforwardinspect" />Meet with him, and you'll see what I mean.
9401_wfcircuit_complete_a: <g id="litearmor_darnit" />You ride like the wind, stranger.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> I admit, I did not expect to lose. C’est la vie…
9401_wfcircuit_complete_b: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I have heard tales of Varangian knights astride great wolves.<g id="litearmor_realize" /> Can you imagine such a thing?<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> Find them, and perhaps you can learn their secret.
9401_wfcircuit_incomplete: You can quit if you would like. These tracks are not for the faint of heart. I suspect you are not the kind to do that, though.
9401_wfcircuit_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_chuckle" />So I have heard. But Jochi<g id="litearmor_concerns" /> is a romantic in love with the idea of rider and mount as one.
9401_wfcircuit_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />I live under no such delusions. I only care what you can bring to the table.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> So show me. I want to see what you can do.
9402_franciosdelarama_00_dialogue: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Beg your pardon, but I haven’t heard of you.<g id="litearmor_youknow" /> This is a private competition, friend. Invite only. Go<g id="litearmor_dismissgetlost2" /> make a name for yourself, and maybe we’ll talk.
9402_franciosdelarama_01_dialogue_a: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Ah… I’ve been wondering when you would show up.<g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" /> They say you’re not one to back down from a challenge.
9402_franciosdelarama_01_dialogue_b: <g id="litearmor_worry" />Well, I have a challenge for you. A ride for the ages across<g id="litearmor_agree1" /> some of Aeternum’s most mysterious thoroughfares.
9402_franciosdelarama_01b_dialogue: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Remember to watch your step around the Varangian…<g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" /> that order has a strict set of ethics, and you never know what might set them off.
9402_franciosdelarama_02_dialogue_a: <g id="litearmor_concerns" />Back again, friend? I already admit defeat.<g id="litearmor_youknow" /> A good smuggler always knows when the jig is up!
9402_franciosdelarama_02_dialogue_b: <g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />But Aeternum is<g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" /> rife with challenges and obstacles. I'm sure you<g id="litearmor_agree1" /> can find other races to keep your heart pounding!
9402_hint_response: My former paramour and I used our knowledge of the Ancient light bridges to move goods for very private clientele.
9402_hint_response_b: But it was too much looking over my shoulder. I organize horse races now. At least when I’m riding I know who’s chasing me.

9403_bsraces_complete_a: <g id="female_thinking" />You've come back! And I cannot believe it, you've beaten times that have stood for milennia!
9403_bsraces_complete_b: <g id="female_applause" />Oh, I knew there was something special about you…<g id="female_flirtsmall" /> I can't wait to compose a story about this!
9403_bsraces_description: Challenge the race times set by Satiah Rahmotep, and prove you can beat the times set by the ancients.
9403_bsraces_incomplete: I know those times seem difficult, but remember, they were set by those whose legends have lasted for lifetimes. Prove that you deserve to stand among them.
9403_bsraces_proposal1: <g id="female_headnodding" />I should hope that you are!<g id="female_explains" /> If you're able to conquer the courses, return to me.<g id="female_taptemple" /> Perhaps I will write about you.
9403_bsraces_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I have! And those that lived<g id="female_gesturerightm" /> here before certainly expected much from their competitors.<g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" /> From what I have heard, though, you are not one to be underestimated.
9403_bsraces_proposal_b: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I'd like to see you challenge the times of the ancient ones.
9403_church: Search the Varangian base for key to wolf cages
9403_firstwolf_00: You hear pitiful wheezing and heavy panting. This wolf has been beaten and burned, it is barely holding onto life.
9403_freewolves_complete: <g id="female_leftfistthreaten" />You've freed the wolves! The natural order is restored.<g id="female_nodconsider" /> Look for one with a compatible spirit, and<g id="female_leanforwardlisten" /> I will arrange a race to push the limits of your partnership.
9403_freewolves_description: A defector of the Varangian Order seeks aid to free a pack of dire wolves from her former compatriots.
9403_freewolves_incomplete: You tarry while our wolf-brothers languish in chains? Free the pack first, then we'll talk.
9403_freewolves_proposal: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />Then you are very naïve or very foolish. The pack is broken,<g id="female_disappointed" /> and the trust of the wolves is lost. No one will be riding them again.
9403_freewolves_proposal1_a: <g id="female_shakeheadno" />The wolves of Misty Borough are swift as the wind. <g id="female_pointthreaten" />But their predatory spirit must be nurtured.<g id="female_crossarms" /> My brethren seek to cage and dominate them. They've imprisoned three wolves.
9403_freewolves_proposal1_b: <g id="female_youknow" />If you free my pack, I<g id="female_gestureforward01" /> will teach you how to take one as your mount.
9403_freewolves_proposal2: <g id="female_nodyes" />Good luck, warrior!<g id="female_order" /> Do not underestimate my kinsmen.
9403_freewolves_start: "I wish to bond with a wolf."
9403_hint_response: Wolves are easier than humans. They do not feel greed or pride or envy. Simply show courage, show yourself to be the natural leader of the pack, and they follow.
9403_key_description: A key to the wolf cages in Misty Borough. Holding it feels like grasping hope.

9403_valenciaiznov_00_dialogue: <g id="female_blameshort" />I don’t know you, outsider. Didn't<g id="female_crossarms" /> your mother teach you not to talk to sullen, well-armed strangers?<g id="female_fingerwagno" /> Do not speak to me unless you've got something useful to say.
9403_valenciaiznov_01_dialogue_a: <g id="female_clenchfistssuffer" />My former comrades, cursed be their names, have brought disgrace on our people.<g id="female_dismissregal" /> Varangians reserve our wrath for our enemies.
9403_valenciaiznov_01_dialogue_b: We do not abuse and subjugate the wonders of the natural world.
9403_valenciaiznov_02_dialogue: <g id="female_salutefistchest" />You and your wolf are now of one spirit.<g id="female_nodding" /> But further challenges will strengthen your bond.<g id="female_leanforwardlisten" /> I have heard of a woman who seeks out the island's greatest champions.<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> Perhaps it is time your legend grows.
9403_valenciaiznov_02a_dialogue: <g id="female_thinking" />You've bested my races, but there is always room to grow.<g id="female_nodding" /> This woman, Satiah Rahmotep, has revived a set of courses from…<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> lifetimes ago.
9403_valenciaiznov_03_dialogue_a: <g id="female_nodrelieved" />Hail to you and your pack, champion.<g id="female_salutefistchest" /> The wolves remember your scent.
9403_valenciaiznov_03_dialogue_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />There are races in the wild that you can conquer to test your spirit and resolve.<g id="female_nodconsider" /> Stay strong, stay fearless,<g id="female_cheerfistpump" /> and your mount will always acknowledge you as alpha.
9403_valenciaiznov_04_dialogue: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />Wolves are pack animals, and will only follow those they deem to be capable.<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> If you're going to bond with your wolf,<g id="female_salutefistchest" /> you will need to show them you are worth their respect.
9403_valenciaiznov_start_dialogue: <g id="female_blameshort" />Now what are you doing here? Speak quickly!
9403_vectorbs_complete: <g id="female_leanforwardsmall" />Ah, and who is this before me? Not<g id="female_fingerwagno" /> a mirage, I should hope! Whew,<g id="female_waveoffdisdain" /> the heat will get to you quick out here.
9403_vectorbs_description: Satiah Rahmotep is collecting a book of records of Aeternum. She has laid out truly challenging courses for those riders who would seek immortal fame.
9403_vectorbs_gotosaitah: Find Satiah Rahmotep in Brimstone Sands (Rec. Player Level: 60)
9403_vectorbs_incomplete: Look<g id="female_thinking" /> for Satiah out in Brimstone. I'd be more specific, but the desert heat is not for me. Oh, and bring plenty of water for your pack.
9403_vectorbs_proposal_a: <g id="female_applause" />Brimstone. I'll put the spot on your map.<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> I've never run these races myself, but if she is to believed, they are second to none.
9403_vectorbs_proposal_b: <g id="female_waveoffdisdain" />With your wolf by your side, though,<g id="female_nodding" /> I'm sure you can master them. Until we meet again, friend.
9403_vectorlions_complete_a: What is this before me? A human deep in the territory of the Beast Lords? Perhaps I should…
9403_vectorlions_complete_b: Ah, but wait… something about your scent is familiar. I think I know who you are.
9403_vectorlions_description: Satiah Rahmotep has suggested that I seek out Zinnumun in the Elysian Wilds to further my riding training.
9403_vectorlions_gotolion: Find Zinnumun in Elysian Wilds (Rec. Player Level: 65)
9403_vectorlions_incomplete_a: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />I have never been to Elysian Wilds,<g id="female_gestureleftm" /> so I can't tell you what to expect.
9403_vectorlions_proposal: <g id="female_spreadarms" />It is, and it probably seems like it is hardly the place to compete in races.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> But the creatures that thrive in that environment… I've heard they move like no other.
9403_vectorlions_proposal1_a: <g id="female_fingerwagno" />If you want to become the greatest rider in Aeternum,<g id="female_headnodding" /> I believe they are the ones to show you how.
9403_vectorlions_proposal1_b: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />There is a name that is known to me - Zinnumun. I know little about her or her nature,<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> but I do know that she respects the swift. Find her.
9403_vectorwolves_complete: <g id="female_clenchfistsgetpumped" />Stay yourself, stranger!<g id="female_blameshort" /> I have no qualms about sending a<g id="female_impatient" />  wayward traveler back to their spirit shrine the hard way!
9403_vectorwolves_description: François de La Rama has asked that I seek out a Varangian named Valencia Iznov, saying she might have the secret to riding wolves. I should look for her in Great Cleave and see if I can earn her trust.
9403_vectorwolves_gotovalencia: Find Valencia Iznov in Great Cleave  [Recommended Player Level: 45]
9403_vectorwolves_incomplete: Last time I saw her, Valencia was up in Great Cleave. I can't promise she's still there, but that's your best bet.
9403_vectorwolves_proposal1_a: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Like I said, mind yourself, and<g id="litearmor_agree1" /> find a way to earn her trust. Do that, and she<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> may show you what she knows about riding.
9403_vectorwolves_proposal1_b: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Or she might try to run you through.<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> I really was never sure with her. Good luck.
9403_vectorwolves_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />If you'd like to continue your training, that's exactly what you need to do.<g id="litearmor_converseleft" /> I've dealt with this Varangian before -<g id="litearmor_secretiveshort" /> Valencia Iznov is her name.
9403_vectorwolves_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_realize" />She and I didn't part ways on the umm, best of terms, but<g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" /> she's different than others like her.
9403_vectorwolves_response: "I see. Anything else I should know?"
9403_wolfraces_description: In order to better bond with my wolf, I need to run the circuit set up by Valencia Iznov.
9403_wolfraces_incomplete: <g id="female_worry" />My races are difficult, but they are meant to be.<g id="female_nodding" /> The wolves need to know your strength.
9403_wolfraces_proposal_a: <g id="female_thinking" />That would certainly work. The pack is swift and strong, and<g id="female_explains" /> showing the wolf that you can guide them would prove you are capable.
9403_wolfraces_proposal_b: <g id="female_nodding" />I have set up a series of challenging races near here that you can use for that purpose.<g id="female_touchhands" /> Come back to me when you've finished them.
9403_wolftour: Investigate Varangian treatment of the wolves
9404_hint_response: Oh, I can't take sides, hero. That wouldn't be sporting. But you seem capable enough. But the fastest riders have knowledge of hidden glyphs and the Ancient bridges.

9404_rally_1_proposal_2: The great pyramid, the mercury pools, and the settlement - the ancient gods look over everything in eternal splendor. Ends at New Corsica in Brimstone Sands.
