9404_satiahrahmotep_00_dialogue: <g id="female_fingerwagno" />This is a place for champions, hero.<g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> You are admired for a great many things, but expertise as a rider is world unto itself.<g id="female_disagreecrossarms" /> Prove yourself in some of Aeternum’s other races, then we’ll talk.
9404_satiahrahmotep_01_dialogue_a: <g id="female_salutefistchest" />Hail to you, champion.<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> I am Satiah, a chronicler of Aeternum’s finest.<g id="female_headnodding" /> Even immortals require a legacy.
9404_satiahrahmotep_01_dialogue_b: <g id="female_lookconcern" />Would you be willing to undertake a challenge to preserve what you have learned for the next generation of castaways?
9404_satiahrahmotep_02_dialogue_a: <g id="female_headshakesmall" />I have never seen a rider of your skill, hero.<g id="female_taptemple" /> But there is a rumor…<g id="female_leanforwardsecret" /> whispers of an island to the south, off the coast of what we used to call First Light.
9404_satiahrahmotep_02_dialogue_b: <g id="female_gesturearoundroom" />They say the creatures there are swifter than the wind in a squall.
9404_satiahrahmotep_03_dialogue_a: <g id="female_crossarms" />I cannot imagine a human rider that is your equal, champion.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> But there are deeper mysteries in this strange and terrible land.
9404_satiahrahmotep_03_dialogue_b: <g id="female_gesturearoundroom" />Perhaps someone, or something, out there in the wild can still challenge a rider of your considerable mastery.

9405_evillionwhisper: Another human who believes he is a master of beasts. Pathetic. Aeternum was once place of balance
9405_evillionwhisper_01: and tranquility, before the arrival of you and your 'gods.' You will learn what it means to be true hunter!

9405_goto_bridge_desc: Travel to Shirzad's Pride to rescue Kaluru
9405_goto_edge_desc: Follow the path to Isle of Zurvān
9405_hint_response: Your kind are not like us. Mother Earth has not given you a natural instinct to follow. Some, like yourself, are as constant as the tides. Others are capricious, like a leaf on the wind. I trust who I can and am wary of others.
9405_isleentrance: Discover the entrance to the mysterious island
9405_kaluru_00_dialogue: All this time, I believed humans understood only dominance. But now I owe every free breath I take to you. Your heart beats with a lion's pride. I will let all my kind know, you are friend to the wilds.
9405_kaluru_01_dialogue: Before your kind arrived in this land, we lions were known as the king of beasts. All creatures, great and small, bowed to our majesty. The world has changed now... for all of us.
9405_kaluru_02_dialogue: This lion looks severely malnourished. You can hear him whimpering.
9405_key_description: A key to Kaluru's cage. It seems to emanate primal power.
9405_lionraces_complete_a: You're come back, every bit as capable as a member of our tribe.
9405_lionraces_complete_b: I commend you, friend human. There are few of your kind that could accomplish what you have. Go forth, and use your bonds wisely.
9405_lionraces_description: Zinnumun has set me to train on the same courses they use to teach their young. I must show I can match or beat the times set by hunting lions.
9405_lionraces_incomplete: We expect much from our young. If you are going to stride alongside lions, you must show you can keep up with the pride.
9405_lionraces_proposal1_a: There is a series of courses that we lions use to teach our young to be swift and agile. I will see to it that these are set up on a way that you can understand as a human.
9405_lionraces_proposal1_b: Beat those times, and you will learn what you need to.
9405_lionraces_proposal_a: I see… well, as you have proven yourself on many occasions to be a friend of our kind, we will grant you this favor.
9405_lionraces_proposal_b: There is no greater teacher than experience, though, and that is what I will give you.
9405_lionraces_response: "What is it I need to do?"
9405_lionraces_start: "I wish to be a peerless rider."
9405_rally_1_proposal: Emerald Run Rally - "The beast stirs within your heart. Imagine what you might accomplish if you set it free!" – Shirzad. (Rec. Player Level: 65, Riding Level: 200-249)
9405_rally_1_proposal_2: Descend into the wild greens of Beast Lord stomping grounds, leap beyond the clutch of hungry teeth, and make your way back to Last Light.
9405_rally_2_proposal: Hanging Gardens Rally - "In time, even the pride of the greatest civilizations is reclaimed by mother nature." - Artemis. (Rec. Player Level: 65, Riding Level: 200-249)
9405_rally_2_proposal_2: Dash through green rolling hills and the tunnels of Tempestas Custodia for the ultimate test of your agility.
9405_rescuelion_complete: Because of you, my darling Kaluru runs free. You have proven you have the heart of a lion. Should you require aid, call to me, and I will answer.
9405_rescuelion_description: Zinnumun, matriarch of the Elysian lions, summons Aeternum's greatest hero to liberate her mate Kaluru from the clutches of pretender Lion Lords that seek to end the growing alliance between man and beast.
9405_rescuelion_incomplete: You’re back? I don’t see my mate. Perhaps your skills as a hunter are exaggerated.
9405_rescuelion_proposal: Their den lies just a short sprint ahead. But be cautious: they are skilled hunters. Free him, and you will have earned my bond as well.
9405_rescuelion_proposal_next: Then may Shirzad bless your hunt, human.
9405_tour_1_proposal: Warrior's Reprise Tour - "Conquering the world on horseback is easy. It is dismounting and governing that is hard." - Genghis Khan (Rec. Player Level: 65, Riding Level: 200-249)
9405_tour_1_proposal_2: Ride back to where your journey with beastkind began. Ends at Jochi's Stable in Everfall.
9405_tour_2_proposal: Island Tour - "The truth is like a lion. There is no need to defend it. Let it loose and it will defend itself." - Augustine of Hippo (Rec. Player Level: 65, Riding Level: 200 -249)
9405_tour_2_proposal_2: Island Tour - Test your true mettle with the fearlessness of a lion. Ends at Deadman's Shrine in Monarch's Bluffs.
9405_tour_3_proposal: Sands and Storms Tour - "Shine like lightning. Roar like thunder. Ride like the wind." - Unknown. (Rec. Player Level: 65, Riding Level: 200 -249)
9405_tour_3_proposal_2: Ponder the mysteries of Aeternum through along a route wrought with clandestine whispers. Ends at Syndicate Enclave in Everfall.

9405_zinnumun_00_b_dialogue: You are either very brave or very mad, human. Most of your kind do not dare offer warm greetings to a mighty hunter such as myself.
9405_zinnumun_00_dialogue: You are either very brave or very mad, human. Most of your kind do not dare offer warm greetings to a mighty hunter such as myself.
9405_zinnumun_01_dialogue_a: Greetings, human. I have heard you are a friend to beasts. My mate, Kaluru, is welcoming to your kind.
9405_zinnumun_01_dialogue_b: And for that, the would-be lion lord twins, Zurvān of Moon’s Shadow and Sun’s Wing hold him in bondage. Would you honor his bond with your people?
9405_zinnumun_02_dialogue_a: Back again, friend human? The lions remember your service.
9405_zinnumun_02_dialogue_b: Perhaps you should test your bond with our kind by seeking out some of this land's most challenging races. There is no greater teacher than experience.
9405_zinnumun_start_races: Now, what is it that I can do for you, friend human?
95_dogcamp_p01_defaultdialogue_01: (Dog twitches his tail playfully. He seems happy there's more people around. Has he grown a bit bigger?)
95_s01_01_bag_description: Official Bag of the Silver Crows.
95_s01_01_campsuppliesitem_description: Building supplies retrieved from a Corrupted camp.
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_buildcam: Use your supplies to build the Crow's Nest
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_buitbann: You've built a home base for the Silver Crows
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_complete: <g id="g_grace_gesturearound" priority="high" />Now we got a safe place for the Silver Crows to call home! It's time to start expanding the crew and earning some coin!
<g id="g_grace_no" />I'd swear I've crossed this entire island ten times now, so I'll<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> handle this place<g id="g_grace_chuckle" /> - you do the footwork.
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_cue_a: <g id="g_grace_casualhail" />Good to see you again, mate. Feels like there's been a lull in us adventuring together!
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_cue_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturelefts" />I've been thinking, new threats keep rising up here…<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> maybe we need a plan that takes that into account.
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_descript: Grace O'Malley has developed a plan to found an enterprising new group of heroes who can work together to face the threats of Aeternum and possibly earn a little coin in the process.
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_gototrig: Drive the Corrupted away from the outskirts of the Crow's Nest
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_incomple: <g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" />These pesky Corrupted keep turning up everywhere.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> I'm starting to get used to it.
95_s01_01_crow_gracelessrequest_proposal: <g id="g_grace_dismiss" />Grace O'Malley never gives up! I just changed my mind.<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> It's not so bad on Aeternum, long as there's good company and good coin.
<g id="g_grace_consider" />So I'm thinking we build on your reputation and start a heroes for hire sort of affair.
<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />This camp's not much, but it beats that drafty old Caer Dun, and<g id="g_grace_gesturel" /> we can expand later, call it the Crow's Nest.
<g id="g_grace_no" />Only problem is some of those red-eyed bastards camping nearby. You clear them<g id="g_grace_yes" /> out, we're in business.
<g id="g_grace_chuckle" />Ah yeah, we're sailing with the same wind!<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> We'd recruit the island's best talent, maybe call the operation "Silver Crows."
<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />You'd captain the gang with me as First Mate<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> - I'd even give you double share on prizes. What do you say?
"I'm in. We just need a hideout."
95_s01_02_2hblunderbuss_description: Put a ring in their ear and a grin on your face with this gift of Grace.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_ambush_foll: Follow the tracks to search for Skye's partner Aidyn
Retrace Skye's steps to search for her partner Aidyn
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_ambush_geta: Recover Aidyn's Brooch and the message left for Skye
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_ambush_goto: Investigate the shiny object on the ground
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_complete_a: All you found is her brooch? Did she get herself captured?
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_complete_b: Ah, a message too… Beira's teeth! She's gone mad, decided she's going after the warlock on her own!
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_complete_ne: That's the spirit I'm looking for! And when we find him, my spear will drink its fill of his heart's blood. I swear it on the west and east!
Aidyn's always been overproud. Her warrior's fire blazed brightest… until that Faceless bastard stole it.
She wasn't happy when I asked for help… but with the curse, Faceless will swat her away like a fly.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_cue_a: Ah, I hope you'll forgive me, but I was floating your name around even before we shook on this deal.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_cue_b: It's a lodestone for business, I tell you, so I've already lined up our first client - a Celtic speardaughter named Skye.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_description: Grace has already lined up a first engagement for the Silver Crows. Learn about your mission and meet the customer in Great Cleave.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_gotowoods: Find Skye and her partner in Great Cleave
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_incomplete: Keep me posted on how things go with Skye. This is our first client, so we need to make a good impression.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_interact_ba: The ground here is marked with signs of a struggle. A separate set of tracks leads downhill.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_interact_cl: Aidyn's trail stops at the edge of the cliff. You catch a tiny glint of metal far below.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_meetskye: Meet Skye and her partner in Great Cleave
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_proposal_a: Skye and her partner got cursed by a Varangian Warlock - probably something to do with this new contingent called "The Forged."
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_proposal_b: Some grim tidings coming from Great Cleave lately. This Skye, she seems desperate.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_proposal_ne: No doubt, but make sure to read Skye's letter first, hear the tale in her own words.
Then head out to find her, and her spear-sister, in Great Cleave. Good luck, and may fortune smile on us all with this business.
95_s01_02_temp_firstcustomer_talktoskye_: Please… please, I need help! Are you from the Silver Crows? Yes, thank the gods you're here.
My spear-sister and I… we were scouting the Varangians' position to give you a start… but they caught on.
Ambush. They sent a band of brutes around to surprise us... Aidyn and I were running, and then I lost her.
You must find her quickly, she may be in trouble.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_complete_a: Here I am talking to Skye like she's some young girl from Cork, but in truth, she's got centuries on me.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_complete_b: She's been on the island since before Cork was even on the map! Still can't wrap my head around it!
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_complete_next_a: That she does, and she needs our help, that's for sure. Poor thing, losing Aidyn, her only friend in the world.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_complete_next_b: What say we recruit some new Crows to widen her social circle?
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_completionavail: (This table looks like it could be used to destroy the bone talismans.)
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_cue_a: First thing we need to do is lift this damn curse and get my fire back.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_cue_b: There's a sorceress in these parts named Shailyn - she knows about the Varangians' dark hexes. She's got answers I need.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_description: Skye seeks a way to lift the curse on herself and other victims of the Varangians.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_destroyfirstbon: As you crush the bones, you sense power being released back to the victims.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_incomplete_a: I feel the darkness of Faceless's curse weigh down my neck, heavy as Beira's hammer.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_killandgatherch: Defeat Varangian Soldiers to collect Bone Talismans made by Faceless
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_proposal_a: You'd do that for me? I made the right choice, seeking you out.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_proposal_b: Alright, I'll head to your Crow's Nest camp. Learn what you can from Shailyn and then meet me back there.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktobonecharm: (This table looks like it could be used to destroy the bone talismans.)
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoshailyn_a: If you've come seeking treasures from the Empyrean forge, you should abandon that notion.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoshailyn_b: It's been claimed by a ruthless band of Varangian raiders… their methods are cruel and their magic is malignant.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoshailyn_d: Talk to the sorceress Shailyn to see if she can help lift Skye's curse
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoshailyn_n: Exactly, Hróaldr drains the warrior's fire from his victims and infuses the bone talismans to strengthen himself and his soldiers.
Collect and destroy the talismans to restore the victims' fire. That's the only cure I know of.
Is this about the speardaughter? She ran afoul of Hróaldr - the Faceless one. I am all too familiar with his sadistic power.
The warlock himself has not been here, but I have seen warriors wearing his bone talismans.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoshailyn_p: "Do you know how to lift a curse."
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoskye_a: That seemed fast! Perhaps because Grace is lifting my spirits, regaling me with news of the old world, and tales of your exploits, of course.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoskye_b: Please tell me... the sorceress Shailyn, did she have answers - a way of lifting this damned curse?
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoskye_desc: Return to the Crow's Nest to show Skye the Bone Talismans
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_talktoskye_next: Just our luck, right? Still, it's nice to think smashing these will restore the might of other warriors.
I'll settle for that satisfaction now, and I'll hope we find either Aidyn or Faceless before they find each other.
So these talismans are infused with the warrior's fire stolen by Faceless?
Interesting, each talisman bears a sigil similar to those etched on both Aidyn's back and my own… but there's not a direct match here.
95_s01_02a_temp_thecurse_title: The Curse of the Faceless One
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_no" />Clearly, that was not the best of Aeternum.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />I could tell you didn't like this idea to begin with, and you were right. We need another way.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_cue: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Now I've known you long enough to tell. Something's bothering you, isn't it?
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_cue_alt_a: <g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" />When I was Captain of the Satisfaction, I left the recruiting to the First Mate,<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> thought it was a simple task, you know?
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_cue_alt_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Turns out it's a wee bit more difficult finding quality people…<g id="g_grace_handheart" /> especially with you and me kinda setting the standard.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_descriptio: The Silver Crows need more members. Work with Grace to find additional heroes to join the group.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_gotavernin: Meet Grace O'Malley at the tavern to interview candidates for the Silver Crows
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_gotopoifly: Travel to Mourningdale to recruit new members for the Silver Crows
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_incomplete: <g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" />I can tell you don't like the idea of finding true talent by posting notices.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> But you'll see, it's a mercenary company tradition.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_interview_: After years of meticulous study, I finally know the secret of the Ancients! They came from the future!
After years of meticulous study, I finally know the secret of the Ancients!
There you are! Been waiting for you to get started. Already got a few candidates lined up!
Alright, let's bring on the candidates then, shall we?
All right, who's first? Step up and let's hear your qualifications.
Alright, we're done here. Ahh, this was a mistake, to be fair.
I am a great admirer of your mercenary company. To me, the Iron Rose has-- is this not the interviews for the Iron Rose?
I am a great admirer of your mercenary company.
To me, the Iron Rose has--
Is this not the interviews for the Iron Rose?
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_next_a: <g id="g_grace_no" />Well we've got to start somewhere.<g id="g_grace_crossarmsinsulted" /> The way I see it, we need people with the mettle to sail through bad weather.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_next_b: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />And there's nowhere on Aeternum with worse weather than Mourningdale.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_postflyers: Post Silver Crows recruitment flyers in Grayvale Hamlet
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_proposal: <g id="g_grace_realize" />Matter of fact, I was just heading over to Mourningdale to post up some recruiting notices.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> Care to join me?
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />Well now, that'd be most welcome, posting flyers and<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> conducting these interviews could be<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> a team effort.
<g id="g_grace_consider" />I've been poking around different settlements, I think Mourningdale's the best place to recruit.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_tavern_gre: <g id="g_grace_spreadarms" />There you are! I guess you must've gotten all those notices posted, because we got people lining up already.
<g id="g_grace_no" />Not sure this is the best Aeternum has to offer - some of these volunteers seem a bit a dodgy.
95_s01_03_crow_bestofaeternum_tavern_tal: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Now you're throwing my lines back at me?<g id="g_grace_crossarmsinsulted" /> Never miss a chance to give me shite, do you?
<g id="g_grace_flirt" />So it is, though. We'll see what these folks have to say for themselves… let's just keep our<g id="g_grace_gesturelefts" /> expectations… low.
95_s01_03_heroesposteritem_description: A recruting poster for the Silver Crows.
95_s01_04_azothsap_description: A few small drops of bluish, glowing sap.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_collectflame: Collect Verdant Essence from Angry Earth
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_collectgator: Collect a Gator Liver from Black Alligators
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_complete_a: <g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />Thank you, my friend. This is very clever, making a treat to heal the kitty-cat.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_complete_b: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />I must think about this some more. Perhaps I can create a<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> new recipe or two of my own for the little fellow.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_complete_nex: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Of course! What about me does not suggest that I love to cook?
<g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Of course! What about me does not suggest that I love to cook?

<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Everyone knows me as Zander the Baker, yes?<g id="g_female_notsure" /> Ah, just wait until you try my lemon cakes. Oh, I guess that means I'll join you.<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> Go on, I'll meet you there.
<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Everyone knows me as Zander the Baker, yes?<g id="g_female_notsure" /> Ah, just wait until you try my lemon cakes.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_crafthealing: Craft Eynon's Purifying Pâté at a Kitchen or at your Camp
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_cue_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Believe it or not,<g id="g_grace_convince2" /> I've got a strong candidate to be our next Crow - a real mean fellow, an enforcer known as "Zander the Undying."
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_cue_b: <g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />So tough, he's yet to die even once.<g id="g_grace_concerns" /> He's been mauled, shot, poisoned, but never died.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_description: Grace has a great candidate in mind. Locate Zander the Undying and convince him to join the Crows.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_gatheringred: Gather ingredients for Eynon's Purifying Pâté anti-toxin
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_incomplete: <g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" />This Zander character seems like he'd round out our team pretty well.<g id="g_grace_yes" /> Let me know what you think.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_meeteynon: Talk to Eynon the Druid about getting medicine for the baby lynx
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_meetzander: Speak to Zander the Undying in Edengrove about joining the Silver Crows
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_secret" />Word is, he's left his old employer, a bit of a shady outfit, but that might not be so terrible.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Zander's hunkered down in a small cabin over in Edengrove. He's expecting you, so go talk to him and then<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> you make the call.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_returnhealin: Return the Purifying Pâté to Zander
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_talkto_first: Ahh! No! No claw! Listen to me, baby cat. Scratch me one more time, and I will bake you into a pie. It will be very hot, and sugary, and-- OW!
Ahh! No! No claw! Listen to me, baby cat-
Scratch me one more time, and I will bake you into a pie.
It will be very hot, and sugary, and-- OW!
<g id="g_female_notsure" />Hm, so you're the boss of the Silver Crows, eh? Yes of course, I have heard of you and your mighty deeds.
<g id="g_male_compliment" />You're the infamous commander who came to Aeternum on a ship, and upon landing,<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> tragically fell to Corruption.
<g id="g_female_spreadarms" />Well now, that would be very good of you. Find<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> Eynon the Druid - he'll have something to treat him.
<g id="g_male_nodsympathysmall" />Brave little kitty! Our new friend's going to get you some medicine… don't you worry.

<g id="g_female_nodyes" />Hm. Even more impressive!<g id="g_female_fingerwagno" /> But I cannot join the Crows right now -<g id="g_male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" /> this sick little kitty has a greenish color and needs my help.
<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />What can I do? Little fellow's too weak to bring to a healer, and I<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> cannot leave him here alone.
95_s01_04_crow_zanderthered_talktoeynon_: If you're a hunter, hoping to trick me into giving you the location of some creature's den, don't bother. I'm wise to that.
If you're hoping to learn how to talk to animals, there's a waiting list… and it's long.
Oh… yes. This recipe is for a treat to reverse the process, but don't let the kitty near water for two days after they eat it. You're welcome.
Remember, Eynon heals all animals. Except squirrels, the dirty little hoarders.
Oh no, another one with the green complexion? First a goat with potato eyes, then a bear with ears of corn!
Animals turning into plants…  nature's a trickster, even for a druid, but I'd say someone's behind this.
95_s01_04_gatorliver_description: The liver of a large gator.
95_s01_04_healingsalve_description: A liver-based edible meant to cure toxins for animals.
95_s01_04_healingsalve_workorder_descrip: Instructions on how to make Eynon's Purifying Pâté. It seems to be a cooking recipe.
95_s01_05_2hwarhammer_description: Useful both in and out of the kitchen.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />First off, great work getting Zander to sign on, he'll be a great add to our team.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_doubt" />Second, that mangy dog he brought? It has to go.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_complete_nex: <g id="g_grace_frustrated" />Dog…. Lynx... whatever it is, it has fleas, which is why I made Zander<g id="g_grace_gesturerighthand" /> put it all the way over there.
<g id="g_grace_noway" />The loathsome little thing keeps trying to sneak into my bedroll. I feel itchy just thinking about it.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_confrontprie: Confront Dicun about stealing the funds
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_cue_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />About your Silver Crows, I would like to join, but there's a slight problem.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_cue_b: <g id="g_female_youknow" />My current employer, Granny Pike, she gets… attached.<g id="g_male_concerns" /> She buried a man alive for a day after he was thinking of leaving her employ.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_description: Help Zander find a way out of his organization.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_dicungetsawa: It seems that Dicun's gone for now. And good riddance.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_ebonscale_re: Travel to Brightwood Isle to find Dicun's hidden loot
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_gobwchurch: Visit the Calvary church to investigate thefts
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_hearnoise: It sounds like Dicun's voice outside the cabin- has he followed you here?
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_incomplete: <g id="g_male_itsokay" />If you talk to Granny, be… diplomatic.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> I can still hear the sound of dirt hitting the lid of that coffin.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_interviewcle: Ask the priest about the stolen funds
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_plantfunds: Store the fake funds in the cabinet
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_plantfunds_s: Now that you've planted the funds, find a good vantage point to watch for the thief. Perhaps the rooftop…
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_proposal_a: <g id="g_female_headnodding" />You are speaking to him. After she released me,<g id="g_female_spreadarms" /> she said I could take time away, but leaving would never be an option.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_proposal_b: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Maybe you can change her mind? It's up to you, but<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> without her approval, I'm stuck.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_recoverfunds: Recover Granny's funds from Brightwood Isle so she'll let Zander join your team
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_returnfundsg: Return the church renovation funds to Granny
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_spypriest: Find a good spot to watch for the thief
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_talkto_amis_: Sure, put the coin inside, but Marty and me are taking a break soon. Here, last time, we weren't gone more than a few minutes, and it disappeared.
It's one of those specters we seen out on the moors, I swear it!
Don't you know about Brightwood? How they used to bury people alive?
So now there's one of them back for revenge, figures we owe him for all the suffering he's been through.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_talkto_dicun: It may sound pathetic to you, for an old man like me to say I've changed, but it's true.
You've allowed me to redeem myself. And I will. I'll make sure you are rewarded for your faith in me.
Ah! How did you escape from there?
All right, all right, y-you caught me! I'll make a full confession, I swear it!
Ah! My goodness but you gave me quite the start! Funny that you're here. I was just checking to make sure your funds were secure.
Oh no! No, no! Have mercy, please, don't tell Granny!
I haven't touched a coin of what I took before, you'll see, I'll tell you where I hid it!
Daaah, ta da da da da daa da da daa da daahh, dah dah dah hm hm hm hm hmmm…
If you're here with money from Granny, leave it in the cabinet on the far wall, and thank you for your service.
Sad isn't it? We came to this land of plentiful life and bounty, and yet - and yet our greed, ambition, hunger - nothing changed, did it?
It could be anyone. The guards, Beatris, myself, none of us make much coin. Ah, but I'm not sure my opinion matters.
I'm just happy they decided to restart the construction. It will be joyous to see this place restored.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_talkto_grann: Oh, I know who you are - you've been talking to Zander. Yes, Granny has eyes everywhere. Don’t forget it.
And you can give up on recruiting Zander. He won't join your little band of greedy do-gooders.
That's what I want to know. Our organization's paying to rebuild it - we see it as a way of giving back to the community.
But someone's skimming our funds. Find the thief, recover our coin, and we'll talk about Zander.
Clever, you. Too clever gets the cleaver, hm? Alright, you've got steel in your spine.
Do me a favor, and I'll consider it. There's a church in Calvary, in Brightwood, it's under construction… for years now.
You recovered the stolen funds, I see. You're as clever as I had you figured to be. Now, what say you tell me who was the culprit?
Fine. He's yours, for now. Tell him Granny Pike said-- Ah, damned dust. Go on, leave me be, child.
Ha! I get it! You're running your own little protection racket now, are you?
I was going to hire you, but there's only enough room for one big fish in this pond. So get on with you - our deal is one and done.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_talkto_marty: Sent you with replacement funds, did they? Well let me tell you what I think-- Shut your trap Amis, what do you know?
I say it's that lurking priest! He took the money, so they don't have to pay the builders!
Yeah, well, I'm still sorting it all out, but it's coming clear, all right.
Clear as the wind coming through those great big holes in the roof!
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_talkto_zande: <g id="g_male_shocked" />Granny Pike told you that I could join the Silver Crows?<g id="g_male_compliment" /> You are an incredible wonder. I feel the urge to hug you with all my strength.
<g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Thank you. For<g id="g_male_willcoverit" /> the second time in my life, I feel I have met a true friend.
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />And you also made the priest make a confession?<g id="g_male_laugh" /> Ah ha ha! That is what they call a "metaphor," my friend.
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_zanderbanner: You've recruited Zander the Undying and Dog to join your team
95_s01_05_crow_canonandcoin_zandergoodne: Meet Zander at the Crow's Nest where he's gone to await Granny's answer
95_s01_05_fakefundsitem_description: Fake replacement funds to lure the thief in Brightwood.
95_s01_06_lighthelm_description: Hide your fearless smirk behind this mask.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychain_interact_foot: The footprints seem to lead toward an abandoned shack.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychain_interact_trai: The tracks are fresh, and look about the right size for the smuggler.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_cageunlock: Free the prisoner in the cage
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_caravan_onsi: Zander's thorough, I'll give him that. And every bit as scary as I thought he'd be.
The fact that he bakes delicious lemon cakes makes him even more terrifying somehow.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_complete_a: I guess Frank discovered his conscience, he came by to spill his "fearless" guts about the operation.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_complete_b: Zander's having a chat with him to find out what he knows.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_complete_nex: Ah, don't get caught up in the rigging, we'll take care of things here.
I'll let you know what we find out about Faceless, back at the Crow's Nest.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_completetogr: Check with Grace for any new leads on Faceless
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_cue_a: So, I was talking to Skye about what happened, how Faceless came and stole her warrior's fire.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_cue_b: Doesn't it seem strange to you that he took the time to show up in person, when he wants to empower his whole army?
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_description: Work with the Crows to track down the Varangian warlock, Faceless.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_egpoilocatef: Travel to Valor Hold in Edengrove to look for the smuggler
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_fergus_getin: Oh, I'm still fearless. I just decided, free of fear, to share what I know.
And I already told you everything I know, so go away!
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_freeprisoner: Free the captured warriors and look for information on Faceless
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_getcaravanin: Ask Frank where he's taking the kidnapped warriors
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_getkey: Defeat the Varangian guards to get a key for the cage
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_incomplete: Once we find this warlock-- Well, just, be careful. It's not like I've got piles of friends like you lying about.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_next_a: You're getting this a lot faster than we did. Anyhow, I checked with some acquaintances.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_next_b: There's a smuggler "recruiting warriors" in Valor Hold, hundreds they say. Let's follow the rat to the cheese, shall we?
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_prisonerresc: Thank you, friend! These Varangians were brutal captors.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_proposal_a: Exactly! And the other thing we can guess is, he had to be there in person to curse them.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_proposal_b: Which means, now that he's making hundreds of those filthy talismans…
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_questionferg: Question the smuggler for clues on Faceless's location
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_skye_impatie: Alright, pull yourself together, Skye. You've got this.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_talkto_fergu: Damn it all! How'd you find me? You just won't leave well enough alone, will you?
If you're here hoping to collect that bounty on my head, you're wasting your time - someone already killed me and claimed it!
Hm... Yeah, I guess you got a point. I don't fear death, but that warlock makes me queasy. If I'm being honest, I never liked this whole abduction scheme.
Tell you what, I'll mark the spot on your map where I'm supposed to make the exchange… and I wash my hands of it!
Oh, that? You can ask all day, but I'm not talking. Go ahead and do your worst.
You're dealing with Fearless Frank - I been killed so many times, there's nothing that'll give me even a sliver of fear.
Hey, aren't you the one who… yeah you're the one - a real hero, they say.
Don't know what you're doing talking to me, but you gotta move along. I got business to take care of.
Yeah… Not of your ilk. I'm specifically looking for the less… heroic type.
I got no bone to pick with you, just asking you to mind your own business.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_talkto_skye_: I used to be sure in a fight, of my feet, my spear, my breath. Now, there’s a doubt. I feel I might miss, and I do. I stumble on a rock I knew was there.
Yet, I still want the fight! And that’s worst of all.
Will we? If only I could help! If I could just fight! Or even have enough strength to go and search for Aidyn.
Tell me. If it were you, and you felt despair's icy grip at your throat, what would you do?
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_talktoskye_f: Ah, that. I'm sorry, I'll not shed a tear for myself, how unseemly.
I'm grateful for your friendship, and for the strength it provides. More than you can possibly know.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_talktoskye_j: Only you would make me smile at a time like this, in my most desperate of hours.
You have a gift, friend, of putting my heart at ease. Thank you.
95_s01_06_temp_supplychains_talktoskye_s: Indeed. It might be, my conversation with Grace, could be the small step that leads us to strike true in our hunt.
Thank you, friend. Once more, you've put my mind at ease.
"I'd take what small step I could."
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_clear: Clear the mysterious growth on the outskirts of the Crow's Nest
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_compl: It worked? That is good. But who is it that twists Nature in this way? Innocent animals suffer, and now even plants are made to struggle against us.
When I find who does this, they will suffer as the kitty did.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_craft: Craft Zander's Fire Dressing using a Workshop or your Camp
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_cue_a: By the way, we're having a bit of a problem around the camp. Seems like there's some kind of strange… things, growing.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_cue_b: If you've got a few minutes to spare, maybe you could have a look.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_descr: Strange growths have appeared near the Crow's Nest. Grace is asking you to investigate and get rid of them.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_dog_d: (Dog meows plaintively at you. He looks worried about something.)
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_gathe: Gather ingredients for Zander's Fire Dressing (weapon coating)
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_getfl: Collect Cinderquartz from Any Ancient Guardian
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_getsu: Collect Luimous Solvent from Any Corrupted
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_incom: Things are much worse than I thought.
Come talk to me once you're done with those vines.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_inves: Investigate the growth on the outskirts of the Crow's Nest
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_propo: The kind associated with those elemental rotters… the Furious Earth, or whatever they're called.
Strange as it may be, Zander seems to know a thing or two about plants - maybe ask him about it.
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_talkt: Are those strange vines out there making you as nervous as they're making me? Like nothing I've ever seen before.
I've been cutting them down as soon as they sprout, but for the big ones, it might take something with a little more punch.
My thinking, too, and they'll fight dirty. But I got just the thing! A recipe, but not for eating.
"Fire Dressing," I call it. Haha! Try that on those giant vines. That'll cook them all right, and then maybe we could eat them... Maybe?
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_useco: Use Zander's Fire Dressing on your weapons
95_s01_07_temp_possibilitiesoffire_zande: It is a puzzle. Outside of Aeternum, animals only fight to survive. On Aeternum, they march to war.
But who strikes the drum? And how do they hear it?
Talk to Zander about the camp's greenery problem
95_s01_08_2hspear_description: Aidyn smote the Varangian warrior Ormr and took his spear, but could not break free of Faceless.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_aidyn_comba: You will not take Skye from me!
This power-- too many speak in my mind!
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_aidyn_scrip: No! Stay back… I'm sorry, Skye!
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_complete_a: Poor Aidyn. What she had to go through, all thanks to that shite bastard Faceless.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_complete_b: Cat's curse on him. If only we'd been a step quicker.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_cue_a: Ah! With those vines wrapping around my brain, I forgot! The spear-woman got all nervous and angry.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_cue_b: I think maybe her mate got captured. Aidyn, I think? Something about her face… I forget.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_description: Skye's lover Aidyn has been spotted. Find her as soon as possible.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_faceless_ba: Heeheehee! Hehehe! Haha! HA HA HA!
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_grace_aidyn: Remember what I said about playing it safe.
A couple of coins isn't worth you getting cursed like Skye.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_incomplete: I think you should find the spear-woman quickly… before she gets in trouble.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_proposal_a: Ah, yes! That's it! Fearful Frank told us of a cave in Edengrove.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_proposal_b: Grace sent scouts there. They saw Aidyn taken there by Faceless and several soldiers.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_skye_defaul: I don't want to fight you, but I will if you don't tell me!
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_talkto_grac: Ah, thank the stars you're here! They got Aidyn, and as you can see, Skye's ready for battle, or at least she thinks she is.
Between you and I, I'm not sure how long Aidyn'll last in that cave. You'd best be going.
True, she's in no condition to fight, doubting herself and all. I'll talk to her as a distraction, and you just slip away to do the deed.
Hurry though, I don't think I'll be able to delay her for long.
95_s01_08_temp_hotonthetrail_talkto_skye: I will not stand by while they torture Aidyn!
You must let me go! Tell Grace to give me the location where they're holding her!
I know. With this curse, it's just that nothing ever feels right, always this sense of impending doom!
Please, help Aidyn. And don't try to stop me from coming too!
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_combatbarks_intr: Welcome, hero. I can hardly wait to taste your warrior's fire!
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_combatbarks_laug: Ha ha ha ha ha! Ahahaha!
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_combatbarks_tran: Enough toying about! Let me teach you the taste of defeat.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_complete_a: Would that I could feel my spear rip through the back of his neck, and smile at him as he choked on his own blood.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_complete_b: Still, you've avenged me. Thank you, once again. I will never forget all that you've done.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_cue_a: Listen, Skye's gone after Faceless. I sent Zander after her, but-
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_cue_b: Don't look at me like that, I'd like to see you try to stop that woman and her spear from doing whatever they want!
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_description: Skye has gone after Faceless by herself. Find the Varangian warlock and destroy him.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_dog_facelessdefe: (Dog meows happily, and licks someone's blood off his chin.)
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_dog_hiding_defau: (Dog's ears flicker, alert for enemies. You get the feeling he's protecting Skye and Zander.)
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_gotofortress: Go to the Varangian Fortress to look for Skye
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_grace_facelessde: Never doubted you for a second, mate.
See you back at the Crow's Nest!
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_incomplete: You and I always get caught up in the biggest storms. But we always sail clear, don't we?
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_proposal_a: They're headed to a Varangian fortress south of here, I'll mark it on your map.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_proposal_b: We'd best get moving and find Skye. Don't want a repeat of what happened to Aidyn. I'll meet you there.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_skye_facelessdef: You've avenged me. I am forever in your debt.
If only Aidyn were here to share this feeling.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_skye_hiding_defa: Be wary of his curse powers.
I'd not like seeing another friend fall to that snake's poison.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_talkto_dog_hidin: (Dog meows at you, as if asking if you're all right.)
(Dog's chest puffs up with pride. His eyes seem to say, "Of course.")
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_talkto_skye_desc: You've spotted Skye outside the Fortress. Go talk to her.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_talkto_skye_hidi: I went at Faceless with everything I had. All the strength that my rage, my loss, my hate would lend me.
He just laughed, and struck me aside as if I were a toy.
I believe you. Crush that bastard… for what he did to me, and what he did to Aidyn.
When you're done, and I've got my fire back, then it'll be my turn.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_talkto_zander_hi: The spear woman is badly wounded.
Don't worry, I will keep her safe for you.
It is simple. I do what I do, for me, also for you.
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_zander_facelessd: Haha! We have defeated our enemy. But on this island, people die and return to life.
Have we seen the last of Faceless, or will he return?
95_s01_09_temp_faceless_zander_hiding_de: His mask does not frighten me. Only a coward hides behind deception.
But magic. Magic, I do not understand. It is not something you can hold in your hands.
95_s01_10_1hgauntletvoid_description: All that remains of a faceless foe.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_cue_a: Wait, is that…? That sigil… it matches the one on my back. And Aidyn's as well.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_cue_b: Our warrior's fire! Gods, but I'm still nervous somehow… what if it doesn't work?
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_description: Wrap up your contract with Skye.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_finalbonech: Destroy the cursed bone talisman at camp
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_incomplete_: Whatever happens next, I thank you, friend.
For everything you've done for me.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_proposal_a: For so long, Aidyn's been the arm I lean on… and now she's gone.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_proposal_b: Your support through all this, it's more… it's more than I hoped for. Let's go then.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_skye_styrkr: I feel incredible! To have my strength back, and the doubt I once had, is gone, like a bad dream.
You've given everything to me. Thank you again.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_talkto_bone: (As you look at the table, you feel the satisfaction of knowing that you've freed the strength of many warriors.)
(You place the talisman on the table, a powerful aura radiating from the grisly sigils etched into bone).
A thunderclap of energy rocks the camp.
You sense the power of the remaining victims being freed from Faceless' curse.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_talkto_dog_: (As Dog looks at you, you think back on his actions, and start to realize he may be much smarter than you thought.)
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_talkto_grac: Well, captain, we started the Crows, finished our first contract, and smooth sailing at every turn.
All thanks to someone's perfect planning and coordination.
All the work? The nerve! How do you even fit that galleon-sized head through doorways?
Regardless, a job well done. Oh, and I hope you like hot weather…
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_talkto_skye: I found this place, long ago. It's special to me.
I used to think that strength was the only measure of a person.
Because of you, I see there are many forms of strength. And I see something else, as well.
(Meow!)
(Dog looks at you with big, innocent eyes.)
We saw you both leave the Crow's Nest, so we were just… worried, is all it was.
Hope we didn't interrupt anything interesting. Did we?
Ha ha!
I see your friends.
I do not understand why you people are so shy. When my mother met my father, she threw him over her shoulder, carried him to her home, and--
Actually, she always stopped there when she told that story.
Ah ha ha!
Ah, it is incredible, to feel my warrior's power again!
Whole. Alive. Ahh, I want to battle again! Could I ask one last favor of you?
Oh! Now that you say it, the idea's sorely tempting! Just a friendly little contest, of course, lasting no more than a few days.
But no, I had only hoped to speak with you, privately.
"Are you asking to fight?"
That was a misstep, to-- It's just, all the feelings I have, I mean, from the things you've done for me.
Defeating Faceless, winning back my strength. Well, I should be going.
I could not have asked for a better friend. I will spend some time in the mountains, thinking.
After that time, if it might please you to seek me out, I hope you do. I would welcome your company, any time.
Then I may give you a muffler, to remember me. I will spend some time in the mountains, thinking.
Perhaps we'll meet again. I only hope your jokes are better next time.
"It'll be strange, without you."
I'll take my first small steps to rediscover who I am. You've changed me, and cleared my path.
I will spend some time in the mountains, thinking. I hope we may meet again, if fate allows.
95_s01_10_temp_tobecontinued_talkto_zand: Meeting you was a great thing. I have enjoyed working with you, my friend.
And one day very soon, you will try one of my lemon cakes. You will never wish to eat another living creature again!
No, I am Zander. But I find my mind is weakened by eating animals. Because I eat only plants, my mind is always this sharp.
Although, I do sometimes eat a squirrel. They are so stupid they're basically plants.

95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_complete_a: I watched from afar and saw Ser Loth's Varangian allies in quite a disarray. Whatever you accomplished in there - it must've worked.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_complete_b: Tell me, though, had any of them acquired the full power of the Forge?
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_complete_next_a: That is a battle I would've liked to witness. You're as strong as I sensed.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_complete_next_b: If that loathsome serpent Loth escaped, I fear he will only pursue this endeavor with less restraint, but for today, I celebrate your victory.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_cue_a: Your aura radiates a strength I've not seen in many, many years. There is a task, a heroic undertaking I must request of you.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_cue_b: You must help me defeat one of the Knights of the Round Table.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_description: Shailyn wants to uncover what Loth and his Varangians are doing in the Forge. Help her find Loth.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_enterdungeondesc: Enter the Empyrean Forge to find and stop Loth
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_incomplete: I await news of your success, young one.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_marius_combat_in: You are too late. Our master Ser Loth will seize the eldritch power that courses through these halls.
I am to rid this world of the likes of you. Come and witness a taste of the power our lord will soon claim!
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_next2_a: By any means necessary. If anyone has the potential, I sense it is you.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_next2_b: Strike through our enemies to the heart of the Forge, and if any have received its full power… gods help us, just do what you can.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_next_a: An elemental force older even than the Ancients who built this structure in their twisted effort to control it.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_next_b: Ser Loth and his allies would use this primal fire to reforge themselves as warriors of devastating might.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_proposal_a: Because he has given in to madness and savagery, joined with the Varangians.
95_s01_x1_expd_empyrean_proposal_b: Ser Loth is who I speak of, and within the Empyrean Forge, his forces seek to claim a power that could be the unmaking of us all.
95_s01_x2_antiquarianspouse_defaultdialo: Stand back or I'll-- Oh thank goodness, you're not one of those Forged, are you?
Fortunately, I was already hiding when they made their way to this area. Did Leonie give up and send you to find me?
Oh! I can help with that. I love puzzles, and well, the Ancients!
You'll just need to go in the other room, there's a puzzle in there I haven't figured out yet. Let me just unlock this device for you to activate it.
"No, we’re searching for a way in."

95_s01_x2_expd_empyreanrepeat_proposal_b: You see, I use them to construct runeglass containers which can highly enhance the conductivity-- Ja, well, in short, to make my toys.
95_s04_01_searchring_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_crossarms" priority="high" />Mordred. Son of Morgaine! I've heard plenty about him, and none of it good. And<g id="g_grace_headshakeno" /> now he's after some relics.
95_s04_01_searchring_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_no" />Smells like desperate weather ahead.<g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" /> Ah, I don't like that look. You love this, don't<g id="g_grace_goaway" /> you, working for free!
95_s04_01_searchring_complete_next_a: <g id="g_grace_sympathy" />Ah. Well. Wouldn't hurt for Morgaine to owe us a favor. And the relics- we could always sell them.
95_s04_01_searchring_complete_next_b: <g id="g_grace_throwarms" />Fine! We'll pull on this rope a bit longer, and pray it doesn't hang us.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> For now, seems we need an expert in magical fire.

95_s04_01_searchring_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_consider" />If you're wondering where Rima is, she's off having a talk with our good friend Skye the Spear Daughter.
95_s04_01_searchring_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />Apparently, Skye's not back for our bad jokes. She's got quite the serious face.
95_s04_01_searchring_greet_dnmskye_a: <g id="g_grace_consider" />If you're wondering where Rima is, she's bringing along a Spear Daughter by the name of Skye.
95_s04_01_searchring_greet_dnmskye_b: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />Apparently, Skye's not visiting to hear our famously bad jokes. Her message seemed pretty urgent.
95_s04_01_searchring_hearmorgaine_hint: As you finish reading, someone enters the cabin.
95_s04_01_searchring_icevarang_hint: Looks like Skye was right. The village is overrun with Varangian soldiers.
95_s04_01_searchring_igc_missionassign_h: (Hubbub of the Silver Crows arguing in camp)
95_s04_01_searchring_incomplete: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Let me know what you find out.<g id="g_grace_convince1" /> And remember, it's 'in business,' not 'in charity!'
95_s04_01_searchring_mordred_lore_pedest: Idiotic villagers. How does one suffer such peasants and their incessant bleating? No matter, for I've located the ring. Now this damned ice deters me from my prize. How to shatter it. Perhaps- yes, the type of fire was wrong.

Now this damned ice deters me from my prize. How to shatter it. Perhaps- yes, the type of fire was wrong.
95_s04_01_searchring_mordred_p01_default: Who are you people? I've no time for foolish banter. Away, before I lose my patience.
What a world, where churls may freely bother Knights! Something I'll change very soon, to be sure.
95_s04_01_searchring_mordredguard1_p01_d: Do not try your fancy words with me. Stand back, or I will crush you back into the mud where you belong.
95_s04_01_searchring_mordredguard2_p01_d: Make no mistake, I love the villagers. I can still taste their sad little mewls of pain - like fresh milk.
Ah, I wonder how you sound when you cry for mercy? It must be absolutely delicious.
95_s04_01_searchring_mordredtracks1_hint: Several footprints lead up the hill above the village.
95_s04_01_searchring_mordredtracks4_hint: You hear some voices from the rocks above.
95_s04_01_searchring_morgaine_p01_defaul: If I had but a coin for every time my wayward son blundered into trouble.
A fine puzzle. I've neither the time nor the taste for ridiculous notions such as maternal duty. And yet, here I am.
95_s04_01_searchring_pedestallore_hint: You spot a scrap of parchment out of the corner of your eye.
95_s04_01_searchring_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_goaway" />Damned if I know! Seems our Spear Daughter wants your ear alone - as if the rest of us lot<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> were untrustworthy.
95_s04_01_searchring_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />Eh, maybe I'm in a mood. We should hear her out.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> Maybe check with her, find out what's going on?
95_s04_01_searchring_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_frustrated" priority="high" />Och, if it were up to you and Zander, we'd be working for wishes. Least Rima's got a nose for profit.
95_s04_01_searchring_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Well, they'll be along any minute. Let's see what Skye says, and if it's a charity case, tell her<g id="g_grace_laughs" priority="high" /> absolutely- not. Ha!
95_s04_01_searchring_quam_p01_defaultdia: This is a hard land, but we eked out a spare living from this cold earth. Fallen to wreck and ruin in an instant!
Have any of the others survived? Will they return? Hope now seems as far away as the moon in the sky.
95_s04_01_searchring_returncnskye_descri: Return to camp and tell Skye that Mordred is after the Frosted Crown of King Idris
95_s04_01_searchring_se_villagesurvivor_: (Hums) Hmm hm hmm. It's fine. No, they'll see me. They'll see right through these holes in the roof!
You know what? I'll take them on alone! Give them a share or two of pain, I will.
Failure! What kind of headman am I? A weak one. You're weak, Quam!
Who's that! Is- is somebody there?
95_s04_01_searchring_searchcabin_descrip: Search Mordred's cabin for clues about his plans
95_s04_01_searchring_searchcabin_hint: A fetid rot hits your nose. Amidst the debris is a letter on the table.
95_s04_01_searchring_skye_p01_defaultdia: <g id="g_female_handsonhipsshakehead" />I do not know who this man is, but he makes me want to<g id="g_male_clenchfistsgetpumped02" /> lend my spear to his face.
<g id="g_female_crossarms" />We have a word for him where I come from, but I had better not say it. They say the<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> gods are always watching.

<g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Let me know what you find, and<g id="g_female_leanforwardlistennod" /> be wary. I wouldn't put it past those craven dogs to lay<g id="g_male_dismissgetlost2" /> a trap or two.
<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />As terrible as things seem<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />, it is thrilling to stand by your side!<g id="g_male_waghand01" /> Ah, I am- it's embarrassing.
<g id="g_male_sighrelief" />Hundreds of years in this life, and still I'm not able to leash my tongue.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> It is- a bit warm here.
95_s04_01_searchring_skyecamp_p01_defaul: <g id="g_male_compliment" />It feels like the first warm breeze of Spring to<g id="g_female_spreadarms" /> be here again with all of you. And<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> though it seems your camp is still-<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> being worked on,<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> it feels a fine home.

<g id="g_male_compliment" />It stirs the heart to stand with a group of warriors of such skill. And this camp-<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> it is not as ugly<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> as I had heard.<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> It feels a fine home to me.
95_s04_01_searchring_survivors_hint: You hear someone cry out. There may be survivors.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_mordred_haught: Looking for a challenge, are you? As much as I would relish a fight, I have more important things to attend to.
Oh why must I, Mordred, a Knight of the Round Table, answer to these filthy, nosy, commoners!
Artorius? The blustering doddard! He hasn't the will nor the strength to endure my path. His absence is the clearest proof of that.
But lo, the mystery continues! Why am I still talking to these plebeians? Out of my way.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_morgaine_cabin: So the Silver Crows are here. Let me guess. You're here looking for my son, Mordred. Ha! Don't be so surprised.
It took no enchantment to puzzle those pieces. That arrogant, misguided fool. What trouble is he after now?
Ah, the Frosted Crown. Poor King Idris. Stole the crown from its resting place, and it drove him mad. Sealed his castle in ice.
I doubt an army of fire mages could breach his gate now. But what does my son want with it?
Ha! If only I could answer what my fool of a son wants or why. A ring, a crown. Has he got into my manuscripts again?
I'll look into it, and find you after I've learned something. Meantime, here's where you can find King Idris.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_quam_varang_gr: Oh! You're not with those Varangians, are you? They are not men, they are monsters! The cruelty. The things they have done.
Why? We are simple folk! We've no ring of theirs!
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_quam_varang_re: Would that I knew! They killed. Burned our homes. Took our meager possessions. All for a ring. What ring, we said! What ring!
Their leader- he took to the cliffs behind the village. But you must flee! It is not safe here!
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_aftercave: <g id="g_male_handshipsdisapprove" />So he did find that ring he wanted? Ill luck to that swaggering croc.

<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" priority="high" />Wait- that name, Mordred… Mordred.<g id="g_female_explains" /> Aidyn told me, years ago. There was a madman who<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> went by that name, living alone in a small cabin,<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> just north of Bastion Outpost.

<g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Good, you may find clues as to<g id="g_female_gesturerights" /> what he seeks.<g id="g_female_youknow" /> I will return to the Crow's Nest<g id="g_male_nod2" /> and let Grace know what we learned.
<g id="g_male_think" />Perhaps the others may know more about this ring.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> Something tells me there is<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> more to it than we realize.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_mordred_g: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />The villager said they were searching for a ring? That<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> Mordred bastard came out of<g id="g_female_lookright" /> those caves- might be worth a look.
<g id="g_male_crossarmsupset" />Ah, we should have kept him from leaving. And<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> stuck him a few times while we were at it.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_mordred_p: "I'll take a look at the caves."
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_mordred_r: <g id="g_female_salutefistchest" />Then I will guard your return.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> Tch! The sooner we wipe Aeternum clean of these Varangian scum, the better.
I'm sorry.<g id="g_female_notsure" /> Letting the forge spill onto the rushes, as Aidyn used to say.<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> Stay safe in there.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_needfire_: <g id="g_female_notsure" />Mordred is Morgaine's son? Their only commonality may<g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" /> be their lack of commonality with others.

<g id="g_male_throwarms" />If it were Morgaine wanting this ring and crown,<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> maybe I'd have no qualms- but her evil get, Mordred?<g id="g_male_shakehead" /> It ties my stomach in knots.
"He's human like the rest of us."
<g id="g_female_headnodding" />Aye, if we're to<g id="g_male_handshipsconsider" /> get that crown before Mordred does, we need a way into the ice castle. Perhaps someone who can wield magic fire?
<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" priority="high" />Of sorcerers, I know precious few. Shailyn is pre-occupied. Perhaps<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> Grace knows someone?
<g id="g_female_crossarms" />Is he? Is a man who does evil, still worthy of being called "human?"<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> You may believe in second chances.

But I say,<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> the fox will always eat the hen.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> Question is, how do we put this fox in a cage?<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> We have to beat him to his prize.
95_s04_01_searchring_talk_skye_varangian: <g id="g_female_sighrelief" />It is wonderful to see you again!<g id="g_male_shakehead" /> Yet I wish I bore better news.<g id="g_female_crossarms" /> It's the Varangians.

<g id="g_female_youknow" />They've raided a village in Great Cleave.<g id="g_female_worry" /> Strange thing is, it's a tiny homestead- trappers, miners.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> Normally they would not bother.
<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />What an honor to meet you, Soulwarden!<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> And yet I wish I bore better news. It's<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> the Varangians.
<g id="g_female_youknow" />They've raided a village in south Great Cleave, but the<g id="g_female_worry" /> strange thing is, it's a tiny homestead. Normally they would not bother.
"We should see what they're up to."
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />I had hoped you would say that. It<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> may sound strange, but<g id="g_female_sighrelief" /> in a way, I'm glad.

<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />I haven't forgotten all you've done for me, and- and it will be nice to<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> work together with you again.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> Well I suppose<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> we should go!
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />I had hoped you would say that. It<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> may sound strange, but<g id="g_female_sighrelief" /> in a way, I'm glad.

<g id="g_male_compliment" />I've heard many tales of your valor in battle, and now, to meet the legend in person! Ah, I suppose<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> we should go.<g id="g_female_youknow" /> I will meet you there.
95_s04_01_searchring_traversecaves_descr: Make your way deeper into the caves
95_s04_01_searchring_trigger_missionassi: Hear Skye's report on Varangian activity

<g id="g_male_explain" />Then she says, that is not the point!<g id="g_female_shrugdontcare" /> What is not the point?<g id="g_male_righthandangry" /> Why is she laughing?

95_s04_02_getdaichi_bark_phase1to2: Well, you can fight. Let's see how you think.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_bark_phase2to3: Ah ha ha! You can take a little heat. Now, stand in the fire!
