95_s04_02_getdaichi_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_flirt" />Well, congratulations on hiring Daichi. He's no doubt a powerful add to the team.<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> It's just-
95_s04_02_getdaichi_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />I wonder if you might have a word with him about that<g id="g_grace_headshakeno" /> attitude of his.<g id="g_grace_noway" priority="high" /> He won't listen to anything I say- calls me the "lady with the hat."
95_s04_02_getdaichi_complete_response_a: <g id="g_grace_frustrated" />So does Rima! All right, I admit, he probably just needs some time to fit in<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> with- anyone.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_complete_response_b: <g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" />But if things don't get better soon, then I say<g id="g_grace_fisthigh" /> we give him the heave-ho.<g id="g_grace_gesturer" /> Even Zander doesn't like him!
95_s04_02_getdaichi_daichi_p01_defaultdi: This valley is full of darkness. It fills the mind with fear. My master would have- Ah, but that is in the past. We are all only shadows on the rocks.
(Daichi concentrates, his mind focused elsewhere. It doesn't seem as if he can speak to you at the moment.)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_daichi_p02_defaultdi: If you think you may lose, you have already lost. The key is not to think at all, simply be.
Surviving a battle is not strength. Nor is falling before a superior enemy weakness.
With my defeat, destiny has changed. I ride the tail of a dragon who shapes the very earth. I will meet you back at your camp.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_daichicamp_p01_defau: <g id="g_yonas_crossarmsshakehead" />Ah, so noisy here. To have the solitude of the mountains again.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_desc: Grace O'Malley wants to add more firepower to the team. Find Daichi Saito and recruit him to the Silver Crows.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_dogcamp_p01_defaultd: (Dog seems absorbed by watching Daichi. It seems fairly likely that Daichi's been sneaking him treats.)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_enterdojo_descriptio: Use the war fan to enter Daichi's dojo
95_s04_02_getdaichi_getwood_description: Gather spirit wood, then build the Trapping Seals in any order
95_s04_02_getdaichi_gocn_description: Return to the Crow's Nest and get Daichi settled in with the team
95_s04_02_getdaichi_gracecamp_p01_defaul: <g id="g_grace_noway" />I'm not sure what's more unpleasant- having Daichi not listen to anyone, or hearing Rima complain about it.
<g id="g_grace_relief" />I almost wish she would complain about the camp again.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />I've been meaning to speak with you about the crew. Zander's-<g id="g_grace_no" /> well, he's a wall of muscle.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_convince2" />Rima's got great connections, she'll help us get better contracts. So I'm thinking, maybe we mix it up, add someone with-
95_s04_02_getdaichi_greet_fire_a: I've been meaning to speak with you about the crew. When it comes to a fight, Zander's a wall of muscle.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_greet_fire_b: Rima's quick with a blade, and you- you're deadly with that fire magic. So I'm thinking, let's add even more-
95_s04_02_getdaichi_igc_sealed_daichi_01: (sharp intake of breath- Daichi senses the ghost and opens his eyes)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_igc_sealed_daichi_03: (effort sound such as "hmm!" or "mph!"- as Daichi casts a fire net around the ghost to hold it)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_igc_sealed_daichi_04: (effort, gasping, shaking- as Daichi holds the struggling ghost in his net of magical fire)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_igc_sealed_daichi_05: (effort of Daichi's attack- he stands, parries a blow from the ghost, and swings upward with the naginata, slicing at it)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_igc_sealed_daichi_06: (Daichi breathing- as he stands stock still in his finishing pose from his strike)
95_s04_02_getdaichi_incomplete_a: <g id="g_grace_spreadarms" />Always good to bring more hands on deck, but our coffers are getting a bit dusty.<g id="g_grace_no" /> Might need to trim our sails.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_incomplete_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" />Hire some Ancient guardians- work long hours for a low<g id="g_grace_goaway" /> wage. Relax, I’m joking.<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> Do you think- nah.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_jubei_lore_seals: When asked how to properly form the seal, Fox replied with yet another question. "Which element endures? Rivers carve the earth. Fire needs air to breathe. Yet the wind throws itself in vain against stone walls."
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_a_descrip: Launch the Rocket at the Water Seal
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_b_descrip: Launch the Rocket at the Earth Seal
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_c_descrip: Launch the Rocket at the Air Seal
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_d_descrip: Launch the Rocket at the Fire Seal
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_descripti: Use the launchers to light the fire seals in the order depicted in Daichi's note
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lightfires_fail_desc: It seems you didn't light the seals in the correct order...
95_s04_02_getdaichi_lorenote_description: Read the scroll for instructions on the Trapping Seal
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Yeah, and literally, someone with magical fire. It’s a powerful element, I’m sure you’d agree.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_no" />Nothing better than fire to deal with those-<g id="g_grace_realize" /> what are they, Furious Trees. Or<g id="g_grace_flirt" /> burn our way into a castle full of treasure.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Good thinking. Actually, you may want to chat with Rima- she's got more friends than the rest of us put together.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_grace_convince1" />Plus, it'll give her something to do, besides complain about the camp. It's<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> not half bad, if you ask me.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_next_s5_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Good thinking. Actually, you may want to chat with Rima what with her connections.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> And listen-
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_next_s5_b: <g id="g_grace_greethead" priority="high" />Skye the Spear Daughter's another strong candidate I've been thinking about. She's a terrifying good fighter,<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> got a good heart-
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_s5_a: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Yeah, and literally, someone with magical fire. It’s a powerful element, I’m sure you’d agree.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_proposal_s5_b: <g id="g_grace_no" />Nothing better than fire to deal with those-<g id="g_grace_realize" /> what are they, Furious Trees. Or<g id="g_grace_flirt" /> burn our way into a castle full of treasure.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_rimacamp_p01_default: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Rock-headed, offensive- person!<g id="g_male_why" /> Yes, Daichi! I don't know if he's<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> actually making an effort to infuriate me?

<g id="g_female_touchhands" />"Young lady. Why do you not stop talking and<g id="g_litearmor_dismissgetlost2" /> go play with your little guitar?"<g id="g_female_yourecrazy" /> First of all, it is NOT A GUITAR!
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_enenra_g: Perhaps I need a sign which says, "Here is someone meditating. That is why they are kneeling with their eyes closed."
Since you have disturbed my battle, might I ask your help? This Enenra is- quite strong.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_enenra_r: Exactly! I cannot force the demon to appear. It is taking all of my energy to prevent it from escaping this valley.
If you will light the fire seals, that will trap it. Then I can draw it out and defeat it.
No, we must follow the proper ritual. Build the fires with spirit wood, and light them in the correct sequence. Use the launchers. Here, this scroll.
It has the four patterns, and the order. Hurry! I do not know how much longer I can hold this beast.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_fight_gr: They say the measure of a samurai is how resolute one is, in the acceptance of death.
But when death has no meaning, how can we measure a warrior's worth?
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_fight_re: Ha ha ha! I like you more and more! Let us see if you live up to your confidence, and your fancy reputation.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_onboarde: <g id="g_yonas_gestureforward" />The one with the hat keeps telling me what to do.<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> Do they think I am weak because I lost our match?<g id="g_yonas_headshakedisappointed" /> To understimate me would be a grave mistake.
<g id="g_yonas_shrug" />I have no need to get along- it is you I follow, not them.
<g id="g_yonas_spreadarmsnod" />But, if it puts your mind at peace, I will tolerate their hand waving and<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> incessant, awkward, blathering.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_sealed_g: <g id="g_yonas_bowshallow" />Thank you for your help, Soulwarden.<g id="g_yonas_noddingheadapproval" /> Oh, I know who you are and why you are here. But I am<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> not willing to join your Silver Crows just yet.
<g id="g_yonas_shrug" />What I do not know is, are you someone I can respect as a leader?<g id="g_yonas_shh" /> I want a match with you.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_daichi_sealed_r: <g id="g_yonas_fistsmack" />Hm! "Quickness is the essence of war."<g id="g_yonas_headnodyes" /> I like the manner in which your mind works.
<g id="g_yonas_nodbig" />Follow me, then.<g id="g_yonas_lookbehind" /> Use my war fan. It will take you to the spirit shrine in<g id="g_yonas_noddingsubtle" /> my dojo.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_grace_skyeonboa: <g id="g_grace_yes" />Glad to hear you say that! I<g id="g_grace_consider" /> didn't want to push too much as your First Mate but- good thing is, you and I seem to think alike.
<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />I'll send word for her to join us.<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> I expect it'll take awhile to reach her in the mountains.
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_rima_candidates: <g id="g_litearmor_think" priority="high" />Fire magic, hm? Fire magic. There's Landry, but no, he's an idiot, really.<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> Sven, too talkative, also no.
<g id="g_female_pointthreaten" />Oh! Have I ever got the candidate for you! <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />How does a ronin, turned warrior monk of a fire temple, strike your fancy?
<g id="g_male_explain" />Well, that's just it- while others may want him, I hear he hasn't exactly been<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> open to offers.

<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />He's been spending time in the northeast of Shattered Mountain, if you'd care to give him a try.<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Daichi Saito's his name.
<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Ex-samurai in this case, but well- on Aeternum,<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> haven't we all been given a fresh start?
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />Now if one's to believe the gossip, he may have the very strongest fire magic around. Something to do with<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> spiritual harmony?
95_s04_02_getdaichi_talk_zander_howdaich: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />What do I think of Daichi?<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> He thinks he is better than everyone else.
<g id="g_female_notsure" />So he is like Rima, but with a better sense for dressing himself.<g id="g_male_laugh" /> Ha ha! Did<g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" /> you hear that, Rima?
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Listen to me.<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> The best of the best, that is what you are<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> gathering here.

<g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" />There will always be trouble between the strong. That is<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> why we have you, to settle things.<g id="g_male_shocked" /> Ah! Rima! What<g id="g_female_clenchfistssuffer" /> did you put in my boots!
95_s04_02_getdaichi_trigger_bonfiresolve: Let Daichi know the fires are lit
95_s04_02_getdaichi_tv_finddaichi_descri: Find the fire mage Daichi Saito
95_s04_02_getdaichi_zandercamp_p01_defau: <g id="g_female_notsure" />Daichi? Well, he is very unpleasant. But<g id="g_female_youknow" /> in Greece we say, a true friend<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> shows their worth when you are standing in the muck.
<g id="g_male_agree1" />What does it matter if someone smiles at you if they run<g id="g_male_spreadhands" /> when it is time to fight?
95_s04_03_entercastle_boat_hint: The island is faintly visible from shore. You might use one of these boats to reach it.
95_s04_03_entercastle_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" />All things considered, a<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> job well done. But<g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" /> make no mistake, we’re deep in the pickle brine now.
95_s04_03_entercastle_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_worry" />We mess this up, and there'll be an unwelcome visitor having a nice long stay with us.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> And its name is Winter.
95_s04_03_entercastle_daichi_p03_default: <g id="g_yonas_explain01" />It is narrow of mind to think this way! The purple one, Zander, the lady with the hat, all of them speak as if fire and ice were opposite!
<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" />They are more alike than different.<g id="g_yonas_waghanddisagree02" priority="high" /> Ice is not alive? Everything has life!
95_s04_03_entercastle_daichi_p04_default: <g id="g_yonas_crossarmsshakehead" />These games. Shogi, chess, chaturanga, they were wrong to make them. People think that playing will make them smart.
<g id="g_yonas_onehandoutnoway" />No. The mind then becomes master to the spirit. Living in the future, never in the now.
95_s04_03_entercastle_daichi_p05_default: <g id="g_yonas_shrug" />Why? Why do a thing such as this?<g id="g_yonas_explain01" /> Fire and ice, they are not just tools. They shape those who wield them.
<g id="g_yonas_gesturearound" priority="high" />In this place, frost has carved a darkness into the heart of this castle, and its lord.

<g id="g_yonas_explain02" />I would not believe it, had I not seen it! You<g id="g_yonas_righthand02" /> attuned yourself to the fire charm, more<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" /> perfectly than even I could have.
<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" />Are you some trickster god come to humble me?<g id="g_yonas_shrugdontcare" priority="high" /> If so, I do not feel bad for losing our match.
95_s04_03_entercastle_daichirescue_descr: Ask Daichi if he can free the frozen prisoners
95_s04_03_entercastle_desc: Work with Daichi Saito to find a way into the legendary Ice Castle, and look for the Frost Crown.
95_s04_03_entercastle_dog_p01_defaultdia: (Dog seems comfortable in the extreme cold. He might actually be enjoying it.)
95_s04_03_entercastle_dogcamp_p01_defaul: (Dog digs his claws into the wood beneath him. He seems worried. It makes you wonder just how aware he is of what's going on.)
95_s04_03_entercastle_elsa_p01_defaultdi: (You could swear that the statue's eyes are following your movement.)
95_s04_03_entercastle_elsa_p02_defaultdi: What a fool I was, to seek out the mysteries of a mad king!
I've had decades to think on it, and I've decided. I'll be moving to Brimstone Sands! Oh, what I wouldn't give for a nice, painful, sunburn!
95_s04_03_entercastle_enterchessroom_des: Enter the inner keep to search for King Idris and the Frost Crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_enterthekeep_descr: Search for a way into the castle keep to find the Frost Crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_enterthroneroom_de: Enter the Throne Room to look for King Idris and the Frost Crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_findidris_descript: Search the castle for King Idris and the Frost Crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_frozenstatues_hint: Before you is a gruesome sight- statues of frozen humans. Only two show faint signs of life.
95_s04_03_entercastle_getchessexitkey: Recover the gem that fell from the King chess piece
95_s04_03_entercastle_grace_p01_defaultd: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />I’ve always thought, if you can’t change your cards, you<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> change the way you play them.

<g id="g_grace_disapprove" />But I’m not sure the people that lived here had much of a choice either way. And if<g id="g_grace_dismiss2" priority="high" /> Mordred gets his way, we’re all in the soup.
95_s04_03_entercastle_gracecamp_p01_defa: <g id="g_grace_no" />An endless age of ice, Ancient magics, an evil knight and his<g id="g_grace_gesturelefts" /> powerful toys.
<g id="g_grace_noway" priority="high" />If I weren't the woman of action that I am, I'd be inclined to duck into my tent and hide my head under the covers.
95_s04_03_entercastle_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_consider" />Let's see what our new recruit can do about getting us into that Ice Castle, so we can get the Frost Crown<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> before Mordred.
95_s04_03_entercastle_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_think" />Problem is, there's a lot of water between the shoreline and that island. We'll need a way across.
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_combatbark_d: Thieves! You will win no words of regret from these lips!
Nothing- nothing! Without the power of Frost.
Forgotten by all. Is that- our fate?
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_combatbark_i: Stolen! Stolen, and you- you're with him!
Come to take what belongs to King Idris? Think us weak without the Crown? We will show you true might!
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_combatbark_t: Bare your neck to the snap of Frost!
Come, join my Garden of Ice!
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_combatbark_v: Let all know the might of King Idris!
The Frost Crown was nothing! It is our might! Our might! That won this day.
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_lore: That thieving whelp! Took the Frost Crown! A thousand curses! May it break him as it has tormented us.
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_lore_sub01: That thieving whelp! Took the Frost Crown! A thousand curses!
95_s04_03_entercastle_idris_lore_sub02: May it break him as it has tormented us.
95_s04_03_entercastle_idrislorenote_desc: Read the journal entry from King Idris
95_s04_03_entercastle_igc_meltwall_zande: I am telling you, it is hopeless! The gate is solid ice.
I used all my strength and could not make a single scratch. There is nothing-
Pretty sure I saw cracks in the ice after I struck it.

I am telling you, it is hopeless! The gate is solid ice. I used all my strength and could not make a single scratch. There is nothing- that can get through it. I weakened it for him. Pretty sure I saw cracks in the ice after I struck it.
95_s04_03_entercastle_incomplete_a: <g id="g_grace_lean" />Let’s keep an eye out for any interesting items in that Ice Castle. I’m certainly not hoping for any<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> rewards from mad King Idris.
95_s04_03_entercastle_killghostsforkey_d: Defeat the Lost servants of King Idris for a key to his inner keep
95_s04_03_entercastle_meltwall_descripti: Talk to Zander at the Frost Gate
95_s04_03_entercastle_morgaine_p02_defau: If I lend my hand, I give my son exactly what he wants and make things even worse. So I'll put my trust in you and whatever gods might be listening.
95_s04_03_entercastle_morgaineentrance_d: Ask Morgaine what she's found about Mordred's plans
95_s04_03_entercastle_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Good idea. Bound to find some small fishing or supply boats that way. I'll meet you on the island with the others.
95_s04_03_entercastle_proposal_b: Truth is,<g id="g_grace_no" /> I'm tired of paperwork. And I'm<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> more than a bit curious to see Saito's wizardry.
95_s04_03_entercastle_returntoentrance_d: Return to the castle gate to let the others know that Mordred has the crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_rima_p01_defaultdi: <g id="g_female_lookaroundconfused" priority="high" />This place is truly a wonder. Can you imagine the tragic story of the people who once lived here?
<g id="g_male_handheart" />The Lament of Idris. "<g id="g_male_spreadhands" />Then came the killing frost, and all their hope was lost.<g id="g_female_spreadarms" /> All their hope was lost."

<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I suppose it’s true that life has a balance. That<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> insufferable man with a heart of cold iron who could not make a friend if his life depended on it, also happens to have<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> incredibly powerful fire magic.
<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />Daichi may be full of contradictions.
95_s04_03_entercastle_searchcoast_descri: Get to the Island of Frost before Mordred does
95_s04_03_entercastle_searchcrown_descri: Continue to search for the Frost Crown
95_s04_03_entercastle_shen_p01_defaultdi: (As if in response to your voice, you detect the faintest hint of movement.)
95_s04_03_entercastle_shen_p02_defaultdi: Augh! Thank the gods for sending you! That foul King Idris! If only I hadn't needed the coin, I'd have never signed up.
We all knew something was wrong, worse by the day, eating away at him- you could see it in his eyes!
95_s04_03_entercastle_skye_p02_defaultdi: <g id="g_male_waghand01" />I thought I knew cold weather. I have seen<g id="g_female_shrugshort" /> plenty of ice before. But there is<g id="g_male_think" /> something- wrong, about this place.
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />As if Beira herself had a hand in its making. Or worse, the Hag.<g id="g_female_sighrelief" /> It sends a chill through me.
95_s04_03_entercastle_skye_p03_defaultdi: <g id="g_female_headnodding" />I have seen such pieces before.<g id="g_male_rememberbig" priority="high" /> No, I have fought them! An ogre, an occultist-<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> yes, they are fashioned after the Corrupted.
<g id="g_female_lookforwardwonder" />What skillful magic imbues this place. A wonder to revel in, were there not such evil at play.
95_s04_03_entercastle_skye_p04_defaultdi: <g id="g_male_handshipsdisapprove" />Who would do such a thing? To freeze someone in such a way, and kill them, is wrong. But to<g id="g_female_disagreerighthandout" /> do this on Aeternum.
<g id="g_female_gestureforward01" />These people will die forever.<g id="g_female_crossarms" /> Ah, this kind of cruelty fills me with such an anger.
95_s04_03_entercastle_skyeescort_descrip: Talk to Skye about escorting the prisoners to safety
95_s04_03_entercastle_slotchessexitkey: Place the gem on the pedestal to unlock the door
95_s04_03_entercastle_talk_daichi_givech: <g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" />I know what you would ask but I cannot free them. This is a<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" /> powerful, old magic. The cold-<g id="g_yonas_gestureforward" priority="high" /> it has seeped like a poison into their souls.
<g id="g_yonas_handsextendedsorry" />Like the fangs of a snake. Pulling them out may harm them in even a worse manner.
<g id="g_yonas_headshakeno" />So be it.<g id="g_yonas_giveitem" /> I will give you a special fire charm- an ofuda.<g id="g_yonas_noddingsubtle" /> I believe you have the ability to use it.
<g id="g_yonas_shakeheadworried" priority="high" />You may be able to release them. But, should you fail- I cannot speak of such horror.
95_s04_03_entercastle_talk_morgaine_icer: Mordred took the crown from Idris? That makes my news all the worse. My fool son has indeed gotten into my research.
There were once Ancients, evil ones, who sought ways to imbue mortals with power akin to their own.
"We must find the staff and rune-"
-Before Mordred does. But your "we" must exclude me. He would not listen to reason were I to join you.
The rune and the chamber are lost to legend, but I will light your path to the staff and the mage who found it.
Yes. A god of winter. To do this, he needs a ternion- the ring, the crown, and the Staff of Samhain.
Binding them with the Winter Rune would make him into a monster, and unleash calamity upon the world. An eternal frost.
95_s04_03_entercastle_talk_skye_escortpr: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />Just when I think I stopped being surprised by your abilities! You really<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> do live up to your name.
<g id="g_male_compliment" />The joy, the relief these poor prisoners must feel, all<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> thanks to you.
<g id="g_male_willcoverit" />And you may rely on us. We'll be sure they make<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> free of this cursed place.

<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />Strength to your arm. And deliver a firm "message" from us to that<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> vile King Idris-<g id="g_female_smackfist" priority="high" /> as you knock the Frost Crown from his head.
95_s04_03_entercastle_talk_zander_howche: <g id="g_female_notsure" />Do I play chess? Do<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> squirrels not taste of chicken?<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> Wait. That is-<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> not. True. Anyway!<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> Look at this board- the ogre is a rook.
<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />The spearmen are pawns, the Corrupted priest is a bishop, the elk is a knight,<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> and the maiden, a queen.
<g id="g_female_fingerwagno" />Do not visit Brimstone Sands in the summer!<g id="g_male_laughbig" /> Ha ha ha! But listen,<g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" /> in chess, as in life, take what you want!

<g id="g_male_think" />Oh. That gem on the enemy king. I<g id="g_female_youknow" /> think it can fit into that pedestal by the exit, and maybe<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> unlock the door.<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> Opa!
95_s04_03_entercastle_talkdaichiwall_des: Ask Daichi if he can burn a hole through the gate
95_s04_03_entercastle_talkzanderwall_des: Talk to Zander at the Frost Gate

95_s04_03_entercastle_zander_p01_default: <g id="g_female_waveoffdisdain" />Ah, listen to me, we are wasting our time here.<g id="g_male_agree1" /> That wall, it is solid ice, very very thick!<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Granny Pike used to say to me-

<g id="g_male_compliment" />"Zander, do not fight a rat with only your mouth.<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> Unless it is dead."<g id="g_male_laughbig" /> Ha ha ha!<g id="g_female_youknow" /> She is so funny.

<g id="g_male_pointblame" />You know, I still say I loosened up that wall. I am<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> telling you, when something cracks many times, the cracks become<g id="g_female_notsure" /> very small and looks like what? Ice.
<g id="g_female_rightfistthreaten" />I hear the snorting sounds coming from your nose, Rima,<g id="g_male_shakehead" /> and it is not helpful!
95_s04_03_entercastle_zander_p02_default: <g id="g_male_nod2" />Ah, this is exciting! Chess! A king's game. I have played<g id="g_female_waverightnoway" /> many, many times in Greece.
<g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" />Why are you looking at me that way? It is the truth,<g id="g_male_agree1" /> I am something like an expert in this game!
95_s04_03_entercastle_zander_p03_default: <g id="g_male_itsokay" />I would like to have a long talk with the one who is freezing people this way.
<g id="g_female_youknow" />And by "long talk" I mean, not talking with words, but<g id="g_female_fingerwagno" /> instead, punching them very hard.
95_s04_03_entercastle_zandermumbling_hin: Zander is muttering loudly about chess- maybe he has an idea about this room.
95_s04_03_failedchesspuzzle_description: The wrong move was made. Resetting the board...
95_s04_03_failedchesspuzzle_hint: The board resets. Perhaps you made the wrong move?
95_s04_03_solvechesspuzzle_description: Solve the chess endgame to win the exit gem
95_s04_04_fightmage_artorius_lore_forgiv: It was pride, Gwynn. My pride. Yes, in equal part, the lad's incessant prodding. His sharp, bottomless ambition. And in that moment, too painful a reminder. Of my own failures as King- nay, as a man. On the morrow I'll send word. Mordred still carries a seat at our table, such as is left of it.
It was pride, Gwynn. My pride. Yes, in equal part, the lad's incessant prodding. His sharp, bottomless ambition.
And in that moment, too painful a reminder. Of my own failures as King- nay, as a man.
On the morrow I'll send word. Mordred still carries a seat at our table, such as is left of it.
95_s04_04_fightmage_artorius_lorenote_de: Read the journal entry from Artorius
95_s04_04_fightmage_askrimamordred_descr: Ask Rima for her thoughts on stopping Mordred
95_s04_04_fightmage_checkinskye_descript: Ask Skye if she's seen Rima or Mordred
95_s04_04_fightmage_complete: <g id="g_grace_upset" priority="high" />Cat's curse. Mordred's got everything he needs to turn us all into icicles, save the rune. We'll<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> need to move fast.<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> Brr. Is<g id="g_grace_cantremember" priority="high" /> it just me, or did it get colder here, all of a sudden?
95_s04_04_fightmage_defeatjehan_descript: Defeat Jehan and find a way to reach the Staff of Samhain
95_s04_04_fightmage_desc: Morgaine spoke of a mage who obtained the Staff of Samhain, the final artifact needed to empower Mordred and bring on an endless winter. Get the staff from the mage before Mordred does.
95_s04_04_fightmage_dog_p02_defaultdialo: (Dog's tufted ears flicker, perhaps turning toward sounds he hears nearby.)
95_s04_04_fightmage_dog_p03_defaultdialo: (Dog seems quite interested in the wall, for some reason. Perhaps he saw a rat.)
(Dog flickers his ears, focused on the crumbled section of wall. He seems to be waiting for you to do something.)
95_s04_04_fightmage_dog_p04_defaultdialo: (Dog's ears are laid back slightly. He doesn't like the feeling of this cave, for some reason.)
95_s04_04_fightmage_givepassword_descrip: Tell the magic door the pass phrase and pursue Mordred
95_s04_04_fightmage_gotoer_description: Travel to Ebonscale Reach to ask a Prydwen scholar for information that could curb Mordred's ambitions
95_s04_04_fightmage_gotoyeticaves_descri: Travel to the hills of Ebonscale Reach to look for Mordred and the Staff of Samhain
95_s04_04_fightmage_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Seems if we stop Mordred, we stop the forever winter. So we<g id="g_grace_realize" /> need to get the Staff of Samhain, and the Winter Rune, before he does.
95_s04_04_fightmage_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_concerns" />But we've been drinking from his wake. We need to<g id="g_grace_smackfist" priority="high" /> get ahead of him, catch some clear wind.
95_s04_04_fightmage_incomplete_a: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />We'll let you know what we find out about the Winter Rune. Ah, it might be time to start<g id="g_grace_no" /> fortifying the camp.
95_s04_04_fightmage_incomplete_b: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />If we get ahold of either the staff or the rune, there's<g id="g_grace_spreadarms" /> nothing left for Mordred to do except come after us.
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehan_combatbark_dea: I see. I was- wrong. The Staff. Take it!
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehan_combatbark_int: That one told me. You've come to take the Staff. You must not! You will not!
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehan_combatbark_tra: The Staff calls to me. The Staff guides me!
I found the Staff! It is mine! Mine!
I won't go back. I cannot go back!
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehan_combatbark_vic: At last, the stink is purged.
Ha ha ha! You see! The weakness of your frame.
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehan_lore_becominga: I have not slept since the Staff came into my possession. It was buried here, hidden, protected by powerful magic, I found. I- cannot think well.
I awoke, staring at the Staff. Eyes full of sand, legs afire, as if I'd been squatting in front of it for days. Have I been? In and out the door. "Nevermore. Nevermore."
The cold, the endless cold. No, not the fault of the Staff. The fault lies in this frail body. Yes. the constructs. So perfect. Clean. If only I could- be one. Yes.
At last, I will rid myself of it. Of this dirty, weak shell. It itches. This disgusting human skin. I will rid myself of it and finally, ascend to freedom. How glorious.
95_s04_04_fightmage_jehanvln_description: Search Jehan's notes for the door's pass phrase
95_s04_04_fightmage_magicdoor_p01_defaul: Yes? Oh, you expected something witty? Sinister? Something that rhymes? I'm a magic door, not a poet!
Go thou forth and find the glorious word of passing, so I may goest back to my nap. Tinkle glitter magic sounds, the end.
95_s04_04_fightmage_magicdoormovement_hi: Something seems to be moving, on the right side of the doorway.
95_s04_04_fightmage_map_lorenote_descrip: Examine the map that Rima "borrowed" from Mordred
95_s04_04_fightmage_mordred_p02_defaultd: I thought myself rid of you, but now I see that you're like a village mongrel. Noxious, foul-tempered, sniffing my tracks like a thieving cur.
95_s04_04_fightmage_mordred_se_staff_out: Yes! The mage's death. The barrier is gone!
Nothing can stop me now, Artorius!
Yes! The mage's death. The barrier is gone! Nothing can stop me now, Artorius!
95_s04_04_fightmage_mordredtrystaff_hint: Mordred is at the far end of the cavern, trying to retrieve the Staff
95_s04_04_fightmage_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Great idea. That way we've got a better chance of getting either the rune or the staff.
95_s04_04_fightmage_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_realize" />We know where the staff is- maybe you can take a team after that? The<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> rest of us will look into the rune, figure out where it is.
95_s04_04_fightmage_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_yes" />Brains and brawn, eh? Sounds like a plan.<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> Rima's got a good head for legends and such.
95_s04_04_fightmage_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_grace_greethead" />May want to check if she knows anything else about Mordred that could help,<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> in case you run into him.
95_s04_04_fightmage_rima_p01_defaultdial: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />I spent some time there in my wandering youth.<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> "Oh Ebonscale, heads or tails-"
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />Ah, it was a brighter place once, despite the challenges. I once knew a fair lass- but,<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> that's a tale for another day.
95_s04_04_fightmage_rima_p02_defaultdial: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />I've heard tales of King Artorius, of course- but to<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> read that letter. It was so heartfelt.

<g id="g_litearmor_headshakeno" />I wish I could have met him.<g id="g_female_youknows" /> I picture him with a beard, don't you?<g id="g_female_laughmed" /> A bit unkempt, bits of dried ale in it. I'm joking!
95_s04_04_fightmage_rima_p03_defaultdial: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Worse and worse. This is a tale told at night, with horror enough to shake the strong.<g id="g_litearmor_darnit" /> We had him in front of us!
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Skye was right. There was no sense in my appealing to his<g id="g_litearmor_dismissgetlost2" /> humanity, as he has none left!
95_s04_04_fightmage_rima_p04_defaultdial: <g id="g_female_explains" />If we do find Mordred here, we need to think on how to convey what we've found.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> One thing's for certain, let's not mention Morgaine.
<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />Seems they don't have a very good relationship.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> Boys and their mothers.
95_s04_04_fightmage_rima_p05_defaultdial: <g id="g_female_nodconsider" />Something's bothering me about this whole mess. I've the feeling that-
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />It may sound odd, but I've the uncanny feeling that Mordred's being used by some-<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> other power.
95_s04_04_fightmage_scholar_p01_defaultd: The Staff of Samhain? Yes, it was recovered by a mage. His name is Jehan Pelerin.
He was also very interested in the Ancients - it was the constructs that intrigued him. But I haven't heard from him in a very long time.
95_s04_04_fightmage_se_dog_01_bark: (Dog meows loudly to draw the player's attention)
95_s04_04_fightmage_se_rima_dooropen_bar: Whatever you did, I think it's open!
Rima: Whatever you did, I think it's open!
95_s04_04_fightmage_skye_p05_defaultdial: <g id="g_female_handsonhipsshakeheads" />It is unsettling, what Morgaine told you. An<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> eternal winter that would destroy all life. A<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> cold without end. It is<g id="g_female_youknow" /> not possible to imagine such a thing.
95_s04_04_fightmage_solvedoorpuzzle_desc: Unlock the entrance to the inner caverns
95_s04_04_fightmage_solvemagedoorpuzzle_: Select the correct combination of door symbols to unlock the cavern entrance
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_dog_crumblywall: (Dog seems to be calling your attention to a crumbled section of wall that he's standing next to.)
(Dog meows affirmatively. He seems happy that you've understood!)
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_magicdoor_first: Talk to the head that appeared to the right of the doorway
Brain bird, goat curd, do you have the pass word? If you don't, then I suggest you look, through Jehan's notes, from Jehan's books.
Oh, I do hate rhyming. Anyway, speak the secret phrase or you shall not pass.
You mean Ser Loves-Himself? No helping it, he threatened to burn a hole through me if I didn't let him through.
I jest. He spoke the pass word before you arrived. Now go! Find the phrase, and you will amaze!
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_magicdoor_unloc: Took you long enough. I could have baked a pie, it took so long. Of course I don't bake, I'm a magic door!
Well? Do you have the phrase, or must I keep talking for an Aeternum? Did you like that?
Aww, pish! Boring. You have bored me with your password finding skills. Why don't you go become a scribe.
I'll unlock the door now. If you miss me, ask Jehan to make me on your own door. Goodbye.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_mordred_cantsto: What. A letter from Artorius? Let me see. Oh, how easy for him. To banish me in one breath, and in the next, offer a seat back at his table.
Am I then a cur cast into the cold, only to limp back, mewling for milk?
He loved himself! How kingly of him to forgive! After ruining my life on a whim, because I piqued his temper.
So yes, it is proof. Proof I was never more than a fly to him. All the more reason to tear down everything he loved!
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_rima_artoriusvl: <g id="g_litearmor_headshakeno" />That was- surprisingly sad.<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> And tragic that word never reached Mordred.<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> I suppose the King disappeared before it was sent.
<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />But this is exactly what we were looking for! Artorius felt<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" /> terrible for what he'd done.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />You have a good point. Pride and anger,<g id="g_male_waghand02" /> once in motion, is hard to recover from.

<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />But we must try, if there's even a hint of a chance!<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> These feelings from Artorius may yet reach Mordred-<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> I'm sure they will.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_rima_cantgetthr: <g id="g_female_lookaroundconfused" priority="high" />It seems this place was once a grand affair.
<g id="g_litearmor_think" />Some kind of hidden temple. Perhaps the mage we're looking for found the Staff here, then<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> loved it so much he decided to stay.
<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" />Yes, well, I can't get through. As Zander might say,<g id="g_litearmor_crossarmsupset" /> "Door. Thick like my skull.<g id="g_male_ragepunchfistsdown" /> Cannot break."
<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I've pushed, pulled, yelled phrases at it, some colorful ones as well, and-<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> Say, did you just hear Dog caterwauling?
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_rima_mordrednot: <g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I am so sorry. Not only did my idea not work, it’s provoked him even further.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> Save me from the vanity of men! Er, knights.
<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />We'd best get after him.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> I don’t like to think what'll happen if he gets the staff first.
<g id="g_litearmor_nodunderstand" />Good thinking. Skye and I can watch for Mordred,<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> in the event he tries to escape with the staff.
<g id="g_litearmor_realize" />And oh, I almost forgot, this map- I, um, borrowed it from him as we talked.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> It may be worth a look.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_rima_scholarer_: <g id="g_litearmor_think" />There's something Morgaine said about Mordred, that's been pulling at my sleeve.<g id="g_litearmor_realize" /> That letter he wrote to Artorius.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Doesn't it sound like someone trying to work out their feelings?<g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" /> He's like- a hurt child.
"So the key to this is Artorius."

<g id="g_male_pointblame" />Exactly. Mordred's ego was crushed. If we heal that injury, perhaps all of this<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> goes away.<g id="g_litearmor_tiltheadremember" priority="high" /> Oh- Ebonscale Reach!
<g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />There's a scholar I know, he was a senior scribe at Prydwen.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> He can help us find proof of the King's intentions.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_scholar_artoriu: Oh! You’re from the Silver Crows interviews! I'm- still waiting for a response. Oh yes, King Artorius and Mordred.
Prior to coming here to study the Ancients, I spent years as a scribe in Prydwen, managing their records.
Well, that is amusing! You might say it was a continual falling out. But there is something-
Yes, in the King’s journal, now I remember, it was just after Mordred had been banished. It should be in these scrolls.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_skye_mordredhas: <g id="g_male_dontknow" />We haven't seen Mordred! But<g id="g_male_darnit" /> he has the staff now, as well? Then<g id="g_male_agree1" /> there's little time to waste, and none for parley.
<g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" />Little men like him will only listen to cold iron,<g id="g_female_notsure" /> preferably stuck through their tiny hearts.
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />Yes, the Winter Rune, Morgaine called it. Let's<g id="g_male_spreadhands" /> return to the others and see what they've learned.

<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />I only hope we still have time to stop him, but<g id="g_male_nodunderstand" /> I trust you Soulwarden. Let us<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> put an end to this together.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talk_skye_stayoutsid: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />There you are! Rima's<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> gone ahead with Dog. They<g id="g_female_youknows" /> seek a way in to find the Staff. I will<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> stay to guard the approach.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />None, though he may have gone<g id="g_male_pointblame" /> before. Be wary, for serpents and madmen strike without warning.

<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />Rima thinks we should- what was it- appeal to Mordred's heart.<g id="g_female_crossarms" /> Oh, I want to appeal to his heart. With<g id="g_female_smackfist" priority="high" /> the point of my spear.
95_s04_04_fightmage_talkscholar_descript: Ask the scholar about the relationship between Artorius and Mordred

95_s04_05_retrieverune_complete_a: <g id="g_female_crossarms" />I wish we could celebrate your success, but there is no time.<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> Earlier we saw Mordred and his men<g id="g_female_youknows" /> escape from where you came out.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_complete_b: <g id="g_male_shrugbrief" />It looked like he carried the Rune.<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" priority="high" /> We chased after, but lost them in the forest.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_daichi_p06_defaul: This Mordred-<g id="g_yonas_explain01" /> he does not know it, but something cold, hungry, a terror- it breaks free of its tether, in a place that<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> shadows our world.
<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" />We must stop him. The<g id="g_yonas_concerns" /> weakness of humanity- it will bring ruin on us all.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_defeatruneboss_de: Defeat the Forge Guardian to recover the Winter Rune
95_s04_05_retrieverune_desc: Get the Winter Rune that binds the three winter artifacts together, before Mordred gets to it.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_dog_p05_defaultdi: (Dog seems anxious and upset, unlike his usual relaxed self.)
95_s04_05_retrieverune_enterrunetrial_de: Enter the Rune Forge and get the Winter Rune before Mordred does
95_s04_05_retrieverune_gotoruneforge_des: Travel to the Rune Forge to find the Winter Rune and forestall Mordred
95_s04_05_retrieverune_gracecamp_p01_def: <g id="g_grace_disapprove" />Och, and now Mordred has the rune as well? I was so sure we'd be able to take his sails.
<g id="g_grace_understand" />Well, you and I have made it through tougher weather than this.<g id="g_grace_crossarms" priority="high" /> Just not a never-ending winter kind of weather.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_yes" />Our visit to the library in Brimstone paid off.<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> Turns out there was a forge where the<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> Ancients smithied runes of power.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />It's there they locked away the Winter Rune, thought it was too dangerous.<g id="g_grace_realize" /> Guess where this Rune Forge is?
95_s04_05_retrieverune_incomplete_a: <g id="g_grace_convince1" />Just when things were getting quiet again. I knew I couldn't trust it. Why can't we have a nice, fat, boring,<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> purse-fattening contract?
95_s04_05_retrieverune_placeholderrunetr: Placeholder timer: Enter the Rune Forge, and defeat the Forge Boss
95_s04_05_retrieverune_proposal_a: Great Cleave-<g id="g_grace_relief" /> what? Don't tell me you just guessed that. All right, don't<g id="g_grace_dismiss2" priority="high" /> make a display of yourself.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />At first I thought the map you got from Mordred might be<g id="g_grace_disappointed" priority="high" /> for the Winter Rune, but there are no waterfalls by the Forge.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_proposal_next_a: <g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />Then let's hope we don't need it.<g id="g_grace_chastise" /> I don't fancy getting a clear view of Mordred turning into a monster.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_proposal_next_b: <g id="g_grace_yes" />Take who you need to the Forge.<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> Skye and I'll find Morgaine.<g id="g_grace_handheart" /> Maybe she'll change her mind about helping us.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_rima_p06_defaultd: <g id="g_litearmor_worry" priority="high" />This is not good. Not good at all, if Mordred has all three artifacts.

<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Can you imagine what that madman would do with the power of a god?<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> I can- he'd strip our world of life. We<g id="g_litearmor_headshakeno" /> must hurry.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_skyecamp_p01_defa: <g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" />I wish I could go, but Grace is right. I'll be of<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> more use to you looking for Morgaine. That sorceress<g id="g_female_smackfist" priority="high" /> needs to leash her evil spawn.

And- should you<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> find Mordred first.<g id="g_female_disagreerighthandout" /> Don't sacrifice yourself to stop him.<g id="g_male_pleadhandsopen" /> There is much evil in the world, but only one of you.
95_s04_05_retrieverune_trigger_searchwin: Look for the Winter Rune needed to thwart Mordred
95_s04_05_retrieverune_zander_p04_defaul: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />You know, I thought they were saying "ruin" and not "rune" this whole time. You know,<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> sometimes I think the gods tricked us.
<g id="g_female_youknow" />Giving us language-<g id="g_male_agree1" /> "Here! A nice new present!" But what did it do? It made us forget.<g id="g_male_itsokay" /> Forget how to really communicate.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_collectfirstrune_de: Use the telescope with Daichi's orb to capture the first key rune
95_s04_06_stopdevice_collectfirstrune_hi: The orb that Daichi gave you burns hot. You've captured the key rune "Ascend!"
95_s04_06_stopdevice_collectsecondrune_d: Collect the last key rune "Fear" needed to unseal the Ancient temple
95_s04_06_stopdevice_collectsecondrune_h: The capture orb shudders as it absorbs the key rune, "Fear." You can now unlock the temple.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_combatbark_death_mo: No! Fool! What have you done!
Artorius! I have not failed! I will not!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_combatbark_stage2_m: The fury of the gods, within me!
Praise your good fortune, to behold my newfound might!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_combatbark_stage3_m: Taste the full might of Winter!
Such power! Such might at my command!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_combatbark_victory_: At last you find your place. At my feet.
Truly laughable. Did you really think this would stop me?
Sad little fool. Your meddling has ended.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />If we were betting odds, I<g id="g_grace_headshakeno" priority="high" /> might have wagered against us.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_flirt" />But you and I together, we've got a kind of magic all our own, don't we?<g id="g_grace_smackfist" priority="high" /> We bested that smug arse Mordred.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_daichi_p07_defaultd: <g id="g_yonas_shiftawkward" />No, I am fine. It is this place, not the cold.<g id="g_yonas_lookleftdown" priority="high" /> There is something underneath- coming for us.<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> No. It is waiting for us.

<g id="g_yonas_lookdownconfused" priority="high" />It is- inhuman. Like a spider. And Mordred may be the unsuspecting moth. Or<g id="g_yonas_shrugdontcare" priority="high" /> worse, he is an anchor for the web.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_daichi_p08_defaultd: <g id="g_yonas_shakeheadworried" priority="high" />How many secrets are buried here? I can feel the lives taken- the suffering.
<g id="g_yonas_crossarmsshakehead" />I once was like the Mordred. For me, strength was everything. I see clearly now, my foolishness.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_daichi_p09_defaultd: <g id="g_yonas_lookleftpensive" priority="high" />The magic here- there is great power. The ritual chamber is near.<g id="g_yonas_noddingheadapproval" /> Be ready. Be wary. Something very old watches, waits.
<g id="g_yonas_shakeheadworried" />It is very strong. And not of this world, I know it now. We must stop Mordred, it is the only way.

<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" />Well done. No,<g id="g_yonas_handsextendedsorry" /> I do not look down on you! Does "well done" sound that way to you? I do not know why I always offend those I respect.<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> It is troubling.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_desc: Mordred has everything he needs to activate the Ancient device and become a winter demigod. Stop him before he brings about an Ice Age to Aeternum, and the rest of the world.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_dog_p06_defaultdial: (Dog seems somewhat more at ease than before. Perhaps he was worried if you would make it across the cliffs safely.)
95_s04_06_stopdevice_dog_p07_defaultdial: (Dog stands vigilant. There's steel in his eyes. But, what kind of damage could such a small creature possibly do?)
95_s04_06_stopdevice_dogafterdefeatmordr: Let Dog know you've defeated Mordred
95_s04_06_stopdevice_dogcamp_p01_default: (Dog seems to be relaxed and happy again. He greets you and rolls back for a tummy rub. It's probably a trap.)
95_s04_06_stopdevice_entermordredtrial_d: Enter the ritual chamber and stop Mordred
95_s04_06_stopdevice_entermordredtrial_h: Mordred has transformed into a monstrosity, drawing the power of the Ancients from the chamber. Stop him!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_gracecamp_p01_defau: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Yeah, we sailed right through that storm, didn't we?<g id="g_grace_flirt" /> I have to say, you're lucky you found me on the beach that day.
<g id="g_grace_welcome" />I mean, where would you be without me as your First Mate?
95_s04_06_stopdevice_greet_a: <g id="g_yonas_thinking" />I guess he is going to Mokosh Springs. For the what is it,<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> ritual chamber.<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> Why is your face looking like that?
95_s04_06_stopdevice_greet_b: <g id="g_yonas_gestureleftm" />The map you got from Mordred, the one with the<g id="g_yonas_gesturerights" /> three waterfalls.<g id="g_yonas_nodbig" /> This must be where he is going.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_igc_fightintro_mord: Ancients! Grant me your power! Let all crack and bend before my- might!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_incomplete_a: <g id="g_yonas_noddingheadapproval" />Skye may know a way to find Morgaine. You know, I like Skye very much.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_mordred_lore_fallsj: Three artifacts for the ritual, yes, but also three runes to gain access! I feel your hand at play Artorius, but destiny is on my side. I will find the other two- they must be here. Oh, how the world will shake at my ascendance!
Three artifacts for the ritual, yes, but also three runes to gain access!
I feel your hand at play Artorius, but destiny is on my side.
I will find the other two- they must be here. Oh, how the world will shake at my ascendance!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_mordredwaterfall_vl: Read the note on the ground
95_s04_06_stopdevice_proposal: <g id="g_yonas_shrug" />I thought everyone already knew this. The<g id="g_yonas_lefthand" /> waterfalls, the mountain shape-<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" /> Mokosh.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_proposal_next: <g id="g_yonas_noddingsubtle" />Yes, I can help talk sense to her. If she<g id="g_yonas_headshakedisappointed" /> knows how close her son is to turning us into ice sculptures,<g id="g_yonas_gesturerightm" /> she may change her mind.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_returncrowsnest_des: Victory! Let the other Crows know you've averted Mordred's threat
95_s04_06_stopdevice_rima_p07_defaultdia: How much<g id="g_litearmor_chuckle" /> f-further? I've fallen twenty times on this miserable path. You'd<g id="g_male_leanforwardinspect" /> think DAICHI WOULD LEND A HAND!<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> Damned mountain goat.
<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Well if I thought it was a bit drafty in the Crow's Nest, I've changed my mind completely.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_rima_p08_defaultdia: <g id="g_litearmor_chuckle" />Brr. The sooner we stop M-Mordred, the b-better.

<g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Ah! If my fingers freeze and I can't play anymore, it'll<g id="g_female_pointthreaten" /> be on you to feed and- and bathe me! All my kingdom for<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> a hot bath!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_rima_p09_defaultdia: <g id="g_male_lookuparound" priority="high" />How odd to find such lovely art a place as cold and evil as this one.
Do you know,<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> I once discovered an amazing wood carving inside of a Roman cesspit?<g id="g_male_waghand01" /> Oh no, that's bringing back some bad memories.
<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />That is something, really. All of it! Mordred, Artorius, the eternal winter that you spared all of us from.
<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />Another song, waiting to be written-<g id="g_female_handsforwardrequest" /> by my frozen hands! Ah, for just one cup of piping hot tea!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_rimaafterdefeatmord: Tell Rima that you've stopped Mordred
95_s04_06_stopdevice_rimacamp_p01_defaul: <g id="g_litearmor_lookuparound" priority="high" />As I suspected, I'm quite glad to be back in our cozy little rodent nest of a camp.
<g id="g_female_lookright" priority="high" />Now is it my imagination, or does even Mister Grunts seem to be less-<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> scowly of late?
95_s04_06_stopdevice_seeentrance_hint: The others are waiting for you here, near the cavern entrance
95_s04_06_stopdevice_seefallslore_hint: A fluttering movement catches your eye. There's a note of some kind by the crates.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_seefirstrune_hint: You feel the dark power of a rune from the valley below. If you could see it, you could capture it.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_seelizardart_hint: Paintings on the floor and walls depict three colors of Ancient lizard guardians, facing Corrupted enemies.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_skyecamp_p01_defaul: <g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" />A good riddance to that foul knight! And his<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> twisted plan for a never-ending winter.

<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />But you! I'm<g id="g_female_headnodding" /> glad I placed my trust in you. You've saved us.<g id="g_male_compliment" /> If I had just a portion of your strength, your will.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_solvedpuzzle_hint: Heavy Ancient gears grind into motion. You've unlocked the ritual chamber!
95_s04_06_stopdevice_solvelizardpuzzle_d: Orient the statues to unlock the ritual chamber door
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_daichi_helpfal: The<g id="g_yonas_gestureleft" priority="high"/> temple entrance is behind the waterfall. It will open to you,<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> now that you have the three key runes.
<g id="g_yonas_handsextendedsorry" />Although, it is said that only a fool steps into shadows without a candle. Yes, I am saying we<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> are not ready.
<g id="g_yonas_laughcocky" priority="high" />Hahaha! Yes. And the more time I spend with you, the more I am convinced. I think perhaps<g id="g_yonas_shrug" /> you, at least, are always ready.
<g id="g_yonas_explain02" />Ah! Damn this cold weather. Making me say embarrassing things, like the purple singer.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_daichi_journal: <g id="g_yonas_takeitem8s" priority="high" />Hm- key runes. This note shows places they have searched. They needed three to enter, for the ritual!

<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" />These Ancient words- the rune names. Ascend. And-<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> Night? No- Fear. The last rune, we<g id="g_yonas_gesturelefts" /> have this one. The<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" /> rune of Winter.
"We need two more runes to get in."
<g id="g_yonas_nod" />Yes- let us split our efforts.<g id="g_yonas_noddingsubtle" /> I will search together with Rima, toward the entrance.
Ah-<g id="g_yonas_pointforwardthreaten" /> that telescope! It is pointing to the area below.<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> Perhaps they found a rune down there.
Yes.<g id="g_yonas_giveitem" /> I use "yami" orbs to store kanji seals- we can<g id="g_yonas_nodslight" /> use them to capture any runes we find.
The question is,<g id="g_yonas_shrug" /> where are they? There are<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> places marked closer to the entrance, that they did not check.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_dog_defeatedmo: (Dog sniffs at you briefly, then mrrowls in approval. Impossibly, it seems he already knows you've vanquished the enemy.)
(Dog talks at you extensively- probably an interesting lecture. If only you spoke Lynx.)
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_dog_stayguard_: (Dog makes a strange purring noise as if he's trying to say something. He taps a forepaw on the crate.)
(Dog meows and puffs out his chest. It seems he plans to stay and guard your way out.)
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_rima_defeatedm: <g id="g_male_compliment" />My friend, you've done it! I can't-<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> what an immense relief, it's nothing short of amazing you were able to stop him!
<g id="g_female_notsure" />But you say Mordred froze? I suppose we can't leave him like that, horrible as he is. Or-<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> can we?
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Daichi, of course. Because all<g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> he does now is grunt at me instead of responding like a proper human being.
<g id="g_female_lookright" priority="high" />Yes I'm talking to you, Mister Grunts!<g id="g_female_whattheheck" /> Can you believe- did you hear that?
<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />That's an idea. Hopefully the others were able to find her. Now then,<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> let's return to our camp, shall we?
<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" />Oh, I do believe I'm actually looking forward to that place.<g id="g_litearmor_concerns" /> I may even be able to get along with Mister Grunts.
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talk_rima_lizardpuz: <g id="g_female_lookaroundconfused" priority="high" />It must be close by. The energy here- so cold, foreign. I can absolutely believe this is where the Ancients made<g id="g_litearmor_headshakeno" /> monsters out of people.
And they weren't small, based on the ceilings<g id="g_litearmor_gestureforwardrighthand" /> and size of these door guardians.

<g id="g_litearmor_realize" />Yes, you're right!<g id="g_female_lookbehind" priority="high" /> I think I saw the same lizards in the last room. How strange to find such art here.<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> Such detail.
Look.<g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" /> The base of the statues- I believe they can rotate.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" priority="high" /> Odd. Who'd bother turning them?
95_s04_06_stopdevice_talkdaichijournal_d: Talk to Daichi about the journal note you found
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_defeatedmor: Stop Mordred from bringing about an eternal winter
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_enterancien: Enter the temple to stop Mordred's transformation
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_exitcaves_d: Exit the caves and let Dog know you've defeated Mordred
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_gofirstpoin: Find the waypoint to the Ancient temple where Mordred has gone
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_gotomokosh_: Travel to Mokosh Springs to stop Mordred from becoming a god
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_gototop_des: Reach the top of the mountain to find a path to the Ancient temple
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_lizardpuzzl: Continue your search for Mordred and the ritual chamber
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_lookentranc: Look for the entrance to the Ancient temple where Mordred has gone
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_looksecondr: Look for the second rune needed to unseal the temple
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_mordredfigh: Stop Mordred from bringing about an eternal winter
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_seefirstrun: Look for key runes needed to unseal the temple entrance
95_s04_06_stopdevice_trigger_traverse_de: Traverse the mountain to reach the Ancient temple where Mordred has gone
95_s04_06_stopdevice_unsealdoor_descript: Let Daichi know you have the runes needed to unlock the temple
95_s04_06_stopdevice_zandercamp_p01_defa: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Yes my friend, you have outdone yourself with this Mordred, as you<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> always do!<g id="g_female_pointthreaten" /> Evil has no home when you are-<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> at home.
<g id="g_female_youknow" />And about that ice wall,<g id="g_female_smackfist" priority="high" /> you know, I cracked it first- by my fist,<g id="g_male_agree1" /> you saw that as well, am I right?
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_desc: Mordred has been stopped, and another crisis averted, for now. Share the news with his mother, Morgaine.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_grace_p02_defaultdia: <g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" />She said he was a kind boy once?<g id="g_grace_chuckle" /> Well I suppose even murderers and sailors have mothers.
<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />Why are you looking at me that way?<g id="g_grace_greethead" /> I've a mother.<g id="g_grace_handheart" /> I was once a very sweet, kind, shy young lass.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_gracecamp_p01_defaul: <g id="g_grace_consider" />We've gathered up a damned fine crew. Maybe the best I've ever had, truth be told.
But- it's<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> almost too good.<g id="g_grace_no" /> Sea's always calmest before the storm and all that.<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> Ah, just my imagination I'm sure.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_greet_a: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />To tell the truth, I feel a bit sorry for Morgaine. She acts like she doesn't care, but-
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_greet_b: <g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" />Skye found her in Mordred's old cabin, tensed up like a cat in water. We uh,<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> may need her help in the future.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_incomplete_a: <g id="g_grace_cantremember" />To think this entire place, maybe the whole world, would be covered in ice, if it<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> wasn't for the Silver Crows.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />I was hoping you'd say so. Skye just came back, says she tried approaching her, but the sorceress had her jaw set.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_no" />Determined to stay out of things. Maybe<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> catch up with Skye. I'll<g id="g_grace_gesturerights" /> join you out there.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_skye_p06_defaultdial: <g id="g_female_headshakesmall" />To see the look on her face. I feel<g id="g_male_guiltylookdown" /> some- shame, for wishing her son to suffer.<g id="g_male_whatwantfromme" /> Perhaps a parent can never leave behind their bond, even if they<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> wish to do so.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_skyecamp_p01_default: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Is the breeze warmer?<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> Does the air taste sweeter? I yearned for solace in<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> the mountains.

<g id="g_female_youknow" />Always slaking a never-ending thirst for battle.<g id="g_female_nodconsider" /> Now? Now there are other things to<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> live for. People I care about.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> You.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_talk_daichi_defeated: <g id="g_yonas_nodbig" />In a short time I have had a very satisfying adventure with you. I was<g id="g_yonas_shrug" /> correct to pretend to lose our match.<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> I am joking with you!

<g id="g_yonas_explain01" />You have just saved- perhaps the entire world from eternal winter. And you ask me,<g id="g_yonas_headtilthmm" /> am I happy to be here?<g id="g_yonas_laughbig" /> Ha ha ha!

<g id="g_yonas_shrugdontcare" priority="high" />The food is terrible. The decoration?<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> Painful. But the company-<g id="g_yonas_righthand01" /> I am satisfied.
<g id="g_yonas_noddingslow" />Yes. Though, most of the time people do not understand my sense of humor. Dog understands.
<g id="g_yonas_lookright" priority="high" />He is much more intelligent than most of the others suspect.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_talk_grace_finishque: <g id="g_grace_gesturer" />Seems I just missed it. How did the talk with Morgaine go?<g id="g_grace_consider" priority="high" /> Wonder if we could still ask her for some eh, reasonable compensation.
<g id="g_grace_convince1" />Just enough to cover our expenses. Not to mention having to put up with that son of hers.
<g id="g_grace_frustrated" priority="high" />Ah! That's what I get, for being all tender around you. Now I'm just<g id="g_grace_dismiss" /> sorry I opened up my heart to you, you barrel-headed louse!
<g id="g_grace_crossarmsinsulted" priority="high" />May your barbed tongue freeze into an icicle alongside that Mordred fellow!
<g id="g_grace_understand" />Truer words were never spoken. There’s also pearls. Or<g id="g_grace_realize" /> mermaid's tears, if that's your fancy. But listen.
<g id="g_grace_thankyou2" />You've done a hell of a job, and I mean it. Saving all of us. You've my<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> sincere thanks, and I don't say that often.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_talk_morgaine_mordre: He froze, you say? Do you mean, into solid ice? I see. I see. Ha ha ha ha ha.
I’m sorry, these emotions. It is unlike me. Life has not been easy with him. Nor he with it. But, thank you- for trying to talk sense into him.
I'm certainly not crying, if that's what you're asking. Not for that selfish chick. But I am his mother, so I suppose I will retrieve him.
I just hope. I hope I can show him peace. Do you know, he was a kind boy, once.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_talk_skye_defeatedmo: <g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />Yes! I never doubted you, but still-<g id="g_male_sighrelief" /> my heart rested on knives until I saw you arrive.
<g id="g_male_wavehandsnobig" />Not- not that I was simply waiting for you here, whimpering and<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> pining like some kind of<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" /> weak princess.
<g id="g_male_leanbackcovermouth" />Ha ha! Yes. You did and for that<g id="g_female_bowshallow" /> you have my deepest thanks. And<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> respect.

<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />But now, we should tell Morgaine what's happened to her son.<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> She plays the uncaring mother, but<g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" /> even now she haunts his cabin.
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_talk_skye_finishques: <g id="g_female_youknow" />I am glad she took it well enough. That<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> must have been hard for her. But<g id="g_male_righthandnodeal" /> enough of somber words!
I have a-<g id="g_female_shrugshort" /> request for you. Ah,<g id="g_male_complimentplayer" /> I'll come right to it.<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> Would you let me join the Crows?
<g id="g_male_clasphandsgrateful" />Thank you. I- asked Grace also. She said<g id="g_male_spreadarmscalm" /> you should have the final decision,<g id="g_female_youknow" /> as our captain.
<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />I will see you back at the Crow's Nest, then! And<g id="g_male_waghand01" /> no, I am not blushing!<g id="g_female_fingerwagno" /> A warrior does not blush!
95_s04_07_wrapfrost_trigger_gocabin_desc: Go to Mordred's cabin in search of his mother, Morgaine
95_s04_aowei_defaultdialogue: You've come to marvel at these ice formations as well yes? They are quite something aren't they?
95_s04_ascendruneitem_description: The captured "Ascend" rune, used to unseal the temple entrance.
95_s04_chessexitgemitem_description: A gem dropped by the enemy King chess piece.
95_s04_daichicamp_p01_defaultdialogue_02: <g id="g_yonas_shrug" />These people seem- less noisy than before.<g id="g_yonas_onehandoutnoway" /> No, I still do not like them. But- they are less noisy. 95a_bloodofthesands_body_01_01:
May, 1100 AD

I’m beginning to think this map is fake.

My search of Henkhisesui has again hit a stop. No matter which way I turn this blasted piece of paper, it isn’t lining up with the ruins properly. I am going to try to dig up some of this sand and see if the desert have claimed some of the structures that I’m searching for.

As a side note, something strange happened today that I must make mention of. As Jorich and I had our last meal of the night, we tried to lighten the mood with a few jokes. One of his jokes was so bad it didn’t even elicit as much as a snort from me, but we definitely heard a chuckle coming from the brush behind us. We called out but found no one, and nothing but the footprints of the local jackals around us.

The next morning, I saw a strange jackal sitting on the rocks looking down at us… just staring. It chittered at me, and I swear the sound of the laugh from the night before and the short bark were similar enough that they might have been the same.

A coincidence to be sure, but a story to note how many odd things we might find out here in the sands.

- Q. Almabi
95a_bloodofthesands_body_02_01:
I don’t know how long I’ve been out in the desert, but I’ve seen some strange interactions between the creatures that call Brimstone home in my time here.

I believe the strangest one must be the relationship between the lions and peacocks out in Ruined Seret. On the surface, it looks like a pride of lions have herded a flock of peacocks for an easy dinner. In fact, passers by have given the lions the names “birdherders” or somesuch moniker.

But I think the roles are reversed – my observations of Seret lead me to believe the peacocks are actually the ones in charge there, and the lions are subservient. When I collected a set of the long feathers and placed them within view, the peacocks seemed to react to them. I’m not sure if their calls were protection or an invitation, but the lions moved to the outside of the group while the birds called out.

Very interesting, and definitely worth further study.

- Maharaj Sahjit
95a_bloodofthesands_body_03_01:
I've found it! Blood is the key! 

I've found the means to unlocking our liberation - our tool to overcoming this accursed island and the puppeteers that trapped us here! The Blood of the Sands had this power and they squandered it. 

But I will not! Now that I can hatch the eggs of Shah Neshen, they will be at my beck and call. I will control our fate and see these so-called Ancients bow to my will!

-M
95a_bloodofthesands_body_04_01:
The Magic Flute
By Marsses Ulivander
Pg. 31

… to prove the existence of such a creature. I’m just not seeing any evidence, and thus I believe this poem to be pure fancy with no factual basis.

On the other hand, strangely enough, I think I do have evidence regarding another mythical creature. Although I initially hesitated to put it on this list since the area I searched is on the far edge of Brimstone proper. There is a children’s song that talks about a man with the feet of a goat that once used to haunt the eastern cliffs of the desert. Apparently he used his magic flute to lure young people from their beds and into the hills where they would disappear for one year. “From the tip of the sun to the tip of the sun,” is what the lyric reads, which I suspect is referencing one summer solstice to the next.

I knew about the song, but I wasn’t looking for the beast itself, since it seemed to be more or less a rhythm to dance to and little more. However, when I made camp near the Bubasteum, I did hear some distant flute playing, and heard some strange voices not too far away. They fled when I got near, and I found a strange wooden flute among the brush there. I was never able to retrieve the object because of the lions, but I am planning to go back with a hired hand to see if I can’t pick it back up before they return.

I realize this is not hard evidence, but it is a very strange set of coincidences to be sure.

95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_complete_a: <g id="g_grace_excited2" />Ah, you've done good, recruiting the most famous bard in all Aeternum. Rima rounds out the team even better than I hoped.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_complete_b: <g id="g_grace_flirt" />She seems quite enamored of you as well - I don't think we have to worry that she'll just wander off.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_desc: Grace O'Malley is suggesting I approach a bard named Rima Bahar about joining the Silver Crows.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_incomplete: <g id="g_grace_consider" />Not only will recruiting Rima give us access to all her knowledge, we might even get to hear a little music and singing at the Crow's Nest!
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_proposal_a: <g id="g_grace_headnodyes" />Rima Bahar. She's a<g id="g_grace_gestureleftm" /> minstrel of sorts, performed at taverns across Aeternum for years.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_proposal_b: <g id="g_grace_understand" />But she's not just a musician. They say her blade's as quick as her wits. And she's got a network - she knows things.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_obj_proposal_n: <g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" />She'll be performing at the tavern in New Corsica, as I understand it.<g id="g_grace_greethead" /> I'd suggest you don't drag your feet.
<g id="g_grace_sorry" />These bard types don't stay in one place for long. Can't let her slip away, can we?
<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" />My point exactly! You and me are still newcomers, and Zander… well, let's just say he's not exactly a fount of knowledge.
<g id="g_grace_proud" />Rima's already heard rumors of the Crows, of course, so I took the liberty of sending word you'd pay a visit.

95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_rimajoin_a: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Ah. Yes, I have already spoken with Grace O'Malley, and I will<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> return to her to confirm my commitment.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_rimajoin_b: <g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />First, however, I must spend some time with this beautiful lute. We will make<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> enchanting music together. I will join you after.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_rimasong_a: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Play the song here and we will gauge the magic of it. It should break the seal.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_rimasong_b: <g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />Inside is a sacred lute I have dreamt of playing for many years. With it, I will join you and we will compose legendary songs together.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_song_workorder: A guide on how to write the song Voices of the Desert. It appears to require an engineering table.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_a: <g id="g_litearmor_think" />Hmm, perhaps the intrigue of wondering what I'll write is more valuable than the words themselves.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_b: <g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" />That will be especially true if we are to draw blades together and mix the melodies of our fates.<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> That is your intent, yes?
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_next1: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />Oh, excitement and drama are elements of the equation, but<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> tragedy and passion are vital as well, and… art.
<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />In fact, at the risk of asking too much, I would request that you<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> prove to me you share my passion for music.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_next2: <g id="g_female_flirtsmall" />Hmm. As a matter of fact, I do have something in mind -<g id="g_litearmor_willcoverit" /> an expression of the desert, a song of humor, strife, and woe.
<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />You will need to acquire a satyr's flute to use in collecting the laugh of a jackal, the roar of a lion, and the cry of the peacock.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_next3: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Ah, but it isn't the song itself. Not exactly. You see, my research in the library has unveiled stories of a sacred lute<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> locked behind the "Voices of the Desert."
<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" />I've found the lute, but I need the song.<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> The books are still here, if you want to look for yourself.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_next4: <g id="g_male_spreadarmscalm" />Well, such is the life of a bard and storyteller. The requests, the praise, and the critique… and<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> the need to spin life's mysteries into song.
<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Collect the elements I've requested, then meet me near Jupiter's Grove. Good luck.
95a_s02_voicesofthedesert_talkrima_next_: <g id="g_male_nodsympathysmall" />Hmm. I have no commitment to prevent me from<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> sharing my talents with the Crows, but<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> I will expect compensation, and coin only goes so far.
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />See, what I seek is more valuable - it's inspiration whether by story or song.
