Now let me start on the introduction - it's important to make the hero seem relatable, someone the reader would like to call a friend…
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_desc: I met a historian by the name of Phaedra Kanelos, who fancies herself something of a poet. She is looking to write the next great epic like her hero Homer, and is hoping that by defeating the Devourer, I will become a hero not unlike those in her favorite stories.
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_incomplete: Remember, when you slay the beast, come right back to me. Don't spare any detail!
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_proposal_a: It's what I can do to help you! Forgive me, I am getting ahead of myself. My name is Phaedra Kanelos, and I have been cataloguing the exploits of many a hero on this island.
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_proposal_b: You've been mentioned in more than one account of herosim, and I've finally found you!
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_proposal_next: Well, you see, I am a poet, and I'm looking to write the next epic. I've always loved the Odyssey, and Homer is something of a hero of mine.
I long to write Aeternum's Odyssey - the great epic for this strange island.
“What does this have to do with me?"
I've heard of a beast of immesurable size that prowls the sands. Something so huge that even the mighty Heracles himself would hesitate to face it.
But you, my grand hero, I think YOU can slay it!
“You want me to kill a Devourer?"
The Devourer! Oh yes, yes! That's the one!
I've heard there is a group looking to summon one for their own nefarious plans. If you can put a stop to their plans, you would more than earn your place among the greatest names in history!
Oh now, no need for the modesty.
I had heard you were making your way into Brimstone, so I rushed right over here to try and find you. And I have! Oh, this is so exciting!
“So how is it you can help me?"
95a_t01_riseofthebeast_obj_proposal_prom: “How do you know who I am?"
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_complete: Have you done it? Have you accomplished the impossible once again?
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_complete_next_: Oh wonderful! Now I just need to get all of these details down so I don't leave anything out. This tale is going to spread all across Aeternum, and one day, maybe even beyond!
Thank you again for all of this! I'll let you know if there's more I need!
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_desc: Phaedra is still writing her epic, and wants to collect more notes to really make her story stand out. She has asked that I once again confront a Devourer and bring her the tales of my fight with it.
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_incomplete: When you slay the beast, remember, come right back to me. Don't spare any detail!
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_proposal_a: Well, not to be TOO particular, but I think the story is... How should I put this… still a bit thin?
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_proposal_b: I need more details! Something more that the reader can really sink their teeth into.
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_proposal_next1: Another fight against the beast should give us what we need! And we're in luck as I have heard the villains from before have returned and are seeking to summon the creature once again!
This is our chance! Both to save Brimstone and to get more tales for my... erm, OUR epic!
95a_t02_riseofthehero_obj_proposal_next_: Don't think I do not appreciate the epic scale of the feat you've accomplished. It's not something just anyone could have done!
But the poem calls for more. It needs to drown the reader with the enormity of the tale, barely letting them come up for breath!

97_combattaunt_isabella_08: Hell hath no fury like me!
97_combattaunt_isabella_11: Now that I have my soul, I have no more need for you.
97_combattaunt_isabella_12: The Tempest will swallow you whole.
97_combattaunt_isabella_13: Meet my slaves. Soon, you will be one of them.
97_combattaunt_isabella_14: I have great plans for you.
97_combattaunt_isabella_15: I will make an example of you.
97_combattaunt_isabella_17: Have you come to worship me? It won't save you.
97_combattaunt_isabella_18: Welcome to the new world order.
97_combattaunt_isabella_19: Hilarious. Like cockroaches storming the gates.
97_combattaunt_isabella_20: I am Isabella. You'll find I am nothing like that fool, Thorpe.
97_combattaunt_isabella_21: I take what I want, and I want everything.
97_combattaunt_isabella_22: You will make an excellent target.
97_combattaunt_isabella_23: Whoever kills them will be rewarded.
97_combattaunt_isabella_26: You deserve a truly pathetic death.
97_combattaunt_isabella_27: It seems you long for death. Such a waste.
97_combattaunt_isabella_30: Do you like my pets? Would you like to be one of them?
97_combattaunt_isabella_35: Beg on your knees for death!
97_combattaunt_isabella_36: I've waited a hundred years for this.
97_combattaunt_thorpe_01: Now, I know the island's secret! Now, I know true power!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_04: I will crush you beneath my heel, ant!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_05: You would have been better off dying at sea!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_06: You can't possibly match the strength Corruption has given me.
97_combattaunt_thorpe_07: Give in to Corruption! It's the only way to keep your soul!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_08: Prepare to have your soul crushed!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_10: You are the past - I am the future!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_14: This will be the last time we meet.
97_combattaunt_thorpe_15: I now serve the Tempest… most willingly.
97_combattaunt_thorpe_16: You cannot possibly challenge us now.
97_combattaunt_thorpe_17: She sent me… to destroy you!
97_combattaunt_thorpe_18: Don't you see? It was her soul all along!
97_entryencounter_isabella_01: And they shall soon witness horrors beyond their comprehension...
97_entryencounter_isabella_02: Beyond what mortal minds were meant to endure…
97_relicreturned_isabella_01: Is all this a dream? If I open the box, is that the way to awaken…?
97_relicreturned_isabella_02: And now the dream is released… only the darkness remains…
97_relicreturned_isabella_03: And that shall be the final price the Champion must pay…
97_relicsighted_isabella_01: On the shores of darkness, they shall find one sliver of light… a box, a very personal box…
9801_0101_pktraceabsorbera_description: A padded case, holding a Psychokinetic Trace Absorber.
9801_0101_pktraceabsorberb_description: A padded case, humming with the energy of an absorbed soul trace.
9801_0102_lostbones_description: A long bone, pried from the body of a Fenwallow Lost.
9801_0102_lostflesh_description: A chunk of mottled flesh, peeled from the body of a Swampwater Lost.
9801_0102_losthairs_description: A greasy hunk of hair, cut from the head of a Fenton Lost.
9801_0103_prayerbeads_description: A strand of simple prayer beads.
9801_florina_02_recruitment_a: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" />The whole enclave is talking about what you've been doing around here!<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> I can't believe we met on the side of a road.
9801_florina_02_recruitment_b: <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />I believe it's time you officially became one of us. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />What do you say?
9801_florina_2_a: <g id="female_youknowS" />Greetings traveler, you have the air of one new to Aeternum,<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> so I pray the fires of hope still burn within your heart.
9801_florina_2_b: <g id="female_worry" />I have taken on a daunting quest to bring aid to the needy… but I am the one now in need of assistance.
9801_florina_3_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I'll return once I have tended to the needs of those stranded here in Oxboro.
9801_florina_3_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I do hope we can meet later, in southeastern Everfall at the enclave. <g id="female_explainS" />My brother is there, and I think you two would get along.
9801_florina_4: <g id="female_sighRelief" />At long last I return from Oxboro. I faltered at Olcott farm. <g id="female_bowHead" />You have my eternal thanks for being there to back me up.
9801_florina_5: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />We are stronger with you by our side.<g id="male_explain" /> Holding this terrace, none of those Lost could get past us! Aeternum is brighter with you out there, helping the humblest souls.
9801_florina_default: <g id="female_lookConcern" />You must be wary in these parts, traveler.<g id="female_explainS" /> The nearby farm has fallen to the Lost. If you value your soul, I would suggest staying safely behind the walls in town.
9801_florina_maxed_a: <g id="female_worry" />I've heard stories, from the battle against Corruption. <g id="male_lookDown" />It's too horrible to believe.
9801_florina_maxed_b: <g id="female_disappointed" />I once thought that I could save everyone. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />But that's not the point, is it? It's about helping who we can. That's all we can do.
9801_florina_vectorquest_a: <g id="female_explainS" />I strongly recommend that you visit the Covenant Enclave yourself. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />There is something inspiring about the place.
9801_florina_vectorquest_b: <g id="female_explainS" />In fact, if you don't mind, it would help me greatly if you could take a message to my brother there, Lethold.
9802_lethold_06_factionquest4_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You have done well in your trials, Lumen, but there remain many troubling questions.
9802_lethold_06_factionquest4_b: <g id="male_hanghead" />Livia Luca has disappeared, and we've had no word from Roose. I fear the worst. She may have gone to Shattered Mountain.
9802_lethold_06pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="male_nodSympathySmall" />You have done well in your trials, Lumen, but there remain many troubling questions.
9802_lethold_06pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="male_hanghead" />Livia Luca has disappeared, and we've had no word from Roose. I fear the worst. She may have gone to Shattered Mountain. [ Level 56 required for "Trial of the Adjudicator" ]
9802_lethold_07_factionquest4_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have done much for the Covenant, Adjudicator. We owe you a great deal for your service.
9802_lethold_07_factionquest4_b: <g id="male_patience" />While the work is at times thankless, the faithful are always rewarded in the end.
9802_lethold_07pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have done much for the Covenant, Adjudicator. We owe you a great deal for your service.
9802_lethold_07pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="male_patience" />While the work is at times thankless, the faithful are always rewarded in the end. \n[Level 63 required for "Trial of the Paladin" Quest]
9802_lethold_08_factionquest5: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />With the fall of First Light, tragedy is at our door again. It is time you prove yourself worthy of being a Paladin of the Covenant.
9802_lethold_08pre_factionquest5: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />With the fall of First Light, tragedy is at our door again. It is time you prove yourself worthy of being a Paladin of the Covenant.
9802_lethold_08pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />With the fall of First Light, tragedy is at our door again.
9802_lethold_08pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="male_fistRaiseLeft" />It is time you prove yourself worthy of being a Paladin of the Covenant.
9802_lethold_09_factionquest5_a: <g id="male_patience" />You have done well to subdue those who would sow dissension in our ranks. And yet still, this troubles me.
9802_lethold_09_factionquest5_b: <g id="male_why" />How could such a trifle inspire such discord? Perhaps this idol will provide us some answers.
9802_lethold_09pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="male_patience" />You have done well to subdue those who would sow dissension in our ranks. And yet still, this troubles me.
9802_lethold_09pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="male_why" />How could such a trifle inspire such discord? Perhaps<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> this idol will provide us some answers.\n[Level 63 required for "Trial of the Paladin" Quest]
9802_lethold_2_a: <g id="male_explain" />If you have come with hopeful dreams of enlisting with the Covenant yourself, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />it's only fair you know what you're getting into.
9802_lethold_2_b: <g id="male_shakehead" />A wraith stalks the lands, and some Initiates gave into fear and are now in even greater peril.
9802_lethold_3: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />I've faced down all manner of darkness in my service to the Covenant. But when such darkness comes from within our ranks, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />it wounds me more than any blade ever could.
9802_lethold_4_a: <g id="male_fistRaiseLeft" />Together, we have seen justice done, terror and despair purged from within our own ranks.
9802_lethold_4_b: <g id="male_convince02" />I do hope you will consider committing your skills and courage to the Covenant. You belong with us, friend.
9802_lethold_5: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We must remain vigilant, always. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You and I both know only too well, evil can emerge anywhere, even from within our own ranks.
9802_lethold_default: <g id="male_explain" />If you need shelter, the Covenant Enclave is open to you, as long as you observe our rules.<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> Any news from Oxboro? I'm awaiting the return of an Initiate named Florina.
9802_lethold_maxed_a: <g id="female_bowHead" />I have learned much from you in your time here.
9802_lethold_maxed_b: <g id="female_explainS" />To protect others, we must do so much more than simply keeping them from harm. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Thank you, for leading by example.
9802_lethold_vectorquest_a: <g id="male_explain" />Lumen Morellus would speak with you. She can seem strange, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />but she is one of the most respected members of the order.
9802_lethold_vectorquest_b: <g id="male_explain" />She was my mentor, and I suggest you give great consideration to her words,<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> for she is inspired.
9803_morellus_2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Be assured, you are under no pressure to join the Covenant, <g id="female_salute2finger" />but you have provided us with a strong case concerning your worthiness.
9803_morellus_2_b: <g id="female_youknow" />I must ask, however, if you can help me with another matter, <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />	one requiring some discretion.
9803_morellus_3: <g id="female_sighRelief" />You have recovered the relic from Invectus? Go now, don't say a word. Simply cast it into the pyre.
9803_morellus_4_a: <g id="male_nodProud" />You have proven yourself to be faithful and courageous,<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> an inspiration for any whose souls are in peril.
9803_morellus_4_b: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />I hope you will consider joining our order, swearing your allegiance to the Covenant.
9803_morellus_5_a: <g id="female_thinking" />We must understand the nature of this Corruption and its dark purpose.
9803_morellus_5_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />The shadow clouding these lands feels… <g id="male_headShakeNo" />strangely orchestrated. <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />	Focus, follow the threads, trust your heart and your Covenant brethren.
9803_morellus_default_a: <g id="female_beckon" />You are welcome in the Covenant Hall, visitor. <g id="female_explainS" />We keep our gates open at all hours to ensure those in despair or doubt can find the sanctuary they need.
9803_morellus_default_b: <g id="male_explain" />Remember, it only takes a Spark of hope to ignite the flames of inspiration.
9803_morellus_maxed_a: <g id="female_nodding" />If it comes to it, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I will stand stalwartly by you and hold this keep until they’ve ground the last brick to dust.
9803_morellus_maxed_b: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />In this era of unprecedented darkness, <g id="female_salute2finger" />you are a beacon of hope and inspiration.
9804_feldan_2: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />If you hope to convince me to leave empty-handed,<g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" /> you're wasting your breath. Recover at least some of our family's things… then I will go with you.
9804_feldan_3_a: <g id="male_sighRelief" />Well now, I was having doubts, but here you are, just as you promised. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />This… means a lot.
9804_feldan_3_b: <g id="male_convince01" />Covenant Initiate Florina returned to Oxboro…<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> discouraged. Perhaps you should speak with her.
9804_feldan_default_a: <g id="male_hopeless" />Decades, nearly a century we worked this land, only to have it fall to the Lost.
9804_feldan_default_b: <g id="male_hopeless" />My family took refuge in town, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />but we have nothing beyond the clothes we wore when we fled.
9805_tibbs_00_01_a: <g id="male_laughCocky" />Slide on over, friend! You look like one of them Marauder types. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Like adventure? Maybe a bit of a scrap, aye? How about weapons and riches?
9805_tibbs_00_01_b: <g id="male_headNodYes" />How’d you like a little tip from ol’ Tibbs?<g id="male_beckonUrgent" /> I’ve got something perfect for a new arrival.
9805_tibbs_00_default: <g id="male_laughCocky" />Hey! Aren't you a little young to be in here? Don't get touchy, just a wee bit of Aeternum humor for ya! And fear not mate, I'm as discreet as a privy guard!
9805_tibbs_01_talkto_a: <g id="male_concerns" />Oh-ho, that looks like a bag of ears to me! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />You can… leave that there. Now show us the ring… <g id="female_salute2finger" />Well done!
9805_tibbs_01_talkto_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You’ve got a strong stomach and bravado! I got an eye for it, I do. Climb the steps, and talk to Gladiator Strou'dahia.
9805_tibbs_02_01_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Look, I like you mate! <g id="female_headnodding" />And I know what Strou'dahia has cooking for the new recruits.
9805_tibbs_02_01_b: <g id="male_nod1" />And if you're keen, <g id="female_smackfist" />you could start off with a bang! Short trip, <g id="female_shrugShort" />little warmup, eh? Better loot than Lugdunum to boot.
9805_tibbs_02_02_a: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Well done! Well done indeed! <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />No doubt the fancy folk down in Everfall are all abuzz about that last escapade, my friend.
9805_tibbs_02_02_b: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Reckon I'll be telling that story for an…<g id="male_laughBig" /> Aeternity. Eh? Eh?
9805_tibbs_02_03: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Did I not say it from the start? I knew you would like it here, mate. <g id="male_nod1" />And always getting stronger, aint'cha? <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I look forward to the mayhem we'll bring.
9805_tibbs_02_default_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />We got ourselves a little quid pro quo with Everfall, keeping the Lost out of the hills and off their doorstep.
9805_tibbs_02_default_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Earns a drink or two. Next one is on Tibbs' tab, eh? <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Good luck out there!
9805_tibbs_02_vectorquest_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've made it this far, mate, and I can tell you'll fit right in.
9805_tibbs_02_vectorquest_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Strou'dahia wants to test your mettle if you're gonna join us. <g id="female_explainS" />	Swing some steel, blow those bombs, it'll be over in a flash. Recruitment procedures you see.
9805_tibbs_04_factionquest3_a: <g id="male_rememberBig" />A ways back, there was a Marauder by the name of Florent. He was all that the Marauders should be. He was the best of us.
9805_tibbs_04_factionquest3_b: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />But unfortunately even the best of us are still susceptible to Corruption.
9805_tibbs_04_post_factionquest1_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I see you managed to pull it off, well done. I would still remain vigilant against Silas.
9805_tibbs_04_post_factionquest1_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Now that I think on it, I think Silas had lost a bet a long while back against Lawrence and his gang. Maybe that's why she sent you.
9805_tibbs_04pre_factionquest3_a: <g id="male_rememberBig" />A ways back, there was a Marauder by the name of Florent. He was all that the Marauders should be. He was the best of us.
9805_tibbs_04pre_factionquest3_b: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />But unfortunately even the best of us are still susceptible to Corruption.\n[ Level 56 required for the "Trial of the Commander" Quest ]
9805_tibbs_05_factionquest3_a: <g id="male_nod1" />You did what was right, and that is all I can ask of you. Thank you, friend.
9805_tibbs_05_factionquest3_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />What you did means more than you could know. And as for Silas, well-- she'll get what's coming to her.
9805_tibbs_05_post_factionquest2_a: <g id="male_nod1" />You did more than was expected, though it's unfortunate that your trials have been turned upside down by Silas's sloppy work.
9805_tibbs_05_post_factionquest2_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Sending you to take on those beasts was a lot to ask. She seems to have it out for you, but why?
9805_tibbs_98_q04_postquest_a: <g id="male_nod1" />You did good. It was a tough job dealing with Silas. It was a difficult ask, but you handled it well. You deserve the title of Commander.
9805_tibbs_98_q04_postquest_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />And thanks for getting that amulet back. It means a lot to me.
9805_tibbs_98_q05_postquest_a: <g id="male_cheerbothhands" />Proud to call you a Champion of the Marauders. Brings a tear to my eye knowing I had you gathering ears way back. But see now, it all worked out, didn't it?
9805_tibbs_98_q05_postquest_b: <g id="male_nod1" />I like to think I taught you humility.
9805_tibbs_maxed_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Quite the journey since you first got here. Never could have seen how far you would go. <g id="female_chuckle" />And you, you were mad at me over a few ears!
9805_tibbs_maxed_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />And look at us now! Always got your back, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />friend, through thick and thin.
9806_stroudahia_00_01_a: <g id="male_explain" />When the Varangians first snuck up the cliffs and took Stonekeep, I thought them worthy opponents. <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Now they attack those weaker than them and forfeit any honor.
9806_stroudahia_00_01_b: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />What about you? Would you bleed for the Marauders' cause?
9806_stroudahia_00_02_a: <g id="male_nod1" />You have proven yourself a valiant warrior, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />and have friends here for what you have done.
9806_stroudahia_00_02_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Eternity is a long time. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Consider spending it with us. There will never be a dull moment.
9806_stroudahia_00_03_a: <g id="female_explainS" />The challenges you face in these lands will mold you. <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Forge yourself intently, young one.
9806_stroudahia_00_03_b: Stand strong<g id="female_headnodding" /> alongside your friends. Make your enemies fear your might.
9806_stroudahia_00_default: <g id="female_order" />Walk the grounds and watch. Warriors must train every day, especially on Aeternum. <g id="female_explainS" />If you want to keep up, you will have to prove yourself and challenge your limits.
9806_stroudahia_00_recruitment: <g id="male_waghand02" />The Syndicate. The Covenant. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Neither suit a combatant of your temperament. <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Join our ranks and become a warrior of legend in these eternal lands.
9806_stroudahia_00_talkto_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Tibbs spoke of you. He's odd, but fearless. <g id="male_explain" />He has a unique notion of what constitutes honor, but he's a sharp fighter, keeps his enemies off-guard.
9806_stroudahia_00_talkto_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Individual freedom is as important to a Marauder as honor and glory.
9806_stroudahia_00_talkto_topic_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />We Marauders are a band of warriors united, seeking glory and honor in battle.
9806_stroudahia_00_talkto_topic_b: <g id="male_explain" />If you have the spine to stand with us, we may help you to know yourself, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />both your potential and your limitations. Tibbs is your guide, for now.
9806_stroudahia_04_factionquest4: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Silas was a leader of the Marauders. But she has failed. She has failed not only us, but herself and given into the Corruption. A path no one can return from.
9806_stroudahia_04pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Silas was a leader of the Marauders. But she has failed. She has failed not only us, but herself. And now<g id="female_headnodding" /> she has given into the Corruption. A path no one can return from.\n[ Level 56 required for the "Trial of the Commander" Quest ]
9806_stroudahia_04pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />And now she has given into the Corruption. A path no one can return from.\n[ Level 56 required for the "Trial of the Commander" Quest ]
9806_stroudahia_05_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_nodConsider" />You did well, dealing with Silas. She was a Marauder, but a lesson as well to us all, what might happen when we tread too close to the power that lies in anger.
9806_stroudahia_05_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />And what happens when you refuse to let go of your grudges.
9806_stroudahia_05pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />You did well, dealing with Silas. She was a Marauder, but a lesson as well to us all, what might happen when we tread too close to the power that lies in anger.
9806_stroudahia_05pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_nodConsider" />And what happens when you refuse to let go of your grudges.\n[ Level 63 required for the "Trial of the Champion" Quest ]
9806_stroudahia_06_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I have seen you rise through the ranks as a Marauder. It is no easy feat, but I know you are not one to rest on your laurels, yes?
9806_stroudahia_06_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Because a Marauder is always hungry to prove themselves.
9806_stroudahia_06pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I have seen you rise through the ranks as a Marauder. It is no easy feat, but I know you are not one to rest on your laurels, yes?
9806_stroudahia_06pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Because a Marauder is always hungry to prove themselves.
9806_stroudahia_07_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_order" />You are truly a Champion of the Marauders. What you have done will be remembered since time immemorial.
9806_stroudahia_07_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_order" />Celebrate your victories, Champion. But remember, no great leader will rest on their laurels.
9806_stroudahia_07pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_order" />You are truly a Champion of the Marauders. What you have done will be remembered since time immemorial.
9806_stroudahia_07pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_order" />Celebrate your victories, Champion. But remember, no great leader will rest on their laurels.\n[Level 63 required for "Trial of the Champion" Quest]
9806_stroudahia_maxed_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />You have shaped yourself into a mighty warrior.
9806_stroudahia_maxed_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Never forget, we are both the iron and the blacksmith, and the act of forging ourselves is never ending. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Hold firm in your mind what you must become.
9807_aventus_00_01_a: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Please, please, come! You look well-equipped, <g id="male_explain" />and the Syndicate could pay you for your time.
9807_aventus_00_01_b: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />I see that you are new to the island? <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Aid me, and perhaps I can shine some light on the darkness.
9807_aventus_00_default: Mind your step. <g id="male_gestureAhead" />There are some unnatural beasts in the area. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />You should return to the safety of the walls. Everfall has been more dangerous as of late.
9807_aventus_01_01_a: <g id="female_explainS" />Azoth… the mysterious element that runs deep in this land. <g id="male_patience" />It is like nothing I ever experienced in the Old World. Its potential applications are vast.
9807_aventus_01_01_b: <g id="male_gestureHereweare" />Our very enclave itself is built near something quite special.
9807_aventus_01_02: <g id="male_nodProud" />We return to the Tree often. <g id="female_bowHead" />Thank you for not disturbing the Angry Earth. Our trips are easier when they are less agitated.
9807_aventus_01_02_failed: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />It is a shame you had to engage the Angry Earth. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I would not expect you to lay down and die, but it will be a tougher journey for some time. Pity.
9807_aventus_01_03_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Poor, poor Cleo always has something new on her mind. <g id="male_lookDown" />Discovery has hidden costs, and hers weigh heavily on her heart.
9807_aventus_01_03_b: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Thank you for helping her. She could use a friend.
9807_aventus_01_04: <g id="male_smile" />Let us uncover wonderful new mysteries together. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I am happy to call you a colleague, and hopefully, in time, a good friend.
9807_aventus_01_talkto_a: <g id="male_goodnews" />Thank you for helping to resolve those, ah, unexpected consequences. We do important work here, studying Azoth's applications. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />But it is not without risks.
9807_aventus_01_talkto_b: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Please, come in. If you would, introduce yourself to Cleo.
9807_aventus_01_vectorquest: <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />Cleo has already requested a word, if you came back in one piece. I see within you the same potential. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Please, go and speak with her.
9807_aventus_maxed_a: <g id="male_nodProud" />This sanctum might not be here, if not for your efforts across Aeternum.
9807_aventus_maxed_b: <g id="male_nodProud" />It may be hard to see at times, but even the tiniest actions help in the face of untold suffering. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Thank you, friend!
9808_cleo_00_02_a: The impermanence<g id="female_headnodding" /> of death presents a peculiar conundrum when dealing with our adversaries.
9808_cleo_00_02_b: <g id="female_thinking" />Let me ask you, how do you kill that which has no life? Well, we of the Syndicate aim to solve that.
9808_cleo_00_03_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I will return in time, to observe the effects of the sleeping draught and take samples.
9808_cleo_00_03_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Thank you for trusting in my experiment and aiding me. Maybe one day, we can save the Lost instead of pacifying them.
9808_cleo_00_04_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You are a curious sort, perhaps the precise catalyst the Syndicate needs.
9808_cleo_00_04_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />One day, you will have to tell me what transpired on that beach. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />I've heard rumors, but nothing beats an eyewitness.
9808_cleo_00_05_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />You are an invaluable asset to our cause. I will not let the work you've done with Krockes go unnoticed. Yet I fear he has gone too far.
9808_cleo_00_05_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Some lessons can become cautionary tales, it seems…
9808_cleo_00_05pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />You are an invaluable asset to our cause. I will not let the work you've done with Krockes go unnoticed. Yet I fear he has gone too far.
9808_cleo_00_05pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Some lessons can become cautionary tales, it seems...\n[ Level 56 required for "Trial of the Alchemist"]
9808_cleo_00_06_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_explainS" />While the truth might not always be easy to find, the line between madness and brilliance can at times be even more difficult to discern.
9808_cleo_00_06_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_nodYes" />I know you have learned this lesson well.
9808_cleo_00_06pre_factionquest4_a: <g id="female_explainS" />While the truth might not always be easy to find, the line between madness and brilliance can at times be even more difficult to discern.
9808_cleo_00_06pre_factionquest4_b: <g id="female_nodYes" />I know you have learned this lesson well.\n[ Level 56 required for "Trial of the Alchemist"]
9808_cleo_00_07_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />While the tragedy of First Light's fall is not lost on me, there remains much to discover within these new lands.
9808_cleo_00_07_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Ancient secrets of such potency haven't been seen since Brimstone.
9808_cleo_00_07pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />While the tragedy of First Light's fall is not lost on me, there remains much to discover within these new lands.
9808_cleo_00_07pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Ancient secrets of such potency haven't been seen since Brimstone.
9808_cleo_00_08_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Ah, our newest Magus. It makes me proud to see you achieve your potential, after having done so much work for our cause.
9808_cleo_00_08_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_youknow" />I am quite certain these ancient relics will prove invaluable to the Syndicate.
9808_cleo_00_08pre_factionquest5_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Ah, our newest Magus. It makes me proud to see you achieve your potential, after having done so much work for our cause.
9808_cleo_00_08pre_factionquest5_b: <g id="female_youknow" />I am quite certain these ancient relics will prove invaluable to the Syndicate.\n[ Level 63 required for "Trial of the Magus" ]
9808_cleo_00_default: <g id="female_impatient" />Please, if you wouldn't mind standing aside. I have many problems to unravel. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />The Scriveners are always thrilled to challenge hopeful initiates, if you are looking for work.
9808_cleo_00_recruitment_a: <g id="female_explainS" />The Syndicate is an eclectic group, one that would be honored to have you listed amongst our ranks.
9808_cleo_00_recruitment_b: <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Please, if you wish to join us in the pursuit of unraveling the mysteries of Aeternum, the time is now.
9808_cleo_00_talkto_a: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Acquaintance of Aventus? His enthusiasm for research is admirable, <g id="male_explain" />but it creates complications from time to time.
9808_cleo_00_talkto_b: <g id="female_explainS" />He must make friends regularly. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />The Syndicate values those who help him uncomplicate his results.
9808_cleo_00_talkto_topic_a: <g id="female_explainS" />The Syndicate: scholars, arcanists, inventors, explorers of every kind.
9808_cleo_00_talkto_topic_b: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />This land suits the intellectually curious. Those who can handle a measure of danger, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />doubly so. You are welcome here. Return to Aventus.
9808_cleo_maxed_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />You have proven yourself an exemplary agent of the Syndicate, time and time again.
9808_cleo_maxed_b: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" />If you had been with me in the ruins of Brimstone… <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />things might have been different.
9810_alejandro_01: Don't get too close there, friend. The paint isn't quite dry yet, and I'd hate to stain my hands with your blood.
9810_alejandro_default: No... something isn't right…  Why can't I remember what his face looked like?
9811_gregario_01: How goes the hunt? What wickedness have you put to rest?
9811_gregario_default: A potential Initiate? If you value strength, listen well. Don't strike out at whatever suits you in the moment. True power comes from giving that strength a purpose.
9812_peta_01: Good to see you again, hon. I mainly keep this kitchen running for outsiders, but you can still help yourself any time.
9812_peta_default: Feel free to grab some soup, hon. It gets mighty chilly up here and you'll need something to keep warm.
9813_damiano_01: I knew someone like you could not resist our noble cause. The land of Aeternum will be made brighter by your strength. Stay resolute!
9813_damiano_default_a: You have my deepest appreciation for saving me from that foul crypt.
9813_damiano_default_b: The more we learn about Corruption, the more I understand the things I saw in that cave. What I could have become…
9813_damiano_rescue: Praise the light! My hope was fading fast! I can make it back to the Enclave now!
9814_repbeyza_01_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Based on what I've heard from Adjudicator Lethold and Lumen Morellus, your courage is incontestable.
9814_repbeyza_01_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />If you are ready to swear your allegiance to the Covenant, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />we would welcome you into the Order.
9814_repbeyza_02_a: <g id="male_explain" />Now that you have joined our righteous ranks, you'll find we have ample opportunity for spreading the light.
9814_repbeyza_02_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Missions are always available here and anywhere on Aeternum where our banner flies. I have Covenant gear, as well.
9814_repbeyza_03: <g id="female_headnodding" />We'll use all the aid we can get. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Or, perhaps you would enlist in an even greater conflict?
9814_repbeyza_cooldownmultiple: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you at this time.
9814_repbeyza_cooldownsingle: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you for one more day.
9814_repbeyza_default_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Welcome to the Covenant Enclave. It's a pleasure, but you haven't arrived at the best time...
9814_repbeyza_default_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />If you are inclined to join the Covenant, you will need to prove yourself worthy first.
9816_pavel_01: Aye, welcome back and indeed welcome to the crew. There'll be enough stew to feed an army, help yourself any time.
9816_pavel_default: Scram! Food's for Marauders only. If you want to be fed around here, you gotta earn it.
9817_mersha_01: Keep lifting, trainee. Don't let "good enough" be good enough.
9817_mersha_default: You are new here, yes? Stick around and maybe you learn how to lift.
9818_doc_01_a: As a fellow Marauder, I am required to tell you that I may render first aid upon request. I am not required to tell you how much it will hurt.
9818_doc_01_b: Don't forget you come back when you die…
9818_doc_default: Not sick, are you? I don't have the time to treat outsiders unless you need something amputated. Always have time for that.
9819_hedge_01: They still let me join, even after getting stuck. Perks of being friends with the rep, I suppose. I better pay attention and practice.
9819_hedge_02: Once I finish my training, we are going to absolutely SMASH!
9819_hedge_default: Never want to be stuck in a box again. Never thought it could happen to me. One bonk to the head, and BAM! Thanks again for the spring!
9819_hedge_rescue: I'm getting out of here before they shove me back in!
9820_repsmiggs_01_a: From the first, we knew you were one of us. It's in the way you carry yourself, you see?
9820_repsmiggs_01_b: Strou'dahia has vouched for your valor, so it's time. Pledge our oaths and join our ranks, the choice is yours.
9820_repsmiggs_02_a: Hail, warrior! You are a credit to our ranks.
9820_repsmiggs_02_b: Do you seek more glory? Look no further. Missions are available here and anywhere else our banner flies. I also have arms and armor, if you need.
9820_repsmiggs_03: Aye, looking strong. Which noble cause draws you? Or, perhaps you seek assignment to even greater conflict?
9820_repsmiggs_cooldownmultiple: I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you at this time.
9820_repsmiggs_cooldownsingle: I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you for one more day.
9820_repsmiggs_default: If you would like to join our crew, you will first need to make your plea to Strou'dahia. You will be challenged, so be prepared.
9822_abayomi_01: You're back. She said you'd be back.
9822_abayomi_default: Ah, you have that look about you. Does she speak to you as well? I hear the whispers of Aeternum. Not all are as blessed as we.
9823_amelia_01: People call me a scoundrel, but I haven't been this happy in ages. Do you know anyone that needs their pockets picked? A temple scouted? A house robbed? Give me a holler!
9823_amelia_default_a: When you've been around as long as I have, you start to wonder about the places you aren't supposed to be, the things you aren't supposed to see.
9823_amelia_default_b: What better place for that special wonder than the Syndicate!
9824_kuro_01: You're looking thirsty. Could I interest you in the latest homebrew? I'm getting few reports of ill effects this time!
9824_kuro_default: A newcomer! Care for a drink? I don't get many volunteers these days…
9825_pop_01: Aye, I am glad you joined us. Never forget the way you reacted when I fired that one round!
9825_pop_default: How did she get that nickname, they think. Then, BANG! It hits them.
9826_repastrid_01_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Aventus came over here six times, to tell me about you and the wolves. Six. Times.
9826_repastrid_01_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />I only needed the letter from Cleo. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Should you wish to join us, it is but a pen stroke away.
9826_repastrid_02_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Well then, another fox finds the den. <g id="female_bowHead" />I expect to see your name on many papers these days.
9826_repastrid_02_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Care to bolster that reputation of yours some more? <g id="male_explain" />I also have equipment available, should you find the need.
9826_repastrid_03: <g id="female_headnodding" />Everything is in motion now. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I need a fixer, and that means you. Or, perhaps you seek assignment to even greater conflict?
9826_repastrid_cooldownmultiple: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you at this time.
9826_repastrid_cooldownsingle: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I'd ask you to reconsider your faction alignment. We cannot recruit you for one more day.
9826_repastrid_default: <g id="male_explain" />Should you wish to stalk about here freely, you must get approved by Cabalist Elsayad first. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />This is a sanctum, after all.
98_c_0001_completetrial_templar: Complete the Trial of the Templar at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 25)
98_c_0001_completetrial_templar_v2: Speak with Beatris Roose and Complete the Trial of the Templar at the Enclave

98_c_0001_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Templar and then complete the Trial of the Templar quest from Beatris Roose at the Covenant Enclave.
98_c_0001_rankup_factionhandoff: Complete missions from the Faction Board, then report to the local Magistrate
98_c_0001_rankup_factionhandoff_v2: Complete missions from the Faction Board, then report to the local Magistrate
98_c_0102_completetrial_excubitor: Complete the Trial of the Excubitor in Weaver's Fen (Rec. Level: 35)
98_c_0102_completetrial_excubitor_v2: Complete the Trial of the Excubitor at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 35)
98_c_0102_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Excubitor and then complete the Trial of the Excubitor Quest from the Faction Representative in Weaver's Fen.
98_c_0102_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Excubitor and then complete the Trial of the Excubitor quest from Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave.
98_c_01_theapostate_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_notsure" />These pages are from my son you say? <g id="male_lookawayGuilty" priority="high" />Well… thank you for retrieving his last testament, Templar. Unfortunately, our leadership's judgment is final.
98_c_01_theapostate_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />It seems there is quite a bit I must make sense of.
98_c_01_theapostate_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_beckon" />Ah, you have returned! I have taken over the Trial. Adjudicator Roose is otherwise occupied.
98_c_01_theapostate_complete_v2_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I am Livia Luca, Covenant Adjudicator. If that name sounds familiar it is because I am the mother of Bremen Luca.
98_c_01_theapostate_description: Track down the missing Covenant Initiate Bremen Luca and attempt to discover what happened to him to advance to the rank of Templar. Talk to Templar Roose in the Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_01_theapostate_description_v2: Track down the Apostate Covenant Initiate Bremen Luca and attempt to discover what happened to him to advance to the rank of Templar. Talk to Templar Roose at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_01_theapostate_goto_poi: Track down Covenant Initiate Luca in {POITags} to Earn Rank of Templar
98_c_01_theapostate_goto_poi_v2: Track down Apostate Luca in {POITags} to Earn Rank of Templar
98_c_01_theapostate_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Find the Apostate and offer him his final rest. May he at last find peace, at least for some time.
98_c_01_theapostate_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Yes, it's grim business to be certain, yet we must complete it with dignity. <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />He was of our number and though he became Lost, we shall remember him.
98_c_01_theapostate_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />If you can, bring back any tokens or memories for his next of kin.
98_c_01_theapostate_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />An Initiate, like yourself, has asked some uncomfortable questions. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />A few that, I'm afraid, we cannot allow.
98_c_01_theapostate_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />He was named an Apostate, and it seems<g id="female_sympathyHandsheart" /> in his despair that he's fallen Lost. We must lay him to his final rest.
98_c_01_theapostate_start_prompt_v2: "I am ready. What do I do?"
98_c_01b_fenredemption_complete_next_v2_: <g id="female_thinking" />There must be someone responsible, but who? <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I apologize that this is not your normal trial you were expecting. But rest assured that you are an Excubitor now.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Well done, and we will talk more soon I expect.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_thinking" />You found this page? And… prayer beads? These are beads of the Covenant. That must mean these were once Covenant members.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I'm afraid this has much darker implications than I originally thought.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_description: Put to rest some of those who've fallen in Weaver's Fen to advance to the rank of Excubitor. Talk to Adjudicator Sheng in Weaver's Fen when the task is complete.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_description_v2: Find the second page of the journal of Bremen Luca to advance to the rank of Excubitor. Talk to Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_goto_poi_v2: Track down Bremen Luca's journal in {POITags} to Earn Rank of Excubitor
98_c_01b_fenredemption_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_order" />Travel the Fen and find what my son was investigating. <g id="male_patience" />Then I will grant you the rank of Excubitor. Remember, we must not tell the others.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_proposal_next_v2_: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />No, unfortunately I don’t know who is responsible for condemning Bremen. This will be your next trial. <g id="female_order" />Go to Weaver's Fen and find my son's journal.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Bring back any other evidence you find. And please, keep this between us.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_worry" />Something of grave concern. My son was named an Apostate, yet he was not the only one excommunicated from the Covenant.
98_c_01b_fenredemption_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I fear this runs deeper than I thought. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />I believe that there was a conspiracy against my son.
98_c_0203_completetrial_lumen: Complete the Trial of the Lumen in Great Cleave (Rec. Level: 49)
98_c_0203_completetrial_lumen_v2: Complete the Trial of the Lumen at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 49)
98_c_0203_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Lumen and then complete the Trial of the Lumen Quest from the Faction Representative in Great Cleave.
98_c_0203_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Lumen and then complete the Trial of the Lumen quest from Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have helped make things right. <g id="female_bowHead" />I'd expect nothing less from a Lumen of the Covenant.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />I will resolve to find out who was responsible for this, and ensure it never happens again. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Thank you, Lumen, you are dismissed.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />This was when he made a discovery about some of the leaders, then. <g id="male_rememberBig" />He uncovered the fallen of the Covenant, and they punished him for seeking the truth.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_thinking" />It all started with this Templar Ambrose, his fall started Bremen's path.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_description: Recover Prayer Beads from Corrupted Templars to earn the rank of Lumen. Talk to Excubitor Luca in Great Cleave when the task is done.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_description_v2: Find Bremen Luca's journal at Hollowing Fort and recover Prayer Beads from Corrupted Templars to earn the rank of Lumen. Talk to Adjudicator Luca at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_goto_poi_v2: Travel to Ostrog Pike in Great Cleave and find Bremen Luca's journal
98_c_02_soulsalvation_incomplete_v2_a: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Your help has been invaluable to me, and to the entire Covenant.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_incomplete_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />We will uncover the truth, and your valor will be recognized. But first, we must find the evidence.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I suspect he may have more of my son's writings, almost as if Bremen was leaving us a trail.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />And bring back more prayer beads as proof Templar Ambrose has fallen to Corruption. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I believe we are close to the answers we seek.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I have continued piecing together the fragments of my son's journals. He mentioned someone called Templar Ambrose who went to Great Cleave.
98_c_02_soulsalvation_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />I don’t know him, but I need you to find out more. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />With him lies the answers.
98_c_0304_completetrial_adjudicator: Complete the Trial of the Adjudicator in Shattered Mountain (Rec. Level: 60)
98_c_0304_completetrial_adjudicator_v2: Complete the Trial of the Adjudicator at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 60)
98_c_0304_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Adjudicator and then complete the Trial of the Adjudicator Quest from the Faction Representative in Shattered Mountain.
98_c_0304_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Adjudicator and then complete the Trial of the Adjudicator quest from the Lethold at the Covenant Enclave.
98_c_03_0209_adjudicator_98_talkto_promp: "I cleared the way to the Enclave."
98_c_03_0209_adjudicator_98_talkto_topic: <g id="female_headnodding" />Very well, I will see you back at the Enclave.
98_c_03_0209_adjudicator_98_talkto_v2: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />You've seen how she turned on us. She's fallen to the Corruption.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_complete_next_: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />She and her son were members of the Covenant. <g id="male_explain" />We will address this vendetta against Bremen with those who conspired against him.
<g id="male_nodSympathySmall" />He was an exemplar of good, a lesson to us all. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Now we must strive to save those who are left.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_complete_v2: <g id="male_handheart" />It's done, then? Perhaps she will find peace in death. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />And I see that Adjudicator Roose has returned. You have done what has been asked of you and more.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_description: Destroy the Corrupted Excubitor Luca to earn the rank of Adjudicator. Talk to Adjudicator Maras in Shattered Mountain when the task is complete.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_description_v2: Lay Corrupted Adjudicator Luca to rest and find Adjudicator Roose to earn the rank of Adjudicator. Talk to Lethold at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_findluca_v2: Confront Corrupted Adjudicator Luca and rescue Adjudicator Roose
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_goto_poi: Descend into {POITags} and confront Excubitor Luca to Earn the Rank of Adjudicator.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_goto_poi_v2: Descend into {POITags} and confront Adjudicator Luca and rescue Adjudicator Roose to Earn the Rank of Adjudicator.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_incomplete_v2: <g id="male_handheart" />I shudder to think Luca might have fallen, but we must do what is necessary for the Covenant. <g id="female_smackfist" />May justice be swift for those who turn to Corruption.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_proposal_next_: <g id="male_handheart" />Indeed. She is... was... a member of the Covenant. <g id="male_lookDown" />But our justice must be swift if she has turned.
<g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />And if Adjudicator Roose is with her, we need to ensure her safety. This will be your next trial. <g id="female_order" />See that it is done.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />Our scouts report that she has turned to the Corruption. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />If that is the case, she must be dealt with, and it may mean that Adjudicator Roose is in peril as well.
98_c_03_thepathtodarkness_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />This is no mean task, but... you must track down Luca.
98_c_0405_completetrial_paragon_v2: Complete the Trial of the Paladin at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 65)
98_c_0405_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Paladin and then complete the Trial of the Paladin quest from the Lethold at the Covenant Enclave.
98_c_04_justforinjust_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />I am concerned what this means for the future of that settlement, but I am grateful that we have answers.
98_c_04_justforinjust_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="male_fistRaiseLeft" />You have shown true mettle in the face of danger in the Elysian Wilds. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You are a true Paladin of the Covenant.
98_c_04_justforinjust_complete_v2: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />What have you found out about the settlement in Old First Light? Who was this Simon Jeffrey and Rotgut?
98_c_04_justforinjust_defeatangryearth_t: Defeat the Covenant Traitor and take the idol
98_c_04_justforinjust_description_v2: Find and defeat the Covenant Traitor in the Elysian Wilds to earn the rank of Paladin. Talk to Lethold at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
98_c_04_justforinjust_get_lore_page1_v2: Find the journal of the Covenant Traitor
98_c_04_justforinjust_get_lore_page2_v2: Find the second journal page of the Covenant Traitor
98_c_04_justforinjust_goto_poi_v2: Travel to {POITags} and confront the Covenant Traitor to Earn the Rank of Paladin.
98_c_04_justforinjust_incomplete_v2: <g id="male_patience" />Be on your guard out in the Elysian Wilds. <g id="male_explain" />Much has changed out there and some truly formidable enemies now prowl the wildlands. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Keep a sharp eye.
98_c_04_justforinjust_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I have a letter from someone by the name of Simon Jeffrey who says he was assisting the Covenant's cause there with someone named Rotgut.
98_c_04_justforinjust_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Travel there, find out what you can, and return with any evidence you can gather.
98_c_04_justforinjust_proposal_prompt_v2: "What do you need me to do?"
98_c_04_justforinjust_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Yes. There are many things we do not know, <g id="male_explain" />but what is certain is that we have no communication with those left at Old First Light.
98_c_04_justforinjust_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_shakehead" />I fear the worst has happened.
98_c_q5_talisman_description: An idol of unknown origin from which a powerful aura emanates.
98_c_raidmonarch_interact_factionmission: Enter {POITags} and cleanse all the Lost Crystals on the island.
98_c_reach_nextcovenantrank: Earn Faction Reputation to face the Trial for your next Rank
98_c_reach_nextcovenantrank_v2: Earn Faction Reputation to face the Trial for your next Rank
98_isabella_covenant: Their belief in justice is not misplaced. But we must forge our own justice... Lead. Shepherd. Step into my embrace. Let us protect Aeternum together.
98_isabella_covenant_a: Their belief in justice is not misplaced. But we must forge our own justice... Lead. Shepherd.
98_isabella_covenant_b: Step into my embrace. Let us protect Aeternum together.
98_isabella_marauder: This band of warriors could do well, if they seized their true potential. Treasure, wealth, power - all things you could offer, if you would join us…
98_isabella_marauder_a: This band of warriors could do well, if they seized their true potential.
98_isabella_marauder_b: Treasure, wealth, power - all things you could offer, if you would join us…
98_isabella_syndicate: Do you endeavor to understand these worlds? Your potential? You think you've seen much with the Syndicate. I will show you so much more…
98_isabella_syndicate_a: Do you endeavor to understand these worlds? Your potential?
98_isabella_syndicate_b: You think you've seen much with the Syndicate. I will show you so much more…
98_m_0001_completetrial_gladiator: Complete the Trial of the Gladiator at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 25)
98_m_0001_completetrial_gladiator_v2: Speak to Winifred Silas and Complete the Trial of the Gladiator at the Enclave
98_m_0001_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Gladiator and then complete the Trial of the Gladiator Quest from the Enclave.
98_m_0001_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Gladiator and then complete the Trial of the Gladiator quest from the Enclave.
98_m_0001_rankup_factionhandoff: Complete missions from the Faction Board, then report to the local Magistrate
98_m_0001_rankup_factionhandoff_v2: Complete missions from the Faction Board, then report to the local magistrate
98_m_0102_completetrial_ravager: Complete the Trial of the Ravager in Weaver's Fen (Rec. Level: 35)
98_m_0102_completetrial_ravager_v2: Complete the Trial of the Ravager at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 35)
98_m_0102_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Ravager and then complete the Trial of the Ravager Quest from the Faction Representative in Weaver's Fen.
98_m_0102_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Ravager and then complete the Trial of the Ravager quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.
98_m_01_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_prompt_v2: "I need to check Broken Hull Hold."
98_m_01_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_topic_v2: <g id="male_rememberbig" />Broken Hull Hold... now that name rings a bell, but not the right sort of bell, I'm afraid. <g id="female_explainS" />Keep your weapon ready and watch the shadows in there.
98_m_01_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_v2_a: <g id="male_chuckle" />Fancy seeing you again! <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Saw you talking with Silas and thought I caught wind that you're looking for your next rank.
98_m_01_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_v2_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I can give you a pointer if you tell me where she's sending you.
98_m_01_combatprowess_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_shocked" />You defeated Lawrence? You? <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Bah, I knew I should have given you a tougher challenge.
98_m_01_combatprowess_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="grace_proud" />Very well, Gladiator. You may have dealt with them, but you're far from getting to be a true Marauder.
98_m_01_combatprowess_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_youknow" />Saw you speaking with Tibbs over there. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Not sure that was what I had assigned, but I bet you were getting help.
98_m_01_combatprowess_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />Doesn't surprise me, he's just as useless as you are. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Talk to him all you like, it won't help you.
98_m_01_combatprowess_description: Defeat the lost pirate Lawrence of the Long Shadow to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Gladiator. Talk to Ravager Silas at the Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_01_combatprowess_description_v2: Defeat the Lost and their leader, Pirate Lawrence of the Long Shadow to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Gladiator. Talk to Commander Silas at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_01_combatprowess_goto_poi: Defeat Lawrence of the Long Shadow in {POITags} to earn the rank of Gladiator
98_m_01_combatprowess_goto_poi_v2: Defeat Lawrence of the Long Shadow and the Lost in {POITags} to earn the rank of Gladiator
98_m_01_combatprowess_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_youknow" />Smart. You should make sure you're ready before facing Lawrence.<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> Could take some time. Possibly forever.
98_m_01_combatprowess_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="grace_proud" />Seems you're in a hurry to experience a painful death. Fine.
98_m_01_combatprowess_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_youknow" />The legendary warrior Lawrence of the Long Shadow now finds himself among the Lost.<g id="male_explain" /> Defeat them, and destroy their camp while you're at it.
98_m_01_combatprowess_proposal_prompt_v2: "Just tell me what I have to do."
98_m_01_combatprowess_proposal_v2_a: <g id="grace_proud" />Oh, a really smart tongue on this one. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It's a shame I don't have time to make you eat those words.
98_m_01_combatprowess_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />This challenge should be punishment enough, anyhow. It's helpful to me either way if you fail.
98_m_01_combatprowess_start_prompt_v2: "Can't be too hard. You made it."
98_m_01b_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_topic_v2_a: <g id="male_whattheheckBig" />You had to face Grimclaw? I heard that Silas had it out for you, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />but I didn't know it was that bad. She shouldn't have set you such a task.
98_m_01b_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_topic_v2_b: <g id="male_nod1" />I think my hunch was right. <g id="male_patience" />She's up to something. I just have to figure out what.
98_m_01b_9805_tibbs_00_talkto_v2: <g id="male_nod1" />You're on your next trial I see. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I expect it wasn't a problem for you, you don't look worse for wear. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Well not any worse than usual. What've you had to do?
98_m_01b_fenravager_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_shocked" />What? You managed to kill them? Grimclaw, too? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />That beast bested me in my trials! How could someone like you manage to--
98_m_01b_fenravager_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="female_youknow" />No matter. The next trial will be your last, mark my words.
98_m_01b_fenravager_complete_v2: <g id="female_youknow" />Back so soon? I assume you've come to concede. I suppose you can still serve under Tibbs' command, if he isn't too ashamed of you.
98_m_01b_fenravager_description: Defeat enemies across Weaver's Fen to advance to the rank of Ravager. Talk to Commander Bergeron in Weaver's Fen when the task is complete.
98_m_01b_fenravager_description_v2: Defeat a clan of bears in Greyvale Grotto to advance to the rank of Ravager. Talk to Commander Silas at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_01b_fenravager_goto_poi_v2: Go to {POITags} to defeat Grimclaw and his kin to Earn Rank of Ravager
98_m_01b_fenravager_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_order" />Make your way to Greyvale Grotto in Brightwood. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />And try not to die. It reflects poorly on all of us when Gladiators get eaten by wild beasts.
98_m_01b_fenravager_killtarget_cut_down_: Cut down {targetName} in the surrounding area
98_m_01b_fenravager_killtarget_defeat_ai: Defeat Grimclaw and take a Trophy
98_m_01b_fenravager_proposal_next_v2: <g id="female_shocked" />Huh? They're big massive bears! <g id="female_smackfist" />They'll kill you! Repeatedly. Until you give up.
98_m_01b_fenravager_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_youknow" />Ha ha! Still cocky. But the bears of Greyvale Grotto will teach you a bit about humility.
98_m_01b_fenravager_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_order" />Head there and do your best to avoid getting mauled by Grimclaw.<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> In the unlikely event you survive, you'll be a Ravager.
98_m_01b_fenravager_start_prompt_v2: "Just tell me what I have to do."
98_m_0203_completetrial_destroyer: Complete the Trial of the Destroyer in Restless Shore (Rec. Level: 49)
98_m_0203_completetrial_destroyer_v2: Complete the Trial of the Destroyer at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 49)
98_m_0203_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Destroyer and then complete the Trial of the Destroyer Quest from the Faction Representative in Restless Shore.
98_m_0203_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Destroyer and then complete the Trial of the Destroyer quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.
98_m_02_9806_stroudahia_98_postquest_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />Though your journey has been difficult, you have handled it well. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I am proud to see you ascend through the ranks.
98_m_02_9806_stroudahia_98_q03_prompt_v2: "Yes, it was a gift from Silas."
98_m_02_9806_stroudahia_98_q03_talkto_v2: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Always a welcome sight to see one of our strongest soldiers return from battle. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />I trust you've recovered Florent's amulet?
98_m_02_9806_stroudahia_98_q03_topic_v2: <g id="female_worry" />It came from Silas, eh? That is… disconcerting. <g id="male_lookDown" />Why would she be giving an amulet to a new recruit? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />I will have a word with her. Meantime, share these tidings with Tibbs.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_complete_next_v2: <g id="male_whattheheckBig" />She did? Blast it, never trusted that one! <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />This is her sick game then, sabotagin' recruits' efforts to advance. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Good work on your part, now she needs to answer for all this.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_complete_v2: <g id="male_casualhail" />Welcome back. So you recovered Florent's amulet? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />If it was the amulet that caused the old boy to fall, any clues to where it came from?
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_description: Destroy enemies from each region of Mourningdale to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Destroyer. Talk to Destroyer Garcia in Restless Shores when the task is complete.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_description_v2: Defeat the corrupted ex-marauders in the Great Cleave. Talk to Lieutenant Tibbs at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_incomplete_v2: <g id="male_explain" />Careful out there. Great Cleave is treacherous… for all of us. <g id="female_order" />Report to Strou'dahia once you've recovered the amulet.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_poi_corruptedfor: Travel to Ostrog Maul and defeat the renegade Corrupted Marauders
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_proposal_next_v2: <g id="male_nod1" />Indeed, not something we can afford to ignore, and now it's yours to recover. Strou'dahia and I have agreed - <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />this will serve as your trial to earn the rank of Destroyer.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_nod1" />Unfortunately, yes. <g id="male_rememberBig" />We fought together, honorably, at one time, but due to events in the Great Cleave, he turned.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_think" />Gladiator Strou'dahia believes it might have been the influence of an amulet Florent wore.
98_m_02_ultimatewarrior_readjournal_v2: Read the journal of Ravager Florent
98_m_0304_completetrial_commander: Complete the Trial of the Commander in Ebonscale Reach (Rec. Level: 60)
98_m_0304_completetrial_commander_v2: Complete the Trial of the Commander at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 60)
98_m_0304_rankup_description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Commander and then complete the Trial of the Commander Quest from the Faction Representative in Ebonscale Reach.
98_m_0304_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Commander and then complete the Trial of the Commander quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.
98_m_03_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_topic_v2_a: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />She took it while I wasn't looking. <g id="female_shrinkEmbarrassed" />Distracted me when she came over here, said something about how it would make her stronger.
98_m_03_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_topic_v2_b: <g id="male_dontknowS" />Couldn't figure what that meant, all I care about is the memory of my comrade.
98_m_03_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_v2: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I still can't believe she stole it, my only memory of Florent. <g id="female_explainS" />He was the best of us and it was a way for me to remember the old days we spent together.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Very good, Commander. But let us not forget Silas,<g id="male_patience" /> she serves as an example as well, but for the path of darkness.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />The path that those who seek strength alone may fall into, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />that we all may fall into, <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />if we are not vigilant.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_complete_prompt_v2: "I strive to be the best Marauder."
98_m_03_darkvengeance_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_nodConsider" />It is done then? Ah yes, this amulet is a symbol of your accomplishment. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have served as an exemplar of the tenets we adhere to.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_cheerFisthigh" />Let this be a lesson to all those who strive for greatness in the Marauders.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_description: Defeat Corrupted Ravager Silas to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Commander. Talk to Commander Hartford in Ebonscale when the task is complete.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_description_v2: Defeat Corrupted Commander Silas and return the corrupted amulet to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Commander. Talk to Gladiator Strou'Dahia at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_goto_poi: Defeat the Corrupted Ravager Silas in {POITags} to earn the rank of Commander
98_m_03_darkvengeance_goto_poi_v2: Defeat the Corrupted Commander Silas and retrieve the signet ring in {POITags} to earn the rank of Commander
98_m_03_darkvengeance_incomplete_v2_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Our task is grim, but the Marauders must take the difficult path, even when dealing with those we do not like.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_incomplete_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />Silas was a good Marauder for all her faults. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />But allowing the Corruption to overtake you is inexcusable.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="male_rememberBig" />Yes, the anger and callous soul within her led her to this, but the amulet enabled her. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />The relic was cursed, but Corruption found a way to her through it.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_order" />Bring back the amulet, prove yourself worthy of being a Commander.
98_m_03_darkvengeance_proposal_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />Silas gave into fury and pride, and embraced Corruption. It's a stain on the honor of all Marauders. I'm sorry to say that Silas still wears an amulet awarded to her.
98_m_0405_completetrial_champion_v2: Complete the Trial of the Champion at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 65)
98_m_0405_rankup_description_v2: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Champion and then complete the Trial of the Champion Quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.
98_m_04_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_topic_v2_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Hah! That doesn't surprise me one bit. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />You haven't faltered at any challenges thrown your way.
98_m_04_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_topic_v2_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Let any Marauder argue against your worthiness and you'll have a hundred more singing your praises.
98_m_04_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_v2_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've done a great deal for the Marauders.<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> Did I hear right that you started the Trial of the Champion?
98_m_04_9805_tibbs_98_talkto_v2_b: <g id="male_nod1" />You know that's a rare opportunity, not many get the chance to even participate.
98_m_04_bullseye_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />That you did, it is done, and you have earned this right. <g id="female_bowHead" />You are now a Champion of the Marauders.
98_m_04_bullseye_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />It is usually a cause for celebration, but given the grim situation of the fall of First Light, ceremony will need to wait.
98_m_04_bullseye_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I see you have spoken with Tibbs. The look on his face was all that I needed.
98_m_04_bullseye_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />I will take the trophies that you earned. The Marauders will keep them as a reminder of what you have accomplished.
98_m_04_bullseye_description_v2: Brave the dangers of Brimstone Sands and Hornhold to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Champion. Talk to Gladiator Strou'dahia at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
98_m_04_bullseye_goto_poi_armoreddrake_v: Go to Hornhold to find and defeat Sividus
98_m_04_bullseye_goto_poi_colossus_v2: Go to the ruins and defeat the Colossus of Qebui
98_m_04_bullseye_goto_poi_sulfurdragon_v: Go to the Pools of Orcus to find and defeat the Khelone Khelydorea
98_m_04_bullseye_goto_poi_v2: Collect the coins at Hornhold and defeat the Armored Drake in {POITags} to earn the rank of Champion
98_m_04_bullseye_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_headnodding" />Many have failed at this trial, so I do not have to tell you twice to think with a keen mind and a cautious eye. The rest... Well, that is up to you.
98_m_04_bullseye_killandcollect_containe: Collect the Trophies of the Legendary Adversaries
98_m_04_bullseye_killtarget_defeat_ai_v2: Defeat the {targetName} and claim their trophy
98_m_04_bullseye_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />Yes, and you will prove it by hunting the Khelone Khelydorea, the Colossus of Qebui, and Sividus the Armored Drake.
98_m_04_bullseye_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_order" />From each you will claim a trophy and prove yourself worthy of the title of Champion of the Marauders.
98_m_04_bullseye_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />As a Commander of the Marauders, you have the chance to become one of the very best of the Marauders.
98_m_04_bullseye_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />But I have a new trial, a station that has not been achieved for generations. A true Champion.
98_m_q5_beastcoin_description: A massive claw that radiates acidic ichor from the Khelone Khelydorea.
98_m_q5_colossuscore_description: The pulsating core of the Colossus of Qebui that reacts with a magical crackle at any slight touch.
