98_s_01_theexperiment_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Ah right, yes! You have done well, and I am pleased to promote you to the rank of Scrivener!
98_s_01_theexperiment_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Great well, now I must study these results, the work never ends my friend!
98_s_01_theexperiment_complete_v2_a: <g id="male_smile" />Ah, at last! Yes, yes, you see? There are traces of Malikor's soul in here! This could change everything!
98_s_01_theexperiment_complete_v2_b: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />This device will surely cause a revolution in our studies of the Lost!
98_s_01_theexperiment_description: Defeat Lost Gheist Malikor and use the Psychokinetic Absorber to capture any soul remnants to earn the rank of Scrivener. Talk to Scrivener Krockes in Brightwood when the task is complete.
98_s_01_theexperiment_description_v2: Defeat Lost Gheist Malikor and use the Psychokinetic Absorber to capture any ectoplasm to earn the rank of Scrivener. Talk to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.
98_s_01_theexperiment_goto_poi: Capture Soul Traces from Lost Gheist Malikor at {POITags} to Earn Rank of Scrivener
98_s_01_theexperiment_goto_poi_v2: Capture Ectoplasm and Soul Traces from Lost Gheist Malikor at {POITags} to Earn Rank of Scrivener
98_s_01_theexperiment_incomplete_v2: <g id="male_explain" />Have you located Malikor yet? He's somewhere out there. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Use the Absorber and bring back the traces of his soul!
98_s_01_theexperiment_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="male_explain" />Yes. We just proved the hypothesis by examining one of our Lost captives. <g id="female_order" />Find Gheist Malikor. He was quite formidable in life, so be wary.
98_s_01_theexperiment_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" />Use the Psychokinetic Absorber and strike him down. You'll see!
98_s_01_theexperiment_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />You have arrived at the perfect moment.<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> I am ready to test my new Psychokinetic Absorber.
98_s_01_theexperiment_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />Did you know that some of the Lost still possess small traces of their souls?
98_s_01b_fenscholar_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />With these in hand, the things we might accomplish are innumerable! I just need time.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />And for your contribution, you have earned your new rank.<g id="female_bowHead" /> Congratulations, Chronicler {playerName}.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_complete_v2: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Really? You got all of it? And rather quickly too, I think. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Your abilities once again prove you are an invaluable resource!
98_s_01b_fenscholar_description: Gather specimens from the various Lost in Weaver's Fen and return to Alchemist Rubis in Weaver's Fen to earn the rank of Chronicler.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_description_v2: Gather ectoplasm and soul traces from the various Lost in Periville and return to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave to earn the rank of Chronicler.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_goto_poi_v2: Gather ectoplasm and soul traces from the various Lost in Periville
98_s_01b_fenscholar_incomplete_v2: <g id="male_explain" />Gather the specimens for our work in the Fen, and then I will see you advanced in rank.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="male_explain" />Ah- well you see, I've made some slight adjustments. This shouldn't be anything noticeable in the appearance, but rest assured it is improved.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Just don't go shaking it around too much, still a bit finnicky at times.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />After our first success? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Of course! I consider you a most audacious companion!
98_s_01b_fenscholar_proposal_v2_b: <g id="male_explain" />Gather up specimens from Periville, and let us repeat our experiment on a new subject.
98_s_01b_fenscholar_start_prompt_v2: "Will you give me the trial again?"
98_s_0203_completetrial_cabalist: Complete the Trial of the Cabalist in Mourningdale (Rec. Level: 49)
98_s_0203_completetrial_cabalist_v2: Complete the Trial of the Cabalist at the Enclave (Rec. Level: 49)

98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_complete_ne: <g id="male_explain" />Yes, yes, you deserve this. I mean, your title. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />We will be remembered for all time in our accomplishments, no matter what Cleo says!
<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Er- and you are a Cabalist too now! Congratulations.
98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_complete_v2: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Perfect! Perfect! <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have accomplished quite the feat, and this harvest will be invaluable to me-- <g id="female_bowHead" />and the Syndicate of course.
<g id="male_explain" />But I must collect them, yes and soon.
98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_description: Place Psychokinetic Absorbers at strategic points in Mourningdale to earn the rank of Cabalist. Talk to Alchemist Crawford in Mourningdale when the task is done.
Place Psychokinetic Absorbers at strategic points in Mourningdale to earn the rank of Cabalist. Talk to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is done.
98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_incomplete_: <g id="male_explain" />Those Psychokinetic Absorbers won't place themselves. <g id="female_smackfist" />The sooner, the better. The research never ends, my friend!
98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_proposal_ne: <g id="male_explain" />Place and activate them, if you will, in the strategic points along Mourningdale's leylines. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You're no stranger to these devices, so it should go swimmingly.
<g id="male_headNodYes" />Ah yes as well, additional specimen will need to be gathered.
98_s_02_necromanticchemistry_proposal_v2: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Oh right, yes of course, <g id="male_rememberBig" />I am doing perfectly well. I just was distracted.
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />It matters not, we have yet another prototype to test. <g id="male_explain" />This time, a unique one that must be tested in Mourningdale!

98_s_03_lostnotlost_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Then the deed is done? Krockes is no more? Well done!
98_s_03_lostnotlost_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />The integrity of our research must be preserved. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have served with distinction and earned the rank of Alchemist. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Congratulations!
98_s_03_lostnotlost_description: Defeat Alchemist Krockes and absorb his soul into the Psychokinetic Absorber and then take it to the Dryads in Reekwater to destroy it to earn the rank of Alchemist. Talk to Alchemist Santos in Reekwater when the task is done.
98_s_03_lostnotlost_description_v2: Defeat Alchemist Krockes and absorb his soul into the Psychokinetic Absorber and then return it to Cleo Elsayad to earn the rank of Alchemist. Talk to Cleo Elsayad at the  Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.

98_s_03_lostnotlost_incomplete_v2: <g id="female_youknow" />When you find Krockes, don't hesitate. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I suspect he has become quite… volatile.
98_s_03_lostnotlost_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />You must learn to clean up the messes you've made.
98_s_03_lostnotlost_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Krockes is not only Lost, he's harnessing soul power. <g id="female_smackfist" />He must be destroyed. Immediately. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />It's the only way to set things right.
98_s_03_lostnotlost_proposal_v2_a: <g id="male_patience" />The way it always does with the undisciplined. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Too enamored of their research and their reputation.
98_s_03_lostnotlost_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Krockes was simply not strong-minded enough. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />You are ready to face your final trial, are you not?

98_s_04_ciphercryptic_complete_next_v2_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />He has not been heard from in some time, and the research he was performing is invaluable. I am sure he would wish for us to preserve his findings.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_complete_next_v2_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Travel to Tempestas Custodia in Elysian Wilds and locate his research.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_complete_v2_a: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Well done, I knew that you could be trusted with such a monumental task. You will be named a Magus immediately.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_complete_v2_b: <g id="female_explainS" />And so shall Sigurdsson, should he ever return. Hope springs eternal here in Aeternum, after all.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_description_v2: Venture to Tempestas Custodia to obtain the work of Syndicate Researcher Sigurdsson and return it to Cleo Elsayad to earn the rank of Magus. Talk to Cleo Elsayad at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.

98_s_04_ciphercryptic_incomplete_v2_b: <g id="female_explainS" />The Syndicate's mission often requires us to visit such untamed lands.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_proposal_next_v2_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />He has not been heard from in some time, and the research he was performing is invaluable. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />I am sure he would wish for us to preserve his findings.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_proposal_next_v2_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Travel to Tempestas Custodia in Elysian Wilds and locate his research.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_proposal_v2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Ah yes, <g id="male_explain" />well you see there had been Syndicate researchers dispatched to study these sites. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />One of particular interest was called Tempestas Custodia.
98_s_04_ciphercryptic_proposal_v2_b: <g id="female_explainS" />A researcher named Sigurdsson volunteered to delve further into the site.

9926_00_vk_abigailrose_defaultdialog: You finally find a home worth having only to see it ripped away by some trespassing bastards. That is the refrain on this damn island.
9926_00_vk_abigailroseep2_defaultdialog: You again? Nice to see someone here who knows what we're up against. Though you should keep your head down…
9926_00_vk_abigailroseep2_defaultdialog_: The guards at the camp down there haven't noticed me yet, and I'm trying to keep it that way.
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_complete_availab: Ah, you dealt that laughing bastard a thrashing? Well done! The wolves finally met a more vicious wolf!
This doesn’t mean I trust you, by the way. But I can’t argue with your results. Did you learn why they're here?
Hmmph! Let's see… ‘Varangians,’ eh? Never heard of them. Not much to work with here, but I didn't expect much anyways.
Backup plan, I'll surround the Keep with enough traps so those bastards regret they ever came here. Heh!
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_gotopoi_stonerea: Investigate Stonereach Keep for clues to the Raiders' purpose here
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_gotopoi_warcamp: Visit {POITags} and Confront the Raiders' Leader
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_incomplete: Have you figured out what these trespassers are doing in my Keep? Whatever it takes to get rid of them, I'm up for it.
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_objective_desc: Mysterious Raiders have taken over the ruins of Stonereach Keep where Abigail Rose was living. She's asked you to help figure who they are, why they're here and how she can get rid of them.
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal: Out here, that's a critical trait, lest you wind up Corrupted or Lost!
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal_a: And don't try to tell me a settlement would be safer! I'll not be trusting my fate to some bumbling constable!
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal_next: I am… or at least, I was! The keep up the road - Stonereach - was my home until these swine-loving soldiers showed up!
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal_next2: A mercenary, are you? I knew it. Fine, go to the keep and learn what you can. Feel free to leave none alive.
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal_next2_a: They’ve got a camp to the west too. I’m headed to scout that out. Meet me there when you’ve dealt with these louts.
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_proposal_next_a: Don’t recognize their banners. Don't know who they are or why they're here, but I want them out!
9926_0101_tenaciousrose_start_prompt: "Whoa, easy! You seem a bit jumpy."
9926_0103_activityreport_description: Detailed notes regarding deployment and logistics for the Varangian groups throughout the island.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_abigailtalkto: Looks like you've found plenty. Activity reports, a personal journal... wait. This says that Romac was captured!
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_abigailtalkto_a: "I'm sending him north to Riverside Keep under heavy guard." Bah, I know where they've taken him... but I have to take this information back.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_abigailtalkto_ne: You know... if I had a hundred of you, we could drive these damned Varangians from our shores forever, and make sure they never return. Yes, please, if you could.
I've heard how they treat prisoners. It isn't pretty. And with the island keeping a person alive, that just gives them more time to work... please, hurry.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_complete_availab: Thanks for your help. I'm going to rest here, then take the long way back to the south. Don't want to have any other accidental run-ins with those armored cretins.
Much better at staying out of sight than in a brawl. Abigail will be waiting for my report.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_gather_romacpack: Locate and recover Romac's pack within {POITags}
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_goto_camp: Search for Abigail's missing companion among the Varangians in {POITags}
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_goto_keep: Travel to {POITags} to rescue Abigail's companion, Romac
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_incomplete: Stick to the shadows, move slowly... and when the time is right, take them down. That's how we'll get these fools off our land.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_objective_desc: Locate Abigail Rose's missing companion, and find any evidence that points to what the Varangian Knights are searching for.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_proposal: My partner and I have been watching this camp for some time, and he moved closer to get a better look. Keep hoping for some sign from him, but nothing yet.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_proposal_a: View is limited, and the patrols are thick. You... wouldn't be interested in helping me again, would you?
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_proposal_next: That's part of it, yes. Romac, that damned scarecrow, went down to the camp about four days ago. He's a master of disguise, so he could be hiding in plain sight.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_proposal_next_a: Look for any sign of him. Search for anything that explains what those Varangian bastards are looking for. There's too much focus here for it to just be another camp.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_proposal_prompt: "You want me to find your partner?"
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto2: You're back! Didn't have any trouble going through them, did you? Good, good. Were you able to find my pack? I'll need it to crack this cage.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto2_nex: Let me just... ha! Exactly this. Now then, I've got the tools, but it'll take a bit of time. I need a distraction. There's a big cannon up on the walls behind me.
Turn it onto the camp, light up some of their tents. Maybe take down their leader, if you're up to it. That should be more than enough to let me escape.
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b1: Another one... what will it be this time? More hot coals? Going to take a finger or a toe?
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b1_a: Wait, you're not one of those Varangians! You've got to help get me out of here!
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b1_n: Abigail? Oh, that brilliant woman. Figured it wouldn't take her long to mount a rescue, especially since I've figured out what these brutes are searching for…
Before I joined the resistance, I was a relic hunter. Traveled all over this island searching for all manner of strange items.
Some time ago, I followed a trail of clues to a cave in Edengrove that I believe was Myrddin's workshop...
No! Turns out, torture doesn't work so well on me! But I did take extensive notes on my travels, and now the Varangians have those.
But that's a problem for later... Right now, let's get me out of here. If you can bring me my pack, I'll have what I need to break out.
Myrddin's workshop! The problem is that I may have given them the way to reach it...
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b1_p: "Abigail sent me to do just that."
"So they tortured it out of you?"
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b2: Another one... what will it be this time? More hot coals? Going to take a finger or a toe?
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b2_a: Wait, you're not one of those Varangians! You've got to help me get out of here!
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b2_n: Abigail? Oh, that brilliant woman. Figured it wouldn't take her long to mount a rescue, especially since I've figured out what these brutes are searching for…
You did? Well, were you able to track down my journal and deliver it to that wonderful woman, Caoimhe?
Ha! There's a thumb in their eye, I'm sure of it. That Sonechka woman at the camp thought she'd solved every problem when she found my journal and the keystone!
Right then, let's get me out of here. If you can bring me my pack, I'll have what I need to break out.
Myrddin's workshop! The problem is that I may have given them the way to reach it...
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_romactalkto_b2_p: "Abigail sent me to do just that."
"I found the note you left behind."
9926_0103_lostscarecrow_triggervol_lever: Locate the access lever to enter the sealed area
9926_0103_romacpack_description: A traveling satchel filled with an assortment of useful tools for any situation.
9926_01_vk_abigailrose_defaultdialog: Who are you? You have a dangerous look about you. If you think I’ll be easy prey, you’re sadly mistaken. Go ahead - make your move!
9926_01_vk_abigailroseep2_defaultdialog: You again? Nice to see someone here who knows what we're up against. Though you should keep your head down…
9926_01_vk_abigailroseep2_defaultdialog_: The guards at the camp down there haven't noticed me yet, and I'm trying to keep it that way.
9926_02_vk_abigailrose_defaultdialog: Be careful where you step if you're out towards Stonereach Keep again. My snares have a bite to 'em that'll haunt you for the rest of your days.
9926_02_vk_abigailroseep2_defaultdialog: Thanks for chasing down Romac and getting him out of there. Wish I wasn't always asking you to risk your neck on my behalf. Life on this island, eh?
9927_00_vk_scoutsnote_defaultdialog: I beseech anyone finding this note to see it delivered to Survivalist Riches in the First Light Settlement! I fear my scouting mission has failed and my capture by the enemy is imminent.
9927_0102_scoutsnote_description: A bloody report on the invaders, for Survivalist Riches.
9927_0102_visionsofinvaders_complete_ava: What's this we have here? A note from Scout Desdemona? Oh dear, bless her soul... \n\nIt’s as I feared. I dreamed of these ‘Varangians’ sweeping across the southern lands, a wolfpack on the hunt. But who or what is their prey?

Not much at the present. With the threat of Corruption dire as it seems, we must focus on that.\n\nBut fear not, I will be gifted with another vision about these Varangians soon enough, and then our course will be clear.

99_msq_body_01_01:
Journal of Warden Alazar

VII.XXVII.MLX

It's as I feared. My leg is useless, broken in the battle. Pravin and Michael carried me to Arcturus Tower, but I can see that my weight is a burden. They're already exhausted…there's still so much further to run. 

I told them to leave me behind. I knew they'd get farther without me. They refused, like I knew they would. Michael swore the loudest. But in the end, even he couldn't disobey my orders. 

I've barricaded the doors and lit a bonfire on the roof. The enemy can't fail to see it. Hopefully, they'll take the bait. If I can buy enough time for the others to escape, I don't care what happens to me.
99_msq_body_01_02:
Journal of Warden Alazar

VII.XXVIII.MLX

This will be my last entry. It's just me and the stars now. To the south, my Soulwardens are running. From the north, Corruption's army comes. Only I can see them both, from up here. 

Some people live their last moments in a dungeon. I'm lucky to have the stars for company. 

They've reached the foot of the tower. I, Yonas Alazar, am honored to have served as the Soulwarden Commander for all these 

Wait. One of my Soulwardens is coming back. What is Michael doing? I ordered them all to run! 

That stubborn LUNATIC is going to get himself Corrupted!
99_msq_body_01_03: LaCuran, I've gone on the run. I am so sorry to leave you to face Captain Isabella's wrath alone. Whatever she does to you will be less horrible than what she had planned. Perhaps that's some small comfort? I hope so. I couldn't let her go through with it. I couldn't let her become the monster she wanted to be. My final request of you is to distract her until I can escape the island with the box. She will certainly kill you for it, and maybe worse; still, I must ask, for the sake of our long friendship. If that's not enough, for the sake of every living thing in this world. Even now, I fear it is too late for I hear the Heretic's laughter. Hellish echoes that plague my waking thoughts and haunt my nightmares. I must flee. Go with God, friend, if you can still find him. - Father Russo
99_msq_body_01_04:
I heard the Heretic's voice again last night, in Isabella's quarters. They were discussing something. I ran in, crucifix in hand, but Isabella was alone. She watched as I searched the room, smiled as the crucifix fell from my fingers. I let her embrace me, and felt her body shake with silent laughter.

Did I imagine it? Was I finally going mad? The Devil is certainly within his right to play tricks on me. Only a madman could think a wooden crucifix capable of saving Isabella's soul. Only a hypocrite could love her.

I had to leave her. I couldn't leave her. Not until what I discovered tonight. 

- Father Russo
99_msq_body_01_05:
My Isabella, 

As you struggled in the fever's grip, I invoked the ancient rite. I would not see your soul damned to the Pit even if it meant condemning my own. When your fever finally broke, I hoped for an instant that God had returned you to me. 

But it's the Devil that delights in the hopes of weak men. I finally see that the creature that came back is not the woman I loved. 

The truth is, until tonight, I've never done a single thing worthy of reward. Saving your soul was never within my power. The only thing left for me to do was steal it, and save the world from what you've become. 

We will not meet in Heaven. I hope that we never meet again. To spend my life guarding this box…to grow old, to die alone, imagining the hate you feel for me…that will be my reward. 


Goodbye, my love. 

- Dante

99a_msq_03_arcturussiege_volorenote_1: Siege of Arcturus, Day One: We have fallen back to the tower. On all sides, the Corrupted come for us. Our lines of defense are broken, our compatriots fleeing. Those who could cover the distance have come to this ancient place seeking shelter.\nWe are preparing fortifications. We will make our stand here. I do not think it will be enough.
99a_msq_03_arcturussiege_volorenote_2: Siege of Arcturus, Day Six: They have broken through. We no longer have means of escape, but we were able to seal the upper floors of the tower. Even now I can hear them battering against our barrier. We have rationed our food and supplies, our weapons. They will not last much longer. \nSleepless nights are evident in frayed nerves and quiet tears. The Soulwardens search my face for composure. I cannot save them, but I will not show them my despair.
99a_msq_03_arcturussiege_volorenote_3: Siege of Arcturus, Day Thirteen: … supplies are exhausted. The tower shudders under their assault. There is nowhere else to go. Soon they will ascend the stair and all will be lost.\n\nThey beg me to run, to preserve the Order's future. I will not be the Last Soulwarden. I will not abandon my post.
99a_msq_03_climbarcturus_complete_availa: Again you return. Again that expectant look on your face. What misery do you bring to me? What answers did the tower provide?
<g id="sit_shrugbrief" />You have been to the tower then, have you? <g id="sit_headshakeno" />The ghosts of my fellow Wardens call from there, demanding that I remember.
I see. They clamor, their ghosts. Begging me to remember.
<g id="sit_headshakeno" />Pain. Sadness. Regret. <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />I have stemmed the waters of memory for many years, but the dam is breaking. <g id="sit_nod" />I will tell you what happened.
I see failure. I see a crushing, final defeat. My friend, I believe your hope is long gone from this world.
<g id="sit_shrugbrief" />There now, my story is complete, and <g id="sit_nod" />you know the truth of who and what I was. And of my failure.

99a_msq_04_02c_talktograce: Ask Grace O'Malley about the Huntress
99a_msq_04_02d_captain_response_a: <g id="male_chuckle" priority="high" />Hah. There's legends and then there's truth - <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />people talk nonsense, say the Huntress is <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />part animal or some kind of spirit.
99a_msq_04_02d_captain_response_b: <g id="male_explain" />She's actually just a recluse, makes a shrine near the mines <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />to the north of her home. I'd look there.
99a_msq_04_02d_talktocaptain: Ask Captain Dubois about the Huntress
99a_msq_04_03_gotopoi_daughterwell: Seek out the Huntress in northern Everfall
99a_msq_04_2a_huntsman_response_a: <g id="male_chuckle" />The women here are not exactly the rugged sort, <g id="male_secretiveshort" />if you take my meaning.
99a_msq_04_2a_huntsman_response_b: <g id="male_explain" />Though the ever-so-charming Tekla-- er, Artificer Petrowski-- may know. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />She IS the sort to traipse around in the woods.
99a_msq_04_2b_artificer_prompt: "He said you know of the Huntress."
99a_msq_04_2b_artificer_response_a: <g id="female_thinking" />He did, did he? I've heard rumors about a strange woman who lives alone in the woods, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but it smacks of gossip and folklore to me.
99a_msq_04_2b_artificer_response_b: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Mayhaps there's someone who deals in gossip that could tell you more.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_complete_available_r: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />You tread on what was once hallowed ground, human. Whatever your purpose coming here, it is misguided. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Go back to your settlement.
<g id="male_chuckle" />No surprise. Your kind are always speaking, never listening.<g id="female_nodyes" /> That is why so few of you can hear the whispers of the Angry Earth.
"I came to speak to you, actually."
99a_msq_04_toadiana_incomplete: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Even if you do manage to track this Huntress down, have no expectations. <g id="sit_headshakeno" />She's not fond of other people, as I recall.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_objective_desc: Yonas Alazar says that if you want to become a Soulwarden, you'll need a living seed from the Angry Earth. Yonas recalls a woman in the wildnerness, elusive as a shadow, that may be able to help you acquire such a thing, if you can find her.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_a: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />That is a… terrible idea. <g id="sit_headshakeno" />The process required to harden one's soul against Corruption demands <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />a sacrifice you cannot imagine.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_b: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />The days of the Soulwardens are done with, and <g id="sit_nod" />I have a great deal of fishing to do…
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_next2_a: <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />There was once a Huntress in these parts, <g id="sit_headshakeno" />an unfriendly and elusive sort.<g id="sit_shrugbrief" /> She spoke on the Angry Earth's behalf.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_next2_b: <g id="sit_nod" />You might ask about her in Oxboro, but getting her to give you a Living Seed... <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />well, don't say <g id="sit_headshakeno" />I didn't warn you.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_next_a: <g id="sit_dismissLeft" />Bah! Even if you were to pursue such a foolish notion, <g id="sit_nod" />you would need to forge a weapon capable of combating Corruption.
99a_msq_04_toadiana_proposal_next_b: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />And that would be difficult indeed... <g id="sit_nod" />the Angry Earth is no longer generous with its seeds of power.
99a_msq_05_01_gotopoi_canarymine: Investigate {POITags} for\nthe cause of the blocked Azoth flow
99a_msq_05_02_container_killcorrupteddes: Destroy sources of Corruption blocking the flow of Azoth
99a_msq_05_04a_cinematictrigger: Return to see if your actions unblocked the Fountain
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_complete_avai: Well, the fountain is running again, so you've either been blessed with good fortune, or you actually followed through.
<g id="male_handheart" />We are grateful for your role in restoring the fountain, but <g id="female_youknow" />you should know that the Angry Earth is capable of defending itself against Corruption.
I'm curious, however. What caused the blockage?
<g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Our secrets belong to us alone, but we have been known to offer some boons to those <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />who prove to be our loyal allies.
Corruption, blocking the flow of Azoth through earthly passages?
Impossible. There must be another explanation, but I will look into the matter myself.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_incomplete_a: The fountain still runs dry. That means you haven’t yet done as we asked.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_incomplete_b: Was your offer insincere? Or do you lack the strength to follow through?
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_incomplete_ne: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Contamination still clogs the fountain. We have nothing to say to you.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_objective_des: Explore the Canary Mine and purge any Corrupted manifestations might be blocking the flow of Azoth to Adiana's fountain in the Daughterwell.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_proposal_a: <g id="male_shakehead" />You are wasting your time and mine.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_proposal_b: What this land needs is fewer humans, time to heal… and a working Azoth fountain. This one seems to be blocked.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_proposal_b_ne: <g id="male_pointBlame" />It is the evil of your kind that slowly spreads across the land, poisoning… everything. <g id="female_pointRight" />This fountain, once a source of life and power, now fouled.
99a_msq_05_unblockfountain_proposal_next: The flow of Azoth that feeds this fountain comes from the caves nearby, where I suspect it has become blocked.
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />The flow of Azoth that once fed the fountain has become blocked, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />undoubtedly by the crimson plague that's overcome the nearby mine.
Get it flowing again and I will at least listen to what you have to say.

<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Very well. If you can destroy whatever vile cankers have grown in the mine, we will hear your request. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Otherwise, begone.
99a_msq_06_03_craftcorruptiontincture: Use Adiana's Mortar and Pestle to craft a Corruption Tincture
99a_msq_06_azothwater_description: The mist condenses into tiny droplets in your palm, shimmering with a faint blue sheen.
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_complete_a: <g id="female_nodding" />There now, that will afford you some protection, whether or not your request for the Seed is granted.
<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />I communed with the elements while you were away, but <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />they have not yet given an answer.
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Have you made the tincture I taught you yet? You're going to need it.
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_objective_: Use Adiana's recipe to gather the ingredients to craft a tincture that will dampen the effects of Corruption.
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_proposal_a: <g id="female_laughCocky" priority="high" />Hah. Do you even realize how much you ask? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />How much your kind has already taken?
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_proposal_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />The Angry Earth will want to know the truth: do you plan to use this<g id="male_secretiveshort" /> seed to fight Corruption?
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_proposal_n: Because Corruption's <g id="male_pointBlame" />power feeds the ego, your kind's great weakness.
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Angry Earth has no ego, and that is how it offers protection. <g id="male_itemGiveRight" priority="high" />Try this tincture recipe - I believe it will help you.
<g id="female_thinking" />You are honest, aren't you? Good. We loathe deceit.
<g id="female_nodyes" />Perhaps on that account I will make your request.<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> But tell me, do you know why humans fall to Corruption, but the Angry Earth does not?
99a_msq_06_corruptiontincture_start_prom: "I need a seed of the Angry Earth."
99a_msq_06_petalcap_description: The unusually green petals suggest deep roots and abundant water.
99a_msq_06_rivercress_description: The stem continues to thrum with elemental energy long after being severed from the earth.
99a_msq_07_01_gotopoi_ebonrock: Scout Ebonrock Armory for the source of the incursion
99a_msq_07_01a_isabellawhisper: This island thrums with such sources of power... I will find them all to fortify our cause… the cause of humanity.
99a_msq_07_03_isabellawhisper: You resist the call, but you have seen the truth and the vision… please, waste no more time resisting. Seize your birthright and join me!
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_complete_avail: <g id="female_gestureleft"/>My companion has told me all that transpired in the cavern. <g id="male_willcoverit" bin="1" />Not even I knew of the shrine the Angry Earth harbored there.
<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />That they have succeeded in Corrupting it is... troubling beyond measure.

<g id="male_nodunderstand" />I did. I'd prefer to believe this an anomaly, but precautions must be taken. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I must visit the Motherwell and commune with the primal spirits there.

<g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />Your request has been granted, human. You should realize that this required a sacrifice, and <g id="female_headshakesmall" /> it's not a gift that would be given freely again.
Still, you are a fine representative for humanity. I hope this seed protects you well.
I did. I'd prefer to believe this an anomaly, but precautions must be taken.
I must visit the Motherwell and commune with the primal spirits there.
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_incomplete: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Red eyes in the dark, watching night and day from the Ebonrock Caverns. Purge those you can and find out what it is they seek.
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_objective_desc: Adiana Theron suspects the Corrupted of Ebonrock Armory are looking for something. Thin their forces and determine their purpose there.
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_proposal_a: <g id="male_gestureright" priority="high" />The Ebonrock Caverns nearby are overrun with the Corrupted.
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_proposal_b: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />While they may pose no direct threat to the Angry Earth, they are a scourge on the land.
99a_msq_07_corruptedplans_proposal_promp: <g id="male_chuckle" priority="high" />You alone could not <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />hope to achieve that. No. <g id="male_compliment" />Destroy as many as you can, and see if you can discover the source of this most recent incursion.
<g id="female_nodyes" />I suspect they are looking for something.
99a_msq_07_enc_bark_dryad_released: We are indebted to you. We will meet again.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_complete_available_re: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />It is a relief to see you return. Though my heart trembles to harbor hope again, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />it's too late to turn back.
<g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />You were able to get a living seed of the Angry Earth, then?

<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I'm not surprised. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />The Angry Earth are not our allies by any stretch of the imagination. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />But you seem to have quite a knack for persuasion.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_incomplete: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />You have what you need, so begone from here. <g id="male_shakehead" />This is no longer a place for humans.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_objective_desc: Adiana Theron has seen fit to grant you a seed of power, a fitting conduit for the weapon of a Soulwarden. Return to Yonas Alazar with news of your success.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_proposal_a: <g id="male_chuckle" priority="high" />It grants what your kind lacks - <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />a connection to the Earth itself.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_proposal_b: Give Yonas my regards. If he is your teacher, then you may yet defeat the darkness in your soul. Begone now, human.
99a_msq_08_toyonas_proposal_b_new: <g id="male_compliment" bout="1.5"/>You have what you came for, so be grateful, this will <g id="male_nodunderstand" bin="1"/>strengthen your soul against the evil that seeks to claim it. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" bin="1"/>Now, begone human.
99a_msq_09_01_gotopoi_canis: Search for a hidden cache beneath the obelisk Canis
99a_msq_09_02_crossbarrier: Use the teleporter to enter Canis
99a_msq_09_04_lootcache: Acquire the haft for your Azoth Staff
99a_msq_09_gethaft_complete_available_re: <g id="litearmor_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high"/>Well now, it's been an age since I laid eyes on one of these. It brings back many memories… <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />not all of them painful either.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />We knew the tide was turning against us. I realize now, <g id="litearmor_agree1" />we created the caches in the hope that a day like this might arrive.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_objective_desc: In search of the haft for your Azoth Staff, Yonas indicates the existence a hidden, secret cache within the hidden interior of Canis.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Yes. The relationship between Azoth and the soul is complex, but <g id="litearmor_agree1" />it is this dynamic that gives a Soulwarden their strength.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />When focused through an Azoth staff, it can perform many wonders.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_proposal_prompt_next2: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I fear that is a question <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />none remain to answer.

<g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />The Ancients disappeared thousands of years ago. We simply used the ruins to find sanctuary from the Corrupted. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />In some cases, it worked. Let us hope Canis is one of them.
99a_msq_09_gethaft_proposal_prompt_next_: <g id="litearmor_converseright" />We will start with the haft. The trees from which they were once carved <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />no longer grow on Aeternum.
<g id="litearmor_sighrelief" />The only way is to find one of the hafts we hid away as the days darkened. <g id="litearmor_realize" />The Ancient ruins of Canis contain such a cache.
99a_msq_10_01_gotopoi_ezrasforge: Visit the Ancient Soulwarden forge to find a Warden's Crosspiece
99a_msq_10_02a_getsilver: Unearth pieces of silver from the rubble
99a_msq_10_02b_02_successevent: Access the Forge within the ruins of Vulcanus
99a_msq_10_03_defeatezragethammer: Defeat Forgemaster Ezra to Collect Crosspiece
99a_msq_10_04a_craftcrosspiece: Use the Ancient Forge to craft your Crosspiece
99a_msq_10_enc_bark_forgemasterezra_enga: My hammer will make swift work of you!
99a_msq_10_enc_bark_forgemasterezra_midf: You will be reduced to ash!
99a_msq_10_enc_bark_forgemasterezra_spaw: Fan the flames! The forge must not grow cold!
99a_msq_10_forgemasterhammer_description: Incomprehensibly old, it represents Vulcanus' legacy for the Soulwardens.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_complete_availa: <g id="litearmor_takeandgiveitem5s" priority="high" />I see you managed it after all. A fine crosspiece, almost as fine as Forgemaster Ezra once made. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Did you have any trouble?

<g id="litearmor_think" bout="1.5"/>Ezra? It stands to reason he would remain at his forge, even after the light left him. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />He never did let it go cold. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />I am sure he would be pleased with your work.
I'm sure in time he will forgive your theft.
Our need is greater than his. Hopefully he'll see that someday.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Mind you, tread lightly, young one. Such places belong to the past, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />and the past has a habit of fighting back on this island.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_incomplete_ques: <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Mind you, tread lightly, young one. Such places belong to the past, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />and the past has a habit of fighting back on this island.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_objective_desc: Search the Ancient ruin of Vulcanus for the materials to craft the Crosspiece of your Azoth Staff.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_proposal_a: You can't. We had to melt them all down to make weapons during the last war.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_proposal_b: But, perhaps there's one left that wasn't melted down. Ezra might still have one.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_proposal_new: You can't. We had to melt them all down to make weapons during the last war. But, perhaps there's one left that wasn't melted down. Ezra might still have one.
99a_msq_10_getcrosspiece_proposal_prompt: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Yes, you may need to be resourceful. To the west, you will find the ancient structure that houses the forge. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />It was used by the Soulwarden Order even before my time, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />so you may still find materials scattered throughout.
Ezra, while a wonderful forgemaster, is too sentimental. It's possible he kept one as a reminder of his past great work.
You'll find him to the west, in the Ancient structure that houses the forge.
99a_msq_10_silver_description: Not a single impurity can be seen on the surface of these shards of fine metal.
99a_msq_11_01_craftthestaff: Construct your Azoth Staff within the Obelisk
99a_msq_11_01_gotopoi_shatteredobelisk: Seek the Sacred Chamber beneath the Shattered Obelisk
99a_msq_11_02_isabellawhisper: Wood and metal can be broken. But an ideal endures, and even in small defeats, I step closer to my victory.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_complete_available: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Welcome back. And look at you! Still as fresh as a newborn babe.
<g id="litearmor_think" />Most aspiring Soulwardens return looking at least a little pale. <g id="litearmor_agree1" />You must have extra soul to spare.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_converseright" />Find the altar near the Shattered Obelisk. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />That is where the Staff-forging ritual must take place.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_objective_desc: With the components of an ancient Soulwarden staff in hand, proceed to the forge beneath Shattered Obelisk. There, you will reignite the flame of the Soulwarden Order by bringing a new Azoth Staff into being.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I do not know. <g id="litearmor_worry" />The traveler said the Corrupted rally around something called "The Tempest," a being they worship like a god.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />If it is this same being that haunts you, I fear <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />your soul may be in great peril.
99a_msq_11_forgestaff_proposal_prompt_ne: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I cannot go. You must do this alone. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />It will require the sacrifice of part of your soul.
<g id="litearmor_itemgiveright" />Place the pieces of the staff on the Ancient Altar near the Shattered Obelisk, then brace yourself. <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I will be with you in spirit.
<g id="litearmor_shakehead" />No, other than maybe to give us a greater sense of urgency.
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />But this is a momentous occasion - <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />you are ready to forge your Azoth Staff, and the Soulwardens will soon be born anew.
99a_msq_12_01_gotopoi_settlement: Rally Oxboro to help fight the Corrupted
99a_msq_12_02a_magistrate_returnstaff_re: <g id="male_shocked" />Is THAT what all this hustle and bustle was about? <g id="male_waghand03" />My friend, we are perfectly capable of mounting a defense. Our guards are the finest in Aeternum.
<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Why not rest a while, perhaps leave some coin at our fine establishments?
99a_msq_12_02b_grace_returnstaff_respons: I've heard the constable here in Oxboro came from the old Roman Empire centuries in the past.
Some say she's gone a little soft in the head, but maybe that means she'll take you serious.
<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />These fine folks seem to think they haven't a problem in the world beyond a shortage of herbs… <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />you might try the Constable.

<g id="male_righthandNodeal" priority="high" />I fought enough red-eyed rotters on the beach. If you get in a jam,<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> I've got your back, but I'm <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />not enlisting in that crusade.

<g id="female_nodyes" />That's the one. She's a former Roman Legionnaire, <g id="female_leanforwardListenNod" />and you didn't hear it from me, but I hear her husband's gone missing. She might listen.
99a_msq_12_02b_talktograce: Meet Grace O'Malley in the Oxboro Tavern
99a_msq_12_02c_constable_returnstaff_res: The Corrupted? You should know it is HORRIBLE bad luck to utter the name of the enemy aloud!
No, no, no, I'll not have you summon a dark cloud over this peaceful town! I must ask you to leave at once.

<g id="female_thinking" />I've heard the reports, of course. Corrupted in some isolated spots in north Everfall. <g id="male_waghand03" />But they're not massing for an attack, all the signs are good.

<g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />Corrupted? That's preposterous! <g id="male_nodunderstand" />He's battled the demon hordes more times across the centuries than I can count. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Besides, I would've seen the signs.

<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Now you sound like my husband. Always skeptical. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />He'll return soon! For now, <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />try Captain Dubois. Perhaps he can spare some soldiers for you.
99a_msq_12_02c_talktoconstable: Ask Constable Maecia to help fight the Corrupted
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_complete_availabl: Ever since you went in search of your Huntress, I've been plying everyone with a modicum of power to do something, anything, to prepare themselves for war.

<g id="female_bowShallow" />A fine day to you, traveler. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I trust your meeting with the Constable was mutually beneficial. <g id="male_converseleft" />Was there anything I can offer you to support your interests?
I confess, I am near to the end of my wits.
<g id="male_chuckle" />Ah, well, I've heard the reports, <g id="male_complimentplayer" />and I salute your courage in battling the crimson menace. That staff appears to be a formidable weapon.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_incomplete_a: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />The strength of men will but stall the Corrupted threat. <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />The staff you hold is the only way to permanently destroy the physical manifestations of Corruption.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_objective_desc: Deliver news of hope to the people of Everfall. The staff in your hands carries with it the power to destroy Corruption at its roots.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_proposal_a: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I think so. Go back to Oxboro. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Shout from the rooftops. Bang pots and pans if you must.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_proposal_b: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Rally their men and women at arms to meet the armies coming their way. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />You hold their only hope for salvation.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_proposal_c: <g id="litearmor_willcoverit" />I must make preparations. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />The hardest part of becoming a Soulwarden is still ahead, my young friend.
99a_msq_12_returnstaff_proposal_d: <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Rally the city against the Corrupted in the north and <g id="litearmor_gestureleft" />then meet me in the Southern ruins. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Then you can become a true Soulwarden, if you still wish it.
99a_msq_13_01_gotohowe: Repel the Corrupted in north Everfall\n(Look for Hapless Howe too)
99a_msq_13_01_gotopoi_kelleher: Repel the Corrupted in north Everfall
99a_msq_13_01a_isabellawhisper: The destiny of this island is already decided. Do you not see it? The weak shall succumb and the strong shall prevail.
99a_msq_13_01a_isabellawhisper_sub_01: The destiny of this island is already decided. Do you not see it?
99a_msq_13_01a_isabellawhisper_sub_02: The weak shall succumb and the strong shall prevail.
99a_msq_13_02b_destroycorruption_small: Use your Azoth Staff to destroy Corrupted Growths
99a_msq_13_03_entertoparea: Find the Corrupted Invaders' source of power
99a_msq_13_03_isabellawhisper: You raise your fist against the crimson storm, but it is a force of nature and destiny. Join the Tempest, and be the storm.
99a_msq_13_03_isabellawhisper_sub_01: You raise your fist against the crimson storm, but it is a force of nature and destiny.
99a_msq_13_03_isabellawhisper_sub_02: Join the Tempest, and be the storm.
99a_msq_13_03b_destroycorruption_large: Use your Azoth Staff to clear Colossal Corruption
99a_msq_13_05a_cinematictrigger: Return to Oxboro with news of your victory
99a_msq_13_haplesshowe_talkto: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" bout="1.5"/>Naw, the wolves were vicious and slobbery, but they didn't get any of the good stuff. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I just need someone to help right my cart!
99a_msq_13_haplesshowe_talkto_b: <g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high" />Do I look like a lumberjack or some muscle-bound warrior who can lift a heavy weight with their pinky finger? <g id="male_willcoverit" bin="1"/>I need help here.
99a_msq_13_haplesshowe_talkto_next: <g id="female_sighrelief" />Finally, someone with a heart! <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Help me out here and I'll see you richly rewarded in Oxboro. <g id="female_nodyes" />I've got friends there in high places, I do.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_complete_available_r: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />The staff has done its work- I can taste it in the air. <g id="female_nodyes" /> Consecrated ground will repel the Corrupted for a time.
<g id="female_thinking" />I'd say you were born to be a Soulwarden, if that weren't such a tragic notion.
<g id="female_nodding" />Oh yes, a side effect of the process. Like it or not, you'll be able to taste Corruption soon, too.
<g id="male_secretiveshort" />Like a rotten tooth, sweet with decay, followed by an aftertaste of blood. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />It quite ruins dessert, I'm afraid.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_incomplete: Perhaps, with proof, I can finally convince this mess of a town to fight back.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_incomplete_new: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I hope you have great success in battling the Corrupted. And more importantly, finding our friendly Herbalist, wherever he may be.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_objective_desc: Though the townsfolk of Everfall refuse to help themselves, you have the means to protect them. Guard Captain Franc Dubois offers moral support for your quest to battle the Corrupted in Northern Everfall. He simply asks you to keep an eye out for Herbalist Howe during your travels.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_a: Can such a thing exist? It feels too good to be true. Here we are teetering on the edge of disaster, and you conveniently have the answer?
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_b: Sorry, but I've patrolled the streets of Oxboro long enough to know this ruse.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_b_new: <g id="male_willcoverit" />The herbalist who normally caters to our city is named Howe, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but he hasn't made an appearance in months. We've sent search parties.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_c_new: <g id="female_nodyes" />For Oxboro, it is a crisis of the highest order. So by all means, <g id="male_willcoverit" />your campaign gets my full moral support, but <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />do look out for Howe. <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Good luck!
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_new: <g id="male_shocked" />Why, you haven't heard? Impossible! There's a devastating shortage of herbs! <g id="female_explains" />Many of our wealthiest citizens depend on such herbs for happiness and health.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_next_a: The Soulwardens? I've heard stories, but not in any context which would give me hope. Ha!
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_next_b: But by all means, if you want to battle the Corrupted, you'll find them at the farms to the north. I won't be holding my breath.
99a_msq_13_usestaff_proposal_prompt: "It is a relic of the Soulwardens."
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_complete_availa: <g id="female_takeAndGiveItem8s" priority="high"/>Look at that - an empty Heartgem. Almost brings a tear to my eye. Take a good look, because this thing is going to <g id="male_nodunderstand" />become part of you forever.
Look at that - an empty Heartgem. Almost brings a tear to my eye.
Take a good look, because this thing is going to become part of you forever.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_incomplete: You should be able to open the Amrine temple door with that staff of yours. Bring back the Heartgem, and we can finally start the ritual.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_incomplete_new: <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />Just as the Azoth Staff is the extension of the Soulwarden's strength, <g id="male_willcoverit" />the Heartgem is the source of the Soulwarden's defenses.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_objective_desc: Acquire a Heartgem, meant to shield your soul against the effects of Corruption. Search southern Everfall for rare reagents needed to create a new Heartgem.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_a: A Heartgem - a vessel you'll use to encase your soul, protect it, a cold vault within your chest.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_b: And the place you'll have to go to get one is a cold vault in the earth, beneath the Amrine Temple.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_new: <g id="male_compliment" />You must acquire a Heartgem - your defense against Corruption - a vessel you'll use to <g id="male_handheart" />encase your soul and protect it, a cold vault within your chest.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_next: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Yes, <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />but do not get hung up on details, there will be a time to discuss such things. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />For now, you must simply acquire the gem.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_next2: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />Look here, these Ancient Guardians were once human, proud warriors. In a war now lost to time, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />they sacrificed in ways much like the Soulwardens.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_next3: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> No, but the elements for creating a Heartgem, they do. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />This will be no easy task, but <g id="male_compliment" />I believe in you. I will wait here.
99a_msq_14_heartgemgroup_proposal_prompt: It was once a sacred vault, but long-abandoned even during my prime, now an excavation.
It's the only place I know to get an empty Heartgem. You'll need your staff to gain entry. Good luck.

99a_msq_14b_yeticaveitem_description: Fueled by the primordial elemental forces of Aeternum, this enchanted icy gemstone will never melt and acts to cool the soul against the burning of Corruption's influence.

99a_msq_15_03_isabellawhisper: Our bond  will not be so easily severed. You have shielded your heart, but not your mind. Your mind will guide you to me.
99a_msq_15_ritual_complete_available_res: <g id="male_bowDeepHandsfolded" priority="high" bout="1.5"/>Welcome back, Soulwarden. You are now part of a legacy <g id="female_nodyes" />that goes back beyond the reach of history.

<g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have done more than surrender a life, <g id="male_handheart" />you have surrendered your own soul.<g id="male_bowshallow" priority="high"  /> I salute your sacrifice.
99a_msq_15_ritual_incomplete: Don't worry too much about the ritual. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />You know you're going to die, so it can't be any worse, can it? <g id="male_realize" />In all honesty, it probably can, but let's pretend.
99a_msq_15_ritual_incomplete_a: Don't worry too much about the ritual. You know you're going to die, so it can't be any worse, can it?
99a_msq_15_ritual_incomplete_b: In all honesty, it probably can, but let's pretend.
99a_msq_15_ritual_objective_desc: Complete the ritual deep in Amrine Temple to conquer death and become a Soulwarden in full.
99a_msq_15_ritual_proposal_a: <g id="male_shakehead" />Not entirely. You can still fall to temptation or rage, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but it offers protection, a buffer.
99a_msq_15_ritual_proposal_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Sadly, it also buffers against the taste of food, the warmth of sunlight... the love of another. <g id="male_crossarmsdoubt" />Are you sure you're ready?
99a_msq_15_ritual_proposal_prompt: "Yes. What do I have to do?"
99a_msq_15_ritual_proposal_prompt_next_a: <g id="male_chuckle" priority="high" />Oh, that part is simple - easier than it was, at least. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />You just have to... die.
99a_msq_15_ritual_proposal_prompt_next_b: Once again, I can't hold your hand, but my spirit is with you, and I will see you on the other side. Godspeed, {playerName}.

<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />That is the easy part. First, <g id="male_compliment" />you must enter the Heartforge and face its guardian. Then we will complete the ritual. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Trust me now, and go.
"Sorry, did you say I have to die?"
99a_msq_enc_bark_heartforgeguardian_awak: You tread on sacred ground. Begone.
99a_msq_enc_bark_heartforgeguardian_defe: We see your strength. Approach the Forge and embrace your destiny.
99a_msq_enc_bark_heartforgeguardian_enga: Turn back now. Only death awaits you here.
99a_msq_haplesshowe_greet_00: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />Will you look at my cart?! As if I haven't had enough trouble already this year! <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />It's not fair! It's not fair, I tell you!
99a_msq_haplesshowe_greet_01: <g id="male_pleadhandsopen" />Do you see this? Or are you going to just walk on by like everyone else? <g id="female_nodyes" />These roads are supposed to be safe!
99a_msq_haplesshowe_greet_01b: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" bout="1.5"/> What dark times these must be for people to just turn away from a poor, <g id="male_willcoverit" bin="1"/>innocent merchant who's been waylaid by rabid wolves…
99a_msq_haplesshowe_greet_02: <g id="male_handheart" />You have a heart of gold, good traveler. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I would stay and chat, but <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I am urgently needed elsewhere, and Howe always provides!
99a_msq_haplesshowe_greet_03: <g id="male_quidproquo" />Oh, rotted turnips! I meant to save some herbs for you, but these fine people had the greater need... <g id="female_nodyes" /> and the coin. Now, time to get my new cart!
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_01_01: In memory of Soulwarden Romanos Agallon, bearer of the eternal torch, whose service straddled centuries. All souls fade in time, but he held steadfast against the darkness until the last. May his sacrifice be a lesson to all who come after.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_01_02: In memory of Soulwarden Cristina Krempel, whose gaze never wavered. Her pursuit of humanity's best nature, her defiance of darkness, and her calm wisdom kept the flame of our hopes burning until the last. May her sacrifice be a lesson to all who come after.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_01_03: In memory of Soulwarden Reys Vachan, devoted servant of the order. He took no pride, no ambition in our sacred duty. All that was asked, and much that was not, he gave willingly. By his example did others embrace our greater purpose. May his sacrifice be a lesson to all who come after.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_01_04: In memory of Soulwarden Constanza Suberria, who gave all that was to be given. May her sacrifice be a lesson for those who come after.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_02_01: I, Gilgamesh, do solemnly vow under the radiance of the Sun and the luminescence of the Stars, in the presence of the gods, to serve as an Amarah, the Blessed Inheritor of the Eternal Fire.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_02_02: I vow to be both noble and true, to heed the divine voice, and to aid my people against all hardships and foes. I also swear on my bonded soul to ease the world’s pain, and to fulfill my sworn obligations regardless of the price.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_02_03: I give my breath to the winds, my strength to the lands, and my spirit to the firmament, that it rain down into the blessed earth and the depths of the waters to seal my oath for all time and for all those who would follow in my path.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_03_01: We have fallen back to the tower. On all sides, the Corrupted come for us. Our lines of defense are broken, our compatriots fleeing. Those who could cover the distance have come to this ancient place seeking shelter.\n\nWe are preparing fortifications. We will make our stand here. I do not think it will be enough.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_03_02: They have broken through. We no longer have means of escape, but we were able to seal the upper floors of the tower. Even now I can hear them battering against our barrier. We have rationed our food and supplies, our weapons. They will not last much longer.\n\nSleepless nights are evident in frayed nerves and quiet tears. The Soulwardens search my face for composure. I cannot save them, but I will not show them my despair.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_body_03_03: ... supplies are exhausted. The tower shudders under their assault. There is nowhere else to go. Soon they will ascend the stair, and all will be lost.\n\nThey beg me to run, to preserve the Order's future. I will not be the last Soulwarden. I will not abandon my post.
99a_msq_soulwardenintro_chapter_02: The Oath of the Old Warrior

99a_yonas_02_02_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />The Initiation of a new Soulwarden once called for a feast attended by the entire Order.
99a_yonas_02_02_b: <g id="male_explain" />But with just the two of us, I suspect it would make for a rather dull affair.
99b_galahad_00: <g id="yonas_bowShallow" />Travel safely, friend. While in the Brightwood, I suggest you stay on the road and avoid traveling at night.
99b_galahad_p1_01_a: <g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" />Be wary, traveler. A great tragedy has occurred here.<g id="yonas_gestureAround" priority="high"/> The good people who lived in these hills have fallen and turned into soulless Lost.
99b_galahad_p1_01_b: <g id="g_yonas_waghanddisagree02" priority="high" />If you've come seeking family or an old friend, I fear <g id="yonas_nod" />your journey may be in vain.
99b_galahad_p1_01a: Read the journal if you wish to hear my sad tale.
99b_galahad_p1_02_a: <g id="yonas_headnodyes" />Yes, friend. You are now acquainted with <g id="yonas_shakeheadWorried" />my regretful decision to abandon Umberto and go on a fruitless quest to find the king.
99b_galahad_p1_02_b: <g id="yonas_explain02" />My only desire now is to atone for my mistakes, but I am not sure where to begin.
99b_galahad_p2_01_a: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />What matters most, however, is that we're united in seeking Brother Umberto.
99b_galahad_p2_01_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />To me, it's clear: the darkness consuming the Brightwood is the Lost. Umberto and I swore to fight it, and <g id="male_clenchfistright" />I will honor that oath.
99b_galahad_p3_01_a: Glad you're here - the old man seems quite disturbed, but your presence will reassure him.
99b_galahad_p3_01_b: In regards to Umberto, I found references to the Bright Vigil relocating to a more defensible location. I might even know where.
99b_galahad_p3_02: Have no fear. If I find Umberto, you will be first to know.
99b_galahad_p4_01_a: <g id="male_gestureLeft" />I have been inquiring around town whether anyone here was a witness to the Vigil's fall.
99b_galahad_p4_01_b: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" >But when I saw Yonas, I knew it was <g id="female_nodyes" />my duty to make amends to you both.
99b_galahad_p4_02_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" priority="high"/>I'm afraid I haven't been quite so successful. The only thing I've learned is that Umberto hasn't been seen for years.
99b_galahad_p4_02_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The people of Calvary are strangely quiet when the subject of the Bright Vigil comes up.
99b_galahad_p4_03_a: <g id="female_nodding" />I will go and speak to the Mayor myself. <g id="female_youknows" />In the meantime, it would seem there are still questions as to Umberto's ultimate fate.
99b_galahad_p4_03_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Did Pennyfather give you any leads to follow? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Someone who may know more?
99b_galahad_p5_01_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Fortuitous timing, my friend. You catch me on the verge of <g id="male_pointleft" />traveling into Weaver's Fen to inquire about Umberto.
99b_galahad_p5_01_b: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />Pennyfather was adamant that I'd find answers there.
99b_galahad_p5_02: I have not visited the Fen since the Wars of Crimson Madness. Those are not fond memories.
99b_galahad_p6_01_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />After all we've learned, I presumed Umberto had long since fallen Lost. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />It would have been a just fate, but no.
99b_galahad_p6_01_b: <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />I confronted him myself, and to my horror, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />his humanity has somehow been preserved.
99b_galahad_p6_02_a: <g id="male_apologize" />I… must apologize. I judged the Wardens unfairly, perhaps during the Crimson Madness, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />but most certainly now.
99b_galahad_p6_02_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've proven the order is honorable and strong. With the Corrupted returning, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I salute your courage in facing it.
99b_galahad_p7_01: I've given the matter some thought, and I decided to take you up on your offer.
99b_galahad_p7_02_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />It seems providence has already seen fit to verify I made the right choice in coming.
99b_galahad_p7_02_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I hear this talk of the sorceress with the purple eye, and <g id="female_nodding" />I believe we have another quest to undertake together.
99b_galahad_p8_01: We were so naïve when we arrived on these shores.We actually believed this accursed island held the promise of Avalon.
99b_grace_00: I saw the old man poking around here. Whatever crusade you're involved in, I want no part of it.
99b_grace_p1_01_a: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Well now, imagine finding the only other sane person on this island, <g id="grace_gesturel" />here in this accursed place!
99b_grace_p1_01_b: <g id="grace_secret" />I heard this "Bright Vigil" amassed quite a fortune before they up and vanished. <g id="grace_yes" />They left a stain of evil as well.
99b_grace_p1_01a: Go on now. I'd rather not linger in this place too long.
99b_grace_p1_02_a: <g id="grace_excited2" />Now we're talking… I see you found some shinies. Don't forget - <g id="grace_takeItem5s" priority="high"/>all this is going toward buying a boat to get off this crazy rock.
99b_grace_p1_02_b: <g id="grace_sympathy" />I suppose you're more interested in hearing about this curse, though, aren't you?
99b_grace_p2_01_a: Well now, we got a right crowd hanging about this place.
99b_grace_p2_01_b: Don't get me wrong, I'm not here to stay, but I'm glad to think we've found a safe spot from all the evils lurking on this damned island.

99b_investigatelocation_3: Search for information about Umberto in {POITags}
99b_isabella_whisper_01: No! Why would you desecrate your body with a... hollow gem!? *I* ask no sacrifice of you. And yet... why?
99b_isabella_whisper_02: I do not understand why you reject Corruption. Is there... someone telling you to do this? Lying to you about... everything...?
99b_isabella_whisper_03: Pure Azoth... Ahh... Does it not feel right? Take that morsel from me. In return, I only ask you consider the feast I am offering.
99b_isabella_whisper_03a: More lies hidden on the island. It will be mine, it is required for to help fulfill our destiny.
99b_msq_01_blessedcandle_description: A candle blessed by Brother Umberto, given to families or friends of the Lost.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_complete_availa: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />It appears the town fell to the Lost primarily from within, <g id="male_converseleft" />no signs of any defense.
<g id="male_think" />I wonder if Brother Umberto sought aid from somewhere else.
<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Ser Galahad, eh? The shining knight from the court <g id="male_nodunderstand" />of King Artorius himself.
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />An honorable warrior as I recall, but <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />a bit squeamish regarding the requirements of becoming a Soulwarden.
"He went west to seek Ser Galahad."

99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_incomplete: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> There is no more for us here. <g id="male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" />Meet me at the Shadowmine Shrine.

99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_objective_desc: Yonas recalls a priest named Brother Umberto who once ministered to the Soulwardens. The two of you decide to seek out Umberto in the town of Walsham in Brightwood and learn his fate.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes, we must find allies as well. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />We needn't repeat the failed experiment of doing this alone.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_proposal_b: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />Such fools we were, to turn away those who sought to support us.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_proposal_next2_: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />Hm. A suitable start, I suppose. Brother Umberto trudged off to Brightwood, as I recall. <g id="male_apologize" /> It's a dark and dead forest now, but perhaps he remains there.
<g id="male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" /> Meet me at the Shadowmine Shrine, and <g id="female_nodyes" />we'll go from there.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Arrogance… the childish notion we were special, <g id="male_willcoverit" />that we alone were destined to save the world.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_think" bout="1.5"/>There was a priest who warned us, counseled humility… <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />but we refused his suggestions and his support.

99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_yonas_talkto_a: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />No, it was the cold curse of the soulless Lost <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />that brought misery to Brightwood.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_yonas_talkto_b: <g id="male_apologize" priority="high"/>If Umberto was even still here by that time, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />then he may well have departed.
99b_msq_01_searchwalsham_yonas_talkto_ne: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />That, we must discover. I heard Umberto was ministering to the town of Walsham; <g id="female_gestureleft" />now but a haunted remnant of what it was then.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />I will leave the investigation to your youthful vigor and meet you north of town. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Good hunting, Warden.
99b_msq_01_umberto_lorenote_1:
Pastor Prewitt,

It is with the utmost urgency and discretion that I author this note. Out of respect for your seniority in Walsham, I choose not to challenge you publicly, but I am disappointed nonetheless.

These poor Lost souls who've wandered into town may seem to have lost their humanity, but is this not a test of our faith? The decision to bury them seems to me a decision to surrender hope; there simply must be a more humane way to handle this.

Please, let us at least discuss the matter.

Brother Umberto
99b_msq_01_umberto_lorenote_2:
Prewitt,

It is plain now that ignoring my concerns has cost this town dearly. Even the most faithful are on the verge of despair, and as we've seen, that seems to be the true source of this soulless plague. Our hollow prayers and efforts to bury these tragic events are only making matters worse.

I cannot bear to witness this tragedy unfold. I am told of a Faithful Knight who resides west in Ballard's Manor - Ser Galahad. I will seek him out, and if providence affords, I will return with the hope and the strength to save our town.

Brother Umberto
99b_msq_01_umberto_lorenote_3:
Umberto's Journal  - March 17th

A cold wind blows instead of spring, and the trees of Brightwood are dry and devoid of new growth. Poor Pastor Prewitt fell Lost along with the rest of Walsham and now the Lost are appearing here in Wolfsegg.

Since Galahad's departure, several knights have left the Vigil, and I have begun recruiting and training the local townsfolk as new Vigilants. They've taken to calling themselves 'shadow hunters', and I won't discourage it... anything that keeps them hopeful is welcome.

Umberto
99b_msq_01_umberto_lorenote_4:
Umberto's Journal  - June 8th

It is the peak of summer, but it remains cold, and crops wither in the field. It seems every week, we awaken one morning to find another of the townsfolk has fallen Lost.

Despite my misgivings, I've come to accept the only solution is to bury them. Strange as it may be to see graveyards on Aeternum, my greater concern is that they will soon be widespread.

Umberto
99b_msq_02_brightvigilinsignia_descripti: A small crest representing the Bright Vigil. Why it was thrown in the well, you may never know...
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_complete_availabl: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I welcome your aid for Umberto's sake, but I did<g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> not realize you were a Soulwarden.

<g id="g_male_pointblame"/>During the Wars, your order insisted on the delusion that the Crimson Madness could not be defeated. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Your friend, Yonas, now claims it's returned.
<g id="male_nodunderstand" />Yes, some Corrupted still linger, <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />but I assure you, the Crimson Sorcerer is long gone.

<g id="litearmor_shakehead" />The old man won't hear it - he scouts ahead, <g id="female_gesturearoundroom" priority="high" />determined to prove there's an army of the possessed hiding somewhere in the forest.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_galahad_talktoa_a: <g id="yonas_nod" />Ah, then there <g id="yonas_spreadarms002" />may yet be hope! Brother Umberto is a brave soul - <g id="yonas_explain01" />he and I joined forces to defend these fair lands.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_galahad_talktoa_b: <g id="yonas_headshakeDisappointed" priority="high"/>Ah, but the story pains me to speak aloud. <g id="yonas_gestureLeft" priority="high" />It is better if you read the account in my journal, just there.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_galahad_talktob_a: <g id="yonas_nod" />Indeed. I would like nothing more than to find company <g id="yonas_gestureLeftM" />in this lamentable endeavor.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_galahad_talktob_b: <g id="g_yonas_spreadarmsnod" />If you are willing to overlook my failed duties to the Vigil, <g id="yonas_handHeartLove" />then I will heartily accept your offer.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_galahad_talktob_n: <g id="yonas_gestureBehind" />It was among these townships and the nearby manor that Umberto and I founded the Vigil.
<g id="yonas_thinking" />I know the Manor well - I will search there for clues and you can search the towns. <g id="yonas_bowShallow" />May the Light be with us both.

99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Hm. Some say King Artorius fell during the war, others say he fled, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and there were even whispers that he turned.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Perhaps Galahad can shed light on the fates of both the king and Brother Umberto.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes, there are a few townships and manors that way, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />if they have not fallen Lost like Walsham.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You go on ahead - <g id="male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" />I want to do a little scouting to the north; it's time I pull my own weight. I'll catch up.

99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_yonas_talktoa_a: <g id="male_gesturebackthere" />Ser Galahad continues the search in a town just north - <g id="female_nodyes" />the bright knight refuses to believe the Corrupted have again become a greater threat.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_yonas_talktoa_b: <g id="male_pointBlame" />But you and I know better, and we cannot simply <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />walk away.
99b_msq_02_meetgalahad_yonas_talktoa_nex: <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />We must try. I hoped to find only simple pockets of the Corrupted, <g id="male_think" />but they appear to be consolidating.
<g id="male_gestureLeft" priority="high" />I suggest you enter the Manor and strike down the Corrupted Commander. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />It could buy us time.
