99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_complete_avail: <g id="female_takeItem5s" priority="high"/>Ah, you got the Bright Sigils? Amazing. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I can't express how good it feels to have an ally in this effort - <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />especially one who can fight!
<g id="male_think" />We'll need some token from the Grand Vigilant as well, but that can wait.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_dig_moira: (Optional) Search for Vigilant's Sigil in the grave
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_galahad_talkto: <g id="male_agree1" />Of course. With so many leads to follow, it's good we can split up.

<g id="male_willcoverit" />I will not dally in the Fen; I will gather what information I can and then rejoin you and the alchemist. <g id="male_salutefisttochest" />Until then, Light be with you, friend.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_goto_eastshrin: Meet Ser Galahad at the Pennine Shrine near Weaver's Fen
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_goto_poi: Collect Sigils from Lost Vigilants at {POITags} as proof they paid for their crimes
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_goto_southshri: Bring the Vigilants' Sigils to Sun Fuchun at the Postrehkin Shrine
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_incomplete: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />If everything Pennyfather says is true, Umberto has horrific crimes to answer for…Unless he too has fallen Lost.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_lore_note: Read Vigilant Moira's letter, "Dissension in the Ranks"
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_objective_desc: Mayor Tunstall Pennyfather admitted that he was aware of the Bright Vigil's atrocities and the curse that followed. After discussing with Galahad and the Master Alchemist Sun Fuchun, it becomes clear where the trail leads next.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Very well, then I will leave you <g id="male_complimentplayer" />to follow the trail wherever it leads.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_proposal_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will attempt to learn more about Umberto's fall… <g id="male_think" />I've begun to wonder if he ever sought to find the source of the Lost plague.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_proposal_next_: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It first appeared in the eastern fens, and <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Umberto and I had discussed traveling there.
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If there are no other leads, I shall inquire about him in the fens myself. <g id="male_complimentplayer" /> After that, let's meet to share what we've learned.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_sun_talkto_a: <g id="female_shocked" />He told you? Well then, a secret no more! <g id="female_nodyes" />So yes, I'm trying to restore the "bright" to Brightwood.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_sun_talkto_b: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Despite Pennyfather's hopes, restoring the entire forest is impossible, <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />but I might be able to heal some locations.
99b_msq_07_cursedcemetery_sun_talkto_nex: <g id="female_laughMed" />See now, patience is rewarded. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I've dreamt of this moment, and I know what to do.
<g id="female_pointright" priority="high" />The last Vigilants fell at Brightrest Cemetery - if you'll recover their Sigils and <g id="male_agree1" />meet me at the Postrekhin Shrine, I'll explain.
<g id="male_shocked" />That fort on the hill? The Bright Vigil <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />was up to some DARK deeds there.
Believe it or not, <g id="female_nodding" />I could cure that place… <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />but only if I had help getting proof the Vigil's leaders paid for their crimes.
99b_msq_07_gouravigilinsignia_descriptio: The familiar crest of the Bright Vigil, taken from the Lost form of the former Vigilant Goura.
99b_msq_07_moira_lorenote_1:
Goura,

Whatever Umberto says, you musn't believe him! Something in the Grand Vigilant changed after I expressed doubts about Sonnesbruck. He's been paranoid, keeping secrets, something about making a "Heartgem" to protect himself... like those mad Soulwardens.

I fear he's trying to turn us against each other. If we don't stay united, I worry we'll both end up like the others...

(Unsigned)
99b_msq_07_moiravigilinsignia_descriptio: The crest of the Bright Vigil, found on the body of the former Vigilant Moira.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_complete_available_: <g id="male_think" bout="1.5"/>The alchemist is clearly gifted in some vestal fashion - you've done <g id="male_nodunderstand" />well partnering with her.
<g id="male_apologize" />My tidings are less inspiring… no sign of "Grand Vigilant" Umberto in the Fen, <g id="male_spreadhands" />but a clue guided me to find him back here.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_gather_herb: Gather a {itemName} near the entrances to the cave
99b_msq_08_azothtree_get_item_from_targe: Defeat {targetName} in the cave to collect the {itemName}
99b_msq_08_azothtree_goto_poi: Obtain the vessel used by the Angry Earth in the {POITags}
99b_msq_08_azothtree_goto_poi2: Visit {POITags} to collect the Sacred Waters
99b_msq_08_azothtree_igc_approach: Approach the well of the Azoth Tree
99b_msq_08_azothtree_incomplete: The tree is invested with vast power. Step lightly in the grove.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_objective_desc: In order to cleanse the curse from Caer Dun, Sun Fuchun needs Sacred Waters collected from the Azoth Tree in the nearby grove, but it's necessary to acquire vessels from the Shamans in the neighboring caverns in order to extract the waters. After collecting the waters, rejoin Sun Fuchun.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_a: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Yes, but I'm <g id="male_explain" />not so keen on that wording. The so-called "Angry Earth" evolved from a deep and primal power.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />They pose a grave threat to humanity, <g id="female_nodyes" />but their bond with the energy of Azoth is sacred.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_next2_a: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />A nearby grove harbors a sacred Azoth Tree, tended by Angry Earth shamans.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_next2_b: <g id="male_compliment" />Venture into the shamans' subterranean lair to claim their vessels <g id="female_nodding" />and then use those to collect the Sacred Waters from the tree's roots. I'll wait here.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_willcoverit" />My fascination with plants and alchemy began in the Old World, <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />but here, it transformed into something more… metaphysical.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />This is how I know that with the right components, <g id="male_pointLeft" />we can heal the fortress of Caer Dun.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_return_shrine: Bring the filled Vessel to Sun Fuchun
99b_msq_08_azothtree_sun_talkto_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />All that remains is some token to prove the Grand Vigilant has also answered for his crimes. <g id="male_pointleft" priority="high" />I believe your friend Galahad knows where to find him.
99b_msq_08_azothtree_sun_talkto_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will go on to Caer Dun and make preparations. <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />See you there, soon, I hope.
99b_msq_08_purewaterrootempty_descriptio: An empty, hollow root used by the Angry Earth to commune with the Azoth Tree.
99b_msq_08_purewaterrootfull_description: The hollow root has been filled with water from the Azoth Tree.
99b_msq_08_purificationherb_description: The fragrant leaves of a plant. Just holding them makes you feel grounded and at peace.
99b_msq_09_flawedheartgem_description: A cracked and flawed heartgem, blackened by the wielder's actions.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_complete_availabl: <g id="male_sighRelief" />It is done, then? The tragic tale of the once-brave Brother Umberto <g id="male_nodunderstand" />finally draws to a close.

<g id="male_complimentplayer" />I am grateful to you, my friend, for helping me atone for my part in all this. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />We will never know if I might've prevented these atrocities.
<g id="male_willcoverit" />You are kind to say so, and indeed, we must look forward, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />never back.

<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Speaking of which, I gather you and Yonas now seek to remove the curse on Caer Dun and claim it for the Soulwardens… <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />I suppose that's fitting.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_enter_sanctum: Unlock Sanctum Gate and Enter the Sanctum
99b_msq_09_killumberto_incomplete: <g id="male_compliment" />You're a brave soul to undertake this endeavor. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Umberto has become a monster.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_objective_desc: Galahad has tracked Umberto to Vigil's Stand and it's now time to confront the fallen priest, acquire his Heartgem and then rejoin Galahad at the Postrekhin Shrine.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_proposal_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Did he? I will refrain from commenting on that practice out of respect, <g id="female_nodyes" />but Umberto must be called to answer for his crimes.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_proposal_b: <g id="male_compliment" />If the Heartgem protects him, it must be destroyed, <g id="male_willcoverit" />though I cannot be the one to do it.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />The wretch has been hiding out all this time, <g id="male_righthandAngry" />and when I accosted him, he sealed himself <g id="male_pointright" priority="high"/>inside the sanctum at Vigil's Stand.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />Break in there, defeat him, and take his Heartgem. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />I will await your return. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Godspeed, my friend.
99b_msq_09_killumberto_proposal_next_pro: "I'll do it. Tell me where he is."
99b_msq_09_killumberto_return_shrine: Return and report your success to Galahad
99b_msq_09_killumberto_search_center: Investigate the walled sanctum at the center of {POITags}
99b_msq_09_killumberto_search_houses: Search the nearby homes for keys to the sanctum door's locks
99b_msq_09_sanctumdoorkey_description: An ornate key that appears to fit a lock on Umberto's Sanctum.
99b_msq_09_umberto_dark_combat1: My soul will not be so easily vanquished…
99b_msq_09_umberto_human_combat1: I will not repent, nor will I fall… it is you whose soul will be forfeit!
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_complete_availabl: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've done well, young one. <g id="female_pointRight" />As menacing as that Corrupted army in Great Cleave may be, <g id="female_nodyes" />I believe we are safe here.
<g id="male_willcoverit" />I will maintain my focus on recruiting and training new Soulwardens to defend the place.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_destroy_heartgem: Place the Heartgem on the altar and destroy it
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_enter_undercroft: Enter the Undercroft to destroy the Heartgem
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_exit_undercroft: Return to the surface with the news of Umberto's defeat
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_finalseal: Destroy the Heartgem's final seal and release Brother Umberto's soul
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_goto_poi: Bring Umberto's Heartgem to Sun Fuchun near Caer Dun
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_incomplete: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will give your offer due consideration, my friend. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Until then, good fortune to you at Caer Dun.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_objective_desc: Working with Ser Galahad, you've defeated Grand Vigilant Umberto and taken his Heartgem. All that remains is to return to Caer Dun and follow Sun Fuchun's instructions for removing the curse.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I will return to Calvary and seek other ways I can help restore the Brightwood.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_proposal_b: <g id="male_realize" />Perhaps Pennyfather will have grown a spine by now. <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Either way, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will find some way to serve.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I'm not sure I have it in me to face the Crimson menace once more - <g id="female_nodyes" />this business with Umberto has left me feeling my true age.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />I will have to consider the offer carefully… and then <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />perhaps I shall join you at Caer Dun.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talkto_curse: Ask Sun Fuchun if the curse is lifted
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktoa2_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />Take Umberto's Heartgem into the Undercroft <g id="female_smackfist" />and destroy it.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktoa2_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />If what I'm hearing is true and it protects some part of the soul, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />you may face some resistance. Bottom line, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />he must answer for what he did.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktoa_a: <g id="female_explainS" />Keep in mind, this isn't an exact science, but <g id="female_nodyes" />whatever bad deeds the Vigil performed here, <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />the worst of them were in the Undercroft.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktoa_b: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />I've anointed the entrance with Pure Azoth Water and <g id="male_nodunderstand" />placed the Sigils.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktoa_promp: "Yes, just tell me what to do."
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktob2_a: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />I told you that tree had power, didn't I? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Its wisdom is directing you, of course, telling you what to do next.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktob2_b: <g id="female_youknow" />I think Galahad mentioned a sorceress with a purple eye… maybe we need to find her? <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Ask him about it.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktob2_prom: "I saw a woman with a purple eye."
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktob_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />Funny, Yonas said the same, and Galahad's on board. <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />So I think I might allow myself to go along with the flow.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_sun_talktob_b: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />Speaking of, I didn't push you on this before, but something happened to you at the Azoth Tree, didn't it?
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_yonas_talkto_a: <g id="male_think" />Hm. It seems his soul was tormented and perhaps that drove him to make poor decisions. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />This island eventually makes fools of us all.
99b_msq_10_cleansefort_yonas_talkto_b: Come though, <g id="female_pointleft" />speak with the young lady. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />She has made all kinds of preparations.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_complete_availa: <g id="male_sighRelief" />You've heard Pennyfather's sordid tale, have you? I do not give that man's story much credence.
<g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Neither do I have any desire to meet this sorceress… such types cannot be trusted, in my experience.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_galahad_talkto_: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, though I know her by another name, the Corpse Crone of Weaver's Fen. I have doubts about her existence.
<g id="female_gestureLeft" priority="high"/>But Mayor Pennyfather in Calvary is obsessed; go and hear his account and then <g id="male_nodunderstand" />meet me on the road to the Fen.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_goto_settlement: Go to {POITags} and ask Pennyfather about the Corpse Crone
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_incomplete: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I believe in you, and if you need me, I will be here.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_meet_galahad: Meet Galahad near the Pennine Shrine
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_objective_desc: Following the vision you received from the Azoth Tree, you've decided to search for the sorceress with the purple eye. You must revisit Mayor Tunstall Pennyfather in Calvary and then meet Galahad on the road to Weaver's Fen.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_pennyfather_tal: <g id="female_shocked" />The Corpse Crone!? Don't say that name so loudly lest she be summoned! She is the true cause of ALL this darkness in Brightwood.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Indeed, I have written an account, just there. Read it for yourself, and know the horrors she wrought.
<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" />Be wary then, nosy traveler! Weaver's Fen is a foul territory, ridden with sickness and despair, all the crone's doing, no doubt!
<g id="male_chuckle" />I wish you luck though, or perhaps a miracle… you'll need it, I fear.
"I plan to seek her out, at least."
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_proposal2_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I will not pretend to understand such things as the Azoth Tree, <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />but neither will I deny its primal power.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_proposal2_b: <g id="female_nodyes" />You should heed the vision as Sun suggested. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Ask Galahad about this mysterious sorceress with the purple eye.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />It means you have been imbued with a power that exceeds my understanding, <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />and it makes you both a target and a threat to the enemy.
99b_msq_11_weaversvector_proposal_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I do not envy the destiny that lies before you, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />nor do I know where it leads.
99b_pennyfather_00: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Always a treat to see a new face in Calvary, but <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I have no time to talk right now. It's quite taxing to run this town, you know.
99b_pennyfather_01_a: God's ears! <g id="male_whattheheckbig" priority="high" />Tell me you're not here to talk about missing priests, cursed forts, or the damned Bright Vigil.
99b_pennyfather_01_b: <g id="female_throwarmsFrustrated" />Will you people never stop? Why can't I get any peace?
99b_pennyfather_02: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />Now I've already told you more than I should have. Let me be!
99b_pennyfather_03_a: <g id="female_blameShort" />I see that look in your eye… whatever you found up there, <g id="male_whatwantfromme" />I had nothing to do with it!
99b_pennyfather_03_b: <g id="male_crossarmsNo" />The atrocities Umberto and the Vigilants committed against those poor, innocent families… <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" priority="high"/>it's simply unthinkable.
99b_pennyfather_04: <g id="male_giveup" priority="high"/>If you wish to see me punished for my silence, I accept it. I have nothing to say in my defense.
99b_pennyfather_05_a: <g id="male_whatwantfromme" />You again? No, please! I have nothing more to confess! You've already exposed my secret shame!
99b_pennyfather_05_b: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />And I understand you managed to lure Sun away on some crazy enterprise. What more can you take from me?
99b_pennyfather_05a: Go on, read the book, though it might give you a fright!
99b_pennyfather_06_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />There now, you know the full story! Whatever terrible deeds you attribute to the Bright Vigil, they were victims too.
99b_pennyfather_06_b: <g id="male_concernS" />Tell me though - do you mean to track down the vile crone and hold her to account?
99b_pennyfather_07: I thought you were going to Weaver's Fen… good riddance, I say!
99b_sun_00: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Even shrouded in darkness, there is beauty in Brightwood. <g id="male_agree1" />If you know where to find it.
99b_sun_p1_01_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />If the mayor sent you to nag me about his invitation to tea, please give him my regrets.
99b_sun_p1_01_b: <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />I don't have the interest or the time for social engagements, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />especially when he requests I work alone and keep everything so secret.
99b_sun_p1_02: I have my part in this as well. I'll explain after Brightrest.
99b_sun_p2_01: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider"/>Removing the curse from Caer Dun will take more than just seeing the Vigil's crimes avenged. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />We'll need the healing power of the earth itself.
99b_sun_p2_02_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />There is something… different about you, I think. You were <g id="male_think" />touched somehow by the Tree, weren't you?
99b_sun_p2_02_b: <g id="female_apologetic" priority="high" />Don't worry - I won't pry. We want to remove the curse from Caer Dun, and now we have the waters.
99b_sun_p2_03: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Be careful. The Grand Vigilant is as dark as they come.
99b_sun_p3_01_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />You were just in time to interrupt Yonas sharing another tale of your exploits. <g id="female_fingerwagno" />Not that I wasn't enjoying them, of course.
99b_sun_p3_01_b: <g id="female_youknow" />But I'm keen to take a shot at removing this curse! <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Assuming you have the "Heartgem," are you ready?
99b_sun_p3_02: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Whatever you have to face down there, I have no doubt you can handle it.
99b_sun_p3_03_a: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" priority="high"/>I must admit, I really wasn't sure this would work, but look at this place!
99b_sun_p3_03_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I'd say it's as pristine as the day it was built. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />You and I make a good team.
99b_sun_p3_04: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If I'm being honest, I'm a bit jealous of you getting a vision from the Azoth Tree.
99b_sun_p3_05: I will stay here and help Yonas. I think he needs it.
99b_yonas_00: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" priority="high" />It is very hard to believe this dismal forest was once a happy place. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />So much that was good is gone.
99b_yonas_greatcleave_bark: There are too many! We must retreat and find a secure position!
99b_yonas_p1_01_a: <g id="female_gesturearoundroom" priority="high"/> I hoped time would bring new life to Brightwood, <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />but it remains as dreary as it was two centuries ago.
99b_yonas_p1_01_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The Order was long gone by the time the darkness descended here.
99b_yonas_p2_01_a: <g id="male_converseright" />Many of the king's knights joined the Order… <g id="female_leanforwardSmall" />but of course, you know what happened to them.
99b_yonas_p2_01_b: <g id="male_explain" />Galahad remained at Artorius's side, and now that I hear the name, <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />I do recall hearing he resurfaced after the war.
99b_yonas_p3_01_a: <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Ah, it is good to see you, young Warden. <g id="male_apologizesmall" />I have bad news - I found a large force of Corrupted to the east.
99b_yonas_p3_01_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Ser Galahad has informed me that Corruption has claimed <g id="female_gestureleft" priority="high" />the Manor as well.
99b_yonas_p3_02: <g id="female_nodyes" />If you can defeat their Commander, it will weaken the Corrupted's hold here.
99b_yonas_p5_01_a: <g id="female_nodding" />The ranger already scouted the extent of the territory the Corrupted have claimed.
99b_yonas_p5_01_b: <g id="male_convince02" />She believes their only goal is to collect resources for their war machine, <g id="male_think" />but I suspect a more sinister purpose.
99b_yonas_p6_01_a: <g id="male_hopeless" />In my most dire estimations, <g Id="female_disappointed" priority="high"/>I could not have imagined how desperate the situation has become.
99b_yonas_p6_01_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />A few years ago, the Great Cleave was quiet, safe. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" bout="1.5"/>But now the Corrupted appear to have total dominion.
99b_yonas_p6_02: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I am going to focus every moment on recruiting new Soulwardens. One thing is certain - we cannot do this alone.
99b_yonas_p7_01_a: <g id="male_bowShallow" />Welcome back, Warden. <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />If I had known the difficulty in claiming the fortress, I might've thought twice.
99b_yonas_p7_01_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />However, I understand it was Umberto's actions that cursed these grounds, <g id="female_spreadarms" />and somehow he was the last one standing?
99b_yonas_p7_02: If this works, I think we'll have a fine fortress for the new Order.
99b_yonas_p8_01_a: <g id="female_gestureforward02" />You, on the other hand, have no such luxury. <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />You've been quiet, but I can tell the voice of the Tempest still speaks to you.
99b_yonas_p8_01_b: <g id="male_concernS" />You are connected through the Pure Azoth you were exposed to, and <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Corruption's drive to claim it.
99b_yonas_p8_02: More and more brave young souls join our ranks each day.We may yet return to the numbers we had so long ago.
99c_msq_01_corpsecronejournal_descriptio: This journal seems to document the experiments of the Corpse Crone.
99c_msq_01_periville_completion_a: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakehead" priority="high" />I hope you had better luck than I, my friend. The legacy of the Corpse Crone <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />seems to have claimed every town in this region.
99c_msq_01_periville_completion_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />The only thing I've learned about Ser Brytmar is that <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />she departed from this area in some haste.
99c_msq_01_periville_completion_next_a: <g id="g_male_complimentplayer" />You found the Crone's grimoire? Quite an important clue! <g id="male_think" />Filled with records of her vile conjurations, no doubt.
99c_msq_01_periville_completion_next_b: <g id="female_takeItem5s" priority="low" />But if it makes mention of Brytmar, then I should<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> very much like to study it further.
99c_msq_01_periville_desc: Find any information pertaining to the whereabouts of the Corpse Crone.
99c_msq_01_periville_gotopoi: Search Periville for any information on the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_01_periville_incomplete: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Light be with you in Periville. I'll meet you outside of Karburg later.
99c_msq_01_periville_interactcoffin: Follow the trail of the Corpse Crone's victims
99c_msq_01_periville_proposal_a: <g id="male_explain" />Careful not to give too much credit to the Azoth Tree - <g id="male_shakehead" />nature here does not always align with humanity's best interests.
99c_msq_01_periville_proposal_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />If she exists, I suspect, however, the Corpse Crone may be <g id="female_nodyes" />hiding secrets of significant power.
99c_msq_01_periville_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />There's a stalwart knight named Ser Brytmar <g id="male_converseleft" />who once protected the Fen - if she remains, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I shall request her aid in this venture.
99c_msq_01_periville_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_think" />Meanwhile, the Crone's curse began in Periville so I suggest you search there. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Do be careful.
99c_msq_01_periville_readlore: Search for information on the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_01_periville_readlore2: Search for more journal pages from the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_01_periville_readwantednote: Look at the Wanted Poster for the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_01_periville_takejournal: Bring the Corpse Crone's journal back to Galahad
99c_msq_02_karburg_cinematic_01: I heard you were looking for me.
99c_msq_02_karburg_cinematic_02: Yes. We won’t allow you to profane this place with your foul sorcery, witch!
99c_msq_02_karburg_cinematic_03: Enough! I don't have time for your ignorance!
99c_msq_02_karburg_completion_a: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />Hmmph! This journal tells more lies than truths! <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I simply cannot believe Brytmar would support this foul sorcery!
99c_msq_02_karburg_completion_b: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />What did you learn in Karburg? Did the Hunters manage to apprehend the Crone?
99c_msq_02_karburg_completion_next_a: <g id="male_shocked" />She cursed an entire town? Such power <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />rivals the magic of even Myrddin himself!
99c_msq_02_karburg_completion_next_b: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Perhaps that explains Brytmar as well… yes, surely the Crone had ensorcelled my brave friend. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />That must be it.
99c_msq_02_karburg_desc: Discover what the Corpse Crone did to Karburg.
99c_msq_02_karburg_gotopoi: Travel to Karburg to find the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_02_karburg_incomplete: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />If there are clues to Brytmar's fate in this journal, I will find them.
99c_msq_02_karburg_isabella_whisper: This is the sad fate of humankind on this island. All of us, everyone, doomed to lose their souls. That is why we fight.
99c_msq_02_karburg_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Perhaps. I've just come from searching Brytmar's home there. <g id="male_darnit" priority="high"/>The Crone's curse swept through Karburg like a hurricane.
99c_msq_02_karburg_proposal_b: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high"/>It appears the entire town fell Lost in hours, and the curse <g id="female_nodyes" />still haunts the streets like a contagion.
99c_msq_02_karburg_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Very well. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I should spend time studying this journal for clues to the Crone's fate and <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />that of the brave and loyal Brytmar.
99c_msq_02_karburg_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_compliment" />Learn what you can in Karburg and then meet me on the town's outskirts. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Light be with you, Warden.
99c_msq_02_karburg_waveevent: Search for the source of the curse
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_bridgetrigger1: Find a way onto the bridge
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_bridgetrigger3: Continue to climb up Vega Bridge
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_completion_a: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />The fact this rank stack of hovels stands as the last safe place in the Fen is <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />testament to the Crone's evil legacy.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_completion_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Like Pennyfather, many here refuse to speak her name aloud… <g id="male_shakehead" />nor do they have word of Ser Brytmar.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_completion_next: <g id="male_think" />Did she? Now that is encouraging… though it also disproves the theory my friend was ensorcelled.
<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> If Brytmar abandoned the Crone, she may have returned to Hinbrucken in the southern marshes. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I shall check there next.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_desc: Follow the Corpse Crone's studies on the Vega Bridge.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_gracechest_resp: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />After you left Caer Dun, that alchemist suggested you might need help, <g id="grace_yes" />tracking down the Crone and all.
<g id="grace_convince2" />Of course, she also mentioned treasure in these ruins... and here we are, a bit of both <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />if we can get this chest open.
<g id="grace_think" />Did she? Well then, I'm willing to bet she was after whatever's in this chest.
<g id="grace_secret" priority="high"/>If you can figure the lock, we'll find something inside, probably something worth some coin.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_graceempty_prom: "It's a clue, but no clear direction."
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_graceempty_resp: <g id="grace_throwarms" priority="high"/>Nothing but a mouldy piece of paper? Is that all? This swamp really is cursed.
<g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />I suppose that's the kinda clue you were looking for though, isn't it? Does it tell you where to search next?
<g id="grace_disapprove" />Well, Twillen isn't so much a town as a pile of wooden planks over the muck, but there's <g id="grace_yes" />a tavern there, at least.
<g id="grace_think" />I'd ask around. Someone in Twillen knows what became of the Crone. I'd bet my boots on it.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_incomplete: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />I refuse to believe Brytmar capable of conspiring with such evil.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_interact_inn: (Optional) Check in at the Inn in Twillen
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_open_container: Find a way to open the Ancient Chest
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />If the journal is to be believed, the Crone spent centuries <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />studying the Ancient ruins in the Fen.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />That is undoubtedly where she acquired her power. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />The last entry makes specific mention of the ruins at Vega Bridge.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />That makes sense. I hope you find answers. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I hope we learn the Crone ultimately faced justice for what she did.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_gestureforwardlefthand" />I will go on to Twillen and inquire about both Brytmar and the Crone - <g id="male_bowShallow" />I'll await you there.
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_readlore1: Read another journal page of the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_03_ancientbridge_talk_graceomall: Talk to Grace O'Malley about the bridge
Talk to Grace O'Malley about the empty chest
99c_msq_04_settlement01_completion_a: <g id="female_flirtSmall" />Well, hello there! What brings you around these parts? Most people have better places to be than Weaver's Fen.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_completion_b: <g id="female_explains" />But for some of us, it's a safe refuge, a place where we can be who we want and live how we want.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_completion_next2: <g id="male_explain" />Despite what others may say, the Corpse Crone doesn't want to turn everyone Lost.
<g id="female_wavehandpshaw" />She doesn't snatch people up in the night, or do anything they don't ask for.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_completion_next_: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Oh? Not to harm her, I hope! You should know the Crone's quite capable of defending herself...
<g id="female_leanpointConvince" />She's not a monster you know. For those in need, the Crone <g id="male_nodunderstand" />has been known to help.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_desc: Ask the citizens of Twillen about the Corpse Crone to pick up her trail.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_fritzconversatio: How dare you speak the name of that hideous fiend! She twisted the land and turned the living into Lost.
We are still burdened by the tyranny of her evil magic, and the best we can do is try to forget it.
She's still out there, lurking in the bog, taking anyone she finds back to her foul lair and stealing their souls!
Don't be a fool - many have sought vengeance against her… none have returned.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_gotopoi: Go to Twillen to ask citizens about the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_04_settlement01_incomplete: <g id="female_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Good luck getting straight answers from these people. You'll need it.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_proposal_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You should. Unfortunately, <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />many people lost faith in the knights during the Wars of Crimson Madness.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_proposal_b: <g id="male_compliment" />Your inquiries about the Corpse Crone may get more honest answers. <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Meantime, I'm off to Hinbrucken.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_ruxandraconversa: <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" priority="high" />Only the most foolish or desperate would seek out the old sorceress of the swamp. I wonder... which are you?
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Hmm, if anyone around here knows how to find the Crone, <g id="male_secretiveshort" />it would be Bella Ruby, but I didn't tell you that.
99c_msq_04_settlement01_start_prompt: "I should ask around town as well."
99c_msq_04_settlement01_talktobella: Ask Bella Ruby about the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_04_settlement01_talktofritz: Ask Fritz Cromer about the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_04_settlement01_talktoruxandra: Ask Ruxandra cel Rau about the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_completion_a: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />At first, I didn't recognize her, and even now I doubt my eyes. <g id="male_shakehead" />She is much changed, but there can be no doubt.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_completion_b: <g id="male_pointLeft" priority="high"/>That's the enchantress Morgaine... sister to Myrddin, the Crimson Sorcerer... and <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />traitor to my lord king!
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_completion_next_: <g id="male_quidproquo" /> No, Morgaine vanished during the Wars of Crimson Madness, just like Myrrdin and the High King himself.
<g id="male_lookLeft" priority="high" />This Corpse Crone business is now a lesser concern - <g id="female_nodyes" />she has far more important questions to answer.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_completion_promp: "And you had no idea she was here?"
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_corpsecrone_resp: Yes, one of many names I've been called. The Witch of Weaver's Fen, Swamp Sorceress, Corpse Crone... the list goes on.
Ironically, no one even knows me by my given name anymore… Brytmar was the last friend I had.
Oh no, tell me you're not with that damned righteous fool! Agh! What the hell is he doing here?
No, no! Your petition is denied! You can pound your head against this barrier all you want - we are done here!
It was tragic... and it was my fault. I thought I had finally found the perfect mixture. Brytmar insisted I test it on her rather than an unwilling subject…
We were the only two left from Camelot after the Wars… now I'm alone.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_desc: Follow the Marsh Lights to find the Corpse Crone's location.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_fight_serbrytmar: Defeat Ser Brytmar to reach the cave
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_incomplete: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Whatever your purpose in seeking the Corpse Crone, I hope she aids you as she did me.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_interacttorches: Follow the light of the torches to petition the Crone
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_proposal_a: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />No, but people need someone to blame for their misery, and <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />they'll choose the easiest target.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />To petition the Crone, follow the trail of torches on the south road… and <g id="male_nodunderstand" />be respectful! She has <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />no patience for fools.
99c_msq_05_findmorgaine_trigger: Get closer to the Corpse Crone
99c_msq_06_isabella_whisper: This miserable fen is a place I would not wish on my worst enemy. Come away, and join me in brighter lands.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_completion_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Morgaine went to great lengths to protect her solitude… <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />those anchors were farther than expected, but <g id="male_pointLeft" priority="high" />this barrier must come down.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_completion_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Though I goaded her into some dialogue, <g id="male_shakehead" />she's now back to ignoring me.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_completion_next_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Yes, and though she was<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> not very forthcoming, her account of what happened during the Wars of Crimson Madness <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />does make some sense.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_completion_next_b: <g id="female_disappointed" />I still have no answers to the fate of Artorius, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but I have learned to live with that for now.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_desc: Destroy the Arcane Anchors Morgaine uses to power the barrier at her cave.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_destroylost: Remove any Lost that would power up the devices
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_incomplete: <g id="male_pointBlame" />Quickly now! We must destroy the anchors before she can strengthen the wards.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Indeed. Nothing could be more important! <g id="male_pointLeft" priority="high" />She believes she's safe behind this barrier, but <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I know her secrets.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Myrddin used wards like this on his sanctum, and there's a way <g id="female_smackfist" />to break through them.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />There will be anchors scattered around the swamp - destroy those and we can confront her.
99c_msq_06_witchmagic_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_lookLeft" priority="high" />I will remain here and ensure Morgaine doesn't escape and vanish again. <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />This time, she will answer for what she's done.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_completion_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />So you see now that I have neither insight nor responsibility in whatever fate befell the High King.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_completion_b: <g id="male_guiltylookside" priority="high" />As to my part in my brother's fall, I have spent every moment making amends… preparing <g id="female_smackfist" />for Corruption's eventual return.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_completion_nex: <g id="female_shocked" />No! That, th-that… cannot be. I would know… <g id="male_darnit" priority="high" />I have been holed up in this cave for… well, for a long time.
<g id="female_thinking" /> I will need to verify this for myself, of course, but if you speak the truth, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />then I have gravely miscalculated.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_desc: Travel through the barrier at Morgaine's cave, tell her about your vision, and learn about Morgaine's past.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_incomplete: <g id="male_shakehead" />If even half of what she claims is true, then <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />things are far different than I imagined.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_proposal_a: <g id="male_hopeless" />I would hardly call it a confession! She has an explanation for <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />everything, of course, as she always did.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_proposal_b: <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />Moreover, I question the veracity of some of her claims - <g id="male_compliment" />you must interrogate her as well.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_proposal_next_: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> With the anchors destroyed, the barrier should be weakened, and <g id="male_converseright" />your staff can likely dispel it.
<g id="male_dismissregal" priority="high"/>Go on and hear Morgaine's explanations for yourself… <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll await you in Twillen. I've heard enough for today.
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_vision_prompt_: "Can you tell me what you know?"
99c_msq_07_destroybarrier_vision_respons: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />That's for the best… <g id="male_willcoverit" />we can have a more reasonable discussion. Galahad cannot accept that some questions <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />have no answers.
<g id="male_realize" />I watched Myrddin's fall to Corruption firsthand… <g id="male_pointBlame" />I know the Crimson Menace does not play by the rules.
<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />I'm afraid that would take several lifetimes, and <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'm quite busy at the present moment.

<g id="male_secretiveshort" />If you wish to hear my account of the Wars and the events that led to my unfortunate reputation… <g id="female_gestureForward02" />I've written it down just there. Go on.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_completion_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ah, perfect. Among these ruins,<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" /> there are sources of power the Ancients learned to manipulate.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_completion_b: <g id="male_explain" />Of most concern, the wells of pure Azoth - <g id="female_nodyes" />Myrddin became obsessed with hoarding as much as he could.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_completion_next_: <g id="male_shocked" />The Tempest? Is that the champion <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Corruption has chosen in this era? We shall have to learn everything we can about her.
<g id="male_pointBlame" />Wait, wait… you have that look. Does the Tempest speak in your mind? <g id="female_nodyes" />Myrddin had such power, as well.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_completion_promp: "The Tempest… she seeks it as well.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_convincegalahad_: "Yes, we need her on our side."
<g id="female_nodyes" />Very well. Learn what you can from Morgaine, and perhaps <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />convince her to join us at Caer Dun.
<g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I shall return to the fortress now to consult with Yonas on military strategy. <g id="male_willcoverit" />That's where I belong. Light be with you, Warden.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_desc: Convince Galahad that Morgaine's help is necessary before meeting Morgaine at Canopus.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_incomplete: <g id="female_nodyes" />I hope time has made Galahad more reasonable.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_proposal_a: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Well, of course they do! It would be a shame if I spent all this time and could offer <g id="male_shrugBrief" />no value to them.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_proposal_b: <g id="female_thinking" /> Wait… you're a Soulwarden? I thought the Order perished… <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />nevermind, we'll need all the help we can get.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Yes well, I'll leave that to you.<g id="female_pointRight" /> I must visit the ruins to the northeast and verify <g id="female_nodyes" />the sources of power there have not fallen to Corruption.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Go after Galahad if you must, but then meet me<g id="female_pointRight" /> in the ruins of Canopus. I'll need <g id="female_nodyes" />your help.
99c_msq_08_settlement02_talk_galahad: Convince Galahad Morgaine's help is necessary
99c_msq_08_settlement02_trigger_twillen: Return to Twillen to speak with Galahad
99c_msq_09_canopus_completion_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You handled that quickly and without complaint. It's been a long time since I partnered with someone so… competent.
99c_msq_09_canopus_completion_b: <g id="male_think" /> People disappoint - it's an unfortunate fact of nature. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Only time will prove if you're an exception.
99c_msq_09_canopus_defeatancients: Power the Ancient Shield Devices by defeating {targetName}
99c_msq_09_canopus_desc: Collect Ancient Shield Devices for Morgaine and meet her at the Ancient Device in Andrometus.
99c_msq_09_canopus_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />There should be several shield devices around Canopus. If they aren't charged, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />you can siphon energy from the Ancient Guardians.
99c_msq_09_canopus_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes. The fountain of pure Azoth at this ruin dried long ago, <g id="female_youknow" />but its residual power remains in the waters and in the Guardians who protect the site.
99c_msq_09_canopus_proposal_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />We must harness that power to <g id="female_nodyes" />recharge an Ancient warding apparatus nearby.
99c_msq_09_canopus_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />Years ago, I placed shield devices to absorb the power here. If they aren't fully charged, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />you can siphon energy from the Guardians.
99c_msq_09_canopus_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_handheart" />I must go on to Andrometus, so once you have the devices, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />meet me there.
99c_msq_09_poweredshields_description: These ancient shields are fully charged and ready to be used by Morgaine.
99c_msq_09_unpoweredshields_description: These ancient shields have been modified by Morgaine, but they lack power.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_chest_trigger: Venture into {POITags} to check the Wards
99c_msq_10_andrometus_completion_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Hm. Twice now, you solved problems without coming back to whine about some complication.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_completion_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Was there some entity that had been entrapped in the wards?
99c_msq_10_andrometus_completion_next_a: <g id="male_think" />That's strange. I can't imagine why an elemental being would trigger Ancient wards… is that a specimen you collected?
99c_msq_10_andrometus_completion_next_b: <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high"/>Let's see… hm, the creature appears to have become Blighted with some strange infection.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_desc: Explore Andrometus to discover what has been imprisoned there.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_haveblightjar: Recover a Blight sample to bring back to Morgaine
99c_msq_10_andrometus_incomplete: Whatever's causing the fault in the eldritch boundaries, it must be remedied.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_killfinalwave: Defeat {targetName} to recover a Blight Sample
99c_msq_10_andrometus_proposal_a: <g id="female_chuckle" />A glutton for danger, are you? <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I hope you have some measure of restraint… but at the moment, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I'll take the bravado.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_proposal_b: <g id="male_realize" />The fault could be caused by a threat the wards identified and contained.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_proposal_next_a: <g id="male_quidproquo" />Well, if I knew that, I'd have said so. If that does prove to be the case - <g id="male_realize" />if some entity has been entrapped, it will need to be released.
99c_msq_10_andrometus_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />So that courage could very well <g id="female_nodyes" />come in handy! Good luck!
99c_msq_10_bottledblight_description: Strange green goo that oozed out of Fulgoris.
99c_msq_11_lepus_adianablight_response_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />The repugnant incursion of Corruption caused this Blight, <g id="female_nodyes" />but that's what happens when humans traffick in forbidden power.
99c_msq_11_lepus_adianablight_response_b: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />Of course, your curiosity demands you see for yourself… go on then.
99c_msq_11_lepus_adianablight_response_n: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />There's no menacing demon, if that's what you fear, rather just the <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />tragic, polluted remnant of what once was a sacred pool.
<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />I have seen this too many times at this point. I will endure no more.
99c_msq_11_lepus_completion_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />I can tell from here that the ruin and the Angry Earth who resided there are riddled with the Blight.
99c_msq_11_lepus_completion_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Let me guess - the Azoth fountain within had been claimed by the Corrupted, by the Tempest?
99c_msq_11_lepus_completion_next_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Recharging the wards proved impossible - <g id="female_nodyes" />so I knew the Corrupted must have already come and gone.
99c_msq_11_lepus_completion_next_b: <g id="male_think" />I once theorized the Angry Earth could have a reaction to the Corrupted. <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Horrid as it appears, I find this Blight fascinating.
99c_msq_11_lepus_desc: Follow the trail of Blight back to its Source for Morgaine.
99c_msq_11_lepus_exit: Report back to Morgaine on the source of the Blight
99c_msq_11_lepus_followblight: Follow the trail of Green Blight
99c_msq_11_lepus_followblight1: Follow the trail of Green Blight
99c_msq_11_lepus_followblight2: Find the Source of the Blight
99c_msq_11_lepus_incomplete: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" />Having second thoughts? If you want me to come with you, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />you'll have to wait some time.
99c_msq_11_lepus_isabella_whisper: Nature is not our ally, never question that, or you will pay for your ignorance. Together, we shall overcome.
99c_msq_11_lepus_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodding" />Yes, yes, yes. That adventurous spirit is definitely your weak spot, but once again, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />I'll take full advantage.
99c_msq_11_lepus_proposal_b: <g id="male_handheart" />I'll work on the wards while you track this... Blight back to its source. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Do be careful.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_a: <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Welcome home, young one. We have made strides while you were away. <g id="female_nodyes" />Many new souls joined our ranks.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Ser Galahad tells me the Corpse Crone was revealed to be none other than <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />the sorceress Morgaine.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_new_a: I am grateful<g id="male_bowShallow" /> to have you returned, Soulwarden.<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> Hasty decisions have been made, and we need your insight.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_new_b: But I know you've just returned<g id="female_youknow" /> from the Fen - has Morgaine agreed to join our cause?
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_new_prompt: "Yes, she will come here in time."
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next2_a: <g id="male_think" />That explains it. He threatens you by name, accusing you of betrayal, thievery, cowardice… and the list goes on… <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />he's furious about "his box."
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next2_b: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Some of the new wardens say they've seen him rallying the Corrupted forces in Great Cleave.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next2_new_a: He's been gone<g id="male_explain" /> for some time now. I had asked him to wait, but he refused.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next2_new_b: He had become<g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" /> deeply suspicious about the enemy's activities to the north, convinced they plotted some terrible campaign.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next_a: That<g id="g_male_headnodyes" /> is good… I think. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'm afraid I have less inspiring tidings for you.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next_b: <g id="male_itemGiveRight" priority="high" />We've received a dispatch from a warlord among the Corrupted who knows you personally… <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Captain Thorpe, I believe is the name.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next_new_a: I shall endeavor to put<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> aside my grievances against the sorceress,<g id="female_explainS" /> our circumstances demand it.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_next_new_b: I apologize<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> for my abrupt departure. I hoped to strategize with Yonas, but he was already quite set on a plan of his own making.
99c_msq_12_vector_completion_prompt2: "Yes. I came here aboard his ship."
99c_msq_12_vector_desc: Travel back to Caer Dun to bring Yonas news from Morgaine.
99c_msq_12_vector_gotopoi: Travel back to Caer Dun to bring news from Morgaine
99c_msq_12_vector_incomplete: I hope we are not too late in our efforts to combat the Corrupted.
99c_msq_12_vector_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodding" />Yes, of course, your fellow Soulwardens! <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />It will be critical that we strike back against the Corrupted with both a martial <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and a magical strategy.
99c_msq_12_vector_proposal_b: <g id="male_realize" />Tell me - where are you and your allies based? I will meet you there.
99c_msq_12_vector_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_notsure" />I do not know this place, but after I study the Blight, <g id="female_nodyes" />I will find Caer Dun and bring my equipment with me.
99c_msq_12_vector_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have impressed me at every turn, you know. This could be a promising partnership.
99c_msq_12_vector_useshrine: (Optional) Use a Spirit Shrine to travel to Caer Dun
99c_p1_adiana_00: This land cries out in pain. <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" />If you cannot hear it, it's because you have made yourself deaf to its cries.
99c_p1_adiana_01_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Once again, we meet on sacred grounds rendered sickly by an insatiable thirst for power.
99c_p1_adiana_01_b: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />You should go. This time, there is no way to heal the land of the wounds inflicted by human ego.
99c_p1_adiana_02: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />Satisfy your curiosity and leave, if you value your soul. This Blight is as detrimental to you as Corruption itself.
99c_p1_bellaruby_00_a: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />Whatever brought you to the Fen, I'm confident it probably isn't a pleasant thing.
99c_p1_bellaruby_00_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Don't believe everyone's tales of woe, however. There is a way to live here and be happy.
99c_p1_bellaruby_01_a: <g id="female_flirtSmall" />Well, hello there! What brings you around these parts? Most people have better places to be than Weaver's Fen.
99c_p1_bellaruby_01_b: <g id="female_explains" />But for some of us, it's a safe refuge, a place where we can be who we want and live how we want.
99c_p1_bellaruby_02_a: <g id="female_youknows" />I sought the Crone myself at one point. <g id="male_willcoverit" />You see, I was struggling with my identity... Who I am inside, and <g id="male_nodunderstand" />she helped me.
99c_p1_bellaruby_02_b: <g id="male_clasphandsgrateful" /> She gave me these wonderful medicines, and now <g id="male_handheart" />everyone sees me in the way I see myself.
99c_p1_bellaruby_03: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Take care on the southern road. The Crone may have a kind soul buried under her gruff exterior, but the Lost do not.
99c_p1_fritzcromer_00_a: Hope you didn’t come here, wanting a meal. It’s a dreadful stinking bog that resists every effort to make decent farmland.
99c_p1_fritzcromer_00_b: Eat the plants from these fields and you’ll be in the privy for a week.
99c_p1_fritzcromer_01_a: What drags you into the vile waters of Weaver's Fen, traveler?
99c_p1_fritzcromer_01_b: Bilge and bastards, that's all you'll find here… anyone who could leave this place has left long since.
99c_p1_fritzcromer_02: I have nothing more to say to you, traveler. Leave here while you can.
99c_p1_galahad_00: <g id="male_shakehead" />The Fens are a wretched place. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Though we strive to bring light where we can, <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />this is one territory that may not be worth the effort.
99c_p1_galahad_01_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />We've come this far, and discovering the truth <g id="male_nodunderstand" />about the source of the Lost plague seems wise.
99c_p1_galahad_01_b: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> But there's a great deal of ground to cover, and little time, if the Corrupted are as strong as they seem.
99c_p1_graceomalley_00: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Hoped I might bump into you out here. <g id="grace_disappointed" priority="high" />Been searching this miserable swamp with nary a friend nor a bit of treasure to sustain me.
99c_p1_graceomalley_01_a: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Well now, your timing's as fickle as the tides! It sure would've been nice <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />if you had shown up before I spent six hours trying this myself.
99c_p1_graceomalley_01_b: <g id="grace_gestureBehind" priority="high"/>This chest is locked by some puzzle, and that's <g id="grace_secret" priority="high"/>really more your thing than mine.
99c_p1_graceomalley_02: <g id="grace_crossarms" priority="high"/>Just because we have all eternity here, it doesn't mean we need to be dawdling about, you know.
99c_p1_graceomalley_03: <g id="grace_excited2" />So, did you find anything inside? I always fancied a crown for myself, one of those big jewel-studded affairs.
99c_p1_graceomalley_04_a: <g id="grace_disappointed" priority="high" />Well, this venture wasn't as profitable as I hoped, and the smell… I'm about done with this swamp.
99c_p1_graceomalley_04_b: <g id="grace_bowHead" priority="high" />Good luck finding the old crone, and when you do, <g id="grace_yes" />be careful.
99c_p1_morgaine_00: <g id="male_spreadarms001" /> Hm. Do you have a delivery for me? No? <g id="male_dismissGetLost2" priority="high" />Then spare me your presence, I have no patience for it.
99c_p1_morgaine_01_a: Hm. You followed the lights, so you must want something.
99c_p1_morgaine_01_b: Judging by your appearance, however, I'm guessing it's not a friendly visit over a cup of tea.
99c_p1_morgaine_02_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I'm impressed - I felt quite assured no one had both the perception and the prowess to bring down my barrier.
99c_p1_morgaine_02_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />But where is the most holy knight? Perhaps after cooling down, <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />he remembered his steel is no match for my sorcery?
99c_p1_morgaine_03: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />Read the book. I have no time for questions from those who refuse to read.
99c_p1_morgaine_04_a: <g id="female_youknow" />Some people believe Corruption is mankind's inherent evil in its purest form, and others <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />that it's some kind of demonic possession.
99c_p1_morgaine_04_b: <g id="male_pointBlame" />It's far more complex, however. I should know. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I've spent centuries studying it.
99c_p1_ruxandracelrau_00_a: <g id="female_outfitproud" priority="high" />The Weavers of the Fen make the finest garments in all Aeternum.
99c_p1_ruxandracelrau_00_b: <g id="male_handheart" />If you see something you like in the marketplace, it was probably crafted by us.
99c_p1_ruxandracelrau_01_a: <g id="male_handheart" />Dismal as it is here, the weavers of the Fen still honor the old ways - we welcome you as an honored guest.
99c_p1_ruxandracelrau_01_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Our numbers are few now, <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />but if there is anything that will enhance your visit, just let it be known.
99c_p1_ruxandracelrau_02: <g id="female_nodding" /> If you have questions about the history of weaving in the fen, I can answer them. That is my expertise.
99c_p1_yonas_00: <g id="male_think" />Have you found the meaning behind your vision? These things can take time to figure out.
99c_p1_yonas_01: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Every day we make a little more progress. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I only hope it is enough.
99c_p1_yonas_02_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" /> It seems this Thorpe has moved up the ranks of the Corrupted quickly <g id="male_nodunderstand" /> to become a Commander.
99c_p1_yonas_02_b: He's claimed a stronghold and challenges <g id="male_pointBlame" />you to come and face him there.
99c_p2_galahad_02_a: <g id="male_explain" />Though the Bright Vigil never came this far east, it seems there were those who sought <g id="male_clenchfistright" />to hold the Crone accountable for her crimes.
99c_p2_galahad_02_b: <g id="female_pointRight" />I presume you saw the posters? These shadow hunters <g id="male_nodunderstand" />gathered in Karburg.
99c_p2_galahad_03_a: <g id="male_realize" />The only place that hasn't fallen Lost in this dreadful swamp is <g id="male_gestureforwardlefthand" /> the ramshackle settlement of Twillen.
99c_p2_galahad_03_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I should like to go there and inquire after Brytmar. <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />I cannot rest until I find an explanation for all this.
99c_p2_morgaine_05_a: <g id="female_whattheheck" />How could so much have transpired while I toiled in that cave? <g id="male_hanghead" />I feel a fool for sequestering myself so long!
99c_p2_morgaine_05_b: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />If this… Tempest is already amassing pure Azoth, then we are so far behind.
99c_p3_galahad_04_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" /> If Ser Brytmar were with us, we would have not only the benefit of her knowledge, but of<g id="female_nodyes" /> her patience and strategic thinking as well.
99c_p3_galahad_04_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Without her, we have only the <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />terrified and distrustful people of Twillen.
99c_p3_galahad_07_a: <g id="male_shakehead" />I'm still digesting the fact of Brytmar's fall and <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />the claims of Morgaine, which have some merit, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />in truth.
99c_p3_galahad_07_b: <g id="male_spreadhands" />She vexes me to no end, but I cannot dispute the insight she can lend to the cause of <g id="male_nodunderstand" />battling Corruption.
99c_p3_galahad_08: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Let us hope Yonas has managed to recruit more Soulwardens. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />We'll need them.
99c_p3_morgaine_06_a: <g id="female_gestureLeft" />This apparatus once powered Ancient wards for all these ruins, and <g id="female_nodyes" />recharging it will defend against the Corrupted.
99c_p3_morgaine_06_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />There's some kind of fault in the eldritch boundaries, however… <g id="male_apologizeSmall" />it may be impossible to repair.
99c_p3_morgaine_07_a: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I hope you took precautions gathering this sample… whatever Blighted this creature, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />we need to find the source of it.
99c_p3_morgaine_07_b: <g id="male_willcoverit" />After I recharge the wards, I will need to study this sample carefully and check the area for more.
99c_p4_galahad_05_a: <g id="male_darnit" priority="high"/>Dammit! Now it all makes sense! <g id="male_righthandangry" />That's why Ser Brytmar remained loyal to the bitter end!
99c_p4_galahad_05_b: <g id="female_thinking" /> But I still don't understand… we all believed Morgaine succumbed to the Crimson Madness along with her brother…
99c_p4_galahad_06_a: <g id="male_pointrealize" />Though she speaks coldly of Myrddin's fall, I detect some trace of sadness for the loss of her brother.
99c_p4_galahad_06_b: <g id="male_shakehead" priority="high" />But Morgaine is not blameless in what occurred then, nor the dark <g id="male_righthandAngry" bout=".5" />acts she committed as the Corpse Crone.
99c_p4_morgaine_08_a: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" priority="high" />I must return to my cave to examine this specimen of the Blight - <g id="female_nodyes" />it could lead to new defenses we could deploy against the Corrupted.
99c_p4_morgaine_08_b: <g id="female_tiltheadremember" priority="high" />And, then we'll need to secure whatever sources of pure Azoth remain.
99d_changzhen_00_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Hello {playerName}, I’m Zhen Chang, a Soulwarden assigned to Eastburn Outpost.
99d_changzhen_00_b: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />How are you liking the cold? I wish I had stayed home insteading of heading into this snowy waste.
99d_changzhen_01: <g id="male_lookaroundBored" priority="high" />If it's not one thing, it's another. No rest for the weary, friend. Not when there's work to be done.
99d_galahad_00: The road north is dangerous and filled with many pitfalls. I<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> advise you take some friends, it is not a place to go alone.
99d_galahad_01_a: Scouts from<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> Great Cleave reported the rise of some new, fell Commander within the ranks of the Corrupted.
99d_galahad_01_b: They had also witnessed enemy troops engaged<g id="female_explainS" /> in the preparation of siege equipment. Yonas felt action was demanded.
99d_galahad_02_a: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />I managed to recover but a few crates of supplies - I am glad to see you<g id="male_leanforwardInspect" /> met with greater success, and repaired the cart as well!
99d_galahad_02_b: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Now, there's just the matter<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> of the unfortunate scouts who fell to ambush.
99d_galahad_03: I do wish<g id="male_lookupSmall" /> Yonas had listened to my counsel. We might've avoided this.
99d_galahad_04: Any moment now, I fear<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> we'll see an army of the Corrupted marching this way. We can't afford to sit and wait for them.
99d_galahad_05_a: Our discovery<g id="male_gestureHereweare" /> may in fact be tied to what you learned in the ruins.<g id="female_explainS" /> We stumbled upon a massive mining operation in the canyon to the west.
99d_galahad_05_b: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />We assumed they sought more pure Azoth, but<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> this operation is too large.
99d_galahad_06: If we can disable<g id="female_smackfist" /> the Corrupted operations in the canyon, we must then look to push further north.
99d_galahad_07: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Yonas is rather cross with me, but<g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" /> I stand by my decision. We have a chance to establish a foothold in this region,<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> and we cannot afford to squander it.
99d_galahad_08_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I know Yonas is displeased with my decision<g id="female_explainS" /> to scout the western outpost, but I stand by it.
99d_galahad_08_b: <g id="male_nodMild" />We have a chance to establish<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> a foothold in this region, and we should make an effort to take advantage of it.
99d_galahad_09: Lead on, Soulwarden! Let's break<g id="female_leftfistThreaten" /> through this barricade, find Warden Yash, and secure a new position from where we can strike back against the crimson menace.
99d_galahad_10: The outpost is ours, and if we can secure it, we<g id="female_nodConsider" /> might be able to stage sorties from here to the Crimson mountain itself.
99d_galahad_11_a: <g id="female_gestureLeftS" />We left some Wardens to maintain the eastern outpost,<g id="female_explainS" /> but brought most of the others here. Warden Yash was<g id="male_chuckle" /> quite proud to be the one to secure the location.
99d_galahad_11_b: It seems<g id="male_laugh" /> he never even realized he had become cut off.
99d_galahad_12_a: Excellent<g id="male_salute2FingersFast" /> to see you, Soulwarden.<g id="female_explainS" /> I heard of your success before I departed, and that's part of why I'm here.
99d_galahad_12_b: We must not<g id="male_spreadhands" /> let our victories spoil us, and after the gains in Great Cleave,<g id="male_convince02" /> we must fortify our positions.
99d_galahad_13: With luck, and<g id="male_lookUpAround" /> a little work, we'll<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> have this fortress more secure than ever in no time at all.
99d_grace_00: It's a bit too cold up here for liking. Give<g id="grace_spreadarms" /> me the warm rains of Ireland any day!
99d_grace_01_a: Well, look at you, straight<g id="grace_bow" /> back from deep behind enemy lines with a hard-fought victory -<g id="grace_gestureRLow" /> and you killed that bastard Captain of yours, no less.
99d_grace_01_b: I<g id="grace_gestureAround" /> know there was sacrifice, but all-in-all, I'd call this a lucky day.
99d_grace_02: Did<g id="grace_shrugDontknow" /> you find what you need among the supplies?
99d_grace_03_a: Now<g id="grace_cajole" /> that we got the old man all sorted out, we have other matters to discuss.
99d_grace_03_b: Your friend Morgaine came to Caer Dun and<g id="grace_think" /> stirred up a hornet's nest of debate. She and Alchemist Sun have very different ideas about things.
99d_isabella_whisper_01: You see the brilliance of our plans…? There is time yet for you to join the side of righteousness.
99d_isabella_whisper_01_sub01: You see the brilliance of our plans…?
99d_isabella_whisper_01_sub02: There is time yet for you to join the side of righteousness.
99d_isabella_whisper_02: And who is the destroyer now? I seek to create! Your former captain is only one such project! Go, then. Test yourself on him.
99d_isabella_whisper_02_sub01: And who is the destroyer now?
99d_isabella_whisper_02_sub02: I seek to create! Your former captain is only one such project!
99d_isabella_whisper_02_sub03: Go, then. Test yourself on him.
99d_isabella_whisper_03: “And so shall lies be tested, like flaws in a sword." He was... unworthy. Truly, it should've been you at my side.
99d_isabella_whisper_03_sub01: “And so shall lies be tested, like flaws in a sword.”
99d_isabella_whisper_03_sub02: He was... unworthy. Truly, it should've been you at my side.
99d_jacquetdavy_00: I feel guilty getting here when so many others did not.
99d_jacquetdavy_01: I turned around and it was too late, half my group had already been captured. My only chance to help them was to push on and get reinforcements.
99d_jacquetdavy_02: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />When I saw the others fall, it just sapped the last hope from me.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> I can't fight my former friends… I would rather… give up.<g id="female_youknowS" /> Tell me you understand.
99d_jacquetdavy_03: Lead on. My resolve is restored. I won't let the past get in the way of the present.
99d_jacquetdavy_04: It hasn't been easy, what we have done here. In Judithe's name we shall stay, and make sure it doesn't get any worse.
99d_juditheowens_00: How does it look out there? The Corrupted patrols keep coming by.

99d_ruins_thorpe_vonote:
The Ancients knew very well the power of Corruption far outstripped their own, but such gifts were reserved for humanity, and they brought only disaster upon themselves.

This is the hour long awaited, this is the moment we marshal the resources promised us...

and assume command of the greatest military force the world has ever known.
99d_thorpe_voicedlorenote_01:
Here I come full circle, from laboring in the mines on behalf of our mistress, to now being in command of the entire operation. 

I shall bring new purpose to this enterprise as well. To the mistress, the motes of that infernal Azoth, but to me, the materials to construct the designs of the Ancients. 

History will be made here in Great Cleave.
99d_thorpe_voicedlorenote_02:
The mistress is displeased with the fact we've found so little of the pure Azoth she seeks, but when I shared of our accomplishments towards my plan, I could see that I have once again proved to her that I am the one who can deliver this victory.

She's wisely committed even more of our forces to the cause. The ore flows like a river up to the summit. 

I will soon bask in the glory of my success.
99d_thorpe_voicedlorenote_03:
Isabella has now become extremely interested in our enterprise here in Great Cleave, and where I hoped to only construct a handful of the Felportals, she has expanded the plan to include many more.

The final stonework for our first structure at the summit nears completion, and I will now leave this operation to my lieutenants and ascend to ensure the rituals are planned to perfection. The strength and pride I feel for this work makes up for whatever regrets I may have for my time in the Old World.

This was my destiny all along.
99d_thorpe_voicedlorenote_04:
The priests tell me they have seen visions of the realm of Corruption, and though a hellscape it may be, I've come to see the truth of the Tempest's faith.

She says this is the birthright humanity was denied at the dawn of time, that the Ancients here expelled us from this Eden and planted the false mythologies in our minds to keep us in the dark.

The so-called Corruption is not some fiendish terror but rather the gift of godhead that we will now share across this island, and across the Earth.
99d_thorpe_voicedlorenote_05:
The time of confluence draws near. The portals are almost done. 

They have been placed all around the heights, and shall turn the land red with their glow. It will be glorious, a triumph of engineering and skill, of conquest and battle. 

We shall bring forth reinforcements that this land has never seen. At the highest point to the west shall we rise, and our power will flow out across the land in a crimson wave. 

Never again will we be lost, for we are united in our purpose.

99e_adiana_edengrove_shrine_1:
The forests of Edengrove are not places, they are entities in and of themselves, each speaking for its own, but with a shared voice.

Here, the lives of our walking brethren begin in the Garden, but like us, we draw our strength from a deeper well.

All the children are fed by the mother, their sustenance drawn from the river flowing from the one true source.
If a limb becomes infected, it must be severed to protect the source.

99e_galahad_p1_00_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />It was with great hesitation that I departed<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> from Caer Dun during a time of such critical preparation.
99e_galahad_p1_00_b: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />I can only hope Morgaine's theories lead us to something of<g id="male_shrugBrief" /> tremendous value to assist in our efforts.

99e_galahad_p1_02_b: Gods, why<g id="male_noway" /> is it always magic? Why not a sword, or a lever, or a simple secret door…
99e_galahad_p2_00: I'm no enchanter, but<g id="male_gestureRight" /> these designs do remind me of the gewgaws I saw in Myrddin's workshop centuries ago.<g id="female_explainS" /> Perhaps there's some truth to Morgaine's theory.
99e_galahad_p2_01_a: So that did… something?<g id="male_lookaroundSmall" /> Can never be too certain about how magic works, or doesn't. But it seems we did whatever was expected.
99e_galahad_p2_01_b: We should go<g id="male_nod2" /> find out if Morgaine has had any luck in the other tower.
99e_galahad_p3_02_a: I suppose, however, that<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> the floating tower is revealed, and it beckons to us.

99e_galahad_p4_00_a: I have stood on mountaintops and cliffs, looked out<g id="male_lookDown" /> over the land and sea... but this is far too unnatural for my taste.
99e_galahad_p4_00_b: I know I must be here,<g id="male_crossarmsNo" /> but I will be happier when my feet are planted firmly on the ground.
99e_isabella_whisper_01: Where were you just now...? Did you find a way to elude me? If so, it was only temporary. Our bond cannot be broken.
99e_isabella_whisper_02: I realize now that I have given you far too many opportunities to join me. The time for an alliance has passed. It will be war, and you will lose.

99e_isabella_whisper_04: A pity you cannot see through my eyes. I see banners of blue and gold, and fire. Glorious, beautiful fire.
99e_isabella_whisper_05: Oh and now a pity you cannot hear through my ears, the cries of pain, the pleas for mercy… the smashing of Heartgems…
