99e_morgaine_p10_00: I have seen this tower… was<g id="female_lookup" /> it in a dream? Or are we dreaming even now?
99e_morgaine_p10_03: My<g id="female_theseidiots" /> mind is racing with a battering of ideas and a plague of emotions. There is a way, and I will not leave until I find it!
99e_morgaine_p11_01: I have heard the news from Caer Dun, Soulwarden. I am sorry, so very sorry. We've all lost… lost too much, I think.
99e_morgaine_p1_00: So<g id="female_thinking" /> different from the Fen… everything here is so alive. Equally deadly, but in a different sort of way.
99e_morgaine_p2v1_00: I have a strange<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> feeling about this place, Soulwarden. It's as if Myrddin placed secrets here he intended for me to discover.
99e_morgaine_p2v1_01_a: Good work<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> in the ruins up there. If the Angry Earth were spawned after the first war with Corruption,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> they may well hold the secret to defeating it.
99e_morgaine_p2v1_01_b: I wonder if that's why Myrddin<g id="female_lookLeft" /> came to this region.
99e_morgaine_p2v2_00: I had forgotten how<g id="male_clutchhead02" /> exhausting it was dealing with my brother. I need to find an inn…
99e_morgaine_p2v2_01_a: I-I<g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" /> must've dozed off up there, by that swirling maelstrom of chaos that swallowed my brother.
99e_morgaine_p2v2_01_b: I<g id="male_lookUpAround" /> had a dream in which I was in Caer Dun, only it was burning…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> it was more of a nightmare, really.
99e_morgaine_p6_00: Lost for centuries, no<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> clue to your whereabouts… and now, a path to follow. I shall find you, brother.
99e_morgaine_p6_01_a: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />For years, I've looked for clues to Myrddin's fate, and only<g id="female_shocked" /> now do I discover this sanctum? I feel like a fool for not coming here sooner!
99e_morgaine_p6_01_b: There must be some clue in his words…<g id="female_gestureForward01" /> something about his research into sundering.
99e_morgaine_p7_00: My mind is spinning<g id="female_lookaroundConfused" /> from what we discovered in the crystal sanctum. I believe Myrddin left something for us, something that could prove very valuable.
99e_morgaine_p7_01_a: If my reasoning is accurate, and it usually is, I<g id="female_explainS" /> believe Myrddin may have unlocked the secret to the ritual of sundering.
99e_morgaine_p7_01_b: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />If this is true, and we can find whatever further<g id="male_agree1" /> secrets he left for us, this could change everything.
99e_morgaine_p8_00: <g id="female_smackfist" />I knew it! These glyphs<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> are the same as my brother left behind in his workshop. This has to be his handiwork. We are close, I can feel it.
99e_morgaine_p8_02_a: There was definitely a change in the energies here,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> but to what end, I know not.
99e_morgaine_p8_02_b: Come,<g id="female_beckon" /> we must look to the other towers, this cannot be the only piece of the puzzle.

Exactly,<g id="female_nodding" /> and that is what I will be working on.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> It seems the sorceress has become distracted with clues about her brother.

99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_igc_sun:
Behold, Edengrove; the jewel of Aeternum! Here is a land where nature still commands. 
It’s thorny, poisonous, and beautiful. You’ll never find in all the world such an abundance of peculiar flora. 
Speaking of peculiar, did you know the life cycle of the Angry Earth begins in Edengrove? 
I’ve been studying them for ages, but always from a distance. 
Now, I'm finally to the heart of the matter. 
They're key to defeating the Corrupted, I'm sure of it. 
There's a druid settlement nearby. They brokered a shaky truce with the Angry Earth in order to maintain a colony here. 
No small feat, that. The druids will point us to the answers we seek.

99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_morgaine_01_st: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />At last! How<g id="female_sighBigRelief" /> I have looked forward to finding you, Soulwarden!<g id="male_nodMild" /> I confirmed the Blight we saw in Weaver's Fen can resist Corruption!
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />But your allies at Caer Dun<g id="male_whocares" /> - especially that leaf-lover Sun Fuchun - refused to hear me out!
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_morgaine_01_ta: We need to know why the Varangians have come to Edengrove.<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> Go on.
Varangians,<g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" /> ruthless raiders who seek to amass all the island's magical artifacts. They often search Myrddin's old haunts.
If you'll investigate their camp to<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> the south, I'll wait and smooth out Sun's ruffled feathers.
Bah!<g id="male_dismissGetLost2" /> In crises, caution can be foolish, but I'm willing to humor her.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> I trust she'll be joining us? Fine.
Before we proceed, however, I've<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> discovered there are suspicious activities in this region, enemies of a different sort.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_morgaine_02_st: Heh!<g id="female_laughMed" /> You'll be glad to know Sun and I have settled our differences, and although my studies will be...<g id="female_gestureRightM" /> slowed somewhat, they will continue.
But you've returned from<g id="female_leftfistThreaten" /> the Varangians' camp! Tell me, what did you find?
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_morgaine_02_ta: So my brother<g id="female_crossarms" /> was here! I knew he ranged this far north, but I did not know he studied the Angry Earth!<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> This is quite a revelation!
I must<g id="female_takeitem" /> take these notes where I can study them more carefully… you should talk to Sun.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_murala_observe: Two Ancients, on opposite sides of a conflict.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_muralb_observe: Angry Earth warriors and... Corrupted? A green barrier divides them.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_muralc_observe: Three towers, surrounded by trees and floating rocks. Edengrove?
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_objective_desc: After a successful offensive in Great Cleave, the focus now turns to a more permanent solution for Corruption.\nTravel into Edengrove with Sun and Morgaine to search for knowledge, weapons, or allies that may help in the battle ahead.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_proposal_a: The Blight has only surfaced in recent years on Aeternum, while<g id="female_thosepeasants" /> clashes between the Angry Earth and Corruption have occurred for centuries.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_proposal_b: Most<g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" /> don't even realize that the Stormwall is an expression of the Angry Earth.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_proposal_next2: She rushes<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> ahead on the road to Edengrove, the heart of the Angry Earth's presence on Aeternum.
Please,<g id="male_agree1" /> catch her and get her to at least hear me out. I'll<g id="female_sighRelief" /> gather my things, and then join you on the road.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_proposal_next_: Everyone<g id="female_lookRight" /> thinks that, but the visible Corruption simply<g id="female_smackfist" /> strains against the barrier the Angry Earth manifested to keep it contained.
But what matters now<g id="female_youknow" /> is that Morgaine, and all of us, proceed with caution.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_sun_01_startta: There are countless<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> Ancient Ruins in Edengrove, most of them constructed before the Angry Earth came.
<g id="female_gestureLeftS" />But the terraces on these roads were built later, possibly<g id="female_explainS" /> even by humans who worshipped the Angry Earth.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_sun_01_talkto_: <g id="male_nodMild" />Yes, that is likely; there may even be<g id="female_lookLeft" /> glyphs in the stonework that will give us hints to the Angry Earth's origins.
Let us search, and if you find anything,<g id="female_headnodding" /> give a shout, and I will attempt to translate.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_sun_02_startta: Everything I've learned on Aeternum<g id="female_youknow" /> now needs to be reconsidered in this new light.
If these glyphs are truthful, the Angry<g id="male_dazed" /> Earth literally grew from the bones of dead Ancients… I confess I'm somewhat in shock.
99e_msq_01_enteredengrove_sun_02_talkto_: <g id="male_nodMild" />Yes, yes, we must. I caught a glimpse of an encampment<g id="female_pointLeft" /> down the road by the water. Perhaps Morgaine is there.
<g id="female_youknowS" />We should head there directly,<g id="female_nodConsider" /> if for no other reason than to have a safe place to consider what we've learned.

99e_msq_02_myrddin_vo_clue2: Words are but vessels. Prisons of meaning, where an idea, or a mind can be trapped.
99e_msq_02_myrddin_vo_clue3: Like the facets of these crystals, mind, heart and soul are just aspects of a singular thing. Take heed, sister.
99e_msq_02_myrddin_vo_clue3_sub1: Like the facets of these crystals, mind, heart and soul are just aspects of a singular thing.
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_complete_availab: There... his voice<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> again, speaking as if he knew I'd come, and left some riddle… how? What games do you play, brother?
Tell me<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> Soulwarden, what did you find in the sanctum that elicited this response?

A pendant?<g id="female_explainS" /> Myrddin never cared for jewelry... wait, this was… it<g id="male_pointAngry" /> was mine! That bastard of a brother must've stolen it from me.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> I spent weeks searching!
Bah! Can't<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> get distracted, there's more to learn here, I know it!

99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_03_star: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Sometimes secrets are standing right in front of us, and we are oblivious nonetheless. Do<g id="female_gestureLeft" /> you see this stone creag suspended in roots?
What does this tell us?<g id="female_youknow" /> The earth gropes after the energy in this stone…
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_03_talk: Oh my,<g id="female_thinking" /> that is... a rather outlandish proposition, but based on your earlier discovery, it makes sense. Myrddin must've known this.
Look for samples<g id="male_quidproquo" /> of the veined stone that might be mined. Whatever's inside, we need it.
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_04_star: This. This<g id="male_leanforwardInspect" /> was constructed by Myrddin! I can almost smell the redolence of herbs he carried in his robes!<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> It is uncanny!
It's like he wanted me<g id="female_smackfist" /> to find this device - it must serve some purpose!
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_04_talk: What do you think<g id="male_darnit" /> I've been doing here? Just humming a melody? The<g id="male_gestureLeft" /> blasted thing is lacking an energy source.
Just the kind of absurdity my brother so enjoyed…<g id="male_rememberBig" /> wait, try using the crystals from the veined stones!
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_05_star: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I can't believe my ears! I heard Myrddin's voice... like he was right<g id="female_gestureForward02" /> beside me! You heard it too!
<g id="female_youknowS" />This is the place! A cavern of crystals, emanating a power<g id="male_lookrightSurprised" /> unlike any I've seen, even here on Aeternum.
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_morgaine_05_talk: <g id="male_nodMild" />Yes, we must! But those damned<g id="female_pointThreaten" /> Varangian raiders are already rummaging about… who knows how much they've already spoiled?!
Destroy them,<g id="female_waverightNoway" /> and carve a path for us to reach Myrddin's sanctum. We're so close now!

99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_proposal_a: Eventually,<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> yes, but he spent many years before that seeking answers about how he might study it,<g id="female_explainS" /> without falling under its influence.
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_proposal_b: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />My brother kept many secrets, and I<g id="female_youknowS" /> believe some of them are hidden here in Edengrove.
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_proposal_next_a: Yes,<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> my bond with my brother was strong, especially being scarred in our final encounter, and I can almost sense<g id="female_lookup" /> his presence… hovering above us?
99e_msq_02_myrddinclues_proposal_next_b: Come,<g id="female_beckon" /> let us ascend to greater heights to... get a better view.

99e_msq_03_collectsamples_complete_avail: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />Now, I think we've finally found something useful. The whispers<g id="female_thinking" /> spoke of the source, from where the Angry Earth's lifeforce is drawn.
If there is power to fight the Corruption,<g id="female_youknow" /> it is guarded within this Motherwell.
I'm not<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> sure, but the scrolls in Caliburne spoke of something similar, a hidden basin sacred to the Angry Earth.
The waters<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> of this region are collected there, and if this is true, that might be the key to finding it.

99e_msq_03_collectsamples_proposal_a: Myrddin<g id="female_impatient" /> was obsessed with the Ancients' methods of sundering the souls of their guardians.

99e_msq_03_collectsamples_proposal_next2: <g id="male_nodMild" />Ah, yes!<g id="male_lookupSmall" /> Tell her what we found. Although she'll want to see this, and…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> no, that's not good. Not yet.
I need<g id="male_scoldFingerwag" /> time, Soulwarden. You and Sun can get on with studying the Angry Earth. I'll join you in Caliburne soon.

99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_03_startta: Not many records of<g id="male_secretive" /> the elder druids here, but I did find clues as to how they kept peace with the Angry Earth.
<g id="female_gestureRightM" />But what about you? I know<g id="male_shrugBrief" /> Morgaine felt strongly that her brother came here… did you find any signs of him?
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_03_talkto_: <g id="female_gestureLeftS" />Great idea! The elder<g id="female_nodConsider" /> druids brought offerings to shrines in the woods to make contact.
We will need to extract<g id="female_swayBored" /> samples from dryads or other Angry Earth. Let's collect as many as we can and meet in the mangroves. Good luck.

I'm curious about<g id="male_lookupSmall" /> these druidic rituals used to commune with what<g id="female_explainS" /> they called "the forest spirit."
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_04_startta: It's amazing.<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> This mangrove swamp is teeming with the life force of the Angry Earth!
<g id="male_nodMild" />They are stronger here, more resilient, and quicker to resurrect. Their<g id="female_gestureDown" /> power is bound to the land here.
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_04_talkto_: A plant's hardiness is<g id="female_explainS" /> determined by the dirt encasing its roots, and so do these dryads and other life forms thrive here.
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />But let us proceed. Search for these<g id="female_gestureForward02" /> "shrines" and offer up the samples… then let's see what happens.
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_05_startta: Well, either my sanity is finally slipping, or<g id="female_shocked" /> the ritual worked! I heard a voice, speaking…<g id="female_explainS" /> something about a garden and severing infected limbs.
I wonder<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> if that's a reference to the Blight in the nearby ruins.
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_05_talkto_: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I don't know. Perhaps we collect samples<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> from the creatures who've become Blighted? Yes, yes, and then seek out another shrine.

99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_06_startta: There! I heard it too, but different<g id="male_dontknow" /> than before, weaker, alone and very confused.
It would seem<g id="male_agree1" /> the Blighted Angry Earth are cut off from the power that sustains them. That<g id="female_youknowS" /> is the power we need to fight Corruption.
99e_msq_03_collectsamples_sun_06_talkto_: Yes, perhaps<g id="female_spreadarms" /> here in this eastern grove, where the Blight has not encroached and the forest remains pure.

99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_complete_avai: <g id="male_nodMild" />Ah, Soulwarden, I've been waiting for your return! There<g id="male_smallSingleWave" /> is an incredible power hidden within the Ancient Towers here.

<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />This is about the Angry Earth, yes? Make no mistake - I am interested,<g id="male_waghand01" /> but it will have to wait.
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Myrddin's clues strongly assert time<g id="female_youknow" /> is critical in solving his riddles, and the answers<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> are hidden in these towers.

99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_proposal_a: Ah, wait,<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> but this is clearly not just the waters of this region, but rather the Azoth that is undoubtedly bound to it.
99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_proposal_b: We need some device<g id="male_quidproquo" /> with which we read the flow of Azoth to triangulate the position of the Motherwell.
99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_proposal_next: Of course! Brilliant!<g id="female_chuckle" /> It's almost as if fate has guided us here, equipped for this very purpose.

99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_sun_06_startt: This looks promising! An upsurge<g id="female_gestureForward01" /> from deep underground, certainly a pocket of Azoth, seeking to find its way to the source.

99e_msq_04_motherwellclues_sun_06_talkto: Place your Azoth Staff<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> in the water and step back. If this works, the staff should move in some way and point us in the general direction of the Motherwell.

99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yash_01_starttalkto: Where… where were you? The<g id="male_guiltyLookside" /> attack, it came on so quickly. The whole place was burning, and Corrupted everywhere!

99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yash_01_talkto_next: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />She… I mean that thing, that<g id="male_ragepunchfistsdown" /> demon dragged him off towards the north gate. Let's go quickly… perhaps there is still time.
99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yash_02_starttalkto: He-he saved<g id="female_lookdownSorry" /> me you see, and then he was knocked down, but there wasn't anything I could do… They have taken our fearless leader captive,<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> and with him, my hope.
99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yash_02_talkto_next: I think they went<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> west… I think, but I do not know.
After I saw the darkness in her eyes, everything<g id="male_pleadHandsopen" /> is very foggy in my memory… go after him, after Yonas, if you can. Please!
99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yonascave_barkyonas: I don't… want… this! Stop me!
You have… saved… me. Thank you…
99e_msq_10_tocaerdun_yonascave_isabella_: Look who's here! Ah, but you've just missed all the excitement. Extracting a Heartgem is easier than I imagined!
You thought you were getting the edge, but you never had a chance. What little you accomplished, I have taken.
Here is your mentor, your friend… or what's left of him. Ha!
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_complete_avai: Hail, Warden! Are you the vanguard of our reinforcements?
I'd expected to see Yonas crossing the mountains at the front of a great force, but you are the only one we've seen. How long until the army arrives?
Hearing that Yonas has fallen… that is a blow. His loss will be felt for quite some time.
And without reinforcements on the way, we may be forced to abandon this position.
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_incomplete: We will do what we can here, then we will come north. There is nowhere else to go.
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_objective_des: With the fortress of Caer Dun in shambles, plans against the forces of Corruption have stalled.\nTravel to Shattered Mountain and give the terrible news to Warden Yseult.
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_proposal_a: Yes, and even further, behind the lines in Shattered Mountain, but they were barely holding their positions. Yonas planned to send reinforcements.
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_proposal_b: But now, there is no one to send.
99e_msq_11_shatteredvector_proposal_next: Then you should. There is nothing left here, very little to even salvage. If our cause has any chance at all, it is in assaulting the Shattered Mountain.
Go. Whatever shred of hope remains in my heart goes with you.
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_01: Behold, Edengrove, the jewel of Aeternum!
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_02: Here is a land where nature still commands. It’s thorny, poisonous, and beautiful,
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_03: and you’ll never find in all the world such an abundance of peculiar flora.
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_04: Speaking of peculiar, did you know the life cycle of the Angry Earth begins in Edengrove?
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_05: I’ve been studying them for ages, but always from a distance.
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_06: It seems now we must study them ever more closely.
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_07: There is an enclave founded by the elder druids to the north; we will have to visit there…
99e_sun_edengrove_igc_subtitle_08: they undoubtedly hoard some of the knowledge we seek...
99e_sun_p10_00: If the Blighted Angry Earth are cut off from their source<g id="female_lookConcern" /> of power, I fear there is no method of using the Blight to battle Corruption.
99e_sun_p10_01_a: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />The energy that sustains the Angry Earth flows through the waters here...<g id="female_nodYes" /> what could be more natural?
99e_sun_p10_01_b: We find the Motherwell where all the waters of Edengrove<g id="female_explainS" /> flow, and we find a source of immense power.
99e_sun_p11_00: Now I want an Azoth staff of my own.<g id="female_laughMed" /> I might have to reconsider your invitation to become a Soulwarden.
99e_sun_p12_01: Well, it gave us a direction to travel in, at least! I suppose this could be<g id="female_smackfist" /> a wild turkey chase, but what if it isn't?
99e_sun_p13_01: So far the staff has pointed south<g id="female_thinking" /> each time, but there is a lot of ground in that direction. Perhaps we need to find the location where all these lines intersect.
99e_sun_p14_01_a: The<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> question now is what to do with this infernal artifact. It must be destroyed, but how?
99e_sun_p14_01_b: Tell me it doesn't<g id="male_lookDown" /> need to be cast into the fires of the Shattered Mountain.
99e_sun_p15_00: This<g id="female_spreadarms" /> is it. This is where I spoke with the Huntress, but I'm not sure you're ready yet.
99e_sun_p15_02_a: We come here asking for<g id="male_lookaroundSmall" /> help to battle a threat that would consume all Aeternum, and she can't be bothered!
99e_sun_p15_02_b: It's tempting to defy<g id="female_pointThreaten" /> her entirely and take our chances in the Motherwell without her blessing.
99e_sun_p16_01: We are too<g id="female_youknowS" /> late returning home… I see Yash.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> Is there anyone else? Anyone?
99e_sun_p17_01: We must leave. There is nothing for us here. I suppose<g id="female_touchhands" /> I should return to Ebonscale Reach. You are welcome to come with me, Soulwarden.
99e_sun_p1_01_a: The sorceress<g id="female_explainS" /> spent a few weeks studying the Blight in Weaver's Fen, and now she's<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> certain it can be used as a weapon against the Corrupted.
99e_sun_p1_01_b: I<g id="female_impatient" /> have spent decades among the Angry Earth, and I'm skeptical of her reasoning.
99e_sun_p2_00: I think we're now<g id="female_spreadarms" /> agreed on continuing Morgaine's research, but with caution.<g id="male_nodMild" /> I hope this new collaborative spirit is here to stay.
99e_sun_p3_01_a: Well,<g id="female_swayBored" /> it seems you've found something to capture Morgaine's attention.
99e_sun_p3_01_b: That's good<g id="female_youknowS" /> because I should like to share with you more about this wondrous place we venture into.<g id="female_beckon" /> Please, follow me…
99e_sun_p6v1_00: I would<g id="female_nodConsider" /> like to continue on to the druidic enclave as soon as we get our bearings.
99e_sun_p6v2_00: <g id="male_nodMild" />There's something to this. If I'm not mistaken,<g id="female_explainS" /> this is all pointing towards the mountains to the south.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Though the exact location we still need to figure out.
99e_sun_p6v2_02_a: If<g id="female_thinking" /> there is some danger of the Tempest acquiring that power, then the Motherwell will have to wait.
99e_sun_p6v2_02_b: If the staff has not been reclaimed, does that<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> mean it's hidden somewhere? That we might find it first?
99e_sun_p6v3_00: We did it. I<g id="female_swayBored" /> can't believe we did it, but we did. The Huntress will be furious in ways I fear will come back to haunt us.
99e_sun_p7_00: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />The elder druids who founded this settlement are mostly gone… along<g id="female_shrugShort" /> with whatever secrets they knew about the Angry Earth.
99e_sun_p8_00: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I am skeptical that the elder druids really communed with any<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> 'forest spirits,' more likely they were a little addled. We will see soon enough.
99e_sun_p9_00: One step, one fragment of<g id="male_explain" /> knowledge, leads to another. Growth comes in fits and starts, and so does our comprehension of these elemental creatures.
99e_yash_00: We need to get<g id="male_gestureHereweare" /> these fires out, then find Yonas! Help me, please!
99e_yash_p2_02: What do<g id="female_worry" /> we do now…? What if… what if she comes back?
99e_yash_p3_01_a: I am sorry, I know I should pull myself together. Perhaps I just need time. So many Wardens lost.
99e_yash_p3_01_b: I wonder how those fare who remain in the north, at the outposts we established.
99f_constance_greet_createrefuge_00: The<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> mountains here are incredible. If only... we could have journeyed here under happier circumstances.
99f_eliza_greet_createrefuge_00: So<g id="male_lookDown" /> many of us gone now… Are the Soulwardens finished, do you think?

99f_grace_greet_createrefuge_00: Got some more scouting to do before I head back. I'll<g id="grace_salutefingers" /> see you soon enough.
99f_grace_greet_gatherallies_00: Well, this is a right mess now, isn't it?<g id="grace_handheart" /> I had really come to like the old man, and now he's gone. It's just rotten.
99f_grace_greet_gatherallies_01: I'll keep an eye out<g id="grace_fisthigh" /> for the others till you get back. Then we can plan our next steps.
99f_grace_greet_inspireallies_00: A<g id="grace_fisthigh" /> banner! Look at me, coming up with a project all of a sudden like that. Masterpiece<g id="grace_gestureU" /> of an idea, that is.
99f_grace_greet_reunitefamily_00: Just happened to be in town on<g id="grace_crossarms" /> business, and I hear tales of your heroics. I'm seeing light on the horizon.
99f_grace_greet_stealboat_01: You have the Seals yet? You<g id="grace_dismiss" /> better hurry! The Empress is about to shove off!
99f_liang_greet_deliverpoem_00: The<g id="male_lookupSmall" /> Heavens are… so quiet now.
99f_liang_greet_deliverpoem_01: Ohh, how I have<g id="male_handheart" /> missed the deepness of the sky…
99f_liang_greet_reunitefamily_00: There are so<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> many more people in this world… than I remembered.
99f_liang_greet_reunitefamily_01: I know that I too… have words<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> inside. Unlike Mother's poems they are difficult to… find.
99f_liang_greet_reunitefamily_02: It is me, Mother… it is…
99f_msq01_gatherallies_complete: Thank<g id="female_bowHead" /> you for finding the other Soulwardens. I should have exercised more caution. But<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> I never imagined the Corrupted… here?
99f_msq01_gatherallies_desc: After the sacking of Caer Dun, the Soulwardens risk losing everything if the Tempest strikes again. In order to survive, they must relocate to the presumed safety of Ebonscale Reach.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_findgrace_desc: Search for Grace O'Malley deeper in the forest
99f_msq01_gatherallies_findwardens_desc: Find the missing Soulwardens near the ambush site
99f_msq01_gatherallies_followsun_desc: Follow Sun Fuchun to Ebonscale Reach
99f_msq01_gatherallies_followsun_desc_2: Rejoin your allies in Ebonscale Reach
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktob_01: Good.<g id="grace_yes" /> I thought all was lost for a minute there.<g id="grace_clenchfists1" /> What I want to know is how the red-eyed rotters knew we were coming.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktob_02: There's time for questions after, though. Right<g id="grace_defiant" /> now, we gotta get back our banner… the Soulwarden banner.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktob_03: Yeah,<g id="grace_embarrassed" /> and I was hot on their heels. I may not be a Warden proper, but a flag's not something you let slip away.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktob_04: The Corrupted tore it to pieces, scattered it around<g id="grace_gestureL" /> their camp. I figure it's your turn to have some fun. I'll wait here.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktob_sta: Look at you,<g id="grace_wherearewe" /> here to finish the job. Did you find the others then? I was planning to circle back, you know.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktoc_01: Now<g id="grace_throwarms" /> why would you go and say a thing like that? You've been the savior at every turn!
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktoc_02: Or...<g id="grace_lean" /> Is it because that demon lady has her hooks in you? Is that it? That's how she knew…<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> I'll be damned.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktoc_02_: "I need her out of my head."
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktoc_03: Maybe there's some mystical solution here.<g id="grace_gestureLefthand" /> Ask Sun, why don't you? I'll lead the others, but… I won't say where, eh!
99f_msq01_gatherallies_grace_talktoc_sta: Now<g id="grace_welcome" /> there's a spot of hope! We'll get that banner mended, just as soon as we find a safe place to make camp.
"If I'm there, you won't be safe."
99f_msq01_gatherallies_incomplete: Proud<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> Caer Dun… now in shambles.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_isabella_a_whispe: We are still connected, or did you forget our bond? You have taught me so much, including your weaknesses.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_isabella_b_whispe: Your banner is destroyed, your followers demoralized. You are defeated, you just haven't realized it yet.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_isabella_c_whispe: You thought you'd be safe here, but this land is mine too. Where will your Wardens go now? You cannot hide from me.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal: Of course.<g id="male_headNodYes" /> Where you lead, I will follow.<g id="female_gestureRightM" /> Perhaps Sun or Grace has some idea of where we might find safe harbor.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal01: Well,<g id="grace_handheart" /> this is a right mess now, isn't it? I had really come to like the old man, and now he's gone. It's just rotten.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal02: Yonas…<g id="female_touchhands" /> the poor man. Did he suffer? I suppose he must have. The question is… now what?
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal03: I'm<g id="grace_lookaroundwonder" /> thinking a sprawling mansion back in Oxboro would do us right! A little luxury?<g id="grace_gesturebothhands" /> But I guess that's probably not what y'all are thinking, is it?
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal04: I<g id="female_youknow" /> have traveled extensively in my time on Aeternum,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> but I've only ever felt safe in Ebonscale Reach.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal05: Ebonscale<g id="female_headnodding" /> is a land protected by Empress Zhou Taiying.<g id="female_explainS" /> I remain her loyal subject still, and she is a personal friend.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal06: Royal<g id="grace_think" /> type, hmm? Sounds rather… profitable, doesn't it? And safe, of course.<g id="grace_gestureRLow" /> That being the main thing.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal07: Few Soulwardens remain, but I can lead them west. Perhaps<g id="female_gestureRight" priority="high" /> Grace can help… if she's willing to join us.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal08: Well, since you asked so nicely,<g id="grace_shrugDontknow" /> how can I refuse? Besides, they'll need me to watch their backs.<g id="grace_gesturebothhands" /> Alright then, see you there!
99f_msq01_gatherallies_proposal09: I will follow you soon. I<g id="male_sighRelief" /> recognize there is nothing here left to protect. Only ash.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_samir_talkto01: Good. I will look for Constance and Walker. We'll all meet up with you shortly.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_samir_talkto_star: My thanks, Warden! Hurry after Wayne. He tried to make a break for it, but I don't know if he was able to dodge the patrols.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_01: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I hope not. Surely<g id="male_guiltyLookside" /> the Empress was prepared and she and her loyal warriors remain safe… but this area seems to have fallen.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_02: We need<g id="male_dontknowS" /> to find the others. It<g id="female_lookaroundConfused" /> all happened so fast, they came charging at us from all sides, and everyone scattered.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_03: She was<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> here, pistols blazing… or we would have fallen. They all went<g id="female_gestureBehind" /> north through the forest. Please, go after them.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_03_al: She was here, pistols blazing… or we would have fallen. They all went north through the forest. Please, go after them.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_03old: She was here, pistols blazing… or we would have fallen. They all went north towards Skysong Temple. Please, go after them.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_sun_talktob_start: <g id="male_convince02" />Thank goodness you're here! It's all my fault - I<g id="female_lookdownSorry" /> led the Wardens right into an ambush. The Corrupted were waiting.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_talktograce01_des: Talk to Grace O'Malley about the ambush
99f_msq01_gatherallies_talktograce02_des: Talk to Grace O'Malley about the Tempest's spying
99f_msq01_gatherallies_talktograceadditi: Convince Grace O'Malley to escort the survivors
99f_msq01_gatherallies_talktosun01_desc: Talk to Sun Fuchun about finding a safe refuge
99f_msq01_gatherallies_talktosun02_desc: Talk to Sun Fuchun about the situation in Ebonscale Reach
99f_msq01_gatherallies_title: From the Ashes of Caer Dun
99f_msq01_gatherallies_wayne_talkto01: At least there's some good news in all this mess.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_wayne_talkto_star: Glad you're here! I was following the noise of Grace's gunshots, but… they've gone silent now.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_yash_start01: I need<g id="male_dontknow" /> time to think, to mourn.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> I cannot consider the future until I've reckoned with what's just happened.
99f_msq01_gatherallies_yash_start_greet: I'm sorry,<g id="male_apologize" /> I should pull myself together. Yonas would want us to push on,<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> but I don't know how. The Wardens…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> is this the end?
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_complete: Hold<g id="grace_stop" /> on! What are you thinking, coming this way? I<g id="grace_geez" /> finally find a spot of safety, and you come waltzing in, eyes wide open!
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_complete01: You<g id="grace_wagfinger" /> got her out of your head? After all this time, that's got to be a relief. I get a headache<g id="grace_no" /> just thinking of that woman.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_complete02: Yeah,<g id="grace_lookaroundwonder" /> and the Corrupted are in this land full force. We've got our work cut out for us.<g id="grace_pointF" /> Glad you're back to share the load!
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_desc: With the reveal that the Tempest can see through your eyes, the Soulwardens remain on the verge of destruction. On counsel from Sun Fuchun, a plan is devised to seek out her old master who might be able to help if he has not fallen to Corruption.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_focustimer_desc: Focus on the inner calm of self and push Isabella away
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_gotograce_desc: Return to your allies now that you've closed off your mind
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_gotoshen_desc: Search Skysong Temple for Qi Shen
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_gototemple_desc: Travel to {POITags} to find Sun Fuchun's old master
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_graceoldincomplete: I'll keep an eye out for the others till you get back. Then we can plan our next steps.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_incomplete: If<g id="female_worry" /> Master Qi has fallen to Corruption…<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> this day will grow darker indeed.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_isabella_a_whisper: Another old fool you hope will protect you, but your efforts are wasted. I see… wait, what? You-
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_proposal: You mean…<g id="female_startledHandmouth" /> of course. The thought had crossed my mind that the Tempest was seeing through your eyes.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_proposal01: If<g id="female_nodConsider" /> there is any way to purify your consciousness, there is a master here who would know.<g id="female_headnodding" /> His name is Qi Shen.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_proposal02: Skysong Temple. Even<g id="female_explainS" /> if it has fallen, Master Qi may be undisturbed. Seek him out…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> I hope he can help.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_proposal02_alt: A Temple nearby. Even if it has fallen, Master Qi may be undisturbed. Seek him out… I hope he can help.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_01: Your battle against the physical forces of evil has honor.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_02: But the real struggle is the battle of the mind.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_03: Consider the burdens weighing on your companions.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_04: The internal assault this island wages against them.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_05: Aeternum is not just a place, you see. It is a state of being.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_06: And it will scar your soul, unless you choose to change.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_07: Attachments to the past become a prison.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_08: Only balance can transform that prison into a refuge.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_09: As Warden to the souls caught in your sphere…
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_10: You must defend against the shadows darkening their hearts.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_11: Create the island of calm within their storm…
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_12: Because on this island, where time stretches thin to no horizon…
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_13: Your soul too will be stretched thin: a shadow in the dark.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_14: Become the light you have inside.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_cinematic_15: For you are not just in Aeternum; Aeternum is in you.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_talktoa_01: Yes, you do. I<g id="yonas_sighRelief" priority="high" /> can sense from here the discord in your thoughts, and your... unwelcome observer.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_talktoa_02: You seek to<g id="yonas_gestureAround" priority="high" /> wall off your senses to this menacing presence. Yes, I can see why. You endanger all those around you.
99f_msq02_meetwiseman_qi_talktoa_03: Truly<g id="yonas_handsExtendedSorry" priority="high" /> there is no end to the mysteries and tragedies on the isle of Aeternum. Perhaps I can help you restore harmony.

It was a rebirth of a lost dream, and we flourished. And my son thrived.
On the eve of his adulthood, a strange sickness overcame him…

The fleet is now ready to set sail…

99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktoa_02: Seems Sun wants a word<g id="grace_dismiss" /> with you, so I'll go on and take the little prince, and we'll see you there.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktoa_st: <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />So Sun's found a role for me to play in this drama, after all.<g id="grace_casualHail" /> I'm to escort the young prince to a monastery down south.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_01: <g id="grace_frustrated" />The Prince and I came along expecting to hike up to the monastery, and we ran right into them!
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_02: The Tempest and her elite guards<g id="grace_lookBehind" /> must've had somewhere important to go… because they didn't give chase.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_03: I'm sorry,<g id="grace_sympathy" /> Warden, I was running and gunning, took out a slew of the bastards… but when I turned around, he had slipped away.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_04: I'm betting<g id="grace_defiant" /> he went on up to find his mother. A fierce yearning, he has, and he seemed to know the way.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_05: You do<g id="grace_yes" /> that. There's an army of Corrupted that way, but not much choice. Isabella went west, so I'll follow her.<g id="grace_fisthigh" /> Stay sharp, Warden!
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_grace_talktob_st: Hell's<g id="grace_throwarms" /> breath, what took you so damn long? It's bloody madness - the Corrupted are here… and that harpy Isabella too.

99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_lorenoteol: I am not as I was. Time became an endless day with no hope of another dawn. But now I know that I was witness to over a century of love. One day, upon another dawn, I will become myself again and fulfill the long-held dreams of my Dearest Mother.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_start_gree: My body…<g id="female_lookConcern" /> feels strange. I think I was… like that… for far longer than I was ever in this form. Is this even... me?
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_talkto_01: I<g id="female_disappointed" /> see… I feel like there were far more than that. And yet…
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_talkto_02: Oh!<g id="male_goodnews" /> I… remember this one! I was given this on that day when… when…
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_talkto_03: Mother<g id="male_lookUpAround" /> and I stood watching the farmers. It was… early morning. The man waved at me. I was… happy and wished him well.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_liang_talkto_sta: Sun told me... how many<g id="male_dazed" /> years it has been. Were any of my toys still… in good condition?
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_proposal: Who I was before<g id="female_lookaroundConfused" /> I… changed… is hazy. I can only remember… images from when I was younger, playing at the broken ships…
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_proposal01: I think<g id="female_nodConsider" /> I recall… leaving my favorite toys there… but when I was just a child? Or after? My memories are… confused.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktoa_01: <g id="male_nodMild" />Slowly, I suspect. To<g id="female_leanforwardSmall" /> be trapped inside that monstrous form for so long… it will take time to recover his faculties.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktoa_01_a: Slowly, I suspect. To be trapped inside that monstrous form for centuries… it will take time to recover his faculties.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktoa_02: <g id="female_explainS" />We must now reunite Liang with his mother, a reunion long overdue. Grace<g id="female_gestureForward02" /> has offered to help in this matter.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktoa_star: As far as I can<g id="female_lookRight" /> tell, Liang is… physically healthy. I scarcely believe it.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktob_01: I simply want to<g id="male_dontknow" /> express my deepest gratitude. Despite the darkness we endured getting here,<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> I am inspired.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktob_02: You helped me<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> achieve a dream I had abandoned, and I am forever in your debt. I will not forget this.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktob_03: But I shouldn't delay<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> you. I am sure the Empress will want to thank you as well.<g id="male_agree1" /> Go on. I will follow soon.
99f_msq09_reunitefamily_sun_talktob_star: I…<g id="female_crossarms" /> wanted to speak before you go. This has been exhausting on many levels and I need rest before joining you.

99f_msq09_reunitefamily_zhou_talkto02: Whispers have long told me that taking my son away from the island is the only way to save him. And so I shall…

99f_msq11_fightempress_proposal: <g id="grace_headnodyes" />A solid plan, but I got an addendum. What<g id="grace_secret" /> say we shut down the Empress's enterprise and then me and you snag that artifact?

99f_msq12_deliverpoem_complete01: <g id="female_smackfist" />With Ebonscale as an ally, and at least some small blow against the Tempest,<g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped02" /> I'd say the Soulwardens are back.

99f_msq12_deliverpoem_incomplete: We<g id="female_bowHead" /> will speak in a moment, Warden.
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_liang_talkto01: Oh!<g id="male_leanforwardInspect" /> This was her favorite poem by Du Fu… "Over Kuizhou's lonely wall, the setting sun slants..."
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_liang_talkto02: We read this<g id="male_chuckle" /> every autumn when the wind was in the reeds. You<g id="female_lookup" /> could hear them… even from the heights of the Palace.

99f_msq12_deliverpoem_proposal01: For<g id="female_lookRight" /> now, I must help Liang, though. I'll take him back to town.<g id="female_youknow" /> Please join us there as soon as you're able.

99f_msq12_deliverpoem_sun_talkto01: It is not<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> an easy decision, but it is the right thing for me to do.
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_sun_talkto02: I feel particularly<g id="female_lookdownSorry" /> bad walking away at this time, with Grace departing so… abruptly. I am sorry.
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_sun_talkto03: Indeed. The Prince has a<g id="male_explain" /> long recovery ahead… I must prepare him, for he is soon to be – if he is not already – our Emperor.
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_sun_talkto04: Heavens<g id="female_bowShallow" /> watch over you, Warden. Please give my regards to Yash.
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_sun_talkto_start_g: That was... kind<g id="male_itsokay" /> of you. I hope with that, Liang can find closure and begin a new life. But he is going to need help.

99f_msq12_deliverpoem_zhou_lorenote:
My body falls from this shadowed pinnacle
With a step taken into the rush of wind
Swaddled newborn it will bear you up
To rebehold the rising sun in heavenly ascension
99f_msq12_deliverpoem_zhou_lorenote_alt: Atop the shadowed pinnacles I climbed, recalling my homeland. Those distant peaks I lost before you too could ascend. Yet that regret falls along with my body with this step I take from the cliff. I believe the winds will catch you, swaddled newborn, lifting upwards into the sky. At the zenith will you behold the light I always watched as the sun rises again in Heavenly ascension.

99g_msq01_freeprisoner_russo_cinematic_0: I still recall the day I discovered an Angel visiting my church….
Isabella de Leon, a young woman of unsurpassed devotion, seeking redemption for generations of family shame.
It was I who first brought her to hear the mad ravings of the Heretic…
And strangely found myself joining their ill-fated expedition.
On Aeternum, Isabella's aspiration became obsession…
And when she drank from the Fountain, her thirst for divine inspiration transformed into madness.
As the crimson thickened in her eyes, so did the hold of the demonic parasite within her soul.
She met the crew's questions with blood, leaving them as mindless husks.
My heart shattered, my faith lost… I struck down the Heretic for leading us to this damnation…
99g_msq01_freeprisoner_russo_cinematic_1: And I fled in shame to the Old World, determined to return and make this right.
In Rome, I gained access to the darkest archives of my order…
And there found answers that promised salvation when I returned to these shores.
I hired a Captain to bring me back, but after shipwrecking on the island,
I saw what happened… the blessing I intended for her was bestowed upon you instead.

99g_msq01_freeprisoner_russo_lorenote_pr: After a century of being away from this infernal island, I had forgotten the tension that permeates the air on Aeternum. It's invigorating, but there's also a cloying quality to it. It feels like one's constantly trading clarity and hope for this gift of eternal life. Perhaps this is why mankind was never worthy of such a thing. In the decades since I departed, Isabella has been busy and her demon armies now dominate the land. My plans may have been hindered upon arrival, but I will find a way to make amends for my sins... or let me be damned as well.

99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal01_prompt: "I will need help. You know her."
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal02: <g id="male_nodMild" />I will attempt to join you if possible, and together we will grapple with her very soul.<g id="male_quidproquo" /> Beware! You go to her true domain.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal02_alt: In the heart of the mountain, you will grapple with her very soul. Beware! You go to her true domain.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal02_alt2: The power you wield… I fear it will destroy her utterly. Though I know not what darkness may be unleashed from such an event…
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal02oldline: <g id="male_nodMild" />I will attempt to join you if possible, and together we will grapple with her very soul.<g id="male_quidproquo" /> Beware! You go to her true domain.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal03: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Do not strike her down with<g id="female_leftfistThreaten" /> vengeance in your heart. I know what comes of that.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Let your Staff be the instrument of divine mercy.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal04: Isabella de Leon<g id="male_lookawayGuilty" /> was innocent and brave at one time, and I believe that person is still in there…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> waiting to be set free.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_proposal05: And so<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> we surrender our fates to this battle and this purpose, beyond our understanding. "Into<g id="male_lookUp" /> thy hands I commend my spirit." Amen.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_russo_start_greet: Steel<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> yourself, Soulwarden. You stand upon the threshold of Corruption's heart. It<g id="male_shakehead" /> may as well be the Gates of Hell itself.
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_summonphase3_isab: Old fool, you're a remnant of a lesser life. You know nothing. You never did.
Then why did you abandon me, Father!?
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_summonphase3_russ: Isabella... you must stop this madness. The Corruption deceives you. We are not your enemy.
I will not give up on you. Recall the words that once inspired your faith…
That the only truth in this fallen world is the bond of one heart to another!
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_transitionphase2_: You fight well, insolent as you are. But I draw from a power you can't begin to fathom!
Fool! I draw from a power you can't begin to fathom!
And so it imbues even my memories with power. I salute you, Alvaro!
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_transitionphase3_: And now comes the time in which you offer your life to me as well.
Now offer your soul to me…
One day I will remember you… your existence… your futile struggle…
One day I will remember you…
99g_msq11_destroyenemy_transitionphase4_: No… I was to be the savior…
After all this time… am I still… truly… alone…?
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete: I'm half-surprised you're here,<g id="female_sighRelief" /> not that you'd let me down, but I've noticed you never take a moment for yourself.<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> It's unhealthy.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete01: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />Cheers, indeed! Though now I'm to be a bit of a hypocrite, as I'm myself<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> off on a new little… venture. Can't say too much, really…
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete02: But the usual: plenty<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> of coin to be had, and thrills, and excitement, and some modicum of danger. I<g id="male_dontknowS" /> might consider a partner…
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete03: Of<g id="male_agree1" /> course we will! I have that ship I always wanted now, so I have. Don't you just love<g id="female_cheerFisthigh" /> it when a barmy plan comes together?
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete04: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />By the way, caught a snippet of an interesting rumor.<g id="female_beckon" /> Corrupted Roman Legions in the desert!<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> Can you imagine?
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete04_prompt: "Some sun would be a nice change."
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_complete05: Hey,<g id="female_chuckle" /> it's your adventure! Anyhow, we'll be seeing you,<g id="male_gestureForwardLefthand" /> hero, somewhere out in that<g id="female_flirtSmall" /> great vasty island of opportunity!
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_desc: Corruption has been weakened and its loudest voice has been silenced: the Tempest is gone. Find Father Russo to understand what will become of Aeternum in the passing of this storm, and celebrate the victory with your allies.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_grace_start_greet: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Well! No need to selfishly take all the credit. This was a shared victory,<g id="male_quidproquo" /> you and me. Look at us! Come a long way, we have!
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_grace_talkto_start: I'm half-surprised you're here,<g id="female_sighRelief" /> not that you'd let me down, but I've noticed you never take a moment for yourself.<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> It's unhealthy.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_incomplete: <g id="male_dismissGetLost2" />Off with you now! Don't worry, your Grace will be sticking around.<g id="male_nodMild" /> That's a promise, that is!
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_proposal: Bah!<g id="female_wavehandPshaw" /> What choice did you leave me with? It's been a lifetime since we met on that beach;<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> I couldn't just sail away.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_proposal01: Besides, I would've missed all the craziness! Like<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> the end of days, it was! I can't believe it all blew over.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_proposal02: Can't<g id="female_shrugShort" /> say as I know anyone by the name. Clergy type? Nope,<g id="female_sighBigRelief" /> it was just me here when I got back from the fight.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_proposal03: Anyhow, what's it matter? You won! Tell you what, finish up here, meet me at the pub in Oxboro. Have ourselves a chat.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_proposal03b: Anyhow, what's it matter? You<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> won! Tell you what, finish up here, meet me at that fine camp you set up. Have ourselves a chat.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_01: And so it came to pass that the Heart of the Tempest was abandoned by the power for which she traded everything.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_02: Her body consumed in holy light… and her tainted soul ripped into the depths of the mountain.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_03: The Soulwardens are victorious. Aeternum, and the world, pulled back from the precipice of doom.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_05: So many of their numbers Lost or Corrupted.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_06: While the factions ignore their sacrifice and continue their petty struggles for dominance.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_07: And what of the pain and sacrifice that was forced upon the Angry Earth?
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_08: It will become clear soon enough that the vengeful hand of nature will grasp far more than equilibrium.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_09: And the void exposed when the surge in Corruption abates will become a threat in itself…
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_10: … as the soulless remnants of this conflict rise from the battlefield to find purpose and power in a source as yet unrealized.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_11: Yea, though the hapless inhabitants of Aeternum soon will learn this chapter may have come to a close,
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_cinematic_12: the real horrors have just begun.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_russo_lorenote: As the Soulwarden and Isabella knelt before each other, there was a silence unlike any I have ever known. It reminded me of the first time I administered Holy Communion: the silent acknowledge of Divine Love. But the moment ended abruptly. Here in this foul place, that silence has been shattered forever. It is accomplished and the tomb is empty… but She is not here. She is not here. She is not here. There is no redemption.
99g_msq12_bidfarewell_title: The First Things Have Passed Away
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktoa_01: My pride<g id="male_hopeless" /> more than my body! I was tracking a scouting party from the Corrupted Legion, but<g id="male_shakehead" /> the sun betrayed me, and I was forced to flee.
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktoa_02: I suspect the Legion<g id="female_smackfist" /> sent scouts to search the desert for refugees. We need to warn everyone at Wikala al-Waha outpost. Come,<g id="male_beckonUrgent" /> follow me!
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktoa_st: Ho!<g id="male_casualHail" /> My fellow Soulwarden saves the day! Thank you for breaking that snare... I<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> truly thought I'd be stuck there for all eternity.
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktob_01: I suggest you speak to the others in this camp, especially that young woman over<g id="female_pointLeft" /> there. She has been responsible for organizing much of this, and can explain the current situation.
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktob_02: Thank you<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" /> again, comrade. You have brought hope where there was none.
99g_msq13_desertvector_buhawi_talktob_st: I hope<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> this means the residents of this place will get the assistance they need. I've done what I can, but it is far from enough.
99g_msq13_desertvector_complete: Stay together!<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> There’s strength in numbers! Ready what weapons you have, but be prepared to run if it comes to that. Don’t lose hope!
99g_msq13_desertvector_desc: Now that Isabella has finally been defeated and the threat of her forces contained in Shattered Mountain, the Soulwardens turn their attention to whispers of new dangers arising in the deserts to the west.
99g_msq13_desertvector_gotobuhawi: Search within Brimstone Sands for Soulwarden Buhawi
99g_msq13_desertvector_gotoebonscale: Find Sun Fuchun in Fortune's Crossing
99g_msq13_desertvector_gotowikala: Follow Buhawi to the outpost Wikala al-Waha
99g_msq13_desertvector_incomplete: There is much to attend to here in Shattered Mountain. We will<g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" /> remain the bulwark against what Corruption is not yet contained.
99g_msq13_desertvector_morgaine_talkto01: Though<g id="female_leanforwardWhisper01" /> I'd admit it to very few… or likely just yourself… I am rather drained from the battle.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Otherwise, I'd accompany you.
99g_msq13_desertvector_morgaine_talkto02: Manipulating<g id="female_thinking" /> the Ancient Guardians has given me new hypotheses to research. And the library in New Corsica is an excellent place to start.
99g_msq13_desertvector_morgaine_talkto03: I was discussing an idea<g id="female_gestureRightM" /> with Sun Fuchun before she left.<g id="female_theseidiots" /> Apparently her Empress's own library was destroyed by the Corrupted. What a waste!
99g_msq13_desertvector_morgaine_talkto04: <g id="male_nodMild" />Do. She's an interesting person. And not<g id="female_crossarms" /> as dim as I had first presumed.
99g_msq13_desertvector_morgaine_talkto_s: Seems you're throwing yourself<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> at another problem with an immediacy that would make others blanch. Heh. I'm much the same.
99g_msq13_desertvector_proposal: We all<g id="male_nodProud" /> have. This is as much a time for remembrance as it is celebration.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> And yet, our great work must continue.
99g_msq13_desertvector_proposal01: <g id="female_explainS" />I'm afraid one of our scouts reports that, even now,<g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" /> the Corrupted in the western deserts of Brimstone Sands are marching on the city there.
99g_msq13_desertvector_proposal02: <g id="female_gestureLeftS" />I couldn't agree more, but most everyone is well-tasked with cleaning<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> up here. Once again, I think this assignment might be best for you.
99g_msq13_desertvector_proposal03: Seek out the Soulwarden Tomash in Ebonscale.<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" /> He knows the region and can best tell you where to enter the Sands. Luck<g id="male_nodProud" /> be with you, my heroic friend.
99g_msq13_desertvector_proposal04: Ah, and before you depart, I believe Morgaine<g id="male_gestureRight" /> wishes to speak with you.
99g_msq13_desertvector_savebuhawi: Pry open the trap and save Buhawi
99g_msq13_desertvector_sun_talkto01: As is becoming the theme of our<g id="female_bowHead" /> partnership. Good news doesn't always spread as quickly as bad. I suppose I wanted to indulge.
99g_msq13_desertvector_sun_talkto02: And also,<g id="male_lookDown" /> I didn't… want to make as formal a goodbye as we had before. We are parting, yes, but<g id="female_flirtSmall" /> we shall see each other again.
99g_msq13_desertvector_sun_talkto02_prom: "I know it. Give my best to Liang."
99g_msq13_desertvector_sun_talkto03: <g id="male_nodMild" />I will! You know where you can find<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> me if the need ever arises for an emboldened alchemist brewing her war-grade potions. Until then!
99g_msq13_desertvector_sun_talkto_start_: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Soulwarden... hopefully you didn't find me rude disappearing from the camp so suddenly. I<g id="female_cheerFistpump" /> simply needed to inform Liang of your success!
"You had a hand in it, too."

99g_msq13_desertvector_tomash_talkto01: The Corrupted<g id="male_righthandAngry" /> Legion in Brimstone Sands is preparing an assault on the capital of New Corsica. The<g id="male_shakehead" /> civilians are fleeing the region in droves.
99g_msq13_desertvector_tomash_talkto01_p: "Do we have forces to aid them?"
99g_msq13_desertvector_tomash_talkto02: Another Soulwarden,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> Buhawi, has been organizing the refugees, helping in any way he can.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> I haven't heard from him for some time.
99g_msq13_desertvector_tomash_talkto03: <g id="male_nodMild" />You've taken a weight off my shoulders! Thank<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> you for checking up on him.
99g_msq13_desertvector_tomash_talkto_sta: You've made it! Good!<g id="male_sighRelief" /> Your exploits precede you. We have need of your aid.
99g_msq13_desertvector_yash_start_greet: We<g id="male_cheerBothHands" /> have done the impossible! Yonas is avenged. And now he can rest, though his<g id="male_handheart" /> spirit will live on. In all of us.
99g_msq_01_captainslog_description: Log book from when Isabella first became a captain. It includes details of how she made it to Aeternum.
99g_msq_01_cellkey_description: This key has seen better days. The same could be said of anyone it was used to lock up.
99g_msq_02_brooch_description: Delicatedly etched on the brooch is Isabella's family crest, a reminder of where she is from.
99g_msq_02_cup_description: A long-lost gift or the spoils of conquest. Either way, Isabella once prized this possession.
99g_msq_04_amberlichen_description: Warm and rich as spiced tea, this lichen when broken smells of the best parts of autumn.
99g_msq_04_cloudmoss_description: It is not as soft as one would expect from the name, but holds hints of moisture trapped within.
99g_msq_04_pheromone_description: While humans cannot scent these, Phaeris insisted they have a calming affect on Dryads.
99g_msq_05_energizedearth_description: A potent essence of inner strength, extracted from the Angry Earth.
99g_msq_05_spores_description: Spores collected from Blighted plants and fungus.
99g_msq_05_sporesac_description: Distilled from the essence of Blighted Spores, these sac help reinforce a hivemind connection between Blighted Dryads.
99g_msq_06_crystals_description: It is said that these crystals once helped the Ancients give commands to Ancient Guardians.
99g_msq_07_corruptionpus_description: Nasty ooze collected from Corruption Barbs. Sure to inflict issues on anything it comes into contact with.
99g_msq_07_smokebomb_description: Made from the worst parts of Corruption Barbs, it is vile enough to affect anyone when used.
99g_msq_08_gabrielstear_description: A piece of meteor that streaked from the heavens, and still glows with an inner light.
99g_msq_08_silentreliquary_description: An item of great power, but no one has dared discover what it might do.

99g_msq_sm_dungeon_isabella_reliquarydel: I… can see you now. You were the light and… Ahhh. Now I understand!
You who must now go forth in my stead to this place of darkness… I salute your resolve.
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_isabella_thorpesubmis: Now that I have revealed the truth about Corruption, about our birthright, what is your choice…?
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_russomeeting01: I am lost in the dark... I cannot find my way… Is this Hell…?
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_russomeeting03: Why did I ever leave her? That poor fallen Angel… left alone on an island of the damned…
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_russomeeting04: If Divine Love could not save us, what could mortal love possibly accomplish? Oh, Isabella, my dearest companion…
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_russomeeting05_alt: I loved you so very much.
99g_msq_sm_dungeon_russomeeting06: "And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes: and death shall be no more… The first things have passed away."

99g_petar_greet_00: <g id="male_explain" />Found three damaged wagons this week. One had weapons, the other food, the third crafting equipment.
99g_petar_greet_01: <g id="female_salute2finger" />I heard you defeated the Corrupted within their strongholds. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Is any loot left for the picking?
99g_phaeris_greet_bidfarewell_00: We remained behind to bid you farewells. Human! Be<g id="female_spreadarms" /> well! The Huntress calls us back to the garden in convocation. We go<g id="male_nodMild" /> to listen.
99g_phaeris_greet_healally_00: Humans...<g id="male_think" /> such peculiar names. We wonder why?
99g_phaeris_greet_healally_01: This rocky shelter<g id="female_headnodding" /> on the edge of the woodlands is the destination we seek.
99g_phaeris_greet_preparewarfare_00: We will try to be as our rootsibling and find the "bow and arrows" within<g id="male_handheart" /> ourself. Lest she chide, calling us cotyledon.
99g_phaeris_greet_reconnecthive_00: We<g id="male_hivemind" /> tried to tell Huntress of what we do, but she does not respond. Sister Myrtilus did; we are very grateful.
99g_qasim_greet_00: <g id="male_explain" />The longer the bow, the stronger it is. The stronger the bow, <g id="female_crossarms" />the faster and farther your arrow goes.
99g_russo_greet_assaultstronghold_00: The evil<g id="male_lookaroundWorried" /> permeating this blasphemous cathedral has a taste.
99g_russo_greet_attackmentally_00: <g id="male_nodMild" />She may try to resist, but you alone can reach that goodness which remains. I<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" /> believe in you, Soulwarden.
99g_russo_greet_destroyenemy_00: "If<g id="male_lookDown" /> I shall go and prepare a place for you,<g id="male_headShakeNo" />	 I will come again and will take you to myself: that<g id="male_wipetear" /> where I am, you also may be."
99g_russo_greet_freeprisoner_00: The journal<g id="male_gestureLeft" /> is open to the passage you should read.
99g_russo_greet_plantbombs_00: <g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" />I told you I'd find you again, Soulwarden,<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> and here I am. We must speak, and soon.
99g_russo_greet_preparewarfare_00: I have something<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" /> for you, Soulwarden, when you are ready.
99g_samir_greet_preparewarfare_00: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />To think we are here at the very gates of Myrkgard. The Tempest… is<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> just over there…
99g_sun_greet_bidfarewell_00: Liang will be overjoyed to hear of this rousing success! Perhaps now<g id="female_touchhands" /> we can know a second peace – and one to last a long, long time.
99g_sun_greet_plantbombs_00: Normally,<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> I'd feel a bit overwhelmed being in such a dark place. Yet, I feel oddly exhilarated and in control.
99g_sun_greet_plantbombs_01: I'm<g id="female_leanforwardSmall" /> hoping if you talk to him, he'll soon be on his way… that man gives me chills.
99g_sun_greet_preparewarfare_00: Thank you for speaking with me. It may not be my place to say so, but<g id="female_bowShallow" /> I think Yonas would be most proud of you.
99g_tomash_greet_desertvector_00: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />I'm sorry, friend. Something important has my attention right now.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Perhaps later?
99g_tomash_greet_desertvector_01: Where are you? You should have at least sent word by now…
99g_tomash_greet_desertvector_02: You smell like dust and heat, friend! I assume you made it into the deserts of Brimstone Sands without too much difficulty.
99g_walker_greet_preparewarfare_00: I can't do this anymore. It was too much… and what if it happens again…?
99g_wayne_greet_preparewarfare_00: I'll stay with you if you like. Whatever you command, I will do.
99g_wu_greet_preparewarfare_00: Greetings.<g id="male_casualHail" /> It is my honor to assist the Soulwardens in this endeavor. May the Heavens smile on us.
99g_yash_greet_assaultstronghold_00: <g id="male_nodMild" />It is only fitting that you signal the start of battle. Raise<g id="male_pointRight" /> the Soulwarden Banner on high when you are ready.
99g_yash_greet_attackmentally_00: Warden,<g id="male_casualHail" /> I would speak with you further, when you have time.
99g_yash_greet_bidfarewell_00: We<g id="male_cheerBothHands" /> have done the impossible! Yonas is avenged. And now he can rest, though his<g id="male_handheart" /> spirit will live on. In all of us.
99g_yash_greet_excavateartifacts_00: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />I can't believe it. We've managed to amass quite a large and diverse force.<g id="g_female_explains" /> I do not think the Tempest is prepared for this.
99g_yash_greet_freeprisoner_00: I'll see<g id="male_bowShallow" /> you on the road to Shattered Mountain.
99g_yash_greet_preparewarfare_00: You<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> have got this, Warden. I believe in you. Fully. Without hesitation.
99g_yash_greet_reconnecthive_00: We cannot let up. Assaulting<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> the mountain will require great preparation...<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> and great sacrifice, I fear.

adiana_00_init: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />You should not be in these parts, human. This land is wounded, and it will not hesitate to deal with trespassers.
adiana_01_offer_canarymine_a: <g id="female_notsure" /> You say you've come to see me, but I see only darkness dwelling behind your eyes.
adiana_01_offer_canarymine_b: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />The actions of your kind have already tainted this place, so what purpose have you now?
adiana_02_offer_corruptiontincture_a: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You have done your part, so I will hear what you came here to say.
adiana_02_offer_corruptiontincture_b: <g id="male_pointBlame" />But I warn you - I have no sympathy for the plight of humans in the battle against Corruption. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />It is not our fight.
adiana_03_offer_corruptedplans_a: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Your sincerity has impressed me. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />That is the only reason we are still speaking.
adiana_03_offer_corruptedplans_b: <g id="male_explain" />But I think it will take more than sincerity to earn the trust of the Angry Earth.
adiana_04_offer_toyonas_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />Return to your instructor. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />Convey to him that our gift, and the reprieve that comes with it,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> is not without condition.
adiana_04_offer_toyonas_b: <g id="female_pointthreaten" />Should your kind abuse it, we will visit our wrath upon you.
adiana_05_comment_toyonas: There is nothing else for you right now. You should begone from here. But… I do wish you good fortune in your future travels.
adiana_motherwell_death: You have defied me, human, and I will not forget!
adiana_motherwell_intro: Who dares trespass in the Motherwell? You? How… dare you!
