alchemist_body_01_01:
Every day, there is more news from the north, none of it hopeful, none of it promising victory. The Corrupted are massing in greater numbers, and where once a few groups might be seen once a year, now they swarm from the Cleave almost every season. Two days ago, there were rumors that the Great Bridge has fallen.

We cannot fight these beasts if we do not understand them – and I believe the secret to stopping this foul tide is in curing the red sickness that afflicts them.

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_02:
Genevieve, and even little Simon, have both been supportive of my efforts - perhaps more so when I suggested we move from the developing settlement and pursue our lives where we were less likely to be caught in the middle of a company's feud.

I made mention of an isle in the midst of Brightwood Lake, where we might find some manner of peace from the growing unrest on the rest of the isle… and at that, both of them seemed relieved. They have not been deaf to the rumors in the north, and I think they share the same fears as I do and wish to be far from any troubles that come.

I did not tell them of the letter sent and my request – if it is not honored, I shall find another way. I only seek the safety of family – and a cure for this affliction that besets those that come to Aeternum!

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_03:
The isle is beautiful – the sight of the destination did much to quell my family's doubts on the wisdom of our relocation. I did not mention the cages that would soon be shipped to the isle, nor my equipment. I imagine the cages were doing the settlement little good – even criminals are being enlisted for the conflict in the north, if rumors are to be believed.

I did not mention to Genevieve my thoughts on the Corrupted, nor on who I believe to be their cousins: The Withered. We shall see if there is a link, and if so, test it!

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_04:
Genevieve was surprised as I to find a woman at the door – a Captain (a former Captain), no less, carrying a letter and saying that she was here at the Magistrate's request and that she was to assist in my efforts. Her name was Madelaine (Maddie), and she insisted I not use the title of Captain when speaking to her, as her arrival on the shore of Aeternum did not deserve the title – nor did the crew she had lost.

Genevieve was suspicious, then upset, and she asked me many questions – about Maddie's presence, to the alchemical equipment, and most of all, the cages, which alarmed her greatly. What manner of beasts were they to hold, she asked?

Not “hold” but what manner of beasts we may SAVE, I replied. As I attempted to explain, she suddenly stood and left, and I knew the conversation to be over.

It seems I shall sleep in the workshop this night – and not by choice.

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_05:
Maddie begins hunting today – as I suspected, the lake is surrounded by clusters of Withered from the settlements that used to border it.

I have not shared this knowledge with my family – there is no need for them to know what happened to the settlers. It is enough that they know to keep to the island and do not wander far from the house.

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_06:
I have had a breakthrough, however slight, in no small part to Captain Madelaine – Maddie. She has taken to capturing the Withered with a focus I have rarely seen – I suspect it may have to do with someone that she has lost, for she will only take enough coin to sustain her, little else. She does not tire, and my cages remain full for my experiments.

My family does not call me to join them for meals, nor for sleep – I sleep in the workshop now. But the alchemy, it works – the Watchers (the ones willing to still serve as test subjects) report that upon consuming my latest mixture, that the Corruption does not eat at them as it used to, and they retain their strength as they venture north! I have passed along the recipe to the Magistrate, and keep records here as well.

I cannot rest on this success, however – I must continue my research. A half-victory is not enough – the formula only slows the affliction, it doesn't cure it. We must drive it out completely! And I will be the one to make it happen.

-M. Havelock, Archminister
alchemist_body_01_07:
The “Captain” – Maddie returned empty-handed today. She interrupted me in the workshop and when I saw no new Withered in the pen, I inquired – rather sharply – as to why she was disturbing me.

She told me she had spoken to my wife, seen the eyes of Simon, and she has taken their side. She tells me she refuses to capture more Withered for my “experiments” – and then the woman had the NERVE to lecture me, ME, that I have become too narrow of purpose on the Corrupted, that (and I got quite angry at this) my attempts have begun to erode my common sense and are causing both me and my family suffering.

I told her I have no need of her services any longer. If she feels my work is done, then her work is done as well, and there is no reason for us to speak again. She left without a word – good riddance, I say.

-M.H.
alchemist_body_01_08:
In my haste to dismiss Maddie, I remember my cages now lie empty.

I need one - or two - more specimens. It is no trouble, I have observed Maddie's techniques enough that I may capture my own. The Withered are little more than animals – sick animals, but animals to be sure.

I know where some can be found. Though dusk is close, I shall set out at once.

-M.H.
alchemist_body_01_09:
It is a near thing, but the cages have two more captives – though it is strange – for these Withered bear the markings of the settlement to the south – can these have been the settlers there? They smell of a strange sort of rot… sickly sweet, much like if the scents of a corpse and a flower were mixed.

I wonder why they wandered so far – my efforts are more important than ever if the Corruption is making its way this far south. I cannot help but now notice they are caged, these Withered are more eager to return to what might have once been their homes, and they claw at the pen with an unusual strength.

Well, I will not allow it – the only thing they shall find is the mercy of my scalpel and the salvation of my curatives. If they should perish like the others, then when they arise, I shall test them again!

To work!

-M.H.
alchemist_body_01_10:
I labored long into the night – and awoke to screams. I made an error in my methods… my family has paid the price.

Both of the Withered I had caught died upon the table. Yet… and I see my mistake now… when I had taken the second Withered from the pen, I did not lock the gate – and when they rose again hours later, they found the cage unlocked.

Then, they found Genevieve. They found Simon.

The first beast was still skulking outside the house – all I could see was red. I planted a hatchet in its skull, and it turned to ash. The second one soon followed… but as their corpses vanished, the corpses of my wife, my son… they remained.
alchemist_body_01_11:
I finished burying them this morning.

I forgot to say farewell, but I do not think I will – we no longer talked in life, there is no need to do so now that they are dead. I think they wanted to leave the isle, leave this place… leave me… so completely, that the isle honored their wishes and let them sleep.

Afterward… I returned here, to the workshop, to put down my thoughts while they were clear in my mind.

I failed them, yes. But they did not die by my hands, and I will not fail others. No other family will be lost to the Corrupted. All we sought on this isle shall not be lost with them.

This tragedy has only renewed my purpose. I shall bring every Withered beneath the knife, see them exposed to every formula, and I shall see their sickness driven from them. Then, the isle shall know peace. I shall know peace.

-M.H.
alchemist_body_01_12:
The last few visitors – they spoke of the trouble in the north. That the Cleave is nearly abandoned now except for some scattered outposts. When I insisted they take my research, they looked at me as if quite mad – and told me the isle is fragmented, they say, the settlers at each other's throats over Azoth.

The days have bled together. The Withered seem to know my approach, but do not run – as if it is simply the cycle of the day. At times, it seems like they are welcoming me – as if someone familiar, as if family.

-M.H.
alchemist_body_01_13:
A breakthrough – and only I know of it.

This latest formula works, I am certain of it. But without a subject, the only one who may test its properties - is myself.

But if that is what is required, then so be it.

I write now of my symptoms, yet I feel it may prove useless. I will not suffer the Corruption, but in so doing, I have ended my own life, I feel it. My blood seems to flow to unfelt corners of my body, and I can feel the rupturing of every blood vessel – and I can see my eyes bleeding red in my reflection in the lake's waters, and I have no idea how I crawled to the lakeshore… or if I am imagining it.

I will not surrender. This is my home. This is where my family died. I shall NOT die here with them.

My work will live on. I will live on.

ancientaeternum01: Aeternum's ruins tell the tale of a magnificent civilization that once dominated the island.
ancientaeternum02: Its architects, the Ancients, discovered - or possibly created - the energy we call Azoth.
ancientaeternum03: In the millennia that followed, humanity came from countless prehistoric cultures - Sumeria, China, Egypt, and more.
ancientaeternum04: They were called to explore the sea... summoned by the Ancients to this island.
ancientaeternum05: These early arrivals worshiped the Ancients as gods.
ancientaeternum06: They toiled under the Ancients' guidance, building hundreds of monuments and towers.
ancientaeternum07: But humanity's savage nature could not be tamed. Wars broke out...
ancientaeternum08: And amid the chaos, Corruption first appeared.
ancientaeternum09: To combat this new menace, the Ancients imbued a chosen few with gifts.
ancientaeternum10: These heroes were granted monumental powers... and life eternal.
ancientaeternum11: The wars raged on for centuries, and the Ancients' blessed entire armies...
ancientaeternum12: But most of the human vessels degraded into mindless skeletal warriors.
ancientaeternum13: Those wars ended millennia ago, and the Ancients disappeared.
ancientaeternum14: But their haunted Guardians still protect the ruins, oblivious to the fact their cause has long since lost its meaning.

ancientslegacy01: The gods summoned us from the Old World.
ancientslegacy02: Calling us to paradise, the undying land, they promised life eternal.
ancientslegacy03: The divine Ancients shared their wisdom, directing us to build great temples to house their wonders.
ancientslegacy04: The works of my people shone like a jewel in this New World.
ancientslegacy05: But madness erupted throughout the land, igniting a terrible war.
ancientslegacy06: Our great works were laid to waste.
ancientslegacy07: When the fires cooled, the Ancients had vanished.
ancientslegacy08: Leaving behind only ruins and a doomed race of immortal soldiers guarding empty temples.
ancientslegacy09: But we were determined to endure.
ancientslegacy10: In the absence of the Ancients, we became the masters of our own destiny.
ancientslegacy11: We battled the primordial beings birthed by the cataclysm.
ancientslegacy12: And discovered immortality became a curse. Death had not been banished, only transformed.
ancientslegacy13: Even the madness returned to plague us anew.
ancientslegacy14: In the end, the Ancients' promises had been nothing but lies.
ancientslegacy15: I pray they've not blinded us to the terror stirring beneath the sands...

anonymousmanuscripts_body_04_01: This 2nd year harvest proves our stubbornness was justified. Already more are clamoring to join our budding community. The soil is rich and the river provides. \n\n- F. Sneed
anonymousmanuscripts_body_05_01: Jonas was with those hooligans again. I saw them on the bridge and the following morning his face was a mess. I don't like how this place is changing him. He is not the boy I once knew.
anonymousmanuscripts_body_05_02: There was a great commotion several nights ago. Several fevered shouts could be heard from the crest of the waterfall. The precise words were lost to the tumult of the falls themselves. But there were several figures silhouetted against the storm tossed sky in what appeared to be a violent struggle. A thunderbolt forced me to avert my gaze for but an instant and they were gone. I've heard nothing since.
anonymousmanuscripts_body_05_03: More flotsam has washed upon the riverbank this morning and amongst it was a great clump of human hair, matted and bloodied. I fear it belongs to Jonas.

anthurus_00_init_a: <g id="male_hivemind" />Adiana tells us you have come here to seek our boon.
anthurus_00_init_b: <g id="male_shakehead" />We are not easily given to trust, especially with your kind digging, burning, destroying wherever you go.
anthurus_01_comment_rescue_follow: <g id="male_willcoverit" />We have granted the boon you seek. Our debt to you is discharged, and we will not hesitate to hunt you should our paths cross again.
anthurus_01_comment_rescue_new: <g id="male_handheart" />We are indebted to you, beyond words. Tell me, human, how did you come to find this one in that foul place?
anthurus_01_comment_rescue_next: <g id="male_shakehead" />This one feared for a moment it had been forgotten. Corruption clouds even the clearest of vision.<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> We are relieved to be back at the Daughterwell.
anthurus_01_comment_rescue_next2: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />A sanctuary to the Angry Earth, a shrine that dates back to the age of the Ancients, before we even sprouted… this is our home.

apparel_egyptiangods_3_description: Carved in onyx, this armor teems with the power of the chief embalmer.
apparel_egyptiangods_4_description: Signal to all who dare turn their gaze upon you that you are indeed the ruler of the desert.
apparel_fatefortune_fortunetellerl_descr: "Imbued with the shining powers of the crescent moon, lighting up Aeternum just as the lunar surface does at night."
apparel_fatefortune_steampunkh_descripti: "The star shines on, bathing Aeternum in the golden light of redemption."
apparel_firstlightelven_silversweptguard: Stand tall, stalwart guardian of the wilds, and hold high your silvery visage.
apparel_firstlightelven_timberswornenfor: Stalk the wilds like a wraith, passing like a whisper through arbor and vine.
apparel_firstlightelven_verdantdawnsenti: Keen eyes peer from behind a mask adorned in golden vines: ever watching, never ceasing.
apparel_highwayman_capelet_description: When adorned in glittering riches from head to toe, does it truly matter from whence it came? After all, they’re mine now.\n\nIncludes three head skin variants!
apparel_lunar_1_description: "Let loose a roar that shakes the foundations of Aeternum."
apparel_lunar_2_description: "The armor seems to sculpt itself against the wearer's body like a second skin for ultimate stealth."
apparel_malachite_h_description: "Bark as thick and heavy as stone rests on the skin of the wearer, granting them superior immunity."
apparel_malachite_l_description: "The veins of plants unknown cling to this armor, pulsing with life."
apparel_malachite_m_description: "Become the ruler of all things verdant and green in this root-wrapped set."
apparel_metal_h_description: "Proof you've outsmarted the devil himself in a fiddle play-off."
apparel_metal_l_description: "Because you're not hardcore unless you live hardcore."
apparel_metal_m_description: "Be the diehard hero of the Medleyfaire with this intimidating style."
apparel_miner_description: "For those unafraid of getting their gloves dirty with the salt of the earth."
apparel_monster_mummy_description: "For a musty relic contained for thousands of years, it doesn't smell as bad as I thought."
apparel_monster_skeleton_description: "Sinister and sepulchral, armies of bone heed his summons."
apparel_monster_vampire_description: "It's easier to hide any spills if you wear red, my friend."
apparel_nightmares_1_description: Wrapped and sealed tight for comfort and protection. Just try not to get blood in the eye stitches.
apparel_nightmares_2_description: Bare your sharpest of fangs to rip through armor and flesh.
apparel_nightmares_3_description: Protect yourself from the horrors of Aeternum with your stalwart combatant's spirit and this armor fit for a true warrior.
apparel_nightmares_twitch_description: Leave your enemies wondering if they're trapped in a horrible dream as you approach them on the battlefield.
apparel_nightmaresdeluxe_1_description: The red fabric resembles sinewy muscle tissue, all exposed for the battle.
apparel_nightmaresdeluxe_2_description: Gnashing teeth and twirling tongues reflect in shining silver.
apparel_phoenix_h_description: "Outshine, outwit, and bring your opponents to their knees."
apparel_phoenix_l_description: "As it is said, they flock together."
apparel_phoenix_m_description: "As the pyre burns higher, so too does your spirit of battle within."
apparel_romansoldier_description: The standard-bearing soldier of the Roman army marches with purpose and pride.
apparel_royalcourt_crown_description: "Aeternum holds a crown to the head of each traveler, they need only rise to meet it."
apparel_royalcourt_tiara_description: "Not even the rugged wilderness of Aeternum can keep a royal from looking their best."
apparel_sanddune_description: With only your eyes exposed to the elements, look upon the dunes of sand and chart your course to victory.
apparel_seance_theferryman_description: One can only hope to never see a floating vessel in Aeternum, for it would surely be the Charon's and this would surely be the Underworld.
apparel_seance_thehayman_description: No crow fears what is only known in whispers as the Hay Man, for it is equally enmeshed in death as they are.
apparel_seance_theprophet_description: I am All and I am Nothing. I am Everywhere and yet Nowhere. I am the One and now I am You.
apparel_silentdeath_h_description: "Your worst nightmare come alive to haunt the battlefields of Aeternum."
apparel_silentdeath_l_description: "Made of the finest studded leather in Aeternum it is equally protective as it is silent in movement."
apparel_silentdeath_m_description: "What looks at first to be a large bird running at you will be your untimely demise."
apparel_stormbound_description: "Bound by the storm that brought you to Aeternum, you have carved out a name for yourself on the island."
apparel_valentines_1_description: "For those who find themselves lost in frequent bouts of admiration and swooning."
apparel_valentines_2_description: "Upon donning this armor, your chest swells with the urge to protect the innocent, the unguarded, and the lovers of the world."
apparel_vogue_description: "True art is never understood in its own time."
apparel_warspecial_description: "The resplendent uniform of Death itself, said to stalk every battlefield in Aeternum cursing the island's resurrections."
apparel_waveborne_description: "Rising from the dark and twisting sea, a deadly wave crashes ashore."
apparel_wicked_description: "No wolf dare challenge you or Grandma now."
apparel_winterconv2022_1_description: You can feel the uncanny warmth of winter within you.
apparel_winterconv2022_deluxe_descriptio: Celebrants have used such clothing during the Convergence for many centuries.
apparel_winterconv2022_prime_description: Their true purpose has been forgotten for centuries, but such ceremonial knights guard us during our celebrations.
apparel_winterdragon_1_description: Washed ashore from the Eastern Sea, this armor was neither dampened nor sullied by the tides that beseeched it.
apparel_winterdragon_2_description: "Where the Rainbow ends, the Dragon begins."
apparel_winterdragon_deluxe_description: It is said that when the Dragon King descends from the Heavens, the dawn upon his back casts as radiant wings.
apparel_winteroutfit01_description: "By gleam of gem, finery of fur, and glamour of vivid color, one revels and fights back the chill of the darkest nights of the year."
apparel_winteroutfit02_description: "In the dead of winter, even the most practical hunter dons their finest colors before seeking the light and warmth of the season’s festival."
apparel_winteroutfit03_description: "One cuts a distinctive silhouette in the season's gloom as folk gather for celebratory processions."
applebittert1_description: Cooking and crafting ingredient.\n\nGathered from Apple Trees in Nighthaven.

This object contains a gift for watching your favorite streamer.

Includes the following:
<font color="#b2aea1">
5x Vial of Suspended Azoth

25x Dark Matter

3x Gypsum Orbs

15x Infused Health Potion

5x Infused Regeneration Potion

5x Banana Parfait

5x Powerful Honing Stone

5x Powerful Gemstone Dust</font>

artifact_set1_1hflail_desc: Swing this flail with unpredictable fervor, echoing the chaotic dance of battle in every wild strike.
artifact_set1_1hgauntletice_desc: Embrace the chill of this gauntlet, freezing enemies in their tracks and turning the battlefield into a frozen wasteland.
artifact_set1_1hgauntletvoid_desc: This gauntlet taps into the void, siphoning the essence of foes to empower its wielder with each strike.
artifact_set1_1hkiteshield_desc: A shield swirling with energy, offering protection with swift and righteous defense.
artifact_set1_1hlongsword_desc: A blade honed for relentless carnage, cleaving through foes with brutal precision.
artifact_set1_1hrapier_desc: A rapier designed for calculated finesse, delivering the final, elegant thrust to conclude any duel.
artifact_set1_1hroundshield_desc: A shield that embodies the spirit of a fearless warrior, deflecting attacks with grace and tenacity.
artifact_set1_1hthrowingaxe_desc: Infused with the essence of the Norse goddess, this hatchet delivers swift strikes that echo the wrath of the divine.
artifact_set1_1htowershield_desc: A tower shield of unwavering strength, providing an impenetrable barrier for allies behind its unyielding defense.
artifact_set1_2hblunderbuss_desc: This blunderbuss spreads chaos and affliction, its shot scattering like a contagion among those unfortunate enough to be targeted.
artifact_set1_2hbow_desc: Unleash bolts of precision and power with this bow, turning the tide of battle with each meticulously aimed shot.
artifact_set1_2hgreataxe_desc: A Great Axe that hungers for destruction, its immense weight cutting through enemies as if plunging into the depths of darkness.
artifact_set1_2hgreatsword_desc: A massive greatsword that brings a sense of calm amidst chaos, sweeping through battle with a serene yet devastating force.
artifact_set1_2hmusket_desc: A musket engineered to perfection, firing with mechanical precision and devastating impact.
artifact_set1_2hspear_desc: This deadly spear has the words "get over here" etched on the handle.
artifact_set1_2hstafffire_desc: Harness the fury of flames with this staff, conjuring infernos that engulf adversaries in roaring conflagration.
artifact_set1_2hstafflife_desc: A staff that heals and avenges, turning the life force of allies into a force to be reckoned with.
artifact_set1_2hwarhammer_desc: This hammer channels the lightning of legends, its thunderous strikes electrifying the battlefield.
artifact_set1_amulet1_desc: A relic frozen in time, its hands forever halted, a token of moments now lost to the ages.
artifact_set1_amulet2_desc: Worn as a symbol of eternal life, this amulet radiates resilience and protection to those who wear it.
artifact_set1_earring1_desc: An earring that whispers of insatiable desires, granting heightened strength with each fallen adversary.
artifact_set1_earring2_desc: An earring that resonates with tranquil waves, soothing its wearer's spirit and enhancing focus amidst chaos.
artifact_set1_heavychest_desc: Clad in the Void Darkplate, become an embodiment of impenetrable darkness, striking fear into the hearts of those who oppose you.
artifact_set1_heavyfeet_desc: Root yourself, standing firm against all challenges while maintaining unshakable stability.
artifact_set1_heavyhands_desc: Harness the power of attraction with these gauntlets, manipulating metal and drawing your weapon to your enemies weak points.
artifact_set1_heavyhead_desc: A helm that defies defeat, offering resolute protection and instilling unwavering determination in its wearer.
artifact_set1_heavylegs_desc: These pants grant a sense of unparalleled mobility and liberation when worn.
artifact_set1_lightchest_desc: Draped in the Featherweight, move like a whisper and strike with unexpected force, catching enemies off guard.
artifact_set1_lightfeet_desc: Step into the Tumbler Feetwraps to maintain balance even in the midst of chaos, recovering swiftly from falls and evading with acrobatic finesse.
artifact_set1_lighthands_desc: Slip on the Quickdraw Gloves to enhance your reflexes, enabling rapid weapon draws and lightning-fast reactions in the heat of battle.
artifact_set1_lighthead_desc: Crown yourself with the Grey Wizard's Hat to wield mystical prowess, channeling spells with the wisdom and power of a master sorcerer.
artifact_set1_lightlegs_desc: These pants have reinforced knee guards and a swirl of energy around them making you harder to hit.
artifact_set1_mediumchest_desc: Don the Nimble Coat and embrace agility without compromising protection, embodying swift and calculated movements.
artifact_set1_mediumfeet_desc: Step into Winged Leather Shoes, embracing fleet-footed grace and soaring agility as if taking flight on the battlefield.
artifact_set1_mediumhands_desc: Slip on these gloves, attaining an eerie dexterity that allows you to maneuver through shadows with an eerie touch.
artifact_set1_mediumhead_desc: Envelop your senses in the mystique of the Djinn Headwrap, channeling elusive energies and weaving spells with an air of enchantment.
artifact_set1_mediumlegs_desc: Wear the Attuned Leather pants to harmonize grace with protection, ensuring fluidity in combat and evasion when necessary.
artifact_set1_ring1_desc: A ring that pulses with a vampiric hunger, siphoning vitality from foes to empower its bearer.
artifact_set1_ring2_desc: A ring that amplifies the intellect, bestowing strategic prowess upon its wearer in the heat of battle.
artifact_set2_1hflail_desc: The flail leeches the power from your foes, making its bearer stronger in the process.
artifact_set2_1hgauntletice_desc: Take refuge from the cold within my grasp.
artifact_set2_1hgauntletvoid_desc: The very fabric of the metal is held together by a power you do not understand.
artifact_set2_1hrapier_desc: A soft fiery glow emanates from the blade, though it is cool to the touch.
artifact_set2_1hthrowingaxe_desc: This hatchet is a wickedly sharp instrument with a malevolent aura. Its finely honed edge is capable of cutting through the toughest materials effortlessly, making it a fearsome tool in the hands of those who embrace the shadows.
artifact_set2_1htowershield_desc: *Slaps shield* "You can fit so many friends in this thing."
artifact_set2_2hblunderbuss_desc: Chaos' chaoticness is only rivaled by the chaos the wielder brings to any situation.
artifact_set2_2hbow_desc: Bane of the Basilisk, this bow's poison can kill even the strongest of foes.
artifact_set2_2hgreataxe_desc: A force of nature personified. With a massive, swirling blade that mimics the destructive power of a storm, this formidable weapon strikes fear into the hearts of adversaries as it cleaves through the battlefield.
artifact_set2_2hgreatsword_desc: A well balanced blade, as light as a rapier. Holding the blade feels effortless.
artifact_set2_2hmusket_desc: The explosive shells of this musket cause your foes to bleed. Death by a thousand cuts, right?
artifact_set2_2hspear_desc: A deadly weapon designed to deliver swift and precise strikes. Coated with a potent poison that lingers on its razor-sharp tip, this spear ensures that its victims face not only the immediate impact but also a lingering threat.
artifact_set2_2hstafffire_desc: Chosen weapon of the pyromancers of old.
artifact_set2_2hstafflife_desc: Shines brighter than the sun, giving new strength to your light based spells.
artifact_set2_2hwarhammer_desc: A demon appears trapped within the hammer, doing all that it can to escape.
artifact_set2_amulet1_desc: Adorned with fiery insignias, bestows its wearer with the resilience to rise from the ashes of adversity, granting a renewed vigor in the face of challenges.
artifact_set2_earring1_desc: Do what is right, not what it easy.
artifact_set2_heavychest_desc: Bulky plate that protects you from all who would do you harm.
artifact_set2_heavyfeet_desc: Your foes will cower at how fast you are lumbering at them.
artifact_set2_heavyhands_desc: These gauntlets can hold a kinetic charge that can be unleashed dealing a massive attack. They feel cold to the touch and warmup as they charge.
artifact_set2_heavylegs_desc: Forged in intense crucibles, offer unparalleled defense with interlocking iron plates. Gleaming like polished steel, they symbolize durability and empower wearers with an iron heart to overcome challenges on the battlefield.
artifact_set2_lightfeet_desc: A lightweight and versatile footwear that embodies the principles of discipline and dedication. Designed for swift and silent movement, these boots provide the wearer with the agility needed to follow any creed or path.
artifact_set2_lighthead_desc: You look extra powerful with this on. Everyone probably fears you. Probably.
artifact_set2_mediumchest_desc: This coat is a stylish yet rugged garment adorned with intricate nature-themed patterns. Imbued with the essence of the wilderness, this coat offers both protection and a connection to the primal forces of the natural world.
artifact_set2_mediumhead_desc: Look at all those glittery gemstones.
artifact_set2_mediumlegs_desc: Raw energy flows through the leggings, each step you take causing azoth to surge within your being.
artifact_set2_ring1_desc: An intericate caving ontop a band, with symbols matching all of the natural elements.
artifact_set3_1hthrowingaxe_desc: Make sure you keep a safe distance when using this.
artifact_set3_2hbow_desc: Biological warfare never felt so good. Maybe wear a mask while you use this.
artifact_set3_2hgreatsword_desc: Be like water my friend. Sharp, pointy water.
artifact_set3_2hwarhammer_desc: Creating a personal space boundary is the foundation of a healthy life.
artifact_set3_mediumhead_desc: It appears we have weaponized the common cold.

azothtree_body_01_01:
So Merchand and his band of drunken loons were at it in the inn again, enjoying the adoration of the crowd, telling their usual round of wild tales. I thought they'd draw every beast a-mile-round to our walls – or perhaps drive them away, which would be the best to be had this night. “The First and Finest Company of Aeternum's Shores,” they'd taken to calling themselves, when I think “Fermented” would be best tossed in there as well.

It was the usual tales of the Azoth they'd uncovered, the horde of Withered they'd butchered from the Cleave and back (which might number three in all, if the claimed bounties were to be believed). Then the drunken shouts and boasts of the rabble turned to how quickly one could fell a tree, of all things.

Yet one in the crowd spoke up, most carelessly, and said he knew of a tree that none could fell.

The inn got quiet at this, and Merchand demanded where this tree was. The man – no doubt regretting his unintended challenge – said he had seen it on the eastern edge of Brightwood, but curiously, it had not always been there – it had risen from the earth not long after the Night of Blue Lanterns. Many in the inn made the sign to ward off evil.

Merchand, on the contrary, seemed invigorated by this (perhaps seeing a tree as easy prey), and said he would go at once to this tree and “true to his word” (true to his boast more like, and with none but the First and Finest to bear witness) chop it down and bring back its lumber to shore up the walls.

It has been a week since their departure – and while there's been scattered talk of going to find them, none has volunteered for the task.

- Bertand
azothtree_body_01_02:
I inquired of the tradesmen in the outpost, and of the “First and Finest” I caught not a word. If they had gone to the "Great Azoth Tree" in eastern Brightwood, they had not made it this far, even to resupply. More telling of the truth of this was the untapped kegs in the outpost – had they lain empty or shattered, I would have known that Merchand and his band had surely come this way.

I think upon the Night of Blue Lanterns and the rumors of the tree's sudden appearance, and I am uneasy. Perhaps Merchand came upon… not a tree to cut down for its azoth-soaked wood, as he'd hoped, but something that cut him down instead.

The fact he and his band have not been seen since… perhaps he was not one of the blessed of the isle after all, reborn to try to fell the tree again. Whatever his company's end, this much is clear – none are eager to travel to this so-called "Azoth Tree". For if it had the strength to end Merchand's boasts and make him swallow his pride when he could not, it could certainly silence other bold travelers seeking to follow his footsteps, and quickly, too.

- Bertand
azothtree_body_01_03:
It is I, Yorke, that writes this chronicle, feigning to record Merchand's nightful boasts for “posterity,” and I have not the ink, the parchment, nor patience for all of Merchand's rambling. It is fortunate he cannot read this chronicle, for writing the truth of his adventures is one of the sole joys of his company.

It is plain to see he and the fellows have some regret for striking out for the “Azoth Tree” (a fool's errand – what manner of tree suddenly sprouts from the earth, and why would one risk crossing deity or devil for it, esp. seeing what Azoth has done elsewhere!). Laying sight upon it, they seemed not driven for fame at cutting down the tree, but confusion as to how they might set about dismantling and hauling it away. None had thought to bring a wagon big enough for the task.

I, for one, do not like camping here. I find the coincidence of the Night of Blue Lanterns and the sudden appearance of this tree to be a warning most clear, not another feat fit for a rabble who playact at a “task worthy of Hercules.”

As night fell, the Blue Lanterns of the highway seemed to glow brighter, and even the ones in the distance seemed most sharp to my eyes. I write these final lines as Merchand has gone off to slumber, and I'll make up words “worthy of the myth” tomorrow… unless he decided to tear up the parchment in anger, like he has for half of our expeditions that fortune did not favor.

- “The Great Merchand” (i.e., Chronicler Yorke)
azothtree_body_01_04:
I did not sleep. I felt as if something was watching us as we camped beneath the tree. Yet when the light of dawn touched the camp, I felt relief, and my fears were dispelled – and the day brought a new joy: Merchand's humiliation!

It is with no small amusement that I chronicle this – I watched Merchand, then his men, one by one – then in tandem, and finally a half-dozen, all take their hatchets to the tree, and the wood remained untouched! Merchand, finally, his face red, sought about seeking to chop the tree down with curses, to pry at the branches with hatchet and chop at it with sword – but to no avail.

Had he not been so angry, I would have laughed, but the unease I had felt earlier in the day became stronger as night drew on and bid me to keep my tongue. More to my unease, I noticed that Merchand had made no signs of packing up camp – it seemed as if he would work in the light of the moon and the glow of the tree.

Yet… the blue light within the tree's wood seemed sharper to my senses as he hacked at it, as if what was within was resisting his efforts. It may have been the trick of the light… but it seemed to grow stronger, pulsing like a heart after every stroke. Turning from the tree, I scanned the growing darkness, but saw naught but the blue lamps burning… except some… seemed moving, as if carried by men.

What manner of men carry a flame of Azoth to their chest?

- “The Great Merchand” (i.e., Chronicler Yorke)
azothtree_body_01_05:
Be warned, traveler – there is a great tree, but do not seek shelter beneath it – others who came before sought to do so, and their bodies lie spread across its roots. I did not bury the ones I saw, for a corpse in Aeternum is an unusual thing if it does not rise, and there was still hope the corpses would vanish in the light of the sun – but it seemed as if they had been there for some time, which was as unsettling as the tree itself.

The tree seems a lesson in that Aeternum takes its own, and leaves others to rot in the sun. On the crest of one's shield, I recognized the mark of the “First and Finest Company” – Merchand's band of opportunists – yet the shield had been cleaved in two with a sword sharper than the crest that defended its owner.

Around the Company, I saw tracks, not unlike those I'd seen at the ruins where Grenville's curiosity had led him (how many fools does this land inspire?). The Ancient Keepers had come for Merchand's band, one and all.

The tree is a thing born of Azoth, born of the blue light in the lanterns. And where the dead walk with azoth burning in the orbs in their chest, I fear these men now walk with them.

- Maddie

bark_99a_msq_07_enc_bark_overseerzan_def: You can not defeat us all...
bark_99a_msq_07_enc_bark_overseerzan_eng: You will join us or be drained of life!
bark_99a_msq_07_enc_bark_overseerzan_spa: Your arrogance will be your end.
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ability_banish_01: Begone, Soulwarden! Begone and never return!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ability_banish_02: How dare you intrude upon the dreams of my beloved!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ability_banish_bl: Do what you will, daughter. It shall not change your fate!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ability_banish_fi: You think to challenge me, Soulwarden? With the slightest effort, I shall banish you from this realm evermore!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ability_starfall_: The night shall fall upon you!
Even the stars bend to my will! What hope have you to stand against me?!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_destroy_tearofgae: Even if it takes an eternity, I shall have my way!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_ensnare_successfu: Lilith?! Why do you aid them?!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_post_igc_intro_01: I shall make you regret ever setting foot in Nighthaven!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_summoningshadow_a: My daughter, why do you resist  your fate? You could bring your mother back!
bark_soultrial_alecksi_summoningshadow_c: Cecilia!  If only you could see yourself for what you truly are, there would be none in Aeternum who could stand against you!
bark_soultrial_cecilia_ability_arcaneshi: It will take me some time to focus. Do what you can to hold him off!
To me, Soulwarden! I'll protect us!
bark_soultrial_cecilia_defending_against: Help me, Soulwarden! I cannot hold her off on my own!
bark_soultrial_lillith_ability_ensnare_f: Let me guide your sight, Soulwarden. See that which is hidden and you may still overcome him!
bark_soultrial_lillith_first_ensnare_suc: You forget the ground upon which you stand, 'Warrior King'. There can be no atonement for what you have done!

beastlords01: At the dawn of time, the Beast Lords were among the Titans who roamed the Earth.
beastlords02: They existed in harmony, masters of the world in its natural state.
beastlords03: When the Ancients arrived, they sought dominion over all,
beastlords04: But the newcomers soon discovered Earth's primal children could not be tamed.
beastlords05: I walked among humans at that time and received the Ancients' immortal gifts.
beastlords06: I became their emissary to the primal world.
beastlords07: During the Ancients' Civil War, I fought alongside Artemis against the Corruption.
beastlords08: But the Beast Lords stayed out of the fray, withdrawing to their underworld realm.
beastlords09: Taking with them the Tear of Gaea,
beastlords10: Safekeeping its potential to transform the Earth.
beastlords11: Millennia later, the Huntress called on me to fight at her side once again...
beastlords12: Promising to restore the natural order and the Beast Lords to their place.
beastlords13: But her powers seem to have inspired a strange fury...
beastlords14: One I fear could become a destructive rage that threatens all Aeternum.

berserk_description: Enter a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">berserk</font> mode that increases all attack damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.  Hitting a target will extend duration by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}s</font>, up to a max duration of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">12s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cooldown for this ability will not start until the mode ends.)\n\nTaunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your hatchet, activating this ability inflicts taunt for {[8.000000]}s to all enemies within 8m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)</font>
berserk_mod1_description: While Berserk is active, your movement speed is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.130000 * 100]}%</font>.
berserk_mod2_description: While Berserk is active, all attacks gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> lifesteal.
berserk_mod3_description: Remove all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stuns</font>, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">slows</font>, and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">roots</font> from yourself when you activate Berserk.
berserk_mod4_description: While Berserk is active, your attacks are <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">uninterruptible</font> and you can't be <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">staggered</font>.
berserktree0passive1_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Abilities</font> and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heavy</font> attacks deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to targets below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font> health.
berserktree0passive2_description: After <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> successful light attacks or aimed throws against the same target, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, granting a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> base damage increase for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font> or until the next attack.
berserktree0passive3_description: After a successful heavy attack, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, granting a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> damage increase for the next <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">4</font> attacks within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
berserktree0passive4_description: All cooldowns are reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.020000 * -100]}%</font> when hitting an enemy with an attack while your health is below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} hits per attack.)</font>
berserktree0passive5_description: Increase base damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for every enemy within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}m</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#808080">(Max {[5.000000]} targets.)</font>
berserktree0passive6_description: Hitting a target with a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heavy</font> attack grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font>, increasing armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>.
berserktree0passive7_description: Remove all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font>, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">burn</font>, and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">poison</font> effects from yourself if you hit an enemy while your health is below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cooldown {[60.000000]}s.)</font>
berserktree0ult_description: When you receive lethal damage, avoid death and become invulnerable for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000]}s</font> and restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[500.000000]} HP</font> + <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}%</font> of your base health upon activation. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[70.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>

bookofshadows_body_01_01:
I met the old Norse woman near the windmill house overlooking the swamp. She called the area Fen’s Breath, though we know it as Outlook Mill. She claimed to have been a wise woman in the Old World, one who could speak with the spirits of nature. The Fae, she called them, the Folk of Light and Shadow.

She claimed they taught her to create various wards and charms. I had heard of such things but my granny told me such magics were wicked. But here, magic manifests as easily as mist on a cold night. The wise woman agreed to tell me of her spells so that I could create a Book of Shadows.

I asked her if the Fae were present on Aeternum. She smiled and stroked the end of her crooked nose. “They be everywhere, child,” she whispered. “You may not see them with your eyes, but they are there, watching, waiting…”

I asked her what they were waiting for, but she would not answer. She began humming a haunting tune I had never heard before, but I have heard many times since.

-Deidre
bookofshadows_body_01_02:
It is said Odin shaped the world and the cosmos with the corpse of Ymir. So too do we shape the chaos of our world through acts upon the lifeless clay. Though it might give these milksop church lambkins a dire case of the collywobbles to contemplate it, we know there dwells a tremendous wellspring of virtuous power among the once living remains, both man and beast, long after the spirit flees.

By His many Names and Faces, may He spare me a straw death. By Her many Names and Faces, may She grant me this corpus of knowledge and the audacity to use it. The corpse is a vehicle of change. The clay is the means to shape order in the chaos.
bookofshadows_body_01_03:
Acquire the head or skull of a wolf. Boil it in a dead thief’s tallow and place it in a circle of stones where it may soak up moonlight. Keep vigil over the skull for no less than three days, keeping away any beast or bird that might disturb it. 

Offer the skull a portion of your meal on the night of a holy feast. Draw the appropriate magical stave upon the skull’s brow.

And now, may you enjoy expeditious travel, when you call upon the living name of the wolf’s skull.
bookofshadows_body_01_04:
Whosoever is troubled by unruly sleep in the night would be wise to acquire a raven’s head. Place said head near the entrance to the house, beak pointing to the portal. In front of the beak, draw the appropriate magical stave in the dirt.

May you know peaceful sleep.
bookofshadows_body_01_05:
Acquire a wolf with fur the color of night. Deglove the skin from its body.
Mix pigment with the water extracted from a raven’s eye and draw the appropriate magical stave upon the skin.
Sprinkle the skin with myrrh and submerge the lot in a well, stave facing down.
Circumambulate around the well, four times, anticlockwise.
Remove the skin and peer deeply into the drawn stave.
You shall receive the Shadow Sight.
Store the skin in a caul until you next intend to use it.
bookofshadows_body_01_06:
Thus, he made a gallows of the World Tree.
Full of fruit dangling, wisdom ripening.
And so, I know, if on a tree I see
a hanged one hoisted on high:
thus, to scribe with the runes I stain,
that down he drops
and tells me no lie.
bookofshadows_subtitle_01_06: Preserving the Heads of the Wise

bundle_pr_balance_heraldoforder_descript: Will you fight to maintain the balance of chaos and order on Aeternum?
bundle_pr_balance_keeperofequilibrium_de: The balance between light and shadow can easily shift here on Aeternum.
bundle_pr_bf_azotharcana_description: For those who feel the threads of magic interwoven with their very being.
bundle_pr_bf_gladekeeper_description: The glade remains peaceful and serene only due to your steadfast protection.
bundle_pr_bf_huntersinstinct_description: Your fingers are as sensitive to a bowstring as a bard's are to a lute. Yet your opponent hears no song, only a whistle from the arrow flying towards their heart.
bundle_pr_bf_knightofhonor_description: Chivalry isn't dead. Not as long as you're alive.
bundle_pr_bf_maulersbrawlers_description: Reach out and touch someone extremely forcefully with a deadly implement.
bundle_pr_classicmonster_apparel_descrip: Costumes sure to cause a stir at the party, and make partygoers draw their blades in fear at your arrival.
bundle_pr_classicmonster_weapons_descrip: Conjure the most primordial fears in those who oppose you.
bundle_pr_damagedealers_description: Everything you need to leave a trail of bodies in your wake.
bundle_pr_dancemix_description: Show off your amazing dance moves!
bundle_pr_darkfae_apparel_description: While Aeternum is rife with corrupted souls, one can also find delicate and enchanting magic among its many spirits.
bundle_pr_darkfae_weapon_description: The results are both unpredictable and enchanting when using weapons blessed by the spirits of the wild.
bundle_pr_dec23_unvaultpromo_desc: Dress yourself for the season! Perfect for all the holiday parties from Caliburne to Windsward.
bundle_pr_deepseacreatures_apparel_descr: Drink deep of the wine-dark sea, and embrace the power held within.
bundle_pr_deepseagothic_weapon_descripti: Long have you known fathoms below contain unspeakable wonders - and now, they rest in your palms.
bundle_pr_elven_apparel_description: Cloaked in Nature's fury, set forth to explore the untamed wild.
bundle_pr_elven_weapon_description: The elegant beauty and raw power of nature, all in the palm of your hand.
bundle_pr_emotetaunts_description: Tell them how you really feel!
bundle_pr_fireandflames_description: Go out in a blaze of glory, or up in smoke.
bundle_pr_firelight_apparel_description: Fashion that in and of itself is a sick burn.
bundle_pr_firelight_weapon_description: Forged in fire, quenched in flame, these weapons burn hotter than the rage within your heart.
bundle_pr_frontierwasteland_apparel_desc: Your clothes mark you as one unafraid of the untamed wilderness, capable enough to face its dangers alone.
bundle_pr_frontierwasteland_weapon_descr: Steel is more valuable than a companion when wandering the wasteland. Companions can be unreliable. Steel never is.
bundle_pr_gothknight_weaponarmor_desc: Embrace the darkness, and come in to your power.
bundle_pr_highwayman_apparel_description: Will you throw in  your lot with the highwaymen and scoundrels who roam Aeternum?
bundle_pr_highwayman_weapon_description: Weapons suitable for mercenaries, brigands and other dangerous wanderers of the land.
bundle_pr_jestersmile_description: The wit of the Jester can be deadly. Give him a blade and soon you may not be laughing at all.
bundle_pr_launchpets_description: "Everyone needs companionship on this twisted, cruel island. Invite these four-legged friends into your home."
bundle_pr_legendarytoolsets_description: "Masterly crafted toolsets demonstrate your flair while you do the hard work required to build a fortune."
bundle_pr_lichenlord_description: Even amid the horrors of Aeternum, one can find still find verdant green sanctuaries, but the Angry Earth is always near at hand.
bundle_pr_medievalhistoric_apparel_descr: Encase yourself in a shell of steel or end up in a coffin of wood.\n\nIncludes two apparel variants, one marked with the scars of battle!
bundle_pr_medievalhistoric_apparel_name: Ivory and Gold Battleworn Apparel Bundle
bundle_pr_medievalhistoric_weapon_descri: Steel from centuries past, if well maintained, is just as deadly as any crafted today.
bundle_pr_megapack_angelsdemons_descript: Get all Angels and Demons apparel and weapon skins! A statement on the duality of the world.
bundle_pr_megapack_lunar_description: Get all Lunar New Year apparel, tool, and weapon skins! May Fortune favor your endeavors in Aeternum this year.
bundle_pr_megapack_royalcourt_descriptio: Get all Royal Court apparel, tool, and weapon skins! Whether you rule through benevolence or with an iron fist, your style needs are covered.
bundle_pr_megapack_runic_description: Get all Runic apparel and weapon skins! Longship and bloodthirst not included.
bundle_pr_metal_megapack_description: "Heavy lies the head that tunes down."
bundle_pr_nightmare_apparel_description: Clothe yourself in the darkness of ancient memories.
bundle_pr_nightmare_mask_set_description: They may not know your name, but they will know you by your deeds.
bundle_pr_nightmare_weapons_description: Weapons that will lodge themselves in the nightmares, and flesh, of your foes.
bundle_pr_omensofwinter_apparel_descript: Which omen will appear? That of a mild winter or that of a treacherous, frigid nightmare?
bundle_pr_omensofwinter_weapon_descripti: They say delusion is the only way to feel warmth once the frozen pall of winter arrives.
bundle_pr_pauldronedfears_description: Clad yourself in menacing armor and be ready to annihilate your foes.
bundle_pr_ronin_ironscalearcher_desc: May your arrows fly true, and ever find their mark.
bundle_pr_ronin_resolutesoul_desc: Seek your own destiny, and be unbound from the expectations of others.
bundle_pr_ronin_roadwornfateweaver_desc: When fate's head rears, weave your own path.
bundle_pr_ronin_shadowsreach_desc: The reach of the shadows is boundless - do not underestimate those that walk in them.
bundle_pr_rosesaresharp_description: Give your love a rose, thorns first.
bundle_pr_rpg_apparel_description: "The perfect attire for exploring primeval forests or abyssal dungeons."
bundle_pr_rpg_weapons_description: "Weapons that have long slumbered in the lair of a wicked worm, still sharp and ready for battle."
bundle_pr_seance_apparel_description: When the moon looms above and the veil wears thin, they prowl and creak among the shadows.
bundle_pr_seance_masks_description: Spirits from beyond the grave roam more freely on Aeternum than the world at large. Best they don't know you too intimately.
bundle_pr_seance_weapon_description: Legends long past lend power in death, as they did in life.
bundle_pr_silentdeath_apparel_descriptio: "Stalk your enemies with confidence, knowing that when they realize you're there… it's already too late."
bundle_pr_silentdeath_weapons_descriptio: "The tools of someone fanatically dedicated to the taking of life."
bundle_pr_weapon_lunar_description: "Mark the new year with a fearsome roar and wicked slash."
bundle_pr_weapon_lunar_name: Lunar New Year Weapon Skin Bundle
bundle_pr_weapon_royalcourt_description: "A selection of weapons fit for the mightiest ruler."
bundle_pr_winterconv2022_apparel_descrip: Stave off forever winter in festive spirit with these seasonal outfits!
bundle_pr_winterconv2022_weapons_descrip: Winter Convergence is a wonderful time to celebrate with family and draw deadly weapons over the slightest insult!
bundle_pr_winterdragon_apparel_descripti: Which is colder? The icy heart of winter or the frosty heart of the dragon?
bundle_pr_winterdragon_weapons_descripti: Cleave your way through the deepest of winter snow.
bundle_pr_wintermerc_snowboundsavior_des: Whether warming hearts or piercing them with an icy blow, do it in comfort and style.
bundle_pr_wintermerc_stag-heartedwarrior: Stand fearlessly against your foes, and strike a valiant figure while doing so.
bundle_regenpotion_12_description: Claim this tidy bundle of 12 Infused Regeneration Potions!
bundle_regenpotion_3_description: Claim this tidy bundle of 3 Infused Regeneration Potions!
bundle_starter_description: "A collection of essentials to help you survive in style on Aeternum."
bundle_superdeluxepack_description: Rise up with the might of the desert wind and unleash forces of an ancient evil. This bundle also includes the "Desert Vanguard" title.
bundle_tool_classicmonster_description: "A collection of frightful, cursed tools that bore into the user's very psyche for their power."
bundle_tool_darkfae_description: The mystical spirits that guard the land that have imbued this toolset with their knowledge of how to best harvest its resources.
bundle_tool_egyptiangods_description: "Uncover ancient mysteries with these magnificent relics."
bundle_tool_elven_description: Nature gives, and nature takes… but these tools may help you balance the scales.
bundle_tool_fatefortune_description: "Wealth and resources do not guarantee a glorious destiny."
bundle_tool_firelight_description: Hard effort in the heat of the fire yields infernal rewards.
bundle_tool_frontierwasteland_descriptio: Wanderers of Aeternum need great skill in foraging in order to survive.
bundle_tool_legendaryazoth_description: "A touch of magic pairs well with any task, including gathering what is needed to survive."
bundle_tool_legendarystrength_descriptio: "Strength of arm can be the best way to render the resources of Aeternum into their constituent natures."
bundle_tool_legendarytech_description: "These wondrous implements represent a lost technology beyond the sciences of any scholar you know."
bundle_tool_lunar_description: "These tools may help you find fortune in the coming year."
bundle_tool_metal_description: "For those who find the harshest melodies in the simplest of tasks."
bundle_tool_nightmares_description: Ancient horrors can help reap new nightmares.
bundle_tool_phoenix_description: "Airily light, to make it easy to lift your fortunes."
bundle_tool_royalcourt_description: "These tools shine so that all may know who wields the power of gold on Aeternum."
bundle_tool_silentdeath_description: "For those in the dark trades, even resource gathering is done in the black of night."
bundle_tool_valentines_description: "Love benefits from great effort… and the accumulation of resources."
bundle_tool_winter21_description: "Gathering resources in the dead of winter can be a grim and gloomy enterprise. Why not warm the heart with glitter and gilt?"
bundle_umbralshard_1000_description: Claim this generous pile of 1000 Umbral Shards!
bundle_umbralshard_1500_description: Claim this massive heap of 1500 Umbral Shards!
bundle_umbralshard_300_description: Claim this neat stack of 300 Umbral Shards!
bundle_umbralshard_500_description: Claim this tidy bundle of 500 Umbral Shards!
bundle_vogue_promo_description: "True art is never understood in its time. Style yourself accordingly."
bundle_warspecial_promo_description: "Don the resplendent uniform of Death itself, said to stalk every battlefield in Aeternum. Get some dark gray dye along with it to remove even more light from the world."
bundle_weapon_good_evil_description: "Will you choose weapons imbued with the light of grace, or those extracted from the chaos of the inferno?"
bundle_weapon_good_evil_name: Angels and Demons Weapon Skin Bundle
bundle_weapon_runic_description: "Weapons engraved with the mystic runes of a fearsome warrior culture."
bundle_weapon_wicked_description: When you stare into the gem, evil stares back.
buttert1_description: Cooking ingredient.\n\nCreated at a Kitchen by combining other ingredients.
c10a_adjudicator_00: Much of the suffering in this settlement is brought on by the foolish actions of those who settled here.
c10a_adjudicator_01: You have so much more inside than you know, Marauder.
c10a_adjudicator_default: Much of the suffering in this settlement is brought on by the foolish actions of those who settled here.
c10a_alchemist_00: I have been studying the ruins and am working to harness the power of Azoth within them.
c10a_alchemist_01: You profiteers let your greed for gold distract you from the real fortune of Aeturnum.
c10a_alchemist_02: I'll grant that you acolytes live a noble life. Ignorant and blind, perhaps pointless, even. Yet noble.
c10a_alchemist_default: Ah, I am Alchemist Edwarde Geoff. The legacy of the Ancients has never been closer, but only we of the Syndicate are positioned to take it in our grasp.
c10a_antonia_00: Welcome to Cutlass Keys. I am Antonia Cassia Lucian, captain of this settlement. It was my crew that first established this place when we shipwrecked years ago.
c10a_antonia_01: Ever since those cursed doubloons washed ashore, Cutlass Keys has been a magnet for Lost pirates. If we don't do something soon, we'll be overrun!
c10a_antonia_02: The tremors have resumed with greater force and frequency than before. I feared this might happen.
c10a_antonia_03: We've been noticing some slight seismic activity again…
c10a_antonia_04: The hills sound quiet for now… I'll flag you down if and when they starting acting up again.
c10a_arnold_00: Arnold Trost at your service. I used to be the sailing master on the Vernal Bounty, keeping watch against storms. These days I prefer to stay indoors.
c10a_arnold_01: All this excitement has gotten the Lost a little too riled up for my taste. Thankfully, I've got this here "Lost Deterrence" concoction to ward them off!
c10a_arnold_02: Whew! That is quite an odor coming off the pylon. Pungent, to say the least... I almost feel bad for using it on those decaying bastards, but it does the job.
c10a_billiam_00: No.. No, no, Orion shouldn’t be there, it can’t be there! It’s supposed to be over there! This is incredible, I’ve never seen anything like this.
c10a_billiam_01: Oh, I do apologize friend. The heavens entrance me you see, so my eyes are usually pointed up, not down. Name’s Billiam, though most call me "Wistful Bill."
c10a_billiam_02: Ah, there’s my fellow star-gazer! You won't believe this, but I'm right back in the same jam I was before! Don't suppose you'd be willing to help?
c10a_billiam_03: That spirit you brought down must’ve lived up to the tales. Its power is immense in even small doses, though I fear I’m getting carried away with my usage.
c10a_bronn_00: To think I once hunted many of the scoundrels here. Now they’re my brothers and sisters in this nightmarish land. What a twist of fate.
c10a_bronn_01: The Sable Fleet are a ruthless bunch. They’ve captured many fortune-seeking pirates flocking south towards newfound treasures.
c10a_bronn_02: I’ve been informed that the Sable Fleet have already amassed new prisoners. They're potential allies in our cause. We can’t let them rot in those cages.
c10a_bronn_03: Don’t stray too far. The way things are goin' down here, those prison cells won't be empty for long!
c10a_bronn_04: With tales of treasure afoot down south, I highly doubt these are the last of the Sable Fleet prisoners.
c10a_claire_00: Hi, hi there! I'm Claire, Claire Fergus. I've read all about Cutlass Keys! It's said to be filled with pirate treasure; you just have to know how to find it.
c10a_claire_01: You’ll remember the name Claire Fergus as the best treasure hunter in all of Cutlass Keys! I just need to, ya know, actually find some treasure first.
c10a_claire_02: Unbelievable… Simply unbelievable. That just can’t be all that was left. We may need to search those ruins again soon; I refuse to give up that easily.
c10a_claire_03: I've been thinking, why don't we take another stab at the Cursed Steps? I'm sure it would be no trouble to venture through again, what with your reputation.
c10a_commander_00: So many heads to bash, so little time. Stop wasting my time and go out there and stake a claim for yourself.
c10a_commander_01: You only have the leisure to study because we Marauders spill our blood.
c10a_commander_02: You cultists always seem scarce when the Corrupted are at our gates.
c10a_commander_default: You must fight to survive here. There are frequent attacks from the Corrupted and a never-ending supply of pirates out to steal our supplies.
c10a_decima_00: Ah, you’re a new face ‘round here! Name’s Decima Opimius, pleasure to meet ya! Can I interest you in any of my delectable recipes?
c10a_decima_01: By chance, are you heading to the Citadel? If so, I’ve become rather well known for cooking up some damn good grub that’s sure to light a fire in your soul.
c10a_decima_02: As harrowing as your last tale was, I can't help but wonder if you have more to tell. Who knows, another story might spark some inspiration for new dishes!
c10a_decima_03: Good to see you again! You know, your story really only whets my appetite. It inspires my cooking, no doubt, but I must admit I long for another tale soon.
c10a_doubloonguard_default: The guard gives you a severe glare and without a word, hands you a note.
c10a_doubloonguard_note: The Note Reads: If you value your tongue, you'd do well to keep your grubby hands off, unless you have doubloons. Trust me, it's no idle threat.
c10a_doubloonpouch_description: Open to acquire a bundle of Mythic Doubloons. More Mythic Doubloon Trades are now available.
c10a_fei_00: Welcome! I'm Fei Lixin, artificer exraordinare. I like to keep up on all the latest crafting advancements. Let me know if you need anything made special.
c10a_fei_01: I have been studying the Lost for quite some time now and I believe that I may be on the verge of an extraordinary breakthrough that could change everything!
c10a_fei_02: You've returned! Impeccable timing, I must say. Thanks to your help in gathering the elemental essences, I have just completed several new prototype devices!
c10a_fei_03: Those lightning bombs are sure to help hold off the Lost the next time they try to take over our fort!
c10a_fei_04: Well, if it isn't my electrifying companion! How about another round of testing? I've already prepared the next batch of lightning bottles.
c10a_fei_05: My work has never progressed this steadily. The data you collected has been invaluable, friend. All these new developments may just warrant another test soon!
c10a_flowers1_description: On its own a normal enough flower, but in slchemy it serves as a powerful bonding agent, allowing the traits of other ingredients to become amplified.
c10a_flowers2_description: These blossoms smell horrid, but so strong their stench would sink into even the thickest of stone.
c10a_flowers3_description: This small flower pulses a sense of vitality as you hold it. Makes you want to dance.
c10a_grimm_00: Be warned friend. Careless adventurers lost to the gold curse tell no tales. Best keep your ruddy hands safe indoors, until you harden that hull of yours. Ha!
c10a_grimm_01: That look in your eye… no accident coming to me, was it? Other folk in these parts don't believe my tale, but you might just be the one I've been looking for.
c10a_grimm_02: Remember, every cursed doubloon you find must come to me to be destroyed. Do not tarry with them in your possession, lest ye find yourself caught by the curse.
c10a_grimm_02_alt: Remember, every doubloon you find must be offered to the Well of Fortune. Do not tarry with them in your possession, lest ye find yourself caught by the curse.
c10a_innkeep_default: Ah, you look like you could use a rest.
c10a_kasper_00: If you think being marooned on Aeternum is a curse, beware the bane surrounding the treasures of Cutlass Keys.
c10a_kasper_01: This is all of it, right? And then… and then you’ll leave me in peace?
c10a_kasper_02: Might I trouble you again? The voice claims that only a few more artifacts remain. With those returned, I will be free today… I know it.
c10a_kasper_03: You’ve been of great help. It’s time to see if the voice will be satisfied with all the recovered artifacts.
c10a_kasper_04: Stay safe out there. These are dark times to be wandering Cutlass Keys without a trustworthy crew.
c10a_kasper_default: I will… I will… yes, yes! I promise! Please stranger, just leave me be. I am talking to… someone else.
c10a_m1_complete: That table has treasure aplenty, <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />and there's more where that came from. So come back after your adventures; bring back a haul of doubloons.
c10a_m1_complete_next: Well… <g id="litearmor_youknow" />if you're comfortable taking bounties, you'll find them aplenty down south, but be careful, you may earn a bounty yourself.
c10a_m1_description: The ever magnanimous Patricia Reid wishes to welcome you to Spyglass Ridge and Cutlass Keys. Do her a favor, and speak to some of her friends, will ya?
c10a_m1_incomplete: Grimm and Oxen, they're both characters, alright.
c10a_m1_listentogrimm: Speak with First Mate Grimm in the Tavern
c10a_m1_listentooxen: Speak with James Oxen in the Tavern
c10a_m1_proposal: Something <g id="litearmor_chuckle" priority="high />like that… name’s Pat, and I make it a point to know everyone in town. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Like to keep my finger on the pulse of the place, you see?
c10a_m1_proposal_next2: It pays, too. Information is as good as cold, hard coin around here, <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />and there's no shortage of that either. If you're looking for work, you won't have to look hard.
c10a_m1_proposal_next3: Matter of fact… and this is the only free tip I'll give you… I know of at least two parties looking to hire out for someone <g id="litearmor_converseright" />bold enough to venture into the jungle.
c10a_m1_proposal_next4: One has a tale to tell. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />A cautionary one, to be sure, but he's also offering rewards if you're willing to stick your neck out. His name’s Grimm.
c10a_m1_proposal_next5: And then there's Oxen. <g id="litearmor_handheart" />Lost his entire crew to some horror they stumbled into out there. A foul affair, but he's also paying, if you'll get him some revenge.
c10a_m1_proposal_next6: That’s the spirit! <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Come see me when you’re done, and if you plan on ranging far from town, be wary. It’s a lawless land out there, friend or foe is a grey line.
c10a_m2_complete: Now, listen and listen well. Those doubloons are mine by right, and I aim to destroy the lot! I brought the curse here, and I aim to rectify that.
c10a_m2_complete_next: Noble? No. Penance... for crimes I can't undo. But you don't work for free, do you? Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while. I have treasure. A lot of it.
c10a_m2_complete_next2: Wealth from several lifetimes of adventure upon these shores. Equipment, armaments, reagents... all of a quality you have yet to behold. So what do you say?
c10a_m2_complete_next2_alt: Gather the doubloons and offer them to the Well of Fortune. Your reward? Equipment, Armaments, Reagents... all of a quality you have yet to behold.
c10a_m2_complete_next3: Very well, then. Should we succeed, you'll have brought some measure of peace to an old freebooter and enriched yourself in the process.
c10a_m2_complete_next4: Much of the Esperanza's gold washed up on the southwest islands. But be warned, those cursed doubloons invite mayhem. Watch your back.
c10a_m2_complete_next_alt: Noble? No. Penance... for crimes I can't undo. But you don't work for free, do you? Don't worry, there's treasure to be had. The Well of Fortune will see to that!
c10a_m2_description: First Mate Grimm waits eagerly in the tavern to tell the tale of the cursed doubloons to any and all newcomers. Hear his words and listen well.
c10a_m2_incomplete: Sit down already, we’re in a damned tavern! Rest your legs and feel the fire. You don’t always need to be in such a rush… This won’t take long.
c10a_m2_proposal: Well, not so much a tale as a nightmare. Those doubloons that everyone's after... nobody knows the power they hold. The madness they inflict…
c10a_m2_watchcinematic: Take a Seat and Listen to Grimm's Pirate Tale
c10a_m3_complete: Greetings, old friend. You must have spoken with Oxen, if you came looking for me here. I'm afraid the captain's story is true... Medusa has returned.
c10a_m3_description: James Oxen is seeking a cure for the curse that turned his crew to stone. Speak to Glendyn Trahern in southeastern Cutlass Keys for answers.
c10a_m3_gotoraidpoi: Follow Oxen's Directions southeast to Gorgon's Landing
c10a_m3_incomplete: The carnage... <g id="litearmor_worry" />there's not enough ale in this tavern to wash away what these eyes have seen…
c10a_m3_proposal: We found Medusa, <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />but she was not alone! Her ravenous brood ripped my crew to pieces. The lucky ones were turned to stone. I- I jumped ship and swam to shore…
c10a_m3_proposal_next: The remains of my crew <g id="litearmor_lookdownguilty" />are at the docks. I abandoned them... their own captain! The druid, Trahern, is looking after 'em now. I'm too ashamed to show my face…
c10a_m3_proposal_next2: Aye. <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />Thank you, friend… I'll be here drinking my sorrows. If you can find a cure for those that survived, I'll be forever in your debt.
c10a_m4_description: The Broodmother Medusa has turned Oxen's crew to stone and is spawning hordes of Hercyne to claim Aeternum. Gather ingredients for the antidote and defeat her.
c10a_m4_flowers1: Collect Hyacinth Flowers from Echoing Vale
c10a_m4_flowers2: Collect Kithos Blossom from the Baths
c10a_m4_flowers3: Collect Gorgon's Bane from The Precipice
c10a_m5_complete: Hah! I heard them cannons roaring! You gave ole Blackpowder a taste of his own medicine, eh? No less than the bastard deserved.
c10a_m5_complete_next: As for me, my piracy days are over. Maybe I'll take up the fishing pole again…
c10a_m5_description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition. Gather the chronicles of the infamous Admiral Blackpowder, and take him down for Wally Widdershins.
c10a_m5_incomplete: Blackpowder... cruelest man in all the seas, and crueler still with that idol. Soon as you've stamped him into the ground, I'm walking the straight and narrow.
c10a_m5_proposal: Hah! Caught your ear, though, didn't I? Same as the Admiral, feeding us golden lies about mysterious treasure on a magic island.
c10a_m5_proposal_next: I smelled a rat, but did anyone believe ole Widdershins? Poor sods. Now they're all Lost, and the Admiral…
c10a_m5_proposal_next2: Worse, far worse. When we first landed on this godforsaken shore, the Admiral found something.
c10a_m5_proposal_next3: An ugly little idol, what turned him into something even uglier. He's a beast now, but even so, I say he can't suffer enough for what he did to us. You in?
c10a_m6_complete: You say she was called a 'Nereid?' Fascinating, fascinating! Even if this Nereid said nothing about an underwater city, she must have come from somewhere, and come here for some purpose. Now to find out what it was…
c10a_m6_complete_next: Even if this Nereid said nothing about an underwater city, she must have come from somewhere, and come here for some purpose. Now to find out what it was…
c10a_m6_description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to disrupt the work of a suspected Water Elemental for Rowan Pennbrook.
c10a_m6_incomplete: In my heyday, I hunted all kinds of Elementals across Aeternum. Rare beasts, sent by the Angry Earth to guard all the island's secrets from human eyes. Gah! Just talking about it gets my blood pumping!
c10a_m6_proposal: Can you imagine? A whole region of Aeternum under water. Of course I can't prove it, but... I did track a Water Elemental to this very lair. Hopefully those pirate fools haven't reached the Elemental's sanctum, though I suspect it is very deep within the caverns.
c10a_m6_proposal_next: Hopefully those pirate fools haven't reached the Elemental's sanctum, though I suspect it is very deep within the caverns.
c10a_m6_proposal_next2: Hmph. I'm not as young as I once was. I've got my pride, but you have a point. Watch yourself. This Water Elemental is composed of pure magic and power, and I wager it won't be friendly. If you manage to find and defeat it, hurry back and tell me!
c10a_m6_proposal_next3: Watch yourself. This Water Elemental is composed of pure magic and power, and I wager it won't be friendly. If you manage to defeat it, hurry back and tell me!
c10a_m7_complete: I've a buyer in mind, but first I must pay you in kind. Take your reward, take your coin, and hurry back for more to purloin!
c10a_m7_cooldown: Useful, useful, yes you were. And so bold! Many a bauble have I, ready to be sold. Come back soon young scallywag, and I'll have more loot for you to bag.
c10a_m7_description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to collect golden trinkets from the crewmembers. Bring them back to Quiggley Quorus to cleanse and sell them.
c10a_m7_incomplete: I've nothing but holy water and wits! You'll fight and bring me the baubles and bits!
c10a_m7_proposal: Aye. I was a holy man once upon a time, but no more, no more. Poverty and celibacy? What a terrible bore!
c10a_m7_proposal_next: I stole away with Holy Water, and the magistrate's only daughter. Now I'm here true and bold, ready to cleanse what can be sold!
c10a_m7_proposal_next2: Of course, of course, you silly horse! Blackpowder's got riches untold, the sort I'd claim, ere I'm old. Bring the pretties to me, and a proper reward you'll see!
c10a_nekumanesh_00: Hey, want to find your way around the swamp? You can't go wrong by talking to me, Swamp Walker Nekumanesh, fresh back from Restless Shore.
c10a_nekumanesh_01: I never thought I'd say this, but it's just too quiet around here, you know? I never noticed the silence while my wife was still around, but now it's deafening.
c10a_nekumanesh_02: I've been thinking about where Jocelyn might have gone. She had some relatives nearby. Strange folks that kept to themselves, but she'd often visit them anyway.
c10a_nekumanesh_03: I realize that you already looked for Jocelyn at River's Crossing, but maybe you just missed her. Would you be so kind as to check back there once more for her?
c10a_nekumanesh_04: Ah Jocelyn, where did we go wrong? At least I have her lengthy diary to remember her by. It will take me a lifetime to read it all!
c10a_oxen_00: You should not idle long in these lands. An encroaching darkness continues to spill over from the Elysian Wilds… I fear it cannot be contained.
