c10a_oxen_01: Black… the waves were black and the sky was red. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />Johnson was up in the crow’s nest. They came from the shore. Those horrid buzzing wings. I heard him screaming.
c10a_oxen_02: I can only hope that with your aid, Trahern and the druids can find a way to contain that serpentine hag once and for all!
c10a_oxen_03: My crew are back to their old freebooting ways, thanks to you. Aye, you've got the gratitude of this old pirate, whatever that's worth.
c10a_patricia_00: Mind your cuttables out there, friend. Apparently, some mysterious treasure washed ashore, and now the place is overrun with pirates on the hunt for gold!
c10a_patricia_01: Welcome to the gem of the south, traveler… <g id="litearmor_converseleft" />the Cutlass Keys. If you’re keen to stand a while and listen, I keep a tip or two for every new visitor!
c10a_patricia_02: And then there's Antonia Lucian, our intrepid magistrate, she's offering doubloons for anyone who can assist in her affairs. Just don't let her send you into the southwestern Keys. You don't want that.
c10a_patricia_talkto: Well,<g id="litearmor_agree1" /> I hope you made out well in your dealings with Grimm and Oxen. Your name's been coming up in a lot of conversations around here. I might even have something else for you.
c10a_patricia_talkto_topic: Those doubloons you've got, you can trade 'em in for loot from Grimm's old hauls. <g id="litearmor_gesturebackthere" />At the well over there. Go check it out.
c10a_patricia_talkto_topic_alt: Those doubloons are worth more than you realize. Throw some in the old well down the way and make a wish... they don't call it the Well of Fortune for nothing!
c10a_patricia_topic_pvp: Whole region's madness. Everyone at war with everyone, no matter your flag. Be warned, you'll have to defend yourself against other adventurers there.
c10a_perseus_1_a_topic: Yes, it is a twisted form of the earth's natrual magics. She believes she is setting the world to right. But her path will only end in tears.
c10a_perseus_1_c_topic: Indeed, the Herceryne are ravenous beings. Twisted abominations of the earth's good soil. I sense a spark in you, I believe you are the one to end this.
c10a_perseus_1_m_topic: I admire the bravado, friend! Haha, one day you might be as storied a hero as I - if you keep your wits about you.
c10a_perseus_1_s_prompt: <font color="#7a63d4">Can we use such power against her?</font>
c10a_perseus_1_s_topic: If you mean to create your own Hercyne to battle hers…. You begin to worry me friend. I implore you to banish such thoughts from your mind.
c10a_perseus_2_a_topic: Not without aid. I used the mirror shield of Athena, hid from her gaze, and decapitated her with a swift strike, but that won't suffice here. You will need allies.
c10a_perseus_2_c_prompt: <font color="#fde63a">It is my honor to serve.</font>
c10a_perseus_2_c_topic: A hero so humble. A rare sight indeed. Pray to whatever god you believe in, and victory will be yours.
c10a_perseus_2_m_topic: There's the flame of tenacity! A lion in man's skin. Soon they will sing your praises with mead in hand. But do not let your confidence be your downfall.
c10a_perseus_2_s_prompt: <font color="#7a63d4">If we could harness her powers…</font>
c10a_perseus_2_s_topic: No! When the history books are written of this day, do not let their quills remember you a villain as well. The ends do not justify the means, my friend.
c10a_perseus_3_a_prompt: How much further to her lair?
c10a_perseus_3_a_topic: The Broodmother Medusa lays in wait just beyond. Prepare your tinctures and equip your best blades. Victory awaits.
c10a_perseus_3_c_prompt: <font color="#fde63a">For the meek. She will be defeated.</font>
c10a_perseus_3_c_topic: Devotion to the weak. Very noble a cause my friend. Go forth and free this land from her twisted maw.
c10a_perseus_3_m_topic: You are fearsome, I admire the fire in your heart. Keep a clear head and you will soon have glory.
c10a_perseus_3_s_prompt: <font color="#7a63d4">How exactly does her spawning work?</font>
c10a_perseus_3_s_topic: Cruely. Painfully. And without mercy…. I see the design of darkness in your eyes, friend. Do not let it consume you like it did poor Odysseus.
c10a_plute_00: Hi, I'm Plute Swampy! I used to be the cook aboard the Salty Albatross. Ah, those were the days! We might not have been the best pirate crew, but we sure had fun.
c10a_plute_01: What'll it be, friend? A stiff drink to keep the horrors at bay? Or perhaps a hearty meal to reassure yourself you ain't Lost?
c10a_plute_02: Them crafty little thieves! They stole more pots and pans from me reserve.
c10a_plute_03: I tell you, it's a relief to have my pots and pans back. They were seasoned to perfection from years upon the sea.
c10a_q1_complete: Oh my... I don't know what's worse. The Lost or the smell of that incense... I guess it beats being overrun and beaten to death by a horde of withered ghouls…
c10a_q1_description: Arnold Trost has discovered Lost are repulsed by man-sized sticks of burning incense. Venture into The Salty Marshes and light a Lost Deterrence Pylon to keep them out of Spyglass Ridge.
c10a_q1_incomplete: Every minute you delay the Lost get more organized.
c10a_q1_proposal: It's pure incense, according to Fei, if you can imagine that. I don't think anyone expected those waterlogged corpses to be mindful of strong smells.
c10a_q1_proposal_next: Fei could explain the science of it, I'm more concerned with results. We chased them back to the swamp, but we'll see more Lost if we aren’t proactive.
c10a_q1_proposal_next2: Why, yes! We plant pylons in the swamp wherever Lost congregate. If we prevent them forming groups, they're less likely to approach Spyglass Ridge.
c10a_q1_proposal_next3: Good for us, friend! Take these with you and light 'em in the swamp. Be mindful of the Lost, these things drive them mad.
c10a_q1_setpylona: Light and defend the Deterrence Pylon
c10a_q1_setpylonb: Light and defend the Deterrence Pylon
c10a_q1_setpylonc: Light and defend the Deterrence Pylon
c10a_q1r_complete: Another batch planted? Good. We're all a little safer.
c10a_q1r_cooldown: Good work there, friend. I can smell those pylons from here... unfortunately. A job well done, though, nevertheless.
c10a_q1r_incomplete: I know it's it's dirty work, but it must be done. Get out to the swamp and place more pylons as soon as you can.
c10a_q1r_proposal: It surely does. We should light more! Keeping pressure on the Lost will ensure they stay busy knocking down incense instead of our doors.
c10a_q1r_proposal_next: The more ground we cover, the further away we'll push the Lost out from our settlements. Find a good spot and get to it.
c10a_q2_complete: A rough lot you saved. We’ll have to vet them before offering our supplies and arms, but I have a feelin' they'll prove their worth. Good work.
c10a_q2_container_02: Release the Captives in Sable Prison
c10a_q2_description: Spymaster Bronn wants you to cause a distraction in Pirate's Stand by unleashing the encaged Ancient Guardians upon their jailers. With the enemy occupied, find the prison key and release the pirate captives to bolster our ranks.
c10a_q2_incomplete: Be careful, I don’t want to see you in one of those cages. We’re running thin as it is.
c10a_q2_prisonkey_description: Used to unlock a cage holding captured pirates.
c10a_q2_proposal: They turn their captives into new crew members. I’ll spare you the grim details of that process. If we save 'em, they'll be in our debt. That's what matters.
c10a_q2_proposal_next: They're in a prison south of here. The Sable Fleet somehow outwitted the Ancient Guardians that inhabited those ruins and transformed it into their stronghold.
c10a_q2_proposal_next2: Glad to hear it! Say though, you might want to create a distraction to keep the Sable Fleet occupied while you free all the prisoners. That's what I'd do.
c10a_q2r_complete: These scallywags look even worse than the last bunch, but they'll increase our strength in numbers, and we should be on the lookout for more in the future.
c10a_q2r_cooldown: Don’t stray too far. With tales of treasure afoot down south, I highly doubt the prison cells will be empty for long.
c10a_q2r_incomplete: I hope you get to the captives before the Sable Fleet enact their judgement. We don’t need even more soulless pirates wandering Cutlass Keys.
c10a_q2r_proposal: Those Sable Fleet bastards are on high alert since your raid. They also managed to capture even more prisoners. We'll need to break them out.
c10a_q2r_proposal_next: Aye, I trust you know your way around the battlefield. Now, let's break those prisoners free before the Sable Fleet have their way with them!
c10a_q3_complete: I can’t thank you enough. As long as those Lost stay away, I can confirm my research and seal our names in the history books of this great island!
c10a_q3_description: Help Billiam Rowen with the discovery of his lifetime by defeating the Spectral Tyrant and ridding his cave of Lost! Return to Billiam in Cutlass Keys when you've finished.
c10a_q3_gotofortbarnacles: Travel to the Cave of Tithing
c10a_q3_incomplete: Oh, how I long for the sea at times… But the skies are a rather compelling alternative. I do hope you’re faring well with my request friend!
c10a_q3_killscourge1_description: Kill the Scourge of the Storm
c10a_q3_plantbomb_description: Charge the Telescope in Quest "A Shocking Revelation"
c10a_q3_plantlure_description: Destroy the Spectral Skull in Quest "A Shocking Revelation"
c10a_q3_proposal: Ah, yes! I’ve been charting the skies above Aeternum for years now and stumbled across quite the revelation. Perhaps you’d like to sit down before I tell you.
c10a_q3_proposal2: The sky moves! No, really, it does. Constellations are popping up where they have no business doing so. See for yourself; look at my charts!
c10a_q3_proposal_next: Well, I can’t, not yet at least. I need two things to confirm my discovery: a significant power boost and a confined space to conduct my studies.
c10a_q3_proposal_next2: I found the perfect cave near Fort Ramos, but a Lost brute forced me out. I even caught a glimpse of an astonishingly powerful spirit in the woods nearby!
c10a_q3_proposal_next3: Rumor has it there’s a trick to summoning that particular spirit, something about 3 pillars and beams and… It’s all a bit beyond me, I’m afraid.
c10a_q3_proposal_next4: I would handle this myself but… Well, my talents lay in more academic matters. How would you like to assist me in the most important discovery in Aeternum?
c10a_q3_spectralessence_description: Spectral essence from a tyrannical spirit.
c10a_q3r_incomplete: The night sky is like a vast sea, with constellations as its beautiful creatures. I wonder if I’ll ever come across a manatee star pattern…?
c10a_q3r_proposal: Maybe we'll get lucky and that fiend won't be there… maybe. I can't tell how important this is for me to continue my studies.
c10a_q4_complete: You found them! Surely, surely this is enough to appease it. I hope… at least. Thank you, friend.
c10a_q4_container_01: Complete the Quest Encounter "Endless Riches"\n(Search for the golden beam surrounding the marked location to find encounter)
c10a_q4_description: A collector named Edwin Kasper is haunted by a voice that demands the recovery of artifacts lost among the shipwrecks of Cutlass Keys. Search for a golden beam to the south west and return the artifacts to satisfy the mysterious voice and save Kasper's sanity.
c10a_q4_encounter_title_description: A mysterious chest calls to you. The treasure inside is yours to claim… if you dare to open it.
c10a_q4_incomplete: I wish I never found this cursed relic. It's sheer torture what it's putting me through.
c10a_q4_proposal: Please, help me. I hear a voice… it hungers for artifacts that it once possessed.
c10a_q4_proposal_next: It's this relic I obtained not long ago. Ever since I found it, I'm hearing this voice commanding me to recover its lost possessions.
c10a_q4_proposal_next2: Just make it… no! Just do what it says! It whispers about a golden beam to the south that shines into the sea of stars. That is where you’ll find the items it seeks. Please, help me!
c10a_q4_spectralartifact_description: Ethereal pieces of antiques that are nearly weightless when held.
c10a_q4r_complete: These must be the last pieces. It has to be. Thank you for not running off with such valuables. Your honor in a land of thieves is to be commended.
c10a_q4r_cooldown: It’s time to find out if the intruder in my mind is satisfied with the artifacts you recovered. I should hear a verdict shortly.
c10a_q4r_incomplete: I pray this is the last of it. I can’t take much more…
c10a_q4r_proposal: You’ve been a boon in this wretched situation. Find the golden beam to the south as before. That should lead you to the artifacts.
c10a_q5_complete: So the legends are true? The Bloody Spike was feeding off your actions, wasn't it? And you return with the gemstones to boot… well done.
c10a_q5_container01: Defeat Warriors around The Bloody Spike
c10a_q5_description: Rosina Bryce's search for supernatural rumors have led her to The Bloody Spike. Defeat warriors living and dead to collect enough Soul Gems for an offering, and see fortune bestowed by The Bloody Spike.
c10a_q5_incomplete: You won't find any gemstones standing around, I'd get moving if I were you.
c10a_q5_killspirits: Collect {itemName}s from Warrior Spirits or Players
c10a_q5_offer: Offer Soul Gems to The Bloody Spike
c10a_q5_proposal: Legend has it living and Lost are both naturally drawn to this spire, and the bloodshed surrounding it hardens the soul into gemstones at the moment of death.
c10a_q5_proposal_next: Warriors are claiming the gems and offering them to The Bloody Spike itself. They claim it brings them "great fortune."
c10a_q5_proposal_next2: No, but that's where you come in. You don't have to slay the livin'… unless you want to, of course. Haha! Just strike down enough to see what's what, and then return.
c10a_q5_proposal_next3: Do this, and I'll ensure you receive the "great fortune" as promised! Well, a pretty good fortune anyway. A decent fortune at least.
c10a_q5_soulgem_description: Violence surrounding The Bloody Spike hardened this foe's soul into rock when they finally perished in glorious combat.
c10a_q5r_complete: The Bloody Spike and I are pleased, we hope to see you again soon.
c10a_q5r_cooldown: The Bloody Spike's hunger waxes and wanes, we need not gorge it. The time will come again soon enough.
c10a_q5r_incomplete: I wouldn't keep The Spike waiting.
c10a_q5r_proposal: What do you say we extend our previous deal? Bring us more gems and I'll ensure you find even more fortune.
c10a_q6_complete: That… Well, goodness! That might actually keep me up at night. I wouldn't have thought you could be so vicious. Hope I never disappoint you with my meals!
c10a_q6_description: Get your hands dirty and defeat other fighters at the Citadel. Return to Decima Opimius when you have a story worth telling.
c10a_q6_entercitadelwave_description: Enter the Citadel in Quest "For Guts and Glory"
c10a_q6_incomplete: Oh, come now, your stories aren’t nearly good enough to earn your reward yet. Get back to the Citadel and stand your ground!
c10a_q6_killscourge_description: Kill the Scourge of the Storm
c10a_q6_proposal: Sure have. I can crack a few skulls, sure, but fighting’s not really for me. A spatula’s a bit more my speed. If you’re heading to the Citadel, best prepare!
c10a_q6_proposal_next: I've filled the bellies of many fine warriors, and few among them would step one foot into the Citadel. I'd be careful around that place if I were you.
c10a_q6_proposal_next1: Rumor has it the island was once considered sovereign land and all who stayed there were equals. No laws, just honor among thieves keeping things civil.
c10a_q6_proposal_next2: Well, yes. If the rumors are true, you may be right. I’d go and see for myself, but then who’d keep this lot of ruffians from tearing each other apart?
c10a_q6_proposal_next3: If you do go to the Citadel, and live to tell the tale, come and tell it to me! It’d mean a great deal, and I can even reward ya if the story is good enough.
c10a_q6r_complete: Are you determined to keep me up at night?! That was disgusting. Well, I suppose I did ask for it, and I hate to admit you've left me wanting even more!
c10a_q6r_incomplete: A dash of cinnamon and perhaps some smoked paprika… Are you allergic to anything? Just trying to make you something special for when you get back.
c10a_q6r_proposal: That's the spirit! Get back down to the Citadel and get your hands dirty. I'll get mine dirty too, just with flour... not blood.
c10a_quiggley_00: Treasure, trinkets, gold and glimmer… Make my coin purse shine and shimmer!
c10a_quiggley_01: Treasure, trinkets, gold and glimmer… make my coin purse shine and shimmer! Across the water, buried deep, all for the taking… mine to keep!
c10a_rosina_00: I'm Rosina, I used to be the coxswain on a pirate ship called the Fair Weather Friend. You could say I know a thing or two about enduring hostile environments, haha!
c10a_rosina_01: After the Touched Coin fiasco, I started looking into rumors myself instead of leaving things to chance. Have you heard what they say about The Bloody Spike?
c10a_rosina_02: Here because you want to pay The Bloody Spike another visit?
c10a_rowan_00: The sea near Aeternum churns like a massive cauldron, it's like nothing I've ever seen. I know it sounds fanciful, but I've heard tales of a city beneath the rolling depths.
c10a_rowan_01: The sea near Aeternum churns like a massive cauldron, it's like nothing I've ever seen. I know it sounds fanciful, but I've heard tales of a city beneath the rolling depths.
c10a_rowan_02: An underwater domain of hidden secrets… there must be some truth to the stories. With the Nereid defeated, perhaps there's a way into the Great Beyond beneath the waters.
c10a_s10_complete: Hmm... I do sense powerful magic within these restraints. Something dark... almost... sinister.
c10a_s10_complete_next: Agreed. I will dispose of the items after thoroughly studying them. Perhaps, given enough time, I can design something better.
c10a_s10_description: Gather collars and leashes from tamed dogs and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
c10a_s10_incomplete: I'd stay away from the Lost too - but those at Fort Barnacles have the knowledge I seek! I must have those collars and leashes!
c10a_s10_proposal: Lost Pirates! Have you seen the guard dogs they keep at Fort Barnacles? I must have you investigate and report back. There's so much we can learn from them!
c10a_s10_proposal_next: The Lost must have a method for controlling their animal companions. Bring back any leashes and collars that you find. There's a chance they may be enchanted.
c10a_s10r_complete: You stuff the leather straps into the box with some effort. All that work deserves a reward, and Tosch has graciously provided.
c10a_s10r_cooldown: This station is filled with collars and leashes, it would be best to wait for Tosch to gather them and refill the stash of coins.
c10a_s10r_description: Gather collars and leashes from Lost Pirates and bring them back to the box for Tosch.
c10a_s10r_incomplete: Standing before Tosch's final collecting station makes your heart hurt. You steel yourself before the work ahead.
c10a_s10r_proposal: This is bittersweet, you've found the last of my collecting stations! Gather more of those evil harnesses and bring them here so I may destroy them.
c10a_s11_complete: Just feeling these delicate bristles between my fingers brings me a sense of profound joy. I am confident that a boar is the right choice.
c10a_s11_complete_next: I'll be truly happy once we bring pets to Aeternum for all to enjoy! When that day finally comes, all of this work will have been more than worth the effort.
c10a_s11_description: Gather boar bristles and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he may tame the ultimate pet!
c10a_s11_incomplete: Please find some boar bristles so I can be sure I want one as a pet.
c10a_s11_proposal: I shall cut to the chase then. It's a boar! I simply must tame a wild boar. I just need you to slay a few of them first and bring me their bristles.
c10a_s11_proposal_next: It's the only way I can be sure I'm right, and if you do it, I'll reward you handsomely!
c10a_s11r_complete: My joy in receiving these boar bristles has yet to diminish, nor has my gratitude to you for delivering them to me!
c10a_s11r_cooldown: Lining clothes, stuffing pillows, knitting blankets, I'm keeping very busy. I'll let you know when I need more boar bristles!
c10a_s11r_incomplete: You don't want to hear another boar pun do you? I promise it won't be pretty! Get going before I think up another ab-boar-rent joke!
c10a_s11r_proposal: Ah, I was so lost in thought I didn't see you there! I’ve been using boar’s hair wherever I can, embracing the essence of boar. Could you get more for me?
c10a_s12_complete: There were no signs of Jocelyn? I was certain she'd be there... multiple people from town saw her heading up there.
c10a_s12_complete_next: She always did like chatting to the Lost. Said they were better listeners than her own husband. Maybe she eventually moved on to somewhere else…
c10a_s12_complete_prompt: "No one was there but the Lost."
c10a_s12_description: Search for Jocelyn at Castaway's Colony. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
c10a_s12_incomplete: Chatting with you is filling the silence, but I long to hear my wife's voice again. Seek Jocelyn out at Castaway Colony.
c10a_s12_jocelyn_triggerarea: Search for Jocelyn within the colony
c10a_s12_proposal: We had an argument. She wasn't happy with my being away so often for work. Said she was going to find somewhere else to live... that was some time ago.
c10a_s12_proposal_next: Last I heard, Jocelyn had made her way out to Castaway Colony. But nobody has seen or heard from her since. Will you help me find her?
c10a_s13_complete: So, this is all you could find? No signs of Jocelyn? These teeth are unmistakable, definitely hers... where did you find them? All in one place?
c10a_s13_complete_next: I see. Maybe they were keeping her teeth in case she returned for them. She must have moved on once again. I'm sure we'll find her if we keep looking!
c10a_s13_description: Track Jocelyn by finding her teeth in River's Crossing. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
c10a_s13_gotopoi: Ask residents of River's Crossing about Jocelyn
c10a_s13_incomplete: If only I hadn't gone to help map the swamps in Reekwater. Have you found my wife, or her teeth? River's Crossing is a good place to start looking.
c10a_s13_proposal: They're from River's Crossing. You'll find it just to the west. I'm certain that she must be over there right now, just chatting away with her kinfolk.
c10a_s13_proposal_next: Well, she loved talking. She jawed on so much that her teeth started to fall out! She's there all right, talking away. Just look for a woman with missing teeth.
c10a_s13_teeth: Gather {itemName} from chests at River's Crossing
c10a_s13_teeth_description: From all her talking, over time all Jocelyn's teeth fell out, one by one.
c10a_s14_complete: What's this? Jocelyn's diary? It looks thick enough to be a memoir! Did she give you the diary to bring back to me?
c10a_s14_complete_next: I see. Perhaps she'll be willing to talk once I read the diary. This could take years though... the writing is so small and difficult to read!
c10a_s14_description: Find Jocelyn and recover a keepsake from her. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
c10a_s14_incomplete: Go on, she doesn't bite, at least, not anymore without her teeth. You'll find Jocelyn at River's Crossing.
c10a_s14_jocelyns_diary_description: Every detail of her life, written in extremely fine print.
c10a_s14_proposal: I do recall someone telling me that they found Jocelyn's trunk and many of her belongings in the marsh near the fishery. She must be there after all!
c10a_s15_complete: That’s it, just a handful of doubloons?! Where's the rest of the treasure? Where are the gems, the piles of gold, the chests of riches I was promised?
c10a_s15_complete_next: Curses! My old partner must have beaten us to the punch and used the other half of the map to plunder the treasure! We should search the area again to be sure.
c10a_s15_description: Follow the treasure map Claire provided to discover great riches! Talk to Claire Fergus in Cutlass Keys when the task is done.
c10a_s15_gotopoi: Explore the Cursed Steps in search of treasure
c10a_s15_haveitem: Collect Silver Doubloons from chests in Cursed Steps
c10a_s15_incomplete: This is all a bit exciting, isn’t it? I just wish my last partner hadn’t stolen the other half of the map. At least this half has the ‘x’ that marks the spot!
c10a_s15_proposal: Yes! But that’s where my problems begin; it’s only half a map, unfortunately. It points directly to the Cursed Steps, but I can’t seem to find anything there!
c10a_s15_proposal_next: Be my guest. The map belonged to one Thompson the Tireless who is said to have been so good at hiding riches, his crew couldn’t even find it with a map.
c10a_s15r_complete: By the Kracken, is that really all that was left? This really is looking dire… Maybe if we wait a bit longer, something will turn up?
c10a_s15r_incomplete: Look, I'm flattered, but what are you doing coming back here and talkin' my ear off? It's not a courtship I'm looking for, it's treasure!
c10a_s15r_proposal: There must be! I refuse to believe that traitor I once called a partner was able to best me in my treasure hunt. Get back out there and find whatever you can!
c10a_s1_complete: Ah, let's see… that's them! No better pans in all Aeternum! Oh, I can kiss ya.
c10a_s1_complete_next: Thank you! I'll have to cook up something special just for you! Maybe I'll make one of Shillie's favorites.
c10a_s1_description: Return the set of pots and pans to Cook Swampy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
c10a_s1_incomplete: Have you recovered me pots and pans yet? I once used that frying pan to hit a patron who didn’t pay up. He doesn’t remember it, probably from the concussion.
c10a_s1_proposal: Normally I'd recommend the Cutlass Quiche. But can you believe it, there are some around here who don't appreciate my cooking! My cooking!
c10a_s1_proposal_next: I usually make it a habit to shrug off such nonsense, but not this time.
c10a_s1_proposal_next2: Because those tasteless thieves stole my pots and pans! My father gave me that set, and it was gifted to him by his father before him!
c10a_s1_proposal_next3: Last I saw, the thieves were headed west into the marsh.
c10a_s1_swampys_saucepans_description: Perfect for simmering all types of sauces.
c10a_s1_swampys_skillet_description: Passed down by generations of Swampy's family.
c10a_s1_swampys_stewpots_description: Perfect for cooking stews for long hours.
c10a_s1_swampys_stockpot_description: Once made stock for an entire ship.
c10a_s1_task_01: Travel to {POITags} to find Swampy's Pots and Pans
c10a_s1_task_03: Collect {itemName} from Lost Pistoleers or Lost Blunderbuss
c10a_s1_task_04: Collect {itemName} from a Hungry Streaked Alligator
c10a_s1_task_05: Collect Swampy's Stockpot from the Pirate Leader atop the fort
c10a_s1_task_06: Collect {itemName} from a chest in Spire Rock Fort
c10a_s1r_complete: You brought my pans! Thanks again. I'll cook you up an old Swampy special... on the house of course!
c10a_s1r_cooldown: No chance anyone’s stealing my precious pots and pans ever again. I made sure to lock’em up tight this time. But if they get lucky, I know who to send their way.
c10a_s1r_incomplete: Any luck finding my pots and pans? I can’t believe they found my secret compartment under the rug. Uh oh…
c10a_s1r_proposal: It’s probably the same delinquents from Spire Rock Fort. I admire their taste in cookware, but those are family heirlooms.
c10a_s2_complete: Now, that's a sight to behold! Look at all of this beautiful plunder. This is exactly the type of booty a pirate town needs!
c10a_s2_complete_next: And Heron's notes… hmm, nothing here with clues to more loot. Just a record of his research... probably not worth much. You keep them!
c10a_s2_description: Explore Ancient ruins to collect artifacts. Search chests to collect Heron's notes. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
c10a_s2_incomplete: All that plunder isn't going to go fall into our laps without some effort! Explore the ruins and bring back what artifacts you find.
c10a_s2_proposal: Word is the Ancient ruins might have some good ol' fashioned plunder in them. A man by the name of Heron came through town a while back, saying as much.
c10a_s2_proposal_next: But then we never saw nor heard from Heron again. If you venture out there, I'd reckon there's a good chance the plunder's still there.
c10a_s2_proposal_next2: If we're lucky, you'll find more than just artifacts. Mr. Heron might have left notes we could use to search for more profitable artifacts in the future.
c10a_s2_task_gotopoi: Travel to {POITags} to search for artifacts
c10a_s3_complete: Magnificent! What unusual artifacts. I'm sure we will have no trouble finding a buyer. I dare say a return to the spire for more may be in order!
c10a_s3_description: Loot relics from chests inside Crow's Nest Lighthouse. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
c10a_s3_incomplete: It's not as fun as plundering another ship at sea, but raiding ruins is still quite lucrative. And you don't get seasick, neither!
c10a_s3_proposal: Well for starters, you can find some more of those artifacts. I bartered the last batch for more than its weight in gold!
c10a_s3_proposal_next: I've heard whispers of some peculiar relics stashed in Crow's Nest Lighthouse. They'd fetch a handsome price, but be on your guard: the spire is treacherous.
c10a_s3r_complete: Your plundering has brought welcome disrepute to our fine, pirate town! Well done!
c10a_s3r_incomplete: Ahoy! Do you have the booty?
c10a_s3r_proposal: But of course! There's always loot to be found if one looks in the right place, and Malocchio Spire is surely the right place!
c10a_s4_complete: We'll all sleep safer at night without those explosions rattling the cupboards, but I fear the pirates may soon return.
c10a_s4_complete_next: Thank you, friend. I knew we could count on you for your help.
c10a_s4_description: Investigate the source of the tremors in the Highpass Mining Camp and defuse the situation. Talk to Captain Lucian in Spyglass Ridge when the task is complete.
c10a_s4_incomplete: What we don't need is a landslide ruining our fine settlement. Investigate the mining camp and put a stop to their plans.
c10a_s4_proposal: There's an old mining camp in Pirate's Pass. A band of Lost pirates recently laid claim to it and I fear they may be up to something sinister.
c10a_s4_proposal_next: Tremors have been felt near the mine in recent days. Strong tremors. We need to put a stop to the explosions before the hillside comes down around our ears!
c10a_s4_task_gotocamp: Travel to Highpass Mining Camp to investigate the tremors.
c10a_s4r_complete: That should deter those greedy bastards for some time. Thanks.
c10a_s4r_incomplete: Show those Lost brigands that we will not stand idly by while they threaten our town.
c10a_s4r_proposal: If you would be so kind. We would prefer to keep the mountain, and our town for that matter, intact.
c10a_s5_complete: Ah, yes. These will do nicely! Give me some time to prepare the device, and when you return we will begin the next phase of our work!
c10a_s5_description: Find elemental materials from spirits and bring them back to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
c10a_s5_incomplete: We have to find a better way to fight back against the Lost. Perhaps the bottled lightning is the edge we need.
c10a_s5_proposal: You have no doubt seen the numerous specters and phantasms that wander among the Lost. Some of these spirits even display strange elemental properties.
c10a_s5_proposal_next: My theory is that if a phantom survives too long without a physical body, it must draw upon the elements to continue to exist. The elemental essence is the key!
c10a_s5_proposal_next2: The key to everything! Don't you see? Help me. If we harvest the elemental essence from the phantoms, we can turn it against them. Against the rest of the Lost!
c10a_s5_proposal_next3: Travel to the Spectral Forest and bring back as much elemental essence as you can gather from the spirits there. I will wait here for your return.
c10a_s5_task_gotofield: Travel to the haunted Spectral Forest
c10a_s5r_complete: No doubt Fei Lixin is grateful, and you're now a bit richer.
c10a_s5r_incomplete: The box sits, silent, waiting for goods.
c10a_s5r_proposal: The work order is requesting the necessary resources for more bottled lightning. Bring the resources, take a doubloon. Honor system of course.
c10a_s6_complete: Well? Did the lightning traps perform according to expectations? I do hope it was an electrifying experience!
c10a_s6_complete_next: I plan on it! We'll need every possible trick to hold back the Lost. Something is changing their old habits, so any new advantage we can gain will help.
c10a_s6_description: Place the Lightning Jars in locations around Fort Barnacles. Talk to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when the task is complete.
c10a_s6_incomplete: Those jars aren't going to test themselves. They need to be around a high concentration of Lost.
c10a_s6_proposal: I'm glad you asked! Thanks to your combat prowess and my ingenuity, we have literally captured lightning in a bottle. The Lost are about to get quite a shock!
c10a_s6_proposal_next: Simply place the lightning bottles in areas occupied by the Lost. When enough Lost have gathered near the bottle, it will erupt with electrifying vigor!
c10a_s6_proposal_next2: I recently heard that Fort Ramos has been overrun by a band of Lost pirates. A pity to be sure, but it should act as an ideal testing ground.
c10a_s6r_complete: Ah, excellent work as always! But innovation requires iteration, as they say, so please return soon for the next round of testing.
c10a_s6r_proposal: Several, actually. Mostly minor tweaks, but enough to warrant further testing. Head back to Fort Ramos and deploy them in the same way as before!
c10a_s7_bobcats: Collect Sharpened Wildcat Claws from Island Bobcats
c10a_s7_complete: These are perfect. Can you imagine having a tame wildcat helping you hunt? Or an alligator keeping the Lost away from your home?
c10a_s7_complete_next: Not yet, but soon. Imagine an entire army of alligators rising up against those loathsome Lost and driving them out to sea!
c10a_s7_description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he can study how to tame them.
c10a_s7_incomplete: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. Remember the goal - seek out wildcats and alligators!
c10a_s7_proposal: I'm an animal empath. I can intuit their thoughts and feelings. But sometimes I need more... sometimes I need parts of the animals to understand them.
c10a_s7_proposal_next: It is for a good cause, I assure you. I'd like to study the wildcats and alligators here more closely, if you can bring me some scales and claws, that is.
c10a_s7r_complete: Tosch is sure to find these samples useful, just as he's sure to not miss this doubloon he so graciously left lying here.
c10a_s7r_description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them back to this collecting station.
c10a_s7r_incomplete: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. This collecting station won't fill itself!
c10a_s7r_proposal: I’m so glad you found one of my collecting stations! Since you’re here, why not help me out a trifle? I am in need of both wildcat claws and alligator scales.
c10a_s8_complete: This is a very large fang, even among adult lions. I will take some time to study it closely. In the meantime, I have news regarding your previous task.
c10a_s8_complete_next: It seems the cycle of death and reanimation on Aeternum is affecting the animals. Each time one dies, it comes back with increased aggression.
c10a_s8_complete_next2: Indeed. I will need more time to prove it, of course. In the meantime, I have another task for you.
c10a_s8_description: Collect a tooth from a fierce lion and bring it to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
c10a_s8_incomplete: To catch a lion you need to emulate it - be courageous and boldly go forth to seek it out!
c10a_s8_proposal: A lion named Snaggletooth. Seek out his den and return with his legendary fangs. Soon we will be one step closer to taming these magnificent beasts.
c10a_s8_proposal_next: Hunt him down and bring me back his famed snaggletooth. Then I may be able to understand how he commands such respect from the other lions.
c10a_s8r_complete: You drop a tooth into the box and hear it clatter against numerous other teeth. It sounds distressingly similar to the coin you drop in your purse.
c10a_s8r_cooldown: This station is filled with animal parts, it would be best to wait for Tosch to gather them and refill the stash of coins.
c10a_s8r_description: Collect a tooth from the one and only Snaggletooth and bring it back to the box for Tosch.
c10a_s8r_incomplete: It would be much simpler to take the reward left here by Tosch, but something resembling a conscience is keeping you from this act of blatant thievery.
c10a_s8r_proposal: Excellent work, locating another of my collecting stations! I could do with more Snaggleteeth, drop one off here and take some coin for your trouble.
c10a_s9_complete: These whiskers should do nicely. I can already feel myself connecting with the spirits of the pumas. I feel we're making progress, but something is yet missing.
c10a_s9_complete_next: I wish I knew. I still need more time to attune to the animals. Return to me later and perhaps I will have the answers we seek.
c10a_s9_description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
c10a_s9_incomplete: Now is no time to behave like a cat! You need to get out there and collect some whiskers from the island pumas!
c10a_s9_proposal: I've had trouble communicating with the native pumas. If you bring me some of their whiskers, I might be able to attune myself to their thoughts and feelings.
c10a_s9_proposal_prompt: I've had trouble communicating with the native pumas. If you bring me some of their whiskers, I might be able to attune myself to their thoughts and feelings.
c10a_s9r_complete: "How many whiskers can one man need?" The question plagues your mind as you set them in the designated basket.
c10a_s9r_description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them back to this collecting station.
c10a_s9r_incomplete: This station is still empty and sad, bring back some puma whiskers to make it filled and glad!
c10a_s9r_proposal: Good on you, finding my collecting station! Had to hide it so bandits stopped stealing from it. I could use more island puma whiskers, for a reward of course.
c10a_shillie_00: Shillie Duffy here, quartermaster of this settlement. We all hailed from different vessels when we arrived on these shores, but we formed a new crew.
c10a_shillie_01: No one is going to recognize this as a pirate town without any plunder. Where's the gold, silks, and chests overflowing with purloined booty?
c10a_shillie_02: Spyglass Ridge is finally starting to prosper, but we've still got a lot to do if we want to show those layabouts in Moonbay what a real pirate town looks like.
c10a_shillie_03: I should’ve listened when Swampy first mentioned missing supplies. I've been blind. I kept thinking it was the other pirates, when in truth it was my old crew.
c10a_shillie_04: Welcome, friend! Fancy another trip to Malocchio Spire? We can always use more artifacts to shill... I mean, sell!
c10a_shillie_05: Best let those pirates cool down for a bit. Wouldn't want them to migrate their smuggling grounds.
c10a_table_animalinstincts_00: A station left to collect animal scraps, though it isn't of any use just yet.
c10a_table_animalinstincts_01: This collecting station has a signed note on it from Tosch the Tamer.
c10a_table_catnipping_00: A station left to collect animal scraps, though it isn't of any use just yet.
c10a_table_catnipping_01: This collecting station has a signed note on it from Tosch the Tamer.
c10a_table_lightningbottle_00: This collection station doesn't seem to be set up yet.
c10a_table_lightningbottle_01: This drop-box was set up by Fei-Lixin, and there appears to be a work order posted.
c10a_table_lightningbottle_02: The box appears full. Come back later.
c10a_table_lionhearted_00: A station left by Tosch the Tamer to collect animal scraps. There's a page titled 'Work Order', but is otherwise blank.
c10a_table_lionhearted_01: This collecting station has a signed note on it from Tosch the Tamer.
c10a_table_perfectcompanion_00: A station left by Tosch the Tamer to collect animal scraps.
c10a_table_perfectcompanion_01: Gather boar bristles for Tosch and bring them back here.
c10a_table_snaggletooth_00: A station left by Tosch the Tamer to collect animal scraps, though there's no instructions attached.
c10a_table_snaggletooth_01: This collecting station has a signed note on it from Tosch the Tamer.
c10a_tosch_00: The animals on Aeternum are magnificent! Such power, such strength! Oh, I'm Tosch the Tamer, and I'm certain there is a trick to taming the animals on Aeternum.
c10a_tosch_01: Aeternum has a strange effect on animals. Even pets that arrive here soon turn feral. I've come here in search of answers. Would you be willing to help?
c10a_tosch_02: I have heard tales of a savage beast in Cutlass Keys. The locals fear the animal so much that they refuse to travel near its lair, even during the day.
c10a_tosch_03: I would like to learn more of the wildcat population here in Cutlass Keys. I know it's not easy work, but I'll need more materials from the local felines.
c10a_tosch_04: You may find this difficult to believe, but there is a group on Aeternum who have successfully managed to tame wild animals.
c10a_tosch_05: Now that I know the secret to taming animals on Aeternum, the time has come to find the perfect pet! It must be stalwart, but beautiful. Smart, yet obedient…
c10a_tosch_06: Ah, isn't a boar just the perfect pet? It eats almost anything. And if it reverts to being wild, well, you've got yourself a meal!
c10a_wally_00: Blasted Admiral Blackpowder, blasted crew--blast them all!
c10a_wally_01: You there! Aye, you! Heard the twisted tale of Admiral Blackpowder? Abused me sorely, he did, but I'll have the last laugh. Here, come closer, come closer…
c10a_wally_02: I can't believe you listened to me, but I'm right glad you did, friend.
c10a_wally_02_next: All our suffering wasn't for naught, and you gave the Admiral a sound drumming. It's never a good day round here, but today… today's not bad.
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_complete: You see! Very simple, very simple to do. Also… I need no charity; so… ah, for you. Your first fishing pole! She is… old and weathered, yes. But… very capable still!
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_desc: Collect firefly bait for Perronelle le Noir.
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_incomplete: Listen! Can you hear them? The fish, they call out, 'Catch me!' Ha ha!
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_proposal: You can't… fish!? That is horrible to hear! It is such a pleasure. Life is difficult, no? Even the smallest things… out of reach. But when you fish, you can reflect.
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_proposal_a: As simple as… finding happiness! Well. At times, yes. Easy as digging for worms, at least, and one can lead to the other…
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_proposal_b: Pardon me. I can… ramble. Reflection is good, yes? But it can lead to brooding. My leg, she makes it difficult to... focus now and again. Ah! I'm out of bait!
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_proposal_c: You? No, no, no, no, no. I cannot ask you this. Look at you! That… heroic garb of yours, clearly an important person. Scrounging for bait… this is… peasant's work.
c91_fq_01_unpathedwaters_proposal_d: Well, if you insist, of course. I could do this myself, you know, but... Your eagerness! I'd be unchivalrous to decline. Oh, and you can find bait in the bushes nearby.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_complete: Fantastic, fantastic. You have been busy with your reel. A master fisher in the making indeed. A burgeoning artist, I might even say.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_desc: Cast, hook, and reel in three fish for Perronelle.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_incomplete: Ah, Aeternum. Is it not the land of fish? I see it… so clearly, everywhere I go.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal: Ha ha! Yes, you get it, don't you!? The vision. Start with a humble pond, and you'll soon graduate to the great, wide ocean! There you may find the masterpiece.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_a: Yes. Gladys. A wily foe and the end of many a fish-dreamer. I was not always so… sedentary, you know? I have Gladys to thank for that.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_b: She took from me that which was dearest in all the world. And yet, I will best that scaly brute, and have my vengeance.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_d: Ah… let's not get ahead of ourselves, my dreamy young apprentice. We all must start somewhere, so get to it. Catch us a fish.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_g: Listen to you! You are as sunlight that… glimmers upon the deepest waters. La Lueur! Ah, I think my ancient fishing ensemble would interest you.
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_h: Yes, the Seekers of the Questing Bass. A sacred order of knights. Who fish. We are noble, regal… not quite profitable. My squires are working on that…
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_proposal_next: Ah… I speak of my dream, my eternal longing, my nemesis. The greatest, most terrible fish to ever swim in water. Gladys!
c91_fq_02_undreamedshores_start_prompt: "A creative way to look at it."
c91_fq_02_vector_complete: <g id="male_smallSingleWave" />Oh hello! Rather unusual for someone to find me over here. <g id="female_explainS" />Not that it's much of a secret fishing hole, mind you, it's simply more dangerous around these parts.
c91_fq_02_vector_desc: See Perronelle's assistant, Khadijah Bahri, to continue the fishing quests
c91_fq_02_vector_incomplete: Like all true fishers of life, Khadijah is a student of the waters. Much yet to learn, but a keen eye for technique!
c91_fq_02_vector_proposal: La Lueur, indeed! Even after I say these silly things… still you are eager to continue onwards. There is knightly spirit in you. Oh yes, I can see your glimmer now.
c91_fq_02_vector_proposal_next: Yes! Go and see my squire, Khadijah. If she approves of your skills then I, Perronnelle le Noir, as Fisher Regent, will accept you into our order.
c91_fq_03_01_taskfishsnail: Catch a Snail in Fresh Water
c91_fq_03_03_taskfishclam: Catch a Clam in Salt Water
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_complete: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Caught us some snails and clams, have you? Mmm. <g id="female_headnodding" />Pretty ones, too. Grand work, all around. <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Feels great being out on the water, yeah?
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_complete_b: <g id="female_headnodding" />Ahh, yes. I've always loved the shore life. So romantic, much as Perronelle's story is!<g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> You can read it in that bottle over there.<g id="female_outfitproud" priority="high" /> I even wrote it myself!
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_desc: Catch something other than fish, namely one Snail in Fresh Water and one Clam in Salt Water. Next, salvage them for resources.
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />My test has multiple steps: following guidance, utilizing skills, working with others. And my personal suggestion: <g id="female_whattheheck" />have fun with it!
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_proposal: Captain Perronelle? <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Ohh… <g id="male_hanghead" />I thought this might happen. Just… not so soon. <g id="female_crying" />She carried such a weight, she hid it well, but… what can we do?
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_start_prompt_b: "She said I might join the order?"
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_start_proposal_b: <g id="female_startledHandmouth" />Join? You mean, join the Seekers? Us? Oh!<g id="female_sighRelief" /> That's grand, then! And a relief. <g id="female_explainS" />We could surely use the help.
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_start_proposal_c: <g id="male_explain" />She and I have talked about the types of fishers we are looking for. If she's taken with you, that's the first step. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />And hardest. How did you ever manage that?
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_start_proposal_d: <g id="female_headnodding" />Huh! I guess that makes sense. <g id="female_thinking" />Captain's ways have always been a little... queer. <g id="male_laugh" />Suppose that's why I like her! Splendid, then! For your first test…
c91_fq_03_deboshedfish_start_proposal_e: Patience… <g id="female_steadythere" />is critical for fishing. One test at a time. <g id="female_explainS" />This one also benefits the business. You need to catch snails and clams. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Special bait for special fish!
c91_fq_03_vector_complete: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />In life, you're either the fish or the worm. <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Or the person eating the fish. Or the… um. Wait, what was I talking about… <g id="male_lookaroundStartled01" />Wait! Who are YOU?
c91_fq_03_vector_desc: See Perronelle's other assistant, Urashima Ishii, to continue the fishing quests
c91_fq_03_vector_incomplete: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Check in with Urashima and we'll be closer to knowing if you have what it takes to be a <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Seeker of the Questing Bass!
c91_fq_03_vector_proposal: <g id="female_shrugShort" />Something like that. Go find Urashima. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />He's the "other" squire. A hotshot by his own estimation, <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />but a bit of a laze, in my opinion. You'll learn something, though!
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_complete: <g id="female_headnodding" />Not a bad haul, I admit. Only a fraction of what I needed.<g id="male_laugh" /> Haaa… I pace myself for sanity's sake. Unlike Perronelle, <g id="male_shakehead" />who won't take a break to save her life.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_complete_c: <g id="female_disagreeRighthandout" />That's because she believes those stories about this magic, giant bass or whatever.<g id="male_shakehead" /> I think all that sitting in the rain and sun has gone to her head.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_complete_d: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />That said, there's something strangely compelling about the tale. <g id="female_shrugShort" />I wrote down some thoughts on it once, waiting for fish to bite, of course. <g id="female_gestureUpward" />You can read it, if you want.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_desc: Increase your catch rate by fishing from a Hotspot three times.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />As our fearless leader would say: Carpe Diem. That's French for 'catch fish all day', right? <g id="male_shakehead" />Or is that French for 'hotspots'? I can't remember.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_proposal: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />If I had another pair of hands, and another fishing pole, I might finish my quota. And then I could finally sleep!<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> How many days has it been. Wait! <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Who ARE you?
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_proposal_b: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />So she hasn't given up, then. <g id="male_shakehead" />Can't tell if I'm elated or disappointed. But that's good.<g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" /> That's actually truly good news after all those recent episodes she had.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_proposal_c: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Friend. Hear me. <g id="male_explain" />Just because you'll be on Aeternum forever doesn't mean you have to spend all your time fishing.
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_proposal_d: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />That's how it starts. You offered to help though. Hotspots are wherever rare fish are jumping out of the water. <g id="male_spreadhands" />If you have special bait from Khadijah, let's use it!
c91_fq_04_melancholybait_start_prompt: "Teach me and I'll share the load."
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_complete: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Aha! So glad you came back… <g id="female_nodConsider" />and look at those fish! But that's not as important now. <g id="female_lookConcern" />Something… happened with Perronelle. <g id="male_shakehead" />She's gone mad.
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_complete_c: <g id="female_lookConcern" />She's stopped talking and eating.<g id="male_dontknowS" /> She'll do nothing but fish. I think you inspired her, and while that's a great thing,<g id="male_shakehead" /> it also aggravated her condition.
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_desc: Help Urashima with his work by catching fifteen fish anywhere.
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_incomplete: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I once saw a fish eat another fish. And then I'm thinking, what if there's always a bigger fish? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Where is the biggest fish right now? <g id="female_turnleftStartleSimple" />Are we inside it?
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_proposal: <g id="male_laugh" />Ambitious, aren't you? <g id="female_nodConsider" />But you do have a knack for this… yes, help me get this done and I will sing your praises to Perronelle.
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_proposal_b: Not trying to dump my work… <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />but I'm a Seeker, and well,<g id="female_gestureForward01" /> you're a petitioner. Let's say fifteen fish. That will prove you have the needed commitment.
c91_fq_05_gildedtombs_start_prompt: "I can finish the job for you."
c91_fq_05_vector_complete: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Nice to see a friendly face, even if I have sad news. <g id="male_dontknowS" />The order of The Seekers of the Questing Bass might be dissolved, once and for all.
c91_fq_05_vector_desc: See Khadijah Bahri to get an update on Perronelle.
c91_fq_05_vector_incomplete: <g id="male_dontknowS" />I wonder if she's doing this to herself because I'm not working fast enough… <g id="male_lookawayGuilty" />or my quality isn't high enough…
c91_fq_05_vector_proposal: <g id="female_headnodding" />Yes, please do. Without Perronelle, I'd… well, I don't know what, <g id="male_noway" priority="high" />but that's the problem! This could make her fall Lost. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You go and convince her to rest.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_complete: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />You did it! I've been trying to catch some myself, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />but they were all so small and pathetic looking.<g id="male_lookawayGuilty" /> I hate to say, but I was losing heart.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_complete_c: <g id="female_nodding" />Oh, my! Yes. They are quite gorgeous. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Perronelle would be so proud to see how far you've come.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_desc: Catch eight fish greater than 20 inches in length, for love of the craft. It's what Perronelle would want.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_incomplete: <g id="male_explain" />Remember, only the biggest of fish will be enough to convince her! <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />Do it for the Captain.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_proposal: <g id="female_headnodding" />Be my guest, but words won’t work. <g id="female_explainS" />Her wound. It never heals, you know? Gets worse and worse. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />She tries to hide how bad it is, but I can tell.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_proposal_b: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />People can only tolerate so much pain, and after this many centuries she is finally reaching her limit. <g id="female_lookdownSorry" />I fear she's on the verge of becoming Lost.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_proposal_c: <g id="male_dontknowS" />I don't know. The only thing I can think of is to fish.<g id="female_clasphandsConvince" /> You, me, Urashima… if we fish as madly as she does,<g id="female_headnodding" /> then maybe she'll take notice.
c91_fq_06_rotshead_proposal_d: <g id="female_nodding" />So yes, you're right. We can do something, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />and it's something we all know and love. <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Let's do it! Go for the big fish, as many as you can reel in!
c91_fq_06_taskfishingcatchlength: Catch fish with a length greater than 20 inches
c91_fq_06_vector_complete: Agony… The agony! Damn you, Gladys… you thief! You stole my self from me… you stole… everything!
c91_fq_06_vector_incomplete: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />Hurry on. Captain always likes to see the sheen of water on the scales when judging a catch. <g id="male_laugh" />Says she likes the shine of it.
c91_fq_06_vector_proposal: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Nor I. When I came to Aeternum, everyone seemed self-interested, and uncaring. <g id="male_explain" />But the Captain always treated me right.
c91_fq_06_vector_proposal_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Out by the sea. Her favorite fishing spot. <g id="male_convince01" />Do hurry. She was barely sitting upright last time I went out there. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Show her your catch… and say a prayer.
c91_fq_07_03_bigfishigc_triggervol: Go to the location mentioned in Perronelle’s journal and catch the monster-fish Gladys
c91_fq_07_bigfishcatch_igc_pelles_03: Well, sometimes you catch the fish. Sometimes the fish catches you.
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_complete: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />	I cannot believe this sight. And the air! <g id="male_lookUp" />Paaahh, how fresh it is! <g id="female_gestureForward01" />But who are you? <g id="female_turnleftStartleSimple" />What was that? <g id="male_spreadarms001" />What has happened?
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_complete_b: <g id="male_leanbackCovermouth" />The whole time? It was Gladys, wasn't it?<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Well, thank you for fishing me out.<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> Allow me to introduce myself. I am Pelles, the Fisher King. I serve King Artorius.
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_complete_c: <g id="female_nodding" />Yes, you know her? When Gladys attacked, she bit off Peronelle's leg. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I assumed it would steal the soul from her, but you are saying she…<g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" /> she made it?
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_complete_d: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Of course not. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Wounds caused by that fish will never heal. Believe me, I have seen it before. <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />There is a way, but we must move quickly.
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_desc: Solve the mystery of Gladys by collecting one Squid Ink and one Catfish Whisker after salvaging Hooked Squid and Barbed Catfish.
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_incomplete: Ah… ahh… Where are you? I know you survive still. I know it! If only I could… cast… with all my might…!
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_proposal: In my mind, in my pain… sinking into both depths. Down and down! Khadijah… too kind, I could not bring her. Urashima… too weary, I could not bring him. I am alone.
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_proposal_b: I see that. Your glimmer in the deepness. I fished. And fished. And fished! And suddenly understood her secret. Gladys! I will make her return what she stole!
c91_fq_07_depthsclose_proposal_c: My brother. I cannot speak his name… it hurts more than this damned leg. But I know. I learned her secret! Read my notes! Please… finish what I cannot…!
c91_fq_07_pelorepage: Read Perronelle's notes to learn what she discovered
c91_fq_08_01_taskcatcht1: Catch fish with weight greater than 30 pounds
c91_fq_08_fisherking_complete: Did I not tell you? I would make myself whole. And look, Pelles is too. I have you to thank for both. You! Our newest Seeker of the Questing Bass!
c91_fq_08_fisherking_complete_b: Well, by the sea's bounty, you hooked Gladys, that is a master fisher's feat. Make no mistake, we were victorious today, but she will strike again.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_complete_c: With Pelles's elixir… and his presence, my pain is relieved. I still must sit in my chair, but it does not stop me from fishing, so I cannot complain.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_complete_d: Before you came, I was about to give this all up. But it was your glimmer! As you cast, as you helped! And so I could not. Perronelle le Noir salutes you! My Lueur!
c91_fq_08_fisherking_desc: Fish for the spawn of Gladys so that Pelles can scrape off their essence and save Perronelle.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_incomplete: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />Those devil fish! You must catch them quickly!
c91_fq_08_fisherking_khadijah_post: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />King Pelles is back! Congratulations! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Although this means I'm now fourth-in-command, it was worth it. <g id="female_chuckle" />I've never seen the Captain so happy!
c91_fq_08_fisherking_pelles_post: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />It will take much time to reacclimate to these wide open spaces. <g id="female_nodding" />I look forward to it. And for freeing me from my wretched prison, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />my profound gratitude forever.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_perronelle_post: What more do you want? Get fishing! What else is there to life, La Lueur?
c91_fq_08_fisherking_proposal: <g id="male_convince01" />The offspring of Gladys. Devil monsters, as she. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Monstrous fish with the potential to become gargantuan. <g id="female_explainS" />But within their gullets, the cure we need.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_proposal_b: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />So go quickly. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />These will be very, very big fish! Catch enough, and I can extract what I need for the tincture to aid my sister. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Cast, now!
c91_fq_08_fisherking_turnin: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Marvelous! You caught them all! <g id="male_itemTakeRight" priority="high" />I need but a scraping from their tongues. Keep the rest. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />You have earned them, each and every one.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_turnin_b: <g id="female_beckonUrgent" priority="high" />Now, please, can you tell me where I might find Perronelle?
c91_fq_08_fisherking_turnin_c: <g id="male_laugh" />Of course! Ha ha! She will never change. <g id="male_outfitproud" />More stubborn than a catfish. Not once did she give up on finding me, even though it nearly destroyed her.
c91_fq_08_fisherking_urashima_post: <g id="female_nodding" />Heard you rescued the Fisher King and saved Perronelle. <g id="male_outfitproud" />Not bad for a day of fishing. And better yet, he can help with our next order. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />It's… exhaustingly ambitious.
c91_ishii_explainhotspots: <g id="male_beckonBored" />Ah! So you want to learn about hotspots?
c91_ishii_explainhotspots_response: Fishing hotspots are places where fish jump for joy! At least, that's how I read their mood. When the spot is active, your bites will be quicker and your fish rarer.
c91_ishii_explainhotspots_response_b: Land your line truly, and you'll know you are in the hotspot! Most amateurs forget this next part, so listen up: hotspots deplete after many fish are caught there!
c91_ishii_explainhotspots_response_c: Did the fish stop jumping? Sorry to tell you that, they are not depressed, but that hotspot is depleted. Cheer up, though! It will become active again after a time.
c91_ishii_explainhotspots_response_d: Keep at it. Once your skills at fishing improve, you will naturally find more and better hotspots. Questing Bass believes in you! Don't read this last line. Oh.
c91_khadijah_explainhotspots: <g id="female_headnodding" />Hotspots! Hmm, so you want to learn what I've learned, huh?
c91_khadijah_explainhotspots_response: Urashima knows more than I do, but fishing hotspots are places where fish fly up from the water! When the spot is active, the fish are rarer and bite quicker.
c91_khadijah_explainhotspots_response_b: Trust me, you will know when you hit a hotspot with your line. It can be very exciting! But you must remember: hotspots deplete after many fish are caught there!
c91_khadijah_explainhotspots_response_c: When the fish no longer fly up from that spot, it’s been depleted. Patience is a virtue of Questing Bass! Be assured that spot will become active again after a time.
c91_khadijah_explainhotspots_response_d: Never give up, yeah? As your technique improves, you will naturally find more and better hotspots. Keep an eye out, you never know where or when you might spot one!

captainesteban_death_line1: This isn’t the last you’ve seen of Esteban! The seas will be mine one day!
captainesteban_intro_line1: What are you lot doing here? Come to steal what is mine? Have at you!
captainsnotest1_description: The notes of a captain. While brief, they display a hint of rare wit.
captainthorpe_combat_aftersurge: I feel your blessings surge within me... everlasting glory will be ours...
captainthorpe_combat_beforesurge: Yes, my mistress... I will return what was taken...
captainthorpe_combat_finale: Victory is ours, my mistress... their soul is yours to claim...
captainthorpe_combattaunt_1: Now, I know the island's secret! Now, I know true power!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_10: You are the past - I am the future!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_14: This will be the last time we meet.
captainthorpe_combattaunt_15: I now serve the Tempest… most willingly.
captainthorpe_combattaunt_16: You cannot possibly challenge us now.
captainthorpe_combattaunt_17: She sent me… to destroy you!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_18: Don't you see? It was her soul all along!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_4: I will crush you beneath my heel, ant!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_5: You would have been better off dying at sea!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_6: You can't possibly match the strength Corruption has given me.
captainthorpe_combattaunt_7: Give in to Corruption! It's the only way to keep your soul!
captainthorpe_combattaunt_8: Prepare to have your soul crushed!
captainthorpe_greet_01_a: You, come closer... your captain needs you. One of those blasted things jabbed me... in a bad way.
captainthorpe_greet_01_b: That demon storm... a voice in my head... these foul creatures... I don't know what the hell's going on here!

corpsecrone01: Long ago, a witch crept into the eastern fens. This was the Corpse Crone, and she cast a wicked spell.
corpsecrone02: The deadly hex spread like a sickening plague.
corpsecrone03: The island's immortality was twisted, made obscene. The Curse of the Lost would haunt our lands.
corpsecrone04: The people sought salvation from this plague. Desperate, we believed conviction our only course.
corpsecrone05: We discovered the soulless could hide amongst us.
corpsecrone06: Committing them to the cold earth was the only answer.
corpsecrone07: Eventually, the crone's purpose became clear. Her hex would bind the restless Lost to her will.
corpsecrone08: To this day, her foul curse lingers. Until her evil can be forever extinguished.

covenantseal_barbarian_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to strength and constitution. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_brigand_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to dexterity and constitution. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_cleric_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to focus and constitution. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_occultist_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to intelligence and constitution. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_ranger_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to dexterity. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_sage_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to focus. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_scholar_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to intelligence. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_sentry_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to revert the attributes of sealed Covenant Faction armor back to constitution. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.
covenantseal_soldier_description: Use at the forge and outfitting stations to change the attributes of Covenant Faction armor to strength. This process is permanent and will destroy any socketed gems.

curseddoubloons_body_01_01: Take heed traveler, for this is no ordinary well, but a font of fortune born of a pirate’s lost hope.\n\nCast upon these shores as the sole survivor of a hapless voyage, I lost both treasure and crew to the Esperanza’s curse. In my despair, I cast what remained of my ill-gotten doubloons into this well, expecting naught but to rid myself of their burden. To my astonishment, the well’s waters stirred, alive with magic, feeding upon the curse. In its depths, treasures emerged, a bounty for my cursed offering. Though my adventuring days are now only a memory, I leave behind this note: Rid Aeternum of those cursed doubloons and the spoils of the Well of Fortune shall be yours to claim.

cutscene_line1: FATHER RUSSO: The stories you've heard... they don't tell the whole truth.
cutscene_line11: Chart your course and your fate...
cutscene_line12: I will say a prayer for the souls of your crew.
cutscene_line2: The island is indeed the place of legend.
cutscene_line3: There is power, and vast riches as well.
cutscene_line4: But those who've gone before you have simply vanished, never heard from again.
cutscene_line5: I saw the horror--the madness that overcame the crew.
cutscene_line6: It was beyond any evil the world has ever known.
cutscene_line7: How I survived... I do not know.
cutscene_line8: The contents of this box are not of this world.
cutscene_line9: They will guide you to that one. Wherever and whatever that may be...

darkcommand01: Neither duty nor divine purpose called me from the Old World...
darkcommand02: I sailed into oblivion as master of my own destiny... fearless in my command.
darkcommand03: And I found here that which I sought, the truth of power...
darkcommand04: To which I proudly swore my eternal allegiance.
darkcommand05: I began anew, authority and identity stripped away,
darkcommand06: Embracing inhuman toil and suffering as the path to my return.
darkcommand07: Time came when I could again prove my prowess in battle.
darkcommand08: No man nor demon could withstand my newfound might.
darkcommand09: My domination established, a new destiny earned...
darkcommand10: The voice of truth pronounced ME as champion of our righteous cause.
darkcommand11: And I led our armies to victory again and again...
darkcommand12: The remnants of ragged humanity crushed along the way...
darkcommand13: To bring me here, to the precipice of my ultimate achievement.
darkcommand14: The forces of this world and those beyond... now under my command.

data_season_06_desc:
Carve your destiny through the depths of Aeternum to uncover seasonal armor and weapon skins, transmog tokens, and other treasures long lost to the outside world. Welcome to the cursed isle.

• Mysterious Artifacts of unknown origin continue to tempt even the most ambitious Adventurers. Wear the <font color="#edc63e">Cowl of Power</font> to turn the tide of battle when your mana is low or wield the <font color="#edc63e">Grace Greatsword</font> for greater offensive speed.

• Plunge into your next quest with <font color="#edc63e">Nautical Gladiator armor and weapon skins</font> and serenade your fellow Adventurers with one of the <font color="#edc63e">Seafarers Musical Instruments</font>.

• You can also look forward to acquiring the <font color="#edc63e">Seafarers Camp skin</font>, plus unique emotes like <font color="#edc63e">Finger Guns</font>.


Discover the full collection of rewards, including <font color="#edc63e">7,500 Marks of Fortune</font> and <font color="#edc63e">7 Transmog Tokens</font>, through the in-game Season Pass menu.

devourerlegacy04: Vested with the power of the Titans, even the Ancients could not control them.
devourerlegacy05: But our tribe, the Blood of the Sands, earned their trust, learned to speak to them.
devourerlegacy06: And in time, we fought together in battle as one.
devourerlegacy07: We called them "šà-hul sahar," the heart of the desert.
devourerlegacy08: But when the Ancients vanished, the šà-hul retreated deep beneath the sands...
devourerlegacy10: Their eggs remained, but were plundered by the wicked.
devourerlegacy11: We failed in our duty to protect them.
devourerlegacy12: To preserve the last of the eggs, we sent forth bearers to hide them until the day of prophesy.
devourerlegacy13: Their locations, scattered to the winds.
devourerlegacy14: But the eggs are still alive.
devourerlegacy15: And should they awaken without the Blood of the Sands to tend them...
devourerlegacy16: The world will know the true meaning of "Devourer."

drownedpages_body_01_01: Ol' Irontoe has really gotten us into something this time! Why did he think this was going to be such a good idea?! We knew not to trust those backstabbers. How many times are we going to let them play us for fools?\n\n-Wynn
drownedpages_body_01_02: They struck as soon as the parley had finished. The lying cowards! And now this god-forsaken storm has doomed us all. We have salvaged as much as we could from the wreckage… but there is no sign of the others. Hopefully the seas have claimed them for good.\n\n-Wynn
drownedpages_body_01_03: It's bizarre how life, even in this place, can become so routine. Now that the bulk of construction is complete, the captain has lost a bit of his edge. It turns out this place may end up being what was promised after all, despite the struggle of the last few years.\n\n-Wynn
drownedpages_body_01_04:
I don't trust that stranger, no matter what Irontoe says. Where did he come from? How long has he been watching us? Why is it he only shows up after we have completed all of the difficult work of building this place? 

Something is not right. He stinks of death.

-Wynn
drownedpages_body_01_05: I may have been wrong. Edward is not what I feared. His knowledge of this place has helped us avoid many potential catastrophes. But I still can't shake the feeling that I have met him somewhere before… and I was not wrong about his stench.\n\n-Wynn
drownedpages_body_01_06: Ol' Irontoe has fallen gravely ill. Edward is tending to his needs, but I don't hold out hope that he will last the week. I've seen this before with my own father. But the way Edward speaks, he instills hope, even in the dying.\n\n-Wynn

dungeon_cutlasskeys00_mariner_01_respons: Alas, no. My lady wants something, but no matter what I present to the door in offering, it refuses to budge. Perhaps I'm unworthy of such a wondrous creature…
dungeon_cutlasskeys00_mariner_defaultdia: Leave me be. Can you not see the Lost running amok?
Didn't expect to find another living soul in here. Did She call to you too? I saw Her radiance in my dreams, and I had to come. Now I can immortalize her in verse…
dungeon_cutlasskeys00_scalleywag_01_resp: Don't believe me, do you? No, poor Antonio, no one listens to his tall tales. Mock me if it pleases you. But I wouldn't touch a coin of that bloody treasure.
dungeon_cutlasskeys00_scalleywag_02_resp: Blackpowder called her something funny. Nerry? Nerry-id? Anyhow, he hates her something fierce, has most of his crew battering at her door as we speak.
dungeon_cutlasskeys00_scalleywag_03_resp: Heh heh…eyes on the prize, young'un. Eyes on the prize. If anyone breaks that curse, I'll be out of here with as much gold as these old arms can carry.
dungeon_cutlasskeys00_scalleywag_default: Eh? Can't talk now. After you've dealt with that lot.
Yer wasting time, chasing that treasure! It's cursed, though Blackpowder and his crew won't let it go. He blames that watery wench, says SHE cursed it.
