eastburn_body_01_01: After much turmoil, Elizabeth and I have made it through the storm. This foul tempest has claimed the rest of our troupe… Alcott, Bancroft and Blythe are no longer with us. But alas, the show must go on! Elizabeth and I must simply find a new crew. A new audience awaits us - And with the power of theatre, we shall enrich their hearts and minds!\n\n-William Eastburn
eastburn_body_01_02:
Earlier today, a miracle occurred! Alcott, Bancroft and Blythe, battered and smashed against the rocks not one week ago, have returned to us perfectly well! I saw them run through on the spires with my own two eyes, but here they stand… risen from the grave to join us in our cause. They appear veritably shaken even now, but they are glad to be alive once again.

On this island, can we not perish? How brilliant, how mad! Imagine how this could be used to heighten the realism of our shows... To see Juliet run through with the knife, to see Hamlet cut down with the sword! I must tell the crew at once. I will become the greatest showman the world has ever seen!

-William Eastburn
eastburn_body_01_03:
Rehearsals for our performance have begun, but it is clear that the crew is less committed than I am. They've run through these scenes a dozen times, but talks of “pain” have now dominated their conversations. Even Elizabeth, my dear sweet muse, is prompting me to omit the scene of Blythe's beheading- the CLIMAX, of all things! There is only so much complaining I can take!

We've taken refuge at the Inn in Cleave's Point. The place is full of scoundrels and thieves, but when they heard of our play they were brimming with excitement! If only Alcott and Bancroft understood my work like they do…

These blithering fools! Do they not respect me enough to give me their all? To be a true artist, one must be willing to suffer for their art! Heaven knows I have, with all their complaining. If god must strike me down, so be it. Rehearsals shall continue as planned.

-William Eastburn
eastburn_body_01_04:
The final dress rehearsal has come and gone, and these petulant worms have hardly an ounce to give me! Alcott and Bancroft give their performances well, but I must chain them up in the night to keep them from deserting me. Even worse, Blythe's speech has started to slur- and last night she tried to cleave my head from off of my shoulders!

I'm keeping Blythe under lock and key until further notice, as it is clear she is unable to perform. To prevent the spread of her feral nature, I've kept her locked away, far from the others. Elizabeth, to my dismay, was distraught when I informed her that she would play the role instead- but the show must go on! She has not died before thus far, and that will make the beheading even sweeter… Oh joy! What a show this will be! Cleave's Point will be in awe of my brilliance!

-William Eastburn
eastburn_body_01_05:
I thought I understood the nature of this island. But like Icarus before me, I have flown too close to the sun.

Elizabeth played the part perfectly. Every line, brimming with emotion… but when the beheading came, she faltered. She cried out to me, pleaded, but in my brash foolishness I had Bancroft drop the axe. When she dissipated into dust, she did not return… Instead, she sparked with an energy I have never seen before. Her voice screamed out from the heavens what a terrible man I was, and that she would haunt me for eternity. Then, my beloved muse vanished.

Alcott and Bancroft have left me, seizing the opportunity to take flight as I mourned upon the stage. Blythe has now begun to decay, and I fear she may break from her chains at any moment.

Every night I am tormented by visions of Elizabeth, hanging over my bed to punish me for my transgressions. As the sun sets, I can hear her voice wail from over the walls. Now I only wish for death, but it never comes. Every time I try, I can feel something foul welling up inside of me…

Oh, what a fool I was! What an insolent, vain, blithering, insufferable fool. I knew of their pain, and I cared not. What a curse this island is! Blast the fates that brought me here!

If only I had understood their suffering. If only I had cared.

-William Eastburn

elysianintro01: Time has no claim on the Eternal Isle.
elysianintro05: Mighty Lords, let us cleanse these lands.
elysianintro06: But the future is fixed for neither man nor beast...
elysianintro08: Change is coming for us all.
elysianwilds_body_01_01: Breath quickened to the sound of hooves: heartbeats pounding earth. Wind whistled through every flawed creation and yet the urge to run was unmarred - pure and free - gripped not in fear, but rather the thrill of surpassing every final limit.
elysianwilds_body_01_02: A mosaic of scents permeated the air: sweet bouquet of wildflowers; musk of fallen leaves; rot of fungus; breath of weary travelers. Though long passed, they linger... ephemeral memories blossoming into endless imagination.
elysianwilds_body_01_03: Cords of muscles tensed with subdued rage: a block of flesh on the verge of being carved. The feeling passes - raindrops streaming down cold, old stone - fists unclench, yet still invisibly hold on to an immense and weighty sadness.
elysianwilds_body_01_04: Center of gravity shifted, pulling upwards: toppled walls rebuilding to invulnerability. The ground trembles in awe. The sky draws back in alarm. Defiance reigns - a snort of derision hides a chuckle - unbowed, undeterred, unmoving.
elysianwilds_body_01_05: Sound rang clear and distinct: orchestrated joyous cacophony. The low rustle of grass unto the high-pitched chirping of the birds, a symphony that rose and fell - a sun of itself - weaving ceaselessly into new rhythms and melodies.

emptythrone01: King Artorius arrived on Aeternum 700 years ago to discover a people scattered and divided.
emptythrone02: Promising order, he united Southern Aeternum for the first time since the era of the Ancients.
emptythrone03: The king's rule was built upon the armor-clad shoulders of his sworn knights:
emptythrone04: Courageous Ser Gawain, fierce Ser Lancelot, and the loyal Ser Galahad.
emptythrone05: Their valor was tested when hordes of Corrupted attacked from the north...
emptythrone06: Guided by none other than the king's fallen advisor, the wizard Myrddin.
emptythrone07: In the wake of the conflict, King Artorius was gone, fate unknown as the kingdom crumbled.
emptythrone08: Lancelot left seeking vengeance and Galahad to create a new life...
emptythrone09: But Ser Gawain was heir to the throne - he departed seeking only divine blessing for his rule.
emptythrone10: Prydwen was in a dire state, ravaged by war, its people demoralized.
emptythrone11: It was Minister Lochnir who held the town together, safeguarding the throne for Gawain's return.
emptythrone12: But Ser Jin Jae of Ebonscale Reach captured the hearts of the people.
emptythrone13: After so many dark years, she emerged as a beacon of hope, and was appointed Knight-Regent.
emptythrone14: Now the Minister informs us he's spotted Ser Gawain's sails on the horizon...
emptythrone15: And we prepare for the true heir to finally come home and claim his throne.

excavation_body_01_01:
I almost wish the sparkling rock had not caught our eye, but so it did. Now here we are, and beasts the like of which have never been seen remind me we are strangers to this isle – and the farther north we go, both man and beast alike, become more feral and unapproachable.

The danger started simply enough – while scouring the track, Dunne caught traces of that glittering rock, the one that glitters like stars lie within. Seeing pieces of the ore lying quite thickly about, we spent days looking for a vein of the stuff and sought to mine it. To be sure, we feared the sound of our pickaxes would wake the Corrupted from the Cleave - but that was not to be our misfortune.

As we unearthed the “Star Rock” day upon day and piled it upon the wagons for the outpost, we could not help but notice the days grew colder and colder, more sharply each night. We had learned not to stray too far east and south on account of the great bears, but the sudden onset of winter was something we had not expected. Dunne had caught sight of wolves, he claimed, but he said they did not howl, nor move as he had ever seen a wolf move – he said that they looked as if they were rimed with ice, wreathed around like a coat of winter.

-J. Lipscomb
excavation_body_01_02:
I saw one of the strange wolves today. Dunne did as well, though he is not here to speak of it. It was mid-day, and I saw it all play out most clearly.

We had lifted some of the star ore to the carts, when suddenly, soundless, there was a wolf – a thing shaped as a wolf – at the opening of the mine. It was as if it had just broken free from a glacier, for spikes of ice covered its coat, as if the two were wedded.

I bid my muscles to move, to run, to scream, yet I could do nothing. Dunne was not so fortunate – he issued a cry, as if to drive the thing off, and held a chunk of the starmetal over his head threateningly: as he did, the beast was suddenly upon him, its jaws at his throat. My eyes did not deceive me – I watched as frost blanketed Dunne's throat where the fangs sank into flesh and froze the blood as it jetted from his wound.

I confess I did not stop to aid him – I fled into the mine, hiding there, praying warmth shall return to my bones. If I escape this place, I shall not return, for I am convinced those beasts did not arrive by chance – our working of the ore must have brought them, as if they sought to guard it against those who would take it.

I hereby relinquish my claim to this mine – if others wish it, they must answer to the devils in the ice and make peace with them.

-J. Lipscomb

expedition_body_01_02:
…we traveled there by coach over several days, and I was not privy to the visit. Isabella met the man in his cell alone, and spoke with him for hours before she finally returned. Her eyes were bright, and where the tedium of days had worn upon her, she seem invigorated with new life. 

I have seen this look before, and I do not like it. It was the light that burned in her brother's eyes – her father's eyes. Worried, I asked her how the conversation had gone, and she said, the treasure upon the man was not the Azoth, but the man himself.

He was living proof that the Fountain of Youth existed, and it could grant eternal life to those who found it. The isle of Azoth was no legend – it was true.

I asked her what could be gained from such knowledge, and she laughed lightly and replied, “Because he says he can take us there.”

- F
expedition_body_01_03:
Isabella claimed the isle the prisoner had spoke of was called “Vitae Aeternum”. Whether this was the prisoner's name or the translation bestowed upon his mad ramblings, I am uncertain, but the name has stuck – much like the prisoner's offer, I fear. Isabella has taken his knowledge as if it has lit a fire in her, and it has given her a frightening sense of purpose. I urge her to rest – cautiously – but she will not hear of it. The mere hint of the Fountain of Youth's presence has moved her to action.

The crown was not so understanding – and Isabella had the misfortune to speak of the source of the fountain. They had been willing to back her request to see the heretical prisoner, but a Fountain of Youth returned a different, more scornful answer. It turned out that she might have tried a different tactic, had she thought of it – but as it happened, her father's debts caused an unexpected result.

- F
expedition_body_02_01:
I often seek comfort at the small chapel on the grounds. It is peaceful there, quiet, and I can hear myself think. I know the servants (those who remain) think I come here to pray… but I come only to listen to my thoughts, to sort through them, one by one so I might make sense of it all.

We held the services for my brothers here when they were lost at sea last year, and then again for Mother and Father less than a month ago. I expect even the meager services expended the last of the family “fortune,” which have never recovered from our numerous setbacks. Father proved to be in debt to many companies, and had risked a great deal in his enterprises… and now I am left to bear that burden. I wished I could have traded places with him and my brothers – not in death, but upon the seas, to be far from this place.

Now I simply feel older than my years should allow. It is not grief, it is simply that I lack the compass for where I should go, what I should do – and what I can do. There are not enough years in one's life to do all that I wish to do – or had wished to do, and what status our family had is lost, squandered on fool's errands.

Yet in this simple church, I feel at peace, and take comfort in it.

Isabella
expedition_body_02_02:
The local priest came to speak to me this morning as I sat within the church. I shared my thoughts with him, and he quoted Scripture to me. I had not exchanged more than a few words with him before, but the words came easily. I told him of the absence I felt of family – the fear of debt. And aside from the looming misfortune, there was the looming presence of age to contend with. My brothers had their lives taken from them by the sea, but Mother and Father… they deserved more years than they were granted. I told the priest my father had often spoke, quite passionately, of a Fountain of Youth, where he might take back his years and gain enough years to recover from the trials that life brought with it.

The priest was silent at this, then said, almost apologetically, that we were given this life, a requisite number of years because more… more might cheapen life's beauty. To wish to extend one's life – he seemed quite pained at this – was even considered offensive, heretical by the Church. He spoke as if he had heard heretics saying such, which piqued my curiosity. When I pressed him on it, he protested that I had misread his tone. Anyone speaking, let alone claiming to have proof of such nonsense, would be kept under lock and key so their madness might not affect others.

He knows of someone like this, I am certain of it. I will make inquiries.

Isabella

factionfest_body_01_01:
Victory is ours, as we knew it would be.



Our dedication to understanding this world, understanding Aeternum, understanding the deeper reality that we all share has borne fruit. While the Marauders displayed ruthlessness and the Covenant showed efficiency, only we were able to harness both in the right measure to win this trial. We’ve always known that we possessed the superior philosophies, but proving that in a direct, level field of competition leaves little room for argument. Our combined lifetimes of collection and understanding of the ancient places in Aeternum helped us succeed where others faltered.



So what happens now? We continue. We continue as we always have – digging deeper to find what makes up our world. What powers still lie undiscovered. And how we can use that information to best benefit humankind. While the brutes and zealots have their place in the world, only the Syndicate can truly harness the light to guide Aeternum.
factionfest_body_01_02:
Pah, I’m hearing that we did not win the trial! That the Syndicate, with their noses pushed into books and scrolls all day, somehow overcame our best and came out the victors? HOW?



I was down in the halls of Amrine! I saw how strong our warriors were! The scribes had to flood the depths with their followers to accomplish their goals, while we were able to cut down hordes of enemies with far fewer! We were stepping over the bodies of both the Syndicate and the Covenant to reach our enemies. The spoils should be all ours, make no mistake! The Syndicate can revel in their victory today



We might have lost this trial, warriors, but your performance throughout was second to none. Hold your heads up high, and rest assured that the next time we compete, the Marauders will stand tall!
factionfest_body_01_03:
The Syndicate has emerged victorious in the trials, propelled by numbers and a narrow focus on the goals of the trial. They worked in a formulated motion that mirrored their view of the world – lifeless, cold, and calculated. Neither the Syndicate nor the Marauders cared about the lives lost to achieve their goals, only the victory mattered. In the end, we did more with fewer, and with grace were able to protect our own members.



We now must take the lessons learned from this experience and apply them to our teachings. That, while unsuccessful in the trials, we found that our view of the world truly is the greatest way to protect Aeternum. We have now experienced the singular focus of the Syndicate and the rampant violence of the Marauders, and have a better understanding of how to deal with both. If a trial like this should ever come to pass again, we will be prepared – but the wisdom we have gained will always be useful, come what may.



Be proud and continue our vital work. The truth of Aeternum will be ours to understand and teach, and no formula or axe’s blade can change that.

factionintro_covenant_01_completed_a: <g id="female_sighRelief" />So you made it out of the farm with your soul intact? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />And I suppose you reclaimed the Olcotts' keepsakes as well?
factionintro_covenant_01_completed_b: <g id="female_notsure" />I am ashamed - you kept faith and came through, where I failed. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Perhaps I am not Covenant material.
factionintro_covenant_01_completed_next: <g id="female_youknow" />The Covenant is an order of Templars sworn to battle on Aeternum to keep the Spark of hope alive… <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />	for all eternity. From what I've witnessed,<g id="female_salute2finger" /> you belong as one of us.
factionintro_covenant_01_crest_descripti: The simple standard of a simple farm. Means nothing now.

factionintro_covenant_01_incomplete: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Please, convince old man Olcott to leave. If I don't get him back to town safely... <g id="female_sobbing" />well, I couldn't bear it.

factionintro_covenant_01_locket: Collect a Locket from one of the Lost
factionintro_covenant_01_proposal_a: <g id="female_worry" />It's painful to admit, but when the Olcott farm fell to the Lost, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I offered to help them reclaim their valuables.
factionintro_covenant_01_proposal_b: <g id="female_youknow" />I came here with the old man, Feldan Olcott, but the Withered are too many.<g id="female_shrinkEmbarrassed" /> I had no choice but to run.
factionintro_covenant_01_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />He refuses to flee, and I'm too shaken to go back. <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Please speak with him, and get him to leave before he too becomes Lost.
factionintro_covenant_01_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />You must convince him-- <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />it's not worth risking his soul for a handful of material possessions.
factionintro_covenant_01_topic_feldan1_a: <g id="male_itsokay" />Young Florina? This whole venture was her idea. Save your breath, stranger. <g id="female_smackfist" />I'm not leaving with nothing to show for it.
factionintro_covenant_01_topic_feldan1_b: <g id="male_hanghead" />I don't care about the coin, but the memories… <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />if you help me reclaim our keepsakes, I'll go.
factionintro_covenant_01_topic_feldan2: <g id="male_itsokay" />I'll be safe enough right here until you get back. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I've dealt with the Lost before. If you take too long, I'll come in there myself. <g id="female_smackfist" />This is still my farm, you know.
factionintro_covenant_02_completed_a: <g id="male_explain" />The fortitude of Templar Damiano is proven by his safe return,<g id="female_salute2finger" /> though it is your courage that saved him.
factionintro_covenant_02_completed_b: <g id="male_think" />It sounds like justice was served with the Initiates. But I wonder, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />how did they succumb to become Corrupted?
factionintro_covenant_02_completed_next_: <g id="male_pointAngry" />So they embraced the darkness of their own accord? <g id="female_smackfist" />Then I can only hope they suffered at your hand.
<g id="male_pointAngry" />I will gather any of the Initiates's belongings remaining in the Enclave and see them purged by fire.
factionintro_covenant_02_description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Lethold beseeches you to rush to Clearview Crypt to end whatever terrible acts are transpiring, save Templar Damiano, and return to him at the Covenant Enclave.
factionintro_covenant_02_grimoire_descri: A collection of ideals that lose comprehension the longer you read.
factionintro_covenant_02_hood_reward_des: Worn by the protectors of the Covenant Enclave.
factionintro_covenant_02_incomplete: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I must consult with Lumen Morellus about this alleged heresy. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I hope you find Damiano, and the Initiates as well. <g id="male_lookDown" />I pray they are still whole.
factionintro_covenant_02_proposal_a: <g id="male_nodSympathySmall" />Their cowardice has very likely led them to a dark fate, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />though it is neither surprising nor unjust.
factionintro_covenant_02_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />It appears that in their mad flight, they sought refuge in Clearview Crypt,<g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" /> which has now become disturbingly quiet.
factionintro_covenant_02_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Now there's courage! <g id="male_explain" />I should warn you, however, Lumen Morellus believes the Initiates engaged in heretical behavior.
factionintro_covenant_02_proposal_next_b: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />Templar Damiano went after them, but he has not returned. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />So go then, newcomer. <g id="female_salute2finger" />I have a good feeling about you.
factionintro_covenant_02_readlore: Search for Evidence explaining how the Initiates became Corrupted
factionintro_covenant_03_completed_a: <g id="female_explainS" />There, now we can safely say this whole sordid affair is concluded with some measure of redemption.
factionintro_covenant_03_completed_b: <g id="female_nodding" />Lethold is a champion of righteousness and justice, and a strong leader.
factionintro_covenant_03_completed_next_: <g id="female_explainS" />Quite. The Covenant is as much about preserving hope as it is about seeing justice done.
<g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />It is better for all of us that Lethold stays focused on the future, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />no need to dwell on these dark events.
factionintro_covenant_03_description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Morellus has enlisted you to lure the Corrupted Templar back to Nettlerest Graveyard, best him in battle, collect his cursed necklace, and return to the Convenant Enclave.
factionintro_covenant_03_incomplete: <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />I strongly suggest you do not attempt to use the relic. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It is an insidious poison, Corruption.
factionintro_covenant_03_lifestaff_rewar: Heat emanates from within the staff forcing the Lost to stay clear, while the hostile ones are reminded with a strong burning sensation.
factionintro_covenant_03_proposal_a: <g id="female_headnodding" />I expected as much. <g id="female_explainS" />The problem I need help with is related to Templar Titus Invectus, the one who oversaw the training of our fallen Initiates.
factionintro_covenant_03_proposal_b: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I'm afraid this has driven Titus quite mad, <g id="male_lookDown" />and he, too, is now Corrupted, but through no fault of his own.
factionintro_covenant_03_proposal_next2_: <g id="female_crossarms" />Templar Invectus lurks somewhere in Nettlerest Graveyard - <g id="male_explain" />there's an old marker there he studied. It should lure him out.
<g id="female_leanpointConvince" />Defeat Invectus, bring back the corrupted relic, and then we can destroy it. <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Lethold is wrathful enough already.
factionintro_covenant_03_proposal_next_a: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />No, because we won't allow that.<g id="female_explainS" /> Paranoia and rage make one susceptible to Corruption, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />and that's why we'll keep this between us.
factionintro_covenant_03_proposal_next_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />The fallen Initiates apparently corrupted the relic Titus wore as a necklace, <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />and we must recover it and destroy it, quickly and quietly.

factionintro_covenant_body_01_01:
The Covenant would have you believe great strength comes from collective effort. They taught us that Aeternum is to be feared, that only by working together can we survive. 

This is not true. 

There is power all around us. The individual can not only survive but thrive in this land should they choose to embrace the call.
factionintro_covenant_body_01_02:
Much will be asked of you. 

Things impossible to take will be taken from you, but great sacrifices reward great power. 
First, let the whispers into your mind for knowledge unknowable. Soon after, you will be taught what strength is hiding inside your body. Finally, embrace the change. The weak fear transformation. The strong revel in it.
factionintro_covenant_body_01_03: Embrace strength. Strength strength STRENGTH strength (The writing becomes increasingly erratic and illegible, smeared with what appears to be blood. This page was rather violently torn from its book.)
factionintro_covenant_vector_completed_0: <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Please, good visitor, tell me, have you come from Oxboro?
<g id="female_explainS" />My dear sister Florina embarked on a quest there some time ago,<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> and I am anxious to hear word of her welfare.
<g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />Ah, that's an immense relief to hear. <g id="female_headnodding" />It is inspiring to watch new Initiates face the trials of joining the Covenant.
<g id="male_explain" />But when it's one's younger sister, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />it is impossible not to feel some apprehension.
<g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Thank you for giving me this chance to express my gratitude for the rescue of Templar Damiano.

<g id="female_headnodding" />I see in your eyes the light of a great potential. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You would shine as a member of our order, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />and bring inspiration to many struggling souls.
factionintro_covenant_vector_description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Florina has asked you to visit her brother Lethold at the Covenant enclave in south-eastern Everfall. She has attuned your spirit with the shrine, so you may travel there safely.
Covenant Initiation Quest: Adjudicator Lethold has asked you to speak with Lumen Morellus at the Covenant Enclave for your final initiation test.
factionintro_covenant_vector_incomplete_: <g id="female_explainS" />I really do suggest you inquire about becoming a Covenant Initiate yourself. On Aeternum, it's critical one finds a higher purpose to serve.
<g id="male_convince02" />I suggest you speak with the Lumen soon. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />There is no reason to delay.
factionintro_covenant_vector_proposal_01: <g id="female_touchhands" />Thank you. Lethold undoubtedly worries for my welfare, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />so please reassure him.

<g id="female_youknowS" />I committed to helping people here in Oxboro for my Covenant initiation, and there's more to be done. Hopefully,<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> I'll see you both at the enclave soon.
factionintro_covenant_vector_proposal_02: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Very well. I must attend to cleansing the foul presence of those Initiates from our sacred halls. <g id="female_crossarms" />	When Florina returns, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I hope all this is far behind us.
factionintro_covenant_vector_startprompt: "I can do that. What's the message?"
factionintro_marauders_01_completed_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Don’t give me that look, this place is FULL of wonders! <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Look at me, looking at you, eh!
factionintro_marauders_01_completed_b: <g id="male_headNodYes" />The Marauders are my kind of soldiers, see. Family now. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />And I think you should join our crew. Now, how about another tip from Tibbs?
factionintro_marauders_01_completed_next: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Don't be like that! <g id="male_explain" />Had to put you to a little test, didn’t I? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Or Strou'dahia would chew you up and spit you out. She's a tougher sort.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />Here now, let's be friends. <g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" />Have a reward for putting up with me!

factionintro_marauders_01_signetring: Collect a Signet Ring from a Lost Knight
factionintro_marauders_01_signetring_des: Old and tarnished plated signet ring.
factionintro_marauders_02_completed: <g id="male_goodnews" />Oh ho! Someone's got a mess of booty! <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Hope you gave those blackguards a good walloping. How’s the prize? <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ten percent for me then, eh? Fee, tax, and all.
factionintro_marauders_02_completed_next: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />A little manual labor’s good for you! <g id="female_crossarms" />Now just remember where you’re off to next.

<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Real rough ones always resurrect, aye? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Need a more permanent answer. Plant those barrels near their inner bulwarks, then run like hell!
factionintro_marauders_02_description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Lieutenant Tibbs has directed you to thrash some pirates and steal some black powder barrels at the Pirate Stockpile and then return to the Marauders Enclave.
factionintro_marauders_02_helm_reward_de: A helmet with deep scratches and dents from a few dozen battles. Nothing a solid blacksmith can't buff out.
factionintro_marauders_02_incomplete_a: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Those powder barrels, aye? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />We’ll be using those to impress Strou'dahia in the next step of our little plan.
factionintro_marauders_02_proposal_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Oi, no, no! Though it is Lost again. <g id="male_noway" />Pirates round here, always a pain in our side.
factionintro_marauders_02_proposal_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Tracked some of them down yesterday. <g id="male_ragepunchfistsdown" />Northeast, hiding like rats. Fight ’em, plunder ’em, burn their claim, and take their boom.
factionintro_marauders_03_2hgreataxe_rew: A perfectly weighted Great Axe that is designed to sever the limbs of your foes.
factionintro_marauders_03_completed_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Those who would risk themselves to save their comrades are always welcome in the Marauders.
factionintro_marauders_03_completed_b: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We always stand together, always look after our own. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Now, I know I can trust you in battle.
factionintro_marauders_03_completed_next: <g id="female_headnodding" /> Your little addendum to your mission was noted. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />That’s the third message Tibbs has sent.
<g id="male_explain" />He's an acquired taste, but a loyal and trustworthy ally. Should you wish to join us, <g id="male_nod1" />Smiggs can enter you into our charters.
factionintro_marauders_03_description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Gladiator Stroudahia has ordered you to best Varangians and rescue captives at Stonereach Keep. You must also complete Tibb's secret mission, before returning to the Marauders' Enclave
factionintro_marauders_03_destroytowera: Plant Explosive at the Eastern Tower
factionintro_marauders_03_destroytowerb: Plant Explosive at the Western Tower
factionintro_marauders_03_incomplete_a: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Were it you in captivity, you would hope for a quicker rescue? Suffering festers through inaction.
factionintro_marauders_03_proposal_a: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />The Varangians have begun to take some of our members prisoner. <g id="female_smackfist" />No Marauder lets their brethren stay in chains.
factionintro_marauders_03_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />Free the imprisoned recruits who were less fortunate, and take the Varangian Knights down a peg. <g id="female_smackfist" />Make them feel our wrath!
factionintro_marauders_vector_completed: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Good, stand before me. You have fought boldly so far. <g id="female_explainS" />	Should you wish to join our ranks I have one final test of strength and skill. It is time. Let us begin.
factionintro_marauders_vector_descriptio: Marauder Initiation Quest: Lieutenant Tibbs has asked you to speak with Gladiator Strou'dahia at the Marauder Enclave for your final initiation test.
factionintro_marauders_vector_incomplete: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> Off you trot, mate. <g id="female_crossarms" />Talk to the Doctore and I'll await your return.
factionintro_marauders_vector_proposal: <g id="male_chuckle" />Oh ho! There it is! Those bombs ain't the only things with spark! <g id="female_explainS" />Now, go talk to Gladiator Strou'dahia, and show the Marauders what you've got!
factionintro_syndicate_01_completed_a: <g id="female_explainS" />After that mishap with the wolves, <g id="male_patience" />I must return to experimenting and trying anew. A different formula, or perhaps a new approach.
factionintro_syndicate_01_completed_b: <g id="male_nod1" />Fortunately, research is what this place was built for. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />What I am built for.
factionintro_syndicate_01_completed_next: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />You like them? If you join us in the Syndicate, they will be yours to use. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Should you be interested, I would like to test your mind as well as your body.
factionintro_syndicate_01_container: Destroy the wolves for Aventus, and meet him at the Enclave.
factionintro_syndicate_01_container1: Defeat the Alpha Wolf and Pack (Optional: Place lure to draw the wolves)
factionintro_syndicate_01_container2: Travel north east to the Enclave
factionintro_syndicate_01_description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has hired you to lure the altered wolves to Midnight Den and destroy them, then meet him at the Syndicate Enclave to the north-east when you are finished.
factionintro_syndicate_01_gloves_reward_: A sturdy pair of leather gloves. Great for managing fanged beasts and caustic concoctions!
factionintro_syndicate_01_gotoenclave: Seek out the Syndicate sanctum in north eastern Everfall.
factionintro_syndicate_01_incomplete: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Do not feel too sorry for the wolves. <g id="male_explain" />Given the nature of the island, they are a menace in their best state.
factionintro_syndicate_01_killwolves: Defeat the Alpha Wolf and Pack
factionintro_syndicate_01_placelure: Place the lure to draw the Pack
factionintro_syndicate_01_proposal_a: <g id="male_nod2" />Yes, and the most valuable kind, indeed, if you assist!
factionintro_syndicate_01_proposal_b: <g id="male_explain" />You see, I've been testing alchemical lures on the local wolves. Results were promising, until one of the wolves consumed the bait... <g id="male_headShakeNo" />and grew in both size and ferocity.
factionintro_syndicate_01_proposal_next_: <g id="male_dontknow" />I--well--expected that possibility, but not the precise nature of the reaction.

<g id="male_clenchFistRight" />We must annihilate the creature. <g id="male_explain" />Place this lure in their den and fight until the alpha appears. Slay it, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />then meet me in the enclave for your reward.
factionintro_syndicate_01_talktoaventus: Speak with Aventus at the Enclave
factionintro_syndicate_01_title_descript: Destroy the wolves for Aventus, and meet him at the Enclave.
factionintro_syndicate_02_completed_a: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Now you've seen the Azoth Tree. It was truly beautiful, no? Well worth a little danger.
factionintro_syndicate_02_completed_b: <g id="male_gestureHereweare" />Welcome to Aeternum, my friend. You will have infinite time to take it in.
factionintro_syndicate_02_completed_next: <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />I hope you would see its true beauty. Now, if I may have the infused water, <g id="female_giveitem" />here is your payment.
<g id="male_nodUnderstand" />You would make a marvelous member of the Syndicate. However, you must first see an additional member of our order.
factionintro_syndicate_02_container: Sneak through Brightgrove and collect the Azoth-infused water.
factionintro_syndicate_02_description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has tasked you to climb the cliffs nearby into Brightwood and east into the grove of the Azoth Tree to collect water from the moat, and then return to him.
factionintro_syndicate_02_donotkill: Do Not Kill Any Angry Earth
factionintro_syndicate_02_hat_reward_des: Given to prospects with a passion to advance the Syndicate's research of all things on Aeternum and beyond.
factionintro_syndicate_02_incomplete_a: <g id="female_explainS" />Climb over the cliffs to the northeast. We have left markers as guides for the initiates.
factionintro_syndicate_02_proposal: <g id="male_nodProud" />You're sharp! No progress comes without danger.<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" /> Take this bottle, mind the cliffs, follow the path into Brightwood. Go through the grove, and then to the moat.
factionintro_syndicate_02_proposal_next_: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Consider that part of your test. You will know when you see it.

<g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Oh, one more thing: do not anger the creatures there. <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />You will find that discretion can often serve you far better than brute force.
factionintro_syndicate_02_title: Over the Cliffs, and Through the Woods
factionintro_syndicate_03_completed_a: <g id="female_youknow" />You return victorious. <g id="female_salute2finger" />You are truly committed to the application of knowledge, and not just its pursuit.
factionintro_syndicate_03_completed_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Despite how you may feel about the act itself, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />do know that this work will help the people of Everfall.
factionintro_syndicate_03_completed_next: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />As do I. If I am not, we will simply try something else.
<g id="female_headnodding" />Should you wish, we would be honored to have you join our ranks. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Speak to Astrid when you're ready. She can begin your initiation.
factionintro_syndicate_03_container: Sabotage the Broken Hull Hold water supply
factionintro_syndicate_03_container1: Travel south east to Broken Hull Hold
factionintro_syndicate_03_description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Cleo has requested that you travel to Broken Hull Hold, pour the sleeping draught into their wells, disrupt their reserves, and return to her at the Syndicate Enclave.
factionintro_syndicate_03_incomplete_a: <g id="female_thinking" />It is a grim proposition, to be sure.<g id="male_spreadhands" /> But what should be done?
factionintro_syndicate_03_musket_reward_: Engineered by the finest scientists in the Syndicate Enclave.
factionintro_syndicate_03_proposal_a: <g id="female_nodYes" />Indeed. <g id="male_explain" />This is an Azoth-infused sleeping draught, with which I hope to subdue our immortal foes.
factionintro_syndicate_03_proposal_b: <g id="female_explainS" />Pour it into the wells at Broken Hull Hold, and destroy their reserves to force them to drink it.
factionintro_syndicate_03_proposal_next_: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Lost who sleep do not fight. If they do not fight, they do not die. Those who do not die… do not resurrect.
<g id="female_youknow" />The Old World likened death to slumber. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We are going to turn that metaphor into reality.
factionintro_syndicate_03_well_a: Pour the draught into the Northern Well
factionintro_syndicate_03_well_b: Pour the draught into the Southern Well
factionintro_syndicate_vector_completed_: <g id="female_youknow" />Ah, a moment if you please. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Thank you for speaking with me, Aventus has had much to say about you.

<g id="female_headnodding" />Our order eagerly accepts capable candidates,<g id="male_explain" />	 and I hoped you would perform one final test to join our ranks. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Shall we?
factionintro_syndicate_vector_descriptio: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has asked you to speak with Cabalist Cleo Elsayad at the Syndicate Enclave for your final initiation test.
factionintro_syndicate_vector_incomplete: <g id="male_nodProud" />Go, and speak to Cleo. I eagerly await your return to the enclave.
factionintro_syndicate_vector_proposal: <g id="male_nodProud" />Oh, I believe you are. Go to her, and keep an open mind. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />The task she has prepared may challenge you in more ways than one.

factionmission_c_weapon_greataxe_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Great Axe</font> by cleaving <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its fearsome blade.
factionmission_c_weapon_hatchet_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Hatchet</font> by hacking down <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its ferocious rage.
factionmission_c_weapon_icegauntlet_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Ice Gauntlet</font> by freezing <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its frigid touch.
factionmission_c_weapon_lifestaff_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Life Staff</font> by smiting <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its mortal power.
factionmission_c_weapon_musket_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Musket</font> by gunning down <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its explosive blasts.

factionmission_c_weapon_spear_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Spear</font> by skewering <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its peerless reach.
factionmission_c_weapon_sword_desc: Understand combat to manifest peace.\n\nCome to know the <font color="#b2aea1">Sword</font> by striking down <font color="#b2aea1">{enemyName}</font> with its keen blade.

fallcaerdun01: I've never seen anyone fight so bravely as Yonas did in Great Cleave.
fallcaerdun02: Battered and bloody, he held the line.
fallcaerdun03: Victorious, we returned here to heal and enjoy a moment of peace.
fallcaerdun04: But in the quiet of the night, that peace was shattered.
fallcaerdun05: The Corrupted washed over the fort in a wave – cutting and clawing, rending and tearing...
fallcaerdun07: I tried to help... Then that demon appeared, cutting down one after another. She would have finished me...
fallcaerdun08: She should have... But Yonas was there...
fallcaerdun09: Every ounce of his power, every swing and thrust, was to save us all.
fallcaerdun11: She broke our fearless leader and dragged him away.
fallcaerdun12: Our fortress in ruins... the Soulwardens, crushed.
fallcaerdun13: We were too weak to stop them. There is nothing left.
fallenangel01: I still recall the day I discovered an Angel visiting my church...
fallenangel02: Isabella de Leon, a young woman of unsurpassed devotion, seeking redemption for generations of family shame.
fallenangel03: It was I who first brought her to hear the mad ravings of the Heretic...
fallenangel04: And strangely found myself joining their ill-fated expedition.
fallenangel05: On Aeternum, Isabella's aspiration became obsession...
fallenangel06: And when she drank from the Fountain, her thirst for divine inspiration transformed into madness.
fallenangel07: As the crimson thickened in her eyes, so did the hold of the demonic parasite within her soul.
fallenangel08: She met the crew's questions with blood, leaving them as mindless husks.
fallenangel09: My heart shattered, my faith lost... I struck down the Heretic for leading us to this damnation...
fallenangel10: And I fled in shame to the Old World, determined to return and make this right.
fallenangel11: In Rome, I gained access to the darkest archives of my order...
fallenangel12: And there found answers that promised salvation when I returned to these shores.
fallenangel13: I hired a Captain to bring me back, but after shipwrecking on the island,
fallenangel14: I saw what happened... the blessing I intended for her was bestowed upon YOU instead.
fallsoulwardens01: We were not the first to stand against the Corrupted.
fallsoulwardens02: Heroes of a lost age once harnessed the magic of the Ancients to defend Aeternum.
fallsoulwardens03: Delving into a tomb of legend, we found the ancient rites those heroes employed...
fallsoulwardens04: And the Soulwarden Order was born.
fallsoulwardens05: Harnessing the Ancients' magics, Romano blessed us with a bulwark against Corruption's influence.
fallsoulwardens06: But this gift came at great sacrifice. We would never be the same again.
fallsoulwardens07: Our newfound powers carried us to many victories...
fallsoulwardens08: I began to believe we could actually vanquish the Corrupted.
fallsoulwardens09: But the Crimson Sorcerer was a wily foe. He learned our secrets and exploited them.
fallsoulwardens10: One by one, my fellow Wardens became Corrupted.
fallsoulwardens11: The tower of Arcturus is where we made our stand. In a final act of desperation, Constanza and I would leap from the heights.
fallsoulwardens12: But in the end, I was alone.
fallsoulwardens13: I have tried to honor the memory of my fallen friends, but the memories are too much.
fallsoulwardens14: I am no longer a Soulwarden. There are no Soulwardens anymore.

fish_ishikawa_00_defaultdialogue: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />In life, you're either the fish or the worm.<g id="male_shrugBrief" /> Or the person eating the fish. Or the person ordering from the person fishing the fish that other person will eat.
fish_ishikawa_00_defaultdialogue_vector: <g id="female_throwarmsFrustrated" />Stubborn old fisher! Why won't she rest? <g id="female_disagreeRighthandout" />The fish aren't going anywhere! It's like she wants to suffer,<g id="male_crossarmsJudge" /> and I have no idea why.
fish_ishikawa_01_defaultdialogue: <g id="male_shakehead" />Don't tell me Khadijah sent you. <g id="male_noway" priority="high" />I can't keep up with these orders without a break. Or multiple breaks. It's like the fish… want to be caught! There's no end to it.
fish_ishikawa_02_defaultdialogue: <g id="female_thinking" /> I'm thinking if I can sleep with one eye open, maybe I can fish at the same time as resting. <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Then I can finish the order on time! <g id="male_dontknowS" />Ah, but what if I dream of fish?
fish_khadijah_00_defaultdialogue: <g id="male_quidproquo" />Now, was yours that new request we got from Oxboro? <g id="female_apologetic" />I apologize it's been slower than expected. Those rare catches have been… <g id="female_shrugShort" />well. Rare!
fish_khadijah_01_defaultdialogue: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Perronelle's completely lost it. Catches fish after fish, beautiful fish, and then throws them back. <g id="male_noway" priority="high" />She won't eat… or barely even talk to me.
fish_khadijah_02_defaultdialogue_vector: <g id="male_scoldFingerwag" />But we mustn't get distracted... your test! <g id="female_crossarms" />I need to be assured you can work well with others and prod things when things need prodding.
fish_khadijah_03_defaultdialogue_vector: <g id="male_explain" />With these fish, our plan has the best chance of success. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />I can't know how she'll respond, in her state, <g id="male_outfitproud" />but I can hope.
fish_pelles_00_defaultdialogue: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Now is the time to cast with all your might, my dear savior! <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />For Perronelle! In the name of Artorius and his Honor and Glory!
fish_pelles_01_defaultdialogue: <g id="female_nodding" />You return victorious, I am certain of it. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I can smell those bug-eyed monsters and the foul evil that lurks in their hearts. <g id="male_lookDown" />I know that smell all too well.
fish_perronelle_00_defaultdialogue: The fish aren’t biting much today. Ah, perhaps I've caught too many here... Merde. Have I, ahh, disappointed your plans?
fish_perronelle_01_defaultdialogue: And for your first lesson: casting without bait is a waste of your time… and the fish's. Think of the bait like a paintbrush. Catching the fish, now that's the art!
fish_perronelle_02_defaultdialogue: I have tried so hard. So hard! Ah, and it takes so much effort to do things that are so miniscule. And yet I reach for the ocean. Like you did that day, La Lueur.
fish_perronelle_02_defaultdialogue_vecto: They are younger, minds more flexible for… business. One is so diligent! The other is… a bit of an idler. And I… am stuck in my ways. Ah, what a group we are.

fisher_regent_body_01_01:
First thing you will notice about the monster isn’t her size or smell. It is the sound; a horrible gurgle that pierces through the tides and into your soul.

The laws of time and space hold the most tenuous of grasps on her. She comes and goes as she pleases; from the shores of Aeternum to the rivers, lakes, and even ponds nestled within.

Damage inflicted by a bite from her accompanies the victim beyond death. I have learned this from painful personal experience.

Regardless of the mysteries surrounding her. I will not rest until I have her hooked, weighed, and gutted. She took something precious from me and I intend to retrieve it. I am weary of sitting in this chair, of this pain, and this half existence.
fisher_regent_body_01_02:
It was a dark and stormy night on the Aeternum coast.

“My kingdom is in trouble!” shouted King Artorius from the shore. “We shall surely perish from hunger lest ye shall procure a bounteous quantity of fish!”

“Never you fret,” replied Captain Perronelle le Noir, with nary a fret.

She cast her net into the waves and instantly hauled a grand school of fish. Loading the haul into the ship’s foremast trebuchet, she launched it back to shore. The fish bounced into a bonfire and onto the banquet table, already cooked and delicious [citation needed]. The kingdom rejoiced.

“’Twas nothing,” replied Captain Perronelle. Suddenly, a shape appeared from the water behind her. A monstrous, 20-headed beast, 1000 feet tall, towered over her [citation needed]

“You have terrorized my fishy kindred long enough,” the beast snarled through jagged jaws. “And now I will devour you whole!”

To be continued...?
fisher_regent_body_01_03:
Much ink has been spilled on the subject of Perronelle le Noir’s arch-nemesis, ‘Gladys,’ a mythic creature of monstrous stature. It teleports from sea to pond to tea cup. It is borne forward by the monomaniacal purpose of terrorizing Perronelle.

For the record, there is no one on this island I respect more than Perronelle. She has elevated the plebian’s craft of fishing to a true art form. The way she tracks tides, selects bait, expertly casts her line, is nothing less than masterful.

However, I am steadfastly a man of science. No one has witnessed 'Gladys' save Perronelle. No creature, Lost, Corrupted, Angry, or otherwise, fits her fanciful descriptions.

While I admire my captain, I put no more faith in her nautical ramblings than the fishwives’ tales back in Heian-kyō. We should strive to leave such superstitions in the old world, where they belong.
fisher_regent_body_01_04:
“The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about…” -Jonah 2:5

The flood of pain now subsumes me. As the last vestiges of my humanity evaporate like sea foam, I know that the time has come to reflect on the event that led me to this chair, this incurable injury, and this great sense of loss.

Ages ago, my brother was known as the Fisher King. Together we served King Artorius.

One day, we went fishing like usual, casting our nets into the sea. When out of nowhere, we hear something emerging from the depths. I will never forget that sound, like impending doom. In my darkest nightmares and my brightest hopes I hear it. You will see why.

A monster, like a seething wall of muscle and slime blasted out of the water, smashing our boat like a child’s toy. One moment, my brother was standing next to me. The next, a gaping maw pulled him in like a riptide, and then, gone, swallowed behind a row of teeth. No! I swam after him, but the teeth slammed shut, severing my leg and my bond with my brother. I have not been whole since.

The wound refuses to heal, but this is nothing compared to the loss of my brother. He was never seen again. Something about that damn fish prevents it. But I know he’s still alive. And I will find him.

I have been following Gladys for ages, tracking her patterns and behavior. I know where she will reappear next, and what bait will draw her out. Alas, I am too weak to cast the line myself.

To whomever reads this: you can still save my brother. Catch the specified bait and go to the attached location. If my timing is correct, Gladys should appear shortly. Perhaps you can succeed where I failed.

Oh, my dear brother, I fear that our years apart will soon be stretched into eternity.

fivefarms_body_01_01:
We burned Adriaen today, his flesh given over first to the strange wasting disease on the isle, then second to the flames of the pyre. I could not hold my composure and wept, yet others among us remained silent.

He had already been feared lost almost a season ago – some claimed they thought they had seen him amongst evil-looking soldiers, but they could not be sure, and feared to approach too closely lest they be captured as well.

Still, to see him return, so sickly and feral like a hound, lashing out at all he could find, it took three men of the town to bring him down with clubs until he collapsed, still clinging to life. We gathered around, horrified, none of us knowing what to make of it, until Marten ordered we burn him, lest the infection spread.

Kathrijn
fivefarms_body_01_02:
I examined Adriaen's ashes on the morrow – I could not say whether the flames had consumed him or whether he had simply vanished, for no bones or trace of him remained - only a strange shaping of wood, dyed red, that seemed untouched by the fire. A parting gift, I thought, something that sustained him and not even the fire could burn away.

I did not speak of what I had found, merely buried the keepsake in the fields where Adriaen had labored for the harvest, and then I scattered Adriaen's ashes from the pyre atop it. Wherever Adriaen is now, I hope he is at peace.

Kathrijn
fivefarms_body_01_03:
I found some small comfort today. Where I had buried the Adriaen's red keepsake – the oddly shaped sculpture of wood - a violet flower had sprouted. I sought to pluck it for the mantle, but it resisted my efforts, so I brought a knife and clipped it sharply where it clung to the soil.

In the morning, however, the flower had died, the petals black, though I had made sure it had enough soil and water – and the smell from it was quite peculiar, almost like rot. I cast the remains away, then returned to where I had taken the flower the day before. To my surprise, new flowers had blossomed where I had buried the keepsake, almost a dozen sprouting forth where none had been the day before.

I am afraid to speak of the matter to Marten. I thought to tell my Mother what I had seen, but then put it out of my mind – she did not want to speak of Adriaen - as if by saying his name we would bring the disease upon us.

Kathrijn
fivefarms_body_01_04:
Marten has not returned. We went out in search of him, but it seemed he had wandered off. There were no signs of a struggle, nor bandits from the road, but they gathered us together and ordered us to bolt the doors. It has been days now, and the villagers have taken to whispering amongst themselves.

I did not speak of the flowers I saw where Marten had vanished, and how their color looked red in the dusk, as if drinking in the day's last rays. The flowers grow thickly there as they did at Adriaen's grave – and I have seen them elsewhere in the village as well. The men and women complain about them, how they choke the crops and seem to resist spade and shovel.

They call them not flowers, but weeds – to me, they still have a beauty about them, and I am glad there is some trace of it on this isle, for there is little joy to be had.

Kathrijn
fivefarms_body_01_05:
I saw Adriaen last night. It was no trick of the eye - he was at the place where I had scattered his ashes. It was barely a moment, then he was gone from sight. Though I know it would have made mother and father upset, I took a torch and went to see for myself – yet there was nothing, only a thick carpet of flowers, even thicker than before, so thick it was impossible to see if any tracks lay in the dirt.

I remained there for longer than I realized, for when I came to my senses, dawn was rising, and there I was in my nightclothes. Adriaen, I will watch for you, and next time, I shall be swifter – if you are to be found, it is I who will catch you if you wander outside the village.

I took a flower and placed it in the sill, a reminder to you that I still think of you. Unlike the first flower, this flower was pulled easily from the soil at my touch, as if recognizing me.

Kathrijn
fivefarms_body_01_06:
My daughter, my precious daughter Kathrijn is gone. Her bed was not slept in, and on the sill, one of those horrid-smelling flowers, wilted and dead. They seem to infest the fields now like a blight, a vile weed that jests at our labors.

The men gathered together in search of her, and rode out in the early morning. It was nearly night before they returned, and they were half their number, their faces white. They would not answer our questions until they were inside, the door and shudders bolted. When I pressed for details, had they found her, they said nothing except that I must put her out of my mind.

The other men said nothing, merely clutched their weapons to them.

Marisse
fivefarms_body_01_07:
Marten's daughter, Anika, claims to see have seen Kathrijn. She said she saw her with Adriaen, and two other men of the village who had gone missing. I told her where, and she said, “in the flower fields.” I told her to stop telling stories, and she went quiet at my tone. She asked quietly if she could sleep in my room, and I sent her to bed rather sternly. 

The child has taken to sleeping beneath my bed when scared. If it gives her comfort, so be it. The poor child has nowhere else to sleep, and her presence makes Kathrijn's absence… it makes it less, for a time.

Marisse
fivefarms_body_01_08:
I shared Anika's imagined tale of seeing Kathrijn and Adriaen with the millwright Elias, while we were drawing from the well. I cloaked Anika's tale with scorn, expecting him to shake his head sadly and offer sympathy.

Instead, Elias went quiet, not with disbelief, but in that hesitation I know comes from fear of speaking the truth. I pressed him on it – even threatened to strike him, until at last he cried out that he had seen them, too.

“They're not lost,” he said. “They've been coming back. Each of them… sometimes to the fields. We see them walking among the flower beds, but gone at our approach – we work in pairs now, for fear of being led off into whatever hell claimed them.”

I told him that if we were lost out there, we would want to be found. He shook his head. “It is bad enough they have come back to us, we should not go looking for them. They aren't our people, our family anymore - they belong to the island.”

Marisse
fivefarms_body_01_09:
Elias has taken to checking on me. I do not leave the bed, I feel not myself. Elias volunteered to take Anika for a time, though the child still wishes to sleep here, beneath the bed, seemingly content to be close to me.

I awake some nights, not certain of where I am – there is simply the smell of the flowers, all around us. It is a sea, calm, not like the storm-thrashed waves that surround the isle.

Marisse
fivefarms_body_01_10:
I awoke to a flower on the sill. Its petals were black, its stem resting in a dirty cup as if dug out of a river. The flower smelled of rot, yet I could not throw it out.

I do not know how I knew, but I knew Kathrijn had left for it for me. My daughter had told me she was alive. That I should seek her out amongst the flowers.

Marisse
fivefarms_body_01_11:
Marisse is gone. We went in search of her, even braved the darkness, but to no avail. We searched for two days and two nights. But her going missing - that is not the worst of it. Not at all. It was what I found on my return.

When I returned, I immediately went to Marisse's bedroom to see if she had returned - and found flowers scattered about the bed, the same grave flowers that have swallowed our village.

The flowers… they are so bright when they lie in the earth, violet by day, yet blood red at dusk – and they die so quickly when cut from earth's embrace. We have seen the life this isle brings… we have not seen the death it brings, in all its shapes and kinds.

I fear to say it, but this village is no longer ours. It belongs to all those who have gone missing. And soon we will lie like the petals about the bed in this village, each home now their home.

Elias
fivefarms_body_01_12:
I was hiding beneath Marisse's bed when Elias returned. When he stood in the doorway, I didn't move. I hadn't moved since the night before - when Marisse had come home. And spread the flowers.

When Elias found me, he asked about the flowers Marisse had scattered around the bed. I didn't tell him I had heard her return. I didn't tell him I had seen the flowers fall. I didn't tell him I was there.

I didn't tell him because he is more scared than me, and adults are not supposed to be scared.

I didn't tell him when she had come home, the floorboards did not make a sound. I didn't tell  him how afraid I was to breathe. How I saw Marisse's feet, dirty, torn, covered in scabs, as she walked slowly around the bed, a black petal falling with each step. I only closed my eyes and prayed until she was gone.

But she's not gone. None of them are. I need to find a new hiding place where no one knows.

Anika
fivefarms_body_01_13:
I am still hiding. It has been three days - I have no more food, I am so hungry, but I am afraid to sneak out, to get more.

All the people of the village who had left came back. They smelled like the flowers in the fields when they are dug up. They don't speak, they simply walk, even do the same things they used to do but they don't do it properly – they do it like they barely remember how.

I don't know how long I can stay here, but they are not leaving. I can hear them moving through the houses even now, their feet scraping on the floorboards, hear their breath. Sometimes… sometimes I think I hear Marisse, whispering my name. She wouldn't hurt me. She would never hurt me.

Anika
fivefarms_body_01_14:
I do not know how long I can stay here. I hear Marisse's voice more and more, in the distance, but I do not know if it is real. I am able to see the whole of the village from my hiding place now, so I do quick looks when I think it is safe.

This last time, I thought I saw Marisse in the field, walking toward me through the flowers – smiling, happy. If it is her, then I will run to her, and ask her to take me away from this horrid place.

There is a sound at the door – someone is here. Marisse?

I can smell flowers, freshly cut. She has come for me, to lay the petals around me so I might sleep.

Anika

ftue_archetypes_desc_crafter: This determines the equipment with which you begin your journey. It does not restrict what you can use.
ftue_archetypes_desc_explorer: This determines the equipment with which you begin your journey. It does not restrict what you can use.
ftue_archetypes_desc_farrier: I have been an apprentice, a journeyman and a craftsman. I am humble, but my skills carry me far. I can build anything, and, one day, will build everything.
ftue_archetypes_desc_fighter: This determines the equipment with which you begin your journey. It does not restrict what you can use.
ftue_archetypes_desc_huntsman: This determines the equipment with which you begin your journey. It does not restrict what you can use.
ftue_archetypes_desc_mercenary: I am pitiless, but principled, versed in the art of mayhem, and loyal to the term of my contract. I am self-sufficient, but at ease as a member of a troop or campaign.
ftue_archetypes_desc_rosicrucian: I am one of the chosen, with privileged knowledge of the clockwork of the world. I unearth secrets, combine unstable elements, and bend them to my service.
ftue_archetypes_desc_scholar: I am a pupil of mystery. I have burrowed through volumes in every palace of learning, collecting clues to forces both deadly and arcane.
ftue_archetypes_desc_servant: I am one of many. Others discover, I exploit. Others settle, I conquer. Others invent, I industrialize. I am unseen, but my presence is felt in all things.
ftue_archetypes_desc_sharpshooter: Start at level 15 with Light Armor, both a Bow and Musket, and Rapier and Spear, stocked with health potions and food to ward Darkness.
ftue_archetypes_desc_stowaway: I have left a world with nothing, to begin a new life with nothing. I have only determination, grit, and the willingness to earn what is offered.
ftue_archetypes_desc_templar: I am the emissary of fate. I am the instrument of righteous fury, seeking the realm of the almighty, whether in the world we know, in the celestial firmament, or hereafter.
ftue_archetypes_description_musketeer: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Damage</font>\n\nA nimble explorer and adventurer, skilled with rapier and rifle alike.
ftue_archetypes_description_occultist: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Damage</font>\n\nA practitioner of primal elemental arts, commanding the forces of frost and flame.
ftue_archetypes_description_soldier: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Tank/Damage</font>\n\nA fighter by trade, balancing defense and offense with sword and shield and hatchet.
ftue_archetypes_description_theurgist: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Healer/Damage</font>\n\nA scholar-warrior who seeks to master the forces of life and death.
ftue_archetypes_description_tracker: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Damage</font>\n\nA keen-eyed hunter, scout, and pathfinder, proficient with bow and spear.
ftue_archetypes_description_wanderer: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Damage/Tank</font>\n\nA gutsy, heavily-armed berserker, wielding a colossal greatsword and blunderbuss.
ftue_archetypes_description_warmonger: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_regular_italic.font">Damage/Tank</font>\n\nA mighty slayer, brutally executing foes with their massive war hammer and great axe.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_mercena: Starts with a boost to Weaponsmithing, Mining, and Smelting.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_muskete: Starts with a boost to Armoring, Harvesting, and Weaving.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_occulti: Starts with a boost to Jewelcrafting, Mining, and Smelting.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_theurgi: Starts with a boost to Arcana, Harvesting, and Weaving.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_tracker: Starts with a boost to Engineering, Logging, and Woodworking.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_wandere: Starts with a boost to Cooking, Fishing, and Leatherworking.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_desc_warmong: Starts with a boost to Armoring, Skinning, and Leatherworking.
ftue_archetypes_proficiency_tooltip: Choosing an archetype only provides a boost to specific trade skills. You can gain mastery in all weapons and trade skills in Aeternum.
ftue_archetypes_secondary_title: Respecs for your attributes and trade skills are free until Level 10
ftue_archetypes_title_tooltip: Your archetype dictates the first items and abilities you'll discover on the island, but you'll be free to master any weapon and wear any armor you wish.
ftue_archetypes_tooltip_mercenary_1: Weaponsmithing allows you to craft metal weapons
ftue_archetypes_tooltip_mercenary_2: Mining allows you to gather more valuable metal ores, stone, and gems
ftue_archetypes_tooltip_mercenary_3: Smelting allows you to refine gathered ore into workable metal ingots
ftue_archetypes_tooltip_musketeer_1: Armoring allows you to craft armor from cloth, leather, or metal

ftue_body_lore1a: The storm has become nigh unbearable. Gale winds, heavy bursts, roiling sea. The sleepless Captain insists we push ahead, his fixation on the vial of Azoth onboard is too strong to combat. The substance is said to multiply the natural properties of all things, but the only thing I have seen it do is increase the Captain's possessive nature and secretive ways. He mutters to himself about a land of conflict, conquering, and endless azoth. None dare challenge him.\n“Mere Courage” Log 17\n
ftue_body_lore1b:
At the Captain's request I have made a study of this strange vial he carries.
What lies within is neither mineral nor liquid, defying all known properties of matter. It glows a haunting blue, and seems almost to hum when held by human hands.
All who make the perilous journey to Aeternum seek this Azoth, but few understand it. I hope I am able to study the wellsprings of this substance said to be found on this strange island, and hope even more that I can send my research back to the Old World.

Almeda Umber
Scholar and Naturalist to the Capital Survey Expedition's “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore1c:
I am two hours now wading amongst the wreckage. High water is coming and like to dislodge the ruins of the great ships grounded here. Some look ancient, while our galley appears to be the newest addition to this graveyard of expeditions. I cannot stay, but will forge inland to seek an overlook to make a signal and spy for other survivors.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore1d:
I swear today I saw Almeda, speared through the chest with a timber, same as I witnessed him thrown overboard six days ago. There he was—pale, water-bloated, hissing, incoherent, and yet the same Almeda I shared mess with. I fled from his ghastly visage as he swiped at me with hands decaying. I do not know what shore we have encountered, but it is not the promised land of our dreams. Only purgatory, only a promise of unholy punishment.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore2:
A foul, rotting thing bearing resemblance to our Captain struck at me from the ruins of a sloop. I drove a splintered oar through its neck, but not before it pierced my stomach with its rusted sword.
Cannot stop the bleeding. Shelter here. Must rest.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore4a:
I am beginning to understand why only a few vials of the potent Azoth made it back to the Old World. It seems all who crash here are stranded with no hope of sailing out into the persistent storm surrounding the island. Even if I were to find a crew and repair a ship I doubt we would be able to get further than the horizon before being smashed to bits by a choppy and unforgiving sea. 

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore4b:
There must be other survivors of the wrecks, though I cannot see them. I see the marks of their presence, footprints tinged with Azoth in the sand leading my way forward. I follow these tracks and the strange blue flames that occupy the repurposed ship lanterns along the path. I pray I find some kind of refuge walking in the footsteps of those who came before me.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore4c:
Awoke at camp, injury healed. I cannot judge how much time has passed but it was not the month of recovery that I needed for such a wound. I am restored, but… incomplete. I cannot return to the shore for fear of what I might find there—the carcass of my former self. This place will not let me die, as it has not released any sailor who drowned, only to wash upon these shores. The reaper claims no souls here, and the dead wander.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_lore4d:
In the distance I have spotted two grand statues of fine craftsmanship standing against the waves. The tide has receded and there is nothing for me in the muddy grave behind me. Ahead, there is a bar of sand leading to the main land of Aeternum. I know not what I will find there, but it must be better than this.

Joan Caron
Cartwright to the Capital Survey Expedition
Survivor of the wrecked ship “Mere Courage”
ftue_body_sealedcommission: We sail west-northwest with the breeze from the west increasing steadily. Cloudy, with unending rain. 2 knots, steady. We are about 600 miles under sail. Unseasonal dampness and warmth threatens to spoil provisions. Crew is haggard and morale is low with none in command sleeping nigh three days. Have the alchemists of the Old World sent us to our deaths chasing a fairytale?\n“Mere Courage” Log 13

ftue_intro_1: Recent disappearances fuel the old legends.\nAny ship passing through these waters, gone without a trace.
ftue_intro_11: If we make landfall, we will have only our wits and determination to rely upon.\nWhether we meet friend or foe, we must be cautious.
ftue_intro_12: May providence guide and protect us.
ftue_intro_2: Yet, into the heart of the storm we sailed, revealing a vast island in the darkness.\nWe tack for it now.
ftue_intro_3: Our Captain has told us to expect hostility.\nLuckily for us, his secretive patrons have provided the finest of weapons.
ftue_intro_4: As for me, I have little but my ambition.\nFate guided me on this voyage because I have rare skills.
ftue_intro_5: I hope to make a name for myself as...
ftue_intro_8: The long-sought alchemical essence.\nThe fabled key to immeasurable power and immortality.
ftue_intro_9: Its promise has drawn us here.

galahadregret01: It was the dream of Avalon that led King Artorius to these shores.
galahadregret02: And of course, the wise counsel of the enchanter, Myrddin.
galahadregret03: But the enchanter became obsessed with the island's mysteries. An insidious evil claimed his soul.
galahadregret04: The Wars of Crimson Madness raged for a century. So many banners… All fallen to the Corruption.
galahadregret05: I know not what transpired to end the conflict.
galahadregret06: We found no answers as to Myrrdin's fate, no trace of the High King.
galahadregret07: I sought new peace and purpose here in the Brightwood.
galahadregret08: But it would not last. A plague of soulless Lost emerged.
galahadregret09: Brother Umberto and I formed the Bright Vigil to fight the darkness.
galahadregret10: But he stood alone when I left in search of my lord king.
galahadregret11: I returned empty handed, to witness the results of my failure.
galahadregret12: The Vigil, fallen to despair, and the Brightwood, bright no more.

grace_00_00_init: <g id="male_casualHail" />Fancy meeting you here! Come to enjoy the view? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Something tells me there are riches to be had here.
grace_00_01_offer_rumors_a: <g id="female_thinking" />Thought I heard scuffling in those ruins. <g id="male_secretiveshort" />I was thinking there might be some treasure in there.
grace_00_01_offer_rumors_b: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />But you don't look like you found something, you look like <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />you're still searching.
grace_01_00_init_a: <g id="female_nodding" />This is my kind of town. Color, opulence, fashion… thievery, gossip, drama…
grace_01_00_init_b: <g id="female_youknow" />Just the sort of place that rewards the ambition of <g id="male_willcoverit" />a woman trying to seek her fortune.
grace_01_01_comment_rumors_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Did you find your rambling old man? Surely someone in this town knows where to find him.
grace_01_01_comment_rumors_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Either way, don't be a stranger. I'm working on a little deal that could earn us some real coin.
grace_01_02_comment_adiana_a: <g id="male_willcoverit" />While you flitter off in search of a myth, I'll be enjoying the company of my betters.
grace_01_02_comment_adiana_b: <g id="female_nodding" />Their doting affection will be right profitable, I'm betting.
grace_01_02_comment_returnstaff_a: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />You're a real puzzle, you know? Delving into ruins and danger <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />to rescue a town that can't be bothered to rescue itself.
grace_01_02_comment_returnstaff_b: <g id="female_nodyes" />Some day I'd like to know just what's <g id="female_taptemple" />knocking about in that head of yours.
grace_01_02a_tasktopic_adiana_a: <g id="female_nodyes" />My hunch about this town was right. <g id="g_male_secretive" />Did you know the jewelers deal in gold plating? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />These pampered city-folk truly can't tell the difference.
grace_01_02a_tasktopic_adiana_b: <g id="male_compliment" />But what have you been up to?
grace_01_02a_tasktopic_returnstaff_a: Don't bother talking to that Magistrate fellow.
grace_01_02a_tasktopic_returnstaff_b: It's a waste of time talking to such fools. Their power is getting others to do things, not doing it themselves.
grace_01_02a_tasktopic_returnstaff_new: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />So now you know what I've been up to, but what about you? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I see that fancy new staff you're toting around. What do you plan to do with that?
grace_01_04_comment_usestaff_a: I have to hand it to you, you're turning into quite the hero.
grace_01_04_comment_usestaff_b: Running off into the woods after a ghost, returning determined to battle those red-eyed demons, and now I hear that SOMEONE beat back the Corrupted in the north. Now who could that be, I wonder?
grace_01_04_comment_usestaff_new: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />You and I know the truth, don't we? Herbalist Howe may get all the glory, <g id="male_compliment" />but you're the one who did the work. You're the real hero.
grace_01_04_comment_usestaff_talkto: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />Nah, you'd be a fool if you did! Flying your flag everywhere is just an invitation for trouble. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You and the old codger are more my sort of people.
