greatbridge_body_01_01:
Even though we have suffered much, and the Bridge has been taken from us, I still carry hope that one day we will be able to drive the Corrupted from its ramparts.

I still recall the wonder when I first set eyes upon the bridge that crossed the Great Cleave. If there was every proof of the architectural skill of those who came before – the bridge quelled all doubts. It is a feat of engineering, something that could be said to rival the wonders of Europe and the East - if only others could see it.

I've surveyed the bridge, both when I arrived, and from a distance later on – it is with great sadness we had to say farewell, to retreat, but I and the other settlers… it was too dangerous to remain within its shadow.

-D. Prieto, Queensport Engineer
greatbridge_body_01_02:
The Bridge seems a continuation of the Ancient roads that cut the isle. The massive pillars that support it suggest it was built to carry heavy cargo, most likely the great stone blocks that compose the Ancient ruins – for we discovered a temple on the Eastern side, complete with the great statues seen elsewhere on the isle. 

The temple is not safe to explore, however: Wolves, seemingly of frost (!), stalk amongst the standing skeletons of the temple – yet I do not know which is worse, the wolves or the skeletons: the skeletons seem to watch us silently, their bone and armor perfectly preserved, spears in their hands of bone. Perhaps they once Bridge guards in times past. Now? They guard it in death.

As with the other Ancient structures I've surveyed, the Bridge seems a cross of mortared stones and pillars of rock that seemed to be shaped seamlessly from a single, great block of stone. How the Ancients constructed such marvels is a mystery – either they had armies of laborers, or, especially in the case of the uncut stone, perhaps a means of shaping the mountains and the canyons to their will, perhaps using the power of the Isle itself? 

We may never know their mysteries, and with the Corrupted and the other creatures now atop the Bridge, we may never be able to uncover its secrets – if we survive at all.

-D. Prieto, Engineer
greatbridge_body_01_03:
We underestimated them – we assumed the Corrupted cunning, yes, but in the back of our minds, we considered them our lessers, barely capable of speech, and still clinging to the garments of settlers of old. We saw them as nothing more than the same shells we had seen to the South – the Withered we eagerly cut down as we harvested what we could from the isle.

This arrogance has cost us the Cleave. 

The Corrupted used the winter against us – as they always have, I now see. They don't feel the cold stabbing at them, it does not slow their march. And worse, the day they fell upon the Great Bridge, they proved capable of not just cunning, but tactics: they used a winter flurry to mask their approach on both roads leading to the Bridge, and even if the watch had time to call out, their voices were lost in the storm. The Corrupted then set upon the remaining soldiers – but none of them did they cut down. Instead they pinned them, shackled them, and carried them away – where? To the North, perhaps. If so, they did not remain there long – within a season, they had returned, the sight of which nearly broke us as we caught sight of our lost men and women upon the Bridge, side by side with the Corrupted.

-D. Prieto, Engineer
greatbridge_body_01_04:
The sight of them is like a knife to the heart. Losing the Bridge was a blow to our morale, but what occurred not soon after nearly pushed us to retreat from the Cleave entirely.

The entire season, the Corrupted still commanded the Bridge, but as the season ended, they were joined by others – and among their number, we saw our own brothers and sisters. They were standing guard as they had before, but this time, they stood not against the Corrupted – but with them. 

I still watch from afar, a single spyglass to pierce the storm. And when I raise the spyglass to see what lies there upon the Bridge, I see their commander, staring back at me, her eyes like two burning coals in the hollow of her face.

-D. Prieto, Engineer
greatbridge_body_01_05:
I know not what to make of recent events – there are rumors of strange occurrences to the South, blue lights along the lanterns of the roads, and even the dead walking, Azoth burning in their chests. I would have passed this off to rumors and wild tales…

…had not the Bridge been touched by the same madness.

I was watching through the spyglass when I saw the first of the Corrupted struck down, its head split from its shoulders – at first, I thought it was only by imagining, perhaps spurred by hope – but no, there was fighting upon the Bridge, another group perhaps, but it was certain – they were attacking the Corrupted!

I sought another vantage point, but the sight gave me hope – I moved swiftly so I could see the battle play out, but this may be the turning point in our efforts!

-D. Prieto, Engineer
greatbridge_body_01_06:
At first I thought the fighting on the Bridge was perhaps a counterattack by another company, or a drunken dare by Merchand and his thugs (who have long boasted they could take the Bridge in their undergarments) – it was neither.

My heart froze colder than the surrounding frost as I saw skeletons, spheres of blue light burning in their chest, slowly marching the span of the Bridge – and when the Corrupted launched themselves at the attackers, the Ancient Keepers did not fall back but met them head-on: the Corrupted were ruthlessly cut down, their remains cast from the Bridge as they dissolved into ash, leaving only their weapons to fall to the stones below – in moments, the Ancient Keepers had taken half the Bridge, seemingly uncaring of the numbers of the Corrupted.

I see now it was fortunate we had not staged the same assault, for the Corrupted had been prepared – for us, perhaps, but not this. In response to this unexpected attack, reinforcements swarmed the Bridge like ants, Corrupted erupting from hidden places in the surrounding rocks to drive back the Guardians – but to no avail.

When the sun fell, the Bridge had once again changed hands – and the Corrupted were no longer its master. The blue fire in the chests of the Guardians lit the top of the Bridge now, marking it as their own.

-D. Prieto, Engineer

grenville_body_02_01:
Maddie's council proved true, even if she is no longer with us. We came to the Temple Ruins late in the day, although Rolfe was silent for the journey. I have left him to his thoughts, and left the attack at the Dig Site behind us as best I can.

There are an unusual number of the dead surrounding the ruins here – some lie on the ground, as if they collapsed where they stood, some still remain standing, blades in hand, as if they were slain in a single, frozen moment. The armor and weapons have markings like that on the Ancient structures on the isle. Are these the ancient colonists - or merely their servants – or soldiers? 

Every skeleton is intact – no sign of broken bones, merely the flesh eaten down to the white… no insects, no spiders, nothing crawls upon them, and what caused them to remain standing, I do not know. Perhaps it was part of the power that keeps some of us deathless upon the isle? 

-Grenville
grenville_body_02_02:
Maddie's words again proved true – the skeletons on the outskirts of the structure have small spheres, with markings much like the Great Spheres, embedded in their chests. They were not posed as warnings – they seemed to have lived once, and I could see the trails they had worn in the stone and the temple perimeter, as if they had walked a circle about it countless times… yet simply one day, stopped. I took one of the spheres for study. 

Tomorrow, Rolfe – if he will come, fear is continually evident on his face – and I will press on into the temple proper.

-Grenville
grenville_body_02_03:
The statues within the temple were strange, indeed, yet were clearly of the culture that came before… yet the likeness was peculiar, each statue bearing a twin pair of arms, and cleft down the middle much like the spheres great and small. A division of the self, a representation of duality, perhaps? In one of the statue's hands was a weapon, the other a familiar orb, outstretched – perhaps it was a religious symbol. Or something to channel other forces perhaps?

I found another skeleton, intact, but with a spear and armor, unlike the ones on the perimeter outside. A leader or ruler, perhaps? It had not been buried, it seemed more a guard of the stone coffer within the temple.

-G
grenville_body_02_04:
We could not move the great stone from the coffer, so I continued my examination of the statues. 

Rolfe urged me to make haste, but night came swiftly upon us… as we sought to leave, we saw shapes in the darkness, white light among the trees, humans but drifting across the ground. Rolfe said we must not leave… the temple might be dangerous, but what wandered in the dark outside was far more dangerous. 

And so we waited the night, neither of us sleeping – just when we thought the night had become safe and still, another ghostlit figure would float from beyond the trees, as if reminding us they were never far and they would never leave as long as night was upon the temple.

May we make it through the night, we will leave this place, head to the great obelisks to the West, perhaps. The skeletons around the perimeter and inside the temple – I should have heeded the warning. At least they have not arisen as the wraiths have, they remain still at their posts, else these would be my last words.

-G
grenville_subtitle_02_04: Spectres of the past or omens of the future? Both, perhaps.

guardcaptain_00_init_a: Everyone in this town has lost their minds. What could be more important than an army pressing down from the north?
guardcaptain_00_init_b: Do not get me started on the squabbles of the Factions. Short sighted fools, all of them!
guardcaptain_01a_tasktopic_msqrumors_a: Eh, eh, eh… if you've come to grease my palms about a permit, demand my aid in a petty squabble, or accuse me of some insane crime, then move along.
guardcaptain_01a_tasktopic_msqrumors_b: I am afraid I am VERY busy today.
guardcaptain_02_comment_rumors: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Keep your nose out of trouble, traveler. I<g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" /> do not need another problem on my plate.
guardcaptain_02_tasktopic_adiana_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />I know a nose sniffing for information when I see one. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I have certainly lived here long enough.
guardcaptain_02_tasktopic_adiana_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, get on with it then. <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />What do you want to know about?
guardcaptain_02a_offer_factionvector_a: Ah, the old man Yonas, right? Yes, he passes through often, always raving about Corruption.
guardcaptain_02a_offer_factionvector_b: He lives outside the walls, in a cabin to the east. Be careful if you're headed that way, or at least don't say I didn't warn you.
guardcaptain_03_comment_adiana_a: <g id="female_nodding" />Good luck in your search. Though I do warn you - <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />there have been Corrupted seen in the north.
guardcaptain_03_comment_adiana_b: <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />If you see any of those red-eyed monsters, I'd suggest steering clear.
guardcaptain_05_offer_usestaff_a: The fact that you are still standing here suggests there's something you haven't told me.
guardcaptain_05_offer_usestaff_b: If it's about the Corrupted coming, I already know, but these others, they won't understand the danger until it's too late.
guardcaptain_05_offer_usestaff_new: <g id="male_apologize" />Unfortunately, I cannot send soldiers to join you on your mission. <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />Every available guardsman is deployed now in an effort to combat the current crisis.
guardcaptain_06_comment_usestaff_a: <g id="male_shakehead" /> I would not have believed it, if it had not happened so soon after your departure.
guardcaptain_06_comment_usestaff_b: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />We have new cause for hope in you, my friend, and I am now spreading the word.
guardcaptain_taskconversation_playfortow: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />I overheard a melody floating on the wind. <g id="male_quidproquo" />I confess, I am not much for the arts myself. My hands can do little more than bear a weapon, but I can appreciate mastery when I hear it.
<g id="male_convince01" />Will you play it again for me?
guardcaptain_tasktopic_playfortown_a: <g id="male_applaud" />It is even more stirring with you before me.
guardcaptain_tasktopic_playfortown_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Where did you come by this song? Did you compose it?
guardcaptain_tasktopic_playfortown_respo: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />They must be prolific indeed, if their work can stand out so in a city like ours.
<g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Constable Maecia will want to hear this.<g id="male_explain" /> She takes delight in introducing rising talent to the gentry. Many consider it a favor.

house_housingitem_alchemist_cabinet_a_de: Lots of space to place all kinds of things, it doesn’t always have to be books.
house_housingitem_alchemist_cabinet_c_de: A low-slung cabinet of drawers, for keeping your heaviest treasures.
house_housingitem_appr_winecask_indoor_d: The flavor profile of wine aged in Aeternian oak barrels has been described by connoisseurs as "demented".
house_housingitem_basket_a_description: Ideal for holding fruit, laundry, or decorative wooden orbs.
house_housingitem_bed_bunk_t2_descriptio: What is better than one bed? Two beds. One on top of the other!
house_housingitem_bed_cot_t1_a_descripti: A simple cot made of straw and skins. Perfectly comfortable, if you don't mind the occasional stab from a prickly piece of grass.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed01_a_de: Every morning, you'll wake from sleep, see this bed, and remember instantly that you've made it in life.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed01_b_de: The red silk sheets will draw joy, luck, and happiness to your home.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed01_c_de: The mix of cool teal silks and warm red woods has an interesting affect in making you feel both alert, yet relaxed.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed01_d_de: A bed extravagantly carved from one block of pure jade. Jade is said to represent good health and long life…in bed.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed02_a_de: The rich warm hue of the silk cushions will give you the energy you need to curl up and finish that novel you're reading.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed02_b_de: The contrast between the red silk and the black wood is especially striking.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed02_c_de: Such a tranquil color. What a perfect place for a nap.
house_housingitem_bed_dynasty_bed02_d_de: The craftsmanship is exquisite, even if the carved jade is a bit cold on your back.
house_housingitem_bed_holidayconv2021_be: A bed of hard ice and soft snow. Perfect for those who overheat in their sleep.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed01_a_des: Sleep a sleep as sweet as honey on this sun-kissed bed with blushing fabric. For even a warrior can have a soft side.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed01_b_des: This soothing blue bedding is optimal for lounging after a long day of smelting and blacksmithing.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed01_c_des: A luxurious place to rest one's feet and escape the administrative toils of Aeternum.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed01_d_des: Tired from a hard day of gathering? This will offer you the ultimate reprieve; almost like napping in a meadow.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed02_a_des: To show that even in sleep you rank the highest among all.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed02_b_des: Craftsmen are the backbone to society, and this bed keeps your backbone comfortable and aligned.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed02_c_des: Purple is usually the color of nobility, and you will feel royal as can be cozied up on this bed.
house_housingitem_bed_legion_bed02_d_des: Bedding the colors of a bright summer day. Careful not to fall off the side!
house_housingitem_bed_pirate_bed01_a_des: Blue, like the endless ocean. Velvet, like your singing voice.
house_housingitem_bed_pirate_bed01_b_des: This is the bed a mermaid queen would sleep in, if mermaids ever slept.
house_housingitem_bed_pirate_bed01_c_des: A red velvet bed, the color of battle. Classic pirate king vibes.
house_housingitem_bed_pirate_bed01_d_des: Sometimes you lie awake at night, thinking about death, but in a way that makes you seem sensitive and interesting to others.
house_housingitem_bed_pirate_bed02_a_des: Perfect to relax in. Too bad it is way too easy to fall out of. Better not risk it.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed01_a_de: An ash wood bunk bed crafted by artisan hands. Curl up on the blue comfy comforter and sleep in as late as you like.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed01_b_de: There's no moping in this maple wood bunk bed. The warm, red blankets lifts your spirits all the way to dream land.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed01_c_de: An oak wood bunk bed built for two. (Except no one ever takes the top bunk.) So go solo and sleep easy on bright green sheets.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed01_d_de: Dark mahogany wood. Bright yellow cloth. Bountiful binary bedding. A doubly delightful contrast sure to make anyone rest easy.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed02_a_de: Blue sheets and ash wood makes up this simple yet comfortable bed. However this bed isn't really full until you are napping in it.
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed02_b_de: This maple wood bed was made with love. (Hence the red sheets.) But it wasn't made for lovin'. Only sleeping. One person at a time!
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed02_c_de: The green sheets might look inviting, like bouncy spring grass. But don't be fooled. This oak bed not for jumping. It's for... other stuff...
house_housingitem_bed_settler_bed02_d_de: I couldn't possibly sleep in this bed. The yellow sheets are just so bright and happy. The mahogany wood too deep and dark. The mattress... too... soft... zzzZZZzz....
house_housingitem_bed_settler_decor_floo: Your loyal companion deserves nothing less than the best in straw-based bedding.
house_housingitem_bed_single_t2_descript: Classic. Wooden. Only semi-comfortable. But it will do for a quick nap.

house_housingitem_cairn_d_description: Several dark stones stacked to make an artful tower. Looking at it makes you feel like you accomplished something.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_chair01_: The curves of this chair are both architectural and ergonomical.
A chair like this almost makes you regret your immortality, just so you could have passed it down to your children.
The hue of the wood is so rich and warm, it's almost a shame to cover it up with your butt.
Sitting in this luminous jade chair is said to open several chakras at once.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_chair02_: The slim legs of this chair are much sturdier than they look.
This antique chair was crafted centuries ago, in a legendary imperial workshop.
The abalone seat of this chair has a strange, beautiful luminosity.
The combination of jade and abalone will keep you cool on even the hottest summer days.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_stool_a_: For a stool, this piece offers a surprising amount of lounging space.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_stool_b_: Rub a bit of walnut oil into this well-loved antique to bring out its original shine.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_stool_c_: Sitting on this rich red stool will force you to improve your posture.
house_housingitem_chair_dynasty_stool_d_: Sitting on this stool feels like sitting at the bottom of a tranquil, sun-dappled pond.
house_housingitem_chair_finechair_a_desc: This chair looks like it might be on its last leg. And you might be too if you hazard to sit in it.
house_housingitem_chair_finechair_b_desc: Perfect for stepping on to reach high places, then falling off and breaking your neck.
house_housingitem_chair_holidayconv2021_: A chair carved from a single block of ice. Try not to sit on it with bare thighs lest you freeze right to the seat.
house_housingitem_chair_holidayturkey202: One of Turkulon's giant eggs. They usually explode, but this one was a dud. But if you were to sit on it long enough, would it hatch?
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair01_a: Everyone should know their place, and you know yours is in a comfortable armchair. Take a seat. You deserve it.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair01_b: Light wood and a yellow pillow to brighten any room. A welcome contrast to the workshops and crafting stalls.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair01_c: An entirely new echelon of opulence awaits you on this armchair. Careful not to get too comfortable while doing paperwork.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair01_d: The earth tones of this armchair let the mind wander to matters of nature.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair02_a: Like territories fought and won, claim your rightful place at the head of the dining table.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair02_b: Pull this chair out from the table to present to a special guest.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair02_c: First among equals? Maybe, but we all know who gets the best seat.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_chair02_d: Recline as you eat, for there is no greater joy than good rest and good food.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_stool_a_d: Fight like a warrior, sit like a conqueror.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_stool_b_d: Don't just put yourself on any old pedestal, put yourself on this one.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_stool_c_d: This gilded stool is stuffed with the feathers of a now-extinct goose. A seat of exquisite quality to match your intellect.
house_housingitem_chair_legion_stool_d_d: Seat oneself with fellowship and break bread together.
house_housingitem_chair_lg_a_description: A simple wooden chair you used to see in schools or libraries. Is it comfortable? No idea.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair01_a: Sit back. Relax. It's good to be the Captain.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair01_b: The soothing color will help keep you calm while making life-or-death decisions.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair01_c: A chair fit for a king. Stolen from a king, in fact.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair01_d: You've read that both purple and velvet are signs of royalty, making this chair twice as majestic.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair02_a: The decorative turned legs can be used as impromptu weapons in a pinch.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair02_b: Made with the bronzed skull of the last person to correct your table manners.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair02_c: Mark your spot at the head of the table with this sumptuous gilded chair.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_chair02_d: This chair is the color of the darkened sky before a hurricane.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_stool_a_d: You can feel the tension drain out of your aching bones as soon as you sit down on the plush velvet.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_stool_b_d: The pale light green of this stool makes you feel like you are practically floating the moment you place your tuchus on it.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_stool_c_d: This red velvet ottoman is so soft and cushy. The gilded feet add an extra dash of panache.
house_housingitem_chair_pirate_stool_d_d: A stool this comfortable almost feels wrong. Almost.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_chair01_: The rugged elegance of this chair elevates any home's style from 'rustic' to 'rustic chic'.
This maple dining chair is warm and inviting, just like you. The iron back supports make it strong enough to support even the weariest back.
This mighty oak chair is bound in iron, for a sitting experience that's as strong as you are.
Nothing like rocking out at the dinner table in this mahogany dining chair.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_chair02_: Though it looks somewhat rickety, the ash wood in this chair makes it strong and flexible.
The resonant maple wood in this beautiful chair will inspire any musician who sits in it.
Strong, stately, and surprisingly comfortable. You can see yourself dictating your memoirs from this chair.
This beautifully crafted mahogany rocking chair is not only elegant, it also has great lumbar support.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_stool_a_: This ash barstool will support you through the good times and the bad.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_stool_b_: Many a festive night has passed in bars across Aeternum, shared by people sitting on stools like this. It'll be a big hit at your housewarming party.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_stool_c_: They say the greatest ruler in Aeternum's history refused his golden throne, preferring instead to sit on a simple oak stool just like this one.
house_housingitem_chair_settler_stool_d_: The dark, lustrous wood of this mahogany stool would pair wonderfully with a bold rug.
house_housingitem_chair_stoolb_t2_descri: Just a simple log. Literally the least amount of work put into crafting a stool in the history of wood.
house_housingitem_cloth_tapestry_a_descr: Cleverly repurposed from the debris of one of Aeternum's many, many shipwrecks.
house_housingitem_cloth_tapestry_b_descr: Simple lengths you can string up on your wall or window. Your neighbors will never know that these used to be your bedsheets.
house_housingitem_cloth_tapestry_c_descr: A simple curtain tied back with a length of rope. The effect is surprisingly charming.
house_housingitem_cookware_cup_a_descrip: Completely safe to drink from. I swear!
house_housingitem_cookware_frypan_a_desc: A cast iron pan. Grandmas everywhere love them. They don't make 'em like they used to.
house_housingitem_dec_branch_element_a_d: Look at the pattern. Now look away. Now look back - have the twigs shifted position?
house_housingitem_decor_wreath_a_descrip: This little guy will guard your door. Any would-be burglar will run for their lives upon seeing it.
house_housingitem_decor_wreath_c_descrip: The geometry of this twig wreath is pleasing to the eye.
house_housingitem_decor_wreath_d_descrip: Aeternians have been weaving these traditional winter decorations for as long as anyone can remember.
house_housingitem_decor_wreath_garlic_de: Vampire proof. And strangely, also keeps your friends from visiting. Is it because of the stench, or are they vampires?
house_housingitem_demijohn_b_description: Just the thing you needed for your pennies. Before long, it is going to be impossible to lift.
house_housingitem_demijohn_d_description: This bottle will go perfectly with the shiplap you just installed.
house_housingitem_demijohn_wicker_a_desc: Aeternum has adopted the European tradition of wrapping glass bottles in wicker to prevent breakage and spoilage.
house_housingitem_demijohn_wicker_b_desc: The contents of this basket-wrapped jug are a complete mystery.
house_housingitem_dynasty_armoire01_a_de: Keep your wits sharp by trying to remember what you put in all these drawers.
house_housingitem_dynasty_armoire01_b_de: In addition to all the normal drawers, this armoire also contains at least one secret drawer.
house_housingitem_dynasty_armoire01_c_de: With this fine cabinet in your house, don't be surprised if your neighbors start coming to you for medical advice.
house_housingitem_dynasty_armoire01_d_de: Ingredients kept in these jade drawers somehow stay fresh longer.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase01_a_d: The brass hardware on this antique bookcase is still in incredible condition.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase01_b_d: This multi-level case is perfect for displaying all your curiosities.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase01_c_d: True interior design is not about the things you put on the shelves, but about the space you leave between them.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase01_d_d: No need to buy fancy first editions. You could put any book on this shelf, and it would still look stunning.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase02_a_d: Each shelf has a handy railing so your books won't fall off the back.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase02_b_d: This bookcase was made before books were even invented.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase02_c_d: Books with upsetting covers can go in the drawers.
house_housingitem_dynasty_bookcase02_d_d: You'll retain 10% more information from books stored in a jade bookcase.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet01_a_de: This beautiful teak chest is equally good at storing silks and snacks.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet01_b_de: If you put your ear to this chest, you might hear the echoes of many years of domestic bliss.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet01_c_de: The dragons painted on the doors of this chest will protect its contents from the outside world.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet01_d_de: The artist developed a special type of paint that adheres to jade without damaging it.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet02_a_de: Finally, a convenient way to organize all those weapons you've got lying around.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet02_b_de: For extra peace of mind, keep this handy weapon rack right next to your bed.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet02_c_de: This beautiful weapon rack comes with a scratch-resistant varnish. Protects the wood, and your weapons.
house_housingitem_dynasty_cabinet02_d_de: Are those the ancient spears of legend? They must be, to earn a place on this incredible weapon rack.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_ceiling_: These bowls dry super fast when you suspend them from the ceiling.
This multi-tier planter is perfect for growing herbs and spices.
The shoots and cuttings in these planters will grow big and strong under your care.
You've found that the drainage offered by this suspended shelf is perfect for your treasured bonsai.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_claybarr: The cheerful green color seems to keep the contents fresher.
The cork stopper makes this pot useful for long-term storage.
This jar is tough enough to stand up to daily use. Usually filled with wine, beer, or oil.
Sealed on top to prevent spillage and evaporation.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_floor_pl: These bamboo shoots are growing so well, they'll soon need a bigger planter.
Which is more exquisite, the bamboo or the vase? Ah, that's a philosophical question.
A no-nonsense clay pot, to store your no-nonsense bamboo poles.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_floor_we: This is the armory rack of a person who has had many, many adventures.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_smallvas: The gemstone luster of this planter is so beautiful, it doesn't even need a plant.
This exquisite planter features a crimson overglaze with a design stenciled in silver leaf, in the traditional style.
The pattern on this planter is reminiscent of luxurious brocade cloth.
The subtle shine of the gold foil on the cream-colored background invites a longer look.
This vibrant blue pigment is hard to source these days. This planter is truly something special.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_di: A wok is an incredibly versatile piece of cookware. You can make almost anything in it.
These delicate dishes will be even more beautiful when they're clean.
These bamboo baskets will serve up plump, glistening, perfectly-steamed dumplings.
Graciously host an afternoon tea party, or a midnight cake party. Anytime is the right time with this refined tea set.
A traditional tea ceremony is a chance to unwind, savor the moment, and contemplate the beautiful transience of life.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_fi: Feel free to admire, but watch out; this feisty goldfish loves to splash anyone who comes in range.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_fl: The fruits of the fall harvest will keep your spirits up during the long, cold Aeternian winter.
A good flower arrangement invokes surprise and delight. This contrast of the maidenhair and baby's breath is a prime example.
Both the aster and artemesia flowers are named after ancient goddesses.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_pl: A beautiful place setting increases anticipation for the coming meal.
In Aeternum, the soup is usually served after the main course.
This dyed bamboo placemat is richly colored and easy to clean.
Invokes the quiet beauty of an imperial garden at your dinner table.
How exquisite. You must take excellent care of this tiny tree. Now where are your tiny tools?
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_st: Practice your fanciest handwriting with this brush set. There is even a book with examples of all the letters in several styles.
With this handy drip-dry brush rack, you'll always have a fresh brush ready to go.
Letter-writing Set with Brush Drying Rack
With this beautiful brush set with matching case, you, too, can succeed in the world of business.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_table_te: Serve up a moment of tranquility for yourself and your three closest friends.
house_housingitem_dynasty_decor_tallvase: This precious vase has changed hands many times over the centuries. Now, those hands are yours. Pay no attention to the rumors that it's cursed.

house_housingitem_hangingsackssm_b_descr: What's in this sack? Potatoes? Beans? Diamonds?... Might be diamonds.

Mid-leap, and adorned with snow, this ice sculpture adds a dynamic factor to any room.

house_housingitem_holidayspring2023_bann: No matter the seasons, this flower will be there for you.

Unlike those terrible wasps, the bee's these flowers attract are rather pleasant.
house_housingitem_holidayspring2023_pigm: These festive colors are sure to get everywhere, and remind you of spring months from now when you least expect it.
house_housingitem_holidayspring2023_pinw: Rachel thinks this is just the best.
house_housingitem_holidayspring2023_wisp: Watch out for the Wispy Wasps!

house_housingitem_holidaysummer2022_fire: Nothing says “summer in Aeternum” like a good ol’ fish grill. Fish included!

A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Fish Headed Hammer you pulled up during the Summer Medleyfaire. It's got little eyes and fins and everything.
Fish Headed Hammer - Large Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Mackerel you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. A fish so oily, it's a wonder it didn't slip right off the hook.
Mackerel - Small Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Madtom you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. Too toxic to eat, but makes for interesting taxidermy.
Madtom - Small Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Mandje Mandje you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. The varying colors looks almost like a rainbow.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from an Egede Serpe you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. The red and white stripes remind you of candy canes. But it doesn't taste like that at all!
Egede Serpe - Medium Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from an Oar you pulled up during the Summer Medleyfaire. Decent for whacking people in a pinch.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Varanus Mandje you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. It likes to drag its tusks through the sediment to force out small prey.
Varanus Mandje - Medium Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Paddlefish you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. Its paddlin' days are over, but its modeling career has only just begun.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from an Oyster you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. You decided to keep the pearl in the oyster, if only to show it off.
Oyster - Small Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Pike you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. A fish that will eat almost anything that moves. Too bad its last meal was your lure.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Sculpin you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. It was a slow and delicate process making this and not getting stabbed.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from some Seaweed you pulled up during the Summer Medleyfaire. Not your typical house-plant.
Seaweed - Small Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Glowing Guardfish you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. Based on how it looks, it isn't clear if this actually a fish or a crustacean. Maybe both?
Glowing Guardfish - Medium Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from an Aquatic Snail you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. Preserving the shell was easy. Posing and preserving the snail part though…

A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Snapper you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. With its expression, name, and how red it is, you worry it will start yelling at you at any moment.
Snapper - Small Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Soggy Boot you pulled up during the Summer Medleyfaire. Whenever people look at this, they will wonder what ever happened to the other boot.

A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Speartooth Shark you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. The name is misleading. This shark has more than one tooth.

Squid - Medium Memento
A commemorative trophy you crafted from a Starfish you caught during the Summer Medleyfaire. The most popular of all the marine invertebrates.

house_housingitem_holidaysummer2022_wind: A charming fish windsock that swims in the air both inside or outside your home, no matter which way the wind blows, or even if it blows at all.
house_housingitem_hw_dishcluster_a_descr: They might be messy, but at least they're clean.
house_housingitem_hw_placesetting_descri: A well-worn place setting that has held years of delicious meals.
house_housingitem_legion_armoire01_a_des: For holding the fine linen that you use when hosting guests.
house_housingitem_legion_armoire01_b_des: What could possibly be hidden within? Towels and clothes most likely.
house_housingitem_legion_armoire01_c_des: Keep your secrets and your armoire locked up tight.
house_housingitem_legion_armoire01_d_des: If no one can see inside your armoire, no one can judge your fashion sense.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase01_a_de: It could hold books well enough, but your spoils of war would look even better on these shelves.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase01_b_de: Should you display your prized tools? Or your highest quality craftmanship? Decisions, decisions…
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase01_c_de: Someone as busy as you are needs to stay organized, and do it with style.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase01_d_de: Many a shelf to display whatever you please. Perhaps that rock collection you've been meaning to start.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase02_a_de: Finally, somewhere to put your memoirs.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase02_b_de: Shelves for you to store both Mediterranean recipe books and philosophy tomes.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase02_c_de: A place for grimoires, books of shadows, and all manner of forbidden rites.
house_housingitem_legion_bookcase02_d_de: Can contain books or adventuring tchotchkes, your preference.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet01_a_des: Eros: Love of Passion, for partners and marriage.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet01_b_des: Philia: Love of Friends, respecting equals and comrades.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet01_c_des: Agape: Love of Humankind, as perfect as a deity's love for humanity.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet01_d_des: Storge: Love of Children, caring for the young and dependent.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet02_a_des: It is not polite to rifle through a stranger's drawers, but houses on Aeternum are open to all…
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet02_b_des: Grandmothers are known to keep coin in these.
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet02_c_des: What in Aeternum would be important enough to store here?
house_housingitem_legion_cabinet02_d_des: For the storage of underthings and love letters.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_acorn01_a: Pine cones were considered fertility charms in ancient times. And a pine cone made of metal should be extra potent.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_brazier01: The coals glow lightly a top this well used brazier. It doesn't light up a room, but it will keep you warm.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_ceilingpl: The best kind of cactus is one seen but not touched. And that is made all the easier when it is well out of reach.
An important part of the ecosystem, this type of cactus can provide food and shelter for many species of birds.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_column01_: A stocky style of column from ancient Greece. Doric style Is usually rather plain, but not this one! This one is extra fancy with gold trimmings.
Many cultures of the Mediterranean loved the design of fluted columns, with each claiming to be the inventor of the style.
An ancient Greek column styled with curling scroll-like patterns. Perfect for displaying things to do with literature or writing.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_deskscrol: There is a lot of paper work to do in an empire. Too much, in fact.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_displaybo: A simple stone block with golden details. Can be used as a coffee table or display platform for your favorite decorations.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_divider01: It won't give you any privacy, but it will divide an area well enough.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_floorbin0: This species of cactus can grow to be huge. Taller than some houses! But this one is just a baby.
It can take up to 40 years for an agave plant to bloom, and it only does it once, so you are luck to see this!
house_housingitem_legion_decor_floorplan: This bush would quickly grow into a tree if planted in the ground. But having portable fresh fruit is too convenient to pass up.
This cactus can not only provide prickly protection for your home, but the broad flat pads can be harvested to make meals or medicine with.
Known for their three-pointed stalks, it's worth keeping around for the sweet fruit it can produce, even if you have to deal with the painful spines.
A desert plant known to grow only in a small area of the Americas; it was shipped to Aeternum at the behest of an eccentric collector of exotic desert flora.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_kitchendi: Best not to let the dishes pile up, clean or otherwise.
A lot of work goes into preparing a meal. So does a lot of dishes.
So many items tend to get used when making meals, and even more just to serve them.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_painting0: Adorn your home with the image of the goddess for good harvests. If it doesn't work, at least it is a nice decoration.
Fresco styles is one of most difficult artistic skills to master. And only a true master could create such integrate mirroring patterns.
The eb and flow of time is depicted as repeating waves in this gold painted pattern. It is as if the eye of eternity is watching you.
A painting of a man and woman singing betwixt a floating lyre. Perhaps they are singing about the crazy magical instrument in front of them.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_placesett: Any soldier worth their salt needs a place to eat their fill. An army marches on its stomach, after all.
The blues of the mat are so vibrant, you almost feel like you are eating your meal in the sky.
This smart looking place setting is perfect for smart people. One cannot administrate on an empty stomach.
The vibrant green of the mat and scent of the wooden dishes stimulates your appetite.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_potterywh: Why pay someone else for pottery, when you can make it yourself! The hardest part is starting. And finishing. And everything in-between.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_statuegod: A goddess to inspire you with handicrafts, the arts, and war. Embroidery and murder often overlap.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_statueman: Which Caesar this statue depicts is unclear. There were so many.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_statuewom: The goddess of hearth and home, and one of several sisters of Jupiter. I wonder what book she has. Perhaps a cook book?
house_housingitem_legion_decor_tablepott: Not only is this perennial flower an important food supply for desert dwelling insects, it looks gorgeous in this metal vase.
These clustered red blooms look just like little torches. But please don't light these on fire. The plant would hate that.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_thronegod: The main god of the roman pantheon. Son of Saturn, with several siblings, and lots and lots and lots of children. So many children.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_towelrack: Rome is famous for its baths, so of course you are going to need a towel.
house_housingitem_legion_decor_wall_curt: A teal valance inspired by the type Centurions use in their war camp windows to look after their legion, but with style.
Centurion Valance
Gold valance whose silky threads herald from Lake Como. Only a little scratchy.
Mediterranean Valance
Purple valance that helps you gain influence and wealth. Note: this statement has not been evaluated by the Aeternum Decor Council.
Influential Valance
A green valence that won't protect your home from sand or sun, but it looks nice.
Verdant Valance
A red tapestry that's a replica of one that was won from a Centurion in a battle. One wonders why they had a tapestry on the battleground.
Centurion Tapestry
A blue tapestry of lineage, inspiring respect from all who see it.
Mediterranean Tapestry
A purple tapestry of royal descent that has been missing from the palaces of the Old World for some time now.
Influential Tapestry
A yellow tapestry that won't show all the sand that's likely to collect on it.
Verdant Tapestry
Red curtains that represent the blood spilled in battles with the Corrupted Legion. You can't even see the blood stains!
Centurion Curtains
Covering your windows with these keeps the house nice and cool.
Mediterranean Curtains
Only peasants have bare walls. Your walls will have these extremely lovely purple curtains, so everyone can tell you have money to spare.
Influential Curtains
Proud, vibrate curtains of a stunning yellow color. They both keep out the sand and have a SPF rating of 80.
Verdant Curtains
house_housingitem_legion_decor_wall_inse: With the glory of the sun god adorning your walls, who knows what you can accomplish!
house_housingitem_legion_decor_wallwaves: A gold metal decoration depicting waves in sunlight. When you have these up, you can just go with the flow.
These golden waves flow so elegantly. You can almost imagine the rolling sea on a bright sunny day when gazing at them.
A silver metal decoration depicting waves in moonlight. These would be good to depict ocean waves in a play.
One is reminded of the cool sea ablaze with the light of the moon. And all without the wet and water.
house_housingitem_legion_dresser01_a_des: Perfect for the serving of after-battle drinks.
house_housingitem_legion_dresser01_b_des: Marked with the seal of a famous general, though no one can remember his name.
house_housingitem_legion_dresser01_c_des: Deep within the back of the drawers is a secret compartment. What will you use yours for?
house_housingitem_legion_dresser01_d_des: As green as any plant you may wish to place atop it.
house_housingitem_legion_shelf01_a_descr: For proudly displaying trophies of war.
house_housingitem_legion_shelf01_b_descr: Can be placed high or low on the walls of your home for showing off items.
house_housingitem_legion_shelf01_c_descr: Show the world that you have taste and that you know how to flaunt it.
house_housingitem_legion_shelf01_d_descr: The perfect place for all those important letters from the Magistrate you're not responding to.
house_housingitem_legion_stove01_a_descr: Be sure to oil your pans before use unless you want the food sticking to the bottom and burning.
house_housingitem_legion_stove01_b_descr: These clay pots were made by the finest of artisans, and do well for preparing a fine meal after a hard day's work.
house_housingitem_legion_stove01_c_descr: A stove capable of cooking for a whole household of guests at your weekly company meetings.
house_housingitem_legion_stove01_d_descr: Happiness is the smell of fresh rations after a long day of adventuring.
house_housingitem_lighting_candle_bunch_: These candles were just friends, at first, but they got too close. Now they are fused together into a super candle.
house_housingitem_lighting_candleholder_: Three tall candles, burning bright, keeping back the endless night.
house_housingitem_lighting_dynasty_light: The light from this lucky lantern is said to scare away hungry monsters that lurk in the darkness.
Four-tasseled Hanging Lantern
This majestic eight-tasseled hanging lantern was once reserved for use only in the imperial palace.
Eight-tasseled Hanging Lantern
The warm yellow glow of this iron lantern makes you feel safe, like someone is watching over you.
Temple Hanging Lantern
Every day is a party with this red paper lantern. There are no exceptions.
Festival Hanging Lantern
If you die out in the wilderness, this cheerful lantern will light a safe path for your soul to return.
Cutout Standing Lantern
Its unique round design allows it to shed its light equally in all directions.
Round Standing Lantern
This brass lantern is a microcosm of a universe in harmony.
Temple Standing Lantern
For some reason, the oil in this elaborate iron lantern seems to last twice as long as it should.
Chrysanthemum Standing Lantern
This red triple lantern provides three times the protection against evil spirits.
Festival Wall-mounted Lantern
With iron banding and a waterproof, fireproof coating, this lantern could withstand a hurricane.
Iron-bound Wall-mounted Lantern
The simplicity of this paper lantern means that nothing will come between you and the light.
Simple Wall-mounted Lantern
There's no need to fear the dark, even if you're short on table space.
Temple Wall-mounted Lantern
house_housingitem_lighting_holidayconv20: The icicles hanging from this chandelier never seem to melt, even with the bright lights within the lanterns.
Despite the thick ice and snow, the cooling blue light within the lantern still shines unimpeded.
house_housingitem_lighting_holidayspring: The layered design of this lantern casts rings of light below that twirl in a breeze.
This glowing lantern is fortunately not a real jellyfish and can sting no one. Although it could still drop on you.
house_housingitem_lighting_holidaysummer: A colorful paper lantern that floats and spins in the air. Hopefully it won't float away.
This lantern is so life-like. You could almost swear that fish was the real deal. Though, how did they get it to glow like that?
A crude spotlight made from barrels and glass. Light up the night sky with cool blue lights of fishing waters.
A spotlight cobbled together from spare wood. The glass and mirror lights the sky with the orange fires of the summer sun.
Festive torches made of reed and bamboo. A popular light source during the Summer Medley holiday.
house_housingitem_lighting_lantern_c_des: This lantern glows with love. But don't touch it. Its love could burn.
house_housingitem_lighting_lantern_ceili: A simple lantern hanging from above, shining light into the highest nooks and crannies.
house_housingitem_lighting_legion_lightc: See the whites of your enemy's eyes by illuminating your rooms with this bright fixture.
Don't forget to fill up the oil every so often if you want these at their brightest.
Show off the latest in lighting technology and everyone will know what a futurist you are.
Never trip over your furniture in the dark again! (Unless you forget to replace the wicks.)
house_housingitem_lighting_legion_lightf: Is this the one you're supposed to rub three times? How shiny does it need to get before you get some wishes?
Comes with a handy pull-chain to quickly extinguish or ignite the oil.
Bring the blue flames of the Ancient Guardians to the comfort of your home. After all, someone of your stature deserves it.
A special copper powder mixed in the oil burns green, and makes for an amusing conversation starter with this lamp.
house_housingitem_lighting_legion_lightt: Fits perfectly on a bedside table and quick to light when it is your shift for the night watch.
The dark copper is striking. Be careful and try not to burn your fingers when lighting this lamp.
Holds a special oil that burns a bright blue flame. Perfect to set the mood for administrative work.
Flickers of bright green flame is reminiscent of fields of green grass blowing in the wind.
house_housingitem_lighting_legion_lightw: Maker not responsible for ceiling burns if you place it too high on the wall.
Red is the color of passion, and this flame is as wild and free as your most passionate dreams.
They mix azoth with the coals so the blue flames really strands out. It shows you have money to burn. Literally.
The light shifts from yellow to green, but lights up your room all the same.
house_housingitem_lighting_pirate_decor_: Something very dark and very bright at the same time.
house_housingitem_lighting_pirate_lightc: This wheel once guided a mighty ship. Now, it'll help guide you through the dark.
After a long, hard life at sea, this ship's wheel is exploring other career options.
Salvaged from a shipwreck and expertly restored by a master craftsman.
This wheel once belonged to the ship of the best-dressed pirate crew in the South Seas.
house_housingitem_lighting_pirate_lightt: Miraculously untarnished despite decades spent underwater.
The patina on this well-preserved candelabra gives away its immense age.
A body washed up onshore with this solid gold candelabra strapped to its back. Unfortunately, it did not make a good flotation device.
This candelabra was recovered from a French shipwreck. Its exquisite detail was revealed once the barnacles were scrubbed off.
house_housingitem_lighting_pirate_lightw: The craze for Quicksilver lamps lasted only a few years. This late-model silver lamp was sold at a deep discount, as most pirates had moved on to the next big thing.
Captain Quicksilver's Lamp sparked a craze, and replicas like this one soon became the most-requested item in the furniture workshops of Tortuga.
Soon, anyone who was anyone in the pirating world had to have a Quicksilver lamp. This solid gold example was the subject of one fierce bidding war and two subsequent assassinations.
The final request of infamous pirate James 'Quicksilver' Forten was that his skull be turned into a wall lamp.
The clever use of reflection produces twice the light.
Young pirates who use this nightlight no longer fear the dark. There are so many other things to fear instead.
house_housingitem_lighting_settler_light: Made with extra bright-burning tallow candles, this chandelier is the perfect mix of utility and ambiance.
Warm Iron Chandelier - Bright
The light from this chandelier is universally flattering, and will make you even more good-looking than you already are.
Warm Iron Chandelier - Dim
The cool tones of this chandelier's light are intended to mimic daylight, to help get you through those long Aeternian winters.
Cool Iron Chandelier - Bright

house_housingitem_lighting_torch_wall_de: This wooden torch is blazing with glorious fire. Let's hope your house doesn't want to feel the same way.
house_housingitem_milkjug_description: An old iron jug, usually used for milk. But if you wanted to, you could put all sorts of things in this.
house_housingitem_oldbookgroup_b_descrip: These books are your all-time favorites, and deserve a place of special honor.
house_housingitem_oldbookgroup_e_descrip: You haven't had time to put these books back on the shelf. Perhaps you're too busy reading.
house_housingitem_oldbookgroup_f_descrip: These books are in remarkably good condition, considering the sorry state of the ship they came from.
house_housingitem_paper_flat_a_descripti: You don't remember writing this, but it's your handwriting. And it contains all your deepest fears and darkest secrets.
house_housingitem_paper_flat_c_descripti: Waterstained and nearly illegible. That's all right; you committed the words to heart long ago.
house_housingitem_paper_flatthin_a_descr: You can already cross off the first entry: "Make a to-do list". You're so productive!
house_housingitem_paper_flatthin_b_descr: Looks like some notes about geometry… But not any kind of geometry you've ever seen.
house_housingitem_paper_seal_a_descripti: A note left from your roommate telling you to put your clothes away. Wait, don't you live alone?
house_housingitem_paper_seal_e_descripti: Look at all these tickets! You need to remember to move your cart on street sweeper day.
house_housingitem_paperparcels_c_descrip: What could be inside? Some ancient instinct is warning you not to open it.
house_housingitem_paperparcels_d_descrip: A stack of very important papers, for the attention of a very important person - you.
house_housingitem_pet_armadillo_brown_de: A tamed armadillo from the harsh deserts of Brimstone. This big baby really loves belly scratches.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_bird_p: A mythical bird of death and rebirth. Its glorious plumage emits heat and fire, but it will not burn the ones it trusts if they were to pet it.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_cat_pr: This midnight prowler regards you with eerily intelligent eyes, almost like those of a... a human's.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_cat_wi: This snowy furred feline is purrfectly happy loafing by the fire, or chilling in the snow. In either case, they adore pets from you.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_deer_r: Complete with his own purple scarf to keep warm to threat of Forever Winter. He loves to be pet on his warm, red nose.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_ghost_: A canine so faithful they don't require a physical form to be there for you. Plus, no allergies or shedding!
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_mastif: A faithful companion to lounge by the fire with you. Who doesn't love a dog in a hat! (Hint: Nobody!)
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_pig_fo: Who is that mysterious swine, and why does it look so dapper? Is it filthy rich?
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_rabbit: Brimming with awe, the vast expanse of the universe resides within the fur of this rabbit. And if you pet them, you might just feel it too.
This hare loves to wear his springtime attire.
This rabbit isn't really a toy. It's just wearing a festive jacket, and is extra adorable for it.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_spider: A very friendly and well-trained spider companion. It knows many tricks and is happy to perform them, as long as it remains well fed.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_tiger_: Neither light nor color can escape the deep darkness of its fur. But do you know what can? Love! And this big kitty needs lots of it.
A mystical being that has gifted you with its presence and its protection - and doesn't mind a scratch behind the ears now and again.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_wolf_f: While intimidating and wild, this warm-hearted guardian is loyal and surprisingly cuddly.
house_housingitem_pet_entitlement_wolf_g: An assassins' breed of wolf, cultivated for generations to silently keep pace with their owner, carrying spare weapons and poisons. The only downside is their breath is worse than their bite.
house_housingitem_pet_holiday_babyyeti_w: This fluffy and posh companion adorned in festive garb happily celebrates with you that winter is finally here.
house_housingitem_pet_holiday_pumpklin_o: A tamed pumpklin pup. It loves getting watered so much, it bursts into blooms every time.
house_housingitem_pet_holiday_rabbit_sum: Most rabbits do not care for water, and this one is no exception. But that won't stop it from wearing a super cute bathing suit and lounging in the sunshine.
house_housingitem_pet_holiday_turkey_pil: The true mastermind behind Turkulon, Feathered Avenger of Death. But with his creation defeated, it now begrudgingly lives with you and accepts your pathetic morsels.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_bobcat_bro: Most bobcats would eat your face, but not this one. This one is spoiled and just wants to lounge and get neck scratches.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_deer_brown: Stags tend to shed their antlers every year. Somehow, the next ones always grow bigger than the last.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_doe_brown_: A graceful doe with such a calming precedence. Seeing it curled up so sweetly makes you want to nap in the sunshine.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_mastiff_br: A gentle giant of a dog that loves nothing more than to laze-about by the fire and get some good neck scratches.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_pig_pink_d: A pampered pig you can bring home to idle by your side and give some great belly rubs to.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_puma_brown: This puma is so calm and relaxed, it can be hard to remember that it could rip your throat out in a flash if it really wanted to.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_rabbit_bro: A sweet and gentle rabbit that just wants a little bit of love. Maybe a carrot or two.
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_turkey_bro: This turkey is too sweet to cook for dinner. Dessert however…
house_housingitem_pet_liveops_wolf_brown: Oh my! What sharp teeth this wolf has. But this particular big baby is more likely to lick you than bite you.
house_housingitem_pet_mastiff_descriptio: The grown spawn of the great Barkimedes and a settlement Mastiff; a forbidden romance for the ages.
house_housingitem_pirate_armoire01_a_des: This armoire has the perfect balance of craftsmanship, practicality, and skulls.
house_housingitem_pirate_armoire01_b_des: Every crack in the wood of this armoire tells a story of the high seas.
house_housingitem_pirate_armoire01_c_des: A savvy captain knows: take care of your things, and they'll take care of you.
house_housingitem_pirate_armoire01_d_des: A popular fairytale claims that Bluebeard told his new wife to never, ever, open this armoire.
house_housingitem_pirate_bathtub01_descr: Only the captain is allowed to indulge in that rarest of pirate luxuries - a bath.
house_housingitem_pirate_bedsidetable_a_: Cleverly repurposed from a barrel, this watertight table could serve as a boat for a very small person.
house_housingitem_pirate_bedsidetable_b_: Is that a skull on that shelf? Do you bring a skull to bed? Don't answer that question.
house_housingitem_pirate_bedsidetable_c_: So richly burnished, you can hardly tell it used to be a humble barrel.
house_housingitem_pirate_bedsidetable_d_: The rum in this barrel was aged for twelve years before the barrel found new life as a table. Even now, the sweet smell lingers.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase01_a_de: A good library is a great comfort to a sleepless captain on those long, lonely nights at sea.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase01_b_de: The finish might been washed off this bookcase by the hard salt sea, but it still holds just as much knowledge as ever.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase01_c_de: A pirate must be well-read, if he wishes to move undetected in high society.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase01_d_de: The bookcase once housed the personal library of the child King. He enjoyed books with lots of pictures.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase02_a_de: This multifunctional piece of furniture serves as a bookcase, a writing desk, and a dresser. So practical!
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase02_b_de: The wood is worn, but the brass hardware looks brand new. Was this bookcase deliberately roughed up?
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase02_c_de: Crafted with love in a Parisian workshop, generations ago.
house_housingitem_pirate_bookcase02_d_de: The history behind this antique bookcase would make any museum curator green with envy.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet01_a_des: A safe and stylish place to store your finery.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet01_b_des: The little skull-shaped drawer-pulls on this dresser are surprisingly charming.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet01_c_des: Wow. Even the underside of this dresser is polished to a mirror finish.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet01_d_des: The main thing that separates a good pirate captain from a legendary one is good costume design. This dresser can help with that.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet02_a_des: Look at all those drawers. You'll be able to store all your billowing silk shirts in here.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet02_b_des: You might need a ladder to reach those top drawers. That's where you'll hide the good stuff.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet02_c_des: Even if you've got nothing to wear but rags, you need a nice place to put them.
house_housingitem_pirate_cabinet02_d_des: On windy nights, you can hear the skulls whisper fashion tips to one another. Or was that just a dream?
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_anchor01_: A fond remembrance of a ship blown to bits long ago.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_bonewreat: Despite its realistic appearance, this bone wreath was actually whittled from basswood.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_cagebones: Why deal with shelving when you have a perfectly good ceiling cage to store your extra stuff.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_cannonbal: These cannonballs never saw action in battle.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_chains01_: You never know what kind of thing you might need to hang from your ceiling.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_chains02_: You could use it as a swing, if you have really good balance.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_chains03_: After a life at sea, many pirates can't get to sleep without the soothing rattle of iron chains.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_curtain01: The view out the window can only be enhanced by hanging this blue velvet fabric above it.
Not enough velvet in your house? Here's an easy and fabulous fix.
This red velvet valance gives a sumptuous look to any captain's window.
This velvet valance is much too elegant to be useful.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_curtain02: These curtains have the maximum number of tassels allowed by Aeternian law.
Keeps your cabin warm and cozy on cold nights.
These curtains are so lovely, you won't even want to look out the window.
The captain is the only person on the ship allowed to sleep in. These heavy velvet curtains will block out every trace of early morning sun.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_curtain03: These curtains are somehow both opulent and threadbare at the same time.
No need to draw these curtains. They'll let the daylight through either way.
These curtains might have been the height of luxury...once.
For when there is darkness in your soul, but not too much.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_drinkcrat: A crate of grog bottles. It might not be fancy, but at least there's a lot of it.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_drinkset0: Technically, this canteen is meant to be used for water.
Beer provides vital nutrition and calories to sailors on long voyages. It often contains less than 1% alcohol.
This drinking set is used to imbibe alcohol in moderation, and in accordance with all local laws and statutes.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_globe01_d: You'll never see the world outside Aeternum again. But at least you can look at this globe.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_jewelbox0: When your ship is being pursued by howling ghosts, you can look at this loot and know that it was all worth it.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_lootarran: This beautiful mixed-metal tea set was crafted in one of the finest workshops in Damascus.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_map01_des: This map of Aeternum is beautiful, but unfinished. There's still much left to discover.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_map02_des: A rolled-up map holds infinite possibilities.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_maptools0: Nothing can be more final than a threatening letter to your enemies. Except, perhaps, how your enemies might respond to said letter.
These tools once belonged to the most talented cartographer who ever sailed the Mediterranean Sea.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_oars01_de: Even in the golden age of sailing, sometimes you've got no choice but to row.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_painting0: A melancholy painting in a silver and burlwood frame. The proud captain of this Spanish galleon never got around to getting her portrait painted while she was still in one piece.
A beatific painting in an arched silver frame. To a pirate, there's no sight more beautiful than a port that he had given up hope of ever reaching.
A timeworn painting in an oval frame. After lights out, sailors used to trade whispered stories about ghost ships like the one in this painting.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_placesett: The tranquil color encourages your guests to linger over dessert.
Yes, it's hard to get food stains out of velvet. But this is a matter of style.
You treat your dinner guests with respect, but also gently remind them that you can have them killed at any time.
With this place setting, any meal becomes a kingly feast.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_potsandpa: A sturdy set of iron cookware is worth its weight in stolen gemstones.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_ropes01_d: These ropes are so beautifully rigged, they could bring an old sailor to tears.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_ropes02_d: The fibers of this old fishing net remember the struggle of every fish it ever caught.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_rumcrate0: An ingenious pirate managed to smuggle a whole shipment of fine cognac out of France by disguising it in these humble rum bottles.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_rumjug01_: The very last bottle of this particular vintage left in the world.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_scroll01_: A pirate scholar's treatise on the great Stormwall of Aeternum.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_scroll02_: An old letter of marque - once a free pass to pillage and terrorize, now just a fond memento.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_sign01_de: Seeing this sign outside a tavern door lets you know that you're in for a fun and wholesome time.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_skullhat0: This proud pirate swore he'd rather die than be parted from his beloved hat.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_swords01_: These swords aren't just for show. They're kept meticulously polished and sharpened in case of a dueling emergency.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_telescope: This state-of-the-art brass telescope is a great comfort for former sailors who once used the stars to navigate the open sea.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_waterbarr: Filled with sweet water transported from the fresh glacier brooks of northern Aeternum.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_watertub0: One benefit of being a landlubber: clothes cleaned in fresh water cause way less chafing.
house_housingitem_pirate_decor_weaponarr: A selection of fine weapons, taken off the bodies of adversaries who made the mistake of fighting fair.
These beautiful flintlock pistols have a walnut stock and a top firing rate of three rounds per minute.
house_housingitem_pirate_keg01_descripti: This keg is proof that you throw the best parties in town. The whole crew is invited!
house_housingitem_pirate_shelf01_a_descr: This shelf holds everything a well-stocked galley needs.
house_housingitem_pirate_shelf01_b_descr: You can store your balsamic vinegar on this shelf without worrying about ruining the finish.
house_housingitem_pirate_shelf01_c_descr: This shelf might be a practical piece of furniture, but that doesn't mean it doesn't deserve fancy gold scrollwork.
house_housingitem_pirate_shelf01_d_descr: A cheeky combination of luxury and coziness that's sure to turn heads.
house_housingitem_pirate_sink01_descript: The ingenious copper mechanism atop this sink actually heats the water as you pump it! Incredible!
house_housingitem_pirate_stove01_a_descr: The iron will keep your vittles hot for a long, long time.
house_housingitem_pirate_stove01_b_descr: If copper was good enough for the ancient Romans, it's good enough for you.
house_housingitem_pirate_stove01_c_descr: This stove was a special order from a pirate captain who loved to cook.
house_housingitem_pirate_stove01_d_descr: This stove proves that you have money to burn.
house_housingitem_powderhorn_description: Contains black gunpowder. Keep the lid on, and don't bring it into the kitchen.
house_housingitem_primaldrumsmall_descri: The ancient remains of drums like this one have been unearthed all over Aeternum.
house_housingitem_primalpottery_a_hang_d: Best to keep the inside of that pot up and out of sight. You don't wanna know what's in it…
house_housingitem_pve_arena_dryad01_desc: From death comes new life. Even if this new life is an itty bitty tree.
house_housingitem_pve_arena_siren01_desc: A powerful weapon once that once caused so much devastation, it now adorns the wall of your home.
house_housingitem_pve_arena_spriggan01_d: The severed hand of a defeated Spriggan. Starring at it gives you the urge to high-five it.
house_housingitem_pvp_arena_greataxe01_d: A pair of axes won from combat in the Arena. More suited for chopping limbs than chopping trees.
house_housingitem_pvp_arena_hatchets01_d: Nimble throwing hatchets won from combat in the Arena. Better mounted on the wall than mounted in your head.
house_housingitem_pvp_arena_mntd_sword01: A glistening sword mounted on deep, red wood. It wasn't clean at all when you earned it from combat in the Arena.
house_housingitem_pvp_arena_riches_pile0: One thing is for sure, war and combat can be quite profitable. If you can survive it.
house_housingitem_pvp_arena_swords01_des: Long and sturdy swords hard-fought and won from combat in the Arena. All the chips and dents from combat have been polished away.
house_housingitem_questrewardbw_decor_me: Erstwhile a sweet memento of one's life, now a sour reminder of those lost.
house_housingitem_questrewardgc_lighting: It’s not much but it’s all that’s left. May it serve in their memory.
house_housingitem_roundbirdcage_descript: A cute wicker birdcage. Unfortunately, the bird seems to have flown away.
house_housingitem_rug_bearpelt_descripti: A soft and fuzzy bear rug to warm your bare feet, or to lounge upon seductively. Or both.
house_housingitem_rug_cloth_flat_a_descr: Technically meets the bare minimum requirements of a rug.
house_housingitem_rug_dynasty_decor_floo: This silky-soft rug features a stylized keystone border. Its symmetrical perfection speaks to the mastery of the court artist who wove it.
The sharp contrast of the dark red and the bright silver calls to you in ways you never knew.
Surround this jewel-toned silk rug with neutral colors to draw the viewer's eye.
The pure simplicity of the colors only highlights the pure mastery of the craftsmanship that is the majesty of this rug.
The bright orange of this woven mat always brings a smile to your face. You just can't help it. It's such a happy color.
The deepness of the red is so striking, no one will ever notice you swept all the dust under it.
A traditional woven bamboo design, dyed a surprising blue-green. An easy-to-clean pop of color for your floor.
If you look carefully, you can see the delicate balance of gold and cream colors interwoven perfectly into what appears to be a solid color.
house_housingitem_rug_fishingnet_b_descr: What a creative use for a fishing net. Sweeping dirt under it is pointless, though.
house_housingitem_rug_legion_decor_floor: The geometric shapes on this rug contrast with the sheathes of wheat, symbolizing that armies need both food and weapons to be affective.
This blue is even bluer than Azoth and the yellow the color of fields of grain.
There is no better way to pronounce your wealth than a rug of purple.
Animals love to lay on this as it reminds them of grass.
house_housingitem_rug_pirate_decor_rug01: Often placed in a lady's cabin, because a woman's bare feet touching the wood of the ship was considered bad luck.
house_housingitem_rug_pirate_decor_rug02: The beautiful color is worth the effort it takes to keep it clean.
house_housingitem_rug_pirate_decor_rug03: The rich red color of this rug hides bloodstains extremely well.
house_housingitem_rug_pirate_decor_rug04: Bewitchingly soft on your bare toes.
house_housingitem_rug_settler_decor_floo: A yellow rug shaped like the sun. Make you feel warm and happy just looking at it.
This cheerful green rug feels especially good on bare feet. It reminds you of spring grass.
The bright blue dye used in this rug was made with a mixture of azoth and oak tree bark. The color can't be exactly replicated anywhere else in the world.
This cheery red rug is fully reversible. Unfortunately, the other side is also red.
house_housingitem_scrollbookcase_lg_desc: Full of cubbies for all your paper, vellum, and papyrus. Clay tablets, too, if you're into the classics.
house_housingitem_season1_sprigganflameb: A replica of the flame braziers constructed to help quell the Fury of the Spriggan.
house_housingitem_season1_varangianflag_: A tattered flag of the ruthless Varangians, a chilling omen of their brutal conquests.
house_housingitem_season2_pvp_rewardtrac: Re-enact your favorite memories with this siege weapon replica. Just remember it's only a replica; you're not winning any wars with this.
