Sandwurm Egg of the Long Journey
An Sandwurm Egg encased in an ornate shell. Received from the Season 2 Season Pass.
A grisly and bloodied Sandwurm Egg. Received from completion of the Blood of the Sands Season Narrative.
Sandwurm Egg of Blood and Sand
A distinctly earthy and lush Sandwurm Egg. Received from the Siege of Sulfur World Event.
A beautifully decorated Sandwurm Egg. Received from The Hatchery Trial.
house_housingitem_season4_statue_cyclops: A miniature depiction of Crassus' fierce Cyclops Centurion, Decimus.
A miniature depiction of Crassus' fierce Cyclops Centurion, Lucanus.
house_housingitem_season5_pvp_rewardtrac: A respite fit for a king, or the one who slew him.
A standing testament to both your achievements and prowess.
The throne of an officer of war.
While it may be unfactioned, you'll still have to choose a side.
A collection of trophies from your favorite former foes.
house_housingitem_season7_victoriansausa:
To commemorate a strange event from years past, when Aeternians collectively shared a vision of Big Sausage. On the frame’s back is scrawled this poem:

Solemnly ground, eyes over-glazed,
Enraptured in reverence amidst smoky haze.
A link to such ecstasy is hardly a first
From which to be cured is simply the wurst.
So savor our savior without gristly flaw,
For frankly even one cursed haven’t the gall
To be filled with anything but awe:
Ode to sausage, the greatest brat of all.
house_housingitem_settler_armoire01_a_de: Ash is also known as "firelight" wood, and gives off a wonderful long-burning heat due to its density. Not that you'd ever burn your beautiful ash armoire, of course.
house_housingitem_settler_armoire01_b_de: If you shut yourself into this armoire on a quiet night, you might be able to hear the wood around you resonate with the music of the cosmos.
house_housingitem_settler_armoire01_c_de: An immortal owner needs an immortal place to store their clothes. The oak armoire is sturdy enough to withstand the ravages of both time and small explosions.
house_housingitem_settler_armoire01_d_de: Just because you're a settler doesn't mean you have to settle for less than the best. This mahogany armoire is proof of your exquisite taste.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase01_a_d: The top interior decorator in Aeternum adores the weathered look of this compact ash bookcase, making it a very popular piece.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase01_b_d: There's no finer place to store all your old sea maps and star charts. You won't be needing them here on Aeternum.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase01_c_d: This oak bookcase is perfect for displaying your favorite flowers, for a bright pop of color and a soothing fragrance.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase01_d_d: If you're going to go to the trouble of owning all these impressive books, you may as well display them in this impressive mahogany bookcase.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase02_a_d: No metal fasteners were used in the joinery of this ash bookcase. Its craftsmanship is second to none.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase02_b_d: The same wood that went into this bookcase is also used by luthiers to craft Aeternum's finest musical instruments.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase02_c_d: This bookcase is sturdy enough to hold all your hopes and dreams for the future.
house_housingitem_settler_bookcase02_d_d: This bookcase of gleaming mahogany lends you an air of confidence when you stand in front of it. Try it out!
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet01_a_de: Just imagining all the things you could put in these tiny drawers fills you with a sense of excitement.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet01_b_de: This maple chest of drawers will keep your collection safe and sound. What collection? Any collection!
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet01_c_de: What's inside the drawers isn't important. What really matters is that you did your best.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet01_d_de: This chest has four drawers, one for each of the major accessory groups: capes, half-capes, falconry gloves, and socks.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet02_a_de: Some people claim that clothes kept in this ash wood cabinet will never go out of fashion.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet02_b_de: There is a custom on Aeternum that a young woodsman must use his own two hands to make a cabinet out of the first tree he ever fells.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet02_c_de: You can't just hide your secrets in any old cabinet. There's a saying on Aeternum: 'oak never tells'.
house_housingitem_settler_cabinet02_d_de: The cubbyholes in this mahogany cabinet are the perfect place to store your various medals and commendations.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_desk_clo: Sewing is one of the most practical skills any adventurer can have. No one else is going to mend your pants for you.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_desk_flo: Life on Aeternum can be stressful. Flower arrangement is a healthy way to unwind after a day full of dying.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_desk_pap: You can write about whatever you want with this desk set. It's here to support you and your literary dreams.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_floor_fi: Many a retired adventurer has spent their golden years poking at the fire and thinking of the past.
A bellows for the optimists. A bucket of water for the realists.
What better place to store your precious books than near an open flame?
house_housingitem_settler_decor_floralar: The scent of these cheerful yellow flowers is strongest at solar noon, earning them the nickname 'sunbathers'. On the summer solstice, they can be smelled from up to fifty yards away.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_garden_p: An arrangement of winter blooms. The red berries of the firethorn are said to ease homesickness when eaten. They are a traditional welcoming gift for newcomers to Aeternum.
Delphinium flower cultivation is a popular pastime on Aeternum, and garden competitions can be cutthroat. The plant contains deadly alkaloids, and "accidental" poisonings occur frequently.
A colorful display of aster and wormwood that soothes a tired soul.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_garden_w: A wheelbarrow is a marvelous invention. Now you no longer have to transport manure with your bare hands.
A good garden takes sweat to plant and time to grow. Your trusty wheelbarrow will be with you every step of the way.
When the wind blows from the south, the colorful ribbons and melody reminds you of your childhood. Ring any bells?
It takes a pretty stiff wind to rattle these chunky copper chimes. But when they chime, it is a sound to behold.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_painting: A serene oil painting in an ash wood frame. No one is quite sure how the artist got the bear in this painting to stand still for six hours.
A haunting watercolor painting in a maple wood frame. It is so rich with atmosphere that the viewer can almost feel the chilly mist on their skin.
A painting that captures the essence of an Aeternian sunrise within a fine oak frame. The painter nearly drove herself mad trying to capture the passing of autumn with the coming of winter.
It is hard to tell which is nicer; the oil painting of a scenic river, or the carved and polish mahogany frame it rests within.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_shelf_di: Simple dishes, carved from simple wood, for simple meals. What could be more simple?
A good host always has enough plates to make sure that no one leaves hungry.
Washing the dishes can be a risky proposition when you have to go down to the river to do it. But the mallet does provide some protection.
The wear and tear on these dishes is a testament to countless meals savored to the last bite.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_shelf_po: In the Old World, a good cauldron was often passed down through the generations. Here in Aeternum, nothing gets passed down.
Cooking is a very important survival skill in Aeternum. Anyone who has ever tried to eat raw boar meat will understand why.
You've gained mastery over fire. Prove your dominance by using it to cook a delicious meal.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_table_fl: A sprinkle of lemon juice will keep your flowers looking as fresh as the day you cut them.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_table_ki: You're ready to create a culinary masterpiece. Now all you need is the food.
house_housingitem_settler_decor_table_pl: Is this the aftermath of a meal, or the beforemath? (Beforemath is a common word in Aeternum.)
This tableware is almost too pretty to use, unless you're hungry, and the bright red placemat makes you real hungry for fresh fruit.
You might just lose sight of your meal if you were to have a picnic on the grass, that is, if the ants don't get to it first.
Every meal you eat makes you feel a bit happier, a bit brighter when you use this place setting. I wonder why?
house_housingitem_settler_decor_wall_cur: A thick, blue drape to block the light from a window. Perfect for those who like to sleep until noon.
Cerulean Drape
You won't feel dreary with this delightfully dapper drape. The bright red reminds you of fresh fruit.
Cherry Drape
If you don't want to look out a window at the green rolling hills, you can look at this drape instead, with its green rolling fabric.
Grassy Drape
You can have a bright outlook with this drape, even if you can't look out a window through it.
Sunny Drape
A lovely blue colored fabric hanging loosely. For those who want all the style of a curtain with none of the utility.
Cerulean Valance
Think of this bright red fabric like a window hat. It is pretty, and does very little to keep the light out.
Cherry Valance
Bring the outdoors in with some grassy green fabric. Drapery never looked so good.
Grassy Valance
Add some lovely color with this happy fabric. You can hang it above your windows, your door, your bed. Any wall you like!
Sunny Valance
The sky's the limit with these blue sky drapes. It's the next best thing to being outside.
Cerulean Curtains
Frame your window with style. And nothing says 'style' like these cherry colored drapes. They really make the room pop.
Cherry Curtains
Bring the spirit of the forest inside with these long green drapes. Their tallness reminds you of trees.
Grassy Curtains
You won't be able to tell where the window stops and these curtains begin on a sunny day.
Sunny Curtains
house_housingitem_settler_decor_wall_flo: This exuberant wreath uses dried flowers, so you can get that summertime feel even in the dead of winter.
Hanging a wreath of delphiniums on your door or in your window means that you're ready for visitors. Hope the place is clean!
house_housingitem_settler_dresser01_a_de: This single-source dresser was crafted from the wood of one ash tree, which had lived a long, full life with no regrets.
house_housingitem_settler_dresser01_b_de: To make a maple dresser of this quality, the artisan must completely clear their mind of all thoughts. Then, they say, the dresser makes itself.
house_housingitem_settler_dresser01_c_de: Oak wood is associated with the king of gods in many mythic traditions. Your socks and underwear deserve nothing less.
house_housingitem_settler_dresser01_d_de: This dresser has been burnished with a rich oil, to bring out the grain of the wood. Your unmentionables will be stored in luxury.
house_housingitem_settler_shelf01_a_desc: The flexible joints of this ash shelf can support the heaviest of collectible figurines.
house_housingitem_settler_shelf01_b_desc: This maple shelf calls out for something soft and comforting, like your favorite stuffed animal.
house_housingitem_settler_shelf01_c_desc: Oak trees are the most likely to be hit by lightning. Luckily, this shelf is specially insulated.
house_housingitem_settler_shelf01_d_desc: This shelf is perfect for displaying your most expensive violin. You have one of those, right?
house_housingitem_settler_stove01_a_desc: This stove takes time to heat up, but will stay warm long after the fire burns down.
house_housingitem_settler_stove01_b_desc: This handsome stove is rust-resistant and waterproof up to a depth of 30 feet.
house_housingitem_settler_stove01_c_desc: This stove gives off heat even when there's no fuel inside. Unsettling, but saves on heating costs.
house_housingitem_settler_stove01_d_desc: In the Old World, orichalcum was so rare that it was almost mythical. Here on Aeternum, it makes for a very shiny stove.
house_housingitem_shelfbottles01_descrip: Colorful bottles for any occasion and for any substance, from spices to poison. Just don't get them mixed up.
house_housingitem_singleshelf_a_descript: The beauty is not in the shelf itself, but in the possibilities it contains.
house_housingitem_smallalchemycabinet_de: Perfect for a very organized person. A place for everything, and everything in its place.
house_housingitem_spriggan2024_pottedtre: This mysterious little sapling glows with an unknown power. Take good care of it!
house_housingitem_statue_motherslove_des: A decorative statue to honor all Mothers, past and present, infused with the spirit of Love and Motherhood.
house_housingitem_stonefurnace_alchemy_d: Keep that fire in its place, which is inside this stove.

house_housingitem_storage_t2_chestprimal:

house_housingitem_storage_t3_pirate_desc:

house_housingitem_storage_t3_settler_des:

house_housingitem_table_dintable_lg_a_de: A classic long dining table. So classic, in fact, that it might be the original from which all other dining tables evolved.
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_bedsidet: This type of carved table is extremely popular among the merchant classes of Beijing.
This antique end table is in pristine condition. It would definitely spark a bidding war in the auction houses of Europe.
Placing this end table next to your bed is sure to bring dreams of happiness.
The latticework on this jade table is breathtaking. How did they carve that without cracking the stone?
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_desk01_a: It's easy to write poetry at this low desk. Being close to the earth provides inspiration.
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_desk01_b: The elegant simplicity and graceful wear of this low writing desk whispers "old money".
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_desk01_c: If you want to do any writing at this desk, you will have to place a mat and sit on the floor. It's the proper method.
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_desk01_d: Any letters written at this commanding jade desk automatically become Proclamations.
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_table01_: Teak trees don't grow on Aeternum, making this imported table especially prized.
This latticed table is an Aeternum original, created by a Chinese master craftsman. He wash up with the remains of his ship after a storm.
The minimalist lines and understated aesthetic of this table places its origin squarely in the Ming Dynasty period.
This solid jade table weighs over twelve hundred pounds. You should probably keep your cool, because this baby is unflippable.
house_housingitem_table_dynasty_table02_: The perfect place to put a pitcher of iced tea. The abalone top will help keep the ice from melting.
This particular type of iridescent abalone used for this tabletop is unique to Aeternum.
Either they used a whole bunch of abalone to make the top for this table, or that was one really huge shellfish.
When the sunlight hits the abalone in exactly the right way, you can almost imagine a face just below the surface.
house_housingitem_table_holidayconv2021_: For keeping your bedside drink cool overnight. Just hope it doesn't freeze while you sleep.
A sturdy table for a holiday feast. Now whose turn is it to cook this time?
house_housingitem_table_legion_bedsideta: The depiction on the bedside table is a mystery to you. Who could these figures be?
Placed at the side of the bed, this table shows two people amidst conversation.
In a luxurious purple a man and woman surround an instrument of power.
The shadows of two humans are cast upon this bedside table, leaving you with more questions than answers.
house_housingitem_table_legion_desk01_a_: Here you may sit and write to your company colleagues about the next war or invasion.
house_housingitem_table_legion_desk01_b_: This wooden desk is firm enough to take the furious scratchings of your pen to parchment as you write jeers about the other factions.
house_housingitem_table_legion_desk01_c_: For the writing of love letters, music, and poetry betwixt writing laws and declarations.
house_housingitem_table_legion_desk01_d_: The drawers contain everything you need to draft up that next composition or maps.
house_housingitem_table_legion_smalltabl: The tiles on this mosaic were smoothed down by a skilled craftsperson.
This wooden stand can hold any memento of import, or not-so-import.
The dark tiles entrance the viewer. How did they get it so perfectly circular?
For the playing of games with friends, be it Ludus Latrunculi, Knucklebones, or even Tic-Tac-Toe.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table01_a: Make yourself the host with the most when you serve upon this marble tabletop.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table01_b: The blue marble is as deep and enchanting as the rough seas around Aeternum.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table01_c: Dinner party dishes have never looked so good as they look atop this table.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table01_d: Not even the fields of Windsward are this green!
house_housingitem_table_legion_table02_a: A small table versatile enough to be placed in any kind of room. Now what to place upon it?
house_housingitem_table_legion_table02_b: The white oak of this table is so smooth you can run your hand over the top without getting a splinter.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table02_c: This small table holds a great deal of power in its presence, and can hold aloft even the heaviest of lamps.
house_housingitem_table_legion_table02_d: The sight of this olive wood table fills you with a nostalgia for home you will never be able to quench.
house_housingitem_table_logtable_descrip: A rustic table made from tree stumps. Perfect for planning adventures with your animal friends.
house_housingitem_table_logtablestump_de: A stump is a sort of proto-table already. You're just cutting out the middleman.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_counter02: This counter is perfect for counting your treasure. The mallet is for anyone who tries to interrupt you.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_desk01_a_: This desk is just for fun. Everyone knows that the best part of being a pirate is - no paperwork.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_desk01_b_: Watch out for splinters in your writing hand.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_desk01_c_: This desk is perfect for writing poetry and ransom notes.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_desk01_d_: A legendary pirate queen once wrote letters to her many lovers at this desk.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_dresser01: It's important to look your best while raining terror down on your enemies.
Place this handsome vanity table near your front door, to make sure your hat looks good before you leave.
You wake in a cold sweat. There's someone in the room! Wait, no... it's just your reflection in this fine vanity mirror.
This gilded vanity was a custom order from a Dutch workshop that specializes in pirate décor.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_island01_: Imagine how many off-key sea shanties this double keg countertop has heard.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table01_a: A table for those with great taste and a big appetite for culinary adventure.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table01_b: The bronze skulls, ever-present reminders of death, help you truly savor your meal as if it were your last.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table01_c: Being invited to dine at the Captain's table is a great honor for a humble pirate.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table01_d: Imagine how much champagne and caviar this table could hold. (And yet somehow, still not enough.)
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table02_a: Perfect for a small, tight-knit crew.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table02_b: This style of table is becoming increasingly popular in Aeternum, even among landlubbers.
house_housingitem_table_pirate_table02_d: Contains a hidden compartment for snacks. Very expensive snacks!
house_housingitem_table_settler_bedsidet: The energy in your house seems so much lighter, now that you have this ash end table.
No matter what you keep next to your bed, this maple end table will not judge you.
This oak end table is strong enough to hold all your hardest-hitting books and periodicals.
When you wake up screaming in the night, the reassuring presence of mahogany bedside table will help calm you.
house_housingitem_table_settler_decor_ga: This weather-beaten picnic table has seen many birthday parties in its day.
house_housingitem_table_settler_desk01_a: You are a popular person with many friends. Keep in touch with all of them by writing letters at this attractive ash desk.
house_housingitem_table_settler_desk01_b: Writing at this desk could inspire a symphony. All you have to do is close your eyes and listen.
house_housingitem_table_settler_desk01_c: When houseguests see this mighty oak desk, they'll say, "Wow. This desk must belong to a very important person." That person is you.
house_housingitem_table_settler_desk01_d: Look left. Look right. None of your neighbors have more exquisite taste in desks than you do.
house_housingitem_table_settler_table01_: When you're not hungry enough for a full meal, this snack-sized ash dining table is just right.
This sturdy table is perfect for use as a workbench. Unleash your creative side!
This oak table may be small, but it holds memories of being the mightiest tree in the forest.
No matter what you put on this mahogany table, it will be exactly the right choice.
house_housingitem_table_settler_table02_: Ash wood has natural protective and healing properties. You'll never get indigestion from food eaten off this table.
Just think of the warm, nourishing meals you and your loved ones will eat off this table.
A dining table needs to be sturdy. This oak table can hold a feast and a half without even creaking.
The rich red hue of this magnificent table whispers 'luxury'. Not too much; just enough.
house_housingitem_table_sidedesk_md_desc: If you need some extra desk, well, here you go!
house_housingitem_table_tablesmalla_desc: Who built this table? It isn't very well made. Is that even wood? Can it be trusted?
house_housingitem_targetdummy_descriptio: This target dummy dreamed of becoming a scarecrow, but joined the army instead.
house_housingitem_uidrink_tea_t3_descrip: Comes with a matching saucer. Sit in your favorite chair and savor the perfect cup of tea.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_a: Look at these wonderful climbing vines. Something about them just makes you smile.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_b: Waxy blooms with a mild scent. People plant them more for the popping pink than anything else.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_c: These vines grow really fast. So fast in fact, they might quickly outgrow their trellis. So trim the vines, but leave the flowers.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_d: The bright orange of these flowers reminds you of warm, sunny days. Even more so when they attract hummingbirds and butterflies.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_e: The moonflower is prized for the bright white of its petals. But look; don't touch, or you might walk away with a rash.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_med_f: Your home will not only look amazing with his trellis, but also smell amazingly sweet from the purple blooms.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_a_: The glory days of this small vine are still ahead, but it might need a taller trellis to get there.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_b_: These blushing blooms don't really serve any purpose besides looking nice. And boy, do they ever!
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_c_: The scent of these flowers is very evocative of the forest. But the reds remind you instead of romance.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_d_: These flowers are often brewed to make an herbal tisane as a cure for what ails ya'.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_e_: These flowers have hardly any scent. But that doesn't stop them from looking gorgeous.
house_housingitem_vegetation_vines_sm_f_: Some say you can make wine from these purple blooms. Others say they are toxic. Pick your poison, I guess.
house_housingitem_windchimes_post_c_desc: An old windchime holder with no windchimes. It looks like it is barely standing up.
house_housingitem_windswardqst_wyrdwoodp: One more potted plant couldn't hurt. Besides, how could you pass up a glowing one!
House plants. For the home owner who wants kids but also wants to keep their gold.
Give it water and sun. Plants are basically people with less complicated emotions.
house_housingitem_winter2023_festivecent: No Winter Convergence dining table is complete without it.
house_housingitem_winter2023_gleamitestr: The small crystals twinkle like gently falling stars.
house_housingitem_winter2023_gleamitetab: Perfect for adding a touch of magic to the corner of your desk.
house_housingitem_winter2023_trainset_de: No one really knows what a 'train' even is but most agree that they're a lot of fun to play with.
house_housingitem_winter2023_woodenmobil: The ornaments twirl in the winter breeze, invoking a childish sense of glee and wonder.
house_housingitem_writing_openbook_descr: You're determined to finish this book before your friends spoil the ending.
house_housingitem_writing_scrollstack_a_: You were warned not to open these sealed documents until you receive the signal.

If he was right, we'll rule like kings on this island!\nI'm moving ahead to get everything ready. Wait for a few hours, then follow to the second camp. I'll leave more instructions for you there.

- 1 ground bone of Withered

houseofgiacomo_body_01_04:
Arrived here yesterday, Airic said this place had what's needed for the plan. With all we're collecting, think we'll need to up the cost to stay in one of our little safehouses... maybe we could even charge Azoth! Wouldn't that be something! Few years time, we'll need to start finding places to stash away all that profit!
Heading to the caverns tomorrow, going to rest for a while. Strange... nobody's around, but I hear voices. Whispers. Must be the wind through the cliffs.

...

Damned creatures almost took my foot off! Patched myself up, but I'll be stuck here a bit. Just going to rest, listen to the voices in the wind.
houseofgiacomo_body_01_05: Only one piece left, and I'll be done. Ichor and water, just need some of those stones... then I'll be set. Haven't heard from the others, no messages anywhere. Guess that means I don't have to share!\nHeading to Grus tomorrow, should find what I need there, then keep north. Maybe being away from these ruins will stop this buzzing...

hunterscabin_body_01_01:
Mesdames, Messieurs – welcome. Though absent, I am your host - help yourself to the garden, and any of the livestock (if the ungrateful swine are still here), just kill them quick swiftly so they don't remember in the morning.

If you have chanced upon a rare creature, I'd ask you add a note in the log, for I have much curiosity regarding the creatures native to Aeternum – also, as a courtesy to your hostess, you leave the trophies I have gathered here out of respect, for I went to considerable effort for each, and each bears a tale.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_02:
It is not the animals brought with us on La Renommée that interest me – nor the deer or wolf of the isle, though of great size and fierce disposition – it is the beasts native to Aeternum. I fear it would take a lifetime, perhaps several, to see them all - yet my curiosity will not let me remain idle. Even Jacques' memory has faded, washed away as he was in the storm – but perhaps that is for the best, for had he survived, life would have been quite different.

I have been given a chance many would dream of - to explore this isle and see what flourishes here.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_03:
The reason for the migration of animals and beasts is now clear to me – they are fleeing south, driven from the Great Cleave to the North. 

If so, they may be a warning that the Corrupted may be massing for another foray into the Brightwood. This has swept away my desire for the hunt – if I remain overlong, it will be I who will be hunted, and I fear for my soul should those devils capture me and take me to the Shattered Mountain.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_04:
I hunt bison in the area mostly for something to do – they roam thickly here and in Everfall, and the skins fetch a decent price in Windsward for those unwilling to do the labor. I've not had the same aversion to cold as other settlers – hunting near the mountains is peaceful to me. I had a small base camp at the mountain to the north along the trails but past this expedition I found little game as it went deeper into the snows and mountains than before.

It was there I came across the first bison corpse – killed by wolves it seemed at a glance, but upon inspection I saw that the wounds the bison bore were marks of teeth and claws much bigger than any wolf I had ever seen. Inspecting the corpse more carefully, I discovered the bison's mouth to be covered in ice, as if its breath had frozen before it was torn apart. The icy tracks of the assailant led into the northern mountains.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_05:
The tracks of the creature that killed the bison were that of a wolf – but not a pack of wolves, a single wolf. Yet, based on the snow, much heavier than any wolf – and embedded in the tracks were small, snapped twigs, and in one, what seemed to be part of a tree root, covered in the same frost as marked the bison's wounds.

I consider myself no coward, but this isle's mysteries frighten me, for I do not know what the snows hide that stalks in the shape of a wolf and whose tracks are blended with that of the forest – but I do not wish to find out.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_06:
Yet as the bison seemed to thin in the passes and I became wary of the strange wolf tracks in the mountains, I found myself avoiding the mountain snows and instead, favoring hunts deeper into the woods. 

It was on the hunt today that I first caught sight of the stag – not a stag as familiar to us, but something that seemed grown from the forest and had taken the shape of a stag – I know not how to explain it. Around its horns grew moss, flowers, and its hide was the rich green grass of the forest floor. The sight struck me so I could not move, I could not breathe, until the creature seemed to spot me, then leapt away and vanished into the undergrowth.

Now every silhouette in the forest stands out starkly to me: the animals of the isle are not governed by the seasons, but shaped from them – the earth, the vegetation, even the snow and ice.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_07:
I head to the great crater lake at first light – the journey will be long, but I think the leagues shall pass quickly. I have heard tales of the strange forest creatures there, seemingly woven from the wood itself – a trapper in the local outpost had given the creature a name, a ‘spriggan,' a tree spirit the height of four men, with a body and limbs of branches given life – is this something born of the isle? Or perhaps something created by the Azoth in the forest?

This isle is filled with wonders, and I wish to see them all. May fortune favor me on my journey – a glimpse of such a sprite is all I require, even if I must spend weeks circling the lake.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_08:
Chance meeting and odd meeting with someone I had nearly forgotten about – the gentleman scholar I had met the previous year, M. Grenville. The man seems struck by the same wanderlust as I, though his seems more in the way of digging up stones and picking at bricks in old ruins. I offered him and his companions shelter for the night, but though his companions seemed to want to rest, he seemed eager to be on his way and kept speaking of a Great Discovery that was within his reach, if his efforts proved true. 

His manner – while not hostile, and I'm certain he meant no rudeness or insult by it – was rather unsettling, and seemed to have an urgency about him – not of one fleeing something, but chasing something. 

In an attempt to calm him, I asked if he still played his piano, and he seemed confused for a moment, as if he had quite forgotten it existed, then shook his head, as if the memory was unwelcome, a distraction. I hope he finds what he seeks, though I fear what he might stir up in the Brightwood if he does not take care to slow his pace.

- Renée Marie Cartier
hunterscabin_body_01_09:
I awoke to hear the cry of the animals – I heard them making cries in the middle of the night, and blue fires on the roads from lanterns that had been dark for as long as I have been upon the isle. Behind it all, there was a roar that rose in waves, then faded - and a great frozen light from the great rock that sits in the center of the stone ring. 

I fear what I shall find, but I will not wait for the tide to claim me without going to see with my own eyes what has happened. Is this the Great Discovery that Grenville spoke of? If so, I fear it has consumed him – and awoken something in the isle itself.

- Renée Marie Cartier

inferiorman_body_01_01: Of the four of us, Edward is the youngest in years, and the heart of our family. His small pale lips are quick to turn up to a smile, though it is more often than not, accompanied by a shrug and a turning away of the gaze that I have tried unsuccessfully to train out of him for greater than a decade. You may think I value him no more than the hound that scampers at his side, that I seek only to make him more useful to my own ends, or to subvert his nature to make him less embarrassing to our House. In truth, however, I worry for him. Mettle makes the man. Our journey is not without danger, but I have brought Edward along in an attempt to stiffen his spine, perchance to learn by watching my comport of command with the men. As I watch him on deck laughing at Talbot’s antics, I see my mother in his clear eyes and curly straw locks, but it is clear to all that he is the inferior man. But now the sky darkens and the sea spits promise of the Devil’s plans. The call grows for me to take the helm. Watch, Edward. Watch and learn.
inferiorman_body_01_02: Five of us washed ashore, with the sixth, as luck would have it, being our navigator. He arrived decoupled from his body, hung high on the side of a barnacled sea stack, tangled in the brined ropes of the forestay as if hung up for display in some odd curio shop, pendent in a knotted bag. It took the better part of the day for us to climb to Sailing Master John’s remains, cut it free, and put it to a proper burial, but despite our weary condition and in fact because of it, I deemed it a necessary task and an opportunity to solidify discipline for the small remnant of our crew. I was wrong on both counts. As I worked alongside the men on this arduous and troubling task, stared at by bird pecked sockets that cast supervisory judgement upon our work, Seaman Marten and Gunner Satyre glanced frequently over at Edward. He was too sick to help, and sat away from the sightless grasping of the sea, holding tight his knees to hide the trembling he knew would disappoint me. Talbot lay at his feet in weary guard, too tired to shake free of the salt which encrusted his fur. It happened just as we cut the head free and it tumbled into my arms. I saw, or rather felt, something watching.
inferiorman_body_01_03: The other men felt it as well. But perhaps wearied of our efforts, we, as if posing for a family portrait, froze stock-still and dared not- nay, could not move. To our shame it was Talbot who enabled us to turn our heads. He commenced a high pitched baying that set the hairs of my neck aloft. It was a sound which he’d never uttered until that day. Thus unfrozen, we turned as if on strings toward a rocky cliff overhanging the sand. It was day as near as we could tell, though the gloom is pervasive on this island. Heavy clouds cling to its bone white teeth like a funeral pall. So it was that despite the keen vision requisite to those of us who persuade the sea to our ends, we could not make out the face of the watcher on the rampart above, save that he appeared to wear some kind of hood, as his head would otherwise be canted at an impossible angle. Was it Fear that made our eyes seem to slide across his form, unable to truly perceive it? If so it would be inaugural for I, who had never entertained such base emotion. I prized above all, my ability to remain detached, to make the best, most correct decisions with precise timing and judgement. These were not merely skills ingrained over years of education and training, but as I had chastised Edward many times, it was superior instinct bred across generations of our noble line, akin to the traits of the wolfhound who had just now proved itself the better of us all. My entire life I had denied Fear purchase, yet it had come now to roost squarely between my shoulders, and with the delight of a long separated lover, probed with a violent avarice into my body with icy, skeletal fingers. Our hooded watcher stood motionless for several frozen breaths, until my better nature finally stirred me to action. Or, perhaps it was simply the mounting excitement and relief at seeing another living being upon this deserted isle. I called out, but the watcher, as if in reply, merely pointed inland with his entire arm as if it were a needle on a compass, then turned and disappeared into the jungled growth beyond the cliff’s edge. It is then that I heard clearly for the first time, what Cook Petru had been muttering to himself since the time he had awoken next to me on these mournful shores. It was not, as I’d previously presumed, a prayer from his homeland near the Black Sea. It was a single word- “Strigoi.”
inferiorman_body_01_04: Frustrations ran high, fanned by anger. Anger at ourselves, against each other, and toward the heavens that determined to tilt us at this trial. My self-vaunted leadership failed me. I allowed, even encouraged delay. For as much as we none of us wished to wait for help that would never arrive, we were also afraid to leave this small patch of sand. As a result, we squandered what little “daylight” we had left. Though we knew not the time, we knew the light grew steadily dimmer and shadows more oppressive by the minute. Our remaining energy was spent poorly, as we engaged in equally passionate and circular debates over questions to which we had no answer. What was the identity of our compass-pointing watcher? Was he friend or foe? What was his intention? (We agreed that to our perception of his dress and bearing, it was without doubt a “he” and not a “she” who had invited us deeper into the interior of the island.) Much of our speculation regarded our location. Was it Europe? We were alternately swept away on an accelerated current, or plucked by Angels from the waters of the Mare Brittanicum and transported to the West Indies in a single day. Finally, we debated on which direction to go. Whether we would follow our watcher’s guidance or go the opposite direction if it were a warning. But this debate, which had little contribution from Edward, who I grew increasingly frustrated with for appearing to show no initiative nor even interest in our survival, was abruptly curtailed by the sonorous tolling of a clocktower.
inferiorman_body_01_05: As the third bell struck, Satyre wheezed a high-pitched, barking laugh, likely in relief at hearing such clear evidence of nearby civilization. Marten spat in the sand, for what reason, I do not know. Petru’s dark bushy eyebrows furrowed even more than before, set bold and stark against the skin of his now blanched face. After whispering “strigoi” once more, he stumbled and ran, plowing across the sand and into the shadowed wood beyond, before any could stop him. I stood and called after him, though my cry went unheeded. Then Edward rose shakily to his feet, but he did not turn to Petru. Instead, his eyes grew wide, almost comically so, as he pointed toward the water. As if to punctuate his movement, the sixth bell, as if accounting our doom, tolled. As my back faced the relentless churn, I did not immediately see what caused Edward’s legs to buckle, nor what Talbot vented his fury toward. Fear shot through my veins, filling them with a heavy quicksilver that urgently stifled my will to move. It grasped me close with clawed fingers, and whispered in my ear, “Silly one. You thought you had escaped me, but I shall never leave your side.” When I finally managed to turn about, I knew our lives to be forfeit. That which came from the sea toward us was not of this earthly realm. The word “Mermen” brazenly trudged to the fore, before it shrugged and slunk back to the routed tangle of my thoughts. For these creatures were clearly no progeny of land nor of sea. These were things which could only have been conceived in Hell. An instant was enough. Too long, our eyes gorged themselves sick on the endless nightmare splayed out before us. An army of clambering, sea-tangled limbs and gurgling, fish-gnawed faces clawed themselves free of sea foam, as the last echo of the final bell retreated past the shoreline. We fled as one, making a mockery of our hours-long debate, as fast as our five bodies and four spirits would allow, we ran on in Petru’s wake. We ran, not caring who was with us or in what condition, we ran only to preserve ourselves in a kind of mad, breathless race. It was then that our troubles began in earnest.
inferiorman_body_01_06:
We were sure of two things: one, that we traveled in the direction our hooded watcher had guided us, and two, that it was the same direction toward the belltower that faithfully tolled every evening. We would later be disabused of both notions.

The belltower, we found, was a warning, an alarm, and I gave thanks inwardly to the brave souls who had mobilized a defense against the dangers of the night. For on this island, that alarm bell is critical to one’s survival. We learned to heed its dolorous call, to hide ourselves as best we were able until dawn broke once more. Each night, we barely survived monstrosities that seemed born purely of imagination. I at times fancied we were having a collective dream, from which I feared we would never wake. One night, we huddled together under pine branches we hacked off using Marten’s spear, staring at a half-headed woman drifting overhead our feeble shelter. As it floated closer, a powerful stench arose, one that smelled of a very old grave. Talbot had whimpered loudly enough that I thought to break the animal’s neck to save ourselves. But after lingering a moment, the spirit finally passed. On another night, we climbed into the trees, delayed by Edward’s insistence to bring Talbot, just in time to avoid bestial forms that slithered through the reddish trunks which grasped at the sky with twisted, blistered hands. We watched, Talbot’s wildly beating heart hammering against the crook of my arm, as the beasts growled, having cornered an unseen prey. They let out a curious crooning sound, and fell upon it in the darkness. There came a piteous cry, the voice unmistakably human. The staccato trills grew weaker, continuing in terrible harmony with the greedy wet tearing of entrails. None of us spoke of this event afterwards. You may believe that we entertained such noble thoughts as, “If only we had,” but rather, each of us thought, “If we had, it would certainly be us.”

We were cowards born of practicality. We had little more than makeshift weapons. Satyre had sharpened a stick using Marten’s knife to fashion a crude spear. Marten had then tied his knife with vines to the end of a second stick, to form a more durable version. We also had my pistol, though its powder had long been lost in the same waters which had simultaneously crushed both our ship and our fortunes. I kept the hilt jutting from my waistband and acted as if it were still functional, because we were now on our sixth day without food, and Marten and Satyre had begun openly discussing eating Edward’s hound, Talbot.
inferiorman_body_01_07: The third thing we became sure of was something which Edward discovered, deep into our sixth day, and heading into night. He was walking in front of me when he abruptly stopped in his tracks. “Brother,” he said. I followed his gaze to two twigs which formed an inverted “V.” We were traveling in circles. I glanced at the other men, who had turned their attention to Edward’s call. Now they also knew we were lost. Edward flushed, realizing he had doomed us. Marten and Satyre, who were merely waiting for the right time to mutiny, acted immediately. Some part of my mind wanted to tell Edward even then, “See, that is how you do it.” Satyre struck Edward unconscious. Marten advanced on me. I drew my pistol, but Marten merely grinned, yanked the weapon from my hands, and tucket it into his own belt. He thrust the tip of his makeshift spear under my chin and said, “I know you got no powder for it.” I cast about. Petru and Talbot were gone, and Satyre had just realized it. Satyre was urging Marten to depart soon, and during their heated talk, I was temporarily ignored. I thought of escape, when Marten whirled suddenly and thrust his spear deep into my belly. “Payment for all your high and mighty looking down upon us, Master Captain sir.” I managed to croak a surprised protest, before all went black. Oddly, of all things I could regret, I dismayed that his crude laughter would be the last thing I would hear, as it chased me into the depths of the Afterlife.
inferiorman_body_01_08:
I had disturbing dreams then. I ran, endlessly, breathlessly, chased through an endless forest of thorns by dozens of beasts with demonic heads of wolves and goats. And though thorns pierced my flesh, I continued to run, until I found I moved no longer. I looked down and saw that I had run my feet into bloody stumps. There was only jagged bone where they once had been. I sought to scream then, but found I had no voice with which to do so. I came to a silvered mirror to examine my throat, and when I looked, the sightless visage of Sailing Master John stared back.

“You’ve come around.” Something about his voice was both stirring and soothingly familiar. He was the definition of a Lord, at the same time delicate and strong, with an air of command that could not be denied. His hair was tied back in intricate loops, a neat ribbon summarizing all into a final statement of elegance. He was naturally superior in every way to me, I understood this at a bodily level. He was unattainable. And therefore desirable. I craved his smell. It was exotic, a musky incense burned in ancient temples. I yearned for his cool and gentle touch, which he withdrew from my face. But most of all I craved his attention. I wanted, needed, all of it, as I needed the very air I breathed.

“Your brother is safe,” he said. After a long moment of staring at his hazel eyes, I recalled that I had a brother. Yes, I was sure of it. A name visited my mind, unbidden, but left just as quickly, teasing, ever out of reach, just like my Lord. Embarrassment ran through me, swirling into a stew of irritation. I was not upset that I had forgotten my own brother’s name. Rather, I was infuriated that my brother had taken even the tiniest sliver of my Lord’s attention. Was my Lord concerned about my brother? Did he love him? I instantly hated my brother and his bottomless selfishness. How dare he take from me, the attention I needed to live.

Grasping for a way to hold my Lord’s attention, I stammered out the only thing I could think of, “Where am I? You’ve healed me.” It was then I realized I was utterly devoid of a single article of clothing, and lay in a sumptuous bed, in what must be a very large castle.
inferiorman_body_01_09:
He smiled with effortless charm, eyes crinkling at the corners in a way that spoke of boundless experience and wisdom. I found myself scrabbling after words that might make my Master- for that is what he was to me- look upon me fondly. Then he turned away from me, and it took all I had not to grab his shoulders and force him to turn back. It was as if the Sun itself had turned its gaze and I would be bereft of its warmth forever after. I began to breathe heavily, to panic. I had lost his interest. What had I done wrong that he would leave me?

“I am sure you have many questions, but we will speak anon, at the feast,” he said. Suddenly my great sorrow was extinguished. Thank the heavens. I had another chance, to please him!

Still, when he stepped into the hallway and closed the door behind, I was left utterly alone. I gave no thought to reuniting with my brother, nor of what happened to the rest of my crew, mutinous and otherwise. I believe I cried, in relief and joy, to have finally found my true Master. To have discovered that thing which was so often talked about and which I had only pretended to understand. Love.

I heard his voice out in the hallway, speaking to a woman. Then burned in me a jealousy so hot I feared it would melt the very stone beneath my feet. I listened closely, peering through the crack of the door, and saw her. She resembled my Lord in several ways, her upright bearing and perfection. But there was something else as well. A sorrow? Why was she inflicting her sorrow upon my Lord? I would have run her through, had I held a saber in my grasp. She was challenging him. “What will you do with your new toy?” Was she implying I was but a toy? I was about to burst upon them when he spoke. “I’ve taken an interest. You may have the younger one,” he replied, and walked off. As she watched him walk away, she caught my eye briefly. She mouthed something at me, the words of which I would attempt repeatedly to uncover, until the time of horror.
inferiorman_body_01_10:
It was a grand hall. My Lord stood at the center, surrounded by his guests. In the corner, her arms folded, leaning against a pillar, was the one who had mouthed the words to me, though now she paid me no attention, which suited me well, for my Sun was singular. “My Lords and Ladies,” my Light said, “we have among us a new member of our household.” He, and then all eyes in the room, turned to me. I felt their hatred, their jealousy, and it excited me. Of course they were jealous of me, for He loved me best, and who would not? I preened in my finery. He wanted me, and He did not want them. I was so engrossed in this thought, that I barely noticed when a young man seated himself next to me. I almost struck him for distracting my attention from my Lord, what my Lord was saying was important, He was saying-

“Remember yourself.”

Unbidden came the words the woman had said, and suddenly those words were all I heard, crashing on my ears like the lightning-cracked mast of my ship had crashed into the sea. My Lord’s voice was getting so far away. Remember myself? It was the last thing I wanted- no, no! I felt a touch on my hand, looked, and it was the young man again. It was my brother. Edward, was his name. I yanked my hand from his grasp, saw the hurt in his eyes.

“Let us now invite our special guests!” My Lord gestured to a doorway, through which streamed- living horrors. Though some walked on legs, that is where the resemblance to humans ended. They had the skin of corpses, their mandibles insect-like, with tight rows of long needle-like teeth that champed into one another from above and below. Made for rending flesh. I nearly shouted in alarm, when I felt Edward’s hand on mine again, this time squeezing hard in warning. “Still your heart and listen carefully, brother. I’ve made bargain with her. The one who woke you. She’ll help you escape from here.” 

Servants rolled a cart around with food- ah, food- I had forgotten how starved I was. Two covered platters. Not silver, but unpolished copper. My hunger nearly made me forgot the danger we were in, until they lifted the lids. To my horror, Talbot lay in one pan, roasted to a crisp, where the other held what seemed to be a human thigh. I wondered in a maniacal way, would I have eaten them, had my thoughts still been ensorcelled? I knew the answer without thinking. But this final shock completely awoke me from my daze. “Don’t look,” I bade Edward, whose tear-stained face told me he already knew. “Come, let’s flee together,” I urged my little brother, as the monsters filed in silently, and descended upon the servants who simply stared forward listlessly as they were fed upon.

But Edward shook his head. “You’ll be safer alone, I’d only slow you down.” He smiled sadly, with those small pale lips. And this time, he did not avert his gaze. 

That gaze would haunt me. I left him. I left him at that feast of horrors.
inferiorman_body_01_11:
It was, I realized, just like my dream. I ran. I ran and ran, though thorns tore at my feet. I heard the howling of wolves again. Bats flew at my face as if to warn me to go back, before it was too late. Go back before he gets angry. Go back, to save your brother. But the woman was dutifully waiting for me at the edge of the castle grounds, and directed me through a side gate. A coach. Horses galloping, carriage trundling and rocking wildly in the urgency of our flight. As I dismounted I heard and saw their foaming jaws, and was reminded again of the sea that day, when the undead crawled forth to greet us. 

My mind was aswirl with questions. I wondered for the hundredth time, why she would go to this extent for me. Did she love me? Did she love my brother? Would she devour him? Would He consume him? And why, knowing that staying behind could only end in misery, would my brother have chosen to stay? Did he love her as I had loved the man I’d so easily called my Master? I could not face the other truth, the real one which I hid from myself. Edward had sacrificed himself for me. No, that story is a lie. But a lie is merely a truth we cannot live with.

A ship did wait for me, though my heart had protested wildly that it would not. Now at journey’s end, I know not where I am, only that the ship moved without crew, and landed here. When I disembarked, my heart sank. For this castle, its structure, was built in the same fashion as the castle I’d escaped from. I had not gone far, not far enough. I shall find a way out, I shall find a way free, and I shall come back for my brother. I will find Petru, Marten and Satyre. And He, I shall destroy Him. I shall find it in my heart, the strength to do so. I will.

But even now, I feel Him getting closer. Closer to the shadows in which I huddle in gibbering fear. He is in a rage. He is here. He clutches me close with clawed fingers. And He whispers with the breath of a moldering grave. “You thought you had escaped me, but you shall never leave my side.”

inquisitortrial_body_01_01:
Forthwith, let it be known, 
By blood, by wind, and by stone, 
That we find the defendant, Thaddeus Mayhew, guilty on all charges. 

In his tenure as self-proclaimed Inquisitor General, he has committed harassments, torture, murder, false witness, and a litany of crimes too long to tally in this document. And though these crimes be committed in the Old World, Thaddeus Mayhew shall know no protective limits of time and distance. 

What the Old World hath permitted, let the New World punish! 

We mark Thaddeus Mayhew with the invisible Sign of Anathema. May all who meet him, friend or stranger, offer him nothing but disgust and personal violence. May he find no succor nor respite. May his body and soul whittle down till he is naught but one of the Lost. May the gods have pity on Thaddeus Mayhew, for no mortal shall. 

We bear witness to this sentence, we the conjurers, healers, and cunning folk condemned in the Old World. Let our wrath be known in the New. 

-THE BROKEN COVENANT

intro1_cutscene_line1: Sailor: I don’t like it. Sailin' to an uncharted island with strange folk aboard--
intro1_cutscene_line2: Deckhand: Keep yer voice down! Lest ye want the cap’n ta hear ye.
intro1_cutscene_line3: Sailor: It ain’t the Captain I’m worried about, it’s that priest… If he’s a man of the cloth, I’m the Virgin Mary.

intro1_cutscene_line5: Father Russo: It is indeed the island of legend.
intro1_cutscene_line7: Captain Thorpe: If you’re wrong, the price of the voyage will be paid in blood. Yours and those vagabonds you’ve brought along.
intro1_cutscene_line8: Father Russo: They merely seek adventure, Captain.
intro1_cutscene_line9: Father Russo: The island calls to those who forge their own destiny.

kubikirisburden_body_01_01: Here I leave the last testament of Kubikiri the Edge of the World, and Sensou no Ko, the demon Axe.\nPray you heed my woeful tale and stay far from the cursed blade, and never seek it out!
kubikirisburden_body_01_02:
When I was a young man, I turned my forester childhood toward learning the way of the headsman. I was efficient and clean, as good executioners are, and soon, my talents were recognized.
I was given a gift! A badge of office.

Woe to me, Sensou no Ko, the legendary executioners' axe was bestowed upon me.
Thus my curse took hold.
kubikirisburden_body_01_03:
The axe was more than a badge, or even a tool. The axe hides within it a demon!
The kami stirred as soon as I took hold of the thing, it filled me with a strength like I've never felt before!
I was overtaken by a white-hot pride, and a terrible bloodlust.
Soon my duties were not enough, and the kami Sensou no Ko - that demon blade - drove me to kill them all!
I fled to sea, hiding on a trade-ship, but I could never escape fate.
It brought me here, for penance.
kubikirisburden_body_01_04:
I no longer even feel the eyes of my ancestors upon me, all have turned away.
The cries, the screaming, Sensou no Ko's victims clamor in my head.
Worse though, worse is the hunger.

Even killing doesn't slake it any longer, these hollow souls hardly count as deaths to the demon blade at all.
Soon, I believe it will turn on me for sustenance.

By now I would welcome it.

ladimere_intro_line1: Go near the altar, matey? Over my body.
laesperanza02: And nary was there a captain and crew as brave - or feared - as ours.
laesperanza04: Until the phantom galleon "Esperanza" appeared on the horizon.
laesperanza05: Aye... we knew the ship well. Story went she plundered a legendary island.
laesperanza07: On board, the wind was still - the Esperanza's crew entombed within, all slaughtered by an unknown hand...
laesperanza08: Our courage rewarded - the most legendary treasure in the southern seas was ours to claim.
laesperanza09: That evening, as we celebrated our newfound wealth, treacherous thoughts took hold...
laesperanza10: I was awakened in the night to sounds of pistol fire, a mutiny under way.
laesperanza11: I rushed through smoke and flame to the Captain's quarters.
laesperanza12: But I was too late... the Captain was already slain.
laesperanza13: When I reached the deck, all was lost. We’d sailed into the heart of a hellish storm...
laesperanza14: Our ill fortune ran us aground on the ragged coast of Aeternum.
laesperanza15: I was the only survivor... and the treasure, scattered along the shore.
laesperanza16: Fortune favors the bold... but those cursed doubloons will bring naught but a wealth of horror.

legal_closed_beta_description:
New World: Aeternum will offer an epic adventure with a revamped story, new starting experience, and fresh content for PC veterans to experience at launch. Newcomers can embark on an unforgettable journey, which is playable solo, co-op, or with cross-platform play. This test is focused on the console experience.

<font color={colorHex} face="lyshineui/fonts/nimbus_bold.font">As a confidential pre-release build, players may encounter bugs, glitches, or issues. Features and mechanics are subject to change and might not function as intended. Progress made during the Closed Beta will not carry over to future tests or the final release</font>.

Your feedback is highly valued! Bugs or suggestions for improvements should be reported through the in-game feedback system under game settings.

The Confidential Console Closed Beta Test will be available from July 25th, 9 AM PDT, until July 31st, 9 AM PDT. As a reminder, this test is CONFIDENTIAL, and no sharing of information or media is permitted. By participating, you agree to keep it strictly confidential.

See you in Aeternum!
legal_closed_beta_title: New World: Aeternum Closed Beta Test!

leviathon_01_description: Shoot forward a four pronged claw attached to a chain from the muzzle. The projectile will travel up to 14m and cannot pull you upwards more than 3m. If it connects to an enemy it will deal {[0.400000 * 100]}% weapon damage and inflict root for {[0.700000]}s before quickly pulling you towards them. The pull can be cancelled by any ability use or primary fire. Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your blunderbuss, this ability inflicts taunt for {[4.000000]}s when it hits. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
leviathon_01_mod1_description: Upon usage, restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}</font> stamina every second for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>.
leviathon_01_mod2_description: Landing a pellet, even if blocked, lowers the cooldown of this ability by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.020000 * -100]}%</font> each.
leviathon_01_mod3_description: Successful pulls will automatically grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1</font> loaded ammunition. If you currently have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2</font> loaded ammunition this will exceed the max cap and grant a third.
leviathon_02_description: Fire a large net out of the blunderbuss that deals {[0.700000 * 100]}% weapon damage and slows targets it hits by {[-0.400000 * -100]}% for {[3.000000]}s. (Slow reduces target's movement speed.) If standing still or moving backwards, the recoil from this attack will knock you further backwards. If moving sideways or forwards, you will continue forward unhindered.
leviathon_02_mod1_description: If Net Shot hits a target, reduce its cooldown by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.200000 * -100]}%</font>.
leviathon_02_mod2_description: Net Shot's initial hit is reduced to {[0.300000 * 100]}% weapon damage. However, it now deals {[-0.350000 * -100]}% additional weapon damage as bleeding each second for {[3.000000]}s.
leviathon_02_mod3_description: The net now inflicts a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.500000 * -100]}% slow</font> that degrades to normal move speed over <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[7.000000]}s</font>.
leviathon_03_description: Blast immense wind out of the blunderbuss knocking down any target immediately in front of you. Blast Shot deals {[0.500000 * 100]}% weapon damage. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your blunderbuss, hits with this ability inflict taunt for {[4.000000]}s. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
leviathon_03_mod1_description: Blast Shot applies <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">rend</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}s</font> to all targets affected by this ability. \n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Rend reduces target's armor.)</font>
leviathon_03_mod2_description: The area <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">10m</font> in front of you remains influenced by wind for the next <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}s</font>. You and your allies gain a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.180000 * 100]}%</font> move speed bonus while in the area.<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(This effect cannot be dispelled.)</font>
leviathon_04_description: Shoot a grenade out of the blunderbuss that can bounce up to 4 times. The Splitting Grenade will detonate after 1.5s but can be detonated early by reactivating its ability key within this time period. Upon detonation, it will create 3 mini grenades that will disperse and explode 1s after landing, dealing {[0.850000 * 100]}% weapon damage in a 3m radius area. (Each successive grenade hit against the same target deals {[-0.400000 * -100]}% less base damage.)
leviathon_04_mod1_description: Deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to targets greater than <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> health.
leviathon_04_mod2_description: Any grenade hit grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">haste</font>, increasing movement speed by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Multiple hits will refresh the duration.)</font>
leviathon_04_mod3_description: Splitting Grenade explosions inflict burn on hit, dealing {[-0.100000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second for {[10.000000]}s. (Stacks up to {[3.000000]} times.)
leviathon_05_description: Fire 5 shots in a horizontal fan in front of you while pushing yourself backwards. Each shot will deal {[0.450000 * 100]}% weapon damage. \n\n(Every consecutive hit on the same target will deal {[-0.200000 * -100]}% less damage than the previous hit.)
leviathon_05_mod1_description: Increase the range of this attack from <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">12m</font> to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">16m</font>.
leviathon_05_mod2_description: Fire <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">4</font> additional pellets with each use of this ability.
leviathon_05_mod3_description: Each individual hit from this ability or from the blunderbuss primary fire will lower the cooldown of this ability by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.015000 * -100]}%</font>.
leviathon_05_mod4_description: Fire a singular bomb down the center of the fan. This bomb will implant itself in the world and explode dealing {[1.000000 * 100]}% weapon damage in a 3m area after a 1s delay.
leviathon_06_description: Load the blunderbuss with heavy canisters. For the next 15s or 3 shots, shots will no longer fire multiple pellets but instead will fire a heavy, fast diving, mortar-style canister that causes a tall explosion upon impact, dealing {[1.000000 * 100]}% weapon damage in a 3m area. \n\nIf the target is {[10.000000]}m away or further, they will take {[0.350000 * 100]}% increased damage from the mortar.
leviathon_06_mod2_description: Firing grants a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}% haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>
leviathon_06_mod3_description: Gain an extra canister, you can now fire up to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">4</font> shots.
leviathon_contultimate_description: The next shot fired within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}s</font> after triggering an ability will have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">8</font> pellets instead of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">6</font>.
leviathon_passive01_description:
You can no longer aim down sights and perform a melee attack with your gun instead.
This attack will always <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">slow</font> the target by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>. If you hit a target and have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-50.000000 * -1]}</font> or more stamina, Stock Smash will consume that stamina to push back the target <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">4m</font> and grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1</font> loaded ammunition; if you currently have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2</font> loaded ammunition this will exceed the max cap and grant a third. 

Stock Smash can be used during abiltiies and primary fires to cancel them.
leviathon_passive02_description: Whenever you take a hit and your health is below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font>, increasing armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[30.000000]}s cooldown)</font>
leviathon_passive03_description: Basic shots restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}</font> stamina per pellet hit.
leviathon_passive04_description: Every pellet that is a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">headshot</font> reduces all cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.005000 * -100]}%</font>.
leviathon_passive05_description: Using an ability reduces all other ability cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.040000 * -100]}%</font>.
leviathon_passive06_description: The last shot loaded into the blunderbuss will do <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage.
leviathon_passive07_description: Direct base damage from abilities is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> if the victim is <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}m</font> or further away.
leviathon_passive08_description: Deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to any target as long as you have not damaged them in the last <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}s</font>.
leviathon_passive09_description: Successful hits within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}m</font> grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font>, increasing armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>.
leviathon_passive10_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Reloads</font> give you a damage boost of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.040000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)</font>
leviathon_passive11_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Reloading</font> gives you a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}% haste</font> that lasts for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.800000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>
leviathon_passive12_description: Triggering an ability grants a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.030000 * 100]}% fortify</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>. \n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Stacks up to {[5.000000]} times.) \n(Fortify increases armor.)</font>
leviathon_passive13_description: Holding onto <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2</font> loaded ammunition for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font> after a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">reload</font> will load a 3rd active ammunition.
leviathon_passivec_description: Once every <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}s</font>, your next ability used will have its cooldown reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.500000 * -100]}%</font>.
