malleusmortuis_body_01_01: First of all, fire’s no good! Total destruction’s no good. So, fie to your fire! Get it out of your head. This island’s got a powerful mean memory. It remembers a corpse. Reduce one of these shambling cadavers down to fragments and vapors, and the island just remembers it back into being. \n\nThat said, there are other methods. Trial and error, as my father, gods damn his soul, used to say. I was a sexton by trade, back in the Old World. If anyone’s going to figure out how to make a dead body behave, it’s going to be me. I’m assembling this manual, such as it is, from what I and others have tried and continue to try. Lots of trials. Lots of bloody errors. You just keep hammering a nail till it submits. Father said that too. Anyway, here we go.
malleusmortuis_body_01_02:
By and large, these are worth piss all. Say your prayers, do your motions, light the incense, do the whole bloody mummers play production. The shambling corpses will just commence their shambling. 

We’ve tried the prayers and rituals from East to West and up and down, to Europe, to Africa, to Asia, and back again. Believe me, this island gets all manner of visitor, and they’ve lent us their ways, and none of it seems to work, where ambling corpses are concerned. 

Now there’s apocryphal talk of some powerful conjurers working some fancy invocations that keep the Lost sleeping for a spell. But I haven’t seen so with my own eyes. Not yet anyway.
malleusmortuis_body_01_03:
The Lost don’t exactly hold still. We’ve lost a few fingers here and there. According to the old customs, we’ve stuffed their maws with coins and garlic. We’ve tried holy water. We’ve tried pouring incense into the eyes, ears, and nose. 

No effect. 

Stitching the mouth sometimes holds it shut for a spell. Sometimes.
malleusmortuis_body_01_04: Last night, in accordance with some custom or another, we tried burying a shambler at a crossroads. It didn’t take. \n\nA colleague in this gruesome trade claims to have placed mirrors around a burial site, to ward off would-be shamblers from rising. He says it worked a treat. The man’s only vices are drinking and lying, so take that at its grimy worth.
malleusmortuis_body_01_05: We did it all proper and tidy, just as the old skald told us. The unruly corpse went in a sturdy coffin of oak, sealed shut with iron nails taken from a shield bloodied in battle. Then I hammered three more nails to the foot of the coffin. As I hammered with my left hand, no easy task, I repeated these words:   Blessed Realm and Blessed Host, Nail the draugr to the post. Thrice I strike with holy crook, One for Wod, one for Thor, and one for Lok. It didn’t take. Thing burst out of the coffin like a ravenous wolf pup eating its way out of the womb. Come to think of it, maybe the coffin was supposed to be made of yew. Anyway, we did it pretty much almost exactly as the skald told us.
malleusmortuis_body_01_06:
We made sure no moonlight or shadows touched the grave. Didn’t work. 
We pounded stakes through the heart of the corpse. Didn’t work. 
We placed a hymn book in the coffin with the corpse. Didn’t work. 

You see the pattern forming, don’t you? We placed rose thorns and silver dust over the grave loam. We walked black goats and roosters over the graves. We tried it with white goats and roosters. None of it worked.

Mutilating the cadaver, cutting off hands and feet and gouging out eyes… that works a bit. Slows them down in the ground. Sometimes the island remembers their bits back, sometimes it don’t. No reasoning with this island. This method definitely buys more time than outright destroying the Lost, but it’s grisly work and ain’t easy.
malleusmortuis_body_01_07:
An old, desperate bit of grave lore. Bury the body either upside-down or on its belly, so as it won’t know which way is up. Stupid, isn’t it? Just stupid enough to sometimes work.

It’s a coin toss chance, but sometimes, the buggers never get their way to the surface. Sometimes I wonder if they’re down there now, still trying to get topside, digging themselves straight to Hell.

Flaw in this method is that time can dull your paranoia, and sometime later, a cadaver bursts out of the grave loam to take you by surprise.
malleusmortuis_body_01_08:
Be my time soon. Can feel it. Little things. Memories fading. Color is unnatural. Made a face that set the butcher’s apprentice to fainting. Didn’t mean to.

It’s the burial experiments that did it. Each one took its toll. Each corpse took a little strip of me with it. Cunning buggers. They played the long game.

Nothing for it. Going to lie in the hole. Face down. Hope for the best…

-Oliver Ashwell

medea_combat_line1: Foolish child, the blood of Helios courses through my veins!
medea_combat_line2: I built Windsward with my own hands! I can destroy it with a snap of my fingers!
medea_combat_line3: I'll have your blood for tribute!
medea_combat_line4: Enough! Your skill is… surprising. I am intrigued.
medeastribute01: Two-thousand years ago, cataclysmic wars between Aeternum's earliest civilizations ravaged these southern plains.
medeastribute02: The sorceress Medea came to Windsward in the wars' aftermath, determined to restore this land.
medeastribute03: Though the Ancients were gone, Medea had learned many of their secrets.
medeastribute04: She channeled Azoth to create the Verdant Gemstones. These would shield and heal her new domain.
medeastribute05: The Elder Druids arrived centuries later to discover what had become a bountiful land.
medeastribute06: With Medea's blessing, they tended to the plants and animals, and Windsward flourished to new heights.
medeastribute07: But as centuries passed, the Sorceress developed new ambitions, seeking to claim realms previously beyond her reach.
medeastribute08: The Verdant Gemstones were left in the druids' care; this would now be their garden, their responsibility.
medeastribute09: But the wrath of the Angry Earth struck soon thereafter, and the druids were hopelessly outmatched.
medeastribute10: Medea returned with a fury, purging every last baleful sprig, rescuing Windsward once more.
medeastribute11: For their failure, the druids' exclusive claim was rescinded, and settlers came to Corinth.
medeastribute12: Medea demanded a tribute for her continued protection, hiring the Iron Rose Mercenaries to deliver it.
medeastribute13: Now it seems... something has gone awry yet again. I return home to find our land suffering, and my fellow druids with it.
medeastribute14: Druidic blessings turned to curses. Bounty turned to famine. And life withering away, no hope in sight.

memorials_body_01_01:
The soul is a mysterious thing both on and off Aeternum. 

But even before we came to this strange island, death vexed us with the loss of your mother in the Old World. 

Laura Marie Charron— a woman who went out of her way to better everyone’s day with joy and love. Selfless, radiant, and fearless. It is for her that I dedicate this to writing: that our souls are forever intertwined. 

Adam and Archer, it is my hope you find soulmates as kind and patient with you as your mother was with me. I know out there for you there is a twin flame whose heart burns with the same passion yours does. 

Your mother and I, with the time we were allowed, created two perfect examples of our love: you. Her love for you was beyond the confines of this world and that love lives on in us. Eternal life isn’t limited to what we see here in Aeternum—it is in our very hearts. 

Laura, as you were in life, I know you are always with Adam, Archer, and I. The boys and I will come here to remember you and all you did for us, and all your memory continues to do.  Until we are together again in Paradise, my heart is here with you my love. 

Let this place be blessed as a sanctuary for all who have lost, and all who wish to remember those who came before them.

Honor her shrine, hear her voice, and feel her here with us.

monster_lifestaff_description: "Its kiss giveth life, its sting taketh it away."
monster_rapier_description: "A fearsome beast, now lost to time, donated the bones that form this insidious blade."
monster_voidgauntlet_description: "The murky depths shelter remnants of the primordial darkness.“
monster_warhammer_description: "The spark of life descends from the heavens."
moonlit_guitar_part1_page1_description: Sheet music for Moonlit Shadows for Guitar. Can be learned or brought to an Engineering Station to be researched for additional Trade Skill XP.
moonstonecut_groupdesc: Cut and polished Moonstone Gemstones. Can be crafted into jewelry to increase Strength and Focus, or socketed into equipment to provide the Exhilarate and Slash Ward perks.
moonstonecutt1_description: A gem with an attunement to the Exhilarate I weapon trait and Slash Ward I armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
moonstonecutt2_description: A gem with an attunement to the Exhilarate II weapon trait and Slash Ward II armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
moonstonecutt3_description: A gem with an attunement to the Exhilarate III weapon trait and Slash Ward III armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
moonstonecutt4_description: A gem with an attunement to the Exhilarate IV weapon trait and Slash Ward IV armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
moonstonet1_description: Used in Jewelcrafting, but must be cut and polished at an Outfitting Station first.
moonstonet2_description: Used in Jewelcrafting, but must be cut and polished at an Outfitting Station first.
moonstonet3_description: Used in Jewelcrafting, but must be cut and polished at an Outfitting Station first.
moonstonet4_description: Used in Jewelcrafting, but must be cut and polished at an Outfitting Station first.
mordred_bark_archimideantrap: Such power! Such might at my command!
mordred_bark_phase1to2: The fury of the gods, within me!
mordred_bark_phase2to3: Taste the full might of Winter!
mordred_bark_victory: At last you find your place. At my feet.
mordredsregret01: I can never forget the glory of that day.
mordredsregret02: You would sail for Avalon with a new member of the Round Table-
mordredsregret03: -Ser Mordred. I can still feel the cold weight of Excalibur on my shoulder.
mordredsregret04: But you only loved those who did not love you.
mordredsregret05: Blind to Myrddin's deceit, you thought me the traitor.
mordredsregret06: To save you, I would find proof. Even a way to turn my uncle's magic against him.
mordredsregret07: But Mother stopped me, though she knew the truth.
mordredsregret08: When the Crimson Sorceror marched on Prydwen and sundered the Round Table-
mordredsregret09: You blamed me. You took everything. Title. Honor. Home.
mordredsregret10: Why? Why cast me away when I would give you everything?
mordredsregret11: And then it came to me. It was so simple.
mordredsregret12: The power I sought was never meant for you, Artorius.
mordredsregret14: Be glad, for I will rule as you could not.
mordredsregret15: By Ring and Frosted Crown, Avalon, and all this cold world shall come crashing down.
morgainetruth01: Aeternum's secrets called to us in dreams. Promising vast, ancient knowledge.
morgainetruth02: What we discovered was an entity longing for release.
morgainetruth03: Myrddin believed his spell-craft would ensure protection.
morgainetruth04: But this fell power claimed him for its own.
morgainetruth05: As the Crimson Sorcerer, he became the Herald of Madness.
morgainetruth06: When all else failed, I confronted my brother. Our magics clashed...
morgainetruth07: And then silence. I was forever changed.
morgainetruth08: I knew the Corruption would return. But the power I needed came at a terrible cost.
morgainetruth09: The secrets I sought continued to elude me. But I refused to relent.
morgainetruth10: I became the Corpse Crone, the Curse of Weaver's Fen. The target of foolish Shadow-Hunters.
morgainetruth11: I spent the centuries since alone, preparing. When the Crimson Madness returns, I shall be ready.
mothershope01: My throne stolen, I sailed from my homeland an exile, dreaming of a new home for my people, and...
mothershope03: While so many have trouble adjusting to this island, my people took to Ebonscale Reach.
mothershope04: It was a rebirth of a lost dream, and we flourished. And my son thrived.
mothershope05: On the eve of his adulthood, a strange sickness overcame him...
mothershope07: Prayers! Curatives! Rituals! Wise counsel! There is nothing I did not try!
mothershope09: I vowed to find a way to breach the Stormwall, my intuition said that would save him.
mothershope10: Every attempt failed, and with each failure, my people's suffering increased.
mothershope11: Long have I known of the young upstart. But only now have I accepted her invitation to... listen.
mothershope12: My mother raised no fool. And yet, I admit to you, Isabella's bargain is not unreasonable.
mothershope13: The fleet is now ready to set sail...
mothershope14: Yet my balance falters upon the edge of a step I know I should not take.
mount_horse_gothic_11_description: A horse with a penchant for drama.
mount_horse_patterna4_description: Sold by the horse vendor who assures Benson's good nature and faithfulness is second to none.
mount_horse_patterna8_description: Golda's high opinion of themself is justifiable. They're both powerful and beautiful.
mount_horse_tooltip: Unlocks "My Kingdom for a Horse" quest, which grants the ability to summon a Horse mount.\n\nRequires Rise of the Angry Earth
mount_lion_patterna10_description: Godfrey's always been lucky even as a cub. May their good fortune rub off on you.
mount_lion_patterna1_description: Kodger's sandy orange fur is their source of pride, hence they like to keep it clean.
mount_lion_patterna9_description: Scurge has a certain majestic quality making them the envy of the pride.
mount_wolf_patterna10_description: Wolfgang is the strong, silent type. Until they unleash their deafening howl.
mount_wolf_patterna6_description: Runa's mighty appetite keeps the food bill totting up. Perhaps that's why the vendor is willing to sell such a magnificent beast.
mountattachmentitem_anchor_b_description: This anchor can be attached to the side of your mount.
mountattachmentitem_ancientartifact_desc: It looks amazing. Hopefully, it won't open a portal and let even more horrid creatures on to Aeternum.
mountattachmentitem_blacksmith_descripti: This anvil will come in tremendously handy if you have a hammer.
mountattachmentitem_botanykit_descriptio: For those who've taken a keen interest in plants of all kinds.
mountattachmentitem_clothsack_descriptio: This cloth sack can be attached to the side of your mount.
mountattachmentitem_cooking_description: The cook is always popular. Unless they're a terrible chef. Then, they're usually killed.
mountattachmentitem_covenant_flag_descri: Righteously fly the Covenant flag to convert all the sinners and unholy.
mountattachmentitem_fishing_description: Quite a catch! May your mount speed you to a settlement before it begins to smell!
mountattachmentitem_flag_description: This decorative flag can be attached to the side of your mount.
mountattachmentitem_logging_description: There's no tree you won't chop down to size.
mountattachmentitem_marauder_flag_descri: Proudly fly the Marauder flag so they can see your might.

mut_staminadamage_1_buff_tooltip: Enemies forgo the {[-0.250000 * -100]}% reduced stamina damage in Expeditions.\nEnemies deal {[0.400000 * 100]}% increased stamina damage.\nAdditionally, upon breaking your block, enemies apply a bleed, dealing {[-0.050000 * -100]}% base health damage per tick.
mut_staminadamage_2_blockbreak_bleed_too: Bleeding for {[-0.080000 * -100]}% base health Physical damage every {[2.000000]} seconds.
mut_staminadamage_2_buff_tooltip: Enemies forgo the {[-0.250000 * -100]}% reduced stamina damage in Expeditions.\nEnemies deal {[0.400000 * 100]}/{[0.750000 * 100]}% increased stamina damage.\nAdditionally, upon breaking your block, enemies apply a bleed, dealing {[-0.050000 * -100]}/{[-0.080000 * -100]}% base health damage per tick.
mut_voi_curse1_major_buff_tooltip: Periodically selects a chosen player. That player emits an aura dealing Void damage to nearby players and gains greatly increased Void absorption. (This effect cannot be cleansed by player abilities)
mut_voi_curse1_minor_buff_tooltip: After dodging, you leave a small zone that deals Void damage over time. (This effect cannot be cleansed by player abilities)
mut_voi_curse3_major_buff_tooltip: When selecting the lowest percent health player, all other players are given Shrivelled Weaken, reducing their damage by {[-0.500000 * -100]}% and outgoing healing by {[-0.5 * -100]}%. The selected player gains an aura that cleanses Shrivelled Weaken. (This effect cannot be cleansed by player abilities)
mut_voi_curse3_minor_buff_tooltip: Periodically selects the player with the lowest percent health. After several seconds, the selected player casts chain Void, damaging nearby players {[-0.500000 * -100]}% of their max health. (This effect cannot be cleansed by player abilities)
mut_voi_curse4_minor_buff_tooltip: Using abilities depletes a global affliction. When the affliction is depleted, a zone is cast on all players which silences players in its area. After the affliction expires, the zones detonate dealing {[-0.650000 * -100]}% max health Void damage to players in the radius. (This effect cannot be cleansed by player abilities)
mut_voi_damage_buff_tooltip: Enemies deal {[0.500000 * 100]}% of all damage as Void damage.
mut_voi_death_buff_tooltip: On death, enemies cast a spell granting other enemies in the area Void Empower, increasing their Void damage by {[0.500000 * 100]}%.
mut_voi_leech_1_buff_tooltip: Enemies apply Leech on hit, dealing {[-0.200000 * -100]}% base Void damage and healing the enemy for {[0.900000 * 100]}% damage dealt over time.
mut_voi_leech_1_damage_tooltip: Taking {[-0.200000 * -100]}% base Void damage and healing the caster {[0.900000 * 100]}% of damage dealt, every {[3.000000]} seconds.
mut_voi_leech_2_buff_tooltip: Enemies apply Leech on hit, dealing {[-0.200000 * -100]}/{[-0.300000 * -100]}% base Void damage and healing the enemy for {[0.900000 * 100]}/{[1.200000 * 100]}% damage dealt over time.
mut_voi_leech_2_damage_tooltip: Taking {[-0.300000 * -100]}% base Void damage and healing the caster {[1.200000 * 100]}% of damage dealt, every {[3.000000]} seconds.
mut_voi_stacks_1_buff_tooltip: Enemies apply building stacks of Paranoia when hit. At {[4.000000]} stacks, causes a void burst to appear at your location dealing {[0.400000 * 100]}% base Void damage in a small area.
mut_voi_stacks_1_effect_tooltip: Filled with dread for {[3.000000]} seconds. At {[4.000000]} stacks, causes a void burst to appear at your location.
mut_voi_stacks_2_buff_tooltip: Enemies apply building stacks of Paranoia when hit. At {[4.000000]}/{[4.000000]} stacks, causes a void burst to appear at your location dealing {[0.400000 * 100]}/{[0.700000 * 100]}% base Void damage in a small area.
mut_voi_stacks_2_effect_tooltip: Filled with dread for {[3.000000]} seconds. At {[4.000000]} stacks, causes a void burst to appear at your location.

neweden01: It began when the Ennead awakened, its power moving through the earth.
neweden02: Its light erupting from the tower here in terrible glory.
neweden03: Daring to investigate, they witnessed a hideous transformation...
neweden04: Artemis created an ally, one whose gaze turned flesh to stone.
neweden05: As the Ancient's terror spread, the people of the settlement staged a final stand...
neweden06: But the flora of First Light twisted... and turned against them.
neweden07: The defeated were told they had a greater purpose to serve...
neweden08: Their fates and spirits would be bound... to the birthing of a new world.
neweden09: It appears Artemis then called forth a beastly horde.
neweden10: Primal creatures summoned from some abyssal realm.
neweden11: What followed is madness... obscene acts to make amalgamations of people, beasts, and plants...
neweden12: Our witness, in soulstruck horror, took flight in body... and in mind.
neweden13: Her sanity is now shattered by this mad Ancient's vision for the future.
neweden14: A savage Eden where humanity has no place.
newelysianintro01: The furious vengeance of the Angry Earth has ravaged First Light.
newelysianintro02: We should have seen this coming...
newelysianintro03: I... should have seen this coming.
newelysianintro05: Time has no claim on the Eternal Isle.
newelysianintro07: Mighty Lords, let us cleanse these lands.
newelysianintro10: But the future is fixed for neither man nor beast.

npc_04288_state_0_defaultdialogue: Isn’t Reekwater wonderful! It’s so vibrant here, so alive! If the Soulwardens weren't dying, this is would be an amazing place.
npc_04288_state_1_defaultdialogue: I knew we’d get help, even when everyone else had given up hope. It's been hard on the others, especially with how many we've lost.
npc_04288_state_2_defaultdialogue: It's terrible what's happening to the Soulwardens. We thought our Heartgems made us invincible!
npc_04288_state_3_defaultdialogue: Now that you’ve met everyone, you should join our training exercises. We've been doing them to make sure our Heartgems stay strong, and our wills focused.
npc_04288_state_4_defaultdialogue: I knew we’d get help, even when everyone else had given up hope. It's been hard on the others, especially with how many we've lost.
npc_04288_state_4_defaultdialogue_1: That's wonderful! I had stayed down here in case my message got through to her. We’ve found a library that might help heal the heartgems.
npc_04288_state_4_topic_0_npcresponse: The library is up above. Darshan rushed on ahead, not wanting to waste any time. He was muttering about a key, and facing unknown dangers.
npc_04288_state_4_topic_0_npcresponse_1: Perhaps you can catch up to him and help him with that key? He seems like he could use a hand. I'll let Wiltrud know you made it to us.
npc_04289_state_0_defaultdialogue: The goal of the Soulwardens is to make Reekwater a better place. It’s a lofty goal, I admit, and it keeps us busy.
npc_04289_state_1_defaultdialogue: Please tell me you’re here to help. We’re not desperate, not yet, but you might say we’re balanced on the edge of desperation.
npc_04289_state_2_defaultdialogue: Losing Soulwardens in this place is a blow, but running into the Fallen Soulwardens again after they lost their Heartgems was more than some could take.
npc_04289_state_2_defaultdialogue_1: We don’t know what damages Heartgems this way. Perhaps our process for making them was flawed.
npc_04289_state_3_defaultdialogue: Reekwater may seem like a lost cause at times, but the Soulwardens are making a real impact here.
npc_04289_state_5_defaultdialogue: Do you see what's wrong with the Damaged Heartgems?
npc_04289_state_5_topic_0_npcresponse: Exactly. Now you see what we’re up against. Something is weakening the resolve of the Soulwardens in Reekwater.
npc_04289_state_5_topic_0_npcresponse_1: If only there was a way to strengthen our Heartgems. Hopefully you can help us discover one. We’ve already picked up a few Ancient tricks from the ruins.
npc_04289_state_5_topic_0_npcresponse_2: We managed to piece together enough Ancient machines to make our Soulwarden Armory. It’s truly a marvel. You should visit it to see what you can craft.
npc_04290_state_0_defaultdialogue: You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here. This place – it’s not for people like us.
npc_04290_state_1_defaultdialogue: You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here. This place – it’s not for people like us.
npc_04290_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: How can you say that? We were both at Skyview. But you’ll see. Other places are far worse. You should leave while you can. Forget the swamps, go anywhere else.
npc_04290_state_2_defaultdialogue: The Ancient devices throughout Reekwater, do you know why they are activating?
npc_04290_state_3_defaultdialogue: Why did I have to be stationed here? This is a terrible place, filled with the worst horrors the Ancients unleashed.
npc_04290_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse: Yes, I managed to find the key for the library door. I was on my way back to Asa when I got trapped.
npc_04290_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse_1: You can have the key, and my thanks. I'm glad you showed up, but I'm getting out of here while they are distracted!
npc_04291_state_0_defaultdialogue: I'm not going back out in the swamp. I've lost too many friends who went out, and never came back.
npc_04291_state_1_defaultdialogue: There are things here I’ve never seen anywhere else on Aeternum! Sadly, that includes the loss of my friends, the Soulwardens whose Heartgems were damaged.
npc_04291_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Honestly, not good. I haven't left the settlement since the reports of the last Soulwarden who didn't make it back.
npc_04291_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: I try to put on a brave face, I want to help. But I just can't bring myself to face what's out there. What if I don't come back next time?
npc_04291_state_2_defaultdialogue: By now you have come across the Heartgems of our fallen companions. I have heard rumors of a place where the Damaged Heartgems can be healed.
npc_04291_state_3_defaultdialogue: Who knew that so many of the myths we’ve heard actually exist? Why, just yesterday I learned there really are terrible bear monsters in some caves!
npc_04291_state_4_defaultdialogue: Your courage inspired me to venture forth, but sadly the rumors were incorrect. There’s no altar here. Ah, I see where I went wrong, I had the map sideways.
npc_04291_state_4_topic_0_npcresponse: Ha, yes. It must have been my nerves… The location of the altar is to the west of Farharbor, at Fisher's Glory. This time I'm sure I have it right.
npc_04291_state_4_topic_0_npcresponse_1: You'll check it out for me, won't you? I can't possibly do this on my own.
npc_04292_state_0_defaultdialogue: Did you know the Ancients used to have great machinery set up in Reekwater? Some say it is still active, if you can find it.
npc_04292_state_1_defaultdialogue: I heard you were at Skyview, so you've seen Ancient machinery in action. Those doors! I'd love to learn how they work.
npc_04292_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Very nice! I can't wait to check out those sites! One of them is bound to help us figure out how to fix the Damaged Heartgems.
npc_04292_state_1_topic_0_playerprompt: "Look at the map I found there."
npc_04292_state_2_defaultdialogue: It is said that long ago, the Ancient used to make their Guardians in these festering swamps.
npc_04292_state_2_defaultdialogue_1: They would fire up these great big machines, and to activate the Guardian they would insert some bloody great gem into the center of their chest.
npc_04292_state_3_defaultdialogue: From the information you provided, I've learned of a Guardian Heartforge that is supposed to still be working after all this time!
npc_04293_state_0_defaultdialogue: I bet you love the swamp. Me, I’d give anything to be elsewhere.
npc_04293_state_1_defaultdialogue: Have you ever had a song stuck in your head, to the point where you can't think about anything else?
npc_04293_state_2_defaultdialogue: I have sounded the alarm in Reekwater, but no one understands the danger.
npc_04294_state_0_defaultdialogue: This place is wonderful for my work. So much to analyze, so much to test!
npc_04294_state_1_defaultdialogue: Come here, look at this. See how Azoth seems to uniquely react to the water of Reekwater? It grows into shapes as if it’s living crystals!
npc_04294_state_2_defaultdialogue: I’m so close… I almost have it. I just need more time.
npc_04295_state_0_defaultdialogue: Reekwater punishes the overconfident. The swamps will chew you up and spit you out, if you aren’t prepared.
npc_04295_state_1_defaultdialogue: You look like a survivor. Someone who has been through a lot, and come out on top. That’s a useful skill, here in Reekwater.
npc_04295_state_2_defaultdialogue: Ah, I'm glad you're here. It seems that those beasts have had time to move back into their caves.
npc_04296_state_0_defaultdialogue: We sense an imbalance here. We must make sure the eternal cycle continues unimpeded.
npc_04296_state_1_defaultdialogue: Nature is out of balance. We were sent to tend to this, to soothe that which is unharmonious.
npc_04296_state_2_defaultdialogue: The Protector of the Source still refuses to listen to us. Their mind has been closed off, filled with rage.
npc_04297_state_0_defaultdialogue: Just in case you were wondering - all the drinks I serve are clean.
npc_04297_state_0_defaultdialogue_1: I run all the water I use through six layers of cloth, then triple distill it. Purest water you ever drank.
npc_04297_state_1_defaultdialogue: It’s hard enough finding good help without all the best workers getting lured away.
npc_04297_state_1_defaultdialogue_1: The Siren Queen’s causing trouble, mesmerizing the locals. Listening to her songs causes them to drop everything and run off.
npc_04297_state_2_defaultdialogue: I’d hire more help, but everyone keeps joining that cursed Siren Queen.
npc_1338_masterofceremonies_defaultdialo: My, my, who's this? A hero? A legend?! Come to visit my humble little Medleyfaire? I'm charmed, honored, truly delighted to meet you!
My, my, who's this? A hero? A legend?! Come to visit my humble little Medleyfaire? I'm charmed, honored, truly delighted to meet you!
Now, I speak of no humdrum fish. The Aeternum Sturgeon is the fairest creature in the sea, and fortune favors any who catch one.
But first, you'll need a fat, adorable little Maudlinbug for bait.
I must warn you; the Aeternum Sturgeon may be the finest fish you've ever caught, but they can be a bit challenging.
And of course, you won't be the only angler seeking to land a prize.
Hmm… something's still amiss. And the sorry state of the dance floor won't do at all! Oh, what to do, whom to invite?
Next, we'll need a splash of color. No such thing as too many flowers, and I know just the person.
Bak Ye-Jun. She's new to the island, so she may not have heard of our little party yet.
If you don’t mind meeting someone new, I have an old friend who always worries me this time of year. All furrowed brows and thunderclouds, that one.
Now that we have honey, we need a baker who knows what to do with it.
Mischa Balchunas and her sweet, summery pastries… my mouth waters just thinking about it!
If you'll indulge me, my dear friend, I have one final guest on my mind.
Have you ever read any verse by Blaise Thomas? Others may demur, but I consider him the poet laureate of Aeternum!
The dance floor is bursting, the food and drink are flowing, and the music never stops!
I daresay, this is the finest Medleyfaire I've ever hosted, and I owe so much of it to you.
Welcome one, welcome all, to the Summer Medleyfaire! This year is a complete triumph, thanks to you!
npc_1339_festivaltender_01_defaultdialog: Food and drinks, get your food and drinks! Don't be shy, this banquet won't eat itself!
npc_1340_festivaltender_02_defaultdialog: Kebabs, caviar, and that weird shimmering drink Claudia concocted! It's all here, and all fresh!
npc_1341_bandmember_01_defaultdialogue_0: Keep on dancing, yeah, keep on dancing! We'll keep on playing, all night long!
npc_1342_bandmember_02_defaultdialogue_0: Everybody having fun? Do I need to play LOUDER?
npc_1343_bandmember_03_defaultdialogue_0: This is so much better than stuffy court music. Hah!
npc_1344_fishmounter_00_defaultdialogue_: Wondering how to mount a fish? Don't worry, it gets easier and less smelly every year.
Just bring your catch, and a special Ether Concoction to help preserve it. You can buy the ether with Summer Tokens.
npc_1345_partyguest_01_defaultdialogue_0: Okay! We have seeds to plant, pots to water, stems to trim, vases to clean… It never seems to end!
Okay! We have seeds to plant, pots to water, stems to trim, vases to clean… It never seems to end!
These flowers are looking like they'll be able to sit for awhile without me, so… Yes! I shall attend the Medleyfaire!
The island is so alive here! What a joy! Thank you friend, for allowing me to attend!
npc_1346_partyguest_02_defaultdialogue_0: Oh! Pardon me, I didn't see you waiting. Do you… are you interested in a cake? Or a fruit tart? If not, t-that's all right.
Oh! Pardon me, I didn't see you waiting. Do you… are you interested in a cake? Or a fruit tart? If not, t-that's all right.
I sincerely hope my dance skills are up to par for the Medleyfaire Maestro. See you at the Medleyfaire!
Am I doing it right? The dancing? I-I hope I'm not making a fool of myself.
npc_1347_partyguest_03_defaultdialogue_0: Ah, let me guess. It's that time of year, the Master of Ceremonies "forgot" to find a proper carpenter, and they sent you to sweet-talk me.
Oh, don't look so surprised. It's the same story every year.
Ah, let me guess. It's that time of year, the Master of Ceremonies "forgot" to find a proper carpenter, and they sent you to sweet-talk me.
Oh, don't look so surprised. It's the same story every year.
You attached those vices like a true professional.I'll see you at the Medleyfaire!
Well, the stage doesn't look like it will collapse, and the Medleyfaire Maestro has invited me to dance. So, dance I shall!
npc_1348_partyguest_04_defaultdialogue_0: Oh, the despair! Fresh heartbreak, how it stings! The clouds have swallowed the light of the stars, and never again shall they shine on this poor soul!
Oh, the despair! Fresh heartbreak, how it stings! The clouds have swallowed the light of the stars, and never again shall they shine on this poor soul!
I have never seen such grace, such beauty! I am moved to tears, and I simply must see more of your dancing once I get to the Medleyfaire.
Jubilation and greetings, my inspiring friend! Come, come, come! Dance for me once more so I might be inspired anew!
npc_1349_partyguest_05_defaultdialogue_0: Shoo, begone, you foul buzzing demons! Oh no, I'm so sorry, I didn't mean you. Now I've gone and insulted a perfect stranger…
Shoo, begone, you foul buzzing demons! Oh no, I'm so sorry, I didn't mean you. Now I've gone and insulted a perfect stranger…
Thankfully, the Maudlinbugs tend to be out in the wilds while I get to enjoy the shelter of the Medleyfaire.I shall buy you a drink once we're there!
I don't know… do you think the bees are doing well in my absence? I think it would be all right if I stayed for one more dance. Okay, let's go!
npc_18000_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Nighthaven. We don't get many visitors of your caliber here.
npc_18000_state_1_defaultdialogue: Did Lynette send you? I am her master, Alecksi. I've sent a few lost townsfolk back to Grivaros, but not as many as I had hoped.
npc_18000_state_1_defaultdialogue_1: I've been trying to restore the shield those beasts shut down. I've tracked their movements here, where no doubt they rampaged through the catacombs.
npc_18000_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Ah, I like your eagerness to help. Together, it shouldn't take us long. First we must recover and replace the batteries that power the generators.
npc_18000_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: The batteries are inside the catacombs. I will continue to search the forest for survivors. Retrieve the batteries, then meet me at the House of Varlaam.
npc_18000_state_1_topic_0_playerprompt: "How do we get the shield back up?"
npc_18001_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Nighthaven. We don't get many visitors of your caliber here.
npc_18001_state_1_defaultdialogue: The first step is to wire the batteries to the generator, and the second is to repair the damage those wretched beasts are sure to have caused.
npc_18002_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Nighthaven. We don't get many visitors of your caliber here.
npc_18002_state_1_defaultdialogue: Regretfully, the bridge is still out. It will take ages to repair the damage these beasts have wrought.
npc_18003_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Nighthaven. We don't get many visitors of your caliber here.
npc_18003_state_1_defaultdialogue: You have arrived, at last! And you are just in time... there is to be a ball tonight, and you should not miss it.
npc_18003_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: You remember well. All shall be discussed in time. For now, enjoy yourself at the feast. It is the least I can do to reward your service to Grivaros.
npc_18003_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: Did you bring a gift? No? How could you have known? Worry not, my friend. Fetch the finest vintage from my cellars and the nobility will be just as pleased.
npc_18004_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Nighthaven. We don't get many visitors of your caliber here.
npc_18004_state_1_defaultdialogue: Ah, a fine choice! I am sure this wine will do much to loosen the lips of our guests. There are several courtiers here with a talent for finding unfindable artifacts.
npc_18004_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Take your pick. Though they all compete for my favor, they do share a particular disdain for the Berlaur. They will be eager to help.
npc_18004_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: You are fortunate that everyone who is anyone in Nighthaven is here in attendance. One might consider them a captive audience…
npc_18004_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_2: You may find the answers you seek at the ball. You may also see things strange, and extraordinary -- but do not fear, you have made a powerful friend.
npc_18005_state_0_defaultdialogue: Finding the Tear of Gaea is of utmost importance! Do not let me down! My… friend.
npc_18005_state_1_defaultdialogue: You should share this information with Lynette. If Asena has indeed stolen the Tear, then Lynette will surely find a way to get it back.
npc_18006_state_0_defaultdialogue: You must be new here. I would have remembered seeing someone like you before.
npc_18006_state_1_defaultdialogue: Are you here for the ball? No, you work for Alecksi, don't you? Don't let me keep you.
npc_18006_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: You should be on your way, I'd hate for you to disappoint him. I'm sure Volos gave you baffling directions, but you're on the right path.
npc_18006_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: I’ll tell you this for free: look for hidden levers. Not all dead ends are what they seem.
npc_18007_state_0_defaultdialogue: Thank you for freeing me. I'm sorry about before; I feel like we didn't start off on the right foot.
npc_18007_state_1_defaultdialogue: Thank you for freeing me. I'm sorry about before; I feel like we didn't start off on the right foot.
npc_18007_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: I was overwhelmed, but am otherwise unharmed. I was also sent to retrieve the Tear of Gaea.
npc_18007_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: Asena guards it below. If you're serious about reclaiming it, you'll need to move quickly. The wolfmother has many dens.
npc_18008_state_0_defaultdialogue: Imagine meeting you here! We keep running into each other at the worst places.
npc_18008_state_1_defaultdialogue: I do not know Morgaine's intentions, but I do know that my father will not rest until he finds the Tear.
npc_18009_state_0_defaultdialogue: Leave my father to me. For now, return to the castle and wait for my word.
npc_18009_state_1_defaultdialogue: You said Morgaine has been ill. Has she been fatigued? Sensitive to light, perhaps? I wonder…
npc_18010_state_0_defaultdialogue: This isn't my first trip to the dungeon, sad to say. I know this place like the back of my hand. I'll meet you at the reliquary.
npc_18010_state_1_defaultdialogue: My father is not himself! When I asked him about Morgaine, he accused me of trying to steal the Tear -- and you can imagine what happened next.
npc_18010_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Exactly. I'm not sure what is going on, but if we want to find out, we need to visit my father’s private reliquary.
npc_18010_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: He often spends time there, contemplating the past. If there are clues waiting to be found, I would search there first.

npc_18061_state_2_defaultdialogue: Time is of the essence, and unfortunately there are more ingredients we need... if we are to truly help Morgaine.

npc_18062_state_1_defaultdialogue: The name of the Archive has changed over time. Perhaps too many people knew of it, and the many secrets it guards. What have you discovered?
npc_18063_state_0_defaultdialogue: Oh! Are you trapped in here too? I haven't manged to climb out yet, and I'm terrible at swimming.
npc_18063_state_1_defaultdialogue: Those Berlaur sure were unexpected! They took me by surprise, but I was able to hide here.
npc_18063_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Climbing seems to be the only way. Unfortunately, I can't seem to get the hang of these springboards.
npc_18063_state_1_topic_0_playerprompt: "How do we get out of here?"
npc_18063_state_2_defaultdialogue: If you do get out, could you let Lepădat know where I am? I'm sure he's worrying.
npc_18065_state_0_defaultdialogue: Oh, what I wouldn't do to have our talismans back!
npc_18065_state_1_defaultdialogue: I heard you helped out around Grivaros during the attack. I do hate to impose, but we need your help again!
npc_18066_state_0_defaultdialogue: Imagine cream puffs flavored with oysters and rosemary rat tartlets…!
npc_18066_state_1_defaultdialogue: Excuse me! Are you perchance going into that dreadful cellar ahead?
npc_18067_state_0_defaultdialogue: I'm really more of an artist than a chef. Imagine airy cream puffs flavored with a hint of oyster and rosemary rat tongue tartlets...
npc_18067_state_1_defaultdialogue: I do hope you have what I required. The patrons are getting impatient. I don't know how much longer I can delay them.
npc_18067_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Magnificent! Such firmness. Such plumpness. Such juiciness. Why, it will only be a moment and I will have the hors d'oeuvres read for you to place on the tables.
npc_18068_state_0_defaultdialogue: You found them! Unngh. This one looks as if it's been… chewed on? In any case, thank you so much for your help. I can't wait to hang these back up in the window.
npc_20003_state_0_defaultdialogue: Isn't it magnificent? I could spend all day simply admiring the splendor of the ancient builders.
npc_20003_state_1_defaultdialogue: You look like the enterprising sort who also happens to be striding with a purpose toward the ruins below. Can I trouble you with a request?
npc_20003_state_2_defaultdialogue: These artifacts should be kept safe in a private collection. I'd hate to see them down there in those filthy— I mean magnificent ruins, collecting dust.
npc_20004_state_0_defaultdialogue: Mind where you rest your eyes, traveler. This is not a safe place.
npc_20004_state_1_defaultdialogue: You there. Step closer. Keep your voice low.
npc_20004_state_2_defaultdialogue: I am grateful to you, but you should not associate with us any longer. We cannot take the risk.
npc_20005_state_0_defaultdialogue: Time to show your quality and assure our foothold in these lands! Squash our enemies like bugs!
npc_20005_state_1_defaultdialogue: Time to show your quality and assure our foothold in these lands! Squash our enemies like bugs!
npc_20005_state_2_defaultdialogue: Mind your little experiments don't plant you on the wrong side of this conflict, eh?
npc_20005_state_3_defaultdialogue: Try not to get distracted by all the books. There is work to be done.
npc_20006_state_0_defaultdialogue: So many mysteries here. So much power for the taking, I can hardly contain myself.
npc_20006_state_1_defaultdialogue: So many mysteries here. So much power for the taking, I can hardly contain myself.
npc_20006_state_2_defaultdialogue: Brute force will only get you so far in this land. We look forward to watching you struggle to grasp the true wealth of Nighthaven.
npc_20006_state_3_defaultdialogue: Mind your navel gazing, acolyte -- lest you trip over your ego on the way out.
npc_20007_state_0_defaultdialogue: Humans, Berlaur, and Upyr. Such innate conflict between them. Perhaps the Covenant's wisdom can prevail here.
npc_20007_state_1_defaultdialogue: Humans, Berlaur, and Upyr. Such innate conflict between them. Perhaps the Covenant's wisdom can prevail here.
npc_20007_state_2_defaultdialogue: Cooler heads will prevail, little Adventurer. Be careful where you swing your weapon.
npc_20007_state_3_defaultdialogue: Meddling in forces best left untouched may not give you the best results. Be careful.
npc_20008_state_0_defaultdialogue: Welcome to Tularest. Do you require a place to… rest?
npc_20009_state_0_defaultdialogue: Don't worry, you can sleep late, no need to be up with the dawn here, even if I am!
npc_28000_state_0_defaultdialogue: Be you of ill intent, pass on by these Gates of Pandemonium. Be you of good heart, enter the horrors that lie herein. May all beware!
npc_28000_state_1_defaultdialogue: [The air around the Angel Statue seems to stir, as if in recognition.]
npc_28000_state_2_defaultdialogue_1: [The silence deepens, as if it is slowly turning to stone. There is a final whisper of unseen movement as the gate settles into place. Then that too is gone forever, and you are alone.]
npc_28001_state_1_defaultdialogue: I think this is the complete dialogue.
npc_28001_state_2_defaultdialogue: Your pardon, but the long passage of time has winnowed from me my name. All I remember is that I was... I am... a Lightshield Crusader. The very last of my Order.
npc_28001_state_3_defaultdialogue: I shall await your inevitable victory, though my form is failing me with such rapidity I can barely sense you standing before me.
npc_28001_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse: Ahh... you have done the impossible task and with much grace, in truth. All is darkness in my sight. I cannot see a single finger on this hand of mine. "I have no need of thee"? Ha!
npc_28001_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse_1: But you! You are burnished in such a blinding azure!
npc_28001_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse_2: And I? I am receding, my friend. I am drawn away from you at a tremendous speed. We are distanced as if by centuries. You are star-like. So small, and yet so fiercely bright and unwavering.
npc_28001_state_3_topic_0_npcresponse_3: That I have lived through such times to see such a sight. Praise be...
npc_28002_state_1_defaultdialogue: One day, long ago, this was the site of so many good intentions! Now it is a hollow monument to death, and a grim reminder of our moral failure.
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: Very good. My incorporeal state is increasingly useless, so I must rely on your noble works and diligent hands.
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: But that is an old story now. What you do this day is your story. And our struggle is only now begun.
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_2: Our master tactician, who routed every enemy we encountered on the field of battle, except one. The Warrior King was unyielding. And so he suggested we seek Corruption's power...
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_3: Then his sight turned inwards, so cruelly, found our weakpoints and... culled them, like a barbaric surgeon, until we were a shadow of our glory.
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_4: Just so. Find the statue dedicated to the Sightless One. Burn his eyes, along with the silk. This will force his pestilential spirit hither, and imprison him. Then you must go and slay him.
npc_28002_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_4_: "First, I must deal with the Seraph."
npc_28002_state_2_defaultdialogue: There can be no doubt now, as we have proven the method. Now must you hunt down the remaining vestiges of the Seraphim's humanity and cast them all into cleansing fire.
npc_28002_state_3_defaultdialogue: Your pardon, if it please you. This is not easy. It has... become another ordeal, perhaps even greater than the first.
npc_28002_state_4_defaultdialogue: I apologize for my lacking usefulness. It seems that the less there are of the Seraphim, the less there is of me. Could this be my final death, I wonder?
npc_28002_state_5_defaultdialogue: Oh my friend, I could not have hoped for a more thorough deliverance! To know that my failures exist only within my memories, and no longer in Aeternum... it is a weight I thought would never be lifted!
npc_28003_state_0_defaultdialogue: [You feel an energy reaching out to you, probing the edges of your Heartgem as if for entry.]
npc_28003_state_1_defaultdialogue: [You feel an energy reaching out to you, probing the edges of your Heartgem as if for entry.]
npc_28003_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse: [A deeper silence descends in your presence. It feels like it is watching you. Waiting for you.]
npc_28003_state_1_topic_0_npcresponse_1: Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…
npc_28004_state_0_defaultdialogue: Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse: YOU DO NOT KNOW THE FOLLY OF MANKIND THE DESCENT INTO MADDENING WONDER.
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse_1: THE GRAVES ARE EMPTY AND WE REMAIN, WAITING FOR MORE VESSELS TO FILL TO BURSTING.
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse_2: A HOLLOW PUPPET VOIDED OF INTENT A FOUL CREATED FAILURE OF LOGIC CASTOFF DETRITUS. THEY COULD NOT BECOME US. THEIR GLORY WAS NOT OURS.
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse_4: YOU ARE ALREADY WALKING THEIR PATH. YOUR FOOTSTEPS ON THE PILGRIMAGE OF PAIN. YOU TOUCH THE TREE. YOU RAISE A STAFF. YOU PLAY YOUR PART.
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse_5: WE HAVE IN KNOWING PREPARED YOUR WAY: THE BIRTH PANGS OF THE LONG-AWAITED SLOUGHING. WE GRANT YOU A BOON TO PROVE OUR INEVITABILITY.
npc_28004_state_0_topic_0_npcresponse_6: ABOVE WE PRESERVE RASPING BREATHS UNSCREAMED CENTURIES. THIS BOON IS YOURS WHEN YOU RELEASE THIS CREATURE FROM BONDAGE. SHE HAS TASKS TO PERFORM YET.
npc_28004_state_1_defaultdialogue: Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…
npc_28010_state_0_defaultdialogue: Be careful in the... catacombs. They are full of... nitre. Heh. Heh heh heh...
npc_28013_state_0_defaultdialogue: Too many graves in Nighthaven. Too many! It's glorious! But my arms are going to drop off. I can't keep digging. I must keep digging!
npc_28013_state_1_defaultdialogue: Too many graves in Nighthaven. Too many! It's glorious! But my arms are going to drop off. I can't keep digging. I must keep digging!
npc_28013_state_2_defaultdialogue: The Builder King was an exquisite architect! But not very legible. Amazing style, however! Look at that odd shape there! And this one that resembles a food stain! Brilliant!
npc_28014_state_0_defaultdialogue: [It feels like it's watching you and wants desperately to be your truest friend and give you all the best things in life and go on the greatest adventure that will never, ever end.]
npc_28014_state_1_defaultdialogue: Is that a kind heart I sense down there? Hello, can you see me? I am far above you and so very, very small.
npc_28015_state_0_defaultdialogue: [The Reliquary is at peace and no longer tainted by Corruption.]
npc_28018_state_0_defaultdialogue: Don't worry, you can sleep late, no need to be up with the dawn here, even if I am!
npc_42001_state_0_defaultdialogue: Nighthaven has secrets within secrets, if you know where to look.
npc_42001_state_1_defaultdialogue: Oh, hello Soulwarden. I've been waiting to meet you.
npc_42001_state_2_defaultdialogue: Soulwarden, I imagine these fragments were not easy to find, but...
npc_42001_state_3_defaultdialogue: We've come so far, but there are still more fragments to be found in the darkest corners of Nighthaven.
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_1: Why... yes. YES! I think you have! I feel... relief. Clarity.
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_1_prom: "I believe I have found them all."
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_2: I think we've done all that we need to. I believe the voice who wanted these -- who needed these -- is whole again. Or as close to whole as they can be.
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_2_prom: "What should we do with them now?"
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_3: They would like to speak with you as well. They're in a secluded place, not far from here. Lend me your map, I'll mark where they are.
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_3_prom: "I would like to speak with them."
npc_42001_state_4_defaultdialogue_4: Me? I don't know! I feel a weight off of me, but I can't explain why... For now, I will enjoy the relief, then... who knows? Perhaps I'll return to my studies.
npc_42002_state_0_defaultdialogue: I will need to refamiliarize myself with Nighthaven. Much has changed since I once walked these lands.
npc_61000_state_0_defaultdialogue: Such a ponderous affliction that created the Berlaur.
npc_61000_state_0_defaultdialogue_2: I have learned so much and so little- namely that I need to rethink my strategy of choosing apprentices.
npc_61000_state_1_defaultdialogue: Ah, you there! Spare a moment, if you would please?
npc_61000_state_2_defaultdialogue: Poor Ejnar, the boy was always foolhardy. Sounds like he took it upon himself to try and contain the outbreak at Piatra Antica. Go there and convince him to come back, will you?
npc_default_dialogue_00_hunterjulio: Hey there. Always nice to see a friendly face out here. If there's anything you need, just ask.
npc_default_dialogue_00_researcherling: Where's Theo with that bear repellent? Did he get distracted again?
npc_default_dialogue_00_researcherlubin: Have you seen any bears? Did they say anything about me?
npc_default_dialogue_00_researcherpiper: Hello! I'd love to chat, but the bears might overhear.
npc_default_dialogue_00_researcherrinde: Oh boy, I must have pissed off someone at headquarters to get this assignment.
npc_default_dialogue_00_theophrastus: Can't talk yet. Must monitor the experiment, very volatile. Must watch the condensation… mustn't talk… mustn't... sleep…
npc_default_dialogue_01_hunterjulio: Heard you tromping through the brush from yards out. Thought you were one of those Syndicate clowns. They scare off the game.
npc_default_dialogue_01_researcherling: Now I can finally concentrate on my work.
npc_default_dialogue_01_researcherlubin: It's probably for the best that the bears and I don't become best friends… Gotta keep a professional distance.
npc_default_dialogue_01_researcherpiper: Every time I don't get eaten by a bear, I'll think of you.
npc_default_dialogue_01_researcherrinde: Thanks for the urine, I guess.
npc_default_dialogue_01_theophrastus_a: But I don't mean to be rude, just thought you were delivering my alembics.
npc_default_dialogue_01_theophrastus_b: Let me introduce myself - my parents named me Theophrastus Bombastus. They were otherwise good parents. But you can call me 'Doctor Theo'.
npc_default_dialogue_02_hunterjulio: Now I can avoid accidentally stepping on those field researchers…because they reek of bear urine.
npc_default_dialogue_02_theophrastus_a: But I don't mean to be rude to a fellow Syndicate member, especially.
npc_default_dialogue_02_theophrastus_b: Let me introduce myself - my parents named me Theophrastus Bombastus. They were otherwise good parents. But you can call me 'Doctor Theo'.
npc_default_dialogue_03_theophrastus_a: With the bear threat eliminated, we can study the physio-botanical aspects of this region further.
npc_default_dialogue_03_theophrastus_b: I have a theory, you see, about Corruption and the Angry Earth.
npc_default_dialogue_1307_00_commander: You shall refer to me as Mistress Bergeron. I hope you like it as much as I do.
npc_default_dialogue_1307_01_commander: Stand upright and look me in the eye when you address me, Marauder. Now what is your business?
npc_default_dialogue_1307_01pre_commande: Stand upright and look me in the eye when you address me, Marauder. Now what is your business? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1307_02_commander: Turn around, weak one, and return the direction from which you approached.
npc_default_dialogue_1307_03_commander: I am here on official business. I have no time to trifle with you.
npc_default_dialogue_1307_04_commander_a: Greetings, Gladiator {playerName}. I understand you continue on your path to glory.
npc_default_dialogue_1307_04_commander_b: Are you now prepared to face the trial to become a Ravager?
npc_default_dialogue_1307_04pre_commande: Greetings, Gladiator {playerName}. I understand you continue on your path to glory. Are you now prepared to face the trial to become a Ravager? \n[ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1307_05_commander: Hail, fellow warrior! Your presence honors us here in the Fen. Come, let's not allow your talents to go to waste!
npc_default_dialogue_1307_05pre_commande: Hail, fellow warrior! Your presence honors us here in the Fen.
Come, let's not allow your talents to go to waste! [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1308_00_alchemist: Why continue to wander alone when the Syndicate offers so much?
npc_default_dialogue_1308_01_alchemist: Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you?
npc_default_dialogue_1308_01pre_alchemis: Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1308_02_alchemist: You may be surprised to know that la famille Rubis has a lineage of great warriors.
npc_default_dialogue_1308_03_alchemist: To be free to practice the religion of your conscience without persecution.
npc_default_dialogue_1308_04_alchemist_a: Some find the smell of the swamp offensive, but I find it quite delightful!
npc_default_dialogue_1308_04_alchemist_b: Ah, but it's you, Scrivener {playerName}! And you are prepared to advance in rank as well?
npc_default_dialogue_1308_04pre_alchemis: Some find the smell of the swamp offensive, but I find it quite delightful! Ah, but it's you, Scrivener {playerName}! And you are prepared to advance In rank as well? \n[ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1308_05_alchemist: The specimens you gathered are helping me learn a great deal about the Fen. Now, what else can we do to benefit the Syndicate?
npc_default_dialogue_1308_05pre_alchemis: The specimens you gathered are helping me learn a great deal about the Fen.
Now, what else can we do to benefit the Syndicate? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1309_00_adjudicator: Those who are truly blind cannot see even in the light.
npc_default_dialogue_1309_01_adjudicator: If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee?
npc_default_dialogue_1309_01pre_adjudica: If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1309_02_adjudicator: Arrogance invites ruin. Humility receives benefits.
npc_default_dialogue_1309_03_adjudicator: The bird does not sing because he has the answer. He sings because he has a song.
npc_default_dialogue_1309_04_adjudicator: The Spark shines brightly in the Fen with you here, Templar {playerName}. And it seems you have now proven yourself worthy of further advancement.
npc_default_dialogue_1309_04pre_adjudica: The Spark shines brightly in the Fen with you here, Templar {playerName}.
And it seems you have now proven yourself worthy of further advancement. [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1309_05_adjudicator: You are always welcome to fight for justice with us here in Weaver's Fen. Wherever you go, however, may the light of the Spark go with you.
npc_default_dialogue_1309_05pre_adjudica: You are always welcome to fight for justice with us here in Weaver's Fen.
Wherever you go, however, may the light of the Spark go with you. [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1310_00_barkeep: Some folks are saying that a warm cup of mead is the perfect way to stave off the illness.
npc_default_dialogue_1322_00_innkeep: Takes a certain kind to travel through the Fen. You best be warned I'll have my eye on you, stranger.
npc_default_dialogue_1322_00_innkeep_b: No matter, make yourself comfortable. Just not too comfortable.
npc_default_dialogue_1322_01_innkeep: I was skeptical when I first saw you stroll by here - but you've proven me wrong.
npc_default_dialogue_1322_01_innkeep_b: Weaver's Fen's in a better place than when you found it. Have you heard about Restless Shore though?
npc_default_dialogue_1322_02_innkeep: Always good to see a familiar face back here in the Fen. People are still talking about all you did here.
npc_default_dialogue_1502_00_magistrate_: If you've come to the Restless Shore seeking adventure, I suspect you will get more than you bargained for.
Some people will ignore what is right in front of their eyes, but we will all see, soon enough.
npc_default_dialogue_1502_01_magistrate_: Greetings, traveler. Are you perchance the hero I've heard about? Yes, I thought so.
I'm glad you've come. The blasted Lost here have gone to war with each other, if you can believe that.
npc_default_dialogue_1502_02_magistrate_: The Withered most certainly had acquired an advantage in battle, but while you were away, I learned of something new.
The Lost pirates - they are not just fighting - they are fishing as well!
npc_default_dialogue_1502_03_magistrate: The thing I've been wondering about - if the Lost here are getting this new sense of purpose, don't you think it's probably happening elsewhere as well?
npc_default_dialogue_1502_04_magistrate_: You are not going to believe this, my friend, but all our work with Constable Muller may have backfired.
Now, the Lost are the only threat she wants to think about.
npc_default_dialogue_1502_05_magistrate_: You have dealt with threats from both the Lost and Corrupted - that is nothing less than heroic, {playerName}.
Every being in Restless Shore owes you a debt of gratitude.
npc_default_dialogue_1503_00_survivalist: I have walked the wilds of eastern Aeternum for as far back as I can remember, but it no longer seems safe.
Strange things are afoot in Restless Shore, my friend. Strange things.
npc_default_dialogue_1503_01_survivalist: Now, I've seen my fair share of magic and miracle since coming to this island, but not like this.
The wildlife here in Restless Shore's fallen under some bizarre new influence from the Angry Earth.
npc_default_dialogue_1503_02_survivalist: Let's just hope Fangsnap was the only creature out there infected by this Lycanthropy.
I can't even imagine if something like this became widespread.
npc_default_dialogue_1503_03_survivalist: I have some unfortunate news, my friend. I have reason to believe Fangsnap was not the only lycanthrope in Restless Shore.
I have seen tracks suggesting the presence of a were-boar, as well.
npc_default_dialogue_1503_04_survivalist: I've seen no more tracks suggesting the lycanthropy spread beyond the wolf and the boar.
I did see some suspicious bear tracks, however…
npc_default_dialogue_1504_00_overseer_a: Everyone is so bent out-of-shape about Shattered Mountain, I swear they are starting to imagine things.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_00_overseer_b: This too shall pass, right? That's my motto, and I'm sticking to it.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_01_overseer_a: Welcome to Restless Shore. I can't tell you what a relief it is to see a new face here with clear eyes.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_01_overseer_b: I swear, everyone in this settlement has gone mad!
npc_default_dialogue_1504_02_overseer_a: I'll start redestributing all the stolen items soon.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_02_overseer_b: Let's hope that'll put everyone's mind at ease and stop all this nonsense they're talking.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_03_overseer_a: Alright. Let's say it's true - the Lost are getting smarter.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_03_overseer_b: The coastal pirates and the Withered aren't too worrisome - what would scare me is if we saw more activity at Fort Damnation.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_04_overseer_a: No matter what, If the Lost to the north are also showing signs of these advanced tactics, we've got trouble.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_04_overseer_b: Odds are that this whole thing's being directed from the Fort.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_05_overseer_a: I wish I could say I'll be resting easier with Admiral Reis destroyed, but that's just not the case.
npc_default_dialogue_1504_05_overseer_b: This whole thing with the Lost…it's got me more than a little worried for the longterm.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_00_artificer_a: Believe it or not, there was a time when we enjoyed relative peace on Aeternum.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_00_artificer_b: These days, there are as many wars as there are people.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_01_artificer_a: Ah, {playerName}! Gurkin says you've been recruited to our cause. I'm right glad to meet you.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_01_artificer_b: He's going to try again to convince Muller, but meanwhile, we got work to do.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_02_artificer_a: Sad to say Gurkin had less success than you did. Constable Muller's as stubborn as ever.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_02_artificer_b: Even bigger problem though, is now we got things really out of balance.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_03_artificer_a: Let's just hope Muller's not going to back out on us.
npc_default_dialogue_1505_03_artificer_b: I worry it's just too easy for her to slip back into denial, and that's something we can't afford.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_00_commander: Be warned that the Pirates around here take no quarter. You would be wise to ally with a powerful group like I did.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_01_commander: Welcome to Restless Shore, Marauder. There is much to do here and I humbly seek your help.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_01pre_commande: Welcome to Restless Shore, Marauder. There is much to do here and I humbly seek your help.[ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1507_02_commander: I fear you are mistaken, my genius friend. I have nothing to say to you.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_03_commander: Well, thank you for your concern, but I have all I need as a proud bearer of the Marauder's banner.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_04_commander_a: Ah, it is nice to finally meet you, {playerName}. You are quite notorious, you know.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_04_commander_b: Your trial to become a Gladiator was such a scandal, and now you are ready to become a Ravager.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_04pre_commande: Ah, it is nice to finally meet you, {playerName}. You are quite notorious, you know.
Your trial to become a Gladiator was such a scandal, and now you are ready to become a Ravager. [ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1507_05_commander: To face the dangers of Restless Shores and not become Lost, you are a fine warrior indeed.I am privileged to call you a comrade!
npc_default_dialogue_1507_05pre_commande: To face the dangers of Restless Shores and not become Lost, you are a fine warrior indeed.
I am privileged to call you a comrade! [ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1507_06_commander: I heard about what happened with Ravager Silas. It was… regrettable.Still, I am glad it is you who is still with us, and not her.
npc_default_dialogue_1507_06pre_commande: I heard about what happened with Ravager Silas. It was… regrettable.
Still, I am glad it is you who is still with us, and not her. [ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1508_00_alchemist: My dear traveler, be aware. All kinds of pirates and ruffians surround our fair town.
npc_default_dialogue_1508_01_alchemist: It so inspires me to discourse with one of our own. To what do I owe this auspicious meeting?
npc_default_dialogue_1508_01pre_alchemis: It so inspires me to discourse with one of our own. To what do I owe this auspicious meeting?[ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1508_02_alchemist: I know you mean well, but you Marauders are like a hammer in a sewing kit.
npc_default_dialogue_1508_03_alchemist: Did you know that I too once followed the Spark? I also used to believe in Pelznickel. However, I matured.
npc_default_dialogue_1509_00_adjudicator: Indulge not, and remain vigilant. The Covenant is watching. Always.
npc_default_dialogue_1509_01_adjudicator: By the grace of the light, my belief has been rewarded! I had hoped for the aid of a hero, and here you are.
npc_default_dialogue_1509_01pre_adjudica: By the grace of the light, my belief has been rewarded! I had hoped for the aid of a hero, and here you are.[ Level 39 required for Restless Shores faction missions ]
npc_default_dialogue_1509_02_adjudicator: Without the Spark to guide you, you're just another brute with a sword.
npc_default_dialogue_1509_03_adjudicator: Do you suppose I could fit the book up your arse? I mean, may the light protect you.
npc_default_dialogue_1510_00_barkeep_a: That which you focus on is that which you become, traveler.
npc_default_dialogue_1510_00_barkeep_b: This is why we must drink and be merry - happiness is the recipe for good fortune.
npc_default_dialogue_1510_01_barkeep: Well, it is happy times around here since you showed up. Have you heard the news from Mourningdale, though? It is truly a tragedy.
npc_default_dialogue_1510_02_barkeep_a: Well now, it's good to know Barkeep Brewell's still got their hands on the taps over there in Mourningdale.
npc_default_dialogue_1510_02_barkeep_b: They'll get through their difficults, I'm sure. Just like we did.
npc_default_dialogue_1522_00_innkeep: I have a feeling I'll be seeing more of you than either of us would like. Well, come on in. Might as well get familiar with the Sunken Compass.
npc_default_dialogue_1523_00_fisher: Hey hey, I'm Master Fisher O'Connor! What's new?
npc_default_dialogue_1523_01_fisher: Not that I have any intentions of fighting you - that would be foolish.Besides, you look like an aspiring young Fisher yourself.
npc_default_dialogue_1523_02_fisher: Hope those drowned weapons are serving you well, or at least fetched you a fine price in trading!
npc_default_dialogue_1524_00_boatswain: Have we met before? I'm Santiago Salazar. Hmm, is that is my name? It's so easy to forget oneself.
npc_default_dialogue_1524_01_boatswain: Pardon, have we met? Sorry, my mind's a blur. Been wandering this beach for... I've forgotten how long. It's dreadful, not remembering...
npc_default_dialogue_1524_01a_boatswain: Pardon, have we met? Sorry, my mind's a blur. Been wandering this beach for... I've forgotten how long. It's dreadful, not remembering...
npc_default_dialogue_1524_02_boatswain_a: Navigating my memories is like sailing at night through a thick fog.
npc_default_dialogue_1524_02_boatswain_b: And now you say I was never on those ships? I feel awful for sending you to those dangerous places.
npc_default_dialogue_1524_03_boatswain_a: My memory slowly returns thanks to you. I now remember how I came to this cursed island.
npc_default_dialogue_1524_03_boatswain_b: We were merchants captured by pirates and brought here against our will!
npc_default_dialogue_1524_04_boatswain_a: It’s all becoming clearer now - my purpose, my past. I remember there was a mutiny on our pirate ship.
npc_default_dialogue_1524_04_boatswain_b: We threw Scurvyhook overboard. But somehow the bastard survived.
npc_default_dialogue_1525_00_angryearth_: Have you not been told that staring into the foliage invites attacks from that which you cannot see?
No? Let this be your first warning, human.
npc_default_dialogue_1525_01_angryearth_: To stare into the foliage invites attack, for the land takes advantage of hesitancy.
Under normal circumstances, we would gladly take you up on the offer of a fight, but these are not normal circumstances.
npc_default_dialogue_1525_02_angryearth_: Your confusion is evident. These are dark times with our minds divided.
Many in Verdant Ascent do not support visiting Edengrove to discover what has happened. They are root bound and have settled into unhealthy ways.
npc_default_dialogue_1525_03_angryearth_: If we may impose upon you once more. We are well armed for our journey, but we are still lacking one important element.
It is unwise to head into the unknown without a secure source of sustenance.
npc_default_dialogue_1525_04_angryearth_: Do you know what a pleasure it is to hear ourselves think? The other minds are not so loud here, away from the bustle of Eridanus.
Perhaps we shall enjoy some time to ourselves before heading off to check on Edengrove.
npc_default_dialogue_1526_00_naturalist: Shh! You'll disturb the wildlife! We must tread carefully, for we share the land with all types of creatures.
npc_default_dialogue_1526_01_naturalist_: Have you noticed anything off about the wildlife in the Sunshade Plains? This place is teeming with animals! But some of them are very out of place.
They don’t belong here. Just like us, we don't belong here.
npc_default_dialogue_1526_02_naturalist_: Now that we know this area has been tampered with, we need to find out what other harm those poachers have done.
I have my suspicions, but it would be good to have hard evidence.
npc_default_dialogue_1526_03_naturalist_: This is terrible! Imagine, if it hadn’t been for me, they would still be doing this.
Even so, I was too late. I wasn't able to stop them. Those poor wolves…
npc_default_dialogue_1527_00_wader_a: Have you seen that roguish treasure hunter, Xue? Doesn't he cut a dashing figure?
npc_default_dialogue_1527_00_wader_b: I wish I knew what treasure he was searching for so I could give it to him.
npc_default_dialogue_1527_01_wader_a: Have you seen that handsome treasure hunter, Xue? He's such a scoundrel. And I find that irresistible.
npc_default_dialogue_1527_01_wader_b: If only I was half as confident! I’d court him in a heartbeat!
npc_default_dialogue_1527_02_wader_a: You’ve inspired me! I’m going to offer Xue my services as an aquatic treasure hunter.
npc_default_dialogue_1527_02_wader_b: I still want to give him Poseidon’s Goblet, but I don’t want to make it seem like a bribe.
npc_default_dialogue_1527_03_wader_a: I’m so nervous! Do you think Xue will agree to being partners?
npc_default_dialogue_1527_03_wader_b: I just don’t know what to say when he's around. What if he thinks I’m foolish?
npc_default_dialogue_1528_00_rogue: Why hello! What brings you to my stretch of beach? There's a wealth of treasure to be found here, if you know where to look.
npc_default_dialogue_1528_01_rogue_a: Give me predictable terrors any day over the unknown. The pirates on the beach have their habits. Even the alligators have their set ways.
npc_default_dialogue_1528_01_rogue_b: But the fickle sea? It strikes without warning, taking everything from you.
npc_default_dialogue_1528_02_rogue: Are my clothes clean? Is my hair tidy? I want to make sure I make a good impression when I meet with Wafa.
npc_default_dialogue_1599_01_nekumanesh: Rrrrr… (The alligator seems hungry and weak.)
npc_default_dialogue_1601_00_gideon: Be careful when traveling outside the city. An invasionary force gathers out there!
npc_default_dialogue_1601_01_gideon_a: New Corsica is in desperate need of able-bodied heroes.
npc_default_dialogue_1601_01_gideon_b: The Corrupted Legion will overrun this city unless we can find a way to stop them.
npc_default_dialogue_1601_02_gideon: Your courage has given New Corsica a chance to resist Crassus. The people thank you!
npc_default_dialogue_1602_00_crassus: You are not familiar to me. And I do not know a Tribune Kraus. Where is everyone? What happened to the fort?
npc_default_dialogue_1602_01_crassus: So much has changed. How could I have been dreaming for so long? I must gather my wits about me…
npc_default_dialogue_1602_02_crassus_a: Prefect Drusilla commands these soldiers. She’s a bloodthirsty warmonger who serves only her own ambition.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_02_crassus_b: I always considered her a disgrace to the Legion. The Corruption must have found its way into the 19th through her.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_03_crassus_a: Drusilla has a bodyguard named Magnus. He’s a giant of a Gaul who could kill most men with his bare hands.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_03_crassus_b: The other centurions greatly fear and respect him. He is a symbol of Drusilla’s power.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_04_crassus: The success of your raids has left the camp in disarray! Drusilla will seek to close ranks with her tribunes. She’s always so predictable.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_05_crassus: Drusilla must feel as if she’s stalked by Nemesis herself. I wouldn’t be surprised if the invasion of New Corsica was entirely her design.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_06_crassus: I humbly beg your pardon. This letter… comes as a terrible shock…
npc_default_dialogue_1602_07_crassus: The defense of New Corsica continues. Steel yourself for the coming conflict.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_08_crassus_a: There you are, friend! I’ve spoken to Prefect Severan. He’s recalling the remaining Praetorians and securing the city.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_09_crassus: There are many evils that plague this land. Soon there will have to be a reckoning.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_10_crassus_a: I wanted to believe that the noble man who sacrificed so much, the loyal soul who loved friends and family, the champion who diligently protected the people of New Corsica, still existed.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_10_crassus_b: But I must face the truth.
npc_default_dialogue_1602_11_crassus: Hail, hero of New Corsica! Your deeds shall endure as long as the stars!
npc_default_dialogue_1603_00_barnabas: Welcome to New Corsica, stranger. I apologize for the state of our city but we live in troubled times.
npc_default_dialogue_1603_01_barnabas: New Corsica welcomes you, traveler. I am Prefect Barnabas Severan. I must apologize for the state of our city but we live in troubled times.
npc_default_dialogue_1603_03_barnabas: Word of your remarkable deeds is spreading, noble warrior. New Corsica salutes you!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_00_charmion_a: The gods prepare to return, stranger! They judge our every deed, word, and thought!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_00_charmion_b: Do not anger them, lest you suffer their divine wrath!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_01_charmion: New Corsica has lost its way! We have displeased the gods and now evil sweeps over these lands led by a terrible demon!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_02_charmion: If we do not prove ourselves worthy, the gods will never return! We must prepare the way! An age of enlightenment awaits us!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_03_charmion: What will become of us? Repent before it is too late! I pray the gods have mercy upon us all!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_04_charmion: Be warned, New Corsica! The tyrant’s son has returned! We must be vigilant! There is a venomous serpent in our midst!
npc_default_dialogue_1604_05_charmion: I must prepare the way… I do this for you, my beloved… enlightenment will come to the people…
npc_default_dialogue_1605_00_akila: Greetings, pilgrim. The gods once inhabited this holy site. Tread with reverence for they are watching.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_01_akila: The idols here were once vessels for the gods. The Pontifex believes that with the proper holy relic, we may call upon their power to aid us in our time of need.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_02_akila: The relic’s dimensions must be precise. A hand in length, a palm in breadth, two digits in height… Yes, that’s correct!
npc_default_dialogue_1605_03_akila: There! The holy relic is done. It’s far more beautiful than I imagined. I put the hope of New Corsica in your hands, noble hero.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_04_akila: I have failed the people of New Corsica and exposed you to terrible danger. Please forgive my unworthiness.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_05_akila: Please allow me time for quiet reflection. I must pray for forgiveness and seek to atone for my failure.
