npc_default_dialogue_1605_06_akila: One thing has become clear to me: The Pontifex has lost her reason. The long centuries have proven too much for her mind. For her, immortality proved to be a curse.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_07_akila: Oh goodness, it seems the Pontifex once loved Crassus. She calls him by his first name, Lucius. She’s even written romantic poetry about him…
npc_default_dialogue_1605_08_akila_a: According to the Codex, the Prime Key can be reassembled in something called the Forge of Ptah.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_08_akila_b: It requires a special code to ignite it, but I believe that code can be found near the forge itself.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_09_akila: With the Prime Key, I believe we now have hope of stopping Crassus and preventing another curse from being unleashed upon the land.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_10_akila: There you are! I’ve finished translating the glyphs in the Forge of Ptah. I know the purpose of the Prime Key.
npc_default_dialogue_1605_11_akila: The gods of this land bless you, noble hero. You are truly their chosen champion.
npc_default_dialogue_1606_00_ambrosius_a: How is an honest, hardworking merchant to make a living under these wretched conditions?
npc_default_dialogue_1606_00_ambrosius_b: It’s a disgrace to New Corsica and to our patrons.
npc_default_dialogue_1606_01_ambrosius_a: Look at this wreckage! It’s a disgrace! Where are the blasted Praetorians?
npc_default_dialogue_1606_01_ambrosius_b: New Corsica’s already battered reputation may not survive this latest calamity!
npc_default_dialogue_1606_02_ambrosius_a: Well, I still insist that monster was a manticore! And you singlehandedly destroyed it!
npc_default_dialogue_1606_02_ambrosius_b: Why, your legend will outshine even that of noble Evandrus!
npc_default_dialogue_1607_00_commander: I am here on official Marauder business. I have no time to trifle with you. Why don't you come back when you've got some guts!
npc_default_dialogue_1607_01_commander: Well met, fellow Marauder! What trophies have you taken lately?
npc_default_dialogue_1607_02_commander: Pah, you're in the wrong place. Go beg the gods for help, or whatever it is you do.
npc_default_dialogue_1607_03_commander: Walk back the way you came. Unless you're looking for a good fight…
npc_default_dialogue_1607_04_commander: Ah, the sight of you warms this old warrior's heart. Keep winning glory, for mighty Mars and the Marauders!
npc_default_dialogue_1608_00_alchemist: Begone! I have time only for those who crave knowledge. The Syndicate keeps to our own.
npc_default_dialogue_1608_01_alchemist: Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you?
npc_default_dialogue_1608_02_alchemist: Spare me your misguided idealism. My time is too valuable to waste with you.
npc_default_dialogue_1608_03_alchemist: You're looking for Commander Maximo, Marauder. My words would be meaningless to you.
npc_default_dialogue_1608_04_alchemist: If only there were more members of the Syndicate like you. Think of all we could achieve, the vast ambitions we could realize…
npc_default_dialogue_1609_00_adjudicator: Hmm… Those who are truly blind cannot see even in the light.
Once you have taken the scales from your eyes and sided with the Covenant, then we may do business.
npc_default_dialogue_1609_01_adjudicator: If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee?
npc_default_dialogue_1609_02_adjudicator: Those who live by the sword will perish by it. Be on your way, Marauder.
npc_default_dialogue_1609_03_adjudicator: Are you here to make amends for your hubris? Let me know if you change your mind.
npc_default_dialogue_1609_04_adjudicator: You are a beacon of hope and life in these trying times. Every deed, from the humble to the great, kindles the light in all of us.
npc_default_dialogue_1610_00_barkeep: The Legion's at our door, and the Ancients are rampaging across the sands. Let us drink and laugh while we can!
npc_default_dialogue_1612_00_clermont: Hearken to me, traveler! These roads are dangerous. Be on your guard!
npc_default_dialogue_1612_01_clermont_a: These Praetorians were to guard the roads so citizens could evacuate the city. We'd received troubling reports of bandits so I was dispatched to check on their status.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_01_clermont_b: I found their camp abandoned and no sign of any of them.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_01a_clermont_a: Praise the gods! I’ve been desperate to send word to New Corsica.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_01a_clermont_b: The Praetorians assigned to this camp are missing, and I couldn't abandon this post.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_02_clermont_a: Malatesta joined the Praetorians a few years ago. There were some problems at first and he almost mustered out.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_02_clermont_b: Eventually, he overcame his personal demons and rose quickly through the ranks.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_03_clermont: Prefect Severan must be informed of the situation here. The roads are more perilous than ever. I wish I had better news.
npc_default_dialogue_1612_04_clermont: The defense of our roads will continue. Oh, should you encounter any Corrupted or Lost on the roads, I’d appreciate you eliminating the threat.
npc_default_dialogue_1613_00_alaina: You have entered a desperate battlefield, stranger! Be ready to defend yourself against the Corrupted!
npc_default_dialogue_1613_01_alaina_a: Crassus has split his legion. He has taken the First Cohort to assault Akhet.
npc_default_dialogue_1613_01_alaina_b: I believe he intends to invade the sacred temple as he did centuries ago.
npc_default_dialogue_1613_02_alaina_a: Your courage and skill are inspiring, but the sight of those siege engines darkens my hopes.
npc_default_dialogue_1613_02_alaina_b: The 19th Legion is a formidable enough enemy without them.
npc_default_dialogue_1613_03_alaina: Well done, noble hero! This Hydra’s Breath will burn those blasted siege weapons to the ground!
npc_default_dialogue_1613_04_alaina: You must find the noble Evandrus Crassus! He may prove a great ally to our cause!
npc_default_dialogue_1613_05_alaina: Your deeds will never be forgotten! New Corsica would be fortunate to have you as a citizen!
npc_default_dialogue_1614_00_guard: This place holds many dangers for the unwary. Make sure your weapon is at the ready, and keep your wits about you.
npc_default_dialogue_1615_00_nicabar: There is never enough wine around when you need it. I am simply parched and could do with a cold drink.
npc_default_dialogue_1616_00_speculatore: Greetings, Seeker. I'm tracking the movements of the 19th Legion. My task, I fear, will never be finished.
npc_default_dialogue_1617_00_publius_a: My farm was all but destroyed the last time I needed to travel to New Corsica.
npc_default_dialogue_1617_00_publius_b: I swear, I never know what will happen next when I am away. But I must visit the city for supplies.
npc_default_dialogue_1618_00_caeso: I hope you have paid your taxes recently! If you have, you needn't worry about a visit from me, Caeso, Frumen of New Corsica!
npc_default_dialogue_1622_00_innkeep: Welcome to the Thermae, my friend - the finest place to rest in all of Brimstone Sands!
npc_default_dialogue_1622_01_innkeep: Thank you for the delivery… and your discretion. For you, the baths are complimentary!
npc_default_dialogue_1624_00_imhotep_v1p: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />As Ghazi noted, the Angry Earth has not<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" /> been a significant force here for hundreds of years.
<g id="g_female_youknow" />Their fearsome presence has multiplied by a significant factor recently. That never happens by chance.
<g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />This device is of Ancient make. I recognize the distinctive markings and construction. It’s a focus for some kind of power.
<g id="g_female_headshakesmall" />But I’ve never seen one exactly like this before.
npc_default_dialogue_1624_00_imhotep_v2p: Apophis is a Primordial, one of the powerful elders of the Angry Earth. I had believed him banished long ago.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands"  bin="2" bout="2"/>Apophis is a Primordial, an elder of the Angry Earth we believed banished. His return heralds the destruction of humanity.
His return can only mean destruction. Possibly even another Great Purge.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />The scrolls speak of a process that combines the bodies and souls of different creatures together into a chimera.
This is the blasphemous power that the Ancients used to create the Primordials.
npc_default_dialogue_1624_00_imhotep_v4p: <g id="g_female_clasphandsrequest" />I’m afraid I must ask you for one final boon. Given what you’ve done,<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> I feel almost selfish making this request.
<g id="g_male_spreadhands" />But I would trust only you to undertake this most important task.
<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />It is good to see hope restored to these sands, but I must confess that I am troubled by the reactivation of the Ennead.
<g id="g_female_explains" />Knowing that Artemis is involved and that she sought to raise Sutekh… it does not bode well.
npc_default_dialogue_1624_01_imhotep_v2p: <g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> The Disks of Atum were used to focus the quintessence harnessed by the Ennead,<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> a vast power source housed within the Great Pyramid of Akhet.
<g id="g_female_headnodding" />A structure I built for the Ancients long ago.
npc_default_dialogue_1624_01_imhotep_v4p: <g id="g_female_giveitem" />Now that you have the code and the Eye, here is the location of Sutekh’s Necropolis.
<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />It was hidden long ago to ensure the slumbering Ancient would not be disturbed.
<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you spoken to Evandrus about Queen Cleopatra’s return?<g id="g_female_explains" /> His opinion is vital to swaying Ghazi.
<g id="g_female_shrugdontcare" />I vowed I would never speak your name openly. And I have not broken that vow.
<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />This noble soul deserves to know the truth. After all we’ve gone through together.<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> I know you believe that.
It seems our work is never done. I've received word from a trusted ally named Lysandra.
She's been hearing rumors of strange tremors in the desert.
npc_default_dialogue_1624_02_imhotep_v2p: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />I must find the Eye of Horus… yes, the Eye is the key… yes, that is the only way…
npc_default_dialogue_1624_02_imhotep_v4p: <g id="g_male_spreadhands" />Please help Ghazi to decide how best to serve the people of Brimstone Sands.
Keep your senses honed, my friend.
I may need to travel to other parts of Aeternum to gather more knowledge. We stand at the dawn of a new age…
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p1_a: Stay together!<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> There’s strength in numbers!
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p1_b: Ready what weapons you have, but be prepared to run if it comes to that. Don’t lose hope!
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p2_a: <g id="g_litearmor_sighrelief" />Luckily, my efforts to locate Imhotep have borne fruit! Aban sent a message that they were heading to Carthago.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p2_b: <g id="g_litearmor_worry" />Aban seemed especially worried about our master losing himself…
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p3_a: <g id="g_litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />I knew something had gone wrong! I’m cursed with an infallible instinct for these sorts of things.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p3_b: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Did you discover anything else in New Rhacotis?
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p4_a: <g id="g_female_sympathyhandsheart" />Please excuse the mess. Most of the important books and scrolls in the city were seized and stored here.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p4_b: It’s become our library and our sanctum.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p6_a: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />The Great Pharaoh is relying on you. Oh, who am I kidding?<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> I'm relying on you.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00_ghazi_p6_b: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />I don’t think we could’ve chosen a better champion.<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> That's not too much pressure, is it?
npc_default_dialogue_1625_00a_ghazi_p1: Stay together!<g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" /> There’s strength in numbers! Ready what weapons you have, but be prepared to run if it comes to that. Don’t lose hope!
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p1: <g id="g_female_gesturerightm" bin="1" bout="1.5" />You there! You have a heroic look about you.<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" bin="1" /> That steely glint in your eyes, the aura of confidence, the distinctive swagger.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p4: I have a feeling matters are about to get far more complicated.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> And not in a good way. I certainly hope we're both ready.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p6_a: <g id="g_male_headshakeno" />The Pools of Orcus are a foul place. The fumes there sicken even the heartiest of individuals.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p6_b: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />Tread carefully, Sword of Imhotep. The less time spent there, the better.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p7_a: What are you doing? Didn’t your Queen command that you relax and enjoy yourself?
npc_default_dialogue_1625_01_ghazi_p7_b: Eat, drink, dance. There's more to life than fighting monsters.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p1_a: I’m not only a scholar, I’m also a chronicler.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p1_b: For the last several years, I’ve been committing to parchment the extraordinary life of<g id="g_female_explains" /> none other than “Imhotep the Wise!”
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p4: I've been to the Oasis Spontanea. It contains both<g id="g_male_converseright" /> beauty and danger. Out here, that particular combination is relatively common.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p5: <g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />Imhotep knows many arcane spells and secrets. His mastery of Ancient magic is<g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" /> unrivaled on Aeternum.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p6_a: <g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" />This mystery becomes more frightening with every step.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_02_ghazi_p6_b: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />I can't imagine where it's leading us, but my instinct tells me it's a terrifying place.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_03_ghazi_p1_a: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Your bold and effective defense of these refugees has enraged the Legion garrison at Crassus’s Rise.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_03_ghazi_p1_b: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />They’re preparing a massive assault to wipe us all out.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_03_ghazi_p5: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />We must attend to the words of the Great Pharaoh.<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> I know he seems different, but he's still Imhotep and wise beyond measure.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_03_ghazi_p6: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />The revelation of Sutekh's return has pushed Imhotep's mind to the edge! If we lose him, we are truly doomed!
npc_default_dialogue_1625_04_ghazi_p6_a: <g id="g_male_why" />Imhotep’s obsessed with Sutekh’s return! He kept insisting he had to "prepare the way!"
npc_default_dialogue_1625_04_ghazi_p6_b: <g id="g_female_shrugnothingicando" />I’ve never seen him like this! He called himself<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> the “Vizier of the Ancients!”
npc_default_dialogue_1625_05_ghazi_p6: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" />I don’t know about you, but I could use a hot bath and a nice long nap.<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> Some company would be nice as well…
npc_default_dialogue_1625_06_ghazi_p6_a: <g id="g_female_headshakesmall" />I’m sorry, I should have told you sooner. I wanted to. But I’ve been Ghazi for so long…
npc_default_dialogue_1625_06_ghazi_p6_b: <g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" />My actual name, the one I was given at birth, is Cleopatra.
npc_default_dialogue_1625_07_ghazi_p6: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />I have considered what you and Imhotep have said. You<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> both sacrificed so much for this land.<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> It is only fair that I do the same.
npc_default_dialogue_1625a_00_ghazi_p8: Your striking visage is always welcome, Sword of Brimstone. You make the days brighter, and the nights sweeter.
npc_default_dialogue_1626_00_hermogenes_: You look like a person who lives for excitement. Tell me my intuition is right! Life has been ever so dull around here.
I tell you, Pontifex Charmion even shut down my plays! What is a city without a lively theatre scene?
npc_default_dialogue_1626_01_hermogenes_: Good riddance to that harpy Charmion! I'll be happier without her around.
I know, I sound indelicate, but she threatened to behead me if I kept writing plays about her and Crassus. Beheading? Over a few jests!
npc_default_dialogue_1626_02_hermogenes_: I've been thinking about writing a new play about you.
The source material is a playwright's dream. Ambition, betrayal, tragedy, triumph… your story has it all!
npc_default_dialogue_1627_00_mevia_a: Here for the arena? Out of luck. Pontifex shut it down. Nothing to do but sit, wait, and drink.
npc_default_dialogue_1627_00_mevia_b: Could go out there and fight the Legion, but fighting for sport's different from fighting for real.
npc_default_dialogue_1627_01_mevia_a: Heard a lot about you adventurers lately. Sounds like a decent living. See places, meet people, fight monsters.
npc_default_dialogue_1627_01_mevia_b: Not sure if I could do it. Lost a lot over the years. Memories, skills, and people.
npc_default_dialogue_1627_02_mevia_a: Arena might open again, with Charmion gone. Don't know if I'll stick around to see it.
npc_default_dialogue_1627_02_mevia_b: Still like the idea of doing what you do. Adventurer Mevia. There's a nice ring to it, don’t you think?
npc_default_dialogue_1628_00_bekis_a: Cacti must be god's idea of a joke. They're too bitter to drink, too spiky to eat, and too tough to uproot.
npc_default_dialogue_1628_00_bekis_b: If you ask me, Sutekh's to blame. He's the sort of god who'd litter the earth with useless, spiny plants.
npc_default_dialogue_1628_01_bekis_a: I've brewed a new drink in honor of Queen Cleopatra's return. And you'll never guess what gives it color and flavor.
npc_default_dialogue_1628_01_bekis_b: Cactus fruit! I've taste-tested every batch, and I guarantee it's a drink worthy of our beloved Queen.
npc_default_dialogue_1629_00_elissa_a: My goodness, so many new arrivals these days. And your clothes are like nothing I've ever seen!
npc_default_dialogue_1629_00_elissa_b: Oh, I know times are tough, but I can't help getting excited. We're long overdue for fresh faces in New Corsica.
npc_default_dialogue_1629_01_elissa_a: Poor Evandrus. He's a brave man, coming back to face his demons.
npc_default_dialogue_1629_01_elissa_b: I offered him a gift of new tunics, but I don't think he feels comfortable out of his armor. It's hard to blame him, after what he's seen.
npc_default_dialogue_1629_02_elissa_a: The Queen ordered some purple gowns for her wardrobe. Oh, what am I to do?
npc_default_dialogue_1629_02_elissa_b: Nothing on this island produces color as rich as Tyrian purple. But I'll find a way. Nothing but the best for Queen Cleopatra.
npc_default_dialogue_1630_00_tristan_a: No escape. No hope. No salvation from the red-eyed devils. T-they were at Shattered Mountain. On the shores. In the voices that howled.
npc_default_dialogue_1630_00_tristan_b: And n-now, here too? I c-can't fight them, not again!
npc_default_dialogue_1630_01_tristan: I n-never was much good with a sword. Father was a rancher. M-maybe I could do the same, somewhere far from the f-fighting.
npc_default_dialogue_1631_00_tasechmi_a: Let me guess. You saw a poor old woman alone in the desert, and thought she needed help hobbling back to town?
npc_default_dialogue_1631_00_tasechmi_b: Pah! You townsfolk are all the same. I'm quite content here, far from all the noise and trouble.
npc_default_dialogue_1631_01_tasechmi_a: So you've met the Insatiable Flame. That rascal tore up all my plants when he first showed up.
npc_default_dialogue_1631_01_tasechmi_b: Then he cowered like a kitten after I gave him a good scolding. He's quite sweet, as long as he's well-fed.
npc_default_dialogue_1631_02_tasechmi: Tamouthis stopped by the other day. Said you put down the scorpion queen and her vile brood. Maybe you're all right for a city-dweller.
npc_default_dialogue_1632_00_titus_a: The moon and sun were one. Great Kronos peeled back the veil, and I saw the true nature of all things.
npc_default_dialogue_1632_00_titus_b: There are terrible holes in the world. Should we fall through, we will be devoured whole.
npc_default_dialogue_1632_01_titus_a: The boy does not know, yet he believes himself wise. I have stepped through the gates and lost my way.
npc_default_dialogue_1632_01_titus_b: They are not trifles for our convenience or amusement, no! But does he listen to poor, mad Titus? No one does!
npc_default_dialogue_1632_02_titus_a: You believe yourself victorious. It is but a respite. A moment of calm before the storm.
npc_default_dialogue_1632_02_titus_b: Ancient gods will blot out the sun. Their arms will cross the horizon and envelop the world in shadow.
npc_default_dialogue_1633_00_murdoch_a: The locals speak of a mighty wurm that burrows beneath the dunes. This land of blistering sun and biting wind has horrors aplenty, but so far I've seen no sign of the beast.
npc_default_dialogue_1633_00_murdoch_b: If you catch a glimpse of it, let me know. Its head will make a fine addition to my wall.
npc_default_dialogue_1633_01_murdoch_a: By God, I was such a fool to come here! A few nights ago, I saw the face of the great wurm.
npc_default_dialogue_1633_01_murdoch_b: I fell to my knees and waited for the end. But it passed without taking my life. Why? Why did it spare me?
npc_default_dialogue_1634_00_phimenis_a: Finally, someone with the sense to bring their own supplies.
npc_default_dialogue_1634_00_phimenis_b: Not that I'd have much to give you if you didn't. We're short of everything useful around here.
npc_default_dialogue_1634_01_phimenis_a: I heard about your exploits at the Great Pyramid. The whole camp talks of nothing else.
npc_default_dialogue_1634_01_phimenis_b: You can't seem to keep yourself out of trouble, friend. The world-ending, earth-shaking sort of trouble.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_00_antonia_a: You're no soldier. Were we friends, or foes? I… can't recall your face, but I hope you're here to help.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_00_antonia_b: The Legion was supposed to protect people. And we did, long ago.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_01_antonia_a: Evandrus. I remember… the day I told him I was retiring. He smiled at me, the happiest smile I've ever seen.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_01_antonia_b: Now we're both back in armor, fighting, with no more smiles between us.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_02_antonia_a: Is it over? I can go back to my farm, and let this fade into the fog of memory.
npc_default_dialogue_1635_02_antonia_b: Well, I hope I won't forget you. You were kind, brave, and true. Everything I wanted to be as a legionary.
npc_default_dialogue_1636_00_kollauthis_: Devastation and ruin as far as the eye can see, and no one to lead us through it.
No matter how fervently we prayed, the gods refused to give us peace and quiet. We'll only find help in each other.
npc_default_dialogue_1636_01_kollauthis: I wondered when Charmion would show her true face. Hmph. The less said about her, the better.
npc_default_dialogue_1636_02_kollauthis_: Are the rumors true? Has Queen Cleopatra herself returned to us? Part of me yearns to see her splendor.
But I wasted so many years in New Corsica, under Charmion's thumb. Better to stay here and help where I can.
npc_default_dialogue_1637_00_livia_a: I've lost two carts, several priceless heirlooms, and my best sandals since leaving New Corsica.
npc_default_dialogue_1637_00_livia_b: Fortuna is a cruel mistress, but she could always take more from me.
npc_default_dialogue_1637_01_livia_a: Things seem to be going well, but I think my time in this land is coming to a close. Call it business intuition or wanderlust.
npc_default_dialogue_1637_01_livia_b: Hmm… I've never been to Ebonscale Reach. That sounds like a good change of scenery.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_00_suke_a: I hope you haven't come in search of healing. I will do my very best, but I have little to work with.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_00_suke_b: People on Aeternum are so careless toward their own health. It's frightful to see.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_01_suke_a: Someday, I'd like to learn how to use a Life Staff. I thought the locals were exaggerating when they told me about it.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_01_suke_b: The power to heal injuries and soothe pain with a wave of your hands… it's like something out of a legend.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_02_suke_a: Take care of yourself, friend. After all your heroic struggles, I think you've earned a breather.
npc_default_dialogue_1638_02_suke_b: We may live forever, but we're still human. We need rest and care, and you're no exception.
npc_default_dialogue_1639_00_leo_a: So many abandoned valuables, so little time. People leave the most incredible things behind.
npc_default_dialogue_1639_00_leo_b: Oh, judge not lest ye be judged, friend. Besides, I doubt the Lost or Corrupted need their earthly treasures.
npc_default_dialogue_1639_01_leo_a: With the Legion no longer on the rampage, it's easier than ever to scavenge things.
npc_default_dialogue_1639_01_leo_b: But I loved the danger, every second of it. There's nothing like the rush of barely escaping with your life. You can relate, right?
npc_default_dialogue_1640_00_steffan_a: Hah! It seems the New Corsicans finally listened to me, and sent another professional to do their killing.
npc_default_dialogue_1640_00_steffan_b: Welcome to this little piece of hell, friend. There's no shortage of danger, and plenty of work for two.
npc_default_dialogue_1640_01_steffan_a: I hear Evandrus is trying to rehabilitate his father's image. Wonder how much of the eulogizing is true.
npc_default_dialogue_1640_01_steffan_b: People are awfully quick to put words in the mouths of the departed, if you catch my drift.
npc_default_dialogue_1640_02_steffan_a: If Cleopatra needs mercenaries, put in a word for me. Things got mighty quiet around here.
npc_default_dialogue_1640_02_steffan_b: Good for everyone else, bad for me. I get bored when the fighting dies down.
npc_default_dialogue_1641_00_eudoxia: This desert air is terrible for my tools, to say nothing of my skin. What I wouldn't give for a proper university workshop.
npc_default_dialogue_1641_01_eudoxia_a: You don't look like a local. I was hoping I might bend your ear for an unusual request.
npc_default_dialogue_1641_01_eudoxia_b: But nothing illegal, I promise. Let's simply call it... destructive investigation.
npc_default_dialogue_1641_02_eudoxia_a: Sulfur, mercury, gypsum glass, but this fourth element eludes me. Some kind of refined Azoth? How does it remain stable?
npc_default_dialogue_1641_02_eudoxia_b: Ah, it's you! As you can see, the scarab power sources keep me very busy.
npc_default_dialogue_1642_00_senhyris_a: W-Who are you?! Stay back, don't come any closer!
npc_default_dialogue_1642_00_senhyris_b: Augh… I really hope you aren't a bandit. Though if you are, I don't have much for you to take.
npc_default_dialogue_1642_01_senhyris_a: Before you appeared, I didn't think strangers would show us any kindness. The gods might have abandoned us, but you didn't.
npc_default_dialogue_1642_01_senhyris_b: Thanks again, friend. I'll remember you when I'm well enough to hunt again.
npc_default_dialogue_1643_00_gaius: Oh, mighty Jupiter, have mercy on me!
npc_default_dialogue_1643_01_gaius_a: You saved my life, and I was too flustered to thank you properly. Please accept my humblest apologies.
npc_default_dialogue_1643_01_gaius_b: I don’t know what you' re seeking, but I hope Fortuna is kinder to you than she was to me.
npc_default_dialogue_1644_00_nesse_a: Naught left but feathers and blood. At this rate I'll be ruined, though we'll all starve first. Now there's a cheery thought.
npc_default_dialogue_1644_00_nesse_b: What are you looking at? A woman at her wits' end, that's what.
npc_default_dialogue_1644_01_nesse_a: I'll say this for the New Corsicans. They're a hardy lot. Despite the Legion and the wild beasts, the camp's held together.
npc_default_dialogue_1644_01_nesse_b: Perhaps I'll stay a while longer, at least until I get back on my feet.
npc_default_dialogue_1645_00_xiaoling: What a fine mess. I'll be lucky if I ever find him. Oh, why did that storm have to strike now?
npc_default_dialogue_1645_01_xiaoling_a: I'm sorry to trouble you, but did you see a man wash up on the southern shore?
npc_default_dialogue_1645_01_xiaoling_b: I was awaiting his arrival, but then his ship crashed during the storm. I saw it all happen!
npc_default_dialogue_1645_02_xiaoling_a: You'll be glad to hear that no more of the Empress's ships have sailed this way.
npc_default_dialogue_1645_02_xiaoling_b: I would dearly love to return home. But this Corrupted Legion... they worry me.
npc_default_dialogue_1646_00_froderico_a: These rough conditions are utterly beneath me. Do you know who I am?
npc_default_dialogue_1646_00_froderico_b: Froderico Renaldi, renowned scholar of the classics! You may know me from my treatise about Marius's reforms.
npc_default_dialogue_1646_01_froderico: They killed me! How dare they! Stabbed me through and tossed me over the palisade like a rag doll! Oh, the indignity of it all…
npc_default_dialogue_1646_02_froderico_a: Oh. I began working on a new book, about textiles and evolving fashion among the Roman exiles.
npc_default_dialogue_1646_02_froderico_b: It may be a less prestigious topic, but looms are less likely to stab me to death.
npc_default_dialogue_1647_00_aulus: Will she ever forgive me? Her Excellency isn't known for her charitable nature, but this humble servant can hope for her favor.
npc_default_dialogue_1647_01_aulus_a: I am unworthy! I have doomed Her Excellency, that gentle soul entrusted to my care.
npc_default_dialogue_1647_01_aulus_b: There is no warmth in the sun, and no more joy in life.
npc_default_dialogue_1647_02_aulus_a: Have you given a name to your own armadillo? Flora the Second has a pleasant ring to it.
npc_default_dialogue_1647_02_aulus_b: Then again, Her Excellency may prefer to be the only Flora. You should pick a different name.
npc_default_dialogue_1648_00_flora: (The armadillo gives you a single, disdainful sniff before looking away.)
npc_default_dialogue_1648_01_flora_a: I happened to be eavesdropping. For your information, I have never spoken to Aulus as I speak to you.
npc_default_dialogue_1648_01_flora_b: His poor, tiny mind couldn't handle the shock! At least yours is made of sterner stuff.
npc_default_dialogue_1649_00_miresis: We have strayed from the ways of our ancestors. And in return, the curse of the Lost is ours to bear.
npc_default_dialogue_1649_01_miresis_a: Memory fades with each passing year, and none remember the old rituals.
npc_default_dialogue_1649_01_miresis_b: I wouldn't expect such things to matter to an outsider. But to those who try to honor the gods, it is of profound importance.
npc_default_dialogue_1649_02_miresis: What incantation do I try next? To whom do I pray? Someone must hear our prayers. If not… no, I dare not entertain the thought.
npc_default_dialogue_1650_00_flame_a: Hrrm? A delicious passing morsel? No, you look rather too large and uncomfortable to eat.
npc_default_dialogue_1650_00_flame_b: Why do you stare? Do you WANT to be my dinner?
npc_default_dialogue_1650_01_flame: A human? Ah, my favorite human, the bringer of fish. May your sunbeams be warm, your catches plentiful, and your belly full.
npc_default_dialogue_1651_00_enez: According to this map, the ruin's a bit further up the cliff. Oh, I should've asked for directions before wandering out here.
npc_default_dialogue_1651_01_enez_a: Ah, a fellow traveler! This may strike you as an odd question, but have you ever seen a dragon on this mountainside?
npc_default_dialogue_1651_01_enez_b: To be clear, I speak of the variety with large wings and flaming breath.
npc_default_dialogue_1651_02_enez_a: Thanks to you, I'm overflowing with ideas for my sculptures. Why stop at dragon eggs?
npc_default_dialogue_1651_02_enez_b: The well-to-do of Aeternum may want a unicorn horn, or a manticore stinger to hang over their fireplaces.
npc_default_dialogue_1652_00_lysandra: I can't help watching the Great Pyramid out of the corner of my eye. Do you know what holds it aloft? Neither do I. I don't like the thought one bit.
npc_default_dialogue_1652_01_lysandra: Another mercenary. The deserts have been lousy with you lot. Pick up a survey map and make yourself useful. How's your hearing?
npc_default_dialogue_1652_02_lysandra_a: The tremors continue, but I've yet to see the creature emerge above ground.
npc_default_dialogue_1652_02_lysandra_b: A few other travelers mentioned sightings, but I told them to keep their distance.
npc_default_dialogue_1653_00_lavinia_a: I've had it with my family! My mother, my uncles, the whole decrepit lot of them.
npc_default_dialogue_1653_00_lavinia_b: Must I throw myself over the cliffs to make them see sense? Will anything put a stop to their tiresome meddling?
npc_default_dialogue_1653_01_lavinia_a: We should just throw caution to the winds and elope. We wouldn't be the only ones leaving New Corsica.
npc_default_dialogue_1653_01_lavinia_b: And the look on my uncle's face as we flee into the sunset… oh, it would be priceless!
npc_default_dialogue_1654_00_margarete_a: You're also new to this place, aren't you?
npc_default_dialogue_1654_00_margarete_b: The monuments and statues are impressive, but I'll never forget the first time I saw a Greek play. I laughed until my sides ached!
npc_default_dialogue_1654_01_margarete_a: You've emboldened Lavinia, friend. Now she's talking of eloping with me! Hah!
npc_default_dialogue_1654_01_margarete_b: She's lived here for centuries, and she's just going to leave it all behind? I'm nervous, but I think she really means it.
npc_default_dialogue_1655_00_sokmenis: Please don't disturb an old man's peaceful retirement.I believe I've earned some quiet.
npc_default_dialogue_1655_01_sokmenis_a: Sharp eyes, well-worn clothes, and heavy bags. You have the look of a seasoned traveler.
npc_default_dialogue_1655_01_sokmenis_b: If you'll indulge an old man's curiosity, what brings you to this troubled land?
npc_default_dialogue_1656_00_perrin_a: The Ancients must have been giants compared to us.
npc_default_dialogue_1656_00_perrin_b: Look at the size of these steps, the monumental perfection of each stone block! One can only wonder at the secrets they contain.
npc_default_dialogue_1656_01_perrin_a: I'll have a limp for weeks. Monsieur Heron makes scrambling up and down ancient ruins sound so easy!
npc_default_dialogue_1656_01_perrin_b: Oh, I beg your pardon. I'm just recovering from an embarrassing fall.
npc_default_dialogue_1656_02_perrin_a: Have you seen the circular stone gates at Hermopolis? There is one just like them, right above our heads.
npc_default_dialogue_1656_02_perrin_b: But no matter what I do, the gateway here remains inactive.
npc_default_dialogue_1656_03_perrin_a: Do you think Monsieur Heron would be interested in collaborating with me?
npc_default_dialogue_1656_03_perrin_b: My knowledge of languages pales next to his. I should brush up on my Latin, but I've never found book learning easy.
npc_default_dialogue_1657_00_tamouthis: Mind your step, traveler. The little scorpions are easy to skewer, but the big ones get the better of many overconfident hunters.
npc_default_dialogue_1657_01_tamouthis: I've heard the most fantastic rumors about you. So, you should have no trouble with a large swarm of angry scorpions.
npc_default_dialogue_1657_02_tamouthis: The creatures of the wilds are not to be feared, but understood. That lesson's lost on most, but not you. It's nice to meet a kindred spirit.
npc_default_dialogue_1658_00_mihri_a: Those pillars look much taller up close.
npc_default_dialogue_1658_00_mihri_b: Well, they aren't getting any shorter by staring at them. I hope these old legs will carry me the rest of the way.
npc_default_dialogue_1658_01_mihri_a: Damn my aching bones, and damn those goats!
npc_default_dialogue_1658_01_mihri_b: Look at them, bleating down at the world below. It's as though they're taunting me! How did they even get up there?
npc_default_dialogue_1658_02_mihri_a: I've been talking to some of the Romans. Did you know they make a sweet omelette with honey and pepper?
npc_default_dialogue_1658_02_mihri_b: Sweet, peppery eggs sound odd, but that's the beauty of food. We all have our own tastes.
npc_default_dialogue_1659_00_anna_a: Phew, finally got away from all those guardians.
npc_default_dialogue_1659_00_anna_b: But now what? I can't leave until my mission's complete, but I can't fight through the Ancient guardians either…
npc_default_dialogue_1659_01_anna_a: A fellow Soulwarden out here? Well, I won't look a gift horse in the mouth.
npc_default_dialogue_1659_01_anna_b: Care to help our brethren one more time? Don't worry, this is a blessing for us… I hope.
npc_default_dialogue_1659_02_anna_a: I thought the ruins in Everfall were impressive, but that was before I laid eyes on the Wall.
npc_default_dialogue_1659_02_anna_b: I'll bet that it hides even more secrets. Try going back from time to time, and see if anything else opens up for you.
npc_default_dialogue_1660_00_paubastis: You are far from civilization, stranger. Indulge me in an odd question: how adept are you at handling great beasts of the desert?
npc_default_dialogue_1660_01_paubastis: You again? The sacrifice has been accepted, and we can only pray that the gods stay their wrath. Go, now. I have no more coin or treasure for you.
npc_default_dialogue_1661_00_jackal: (The jackal's piercing eyes look you over from head to toe.)
npc_default_dialogue_1662_00_rima_a: Jabir ibn Hayyan posits a balance of sulfur and mercury, but the potency of local sulfur overwhelms mercury and disrupts the normal methods of transmutation.
npc_default_dialogue_1662_01_rima_a: Huh. Jabir ibn Hayyan posits a balance of sulfur and mercury, but the potency of local sulfur overwhelms mercury and disrupts normal methods of transmutation.
npc_default_dialogue_1662_01_rima_b: Oh, I'm sorry. I promise, I don't usually talk to myself along the roadside.
npc_default_dialogue_1662_02_rima_a: I thought about using Brimstone sulfur to refine potions. But there's always the issue of drinking the resulting potion.
npc_default_dialogue_1662_02_rima_b: I've had exactly one serious mishap, and I'm not eager to repeat it.
npc_default_dialogue_1663_00_esoeris: All these excavations, and for what? For all our efforts at enlightenment, we seem to reap nothing but dust.
npc_default_dialogue_1663_02_esoeris_a: Maybe I should spend some time at the baths, for my health.
npc_default_dialogue_1663_02_esoeris_b: I've been jumping at shadows since the… since that incident. Nobody needs a nervous guard.
npc_default_dialogue_1665_00_heron: New Corsica, ancient bastion of knowledge and hidden secrets. I find this place suits me, though I wish travel by spirit shrines wasn't so nauseating.
npc_default_dialogue_1665_01_heron_a: How goes your search for the Ancient glyphs?
npc_default_dialogue_1665_01_heron_b: I've been tracking down local rumors of their locations, but it's tedious work sorting the wheat from the chaff.
npc_default_dialogue_1665_02_heron_a: Your dedication to knowledge may even come close to my own. And you're much better suited to exploring dangerous locales.
npc_default_dialogue_1665_02_heron_b: I am in your debt. When I uncover more about the glyphs or the language's secrets, you will be the first to know.
npc_default_dialogue_1666_00_razin: Hearken to the words of the blessed Pontifex Charmion! She speaks for the gods and dispenses their wisdom!
npc_default_dialogue_1666_01_razin_b: If you wish an audience with the blessed Pontifex Charmion, you must meditate on the wisdom of the Sacred Scroll of Awakening.
npc_default_dialogue_1666_02_razin: Prayer alone will not save us! The gods require deeds! Words without action are empty!
npc_default_dialogue_1666_03_razin_a: The people of New Corsica need a better way forward. Not a new faith, but a fresh interpretation for changing times.
npc_default_dialogue_1666_03_razin_b: With my knowledgeable guidance, of course. I've no intention of going anywhere.
npc_default_dialogue_1666_04_razin_a: Attend the words of the Pontifex Nuru. Her wisdom will guide us into a new age of enlightenment.
npc_default_dialogue_1666_04_razin_b: I'm sure you're as eager as I am to witness such a miracle.
npc_default_dialogue_1667_00_lostpack: This bag was almost buried by the sands. It contains several small portraits on wood, a half-full waterskin, and a brittle note.
npc_default_dialogue_1668_00_statue: This small, weathered statue appears unremarkable.
npc_default_dialogue_1669_00_tablet: It's hard to make out the writing on this ancient tablet. You can only pick out three words: Ennead, pilgrimage, power.
npc_default_dialogue_1671_00_commander2: You would be an excellent candidate for the Marauders. If you wish to join our battles, I welcome you with open arms.
npc_default_dialogue_1671_01_commander2: We never run out of foes to fight and victories to win. This vicious island suits us Marauders.
npc_default_dialogue_1671_02_commander2: You'll want Adjudicator Teos, not me. I never was much of an orator.
npc_default_dialogue_1671_03_commander2: Talk to Alchemist Euphrosyne if you must. I never have any idea what you Syndicate are talking about.
npc_default_dialogue_1671_04_commander2: There are no pretenses among us Marauders. You're here for gold, battle, and glory, and I have opportunites aplenty.
npc_default_dialogue_1672_00_alchemist2_: Others see eternal life as a curse, but not the seekers of the Syndicate.
Endless years to learn, understand, and plumb the mysteries of the world. What could be better?
npc_default_dialogue_1672_01_alchemist2: Welcome, welcome. There are enough mysteries in this land to keep both of us occupied.
npc_default_dialogue_1672_02_alchemist2: We're not so different, you and I. All you need is a little more curiosity about the light you so fervently safeguard.
npc_default_dialogue_1672_03_alchemist2: Don't you ever wonder if there's more to life than battle and bloodshed? If so, you know where to find me.
npc_default_dialogue_1672_04_alchemist2: Someday, we'll rival the works of the Ancients themselves. We will be the architects of our own paradise, right here on Aeternum.
npc_default_dialogue_1673_00_adjudicator: Are you lost, friend? We all are, in one way or another.
But some of us choose to join the Covenant and find our way through the darkness, together.
npc_default_dialogue_1673_01_adjudicator: We sing the song of hope on an island of strife.
I know it seems a thankless task at times, but you are never alone. The light of others shines with you.
npc_default_dialogue_1673_02_adjudicator: A Marauder? If you're here to pick a fight, I must decline. This is not the time or place.
npc_default_dialogue_1673_03_adjudicator: For those who claim to know so much, you Syndicate understand little. Farewell.
npc_default_dialogue_1673_04_adjudicator: It's easy to give in to one's base impulses. Violence, greed, naked ambition.
But you rise above such things. You are an inspiration to us all.
npc_default_dialogue_1674_00_commander3: You're strong, traveler, but you'd be stronger with Marauders at your side. Come on, I promise we don't bite. Much.
npc_default_dialogue_1674_01_commander3: I've heard the wildest tales about your battles, friend. If even half are true, you could cross blades with the legends of old!
npc_default_dialogue_1674_02_commander3: You here for a drink? How about a fight? Tch, you Covenant are all work and no play.
npc_default_dialogue_1674_03_commander3: Hello. How's your disturbing research going? What? That's what the Syndicate does, right?
npc_default_dialogue_1674_04_commander3: Having you around has really livened this place up. I hope you stay a while, friend. Our victories will be the stuff of legend!
npc_default_dialogue_1675_00_alchemist3: Return when you are ready to be inducted in the arcane mysteries of the Syndicate. Until then, we have nothing to discuss.
npc_default_dialogue_1675_01_alchemist3: With each new discovery, our understanding deepens, and our power grows. The quest never ends, fellow seeker.
npc_default_dialogue_1675_02_alchemist3: Open your mind to the infinite possibilities of the cosmos. Perhaps then, we can talk.
npc_default_dialogue_1675_03_alchemist3: We have nothing for you, Marauder. Seek your simple pleasures elsewhere.
npc_default_dialogue_1675_04_alchemist3: The day is coming, fellow seeker. That sublime dawn when knowledge sets us free, and mankind breaks all its shackles.
npc_default_dialogue_1676_00_adjudicator: No one, no matter how strong, should be without allies. Remember that, traveler.
npc_default_dialogue_1676_01_adjudicator: Welcome home, friend. The divine calls to us with many different voices, but we of the Covenant answer as one.
npc_default_dialogue_1676_02_adjudicator: Valor is nothing without a higher purpose.
npc_default_dialogue_1676_03_adjudicator: Wisdom comes with compassion, not ambitious grasping.
npc_default_dialogue_1676_04_adjudicator: Aeternum is a land in desperate need of hope, love, and protection. We provide it through our service. Never doubt that, friend.
npc_default_dialogue_1678_00_emptychest: (The chest is empty. The Eye of Horus is gone.)
npc_default_dialogue_1679_00_tomash_a: Where are you? You should have at least sent word by now…
npc_default_dialogue_1679_00_tomash_b: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />I'm sorry, friend. Something important has my attention right now.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Perhaps later?
npc_default_dialogue_1679_01_tomash_a: You've made it! Good!<g id="male_sighRelief" /> Your exploits precede you, and we have need of your aid.
npc_default_dialogue_1679_01_tomash_b: The Corrupted<g id="male_righthandAngry" /> Legion in Brimstone Sands is preparing an assault on the capital of New Corsica. The<g id="male_shakehead" /> civilians are fleeing the region in droves.
npc_default_dialogue_1679_02_tomash_a: You smell like dust and heat, friend! I assume you made it into the deserts of Brimstone Sands without too much difficulty. And Buhawi?
npc_default_dialogue_1679_02_tomash_b: <g id="male_nodMild" />You've taken a weight off my shoulders! Thank<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> you for checking up on him.
npc_default_dialogue_1680_00_buhawi_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Tomash is a bit overprotective at times.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Just means he cares. But helping people is what I'm meant to do,<g id="female_smackfist" /> no matter the danger.
npc_default_dialogue_1680_00_buhawi_b: <g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" />Corruption, Lost, an Ancient device… doesn't matter. I am a warrior, a defender, and I will stand between the darkness and the light!
npc_default_dialogue_1680_01_buhawi_a: Tomash is a bit overprotective at times. Just means he cares. But helping people is what I'm meant to do, no matter the danger. Corruption, Lost, an Ancient device… doesn't matter.
npc_default_dialogue_1680_01_buhawi_b: I am a warrior, a defender, and I will stand between the darkness and the light!
npc_default_dialogue_1681_00_innkeep: Welcome, welcome! Please, there is plenty of room. Have a seat by the fire, or take a rest if you'd like.
npc_default_dialogue_1682_00_innkeep: You're brave, traveler. Not many come this way by choice.We've bunks in the tent, if you need to rest for a while.
npc_default_dialogue_9501_grace_s01_c00_: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" />One thing I don't miss from the old world - it was ambition for a man to chase a fortune, but greed for a woman.
<g id="g_grace_understand" />That way of thinking doesn't hold much water on Aeternum, so that's something.
npc_default_dialogue_9501_grace_s01_camp: <g id="g_grace_no" />No, Zander, we don't have a kitchen here, you can use the fire and a stick like everyone else.
<g id="g_grace_throwarms" />Just arrived and he's already making demands.<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> Don't you start getting any ideas, all right?
<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" />You know, after bumping around the island for so many months, this is the first time I've felt at home since I lost my ship.
<g id="g_grace_nicememory" />With a little extra coin, we'll turn this place into a right proper estate, I think.
npc_default_dialogue_9502_zander_s01_c00: <g id="g_male_wavehandsno" />Even on Aeternum, I do not think of death lightly. Who knows what is<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> taken from you when you die?
<g id="g_male_explain" />Are you truly the same person? Or someone else, using your body,<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> thinking your thoughts. It is… unsettling.
npc_default_dialogue_9502_zander_s01_fir: This place may be<g id="g_male_spreadarms001" /> small, but I feel it has a big heart.
<g id="g_female_nodyes" />There is a great warmth here, that speaks of family.
npc_default_dialogue_9503_dog_s01_c00: (The baby lynx kitten greets you with a weak meow. He seems to like you.)
npc_default_dialogue_9503_dog_s01_joined: (The baby lynx kitten meows happily. You'd swear he was thanking you. He looks a lot better!)
npc_default_dialogue_9503_dog_s01_recogn: (The baby lynx kitten purrs. He seems to recognize you.)
npc_default_dialogue_9504_shailyn_s01_c0: I wonder if Aeternum will ever be rid of the legacy of the proud Knights of the Round Table.
That one of them now marches with the Varangians… Artorius would be crushed to learn his faith was so misplaced.
npc_default_dialogue_9505_skye_s01_helpa: I'll be fine - just go find Aidyn!
npc_default_dialogue_9505_skye_s01_hopea: Aidyn thinks with her heart, first. She'll be back, I'm sure of it.
npc_default_dialogue_9505_skye_s01_ihave: I feel as if your warrior's fire has rekindled a beacon I'd lost sight of - hope.
npc_default_dialogue_9505_skye_s01_mount: You've found me! Well, this is exciting. There isn't a day that goes by that I don't think of you.
Mostly about our promised battle, but sometimes, other things as well.
npc_default_dialogue_9506_granny_s01_c00: Ah, Zander, I'm too soft on that child. Having a kind heart won't do him any favors in this world.
npc_default_dialogue_9506_granny_s01_ebo: If it isn't the Clever Cleaver. How's my Zander doing?
Don't be too soft on him, it's not good for that boy.
npc_default_dialogue_9507_williamdaintit: Ah! You're to be my little junior Crow, are you? Well met, indeed!
npc_default_dialogue_9508_quirinusflaccu: Iron Rose, Silver Crows - anyone would have mixed the two.
Perhaps you'd consider renaming your group to the "Iron Crows." Has more of a "Let your blade shine a light in the dark," feel to it.
npc_default_dialogue_9509_adolfodeacutis: Is it so ludicrous a notion to think the Ancients could come from the future? Just think on it.
npc_default_dialogue_9510_eynonvoyle_s01: Yes, I know, the typical druid, standing under an overlarge tree! That's what I am.
But let me just say, I do not prance about in nothing but laurel leaves, and I hold no love for squirrels.
npc_default_dialogue_9511_dicunhobday_s0: May the Spark watch over you, my friend. I hope you find succor and company here in our humble house, such as it is.
npc_default_dialogue_9512_marty_s01_c00_: Some people think money don't matter on Aeternum. They're wrong. How'd you like to be poor forever? We still want to eat, right?
You know, have to hang our coat up somewhere. Think about it.
npc_default_dialogue_9513_amis_s01_c00_a: Have you heard? That pirate lady's got a new crew going by the name of the Silver Crows.
npc_default_dialogue_9513_amis_s01_c00_b: Wonder if they might hire on me and Marty. I mean, I'm a fair shot. As long as the target don't move around.
npc_default_dialogue_9518_skyebonecharmt: (Use this table to destroy Varangian Bone Talismans)
npc_defaultdialog_01_elderkemba: I still think about my friends often. The best I can do for them is remember them fondly.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_0252a_guard_a: Welcome to Calvary! Meeting strangers is the only advantage of this job. Told my daughter not to join her dad’s line of work, but she never listens to me.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_0252a_guard_b: You need to listen to your parents. Parents know what’s good for you.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_0253a_guard_a: New to Brightwood? Well, you can get lost in a graveyard and fight screaming monsters or be warm in our rickety but lovable settlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_0253a_guard_b: Can you guess which one I chose?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_13a_guard1_a: Good day! Resting in Twillen for a bit? I bet some new missions have come up on the townboard.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_13a_guard1_b: I like taking a break to check them once in a while. Always something interesting!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_13a_guard2_a: Hello, adventurer! Welcome to Twillen. You seem smart. But are you?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_13a_guard2_b: If you can get me some gold from a place that starts with water, then maybe you’ll convince me.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_ahurafarid: Corinth isn't so bad. We've still got food, for now, at least. The Speaker promises things will be better soon.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_allyamusa: <g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" />Believe me when I say, you don’t want to go into the mine. Everyone's fallen Lost, and still no word from Prydwen.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_ashedubois_a: Did the pesky pirates give you trouble when you first arrived on these shores?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_ashedubois_b: Someone has got to stop these bearded meanies! And that someone is me!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_cemalqadir_a: What wall can keep out despair? Which supplies can help people keep their faith?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_cemalqadir_b: I know how to keep the Lost out of the settlement. I don't know how to judge which of our brethren are going to turn.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_chanduiyer_a: Do you know what happened with Allya’s messages? The Regent would have never taken that much time to send help.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_chanduiyer_b: The first time I came here, she called me to Court, just to make me feel welcome.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_clericletter_a: It was nothing short of a plague. They kept coming in droves, and it was all we could do to hold them back.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_clericletter_b: I was sure faith had a role to play here, as it does in the tales back home.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_dayomusa_a: This island is filled with trials. So be prepared to learn who you really are.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_dayomusa_b: Man is like pepper — you only know him when you’ve ground him.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_donquixolay_a: I knew there was a great elsewhere out there, where chivalry hadn’t died an untimely death.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_donquixolay_b: I found it! Here, I can put my ignoble past behind me and take up the glorious burdens of knighthood!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_eddayonkers_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Have you ever held the song of love in your heart?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_eddayonkers_b: <g id="female_explainS" />It’s hard to keep your spirits up on the island. But a darling sweeting can make any place feel like home!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_eliasderit_a: I won’t leave here, not till every last one of us is safe. The others depend on me.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_eliasderit_b: But tell Geertie to keep a warm pot of soup going. I'll get out at some point!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_elricchapman: Have you seen the spheres? Aren't they magnificent? I wonder what they were used for…
npc_defaultdialogue_00_fancybrushset: [A set of well maintained brushes rests here. Somone must have left them behind.]
npc_defaultdialogue_00_fatherrusso: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I am lost in the dark... I cannot find my way… <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" />Is this hell…?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_fionamurphy: Welcome to the Bluffs, take rest. Please make this your home. This blighted land will soon be blessed, when the True Heir takes the throne.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_francisturner_a: <g id="sit_laughmed_francis" />Welcome to the breadbasket of Aeternum, stranger!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_francisturner_b: <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />We don't have much food to spare at present, but I can assure you, it's a temporary problem! <g id="sit_nod_francis" />We'll be back! As surely as day follows night!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_fudehinode: There's so much inspiration to be found here, you know? I could spend years painting the pastoral landscapes of Windsward.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_gaetanfortier_a: It's a happy day when the woman you've loved several lifetimes says yes to being yours.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_gaetanfortier_b: The sky may fall down, but as for me, I am the happiest man on Aeternum - nay, in the world!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_geertielother_a: What'll it be, friend? A drink to wash away your sorrows, or a drink to celebrate the gift of life?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_geertielother_b: There's always a good reason to knock one back, if you ask me.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_gideonstormsbane: <g id="male_pleadHandsclasped" />How did you manage to get past the Lost? Those spectres are everywhere! <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />There's no escaping them!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_gideonstormsbane_: How did you manage to get past the Lost?
Those spectres are everywhere! There's no escaping them!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_graceomalley_a: I must say, when the Watcher said we'd find a town, I expected more than this.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_graceomalley_a_ne: <g id="grace_secret" />I have to tell you, when those squatters on the beach mentioned a town up the road, <g id="grace_yes" />I expected more than this.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_graceomalley_b: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />This soddy wee village is on the verge of extinction. <g id="grace_headshakeno" />Not much gold to be had around here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_hamzakillic: Oh, hello! Haven’t died many times, have you? You have gorgeous pearly whites. Dying spoils teeth.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_heretic_a: <g id="male_think" />The ropes… bound tight… <g id="male_spreadhands" />What do they bind? What do they hold?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_heretic_b: <g id="male_explain" />The writhing chaos cannot be bound... The endless dark cannot be held… <g id="female_chuckle" />hehehehe...
npc_defaultdialogue_00_hugomolina_a: Oh, I'm a sad man who has made many a poor decision, like deciding to come here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_hugomolina_b: The island has ripped out my heart and fed her to the Lost, while I was sleeping.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_iseuljeong_a: Are you betrothed to anyone? I’m struggling to convince Nabi to get married.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_iseuljeong_b: She mustn’t meet a horrendous fate. I wouldn’t be able to live with myself.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_jeongiseul_a: Are you betrothed to anyone? I’m struggling to convince Nabi to get married.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_jeongiseul_b: She mustn’t meet a horrendous fate. I wouldn’t be able to live with myself.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_kathrijnjanssen_a: These are troublesome times. And my delectable treats could bring much needed joy to people.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_kathrijnjanssen_b: But the countryside is so dangerous I can't get back to my kitchen. And I really don't like camping.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_knightsdecree_a: Margot Dubois the Steadfast, knighted by Artorius, seated in the fifth seat of the Round table.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_knightsdecree_b: The Resolved Scout, Keeper of the Scepter, Crest of the Lark, bequeathed this day on a scarf of olive silk.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_leovixsilva: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />Are you… oh, no. You're <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />not a soldier of the Iron Rose Company. I had hoped some of my comrades might've been spared. But hope has withered here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_leovixsilva_a: Are you… oh, no. You're not a soldier of the Iron Rose Company.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_leovixsilva_b: I had hoped some of my comrades might've been spared. But hope has withered here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lijsbetdevries: What are you doing here? How did you get past the Withered?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lioneldelarue_a: This is a big problem you see. The shortages here in Windsward are just awful!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lioneldelarue_b: I haven't been able to create any new clothes. Sadly there just aren't enough supplies to be spared.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lizihan: Have you tried the tea? I find it is most calming.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lochnir: <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />Prydwen is a town unlike any other in Aeternum. Here, we honor the traditions from the reign of the High King. <g id="guard_nod" />I take personal interest in ensuring that.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_lochnir_b: Here, we honor the traditions from the reign of the High King. I take personal interest in ensuring that.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_marceldupont_a: Another new face in Corinth. Have you come from the shore?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_marceldupont_a_ne: <g id="guard_dismissLeft" />Another new face in Corinth just means another mouth to feed, <g id="guard_headshakeno" />and we don't have the food. Wherever you came from, I suggest you go back.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_marceldupont_b: I'm anticipating a report from the Watcher on that terrible storm. Something's happening down there.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_margotemerson_a: Aeternum is an island of exotic people and strange beasts, mystical powers, and new lands that need charting.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_margotemerson_b: There is so little we understand, but we must always start with the ground beneath our feet.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_mb_grace: <g id="grace_wherearewe" />Strange island, strange little town, strange people. Out of everyone I've met, you're the only one I feel I can trust.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_medea_a: <g id="male_think" />I see a clarity in your eyes, a wisdom I haven't seen since… well,<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" /> in quite some time.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_medea_b: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />These days are indeed dark, but even darker ones are approaching. I hope you are prepared for them.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_michaellewis: Shhh! They'll hear you, and believe me, we don't want that!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_moirachapman_a: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />History gives a strong perspective on the present.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_moirachapman_b: <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />How can you make sure you don't repeat the mistakes of the past if you don't actually study them?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_nabijeong_a: How are you adapting to this land, traveller? Have you grown up with tales of knights or like me, is it all a bit mysterious to you?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_nabijeong_b: My mother misses the Joseon court. She understood what was expected of her there.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_nessaharrower_a: <g id="female_thinking" />It's strange, isn't it, returning to a place you once called home and hardly recognizing it?
npc_defaultdialogue_00_nessaharrower_b: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />I would have assumed it was my faulty memories, but no, it's the town. <g id="g_male_headnodyes" bin="1.5" bout="1.5"/>Things were much more… harmonious back then.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_oldegeiser_a: Have you ever observed the Lost? They look sad but they could be secretly peaceful.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_oldegeiser_b: Imagine if the most beautiful music played inside their minds. And they just can’t tell us about it.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_oliviabarovier_a: My home has been destroyed. My father has been twisted into a monster I can't recognize. I can't even afford a place to sleep.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_oliviabarovier_b: No one can save me. And nobody will.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_percillawallen: I will defend this farm with everything I have. It shall not fall to the Lost. We will support Prydwen until the bitter end.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_percillawallen_ne: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />This keep and farm was granted to me by Artorius himself, many centuries ago. <g id="male_willcoverit" />This is where I make my stand, not at Prydwen.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_phaedra_a: Excuse me, I am trying to make sure I brought all of my materials. So I have papyrus, my pen, and my journals.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_phaedra_b: Ink? Did I bring ink? By Hephesteus' beard I better not have dropped it…
npc_defaultdialogue_00_priyathakur_a: This land is empty… as empty as my dreams.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_priyathakur_b: My farm is ruined. What am I to do now? Death is temporary, but suffering seems to spring eternal here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_regentjinjae_a: <g id="female_bowDeep" />Normally, I would extend every courtesy to a new visitor to Prydwen, but there are serious matters that require my attention.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_regentjinjae_a_ne: <g id="female_bowDeep" />Normally, I would extend every courtesy to a new visitor to Prydwen, but there are serious matters that require my attention.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_regentjinjae_b: Care for the townspeople as you would your family, and you will always be welcome here.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_rima: <g id="g_litearmor_converseright" />New Corsica may be my favorite city in all of Aeternum - the<g id="g_female_flirtsmall" /> romance, the mystery, the passionate heat of desert nights… it's a lively place.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_royahakimi_a: I've always wanted to join the Iron Rose Company. They're a brave lot.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_royahakimi_b: They saved me from a grisly death when I was new here. I'd be haunting this island as a Lost if it weren't for them.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_saatvikagrawal: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Hello there, wayfarer. I see you're a newcomer to Corinth. You should speak with Captain Dupont if you haven't already.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_serpaynebennett_a: Greetings, intrepid adventurer! Have you perchance ambled up from the shore? What tidings do you bring?
<g id="male_spreadarms001" />Welcome to Prydwen, traveler! I do hope you're the honorable sort. Security is critical right now. But, you seem friendly enough. Carry on!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_serpaynebennett_b: The town of Prydwen anxiously awaits news of that colossal storm.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_shaegarcia: I came here from the north, believing this place would be better. Instead, I found a den of snakes in the guise of chivalry.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_shazaancortis_a: My peers are probably having a good time fishing somewhere on the island, sharing tales of the Old World.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_shazaancortis_b: Meanwhile, I’ve barely made it out of a monster-ridden mine with my skin intact.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_talesaserrano: <g id="sit_headtilthmm" />Did you see that? No? Ah, well. Maybe next time. When you're a hunter like me, you learn to keep a sharp eye out.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_tomiradudek_a: Thanks for rescuing us! When I was surrounded by the Lost, I remembered everyone who’d ever told me I shouldn’t venture out on my own.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_tomiradudek_b: Beating the odds felt good. It made every decision I’ve ever made feel right in a way.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_towerjournal: The journal looks like a trove of knowledge. But the size makes you wonder if it was left here on purpose.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_tsuifen_a: <g id="male_bowShallow" />There is a serene little pond up here, a nice place to sit and meditate... <g id="male_shrugBrief" />as long as the pumas aren't prowling about.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_tsuifen_b: <g id="male_handshipsdisapprove" />Beware if you go further - there's a very angry Bear. Many have been mauled by trespassing in its lair.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_utkarshsingh_a: Have you found any Ancient tombs? How better to learn about how they lived than to study how they treated their dead!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_utkarshsingh_b: Though I suppose death is somewhat fluid here… I simply must continue my studies!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_verildisjannsen: Welcome to 'The Southern Breeze'! May a gentle wind always guide you home! Do you wish to check in? We'd be happy to have you!
npc_defaultdialogue_00_yelenapajitnova: Oh dear, you spooked me! I'm a little nervous wandering around out here on my own.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_youngegeiser: Ah… hello! Wish I had more time to talk. But I’ve got new scrolls to study. Must get to it.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_zhanghaoyu_a: When times are tough, people are nervous. And nervous people want armor.
npc_defaultdialogue_00_zhanghaoyu_b: I'm flattered my work is being appreciated, but it's been difficult keeping up with the demand.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_ahurafarid_a: Every day is the same. The same walls over and over. The same woes. There is no splendor.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_ahurafarid_b: I want to feel excited by life again, but everything has lost its color.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_allyamusa_a: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />For a while, some of the miners were holding out, fighting back with their picks against the teeth and claws of their now-Withered friends.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_allyamusa_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />At this point, it's probably a lost cause. <g id="male_shakehead" />I can't imagine that any of them are still standing.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_ashedubois_a: Have you ever met such coordinated pirates? It’s like they went to school or something.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_ashedubois_b: How will people ever find their way to Prydwen, if they can’t even survive this beach?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_cemalqadir_a: I’d help you settle in, but I’m the one who needs help right now.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_cemalqadir_b: We've lost men, lost equipment. I have to build strong defenses for the Regent and her people, but how can I do that without resources?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_dayomusa_a: It was nothing short of a plague. They kept coming in droves, and it was all we could do to hold them back.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_dayomusa_b: I was sure faith had a role to play here, as it does in the tales back home.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_eddayonkers_a: <g id="female_explainS" />Love keeps you warm, but so does wool. Come to me, if you ever need something stitched.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_eddayonkers_b: <g id="female_explainS" />I've made a fair garment for many a fine folk. Even my darling Eddie, <g id="female_fingerwagNo" />who isn’t back yet!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_eliasderit_a: This whole thing started when we found a damn tablet deep in the mine.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_eliasderit_b: Someone had tried to make it look like it was just unearthed, but I know the look of freshly cut stone, and it wasn't fresh.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_eliasderit_new: <g id="female_taptemple" /> I saw it with my own eyes - an ancient tablet unearthed from its rocky tomb. <g id="male_shakehead" />I had a bad feeling about it from the start. An ill omen to be sure!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_elricchapman_a: What is in the spheres? A weapon? A treasure? Something more sinister?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_elricchapman_b: The excavation crew should have found out by now. Where have they gone?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_fancybrushset: [A set of well maintained brushes rests here. Somone must have left them behind. There seems to be some vellum with them.]
npc_defaultdialogue_01_fionamurphy: Come, Seeker, danger abounds, but your fortune will be grown. The Lost banished, peace found, when the True Heir takes the throne.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_francisturner_a: I suppose you've heard about the famine that's beset our lands. A crisis that demands action, not finger pointing.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_francisturner_a_n: <g id="sit_laughmed_francis" />Haha! A fresh, healthy face with a spark of hope in your eyes! <g id="sit_nod_francis" />That's what we need around here! <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />Less of this moping about and finger-pointing.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_francisturner_b: Some people are claiming this was the work of the sorceress Medea, but that's a load of hogwash.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_francisturner_b_n: <g id="sit_headshakeno_francis" />Elder Saatvik goes around preaching curses on every corner. <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />If he keeps it up, he'll cause a panic! <g id="sit_nod_francis" />How about some good tidings, for once?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_fudehinode_a: This is wonderful! With my favorite set of brushes back in hand, I can paint better landscapes!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_fudehinode_b: Where should I go next? North to Everfall for all that glorious foliage, or south to First Light and those impressive ruins?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_geertielother: Hey, are you the one I've been hearing about? Yes, you must be. You match the description. People talk around here, you know.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_gideonstormsbane_: For god's sake! Where the hell did you come from? Did you see? The entire garrison has turned Lost!

<g id="male_giveup" />It's over, man! It's all over! Everyone's fallen Lost! <g id="female_lookaroundshifty" priority="high"/>And they're trying to make me Lost, too! I may already be turning! Oath be damned! <g id="male_wavehandsnobig" priority="high"/>I quit… I'm done!
My brave comrades are all soulless husks. I saw Cotheran fall… I thought I was surely next…

<g id="female_drawbackAfraid" priority="high" />You-you didn't see… Sergeant Cotheran took an arrow and then she turned<g id="male_whattheheckBig" priority="high" /> and tried to bite my throat! That's it! I'm done! <g id="male_forgetit" />I quit!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_graceomalley_a: <g id="grace_bowHead" priority="high" />I managed to sell that loot we collected. <g id="grace_handheart" />Never let it be said that Grace O'Malley doesn't pay her debts!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_graceomalley_b: <g id="grace_giveitem" priority="high"/>Here's your share of the coin. <g id="grace_headnodyes" />I think you should get to spending it.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_hamzakillic_a: Show me your smile. Your teeth are radiant. Do you use Miswak to brush them?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_hamzakillic_b: In the Ottoman Empire, everyone had good teeth. Here, not so much. Here, people eat whatever they get.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_hugomolina_a: Did you venture forth for freedom or fame? I came here to live happily with my sweetheart, a Moorish woman.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_hugomolina_b: We both fled from impending execution for our forbidden love. Who knew I’d one day crave death like water in the desert?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_kathrijnjanssen_a: Things are pretty dire, aren't they? We've got Swarmancers, we've got Lost, and people are starting to lose hope.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_kathrijnjanssen_b: But I've got a plan to get everyone's spirits back up! You know what everyone loves?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_leovixsilva_a: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />It makes no sense! The Iron Rose have steel spines and iron resolve! <g id="male_shakehead" />We don't despair!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_leovixsilva_b: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />Ultimately, I also fell, beneath the blade of one of my former comrades. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I was too shocked to fight back!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lijsbetdevries: <g id="female_worry"/>Oh dear, did no one else come through this with their souls intact? It should've <g id="male_willcoverit"/>been me who fell Lost. The others were newer to the island.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lioneldelarue_a: I know you're aware of our supply shortages here in Windsward. I've even heard you helped restock our food and wood stores, and for that you have my profound thanks.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lioneldelarue_b: But we are running dangerously low on clothing.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lochnir_a: Across the centuries, I've watched the light fade from Monarch's Bluffs in the absence of a true ruler.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lochnir_a_new: <g id="guard_laughmed" />Ah yes, the newcomer invited to an audience with the Knight-Regent. Imagine, <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />if you had arrived a few days later, you might've been welcomed by a king!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lochnir_b: Of course, the Knight-Regent has done all she can, with my wise counsel. And now, our patience will soon be rewarded.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_lochnir_b_new: <g id="guard_nod" />Yes, Gawain's return will restore Prydwen's glory. <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />The Knight-Regent has performed well with my counsel, but she sometimes... exceeds her mandate.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_marceldupont_a: Hmm, according to Reese's report, you're quite the hero. Good for you!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_marceldupont_a_ne: <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />As if we don't have enough problems… everyone talking about some ancient curse on the land! <g id="guard_headshakeno" />Last thing we need is to have to worry about Corrupted as well.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_marceldupont_b: Well, hero or not, we can't afford another mouth to feed. Corinth has gone from feast to famine.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_margotemerson_a: Aeternum is a new land full of strange beasts. New paths that need charting. There is so little we understand. Like the Buffalo.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_margotemerson_b: <g id="male_shakehead" />They just don't make any sense. There must be an answer to the question of them.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_mb_grace_a: <g id="grace_yes" />We're both a little light in the pocket, <g id="grace_giveitem" priority="high"/>but I did sell that loot we collected, so there's your share.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_mb_grace_b: <g id="grace_bowhead" priority="high"/>Never let it be said Grace O'Malley doesn't pay her debts.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_medea_a: <g id="female_crossarmssuspicious" />Well now, it seems someone has finally begun restoring my shrines. Why are people so quick to forget their history? <g id="male_headShakeNo" />
npc_defaultdialogue_01_michaellewis_a: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />After what I've seen, I fear eternal life may become eternal torment. <g id="male_concernS" />It's a sight that will haunt me all my days.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_michaellewis_b: <g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high"/>Watching my sweet Therese consumed by beetles, and then rise up again as a Withered…
npc_defaultdialogue_01_moirachapman_a: Have you visited the towers yet? They certainly stand out. Can't get lost with the towers to guide your way.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_moirachapman_b: I wish we knew more about them. They had to be created for some greater purpose!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_moirachapman_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />And with the situation in Windsward more dire than it's been in centuries, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />we will gladly accept your help. <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Are you here to talk about the location of the shrines?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_nabijeong_a: As royal ladies, we've always been protected. We led lavish lives in the Joseon court and for a while, in Ebonscale Reach.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_nabijeong_b: It's the first time we're living out in the wilds, like common folk. We're trying to adapt.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_nessaharrower_a: Nothing I've learned in all my studies has prepared me for this.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_nessaharrower_b: I've heard of Druids falling ill, or even becoming Lost, but some truly foul magic is at work here.
