npc_defaultdialogue_01_nessaharrower_new: <g id="female_whattheheck" />What a mess! Nothing in my studies prepared me for this. <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />I came looking for the other druids, and somehow, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I got a bit… surrounded, I suppose.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_oldegeiser_a: How does it feel to be alive, stranger? To know you cannot die?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_oldegeiser_b: I used to dig graves in Bavaria but obviously, I couldn't do that here. I survived on scraps for a while until I devised a new livelihood.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_oliviabarovier_a: I have been ruined. I can't work like I once used to.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_oliviabarovier_b: What good are hands when your mind is occupied by the demons that plague your dreams?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_percillawallen_a: It was not long after I left Teyrnon Keep that my fellow knights there… fell to becoming Lost as well.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_percillawallen_b: If I overheard correctly, you found proof that Lochnir planned all of this?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_percillawallen_ne: <g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> The knights I served with at Teyrnon Keep were the bravest, most loyal men and women I've ever known. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />To think of them as fallen… it's too much to bear.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_phaedra: You! Oh, you there! Can you spare me a moment, please?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_priyathakur_a: Where has my zeal gone? I used to be thrilled to tend the crops, to share my food with others, but now it feels empty.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_priyathakur_b: Seems like I've seen all there is to see. Done all there is to do.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_regentjinjae_a: For weeks now, we've heard horror stories from people fleeing the farms, grieving the loved ones that turned on them.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_regentjinjae_a_ne: <g id="female_worry" priority="high" />With all the excitement for the return of the True Heir, I believe we are ignoring signs of grave threats to <g id="female_shrugshort" />Prydwen, and news of Corrupted adds to the list.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_regentjinjae_b: Behind their words, I sense a suppressed longing to surrender their own souls to despair.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_regentjinjae_b_ne: <g id="female_clasphandsrequest" />However, the greater concern right now is the rash of disappearances, <g id="male_headshakeno" />sworn knights who've failed to report in over the last several weeks.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_rima_a: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />This is no common wayfarer stopping in for a tankard and a tune!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_rima_b: <g id="g_male_spreadarmscalm" />Your deeds are known to me, Soulwarden, and your more recent incarnation leading the Silver Crows. I've considered composing a song about you.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_royahakimi_a: Commander Merrill dives under the minotaur's blade, dodges left, weaves right, and plunges his sword into the heart of the beast!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_royahakimi_b: Oh, sorry. I didn't notice someone was near. I was… training.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_saatvikagrawal_a: But all that aside, you're still welcome in Corinth.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_saatvikagrawal_a_: <g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />Even with this demoralizing display, the Speaker chooses ignorance! <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />He brushes off any suggestion the Sorceress Medea's cursed us.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_saatvikagrawal_b: And really, I shouldn't suggest this famine is the result of bad luck. Our town leader, the "Speaker of the Winds" is entirely responsible for all this.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_serpaynebennett_a: In his report, Watcher Reese acknowledges your heroism, in which case, you belong here - Prydwen has a strong tradition of heroes.
<g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />The worst part is that it's all happening on the eve of the most fortuitous occasion Prydwen's known in four hundred years!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_serpaynebennett_b: Of course, we always welcome guests, and you've arrived at a most fortuitous occasion.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_talesaserrano_a: Everyone needs goods, don't they? <g id="sit_headshakeno" />Sadly, we have none to spare.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_talesaserrano_b: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />And it's not just food. Everyone eats, of course. But folks need timber, stone, and leather as well.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_towerjournal_a: The journal looks like a trove of knowledge. It's certainly massive enough.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_towerjournal_b: After flipping through the pages, you find an address inked inside the back cover.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_tsuifen_a: <g id="female_youknow" />Ah. The farms may be unproductive and overrun, but luckily, animals are still abundant.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_tsuifen_b: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />You look tough enough to help hunt pumas. They provide good food for the settlement, and hides for the tanner's guild.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_utkarshsingh_a: I've spelunked caverns of the ancients, crossed the sands of Brimstone by foot, and yet the world is still closed to me. I've found no answers. Only more questions.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_utkarshsingh_b: What is the point of searching anymore? To what end?
npc_defaultdialogue_01_verildisjannsen: Welcome to 'The Southern Breeze'! May a gentle wind always guide you home! You wish to check in? Now this is a pleasant surprise, two new customers in one day!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_verildisjannsen_a: Welcome to 'The Southern Breeze'! May a gentle wind always guide you home
npc_defaultdialogue_01_verildisjannsen_b: You wish to check in? Now this is a pleasant surprise, two new customers in one day!
npc_defaultdialogue_01_yelenapajitnova_a: Oh dear, you spooked me! Needless to say, I'm a little nervous wandering around out here on my own.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_yelenapajitnova_b: I must complete my collection, however, whatever risk it requires.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_zander_b: You look ready to embark on a great adventure.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_zhanghaoyu_a: A new face? I haven't seen you around Corinth before.
npc_defaultdialogue_01_zhanghaoyu_b: I suppose it falls to me to tell you about our current troubles. Wouldn't want you to go around uninformed.
npc_defaultdialogue_01a_francisturner_ne: Hehe, Elder Saatvik, <g id="sit_shrugbrief_francis" />when will he learn? When confronted with confidence, <g id="sit_nod_francis" />these problems solve themselves!
npc_defaultdialogue_01b_serpaynebennett: Did you meet with the Minister? He will certainly get you started in your new life here in Prydwen!
npc_defaultdialogue_01b_serpaynebennett_: <g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high" />Well, you seem to be getting along ! I do hope you had time to meet with the Knight-Regent. She was rather anxious to hear your account.
npc_defaultdialogue_01postquest_elriccha: Curious… I've been hypothesizing that the spheres were either a tool of creation or transportation from the Ancients.
I'm not sure what determines what is conjured. I wonder if that's how the buffalo got to this island…?
npc_defaultdialogue_0242a_00_edeabernath: Careful! No stepping on my honeysuckle! Hard enough to grow anything in this bleeding place without bootprints through my flower bed.
Had to import my own hives just to get the flowers blooming.
npc_defaultdialogue_0242a_01_edeabernath: This is who we really are, stranger. Cowards, the lot of us. Willing to plow under friends and neighbors just to save our own hide.
Some crimes aren’t meant to be forgiven. Believe me… I know better than most.
npc_defaultdialogue_0242a_02_edeabernath: Tread careful, stranger. The longer you stay in this place, the more like you are to lose yourself.
Once, I was like you: proud and brave. Then, the man I trusted most took the sword from my hand, and handed me a shovel…
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_00_nikodemus_a: Best keep on the march, stranger. See in this place, sometimes your final rest ain’t your final rest.
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_00_nikodemus_b: And when the dead get restless, we give them to the earth here. You don’t want to be around when they get restless, do you?
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_01_nikodemus_a: You don’t know what it was like, stranger. Friends and loved ones going about their day, minding their own, off they go into town, and they come back Lost!
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_01_nikodemus_b: We just wanted to spare the families that pain.
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_02_nikodemus_a: Gone you say? Well that don’t change a thing!
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_02_nikodemus_b: I swore I’d keep the dark ones turning in their graves until the waters take this place. I’ll see to it the dead stay buried, for so long as I can still lift a shovel!
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_03_nikodemus_a: I hear the Vigil’s shuffled off the old mortal coil? Well, curse or no curse, the dead here are still restless.
npc_defaultdialogue_0243a_03_nikodemus_b: And it’s up to old Nik to keep them tethered to the ground. It’s a dirty job, friend. But for the sake of old Calvary, somebody’s got to do it.
npc_defaultdialogue_0244a_00_sebastionmo: Eggs, almonds, vanilla, a touch of rosewater, and… magic!
Guten tag, stranger! I am Sebastian, confectioner extraordinaire. For what else is there to live for in this God-forsaken place? Now please, try the marzipan. It is wunderbar!
npc_defaultdialogue_0244a_01_sebastionmo: These are dark days, friend. But in here, things are always sweet! Enjoy a sample of the butchtel.
Like the sun rising above the clouds, bringing a rush of fresh air. Keep the bounce in your step as you stand tall against the dark powers that prowl this accursed place!
npc_defaultdialogue_0244a_02_sebastionmo: Ah, my friend! At last, we are free! There is hope again in the eyes of the people.
This calls for a celebration. I must bake a great cake! One that will do justice to such a momentous occasion. A masterpiece!
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_00_zhuliang_a: Where am I from? There is a land to the Northwest of here, stranger. My Empress is most concerned about the happenings here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_00_zhuliang_b: From the Corruption massing to the north, to the scourge of the Lost, I have been sent to learn of these new threats.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_01_zhuliang_a: Take care who you choose to serve, stranger.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_01_zhuliang_b: The enemy of your enemy is not always your friend. The things men do in the grip of fear are not always guided by reason.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_02_zhuliang_a: Tread carefully, friend. The Lost are not easily laid to rest, and those with a sense of grievance or sanctimony usually do not go quietly.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_02_zhuliang_b: Keep your blade true and your wits about you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_03_zhuliang_a: Fate, it seems, is not done with you. It pleases me that you are well.
npc_defaultdialogue_0245a_03_zhuliang_b: This strange place needs warriors like you, who will stand against the tide of unnatural forces until the price of eternity comes due.
npc_defaultdialogue_0246a_00_corneliusva: Strange. So strange! Bark, roots, leaves, branches—the power of Azoth permeates them all.
Where else but here could such an oddity exist? Have you ever seen such a marvel, stranger? Praise be!
npc_defaultdialogue_0246a_01_corneliusva: Out of balance? Nonsense! This land is positively teeming with all the energies of the universe! Life itself runs through the very soil.
npc_defaultdialogue_0246a_02_corneliusva: You’ve seen it? Touched it? And come back to tell the tale?
You are very lucky, stranger! This land has offered up its blessings, and you have been found worthy.
npc_defaultdialogue_0246a_03_corneliusva: The balance has been restored! Yes… I feel it now.
The flow seems steadier. Somehow stronger. I did not know one could improve on perfection, but here it is!
npc_defaultdialogue_0247a_00_anorawoodvi: Don’t make any trouble, outsider. Just because times are hard doesn’t mean you can simply do as you please.
There are laws here in Calvary and they are strictly enforced!
npc_defaultdialogue_0247a_01_anorawoodvi: There are no heroes out there, walking the road, waiting to come save us.
We have to find the strength to save ourselves!
npc_defaultdialogue_0247a_02_anorawoodvi: Do you know what it takes to protect a home in times like these, stranger? To make hard choices to keep the ones you love safe?
People were scared! Order was breaking down! We did what we had to do.
npc_defaultdialogue_0247a_03_anorawoodvi: It was true what I said about hard times, stranger. But I always had doubts.
The cost has been so great. Perhaps… in the end, we all reap what we have sown. I pray that, in time, I may be forgiven.
npc_defaultdialogue_0247a_04_anorawoodvi: Maybe now that the Vigil’s reign of terror is over, we can begin to trust each other once more.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_00_rosecolly_a: What’s it like out there, friend? Living by your wits, fighting the good fight. I’d be like to follow you if it weren’t for I’m needed here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_00_rosecolly_b: Knighthood’s grand, but there’s no town without a good mason to put one stone on top of another.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_01_rosecolly_a: So chivalry’s dead, is it? I suppose nothing endures in this strange new world of ours.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_01_rosecolly_b: The Bright Vigil were supposed to be a light in these dark times.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_02_rosecolly_a: The Bright Vigil has fallen? Good riddance. Maybe someone like you can be a new beacon for Brightwood in the darkness.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_02_rosecolly_b: You give us hope that there are still heroes in this world.
npc_defaultdialogue_0248a_03_rosecolly: I thought the Bright Vigil was standing tall to protect us from the dark forces, but it was we who needed protecting from them!
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_00_aethelwynn_: <g id="female_crossarms" />The villages don't look at all inviting,<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" /> and the villagers even less.
<g id="female_disappointed" />Ugh, maybe this isn't the right place after all.<g id="female_waveoffdisdain" /> Where did I put my map?
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_01_aethelwynn: <g id="female_nodrelieved" />Hello? Oh, thank goodness, you're not one of the wandering Lost.<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> I'm Aethelwynn, and you're the friendliest face I've seen all day.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_02_aethelwynn: <g id="female_youknow" />Just about done reading through these records.<g id="female_thinking" /> My eyes are swimming, but it'll be worth it in the end. It has to be.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_03_aethelwynn: <g id="female_beckon" />I was about to go looking for you, {playerName}!<g id="female_taptemple" /> You'll never guess what I found in those moldy old records.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_04_aethelwynn: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />People still live here?<g id="female_worry" /> I thought this place would be full of nothing but ghosts.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_05_aethelwynn: <g id="female_shrugshort" />You... still want to help me, right?<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> Find treasure, I mean. If you don't, I'd understand.<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> I could figure something out on my own.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_06_aethelwynn: <g id="female_youknow" />…Hi. Seems like you've met Baldr.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_07_aethelwynn: <g id="female_explains" />I owe you an explanation.<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> And an awful lot of gratitude. I'm sure<g id="female_taptemple" /> you've realized the truth by now, but I'm no treasure hunter.<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> Sorry…
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_08_aethelwynn_: <g id="female_apologetic" />There is one last thing. My<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> sister Emmeline's necklace. It was the<g id="female_spreadarms" /> only real valuable we owned.
I'll<g id="female_handsonhipsshakehead" /> bet Archminister Havelock took it. He always was a greedy bastard.
npc_defaultdialogue_0249a_09_aethelwynn_: <g id="female_thinking" />Can I tell you a secret? I thought you were a bit scary when we first met.
<g id="female_taptemple" />But I was desperate, and I took a chance.<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> Luckily for me, you were one of the brightest souls left in Brightwood.
npc_defaultdialogue_0250a_00_baldr: (The large dog is clearly not interested in you.)
npc_defaultdialogue_0250a_01_baldr_a: (This is where you were supposed to meet Aethelwynn, but there's no sign of her.
npc_defaultdialogue_0250a_01_baldr_b: (Instead, this large dog sits at the crossroads.)
npc_defaultdialogue_0250a_02_baldr: (The dog gives you a friendly wag of his tail, but sticks stubbornly by Aethelwynn's side.)
npc_defaultdialogue_0250a_03_baldr: (Though it's taken a while, it seems Baldr has finally warmed up to you.)
npc_defaultdialogue_0251a_00_headstone: [The writing on this rough headstone is weathered with age.]
npc_defaultdialogue_0251a_01_headstone_a: [The writing on this rough headstone is weathered with age.]
npc_defaultdialogue_0251a_01_headstone_b: [On closer examination, you can make out a few words: Aethelwynn, daughter of Adalbert the carpenter.]
npc_defaultdialogue_0251a_02_headstone: [Aethelwynn's headstone, abandoned to the wind and rain. In time, even the faded name will disappear.]
npc_defaultdialogue_02_ahurafarid: Look at the green of the trees, the azure glory of the river. There is such beauty in the hues of the world.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_allyamusa: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />It was startling to see some of my miners escaping with their souls intact. The Knight-Regent may have sent help late, but I'm glad she sent you.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_ashedubois_b: Let's keep protecting those who newly arrive here and one day, we may be made knights for our efforts!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_cemalqadir_a: Let me give you a tip, rajal sadaq. No one cares where you came from. We care about what you can do.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_cemalqadir_b: The Regent made me her Master Builder after she saw my work. Though she probably regrets that now…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_dayomusa: I hope you keep an open heart on this island. I fear it's too late for me. One who has been bitten by a snake lives in fear of worms.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_eddayonkers: <g id="female_explainS" />Eddie made life here bearable, you know. Without him… What am I thinking? You don’t have the time to listen to my woes.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_eliasderit_a: A promise is a promise. You held up your end of the bargain, so it's my turn.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_eliasderit_b: I'll go, but I swear one thing - I'll be coming back to reclaim this place as soon as we get the Lost out.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_eliasderit_new: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />I hate to abandon the mine, but with the tablet gone, <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />maybe these pirates clear out and we can get back to work after time passes… if anyone's left, that is.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_elricchapman: There you are! I've been looking for you. I have a theory. My mother thinks it's hogwash, but I believe it to hold promise.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_fatherrusso: <g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />She abandoned me in the dark, she never loved me, my love turns to dust in my hands, bile in my mouth. Something approaches, something calls to me. <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />Dear God, save my soul…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_fionamurphy_a: The True Heir sought to save us once, and now, the answer they’ll bring.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_fionamurphy_b: The Lost will learn, be forever turned. They’ll know them as Our One True King!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_francisturner: <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />How many times do I have to tell people? We sent the damn tribute! No matter, <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Captain Dupont will soon sort out who's been spreading such nasty rumors.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_francisturner_a: How many times do I have to tell people? We sent the damn tribute!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_francisturner_b: No matter, Captain Dupont will soon sort out who's been spreading such nasty rumors.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_geertielother: You did me a good turn with my "Devil's Honey." I'm thinking I might have another favor to ask, if you've got the time.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_gideonstormsbane: I'm fighting my way out of here, one way or another! I owe it to my Iron Rose comrades to survive! I will never forget you, dear friends!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_gideonstormsbane_: <g id="female_shrinkEmbarrassed" />I'm just gonna stay here a minute... I think I spoiled my armor. <g id="male_smallSingleWave" />Go on, it's better if we travel separately.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_graceomalley_a: The real tragedy of Corinth is there's no way a girl can make some quick money around here.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_graceomalley_a_ne: <g id="grace_chuckle" />This Elder Saatvik fellow came in, <g id="grace_yes" />trying to rally folks to go out and salvage crops from the farms, <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />but he offered no reward!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_graceomalley_b: That daft town guard treats me like your servant, leaving me messages to give you. And not a single coin for it!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_graceomalley_b_ne: <g id="grace_convince1" />Heh. Poor bastard didn't get a single volunteer. Went out on his own... <g id="grace_headshakeno" />Barkeep says he'll probably become a soulless Lost himself…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_hamzakillic: If you ever lose all your teeth, you know who to find. You may lose your soul but you'll never lose your smile!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_heretic: <g id="female_leanforwardListensound" />The screams… they sing like a choir… <g id="male_nodProud" />a lovely chorus of suffering...
npc_defaultdialogue_02_hugomolina_a: Fatimah will be delighted with this mirror. I can sense a bit of magic in it already.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_hugomolina_b: I wonder why she was so insistent I put it together. Maybe, I'll find out soon.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_kathrijnjanssen_a: It's not just dessert that will make the settlement feel better.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_kathrijnjanssen_b: After weeks of tough, dried meat that tastes like leather, everyone is sure to enjoy a meal full of robust flavor.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_leovixsilva_a: What news from the garrison? What's this? Sergeant Cotheran's armband! Oh no...
npc_defaultdialogue_02_leovixsilva_a_new: <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high" />What did you find there? Is this… Sergeant Cotheran's armband...? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I can't believe it. The fall of Cotheran the Red.<g id="male_hanghead" priority="high"/> Never thought I'd see the day.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_leovixsilva_b: The fall of Cotheran the Red, all the more tragic because she had been assigned to escort the tribute to Medea.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_leovixsilva_b_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Of course, this day is not like any other. The Iron Keep has fallen to darkness. <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />Something, or someone, clearly brought a curse on us.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lijsbetdevries: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />I've been on this island longer than I can recall, and I've rebuilt my life many times. But I'm so tired… <g id="male_shrugBrief" />I can't start over again. I simply don't have the heart…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lijsbetdevries_a: I've been on this island longer than I can recall, and I've rebuilt my life many times.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lijsbetdevries_b: But I'm so tired… I can't start over again. I simply don't have the heart…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lioneldelarue_a: The Ancients had such wonderful garments, such fantastic cloth, such marvelous dyes.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lioneldelarue_b: My dream is to recreate those stunning fashions and make them into modern sensations.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lochnir: <g id="guard_nod" />I do hope you appreciate your good fortune. The future is very bright. <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />When the True Heir assumes the throne, we will restore Prydwen's former glory.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lochnir_a: I do hope you appreciate your good fortune. The future is very bright.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_lochnir_b: When the True Heir assumes the throne, we will restore Prydwen's former glory.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_marceldupont_a: Let me know when you and Quartermaster Agrawal have solved our supply crisis.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_marceldupont_b: I'll gather everyone together and we'll boost you up on our shoulders and parade you around town.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_marceldupont_new: So you talked to the Speaker, did you? Heh. And now back on the road. That's for the best, I think.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_margotemerson: <g id="female_spreadarms" />When was the last time you truly stood in wonder of the world? There is glory in the morning dew. The sun's kiss on our cheeks is more warm and gentle than any lover's lips.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_mb_grace_a: That Ser Payne and Minister Lochnir talk this place up like it's got a grand history and a bright future, but I'm not buying it.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_mb_grace_a_new: <g id="grace_shifty" priority="high" />Word around town says the Knight-Regent's just a puppet, and some Minister Lochnir's actually running things. And then this 'True Heir' business…
npc_defaultdialogue_02_mb_grace_b: Word in the tavern is that Prydwen's overrun with people fleeing from trouble at the outlying farms.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_mb_grace_b_new: <g id="grace_secret" priority="high"  />You'd think that's what drew the crowds, but barkeep says it's really just people fleeing from trouble at the outlying farms.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_medea: <g id="female_waveoffDisdain" />What's done is done. I shall no longer stand idly by while my work is scorned, broken, disrupted. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />They shall soon see the terrible glory of my craft!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_michaellewis: <g id="male_shakehead" />I can't stay here. Too many memories destroyed along with these fields.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_michaellewis_a: I can't stay here. Too many memories destroyed along with these fields.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_michaellewis_b: Whoever's responsible for this, I'm going to make sure they get what they deserve!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_moirachapman_a: There's no end to what we could learn from the ancients. If you wish to know more, you should speak to my son Elric.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_moirachapman_b: He's been studying the spheres, those fascinating artifacts!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_moirachapman_new: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Though I am not endorsing this calamity, it's always nice <g id="litearmor_youknow" />when historical insights are needed to solve present-day challenges.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_nabijeong_a: A free life is better than a royal one, traveler.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_nabijeong_b: The last thing I want is a pair of shackles around these heels. Maybe one day, I'll convince my mother.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_nessaharrower_a: <g id="female_whattheheck" />How did the farms deteriorate so quickly? <g id="male_shakehead" />It just doesn't make sense.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_nessaharrower_b: <g id="female_thinking" />Hmm. Transforming druids into swarmancers, that's not human magic. <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />That seems like the magic of the island itself.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_oldegeiser_a: A lot of people passed right by me before you stopped and offered me assistance.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_oldegeiser_b: Olde Geiser will remember you for your kindness always. May you go far on the island!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_oliviabarovier_a: My father had his time with me and he squandered it. I have no time for his sentiments now.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_oliviabarovier_b: At least his glassworks have fetched a good price.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_percillawallen_a: The Minister told us we would be honored to be the first to kneel before the new king.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_percillawallen_b: But when he ushered Ser Gawain into the Keep, we realized… the True Heir was Lost himself! We were aghast, speechless.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_percillawallen_ne: <g id="male_concernS" /> I must confess… I fought at Jin Jae's side for centuries and never realized how strong she really is. <g id="male_realize" />Her resolve in the face of this horror… I-I don't know.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_phaedra_a: The wording needs to evoke emotion, stir the imagination, and seize the reader's attention.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_phaedra_b: I'll read this a thousand times if I have to just to get it right!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_priyathakur: I walk lighter because of you. There is a pep in these old bones. I am blessed to be alive in this land of marvels.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_regentjinjae: <g id="female_clasphandsrequest" />If there is indeed trouble at the mines, do what you can to help them. Let me know what comes of it.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_rima: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Don't mistake the complexity of my request for hesitation. I am<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> very much interested in teaming up with you and the Silver Crows.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_royahakimi: The creed says valor is a beacon to those who've lost hope. Let your blade shine a light in the dark….
npc_defaultdialogue_02_saatvikagrawal_a: Whether the Speaker decides to resume tribute or not, the real problem now is finding enough food to get us through the week.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_saatvikagrawal_b: I have my work cut out for me.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_saatvikagrawal_ne: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Whether the Speaker is willing to help or not, <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I have no choice but to take action to help the people of Corinth.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_serpaynebennett_a: Excellent to see you again! Perhaps Miss O'Malley can be trusted, after all.
<g id="male_bowShallow" priority="high"/>Excellent to see you again! I hope you've been steering clear of that pirate captain who arrived just before you. A bad influence, in my estimation.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_serpaynebennett_b: As to you, however, the Watcher's report guarantees it. In fact, the Knight-Regent would like to discuss a rather… delicate situation, if you're willing.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_talesaserrano_a: <g id="sit_nod" />Thanks again, friend! We'll find a good use for everything you brought.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_talesaserrano_b: <g id="sit_nod" />We can strengthen our walls against the Lost. Folks will have new shoes to run away from horrors. <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />And the Speaker can finally get his escritoire!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_tsuifen_a: <g id="male_shakehead" />Oh dear, oh dear. There was another death - the kind that people rarely return from.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_tsuifen_b: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Getting mauled by a bear is enough to make even the hardiest souls become Lost.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_utkarshsingh: There is more yet to be seen. Not documented and researched, but lived. The eyes do not tire so long as they glimpse the horizon and yearn for tomorrow.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_verildisjannsen: Welcome back to 'The Southern Breeze'! May a gentle wind always guide you home! Do you wish to check in? We'd be happy to have you!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_yelenapajitnova_a: The items you helped add to my collection suggest multiple possibilities for the Ancients' construction methods.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_yelenapajitnova_b: Do return some time and we shall explore these matters further.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_youngegeiser: I can't imagine how the tablet and the altar were affecting the Lost. But if there are answers, they'll come from those ruins!
npc_defaultdialogue_02_zhanghaoyu_a: With the Lost prowling, it's not safe to head outside the settlement's walls without protection.
npc_defaultdialogue_02_zhanghaoyu_b: Some youngsters have been demanding more weapons and armor to defend themselves, but… only a fool would arm anybody that green.
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_grace_a: Before you go all heroic on me and kill the deal, you've got to make sure you have the full story.
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_grace_alt_a: <g id="g_grace_convince2" />More good news! I've caught wind of another adventurer well-suited to joining the Silver Crows.
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_grace_alt_b: <g id="g_grace_doubt" />Between you and Zander, we got the brawn. This one, she brings a wealth of knowledge. And not the kind you get from a book!
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_grace_b: I know someone who can help us, a real knowledgable lady I've been eyeing as a recruit for the Silver Crows.
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_rima_a: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />For a moment, I doubted whether you would go through with it, but I am<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> enormously pleased that you did.
npc_defaultdialogue_02a_rima_b: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />If you have collected what I asked for with the satyr's flute, all that remains now is the music.
npc_defaultdialogue_02b_rima: <g id="g_male_spreadarmscalm" />Go on. My ears and my heart yearn to hear your music.
npc_defaultdialogue_02c_rima_a: <g id="g_male_leanforwardinspect" />Ah, to rest my eyes on such a legendary instrument! This alone would be adequate compensation for joining the Silver Crows.
npc_defaultdialogue_02c_rima_b: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />The chance to partner with you and bear witness to your heroic deeds… that<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> is a bonus.
npc_defaultdialogue_0307_00_commander_a: I have no time for those who have not dedicated themselves to battle.
npc_defaultdialogue_0307_01pre_commander: Commander Ozian Atreus here. [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_00_adjudicator: The Spark is unwavering and indivisible. I, Excubitor Livia Luca, live in the light. If you have not witnessed the light, then you soon will.
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_00_alchemist: Do you blindly accept everything you hear as fact?
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_01_adjudicator: Greetings, my fellow believer. The path here in Great Cleave is twisted. Keep focused on the Spark - it will always guide you through.
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_01_alchemist: Yes, I'm Sai Kumal, the Alchemist, who wants to know?
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_01pre_adjudicat: Greetings, my fellow believer. The path here in Great Cleave is twisted. Keep focused on the Spark - it will always guide you through. [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_01pre_alchemist: Yes, I'm Sai Kumal, the Alchemist, who wants to know? [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_02_adjudicator_: I have been looking forward to making your acquaintance, {playerName}.
You have come because you are prepared to face the trial to advance in rank?
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_02pre_adjudicat: I have been looking forward to making your acquaintance, {playerName}.
You have come because you are prepared to face the trial to advance in rank? [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_03_adjudicator: We will keep these revelations about Adjudicator Maras between us for now. We must choose the right moment to confront her.
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_03pre_adjudicat: We will keep these revelations about Adjudicator Maras between us for now.
We must choose the right moment to confront her. [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_04_adjudicator_: Greetings and well met, fellow Lightbringer. You were involved in that business with Livia Luca, weren't you?
It's a shame. She was a woman of great faith once. We must always keep vigil.
npc_defaultdialogue_0308_04pre_adjudicat: Greetings and well met, fellow Lightbringer. You were involved in that business with Livia Luca, weren't you?
It's a shame. She was a woman of great faith once. We must always keep vigil. [ Level 39 required for Great Cleave faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_00_adjudicator_: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />The Spark is unwavering and indivisible. I, Adjudicator Livia Luca, live in the light. If you have not witnessed its majesty, you soon will.
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_01_adjudicator_: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />I must know how my son became Lost. Him becoming Apostate then Lost, something seems amiss.
<g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I cannot say what it is, but I must delve further into this. Surely I will find some detail here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_01pre_adjudicat: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />I must know how my son became Lost. Him becoming Apostate then Lost, something seems amiss.
<g id="female_shakeheadNo" />I cannot say what it is, but I must delve further into this. Surely I will find some detail here.\n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Excubitor"]
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_02_adjudicator_: <g id="female_spreadarms" />I've found the answers I needed, and what's more I found my son's older journals.
<g id="female_headnodding" />I have retraced my son's steps to Weaver's Fen. I'm missing the account of when he traveled there, which is the next piece I need.
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_02pre_adjudicat: <g id="female_spreadarms" />I've found the answers I needed, and what's more I found my son's older journals.

<g id="female_headnodding" />I have retraced my son's steps to Weaver's Fen. I'm missing the account of when he traveled there, which is the next piece I need.\n[ Level 24 required for "Trial of the Excubitor"]
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_03_adjudicator_: <g id="female_headnodding" />My son did so much. He tried to save those Covenant members, yet he was turned away. Why? Why did they spurn him so? I need answers.
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_03pre_adjudicat: <g id="female_headnodding" />My son did so much. He tried to save those Covenant members, yet he was turned away.
<g id="female_thinking" />Why? Why did they spurn him so? I need answers.\n[ Level 43 required for "Trial of the Lumen" ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_04_adjudicator_: <g id="female_headnodding" />It's all here, but I cannot seem to put the pieces together. I must know the truth of it!
<g id="female_thinking" />Great Cleave. Somewhere buried in those snowy peaks, we will find answers. Are you prepared for another trial?
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_04pre_adjudicat: <g id="female_headnodding" />It's all here, but I cannot seem to put the pieces together. I must know the truth of it!
<g id="female_thinking" />Great Cleave. Somewhere buried in those snowy peaks, we will find answers. Are you prepared for another trial? [ Level 43 required for "Trial of the Lumen" ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_05_adjudicator_: <g id="female_headnodding" />Bremen's compassion for the fallen is what compelled him. And yet these leaders rejected him, told him and he was on the wrong path.
<g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />My son lost his soul because of their choice. They have failed us. Failed us all.
npc_defaultdialogue_0309_05pre_adjudicat: <g id="female_headnodding" />Bremen lost himself to this, due to his dedication to compassion for the fallen. And yet the leaders rejected him, told him and he was on the wrong path.
<g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />My son lost his soul because of their choice. They have failed us. Failed us all.\n[ Level 56 required for "Trial of the Adjudicator" ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_00_watcher_a: Welcome, I’m James Sexton, a Soulwarden here at Eastburn Outpost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_00_watcher_b: I'm impressed you made it through; even if there's no bad weather, there's sure to be Corrupted blocking the roads.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_01_watcher_a: Do you have any idea how worried I've been about…oh, you're not her. My apologies.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_01_watcher_b: I'm surprised to see a new face around, our outpost isn't exactly known for casual visits. Especially not in wartime.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_02_watcher_a: Thank you again for recovering Patricia's belongings. It didn't seem right for some Corrupted husk to carry her Heartgem. It means a lot, to have it back.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_02_watcher_b: Oh! You’ve reminded me of something.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_03_watcher_a: When I think of Patricia, fallen to Corruption, I get so mad I can't see straight.
npc_defaultdialogue_0312_03_watcher_b: If only there was something I could do to reverse her condition.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_00_watcher_a: Hello {playerName}, I’m Zhen Chang, a Soulwarden assigned to Eastburn Outpost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_00_watcher_b: How are you liking the cold? I wish I had stayed home insteading of heading into this snowy waste.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_01_watcher_a: So you've seen the monstrosity called Cleaves Malice?
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_01_watcher_b: The Corrupted were able to build it so quickly because we'd done most of the work for them.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_02_watcher: If it's not one thing, it's another. No rest for the weary, friend. Not when there's work to be done.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_03_watcher_a: Thank you for collecting all these Heartgems. I know it wasn’t easy.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_03_watcher_b: But the souls of our friends won’t find rest until we cleanse the Corruption from them. For that, we’ll need to hold a cleansing ritual.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_04_watcher_a: I'm honestly surprised to see you still around. Don't get me wrong, your aid has been invaluable.
npc_defaultdialogue_0313_04_watcher_b: But if I had the choice, I'd be headed home, or at least someplace warmer.
npc_defaultdialogue_0314_00_watcher_b: It does my heart good to see someone new around here. Please, tell me stories of the outside world.
npc_defaultdialogue_0314_01_watcher_a: Have you heard the stories, Warden? Beyond Glass Lake there's a blessed hilltop, where Corruption can't take root.
npc_defaultdialogue_0314_01_watcher_b: Imagine living in such a place, free from Corruption and this infernal war…
npc_defaultdialogue_0314_02_watcher: Oh, I'm glad to see your face. {playerName}, we need your help. Something terrible has happened. It's Warden Dimka.
npc_defaultdialogue_0314_03_watcher: May your spirit stay strong in these dark times. We can't afford to lose another Soulwarden to Corruption.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_00_watcher_a: Bienvenue! I’m Judithe Owens. I'm a Soulwarden based here in Cleave's Point Outpost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_00_watcher_b: I'd love to talk to you about where you're from, sometime when you aren't too busy.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_01_watcher_a: You're quite the traveller, aren't you? You've been to quite a few places here in Great Cleave.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_01_watcher_b: Have you managed to make it over to the Eeriedune Graveyard or Misty Borough?
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_02_watcher_a: Hello, marhaba, {playerName}. I've been getting some horrifying reports from Capitulum Prime.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_02_watcher_b: Something strange is going on there, even stranger than those lanterns I had you gather before.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_03_watcher_a: {playerName}, I’ve learned a lot of languages in my time on this earth.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_03_watcher_b: There aren’t enough words in any of them to thank you enough for what you’ve done for us here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_04_watcher_a: We've learned our lesson, like calls to like.
npc_defaultdialogue_0315_04_watcher_b: We won't be storing all the Heartgems of the Corrupted Soulwardens all in one place anymore.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_00_warden_a: Welcome to Eastburn Outpost, my friend. Soulwarden Dac-Kien Phan at your service.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_00_warden_b: Unfortunately the war against the Corrupted has prevented us from receiving news from other areas, so you are a welcome sight.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_01_warden_a: If only you could have seen this place before the war.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_01_warden_b: Still, it's great to see someone new around here, it means there's still hope!
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_02_warden: Oh, there you are. Listen…I was hoping you could do me a personal favor.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_03_warden_a: You'd best keep yourself safe out there, {playerName}!
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_03_warden_b: We can't afford to lose any more people around here, moral is low enough as it is.
npc_defaultdialogue_0316_04_warden: Warm food is the best way to raise morale. It's easy to forget the Corrupted for a few moments while savoring a hot meal.
npc_defaultdialogue_0317_00_warden_a: Be welcome, newcomer. I’m Sauquillo Dimka, a Soulwarden at Cleave's Point.
npc_defaultdialogue_0317_00_warden_b: If you work hard, you will go far, especially in dark times like these.
npc_defaultdialogue_0317_01_warden: I…I can’t let myself think about this right now. Not when there’s so much work to be done.
npc_defaultdialogue_0317_02_warden: Hello. Sorry, but I'm not in a talking mood.
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_00_ranger: Hello, I’m Rymon Knatchbull. I've been a Ranger in Great Cleave longer than most people have been on living in the outposts.
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_01_ranger_a: I've seen you around the outpost, helping the Wardens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_01_ranger_b: If you're willing to give us a little more aid, you may be just what we need to turn the tide against the Corrupted.
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_02_ranger: I thought I'd be seeing you sooner rather than later. Have you spoken recently with Ranger Madaki?
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_03_ranger_a: Hard to stay hidden when carrying a hammer like the Rampant Conviction of Hope.
npc_defaultdialogue_0318_03_ranger_b: But I bet you could do it, if you put your mind to it.
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_00_ranger_a: Welcome to Cleave's Point! I’m Ranger Mirrell Law.
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_00_ranger_b: Just you wait, we'll be turning the tide against the Corrupted any day now!
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_01_ranger_a: Did you know four of our forts are currently held by the Corrupted? Four!
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_01_ranger_b: Acedia Bastion, Breakaway Fort, Hollowing Fort, and Nullcavity.
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_02_ranger_a: You did a fine job out at Eastburn, really helped them out with their problems.
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_02_ranger_b: I've heard something that might be helpful to you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_03_ranger_a: Just seeing Prime Resolve makes me feel warm inside!
npc_defaultdialogue_0319_03_ranger_b: Have you been using it to cleanse the land of the Corrupted? Soon, all of Aeternum will be clean.
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_00_ranger_a: Yes, it's really me. I’m Ranger Kayode Balogun, the best Ranger this side of Great Cleave.
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_00_ranger_b: Those other Rangers try, but they don't understand what it takes to be the best.
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_01_ranger_a: You're making quite a name for yourself, {playerName}.
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_01_ranger_b: You're the adventurer who braved Infernal Host, in Shattered Mountain!
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_02_ranger_a: Ah, I knew it was you!
npc_defaultdialogue_0320_02_ranger_b: I can hear the pure tones of Glimmering Mercy ring out as you approach. I have to admit, it suits you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0321_00_ranger_a: Hi there! I’m Ranger Tibbe Fowler. Have you met my pet rabbit? I'm sure he was around here somewhere…
npc_defaultdialogue_0321_00_ranger_b: No matter how many times I warn him about the dangers he keeps haring off!
npc_defaultdialogue_0321_01_ranger_a: You found me, good! I'm often on the move.
npc_defaultdialogue_0321_01_ranger_b: When Madaki told me about this Corrupted weapon plot, I didn't quite believe her... sounded a bit outlandish, honestly.
npc_defaultdialogue_0321_02_ranger: Ooo, look at that! You have the Azure Ravager! I'd love to toss it at the Corrupted and see what it can do.
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_00_innkeep_a: I hope no Corrupted saw you come here, friend. We need to lay low to stay alive.
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_00_innkeep_b: But you can be safe in my inn. And we have food, thanks to Amis!
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_01_innkeep_a: Don't let the atmosphere around the outpost get you down!
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_01_innkeep_b: Anytime now we're going to break through the Corrupted and the tide of battle will turn!
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_02_innkeep_a: Welcome to Great Cleave, {playerName}! I'm Eppie Grace, the proprietor of the Hound and Hammer Inn.
npc_defaultdialogue_0322_02_innkeep_b: Stop by any time you like to get out of the chill.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_00_innkeep_a: Welcome! I'm Ingram. I wish we were meeting in better circumstances.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_00_innkeep_b: I'd give you a mince pie and a mug of ale, but the Corrupted took the last of our supplies.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_01_innkeep_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You've done a lot of good for Eastburn Outpost {playerName}.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_01_innkeep_b: Now, don't forget to bundle up before heading out into the cold!
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_01a_innkeep_a: You've done us a tremendous favor by letting me know the dispatches weren't getting through.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_01a_innkeep_b: Now we just have to find out how our messengers were compromised. Shh.
npc_defaultdialogue_0323_02_innkeep_b: Don't worry, you can sleep late, no need to be up with the dawn here, even if I am!
npc_defaultdialogue_0324_00_fisher: Hello, I'm Master Fisher Eberhart Klaus. The fish around here present a challenge like no other. Just like the mountains themselves.
npc_defaultdialogue_0324_01_fisher: I see you've recently been fishing up treasure chests for Master Abebe. How is he these days?
npc_defaultdialogue_0324_02_fisher: You've done the Soulwardens a great service with those rations. Nothing like a little fresh fish to spice up their meals.
npc_defaultdialogue_0325_00_ranger: Welcome to Great Cleave {playerName}. I’m Jennifer Heatly, a Ranger in these parts.
npc_defaultdialogue_0325_01_ranger: There is something to be said about the different faces of winter. The lashing winds of ice, the gentle death of snow.
npc_defaultdialogue_0325_02_ranger_a: I can really feel the effects of Rimelash.
npc_defaultdialogue_0325_02_ranger_b: I wouldn't want to get too close, there's a icy calm about you that speaks of storms on your horizon.
npc_defaultdialogue_0326_00_prospector: Are you ready to seek riches and glory?
npc_defaultdialogue_0329_00_adjudicator: In these cold reaches, the warmth of the Spark is what keeps the flame in my heart alive!
npc_defaultdialogue_0329_01_adjudicator: Welcome to the Great Cleave, the Spark shines brightly within you, my friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_0329_01pre_adjudicat: Welcome to the Great Cleave, the Spark shines brightly within you, my friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_00_ranger_a: <g id="male_nodProud" />You may have heard of me, lucky Heo. No? <g id="female_disappointed" />That's a first.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_00_ranger_b: <g id="male_explain" />Here I thought everyone knew how I survived the destruction of three separate bastions… <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />not that it did me any good.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_01_ranger_a: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />The story of how I came to be here is a long one, filled with much hardship.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_01_ranger_b: <g id="male_nodProud" />I have survived the destruction of three bastions, <g id="male_hanghead" />though many of the other rangers assigned there were not so lucky.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_02_ranger_a: <g id="male_explain" />It's obvious the Corrupted have plans for this area. Have you noticed how the breaches get worse when they are around? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />There is a clear connection.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_02_ranger_b: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />We have to find a way to predict where they will strike next.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_03_ranger_a: <g id="female_thinking" />Since the Corrupted have given us a bit of breathing room, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I'm going to take this time to honor our fallen.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_03_ranger_b: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />There are so many fine rangers that didn't make it out of the bastions alive.
npc_defaultdialogue_0330_04_ranger: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Just you wait, our next bastion will be our best yet! <g id="female_salute2finger" />The Corrupted won't overrun it so easily, thanks to your help!
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_00_tracker_a: <g id="female_lookConcern" />There are troubling rumors that haunt these roads.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_00_tracker_b: <g id="female_lookaroundScared" />Tales of the Balemaw Beast, of winter wolves, and even Yetis mauling innocent travelers. <g id="female_smackfist" />Be wary!
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_01_tracker_a: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Greetings, may you stay safe on the roads.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_01_tracker_b: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />There have been troubling tales lately of a beast that roams the nearby woods which preys upon unsuspecting travelers.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_02_tracker_a: <g id="male_explain" />Speaking of real terrors, while you were off tracking the Balemaw Beast,<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> there have been reports of more attacks on the northern road.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_02_tracker_b: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />This time by creatures with glowing blue eyes.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_03_tracker_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I hate to bring it up again, but there have been more news of the Balemaw Beast. <g id="male_explain" />These tales are far more gruesome from the last.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_03_tracker_b: <g id="male_recoilAfraid"/>They talk of travelers getting ripped limb from limb.
npc_defaultdialogue_0331_04_tracker: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Your help is like a beacon, shining hope onto this cursed ground. <g id="male_compliment" />Your next visit is sure to chase away the gloom.
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_00_furrier: <g id="female_lookaroundWonder" />Have you seen the creatures out here? Don't you think their coats are absolutely divine? <g id="female_headnodding" />The stripes, the patterns, they are all so luscious!
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_01_furrier: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Good fashion is to die for! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />But best is to have others die for it rather than ourselves, yes?
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_02_furrier: <g id="male_explain" />Speaking of intense, have you seen the colors of the fur on some of the animals up here? <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />That striking red, that vibrant blue!
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_03_furrier: <g id="male_explain" />Speaking of the best, while traveling here I saw some simply magnificent fur. It was pure as the snow. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Can you imagine the possibilities?
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_04_furrier_a: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Oh, you simply must stop by again! <g id="male_compliment" />I love seeing what you're wearing.
npc_defaultdialogue_0332_04_furrier_b: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Truly, your choices are inspirational! Now, how do you feel about wearing more fur?
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_00_arcanist: Can you hear it on the breeze? How children's laughter rustles through the leaves?
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_01_arcanist: Oh how I long for a child of my own. To run through the snow in wonder, to see this world through new eyes.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_02_arcanist_a: There is much yet that needs to be collected if I am to have a child.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_02_arcanist_b: Something that glistens like fresh blood, yet does not fade away. Something that keeps its color, brilliant and bright.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_03_arcanist_a: I am so close now, so close to my dream. There is one more component I need. Ebony, a rare wood even if this was not Aeternum.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_03_arcanist_b: I fear it will be impossible to find.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_04_arcanist: Tales say that the Wishing Tree grants wishes, but only if you have made a sufficient offering.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_05_arcanist_a: The poppet has been placed. All there is to do now is wait.
npc_defaultdialogue_0333_05_arcanist_b: Soon I shall start to sew a blanket for my child in anticipation of their arrival.
npc_defaultdialogue_0334_00_baker_b: The Soulwardens need something that sticks to their ribs and keeps them warm, if they are going to keep up their fight!
npc_defaultdialogue_0334_01_baker: You look like you could use a good meal. Just like those Soulwardens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0334_02_baker_a: Thank you so much for bringing the ingredients.
npc_defaultdialogue_0334_02_baker_b: Now that I have what I need, I want to do something to help the Soulwardens at Warden's Rise.
npc_defaultdialogue_0334_03_baker: Supplies might be hard to come by, but I'm not leaving. Someone needs to stay and keep morale up, one piroshki at a time.
npc_defaultdialogue_0335_00_beast: Rawr! Grah! Oh! You’re not from around here. Look, just, don't tell anyone I'm here, alright?
npc_defaultdialogue_0335_01_beast: Grah! Hey, you aren't running away! And... is that a weapon? Whatever I did, I can explain!
npc_defaultdialogue_0335_02_beast_a: I swear, my scaring days are over.
npc_defaultdialogue_0335_02_beast_b: I'll head back to the settlement soon, I promise.
npc_defaultdialogue_0335_04_beast: When I get back, I'm done impersonating that… thing.
npc_defaultdialogue_0336_00_ranger: Have you seen the Corrupted ahead? They are up to something, and I intend to discover what it is!
npc_defaultdialogue_0336_01_ranger: I have never seen the Corrupted so active like they are here. I believe the enemy is going to make their final move soon.
npc_defaultdialogue_0336_02_ranger_a: The bastion Do-yun and I were stationed at may be overrun, but our work is not done.
npc_defaultdialogue_0336_02_ranger_b: I shall stay here and watch the Corrupted so that next time we'll have warnings before they attack.
npc_defaultdialogue_0337_00_ranger: I'd give anything to be back at home…
npc_defaultdialogue_0337_01_ranger_a: Ah! You've found me! Here I thought everyone had given up on us after our bastion was overrun.
npc_defaultdialogue_0337_02_ranger_a: Do-yun is brave to keep watch against the growing darkness. If he isn't giving up, neither am I.
npc_defaultdialogue_0337_02_ranger_b: I'll patrol near here and send reports back about the movements of the Corrupted.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_ashedubois: I will follow the path of my ancestor, Ser Margot Dubois. I’ll become a knight worthy of her praise!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_cemalqadir_a: Have you made friends here? You seem like someone a person would be lucky to call a friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_cemalqadir_b: Back home in Syria, we always repay favors. You’ve helped me a lot. I hope I can return the favor.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_dog: [Dog rolls over on his back briefly. It's probably a trap.]
npc_defaultdialogue_03_eliasderit: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I sure hope Geertie's got a pot of turnip soup going back at the tavern. I haven't eaten in, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />oh I don't know... too long!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_elricchapman: Thank you for your aid, my friend. I worry that my colleagues will laugh at my findings unless I get firm evidence. So I will continue the search.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_francisturner: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />Ah! The hero who restored our Windmills returns from the field! <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Gratitude is in short supply in Corinth these days, <g id="female_bowDeep" priority="high"/>but I, for one, salute your courage!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_francisturner_a: Ah! The hero who restored our Windmills returns from the field!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_francisturner_b: Gratitude is in short supply in Corinth these days, but I, for one, salute your courage!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_geertielother: Oh yeah, I can feel the party coming on already! We got wine and honeycakes - it's gonna be a feast!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_grace_a: <g id="g_grace_gesturer" />Our newest member came in from the desert more than a little inspired, I'd say.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_grace_b: She was only here a moment and went off to prove her worth - to learn the truth about Malek and his claims on being the Blood of the Sands.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_graceomalley_a: Right, I won't be staying here long, but I'll make sure to leave a message when I head out.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_graceomalley_b: Keep your eyes on the horizon, mate, and stay upwind of your enemies.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_graceomalley_new: <g id="grace_disappointed" />Not much luck finding any coin… or even any leads for finding coin, not around here. <g id="grace_understand" />Seems like these pirates might be the best bet.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_hugomolina_a: What folly we have committed! We unleashed a most tragic magic by giving in to Fatimah's whims.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_hugomolina_b: We made a talking mirror that berates me for my decisions, every minute, every hour, every day. It just doesn’t stop!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_jackal: (The strange jackal seems to stare right at you, as if it is expecting something.)
npc_defaultdialogue_03_kathrijnjanssen_a: This island has all kinds of local plants just waiting to be used in cooking! Some of them are even edible. Hah.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_kathrijnjanssen_b: Ha! Edible doesn't necessarily mean delicious, though. I'll have to try them out for new recipes.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_leovixsilva_a: If Medea's responsible for this curse, I fear it will only get worse.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_leovixsilva_a_new: <g id="male_think" />So all this means the tribute never made it to Medea, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />but I still don't understand, if the Iron Rose didn't have the tribute, who did?
npc_defaultdialogue_03_leovixsilva_b: That sorceress is ruthless in a way these people simply do not understand. Those tributes are dear to her.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_lochnir_a: <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />Ah! Our brave newcomer returns! I understand the Knight-Regent dispatched you to the mines. <g id="guard_shrugbrief" />A lot to ask of a guest, but it's her prerogative.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_lochnir_b: <g id="guard_nod" />Do tell, though - I hope the situation there wasn't as dire as it sounded.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_marceldupont_a: <g id="male_wavehandsNo" />Alright, slow down, hero! We're all mad about the stolen tribute, myself included, but<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" /> going out there to reclaim it <g id="male_shakehead" />won't be a walk on the beach.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_marceldupont_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />The pirates that hit us are a tough crew. <g id="female_pointThreaten" />If you want to volunteer to take them on yourself, be my guest, <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />but I ain't going anywhere.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_margotemerson_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />There are countless wonders in nature. Be it the song of the wind too perfect for words, or the laughter of the creek babbling on eternally.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_margotemerson_b: <g id="male_explain" />Stop and be moved by nature. If you do, it will move through you and bring peace to others.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_mb_grace_a: <g id="grace_shifty" />I heard this "True Heir" is traveling here by a ship along the coast.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_mb_grace_b: <g id="grace_secret" />Thinking he might not be needing it any more. Could be that ship's available for a new captain…
npc_defaultdialogue_03_medea_a: Behold the cost of breaking your covenant with the Sorceress Medea!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_medea_b: Once again I am shown that people cannot be trusted to keep their word!
npc_defaultdialogue_03_michaellewis_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I won't just watch Windsward go to hell. The Swarmancers, the Withered, the pirates… it's a damned mess, and we have to start somewhere.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_michaellewis_b: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Heard Francis was working with the pirates? Well, I know how to stop that.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_moirachapman_new: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />This has been an interesting series of events so far… <g id="litearmor_think" />and I daresay the story is not yet finished.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_nessaharrower_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I wonder if there's a way…? No one's ever come back from being Lost, but there's a first time for everything, right?
npc_defaultdialogue_03_nessaharrower_b: <g id="female_nodyes" />If I'm the last Druid remaining in Windsward, then it's my duty to try.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_percillawallen_a: I was so ashamed of abandoning my duties that I buried my armor.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_percillawallen_b: I shall dig it up and join you. I hope this will restore some measure of my honor…
npc_defaultdialogue_03_percillawallen_ne: <g id="male_concernS" /> I must confess… I fought at Jin Jae's side for centuries and never realized how strong she really is. <g id="male_realize" />Her resolve in the face of this horror… I-I don't know.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_regentjinjae_a: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />From this moment forward, I will take every precaution to ensure the people of Prydwen are safe, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />inside and outside these walls.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_regentjinjae_b: <g id="female_spreadarms" />We will start by discovering how this disaster at the mine began. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Surely someone saw something.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_rima: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />I will meet you back in New Corsica.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_royahakimi: It's all been for nothing. All my training. My research into the Iron Rose... There's no chance of me becoming one of their ranks now.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_saatvikagrawal_a: <g id="litearmor_darnit" />The scene here is unthinkable. A month ago, <g id="litearmor_converseleft" />the most flourishing fields in all Aeternum. <g id="litearmor_gestureright" />Now, this.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_saatvikagrawal_b: <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />The Druids were such gentle people, and now <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />they're these Lost Swarmancers, destroying the land.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_serpaynebennett_a: <g id="male_think" />Yes, I do hope all these reports regarding the Lost turn out to be exaggerated.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_serpaynebennett_b: <g id="male_shakehead" /> It simply wouldn't do to have the True Heir return to find we've allowed things to get so dire.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_tsuifen_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Thanks again for helping out. We've got more reliable food now, thanks to you, and camping near the lake has been safer.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_tsuifen_b: I just wish it hadn't been too late for Albrekt. I still haven't seen him return.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_yelenapajitnova_a: It's clear they were capable of harnessing some type of energy to aid in their construction.
npc_defaultdialogue_03_yelenapajitnova_b: But I believe there was some labor involved as well.
npc_defaultdialogue_03alt_rima: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />I will meet you back at the Silver Crows encampment.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_00_magistrate: Welcome to Everfall! A finer and safer place you will not find in all of Aeternum!
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_01_magistrate: We must make preparations to secure the settlement. The Corruption will come - it's just a question of when.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_02_magistrate: If you intend to enlist with another settlement, now is the time. We can certainly use your sword-arm around here, however.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_03_magistrate: Back in the Old World, I knew for certain that a score of valiant soldiers could defend against any threat. Those days are gone.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_04_magistrate: You've undoubtedly seen the factions in town - the Marauders, the Syndicate, and the Covenant. Like or not, they are best equipped to defend Everfall.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_06_magistrate: Despite the general mood around town, I have a good feeling about things.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_07_magistrate: Surely you've noticed the Towers of the Ancients in our territory. I've often wondered what secrets they might contain.
npc_defaultdialogue_0402_08_magistrate: The Corruption is most undoubtedly spreading across Aeternum right now. We must find a way to keep it outside our walls.
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_00_survivalist: Storms buffeting the shores, the shattered mountain spewing Corruption, and breaches opening up in our own backyard! Exciting times, my friend!
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_01_survivalist: Question for you is, what'll you do if this all comes crashing down? You better know how to survive on your own.
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_02_survivalist: You remind me that sometimes I need a break from settlement life. Nothing like running through the woods with nothing but your pants on, you know?
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_03_survivalist: Now here comes a proud warrior if ever I've seen one! If you're looking to knock some skulls around, you've come to the right place!
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_04_survivalist: I swear, I don't know what the woman has against me. Am I just too damn sexy for her because of the way I dress?
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_05_survivalist: Now here comes a proud warrior if ever I've seen one! If you're looking to knock some skulls around, you've come to the right place!
npc_defaultdialogue_0403_06_survivalist: Sometimes good things happen only when you give up and stop forcing them to be that way.
npc_defaultdialogue_0403a_00_huntsmanlee: Where has<g id="male_lookaroundWorried" /> Riker gotten off to? The man best not be in the belly of some beast. He gets so cranky when he dies.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_00_overseer: Thank you for visiting, but now's not a good time. Be careful when you go - don't slip on that loose board out there!
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_01_overseer: I'd call a town meeting, but I worry my misfortune is contagious. We need an expert on this Corruption business… and someone to boost defenses. It's… overwhelming.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_02_overseer: I should just stay here and mind my own business. It's safer for everyone that way.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_03_overseer: From now on, anytime you like, visit me or the Town Board. You can take any tasks that suit your fancy.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_03a_overseer: This Corruption business gets thicker and more ominous by the minute. People have been reporting gobs of that crimson evil popping up everywhere, closer and closer to the setttlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_03b_overseer: I hope that crazy old man knows something that can turn the tide around here. If not, we'll all be walking around, red eyes and raving lunatics before you know it.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_04_overseer: Ah, look what the mangy old cat dragged in! Cecilia says you helped her make me this lucky charm. That was very kind of you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0404_05_overseer: I'll tell Magistrate Clark he doesn't have to bear all the burden any more. I'm ready and willing to do my part.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_00_artificer: If you want to engage in idle chit-chat, I suggest you visit the barkeep.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_01_artificer: I understand you've been working with Maecia. She is a… unique leader, is she not?
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_02_artificer: You can take that blade, or anything else you forge to the trading post. The Magistrate will make purchases for the arsenal.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_03_artificer: Survivalist Lee, or 'Fancypants,' as I call him, is an egotistical brute. And I find his fashion sense wanting.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_04_artificer: Unfortunately, it's difficult to get any work done around that nettlesome Survivalist. I suggest you avoid him at all cost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_05_artificer: Have you spoken to Survivalist Lee? He hasn't said a word to me in some time.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405_06_artificer: You know, I never would have guessed it, but my brooch matches Odnell's pants quite well, I think.
npc_defaultdialogue_0405a_00_artificerpe: I have not<g id="female_beckon" /> seen your face around Everfall before. Tread carefully, adventurer. Danger lurks outside of the settlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_00_commander: You look strong, friend. You should consider joining the Marauders. We will put that strength to use.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_01_commander: Who's brave enough to approach the Marauder Commander?
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_02_commander: I challenge you to meet with the other Factions. Then you will understand that we Marauders are the strongest.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_03_commander: You look strong, friend. You should consider joining the Marauders. We will put that strength to use.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_04_commander: And here we have a member of the Syndicate. I suggest you stay with your nose in those books. Leave the fighting to us.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_05_commander: I’m fine on my own, thank you very much. A Marauder needs help from no Covenant.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_06_commander: A Marauder salivates at the prospect of battle. This mission is not a test, but a reward.
npc_defaultdialogue_0407_07_commander: I salute you, fellow Marauder. We will never give up the fight, and in the end, we will emerge victorious.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_00_alchemist: I’m with the Syndicate, the true inheritors of The Ancients legacy. We are committed to harnessing the power of Azoth and ushering in a new and never-ending age of enlightenment for all.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_00_alchemist_a: I’m with the Syndicate, the true inheritors of the Ancients' legacy.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_00_alchemist_b: We are committed to harnessing the power of Azoth and ushering in a new and never-ending age of enlightenment for all.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_01_alchemist: Are you here to seek knowledge? Then this is proof you have wisdom.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_02_alchemist: Observe the other Faction Leaders and you will come to understand that your path is with the Syndicate.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_03_alchemist: I see that inquisitive sparkle in your eye. It is the same with us all. Knowledge stands above all things - that is our code.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_04_alchemist: Strength untempered by reason leads to nothing but ruin. Alas, you will learn this soon enough.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_05_alchemist: You zealots see faith as a virtue. But what is faith if not belief without evidence? In other words, madness.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_06_alchemist: Now that you are one of us, you will have access to vast knowledge… in time. But first, I have a challenge for you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0408_07_alchemist: I greet you in reverence, fellow pursuer of knowledge.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_00_adjudicator: We are the Covenant. We are charged by divine decree to protect this place and administer justice. I serve as the Adjudicator for this settlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_00_adjudicator_: We are the Covenant. We are driven to protect this place, defend the helpless, and administer justice.
I serve as the Adjudicator for this settlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_01_adjudicator: I am here on behalf of the Covenant seeking those who are similarly inspired.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_02_adjudicator: Learn of the other factions to understand their folly. Return to me to find salvation by joining the Covenant.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_03_adjudicator: Do I see the spark of righteousness in this one? In a world beset by darkness, we are the light.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_04_adjudicator: Oh great Marauder, always in such a rush to act. Yet so blind to the suffering such methods beget. May your Spark burn steadfastly, and illuminate a new truth in you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_05_adjudicator: So great must be the burden of knowing all the world's truths! Have you come to educate such a wretch as me?
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_06_adjudicator: We cannot stand by and watch others suffer. That is why I must make one request of you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0409_07_adjudicator: The light of the Covenant shines within you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0411a_00_williamhero: I can see that you're new to Aeternum. Strong arms, though--clearly a warrior.
I'm sure you have plenty of… whatever it is you do. Good day!
npc_defaultdialogue_0428_00_jones: You look like a smart individual. I bet you'd love to make yourself rich, like me. I tell you, corner the market on iron. You can't go wrong, everyone needs iron! It's just like gold, only more useful in the long run.
npc_defaultdialogue_0428_01_jones: Here for more tips? I knew you’d be back. Look. Forget iron, orichalcum is where it’s at! Buy now, sell high later, you won't regret it! It's how you can save up for three houses. I should know, it's how I saved up for mine!
npc_defaultdialogue_0430_00_pvparena: One day, my fine friend, one day you shall be strong enough to participate in a glorious spectacle! Keep training, and return to me when you have a want to prove yourself in combat with allies.
npc_defaultdialogue_0430_01_pvparena: Step right up, step right up, for a showdown you will never forget! Two teams enter, and after a clash of skill and brutality a team emerges victorious!
npc_defaultdialogue_0430_01_pvparena_a: Are you courageous enough to brave… the Arena?
npc_defaultdialogue_0430_01_pvparena_b: Two teams enter, and after a clash of skill and brutality a team emerges victorious! Are you courageous enough to brave… the Arena?
npc_defaultdialogue_0430_02_pvparena: There's my champion! Up for another bout? You can return anytime to the glory and spectacle that is... the Arena!
npc_defaultdialogue_0435_00_announcer: I’ll dredge up a few more challengers…
npc_defaultdialogue_0436a_00_tamraayad: Have you also come to laugh at me? It was an accident, I swear…
npc_defaultdialogue_0437a_00_felixlivius: Unless you intend to risk life and limb for the sake of sport, I suggest you keep an eye out for bears. They wander this stretch of forest.
npc_defaultdialogue_0438a_00_jacobevans: Polly, my sweet Polly. I've failed you for the last time. All I wanted was to see you smile again, but I can barely muster a smile for myself.
npc_defaultdialogue_0439a_00_anwirhughes: You're looking a bit peaky, traveler. Whether it's a stiff leg, sore head, or the simple ennui of life, Anwir Hughes has an elixir for you!
npc_defaultdialogue_0440a_00_atticusdelp: I am afraid I have little time for casual conversation, stranger. My proprietor keeps my hands busy at all times.
npc_defaultdialogue_0441a_00_sairayangan: You must<g id="female_headnodding" /> be new to town. I would remember a face like yours.
If you<g id="female_touchhands" /> come across any interesting gossip, do be sure to let me know. I might have a favor to offer in exchange.
npc_defaultdialogue_0442a_00_concettasac: Do I know you? Hmph. Whatever your business, you should speak to my manservant, Atticus. I am terribly busy, you see.
npc_defaultdialogue_0443a_00_oushen_a: How curious. You approach unannounced and unaccompanied. Perhaps you do not understand basic etiquette.
npc_defaultdialogue_0443a_00_oushen_b: Ignorance deserves patience, but I caution you against such impropriety in the future. I bid you farewell.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_ashedubois_a: Margot Dubois the Steadfast, knighted by Artorius, seated in the fifth seat of the Round table.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_ashedubois_b: The Resolved Scout, Keeper of the Scepter, Crest of the Lark, bequeathed this day on a scarf of olive silk.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_cemalqadir: A lot of people have been telling me great things about you. I hope you know, you’ll have many friends here, if you choose to stay.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_dog: [Dog seems to be interested in some nearby sounds. His ears are moving quickly.]
