npc_defaultdialogue_04_francisturner: <g id="female_youknow" />The sorceress has been waiting for an excuse like this. <g id="female_nodyes" />It's a cauldron that's been boiling for too long! We'll see, sure enough.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_gideonstormsbane_: <g id="male_willcoverit" />When I joined the Iron Rose, I swore to bring beauty and peace to the land with the aid of my sword.
<g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have restored that hope in me. I am eternally grateful for your service.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_graceomalley_a: <g id="grace_excited2" />Hah, now this is more like it! Have you seen Buccaneer Creek? <g id="grace_yes" />There's a place we can get some proper plunder!
npc_defaultdialogue_04_graceomalley_b: <g id="grace_convince"/>If we play our cards right, we might liberate some of their stolen property and be called heroes for it!
npc_defaultdialogue_04_hugomolina: May you find what you’re looking for, friend. May your wishes be fulfilled without ever being twisted.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_leovixsilva_a: <g id="female_thinking" />But honestly, Medea may be ruthless with those who cross her, but I don’t think she'd do this, not to the entire region. <g id="female_youknow" />That's cruel, even for her.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_lochnir: <g id="guard_nod" />Oh, yes! The Knight-Regent is still waiting for me to answer her summons! <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />Rest assured, I'll be there as soon as I'm done here.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_marceldupont: <g id="male_taunt" />If I was putting coin on it, I'd wager the Buccaneer Creek Pirates are going to cut you to ribbons. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />One less mouth to feed, as far as I'm concerned.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_mb_grace_a: Selling goods at market may be enough for some folks, but it’s too slow for me.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_mb_grace_a_new: <g id="grace_throwarms" priority="high"/>For a minute there, I thought that blowhard was gonna skewer me with his blade. <g id="grace_yes" />It's a good thing you came along when you did.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_mb_grace_b: I loosened lips at the tavern until I heard about these pirates. Then I came for the loot. Tell this suspicious sod, that's the only reason I'm here.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_medea_a: What's done is done. I shall no longer stand idly by while my work is scorned, broken, disrupted.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_medea_b: They shall soon see the terrible glory of my craft!
npc_defaultdialogue_04_michaellewis: <g id="female_nodyes" />My farm's lost, but it wasn't all for naught. I'm going to keep those pirates nice and bottled up in their little hideaway.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_nessaharrower_a: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />This business about the tribute to Medea sounds suspicious, <g id="male_shrugBrief" />but that can't be the cause of all this. No it's something in the magic of the land. It has to be…
npc_defaultdialogue_04_percillawallen_a: Ser Gawain and his court of Lost Knights are not far. They're fortified in his ancestral home across the water, Corbenic Castle.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_percillawallen_a_: <g id="yonas_explain02" />You see… I know where Ser Gawain and Lochnir are conspiring in darkness to steal all our souls. <g id="yonas_gestureLeft" />They're in Gawain's ancestral home, Corbenic Castle.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_percillawallen_b: I suspect that's where Lochnir has led his unfortunate followers, as well.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_regentjinjae_a: <g id="male_converseleft" />While you were away, Foreman Musa visited and <g id="male_shakehead" /> related the whole story from the mines.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_regentjinjae_b: <g id="male_think" />She says the day after the mysterious tablet appeared, Lost Pirates attacked the mines, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />seemingly out of nowhere.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_royahakimi_a: Thank you for delivering my letter to Gideon. He told me he will consider my application.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_royahakimi_b: His response seemed promising. In the meanwhile I'll continue practicing the stances.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_saatvikagrawal_a: <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />Did you see anyone out there who hasn't become Lost? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The Druids, the farmers, surely someone remains.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_saatvikagrawal_b: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />I know many fled, but <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />it's strange that I've heard no firsthand accounts of how it happened.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_serpaynebennett_a: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />The Knight-Regent seems to think very highly of you, as do I!
npc_defaultdialogue_04_serpaynebennett_b: You have the makings of a great knight. <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Why, you could be the first one knighted by the new king!
npc_defaultdialogue_04_yelenapajitnova_a: Well now, I'm almost starting to think of you as an old friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_04_yelenapajitnova_b: Don't go disappearing on me, now. I'm still mourning the loss of my best friend and former colleague.
npc_defaultdialogue_04a_mb_grace_new: <g id="grace_crossarmsInsulted" />Well now, I do hope you straightened everything out with Ser Pain-in-me-arse! <g id="grace_gestureRLow" />I tried to tell that sod, if you want to defeat these pirates, I know the way.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_dog: [Dog's eyes are wide as he watches the area around him.]
npc_defaultdialogue_05_francisturner_a: Ah, but this is so unlike you! Why are you snooping around here?
npc_defaultdialogue_05_francisturner_b: Sit down and have a drink with me. If there's some misunderstanding, I'm sure we can work it out.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_francisturner_new: <g id="female_whattheheck" priority="high"/>I don't know why you're so determined to bring me down… <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />snooping around my personal affairs? <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I'm Speaker of the Winds! <g id="female_pointThreaten" />I could have you arrested!
npc_defaultdialogue_05_graceomalley_a: I couldn't help but notice mention in the Speaker's note of some kinda precious gemstones.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_graceomalley_b: I know for a fact that these same pirates have another hideout just a stone's throw away.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_graceomalley_new: <g id="grace_gesturebothhands" />Just think… if we could find enough loot here to buy a ship, <g id="grace_handheart" />we could be back at sea within a fortnight! Ah, that'd be such a relief.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_leovixsilva: <g id="male_shakehead" />I'm still trying to shake those images out of my mind. Those soldiers… I fought alongside them for decades. <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />I never thought the Iron Rose would end up like this.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_leovixsilva_a: I'm still trying to shake those images out of my mind. Those soldiers… I fought alongside them for decades.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_leovixsilva_b: I never thought the Iron Rose would end up like this.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_lochnir_a: <g id="guard_laughmed" priority="high" />Well, if it isn't the Knight-Regent's new page! On an errand <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />even now, I presume.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_lochnir_b: <g id="guard_headtilthmm" />I am curious, what merits such urgent attention when Jae's duty as regent so soon draws to an end?
npc_defaultdialogue_05_marceldupont_a: You and that brute Leovix are up to something, aren't you? He's been eyeing me like a hungry wolf.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_marceldupont_b: His grudge is misplaced. As the Speaker and I have explained, the Buccaneer Creek Pirates are to blame.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_marceldupont_new: <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" />See now, that Iron Rose thug wants to carve me up, but <g id="male_nodunderstand" />I'm just a soldier in this affair. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Everything I did, I was just following orders.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_mb_grace_a: Hey! Something just occurred to me… about this island and how we might get off it.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_mb_grace_b: Give me a little space here! I need a minute to think!
npc_defaultdialogue_05_mb_grace_new: <g id="grace_convince" />You're not going to believe what happened back in the town. That Minister Lochnir… I said he was mad, didn't I? And believe it or not, I was right!
npc_defaultdialogue_05_medea: Behold, the gifted warrior who bested me approaches. I am sorely tempted to test you once again.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_medea_new: <g id="grace_crossarmsInsulted" />If I am to train you, Nessa, the first insight I will share is that <g id="grace_headshakeno" />I don't believe your friend will be able to remain in Corinth and help protect it.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_nessaharrower_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />The Speaker's story doesn't add up. He's hiding something, and we must discover what it is. <g id="male_explain" />Though I'm also still skeptical that this curse is the work of Medea.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_percillawallen: <g id="yonas_gestureRight" />I look to the ramparts and I recognize many knights, now Lost… <g id="yonas_headnodyes" />they were dear friends. <g id="yonas_shakehead" />This will not be easy for me.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_percillawallen_a: I don’t know what defenses this tower possesses, but it is clearly well-fortified, and Lochnir has undoubtedly taken precautions.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_regentjinjae: <g id="female_nodyes" />You will find Ser Payne and his squire at Brysedd Shore. I have no doubt your support will be welcome.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_saatvikagrawal_a: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />The Speaker insists he sent Medea's tribute, <g id="litearmor_realize" />which means it would've been carted off by the Iron Rose Mercenaries.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_saatvikagrawal_b: <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />They're supposed to be protecting these farms as well, but I haven't seen hide nor hair of them.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_serpaynebennett: Making a camp should be simple. <g id="female_explainS" />You just need a spot and a few materials. You can collect materials from around here. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />You don't have to look too far.
npc_defaultdialogue_05_yelenapajitnova: The Eyepiece is even more useful than I remembered. Thank you for retrieving it.
npc_defaultdialogue_05a_nessaharrower: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I must continue on to the ruins to investigate. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You seem able enough to handle the pirates with some ease. I wonder if I might enlist your aid.
npc_defaultdialogue_05pre_francisturner_: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Whatever that rat Dupont tells you, it isn't true. If anything, this is HIS fault. <g id="female_youknow" />Let's not forget he's the one who let the tribute get stolen.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_00_commander: For years, people doubted me, insulted me. But now they look up to me, for I am a Marauder.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_01_commander: You think you are the stuff of Marauders? Do not underestimate us. Our path demands sacrifice.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_02_commander: I think you have a physique for the Syndicate and a will for the Covenant. Perhaps you should visit them.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_03_commander: Dare you believe yourself worthy of the Marauders? Are you bold only of tongue or can you support that with action?
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_04_commander: Long ago, I considered joining the Syndicate. But then I realized that I have a spine.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_05_commander: The Covenant’s folly will always be their desire to help others before themselves. I stand strong on my own two feet.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_06_commander: My initiation into the Marauders was the pivotal moment of my life. Now, accept this challenge to complete yours.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_07_commander: My blade, my life. Choose your next contribution to our cause.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_07a_commander_a: Now that you have officially joined our ranks, we expect you to seize every opportunity to gain honor.
npc_defaultdialogue_0607_07a_commander_b: Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_00_alchemist: Glad tidings to you, friend. Lend me an ear and I'll weave you a yarn.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_01_alchemist_a: So you seek an audience with yours truly? What subject do you fancy?
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_01_alchemist_b: Astrology, numerology, alchemy, or any of the other sciences for that matter.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_02_alchemist_a: I have quite the thirst for a cold brew from Cormack's place. Don't let my size fool you, I can hold my fill.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_02_alchemist_b: But I digress. Why not take a moment to visit the other faction leaders. See what they're missing.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_03_alchemist: The look on that distinctive face of yours tells me you've made a decision. Hold me in suspense no longer. Out with it!
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_04_alchemist: One day, perhaps we'll raise a glass together. But not if you keep spoiling the land around here -- Cormack can't get enough hops!
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_05_alchemist: I’ve yet to meet a Templar that made a good drinking buddy, maybe you’ll be the first.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_06_alchemist: Welcome into the fold. We'll uncork a bottle later, but we have work to do first.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_07_alchemist: Glad to cast eyes upon you again, friend. Have you returned for more adventure?
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_07a_alchemist_a: Now that you have officially joined in our enterprise, you should always seek ways to advance our interests.
npc_defaultdialogue_0608_07a_alchemist_b: Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_00_adjudicator: Of what ilk are you stranger? Care to better Aeternum?
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_01_adjudicator: Glad tae meet ye. What can I do for you?
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_02_adjudicator: Before you get too far here, go visit those other dobbers. Then come back here and we'll have a blether.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_03_adjudicator: Have you returned to pledge yer life to bearing the light? Gaun yersel.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_04_adjudicator: Your head’s full of mince, Marauder. Go pillage elsewhere.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_05_adjudicator: I’ve seen you skulking around town collecting whispers. You’ll get nothing from me.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_06_adjudicator: Ya’ve made a good move friend. We are stronger together.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_07_adjudicator: I see the light is still with ye.
npc_defaultdialogue_0609_07a_adjudicator: Now that you have joined in our cause, you must carry the light into the world at every chance.
Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_francisturner_a: Come now, you wouldn't let anyone come after your good old friend, Francis, would you?
npc_defaultdialogue_06_francisturner_b: I will leave peacefully and trouble no one. I promise. Just give me time to gather my things…
npc_defaultdialogue_06_francisturner_new: <g id="male_waghand01" />You can't do this! The people of Corinth will revolt if you take away their Speaker! You'll see!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_graceomalley_a: I'm a bit disappointed. I thought you and I had a profitable plan before little-miss-bright-eyes came along.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_graceomalley_b: I suppose you'll be wanting to be all generous now. I guess you’ve earned the right to make that decision.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_graceomalley_new: <g id="grace_disappointed" priority="high"/>I can't believe it! What happened? You and I had a profitable plan before little-miss-green-thumb came along. <g id="grace_gestureLefthand" />That Gemstone… you risked your neck for it!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_leovixsilva: I just can't get over it. <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheads" />All this pain because the Speaker decided he'd let the town guard take the tribute this season. What the hell was he thinking?
npc_defaultdialogue_06_leovixsilva_a: I just can't get over it. All this pain because the Speaker decided he'd let the town guard take the tribute this season.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_leovixsilva_b: What the hell was he thinking?
npc_defaultdialogue_06_lochnir_a: <g id="guard_nod" />We have awaited this day for centuries, and our patience will be rewarded.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_lochnir_b: <g id="guard_gestureleftM" />All of Prydwen will bask in the glory of the bloodline restored! It is our destiny!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_marceldupont_a: Please, I beg you, don't let Leovix do whatever it is that he's thinking of doing.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_marceldupont_b: I'll leave here and you'll never hear from me again. You have my word!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_marceldupont_new: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />That Iron Rose bastard has violence in his eyes. Promise me you won't forget our deal… right? Right?
npc_defaultdialogue_06_mb_grace_a: Just after you left Prydwen, that wide-eyed Minister Lochnir started acting strange, shouting around town that the True Heir's arrival was upon us.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_mb_grace_b: He led some knights and even some townsfolk down south to "welcome the new king!"
npc_defaultdialogue_06_mb_grace_new: <g id="grace_worry" />I hope the Knight-Regent hasn't gone and gotten herself into trouble. She's awful dry that one, but she's got grit… I respect that!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_medea: <g id="grace_handheart" />If I could help with your condition, I would, <g id="grace_headshakeno" />but it is beyond even my ability. It is a battle you must fight yourself.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_nessaharrower: So this is where the trail of the missing tribute leads? The lies from the Speaker of the Winds just keep piling up.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_nessaharrower_new: Quite a friend you have there… she's not serious, is she? I hope not.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_percillawallen_a: After this, perhaps we should consider abandoning this obsession with restoring the royal bloodline.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_percillawallen_b: We can't return the Circlet of Swords to Teyrnon Keep, anyhow. I think we should return it to Prydwen.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_percillawallen_ne: <g id="yonas_spreadarmsNod" />Your courage and valor have spared Prydwen from a dreadful fate.<g id="yonas_plead02" /> The Knight-Regent will undoubtedly want to cover your chest in medals.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_regentjinjae_a: <g id="male_secretiveshort" />Minister Lochnir finally graced me with his presence. I was able to speak with him at last.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_regentjinjae_b: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" priority="high"/>As much as I respect the man's legacy here in Prydwen, his explanations are not satisfactory.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_saatvikagrawal: <g id="litearmor_crossarmsupset" />The fall of the farms. The Swarmancers. It must be connected to the Tribute. <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />But we need more information. Something about the Speaker's story isn't adding up.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_saatvikagrawal_a: The fall of the farms. The Swarmancers. It must be connected to the Tribute.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_saatvikagrawal_b: But we need more information. Something about the Speaker's story isn't adding up.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_serpaynebennett_a: <g id="female_youknow" />You two stay here and defend our position. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will go forth and challenge the leader of the pirates to a duel.
npc_defaultdialogue_06_serpaynebennett_b: <g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> When I am victorious, I will demand that they <g id="male_nodunderstand" />withdraw from these shores forthwith, never to return!
npc_defaultdialogue_06_zander: <g id="g_male_nod2" />There are so many ingredients out here that I haven’t seen! This expedition is proving to be quite useful!
npc_defaultdialogue_06a_graceomalley_a: Think of that precious gemstone, all alone in that hostile place. It's a right heartache!
npc_defaultdialogue_06a_graceomalley_b: One thing's for sure, it's of no use to those rotters now that they've fallen Lost.
npc_defaultdialogue_06a_regentjinjae: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />How is Ser Payne? He is one of our most trusted knights and a seasoned soldier. I hope you managed to rout the pirates together…?
npc_defaultdialogue_0707_00_commander: If you're not Marauder, you're nothing.
npc_defaultdialogue_0707_01_commander_a: We need more 'real' warriors around here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0707_01_commander_b: This is the battle that counts.
npc_defaultdialogue_0707_01pre_commander: We need more 'real' warriors around here. This is the battle that counts.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_00_adjudicator_: The Spark requires fuel for its sustenance.
Faith cannot exist in vacuum. I hope you realize this some day.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_00_alchemist: Simple minds will find little traction communicating with the enlightened.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_01_adjudicator_: Watch yourself in Shattered Mountain, my courageous colleague.
Even those of great faith can fall to Corruption this close to source.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_01_alchemist_a: Ah, I have heard your name whispered in quiet places.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_01_alchemist_b: You see the truth. And where you do not see it, you search.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_01pre_adjudicat: Watch yourself in Shattered Mountain, my courageous colleague.
Even those of great faith can fall to Corruption this close to source.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_01pre_alchemist: Ah, I have your name whispered in quiet places. You see the truth, and where you not see it, you search.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_02_adjudicator_: I have been awaiting you, {playerName}. I know all about the twisted lies that have darkened your past trials.
I am proud that you have held close to the Spark and are now prepared for your final trial.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_02pre_adjudicat: I have been awaiting you, {playerName}. I know all about the twisted lies that have darkened your past trials.
I am proud that you have held close to the Spark and are now prepared for your final trial.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_03_adjudicator_: The Spark shines brightest in the darkest hours.
We must rally to face and destroy the menace of Corruption. Light guide your path, Adjudicator.
npc_defaultdialogue_0708_03pre_adjudicat: The Spark shines brightest in the darkest hours. We must rally to face and destroy the menace of Corruption.
Light guide your path, Adjudicator.\n[ Level 58 required for Shattered Mountain faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_00_watcher_a: I must confess - even I am beginning to feel hopeless in the face of such evil.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_00_watcher_b: The Corrupted are relentless and they seem to know when and where to strike.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_01_watcher_a: For too long we have been able to do little while Corruption spreads down from the mountain.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_01_watcher_b: I know you are preparing your assault against the enemy, but we need defensive measures in place to blunt any preemptive strike by the Tempest.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_02_watcher_a: If it isn't my friend {playerName} from the beach in Windsward. Long ago, that seems now.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_02_watcher_b: With those rituals disrupted, we can more easily prepare a stronger bulwark here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_03_watcher_a: Your presence here is more than an inspiration, my friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_0712_03_watcher_b: It is a lifeline for the Soulwardens who have grown weary fighting on the front lines.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_00_watcher_a: At this point, I've been watching for Corruption or fighting against it as long as I can remember.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_00_watcher_b: If that means my mind is sliding, then let it slide, I say! I'm in this until the end.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_01_watcher_a: If I was a woman of faith, I'd say you were sent straight from the heavens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_01_watcher_b: But I suspect your journey here was not quite so blessed.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_02_watcher_a: Aye, you've crossed my mind more than once, {playerName}. That day back in First Light seems a lifetime ago.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_02_watcher_b: Somehow though, I'm not terribly surprised we both wound up as Soulwardens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_03_watcher_a: It was no small thing dealing with those vicars and that loathsome ritual.
npc_defaultdialogue_0713_03_watcher_b: As long as we can keep our wits, we've got a fighting chance at least.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_00_watcher_a: From far away, the Shattered Mountain looks rather intimidating.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_00_watcher_b: But up close… well, I suppose it still looks quite ominous, doesn't it?
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_01_watcher_a: You know what I keep asking myself? How exactly did I wind up here?
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_01_watcher_b: I just joined the Soulwardens a few weeks ago, and now I'm here, on the front lines against Corruption. It's madness.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_02_watcher_a: Well now, imagine seeing you here, {playerName}. I had a feeling you joined the Soulwardens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_02_watcher_b: We're a long way from that Watchtower in Everfall, though, aren't we?
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_03_watcher_a: Perhaps there's hope for us yet, eh? Not that I was actually starting to lose hope, mind you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_03_watcher_b: But now that you're here, I think we can aim a little higher than just… holding out.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_04_watcher_a: You know... I just remembered a legend about a 'Baetylus Headpiece'…
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_04_watcher_b: It's been a long time, though. Probably just some old fishwives' tale. No need to risk the Lazarus Well, that's for sure.
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_05_watcher_a: There must be some way we can put these Baetylus Luckstones to work?
npc_defaultdialogue_0714_05_watcher_b: Maybe swallow them? I'll not be the one to try that, I suppose. Let's hope this Headpiece gives us answers.
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_00_watcher_a: Always good to see another regular old human being here in the outpost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_00_watcher_b: Now<g id="female_pointThreaten" /> don't you go getting Corrupted now, you hear?
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_01_watcher_a: <g id="female_thinking" />Well, I don't know - I thought we were doing quite well against the Corrupted,<g id="male_checkbehind" priority="high" /> but… then we weren't.
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_01_watcher_b: <g id="male_explain" />Now we're doing better, but I'm afraid to believe it. <g id="male_spreadhands" />Does that make sense?
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_02_watcher_a: <g id="male_smallSingleWave" />Look here, it's my old friend, {playerName}. <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />I wondered if you had joined the Soulwardens.
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_02_watcher_b: <g id="male_rememberBig" />That day back on the beach of Monarch's Bluffs kinda feels like a dream now.
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_03_watcher_a: <g id="female_notsure" />Honestly, I don't know if I'll be able to bring myself to eat it. <g id="male_spreadhands" />I mean, gator?
npc_defaultdialogue_0715_03_watcher_b: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It's not like I have a weak stomach,<g id="male_convince01" /> but… maybe our rations aren't so bad, you know?
npc_defaultdialogue_0716_00_warden_a: Somehow,<g id="female_thinking" /> some way, we must find a path that leads inside the Mountain itself.
npc_defaultdialogue_0716_00_warden_b: We have deployed scouts to discover this path. Let's just hope they return.
npc_defaultdialogue_0716_01_warden_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />You have done all that you can and more for us here in the outpost, Warden.
npc_defaultdialogue_0716_01_warden_b: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />I think you know where you are needed next.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_00_warden_a: No word from Clarion in some time.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_00_warden_b: If the Corrupted overcome our position there, this fort will be next.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_01_warden_a: So you managed to knock the Corruption off-balance around this hellish place…
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_01_warden_b: That helps, now we just need to get through to Clarion.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_02_warden_a: The fact is simply that the Corrupted grow in strength and numbers by the hour.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_02_warden_b: It may be best to get as far away from the Mountain as possible.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_03_warden_a: If the Tempest is gone, then these infernal Corrupted will have to let up at some point.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_03_warden_b: I'd say this is cause for celebration.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_04_warden_a: There you are! The hero of the hour.
npc_defaultdialogue_0717_04_warden_b: One of these days, you'll have to give me the full story of how you brought down the Tempest.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_00_ranger_b: This is the front line in the battle against the Corruption.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_01_ranger_a: How splendid, another intrepid adventurer out in the wilds!
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_01_ranger_b: If we are to be victorious, however, we are going to have put our knowledge to work.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_02_ranger_a: If we can harness the putrescent horror of the Blight to fight the Corrupted, we can win this.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_02_ranger_b: The problem is that we can't safely handle the Blight ourselves.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_03_ranger_a: There... is another idea that forced itself into my mind.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_03_ranger_b: I hesitate to ask, however, as it would require you to visit the Garden of Genesis in Edengrove.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_04_ranger_a: I still can't get over the fact that you ventured into the Garden of Genesis and returned.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_04_ranger_b: You'll have to tell me all about it someday.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_05_ranger_a: You have proven to be a hero even among Soulwardens, my friend.
npc_defaultdialogue_0718_05_ranger_b: I think it only fitting that a hero such as yourself wields a worthy weapon.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_00_ranger_a: I'm beginning to have doubts about our position here.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_00_ranger_b: Every time I go out for reconnaissance, it seems the Corrupted are gaining ground.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_01_ranger_a: In my time on Aeternum, I've seen darkness to terrify anyone in the Old World.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_01_ranger_b: But I've never seen anything as insidious as the way the Corrupted bolster their ranks.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_02_ranger_a: In my time on Aeternum, I've seen darkness to terrify anyone in the Old World.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_02_ranger_b: Every time I go out for reconnaissance, it seems the Corrupted are gaining ground.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_03_ranger_a: The Corrupted have found a way to use Ancient forging techniques to craft new weapons.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_03_ranger_b: I’ve uncovered pages that show some details as to the process.
npc_defaultdialogue_0719_04_ranger: Let's see what we can do with the materials you've managed to collect.
npc_defaultdialogue_0720_00_ranger_a: I've walked these lands for as long as I can remember.
npc_defaultdialogue_0720_00_ranger_b: It's always been a dark place, but never quite so apocalyptic.
npc_defaultdialogue_0720_01_ranger_a: I have been translating a section of the texts you recovered for Madaki, and I found something truly spectacular.
npc_defaultdialogue_0720_01_ranger_b: It is a ballad of a Legendary Spear known as 'Heavensplitter,' and it tells how to forge it.
npc_defaultdialogue_0721_00_ranger_a: Mind yourself if you leave the outpost.
npc_defaultdialogue_0721_00_ranger_b: Seems half the people who leave… never return.
npc_defaultdialogue_0721_01_ranger_a: I've been studying the materials Ranger Madaki has shared around.
npc_defaultdialogue_0721_01_ranger_b: There's a legendary sword and shield that could be forged.
npc_defaultdialogue_0722_00_innkeep_a: Shattered Mountain is hardly a comfortable place, but we do what we can. Welcome to the 'Last Beacon', friend. Make yourself at home.
npc_defaultdialogue_0723_00_innkeep_a: This maybe an outpost on the front lines, but I tolerate no messiness, understand? You're welcome to the 'Riven Shield', but clean up after yourself.
npc_defaultdialogue_0724_00_fisher: Hello there, I'm Master Fisher Bernard.
npc_defaultdialogue_0724_01_fisher: I'm Master Fisher Bernard, by the way.
npc_defaultdialogue_0724_02_fisher: I worry that the Corruption-Tinged Fish will start popping up all over Aeternum…
npc_defaultdialogue_0725_00_prospector: There are still battles to be had for the resources of this land. Are you interested?
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_00_mararosa_a: <g id="female_thinking" />I am curious about this 'Tempest', <g id="female_notsure" />or should I call her Isabella?
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_00_mararosa_b: <g id="female_order" />Return when you are stronger and we might be able to find out more about her together.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_01_mararosa_a: <g id="female_bowDeep" />I am Mara Rosa. <g id="female_touchhands" />I have managed to make my way to Aeternum and to this broken mountain in search of knowledge. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />But I dare not enter this unholy place.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_01_mararosa_b: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />You, however, you might be the one I've been searching for.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_02_mararosa_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />What of Isabella's family? <g id="male_patience" />The name of de Leon was once respected by the people of Spain.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_02_mararosa_b: I know Isabella lost her parents, <g id="male_spreadhands" />Lord and Lady de Leon, when she was a girl.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_03_mararosa_a: <g id="male_explain" />The documents across the island speak of a man with no name, but a chilling title: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />The Heretic. He was at Isabella's side from the journey's start.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_03_mararosa_b: <g id="female_lookConcern" />Did he lure Isabella into darkness? Did she resist him? <g id="female_thinking" />Or was it as easy as leading a child?
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_04_mararosa_a: <g id="female_thinking" />Now that we know Isabella willingly embraced Corruption, I am curious if any of her humanity remained.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_04_mararosa_b: <g id="female_crossarms" />There are tales of the treatment of her crew. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />They do not paint a flattering portrait.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_05_mararosa_a: <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />It must have been this Heretic who polluted her mind and forced her to commit such atrocities.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_05_mararosa_b: <g id="male_think" />This demon must have been acting through her. <g id="female_smackfist" />That is the only answer!
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_06_mararosa: <g id="female_thinking" />There was a priest who travelled with Isabella. He sought to save her from the Heretic. <g id="female_crossarms" />His name was Father Russo.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_06_mararosa_b: <g id="male_explain" />I served in the Church with him. His love for Isabella matched my own. It even ran deeper.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_07_mararosa_a: <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />Everything we have learned has revealed a great truth: those who were meant to protect Isabella all failed her. <g id="female_lookdownSorry" />Including me.
npc_defaultdialogue_0726_07_mararosa_b: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />My penance is to stay here, at the door to her soul, <g id="female_lookdownSorry" />and relive our failures.
npc_defaultdialogue_0727_00_bookofisabel: A collection of pages about Isabella de Leon.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_graceomalley_a: So I tried having a chat with that lying oaf Francis Turner, but that bastard Captain Dupont wouldn't let me pass.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_graceomalley_b: I was trying to think who we could trust here. Maybe that dandy Quartermaster?
npc_defaultdialogue_07_graceomalley_new: <g id="grace_frustrated" priority="high" />We were so close… but this means there might be more treasures in all these ruins. Hm. <g id="grace_think" />Grace O'Malley, Treasure Hunter. Kinda like the sound of that.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_leovixsilva: You know, over all these years, I've really come to enjoy living here in Windsward. With the Iron Rose Company gone, I'll be moving on. But it's really a damn shame.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_leovixsilva_a: You know, over all these years, I've really come to enjoy living here in Winsward.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_leovixsilva_b: With the Iron Rose Company gone, I'll be moving on. But it's really a damn shame.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_leovixsilva_new: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />I talked to Saatvik. His notion of how to handle the Speaker is a bit more… generous than mine. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />We should all discuss this.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_mb_grace_a: With that revelation, I'd say it's all the more urgent that you catch up with the Knight-Regent.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_mb_grace_b: She wants you to meet her at the last of the farms that hasn't fallen to the Lost. It's not too far from here.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_mb_grace_new: <g id="grace_cajole" />Call yourself a sage? Look past your scrolls to see the man's behavior! Even the Knight-Regent knows Lochnir's gone mad… and let me tell you, <g id="grace_headshakeno" />she's not happy.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_nessaharrower_a: The Druidic scrolls mention a Verdant Spirit that's protected Windsward for centuries.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_nessaharrower_b: I thought it was just a superstition, but there was an annual tradition to visit the Verdant Shrines where the gemstones were kept.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_nessaharrower_new: <g id="male_explain" />You see the ruins are protected by some rather… overprotective guardians,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> far beyond what I can handle. <g id="male_compliment" />You, however, seem to have great prowess.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_percillawallen: <g id="yonas_saluteFistchest" />The new Queen will need a Knight. I plan to stay by her side,<g id="yonas_headnodyes" /> as long as she will have me.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_percillawallen_ne: <g id="yonas_saluteFistchest" />The new Queen will need a Knight. I plan to stay by her side,<g id="yonas_headnodyes" /> as long as she will have me.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_regentjinjae_a: You have been here a short time, but perhaps you have seen the ruins yourself.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_regentjinjae_a_ne: <g id="female_thinking" />Grace says she was with you up north and the pirates were rallying to some strange altar. <g id="female_spreadarms" />Is it possible it's connected to the tablet from the mine?
npc_defaultdialogue_07_regentjinjae_b: Though humans have inhabited this island for thousands of years, there was a mysterious Ancient Civilization here even before we arrived.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_saatvikagrawal_a: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Finally, someone in this town who isn't drinking at the Speaker's poisoned well. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I heard you confronted him about the tribute.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_saatvikagrawal_b: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Of course, now he and Dupont have fallen back on the classic "the pirates' did it" excuse.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_serpaynebennett_a: Believe it or not, while you were battling on the beach, we apprehended an enemy spy!

<g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />The woman claims she snuck into the pirate's den and there are hundreds within… <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />but can we really trust her? After all, she is a pirate herself.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_serpaynebennett_b: We all saw Miss O'Malley in Prydwen, and now we caught her skulking out of the pirates' lair.
npc_defaultdialogue_07_zander: <g id="g_female_notsure" />Good luck with that recipe. Oh, and don’t eat any of it. A lion might roar… but<g id="g_male_shrugbrief" /> I’m not sure what would happen to you.<g id="g_male_laughbig" /> Ha ha!
npc_defaultdialogue_07a_nessaharrower_ne: <g id="male_waghand03" />I'm no less infuriated with the Speaker's actions than anyone else, but the thirst for vengeance mustn't distract us. <g id="female_youknow" />The Gemstones are all that matters now.
npc_defaultdialogue_0803_00_survivalist: If you're the hunting type, you'll find Ebonscale has a variety of wildlife unlike anywhere else on Aeternum.
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_00_commander: Keep lookin' at me like that and I'll make your jaw dance.
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_01_commander: Always happy to see a fellow soldier-of-fortune. How can I help you, mate?
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_01pre_commander: Always happy to see a fellow soldier-of-fortune. How can I help you, mate?\n\n[ Level 49 required for Ebonscale Reach faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_02_commander: Go on, sling your hook, big brain. I've had my fill of your kind.
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_03_commander: Here to offer me salvation? I've got all the salvation I need in this here scabbard.
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_04_commander: Well now, it's my honor to finally acknowledge the rising Champion in our ranks.
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_04pre_commander: Well now, it's my honor to finally acknowledge the rising Champion in our ranks.\n\n[ Level 49 required for Ebonscale Reach faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0807_05pre_commander: I salute you, Commander {playerName}.\n\n[ Level 49 required for Ebonscale Reach faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0808_01_alchemist: Seek forever farther, my scholar. In what manner may I oblige you?
npc_defaultdialogue_0808_01pre_alchemist: Seek forever farther, my scholar. In what manner may I oblige you?\n\n[ Level 49 required for Ebonscale Reach faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0808_02_alchemist: Ignorance is bold, knowledge is reserved. -Thucydides
npc_defaultdialogue_0808_03_alchemist: Many, while doing the foulest deeds, use the fairest words. -Democritus
npc_defaultdialogue_0809_00_adjudicator: May the light protect you. Adjudicator Wen at your service.
npc_defaultdialogue_0809_01_adjudicator: I welcome you in service to the light. What is your bidding, fellow keeper.
npc_defaultdialogue_0809_01pre_adjudicat: I welcome you in service to the light. What is your bidding, fellow keeper.\n\n[ Level 49 required for Ebonscale Reach faction missions ]
npc_defaultdialogue_0809_02_adjudicator: You may not recognize it, Marauder, but the light watches over even you.
npc_defaultdialogue_0809_03_adjudicator: I respect your hunger for knowledge, researcher.
npc_defaultdialogue_0824_00_innkeep: We're honored to host you at the Three Perfections inn. There are many sights and many meals to enjoy here in Ebonscale!
npc_defaultdialogue_0830_02_posting: (The board is now empty, free of wanted postings.)
npc_defaultdialogue_0899_00_liberator: I am here to loose the chains of all who would defy the Empress, for the good of the world.
npc_defaultdialogue_0899_01_liberator: My fighting prime may be long past, but I will never stop being Guo the Liberator. Wherever there is injustice, I appear.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_graceomalley_a: <g id="grace_secret" priority="high"/>This town's tied up in more secrets and lies than the Pope.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_graceomalley_b: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />Normally, that would be exactly my kind of place, but I’m feeling uneasy. <g id="grace_no" />Too much like being back home. There's some dark history there.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_leovixsilva_a: <g id="male_waghand03" priority="high"/>Before you counsel patience, I'd ask you to remember the atrocities <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />the Speaker and his conniving lackey have committed.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_leovixsilva_b: <g id="male_righthandAngry" />They betrayed Medea,<g id="female_nodyes" /> the druids, the Iron Rose, and the entire town. <g id="female_smackfist" />They need to pay in blood!
npc_defaultdialogue_08_mb_grace: <g id="grace_bowHead" priority="high"/>Always good to see a friendly face in this mess. <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />It seems we found the wrong part of Aeternum to make a landing, didn't we?
npc_defaultdialogue_08_nessaharrower_a: Everything we're doing here is for the benefit of Corinth. But I do believe Francis Turner needs to be held to account.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_nessaharrower_b: His dealings with the pirates must be exposed. And the town needs a new Speaker of the Winds.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_nessaharrower_new: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />While it's a proven fact now that Medea is not behind the curse, <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />she is the architect of Windsward's protections. We should get back on her good side.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_regentjinjae: Younge understands the Ancient language better than scholars ten times his age. I'd take his advice and inspect Khalladan and Antares.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_regentjinjae_new: <g id="male_think" />If there is some connection between the tablet and the altar at the pirate's den, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />please let me know right away.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_saatvikagrawal_a: So, I've spoken with Leovix and your friend, Grace O'Malley.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_saatvikagrawal_b: The two of them, you and I, and the Druid… I think we have a nice little resistance cooking.
npc_defaultdialogue_08_saatvikagrawal_ne: <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />Though Leovix might be a little on the aggressive side, I am glad we have him.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_graceomalley: <g id="grace_think" />I was thinking to try and convince you to come with me, but I'm pretty sure that's a lost cause, isn't it?
npc_defaultdialogue_09_leovixsilva_a: Welcome home, comrade! I have assumed the duties of heading up the Town Guard.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_leovixsilva_b: So I am a bit preoccupied right now. You should see the Speaker Agrawal.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_leovixsilva_new: <g id="female_whattheheck" />I can't believe this! No sooner does Saatvik allow those bastards to leave than we actually have a use for them. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Exile! Pshah! They deserve much worse.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_mb_grace_a: The rotten bastards are loading up their ships with explosives as we speak.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_mb_grace_a_new: <g id="grace_understand" />That bastard Lochnir is planning to turn all of Monarch's Bluffs to Lost! <g id="grace_yes" />I guess, though, the scariest part is how close he is to succeeding.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_mb_grace_b: I'd wager they're sailing for Prydwen as soon as he gives word. They'll blast the town from here to Connacht!
npc_defaultdialogue_09_mb_grace_b_new: <g id="grace_gestureL" />They're clearly making preparations here to launch an attack on Prydwen. <g id="grace_no" />Hordes of Lost, stockpiles of explosives… <g id="grace_yes" />I'd say they're about to make their move.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_nessaharrower_a: Perfect timing! I've just come from Historian Moira, and I need your help.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_nessaharrower_b: Moira says there's a map showing the shrine's locations engraved on a monument in the ancient ruins of Breakwater Bulwark.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_nessaharrower_new: <g id="female_crossarms" />Tensions are rising fast around here. I'm beginning to think bloodshed is unavoidable.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_regentjinjae: Have you encountered Minister Lochnir yet? My sources suspect he may have turned into one of the Lost himself.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_saatvikagrawal_a: <g id="litearmor_chuckle" />Always returning victorious and looking like <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />it was a simple matter! I'm glad you're back.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_saatvikagrawal_b: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />I understand you've restored another one of these "Verdant Gemstones" to its proper place.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_serpaynebennett_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I can only imagine the filth you had to wade through to reach the heart of the pirates' den.
npc_defaultdialogue_09_serpaynebennett_b: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Did you find the foul sorcery Miss O'Malley claimed was there?
npc_defaultdialogue_09a_regentjinjae_new: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />With Lochnir in outright rebellion and Ser Percilla refusing to speak to me, <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I wonder if I've not been too tolerant, in my time as Regent.
npc_defaultdialogue_09a_saatvikagrawal: <g id="litearmor_chuckle" />Always returning victorious and looking like <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />it was a simple matter! I'm glad you're back.
npc_defaultdialogue_09b_regentjinjae_new: <g id="male_hanghead" priority="high" />Gawain is… and Lochnir… I just can't. Forgive me. <g id="female_slumpWhattodo" priority="high" />I need a moment to contemplate what I've just heard.
npc_defaultdialogue_09c_regentjinjae_new: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />So you've been to Teyrnon Keep, and you saw the horrors Percilla described? I can't imagine. <g id="male_darnit" priority=""high" />Gawain… Lochnir… this is worse than even my darkest fears.
npc_defaultdialogue_09d_regentjinjae_new: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> If you've not found Grace yet, you shouldn't waste a moment. <g id="male_shakehead" />She has no idea the danger she's facing.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_leovixsilva_a: Good thing you're here, comrade. You won't believe it, but my recruits just returned with confirmation that the new tribute has come under attack.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_leovixsilva_b: I was about to go myself, but if you're willing, I’d prefer it were you.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_leovixsilva_new: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />I can't believe you came out here without me! I had no idea! <g id="male_willcoverit" />If I had known, I would not have allowed you to face such a fight alone.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_mb_grace: <g id="grace_secret" priority="high"/>Word is there's another town to the north where they're filthy with treasure. <g id="grace_think" />I think I'll be heading that way, once everything here's in order.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_nessaharrower_a: Now, we must expose the Speaker and force him to tell us where the other Verdant Gemstones are.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_nessaharrower_b: There's just one problem: Captain Leovix seems intent on tying the Speaker to a rock and throwing him into the sea.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_nessaharrower_new: <g id="male_willcoverit" />Moira and I will get to work on deciphering this straightaway. <g id="male_pointBlame" />Though it's an unfortunate distraction, I think you might need to visit the Town Hall.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_regentjinjae_a: I would understand if you wished to follow and seek adventure to the north yourself.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_regentjinjae_b: Otherwise, I do have Ser Payne and Ser Percilla, but I could always use more knights. Especially if I am to become queen.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_regentjinjae_new: But what's next for you? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You would make a fine knight, and we sorely need to rebuild the order, <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />but I also understand if voices are calling you elsewhere.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_saatvikagrawal_a: Unfortunately, there are new developments that may plunge us back into chaos just as we were starting to have hope.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_saatvikagrawal_b: Just minutes ago, Captain Leovix sent word that the tribute encountered trouble on the road.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_saatvikagrawal_ne: <g id="litearmor_concerns" priority="high" />It would seem Medea will no longer be satisfied with us sending a new tribute. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I promise you this, however... we will not be sending tribute in blood.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_serpaynebennett_a: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I am pleased to report these filthy blackguards have been far less organized since you destroyed the altar.
npc_defaultdialogue_10_serpaynebennett_b: Still, <g id="male_realize" /> a Knight of Prydwen remains vigilant, always!
npc_defaultdialogue_11_leovixsilva: Whatever it takes, we will save this town, goddamn it! If we have to send tribute a hundred times, that's what we'll do.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_leovixsilva_new: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />The victory we won together, comrade. I will never forget it.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_nessaharrower_a: I'll talk to Quartermaster Agrawal about dealing with the two criminals.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_nessaharrower_b: And then I can start asking around town about this Captain Korrapati character.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_nessaharrower_new: Well, <g id="male_willcoverit" />you'll be glad to know we've made progress studying this map. <g id="female_youknow" />I think we've identified the location of at least one of the other shrines.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_regentjinjae_a: Now that I hear about this Corrupted voice in your head, the Watcher's Report is even more disturbing.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_regentjinjae_a_ne: <g id="male_shakehead" />Now that I hear about this Corrupted voice in your head, your account from the beach is all the more disturbing.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_regentjinjae_b: I fear Gawain and Lochnir were a prelude to an even greater threat that now approaches.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_saatvikagrawal: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> The town of Corinth is finally at peace, though I'm nervous to say that out loud. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />There's a long road ahead, but we will be forever in your debt.
npc_defaultdialogue_11_serpaynebennett: Well now, <g id="male_compliment" />all's well that ends well, if I may say so. Not the monarch we expected on throne, but a suitable one all the same! <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Long live Queen Jin Jae!
npc_defaultdialogue_1208_00_alchemist_ne: Have you seen the wonders around you? Look more closely and you will see the science behind them.
The island is like a school to the thirsty mind.
npc_defaultdialogue_1209_00_adjudicator_: Hold on to the spark of hope within you. It will keep you safe in the darkness of despair.
The Regent is blessed and will find a way to save us all.
npc_defaultdialogue_1209_04_adjudicator: You're a Marauder, yes? So tell me how is Rodger…Commander Purcell? Is he in good health?
npc_defaultdialogue_1209_05_adjudicator: What type of fantasy are you weaving yourself today? So much focus on searching for something that is right under your nose.
npc_defaultdialogue_1209_06a_adjudicator: Now that you have joined in our cause, you must carry the light into the world at every chance.
Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_00_commander: Stand strong. Don't give in to the Lost. We will overcome this together. The Regent will see to it.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_00_commander_new_: We are forged in the fire and quenched in the blood of battle. Only the strong and brave can be Marauders.
Go on and look into the other factions. You'll see that the Syndicate are weak and the Covenant naïve.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_01_alchemist: Ok, Marauder. The name is "Tuit", not "twit". And tell that child of a Commander that he needs to grow up.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_01_commander: Typical of the Syndicate to get in over your heads. Best learn to swim as you'll get no help from me.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_02_alchemist: It is you and your cult who are missing the plot. The Syndicate will reveal all in due time.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_02_commander: I harbor you no ill will, cultist, though I feel uneasy when your Adjudicator is near. Her eyes... They seem to drill right through me.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_03_alchemist_a: Now that you have officially joined in our enterprise, you should always seek ways to advance our interests.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_03_alchemist_b: Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_03_commander_a: Now that you have officially joined our ranks, we expect you to seize every opportunity to gain honor.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_03_commander_b: Missions are available anytime on the Faction Board here, and in other settlements.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_03_commander_new: We are strongest together. Let us endeavor to bring victory to the Marauders.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_leovixsilva_a: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />After everything we've been through, I'm proud and honored to stand here today.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_leovixsilva_b: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />If the town of Corinth pulls through this, it's thanks to you, comrade!
npc_defaultdialogue_12_nessaharrower_a: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />I'm glad you're here, but I'm afraid I have bad news. <g id="male_pointLeft" />These pirates have been cursed into Lost just like <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />so many others in Windsward.
npc_defaultdialogue_12_nessaharrower_b: <g id="female_explains" />That means there won't be any chance of negotiating with them.
npc_defaultdialogue_13_nessaharrower_a: More importantly, <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />you've recovered the third Verdant Gemstone! This is the last one. <g id="female_spreadarms" />We’re finally close to restoring the land’s protections.
npc_defaultdialogue_13_nessaharrower_b: <g id="female_pointRight" />You'll need to take the Gemstone to the shrine at the ruins known as Sirius. <g id="male_compliment" />For you, I'm starting to think this will be easy.
npc_defaultdialogue_14_nessaharrower_a: Corinth is doing better than before. There is order and calm in the streets with Saatvik as the new Speaker of the Winds.
npc_defaultdialogue_14_nessaharrower_b: And he's moved quickly to resume the tribute to Medea, so it should already be on its way.
npc_defaultdialogue_14_nessaharrower_new: <g id="female_thinking" />I'd say perhaps if we explained the situation, but... <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />she doesn't seem like she's open to diplomacy at this point, does she?
npc_defaultdialogue_15_nessaharrower_a: I was headed out to the warren when I witnessed this. Just when we thought everything might start getting better.
npc_defaultdialogue_15_nessaharrower_b: I had no idea Medea could command this sort of power.
npc_defaultdialogue_15_nessaharrower_new: <g id="male_shocked" /> You… actually did it. Medea walked out of Thornhall, looking… rather chastened. <g id="male_shrugBrief" />But Leovix is mad he missed out on the action. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />You should speak with him.
npc_defaultdialogue_16_nessaharrower_a: This would suggest the famine was Medea's doing all along, but she's only resorted to such cruelty because of the Verdant Gemstones.
npc_defaultdialogue_16_nessaharrower_b: Moira mentioned something about Medea's involvement in building the shrines.
npc_defaultdialogue_16_nessaharrower_new: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Did you hear that? Can I believe my ears? Am <g id="male_willcoverit" />I actually going to train under the Sorceress Medea? I find that scary… and incredibly exciting.
npc_defaultdialogue_17_nessaharrower_a: <g id="male_leanforwardInspect" />Just being near Medea, I can sense great and terrible magic. I must confess, I find it rather… enticing.
npc_defaultdialogue_17_nessaharrower_b: But you've made all of this possible. You've restored hope to all of Windsward. I'm quite impressed!
npc_defaultdialogue_18_nessaharrower_a: My hopes for the other Druids being restored were not realized. My next steps were uncertain.
npc_defaultdialogue_18_nessaharrower_b: But after serious contemplation, I've decided to seek out Medea. I wish to become her apprentice and learn her craft.

npc_defaultdialogue_7404_01_overseer: Greetings and welcome! I’m the Overseer for this settlement. Consider me the right hand of the Governor.

npc_defaultdialogue_7a_leovixsilva: Alright. I finished sharpening my blade. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />It's high time we pay the Speaker a visit.
npc_defaultdialogue_adjudicator_00: We are the Covenant. We are charged by divine decree to protect this place and administer justice. I serve as the Adjudicator for this settlement.
npc_defaultdialogue_adjudicator_01: We are the Covenant. We are charged by divine decree to protect this place and administer justice. I serve as the Adjudicator for this settlement.

npc_defaultdialogue_magistrate_00: I’m the Magistrate for this settlement. It’s not as prestigious as it sounds… My job is to keep this place running smoothly and keep the populous well informed.
npc_defaultdialogue_magistrate_01: I’m the Magistrate for this settlement. It’s not as prestigious as it sounds… My job is to keep this place running smoothly and keep the populous well informed.
npc_defaultdialogue_magistrate_02: I’m the Magistrate for this settlement. It’s not as prestigious as it sounds… My job is to keep this place running smoothly and keep the populous well informed.
npc_defaultdialogue_magistrate_03: Now it is time to choose a faction. I hope you have learned about the three factions here.
npc_defaultdialogue_magistrate_04: I’m the Magistrate for this settlement. It’s not as prestigious as it sounds… My job is to keep this place running smoothly and keep the populous well informed.
npc_defaultdialogue_overseer_00: Greetings and welcome! I’m the Overseer for this settlement. Consider me the right hand of the Governor.
npc_defaultdialogue_overseer_01: Greetings and welcome! I’m the Overseer for this settlement. Consider me the right hand of the Governor.
npc_defaultdialogue_royahakimi_postsword: Oh thank you, thank you! You truly are a friend. I'll be able to practice properly now. Trees beware!
npc_defaultdialogue_s02_camp_grace_end_a: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Rima's a great addition to our team- she's a sharp one, and much more than meets the eye.
npc_defaultdialogue_s02_camp_grace_end_b: <g id="g_grace_doubt" />I'll wager she'll be running the operation end of things around here before long!
npc_defaultdialogue_s02_camp_rima_end_a: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />We really need to help Grace with the camp construction. Well,<g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" /> it's homey?
npc_defaultdialogue_s02_camp_rima_end_b: <g id="g_female_lookaroundconfused" />But it looks like a pirate gathered bits of shipwreck and strung it together with rope and sailcloth.
npc_defaultdialogue_s02_camp_zander_end_: <g id="g_female_shakeheadno" />I still cannot believe we haven't gotten a chance for you to try my lemon cakes!
<g id="g_male_pointblame" />I'm telling you, once I get a proper oven and I bake them for you, you are going to beg me to make them every day!
npc_defaultdialogue_stillwaterrose_p01_c: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Here comes a lovely walk and a dangerous smile. Am I finally to meet a muse sent by the Ancients themselves to inspire me?
"A bard on Aeternum is to laugh- and cry for hundreds of years. To dance and fling your heart away, through glory and in tears." Well, it's a start.
This one's about a man who loved his staff too much. Ahem. "Fire staff, better half, hotter than no other, meaner than my mother, there can be no other, Fire Staff!"
"Lay, they lay, under the stars. For the wine and clouds mixed, she fell on her- Ask, ask, ask of the moon." What, that's plenty romantic!
npc_defaultdialogue_suvivalist_00: Hey. I’m the local Survivalist. If you need any advice on how to navigate the rough wilds of this incredible place, I’m the one to talk to.
npc_defaultdialogue_suvivalist_01: Hey. I’m the local Survivalist. If you need any advice on how to navigate the rough wilds of this incredible place, I’m the one to talk to.
npc_defaultdialogue_watcher_00: I’m the Watcher assigned to these parts. My job is to keep these damn monsters from coming ashore. It's always good to have some company.
npc_defaultdialogue_watcher_01: I’m the Watcher assigned to these parts. My job is to keep these damn monsters from coming ashore. It's always good to have some company.
npc_defaultdialogue_watcher_02: Hey, hey, there, youuuu! Whatcha doin’ back here? I *hic* think I have the ahhh… *hic* beacheses unner control for now. Thanks, for all yer *hic* help. Shinceresly. Thanks. *hic*
npc_name_prospector_desc: Are you ready to play a 20 vs 20 match that takes place on a mysterious island?
npc_npc_18040_state_1_defaultdialogue_2: The Tear of Gaia... I can feel it's power.
npc_p1_agnes_00_a: Ever talked to a man you fancied and he opens his mouth and the fancy evaporates?
npc_p1_agnes_00_b: And you want to travel back in time to the moment before he spoke, but you can’t?
npc_p1_agnes_01_a: Did you run out of candles? Sadly, I'm all out too.
npc_p1_agnes_01_b: Isn't that just the thing. Can't find a decent man, or a steady supply of warmth. Perhaps it's time to invest in a hearty blanket.
npc_p1_animalhunter_00: Greetings, denizen of this fine, fetid land. Tis I! Samuel Worthington Bloodgood the Third, hunter extraordinaire, at your service!
npc_p1_animalhunter_01_a: Oh, you must be the hardy sort, to wander so freely in a place like this! I dare say you might even be capable with that weapon of yours.
npc_p1_animalhunter_01_b: What say you to a friendly competition?
npc_p1_animalhunter_02: It would be so terribly unfair of me to deprive you of another contest, since I so RUDELY abandoned my own attempt. Shall we have another?
npc_p1_animalhunter_03_a: I am becoming increasingly eager to prove myself to you, my friend.
npc_p1_animalhunter_03_b: To know you have toiled so hard in these Blighted lands, and myself empty-handed! Why, it is hardly befitting of a Bloodgood, let alone the third.
npc_p1_animalhunter_04: I understand I am stretching the bounds of your credulity right now. Truly, I do. Uh, yes, I, uh, I have… a confession to make, if you will hear it.
npc_p1_animalhunter_05_a: Well, I believe retirement is in my future. A quiet, obscure, shameless retirement where no one need witness my forebear’s disappointment.
npc_p1_animalhunter_05_b: I should thank you, but I would rather we did not meet again.
npc_p1_antara_00_a: Isn't this place beautiful? Like the scents of the first rain of the season.
npc_p1_antara_00_b: The colours here are so vivid, it reminds me of the time I had with my mum.
npc_p1_antara_01_a: Doesn't life seem endless sometimes? My mum and I used to sit on the tallest cliffs, our legs dangling over the edge, teasing death.
npc_p1_antara_01_b: She was so adventurous. So indomitable. I miss her. And I don't know if I'll ever measure up to what she was.
npc_p1_antara_02_a: Here's the Wyldwood Water. Doesn't it have a strange sheen, as if there's something living in its depths?
npc_p1_antara_02_b: I don't know the exact effects of drinking it.
npc_p1_antara_03: I'll always remember you. I wish I'd met you before. I think my mum would have liked you.
npc_p1_antiquarian_00: If you happen to spot a woman hiding in some absurd corner of a ruin, do let her know she has won and the game is over. Thank you!
npc_p1_antiquarian_01_a: Finally, a traveler along the road!
npc_p1_antiquarian_01_b: I’m Dr. Leonie Roggeveen. My wife Nora and I – we work as a team – we’re here to see what we could dig up in these ruins. To study. We’re antiquarians– numismatists– scholars, you see.
npc_p1_antiquarian_02_a: Hmm, yeah, that blue-ish hue means starmetal… and the three-faced queen on the obverse…there’s no doubt about it. This coin came from the Canopus dig site!
npc_p1_antiquarian_03_a: Ahem! Okay, let’s see what we’ve got here. Hmm… If I turn it this way and hold it against the other coin… Some sort of bridge? Nein… An aquedu-- Aha!
npc_p1_antiquarian_03_b: I’ve got it! It came from Aqua Acadia!
npc_p1_antiquarian_04: Have you found any more clues? Or, uh, my wife?
npc_p1_antiquarian_05: That was fun. In hindsight, the added threat of bodily harm did make it more thrilling. I am just glad she is back with me.
npc_p1_antiquarianspouse_00: Shh! Find your own hiding spot, will you?
npc_p1_antiquarianspouse_01: She must be so worried about me…
npc_p1_antiquarianspouse_02: I knew Leonie wouldn't be able to resist another puzzle. Be honest, she's loving this, right? She’s not too worried?
npc_p1_antiquarianspouse_03: I think our next game will feature less… excitement. Ah, well, lesson learned.
npc_p1_antiquarianspouse_04: I think our next game will feature less… excitement. Ah, well, lesson learned.
npc_p1_architect_00: Just look at this incredible stonework! Can't you just feel the weight of the years, pressing down?
npc_p1_architect_01_a: Oh, hello! Perfect timing! I'm Na Li, the architect. You've probably seen my work in the Ebonscale settlement.
npc_p1_architect_01_b: Say, do me a favor. Take a look at this bridge, and tell me: how old do you think it is?
npc_p1_architect_02_a: Well, this is puzzling. Judging by the level of erosion, sediment layers, and my chemical analysis… these stones could be several orders of magnitude older than I first guessed.
npc_p1_architect_03_a: I will not allow myself to grow too excited just yet.
npc_p1_architect_03_b: But if my observations are correct, this stone is many hundreds of thousands, perhaps even MILLIONS of years old. Think of the implications!
npc_p1_architect_04: The future is bright, and I am going to be the one to build it.
npc_p1_kazu_00_a: Stay wary in this cave, stranger! I fear the ice wolves have a magic I haven't come across before.
npc_p1_kazu_00_b: Those seemingly innocuous patterns on the wall? They blinded me when I touched them.
npc_p1_kazu_01: Don't hurt the wolf. It's done me no harm!
npc_p1_kazu_02_a: The merchant said he saw similar symbols at a nearby waterfall.
npc_p1_kazu_02_b: I must find a way to get there and search the place. We need every advantage we can get against the demons that inhabit this island.
npc_p1_kazu_03_a: <g id="male_explain" />Once we understand the island more, we can tap into its powers to keep ourselves and our communities safe.
npc_p1_kazu_03_b: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I wish you luck on your journey, friend. <g id="male_spreadhands" />I hope our paths cross again one day.
npc_p1_kazujournal_00_a: (A journal that looks like it was carelessly forgotten.
npc_p1_kazujournal_00_b: It could be a daydreaming owner, could be a person running from danger...)
npc_p1_kazujournal_01_a: A glyph in its smallest unit seems to denote a word. Some patterns have single glyphs. While some have many glyphs joined together to form a complex word.
npc_p1_kazujournal_01_b: Given the location of these glyphs, one could assume they have some connection with the Ancient monuments.
npc_p1_maria_00_a: Isn’t the Fen the prettiest place you’ve ever been? It’s home to so much life, in the waters, in the trees, in the air.
npc_p1_maria_00_b: The earth used to be happy once. You should have seen her in her glory days. Before the Great Shattering.
npc_p1_maria_01_a: Now that you've been around, surely you agree how gorgeous the fens are. The wildlife! The fresh air!
npc_p1_maria_01_b: You should have seen her in her glory days. Before the Great Shattering.
npc_p1_monsterhunter_00: Hey, mind you don’t make too much noise, even on the road. You never know what might come running out of the murk.
npc_p1_monsterhunter_01_a: It’s quiet out there. Far too quiet.
npc_p1_monsterhunter_01_b: I fear the worst for my companions. They should have arisen by now. Have you perchance seen anyone in attire like mine along the road?
npc_p1_monsterhunter_02_a: If you bested The Denier, then perhaps you can be of further use.
npc_p1_monsterhunter_02_b: My comrades and I chose this as a meeting point in the event our hunt was unsuccessful. They still haven't returned...
npc_p1_monsterhunter_03_a: Well, this is grim, isn’t it? Am I the only one left?
npc_p1_monsterhunter_03_b: No. Ruiz founded the White Skulls. He was a shadow hunter of unshakeable resolve. He would not leave me like this…
npc_p1_monsterhunter_04: I will remain vigilant. I will not lose faith, nor hope, nor conviction. Despite the fact that I carry on the hunt alone. For now at least…
npc_p1_niall_00_a: Hah, watch yourself. You don’t want to mess with a reptile her size. She’s a bit grumpy today. And her teeth can cut through iron. Chomp chomp.
npc_p1_niall_00_b: I understand the old girl. I’d be cranky too if I had an aching belly. You know
npc_p1_niall_01: Look at that, she remembers you! Oh, you probably can't sense any changes, but I noticed a slight spring in her crocodilian steps.
npc_p1_perfumealchemist_00: The stench of this swamp… it's so beautiful.
npc_p1_perfumealchemist_01: Stop for a moment, friend. Take a deep breath. Yes, drink it in. What does the Fen smell like to you?
npc_p1_perfumealchemist_02: You can close your eyes against sight, plug your ears against sound… but you can't escape the smell, no.
npc_p1_primrose_00_a: Isn’t it a lovely day? Well, lovely for Weaver's Fen. If you need any ingredients, you can always get them at the Trading Post.
npc_p1_primrose_00_b: If you’re looking for fibres, Maria Sancho can point you in the right direction.
npc_p1_primrose_01_a: Gentle stranger, could you help an old woman? I fear my daughter could be in danger.
npc_p1_primrose_01_b: Oh. Who am I fooling? She's definitely in danger. I mean, it's Aeternum! And she'd surely have missed me by now.
npc_p1_primrose_02_a: Oh goodness! Hazel, what were you doing? She knows such magics are forbidden in the Fen!
npc_p1_primrose_02_b: Why would my baby do something so risky? I didn't even know she wanted a child.
npc_p1_primrose_03_a: Binding animal parts together? That sounds like something the Crone would do!
npc_p1_primrose_03_b: Oh, Hazel... I never asked for a grandchild. Why'd she think I wanted one?
npc_p1_primrose_04: I don't know how I will go on without my Hazel... This island will never be satisfied until it has taken everything from you…
npc_p1_pyro_00: Alright, Torchy, stay cool. Everything is going to be fine. Oh… could you come back a bit later?
npc_p1_pyro_01_a: Well met, traveler! People call me Torchy, on account of my… interests.
npc_p1_pyro_01_b: You have my word, however. Despite what they say, I swear, I am not a threat to society.
npc_p1_pyro_02_a: You seem to be a bright light yourself, my friend. These torches cannot have been easy to acquire.
npc_p1_pyro_02_b: I wonder, though, if you might humor Torchy for one more favor, eh?
npc_p1_pyro_03_a: Yes, my friend. With what you acquired, Eternal Flame is finally within our reach!
npc_p1_pyro_03_b: I just need to get back to my hovel in Restless Shore. So, maybe one more favor for Torchy? This time, it is a righteous one!
npc_p1_pyro_04_a: Once I am back in Restless Shore, I will create the world's first Eternal Flame!
npc_p1_pyro_04_b: I will light it in your honor, my friend. We will set the world on FIRE!
npc_p1_simone_00_a: <g id="male_dontknow" />Have you ever felt like today is exactly as yesterday was, till the days themselves bleed into each other and you start to doubt the existence of time?
npc_p1_simone_00_b: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />I'm cursed to repeat the same day over and over again. <g id="male_headShakeNo" />It's so exasperating!
npc_p1_simone_01_a: <g id="male_spreadhands" />I don't believe I've seen you before. You seem different, an extra element in this stationary world.
npc_p1_simone_01_b: You may be the answer to the curse. <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Oh, please, please, help me break free from whatever magic has been placed upon me!
npc_p1_simone_02_a: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />My aunt's magic is stronger than I expected. <g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />Oh, she torments me with her traps.
npc_p1_simone_02_b: <g id="male_dontknow" />I fear I'm forever doomed to repeat this life. If only there was a way to escape!
npc_p1_theuderic_00_a: Felt the strange heat in the fog? It clings to your skin like a wet sock. Could have you feeling clammy.
npc_p1_theuderic_00_b: Strange dreams? Chills at night? It could be the swamp sickness, my friend.
npc_p1_theuderic_01: Ah, I see you cannot resist my cures after all. At 100 coins, they are a steal, and will keep you safe from any lingering swamp sickness.
npc_p1_wolcott_00_a: What do you think of the art that surrounds us? Some would say the sight is almost breathtaking.
npc_p1_wolcott_00_b: But when you're a true artist, you see every color, every shape without attaching any emotion to it. I miss being a plebian.
npc_p1_wolcott_01_a: Ah! That is my painting. You have passed my test to find a genuine appreciator of fine art.
npc_p1_wolcott_01_b: My artistic endeavors require assistance. The kind only a fellow soul can undertake.
npc_p1_wolcott_02_a: You have done well, friend. Thank you for finding me this most glorious blue.
npc_p1_wolcott_02_b: I hope I can count on you if I need to collaborate for any future creative pursuits. Till then, toodaloo!
npc_p1_wolcottpainting_00: (The colors rich, the strokes indulgent, a rendering of Edengrove that can only be described as abstract. Clearly, the artist was lost in his thoughts.)
npc_p1_wolcottpainting_01: (The colors rich, the strokes indulgent, a rendering of Edengrove that can only be described as abstract. Clearly, the artist was lost in his thoughts.)
npc_p1_wolf_00_a: Kazu has a gentle heart and a strong will to rid the island of Corrupted.
npc_p1_wolf_00_b: Thank you for helping him this far. WE will protect him from here.
npc_topic_7506_00_spawn_dialogue: Why did the mushroom have so many friends?

objectivetasktype_tasksalvageitem_toolti: Occurs when the player salvages the given item
objectivetasktype_taskslayerscript_toolt: Task that triggers a block of slayerscript- use caution when applying this task!

objectivetasktype_tasktimer_tooltip: Task is completed if specified time expires
objectivetasktype_tasktriggerarea_toolti: Triggers when the player is within a specific location
objectivetasktype_tasktriggergameevent_t: A task that triggers a game-event when active. Follows the same fields as TaskGameEvent
