owg_faction_select_confirm: You will only be able to join a Company with players of the same Faction. If flagged for PVP, you will only be able to group up with players from the same Faction. Before joining, you might want to double-check the Faction choices of your friends in New World: Aeternum.\n\nYour choice isn't permanent -- you can change your faction from the Bio screen once. After that, you can change it again every <font color="#edc63e">30 days</font>.
owg_faction_select_no: No, let me think about it.
owg_faction_select_title_incompany: Warning! Your Company Has A Different Faction!
owg_faction_unlock_tooltip: Achieving a higher rank allows players to take on more faction missions and purchase superior gear from the faction shop.
owg_factionwarinfo_desc_1: Align with 1 of the 3 warring Factions to maximize your experience in Aeternum. Reap the powerful rewards by competing against other Factions and tipping the scales of influence for each Territory.
owg_factionwarinfo_desc_2: To combat other players, you must be aligned with a Faction, then flag for PvP while inside a Settlement. Once Flagged, you can damage players of opposing Factions who are also flagged for PvP. (You will see their Faction crest on their nameplates.)
owg_factionwarinfo_desc_3: Coming Soon: Completing Faction Missions provided by your Faction representative within a Settlement earns Faction Influence points within that Territory. Faction Influence is the means of protecting your Territories, or declaring war on the enemy.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_1_desc_1_bullet: Complete Missions for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">XP</font>, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Coin</font>, and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Faction Tokens</font>.
Earn Influence to determine Territory Control
Compete against enemy Factions in PvP Missions to determine Territory Control
owg_factionwarinfo_title_1_desc_2: Gain Access to Elite Faction Gear
owg_factionwarinfo_title_1_desc_2_bullet: Spend Faction Tokens on Special Weapons, Armor, and Consumables
Earn Ranks to unlock Advanced Gear and Crafting Components
owg_factionwarinfo_title_1_desc_3: Enjoy the Benefits of Territory Control
owg_factionwarinfo_title_1_desc_3_bullet: Reduced cost for Workshops and Fast Travel
Complete Town Missions to Upgrade the Settlement
owg_factionwarinfo_title_2_desc_1_bullet: Flag for PvP from any Settlement or Outpost

Get <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">additional XP</font> and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">increased Global Luck</font> when flagged
Contribute to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Faction Influence</font> within the Territory
owg_factionwarinfo_title_2_desc_2_bullet: Faction Members of Controlling Faction Enjoy Benefits in Territory and Settlement
Controlling Factions <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Reinforce</font> control by completing PvP Faction Missions
Opposing Factions <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Undermine</font> enemy Faction’s Control by completing PvP Faction Missions
Earn enough Influence to challenge for Territory Control through a Declaration of War
owg_factionwarinfo_title_2_desc_3_bullet: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">{maxRosterMembers} v {maxRosterMembers} player</font> siege combat at a Territory’s Fort
The winner determines who controls the Territory
The Attacker’s objective is to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">claim the capture point at the heart of the fortress</font>.
The Defender’s objective is to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">fend off the attackers for 30 minutes</font>.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_3_desc_1_bullet: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Territory Influence</font> is a measure of a Faction's control of a Territory

Factions can earn <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Territory Influence</font> by completing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">PvP Faction Missions</font> and controlling the <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Territory's Fort</font>

Attacking Factions that reach <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">100% Territory Influence</font> can <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">declare war</font> on the defending Faction
owg_factionwarinfo_title_3_desc_2: Reinforce or undermine a faction’s territory
owg_factionwarinfo_title_3_desc_2_bullet: Controlling Factions <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Reinforce</font> control by completing PvP Faction Missions
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Undermine</font> the opposing Faction’s Territories by completing PvP Faction Missions within their Territories
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Prevent other Factions</font> from completing PvP Faction Missions by flagging for PvP and patrolling the Territory
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Prevent the controlling</font> Faction from completing PvP Faction Missions by flagging for PvP and patrolling those Territories
owg_factionwarinfo_title_4_desc_1_bullet: Turn your PvP flag on from any Sanctuary, such as a Settlement or Outpost.

Upon leaving a Settlement, you receive a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">30 second timer</font> before becoming flagged. Once the timer expires, you are free to engage flagged members of the opposing Factions

Turning on your PvP flag grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">an XP Bonus</font> and allows you to participate in PvP missions, control Territory Forts, and battle other players.
Completing PVP activities will progress your PvP Reward Track.
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_semibold.font" color="#DDDDDD">Azoth Salt will be awarded</font> when PvP kills happen outside of modes.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_5_desc_1_bullet: The PvP Reward Track contains PvP-specific rewards for doing PvP activities in the game. The track can be completed and run again to get a different selection of rewards, with more prestigious rewards becoming available as more tracks are completed.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_5_desc_2_bullet: Progress your track by defeating other players and engaging in PvP Missions, War, Outpost Rush, Capturing Forts, and 3v3 Arenas.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_5_desc_3_bullet: Azoth Salt is the currency that gets you rewards from the PvP Track. You can gain Azoth Salt by engaging in War, Outpost Rush, 3v3 Arenas, PvP Missions, PvP open world kills, and earning XP while flagged.
owg_factionwarinfo_title_5_desc_4_bullet: Choose between unique rewards such as prestige armor and weapons, emotes, currencies, and consumables.

passive_bow_hunter_accuracy_description: Increases the <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">distance</font> that arrows travel before being affected by gravity by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100%</font>.

passive_bow_hunter_dmgonfirst_descriptio: Deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to any foe as long as you have not damaged them in the last <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>.

passive_bow_hunter_dmgvslow_description: Deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to targets below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health.
passive_bow_hunter_healonfive_descriptio: When you land a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">headshot</font>, heal yourself for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> of damage done.
passive_bow_hunter_heavydmg_description: Heavy attack arrows <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fly faster</font> and deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage.
passive_bow_hunter_heavydmgvsfull_descri: Heavy attacks deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to foes with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100%</font> health.
passive_bow_skirmish_cdrvslow_descriptio: Hitting a foe below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health reduces all bow ability cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font>.
passive_bow_skirmish_debuffdur_descripti: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Debuff</font> durations last {[0.200000 * 100]}% longer. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Does not affect crowd control debuffs.)</font>
passive_bow_skirmish_dmgvsdebuff_descrip: Deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to foes suffering from a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuff</font>.
passive_bow_skirmish_dodgehaste_descript: After dodging with full stamina, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.070000 * 100]}% haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>

(Cooldown {[10.000000]}s.)</font>

passive_bow_skirmish_rendhead_descriptio: Headshots inflict <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">rend</font> reducing target's armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
passive_bow_skirmish_slowfull_descriptio: If you hit a foe with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100%</font> health, inflict a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}% slow</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Slow reduces target's movement speed.)</font>
passive_bow_skirmish_staminavsdebuff_des: Hitting a foe with a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuff</font> grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}</font> stamina.

passive_dagger_critchancebonus_descripti: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Critical hit chance</font> increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> when using daggers.

passive_dagger_stamregengrit_description:
If you hit an enemy with an <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">ability</font> while at full combo points you gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}% </font>stamina regen for 
	<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. If you hit with an ability without full combo points gain grit on basic attacks for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font> or until you use an ability.

passive_firestaff_firemage_cdrheavy_desc: Heavy attacks reduce fire staff cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.070000 * -100]}%</font> on hit.
passive_firestaff_firemage_crit_descript: Your fire staff abilities gain an extra <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> chance to critical strike.
passive_firestaff_firemage_critburn_desc: Light and Heavy attacks inflict a stack of smolder on foes, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage every half second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)
passive_firestaff_firemage_critdmg_descr: While holding a fire staff, your critical strike damage is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_firestaff_firemage_dmgfullmana_d: While holding a fire staff and above <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> mana, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}% empower</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Empower increases damage.)</font>
passive_firestaff_firemage_dmgnodmg_desc: After not taking damage from an attack in the last <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font>, granting <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> more damage.
passive_firestaff_firemage_heavynomana_d: Heavy attacks now trigger a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}m</font> splash on impact, but the damage is reduced to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.200000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_firestaff_firemage_manaonhit_des: Heavy attacks will now restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> of your max mana on hit. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Can only be triggered once every {[0.500000]}s.)</font>
passive_firestaff_firemage_ultimate_desc: Using a fire staff ability places a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font> rune on the ground that grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font>, increasing your damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> while standing inside. passive_firestaff_pyro_burnnearby_descri: When hitting a target within {[4.000000]}m of player, create a field of fire around you dealing {[-0.200000 * -100]}% weapon damage to all to nearby enemies in a {[4.000000]}m radius for {[5000.000000 / 1000]}s. (Cooldown {[30.000000]}s.)
passive_firestaff_pyro_burnonlight_descr: Critical hits with fire staff abilities inflict a stack of smolder, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage every half second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)

passive_firestaff_pyro_manaonblock_descr: Dodging through an enemy melee attack inflicts a stack of smolder on foes, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage every half second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks. {[1.000000]}s Cooldown.)

passive_flail_crusader_passive4_descript: While stamina is at or below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font>, activating an ability will grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[15.000000]}</font> stamina. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[5.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_flail_crusader_passive5_descript:
When blocking a hit, gain a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font> status effect, every blocked hit extends the duration of the status effect by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font> to a max of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[9.000000]}s</font>, and while the effect is active, gain variable damage absorption based on current health percent and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">equip load</font>:
	\n\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Heavy</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">5%</font> absorption at full health increasing to a max of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> mitigation as health decreases
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Medium</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3%</font> absorption at full health increasing to a max of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.130000 * 100]}%</font> mitigation as health decreases
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Light</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1%</font> absorption at full health increasing to a max of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.070000 * 100]}%</font> mitigation as health decreases
passive_flail_crusader_passive6_descript: Increase your max health by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> of your physical armor rating while the flail is equipped.\n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect is active as long as the flail is equipped, even if the flail is sheathed.)</font>
passive_flail_eldritch_passive1_descript:
Abilities and Heavy attack hits against targets with less than <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> health, increase incoming healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> and gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.070000 * 100]}%</font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e"> haste</font> to self for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. 
(Incoming healing increase scales with Focus, increasing its power to up to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font>.) 
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>
passive_flail_eldritch_passive2_descript:
Grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Cooldown Reduction</font> based on actions performed in different <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">equip loads</font>:
	\n\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Heavy</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.010000 * -100]}%</font> cooldown reduction when hit or blocking a hit. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[0.500000]}s cooldown.)</font> 
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Medium</font> - 
	<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> cooldown reduction when dodging an attack. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s cooldown.)</font> 
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Light</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.010000 * -100]}%</font> cooldown reduction when hitting a target. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_flail_eldritch_passive3_descript: Hitting a target with a basic attack within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font> of using an ability will inflict <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">exhaust</font>, reducing stamina regen rate by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
passive_flail_eldritch_passive4_descript: Being hit or blocking a hit from a melee attack while above {[90.000000]}% health inflicts a stack of Impairment for {[6.000000]}s on the attacker, dealing {[-0.100000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second and inflicting weaken, reducing their base damage by {[-0.100000 * -100]}%. (Max {[3.000000]} stacks.) \n\n({[5.000000]}s cooldown.)
passive_flail_eldritch_passive5_descript:
While at or below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> health, all flail attacks grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.030000 * 100]}%</font> lifesteal while attacking targets. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[3.000000]} targets.)</font>
	\n\nWhile above <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> health, all flail attacks extend the duration of damage over time effects on targets by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.070000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_flail_eldritch_passive6_descript:
When no allies are within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}m</font>, all flail attacks deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage.
	\n\nWhen 1 or more allies are within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}m</font>, they gain empower, increasing their damage dealt by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_greataxe_mauler_armorwhenfoesnea: While holding a great axe, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> armor when <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> or more foes are within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font>.
passive_greataxe_mauler_dmgonblock_descr: When you block an attack with a great axe, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> dealing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> more damage for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[3.000000]} stacks.)</font>
passive_greataxe_mauler_dmgwhenfoesnear_: While holding a great axe, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> dealing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> damage when <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> or more foes are within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font>.
passive_greataxe_mauler_heavyaddgrit_des: Adds <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> to great axe heavy attacks. Also grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.120000 * 100]}%</font> base damage reduction while <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> is active. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)</font>
passive_greataxe_mauler_heavyaddpull_des: Heavy attacks with a great axe <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">pull</font> foes closer to you.
passive_greataxe_mauler_pulldur_descript: After you <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">pull</font> a target, they are <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">rooted</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.400000]}s</font>, preventing movement during the duration. \n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s cooldown on each target.)</font>
passive_greataxe_mauler_stamvslowhp_desc: If you get hit while holding a great axe and are below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[40.000000]}</font> stamina. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[20.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_greataxe_reaper_armorpenvslowhp_: Increase armor penetration of great axe attacks by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> against foes below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[50.000000]}%</font> health.
passive_greataxe_reaper_critvslowhp_desc: Great axe attacks against foes below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font> health have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> increased <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">critical chance</font>.
passive_greataxe_reaper_dmgonlight_descr: Light attacks with your great axe give you a stack of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, increasing damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[3.000000]} stacks.)</font>
passive_greataxe_reaper_dmgwhenblocked_d: Whenever your attacks are blocked, gain a stack of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> dealing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> damage for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[1.000000]} stacks.)</font>
passive_greataxe_reaper_hasteonlight_des: Hitting at least <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}</font> targets with a great axe light attack grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>
passive_greataxe_reaper_healvslowhp_desc: Great axe attacks against foes below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font> health <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heal</font> you for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> of damage done.
passive_greataxe_reaper_oncritheal_descr: When you critical hit with a great axe, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heal</font> yourself for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> of the damage done.
passive_greatsword_def_1_description: If you are hit while at full health, reduce the <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">damage taken</font> by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> then gain a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect has a {[20.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_greatsword_def_2_description: Hitting with the final attack of the greatsword chain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">reduces</font> the duration of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuffs</font> on you by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect has a {[5.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_greatsword_def_3_description: For each greatsword <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">buff</font> on you, base damage increases by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.030000 * 100]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[4.000000]} buffs.)</font>
passive_greatsword_def_4_description: After gaining <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">defiant stance</font> you will also gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font>, increasing your armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> for the next hit taken within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.\n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Does not apply to damage from debuffs.)</font>
passive_greatsword_def_5_description: Blocking for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font> causes you to enter <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">defiant stance</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(You must be in combat for this effect to activate. This effect will not renew defiant stance if it is already active.)</font>
passive_greatsword_def_6_description: Charged heavy attacks have grit and inflict bleeding for {[6.000000]}s dealing {[-0.050000 * -100]}% weapon damage every second. (Max {[5.000000]} stacks.)
passive_greatsword_def_7_description: You can now block <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100%</font> of the <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">ranged</font> attack damage while using a greatsword. \n\nAdditionally, you also reduce the stamina damage from all attacks while blocking by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_greatsword_def_8_description: Reduce the attackers <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stamina damage</font> dealt by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}%</font> when blocking attacks just after raising your guard or with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">guard point</font>. \n\nBlocking attacks within this window inflicts a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">rend</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font> against melee attackers. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[3.000000]} stacks.)</font>
passive_greatsword_off_1_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Increases</font> base damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> when attacking foes that are above <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[90.000000]}%</font> health.
passive_greatsword_off_2_description: Charged heavy attacks have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> armor penetration.
passive_greatsword_off_3_description: Gain a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> when hitting a target with a Onslaught tree ability. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect has a {[10.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_greatsword_off_4_description: After gaining <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">onslaught stance</font>, your next attack within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> has a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000 * 100]}%</font> increased <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">critical hit chance</font>.
passive_greatsword_off_5_description: Enter <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">onslaught stance</font> by hitting with a charged heavy attack. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(This effect occurs even if the attack is blocked but will not renew onslaught stance if it is already active.)</font>
passive_greatsword_off_6_description: Become <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">energized</font> by landing a critical hit and regain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]} stamina</font> and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}% base health</font> per second for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect has a {[10.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
passive_greatsword_off_7_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Critical hit chance</font> is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> when attacking foes with an active <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuff</font>.
passive_greatsword_off_8_description: After dodging, gain a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font> for the next <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}</font> hits within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This effect only occurs when in combat.)</font>\n\nAttacks empowered by this effect restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]} stamina</font> on hit.
passive_lifestaff_healing_aoehealwhenhit: When hit in battle, activate a healing aura for you and nearby friends in a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">4m</font> radius. The aura <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heals</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.080000 * 100]}%</font> weapon damage each second for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cooldown {[120.000000]}s.)</font>
passive_lifestaff_healing_cdronlight_des: When you hit with a light attack, reduce Life Staff ability cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font>.
passive_lifestaff_healing_cdronlow_descr: When you <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heal</font> an ally below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health, Life Staff ability cooldowns are reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Can only be triggered once every {[5.000000]}s.)</font>

passive_lifestaff_healing_nomanaonbasic_: Life Staff's heavy attacks restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> of your max mana when they pass through allies. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Can only be triggered once every {[0.500000]}s.)</font>
passive_lifestaff_healing_removeonheavy_: Heavy attacks now remove <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1 debuff</font> when passing through an ally.

passive_lifestaff_protection_hastewhenlo: When you get hit while below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}% haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cooldown {[20.000000]}s.)</font>
passive_lifestaff_protection_healingondo: After a dodge, your <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">outgoing healing</font> is <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> more effective for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
passive_lifestaff_protection_healingperb: If you have a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">buff</font>, all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">outgoing healing</font> is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_lifestaff_protection_manaonblock: When you block a melee attack, regain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> of your mana.
passive_sword_defender_armor_description: Grants an additional <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> physical armor.
passive_sword_defender_cdrwhileblock_des:
Grants a bonus based on what <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">shield type</font> is equipped:
	\n\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Round Shield</font> - Hitting a target will increase the duration of all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuffs</font> on them by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%. </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s Cooldown)</font>. 
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Kite Shield</font> - When you block with a shield, all sword and shield <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">cooldowns</font> are reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.010000 * -100]}%</font>.
	\n•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Tower Shield</font> - Being hit or blocking a hit will extend the duration of all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">buffs</font> on self by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s Cooldown)</font>.
passive_sword_defender_dmgonfinal_descri: The third attack in your light attack chain deals <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage, and if in heavy equip load, generates additional <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">threat</font>.
passive_sword_defender_elearmor_descript: Reduce base damage from all magical types by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_sword_defender_fortwhileblock_de: When you <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">block</font> an attack, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% fortify</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Fortify increases armor.)</font>
passive_sword_defender_healboost_descrip: All incoming <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">healing and regeneration</font> is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
passive_sword_defender_meleeblock_descri: Stamina damage is reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> when blocking a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">melee</font> attack with a shield.

phase1_isabella_bark_b: I am over here. Am I too quick for you?
phase1_isabella_bark_e: That you thought you could do anything to stop me…
phase1_isabella_bark_f: And they shall fall before the might of destiny!
phase1_isabella_bark_i: You cannot keep dodging me forever.
phase2_isabella_bark_a01: Oh no, it does not end like this. Corruption transmutes my past pain into power!
phase2_isabella_bark_a01_versionb: Corruption turns my pain into power!
phase2_isabella_bark_a02: Once more I remember you and live again, Ruiz!
phase2_isabella_bark_a02_versionb: I remember you and live again, Ruiz!
phase2_isabella_bark_b01: A pathetic resistance. Do you not see how outmatched you are? I am not alone!
phase2_isabella_bark_b01_versionb: You are outmatched; I am not alone!
phase2_isabella_bark_b02: All of you! Lend me your aid! Together we overcome this reprobate!
phase2_isabella_bark_b02_versionb: All of you! Lend me your aid!
phase3_isabella_bark01: And so the tide of Crimson rolled back, reared up, and crashed upon the unbelieving masses with the Water of Life.
phase3_isabella_bark01_versionb: And so the tide of Crimson crashed upon the unbelieving masses with the Water of Life.
phase3_isabella_bark02: "Drink of me freely!" she said. "I am of the divine humanity."
phase3_isabella_bark03: "Through me is the way to the city of peace; through me is the way to joy eternal; through me is the way to the found above."
phase3_isabella_bark03_alt: Witness the holy retribution of my sanctuary!
phase3_isabella_bark03_short: "Through me is the way to the city of peace; joy eternal; the found above."
phase3_isabella_bark04: "I was birthed by earthly power, human wisdom, and love inherent."
phase3_isabella_bark04_versionb: "I was birthed by earthly power, human wisdom, and freedom primordial."
phase3_isabella_bark05: "Before me no godly things were. Save those mortal, and mortal I abide."
phase3_isabella_bark06: "Abandon all despair, ye who enter here!"

quest_00000_description: This is the quest you get when you log in on seasonal server 2 at the WW starter beach.
quest_02789_description: While in Reekwater collect Damaged Heartgems, check out the new Soulwarden Armory, and discover what new dangers await the Soulwardens.
quest_02789_destinationcompletionavailab: Now that you've seen the Armory, the truth is that we can use it to reforge Soulmarks collected from the Fallen Soulwardens once their Heartgems are damaged.
It seems that Soulwardens with particularly robust Soulmarks are resilient enough to keep their Heartgems intact. For a time, at least.
quest_02789_inprogressresponse: Please gather some Damaged Heartgems, we must preserve them.
quest_02789_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I'm sorry to say that we've lost a number of Soulwardens in this infernal swamp. Now, I don't expect you to bring them back.
quest_02789_objectiveproposalresponse_1_: Not yet, not until we can cure them. We don't know how, but some Soulwardens had their Heartgems fracture from the strain of this place. That's how they fell.
Exactly. Help us recover the Damaged Heartgems from Sunken Aspect. There has to be a way to fix them, to stop this madness. We owe that much to our fallen brethren.
quest_02789_task_3_description: Talk to Soulwarden Wiltrud Bucheholz in Farharbor
quest_02789_task_3_description_0: Check out the new Soulwarden Armory
quest_02789_task_4_description: Discuss the situation in Reekwater with Wiltrud Bucheholz
quest_02789_task_5_description: Travel to {POITags} to collect a Damaged Heartgem
quest_02790_description: Travel to Skyview Repose to find out if the Ancient library at the site holds the key to repairing the Damaged Heartgems.
quest_02790_destinationcompletionavailab: It's amazing that you were able to get up into the library! Did you find anything we could use?
That's great! If we explore the locations listed on the map, we should find a way to fix the Damaged Heartgems in no time!
quest_02790_inprogressresponse: Meet with the Soulwardens at Skyview Repose to learn more about how to repair the Damaged Heartgems.
quest_02790_objectiveproposalresponse: That remains to be seen. We have some leads. There’s an Ancient library at Skyview Repose, it might provide us with information about how to repair them.
quest_02790_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I was hoping you'd be willing to aid us. Look for Soulwarden Asa Takahashi near Skyview Repose, she has been leading that effort and should know more.
quest_02790_task_1_description: Meet with Soulwarden Asa Takahashi near Skyview Repose
quest_02790_task_6_description: Find Soulwarden Darshan Sharma in Skyview Repose
quest_02791_description: Talk with the other Soulwardens in town, to discover what awaits in the wilds of Reekwater.
quest_02791_destinationcompletionavailab: What do you think? They've seen a lot here, and it weighs on some. But together we are stronger, and we'll get through this if we all help each other out.
And we'll need help from everyone, not just Soulwardens, to pull through this crisis. So make sure you talk with everyone, they all have insights we can use.
quest_02791_inprogressresponse: Together we can figure out how to save the other Soulwardens, I can feel it!
quest_02791_objectiveproposalresponse: Not yet, but I know several of our best minds are working on it. Oh! You haven't met everyone here, have you?
quest_02791_objectiveproposalresponse_1: You should introduce yourself to the other Soulwardens. You might be able to help them with their investigations around Reekwater!
quest_02791_task_1_description: Introduce yourself to Soulwarden Jane Hargreve
quest_02791_task_2_description: Introduce yourself to Soulwarden Kirksley Dunham
quest_02791_task_3_description: Reintroduce yourself to Soulwarden Darshan Sharma
quest_02792_description: The Siren Queen is placing devices around Reekwater to expand her influence. Destroy her banners to free the locals from her hold.
quest_02792_destinationcompletionavailab: You’re back! I was beginning to think you might've joined the Siren Queen's crew!
That’s a relief. There was something mighty unnatural about them. I can feel my Heartgem healing already.
quest_02792_inprogressresponse: You know I can’t help. Once the songs take hold I forgot who I was for a week. When I came to… Well, you don’t want to know.
quest_02792_objectiveoncooldownresponse: It won’t be long before the Siren Queen puts up more banners. She’s industrious like that.
quest_02792_objectiveproposalresponse: Yes. Thanks to you we know the songs come from the strange "banners" made by the Siren Queen. Those foul tangles of ancient relics and flotsam must be destroyed.
quest_02792_objectiveproposalresponse_2: The longer you listen to the songs, the more damage they inflict upon your Heartgem. We must destroy more banners to protect our Heartgems!
quest_02792_task_1_description: Destroy Cursed Banners wherever Pirates may be found
quest_02793_description: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants and destroy the Ancient Machine that boosts all her banners.
quest_02793_destinationcompletionavailab: Nice work taking her highness down! Reekwater feels almost peaceful without her songs wafting around.
quest_02793_inprogressresponse: You'd best go and stop the Siren Queen, without her songs, maybe I can get my customers back!
quest_02793_objectiveoncooldownresponse: You stopped her for now, but it's only a matter of time before the Siren Queen regains her strength and returns.
quest_02793_objectiveproposalresponse: You'd better believe it. It's amazing how fast she can convince people to rebuild her machines.
quest_02793_objectiveproposalresponse_1: You'll need to take on those barnacles she calls her 'crew' and break up that Ancient machine again.
quest_02794_description: Collect Crystalized Azoth Blossoms from the unique Azoth growths in Reekwater.
quest_02794_destinationcompletionavailab: Wonderful! You have the samples! Once these are analyzed, I'm certain we'll be close to a breakthrough!
quest_02794_inprogressresponse: The Crystalized Azoth Blossoms found in the caves are of superior quality, perfect for my research.
quest_02794_objectiveoncooldownresponse: I need time to analyze the last batch of samples you brought me. Come back later. When this analysis is done, I’ll need more to test.
quest_02794_objectiveproposalresponse: Aside from more time? More samples! I could use more Crystalized Azoth Blossoms from the caves. I have plenty of blight samples left over.
quest_02794_task_2_description: Travel to {POITags} to recover more Azoth Blossoms
quest_02795_description: Defeat the Protector of the Source to push back against the Angry Earth's expansion in the zone.
quest_02795_destinationcompletionavailab: There is a calmness in the waters. The rage infecting the land has subsided, for now.
quest_02795_inprogressresponse: The balance hangs on a slender leaf, ready to fall at the slightest breeze.
quest_02795_objectiveoncooldownresponse: The Protector of the Source is currently dormant. Soon enough they will bud forth, and you'll need to prune their expansion in Reekwater again.
quest_02795_objectiveproposalresponse: We understand the resonance caused by such devices disrupts many things. We do not understand why so many insist on tinkering with the Ancient devices.
quest_02795_objectiveproposalresponse_1: No matter the origin, the rage that infects the Protector of the Source must be cleansed. We hope you will agree to help once more.
quest_02795_task_3_description: Travel to {POITags} to fix the imbalance
quest_02796_description: Collect information from Sha Makogai to learn how Guardian Hearts were made.
quest_02796_destinationcompletionavailab: Too bad you didn't find a working Guardian Heartforge, but your efforts weren't in vain. You've recovered such valuable information!
I can't wait to study these Ancient Machina Schematics. This one looks like an automated vegetable peeler, but that can't be right.
quest_02796_inprogressresponse: If only we had instructions for how to restart a Guardian Heartforge.
quest_02796_objectiveproposalresponse: That’s exactly what I thought! So I said to myself, the only way we’re going to know if these Guardian Hearts are similar to Heartgems is by studying both.
quest_02796_objectiveproposalresponse_2: But first, we’ll need to learn more about Ancient machinery. The map you recovered revealed several promising sites. I think we should start with those ruins.
quest_02796_task_3_description: Travel to {POITags} to find the Guardian Heartforge
quest_02797_description: Use the Mysterious Altar to cleanse a Damaged Heartgem.
quest_02797_destinationcompletionavailab: I can't thank you enough for traveling to the Mysterious Altar again.
This is better than I could have dreamed! We have Cleansed Heartgems! There's hope yet for our fallen companions.
quest_02797_inprogressresponse: If you help me out by placing the Heartgems on the Mysterious Altar, I'll make it worth your while, I promise.
quest_02797_objectiveoncooldownresponse: Give the altar some time to recharge, then another Damaged Heartgem can be cleansed.
quest_02797_objectiveproposalresponse: No, I've learned my lesson. But I do have something I'd like you to try. I have heard that the altar can cleanse Damaged Heartgems.
quest_02797_objectiveproposalresponse_1: It's not a rumor if it's true. I'd like you to take a Damaged Heartgem and place it on the Mysterious Altar. Then report back what happens.
quest_02797_task_1_description: Travel to {POITags} to use the Mysterious Altar
quest_02797_task_2_description: Survive the attack after placing the Damaged Heartgem on the Mysterious Altar
quest_02798_description: Remove the dangerous beasts from their dens and restore the natural balance in Reekwater.
quest_02798_destinationcompletionavailab: Nice work. Tomorrow they may be back, but today we can rest easy knowing they are gone.
quest_02798_inprogressresponse: Don’t drop your guard. Those beasts aren’t so easy to displace, now that they've moved in.
quest_02798_objectiveoncooldownresponse: Those dens have been cleared out for now. But tomorrow I’m sure a new host of beasts will return to terrorize them.
quest_02798_objectiveproposalresponse: Indeed, our work never ends. I need you to go out to the dens and defeat the monstrous beasts that reside inside them.
quest_02798_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Make sure you keep your wits about you. If there’s one thing these swamps do well, it’s hide what lurks out there.
quest_02798_task_1_description_0: Defeat one of these three lions:

quest_02799_description: Recover Soulmarks from helping out around Reekwater, to forge a better future for Reekwater, and the Soulwardens.
quest_02799_destinationcompletionavailab: Fantastic work. The Soulwardens are improving every day, and it's all due to your help.
quest_02799_inprogressresponse: Every little bit helps. Recover Soulmarks while exploring Reekwater.
quest_02799_objectiveoncooldownresponse: You've earned a well-deserved rest. There will always be more to collect in the future.
quest_02799_objectiveproposalresponse: Excellent! We could use more like yourself around Reekwater. If more people were willing to help, everyone would be better off.
quest_02799_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Return to me after you've collected more Soulmarks from helping the other Soulwardens, and I'll see you are rewarded for your hard work.
quest_02800_description: Collect hearts from the Guardians, to study for clues to whatever heinous magic the Ancients employed to make the Guardians.
quest_02801_description: Collect the Guardian's Eye from Chardis and stop Chardis from creating any new eyes.
quest_02801_destinationcompletionavailab: You did it! My friend, you have saved us all! Now I shall destroy this.
quest_02801_inprogressresponse: Don’t forget to go for the eye! It needs to be destroyed!
quest_02801_objectiveoncooldownresponse: Chardis has been stopped for now. But we must always be vigilant in case it tries to craft more eyes again.
quest_02801_objectiveproposalresponse: It’s because Chardis is awake! Once, the Ancient Guardian had many eyes, now it has only one. It’s activated all the devices in order to fabricate new eyes!
quest_02801_objectiveproposalresponse_1: We can’t let that happen! If Chardis is able to create more eyes… I shudder to think what would happen to the rest of us.
quest_02801_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Good. Better you than me. You'll need to remove the one eye it has.
quest_02801_objectiveproposalresponse_3: When the eye's removed, it will slow Chardis down from returning to full power. We must prevent Chardis from gaining more power at all costs.
quest_02802_description: Time to clean up the swamp! Join in the Soulwarden training rituals by participating in sieges around Reekwater. Participate in multiple sieges each week to get rewards!
quest_02802_destinationcompletionavailab: It's impressive how you don't let this place bring you down. Instead, you meet every challenge head on. Reekwater is a better place because of you!
quest_02802_inprogressresponse: Did you sign up for a siege? You won't regret it!
quest_02802_objectiveoncooldownresponse: You're an inspiration to Soulwardens everywhere! Don’t forget to check back later to help us with more sieges!
quest_02802_objectiveproposalresponse: We call them sieges, where we band together to take the fight to our enemies! You won’t be disappointed! It will keep your Heartgem strong and it helps Soulwardens learn to fight as a team.

quest_18001_description: Remove the dangerous beasts from their dens and restore the natural balance in Reekwater.
quest_18001_destinationcompletionavailab: I knew you were up for the task. It's good to know those creatures have been cleared out.
quest_18001_inprogressresponse: If there’s one thing these swamps do best, it’s hide what’s out there. Make sure you keep your wits about you.
quest_18001_objectiveproposalresponse: I knew it. Survivors always have that look about them. Like they know things can go sideways at any moment, and are prepared for it.
quest_18001_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I could use someone like you. Thanks to the rage of the Protector of the Source, all the smaller creatures have been scared off.
quest_18001_objectiveproposalresponse_2: I don’t expect you to. But you can help remove the powerful beasts that moved into their dens, destroying the natural balance in the area.
quest_18001_objectiveproposalresponse_3: I need you to go out to the dens and defeat the monstrous beasts that now reside inside them.
quest_18001_playerprompt: "I’ve been through a thing or two."

quest_18002_description: Defeat the Protector of the Source to push back against the Angry Earth's expansion in the zone.
quest_18002_destinationcompletionavailab: You have done well; we can feel the balance returning. We must discover what is causing the Protector of the Source to no longer listen to calmer minds.
quest_18002_inprogressresponse: The rage that infects the Protector of the Source must be cleansed.
quest_18002_objectiveproposalresponse: The Protector of the Source has been acting outside of their mandate, refusing to listen to the rest of us.
quest_18002_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Their unnatural aggression has been influencing all life in Reekwater, leeching into the waters of the Eternal Pool.
quest_18002_objectiveproposalresponse_2: We agree. Prune the Protector of the Source and return their essence to the waters of the Eternal Pool. This will restore the balance in Reekwater.
quest_18002_task_1_description: Travel to {POITags} to fix the imbalance
quest_18003_description: Collect Blight Ooze and Crystalized Azoth Blossoms from the unique Azoth growths in Reekwater for Soulwarden Lorenzo to study.
quest_18003_destinationcompletionavailab: Wonderful! You have the samples I requested! I cannot wait to see what secrets I can unlock from these!
quest_18003_inprogressresponse: The sooner you get those samples, the sooner I can move on to the next phase of the experiment!
quest_18003_objectiveproposalresponse: I don’t know yet, but this must be significant. My work is at such a delicate stage that I cannot leave to collect fresh samples myself.
quest_18003_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Ah yes! What I need is some Blight Ooze and Crystalized Azoth Blossoms from the unique growths spawned near Azoth pools. That should help my studies immensely!
quest_18003_task_1_description: Travel to {POITags} to collect Blight Ooze
quest_18003_task_3_description: Travel to {POITags} to collect Azoth Blossoms
quest_18004_description: Destroy the source of the music plaguing the Soulwardens in Reekwater.
quest_18004_destinationcompletionavailab: Do you know what is causing the music? I can feel it fracturing my Heartgem, a sliver at a time with each unnatural chord.
Those banners? The ones the Siren Queen put up? Could the resonance from them be damaging our Heartgems?
quest_18004_inprogressresponse: You have to make the music stop. The songs… I can't think... I can't focus.
quest_18004_objectiveproposalresponse: Well, I keep hearing music. It wouldn't be so bad, except, I don't remember how I got here. All I know is that I heard a song, and here I am, deep in the swamp.
quest_18004_objectiveproposalresponse_1: You have to help me. Could you find out what is making the music? And make it stop? I can't go another day where I don't remember what I did.
quest_18004_task_1_description: Travel to {POITags} to discover the source of the music
quest_18005_description: Study the Ancient Machina Schematics, then find and activate the Guardian Heartforge to gain a fresh Guardian Heart.
quest_18005_destinationcompletionavailab: You did it! A Guardian Heart! I’m impressed. I thought at best we’d find some old broken one, not one freshly minted.
quest_18005_inprogressresponse: We need more information about Guardian Hearts in order to compare them to Heartgems.
quest_18005_objectiveoncooldownresponse: I’m going to take this Guardian Heart apart! I’ll probably need another one of these later, if I destroy this one.
quest_18005_objectiveproposalresponse: It does sound too convenient, but I can't ignore it. If true, just think of how it will help our cause! We just need a few more schematics on how to use it.
quest_18005_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I’d like a heart too, if we can find one. I can’t imagine one is just lying around. But maybe, if we restarted the Guardian Heartforge, we could make one!

quest_18006_description: Help Soulwarden Kirksley discover the location of the Mysterious Altar, which supposedly can help mend Damaged Heartgems.
quest_18006_destinationcompletionavailab: The altar exists? Amazing! I never thought it was real. Ah, that is to say, I was sure you’d find it, if it did exist. And it does! So it all worked out!
quest_18006_inprogressresponse: I know the altar is somewhere. It's just a matter of finding exactly where.
quest_18006_objectiveproposalresponse: I know, I know, it doesn’t sound real. But it must exist! I'm calling it the Mysterious Altar, though admittedly I don’t know exactly where it is.
quest_18006_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Honestly, not a lot - the only lead I have is from Glimmerfen. I’d know more if you were able to find this Mysterious Altar. Once we have it's location, we can learn more about it's abilities.

quest_18007_description: Hunt down the Siren Queen's lieutenants and destroy the Ancient Machine that boosts all her banners.
quest_18007_destinationcompletionavailab: Nice work taking her Highness down! Reekwater feels almost peaceful without her songs wafting around.
quest_18007_inprogressresponse: Go on, off with you. You’ve things to do, I’ve things to do, and standing around won’t make any of them happen faster.
quest_18007_objectiveproposalresponse: She’s got some kind of machine that amplifies her songs. Those bilge rats she calls her 'crew' have been tinkering around with some Ancient devices.
quest_18007_objectiveproposalresponse_1: That's what I like to hear! You'll need to stop her crew, then deal with that wretched machine.
quest_18008_description: Meet up with Morgaine at Gorgon's Landing to learn about her recent adventures.
quest_18008_objectiveproposalresponse: She says they can figure out more by investigating the place where it was originally taken from, the destroyed caravan.

quest_18009_description: Follow Morgaine to Nighthaven to search for the missing Tear of Gaea.
quest_18009_destinationcompletionavailab: I'm impressed we survived the crossing, those waves did me no favors. It's not easy to get to Nighthaven. The people who live here value their privacy.
quest_18009_inprogressresponse: You aren't waiting for me to row us over, are you? Get to the boat, we're going to Nighthaven!
quest_18009_objectiveproposalresponse: In Nighthaven. After you helped procure the Tear from Adiana, or should I say Artemis, my plan was to take it somewhere safe. A place from long ago.
quest_18009_objectiveproposalresponse_1: There's an archive in Nighthaven where it could be kept away from pickpockets and prying eyes. But on my way there, it was stolen! I must get it back.
quest_18009_playerprompt: "When did you last have the Tear?"
quest_18009_task_1_description: Travel to Nighthaven to help Morgaine search for the Tear of Gaea
quest_18009_task_2_description_0: Take a boat over to Nighthaven

quest_18010_description: Help Morgaine look for the Tear of Gaia by speaking with the locals. Aid the locals and protect them from the Berlaur.
quest_18010_destinationcompletionavailab: We are fortunate to have crossed your path! The town surely would have fallen without your aid.
quest_18010_inprogressresponse: Oh, my head. I'm not in the mood for talking to people, you'll have to ask any questions about the Tear.
quest_18010_objectiveproposalresponse: No, it must have been the journey here. Merely a touch of seasickness, nothing you should worry about.
quest_18010_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Instead of me, focus on recovering the Tear of Gaea! You should ask some of the townsfolk about it. They must have seen something.

quest_18011_inprogressresponse: Believe me, if I tried to get the townsfolk to return, they'd just flee farther away.
quest_18011_objectiveproposalresponse: Yes. I didn't travel here alone. My master is in the woods, leading the search for anyone missing.

quest_18012_inprogressresponse: You must restore power to the shield. Be on your way, now. Time is of the essence.

quest_18013_description: Alecksi offers an invitiation to learn more about the Tear of Gaea at his home, but first Morgaine needs a way to get across the river, now that the bridge is out.
quest_18013_destinationcompletionavailab: Welcome to our humble camp! It is our pleasure to share it with you. After all, if it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have such a bounty to share amongst ourselves!
quest_18013_inprogressresponse: With the bridge in shambles, we will need to find another path to the mainland.
quest_18013_objectiveproposalresponse: I have yet to find out, but only fools rush to battle when caution is the better play. Clearly those beasts had a plan. We must develop our own.
quest_18013_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Let's adjourn to my castle. Once there, we will have all resources at our disposal. A shame the Berlaur were so clever, destroying the bridge to delay our pursuit.
quest_18013_objectiveproposalresponse_1_: Indeed we do. Before we search for the Tear of Gaea, we will need a way back to the mainland. There must be some path that remains…
quest_18013_objectiveproposalresponse_2: This is where we part, as it will be faster for each of us to find our own way across. I shall meet you at the castle gates. Good hunting.
quest_18013_objectiveproposalresponse_2_: Lynette and I shall search east. Let us reconvene later at my castle to discuss the Tear of Gaea and make our plans.

quest_18014_description: Learn how to use Fool's Sight to see through the deceptive magics that permeate Nighthaven.
quest_18014_destinationcompletionavailab: I knew there was something special about you! This new ability you have, Fool's Sight, has a variety of uses, as you'll come to discover.
quest_18014_inprogressresponse: Go, talk to the Fortune Mother. She has the wisdom you seek.
quest_18014_objectiveproposalresponse: It is one thing to be careful, but it is another thing entirely to see that which is hidden before you.
quest_18014_objectiveproposalresponse_1: But you wish for a cure, not my rambling. The best person to speak to would be the Fortune Mother, for if anyone can recognize Morgaine's symptoms, it would be her.
quest_18014_objectiveproposalresponse_1_: You should speak with the Fortune Mother. She wishes to give you a gift, so that your eyes see the truth hidden in the shadows of this land.

quest_18015_description: After discovering the mysteries of the Fool Card, gather materials nearby to craft a potion of Arcana Attunement to harness the cards chaotic magics.
quest_18015_destinationcompletionavailab: Now that you have forged a connection with one of the Arcana, your Fool's Sight is strong enough to allow you to enter the sealed towers.
quest_18015_inprogressresponse: You are a good friend to Morgaine. She needs that, more than she knows.
quest_18015_objectiveproposalresponse: You'll be able to use your new ability to open doors, unlock new paths, or even challenge mighty foes. It changes how you move through the world.
quest_18015_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Speaking of potions, you found your first Arcana card! To fully harness their power, you'll need to craft a potion of Arcana Attunement.
quest_18015_objectiveproposalresponse_2_: You already have the silver, next you'll need Blue Vervain Buds. Collect them and meet me at the abandoned town up ahead. There I’ll teach you the recipe.

quest_18016_destinationcompletionavailab: Bah! I can't believe you wasted such time on these minor folk magics. There are more urgent matters at hand. We must find Asena and reclaim the Tear of Gaea!
quest_18016_inprogressresponse: The time has come to test your proficiency with the Fool's Sight. Good luck, my friend!
quest_18016_objectiveproposalresponse: There's a sealed tower across the stream you can use to test the strength of your new abilities. You'll need to understand them to face what lies ahead.
quest_18016_objectiveproposalresponse_1: With your new connections to the Arcana, you should be able to break the guardian seals around the tower and defeat the champion inside.
quest_18016_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Gather the Ethereal Essence from the chest at the top of the tower and bring it back. This will be a worthy test to prove your mastery of the Arcana.

quest_18019_objectiveproposalresponse: Yes. Alecksi the Warrior King is my father. But enough about him. We need to figure out why Morgaine was after the Tear of Gaea.

quest_18023_inprogressresponse: Go! You must make it to the Grand Carnival before my father realizes what we have done.

quest_18023_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Then you should go, quickly, before the Upyr realize that Morgaine has slipped their grasp. Use one of the carriages from Carmilla -- you can travel safely that way.

quest_18025_inprogressresponse: We must reach Lilith before my father!

quest_18026_description: Now that the Warrior King Alecksi has been deposed, discuss the future of Nighthaven with the new ruler, Cecilia.
quest_18026_destinationcompletionavailab: With my father gone, I am heir to the throne. My father ruled the night, and my mother, light. I will bring the best of them both and usher in a new dawn for Nighthaven.
It is... yes. The loss of the Tear does not bode well, and I'm not sure if anyone knows what that means for Nighthaven. For all of Aeternum, really.
"But the Tear of Gaea is gone…"
I do not know what the future holds, but you have given me the courage to embark on this journey. I am forever in your debt. Thank you, Soulwarden.
quest_18026_inprogressresponse: I must think on what I will do next. Go on ahead. I will meet you in the chapel.
quest_18026_objectiveproposalresponse: Yes. The Tear is where it should be, out of reach -- and out of danger. I will do the same with the Amulet of Ninsun. May it never fall into the wrong hands.
quest_18026_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I will lock this chamber so none can enter here again. Meet me back in my mother's chapel -- the place where we first met.

quest_18029_objectiveproposalresponse: I require four heirlooms to reverse Morgaine's condition. The Lightshield Crusade once held them in their possession. How I miss them; they were a beacon of light in dark times.
quest_18029_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I have no love for the cruel Inquisitors that inhabit the old Lightshield fortresses. Take from them what you must -- in order to save your friend.
quest_18029_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Search the old fortresses for the heirlooms we require, but do not forget: you have the Fool's Sight! Trust it to guide your path.

Morgaine was selected by Alecksi for a reason. She is strong in Mind and Spirit, and there is no questioning her determination. I suspect she will pull through.
I would caution against that. She is being hunted by the Upyr now, and it is best if she remains alone. She will seek you out when she is ready.
quest_18030_inprogressresponse: We must move fast if we are to save Morgaine.

quest_18031_destinationcompletionavailab: That ambush was an act of desperation. Just like with Morgaine, he seeks to delay us. But no more. We will put an end to his plan.
quest_18031_inprogressresponse: We'll meet again at the Archive. Good luck crossing the bridge.
quest_18031_objectiveproposalresponse: Then there is hope yet. The Keystone is the way into the Archive. I doubt my father ever thought we'd be tenacious enough to find it.
quest_18031_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I seem to remember something from my mother's journal about a special artifact in the Archive. I'll search for the page, then meet you on the other side of the bridge.

quest_18033_destinationcompletionavailab: You found them! Unngh. This one looks as if it's been… chewed on? In any case, thank you so much for your help. I can't wait to hang these back up in the window.
quest_18033_inprogressresponse: Who knows when the Berlaur will return to finish the job? Please, how can we protect ourselves without garlic?
quest_18033_objectiveproposalresponse: Well, our protective talismans went missing in the siege! Those talismans are made from a special black garlic that wards off evil.
quest_18033_objectiveproposalresponse_1: What's that look? Of course they work! How could hundreds of years of tradition be wrong?

quest_18034_description: Chef de Cuisine Anthanasius Peseme has run out of hors d'oeuvres for the party. He requires rat tongues to make more dishes to fill out the tables, or his head will be the one to roll.
quest_18034_destinationcompletionavailab: Splendid! Everything is on the tables, and I get to keep my head for another day. Truly, you are a lifesaver!
quest_18034_inprogressresponse: Those rats aren't going to lose their tongues on their own!
quest_18034_objectiveproposalresponse: Ah, so you are! Marvelous! Simply marvelous. I was wondering, since you are already going into such a place, would you be willing to collect something for me?
quest_18034_objectiveproposalresponse_1: We don’t have enough hors d'oeuvres for the party, and if there isn't something on the tables, the nobles will be so displeased. Not that they’d eat them.
quest_18034_objectiveproposalresponse_2: They aren't picky, it just has to look like something someone would eat. Which is why I require plump rat tongues for my masterpiece.

quest_20003_description: Help Mihail avenge his fallen friends by defeating enthralled upyr and freeing afflicted servants from the machinations of Lord Bathory.
quest_20003_destinationcompletionavailab: You seem composed. Perhaps with some small satisfaction?
Strangely, I believe you. I hope you were able to save a few of us.
Indeed. Take my gratitude and a small token of my appreciation. We may not mean much to our lords, but we servants shall never forget your deeds.
quest_20003_inprogressresponse: If you have not seen the horrors within, I beg you: keep going.
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse: They do not yet know it, but I have fallen out of the thrall of our liegelord. The things I have seen... I would run, if there were not so many others I would leave behind.
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse_1: On a whim the Upyr possess the ability to weaponize our minds against us and force us to do their bidding.
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse_1_: "What do you mean by 'out of thrall'?"
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse_2: I cannot run inside without risking my sanity once more, but you... I do not know why, but you seem to possess a special fortitude. Will you enter and rescue my fellows in bondage?
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse_3: Thank you. I will wait here. You may be attacked... just know that none of us will take umbrage with you defending yourself.
quest_20003_objectiveproposalresponse_3_: "I will see what I can do."
quest_20004_description: Enter the Hall of the South King and acquire ethically sourced treasure for Prospero.
quest_20004_destinationcompletionavailab: The suspense is killing me! So much of value in those ruins. It would be a shame for it all to go to waste…
What an odd thing to say. Museums would drool over the honor of signing a contract with a private collector in order to display these priceless antiques for all to see!
"I'm not entirely sure this is for research…"
Well, coin does make future expeditions possible. It all feeds into itself.
And you shall be justly compensated! Thank you for contributing to our ever expanding horde of ancient— uh, knowledge…
quest_20004_inprogressresponse: Did you find my stol— I mean, those precious artifacts I mentioned? I'm afraid I have nothing to offer you without them.
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse: You see, I am an antiquarian of sorts. I specialize in the responsible reclamation of items of intellectual interest from ancient ruins.
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Well, I simply ensure that no harm comes to the ruins in the process of liberating artifacts for preservation and educational purposes. It's really an important job!
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_2: I also make sure to tread lightly around the remaining ah... denizens... who may not be keen on visitors.
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_3: Well, I need you to venture into the so-named Hall of the South King and recover some artifacts I neglected to carry with me on my last expedition.
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_3_: "So what do you need me for?"
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_5: Scary skeletons! Could you do me a favor and help them find eternal rest while you are in there? They seemed pretty tired!
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_6: Why it's the MOST respectful action to take. For myself and future antiquarians. And the denizens. Them first, naturally.
quest_20004_objectiveproposalresponse_7: Now, don't you worry about me. I'll be safe right here where there are no scary skeletons -- I assure you. Just focus on recovering those relics of moderate monetary value and everything will be fine!
quest_20004_task_1_description: Venture to the Hall of the South King
quest_28001_description: Whispers of Corruption emanate from the depths of the catacombs. Is this a new, rising horror in Nighthaven? Or an old adversary stirring in darkling resurrection?
quest_28001_destinationcompletionavailab: Now have you seen the fiends that bound me to these accursed halls. Those wretched betrayers that sacrificed my life to ascend into powers foul and unnatural!
You did not. Be assuaged of these fears. I have kept them in stasis for years uncounted, but my own power was waning... as you can see from that sundered wall. One day, they would have escaped.
And you are a Soulwarden! You are the hope for which I prayed! Now is there a chance to destroy the Seraphim utterly and not simply entomb them with myself.
Indeed. But I fear this struggle will pit you against most fearsome odds. Take heart! For I shall be your steadfast ally in this our shared purpose.
quest_28001_inprogressresponse: [The Angel Statue is as silent and inevitable as the grave.]
quest_28001_objectiveproposalresponse: Then seek salvation alone, lest all freedom be taken from you as it was from me.
