quest_28002_description: The Lightshield Crusader believes the Seraphim can be imprisoned by discovering the last trace of their physical remains. Now the First Seraph must be sought out, and destroyed.
quest_28002_destinationcompletionavailab: You are victorious! These are wondrous tidings. I did worry for your life, but chose to have faith - and now my faith is thus rewarded.
quest_28002_inprogressresponse: Though I cannot say how long it has truly been since the sacrifice, Corruption will have preserved that loathsome eyeball. You can be assured of that grievous fact...
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse: No, indeed, we did not. We became the Inquisition! That is a sordid tale, and the burden falls heavy upon my shoulders to be the sole remaining voice to tell it.
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_1: But if you can defeat all four Seraphim, that would be comfort enough. Each sacrificed an aspect of self, and by gathering that and the correct reagent we can imprison and subdue them.
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_2: The Blind Seraph sacrificed his eye at Ashfall Watch, as I watched helplessly from far below. A fitting reagent would be from Silkfoot Crag, something so gossamer that it is nearly invisible.
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_3: When your preparations are complete, meet me at Monastery Isle to the south. There will we confer upon the summoning.
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_4: No… no. It is too late for that. I am trapped, as your eyes well see, between death and life. The promise of resurrection is denied to me, so this may very well be my eternal fate.
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_6: Those four interred with the Reliquary were the Seraphim. Our former illustrious leaders, brought as low as to the abyssal depths by their dalliance with Corruption. We must destroy them!
quest_28002_objectiveproposalresponse_6_: "Who is it you've kept with you?"

quest_28003_description: With the First Seraph finally destroyed, the rest must also be slain. The Lightshield Crusader gives the task of continuing the grisly, but necessary, work.
quest_28003_destinationcompletionavailab: So, it is done. I fear the thrill of the defeat of the First Seraph possessed my heart. But now, all I can feel is the grief of what has been. And what has been lost.
How strange that I should feel such pain in my chest, yet my heart has not beaten for centuries. Perhaps I should be grateful for this pang that proves my conscience.
quest_28003_inprogressresponse: I look forward to our gains in this dreadful undertaking. And yet my heart weeps for my brethren who have chosen this most wicked path.
quest_28003_objectiveproposalresponse: Very good. I recall that the commander of our vanguard was once stationed at Biteback Bivouac. From there did he spew his most hateful rhetoric, and many listened.
quest_28003_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I thought that if I stayed by his side I might temper his most ardent zealotry. Alas, all I profited was an intimate view of the degeneration of our Order and hastened my own undoing.
quest_28003_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Indeed, it will. Collecting the blood of ghouls will be your task. A fitting liquid to gather from a monster as rabid as the Second Seraph himself.
quest_28003_objectiveproposalresponse_3: How fervently I believed I could sway him! It feels so insidious to be planning his demise now. Even after being destroyed myself, I cannot help wishing he could, instead, be saved.

quest_28004_description: A toll is being inflicted on the Lightshield Crusader from the destruction of the Seraphim. He is losing his connection to life and urges haste before he loses himself completely.
quest_28004_destinationcompletionavailab: You managed to uncover the information needed on your own? And the materials too? Well done!
quest_28004_inprogressresponse: At our height, our Order was one of action. But even then, I recall there was much waiting. It was a time of reflection, and prayer. I fear there are no hymns in my heart here.
quest_28004_objectiveproposalresponse: I am, my friend. I can barely perceive you. With each victory, a little piece of myself dissolves away into... nothingness? I know naught, but I feel diminished.
quest_28004_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I can see... blackness, all around. A great and awesome void. And at times I do, I think, spy the edges of this grand antechamber. Other times I can see you... dimming, yet a brilliant azure flame.
quest_28004_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Yes, the shoreline with an uncertain tide. Stars above that are not, I believe, entirely our own. I stopped seeing these things... I could not say when. If I could let go... would I resurrect anymore, or...?
quest_28004_objectiveproposalresponse_3: While the last two Seraphim persist, that would be impossible. And now the tragedy in which we are bound deepens: I cannot remember anything of our Order's historian, the Third Seraph.
quest_28004_objectiveproposalresponse_4: Ah! Perhaps! We once inhabited those hallowed halls in greener days, and some sign of our passing may yet linger. I cannot speak for certain, but I do implore you to seek and find what you will.

quest_28005_description: The final and most powerful Seraph is all that remains, but the whispers of Corruption are now crescendoing into an unfathomable and overwhelming force.
quest_28005_destinationcompletionavailab: Can it finally be over? My tormenters, my betrayers, gone forever? Merciful heavens, it is done. It is done! Praise be!
quest_28005_inprogressresponse: Steel yourself! This will be a most fearsome fight indeed. And with his fellows so struck down, the fury of the Final Seraph will descend on you alone in full force.
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse: Am I not bereft of such a hope? In this labor of ours, I can scarcely fathom what may be in store for me. It may well be as you say.
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I confess that I had chosen to do so. It felt easier to accept oblivion if I did not mentally languish against its embrace. But you speak properly. I must endure!
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Algarot Hall! Our pernicious leader tore out his fell heart atop its spires. There, seek you the destruction of the Final Seraph!
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_3: Even in my faltering memories, that image is burned into the back of my eyes! The gall! The blasphemous arrogance of accepting the poisoned fruits of Corruption's many temptations!
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_4: I tell you: I defied him then, and I defied the Inquisition until my last breath! Dragging me from the Monastery to the Catacombs... oh, how I cursed them.
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_4_: "It seems he gave into its power."
quest_28005_objectiveproposalresponse_5: But I forget myself in my passions. If you can gather holy salts at that same place, we can end this horror. I leave the rest to you.

quest_28006_description: With the Seraphim now defeated, it is time to save the Lightshield Crusader from his uncertain fate and purge the reliquary of Corruption.
quest_28006_destinationcompletionavailab: [The silence deepens, as if it is slowly turning to stone. There is a final whisper of unseen movement as the offering settles into place. Then that too is gone forever, and you are alone.]
quest_28006_inprogressresponse: Go then. Walk the path of the past, in our long-forgotten footsteps, and learn from it what you may. I will meet you on the other side, and we will purge Corruption from the Reliquary.
quest_28006_objectiveproposalresponse: You shall be absolved of this presently. Know that once the Inquisition was as holy as its ultimate aim, until our lack of self-doubt became our undoing.
quest_28006_objectiveproposalresponse_1: As the final sacrifice, I was bound to both the Monastery and the Catacombs. This means the energies of the ritual, while now dormant, can be manipulated still.
quest_28006_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Loathe though I am to agree, that is correct. If you follow in their footsteps, you can use a ritual to open the channels of Azoth wide - like bloodletting an old wound.
quest_28006_objectiveproposalresponse_3: Take the pilgrimage north through the land of the dead, lighting the Seraphic Torches along your way. This will awaken Corruption, allowing you the opportunity to purge the Reliquary and yourself.
quest_28006_objectiveproposalresponse_3_: "If that is what I must do."

quest_28008_description: Help the creepy doll regain its acceptance among the Grand Carnival and return to its true home.
quest_28008_destinationcompletionavailab: Is the truce established once more? Will my friends accept me again? Tell me the treaty is recovered and my long suffering is over.
You found a strangeness? I cannot see it. You are so far away and my eyes are so very, very small.
Oh. That. The Not-so-Grand Carnival used this catalyst to bind me here and sever their sight of me, since destroying me is impossible.
I didn't want to kill them, but they needed to die. They took so very, very long.
quest_28008_inprogressresponse: I am so small and helpless. I miss my friends and my home.
quest_28008_objectiveproposalresponse: I am in such distress. The inhabitants of the Grand Carnival shun me for a crime I did not commit. Once upon a time, the Fortune Mother warred against the bunnies.
quest_28008_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Rabbit King was her sworn enemy. But I brokered a truce at much risk to myself. Then, one night in secret, someone destroyed the symbol of that treaty. And I was punished.
quest_28008_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Perhaps you can seek out evidence of treason and exonerate me. You will go? Thank you! On your journey, you won't hear from me, but you will see from me.
quest_28008_objectiveproposalresponse_3: Shhhhh! It will be OUR SECRET.

quest_28008_task_43_description: Did you restore the treaty? I will SEND YOU A SMILE
quest_28009_description: The overworked graverobber is asking for help, and potentially seeking a partner-in-victimless-crimes.
quest_28009_destinationcompletionavailab: Is it done? Tell me how it went! Were they very nice graves? Are they eager for my return? Are any of them, like, you know, seeing any... other... gravediggers?
Ohh how I envy you. You've taken the first of many steps into the wonderful world of victimless cri-- ADVENTURE.
"Found fancy coins and all that dirt."
Let me see... Oh. OH! Are these...? they ARE! The Builder King's Secret Catacombs. The graves would never divulge these to me, but they told you? JEALOUSY.
"Thanks. Is this map useful to you?"
Keep your shovel. Mine is better. And I will... hmmm, need to burrow through a couple hills to get where this is pointing-- WAIT. Which side is NORTH?
quest_28009_inprogressresponse: I admit the remaining spoils will be paltry. But you're welcome to anything I missed in my delirium.
quest_28009_objectiveproposalresponse: That's what the graves want me to do. But I see their game. Oh ho ho, ohhhh how I see their game. In the past they tried to snub me. Ever been to Brightwood?
quest_28009_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Those are some cold-shoulder graves. Never acknowledged me... But in this region -- and this is embarrassing -- the graves actually leave ME flowers. So romantic!
quest_28009_objectiveproposalresponse_2: Listen. I'm about all finished up here and moving on. You look like a person who does not know the undiluted joy of desecra-- DIGGING. And the profit of Gravedirt.
quest_28009_objectiveproposalresponse_2_: "I don't think those are for you…"
quest_28009_objectiveproposalresponse_3: No! It's not dirt, it's Dirt! Nighthaven is steaming with that luscious loam. You'll find it very useful for alchemy. Keep any. My pockets are already full to bursting.
quest_28009_task_10_description: Dig up as much Gravedirt as your pockets can carry

quest_42000_description: Eliza Ellingwood, a strange and cryptic historian, has asked me to help look for soul trapped within special statues thoughout Nighthaven. She says that doing so will help 'restore the lost one,' but even she doesn't seem to know exactly what she means.
quest_42000_destinationcompletionavailab: Oh... you've... you've found some! That is fantastic! I can... feel them.
A pull... a voice? It's not important right now. But you've earned a reward for your help. Thank you for finding these!
quest_42000_inprogressresponse: The statues are spread all over Nighthaven. I wish I had better directions, but that's all I know.
quest_42000_objectiveproposalresponse: I... think so, yes. Yes. You can help where no one else can, find what no one else can find. We've waited for someone with your ability for so long.
quest_42000_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I'm sorry... I mean me, Eliza Ellingwood - I'VE waited for so long for help. Have you seen the strange statues? The ones holding blue torches?
quest_42000_objectiveproposalresponse_2: They aren't just statues. They hold... something. A piece of something, like a soul. That flame is the power of the soul, waiting to be reunited.
quest_42000_objectiveproposalresponse_3: With... something. I'm sorry, my thoughts are... fuzzy. Can you collect some of the soul fragments and bring them here? I might understand more if you do.
quest_42000_objectiveproposalresponse_4: Anywhere? Everywhere. I'm sorry, but you'll have to search high and low. Like much of Nighthaven, I think they're meant to stay hidden.
quest_42001_description: Eliza has asked me to continue to collect more of the soul fragments. As before, she cannot specifiy where they all are, only that they are spread throughout Nighthaven.
quest_42001_destinationcompletionavailab: Soulwarden! I knew you were coming back! You've found more, haven't you?
It's as I thought - someone does not want these found. But we knew you'd be able to see through the shadow, seeing what you've accomplished here already.
quest_42001_inprogressresponse: The statues are spread all over Nighthaven. I wish I had better directions, but that's all I know.
quest_42001_objectiveproposalresponse: I... yes. If you would lend your help again. I can hear... a voice. Something that was silent is growing louder.
quest_42001_objectiveproposalresponse_1: ...yes? I don't know. I think so. I don't hear malice in the whisper, but without more fragments I can't be sure.
quest_42001_objectiveproposalresponse_2: More like... feeling it. I know, it's a bit difficult to explain, let alone understand. Please, find more fragments, and maybe I can figure out what's going on.
quest_42001_objectiveproposalresponse_2_: "So you're hearing a voice in your head?"
quest_42002_description: Eliza says the voice is becoming more clear as I collect more of the fragments, and has asked that I continue to do so. She says I should contuinue to look in the hidden places around Nighthaven for more of the statues.
quest_42002_destinationcompletionavailab: You... Soulwarden. You are the one who collected my soul fragments, are you not?
I remember little. I know that I am in Durevos, and that I once called this place home, but my memory is fragmented, much like my soul was.
Nighthaven? How long has it been since... no matter. I have much to relearn since I... passed. But you should be rewarded for helping me.
Eliza... yes. She was my voice when I had none to use. I have released her, and her mind is once more her own. For now, farewell to you, Soulwarden. Perhaps we will speak again one day.
The chamber behind me carries treasures of old. I have no further use of them, although I feel they will aid you in your journeys. The chamber is now open to you.
quest_42002_inprogressresponse: I will let you know if I feel any threat coming from the voice that I'm hearing. In the meantime, let's keep looking for the fragments.
quest_42002_objectiveproposalresponse: I... I know. That voice I can hear... or feel? It's not just in my head. It's like... it's like it is all of me.
quest_42002_objectiveproposalresponse_1: I know. I know it doesn't. But as I said before, I don't feel any malice. I don't feel like it means me harm. Just that it... wants to speak.
quest_42002_objectiveproposalresponse_2: I think so, yes. Each time you bring me more, the voice -- the feeling -- gets more and more clear. I think we're doing the right thing.
quest_42002_objectiveproposalresponse_2_: "And the fragments are how it will?"
quest_42002_objectiveproposalresponse_3: For now, let's focus on collecting the rest of the fragments. As before, they could be anywhere, so please... keep checking the hidden places of Nighthaven.
quest_61000_description: The Occult scientist Mads Larssen has employed you to search for his apprentice, Ejnar. The boy was last seen heading to investigate the outbreak of rabid were beasts at Madmaw Furrow
quest_61000_destinationcompletionavailab: You tracked down his journals you say? I'll have to look through these. The boy may yet be alive. You have my thanks.
quest_61000_inprogressresponse: Poor Ejnar, always too eager to find solutions, risky experimentation. Foolhardy boy. Flighty as a raven and less dependable.
quest_61000_objectiveproposalresponse: Something is wrong with the Berlaur... more than an airborne contagion! I sent poor Ejnar to Madmaw Furrow -- brilliant boy, brittle mind. If the soil whispered, he may have listened too closely.
quest_61000_objectiveproposalresponse_1: Just south of here, a grove of massive trees. The beasts homestead there. I wouldn't recommend visiting, but if you do... keep an eye out for signs of the boy. He has yet to return. If you find anything, I can reward you.
quest_61000_task_52_description: Follow Ejnar to Madmaw Furrow and search for clues as to what happened to him
quest_61001_description: Doctor Larssen's apprentice Ejmar has taken it upon himself to mkae a containment facility for the infected were beasts at Piatra Antica but he has not returned. Go to the ruined castle and search for signs of the lad. Eliminate any rabid werebeasts you find.
quest_61001_destinationcompletionavailab: Ah well. That is disappointing. In the end I suppose this work is not fit for an apprentice. That much is certain.
quest_61001_inprogressresponse: The search for my apprentice must be arduous indeed. I hope to hear good news soon.
quest_61001_inprogressresponse_1: Many thanks, my friend. Do what you can. When you find the lad, tell him he was dumber than a labrador. Going off on a fool's quest when he barely knows his acids from his bases. He's bound to make a grievous mistake.
quest_61001_objectiveproposalresponse: Thank you for tracking down Ejnar's notes. He has been a good apprentice for a long while. The fool took it upon himself to establish a quarantine for the beasts at Piatra. I worry he has gone too far in an attempt get my approval.

raid_c17_dahut_intro_00: Upon my duty to my Father and my new Lord, your little incursion shall end here and now…
raid_c17_dahut_phase2start_00: A commendable effort, but enough games. My knights... Remove them.
raid_c17_dahut_phase3intro_00: Enough! Your pesky squirming will only make this more... brutal.
raid_c17_dahut_phase3introriseagain_00: Now rise, my knights... and fulfill your duty!
raid_c17_dahut_riseagaincd_00: As many times as it takes…
raid_c17_dahut_victory_00: A shame... you were weaker than I had hoped.
raid_c17_gradlonecho_dialogue_02: You are not welcome here... LEAVE!
raid_c17_gradlonecho_dialogue_03: At last, the Jester has fallen! His banishment from the court was too light a punishment, but death befits him well! Praise the heroes who - INTRUDERS! Your presence soils this land, BEGONE!
raid_c17_gradlonecho_dialogue_04: My dear daughter Dahut... may your soul finally find peace, freed from the tyrant's clutches... VERMIN! Your bodies will be broken and your souls scourged!
raid_c17_gradlonecho_dialogue_05: Brave warriors, the tyrant's grip loosens and my mind is mine once more... but my Mist has weakened and Myrddin's magic wanes... The spear will not elude him much longer. You MUST stop him, or all is doomed
raid_c17_gradlonecho_dialogue_06: Myrddin's spell is almost broken, and with it my consciousness fades... Hurry! I beg you!
raid_c17_jester_death_00: THIS... is how I make my exit?
raid_c17_jester_fierycackle_00: I'm BLAZING A TRAIL in buffoonery!
raid_c17_jester_hellring_00: Perfect for a public in the round!
raid_c17_jester_intro_00: WELCOME to my spectacle! Your role today? The vanquished.
raid_c17_jester_originalprankster_00: Can you think outside the box?
raid_c17_jester_outofbounds_00: No, no, no, NO running away!
raid_c17_jester_phase2start_00: Let's move on to the next Act!
raid_c17_jester_pretaunt_00: Finally, a new audience! Welcome to my opening act!
raid_c17_jester_spotthediffcast_00: It's all but smoke and mirrors!
raid_c17_jester_victory_00: A mediocre audience makes for a mediocre spectacle…
raid_c17_myrddinshard_dialogue_01: May this memory fragment guide those who are worthy. May you undo the harm I once caused Ys…
raid_c17_myrddinshard_dialogue_02: These shards will be able to unlock the path forward... But be warned, the relic I have attempted to seal on Ys is powerful and its nefarious influence... contagious.
raid_c17_myrddinshard_dialogue_03: Princess Dahut and her guards will prove instrumental in protecting the Spear of Longinus. I can only hope nothing detracts them from their duty towards Ys and they do not succumb to the relic's influence…
raid_c17_myrddinshard_dialogue_04: Gradlon and I agreed the spear should be kept as far from the rest of the island as possible. The path will be sealed to all but the ruler of Ys... but with this shard, a worthy soul will be able to bypass this restriction should the need arise.
raid_c17_thorpe_death_01: Is this to be my eternal torment, forever falling before you?
raid_c17_thorpe_death_02: Very well... I have grown weary of this vain struggle…
raid_c17_thorpe_domainoftheoverlord_00: I will burn it ALL if I have to!
raid_c17_thorpe_hungerofthevoid_00: I will enjoy watching you burn! I am... Almighty!
raid_c17_thorpe_igc_monologue_01: All shall know the name of Thorpe.
raid_c17_thorpe_igc_monologue_02: Cowardly ghost, the spear is mine!
raid_c17_thorpe_igc_monologue_03: So this... is my fate? At… your hand?
raid_c17_thorpe_igc_monologue_05: Fortune has granted me a successor!
raid_c17_thorpe_igc_monologue_06: To you I bestow the Spear of Longinus. Heed its power.
raid_c17_thorpe_intro_00: Who dares? You? How much longer do you intend to stand in my way? But I am in control of my own fate now and I shall have my revenge against Aeternum... and you!
raid_c17_thorpe_mistextension_00: No longer shall I stand your presence!
raid_c17_thorpe_phase2start_00: You will pay for this! Arise, souls of the dead!
raid_c17_thorpe_phase3start_00: Argh, enough! I will enjoy torturing your souls!
raid_c17_thorpe_phase4start_00: What? No! Not this time! I will sunder your souls!
raid_c17_thorpe_relicchannel_00: This is but a taste of my rancour!
raid_c17_thorpe_relicchannel_01: Finally! How sweet is the taste of revenge!
raid_c17_thorpe_relicrecall_00: Come to me, Spear of Longinus! I am your rightful master!
raid_c17_thorpe_relicrecallfail_00: No! This power is mine alone!
raid_c17_thorpe_unholysmite_00: You exist only to serve me!
raid_c17_thorpe_victory_00: Your suffering will not end with your death!
raid_ck_broodmother_defeat: You fools. You scorch the earth and defile nature's destiny. My children may not fly today... but we will return.
raid_ck_broodmother_intro: The heroes charge in yet again. You humans never quit. But my brood will claim Aeternum and exterminate your kind. All will bow to the mother.
raid_ck_broodmother_victory: The heroes lay crumpled, pathetic and twitching. Spread your wings, my children, fly forth upon the lands beyond.
raid_ck_echidna_intro: What is this…. new body? Such power...! Mmm. I can smell you, human. I will consecrate the soil with your blood.
raid_ck_typhon_intro: Flesh? Sweet Flesh..... plump piggy flesh..... Feast! Teeth will tear. Pigs will bleed.... FEEAASST!!

rapidstrikes_description: Perform 4 fast attacks, each dealing {[0.900000 * 100]}% weapon damage. \n\nRaging Torrent can be block/dodge cancelled after the 1st attack.
rapidstrikes_mod1_description: Hitting a target with Raging Torrent grants <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">haste</font>, increasing movement speed by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}s</font>.

rapier_01_description: Slash so quickly that it extends the reach of your blade up to 5m. This strike deals {[0.500000 * 100]}% weapon damage and applies a bleed that will deal an additional {[-0.100000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second for {[10.000000]}s. (Stacks up to 3 times and refreshes previous applications.)
rapier_01_mod1_description: When applying the first <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font> stack to an opponent, Tondo's cooldown is reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font>.
rapier_01_mod2_description: If you hit only <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1</font> target, even on a blocked hit, Tondo's cooldown is reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.250000 * -100]}%</font>.
rapier_01_mod3_description: Increases initial hit base damage from Tondo by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000 * 100]}%</font> if the target is already inflicted with rapier's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font>.
rapier_02_description: Enter a posed stance and unleash a series of 5 quick thrust attacks with each strike dealing {[0.600000 * 100]}% weapon damage. Flurry can be cancelled at any time by dodging or by using another ability. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
rapier_02_mod1_description: Each hit of Flurry reduces its cooldown by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font>.
rapier_02_mod2_description: Each hit of Flurry does <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> more block damage.
rapier_02_mod3_description: Each hit of Flurry extends the rapier's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font> by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Future stacking applications of this extended bleed will also be extended to its longer duration.)</font>
rapier_02_mod4_description: The last hit of Flurry will inflict the enemy with a stack of bleed, dealing {[-0.100000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second for {[10.000000]}s.
rapier_03_description: Flourish performs an attack dealing {[0.600000 * 100]}% weapon damage, staggering and pushing back enemies. Reactivating this ability or using basic attack at the end of Flourish will perform the follow up attack, Finish. Finish lunges forward dealing {[1.200000 * 100]}% direct weapon damage and consumes all rapier bleeds on any target hit dealing {[1.100000 * 100]}% of their damage immediately.
rapier_03_mod1_description: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> on both Flourish and Finish. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)</font>
rapier_03_mod2_description: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[20.000000]}</font> stamina when successfully hitting a target with Finish.
rapier_03_mod3_description: When Tondo's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font> ticks, reduce the cooldown of this ability by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.090000 * -100]}%</font>. (Max 1 reduction per tick)
rapier_03_mod4_description: Finish deals <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.500000 * 100]}%</font> of the rapier's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">bleed</font> damage instead of only <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
rapier_04_description: Enter into a defensive stance for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">1s</font>. If struck during this ability, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">counter</font> the attacker dealing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}% </font> weapon damage, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">staggering</font> and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stunning</font> them for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>. You are briefly <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">invulnerable</font> upon a successful Riposte.<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\nTaunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your rapier, activating this ability inflicts taunt for {[4.000000]}s to all foes within 5m. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)</font>
rapier_04_mod1_description: If riposte successfully hits a target, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, increasing damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>.
rapier_04_mod2_description: Reduce the cooldown of other rapier abilities by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.200000 * -100]}%</font> when landing a Riposte counter attack.
rapier_04_mod3_description: Increase the <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stun</font> from Riposte to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.500000]}s</font>.
rapier_05_description: Leave the ground lunging forward for 10m in a stabbing motion and pierce through enemies dealing {[1.450000 * 100]}% weapon damage.
rapier_05_mod1_description: Killing with this ability reduces its cooldown by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.800000 * -100]}%</font>.
rapier_05_mod2_description: After performing Fleche, your next critical strike within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> will deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage.
rapier_05_mod3_description: Reactivating this ability or pressing basic attack at any time during Fleche will stop and perform a static, continuation attack dealing {[1.150000 * 100]}% damage.
rapier_06_description: Perform a small, reliable sidestep in your current movement direction that cancels any current activity and provides momentary <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">invulnerability</font>. rapier_06_mod4_description: Individual successful light attacks reduce the cooldown of this ability by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.250000 * -100]}%</font> each. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[0.100000]}s cooldown.)</font>

ridersraces_body_01_01:
The time is almost here. I can feel it. The other day, I came upon a band of wild horses out on the green. At their near flank, I spied a tall palomino, her flowing white mane reaching almost to her knee. As she broke away from the rest to drink from a nearby pond, our eyes met. In her gaze, I saw neither fear nor distrust, but with the piercing curiosity of an equal.

I dared to creep closer, the wisdom of past failures washed away by an overwhelming sense of destiny. As I approached and she reared on her hind legs to test my resolve, pawing at the earth with her hooves. I held her gaze, pausing only a moment to let her apprehension subside. I dared not look away, but I could feel my boots sink deeper into the mud as I closed in. Soon, I could see nothing else but her bright eyes, shining like agates in the midday heat.

I whispered assurances to her in my native tongue, and reached out to touch her mane. She accepted my offered hand, allowing me to run my fingers through her flaxen locks. For a moment we were one heart. Then suddenly, her ears darted this way and that, finally settling on the treeline. She whinnied, sweating with fear despite my reassurance. There was no more I could do to calm her, and a moment later she turned in retreat with the rest of her number.

I dared not linger there to savor this small victory. For whatever malevolent force interrupted our reverie was clearly lurking somewhere in the nearby woods.

-Jochi
ridersraces_body_01_02:
Inez says the golden age of we free traders is now. The horses are a chance to stay one step ahead of the tax man, and the long arm of the law. And it takes a great deal more contraband to put a bow in an equine back! The profit margins will soar like never before.

But I am tired of this life. The running. The hiding. The getting caught, and suffering all manner of torment and humiliation. No… when I am on horseback all I can think of is the wind in my hair, and the smell of the cool night air.

When my Espoir runs, I wish it to be for the sheer joy of a free heart, not because he is chased by some thug who fancies himself a lawkeeper. If Inez does not share my resolve, so be it. I mean to leave behind this life of secrets and squabbles. For this is Aeternum, and there are many ways that a fool and his money may soon be parted.

-François
ridersraces_body_01_03:
The Beast Lords’ returns as brought new life into my studies. There are new secrets to collate, and new records to keep. The animals are our partners again, it’s true, but the conventional wisdom of the mainland has hardly borne fruit. The wild things here are more fickle, more strange, and more wonderous than any of European stock. And the knowledge of their mastery must be preserved for castaways to come.

Still, with no knowledge from our forefathers to light the way, I must admit, I have trouble telling a true master rider from a silver-tongue charlatan. Perhaps I can arrange a race to help separate the proverbial wheat from the chaff.

Yes! That’s the rub. I shall design a challenge befitting a true master of the saddle. That way I can ensure that only the wisdom of the most worthy is chronicled for those who come after. In this way, I can spare new aspirants the indignity of sifting through misinformation set down by egotistical amateurs.

-Satiah Ramotep
ridersraces_body_01_04:
My clan has lost their wits. They think, somehow, that they can master the fury of the wild by dominating it? A caged and battered wolf has none of the cunning and fury required to excel as a hound of war. Their souls must remain sharp as tooth and claw, lest they lose the clarity of purpose and vision that comes from the life of a pack hunter.

All our years in this land, our people have rejected the allure of decadence and luxury, clinging with white knuckles to the hardship that forged us. For what are such things but a prison of a different sort? A Rus who debases himself with such trivialities is no better than caged animal, listless and soft, and will surely lose everything.

But still they do not see! These new warhounds are neither pets nor livestock. They are us! They live for the scent of blood and the thrill of new prey. They follow strength, and eschew all other bonds of fellowship. And above all they are free! They must be allowed to choose, or they will never possess the fighting spirit of a sovereign creature.

These fools are not worthy to call themselves my kinsmen. No matter. I shall forge a new pack without them.

-V

romelegacy01: We set out to find the Field of Reeds, the blessed home of the gods.
romelegacy02: Carrying our dying queen, our only hope lay in finding the gift of immortality.
romelegacy03: We expected to discover divine power, a paradise blessed by the Nine.
romelegacy04: But we found only ruins and devastation, the obvious result of divine wrath.
romelegacy05: Having failed our queen, her body was consigned to the desert. But we would not be defeated.
romelegacy06: Allied with the might of Rome, we would succeed where our ancestors had failed.
romelegacy07: Like mighty Perseus or Achilles, General Crassus became our greatest champion.
romelegacy08: Together, our works inspired the people and brought order to the chaos.
romelegacy09: We would honor the gods and bring about an age of enlightenment.
romelegacy10: But greed and ambition poisoned the minds of our stewards.
romelegacy11: The Romans coveted the power of the gods and our protectors became our oppressors.
romelegacy12: The gods punished them for their arrogance.
romelegacy13: The Curse of Medusa would imprison the unfaithful for centuries.
romelegacy14: The faithful would have to prove ourselves worthy before the gods would return.
romelegacy15: But the plague of evil can never be vanquished. And it corrupts everything it touches.
romelegacy16: Now we pray that the gods will send new champions.
romelegacy17: To vanquish the darkness and find light in the shadows of our past.

s04_gt_expd_01_combatbark_loth_intro2: I will put Shailyn to an end. But first, you.
s04_gt_expd_01_combatbark_loth_intro3: I will put Shailyn's meddling to an end. Starting with you.
s04_gt_expd_01_combatbark_loth_victory_a: Tell Shailyn her pathetic attempt has failed.
s04_gt_expd_01_combatbark_loth_victory_d: Was this outcome ever in question?
s04_gt_expd_01_complete_a: You've done it. You've actually, actually done it. Forgive me. I- I have spent a lifetime, pursuing that vile bastard, Loth.
s04_gt_expd_01_complete_b: I am in your debt. More than you know. And at last, there shall be rest.
s04_gt_expd_01_desc: Shailyn has found another way into the underground caverns in Great Cleave. She wants you to pursue Ser Loth and destroy him.
s04_gt_expd_01_greet_a: Your arrival is a boon from the gods. Though you defeated Ser Marius, we haven't yet routed the true evil- Loth.
s04_gt_expd_01_greet_b: Thankfully, I've found another way into the ancient halls where he seeks power- the Glacial Tarn.
s04_gt_expd_01_incomplete_a: Though the challenge before us is mighty, I can think of none more able to face it, than you.
s04_gt_expd_01_proposal_a: Yes, right through this gateway, in fact. But as you can imagine, there's more in the way of getting to Loth than just this door.
s04_gt_expd_01_proposal_b: Not only his allies, the Varangians, but powerful magic. Primordial. And most deadly.
s04_gt_expd_01_proposal_next_a: Thank you. I could not ask for a stronger ally than you.
s04_gt_expd_01_proposal_next_b: But remember, that foul get has not only consumed the flame of the Empyrean Forge, but now steeps himself in the ancient ice magic from the Glacial Tarn. Be wary.
s04_gt_expd_01_proposal_prompt: "I’ll get Loth. I don't fear him."
s04_gt_expd_rpt_complete_a: Ah! I see you have returned! And you have the ice formations! Excellent! I knew you were the right person to ask for aid!
s04_gt_expd_rpt_complete_b: If ever you are in need of healing, seek me out! I shall return this favor to you then, I assure you!
s04_gt_expd_rpt_cooldown: With the ice sample you've collected I'll be able to whip up more healing tinctures. Come back soon and I'll be happy to pay you again for your aid.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_desc: The healer Ao Wei, is interested in the potential for curative powers of ice found in the Glacial Tarn in Great Cleave. He wants you to collect samples of any interesting ice formations that you find deep in the caverns.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_gatherice1: Gather ice sample from Glacial Caverns
s04_gt_expd_rpt_gatherice2: Gather ice sample from Promenade of Spring
s04_gt_expd_rpt_gatherice3: Gather ice sample from Ascent of Seasons
s04_gt_expd_rpt_greet_a: Well met to you, my friend. I see that you, like me, are here to uncover the mysteries of the Glacial Tarn.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_greet_b: I have a simple request if you are willing. Venture within, and gather for me, specimens of the ice formations found here.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_incomplete_a: Beyond its healing properties, I believe these ice formations hold a secret to our life here on Aeternum.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_proposal_a: That is correct! But this ice- it has properties unlike anything I have ever seen. Is it the purity of the water?
s04_gt_expd_rpt_proposal_b: The magical essence it soaks in? I must have more samples to study! Please, will you help me?
s04_gt_expd_rpt_proposal_next_a: Thank you! Wonderful! I would go myself, you see, but I am a healer, not a fighter.
s04_gt_expd_rpt_proposal_next_b: I have seen enough horrible wounds on those I treat- I would not want to see the monsters of this Glacial Tarn in person.

server_transfer_not_transfer_detail4_too:
Season Pass progression is specific to a region. The progress you see on your character will reflect the progress for your account in your region. Transferring a character to a world in another region will not transfer Season Pass progress.

While Season Pass rewards are region based, some rewards are account wide and cannot be claimed again by transferring or creating a new character.

Season Pass Premium is account wide.

shadowawakens01: Since the beginning, I have sacrificed to protect the Earth.
shadowawakens02: Watching my brothers and sisters yield their very essence to stem the first tide of evil.
shadowawakens03: Upon its return, I sought to restore the garden, and to redeem humanity as Corruption's accomplice.
shadowawakens04: But you prevented that... and invited perils far greater than you can imagine.
shadowawakens05: Your allies go forth, bearing a power never meant for human hands.
shadowawakens06: Oblivious to the horrors it summons from the shadows.
shadowawakens07: The Beast Lords are but the vanguard for savage legions...
shadowawakens08: And they will hunt you down to reclaim their prize.
shadowawakens09: A darkness unseen for centuries awakens with an insatiable thirst...
shadowawakens10: And above all, the specter of time looms, seeking to claim its toll on Aeternum.
shadowawakens11: At long-last, judgement comes for the island of immortals.

sharpshootertree0passive1_description: Landing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2 headshots</font> within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> of each other halves the duration of the next <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">reload</font>.
sharpshootertree0passive2_description: Increase musket base damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> after aiming down sights for more than <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>.
sharpshootertree0passive3_description: If <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}</font> or more targets are hit with a single shot, the duration of the next <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">reload</font> is halved. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[4.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
sharpshootertree0passive4_description: On a successful <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">headshot</font>, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, increasing damage dealt by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
sharpshootertree0passive5_description: Headshots <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">weaken</font> targets, decreasing their damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[8.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
sharpshootertree0passive6_description: Basic attack <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">headshots</font> reduce all musket ability <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">cooldowns</font> by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font>.
sharpshootertree0passive7_description: Musket shots deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to targets <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[20.000000]}m</font> or further away from the player. \n\nAlso deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.075000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to targets within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[40.000000]}m</font>.
sharpshootertree0passive8_description: Successful hits with a musket grant a stackable <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2.5%</font> base damage increase. This effect ends after more than <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> passes between shots. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[6.000000]} stacks.)</font>
sharpshootertree0ult_description: Grants a {[0.150000 * 100]}% damage increase to all headshots. \n\nIf multiple targets are hit with a single musket attack, the next shot within {[3.000000]}s inflicts bleed to all targets the shot passes through, dealing {[-0.150000 * -100]}% weapon damage every second for {[5.000000]}s.
shatter_description: Increase the base damage of the last <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2m</font> of the Wind Chill range by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font>.

shockwave_description: Slam your war hammer into the ground, causing a {[3.000000]}m radius earthquake that deals {[0.600000 * 100]}% weapon damage, staggering and stunning all impacted targets for {[2.000000]}s. This ability has grit. (Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.) Taunt Gem Compatible: If you have a Carnelian gem equipped in your war hammer, this ability inflicts taunt for {[6.000000]}s to all enemies hit. (Taunt causes monsters to focus only on you.)
shockwave_mod1_description: The trauma of the attack causes <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">weaken</font>, decreasing the damage dealt from the target's attacks by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>.
shockwave_mod2_description: Expands the range Shockwave to a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font> radius.
shootersstance_description: Player enters a crouching aim stance to enhance shooting performance. While in this stance, shots deal {[1.000000 * 100]}% weapon damage, mobility is reduced to zero and reload time is reduced by 75%. Shooter's Stance ends after 3 shots. skyeletter02: I was ten when I proved him wrong.
skyeletter03: I chose the path of the warrior. And in two years, my brothers could not match me in battle.
skyeletter04: But among spear-daughters, I forged an unbreakable bond.
skyeletter05: On Aeternum, we fought an endless onslaught of darkness.
skyeletter06: Until that day, a faceless warlock cursed us. He stole our warrior's fire.
skyeletter07: We tried everything to break free, even death.
skyeletter08: But nothing worked... and without our strength, what were we?
skyeletter09: Now, our enemies pursue an even darker power in Great Cleave. They must be stopped.
skyeletter10: Hero of Aeternum, help me reclaim our fire, and strike our enemy asunder.

springtidebloom_body_01_01:
Mine eyes have been opened. It is said there is truth in wine, and a great many mysteries have been revealed to me beneath the sweet embrace of Dionysus. But the nectar of his vine has never yet revealed such marvels to me as the Springtide blooms. 

The fog over this land has parted and I have seen beyond into the sun-kissed fields of Elysium. Pan and his sylvan get dance among the hemp rows, prancing on cloven hooves and whistling through reedpipes while the Wispybloom blossoms shimmer like spilt wine amongst the plantings. At the edge of the field, I beheld the hound Orthos dutifully standing guard, his twin heads darting this way and that as he scoured the past and infinite future for intruders. The red cattle of his master mooed and snorted listlessly in the pasture, awaiting the return of their divine master. 

Here, in this eternal place, the gods have granted me a small mercy: a waking dream of an afterlife I may never know, filled with marvels I feared I might never behold. Praise and approbations to all the gods of Olympus, for offering me this gift on the eve of precious Springtide!
springtidebloom_body_01_02:
I remember the day when I first beheld the bloom. It was on this night, when the sun and moon have equal share of the eternal cosmos, locked in their endless dance across the sky, that I spied the sacred blossoms out amongst the hemp, shining like beams of moonlight kissed by the setting sun. As I plucked one from the earth, still wet with the morning dew, it offered me a glimpse of what lies beyond perception. 

All around, I could see the web of fate spread out before me – innumerable, luminous strands intertwined with one another – each a whole lifetime of wisdom and experience and love and regret. As I gazed into the depths of each, my eyes drawn to the endless stories they held, a strange ripple cascaded across the web. I looked up and at their center, I beheld a strange creature: a coal black spider with the face of a man. 

As I watched the industrious weaver go about his business, his gaze fixed upon me. I asked him to find me the most interesting and beautiful stories in the all the world. His smile disarmed me. He told me some things are beyond human comprehension, and that when I wake, all I have witnessed here will be like a dream. My vision blurred and I found myself once gain standing among the fields, with only a hazy recollection of all the splendors I had witnessed among weaver’s web.
springtidebloom_body_01_03:
I have witnessed a miracle. An experience of such strange magic, I struggle to put thought to paper. In my youth I had heard the elder druids whisper in hushed tones of such marvels, but until last night I never dreamed I would experience such a thing. 

It was a bright and moonlit night when I partook of the Wispybloom. Then, suddenly, the skies caught fire. The stars tumbled down around me, great rivers of firelight, and yet remained in their place to brighten the evening sky. Amid the brilliance, I found myself transported to a realm apart. Where, I cannot say, but the weight of the world had lifted from me. I floated, as if cradled by the waters of the sea on a still day, at once empty of my mortal vessel and at one with all things. 

The leaves of the trees lit up like lightning bugs, and mushroom blooms formed ringlets in the fallow earth. Wisps of light darted from among their caps, leaving trails of radiance hanging in the night air. And the sound! I could hear the rustling of leaves and the chirping of insects, but above it all, the clarion call of female voices, raised in song. 

It was then that I beheld… HIM! The black wolf, Gwyllgi, tall as a man, skulking at the edge of the grove, his blazing red eyes fixed upon me. I knew at once that I was a trespasser here in the land of Annwn, and must return across the veil to my own land.
springtidebloom_body_01_04:
A most peculiar thing happened to me today, as I went for a walk among the wildflowers. 

All at once, the wind began to howl and the Wispyblooms swirled around me like wine-tinged snowflakes. Just past the vortex I could see them: visions of my past, all present, all at once. My grandmother and father, showing mother how space plantings among the rice fields. They were somehow both young and old, visions of their youthful selves aglow with all the wisdom of ages past. Then there was mother, both child and matron, passing on this knowledge to my brothers and sisters. And I among them, young for eternity in this unnatural place – a ruptured stitch in the tapestry of our line. I looked up at the sky, past the swirling petals, to bask in the light of Cheng’e, hoping that she would carry me from this lonely place, back to the land of my ancestors. 

Instead I saw only the eyes of the wolf Tiagou, mouth agape as he loped toward her alabaster light, famished and longing. I dropped to my knees and cried out in warning! 

Darkness enveloped me, and I felt a cool springtime breeze on my face. I awoke among the shoots and stems of the hemp fields, holding this precious memory of hearth and family in my mind’s eye. All trace of my fear had been forgotten.
springtidebloom_body_01_05:
Last night, out upon the field, I spied a queer-looking raven perched among the stalks. Its feathers were white as snow, and its red eyes locked on mine, as if I were somehow familiar. I slunk forward, hoping to get a better look at its magnificence, but it took flight at my approach. Unsure I could trust my eyes, I stooped to pick up one of its fallen feathers. 

Suddenly, I was elsewhere, the sounds of nature roaring in my ears. The noise of birds and beasts and insects soared around me. But also… drums! Where the white raven had been, there stood a waiflike woman. Her skin was ivory, and her cascading blonde locks so sun-bleached, they were almost white. She took me by the hand and raced deeper into the woodlands, tugging me along behind her. I dashed after her, free hand raised to protect my eyes from branches whipping by on either side. 

The ground began to shake, and I realized what I heard was not the retort of drumbeats, but a cavalcade of horse hooves! A huntsman’s horn sounded, and jet-black steeds broke through the foliage, each one beset by an ashen rider, pale and unearthly like my strange attendant. The great host enveloped us, but my companion ran on without fear, leading me on in her wake. The hot breath of horses stuck in my throat as dust filled the air, until all was darkness save the sounding of hooves and the beating of my heart and the clarion peals of her laughter. 

Then I was alone again, racing at a fever pitch through the hemp, each gasp of the cool night air chilling the ecstasy in my heart.
springtidebloom_body_01_06:
For all truth-seekers and those who feel the call of what lies beyond the senses: 

The <font color="#edc63e">Wispyblooms</font> you crave <font color="#edc63e">lie hidden in the fields and grasslands</font>. There, <font color="#edc63e">beneath the rainbow clouds</font>, these secret blooms wait for those who dare to dream. Be bold, and go where intuition guides you! 

Let the Springtide blooms carry you on a journey to new horizons, friend!
springtidebloom_body_01_07: Alder left a <font color="#edc63e">token</font> for me. I found it nestled <font color="#edc63e">inside one of the Prismablooms</font> on the hill overlooking the hemp field. A talisman, meant to bring me good luck as I set off on my reverie. \n\nIt was a sweet tradition. When he first joined us, I left a token for him among the blooms near the river – a place he would often journey to be alone with his thoughts after more ecstatic revelations. He returned beaming at his good fortune, and so the others quickly joined in. Soon, we had hidden so many tokens, I doubt we shall ever reclaim them all. Perhaps someday soon, a stranger will visit us, and will stumble upon one. I can only hope it will offer the same sense of kismet it has brought to those of our number.

summermedleyfaire_body_01_01:
I feel a fool even writing this down. 

After dinner, I saved the sturgeon’s bones. Every last one. They weren’t golden, like in the fairy tales. But I placed them in a bowl, poured seawater over the bones, and spoke a wish anyway. 

Woke up this morning, and my boat still leaks. Useless, stupid story. At least I got a warm meal out of it.
summermedleyfaire_body_01_02:
Tried to repair the leak myself. I’d been at it for hours when I heard music coming from the shore. A strange, warbly flute that rose as the sun set. 

The sound of music came closer, until a masked stranger stepped out from behind the trees. They lowered the flute and smiled at me. 

“Well met, well met! I’m hosting a little fishing competition, and I heard of a lonely fellow who happened to be one of the finest anglers on the island.”
summermedleyfaire_body_01_03:
I’m not one for flattery, so I was going to shoo this strange jester off. But then they came closer. Their eyes glinted golden behind the mask, in the light of the setting sun. 

“There are prizes for the biggest, most magnificent catch! Please do come. A party’s merrier with more guests!” 

Don’t know what made me follow. Maybe it was the music, maybe it was the chance to brag.
summermedleyfaire_body_01_04:
Caught the biggest sturgeon of the year, and you know what the grand prize was? 

A new boat. The masked musician presented it to me with this knowing look, and I didn’t know what to say. 

Next year, I’ll search for that musician as soon as summer comes around. And I’m saving every fish’s bones.
summermedleyfaire_body_02_01: Poor Luis spends the heat of the day chasing Maudlinbugs away from his darling bees. I haven’t said this to Luis, because I’m quite sure he’ll howl with rage if I do. But I find the Maudlinbugs adorable, myself. \n\nTheir funny short wings, glittering dust, and the way they bump into everything around them. They’re like tiny drunken revelers, each buzzing cloud its own miniature party!
summermedleyfaire_body_02_02:
The dream I had last night was unlike any other. 

The creature spoke with a thousand small, buzzing voices, a chorus both rapturous and painful to my ears. “The song, the sssong! We wish only for the sssong!” A universe of beaded, jeweled eyes stared unblinking. Dust poured from their myriad glittering wings. 

I awoke with a pounding head from Luis’s mead, and a new melody in my heart.
summermedleyfaire_body_02_03: My tiny patrons approve! The Maudlinbugs adore my new tune. They gather and dance around me in whirling clouds. And dear Luis and his beehives can finally have some peace and quiet for the rest of summer. \n\nI think I’ll take this little show on the road, though I’ll have to find a suitable tailor first. The darling little Maudlinbugs cover everything with their dust, and my new garb must match theirs.
summermedleyfaire_body_03_01:
So on the hottest damn day of the year, this outrageously dressed stranger waltzes—literally waltzes!—down the street and right through my back door! Who does that? I nearly threw them out, but they got down on their knees, right on my brand new rug. 

“Oh, mistress Appius, purveyor of culinary delights, won’t you give this humble musician an audience?” 

I couldn’t say no. I couldn’t say anything. I was struck speechless by the sheer audacity of it all.
summermedleyfaire_body_03_02:
First course: olives with parsley and fennel, small fish pastries in hot sauce, fresh oysters, smoked sturgeon with cold sage soup 

Second course: fish pie with cinnamon and nutmeg, ginger-stuffed sturgeon, roasted sturgeon and jelly, thrice-spiced sturgeon skewers (brave guests only) 

Desserts: Damn the dessert. I’m good, but I can’t conjure dessert out of a sturgeon!
summermedleyfaire_body_03_03:
My eyes ache. I’ll never get the smell of frying fish out of my best apron. I bought up every last jar of pepper in this town and the next one over. 

And when I said that to the Maestro, what did they do? Smiled that beatific smile, clapped me on the back, and asked, “Same time next year?” 

For Heaven’s sake, I must be mad, but of course I’ll be back next year! And I’m bringing reinforcements. Kartik makes the finest fish curry, and I hope he won’t mind a stranger waltzing into his kitchen.
summermedleyfaire_body_04_01:
Once upon a time, an old fisherman washed up on the shores of Aeternum. Though others sought treasure and power, the fisherman was content to build himself a small hut overlooking a delta, and sail out every day to catch his meals. 

One summer evening, the fisherman found himself lost in a dense fog. He drifted until he saw a light beneath the waves. He cast his line, watching the light bob and sink. The creature that he reeled up was unearthly: an enormous sturgeon with glittering jeweled scales, twice as long as he was tall. 

The astonished fisherman nearly dropped his line, but not before the sturgeon spoke: "Release me, friend, and I will grant you a wish."
summermedleyfaire_body_04_02: In a land of wonders, a talking fish is hardly noteworthy. But something about the sturgeon's blinding scales and golden eyes gave the fisherman pause. \n\nHe bowed and answered, "Will you guide me home?" The sturgeon turned and began swimming away, with the fisherman paddling after. He followed its glowing trail all the way back to shore.
summermedleyfaire_body_04_03:
When his hut was in sight, the fisherman stopped paddling. "Thank you,” he said to the sturgeon. “May I ask for a second wish?" 

The sturgeon did not answer. 

"I wish for your good fortune, friend," continued the fisherman. "I wish for you to prosper, and for the oceans and rivers to be as good to you as they have been to me."
summermedleyfaire_body_04_04:
More lights appeared from beneath the waves. Soon, the shallow water was full of jeweled sturgeon, as many as the stars in the night sky. They all spoke with a single voice as deep as the sea: 

"For your generous spirit, you may make a third wish." The fisherman thought, until the fog cleared and the moon rose high in the sky. Patiently, the many sturgeon waited. 

"I wish for death," said the fisherman. "I am old, and the next step awaits me." 

No one ever saw the fisherman again. He left behind only his boat, his rod, and a single fish scale that crumbled to shimmering dust with the sunrise.
