tempestreckoning02: The heart of the Tempest, Captain Isabella herself, defeated...
tempestreckoning03: Abandoned by the power for which she traded everything.
tempestreckoning05: Pulling Aeternum, and the world, back from the precipice of doom.
tempestreckoning07: So many of their numbers Corrupted or Lost.
tempestreckoning08: Their fragile alliance crumbling as the factions fight for dominance.
tempestreckoning09: And what of the allies they believe they've gained in the Angry Earth?
tempestreckoning10: It will be clear soon enough...
tempestreckoning11: That the vengeful hand of nature would grasp far more than equilibrium.
tempestreckoning12: And the void exposed when the surge in Corruption abates will become a threat of itself...
tempestreckoning13: As the soulless remnants of this conflict rise from the battlefield...
tempestreckoning14: to find purpose and power in a source as yet unrealized.
tempestreckoning15: Yes, the hapless inhabitants of Aeternum will soon learn that this chapter may have come to a close...
tempestreckoning16: But the real horrors have just begun.

tempestrising04: I tasted the knowledge forbidden to us at creation. And I saw the vision of humanity's true potential.
tempestrising05: I knew then, I must correct this ancient injustice, and restore the power which is rightfully ours.

tempestrising07: After a century of preparation, our campaign has begun.

thethingintheswamp_body_01_01:
More sightings of the thing today. Always in the swamps. What’s going on out there?

Spoke with the blacksmith today. Says the thing is like a patch of peat moss ambulating like a man.

Spoke to a traveling merchant today. Says the thing is like a bog body, pickled and preserved, bleeding water the color of strong tea.

Spoke with Seamus today. Said he mistook the thing for his pa, but it turned out to be all worms, a writhing mass contriving into a squelchy fellowship to move as we move?

More talk of the thing today. Community will be in an uproar more damaging than any creature. Going out there to investigate, out into the swamps. Will record findings here, when I return.

threefactions_body_01_01:
I have failed. Our people needed me, and I failed them. As the Lost host continued to grow, so too did my questions. I found no answers.

I had hoped the Covenant leaders might offer some insight, but I found myself threatened, deceived, and finally banished. I have been named Apostate. There was a conspiracy within some of the leaders to shame me. To say that I am working against the Covenant and the orders from on high. 

To whomever should find this when my sanity has finally left me, I implore you: deliver this message to my mother Livia. Tell her that I am sorry. When the Covenant needed me most, I succumbed at last to despair.

And if you are able, release me from this abominable fate to the comforting blackness of oblivion.
threefactions_body_01_02: Those I have spoken to have stonewalled my every inquiry.  There are those amongst the Lost who were once our devoted brothers and sisters, and these leaders of the Covenant refuse to even acknowledge their existence. I have been ordered unceremoniously to return to my duties, and to speak no further on the subject. Adjudicator Roose even implied excommunication if I continued this direction of inquiry. Such an insult is nearly too much to bear. Is concern for my fellows now the crime of an apostate? Unthinkable!\n\nPerhaps it is simple hubris that drives such denials.  But I cannot help but suspect there is something more sinister afoot.  Someone must honor the sacrifice of our fallen comrades by uncovering the truth of their misfortune. If my actions provoke the wrath of these supposed superiors, so be it.
threefactions_body_01_03:
Since the time of my last writing, Templar Ambrose has begun acting strangely. His demeanor has shifted dramatically. He is confused, angry, volatile… as though his mind is fractured. I followed him on his journey to Great Cleave.

He confided in me just prior to his excommunication. He claimed he knew of members of the Covenant falling Lost, and lashed out at our leadership in rage. There were some in the leaders who demanded his removal, and he was declared apostate for his actions. Excommunication for attempting to help those in need? How far we have fallen…

His rage led him and others into the arms of the Corruption. The leadership must be warned of this cycle.
threefactions_body_01_04: They forced my hand. Roose, the leaders of the Covenant, all of them. They made me resort to this in vengeance for my son Bremen, and for all those self-righteous fools who failed him. He sought to help those in need by uncovering the truth, and so he was cast out. His reward for a good heart and a virtuous soul? Shame, isolation, and finally despair.\n\nI have heard their judgment, but I will not go quietly. I have chosen a different path. One that will demonstrate, especially to Roose, that there are consequences for such transgressions. The reward for their hubris shall be wrath, anguish, and finally ruin.
threefactions_body_01_05: My only friends assisted me. Sully "Rotgut" McLane and Morgan "Pimble" Garrison. Rotgut and Pimble told me they would handle things last I saw them.\n\nThey would handle the details. But something else was guiding my hand. An idol buried within the earth, it called out to me, deep within the recesses of my mind. I clutched every moment after I found it. All those around me must have heard it call out too, for they gazed upon me with malice. I could see the hate in their eyes. They were jealous that I had been chosen!
threefactions_body_01_06: The idol has changed me. Even now, I struggle to put ink to paper. But it must be written, my final testament as a human being with a will of my own! My mind is faltering. We heard the call of the Angry Earth, and I know that soon, it will be too strong to resist.\n\nI can barely hold out. The Spark is nothing compared to what stirs within me now. All its splendor seems so insignificant now. How shameful, that in my final moments, I should question my faith. I believe I will walk towards my favorite outlook and reflect in these last moments of clarity what it means, and what shall become of me when I return to the earth.
threefactions_body_02_01:
"Keep Faith"

Shall we rejoice? Humankind's oldest enemy is gone: Death is dead. We have reached the promised land...yet there are some who call it a false promise. 'This land seeks our ruin', they cry, but even more dangerous are the enemies within: moral weakness blinds us to the truth. Those who live in the dark can never recognize Paradise.

But where eyes fail, faith sees. The Covenant carries the Spark. In our time of need, the Spark carries us. Its clarity is our greatest gift. We bring the light of the Spark to the darkest corners. We keep it shining, at any cost, against any foe. And one day, it will shine bright enough to reveal Paradise itself.
threefactions_body_02_02:
"Reach Exceeding"

All worlds are bound by certain natural laws; a scientist's job is to know them. Thanks to Newton, we now know that the small echoes the large; the song of the spheres is the same tune as a falling apple. With the microscope came knowledge of invisible life, too small to see, yet all around us. These discoveries didn't change the world, because they have always been true. But they changed us, humankind. We have grown. Knowledge is transformative, creation's most powerful force.

There is so much we still don't know about Aeternum. Why don't people die? What animates the Lost? Who were the Ancients? We must ask questions to find answers. We have just scratched the surface of the secret depths this place holds. It must be studied and understood, regardless of the cost. And once we understand reality, we can start to improve it.

All rational beings are welcome in the Syndicate. Join us. Help us draw back the veil.
threefactions_body_02_03:
"No Barriers"

Let's keep this short. We're the Marauders. We don't make fancy speeches. We don't need preachy causes. The only thing we need is ourselves.

This island is stuffed with opportunities, for people of ambition. People who take what they want. Riches, power, respect. You want these things too, don't you? Everyone does. We're just honest enough to admit it.

Nothing is fair. Nothing has meaning outside the meaning you give it. Embrace it! We are the masters and mistresses of our domain!

It's a brutal world out there. Don't be a victim. Be a Marauder.
threefactions_body_04_01: The Ancients that dwelt within Tempestas Custodia are indigenous to this particular region, and yet reminiscent of those I observed within Brimstone Sands. They left behind something very peculiar: a tablet that records an Ancient manuscript.\n\nUnfortunately it is written in some impenetrable cipher, and the key must have been lost somewhere within these ruins, I suspect within the eastern wing. Given the secretive nature of our forebears, it is no doubt guarded by some devilish beast or horrifying construct. I will need help if it is to be retrieved, that the secrets of this priceless artifact may be decoded.
threefactions_body_05_01:
I don't remember why it was I was told to come here. But I remember Silas wanted me to take this amulet here to the Great Cleave. To deal with the Corruption.

I feel a strange pull surrounding it. I think that perhaps there is some connection to this area? It feels as though it wants to stay here. The whispers from it, they make my hair stand on end.

Why would Silas send me here to this place, with this amulet? It makes no sense.

I will complete my task, and defeat the Corrupted here as long as I can but I can't help but feel something foreboding.

tidebattle_body_01_01:
Even the snows fight us. It slows our march, and sinks its fangs into us, as if hungry to drain our warmth. It is a friend and ally to the Corrupted - the Corrupted use it as cover, hide in it, and strike without warning – we are only flesh, and while the isle may grant many of us a rebirth (or curse us), it does nothing to drive the cold from us. 

Frostbite has claimed many of us, and some of us have not the fingers to hold weapons, nor the strength to walk where the cold has eaten at their feet and toes. Several of us do not believe the Cleave is worth holding at this price, and many more believe that we have already lost to the Corrupted and the elements.

Still, we march. Still, we fight. I fear if we do not hold the Cleave, and we withdraw to warmer climes, we will be surrendering the heart of the isle to the Corrupted.

Yet we continue to fight, one and all.
tidebattle_body_01_02: The Bridge exposes us to the harshest wind, and many of us seek shelter behind the stone blocks. The watchmen at the bridge's end are not so fortunate – they must stare into the whipping wind and keep their eyes open to the threat of an attack – whether the frost wolves to the east, who are growing in number, or the incursions of Corrupted to the North. They must keep their eyes open, even when their lids are in danger of freezing solid.\n\nThe two Watchers draw straws to see who mans the East edge of the Bridge. For as terrible as an attack by the Corrupted might be, the shadow of the ancient temple there and the way the wolves seem drawn to it is unsettling, and adds further burden to a Watcher's heart.
tidebattle_body_01_03:
The Watchers on the western edge of the Bridge has reported of a new development – he claims to see silhouettes moving in the snows, out of gunshot and arrow range, moving in such small numbers as to be a waste of a target to our siege engines. Yet, he sees a few of these shapes a day – and there is no hint of their destination.

“I fear they are hiding in plain sight, digging beneath the snow,” one Watcher muttered by the fire. “If they were there, we wouldn't know it until their blades were at our throat.”

The other Watcher laughed, but without humor. “That would be a mercy, to be free from this hell.”

There are other hells, I thought. Earlier in the season, I had seen what had happened to one of our band of scouts, walking with the Corrupted, marching in pace with them – not as slaves, but as the Corrupted themselves. There are other hells - the cold is but one of them, and far from the worst.
tidebattle_body_01_04:
Soldiers are deserting. The gloom that consumed Wickbury was a blow to everyone, as was the sightings of what seemed to be priests leading the Corrupted. We were not fighting an army – we were fighting a crusade from the North. The loss of the Bridge only added to our woes, and many saw little to hold onto. “We cannot stop a tide that has already filled our flanks and now rises before us upon the Bridge. The battle will not be won here, we must retreat to Brightwood.”

The talk grows in the camps. In the times when we were united in purpose, any such talk would earn lashes – cruel, but perhaps necessary. But then again, that may be why the alliance fell. Hearts may harden across many deaths, until you feel little at all. After that, there lies little difference between the Corrupted and the soldiers.

If we do not fight the Corrupted, they will consume us. If we fight the Corrupted, they will consume us. Either way, the spirit is tested, and it can only be tested so far before it breaks.


-L.G., Acting Captain
tidebattle_body_01_05:
One of Rutherford's scouts returned – he was one of the ones who had drunk the Brightlake concoction, the one that gave strength to the spirit, and lessened the poison of the lands north of the Cleave. He had suffered, true, but he came to us in right mind, and – to our amazement – smiling.

“They're not just what we once were,” he said. “They're still like us. I've seen beyond the fortifications – they have farms. Towns. Even what might be a church, at the summit of the mountain!”

The men mumbled their surprise, but I was the first to speak in anger – I held my tongue, to give the man some moments of peace to enjoy his return, but his words angered me beyond all reason. I shall walk, collect my thoughts – this fool of a scout, he does not know the truth in what he saw.

If we have not yet lost this war, the sighting of the church has done so, whether the soldiers realize it or not.

-L.G., Acting Captain
tidebattle_body_01_06:
Rutherford's scout continued to speak as the night wore on, as if his words were intended to give hope – he prattled on, continuing on about the farms, the structures near the Shattered Mountain – the ‘civilization' in the North. When he spoke again of the church that he had seen, I could take no more.

“You saw a church,” I heard myself say. “Yet the Corrupted have no religion like any we know. You think this means they are to be reasoned with? That peace will be easier? A church only means we have a canyon wider than the Great Cleave between us – not physically, but in spirit. We know they do not seek to kill us. Do you welcome conversion to… to that?!”

I pointed at the crown of the Shattered Mountain, the isle torn from its foundation. “You think you bring words of hope, that we might make peace, but I tell you – in a single structure, you have given us proof that there will be no peace until we are all as they are, and all worship as they do.”

We are no match for the Corrupted if a twisted religion drives them. I had no patience to speak to the man further – I shall do question him again when I have calmed myself.

-L.G., Acting Captain
tidebattle_body_01_07:
The Rutherford scout, ashamed at my harsh words, did not boast further of his discoveries to the north, and the hope left his features. I felt no remorse in his newfound silence, for best he lose hope now and let truth guide his actions.

I interrogated him most thoroughly. He said that yes, he had seen remnants soldiers we had lost in the camps to the North. He had seen many things… not simply the foul church he had seen, brimming with red light, but the labor of the Corrupted, and worse… leaders. The Priests we had seen upon the Bridge were not unique – there were many, all serving whatever twisted religion led them.

We had already seen what they could do at the Bridge… at the Wickbury. And would likely do so again – to think they numbered more than the three we had seen – it is a dark thought.

-L.G., Acting Captain
tidebattle_body_01_08:
What almost broke me was when the returning scout spoke of the obelisks. Not the ones we'd seen to the South, not the ones common elsewhere in the isle. He saw others, larger ones, being excavated by the Corrupted. Worse, there were other obelisks already unearthed… but these obelisks, freed from the earth – and the scout paused at this, for I feel the import of his words was at last becoming clear to him – he said these obelisks seemed… alive, floating above cyst-like wells in the landscape – floating stones, like the one atop the mountain, harnessed by the Corrupted and their priests.

“Like they are making a claim,” I prompted. His eyes widened at that, and before he could express his confusion, I cut him off. “Not like ours. Never like ours. A claim that is their own, one that will consume this isle. And in coming here, by adding to their ranks – why we've shown them the way to destroy us.”

We must fallback to the Brightwood. Others must know of what we've found.

-L.G., Acting Captain
tidebattle_body_01_09:
We retreated into the forests, conserving our powder. We fell back on familiar trails, careful to strike at the Corrupted and then retreat before more came to its aid. When one of us fell, a soldier would stab a blade through the victim so that they might re-awaken faster and rejoin us at the front. The grudges among the soldiers grow, but in others, it becomes a curious competition, to stave off the most deaths – and for others, to quickly spill the blood of the fallen so they feel as little pain as possible and awaken, still ready to fight.

It is a field of madness. We fight the Corrupted who have our corrupted brothers and sisters among their number, who, too, seem reborn to fight – we slaughter them as we slaughter our own, all for gaining a few feet of ground, to briefly hold a slice of the Ancients road – to anoint this land and claim its Azoth with our blood.

When I stare at the Corrupted – the ones who bear tattered shreds of an age of a hundred years ago, or wear a rusted mask of a Conquisitador, I wonder if settlers ages past went through this cycle as well – and the only victory was in the corruption that spreads like the blood upon the snows.
tidebattle_body_01_10:
I ran into people from the South, where they still fight over wood and flint and timber – great matters to them, but their words, their actions almost sparked me to anger.

Did they not see who we fought? Did they not see the Withered and the Wraiths and the Corrupted as but the first symptoms of something far more terrible? 

Their eyes are filled with azoth – and in a terrible moment, it reminded me of the fire in the eyes of the Corrupted, the twisted red light that seemed to drive them to violence, that seemed to consume them.

And I wondered if perhaps the Corruption and the Azoth were both of the same well from which we drew.
timbert51_description: Ironwood that has been transmuted to be even stronger.
timbert53_description: An exceptionally strong plank that has desirable properties.
tinctureblightt2_description: Fully remove the Blight Affliction and gain minor resistance to it for a short time.
tinctureblightt3_description: Fully remove the Blight Affliction and gain moderate resistance to it for a short time.
tinctureblightt4_description: Fully remove the Blight Affliction and gain major resistance to it for a short time.
tinctureblightt5_description: Fully remove the Blight Affliction and gain maximum resistance to it for a short time.
tincturecorruptiont2_description: Fully remove the Corruption Affliction and gain minor resistance to it for a short time.
tincturecorruptiont3_description: Fully remove the Corruption Affliction and gain moderate resistance to it for a short time.
tincturecorruptiont4_description: Fully remove the Corruption Affliction and gain major resistance to it for a short time.
tincturecorruptiont5_description: Fully remove the Corruption Affliction and gain maximum resistance to it for a short time.
tincturefreezingt2_description: Recover 60 Frostbite Resistance. Slightly increases resistance to Frostbite for a short time.
tincturefreezingt3_description: Recover 60 Frostbite Resistance. Moderately increases resistance to Frostbite for a short time.
tincturefreezingt4_description: Recover 60 Frostbite Resistance. Significantly increases resistance to Frostbite for a short time.
tincturefreezingt5_description: Recover 60 Frostbite Resistance. Provides maximum resistance to Frostbite for a short time.
tip_catacombs_general01-content: Grouping up in Catacombs will give the biggest yield!
tip_catacombs_general02-content: Bosses are often just after a challenge
tip_catacombs_general03-content: Dodging and blocking will prevent Erosion
tip_dungeon_amrineexcavation_bosstip01-c: If anyone tries to escape Foreman Nakashima's chain prison, all players in the area of effect will be stunned.
tip_dungeon_amrineexcavation_bosstip01-t: You're Stuck in Here With ME!
tip_dungeon_amrineexcavation_bosstip02-c: Simon will attempt to devour low health minions to empower himself.
tip_dungeon_amrineexcavation_bosstip03-c: Simon's minions consume his spew pools to empower themselves, but all that bile damages them over time.
tip_dungeon_barnacles_general01-content: When Admiral BlackPowder escapes to the upper deck, load the cannons with cannonballs and fire them at the Admiral to get him back in the fight.
tip_dungeon_barnacles_general02-content: Watch out! If you touch cursed treasure, you will be damaged and slowed.
tip_dungeon_barnacles_general03-content: Tanks should face Nereid away from the group to prevent the rest of the party from being hit by her Lunge and Water Wave abilities.
tip_dungeon_dynastyshipyard_bosstip01-co: The Tempest's tigers, Joven and Oro, each apply a different negative status effect. Pull them apart to avoid the effects being applied to the same target.
tip_dungeon_dynastyshipyard_bosstip02-co: Though she maintains that she has the Dragons' favor, the Empress' reliance on Corruption has warped her dragons into an unrecognizable state.
tip_dungeon_empyreanforge_general01-cont: The Azoth-powered locks of the Empyrean Forge will reconfigure their combinations each time their mechanisms are activated, so try not to move while your allies enter the combination!
tip_dungeon_empyreanforge_general02-cont: The Forge's massive Azoth Pistons spell certain death for anyone who steps underneath one.  Wait for the piston to fall, then run under it while it's rising to stay safe.
tip_dungeon_empyreanforge_general03-cont: When all else fails, you can go prone to avoid Ifrit's fireball barrage.  Just don't try it while Ifrit is breathing fire.
tip_dungeon_empyreanforge_general04-cont: While fighting Commander Marius, flaming balls of lava rock will fall from the sky.  These boulders always fall in a specific order.
tip_dungeon_empyreanforge_general04-titl: Cloudy with a Chance of Marius
tip_dungeon_ennead_general01-content: The power of the Ennead prevents Anpu and Heru from being defeated so long as one still remains. Try to divide your efforts between Anpu and Heru so they can be taken down at the same time!
tip_dungeon_ennead_general02-content: When facing Godling Khepri Supernal, use the pillars of the Ennead to avoid his Ancient Sun Beams.
tip_dungeon_ennead_general03-content: When General Crassus summons his Corrupted Cyclopes, keep your focus on defeating him!
tip_dungeon_gardenofgenesis_bosstip01-co: Alluvium Marl's Root Arena summons minions along the outside, split your team efficiently or be prepared for a large wave of extra enemies.
tip_dungeon_gardenofgenesis_bosstip02-co: Taxodius will pull the furthest player towards it. If you see it pointing at you, run!
tip_dungeon_general_respawn01-content: You can only be revived so many times in Expeditions before having to respawn. Be careful!
tip_dungeon_lazarusinstrumentality_bosst: Cilla's Ancient Might buff greatly increases her physical damage and can be purged by enticing her with arcane pools.
tip_dungeon_lazarusinstrumentality_lore0: The Ancients created more than just the skeletal Guardians, such as the Constructs: living automatons of rock and stone, of which Chardis is the greatest example.
tip_dungeon_savagedivide_general01-conte: Adventurers carrying Ancient Orbs cannot defend themselves. Don't forget to help your friends!
tip_dungeon_savagedivide_general02-conte: Kurok and Mahantaram wield the power of the elements against their foes. Be ready for anything!
tip_dungeon_savagedivide_general03-conte: Beasts are weak to Thrust damage. Don't forget to bring Coatings and Ward Potions!
tip_dungeon_shatteredobelisk_bosstip01-c: During Greundgul the Regent’s Leaping Attack, her eye will glow red. Strike it, and the boss will be stunned for a short time.
tip_dungeon_tempestsheart_general01-cont: Keep an eye out for Antiquated Coffers on your journey throughout Tempest's Heart. Find them all and return their contents to the statues in the City of Darkness for bonus treasure.
tip_dungeon_tempestsheart_general02-cont: The carrier of the Reliquary provides an area of protection against the corruption while dealing significant damage to foes. Use it to safely cross the Sea of Corruption.
tip_dungeon_tempestsheart_general03-cont: When Isabella summons a Monolith, don't go near the Monolith until the corrupted vines spinning around it have disappeared. Then use your Azoth Staff to destroy it.
tip_dungeon_thedepths_bosstip01-content: The Archdeacon's mines can be destroyed before they explode. Your healer will thank you.
tip_elitestrongholds_general01-content: Prepare yourself before entering an Elite Stronghold. And definitely bring friends!
tip_elitestrongholds_general02-content: Elite Chests can only be claimed once per day.
tip_elitestrongholds_general03-content: Elite Strongholds are some of the toughest challenges in Aeternum. Good luck!
tip_elitestrongholds_general04-content: It's wise to place a Camp before entering an Elite Stronghold. You won't regret it.
tip_invasion_specific01-content: The Corrupted Army will attack the fort in waves, with each successive wave becoming stronger.
tip_invasion_specific02-content: The Corrupted Army will try to knock down the gates and take a control point within the fort. If players successfully defend the claim point from invasion, they will win.
tip_invasion_specific03-content: As the war goes on, there will be longer and longer Respawn waves. When soldiers are killed, they will Respawn in the next Respawn wave.
tip_invasion_specific04-content: Players earn Battle Tokens by damaging their enemies. With Battle Tokens, players can purchase various items from Armory.
tip_outpostrush_general01-content: Capture outposts and slay the enemy to score points. First team to 1000 points wins!
tip_outpostrush_general02-content: Gather infused wood, ore, and hides to upgrade your outposts by building gates and siege weapons. Build a command post to gain powerful offensive and defensive boosts for your team.
tip_outpostrush_general03-content: Use summoning stones to summon powerful allies at summoning circles. Defeat key enemies to acquire Bear and Specter summons or gain an ultra-powerful Brute ally by clearing the corrupted portal.
tip_outpostrush_general04-content: Baroness Hain is the ghost of a long dead noble that haunts the island. Slay her to gain a powerful buff that increases the defense of your team and freezes the enemy score!
tip_overworld_aeternumfactions_theancien: The origin of the Ancients and any knowledge of their civilization has been lost to dusty memory. All that remains are relics: crumbled monuments, ruins of cities, and legions of skeletal warriors.
Ancient Guardians are weak to Strike, Lightning, and Void damage.
tip_overworld_aeternumfactions_theangrye: The intermingling of Azoth and nature is most evident in the Angry Earth - a variety of plant-like creatures so named for their fierce guardianship of the wilderness of Aeternum.
Angry Earth are weak to Slash and Fire damage.
tip_overworld_aeternumfactions_thecorrup: The Corrupted serve as the immortal thralls of an ancient and unknowable force that warps all within its reach.
Corrupted are weak to Thrust, Arcane, and Nature damage.
tip_overworld_aeternumfactions_thelost01: The Lost are proof that eternal existence is not the same as fairy-tale immortality. For some, it comes at a terrible price. People become Lost through endless cycles of death and rebirth that wither their souls until there's nothing left.
tip_overworld_aeternumfactions_thelost02: Lost are weak to Strike, Ice, and Nature damage.
tip_overworld_azoth_acquirefrom01-conten: The most reliable sources for acquiring Azoth are completing Quests and closing Corruption Breaches.
tip_overworld_azoth_acquirefrom02-conten: You'll rarely collect Azoth from defeating enemies, but the likelihood can be increased with certain item perks.
tip_overworld_camping_respawn01-content: Place a Camp near important places. You can then Respawn there in case of an unfortunate death.
tip_overworld_camping_respawn02-content: Camps have a limited range in which you can Respawn. If a Camp Icon turns Red that means you've traveled too far away and won't be able to Respawn there.
tip_overworld_camping_upgrades01-content: You can unlock upgrades to your Camp at Levels 15, 25, 40, and 55.
tip_overworld_combat_ai01-content: Enemies in the world will retreat and become temporarily invulnerable if they are led too far from home or cannot reach you.
tip_overworld_combat_attributes01-conten: Attribute Respecs are free until you are Level 60. Take advantage of this time to figure out where you want your Points to go, and avoid costly Respecs in the future!
tip_overworld_combat_bow01-content: While in Aim Mode with the bow, you can Charge Up your shot by holding the attack button.
tip_overworld_combat_damagenumbers01-con: If your Damage Numbers are Blue , the enemy has resistance to your Damage Type. Try using another weapon to deal more damage!
tip_overworld_combat_damagenumbers02-con: Strong attacks are Yellow and deal more damage. Weak attacks are Blue and deal less damage. Both are determined by your physical or elemental damage type.
tip_overworld_combat_damagetypes01-conte: There are 3 physical damage types: Slash, Thrust, and Strike. Find out which damage type is best against your enemies.
tip_overworld_combat_damagetypes02-conte: There are 6 elemental damage types: Arcane, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Nature, and Void. Use gems to add elemental damage to your weapons.
tip_overworld_combat_damagetypes03-conte: Gems which convert damage to elemental damage cannot be placed into weapons that deal that damage by default. For example, a Ruby cannot be added to a Fire Staff.
tip_overworld_combat_duels01-content: There's no penalty for losing a Duel so don't be afraid to take on all challengers!
tip_overworld_combat_duels02-content: Duels cannot be started inside a settlement.
tip_overworld_combat_firestaff01-content: The Fire Staff can be utilized for large Crowd Control or stacking Burn Statuses to a devastating effect.
tip_overworld_combat_greataxe01-content: The Great Axe is excellent for controlling smaller fights, with options for both damaging enemy groups or pulling heavy hitters away from teammates.
tip_overworld_combat_grit01-content: If an attacking character glows White, only Crowd Control Status Effects (Slow, Root, and Stun) can interrupt them.
tip_overworld_combat_hatchet01-content: For the best defense, combine Uninterruptible Berserk and Defy Death to force your way through enemies, and then recover with Berserking Refresh!
tip_overworld_combat_icegaunlet01-conten: The Ice Gauntlet is excellent at hindering enemy progression. Use its Slowing Effects to gain better positioning or give teammates an opening to do more damage.
tip_overworld_combat_lifestaff01-content: If there are no allies around, you can always use Orb of Protection at your feet to Buff yourself.
tip_overworld_combat_musket01-content: Musket shots will penetrate multiple enemies in the line of fire.
tip_overworld_combat_npcnameplates01-con: If the enemy has a Skull over their health bar, don't engage! This indicates a level and difficulty much higher than yours. Aeternum does not show mercy.
tip_overworld_combat_pvpflagging01-conte: You can turn your PvP flag on and off at Sanctuaries including Settlements, Outposts, Watchtowers, and at Spirit Shrines.
tip_overworld_combat_pvpflagging02-conte: Before leaving a Territory, be sure to double-check if you're Flagged for PVP!
tip_overworld_combat_rapier01-content: The Rapier's speedy cuts pair well with other Intelligence-based weapons, such as Staves and Gauntlets.
tip_overworld_combat_spear01-content: The Spear's Zoning Abilities and Dexterity-based scaling make it a great pairing for Ranged Weapons.
tip_overworld_combat_swordandshield01-co: Shield perks are only active if the shield is unsheathed.
tip_overworld_combat_voidgaunlet01-conte: The Void Gauntlet's numerous Buffs and Debuffs make it very effective in group combat.
tip_overworld_combat_warhammer01-content: The War Hammer deals Strike damage, which is effective against Ancients and Lost.
tip_overworld_combat_weaponcoatings01-co: Weapon Coatings are powerful, short-term buffs that you apply to a weapon to give yourself an advantage against a certain family of enemies, such as the Corrupted or the Ancients. Coatings work on ranged and magical weapons too!
tip_overworld_combat_weaponmastery01-con: Defeating an enemy with 2 different weapons will grant half of the Weapon Mastery points to both of those weapons.
tip_overworld_combat_weaponmastery02-con: Weapon Mastery Respecs are free until you reach Level 10 with that weapon. Find out what works best for you.
tip_overworld_company_benefits01-content: Join a Company and fight alongside your friends against the Corrupted and siege opposing Faction Territories.
tip_overworld_company_benefits02-content: Only Companies can declare war and siege Territories to take them over. As Governor of a Territory, your Company earns coin through upkeep, gets huge discounts on Fast Travel, and contributes to the success of your whole Faction.
tip_overworld_company_benefits03-content: Communicate and Group up easily with company members. See when members were last online and get access to a shared amount of Coin in the Company Treasury.
tip_overworld_crafting_azoth01-content: The top-end of the potential Gear Score range for a crafted item increases as your Trade Skill increases. This allows you to add more Azoth to improve your crafting.
tip_overworld_crafting_consumables01-con: Food isn’t just for recovering after a fight! There are foods that increase your chances of getting rare crafting materials and foods that improve your crafting skill as well.
tip_overworld_crafting_gypsum01-content: Craft a Topaz Gypsum Attunement Potion at any Arcana Station or Tier 5 Camp. When attuned, you can earn Topaz Gypsum as a random drop from Level 55+ enemies.
tip_overworld_crafting_materials01-conte: When crafting equipment, you can use higher-tier secondary materials to improve the item’s gear score. The higher the tier of the secondary resource, the more its gear score is improved!
tip_overworld_crafting_materials02-conte: When crafting Consumables, you can use higher-tier ingredients to increase your chances of getting additional items from that craft. The higher the tier of the ingredients, the better chances you have!
tip_overworld_crafting_materials03-conte: Looking for specific ingredients for a Recipe? Pin the Recipe to track it.
tip_overworld_crafting_perks01-content: If you want to see all existing Perks in the game, go to a Trading Post and choose "Select Perks" in the Browse tab.
tip_overworld_crafting_skill01-content: Skilled Arcanists can also craft powerful Potions that can save your life in a tough fight!
tip_overworld_crafting_skill02-content: Each skill that crafts equipment can also craft a unique consumable with powerful effects.
tip_overworld_crafting_skill03-content: Trophies are items crafted by Furnishers that can give powerful Buffs when placed in your House.
tip_overworld_equipment_damage01-content: Equipped items take damage on use and on death.
tip_overworld_equipment_dyes01-content: Dye can be applied to different parts of each item. Make sure you try out different combinations before committing to a color scheme.
tip_overworld_equipment_encumbered01-con: Items you have equipped do not count against your overall carry Weight. Use this to your advantage while hauling that last bit of Iron Ore back to the Settlement.
tip_overworld_equipment_equipmentload01-: Your Equipment Load determines how you will Dodge. A LIGHT Equipment Load will allow you to roll out of danger when Dodging.
tip_overworld_equipment_gems01-content: Want to tank? Socket a Carnelian Gem into a weapon to unlock Taunts on some abilities.
tip_overworld_equipment_lockingitems01-c: Prevent items from being salvaged by selecting the item in your Inventory and choosing "Lock."
tip_overworld_equipment_rarity01-content: Items with higher rarity generally have special effects or gem sockets. Make sure to weigh all the benefits and not just gear score.
tip_overworld_equipment_skins01-content: To equip a skin, select a weapon or piece of armor in your Inventory and choose the "Change Skin" option.
tip_overworld_equipment_storage01-conten: Crafting in a Settlement can pull resources from Inventory or Storage.
tip_overworld_factions_benefits01-conten: Join a Faction to flag for PVP, control Territory, and participate in Wars.
tip_overworld_factions_benefits02-conten: Every settlement has a unique item cart in it. Visit a settlement controlled by your faction to claim free items. Be sure to check back regularly!
tip_overworld_factions_bonus01-content: Earn Bonus Rewards from the first 3 Faction Missions you complete each day!
tip_overworld_factions_currency01-conten: Faction Representatives sell reliable Armor and Weapons. Consider purchasing some if you're looking for something specific.
tip_overworld_factions_huntmissions01-co: Hunting Missions show you where to start, but a good hunter will explore the surrounding area in search of prey.
tip_overworld_factions_pvemissions01-con: Complete PvE Missions to increase your Faction Reputation, increase your XP, and earn access to better Faction Gear.
tip_overworld_factions_pvpmissions01-con: Some PvP Missions will be Reset if you die while they're in progress. Turn in finished PvP Missions as soon as you can to guarantee Rewards for you and your Faction!
tip_overworld_factions_types01-content: Clever disciples who fight with cunning for the sake of truth and progress.
tip_overworld_factions_types02-content: Proud warriors who fight with honor for glory and self-improvement.
tip_overworld_factions_types03-content: Divine champions who fight with conviction for righteousness and justice.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems01-conten: Get Fish Filets and other bounty from Salvaging your fish.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems02-conten: Some Legendary Fish can be used to decorate your House.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems03-conten: Some Legendary Fish can be used to craft a Fishing Trophy.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems04-conten: Some Legendary Fish can be used to make Attribute Bonus Food.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems05-conten: Oysters, Clams, Snails, and Electric Eels can be Salvaged into Bait.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems06-conten: Fish filet can be obtained by salvaging most common fish.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems07-conten: Firm Fish Filet can be obtained by Salvaging most uncommon fish.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems08-conten: Tender Fish Filet can be obtained by Salvaging some rare fish like Paddlefish, Swordfish, and Speartooth Shark.
tip_overworld_fishing_fishitems09-conten: Delicate Fish Filet can be obtained by Salvaging Electric Eels and Swordfish.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots01-content: When fish are jumping from a hotspot, it is active and will allow you to catch rare fish more often. Hotspots without jumping fish need time to replenish.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots02-content: Hotspots are the best place to catch rarer fish. They increase your odds considerably.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots03-content: No bites? If you're having trouble catching fish, then try finding some water. Fish don't live on land.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots04-content: Hotspots come in three categories: Broad, Rare, and Secret. Secret Hotspots offer the chance to catch the rarest fish, but they deplete the quickest.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots05-content: As your Fishing Level rises, more Hotspots become available for discovery.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots06-content: You must have a high enough Fishing Level to discover hotspots.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots07-content: Fishing in active hotspots will get you bites almost immediately.
tip_overworld_fishing_hotspots08-content: Different hotspots offer different fish to catch depending on the Territory and water type.
tip_overworld_fishing_mechanics01-conten: It is easier to overcome a fighting fish with a longer cast.
tip_overworld_fishing_mechanics02-conten: A longer cast can be reeled in quicker, making fish easier to beat.
tip_overworld_fishing_mechanics03-conten: Larger or rarer fish are more likely to put up a fight.
tip_overworld_fishing_mechanics04-conten: Any Bait will decrease the time taken to get bites.
tip_overworld_fishing_poles01-content: Better fishing poles have faster line tension recovery and increased chance of catching rarer fish.
tip_overworld_fishing_poles02-content: Equip the Fishing Pole into the Inventory Tool Slot to use it.
tip_overworld_fishing_progression01-cont: As your Fishing Level rises, you will be able to cast further.
tip_overworld_fishing_progression02-cont: Find Perronelle le Noir to start the Fishing Quests.
tip_overworld_fishing_progression03-cont: Win Fishing Armor by completing the Fishing Quests.
tip_overworld_fishing_progression04-cont: Every time you hook or catch a fish you get Fishing XP, which helps advance your Fishing Level.
tip_overworld_fishing_water01-content: Fish bite more often in deeper water!
tip_overworld_fishing_water02-content: Different fish can be found in salt water versus fresh water. If you can collect it, it means it is fresh water.
tip_overworld_fishing_water03-content: Each Territory contains a unique Legendary Fish.
tip_overworld_fishing_water04-content: Most fish are native to particular Territories, except Salmon and Pike which can be found all over.
tip_overworld_gamemodes_arenakeys01-cont: Have you found one yet? A Trial is an event where you and your friends fight a deadly, legendary creature.
tip_overworld_gamemodes_outpostrush01-co: You can queue for Outpost Rush at your Faction Representative or in the Modes menu.
tip_overworld_housing_benefits01-content: There are 4 tiers of Houses you can purchase. Each improves your Fast Travel cooldown, Max Storage placement, and total Furniture placement.
tip_overworld_housing_benefits02-content: Trophies you place in your House give you benefits all over the island, not just in the Territory the House is in.
tip_overworld_housing_benefits03-content: You can Fast Travel to your House for free, once every few hours, by selecting your house icon on the Map. The higher tier the House, the lower the cooldown is.
tip_overworld_housing_buffs01-content: You can only place 5 different types of Trophies in each House you own. 15 total if you own 3 Houses.
tip_overworld_housing_buffs02-content: You cannot place more than 1 of the same type of Trophy in your House, but you can place 1 of the same type of Trophy in each of your 3 Houses. The Bonuses stack if you do!
tip_overworld_housing_buffs03-content: You can view what Housing Trophy Buffs you have active in your Character Bio page.
tip_overworld_housing_ownership01-conten: You can only own 1 House in a Territory at a time.
tip_overworld_housing_ownership02-conten: You can own up to 3 houses in the world if you meet the Level, Territory, and Coin requirements.
tip_overworld_housing_ownership03-conten: You can get a discount on your first house.
tip_overworld_housing_ownership04-conten: Not all houses are the same. Some are more spacious than others which increases their tier. These houses require a higher standing in that Territory and will cost more gold.
tip_overworld_housing_ownership05-conten: Owning a house has perks, but only if you pay your upkeep. If upkeep is due, you will no longer be able to enjoy Fast Travel or trophy buffs until they are paid.
tip_overworld_housing_score01-content: Place your Furniture and Decorations in your House carefully to gain points in your Decoration Score. With skill and luck, your house might be chosen to be on display to the whole Settlement.
tip_overworld_housing_score02-content: Want to up the curb appeal of your House? Place more items in it, then complete Missions and defeat monsters in the Territory your House is in. Rarer Furnishings cause your curb appeal to increase faster.
tip_overworld_housing_storage01-content: You can place 1-4 Chests in each House, depending on the House tier. Each increases your Max Settlement Storage for the Territory that House is in. The rarer the Storage Chest, the more it increases.
tip_overworld_housing_storage02-content: Any Furniture you 'Pick Up' in your home goes into your Settlement Storage for that Territory, instead of your Inventory.
tip_overworld_housing_storage03-content: All Furniture in a House goes into your Settlement Storage for that Territory when you abandon it.
tip_overworld_misc_general01-content: Remember to take a break when you've been playing New World: Aeternum continuously for a long period of time.
tip_overworld_misc_general02-content: Take screenshots and hide your UI to get the most out of the scenery.
tip_overworld_misc_general03-content: If you're exploring and become stuck, you can free yourself by either typing "/stuck" or selecting "Unstuck" from the Game Menu.
tip_overworld_misc_general03-title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
tip_overworld_misc_general04-content: Nothing to say? Use Emotes to express yourself.
tip_overworld_movement_compass01-content: Increasing certain Trade Skills will unlock higher levels of Resource Tracking on your Compass.
tip_overworld_movement_crouchandprone01-: Lying prone or crouching in vegetation will make it significantly harder for enemy players to see your nameplate.
tip_overworld_movement_fasttravel01-cont: Visit Settlements and Spirit Shrines to expand the network of locations to which you can Fast Travel.
tip_overworld_movement_lore01-content: Feed your head! Reading Lore Pages on Aeternum awards XP!
tip_overworld_movement_map01-content: If you're headed somewhere specific, open the map to place a waypoint at your destination. This will appear on the compass to help guide you.
tip_overworld_movement_shrines01-content: If you follow the tall, blue pillars of light, you'll likely discover a Spirit Shrine.
tip_overworld_pings_contextualpings01-co: Quick pings are contextual. Pinging the environment, PvP enemies, or loot will ping "Moving Here", "Danger Here", and "Loot Here".
tip_overworld_pings_pingonmappings01-con: Did you know you can ping directly on your map? Try setting a ping by opening the Ping Wheel.
tip_overworld_pings_pingwheel01-content: Open the Ping Wheel for more ping types.
tip_overworld_pings_targetmarking01-cont: You can mark NPC targets by pinging while they are under your reticle.
tip_overworld_pvprewardstrack_general01-: The player who commits the killing blow will be awarded PvP XP and Azoth Salt.
tip_overworld_pvprewardstrack_general02-: A PvP victim must have been flagged for at least 10 minutes to be worth anything to kill. This scales up the longer they are flagged.
tip_overworld_pvprewardstrack_general03-: PvP XP and Azoth Salt are awarded for overall performance in Outpost Rush or War.
tip_overworld_pvprewardstrack_general04-: Earning XP while flagged will reward Azoth Salt at set intervals.
tip_overworld_quests_quests01-content: Revisit your Map regularly to discover if any new Quests have become available.
tip_overworld_quests_quests02-content: Always check before heading out to a distant location to see if any Spirit Shrines can hasten your journey.
tip_overworld_quests_quests03-content: Main Story Quests will always appear at the top of your Journal.
tip_overworld_quests_quests04-content: The best Rewards are generally earned by completing the Final Quests in a chain in each Territory.
tip_overworld_quests_quests05-content: It is easy to stay busy on Aeternum. You can use the Main Story section in the Journal to keep up with your next steps.
tip_overworld_quests_quests06-content: Every day you will receive Bonus Rewards for the first 3 Faction Missions you complete!
tip_overworld_quests_quests07-content: Each Faction has 6 Ranks to climb. Earn Renown from Faction Missions and complete the trial assigned to you to earn glory for your Faction!
tip_overworld_quests_quests08-content: Camp Tier is increased at Levels 15, 25, 40, and 55.
tip_overworld_social_donotdisturb01-cont: Prevent social interactions by turning on "Do Not Disturb" in the settings menu or using the shortcut "/dnd".
tip_overworld_social_p2ptrading01-conten: Trade items with other players by selecting "Trade" in their social menu.
tip_overworld_tradingpost_orders01-conte: Trading Post Listing Fees are much lower for shorter duration sales and higher for longer sales.
tip_overworld_tradingpost_orders02-conte: You can select specific perks for buy orders in the Trading Post.
tip_overworld_tradingpost_orders03-conte: To place a Buy Order in the Trading Post, search for the item you want and create a Custom Order.
tip_overworld_tradingpost_orders04-conte: Sharpen your Trading Post discoveries by drilling into the item's listings and using item searches.
tip_overworld_tradingpost_orders05-conte: You can view listings from all Trading Posts by changing your view to "All Settlements".
tip_overworld_zone_brightwood_elitestron: Archminister Havelock and his family have made their home at the manor atop Brightwood Isle.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore01-cont: The harsh, bitter sun of Brimstone Sands requires proper protection to survive.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore02-cont: The Ancients’ language was lost to the sands of time. Until now...
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore03-cont: A monstrous behemoth has awakened in the desert. Local legends refer to it as “The Devourer.”
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore04-cont: It is said that Ancients conducted rituals deep inside the heart of a massive wall built between Brimstone Sands and Shattered Mountain.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore05-cont: Crassus and his Corrupted 19th Legion are an eternal threat to the safety and stability of New Corsica.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore06-cont: One of the oldest living humans on Aeternum, Imhotep the Wise, is said to wander the deserts in search of knowledge.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore07-cont: Tread cautiously when navigating the sulfur pools of Brimstone Sands. If the giant lizards don't get you, the boiling, burning water most certainly will...
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore08-cont: Sandstone is plentiful in Brimstone Sands, and can be smelted into glass items.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore09-cont: Thirsty? Try cutting down a Cactus for small amounts of Water.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore10-cont: No one knows how Armadillos got to Brimstone Sands, but they seem to be thriving nonetheless.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore11-cont: A great tree has somehow flourished in the middle of Brimstone Sands. Some even say that the tree still blooms high in its branches.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore12-cont: Some believe that a deadly manticore stalks the sands of Brimstone so travel with care…
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore13-cont: Legends say that an Ancient lies sleeping somewhere in Brimstone Sands.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore14-cont: The massive scorpions that prowl the desert have more weapons than mere pincers and claws.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore15-cont: Ancient Glyphs are the key to unlocking chests, exploring sealed ruins, and much more. How many can you find?
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore16-cont: Would-be tomb robbers beware: the restless dead sometimes guard their earthly treasures.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore17-cont: Some of the Anubian constructs that prowl Brimstone Sands can be mined for resources.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore18-cont: New Corsica’s gilded facade conceals a viper’s nest of politics, intrigue, and paranoia.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore19-cont: The Legionnaires of Brimstone Sands have lost none of their legendary discipline and fighting skill despite becoming Corrupted.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore20-cont: Marc Antony founded the 19th “Seaborne” Legion, though they could not save him from ruin at the Battle of Actium.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore21-cont: The dying Queen Cleopatra was brought to Brimstone Sands by the Romans who sought to save her life.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore22-cont: Soulwardens are rare in Brimstone Sands. But with Ancients and Corruption both stirring, that may soon change.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore23-cont: There are legends of mysterious, shape-changing spirits known as ifrit that haunt the wastes of the desert. Some can be bargained with.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore24-cont: If you hear a familiar voice calling from the darkness of the wastelands do not approach.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore25-cont: Twisted abominations have begun appearing in Brimstone Sands. The products of some Ancient sorcery.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore26-cont: Brimstone Sands has had two great civilizations shape the land over the millennia: the Egyptians and the Romans.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore27-cont: The Anubian Ancients are far more robust than the dusty skeletons that guard other Ancient ruins. Approach with caution.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore28-cont: The circular stone gates scattered across Brimstone Sands are magical as well as magnificent.
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore29-cont: Vast streams of azoth flow through the Great Pyramid of Akhet. Hopefully, such power will never be turned to nefarious purposes...
tip_overworld_zone_brimstone_lore30-cont: The Angry Earth of Brimstone Sands have no fear of fire and often employ burning sulfur to destroy their foes.
tip_overworld_zone_cutlasskeys_elitestro: Goldstein the Equalizer rules the Isle of Cayo De La Muerte from her throne at Stone Skull Fort.
tip_overworld_zone_ebonscale_elitestrong: When the Empress first laid eyes on Borvarn, she completely forgot about her other pet Daisy.
tip_overworld_zone_ebonscale_lore01-cont: Soon after the Taiying Empress began settling the area, there was a series of floods.
tip_overworld_zone_ebonscale_lore02-cont: Empress Zhou Taiying fled from her brother Shang Wu's usurping of her throne in China and washed up in Aeternum.
tip_overworld_zone_firstlight_lore01-con: The spectral crew of La Esperanza haunt the coastal waters of Aeternum as punishment for attempting to escape the island.
tip_overworld_zone_firstlight_lore02-con: Locals believe a powerful, benevolent entity dwells in the deep and protects the fishermen who offer her gifts.
tip_overworld_zone_greatcleave_elitestro: This road is the first of many tests of strength on the path up the Mangled Heights.
Old Myrkgard Forest once spanned from the Cleave to the city of Myrkgard, but has now diminished in the presence of Corruption.
Foul rituals are conducted here, including the anointing of Corruption's priesthood.
The Balebane Maw is a protective membrane created by High Priest Oseguera many years ago.
High Priest Oseguera conducts the foulest of rituals at the Temple of Severed Visage, which is located at the peak of Mangled Heights.
tip_overworld_zone_monarchsbluff_elitest: Tortured Electrogeists roam Deadman's Cove at night. Take extra caution, or visit during the day when it's safer.
tip_overworld_zone_monarchsbluff_lore01-: Only legends remain of an apparent "High King" who once sought to unify all Aeternum under his rule.
tip_overworld_zone_mourningdale_elitestr: Stray too far from the path, and you risk being lost to Corruption's tendrils.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore01-con: Bring a Fire Staff or a Ruby-socketed Weapon when venturing into spider caves. You won't regret it.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore02-con: Craft a Potion of Fool's Sight at a nearby Arcana station to see invisible secrets all throughout Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore03-con: The Arcana Cards are an old form of Ancient Magic. Find them hidden in secret places all over Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore04-con: Annyru the Fortune Mother has traveled all throughout Nighthaven, and left behind caches of supplies for those who know the secret ways.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore05-con: The Berlaur are a mighty force, but their recent exposure to a new form of golden Azoth has rendered some of them rabid.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore06-con: The Cursed Trees of the Dunwood seep golden Azoth sap, a substance toxic to local wildlife.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore07-con: You can find Sorrowthorn growing from the splitting vines and thorned rows of weeds that grow out from the roots of the Dunwood.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore08-con: Collect all 24 Arcana Cards and you'll have unlimited access to the treasures of Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore09-con: The Grand Carnival operates in quiet opposition to those in power. Their Ancient Magic has kept them safe for centuries.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore10-con: The Tarot Towers of Nighthaven feed on your memories, fears, dreams, and desires. The weak-minded should beware.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore11-con: The Royal City-State of Durevos is the grand capital and crown jewel of Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore12-con: Castle chandeliers can sometimes break and crash on the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore13-con: The Moonflower Prismabloom, a rare dye resource, only spawns at night in Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore14-con: The Upyr and Berlaur factions vie for control in Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore15-con: Visit Tularest to trade with locals and learn more about the ongoing conflict between Upyr and Berlaur.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore16-con: A great Clock looms over Nighthaven - a testament to the power of its immortal ruler.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore17-con: The Clocktower's bells mark the passage of time in Nighthaven - listen for their ominous toll.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore18-con: Spider silk can be gathered from the dangerous spider caves scattered throughout Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore19-con: The Inquisitors still wage their ancient battle against the dark forces of Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore20-con: Varlaam Library holds the brightest memories of forgotten souls.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore21-con: Explore the catacombs beneath Nighthaven to uncover ancient secrets and valuable treasures.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore22-con: The Archivist distills memories in Varlaam Library - seek them out to learn forgotten tales.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore23-con: The forests of Nighthaven hold many dangers - beware the cursed Werebeasts that lurk within.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore24-con: Many books hide in waiting in the darkest corners of Nighthaven. Read them all, and learn the fates of sad and worried souls.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore25-con: Legend says the Fortune Mother stole the final Arcana card from the King and hid it in a distant, secret place.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore26-con: The secrets of Nighthaven are myriad.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore27-con: Have you drank a Potion of Fool's Sight? You might be surprised at what you see.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore28-con: The Spider Queen Uttu holds court at the crown of Esagila. Uttu is a Beast Lord, and the sole progenitor of all spiders in Aeternum.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore29-con: Throwable torches may be found scattered around Nighthaven. Grab one and toss it for a fiery display of power!
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore30-con: The Great Houses of Nighthaven are Varlaam, Carmilla, and Bathory. Rumors speak of a fourth House, but they're unsubstantiated.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore31-con: Pumpkins, sunflowers, and apple orchards are the main export of Nighthaven agriculture.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore32-con: Black feathers are considered an ill omen by those who are ignorant.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore33-con: A powerful card reader threatened the King, so the King killed him. But the magic cards kept him barely alive.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore34-con: A forgotten Great House lies cursed beneath Understone, destroyed by the King.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore35-con: A dozen evil and twisted things scratch and squeak in the dungeons and sewers of every castle.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore36-con: A foul and wretched darkness hides beneath the soil of Nighthaven.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore37-con: Nighthaven's graveyards are famous for their screaming spirits and the valuable spirit-infused dirt that covers the restless dead.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore38-con: Graveyard dirt can be dug up with a shovel. But why would you ever?
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore39-con: Golden apples are a divine fruit, rare and blessed, that grow on Apple Trees.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore40-con: Have you bitten into a Golden Apple? They say you will know everything after the first bite.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore41-con: Got stuck on a Quest? Try pressing the Reset Button in your Objective journal.
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore42-con: The number one lesson of Nighthaven: always look up!
tip_overworld_zone_nighthaven_lore43-con: Keep your eyes up; there are a few things that can fall on your head!
tip_overworld_zone_restlessshore_elitest: The Greenshapers have sealed this temple with vines and trees. Bring a logging axe!
tip_overworld_zone_weaversfen_elitestron: There are echoes of Periville's citizenry that still haunt the city. Guard against their onslaught, and wait for their anger to dissipate.
tip_pvparena_general01-content: Each round lasts for 2 minutes. After the timer ticks down, a deadly ring of fire encircles the arena and begins to shrink.
tip_pvparena_general02-content: The first team to win 3 rounds will win the match and claim victory!
tip_pvparena_general02-title: If you aren’t first, you’re last
tip_pvparena_general03-content: If you’re killed, you can continue to cheer your team on from the viewing box.
tip_pvparena_general04-content: The longer a round lasts, the less effective incoming healing becomes.
tip_pvparena_general05-content: Get out there and put on a show for the crowd! The announcer is sure to have them prepared for the fight.
tip_pvparena_general06-content: Arena wins are a great way to earn PvP Reward Track experience.
tip_raid_isleofnight_general01-content: Make sure to reload the ballistae after shooting them when facing off against the Twin Jesters. They are essential to interrupt one of his most powerful ability, Interlude.
tip_raid_isleofnight_general02-content: You cannot damage a Palatine Guard during Abyss Unstability unless you are inflicted with an Abyss Mark. But if you have an Abyss Mark, you will become a prime target for Queen Dahut's Dance of Death.
tip_raid_isleofnight_general03-content: Make sure to keep track of and regularly destroy the Enthralled Souls that Lost Overlord Thorpe activates on the outer edge of his arena. If you don't, they will detonate and deal massive damage in a very large area.
tip_trial_flamekeeper_general01-content: Fight through each wave of enemies before engaging Razhan the Hordemaster and Hadish Azar.
tip_trial_flamekeeper_general02-content: Run over Hadish Azar's kindling lizards to extinguish their flame.
tip_trial_flamekeeper_general03-content: When Hadish Azar casts Stop, Drop, and Roll, drain all of your stamina to remove the effect.
tip_trial_flamekeeper_general04-content: Razhan's minions will reforge if they live too long. Put a stop to them before it's too late!
tip_trial_sandworm_general01-content: Equipping Chitin in your Gem Slots will reduce damage from Acid.
tip_trial_sandworm_general02-content: Solving the Glyphs will confer a buff on all players allowing them to break Stamina Shields.
tip_trial_sandworm_general03-content: The Devourer will become more difficult the longer the fight takes!
tip_trial_sandworm_general04-content: Bringing a tank - or two - matters.
tip_war_specific01-content: Armories are accessible from bases and control points.
tip_war_specific02-content: Attackers must take all 3 control points before the gates can be damaged. Once they are taken, they become Respawn points and access to Armory.
tip_war_specific03-content: Once all 3 control points are taken, attackers can try to knock down gates and take the control point in the fort. If attackers succeed, they will win the war. If attackers fail to claim it, defenders will win the war.
tip_war_specific04-content: As the war goes on, there will be longer and longer Respawn waves. When soldiers are killed, they will Respawn in the next Respawn wave.
tip_war_specific05-content: Players earn Battle Tokens by damaging their enemies. With Battle Tokens, players can purchase various items from Armory.
tip_war_specific06-content: War leaders can make a ping visible to the entire Army.
tip_warinvasiongeneral_general01-content: War leaders can make a ping visible to the entire Army.
title_season8ss_journeychapter1_box_desc: Open this container to unlock the "Hard as Iron" title.
toadpott1_description: The flesh of a Toadpot mushroom.
toadstoolfringet1_description: The fringe from the edge of a toadstool, carefully scraped.

token_premiumemote_firework1_description: A dazzling blast of color! Allows use of the Flower Rocket Firework emote for 24 hours.
token_premiumemote_firework2_description: Vibrant holiday fun! Allows use of the Dynasty Rocket Firework emote for 24 hours.
token_premiumemote_firework3_description: An explosion of emerald! Allows use of the Dryad Rocket Firework emote for 24 hours.
token_premiumemote_firework4_description: Purple explosion! Allows use of the Ancient Rocket Firework emote for 24 hours.
token_premiumemote_firework5_description: Caution! May emit showers of sparks! Allows use of the Shooting Star Firework emote for 24 hours.
token_premiumemote_snowballthrow_descrip:
Snow way this is going to start a fight. Right?
Permit grants the use of Snowball Throw emote for 24 hours.

You can use an Emote Permit by opening the Augments menu from your inventory.
token_premiumemote_witchbroom_descriptio: Fly, my pretty! \nPermit grants use of Witch's Broom emote for 24 hours.
token_proficiency_boost_description: Increase a character's yield by 10% for 90 minutes of game time while Logging, Mining, Harvesting, and Skinning.\n\nUsage is paused during Outpost Rush.
token_purse_description: This purse can be found once a week and contains a Transmog Token.
token_seasonxp_boost_description: Increase a character's passive Season experience generation by 100% for 2 hours of game time.
token_territorystanding_boost_descriptio: Increase a character's Territory Standing earned by 100% for 2 hours of game time.
token_transmog_x1_description: Each Transmog token allows you to capture one item appearance for use as a skin.
token_transmog_x5_description: A pack of Transmog tokens. Each token allows you to capture one item appearance for use as a skin.
token_use_failure: {boostName} could not be activated at this time.
token_use_new_body: Activate {boostName} for this character?\n\nThis effect will last {duration}.
token_weaponxp_boost_description: Increase a character's Weapon experience earned by 100% for 2 hours of game time.
tolviumt1_description: One of the many resources unique to Aeternum, this metal is too brittle to use as the basis for a weapon or armor. However, as a cutting edge or a weighted core it is unmatched.
tomatot1_description: Cooking ingredient.\n\nFound in Provision Crates and Stockpiles in Monarch's Bluffs, Cutlass Keys and Mourningdale.
tool_azothstaff_legendaryazoth_descripti: "It's been strengthened from the many breaches it has closed." Azoth Staff Tool Skin
tool_azothstaff_legendarystrength_descri: "Tough enough to handle even the most dangerous breaches." Azoth Staff Tool Skin
tool_azothstaff_monster_description: "Can spot a breach at 10 paces. Maybe he needs glasses…" Azoth Staff Tool Skin
tool_azothstaff_royalcourt_description: "The adventurer walks up to the corrupted portal and bangs their scepter on the ground, demanding its vanquishing." Azoth Staff Tool Skin
tool_fishingpole_legendaryazoth_descript: "It uses magic to bob the hook just a little bit. Fish seem to love it." Fishing Pole Tool Skin
tool_fishingpole_legendarystrength_descr: "The extra reinforcements mean you'll never need to worry about your pole snapping." Fishing Pole Tool Skin
tool_fishingpole_monster_description: "Lure legendary fish into submission by wielding a pole that resembles their underwater allies." Fishing Pole Tool Skin
tool_fishingpole_royalcourt_description: "From under the water this pole looks as bright and as harmless as the sun above. Fish will soon learn otherwise." Fishing Pole Tool Skin
tool_loggingaxe_legendaryazoth_descripti: "Never made an alloy out of azoth, but sure, I'll give it a try." Logging Axe Tool Skin
tool_loggingaxe_legendarystrength_descri: "A tool ought to be cared for, but make it out of the right stuff and you won't have to for a long time." Logging Axe Tool Skin
tool_loggingaxe_monster_description: "With this axe, you can swear the creak of the tree falling almost sounds like a wave cresting." Logging Axe Tool Skin
tool_loggingaxe_royalcourt_description: "In a flourish of blinding light the forest falls before you." Logging Axe Tool Skin
tool_pickaxe_legendaryazoth_description: "It may not look like it, but magic courses through this tool." Pickaxe Tool Skin
tool_pickaxe_legendarystrength_descripti: "Tough enough to mine anything you need in Aeternum." Pickaxe Tool Skin
tool_pickaxe_monster_description: "Protect your pick from evil spirits today!" Pickaxe Tool Skin
tool_pickaxe_royalcourt_description: "Commands rock and ore to crumble alike." Pickaxe Tool Skin
tool_sickle_legendaryazoth_description: "The soft blue glow makes you feel like you really fit in at a magical forest." Sickle Tool Skin
tool_sickle_legendarystrength_descriptio: "Keeping a sharp edge for a long time makes this sickle extremely practical." Sickle Tool Skin
tool_sickle_monster_description: "Some giant bird washed up on shore, not sure what it is, but its talons were damn sharp." Sickle Tool Skin
tool_sickle_royalcourt_description: "The shimmer of this tool when used in the wild attracts the eyes of many a jealous adventurer." Sickle Tool Skin
tool_skinningknife_legendaryazoth_descri: "I ordered a skinning knife from you, not an assassin's knife." Skinning Knife Tool Skin
tool_skinningknife_legendarystrength_des: "Tough enough to tear through even Yeti hide." Skinning Knife Tool Skin
tool_skinningknife_monster_description: "Why does it look...hungry?" Skinning Knife Tool Skin
tool_skinningknife_royalcourt_descriptio: "Doubles as a letter opener for your all your regal missives." Skinning Knife Tool Skin
toolst2_s8_description: A cache of Tier 2 tools for any novice explorer. Open this to receive some tools.
toolst3_s8_description: A cache of Tier 3 tools for any dedicated adventurer. Open this to receive some tools.
toolst4_s8_description: A cache of Tier 4 tools for any committed soldier. Open this to receive some tools.
toolst51_s8_description: A cache of Tier 5 tools at maximum Gear Score for any true hero. Open this to receive some tools.
toolst51_s8_mastername: Hero's Tool Cache - Max Gear Score
toolst5_s8_description: A cache of Tier 5 tools for any true hero. Open this to receive some tools.

tooltip_salvage_remote: You cannot salvage items in remote locations.

topazcutt1_description: A gem with an attunement to the Electrified I weapon trait and Lightning Ward I armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
topazcutt2_description: A gem with an attunement to the Electrified II weapon trait and Lightning Ward II armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
topazcutt3_description: A gem with an attunement to the Electrified III weapon trait and Lightning Ward III armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.
topazcutt4_description: A gem with an attunement to the Electrified IV weapon trait and Lightning Ward IV armor trait. Can also be used in Jewelcrafting.

topic_17_iq_body_01_01:
Finally we have discovered a way to subvert Alecksi's indomitable powers!

While this is the earliest stage of research, we have managed to tap into a heretofore unknown force that reacts against, what we have always believed to be, entrances to catacombs sealed only by his very will. It is true, we have not breached yet a single one... but I am not dissuaded! The seal is weakening whenever I employ a method that I will document shortly, after my success.

What we find on the other side may very well prove a strategic advantage against him (for one of our fellows believes all catacombs to be linked); however, I am more of the mind that nullifying the barriers that Alecki can create at whim will give us everything we need to destroy any defense he can muster. Then, instead of sneaking into his lairs, we can stride through the entrance unopposed!
topic_17_iq_body_01_02:
The force I found was Corruption all along. This venture was useless...

And yet, I do not find myself without hope (though my fellows have long since ignored me, fallen into their own paroxysms of despair). I have come to believe, or I should say realize, that these strange minute tendrils of Corruption did indeed weaken the barriers that Alecksi created. This fact cannot be ignored! Especially considering how little we actually used in our tests.

My proposal is thus: safe amounts of Corruption can be used as a wedge, while our own powers become the mallet that breaks through. If this hypothesis holds true through the next trials I will be conducting, without sanction from my fellows admittedly, then it might further be true that we can use Corruption like an innoculate... giving us access to its power, but none of its taint.
topic_17_iq_body_01_03:
How worthy we are becoming with this transcendence. At times, the inverted tentacles nearly extend as a divine finger and brush the folds of my mind. What elation! What truth streaming down from the eternally sunsetting skies! I AM WEEPING.

The innoculate is everything we needed. Alecksi will be overthrown as we did with every age we passed through on our careen towards the center of time's awakening. One-part brilliance distilled into three-parts unimaginible void eyes unblinking the crimson unfolds itself something more than myself or these many pages of notes of an ageless line of strictures.

A woman came to me, another of the myriad shipwreck survivors. I knew she stole the Ashen Lump reagent that is precious to me, but I was too distracted by what she told me next to bother recovering it. She claimed that she was not yet born, but was already here before me. I injected the wonder into her veins and she screamed in happiness at this gift, and danced into the streets along the hills with countless others dancing behind her and we imprisoned her in a cell of MERCY REDOUBT that will divide into a cornucopia of tomorrow.
topic_17_iq_body_01_04:
WE ARE GATHERED TODAY IN THE WOEFUL TASK OF JUDGING OUR FALLEN BROTHER. YES. WE TRANSCRIBE THE GUILT IN CRIMSON.

"Do you not hear your very own words? Corruption speaks with your voices!"

OUR FALLEN BROTHER MISTAKES GLORY AND WONDER FOR FOLLY AND MADNESS. WE WEEP TEARS FOR HIS CHOICE. YES. WE WEEP BLOOD FOR HIS COMING UTILITY.

"It is with trepidation that I have witnessed the descent of our Order. Long had I prayed, and still do, that every one of you in this august assembly would see the error of these ways of yours. To overthrow Alecksi is not worth the price of our very souls!"

THIS ONE SPEAKS OF THE LIGHTSHIELD CRUSADE AS MISGUIDED. IT ASCENDS! IT ECLIPSES THE SUN OF SELF WITH THE JOY OF THE INDESCRIBABLE. YES.

"If you are so lost, then lost are we these our many aims. The Order is no more. All that remains is you and this... fetid... Inquisition.

JUDGEMENT IS RENDERED. WE HAVE A TASK FOR YOU TO ACCOMPLISH ON BEHALF OF THE FOUR MOST WORTHY. YOU WILL KNOW OUR WONDER.
topic_17_iq_body_01_05:
Why I scrawl these paltry thoughts in these my final hours, I know naught. But as I am the last alive in body, and in reason, and in morality… let me record this truth: The Lightshield Crusade is over. We were not successful. Alecksi has won. But it was Corruption that defeated us.

I do not seek absolution, for I do not believe the fault was mine. Indeed, I witnessed the erosion of our integrity from the very start of its weathering -- and though I sought to reinforce each flaw that appeared in our foundations, the mortar of my words was too dilute and the brick of my actions too brittle.

They say their imminent ritual will create 'wonder'. What a strange word to call a sacrifice.
