topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_01: The old woman Annryu’s magical abilities appear to be more powerful than I originally gave her Grand Carnival credit for. She somehow managed to cure a stonemason from Avanpost recently, even as they appeared on the verge of collapse from some vile spider venom.\nThough she offered a potion as part of the treatment, I could feel there was also some greater, interloping force, like fathomless depths of natural light. It was as if all the energies of the earth somehow converged; not bent to her will, but asked and answered in kind...\nThe next day the stonemason awoke, none the worse and eager to get back to cutting stone. When I asked how she had done it, she gave some cryptic, nonsensical response about the Arcana aligning with the ebb and flow of energies. Bah. Smug old crone. I’ll learn the secrets of her methods soon enough.
topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_02:
I have been watching the Fortune Mother for some time, though she is vexingly evasive about her magics. Still, I am gleaning what I can. The Grand Carnival seems to operate fully outside of Alecksi’s sphere, neither his minions nor the werebeasts will set foot near the camp. I can sense a sort of soft thrumming and believe the air itself may somehow be warded in that place.
The ruins around their camp pulse with green light, as though the folk of The Grand Carival are interwoven with power. Entwined in some mystic mesh, every thread alive with potential. Could the blood of old kings, the magics of the Ancients, somehow flow in their veins?
The Arcana defy all laws of the Conservation of Magic. Unlike my own power, it does not draw upon elements within, but from the world around us.
The cards appear to be a way of seeing, no, of harmonizing, with the very fabric of the cosmos itself, though the methods are confouningly complex. And what do these fool wanderers use it for? Readings?! What a waste. I have found a little white book that Annryu keeps, perhaps I’ll find more answers there.
topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_03:
There are twenty-four Cards of the Arcana, each with its own meaning when drawn upright or reversed. You may find cards sometimes reverse their orientation of their own volition, this is never to be disregarded. Shuffle as you will. A fanned choosing and three card spread is most common in Nighthaven.

The Fool
A brave adventurer sets out on a new journey, sword held carelessly over their shoulder. They stand dangerously near the edge of a cliff, risking a fall as their eyes search the horizon. A luna moth accompanies them, but is the sun rising or setting over their undertaking?
- Upright: choices and new paths
- Reversed: recklessness or confusion

The Magician
A hooded silhouette cradles a floating grimoire; green flames spit from the tome’s open pages. The figure’s focus is consumed by the great and terrible power while their back is turned to a dawnlit window.
- Upright: power and manifestation
- Reversed: trickery or lack of control

High Priestess
A bejeweled figure is lit against a night sky, eyes glowing and arms outstretched as if seeing something through a mist. Three braziers are before her, two burn with fire, but the center is yet unlit, or has already been extinguished.
- Upright: mystery and intuition
- Reversed: doubt or repression

The Empress
A ruler in velvet finery and golden crown holds a single star in her hand, the power to crush or cultivate. Her eyes drift to the side, but the object of her gaze is beyond sight; behind her a crescent moon hangs in a scarlet backdrop.
- Upright: life and nurturing
- Reversed: dependence or neglect

The Emperor
A ruler in a three pronged crown stands atop a battlement, dark crenelations to either side bolster his position. He raises his arms, either in command or despair, as a shaft of golden light shines from the heavens.
- Upright: authority and power
- Reversed: tyranny or instability

The Hierophant
A plainly dressed king stands aloft holding a golden hammer with a citadel reflected in its surface; many faces raise up to him, hope in their eyes. Scaffolding in the background either supports new efforts or repairs something broken.
- Upright: spiritual wisdom or conformity
- Reversed: rebellion or a free spirit
topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_04: The Lovers Two white haired lovers stare into each other’s eyes with a longing that spans the oceans of time. Power surrounds them as they embrace for eternity, or one last time? - Upright: union and connection - Reversed: disharmony and loss The Chariot A dark coachman and a dark coach, the door is open and the curtain pulled back, an invitation? Or a parting of ways? Thick woods lie beyond and a castle rises with the full moon. - Upright: movement and progress - Reversed: lack of direction or fearfulness Strength An armored commander with winged helm points a sword to let fly the creatures of war, their quarry unknown. None can stand against this force; fortresses fall and smoke billows amidst a background of fiery destruction. - Upright: endurance and fortitude - Reversed: weakness or being too hard on oneself The Hermit A dark figure, cloaked and alone, emits a golden light from their outstretched palm. They are wayfinding in the depths of a stone labyrinth, with many turns left ahead and no end in sight. - Upright: solitude and wisdom - Reversed: isolation or blocked contribution Wheel of Fortune A ring of stone with glowing blue runes stands in ruin on a grassy, sunlit hill, a place forgotten, a place yet to be seen. Birds take flight in a cerulean sky as clouds swell behind. - Upright: fate and change - Reversed: bad luck or repeated cycles Justice A corrupted figure with red eyes and a red rune emblazoned on its chest lifts a heavy mace aloft; in which direction will it fall? In the background, flames lick as a clocktower burns against the dusk, its sentence is passed. - Upright: law and judgment - Reversed: unfairness or lies
topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_05: The Hanged Man A graceful figure floats amidst a beam of light, arms crossed in supplication. A blue tree spreads its branches in all directions, but can its leaves hear the dire appeal? - Upright: sacrifice and suspension - Reversed: a reversal of fate or stalling Death Face obscured in shadow, a figure in dark robes leans forth, holding a scale that is tipped to one side. Below the scales, a lighted silhouette proffers a key, as if it offers some chance of salvation. - Upright: depths and transformation - Reversed: stagnation or resistance to change Temperance A light against the dark, a winged goddess stands behind a ruler, one hand held high and the other low, cupping an orb of power she is preparing to bestow. The ruler is seated on a shadowed throne, head bowed, waiting for what blessing or curse may come. - Upright: balance and exchange - Reversed: excess and depletion The Devil A great eye appears in a dark sky and opens to send rays of destruction on what stands below. A tower is sundered and falls into flame as the eye razes all in sight. - Upright: protection turned to bondage - Reversed: release from the past The Tower A clock tower rises against a clouded night, with rays of light shining from its face like a beacon to guide lost travelers. A dark landscape shrouded in mist gives way to many bridges and spires on high. - Upright: barriers and their breaking - Reversed: disaster avoided or uncertainty The Star A three sided object representing stability and upward movement shines in a darkened sky. Wreathed in light, it illuminates many roads below it, which weave in and out of distant hills, obstacles that cannot be navigated in the dark. - Upright: hope and guidance - Reversed: discouragement or loss of faith
topic_17_nighthaven_body_17_06: The Moon A blood moon with radials of light encompasses three beasts, a raven, a wolf, and a bear; each with jaws open in outcry. The beasts give form to buried primal impulses: to soar, to hunt, to roar - vying for release. - Upright: illusion and mystery - Reversed: misinterpretation or lack of instinct The Sun An old friend appears holding dual axes, ready to assist in defense or a fight. Their soul is alight and shines from the heart while a radiant golden halo forms a mysterious symbol behind them. - Upright: clarity and joy - Reversed: sadness or obscurity Judgement A shield of pale light soars on winds of change above an ancient juniper tree. The shield seeks to protect and purify, held up by the tree’s resilience and longevity. - Upright: awakening and reckoning - Reversed: lack of awareness, inaction The World Amid a cosmic rift of green light, a double pyramid hovers over an island with a floating rock at its apex. Two halves, past and future, the object is alight with power, will it alter the fate of the island below? - Upright: completion and wholeness - Reversed: incompletion or procrastination The Echo Claws made of shadow form the hands of a clock, reaching and writhing, seeking unknown purpose. The clockface is crooked, upset from its usual position, and the hands spin through time, grasping at whatever they can. - Upright: reflection and identity - Reversed: trapped in a cycle Rebirth A hand with pointed fingers reaches upwards as a luna moth slips from its grasp amidst twinkling stars. The glow of either dawn or dusk illuminates the periwinkle tendrils of a fading soul. - Upright: sustenance and renewal - Reversed: decline or and ending

topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_02: I have given the cub to the bears. His howls echo still. Let it be known: my borders are protected now by claws deeper than yours. Should you test me, I will offer your name next.
topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_03: Dark is the mercy of Duke Raval. He fears ghosts not for what they speak, but for whom they name. I will not silence the dead. Let them speak their truths. Burn me if you must.
topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_04: They made vows in the old tongue. She grinned the whole time. By dawn, her gown was red and the prince’s bones were hung like garlands. The bannermen bowed all the same.

topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_10: We remember. We march. We do not forget. You dined while we starved. You bled us dry, called it harvest. We return not for vengeance, but balance. Begin your prayers.

topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_15: No one dares sit where Duchess Carmilla used to reign. Her laughter still echoes. They say if you sit long enough, you’ll find her hand on your shoulder. And your name missing from the rolls.

topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_18: All mirrors are to be polished, though none reflect. Portraits of former lords must be rehung every fortnight. Their eyes begin to rot if left in the same position too long.
topic_17_nighthaven_body_18_19: Please do not acknowledge the child seen in the east hallway. No child resides at court. If spoken to, it will ask for its name. Do not answer. Continue dusting.

tradingpost_tutorial_about_body: Aeternum's dynamic economy revolves around the <font color="#edc63e">Trading Post</font>. This is your hub for buying and selling items, resources, and other goods in order to make coin.
tradingpost_tutorial_buy_01_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SEARCH AND FILTER </font>
	\n • Use the search bar to find specific items
	\n • Apply filter and sorting preferences
	\n • Select for usability and/or affordability
	\n • Hover over any item to see more details
	\n  
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >PLACE BUY ORDER </font>
	\n • Declare that you will purchase a specific item for a set price
	\n • Define quantity, listing duration, gear score, and more
	\n
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CONFIRM PURCHASE </font>
	\n • Purchased items can be found in your storage
tradingpost_tutorial_buy_02_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DISCOUNTS </font>
	\n • All Buy and Sell Orders on the trading post have a listing fee
	\n • This fee can be discounted with Territory Standing bonuses earned for that trading post's territory
	\n • Further discounts await if your company governs the territory!
	\n
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >MARKET RESEARCH </font>
	\n • The Trading Post can be a fount of wealth if used correctly
	\n • Keep an eye on the cost and desirability of items in the current market
	\n • Setting competitive prices increases your chances of a successful transaction
tradingpost_tutorial_buy_prompt_01_body: Learn how to <font color="#edc63e">buy and sell items</font>, and <font color="#edc63e">place buy orders</font>, in the Journal.
tradingpost_tutorial_myorders_01_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ACTIVE ORDERS </font>
	\n • Monitor currently active Buy and Sell Orders
	\n • Cancel unwanted items or orders by selecting the listing
	\n • Check the details of your open orders here
	\n  
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >COMPLETED AND EXPIRED ORDERS </font>
	\n • Review past transactions both completed and expired
	\n • Items from expired or cancelled orders are returned to your storage
tradingpost_tutorial_myorders_prompt_01_: Learn about <font color="#edc63e">Trading Post Orders</font> in the Journal.
tradingpost_tutorial_sell_01_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >LIST ITEMS FOR SALE </font>
	\n • Select the item to sell in the sell tab, only tradeable items will be shown
	\n • Choose whether to place a sell order or fulfill a buy order listed underneath
	\n • Set a price, quantity, and listing duration
	\n
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >MANAGE AND MONITOR </font>
	\n • Check the order's status under 'My Orders'
	\n • You'll receive a notification when the order's status changes
tradingpost_tutorial_sell_02_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FULFILL BUY ORDERS </font>
	\n • The 'All Items' tab displays all buy orders from other players
	\n • You can filter Buy Orders by perks, attributes, and gear score to find your specific item
	\n • You can also use the Trade chat channel to call out items that you are willing to buy or sell
	\n
	\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SET COMPETITIVE PRICES </font>
	\n • Adjust your price based on market trends of the same or similar items
	\n • Reference the current market prices of the item by selecting the item to see current buy orders or searching for it in the 'All Items' tab
tradingpost_tutorial_sell_prompt_01_body: Learn how to <font color="#edc63e">sell items</font> on the <font color="#edc63e">Trading Post</font> in the Journal.

troubleoxboro01: This town is much older than it looks.
troubleoxboro02: Believe it or not, it was the bleeding Roman Legions that first made it into a proper village.
troubleoxboro03: But it soon became a trading hub for all sorts... the crossroads of Aeternum, and so it was.
troubleoxboro04: People coming from all over to buy and sell, and the gold in the town's coffers piled up.
troubleoxboro05: The trade barons ran the place for profit; no kings, no queens, and no messing.
troubleoxboro06: Each of the town's factions had its own enforcers, and for a while that seemed to work.
troubleoxboro07: But it was just a matter of time until vice and greed turned to violence.
troubleoxboro08: Fighting broke out in the streets, and the whole town burned down.
troubleoxboro09: But coin has a way of fixing things fast - out of the ashes, the town of Oxboro came to life.
troubleoxboro10: The trade barons built it back: bigger, stronger, and more profitable than ever.
troubleoxboro11: And word is it's been smooth sailing ever since.
troubleoxboro12: Even when the Corruption spread across the land centuries ago, Oxboro was still sitting pretty.
troubleoxboro13: These days, coin's flowing like never before, but the trade barons hoard their wealth from the shadows...
troubleoxboro14: It may be tricky, but there's a fortune to be made here, and Grace O'Malley won't be leaving until she gets her share.

tutorial_artifacts_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Artifacts</font> are powerful, rare items of gear found throughout in Aeternum with unique perks that can redefine your playstyle.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FIND ARTIFACTS</font>
	
Artifacts are rare drops or rewards from difficult open world enemies, reward tracks, expeditions, and more. New Artifacts are released regularly!
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >UNLOCK PERKS</font>
	
Artifacts have unique perks that can redefine your playstyle. To unlock each perk, you must complete its <font color="#edc63e">Artifact Quest</font>. Be mindful of how many Quests you have progress toward as there is a limit.
	

After you have unlocked each perk, <font color="#edc63e">upgrade</font> your Artifact by adding a sixth perk at a <font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Kiln</font> using a craft mod of your choice. This sixth perk can be changed again later.
tutorial_artifacts_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Artifacts</font> are powerful gear with unique, unlockable perks.
tutorial_attributes1_01_dialogue_body: There are five attributes you can assign points to in the Character screen that can improve your weapons or increase your health. Each weapon has a primary attribute and a secondary attribute. Assign points to their primary and secondary attributes to increase their damage or healing effectiveness. Earn additional bonuses at various thresholds of each attribute. Hover over next to each attribute in the character screen to learn more. You can respec attributes for free until level 60. PRIMARY ATTRIBUTES Every weapon has a primary attribute. A primary attribute will have the most impact on the weapon’s damage scaling. SECONDARY ATTRIBUTES Weapons also have a secondary attribute that increases weapon damage at a reduced scale compared to its primary attribute, though some weapons have balance scaling with both attributes. For example, the primary attribute for the Spear is Dexterity, it has A tier scaling for this attribute. The secondary attribute for the Spear is Strength which C tier scaling. Discover primary and secondary attributes by hovering over the information icon next to each Attribute in the Character Screen. FOCUS AND HEALING Healing is exclusively scaled by Focus. For example, if you use a Void Gauntlet and only apply attributes in its primary attribute, Intelligence, you will miss out increased Healing effects you could receive from applying attributes in Focus. ATTRIBUTE THRESHOLD BONUSES Each attribute has bonuses that are activated by raising the attribute to a threshold. Hover over the circles in each attribute’s progress bar to learn more.
tutorial_augments1_01_dialogue_body: There are two types of Augments: Booster Tokens and Emote Permits. Boost Tokens are temporary bonuses while leveling up certain trade skills or proficiencies. They do not affect stats or provide any advantage in combat. The available Booster Tokens include: • Proficiency Booster: Bonus Harvesting yield. • Weapon XP Booster: Bonus Weapon Mastery experience earned. • Territory Standing Booster: Bonus Territory Standing earned. • Season XP Booster: Bonus Season experience earned. • Gathering XP Booster: Bonus Harvesting experience earned. Tokens are available to earn in-game through the Free and Premium Track of the Season Pass or purchased directly in the Store. Emote Permits are time-limited interactions that can be performed like any other emote but with extra special effects. Access Augments from your Inventory via the Augments Menu or by pressing {$ui.toggleTokenWindow$}.
tutorial_bags_01_dialogue_body: Different tier bags can hold a different amount of weight by default. Bags can also have <font color="#edc63e">perks</font> that can increase your capacity further, reduce the weight of certain items, and more.\n\nTo create bags that can carry additional weight, try adding <font color="#edc63e">crafting mods</font> and higher grade materials to increase their overall gear score which increases their total yield.
tutorial_bags_01_prompt_body: Equip <font color="#edc63e">bags</font> to increase your carrying capacity.
tutorial_battleroyale_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >STARTING THE MATCH</font>
	
• You'll begin with basic equipment: sword, shield, bow, and basic clothing
	
• You have 20-30 seconds in pre-game to run to your desired starting location
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CORE OBJECTIVES</font>
	
• Be the last player standing among 32 players
	
• Survive the closing ring of death
	
• Eliminate other players
	
• Match duration is approximately 20 minutes
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >GETTING EQUIPMENT</font>
	
• Loot chests throughout the map for better weapons and armor
	
• Defeat other players to claim their dropped equipment
	
• Higher tier loot can be found in more dangerous areas
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SURVIVAL TIPS</font>
	
• Stay inside the ring of death to avoid taking damage
	
• The ring closes in 5 phases, each lasting 2-3 minutes
	
• Use jump pads for quick traversal
	
• Monitor the player count and ring timer on your HUD
	
• Look for power-ups across the map to gain advantages
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >VICTORY CONDITIONS</font>
	
• Last surviving player wins
	
• Players are ranked based on survival order
	
• Better rankings earn better rewards
tutorial_blunderbuss1_01_dialogue_body: The Blunderbuss is a close-quarters <font color="#edc63e">ranged weapon</font> that fires 6 pellets in a single blast. Ideal for keeping pressure on melee targets and getting up close and personal with ranged targets.
tutorial_blunderbuss1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Blunderbuss</font>, a close-quarters ranged weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_blunderbuss2_01_dialogue_body:
Blunderbuss has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Containment</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Chaos</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CONTAINMENT TREE</font>
The Containment tree focuses on maneuverability and keeping pressure on your targets. Close the gap or create space between you and your target all while dealing bursts of intense damage.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CHAOS TREE</font>
The Chaos tree focuses on creating as much chaos as possible with clusters of explosions and massive blasts that devastate your opponents.
tutorial_blunderbuss2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Blunderbuss' <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_blunderbuss3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Containment tree, <font color="#edc63e">Unload</font>, briefly increases the number of pellets fired after using an ability. Alternate between basic attacks and abilities to maximize your damage. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Chaos tree, <font color="#edc63e">Double Down</font>, reduces the cooldown of the next ability used every 30 seconds. Watch the Double Down timer and use it to reduce a specific ability's cooldown at the right time to whittle away at your targets.
tutorial_blunderbuss3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Blunderbuss' <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_bow1_01_dialogue_body: The Bow is a versatile <font color="#edc63e">ranged weapon</font> that can rapidly fire arrows or be fully drawn to maximize damage. Great for maintaining distance while using a variety of attacks to hinder and damage enemies.
tutorial_bow1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Bow</font>, a piercing ranged weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_bow2_01_dialogue_body:
Bow has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Skirmisher</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Hunter</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SKIRMISHER TREE</font>
The Skirmisher tree focuses on control of the field by strategically positioning yourself or your enemies. With a combination of agile and oppressive abilities that can hit multiple targets, use your arrows to blot out the sun... or your opponent's lives.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >HUNTER TREE</font>
The Hunter tree focuses on precision. Master your Bow's projectile speed and arc to pierce your enemies when they least expect it.
tutorial_bow2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Bow's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_bow3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Skirmisher tree, <font color="#edc63e">Evasive Tactics</font>, gives you a brief damage bonus after dodging. Properly time your dodge to maximize your damage output and survivability.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Hunter tree, <font color="#edc63e">Concussion</font>, rewards your precision by dealing additional damage with headshots. Practice consistent headshots to maximize your damage output. Precision is key!
tutorial_bow3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Bow's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_brimstone_glyphs1_01_dialogue_b: Unlock Ancient Glyphs throughout <font color="#edc63e">Brimstone Sands</font>. Once you have unlocked an Ancient Glyph, you can unlock Elite Chests, passageways to difficult enemies, and other secret parts of Aeternum that feature the same Glyph. See your unlocked Ancient Glyphs in the <font color="#edc63e">Documents</font> tab of the <font color="#edc63e">Journal</font>.
tutorial_brimstone_glyphs1_01_prompt_bod: Collect <font color="#edc63e">Ancient Glyphs</font> to unlock Elite Chests and more in Brimstone Sands.\n\nLearn about Ancient Glyphs in the Journal.
tutorial_camp_use_01_dialogue_body: Dying is a part of life in Aeternum, but fortunately you can <font color="#edc63e">respawn at your camp</font>. Place your camp in strategic areas, such as before hard boss fights or in open world PvP, so you don't have to run too far when you inevitably die.\n\nYou can also <font color="#edc63e">craft</font> or <font color="#edc63e">change your camp's skin</font> by interacting with it. You can craft basic consumables and gear at camps that you may need out in the wild, such as potions. More advanced crafting is available at workstations in Settlements.
tutorial_capturetheflag_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >RULES</font>
	
• The team with the <font color="#edc63e">highest score</font> wins when time is over.
	
• If teams are tied when time is up, a short <font color="#edc63e">sudden death overtime</font> will immediately start.
	
• <font color="#edc63e">First</font> to score during overtime wins, otherwise the match will end in a <font color="#edc63e">draw</font>.
	
• <font color="#edc63e">In order to score</font>, your team's flag <font color="#edc63e">must</font> be on/returned to its pedestal.
	
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >POWER-UPS</font>
	
There are 3 types of Power-ups scattered around the maps. Once collected, Power-ups will take time to respawn.
	
• <font color="#edc63e">Health</font>: One time health gain.
	
• <font color="#edc63e">Attack Power</font>: Increase damage output for a while.
	
• <font color="#edc63e">Speed</font>: Increase run speed for a short time.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >JUMP PADS</font>
	
There are various types of jump pads scattered throughout the maps. Jump pads require the players to activate them by pressing {$movement.jump$} while on the pads. Players will always jump forwards, but getting a running start will send you further than standing still.
tutorial_capturetheflag_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Protect</font> your team's flag while <font color="#edc63e">capturing the enemy's flag</font> to score points. <font color="#edc63e">\n\nHighest</font> score wins.
tutorial_catacomb_bosstile_prompt_body: Defeating a <font color="#edc63e">Boss</font> grants major rewards and an <font color="#edc63e">optional safe exit</font> from catacombs.
tutorial_catacomb_difficulty_prompt_body: Defeating each Boss raises the <font color="#edc63e">difficulty level</font> of all enemies.
tutorial_catacomb_erosion_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Erosion</font> accumulates and makes you extremely vulnerable for a period of time.
tutorial_catacomb_erosionpotion_prompt_b: <font color="#edc63e">Erosion Tonic</font> reduces your Erosion severity.
tutorial_catacomb_extraction_prompt_body: Activate the escpae portal before time runs out. At least one teammate needs to enter the portal to complete Catacombs.
tutorial_catacomb_fail_prompt_body: The game <font color="#edc63e">fails</font> when <font color="#edc63e">Resurrection</font> runs out and all allies are dead.
tutorial_catacomb_hazard_prompt_body: Take on optional <font color="#edc63e">Trials of Challengers</font> to access a hidden Boss.
tutorial_catacomb_levelup_prompt_body: Consume <font color="#edc63e">Souls</font> to significantly boost your power at an <font color="#edc63e">Idol of Ascension.</font>
tutorial_catacomb_powerup_prompt_body: Select one from six <font color="#edc63e">Aspects</font> to equip a unique ability.
tutorial_catacomb_respawn_prompt_body: Allies can immediately respawn until <font color="#edc63e">Resurrection</font> hits 0.
tutorial_catacomb_soul_prompt_body: Gain <font color="#edc63e">Souls</font> by killing enemies to ascend later.
tutorial_companies_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Companies</font> are groups of other players you can join to fight for territory, socialize, and organize company-led activities. You must be unfactioned or in the same faction as a Company to join. Use the <font color="#edc63e">Recruitment or Faction chat</font> to find a company to join!
tutorial_companies_01_prompt_body: Join a <font color="#edc63e">Company</font> in your Faction with other players.
tutorial_compass_01_dialogue_body:
Use the <font color="#edc63e">compass</font> at the top of your screen to view quest markers, group members, nearby resources, and more without opening your map.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >QUEST MARKERS</font>
Your Compass will only show pinned quests.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >RESOURCES</font>
Level up your gathering skills to view more resources on your compass.
tutorial_compass_01_prompt_body: Use the <font color="#edc63e">compass</font> at the top of your screen to navigate to <font color="#edc63e">Quest markers</font> and more.
tutorial_conquerors_seasonalserver_s7_di:
<font color="#edc63e">Conqueror's Gear</font> changes the Player versus Player landscape. They feature unique, powerful perks only found on Seasonal Worlds. 

Craft Conqueror's Gear at various crafting stations using Wrathstone. Wrathstone is obtainable when wearing Ethereal Gear. Alternatively, acquire Conqueror's Gear from other players as it <font color="#edc63e">drops on death</font>. 

<font color="#edc63e">Conqueror's Gear has durability</font> and cannot be repaired. You can store Conqueror's Gear in your gear set storage, but it will not protect your gear from dropping on death.

In all instanced activities, such as 3v3 Arenas, Outpost Rush, expeditions, and Invasions, Conqueror's Gear perks are disabled and will not drop on death.
tutorial_conquerors_seasonalserver_s7_pr: You've acquired a piece of powerful <font color="#edc63e">Conqueror's Gear</font>! \n\nDiscover its unique perk in the item's tooltip.
tutorial_consumefood_01_prompt_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Consume equipped food</font> to heal over time by using its assigned quickslot.
	

{$player.quickslot-consumable-1$} <font color="#edc63e">Slot 1</font>
    
{$player.quickslot-consumable-2$} <font color="#edc63e">Slot 2</font>
tutorial_crafting1_01_dialogue_body: Crafting in Aeternum is a means of survival. Gather resources around the island using Tools, refine the resources, then use the resources to create gear and more at Crafting Stations. Progress in Gathering, Refining, and Crafting Tradeskills to unlock more gatherables and recipes. Once you've gathered resources on the island, refine them at the various Refining Stations found in Settlements: • Woodshops refine wood to lumber. • Smelters refine ore to ingots. • Looms refine fibers to cloth. • Tanneries refine hide to leathers. • Stonecutting Tables refine stone to blocks. Refining higher tier resources will require refining materials in addition to the raw resource. Rarer resources sometimes have a limit on how many can be refined a day. Many resources don't need to be refined to be crafted with, such as cooking ingredients and alchemy reagents.
tutorial_crafting2_01_dialogue_body: Use Crafting Stations around settlements to create gear, consumables, and more. Recipes require the correct ingredients and Tradeskill level. Some items that can be crafted include: • Craft light to medium armor, bags, and trinkets at the Outfitting Station. • Craft heavy armor and melee weapons at the Forge. • Craft ranged weapons, furniture, and instruments at the Workshop. • Craft magic weapons, potions, tinctures and more at the Arcane Repository. • Craft food and dyes at the Kitchen. Explore each station to discover what recipes can be crafted at each! Tip: You may find one-time-use Patterns around Aeternum, in Seasonal Events, and as rewards that allow you to craft specialty gear. You can also discover Food Recipes to unlock more options at the Kitchen.
tutorial_crafting2_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Craft</font> gear and more at <font color="#edc63e">Crafting Stations</font>.
tutorial_crafting_end_game1_01_dialogue_: MAXIMUM GEARSCORE CRAFTS \nWhen crafting gear such as armor or weapons, the gearscore that your output will be is shown on the crafting screen. The gearscore is determined by the resources you use and more. To achieve maximum gearscore crafts, you will need: \n \n • Top tier resources \n • Maximum tradeskill level \n • Tradeskill armor \n • Tradeskill earring \n • Three major tradeskill trophies \n • Tradeskill food \n • Tradeskill Lifestyle Buff OR Faction Ownership of the Mourningdale Fort \n \nLifestyle Buffs are territory-based buffs that increase the crafting effectiveness of any crafter who owns a home in that territory. Each Lifestyle Buff affects a particular Tradeskill. They are activated in each territory by the company that owns it and are active for a limited time. You can see what Lifestyle Buffs you have by navigating to your Character Screen and selecting the Territories you own homes in. \n \nForts can be captured by Factions. Once they are captured, they provide buffs to that faction as long as they own it. The Mourningdale Fort provides a buff that can take the place of Lifestyle Buffs when crafting maximum gearscore armor and weapons. \n \nSCARAB CRAFTING \nScarabs are a powerful resource found in Brimstone Sands that allow you to craft powerful, customized gear. \n \n • Golden Scarabs allow you to specify 2 attributes on the crafted gear. \n • Prismatic Scarabs allow you to specify all attributes on the crafted gear. They can be crafted from Golden Scarabs. \n \nTo craft a specific gear type, such as a chestpiece, you must have collected enough Timeless Shards of the same type. \n \nTo craft Prismatic Scarab gear, you must also have an Azoth Inductor.
tutorial_crafting_end_game1_01_prompt_bo: <font color="#edc63e">Maximize</font> the quality of your <font color="#edc63e">crafted gear</font> with Trophies and more.
tutorial_damage_and_enemy_types1_01_dial: DAMAGE TYPES Each weapon has a default damage type. Some attacks and abilities will use a different type than the weapon's default. Certain gems can be used to convert a portion of the damage to a different type. • Slash • Thrust • Strike • Fire: Conversion gem: Ruby • Ice: Conversion gem: Aquamarine • Lightning: Conversion gem: Topaz • Nature: Conversion gem: Amber • Void: Conversion gem: Amethyst • Arcane: Conversion gem: Sapphire When you hit something with an attack or ability, a number will fly out showing the amount of damage with the damage type icon next to it. When targets are weak or resistant to a damage type, you will do more or less damage in these cases and the number will be a different color. ENEMIES Each type of enemy has one or more weaknesses to different damage types and are grouped into one of these categories. • Corrupted: Corrupted creatures and structures are dark and glowing red. Weakness - Thrust, Arcane, and Nature damage. • Lost: The Lost are soulless phantoms and shambling corpses. Weakness - Strike, Ice, and Nature damage. • Beast: Animals large and small. Weakness - Thrust. • Ancient: Living skeletons from an ancient civilization. Weakness - Strike, Lightning, and Void damage. • Angry Earth: Nature that has taken humanoid, animal, and monstrous forms. Weakness - Slash and Fire damage. • Human:Weakness - Slash damage.
tutorial_damage_and_enemy_types1_01_prom: Take advantage of enemy weaknesses to types of damage.
tutorial_dueling1_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Duels</font> are open world fights between individual players or groups. To Duel, open a nearby player's <font color="#edc63e">social menu</font> and select <font color="#edc63e">Invite to Duel</font>. Duels are an excellent way to practice fighting against different playstyles.\n\nOnce a Duel starts, a countdown will begin, and a winner will be determined once a player is downed. Players will automatically regain health once a duel is over, so you can duel over and over again!
tutorial_dueling1_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Duel</font> a nearby player by opening their social menu and selecting <font color="#edc63e">Invite to Duel</font>.
tutorial_elite_chests1_01_dialogue_body: Elite Chests contain powerful rewards but can only be looted once a day. Elite Chests can be found in <font color="#edc63e">Elite Areas</font> that are intended for 5+ players, such as Myrkgard in Shattered Mountain, and other various corners of Aeternum. Some Elite Chests, such as those in Brimstone Sands and Elysian Wilds, require special glyphs or signets to open.\n\nCheck the Recruitment channel for player-organized <font color="#edc63e">Elite Chest Runs</font>.
tutorial_elite_chests1_01_prompt_body: Loot <font color="#edc63e">Elite Chests</font> once a day for valuable rewards.
tutorial_elysian_wilds_beast_marks1_01_d: Unlock <font color="#edc63e">Beast Signets</font> throughout <font color="#edc63e">Elysian Wilds</font>. Once you have unlocked a Beast Signet, you can unlock Elite Chests, pathways to new areas, and other secret parts of Aeternum that feature the same signet. See your unlocked Beast Signets in the <font color="#edc63e">Documents</font> tab of the <font color="#edc63e">Journal</font>.
tutorial_elysian_wilds_beast_marks1_01_p: Collect <font color="#edc63e">Beast Signets</font> to unlock Elite Chests and more in Elysian Wilds.
tutorial_emotes_01_dialogue_body: The <font color="#edc63e">emotes</font> window allows you to quickly bind your favorite emotes and learn more about each one. <font color="#edc63e">Earn emotes</font> on reward tracks, during seasonal events, or purchase them in the store.
tutorial_emotes_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Hold</font> {$player.fishing_activate$} to find <font color="#edc63e">Emotes</font> and quickly communicate to others.
tutorial_encumbrance_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">You are carrying too much.</font>\n\nStore, sell, or drop items to reduce your <font color="#edc63e">encumbrance</font>.
tutorial_endgame_01_dialogue:
Now that you've reached maximum level, continue your path as a <font color="#edc63e">Soulwarden</font>.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >POWER</font>
Seek Power in <font color="#edc63e">Mutated Expeditions</font>, <font color="#edc63e">Elite Chest Runs</font>, and <font color="#edc63e">Elite Trials</font> where you work with others to defeat strong foes and gain powerful gear in return.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >RICHES</font>
Earn <font color="#edc63e">Coin</font> through advanced crafting, refining, and resource gathering.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FAME</font>
Find Fame in Aeternum by taking over <font color="#edc63e">territories</font> with your company or ranking among the elite in <font color="#edc63e">Leaderboards</font>.
tutorial_endgame_01_prompt: You've accomplished much, but your adventure is far from over.\n\nLearn about <font color="#edc63e">End Game Activities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_enemy_quest_marker_01_dialogue_: When enemies or objects are associated with a quest, they will show a <font color="#edc63e">marker</font> above them so you can distinguish what is essential from the rest of the world.
tutorial_enemy_quest_marker_01_prompt_bo: Enemies or items required for your quests will show a <font color="#edc63e">marker</font> above them.
tutorial_enemyblock_01_dialogue_body: Enemies can <font color="#edc63e">block</font> your attacks as long as they have stamina. While all attacks reduce stamina, <font color="#edc63e">heavy attacks</font> will reduce an enemy's stamina faster and break their blocks.
tutorial_enemyblock_01_prompt_body: When your attack is <font color="#edc63e">blocked</font> by an enemy, use <font color="#edc63e">heavy attacks</font> to reduce their stamina.\n\nHold {$player.attack_primary_hold$} to Heavy Attack.
tutorial_equip_weapon_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Hover</font> over each <font color="#edc63e">weapon</font> and use {$ui_inventory_actions.inventoryUse$} to <font color="#edc63e">equip</font> them.
tutorial_equip_weapon_prompt_body_kbam: <font color="#edc63e">Hover</font> over each <font color="#edc63e">weapon</font> and <font color="#edc63e">double click LMB</font> to <font color="#edc63e">equip</font> them.
tutorial_equipfood_01_prompt_body_kbam: Open {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory and <font color="#edc63e">equip your food</font>.
tutorial_equipload_01_dialogue_body: Your Equip Load is an important part of your combat style. For example, <font color="#edc63e">Light Equip Load</font> allows you to roll around enemies as you dodge, while a <font color="#edc63e">Heavy Equip Load's</font> dodge is a shorter and less agile step but much more sturdy. The three equip loads are Light, Medium, and Heavy.\n\nYour Equip Load is determined by the <font color="#edc63e">total weight</font> of all of your armor, so you can combine a variety of different gear weights. Learn more about each load by opening your inventory and hovering over your equip weight found next to your character.
tutorial_equipload_01_prompt_body: Your armor's <font color="#edc63e">weight</font> can change your <font color="#edc63e">dodge distance</font> and <font color="#edc63e">speed</font>.
tutorial_ethereal_seasonalserver_s7_dial:
<font color="#edc63e">Equip Ethereal Gear to acquire Wrathstone</font> from gathering resources, Elite areas, and Corrupted Portals. Use Wrathstone to <font color="#edc63e">craft Conqueror's Gear</font> - gear with powerful perks only found in Seasonal Worlds.

Ethereal Gear can be crafted at various crafting stations. Alternatively, acquire Ethereal Gear from other players as it <font color="#edc63e">drops on death</font>. 

<font color="#edc63e">Ethereal Gear has durability</font> and cannot be repaired. You can store Ethereal Gear in your gear set storage, but it will not protect your gear from dropping on death.

In all instanced activities, such as 3v3 Arenas, Outpost Rush, expeditions, and Invasions, Ethereal Gear perks are disabled and will not drop on death.
tutorial_ethereal_seasonalserver_s7_prom: <font color="#edc63e">Equip Ethereal Gear</font> to obtain <font color="#edc63e">Wrathstone</font> from gathering resources, Elite areas and Corrupted Portals. \n\nCareful, Ethereal gear drops on death.
tutorial_expeditions_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Expeditions</font> are <font color="#edc63e">cooperative adventures</font> for 5 players which feature combat, puzzles, and challenging boss fights. Players work together as a group to overcome the challenges within Expeditions.

Expeditions range from level 25 to 65, but players of a higher level can always join lower level Expeditions.

Expeditions can be joined through the <font color="#edc63e">Activities Tab</font>, the <font color="#edc63e">entrance portal</font> in the world, or by <font color="#edc63e">selecting the Expedition from the map</font>.
tutorial_expeditions_01_prompt_body: Use the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Finder</font> to find a group for a 5 player Expedition.
tutorial_expeditions_mutators_01_dialogu:
Certain Expeditions become <font color="#edc63e">Mutated</font> each week.

A Mutated Expedition has <font color="#edc63e">Mutations</font> that make enemies more dangerous and require you and your group to adjust your gear and playstyle to conquer the Expedition in return for more powerful rewards.

For example, if an Expedition has a <font color="#edc63e">Hellfire Mutation</font>, the enemies will deal more Fire damage. However, you will likely receive gear with perks that defend against or deal more Fire damage in return.

Each Mutated Expedition has <font color="#edc63e">difficulty levels</font> with progressively harder challenges and better rewards. Unlock each level by completing the one prior.

Find the weekly Mutated Expeditions in the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Finder</font> or by opening the <font color="#edc63e">map</font> and finding the indicated Mutation entrances. <font color="#edc63e">Select the Mutated Expedition to see the active Mutations</font>.
tutorial_expeditions_mutators_01_prompt_: Progress through <font color="#edc63e">Mutated Expeditions</font> and earn powerful rewards.
tutorial_expeditions_roles_01_dialogue_b:
Many Activities, such as Expeditions, rely on effective <font color="#edc63e">group coordination</font>. Entering Expeditions requires paying attention to player Roles.

The optimal group features a variety of roles including a <font color="#edc63e">Healer</font>, a <font color="#edc63e">Tank</font>, and 3 <font color="#edc63e">damage-dealing players</font> (often referred to as DPS - or damage per second). This composition maximizes group play.

The matchmaking tool found in the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Finder</font> allows you to choose your role and automatically find a group with the right composition.
tutorial_expeditions_roles_01_prompt_bod: <font color="#edc63e">Heal</font>, <font color="#edc63e">tank</font>, or <font color="#edc63e">deal damage</font> in group activities.
tutorial_factions_01_dialogue_body: Join a faction by completing a Faction questline. Choose between <font color="#edc63e">Marauders</font>, <font color="#edc63e">Covenant</font>, and <font color="#edc63e">Syndicate</font>. Once you join a faction, you can join a company within that faction, visit the faction's vendor to receive missions and make purchases, or flag for PvP (Player-versus-Player) and fight other factions.
tutorial_factions_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Join one of 3 Factions</font> in Everfall to <font color="#edc63e">PvP</font>, join a <font color="#edc63e">Company</font>, and more.
tutorial_fast_travel_01_dialogue_body: Fast Travel Shrines allow you to <font color="#edc63e">teleport</font> to settlements and other shrines. They are also considered <font color="#edc63e">Sanctuaries</font> where you can flag for PvP (Player Versus Player) once you've joined a faction.
tutorial_fast_travel_01_prompt_body: Use a <font color="#edc63e">Fast Travel Shrine</font> to teleport to settlements and other shrines.
tutorial_firestaff1_01_dialogue_body: The Fire Staff is a magical weapon that consumes <font color="#edc63e">Mana</font> to harness the power of flames to burn enemies. \n\nThe Fire Staff is strongest when using its <font color="#edc63e">damage-over-time</font> abilities to constantly inflict fire damage on enemies.
tutorial_firestaff1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Fire Staff</font>, a magic weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_firestaff2_01_dialogue_body:
The Fire Staff has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Fire Mage</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Pyromancer</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FIRE MAGE TREE</font>
The Fire Mage tree focuses on ranged combat. Cast powerful fire spells from a distance that can hit multiple enemies at once.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >PYROMANCER TREE</font>
The Pyromancer tree focuses on close combat. Keep pressure on enemies and maintain multiple stacks of the burning status effect, Smolder, on them.
tutorial_firestaff2_01_prompt_body: Learn about Fire Staff's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_firestaff3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Fire Mage tree, <font color="#edc63e">Runes of Helios</font>, creates a rune on the ground that buffs your damage while inside. Use abilities and attacks that allow you to stay in the radius of the rune to maximize your damage. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Pyromancer tree, <font color="#edc63e">Backdraft</font>, will allow a Heavy attack to consume all stacks of Smolder on a target and deal a burst of damage in an area of effect around the target. Focus your abilities on applying as many stacks of Smolder as possible to take advantage of Backdraft and finish off targets.
tutorial_firestaff3_01_prompt_body: Learn about Fire Staff's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_flail1_01_dialogue_body:
The Flail is a dynamic weapon with a chain to extend the reach of its attacks.

The Flail is strongest when used to support allies while fighting alongside them and can be used with a Shield for extra defense. 

The Flail uses a variety of strike and arcane magic attacks. Despite dealing less damage compared to other weapons, the Flail's oppressive, supportive, and defensive nature will allow the wielder to stand out as a force to be reckoned with while in a fight.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FLAIL AND SHIELD ATTRIBUTES</font>
The Flail's power scales off both the <font color="#edc63e">strength</font> and <font color="#edc63e">focus</font> attributes. 

The strength attribute provides the most damage scaling. 
Focus exclusively controls the power of healing and support buffs, but still provides some scaling to damage.
tutorial_flail1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Flail and Shield</font>, a dynamic weapon duo, in the Journal.
tutorial_flail2_01_dialogue_body:
The Flail has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Cleric</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Bastion</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CLERIC TREE</font>
The Cleric tree primarily focuses on offensive attacks and support abilities. Each ability's final upgrade is support focused and scales using the focus attribute.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BASTION TREE</font>
The Bastion tree provides defense and support for your allies through your own survivability. This tree shines when you want to be able to take on a formidable force thrown at you or your group.
tutorial_flail2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Flail and Shield's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_flail3_01_dialogue_body:
The ultimate ability for the Cleric tree, <font color="#edc63e">Better Together</font>, grants you and all nearby allies passive healing when you are nearby. Be sure to group up when this ultimate is active. 

The ultimate ability for the Bastion tree, <font color="#edc63e">Human Shield</font>, actually turns you into a human shield when you hit a target by absorbing some of the damage a nearby ally would otherwise take. Stick close to your allies and be ready to attack with an ability when they start to take damage to ensure this ultimate is used appropriately.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >TANKING WITH THE FLAIL AND SHIELD</font>
You can tank using Flail and Shield by using a <font color="#edc63e">Carnelian gem</font> in your Flail to activate certain taunt abilities. Taunting non-player enemies will cause them to focus on you, allowing your allies to capitalize on the enemy's focus. Keep an eye out the "Taunt Gem Compatible" text in ability tooltips to learn what abilities can trigger taunts.
tutorial_flail3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Flail and Shield's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_fort_bonuses_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Forts</font> are strategic <font color="#edc63e">PvP control points</font> in each territory that reward the owning faction with a <font color="#edc63e">bonus</font>. You can find out what bonus each Fort provides by hovering over its map icon.\n\nOutside of Influence Races, Forts are <font color="#edc63e">locked for one hour</font> once they are captured. During an Influence Race, they do not lock once captured.
tutorial_fort_bonuses_01_prompt_body: Capture <font color="#edc63e">Forts</font> while flagged for PvP and earn Faction Buffs.
tutorial_gathering_fishing1_01_dialogue_: Fishing allows you to gather unique resources from Aeternum's saltwater coasts, freshwater streams, and everything in between. Each territory has its own subaqueous ecosystem, though species are rarely exclusive to a single territory. While most fish are restricted to one water type, some can thrive in both. But fish aren't the only catch. Flotsam can be frequently scavenged and although most is trash only fit for salvage, if you're lucky, you'll hoist up a Treasure Chest filled with rare loot. What you catch is purely luck but you can narrow your odds of rarer finds by casting in waters that increase Fishing Luck. Shallow water adds a low bonus, deep water adds more, but by far the biggest bonus comes from active Fishing Hotspots. Active Broad, Rare, and Secret Hotspots are easily spotted by their leaping fish. Once a Hotspot is depleted, it'll take time before becoming active again. Fishing Hotspots you've discovered are marked on your map. You can raise your Fishing Luck even higher by using higher tier fishing poles, equipping better bait, placing fishing trophies in your house, or by having perks like Lucky Waters on your gear. With high enough fishing luck, you may even chance a glimpse of a Legendary Fish.
tutorial_gathering_fishing1_01_prompt_bo: {$player.fishing_activate$} to use your <font color="#edc63e">Fishing Pole</font>.\n\n<font color="#edc63e">Equip Bait</font> for better fish.
tutorial_gathering_fishing1_02_dialogue_: While near any body of water, equip your fishing pole using {$player.fishing_activate$}. Before casting, you may add any bait in your inventory by opening the bait menu with {$ui.toggleFishingBaitWindow$}. Some bait is only effective in either Fresh or Salt water. Cast the line with {$player.fishing_primary$} and hold to increase the distance, then release to cast. Careful distancing is useful for aiming at deeper water or Hotspots. When you have a bite, hook your catch with {$player.fishing_primary$}, then hold to reel in or release to give slack. Be mindful of your line tension: If it becomes too taut, the line will snap and you'll lose the catch (and your bait). If it's too loose, it'll drift away. Fish can have different temperaments which effects how hard they fight and when they get tired. Balance your tension with the ferocity of the fish and wait for the right moment to reel. With enough patience, you can catch anything. Have you met Perronelle le Noir? Rumor is she trains master fishermen in Monarch's Bluff or Windsward.
tutorial_gear_score1_01_dialogue_body: Gear Score is what determines the power of your weapons and armor: The higher the Gear Score, the stronger the gear. It directly effects Armor Rating, Type Damage, number of Perks, and Perk effects. As you gain levels, you can utilize higher Gear Score equipment, increasing your overall Gear Score (which is displayed at the top-right of your equipment screen). Some game modes, like Expeditions, are gated by minimum Gear Score requirements so keep raising your overall Gear Score to take on mightier challenges! Gear Score may be restricted by expansions, increasing the maximum Gear Score but only for participating players.
tutorial_gear_score1_01_prompt_body: Use <font color="#edc63e">gear score</font> to help measure whether one item is better than another, similar item.
tutorial_gear_sets_storage1_01_dialogue_: You may have multiple sets of gear piling up in your storage, whether for various types of combat, fashion, or crafting and refining. Use Gear Set Storage to organize and swap between your gear! To access your Gear Set Storage, press the Gear Set button below your health bar. You can purchase additional Gear Set Slots from the Store.
tutorial_gear_sets_storage1_01_prompt_bo: <font color="#edc63e">Storage sheds</font> provide access to items you've stored at <font color="#edc63e">any</font> settlement.\n\n<font color="#edc63e">Use the drop down</font> to change which settlement you wish to store or take items from.
tutorial_gear_sets_using1_01_dialogue_bo: Access stored gear sets outside of your inventory by using the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Wheel</font> (controller), or the <font color="#edc63e">Gear Sets Window</font> (Mouse and Keyboard), to select a desired set.\n\nEach set has its own key binding, so to view or change the bindings, visit your <font color="#edc63e">input settings</font> and look for the 'Gear Set' section.
tutorial_gear_sets_using1_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Hold</font> {$player.fishing_activate$} and press {$player.ability2$} to access your <font color="#edc63e">gear sets</font>.
tutorial_gearupgrade_01_prompt_body: Open {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory and {$ui_inventory_actions.inventoryUse$} <font color="#edc63e">equip your new gear</font>.
tutorial_gearupgrade_01_prompt_body_kbam: Open {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory and <font color="#edc63e">equip your new gear</font>.
tutorial_gemperks1_01_dialogue_body: Any equipment, armor or weapon, with a Gem Slot perk can be affixed with a cut gem of either Flawed, Standard, Brilliant, or Pristine quality. Raw gemstones can be fused into higher tier gemstones and any uncut gems can be refined at an Outfitting Station. To slot a gem, select the equipment you want to socket to and choose the "Attach Gem" option. You can replace the gem of a filled Gem Slot by affixing a new gem to the item; however, the old gem will be destroyed. Some equipment, such as many trinkets, can't have their gem replaced. Gems have two conditional perks: One applies when slotted into a weapon, the other when slotted into armor and trinkets. You can check a cut gem's item description for details on its perk options. Note - Gems that grant the same bonus as an existing perk cannot be socketed into that item. For example, a Fire Staff cannot use a Ruby which grants fire damage. Equipment that has a gear score above 725 has Charm Slots. There are different kinds of slots: • Offense - charms that can go into this slot type will increase your offensive capabilities • Defense - charms that can go into this slot type will increase your defense and survivability • Skill - charms that can go into this slot type will modify active weapon Abilities Armor gem perks and charms are always active while Weapon gem perks and charms are only active while unsheathed.
tutorial_gemperks1_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Slot cut gems</font> in your gear to modify their power.
tutorial_gemperks1_01_subtitle: Slot Gems and Charms in Gear
tutorial_gemperks1_02_dialogue_body: You can't slot a gem of an elemental type into a weapon of the same type. For example, Fire Staffs can't be socketed with a Ruby. • Amber: Bonus Nature Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Amethyst: Bonus Void Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Aquamarine: Bonus Ice Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Ruby: Bonus Fire Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Sapphire: Bonus Arcane Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Topaz: Bonus Lightning Damage (Weapon) or Damage Absorption (Armor). • Carnelian: Generate more threat (Weapon) or Generate less threat (Armor). • Jasper: Bonus damage after blocking or taking a hit (Weapon) or Strike Damage Absorption (Armor). • Opal: Bonus damage while your Stamina is not full (Weapon) or Elemental Damage Absorption (Armor). • Onyx: Bonus damage to healthly targets (Weapon) or Physical Damage Absorption (Armor). • Diamond: Bonus damage and healing at full Health (Weapon) or Physical/Elemental Damage Absorption (Armor). • Emerald: Bonus damage and healing to weakened targets (Weapon) or Thrust Damage Absorption (Armor). • Malachite: Bonus damage against Crowd Controled targets (Weapon) or Physical/Elemental Damage Absorption (Armor). • Moonstone: Bonus damage while abilities are on cooldown (Weapon) or Slash Damage Absorption (Armor). • Pearl: Bonus chance at rare items from chests and monsters (Both Armor and Weapon).
tutorial_gemperks2_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Runeglass Gems</font> are augmented, cut gemstones that have an <font color="#edc63e">additional perk</font> such as bonus Ranged damage or Health recovery. They can be slotted into Gem slots on gear. Runeglass Gems can be purchased on the trading post or crafted.
	\n\n<font color="#edc63e">Runeglass Cases</font> are combined with regular cut gemstones to create a <font color="#edc63e">Runeglass Gem</font>. Craft Runeglass Cases with resources found in Brimstone Sands at the <font color="#edc63e">Runeglass Station</font> in New Corsica, then combine a Runeglass Case with a cut gem at a stonecutting table.
tutorial_gemperks2_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Runeglass Gems</font> make cut gems even more powerful.
tutorial_greataxe1_01_dialogue_body: The Great Axe is a <font color="#edc63e">large melee weapon</font> with wide, arcing swings and powerful, chopping attacks. Ideal for engaging multiple enemies with sweeping damage or executing single targets with a few swings.
tutorial_greataxe1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Great Axe</font>, a sweeping melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_greataxe2_01_dialogue_body:
Great Axe has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Reaper</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Mauler</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >REAPER TREE</font>
The Reaper tree focuses on dealing as much damage as possible to targets. Use powerful attacks, inflict critical hits, and capitalize on the vulnerability of low health targets. This tree is incredibly punishing to all those that face you.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >MAULER TREE</font>
The Mauler tree focuses on dealing repeated attacks to multiple targets. While others are disadvantaged when outnumbered, you will shine. Trap your enemies trying to escape your ferocious attacks with Gravity Well or Maelstrom.
tutorial_greataxe2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Great Axe's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_greataxe3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Reaper tree, <font color="#edc63e">Blood Lust</font>, is a multi-purpose ultimate that provides speed and strength. Use the power granted by Blood Lust to chase down and punish enemies. Be relentless with your actions when building a loadout with this ultimate. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Mauler tree, <font color="#edc63e">Mauler's Fury</font>, grants a stacking damage bonus when hitting targets. Maximize the number of hits either through increasing the number of targets you are attacking or using multi-hit abilities to turn into a force to be reckoned with.
tutorial_greataxe3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Great Axe's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_greatsword1_01_dialogue_body:
The Greatsword is a versatile <font color="#edc63e">melee weapon</font> that uses stances to adapt to different combat situations. It embodies relentless offense paired with aggressive defense to cut through any challenge.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >GREATSWORD STANCES</font>
The Greatsword has two different stances, <font color="#edc63e">Onslaught Stance</font> and <font color="#edc63e">Defiant Stance</font>. Each is activated after using an ability in the respective trees that they are in. 

The Onslaught Stance provides offensive bonuses at the cost of defense, and Defiant Stance offers defensive bonuses at the cost of offense. These stances can also change the functionality of ability upgrades depending on what stance the player is in when activating the ability. Being conscious about what stance you are in is vital to mastering the colossal Greatsword.
tutorial_greatsword1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Greatsword</font>, a versatile melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_greatsword2_01_dialogue_body:
Greatsword has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Onslaught</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Defiance</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ONSLAUGHT TREE</font>
The Onslaught tree is focused on offense. You will obtain offensive bonuses when using any ability in this tree but receive defensive debuffs in return. The bonuses are described in the top left node of the tree. You will be a formidable foe when using this tree but take care as it will weaken your defences.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DEFIANCE TREE</font>
The Defiance tree is focused on defence. You will obtain defensive bonuses when using any ability in this tree but receive offensive debuffs in return. The bonuses are described in the top right node of the tree. You will be a stalwart foe that can outlast your targets using this tree.
tutorial_greatsword2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Greatsword's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_greatsword3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Onslaught tree, <font color="#edc63e">Unrelenting Onslaught</font>, triggers reduced ability cooldowns when striking enemies with basic light and heavy attacks. Include those basic attacks into your flow of combat to maximize your damage output and reduce ability cooldowns. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Defiance tree, <font color="#edc63e">Undying Defiance</font>, will give you lifesteal from your attacks, allowing you to heal yourself based on a percent of your damage dealt. The lifesteal gained from this ultimate can be boosted for a brief duration if you hit a target shortly after blocking an attack. Interweaving blocks and attacks into your combat flow will allow you to more easily maintain a consistent flow of healing from your lifesteal.
tutorial_greatsword3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Greatsword's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_grit1_01_dialogue_body:
If you or an enemy <font color="#edc63e">glow white</font> during an attack, the attack has <font color="#edc63e">Grit</font> and cannot be interrupted. Grit allows the attack to finish even if hit by an attack that would normally stagger or knock down the target. 

The only exception is if the attacker is stunned. <font color="#edc63e">Stun</font> instantly stops all character's actions when applied even if Grit is active.

If you are going up against a target with Grit attacks, equip a weapon with a stun. Inversely, if you plan on capitalizing on your own Grit, keep an eye out for attacks that inflict stun.
tutorial_grit1_01_prompt_body: Possessing <font color="#edc63e">grit</font> prevents interruptions during combat.\n\nWhen an opponent <font color="#edc63e">glows white</font>, they posess grit.
tutorial_groupfinder_01_dialogue_body:
Use the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Finder</font> to join and queue for Expeditions, Outpost Rush, and more.

<font color="#edc63e">Earn daily bonuses</font> for joining random, normal and mutated Expeditions through the Activity Finder.

Access the Activity Finder within <font color="#edc63e">Activities</font> tab.
tutorial_groupfinder_01_prompt_body: Find players to run <font color="#edc63e">Expeditions</font> within the <font color="#edc63e">Activities</font>.
tutorial_groups_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Group</font> with other players to explore Aeternum together. Grouping allows you to ping locations to your group mates and find each other on the map. Group up by opening a player's <font color="#edc63e">social flyout</font> by hovering over them or finding them in the social search and selecting <font color="#edc63e">Invite to Group</font>.
tutorial_groups_01_prompt_body: Group up with other players through their <font color="#edc63e">social flyout</font>.
tutorial_gypsum_and_kiln_01_dialogue_bod:
<font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Kilns</font> are powerful end-game crafting stations that do not require a Tradeskill and can be found at Settlements and Outposts in higher level territories.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >UPGRADING GEAR AND ARTIFACTS</font>
	
Upgrade <font color="#edc63e">Artifacts</font> and certain <font color="#edc63e">Named gear</font> at the Gypsum Kiln. Use a combination of Dark Matter, Gypsum Orbs, a Matrix, and a Chromatic Seal.
	

 • <font color="#edc63e">Dark Matter</font> can be earned by defeating difficult enemies, through the PvP track, and more.
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Orbs</font> can be crafted at the Kiln with various Gypsum you earn in your adventures.
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Matrices</font> can be crafted or bought at the Trading Post.
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Chromatic Seals</font> can be purchased at your Faction Vendor.
	

Note: You need to have the Gear unequipped and unassigned to a Gear Set to upgrade it at the Kiln.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >EXPEDITION REPLICAS</font>
	
Missed out on the exact piece of gear you wanted from an expedition? Use <font color="#edc63e">Expedition Materia</font> to craft it at the Gypsum Kiln. Materia can be earned through completing expeditions and Season Pass Rewards.
tutorial_gypsum_and_kiln_01_prompt_body: Upgrade and craft gear at <font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Kilns</font>.
tutorial_gypsum_and_kiln_01_subtitle: Upgrade Gear at a Gypsum Kiln
tutorial_gypsum_orbs1_01_dialogue_body: Gypsum are resources collected from many different activities around Aeternum. Gypsum of the same type can be combined at a Gypsum Kiln into a Gypsum Orb, which has many uses in advanced crafting. All Gypsum have a limited quantity than can be collected within an 18 hour period. The types of Gypsum are: • Obsidian Gypsum drops from level 60+ Named enemies. Limit: 3. • Sapphire Gypsum drops from level 60+ bosses in Expeditions. Limit: 2. • Citrine Gypsum are earned by completing any Trial. Limit: 2. • Amethyst Gypsum are earned by completing any Corruption Breaches. Limit: 10. • Emerald Gypsum can be found in Aptitude reward containers. Limit: 2. • Garnet Gypsum are earned by competing in 3v3 Arenas. Limit: 2. • Ruby Gypsum are earned by competing in Outpost Rush. Limit: 3. • Topaz Gypsum can drop from some enemies after using a Topaz Gypsum Attunement Potion. Limit: 15. • Diamond Gypsum can be found in a Bag of Juniper Berries or given during Holiday Events. Limit: 6.
tutorial_gypsum_orbs1_01_prompt_body: Use <font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Orbs</font> in advanced crafting.
tutorial_hatchet1_01_dialogue_body: The Hatchet is a versatile weapon that allows for <font color="#edc63e">ranged throwing attacks</font> or <font color="#edc63e">rapid close quarters attacks</font>. Ideal for aggressive, fully committed close quarters melee combat or tactical medium range combat.
tutorial_hatchet1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Hatchet</font>, a relentless melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_hatchet2_01_dialogue_body:
Hatchet has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Berserker</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Throwing</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BERSERKER TREE</font>
The Berserker tree focuses on being up close and personal with your enemies in a relentlessly aggressive manner. It allows you to get into a fight and stay in until only one is left standing.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >THROWING TREE</font>
The Throwing tree forgoes the melee focused aggression with ranged precision. Instead of slicing into an enemy with your Hatchet, throw it at them.
tutorial_hatchet2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Hatchet's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_hatchet3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Berserker tree, <font color="#edc63e">Defy Death</font>, will give you a second wind, restoring some health after you drop to zero as a means to escape death. Use this brief window to finish off targets or recover from injuries.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Throwing tree, <font color="#edc63e">Persistent Hindrance</font>, extends hatchet debuffs on targets and increases damage against targets with debuffs. Try building your ability tree around stacking as many debuffs as possible on a target and keeping them active.
tutorial_hatchet3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Hatchet's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_healthpotion_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Health potions</font> and other <font color="#edc63e">consumables</font> are critical to your survival in Aeternum. Equip them from your {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory.

Potions can be found around Aeternum, bought at the Trading Post, or crafted in town or at your camp. Health Potions, in addition to regeneration potions and food, help maintain your health while adventuring. Unlock higher tier health potions as you level.

Consumables, including Health Potions, have a <font color="#edc63e">cooldown</font> once you use them.
tutorial_healthpotion_01_prompt_body: Open {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory and {$ui_inventory_actions.inventoryUse$} <font color="#edc63e">equip health potions</font>.
tutorial_healthpotion_01_prompt_body_kba: Open {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory and <font color="#edc63e">equip health potions</font>.
tutorial_heartgems1_01_dialogue_body:
Heartrunes grant special abilities that can be used separately from weapon abilities. 
    

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >EQUIPPING HEARTRUNES</font>
    
The Heartrune equipment slot can be unlocked by completing the quest <font color="#edc63e">“Secrets of the Heartgem”</font> in Brimstone Sands.
    

After the slot is unlocked, Heartrunes can be equipped and swapped out similar to other equipment. Only one Heartrune can be equipped at a time.
    

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >USING HEARTRUNES</font>
    
Once a Heartrune is equipped, the Heartrune meter with the same icon as your equipped Heartrune, will be present near your other abilities on the HUD.
    

Engaging in combat will fill the <font color="#edc63e">meter</font>, and once it is full, you will be able to activate the equipped Heartrune ability by pressing {$player.rune_ability$}. The meter will need to be filled again after it's used.
    

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FINDING AND UPGRADING HEARTRUNES</font>
    
Heartrunes can be crafted in a <font color="#edc63e">Gypsum Kiln</font> using materia and can drop from specific enemies in expeditions and raids.
    

When a Heartrune is first obtained, it will be a minor version of the Heartrune. Heartrunes can be upgraded at the Gypsum Kiln.
tutorial_heartgems1_01_prompt_body: Equip <font color="#edc63e">Heartrunes</font> to gain new abilities.
tutorial_housing1_01_dialogue_body:
Become a home owner in Aeternum today!
	

 • Decorate with <font color="#edc63e">furniture</font>
	
 • Place <font color="#edc63e">Trophies</font>
	
 • Take advantage of <font color="#edc63e">Lifestyle Buffs</font>
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Teleport</font> from anywhere
	
 • Increase <font color="#edc63e">storage</font>
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >OWNING A HOME</font>
	
You are eligible to <font color="#edc63e">purchase a house</font> in each Territory’s settlement once you reach <font color="#edc63e">Territory Standing 1</font> and meet level and coin requirements. Purchase a home by approaching a home in the settlement and selecting the <font color="#edc63e">purchase</font> option. You can own up to 3 homes in different settlements. You are required to pay a periodic <font color="#edc63e">housing upkeep cost</font> to keep your housing benefits.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DECORATE</font>
	
Earn, purchase, or craft <font color="#edc63e">furniture</font> to decorate your home with. Furniture can be crafted at a <font color="#edc63e">Workshop</font> and is available as rewards through reward tracks and around the island.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >TROPHIES</font>
	
Place <font color="#edc63e">Trophies</font> in your home that <font color="#edc63e">grant passive bonuses</font> for tradeskills and combat. Trophies can be purchased or crafted.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >LIFESTYLE BUFFS</font>
	
Take advantage of <font color="#edc63e">Lifestyle Buffs</font> that territory owners activate by owning a home in the territory’s settlement. See which Lifestyle Buffs are active for the settlements you own homes in on the Bio tab of your Character screen.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >TELEPORT FROM ANYWHERE</font>
	
<font color="#edc63e">Teleport</font> from nearly anywhere in Aeternum to one of your houses by selecting the house’s settlement on the map. You can teleport again to your home after a cooldown, or pay <font color="#edc63e">Azoth</font> to reset the cooldown.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >INCREASE STORAGE</font>
	
Purchase or find <font color="#edc63e">storage containers</font> to place in your home to access your storage and <font color="#edc63e">increase your total capacity</font> for that territory.
