tutorial_housing1_01_prompt_body: Buy and decorate a <font color="#edc63e">house</font> for increased storage, fast travel, and trophy bonuses.
tutorial_icegauntlet1_01_dialogue_body: The Ice Gauntlet is magical weapon that consumes <font color="#edc63e">Mana</font> to harness the power of frost to damage and hinder enemies.\n\nThe Ice Gauntlet is strongest when used to keep your target at a distance by limiting their movement and unleashing a frosty torment upon them.
tutorial_icegauntlet1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Ice Gauntlet</font>, a magic weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_icegauntlet2_01_dialogue_body:
The Ice Gauntlet has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the  <font color="#edc63e">Ice Tempest</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Builder</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ICE TEMPEST TREE</font>
The Ice Tempest tree focuses on hindering your enemies' movement. Deal as much damage as you can while your enemies are slowed.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BUILDER TREE</font>
The Builder tree focuses on spawning icy deterrents to draw attention away from yourself and provide protection to stay alive.
tutorial_icegauntlet2_01_prompt_body: Learn about Ice Gauntlet's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_icegauntlet3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Ice Tempest tree, <font color="#edc63e">Ultimate Chill</font>, will allow your Ice Gauntlet abilities to Chill targets and increase the amount of damage you deal against them. Focus your abilities around sustained damage to help keep this damage bonus active. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Builder tree, <font color="#edc63e">Ultimate Frost</font>, is an extension of the Ice Pylon ability. It increases your Pylon's health and the area effect around it. Focus your abilities on ones that allow you to stay in the frosted area and use it to your advantage.
tutorial_icegauntlet3_01_prompt_body: Learn about Ice Gauntlet's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_influencerace_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >PUSH INFLUENCE</font>
	
Complete PvP missions and capture towers to push influence and put the territory into conflict.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >FACTION CONTROL POINTS</font>
	
Modifies the amount of Influence earned and provide a continuous flow of influence for the controlling faction.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DECLARE WAR</font>
	
Qualifying companies will be able to declare war at the end of every Influence Race.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >EARN REWARDS</font>
	
Participating players will earn rewards. Bonus war cache for defenders winning the war.
tutorial_intro_seasonalserver_s7_dialogu:
Aeternum has revealed a powerful new resource called <font color="#edc63e">Wrathstone</font>, leading to a battle between Factions over this resource and the formidable Conqueror's Gear that can be crafted from it. <font color="#edc63e">Welcome to Season 7's Seasonal World</font>. 

This is a Player versus Player World (PvP) where you <font color="#edc63e">automatically flag for PvP at level {^u|javelin.pvp-always-on-min-level^}</font>.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CONQUEROR'S GEAR</font>
	
<font color="#edc63e">Gather Wrathstone by wearing craftable Ethereal Gear</font> while gathering resources, doing corrupted portals and in Elite Areas. Use Wrathstone to craft extremely powerful <font color="#edc63e">Conqueror's Gear</font> for the battlefield. 
	

Salvage Conqueror and Ethereal items or refine basic materials such as ore, wood, stone, fiber and hides into <font color="#edc63e">Ethereal Dust</font> which can be further refined into <font color="#edc63e">Ethereal Expertise Animus</font>. These items can be consumed to gain experience and a chance to earn crafting patterns for Conqueror's Gear as well as other items to speed up your progress. Craft your first mount with Ethereal Dust at any camp and is usable at level 15. 
	

Ethereal, Conqueror's Gear and Wrathstones <font color="#edc63e">drop on death</font> in the open world and can be gathered by other players. Ethereal and Conqueror's Gear have <font color="#edc63e">durability</font> and cannot be repaired. 
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >REWARDS AND SEASON END</font>
	
Earn unique skins, titles, and rewards from the <font color="#edc63e">Season Journey</font> and leaderboards.
	

At the end of the season, you can <font color="#edc63e">transfer your character to another world</font>, keeping progression and rewards such as skins and titles that you've earned. Ethereal and Conqueror's gear will be converted into alternative gear available on standard worlds. The leaderboard season ends early in this world. Ensure to log in before world closes for good to claim leaderboard rewards.
tutorial_intro_seasonalserver_s7_prompt_: Entering a <font color="#edc63e">Seasonal World</font>.\n\nCraft and battle for <font color="#edc63e">Conqueror's Gear</font> - never before seen weapons and armor. Get ready, you will <font color="#edc63e">automatically flag for PvP</font> at Level {^u|javelin.pvp-always-on-min-level^}.
tutorial_invasion_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >WAVES</font>
	
The corrupted enemies will attack the fort in waves, with each successive wave becoming stronger.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >WIN CONDITION</font>
	
The corrupted army will try to knock down the gates and take a control point within the fort. If players successfully defend the claim point from invasion, they will win.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >RESPAWNING</font>
	
As the war goes on, there will be longer and longer Respawn waves. When soldiers are killed, they will respawn in the next Respawn wave.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BATTLE TOKENS</font>
	
Players earn Battle Tokens by damaging their enemies. Use Battle Tokens to purchase various items from Armory.
tutorial_invasion_01_prompt_body: The enemies will attack in waves, with each successive wave becoming stronger. Defend the claim point from the invasion.
tutorial_inventorymanagement_01_body:
Inventory lets you view your <font color="#edc63e">Character</font> and <font color="#edc63e">Items</font> you've picked up in the world. <font color="#edc63e">Search</font>, <font color="#edc63e">Filter</font>, and <font color="#edc63e">Sort</font> items using the options at the top of the Inventory menu.
    \n 
    \n • <font color="#edc63e">Search:</font> Item Name, Perks, Gems, Gear Score, Tier
    \n • <font color="#edc63e">Filter:</font> Equipment, Materials
    \n • <font color="#edc63e">Sort:</font> Weight, Gear Score, Tier, Time
tutorial_inventorymanagement_02_body: Customize your character's Weapons and Armors by accessing Changing Skins and Dying Items through the Options button. \n \nYou can also access Augments to use XP Boosters and Permits.
tutorial_inventorymanagement_prompt_body: Learn how to manage your Inventory and '<font color="#edc63e">Search</font>, <font color="#edc63e">Filter</font>, <font color="#edc63e">Sort</font>' items you've picked up in the world in the Journal.
tutorial_itemperks1_01_dialogue_body:
Items can have <font color="#edc63e">perks</font> that <font color="#edc63e">modify their power</font>. Perks can include:
	

 • Gem slot
	
 • Charm slot(offensive, defensive, and skill)
	
 • Attack modifiers
	
 • Power modifiers
	
 • Tradeskill modifiers
	
 • And more!
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SET BONUSES</font>
	
Some gear is part of a set. When you equip enough items from the same set, it will activate additional bonuses and modifiers.
	

Perks and set bonuses are listed in the tooltips of items.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ITEM RARITY</font>
	
The rarity of an item shows how many perks an item has. For uncommon and above combat gear, it can have a mix of perk types.
    

 • <font color="#b9b9b9">Common</font> no perks
    
 • <font color="#07bf2e">Uncommon</font> 1-2 perks
    
 • <font color="#278dda">Rare</font> 3 perks
	
 • <font color="#ff16f7">Epic</font> 4 perks
    
 • <font color="#edc63e">Legendary</font> 5 perks
tutorial_itemperks1_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Item perks</font> modify your gear's power.
tutorial_itemperks1_02_dialogue_body:
The rarity of an item is a quick way to tell how many perks the item has:
    

• <font color="#b9b9b9">Common</font> items don't have any perks.
    
 • <font color="#07bf2e">Uncommon</font> items can have 1-2 perks: 1 that increases attributes and potentially a second that will either be a gem slot or a power or functionality modifying perk.
    
 • <font color="#278dda">Rare</font> items have 3 perks: 1 increasing attributes, and 2 that will either be a gem slot or a power or functionality modifying perk. 
    
 • <font color="#ff16f7">Epic</font> items have 4 perks: 1 increasing attributes, and 3 that will either be a gem slot or a power or functionality modifying perk. 
    
 • <font color="#edc63e">Legendary</font> items have 5 perks: 1 increasing attributes, a gem slot, and 3 power or functionality modifying perks.
tutorial_jumppad_01_prompt_body: Press {$movement.jump$} while standing on <font color="#edc63e">Jump Pads</font>.\n\nJump pads always move you <font color="#edc63e">forward</font>, so line yourself up before jumping.
tutorial_lifestaff1_01_dialogue_body:
The <font color="#edc63e">Life Staff</font> is magic support weapon that consumes <font color="#edc63e">mana</font> and channels the restorative power of Nature spells to keep yourself and allies alive. 

While the Life Staff can damage enemies, it is strongest when its used to heal and buff your allies.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >LIFE STAFF ATTRIBUTES</font>
The Life Staff's power scales exclusively off the <font color="#edc63e">focus attribute</font>. Healing is more effective the more focus you have, so maximize it to provide the strongest heals for your allies.
tutorial_lifestaff1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Life Staff</font>, a support weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_lifestaff2_01_dialogue_body:
The Life Staff has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Healing</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Protector</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >HEALING TREE</font>
While both trees offer a mix of both healing and protection, the Healing tree has a stronger focus on healing as its name suggests.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >PROTECTOR TREE</font>
The Protector tree has sustained heals but provides additional protection for allies using fortify when healing may not be needed.
tutorial_lifestaff2_01_prompt_body: Learn about Life Staff's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_lifestaff3_01_dialogue_body:
Targeted Healing can be adjusted in the settings menu. Targeted Healing allows some healing spells to <font color="#edc63e">automatically target allies when aimed</font>. It will force targeted spells to lock into nearby allies if they are within 25 meters of you.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >GROUP HEALING MODE</font>
You can adjust your targeted healing to enable <font color="#edc63e">group mode</font>, which will allow the player to scroll through only the allies in your group. With group mode disabled, it will scroll through the allies within range in front of the player.

These settings have additional customization for raid groups and with additional hotkeys in the bindings menus.
tutorial_lifestaff3_01_prompt_body: Learn how to use <font color="#edc63e">Targeted Healing</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_lifestaff4_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Healing tree, <font color="#edc63e">Divine Blessing</font>, increases the amount healed when healing an ally that has low health. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Protector tree, <font color="#edc63e">Magnify</font>, extends the duration of life staff buffs on targets healed by Light’s Embrace.
tutorial_lifestaff4_01_prompt_body: Learn about Life Staff's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_loot_biasing1_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Loot biasing</font> increases the chances of getting loot that reflects your equipped gear, including attributes, armor weight, and weapon type. For example if you’re wearing heavy armor with a constitution perk, you’re more likely to receive more heavy armor with a constitution perk. 
	

Loot biasing only takes into account your <font color="#edc63e">currently equipped gear</font> and is stronger at higher levels. It’s intended to help you find gear that’s more effective for your preferred build.
	

There is always a chance for loot biasing to impact your rewards when loot is dropped, and the chance is increased or even guaranteed for some activities such as Mutators and Outpost Rush.
tutorial_loot_biasing1_01_prompt_body: Your equipped gear helps <font color="#edc63e">bias the loot</font> you earn.
tutorial_manage_raids_01_dialogue_body: Leaders can <font color="#edc63e">manage their raid</font> using {$ui.toggleRaidWindow$}. Change group composition and promote other players to a leadership role.\n\nRaid leaders can also <font color="#edc63e">Shout Ping</font>. Shout Pings will be visible to the entire raid. Bring up the Ping menu and follow instructions.
tutorial_manage_raids_01_prompt_body: Leaders can manage their raid using {$ui.toggleRaidWindow$}.
tutorial_mirrorrespawn_01_prompt_body: A magical clock that captures an imprint of your soul. Respawn at <font color="#edc63e">Altars of Chronos</font> scattered throughout Nighthaven.
tutorial_mount_customization_01_dialogue: In the <font color="#edc63e">Mount Inventory</font>, you can equip <font color="#edc63e">Mount Buff Items</font> in the Shoe and Strap Add-On Slots. These provide a variety of buffs to your mount. There are also two attachment slots where you can equip <font color="#edc63e">Mount Attachment Items</font>. These are decorative items that show up on the back left and right of your mount.
tutorial_mount_customization_01_prompt_b: <font color="#edc63e">Customize</font> your <font color="#edc63e">Mount</font> in the <font color="#edc63e">Mount Inventory</font>.\n\nSome items provide <font color="#edc63e">bonuses</font> to your mount.
tutorial_mount_dash_button_01_dialogue_b: When <font color="#edc63e">dashing</font> (by holding {$player.mount_dash$}), a stamina bar will appear and your mount will respond with a burst of increased speed. Once the stamina bar is fully depleted or when not actively dashing, this bar will recharge.
tutorial_musket1_01_dialogue_body: The Musket is a <font color="#edc63e">ranged weapon</font> that fires high-damage cartridges that can penetrate multiple targets. Ideal for keeping targets at a distance with a high payoff for precision.
tutorial_musket1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Musket</font>, a precision ranged weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_musket2_01_dialogue_body:
Musket has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Sharpshooter</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Trapper</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SHARPSHOOTER TREE</font>
The Sharpshooter tree focuses on precision and damage. Stay at a safe distance where you can land precision shots to maximize the abilities on this tree.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >TRAPPER TREE</font>
The Trapper tree focuses on catching enemies too close for comfort. Distance your targets using trapping abilities while dealing massive damage.
tutorial_musket2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Musket's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_musket3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Sharpshooter tree, <font color="#edc63e">Deadeye</font>, rewards you for landing headshots or lining up shots that hit multiple targets. Maximize distance and focus on headshots into crowds to maximize this ultimate.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Hunter tree, <font color="#edc63e">Lethal Combo</font>, gives you a damage bonus against targets affected by Trapper tree debuffs. Time your shots and maximize the uptime of your debuffs to keep your damage flowing.
tutorial_musket3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Musket's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_opening_containers_01_prompt_bo: <font color="#edc63e">Open</font> reward <font color="#edc63e">containers</font> from your {$ui.toggleInventoryWindow$} inventory.
tutorial_outpostrush_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CAPTURE OUTPOSTS</font>
	
Capture outposts and slay the enemy to score points. First team to 1000 points wins!
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >GATHERING RESOURCES</font>
	
Gather infused wood, ore, and hides to upgrade your outposts by building gates and siege weapons. Build a command post to gain powerful offensive and defensive boosts for your team.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SUMMON MONSTROUS ALLIES</font>
	
Use summoning stones to summon powerful allies at summoning circles. Summon a bear by defeating the powerful Alpha Wolf or gain an ultra-powerful brute ally by defeating and closing the corrupted portal.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SLAY THE BOSS</font>
	
Baroness Hain is the ghost of a long dead noble that haunts the island. Slay her to gain a powerful buff that increases the defense of your team and freezes the enemy score!
tutorial_outpostrush_01_prompt_body: Capture outposts and slay the enemy to score points. First team to 1000 points wins.
tutorial_pinging_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Pinging</font> allows you to mark locations and enemies in the world to <font color="#edc63e">notify your group members</font> or for your own navigation.\n\n<font color="#edc63e">Tap</font> {$ui.target_tag$} to place a marker under your reticle. <font color="#edc63e">Hold</font> {$ui.target_tag_selection$} to choose a different marker.
tutorial_pinging_01_prompt_body: {$ui.target_tag$} <font color="#edc63e">Ping</font> a location.\n\nHold {$ui.target_tag_selection$} to select a ping type.
tutorial_prone_01_dialogue_body: Use <font color="#edc63e">Prone</font> and move forward to crawl through tight spaces or hide from enemies. Being prone also has the additional advantage of causing your <font color="#edc63e">Nameplate to disappear</font> from the view of other Players. While it takes a moment to stand up, you can use tactic to ambush PvP opponents in areas with lots of bushes or debris.
tutorial_prone_01_prompt_body: {$movement.prone_toggle_pad$} <font color="#edc63e">Prone</font> and <font color="#edc63e">move forward</font> to crawl.
tutorial_prone_01_prompt_body_kbam: {$movement.prone_toggle$} <font color="#edc63e">Prone</font> and <font color="#edc63e">move forward</font> to crawl.
tutorial_pvp_flagging_01_dialogue_body: Flagging for PvP (Player versus Player) allows you to <font color="#edc63e">fight players</font> in other Factions in the open world. You can also fight for <font color="#edc63e">territory</font> by participating in <font color="#edc63e">Influence Races</font>: an open world PvP activity scheduled daily.
tutorial_pvp_flagging_01_prompt_body: {$player.fishing_activate$} <font color="#edc63e">Hold</font> and press {$player.block$} <font color="#edc63e">to Flag for PvP</font> in a sanctuary.
tutorial_pvp_flagging_01_prompt_body_kba: {$ui.togglePvpFlag$} <font color="#edc63e">to Flag for PvP</font> in a sanctuary
tutorial_pvp_prone_prompt_body: {$movement.prone_toggle_pad$} <font color="#edc63e">Prone during PvP</font> to hide your nameplate from rivals.
tutorial_pvp_prone_prompt_body_kbam: {$movement.prone_toggle$} <font color="#edc63e">Prone during PvP</font> to hide your nameplate from rivals.
tutorial_pvp_rewards_track1_01_dialogue_: Earn <font color="#edc63e">PvP XP</font> and <font color="#edc63e">Azoth Salt</font> during PvP activities such as Outpost Rush, War, and Influence Races. As you earn PvP XP, you will rank up in the PvP Rewards Track and unlock rewards you can purchase with Azoth Salt. Learn more about the PvP Rewards Track by opening your <font color="#edc63e">Character menu</font> and navigating to PvP.
tutorial_pvp_rewards_track1_01_prompt_bo: Prevail in PvP to earn rewards on the <font color="#edc63e">PvP Rewards Track</font>.
tutorial_pvpenabled_seasonalserver_s7_pr: You are now <font color="#edc63e">permanently flagged for PvP</font> on this world. Good luck!
tutorial_pvpwarning_seasonalserver_s7_pr: Reminder: You will <font color="#edc63e">permanently flag for PvP at level {^u|javelin.pvp-always-on-min-level^}</font>.
tutorial_raid_groups_01_dialogue_body:
<font color="#edc63e">Raid groups</font> are comprised of four groups of five players each, up to <font color="#edc63e">twenty players</font> total. Join or create Raid Groups to stick together during Open World activities such as Elite Chest Runs and Influence Races, or to join trials such as the Sandwurm.

<font color="#edc63e">Create a raid</font> by first creating a group then navigating to the Group tab in the social menu. Select "Convert to Raid" at the bottom of the window.

Raid Leaders have access to <font color="#edc63e">Shout Pings</font> that notify the entire raid.
tutorial_raid_groups_01_prompt_body: Convert a group into a <font color="#edc63e">Raid</font> by opening the Social menu, navigating to Group, and selecting Convert to Raid.
tutorial_rapier1_01_dialogue_body: The Rapier is a <font color="#edc63e">speed-oriented</font> melee weapon with a variety of quick lunge attacks. It excels at precise timing and outmaneuvering opponents while applying bleeds that gradually drain the target's health.
tutorial_rapier1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Rapier</font>, a dexterous melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_rapier2_01_dialogue_body:
The Rapier has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Blood</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Grace</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BLOOD TREE</font>
The Blood tree focuses on heavy damage and applying the Bleed effect to your enemies. The Bleed status effect results in small but continuous damage to your enemies. Capitalize on it with perks and other abilities to severely punish those that oppose you.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >GRACE TREE</font>
The Grace tree is a versatile tree that focuses on positioning, maneuverability, and timing. Mastering this tree will turn you into a force to be reckoned with.
tutorial_rapier2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Rapier's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_rapier3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Blood tree, <font color="#edc63e">Bloody End</font>, is an extension of the Flourish and Finish ability that increases the damage applied when Finish consumes the bleeds on your target. Stack as many bleeds as you can before using Flourish and Finish to deal devastating damage to those unlucky enough to reach their Bloody End.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Grace tree, <font color="#edc63e">Momentum</font>, increases the damage of your next basic attack after performing an ability. Use timing and positioning to alternate abilities and basic attacks to maximize Momentum.
tutorial_rapier3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Rapier's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_salvage_items: Salvage your weapons, armor, and tools for <font color="#edc63e">Repair parts</font>.
tutorial_salvaging_01_dialogue_body: Many items in your inventory can be <font color="#edc63e">salvaged</font>. You can do this to get coin, new items, or simply reduce your current carry weight. Most equipment will salvage into some of their base components, such as planks or ingots, while unique items from Expeditions will salvage into Dungeon Materia. Other exceptions include fish, which can be salvaged into cooking ingredients, alchemy reagents, and other crafting resources.\n\nTo salvage an item, select it in your inventory and follow the directions shown in the flyout.
tutorial_salvaging_01_prompt_body: You're encumbered! Try <font color="#edc63e">salvaging</font> items to reduce your carry weight.
tutorial_skins_01_dialogue_body: Change the appearance of your gear. Open your inventory, select the slot you wish to change, and select <font color="#edc63e">Change Skin</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Dye</font>.\n\nYou can unlock more Skins and Dyes by purchasing them in the store, through Transmog, and unlocking them through in and out of game events including the Seasonal Reward Track.
tutorial_skins_01_prompt_body: You received an item that unlocked a <font color="#edc63e">new appearance</font>! Use a <font color="#edc63e">Transmog Token</font> at any <font color="#edc63e">Stylemancer</font> to unlock it.
tutorial_socialmenu_01_prompt_body: {$player.social_align$} <font color="#edc63e">Open Social Actions</font> while hovering over a player.
tutorial_soul_trial_01_dialogue_body: <font color="#edc63e">Soul Trial</font> entrances are found throughout <font color="#edc63e">Aeternum</font>, denoted by blue spinning triangles at their entrances. Soul Trials are solo boss challenges with unique rewards.\n\nSome Trials are repeatable. Navigate to the Soul Trials section of the <font color="#edc63e">Activity Finder</font> to learn about repeating unlocked Trials.
tutorial_soul_trial_01_prompt_body: <font color="#edc63e">Soul Trials</font> are instanced solo challenges.
tutorial_spear1_01_dialogue_body: The Spear is a <font color="#edc63e">melee weapon</font> that utilizes its long reach for aggressive, thrusting attacks. Perfect for strategic positioning, applying persistent pressure, and keeping targets at a distance.
tutorial_spear1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Spear</font>, a zoning melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_spear2_01_dialogue_body:
Spear has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Zoner</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Impaler</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ZONER TREE</font>
The Zoner tree focuses keeping your target at a distance. The abilities use crowd control to limit an enemy's movement, while allowing you to unleash your quick and aggressive attacks on them.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >IMPALER TREE</font>
The Impaler Tree is focused on dealing damage and debuffing your target. This tree benefits aggressive precision. Master the flow of diverse actions and turn into a powerhouse on the battlefield; even your dodges can be offensive!
tutorial_spear2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Spear's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_spear3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Zoner tree, <font color="#edc63e">Reserved Strength</font>, gives you a persistent damage bonus when you have maximum stamina. Focus on stamina regeneration and avoid stamina depleting moves like blocking or dodging.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Impaler tree, <font color="#edc63e">Exploited Weakness</font>, gives you a damage bonus per debuff on your target. Stack debuffs on your target and keep them active to maximize your damage.
tutorial_spear3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the Spear's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_statuseffects1_01_dialogue_body:
Status Effects are <font color="#edc63e">buffs</font> or <font color="#edc63e">debuffs</font> you can apply to yourself or opponents. 

Active status effects are visible above your own health bar and on enemy nameplates. <font color="#edc63e">Buffs</font>, positive status effects, have a black background while <font color="#edc63e">debuffs</font>, or negative status effects, have a red background.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >STATUS EFFECT CATEGORIES</font>
Status effects have a category or type assocated with them that you can find in item perks and weapon mastery tooltips.

The main two status effect categories are buffs (positive effects) and debuffs (negative effects), with debuffs being broken up into 3 separate sub-categories:
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Damage over Time (DoT)</font>: Effects that deal periodic ticks of damage for the duration of the effect.
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Debilitate</font>: Effects that modify the power of the target.
	
 • <font color="#edc63e">Crowd Control (CC)</font>: Effects that modify the movement, speed, and positioning of the target.
tutorial_statuseffects1_01_prompt_body: Administer - or obtain - <font color="#edc63e">buffs</font> and <font color="#edc63e">debuffs</font> in combat.
tutorial_statuseffects1_02_dialogue_body: BUFFS Buffs are positive effects that increase a character's power. Buffs are represented with a black background. Common Buff Status Effect Categories: • Empower: Increases the player's outgoing base damage by a percent. • Fortify: Increases the player's armor by a percent. • Haste: Increases the player's movement speed. • Anointed: Increases how much health the player gets from incoming healing. • Uninterruptible: Prevents the player from being affected by staggers and knockdowns. DEBUFFS Debuffs are negative effects that hinder or decrease a character's power. Debuffs are represented with a red background. Common Debuff Status Effect Categories: • Weaken: Debilitate effect that reduces the outgoing base damage by a percent. • Rend: Debilitate effect that reduces armor by a percent. • Disease: Debilitate effect that reduces how much health the player gets from incoming healing. • Slow: Crowd Control effect that reduces the movement speed. • Root: Crowd Control effect that immediately halts movement. • Stun: Crowd Control effect that immediately halts movement and prevents the target from performing actions for the duration of the effect, or until a hit is taken.
tutorial_statuseffects1_03_dialogue_body:
Status effects have a category or type assocated with them that you can find in item perks and weapon mastery tooltips.

The main two status effect categories are buffs (positive effects) and debuffs (negative effects), with debuffs being broken up into a 3 separate sub-categories:
    
 • Damage over Time (DoT): Effects that deal periodic ticks of damage for the duration of the effect.
    
 • Debilitate: Effects that modify the power of the target.
    
 • Crowd Control (CC): Effects that modify the movement, speed, and positioning of the target.
tutorial_statuseffects1_04_dialogue_body: Debuffs are negative effects that hinder or decrease a character's power. Debuffs are represented with a red background. Common Debuff Status Effect Categories: • Weaken: Debilitate effect that reduces the outgoing base damage by a percent. • Rend: Debilitate effect that reduces armor by a percent. • Disease: Debilitate effect that reduces how much health the player gets from incoming healing. • Slow: Crowd Control effect that reduces the movement speed. • Root: Crowd Control effect that immediately halts movement. • Stun: Crowd Control effect that immediately halts movement and prevents the target from performing actions for the duration of the effect, or until a hit is taken.
tutorial_storageshed_01_body:
Aeternum has a <font color="#edc63e">Storage Shed</font> in each settlement and outpost.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ACCESS</font>
	
Access your Storage Sheds in other territories using the drop-down menu.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SORTING</font>
	
Sort items in storage by Weight, Gear Score, Tier, and Time.
    

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >WEIGHT LIMITS</font>
	
Increase the weight limit of each storage shed by choosing the Storage Bonus when you raise Territory Standing or by placing storage furniture in your house.
tutorial_storageshed_prompt_01_body: <font color="#edc63e">Storage Sheds</font> provide access to items you've stored at <font color="#edc63e">any</font> settlement.\n\n<font color="#edc63e">Use the drop down</font> to change which settlement to store/take items from.
tutorial_swordshield1_01_dialogue_body: The Sword and Shield are a pair of melee-focused weapons that offer solid offensive and defensive capabilities when used together. Use a combination of arcing swings and lunges in your attacks and a shield to maximize your and your allies' defense.
tutorial_swordshield1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Sword and Shield</font>, a duo of melee weapons, in the Journal.
tutorial_swordshield2_01_dialogue_body:
The Sword and Shield have two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Swordmaster</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Defender</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >SWORDMASTER TREE</font>
The Swordmaster tree focuses on a strong offense. Apply pressure to enemies to deal powerful damage with the abilities in this tree.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DEFENDER TREE</font>
The Defender tree focuses on a strong defense and tanking. The abilities focus on interrupting and staggering targets and provides you improved survivability and buffs.
tutorial_swordshield2_01_prompt_body: Learn about Sword and Shield's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_swordshield3_01_dialogue_body:
The ultimate ability for the Swordmaster tree, <font color="#edc63e">Leadership</font>, provides a persistent damage bonus to all members in your group, including yourself. 

The ultimate ability for the Defender tree, <font color="#edc63e">Defensive Formation</font>, will summon a defensive area whenever you are blocking and reduces the damage taken by all nearby allies. Positioning is key for this ultimate, as it can aid in keeping nearby allies alive while they deal damage to targets focused on you. Pair this ultimate with taunts to maximize its power against non-player enemies.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >TANKING WITH THE SWORD AND SHIELD</font>
You can tank using the Sword and Shield by using a <font color="#edc63e">Carnelian gem</font> in your Sword to activate certain taunt abilities. Taunting non-player enemies will cause them to focus on you, allowing your allies to capitalize on the enemy's distraction. Keep an eye out for the "Taunt Gem Compatible" text in ability tooltips to learn what abilities can trigger taunts.
tutorial_swordshield3_01_prompt_body: Learn about Sword and Shield's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_target_lock_01_dialogue_body:
{$combat.camera_lock_toggle$} Use to <font color="#edc63e">Target Lock</font> the closest enemy to your reticle. Your camera will be focused on the indicated target.

Cycle through nearby targets using {$combat.camera_lock_next_target_ccw$}. Your Target Lock will break if you lose sight of the target, get out of range, or your target dies.

Release Target Lock by pressing {$combat.camera_lock_toggle$} again.
tutorial_target_lock_01_prompt_body: {$combat.camera_lock_toggle$} Aim and press to <font color="#edc63e">lock on</font> to an enemy.
tutorial_targetlockswitch_prompt_body: {$combat.camera_lock_toggle$} <font color="#edc63e">Target Lock</font> your enemy.\n\n{$combat.camera_lock_next_target_cw$} <font color="#edc63e">Switch</font> between nearby enemies.
tutorial_territory_ownership1_01_dialogu:
<font color="#edc63e">Companies</font> can own and manage territories in Aeternum. When a Company owns a territory, they <font color="#edc63e">earn a percentage of the fees</font> paid by other players in Aeternum in return for managing their territory. Companies fight for territories by participating in an <font color="#edc63e">Influence Race</font> and going to <font color="#edc63e">War</font>.

Earn enough Influence during an <font color="#edc63e">Influence Race</font> by completing PvP Missions for an opportunity to declare War if your faction wins. You can declare war from the map. Influence Races are scheduled in various territories daily. Once a <font color="#edc63e">War</font> is declared, it will be scheduled the next day according to the defending company's Siege window.

When your Company wins a War, you will own the territory. Manage the territory by starting <font color="#edc63e">Town Projects</font> in the territory's Town Hall that give Lifestyle Buffs and upgrade the Settlement and Fort.
tutorial_territory_ownership1_01_prompt_: War for <font color="#edc63e">territory ownership</font> with your Company.
tutorial_territory_standing1_01_dialogue:
While active in a territory, your reputation within that zone will spread, tracked as your <font color="#edc63e">Territory Standing</font>. Your standing in each territory is separate.
	

Ways to increase your Territory Standing include:
	
 • Crafting	
 • Completing Town Projects	
 • Destroying Corrupted Monoliths (requires an Azoth Staff)
	

When you level up your Standing, you can select a card to <font color="#edc63e">upgrade specific bonuses within that territory</font>. These bonuses include:
	
 • Increasing experience gain	
 • Lowering taxes and fees	
 • Increasing storage capacity
	

When reaching Territory Standing 1, you can unlock <font color="#edc63e">House Ownership</font> which will allow you to purchase houses located in that territory's settlements. Houses have multiple uses but you can only own three houses across all territories.
	

There are many advantages to increasing your Territory Standing all across Aeternum so be sure to build up your reputation in the territories you frequent most!
tutorial_territory_standing1_01_prompt_b: Use <font color="#edc63e">Territory Standing</font> to unlock bonuses.
tutorial_town_boards1_01_dialogue_body: Town Project Boards are always located outside of the settlement's Town Hall and display missions that contribute towards an active Town Project. When enough contribution has been made, the project succeeds and buffs the territory. Projects can result in: • Upgrading the settlement's Crafting and Refining stations • Upgrading the local Fort's defenses • Temporary Combat, Crafting, or Gathering buffs Lifestyle Buffs are chosen by the territory's governing Company. Take advantage of active buffs by owning a house there. The project quests can vary from combat to exploration to crafting. They refresh every 30 minutes, so there's plenty of opportunities for you to participate. For your reward, you'll receive experience, coin, and increase your Territory Standing.
tutorial_town_boards1_01_prompt_body: Complete <font color="#edc63e">Town Projects</font> to improve settlements and gain rewards.
tutorial_transmog1_01_dialogue_body: Transmog lets you capture the appearance of any item you've looted and use it to change the appearance of the items you wear. To unlock captured appearances, spend <font color="#edc63e">Transmog tokens</font> at a <font color="#edc63e">Stylemancer</font> in any settlement. Stylemancers will all have the Transmog icon conveniently located above their head! \n\nYou can purchase Transmog Tokens in the store, receive them on the Season Reward Track, and earn them from Elite Chests.
tutorial_voidgauntlet1_01_dialogue_body:
The Void Gauntlet is a magical weapon that consumes <font color="#edc63e">Mana</font> to harness the power of the abyss and deal void damage to enemies and heal allies. 

The Void Gauntlet is strongest when used to support allies that are near targets.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >VOIDE GAUNTLET ATTRIBUTES</font>
The Void Gauntlet's power scales off both the <font color="#edc63e">intelligence</font> and <font color="#edc63e">focus</font> attributes. 

Intelligence provides higher weapon damage. Focus exclusively controls the power of healing, but still provides some scaling to damage.
tutorial_voidgauntlet1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">Void Gauntlet</font>, a magic and support weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_voidgauntlet2_01_dialogue_body:
The Void Gauntlet has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Annihilation</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Decay</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >ANNIHILATION TREE</font>
The Annihilation tree focuses on keeping targets up close to debuff them while buffing yourself and allies. Reel your enemies in, then unleash Void Blade on them while they struggle to escape your wrath.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >DECAY TREE</font>
The Decay tree is ranged focused and specializes in damaging and debuffing enemies from a distance while also providing creative ways to heal yourself and allies.
tutorial_voidgauntlet2_01_prompt_body: Learn about Void Gauntlet's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in Tutorials.
tutorial_voidgauntlet3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Annihilation tree, <font color="#edc63e">Voidcaller</font>, triggers a healing aura around you when you stack ability hits on your targets. Focus your build on repetitive damage to your targets to maximize this ultimate.\n\nThe ultimate ability for the Decay tree, <font color="#edc63e">Glimpse of the Void</font>, resets all of your Void Gauntlet's cooldowns when you hit a target with a ranged heavy attack and have enough stacks of the Void Essence status effect. Focus your build on maximizing those stacks to become a relentless foe.
tutorial_voidgauntlet3_01_prompt_body: Learn about Void Gauntlet's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_voidgauntletharvest_01_prompt_b: Hold {$player.block_depressed$} to <font color="#edc63e">convert</font> your <font color="#edc63e">Health into Mana</font> when using a <font color="#edc63e">Void Gauntlet</font>.
tutorial_war_01_dialogue_body:
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CONTROL POINTS</font>
	
Attackers must take all 3 control points before the gates can be damaged. Once they are taken, the control points grant access to Armory and attackers may respawn there.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >WIN CONDITION</font>
	
Once all 3 control points are taken, attackers can try to knock down gates and <font color="#ebe3d6">take the control point in the fort.</font> If attackers succeed they will win the war; if attackers fail to claim it, defenders will win the war.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >RESPAWNING</font>
	
As the war goes on, there will be longer and longer Respawn waves. When soldiers are killed, they will respawn in the next Respawn wave.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >BATTLE TOKENS</font>
	
Players earn Battle Tokens by damaging their enemies. Use Battle Tokens to purchase various items from Armory.
tutorial_war_01_prompt_body: Attackers must take all 3 control points, knock down gates, and take the control point in the fort. If attackers succeed they will win the war.
tutorial_warhammer1_01_dialogue_body: The War Hammer is a <font color="#edc63e">mighty combat hammer</font> that can cause the earth to quake with its crushing strikes. Ideal for impeding enemies with ground tremors or dealing crippling blows directly to a target.
tutorial_warhammer1_01_prompt_body: Learn the basics of the <font color="#edc63e">War Hammer</font>, a crushing melee weapon, in the Journal.
tutorial_warhammer2_01_dialogue_body:
War Hammer has two ability trees to allocate points into. Choose between a variety of abilities, upgrades, and passives from the <font color="#edc63e">Juggernaut</font> or <font color="#edc63e">Crowd Crusher</font> trees.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >JUGGERNAUT TREE</font>
The Juggernaut tree is built around shrugging off hits you take and turning them into incredibly powerful attacks against your enemies.

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Regular.font" color="#c6b694" >CROWD CRUSHER TREE</font>
The Crusher tree focuses on dismantling groups of enemies and dealing additional damage to the crowd-controlled foes.
tutorial_warhammer2_01_prompt_body: Learn about the War Hammer's <font color="#edc63e">weapon mastery trees</font> in the Journal.
tutorial_warhammer3_01_dialogue_body: The ultimate ability for the Juggernaut tree, <font color="#edc63e">Justice For All</font>, is an extension of Mighty Gavel that grants you grit, reduces ability cooldowns, and increases the chance for a critical hit. Use this Mighty Gavel at the appropriate time to shrug off a stagger or reduce cooldowns so you can relentlessly bonk your targets. \n\nThe ultimate ability for the Crowd Crusher tree, <font color="#edc63e">Aftershock</font>, will slow your target every time you hit them with an ability. Use that time and space to keep pressure on your target and inflict efficient mayhem!
tutorial_warhammer3_01_prompt_body: Learn about the War Hammer's <font color="#edc63e">ultimate abilities</font> in the Journal.
twinfalls_body_01_01:
Finally, our travels across the Cleave has yielded fruit! We have come upon a stretch of land, fertile and rich, secluded enough that one may hear their own thoughts from the yammering and chopping of wood and clanging of hammer to metal in the settlements to the south. And the waterfalls nearby, such a sight to behold!

The traders of the outposts warned us of the dangers of the Cleave, but I see now they sought to keep us from the unblemished land – here is where we will make our mark, found a claim, and build our homes. We have seen little else but bear tracks in the area, and while numerous, we have not seen their owners since our arrival.

I must ask: Why has such a stretch lain untouched for so long?

Why, it must have been awaiting us - and we are thankful for nature's gift. We shall unload the wagons and put the timber within to good use!

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_01_02:
The beauty of the area is astounding. Everything grows so quickly in the earth, and so much so that the gardens are to bursting – Azoth blesses this place, the vegetation especially.

It grows so thickly, in fact, the men have taken to shifts to trimming away the excess vegetation on the houses and fences, yet it seems to grow back with every dawn, thicker than before. While the Adler Boys frequently complain of the chore, they did make mention of something I had not noticed before – they said the greenery seemed to grow thickest from the homes fashioned with the Wyrdwood timber we had carried with us from the West. Does one encourage the other?

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_01_03:
The Adler Boys, gossipers and layabouts, have been causing trouble, even though I've tried to put their idle hands to use trimming the vegetation back. The two made light that we need not need to fear the bears in the woods – we have no need to bolt our doors at night, for the grass and vine that beset our homes would do it for us.

May the bears take them both if they don't mind their tongues.

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_01_04:
Troubles plague us! Not from the land, nor the construction, but the animals, who have grown overbold at our intrusion. While we saw signs of bears and wolves in our journey here, we encountered nothing – yet now that we are making a home in this place, bears have been sighted in increasing numbers at the edge of our settlement.

We keep the doors secured, food out of reach, yet their numbers seem to grow with each passing day. I have sent the Adler Boys (they are the swiftest of us, since we lost the horses) to run for the local outpost for more powder and perhaps to hire some hunters – we shall make short work of these beasts. This is our home, not theirs, and if they persist, they shall see we have claws as well.

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_01_05:
Without the help of the Adler boys - even with their complaining and slowness at the task - the vegetation is proving more than a match for us – the vines are growing thick, more than we can hack away with every morning – and by afternoon, it tangles around our homes again. It is as if nature itself is seeking to drive us away.

Should things in the village become too much, I may seek shelter in the shack up the river, though I would not want to be trapped there should the bears roam that far, there is little place left to flee.

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_01_06:
The horror I beheld when I awoke this morning – our homes, swallowed in vines, and the roars of the bears through the village – I knew the wilderness acted with intent and did not welcome our intrusion. I confess my cowardice – I ran , ran here, but even the falls could not drown out the cries of the other villagers as the beasts fell upon them.

I fear no help will come. I no longer hold out hope for the Adler Boys' return: I pray they kept running, and they lead no one else to this False Paradise. A green death that surrounds us, and if we do not keep our wits about us, it shall harvest us, not the other way around.

Light fades, and I see great shapes circling the flimsy walls of this shack. I shall keep quiet and hope nothing comes - but I know this hope to be a lie.

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_02_01:
We were making our way east from the Cleave. We might not have noticed the unusual trees had one of the wagons not gotten caught in the mud. While the industrious among us fought to get it to solid footing, we made an unusual discovery – or should I say, the most idle among us made the discovery: the Adler Boys, who have yet to carry their weight beyond gossip and shirking their chores. In this instance, their idleness proved a boon.

The boys had slipped into the woods and had come upon a strange copse of trees – trees that seemed limmed with a strange blue light, suffusing the wood. We might not have known, had they not returned with branches from the same trees – branches they were using as makeshift swords, not knowing the value of what they held. The boys dubbed it “Wyrdwood” and insisted on keeping their new “swords.”

We quickly noticed the wood was remarkably lightweight and sturdy, so we set aside the labor with the wagon a moment to search the area. This wood may be worth harvesting – for if we fashioned homes or walls from the wood, such structures might prove remarkably sturdy. Perhaps the wagon being caught in the mud was not a setback after all, but a blessing!

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_02_02:
The Adler Boys led our band to the copse of the blue-limmed trees, the “Wyrdwood,” and the trees looked dense enough to harvest – it was unusually strong for its weight (though it took us fashioning some stronger hatchets to bring the trees down).

The discovery was a boost to morale – the discovery of the Wyrdwood even made me hesitant to berate the Adlers for straying from the wagons, though they had been warned countless times.

We set about harvesting what we could, while others got the wagons to dry ground – it seemed fortune favored us, and fortune could be made should we collect enough!

-Ealderman Wincroft
twinfalls_body_02_03:
Our fortune with the Wyrdwood soon turned sour. As we sought more of the trees, it did not take us long to see that the trees neighbored one of the great stone ruins: the same ancient ruins with the preserved corpses, standing at attention, the ones that were said to walk with blue fire in their chests. Fortunately, we spotted the ruins at a safe distance, so we quickly and quietly returned to camp – the lumber had already been loaded, so we were soon on our way.

I consulted my maps of the region, and if there were a tie between the wood and the ruins, it was likely other sources of the Wyrdwood could be found near other ancient sites. I did not wish to test our luck by seeking them out - but perhaps the knowledge could be of use to a merchant.

For now, we continue our search for a settlement to make our own – our wagons continued along the roads, making their way east: We'll travel to the other edge of the Cleave if need be, but I'll not settle for nesting near ruins or outposts, that much I swear.

-Ealderman Wincroft

<font color={headerColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">EXPERTISE</font>
Expertise is used to measure the maximum power of an item when you have it equipped.

<font color={subHeaderColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font">Max Expertise that you can reach</font>
<font color={highlightColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">{maximum}</font>


<font color={headerColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">HOW TO INCREASE EXPERTISE</font>

<font color={subHeaderColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font">Elite POIs and Expeditions</font>
Drops from creatures or chests in level 60+ areas have a chance to increase this value.

<font color={subHeaderColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font">Crafting</font>
Crafting a 600 GS item will increase Expertise of this item type.

<font color={subHeaderColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font">Gypsum Cast</font>
Opening a Gypsum Cast will increase Expertise.

<font color={subHeaderColor} face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font">Item Upgrade (with Umbral Shards)</font>
After you reach 600 Expertise, the only way to increase Expertise is via upgrading items with Umbral Shards.

ui_endgame_guide_body1: So you’ve hit Level 60! Congratulations! The world of Aeternum is now completely open to you. Here are the highlights of what life is like in the endgame.
ui_endgame_guide_body2: At Level 60 you have access to several new expeditions: Garden of Genesis in Edengrove, The Lazarus Instrumentality in Reekwater, Tempest’s Heart in Shattered Mountain, and Barnacles and Black Powder in Cutlass Keys.\n\nKeep an eye out for the circular red icon around two Expeditions at a time on the map—this means that Expedition is currently Mutated and offers higher difficulties but greater rewards. Some of the best endgame rewards come from the end bosses in Mutated Expeditions (more on that later).
ui_endgame_guide_body3:
At Level 60, you gain access to Outpost Rush. You can queue for the mode from any Faction representative, or some NPCs in Northern outposts, or the Modes tab on the nav bar. You can enter a queue solo or with a group of up to five.

The mode is a 20v20 PvPvE instanced battleground. There are three outposts which can be claimed to generate points for your team. They can be upgraded via gathering resources in the area and adding them to the gates, cannons, and more. To win, you’ll need to claim and hold these outposts, and the first team to 1,000 points wins the match.

As long as you make a minimum contribution of 500 points for your team, either through PvP or PvE, you will get rewards at the end of the match.
ui_endgame_guide_body4: When a territory is under attack from the Corrupted, you can sign up at the local War Board or the Upcoming Wars tab on the Map Screen to help defend the territory. Any faction can sign up, and there are 40 open slots chosen by the system each time. Invasions come in 6 waves, and the fort must be defended from being claimed by the Corrupted. If they do, the local settlement will experience random downgrades to its crafting stations or local lifestyle buffs.
ui_endgame_guide_body5:
Gypsum is the way to increase your expertise in a specific gear type.

Gypsum comes in different varieties, each of which can be used at a Gypsum Kiln to craft a Gypsum Orb. You’ll need a certain quantity of each type in order to craft 1 Gypsum Orb. A Gypsum Orb can then be used to create a Gypsum Cast of a specific gear type, which once consumed will grant a guaranteed Expertise bump for the chosen gear type and grant a new piece of gear of the higher gear score.

You can obtain Gypsum in various quantities by engaging in different activities as follows:

•Obsidian Gypsum, 3 per day – Level 60+ open-world named bosses, typically found in Elite Landmarks.
•Sapphire Gypsum, 2 per day – Lazarus Instrumentality and Garden of Genesis final bosses.
•Ruby Gypsum, 2 per day – Outpost Rush (must get at least 501 points in the match).
•Emerald Gypsum, 1 per day – Trade Skill Aptitude Reward Checkpoints.
•Citrine Gypsum, 2 per day – PvE arenas.
•Amethyst Gypsum, 7 per day – Closing Corrupted Breaches.
•Topaz Gypsum, 5 per day – Go to an Arcana Station or Tier 5 camp to craft an Attunement Potion. Drink the potion, then kill level 55+ enemies who will drop Topaz Gypsum.
•Diamond Gypsum, 3 per day – You can obtain Diamond Gypsum by gathering any type of node in Aeternum. This usually changes during Seasonal Events such as the Winter Convergence.
•Garnet Gypsum, 2 per day – 3v3 PVP Arenas.
ui_endgame_guide_body6: At Level 60, you gain access to the Season Journey. Each new Season features added adventures and bonus items for completing these adventures during the season timeline. Access the exclusive experience before the season ends!

ui_factions_guide_1_body: Before joining a faction, you must prove yourself by completing a series of Faction Initiation Quests. Reach Level 17 and seek out the initial quest givers for each faction in or near the village of Oxboro in Everfall.
ui_factions_guide_2_body: By joining a faction, you get access to Faction Missions, open world PvP, and Wars. You will be able to take part in shifting control of territories towards your faction.\n\nAdventuring within a territory your faction controls will grant several varying bonuses, such as increased XP gain.

ui_freeweekend_guide_body1: During the Free Weekend event, any player may download New World: Aeternum and create a character to play. Some worlds are restricted to players who have purchased New World: Aeternum. Free players may not transfer characters between worlds nor access the Store and Trading Post. Free player characters are also restricted to a maximum of 2,000.
ui_freeweekend_guide_body2: Use the Social Menu to search for friends in the same world or respond to invites from other players. Participate and join multiplayer activities such as Arena and Outpost Rush. Find a party and embark on an Expedition by opening the Group Finder menu from the map by hovering over any Expedition’s icon.
ui_freeweekend_guide_body3: For free players, New World: Aeternum periodically checks to see if there is a queue for their character’s world. Players may play as long as they like if their world has no queue when this session time check is made. If there is a queue at that time, the free player will be returned to the Main Menu and may queue to reenter the world. If there is no queue at that time, the free player’s session time will be extended until the next check. Players who have purchased New World: Aeternum do not have session time checks and have queue priority over free players.
ui_freeweekend_guide_body4: New World: Aeternum can be purchased through the Steam Store. All characters, items, and progress earned as a free player will be carried forward after purchasing New World: Aeternum. However, only the total time played by all characters on an account after purchase will accrue towards unlocking features such as Player-to-Player Trading and access to the Store and Trading Post.

ui_groupfinder_role_dps_description: A damage dealer's role is to deal as much damage as possible to as many enemies as possible. They are responsible for killing foes before they can overwhelm the party. Damage dealers should invest in skills and attributes that focus on high damage and area of effect (AOE) attacks.
ui_groupfinder_role_dps_recommended: Blunderbuss, Bow, Fire Staff, Great Axe, Hatchet, Ice Gauntlet, Musket, Rapier, Spear, Void Gauntlet
ui_groupfinder_role_healer_description: Healers are responsible for keeping the party alive utilizing healing and mitigation buffs such as fortify. Healers can also be responsible for removing harmful debuffs from their allies such as bleeding or poison. Healers should invest in the Focus stat to maximize their healing effectiveness.
ui_groupfinder_role_tank_description: A tank's role in the party is to absorb damage and attract the attention of enemies away from their allies. Tanks should wear heavy armor and equip Carnellian gems to allow them to taunt foes. A tank usually has some form of crowd control (stun, root, flatten) to stop foes from getting to their allies.
ui_groupfinder_role_tank_recommended: Sword and Shield, Great Axe, War Hammer

ui_landingscreen_disclaimer2:
A very small percentage of individuals may experience epileptic seizures when exposed to certain visual images, including light patterns or flashing lights that may appear in video game or other video content. Exposure to certain patterns or backgrounds on a computer screen or while playing video games may induce an epileptic seizure in these individuals. Certain conditions may induce previously undetected epileptic symptoms even in persons who have no history of prior seizures or epilepsy.

If you or anyone in your family have an epileptic condition, consult your physician prior to playing New World: Aeternum.

If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing - dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of awareness, disorientation, any involuntary movement, or convulsions - discontinue use IMMEDIATELY and consult your physician before resuming use of New World: Aeternum.

ui_mounts_bear_description: Humphrey is a big, grumpy powerhouse of an animal; utterly protective to those he loves./
ui_mounts_bear_description_1: Corrupted Mauler is an all-round menace. Big, fast and hard as nails. A true force of nature.
ui_mounts_bear_description_2: Titan's size betrays the element of surprise. They will hear him coming and, when they do, they run.
ui_mounts_bear_description_3: Contrary to his name, Behemoth is mostly a gentle and placid soul. Mostly.
ui_mounts_bear_description_4: Stooge's penchant for the taste of fish has propelled him into the nightmares of many a salmon.
ui_mounts_bear_description_5: Humphrey's coat helps disguise him at night. Beware, he may be the last thing you see.
ui_mounts_bear_description_6: Renboga may look like a circus bear but, trust me, there's nothing funny about his temper.
ui_mounts_bear_description_7: Goliath is as loyal to his friends as he is to his appetite. His good nature ensures he takes care of both.
ui_mounts_bear_description_8: Apparently there's a trick to making Morti relent, however anyone that's tried is no longer around to tell the tale.
ui_mounts_bear_description_9: Has both the brains and the brawl to make her the toughest of adversaries.
ui_mounts_bear_hippo_description: Wow, a real hippo! I can bearly believe we found one in just under 1,000 days.
ui_mounts_bear_panda_description: No matter how big she grows, she always loves to cuddle. And eat bamboo.
ui_mounts_bear_winter_description: Has worn her hat and scarf ever since she was a cub.
ui_mounts_ghosthorse_description: Chloros obeys only Death... and those marked for it.
ui_mounts_horse_description: Loyal as a hound, proud as a lion, and fast as the wind.
ui_mounts_horse_description_2: Imposing iron barding conceals a will as hard as steel.
ui_mounts_horse_description_3: A nomad's soul. No home but the road ahead.
ui_mounts_horse_description_4: Quick as the North wind, as ashen as fresh fallen snow.
ui_mounts_horse_description_5: Dark as midnight, and as fast as a falling star.
ui_mounts_horse_description_6: A flaxen-maned beauty with the heart of a racer.
ui_mounts_horse_description_7: Felix wears his horned helm proudly. It boasts his might and majesty.
ui_mounts_horse_description_8: Rumor states Daemonicus was born of dark ritual. True or not, their vigor is not in question.
ui_mounts_horse_description_9: To Valhalla are the souls of the fallen carried upon his strong back.
ui_mounts_horse_rudolph_desc: That glowing nose is caused by Holiday Cheer and, thankfully, not Corruption.
ui_mounts_horse_starter_description: You will never forget that fateful day when you saw Moonshadow by the river bank.
ui_mounts_lion_description: An apex predator, and your friend through all troubles.
ui_mounts_lion_description_2: Quiet as a cat and as solid as iron.
ui_mounts_lion_description_3: A solitary hunter. The greatest threats are often those unseen.
ui_mounts_lion_description_4: It is said that the white lion is the messenger of a higher power.
ui_mounts_lion_description_5: Black lions herald the ending of one age, and the start of the next.
ui_mounts_lion_description_6: A rare breed, this majestic beast comes to the aid of those whose hearts remain wild.
ui_mounts_lion_description_7: Alacer's boundless energy defies laws of nature. Sleep is for the weak.
ui_mounts_lion_description_8: While Sicarius is unusually cold to the touch, in their belly the fires burn.
ui_mounts_lion_description_9: A proud beast that carries both himself and his partner with the dignity of a king.
ui_mounts_lion_starter_description: Your reward for navigating the cliff-face to rescue the caged lion. Great to have friends in high places.
ui_mounts_mtx_1_fox_description: A cunning mount to outfox your enemies.
ui_mounts_mtx_1_grunt_description: The Upyr Grunt is a fearsome beast of war.
ui_mounts_mtx_1_turkey_description: A turkey for riding, not eating.\n\nNOTE: This mount cannot be dyed, and it does not display attachments.
ui_mounts_mtx_2_fox_description: A stunning mount from the fridged mountians of Aeternum.
ui_mounts_mtx_2_grunt_description: This Beast is sustained by the blood of it's enemies.
ui_mounts_mtx_2_turkey_description: The spirit of last Thanksgiving.\n\nNOTE: This mount cannot be dyed, and it does not display attachments.
ui_mounts_mtx_3_grunt_description: Fear is just an appetizer for this fearsome creature.
ui_mounts_mtx_lion_cosmicpanther_descrip: By the heavens! She's full of stars!.
ui_mounts_not_owned: You do not own this mount.
ui_mounts_skeletonhorse_description: Life is a road well trodden. She waits for you at its end.
ui_mounts_skeletonturkey_description: Death should be a celebration, not a tragedy. And if there's a feast, hopefully it's beef that's on the menu.\n\nNOTE: This mount cannot be dyed, and it does not display attachments.
ui_mounts_undyeable: This mount's armor cannot be dyed.
ui_mounts_wolf_barbarian_desc: A brutal companion for bloody battle.
ui_mounts_wolf_description: Your bond with this canine cements your place as leader of the pack.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_10: Azoth Stalker is a cunning pack leader. Fearless, savvy and iron-willed by nature, these qualities has overseen their rise to the top.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_2: The claws of a natural hunter, matched with the steel of a knight on the warpath.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_3: A wolf without a pack is like a ghost in the fog.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_4: Fangs like fresh ice, and a coat like the snow on the mountaintops.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_5: Some say the wolves of twilight are an ill omen. But yours is loyal as the dawn.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_6: Gray as smoke with fire in its eyes.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_7: Smokey's stealth poise earnt him much acclaim. Enemies do not see him coming.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_8: Riding Malum evokes fear in the heart of your foe and allies alike.
ui_mounts_wolf_description_9: Loyal without compare and would even follow you into the afterlife.
ui_mounts_wolf_starter_description: Your reward for rescuing the wolves from their cages. May the pack forever be in your debt.
