ui_poi_40348_wintervillage_description: A mysterious village, as snowy as it is jovial, has appeared in Aeternum. Welcome to Winter Convergence!
ui_poi_50300_wintervillage_description: A mysterious village, as snowy as it is jovial, has appeared in Aeternum. Welcome to Winter Convergence!
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_mill_50202_descrip: For those foolish enough to be optimistic.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_40201_desc: Even the most novice of agriculturalists find it easy to master the rich soil of Aeternum.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_40267_desc: O'er yon Fallowhill didst story end\nBless'd soul sought Squash\nAnd yea, left want-ing
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_40298_desc: Old Farmer Kelleher could have never imagined the chaos that would spill forth upon his abandonment of the land.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_40303_desc: They learned, too late, that nothing can hold the darkness back.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_50203_desc: The ruins of a village built too close to the darkness.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_50204_desc: You can still hear the unborn children singing their hymns, praying for better fates.
ui_poi_abandoned_farm_village_50223_desc: The markets of Lappendorf once brought so much joy to travelers like yourself.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_40024_d: A perfect spot for fishing, as long as you don't mind the company.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_40057_d: Where Scarlet Bloom meets rich waters, a prismatic congregation of life flourishes.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_40245_d: The Syndicate often come here to acquire live samples of the aquatic life. That, or they just enjoy fishing.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_40246_d: On a clear day, you can see the Shattered Obelisk from here.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50106_d: The gateway to Reekwater and a bustling fishing village. Losing too many big fish, however, takes a toll...
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50205_d: Fishing as a pastime has relaxed many an adventurer. Sometimes, saving the world can wait.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50206_d: Who says nightmares can't be seen during the day?
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50207_d: One mustn't envision the abominations that ought lurk amid Aeternum's deep waters.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50209_d: If you leave a fish out of water, does it suffocate for eternity? Most people on Aeternum try not to think about it.
ui_poi_abandoned_fishing_village_50237_d: Not all horrors can be seen. Some must simply be felt, creeping up one's skin.
ui_poi_abandoned_haunted_town_50208_desc: Once home to the weavers that gave the fen their name, now nothing is left but the tattered remains of their city.
ui_poi_abandoned_homestead_highpoint_603: Belief is not enough to stop Aeternum from taking its due.
ui_poi_abandoned_homestead_overlook_6040: Once a thriving artist community, now a burned out husk thanks to the Corrupted.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40001_descripti: He held out against the dark hordes until at last, he saw himself in the looking glass.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40002_descripti: Her face took on a ghostly pallor... as the miller told his tale.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40015_descripti: Does the lifecycle of a fish differ here on Aeternum? The Syndicate's mission of truth is ever on the case.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40025_descripti: The spinning wheel may cure one's sorrow, but only for a spell.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40043_descripti: Sister village to <font color="#b2aea1">Kurok's Anchorage</font>. While both enjoy access to water, there is a noted preference for the river.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40044_descripti: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nA new Nemorensis by any name.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40050_descripti: Here the Hercyne gather. Each simulacrum a mockery of Beastkind abroad, an affront to the Beast Lords themselves.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40058_descripti: Was that something moving in the shrubbery?\nOr was that the shrubbery moving itself?
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40060_descripti: A symbol of human ingenuity and resilience, now subjugated to ruin. Seeds of hope are sown among the rubble.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40061_descripti: Old stewards fought petty hardships unnumbered here long ago. Now, Taurus commands by horn and drum. None have conquered the labyrinth.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40204_descripti: In the garden, did nature's children frolic with forever bliss, until eternity itself found limit.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40206_descripti: "These fields are fallow," he said for the third time, with a ruby glint of rage in his eye.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40289_descripti: Lugdunum Fields is generally the first and last stop for any Varangians of Stonereach who lose their way along their bloody incursion.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40307_descripti: Common sense said to raise a hunting lodge in Great Cleave was pure folly. And so the hunters became the quarry.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40308_descripti: A work site where evil designs are made manifest.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_40309_descripti: A dead fool is a lesson unlearned. But on Aeternum, not every death is a mistake.
ui_poi_abandoned_village_60409_descripti: The farmstead would seem almost normal, if it wasn't for the burning gaze of the inhabitants.
ui_poi_accursedcamp_60223_description: Accursed are those who take without asking, giving nothing back.
ui_poi_adianatrial_40078_description: Soul Trial\n\nHear us, Artemis, celebrated queen, eternal and Ancient, of a noble mien: In arrows rejoicing and on all to shine, bow-bearing Goddess, Diana divine; O'er Motherwell presided, Wild Creator and more, glorying in this Elysian war.
ui_poi_ae_cave_50120_description: Tunnels dark and tunnels deep, nature's fingers twist and creep.
ui_poi_ae_elite_50119_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nNature hides its most precious gifts, and when commanded, defends them to the death.
ui_poi_akhet_gates_30403_description: Where do these strange Anubian portals lead? What lies on the other side?
ui_poi_alligator_habitat_40275_descripti: All manner of beast have a chance for sanctuary in Aeternum.
ui_poi_alligator_lagoon_20310_descriptio: "Pay the King a fond hello,\nOr pay the King the toothy toll"\n- Unknown
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_30109_description: High in this meadow, wolves grow like weeds.
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_30110_description: The Marauders tried to domesticate the island's wolves, and utterly failed. Something about Aeternum had turned them inviolably feral.
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_30135_description: Try not to upset the cats.
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_40117_description: "The Woodsman and the Wolf" is a tale as old as time.
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_40118_description: A damp, stone floor is sweet respite after a frolic in the woods on a hot Summer's day.
ui_poi_alpha_wolf_den_40119_description: Beware the eyes that shine from the dark and oily shadows.
ui_poi_amrine_dungeon_description: Expedition\n\nWhy dig deeper, they asked him again and again. He never offered an answer.
ui_poi_ancient_archives_20410_descriptio: Could the artifacts of the Ancients be made whole once again?
ui_poi_ancient_beach_30058_description: Ancient remains litter this perilous island, housing treasures just as old. Don't be fooled by its beauty; danger lurks around every tree and stone.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_30013_description: And to the tower they went, over Ancient stones untouched by time.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_30075_description: The Goldcursed only allow the best to proceed down Admiral's Walk, anyone else is met with cutlass and cannon fire.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40019_description: It spans two islands, a true bridge between worlds.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40053_description: This amalgamation of Ancient architecture and twisted brambles provides a swift but deadly shortcut from the mainland to Saircor.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40121_description: With enough stones, even the sea parts, for a time.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40121_msq2_descrip: With enough stones, even the sea parts, for a time.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40126_description: Surprisingly not named for the shape of the river, but the price of the crossing toll way back when.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_40329_description: A marvel of ancient engineering, this bridge spans a region torn asunder.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_50212_description: Build bridges, not walls. At least that's what the Ancients thought once, in happier times.
ui_poi_ancient_bridge_50215_description: The Ancients constructed safe paths across the wild, untamed lands. Little did they realize, those elevated roads would spell doom for so many.
ui_poi_ancient_buttress_40120_descriptio: The sea levels seem to have fallen since this structure was originally made.
ui_poi_ancient_citadel_30303_description: An old ruin, older than memory, and overrun by unnatural things.
ui_poi_ancient_digsite_20411_description: New Corsica's expedition met its end here, in grisly fashion.
ui_poi_ancient_hall_10311_description: Once called the Athenaeum of the Sage King, time has shorted the name to something easier to pronounce.
ui_poi_ancient_hall_10312_description: A legend kept secret from the gentry says there were once three kings. One betrayed the two. The first king's bones were buried in the desert, the second king's severed head tossed into the sea.
ui_poi_ancient_hero_temple_20402_descrip: Elite Stronghold\n\nFearsome idols guard the secrets of the temple with spell and claw.
ui_poi_ancient_highway_20401_description: Did the gods themselves once walk upon these stones?
ui_poi_ancient_lighthouse_40008_descript: Ever-burning with the blue fires of the island itself, this tower draws survivors in with a deceptive light promising sanctuary.
ui_poi_ancient_lighthouse_40046_descript: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nThe bowstring is drawn, and eternal life hangs in the crosshair of Artemis's judgement.
ui_poi_ancient_lighthouse_60206_descript: Elite Stronghold\n\nHigh atop the Verdant Ascent, nature's quiet reclamation continues unabated.
ui_poi_ancient_lighthouse_60343_descript: Elite Stronghold\n\nA beacon of despair, a monument to plagues, and sickness, and madness.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40009_description: The journey to Elafry Pyrgo requires a visit to this Ancient ruin.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40106_description: Elemental dancer of the tidal rip.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40107_description: Only stars decide, only fates discern.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40108_description: Here rests soul of miscreation slain.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40110_description: Huntsman's life forfeit, duty's purpose nigh failed.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40111_description: On mission's haste, rides keel of mightiest ship.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40112_description: Tail of reptile of all things arcane.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40113_description: And horn of beast, consecrate by hand of holiest priest.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40114_description: And doorway’s seal, by the spirit of the bear upheld.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_40115_description: White feather of blessed bird unbound.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_forestsouth_60307: And now we get to the crux of the matter.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_highcliff_60403_d: Corrupted from its original purpose, it now taints all who dare visit.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_overgrowth_60306_: Archers, ready your bows, for tonight death rains from above.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_portside_60308_de: Ancient Guardians still protect these rain-washed ruins.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_seaside_60305_des: Even the Ancients seemed to watch the coast for something.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_sheperd_50306_des: Like all crows, it is attracted to treasure, and has hidden some away.
ui_poi_ancient_lookout_splitfork_60225_d: This ruin provides an excellent view of the waters snaking through the Flooded Plains.
ui_poi_ancient_observatory_20423_descrip: Elite Overlord\n\nAeternian nights grow long and long, yet Khepri still brings the Dawn.
ui_poi_ancient_pier_60344_description: It never bothered the pirates that this bridge now leads to nowhere, for to them, it leads back to their home, the sea.
ui_poi_ancient_plaza_20403_description: The guardians of the past protect an idol yet to awaken.
ui_poi_ancient_port_60336_description: Lo, and behold, for none dare cross the threshold of New Balefire; for that accursed lighthouse doth loom above.
ui_poi_ancient_ruin_sm_20309_description: Nothing but bare stone left, and memory.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30011_description: A broken collection of stonework is all that is left of this once-populous waystation.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30012_description: The remains of an Ancient city, scattered along the shore.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30074_description: The Displaced Ancients of Cutlass Keys have gathered at the scattered remains of an ancient city in the shadow of the Lighthouse.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30119_description: Where blue fireflies dance in the wooded deep, where eyeless soldiers never sleep.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30120_description: Half of what it used to be, yet the Ancient Guardians never abandoned it.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30121_description: Cold, vengeful stone marks the remnants of a time-lost forest sanctuary.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_30152_description: Your fate will change after visiting these ruins.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40020_description: Overlooking an island, it reaches into the sea.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40054_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nThe cosmos and Ancients are deeply intertwined. This orrery measured leylines of Aeternum, charting the island, and beginning construction of structures like the Shattered Obelisk.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40123_description: A guiding star in the sky, a guiding tower upon the ground.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40153_description: Ancient stones and ancient bones observe the valley below.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40154_description: What is left of these Ancient steps rise up to impressive heights, a journey told through stone.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40155_description: The secrets of the Soulwardens hide in plain sight.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40178_description: Your fate will change after visiting these ruins.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40223_description: Forgotten soldiers oft made fools when time claims the feats of abandoned causes.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_40330_description: There was a time when these pillars touched the sky. Now they lie crumbled at the mountain's base.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_50211_description: Let the light of the ruins guide you to solid ground in the swamp.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_50235_description: One face for every direction. Then the Blight defaced them all.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_50236_description: Does the earth rise up to meet these ruins, or have the ruins subsided into the swamp?
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_crossroads_60313_de: It is only a matter of time before this place floods, too.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_falls_60314_descrip: Despite being looted over the years for its stone, the ruins still remain.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_flooded_60315_descr: How the mighty have fallen, how the statues have toppled.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_forest_60310_descri: Three times did the Ancients try to hold this place.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_hillside_60317_desc: Let not the beauty of this place blind you to its dangers.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_lg_30317_descriptio:
Windswept horizon, eastward bring
Cursed by venom
 Of the spider-queen
 sting
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_mainland_60311_desc: To be worthy of Vela, you first must pass through Haedus.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_mourningbridge_6034: It is said the river that flows under the bridge is filled with Ancient anguish.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_seacliff_60312_desc: Another testament to how prolific the Ancients were with architecture.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_sm_30316_descriptio: "Scholars agree that long ago the complex at Henkhisesui competed as the most luxurious sacred temple of the Bubasteum, with no rivals for centuries!"\n- William Heron
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_sm_30408_descriptio: "... and reinforce the futures of our souls."
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_sm_30411_descriptio: By th' four-head'd Ram, hear my prayer, might this day be when thy colossus might rest, and our caravan allowed safe passage thro' th' north.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_streamside_60309_de: The light of the undying flame watches over this place.
ui_poi_ancient_ruins_woods_60316_descrip: The sting of the scorpion is just as potent after all these years, even with the Ancients gone.
ui_poi_ancient_shrine_40311_description: Once a place of esoteric study, now little more than stones scattered across a frozen wasteland.
ui_poi_ancient_shrine_40312_description: As bindweed strangles a tree, so too the tendrils of Corruption twist and writhe at the peak of Severed Visage.
ui_poi_ancient_shrine_40313_description: The tears of the mountain have yet to cleanse the evil from this place.
ui_poi_ancient_shrine_40314_description: The rituals performed at this site have driven more than a few mad.
ui_poi_ancient_stairs_20412_description: Every step brings us closer to the truth.
ui_poi_ancient_temple_lg_40105_descripti: The humility of the worshipper twisted by the hubris of the worshipped.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_30014_description: The view from the top of the tower is to die for.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_30076_description: The Sable Fleet conquered the Lighthouse and shortly after the Goldcursed appeared. What cursed magic takes place within its walls?
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40215_description: Scent is found by spirit of lesser hound.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40216_description: Strength of hero, let loose your battle cry.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40217_description: Pride and temperance, and humility’s mane.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40218_description: Know all things leave, yet all things return.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40219_description: Bloodied fangs, pierced heart, ruptured vein.
ui_poi_ancient_tower_40220_description: At last, by dying breath is the great one expelled.
ui_poi_ancient_walls_20404_description: The riches of the Ancients fell victim to that eternal adversary: time.
ui_poi_ancient_walls_20417_description: Anubian constructs still run like eternal clockwork.
ui_poi_ancient_watchtower_highbluff_6031: It was here they saw just what they were facing, until the rain blinded them once more.
ui_poi_ancientcave_40415_description: Bones echo in these halls, stiff and creaking with age, and woe to those who enter unprepared.
ui_poi_ancientpyramid_20421_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nAll must attest to the terrifying and overwhelming power of the Ancients.
ui_poi_ancientruins_53014_description: A mound of stones is all that remains of an ancient faith.
ui_poi_ancientruins_cliff_30420_descript: May the birds forever keep watch from above, and your feet kept anchored.
ui_poi_ancientwall_30426_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nA mighty, stalwart hedge against the encroaching Corruption.
ui_poi_ancientwall_elite_30430_descripti: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Great Wall is not impermeable; judgement incurs consequence not within a vaccuum.
ui_poi_ancientwall_solo_30431_descriptio: There is magic in these walls.
ui_poi_anhur_16bs05_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_animalden_60210_description: When Fangsnap bites, Fangsnap never lets go.
ui_poi_aqueduct_30401_description: Only wild animals drink from this mighty structure now.
ui_poi_aqueduct_30427_description: Water is the currency of the desert, but the desert always takes its tithe.
ui_poi_archlightcave_60204_description: Lost light in a place where darkness became the sole source of comfort.
ui_poi_arena_myrkgard_description: Corruption pours forth from the depths of Shattered Mountain.
ui_poi_arena_reekwater_dryad_description: Trial\n\nAn ancient Dryad ravenously feeds above the terminus of Eternal Pool.
ui_poi_arena_siren_description: Trial\n\nYou've climbed so far, only to be thrown back down.
ui_poi_arena_spriggan_description: Trial\n\nBeyond even a glance of civilization, nestled here in the crucible of life, Zygoramet waited.
ui_poi_arena_swamp_description: Trial\n\nIn the heart of Reekwater, there Avarice feeds above the terminus of the Eternal Pool.
ui_poi_armoreddragon_09fl12_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_armory_40290_description: Rise one, rise all, for the unholy altar of Corruption demands your service.
ui_poi_azure_tree_40222_description: A living monument to the soulful sacrifice nature once made to stall the spread of deathless pestilence.
ui_poi_banditvillage_30309_description: Predators linger in the shade, waiting for travelers to fall victim to their lures.
ui_poi_banner_16bs07_necropolis07: Sixth Gate Of The Shining One
ui_poi_banner_16bs07_necropolis10: Ninth Gate Of The Chained Betrayer
ui_poi_banner_16bs09_scorpius: Scorpio has returned dormant for the Day.
ui_poi_banner_16bs10_khepri: Khepri has returned dormant for the Night.
ui_poi_banner_17dw02_memora_libraryopen: A magic portal has been revealed...
ui_poi_banner_17dw06_varlaam_lockeddoor: The lock is broken.\nI can't open it.
ui_poi_bastet_16bs12_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_bayou_village_50126_description: The once-thriving hub of Reekwater, now turned to dangerous purpose.
ui_poi_bazaar_30304_description: Once a hub of trade; now the Dune Phantoms have putrefied its waters.
ui_poi_bear_cave_40321_description:
Little cat, little cat
Lost in the woods
Don't eat the sweet shrub
That's no good
ui_poi_bear_den_30005_description: The Sable Fleet stockpile the cave with supplies, cannons and munitions. The attack on Spyglass Ridge is imminent.
ui_poi_bear_den_30107_description: There is so much iron nearby, a lodestone compass will always point towards this cave.
ui_poi_bear_den_30108_description: Where old stones are left unturned, Ancient secrets are yet to be discovered.
ui_poi_bear_den_40125_description: Scrabbling over rocks, the click of massive claws are much too close.
ui_poi_bear_den_40138_description: Bears are the most savage predators. They remember their deaths, and they fear pain. And the fear is always fresh.
ui_poi_bear_den_40139_description: When the bear decided to move in, the fleeing howls of the wolves could be heard for miles.
ui_poi_bear_den_50301_description: Wild things always succumb to wild instincts.
ui_poi_bear_den_50302_description: Travelers beware, for a monster makes nest here.
ui_poi_bear_den_50391_description: Gren has lived here undisturbed for countless years, and everyone knows this is Gren's place.
ui_poi_bear_den_ramshead_60404_descripti: A grizzly fate awaits those who venture within.
ui_poi_bear_patch_50246_description: The unmitigated anger of the forsaken earth usually manifests itself in bear form.
ui_poi_bearden_40416_description: A lamb from hell is a beast on earth.
ui_poi_bearden_40422_description: "The Plain, wherein a black bituminous gurge Boiles out from under ground, the mouth of Hell."
ui_poi_beast_den_20311_description: The bites are far worse than their bark.
ui_poi_beast_den_20418_description: Still a great view at any time of day, if you can avoid the cats.
ui_poi_beast_den_30319_description: More than a few peacocks have gone missing in this area as of late.
ui_poi_beast_den_30320_description: All beasts, both great and small, share a common desire to flee from the Sun.
ui_poi_beast_den_30321_description: What's worse: a Jackal when it's hungry, or a Jackal when it's thirsty?
ui_poi_beast_den_30406_description: The wildcats of Aeternum can always find warmth on the sunbaked tiles at Seret.
ui_poi_beast_den_30416_description: Elite Overlord\n\nWhat hides during the inferno of day, must hunt ravenously through the frigid cellar of night.
ui_poi_beastencounter_30301_description: Behold the Lodestone floating above. Accept the mystery.
ui_poi_beastlands_40064_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nEmissaries gather at the Highmound to represent the Tribunal: Mahantaram, Kurok, and Shirzad. The rise of the Beast is nigh.
ui_poi_beastportal_09fl12_description: Step into the Portal to be sent to the latest milestone above.
ui_poi_belltower_10206_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nA great monument and teller of time. At night, the Clocktower signals a warning with a deafening bell for all those still out in the forest after dark. At daybreak, a cascade of chimes spell defeat for those that lurk in the shadows and brings forth a new day.
ui_poi_bisonisland_40182_description: A bison's ideal spot for rest and relaxation.
ui_poi_blightcave_50412_description: If kind creatures dwelled here, it wouldn't be called a lair.
ui_poi_blightcave_50413_description: Where the Corruption's influence ends and the Angry Earth's begins. For now.
ui_poi_blightcave_50414_description: Once a treasure, the land is now a trammel.
ui_poi_blightcave_50415_description: Earth was no match for Angry Earth.
ui_poi_blightcave_50417_description: The erratic paths of the Angry Earth all lead to the same end: suffering or death.
ui_poi_blightcave_50420_description: A plague upon all trespassers, a pox upon intruders.
ui_poi_blighted_cave_40224_description: Corruption is patient. And it chips away at you, piece by piece, until there is nothing left of you anymore.
ui_poi_blighted_cave_40247_description: Digging and digging, further and further. Down, down, down.
ui_poi_blightedcamp_60222_description: Once the boars moved in, there was no removing them.
ui_poi_blightedwreck_60217_description: Such a small fish, to try to take on the sea. It didn't go well.
ui_poi_blightgrove_50416_description: When the earth fights back, it fights dirty.
ui_poi_bloodmoon_village_10317_descripti: The Ironwood grows abundantly here! It's a crying shame there is no one left to cut it down.
ui_poi_bloodmoon_village_10318_descripti: Even the fish have all left Nighthaven. There is no hope. There is no end to our suffering.
ui_poi_bloodmoon_village_10319_descripti: Chickens might offer a small reprieve against the yearly doom.
ui_poi_bloodmoon_village_10320_descripti: These orchards were once renowned throughout the land. Now they are all that is left.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Golden Apples</font>
ui_poi_boar_infestation_1_40059_descript: These are the reclaimed lands of Mahantaram, Eldest of the Tribunal, and Holder of the Tear of Gaea.
ui_poi_boar_infestation_1_40145_descript: Survivalists will tell you that Boar are the noblest of prey, for they are the prey that fights back.
ui_poi_bombasticwreckage_60215_descripti: A fairer ship was never to be glimpsed, though it has seen better days.
ui_poi_boss_tower_10223_description: What lies inside is a prison of its own making.
ui_poi_boss_tower_10230_description: We are all clowns in the circus of our life's work and ambition.
ui_poi_boss_tower_10305_description: Ice and snow are but a gentle reminder that warmth and closeness are taken for granted.
ui_poi_boss_tower_10306_description: The sun shall never truly rise on Nighthaven. The eternal overcast gray clouds will never cease.
ui_poi_boss_tower_10331_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe legends are true. A fifth Seraph lives. A lucent, elegant form, lost to memory. The crusade of the Inquisition must end here.
ui_poi_boss_tower_20214_description: Disturb the solitude at your peril.
ui_poi_boss_tower_20220_description: Some things should not be revealed.
ui_poi_boss_tower_20224_description: True strength is knowing when to give up.
ui_poi_boss_tower_20325_description: Beware which face the moon is showing, but know all faces lead to the night.
ui_poi_boss_tower_20338_description: Stolen knowledge is best forgotten, when stolen knowledge is taken without consent. The Trickster King knows the truth.
ui_poi_bridge_ck_revamp_30073_descriptio: Despite the ever-present conflict over this key span, the lower bridge has never once been taken from those loyal to the rueful Commandant Pierre Le Grand.
ui_poi_bridge_ck_revamp_30078_descriptio: Pirates that fly the black flag have set up an outpost controlling roads leading to the Citadel.
ui_poi_bridge_ck_revamp_30079_descriptio: A small checkpoint created to catch the unawares as they attempt to cross the stream.
ui_poi_brightwoodsisle_40221_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nOnce upon a time, there was an Alchemist who lived on an island. Work consumed his days and nights, and ultimately consumed his soul.
ui_poi_brute_island_30024_description: The storms of the Spectral Armada has pushed out the former residents. The island has become the amassing grounds for the ghostly spirits to retake their treasure horde.
ui_poi_bunnyisland_60205_description: There once was a rabbit who lived on an island...
ui_poi_caerdun_40354_dailysolotrials_des: Soul Trial\n\nTerror and madness cling like mold to the walls of the Undercroft. A darkness haunts therein, a Curse enriched by tormented spirits and unholy doings.
ui_poi_caerdun_40354_description: Soul Trial\n\nTerror and madness cling like mold to the walls of the Undercroft. A darkness haunts therein, a Curse enriched by tormented spirits and unholy doings.
ui_poi_camp_30143_description: The baying wolf lopes along the shore\nSeeking to make its enemies no more
ui_poi_camp_40040_description: Glistening silver is the razor band\nA foothold carved in yellow sand.
ui_poi_camp_40174_description: Unraveling the secrets of the Ancients is a task most perilous, even for the wisest of wizards…
ui_poi_carnivalcamp_10231_description: Chosen family is what separates us from the animals.
ui_poi_catacomb_10203_description: Buried in the hillside, this royal mausoleum is the final resting place for nobility. A distinction in the architecture suggests it was built by a civilization that predates any ever encountered on Aeternum before.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_10217_description: The Gloombringer sighed, and realized there was already a deep sadness upon the land. Their services were unrequired.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_10307_description: A bedtime story, the legend of the Builder-King is forbidden by proclamation of the ruling class. I was told the story as a young child, and it's still shared in small circles of commoners. Baba said that he was promised a Crown, and yet on coronation day, it was a folded crown of paper. He was burned alive instead. Dust to dust like Baba says.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_10308_description: Baba told me bedtime stories of the legend of the Builder-King. She said it is oft-whispered between the smallfolk. Baba said that like Atlas he held up the world. For all his miracles, a final reward was the taste of blood in his mouth and the smell of ash in his hair, and a thousand knives in his back.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_10309_description: A place of old and terrible things, long-forgotten, aged in memory and time. Like a fine wine, once uncorked you shan't ever return to that memory. Enjoy that taste, that blind-red devotion painted on every wall, while it lasts.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_20218_description: Each step, another push closer to Hades. Join me in the down deep.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_20335_description: Baba told me the legend of the Builder-King, a story banned in Nighthaven. The tale persists at the tables of peasants and smallfolk. Baba said he was a master artisan who built monuments and cities. And when time was up, he was brutally torn apart by his friend, and scattered to the four corners of the earth.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_20336_description: Baba said the architect of this underworld was not given due process. All those of the aristocracy denied their neglect, and the architect suffered. Shame on those involved.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_catacomb_20337_description: The desire of greater knowledge is a double-edge sword, Baba once told me. Hundreds of scholars gathered here to discover the ocean's truth, until all who involved drowned in the monarch's greed.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_causeways_20222_description: A place of rest and relaxation for the Empress's loyal subjects.
ui_poi_cave2_30064_description: This valuable resource spot for ores is now part of a Lost plot to explosively destroy the main road and keep their Sable and Human enemies out of Cutlass Keys.
ui_poi_cave_30004_description: Spurred on by their past lives' intense emotions, these lost souls have risen to wreak havoc once again.
ui_poi_cave_30008_description: Pirates infest this cave, as rot infests a hollow log.
ui_poi_cave_30124_description: Flintlock pistols and the smell of gunpowder waft in the wind, and the screams of tortured sailors intrude at night.
ui_poi_cave_40042_description: A Lost treasure hoard is now occupied by a greedy brute and no one dares enter.
ui_poi_cave_40063_description: Once a beachhead for Varangian invasion, this inlet found new life as reptilian nesting grounds.
ui_poi_cave_50213_description: It is said that the spirits of the earth meet once an era, and when they do, this is where their courts are held.
ui_poi_cave_50214_description: The rocks cry out inside the mountain, and the soil growls beneath your feet, as all manner of things in life are wont to do.
ui_poi_cave_60337_description: It was to their sorrow they tried to take what the Ancients had left.
ui_poi_cavern_mb_01_30122_description: A foulness, a vileness, lurks in these sea-worn rocks.
ui_poi_cemetery_20320_description: Wake not the tombs of the dead here, lest the screams of ghosts claim you.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Grave Dirt</font>
ui_poi_checkpoint_30059_description: The ground around this pillar of rock is steeped in blood from decades of ruthless battle, now haunted by the remnants of conflict long passed.
ui_poi_checkpoint_ck_revamp_30080_descri: The corpse of this massive sea creature decorates the paths tread by dread pirates, just one footnote in their legacy of battle.
ui_poi_clawpointruins_50234_description: The lynx that live here do not like intruders.
ui_poi_confused_village_10204_descriptio: A place for those to gather in strength, 'neath the shadow of the Lord's lair.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_30010_description: Far from the sea, deranged pirates patrol this treacherous mountain pass leading to their prized cavern.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_30019_description: The spoon, and the sign, have long since rusted away. Only the Corrupted, and the name, remain.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_40013_description: They had a great view of the land, yet didn't see the dangers of Corruption when it crept upon them.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_40048_description: The statues are both warnings and guides.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_40302_description: A land watered by blood reaps naught but death.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_40335_description: Reida always did prefer a place that was easy to defend.
ui_poi_corrupted_camp_40336_description: You have to be strong as iron and tough as nails to survive out here.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_30020_description: Bright and brave and dream-eyed did they arrive, but forlorn and fearful, did they depart.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_30033_description: The Black Flag pirates have discovered riches in this mythical hollow. Strange and powerful forces from within protect their plunder from any outsiders.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_30060_description: Once occupied by the Corrupted, this strategic fort is now a stronghold for the infamous Barnacles’ crew. Vast treasure awaits those foolhardy enough to enter.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_alchemy_00_40315_d: All the Corruption in Aeternum cannot infect a fort unless it gets inside. And so it did.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_alchemy_01_40403_d: The wage of Corruption is eternal torment.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_blacksmith_00_4031: Between life and Corruption falls the shadow.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_outfitting_00_4031: Some say it was the endless clamor from the mines that drove them mad.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_provisioning_00_40: Once a refuge against Corruption, it now harbors them.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_provisioning_01_40: That which is true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report is not found within this mountain temple.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_tannery_01_40402_d: "Fear makes devils of cherubims; they never see truly."
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_weaving_00_40319_d: Hollow eyes, soulless husks, insatiable rage.
ui_poi_corrupted_fort_weaving_01_40401_d: They will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
ui_poi_corrupted_mine_40049_description: Churning vines unearthed Jurassic beetles from these abandoned mines. Unfortunately, they've gotten along rather well with the Angry Earth.
ui_poi_corrupted_mine_40306_description: Close by the anvil, the clang of the hammer drowns out the endless 'tink-tink' of pick on stone.
ui_poi_corrupted_ritual_40304_descriptio: Foulest of rituals, and most unhallowed of priesthoods, are consecrated at the end of the Pilgrims Passage.
ui_poi_corrupted_ritual_40343_descriptio: Stay on the solid path, lest you fall prey to horrors in the lightless dim.
ui_poi_corruptedcamp_30347_description: Corruption's pox will never respect free will or territorial borderlines.
ui_poi_corruptedfort_40417_description: "Why, this is hell, nor are you out of it."
ui_poi_corruptedpriest_40181_description: Once a place of solemn meditation, where one could humble themselves upon the vastness of Everfall. The new denizens that set their gaze from its peaks covet a land ripe for harvest.
ui_poi_corsica_statue_30407_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nBehold the might and glory of the Republic!
ui_poi_covenant_outpost_40276_descriptio: The ranks of the Covenant's outreach efforts seem to grow thinner day by day...
ui_poi_covenantenclave_40184_description: Cresting out from the miasma choked hills of Nettlerest, the Covenant Enclave is a shining testament to their eternal resolve, and a bastion to those who would seek shelter within its walls.
ui_poi_crassusrise_30306_description: The leader of the 19th Legion made his mark on the land.
ui_poi_crater_ancientwatchtower_50328_de: Bewitching and benighted in equal measures.
ui_poi_crater_blightedbridge_50351_descr: Blighted and broken, the Angry Earth have reclaimed what the Ancients have not.
ui_poi_crater_blightedcave_50320_descrip: In order for an organism to survive it must adapt protective measures. The Earth is no different.
ui_poi_crater_blightedvillage_50343_desc: Not all empty land is unclaimed, as this village discovered.
ui_poi_crater_blightedvillage_50353_desc: Only fragments remain of a once-mighty bridge. The rest has been swallowed up by the green maw of Edengrove.
ui_poi_crater_blightedvillage_50358_desc: Sometimes what shines is more dangerous that the darkness surrounding it.
ui_poi_crater_blightedvillage_50382_desc: The colors are nice but mind the poison.
ui_poi_crater_brutalburrow_50403_descrip: For each branch broken, so too a bone.
ui_poi_crater_brutallair_50402_descripti: Such bright flowers, such sharp thorns.
ui_poi_crater_brutaloffering_50330_descr: A boulder kept aloft by some unknowable force.
ui_poi_crater_brutalreach_50307_descript: A site reclaimed at the implacable pace of nature.
ui_poi_crater_brutalrest_50308_descripti: From here the borders of heaven are within reach.
ui_poi_crater_brutalsummit_50309_descrip: The fingers of the mountain reach out for the stars, only to have them slip through the gaps.
ui_poi_crater_brutalviewsite_50311_descr: And so the roots pull down what the Ancients built up.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedceremony_50411_de: It is best not to ask what they do here, in isolation.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedminecamp_50339_de: All those Corrupted miners have to eat somewhere.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedminecamp_50340_de: Perched atop a waterfall, foolhardy or brave are two sides of the same coin.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedminecamp_50341_de: Work at these dark, demonic mills never ceases.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedminewest_50332_de: The paths inside are as twisted as those who made them.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedruinedfort_50335_: The smell of the cookfires are sickeningly sweet, but supper would not be a happy occasion.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedsettlement_60338_: Perhaps there is something about these mountains that Corrupts the soul.
ui_poi_crater_corruptedsettlement_60341_: This place is anything but paradise.
ui_poi_crater_feralaqueduct_50356_descri: It once transported water to sundry points. Now any liquid lies stagnant in pools below.
ui_poi_crater_feralarchway_50342_descrip: A view that should not be missed.
ui_poi_crater_feralcolony_50324_descript: Art can be a form of worship.
ui_poi_crater_feralhaven_50312_descripti: A tangle of vines and stonework make something old into something new.
ui_poi_crater_feralledge_50313_descripti: The beauty of the flowers distracts from the malice of the environs.
ui_poi_crater_feralruins_50375_descripti: The strength of the land goes deep.
ui_poi_crater_feycrossing_50314_descript: These aren't the plains of pleasure ye seek.
ui_poi_crater_feyretreat_50315_descripti: The ancient fires still glow in the night.
ui_poi_crater_feyruins_50354_description: The tangled webs we weave are nothing compared to those wrought by nature.
ui_poi_crater_malevolence_50325_descript: This dark malevolent tower bursts like a thorn from the heart of Edengrove.
ui_poi_crater_malice_50327_description: A tower rises from the nettles like a beacon of pain.
ui_poi_crater_mysticbridge_50367_descrip: Hell comes in infinite forms and hues.
ui_poi_crater_mysticbridgetower_50368_de: A perilous spot en route to Edengrove's epicenter of evil.
ui_poi_crater_mysticfen_50317_descriptio: Take heed around this pleasant pond. What better place for a trap than a paradise?
ui_poi_crater_mysticgrove_50318_descript: With antlers like branches, the Forest Guardians protect the one truly peaceful grove in Edengrove.
ui_poi_crater_mysticruins_50366_descript: Those much wiser than you have also been ensnared by beauty.
ui_poi_crater_spite_50326_description: They did not ask the land if it suffered, and yet the land found a way to makes its suffering known.
ui_poi_crater_spriggan_50322_description: Trial\n\nBeyond even a glance of civilization, nestled here in the crucible of life, Zygoramet waited.
ui_poi_crater_spriggan_50323_description: Trial\n\nBeyond even a glance of civilization, nestled here in the crucible of life, Zygoramet waited.
ui_poi_crater_spriggan_50409_description: Trial\n\nBeyond even a glance of civilization, nestled here in the crucible of life, Zygoramet waited.
ui_poi_crater_spriggan_description: Trial\n\nBeyond even a glance of civilization, nestled here in the crucible of life, Zygoramet waited.
ui_poi_crystal_cave_53003_description: Sanctuary of a once-powerful sorceror… Or perhaps it is his prison.
ui_poi_crystleclaw_caverns_40071_descrip: Expedition\n\nThe powers of Artemis flourish within these caverns of stone and ancient root.
ui_poi_cutthroatcavern_60203_description: The loyalty of a pirate crew dries quick, when marching too far from salt and sea.
ui_poi_cygnius_40185_description: Twisted and gnarled is the path towards redemption.
ui_poi_daichi_dojo_dailysolotrials_descr: Soul Trial\n\nHidden away amongst the hills.
ui_poi_daichi_valley_description: A forgotten valley surrounded by four hills.
ui_poi_damnedfortress_40408_description: Those who surrendered to the Corruption now work tirelessly to keep its furnaces and forges burning brightly.
ui_poi_decayedcamp_60213_description: Little did Seele know exactly what was at stake, when building a camp here.
ui_poi_description_16bs07_ancientcodepil:
Hostile Of Face
Raging Of Voice
Sealed By Nine Veils
By Eight, Rejoice
ui_poi_description_16bs07_necropolis01:
Pass the Gates
By the Nine, Behold
A Manifold Of Forms
By Ennead, Foretold
ui_poi_desiccatedtown_30308_description: The town looked up in envy at their neighbors, and brought ruin down on them both.
ui_poi_devilspit_30134_description: A view of the mines, the taste of sweet honey. A fine vantage point, if ever there was one.
ui_poi_devworld_cave_description: A cave that has spawn scaling wolves.
ui_poi_devworld_dummies_description: A testing area with multiple target dummies.
ui_poi_devworld_farm_description: A neat farm to check out.
ui_poi_drowned_cave_40021_description: Mutiny is punished for life, and unlife.
ui_poi_drowned_cave_40022_description: Wickedness and poison belch forth from beyond the murky threshold.
ui_poi_drowned_cave_40055_description: Shifting shorelines reveal Ancient eyes flashing like lightning in the salty mist.
ui_poi_drownedcavern_30219_description: When the dead drag you down, there is no coming up for air.
ui_poi_drownedcavern_40146_description: Sometimes what the dawn brings is not what you want to see.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_1_40144_descript: "Swear by me sealegs, to give th' Isle a splendid crown. For no thing but tha' red storm has bested me."\n- Captain Corpora
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_1_40144_msq2_des: A terror on the tide, and a corrupted horror on the land.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_2_40142_descript: A terror on the seas, and a horror on the land.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_2_40142_msq2_des: Hope fades not when humanity has a say.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_3_40140_descript: The story of First Mate Ruskin was forgotten centuries ago, but it probably had something to do with treasure or grog.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_3_40140_msq2_des: The wreck alone would fetch a fortune at auction.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_4_40141_descript: The captain of the Satisfaction grew to be wholly unsatisfied with the vessel in the end.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_4_40141_msq2_des: The captain of the Satisfaction grew to be wholly unsatisfied with the vessel in the end.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_ef_1_30215_descr: Proud and sharp did she cut through the waves, only to screech into splinters on these stoney shores.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_ef_2_30216_descr: A boon, you say? Nothing like that here.
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_ef_3_30217_descr: The oracle pulled the card from the deck, and read Temperance.\n"Aye, ain't givin' up th' drink. Try another."
ui_poi_drownedshipwreck_ef_4_30218_descr: Once it beat back the waves, now the water takes their revenge.
ui_poi_dryad_cavern_40229_description: Be at peace with such beauteous vitality of Gaia, mother's kiss, made forth by weavers with the Greenshaped gift.
ui_poi_dryad_cavern_40248_description: A wealth of plants, well hidden in sinuous passageways.
ui_poi_dryad_ruins_30229_description: A Dryad's claim to a portion of land is often well-known, and not easily challenged.
ui_poi_dryad_ruins_30233_description: A place where the scent of nectar mixes with rotten wood, and the ground bubbles alive.
ui_poi_dryad_ruins_40214_description: An Ancient gateway now protected by the earth.
ui_poi_dryadgate_50419_description: The eyes of the Ancients gazed across the land from this point.
ui_poi_dryadlookout_50418_description: A pillar of ancient stone in a valley once pastoral, now struggling against the press of Corruption.
ui_poi_dungeon_20207_description: Expedition\n\nThe Empress and her fleet await your covert arrival.
ui_poi_dungeon_cutlasskeys_30040_descrip: Expedition\n\nInfiltrate the Black Flag Pirates hideout and discover what lies in the depths beneath the cove.
ui_poi_dungeon_dunwood_10207_description: Expedition\n\nHigh atop a windswept tower, the ever-peering Archivist taps into the harvested memories of its victims. There, nestled midst a web-shaped infinitum of memory, as if a spider waiting for its prey to arrive.
ui_poi_dungeon_edengrove_50422_descripti: Expedition\n\nSite of the Great Sacrifice, this is the birthplace of the Angry Earth. The mysteries contained within draw many unwary adventurers to their doom...
ui_poi_dungeon_ennead_20413_description: Expedition\n\nStretching signals that echo off time, drifting crested atop the ever-expanding edges of this void.
ui_poi_dungeon_entrance_20204_descriptio: Expedition\n\nTake the secret beach path to the shipyard. There, a boat will be waiting for you.
ui_poi_dungeon_forge_40351_description: Expedition\n\nLegendary foundry where Ancients forged their devastating engines of war. Those who hunger for power yearn for the eldritch magics unleashed in these colossal ruins.
ui_poi_dungeon_reekwater_50146_descripti: Expedition\n\nCome forth, be learned thy destiny and honor, that which awaits all servants of oldest ones afore.
ui_poi_dungeon_shattermtn_40428_descript: Expedition\n\nPursue Isabella into a corrupted dimension of reality.
ui_poi_dungeon_tarn_40360_description: Expedition\n\nDiscovered centuries ago by an ill-fated expedition, these frozen caverns harbor a long-lost passage into the Empyrean Forge.
ui_poi_dungeonentrance_60238_description: Expedition\n\nIn the deepest abyss, the familiar face of calamity abides below.
ui_poi_dunwood_castle_10201_description: The capital of the realm and seat of the venerated King of Nighthaven.
ui_poi_dynasty_bridge_20202_description: What foul energies swirl here in the shadow of the Palace?
ui_poi_dynasty_camp_30237_description: Patrols often sweep the land of Ebonscale Reach to keep the Empress's peace, and to implement her will.
ui_poi_dynasty_cavern_30241_description: To reach the Monastery, take the Outpost road.
ui_poi_dynasty_checkpoint_30230_descript: Order will be maintained by Imperial authority.
ui_poi_dynasty_earthshrine_30231_descrip: By salt of the mountain and earth we stand.
ui_poi_dynasty_fireshrine_30228_descript: By candle's flame and Sun's rising light.
ui_poi_dynasty_harborage_20209_descripti: Once teeming with the shipwrights of the Empress, these sprawling docks now serve the will of the Corruption.
ui_poi_dynasty_monastery_30240_descripti: Pilgrims from all across Aeternum have made the journey to the Monastery.
ui_poi_dynasty_mountaintemple_30235_desc: To the mountain we all go.
ui_poi_dynasty_shipwreck_30227_descripti: The Dynasty is nigh unmatched in naval might, yet Aeternum takes its toll.
ui_poi_dynasty_shrine_20203_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nFar north of the Palace, the tendrils of Corruption thrive. And in the midst, the Empress's favorite pet.
ui_poi_dynasty_shrine_30302_description: By ore glinting, the lightning's sting.
ui_poi_dynasty_shrine_30312_description: A place once sacred, befouled by Corruption.
ui_poi_dynasty_temple_40339_description: A marriage of true minds meets to spawn an unstoppable evil.
ui_poi_dynasty_wall_30242_description: To the south, the Dynasty's reach is maintained.
ui_poi_dynasty_wall_30243_description: Here, the Dynasty northern border was once marked by tall and elegant columns.\n\nBut what lies beyond the wall?
ui_poi_dynasty_wall_30258_description: You are now entering the sprawling lands of Empress Zhou Taiying, ruler of Ebonscale Reach. Long may she reign.
ui_poi_dynasty_watershrine_30234_descrip: By shell and rain, and rivers untamed.
ui_poi_east_gate_30404_description: A prominent entrance to the Ancient ruins of the Cradle.
ui_poi_eastshorepier_60214_description: An impressive feat of engineering, reusing scraps of ships to construct this multi-level pier.
ui_poi_eldergate_ruins_40177_description: Once a beacon in the night, this spire has fallen into disrepair.
ui_poi_elite_castle_10316_description: Elite Stronghold Siege\n\nA powerful Arcanist built this castle. He was engaged to a beautiful Princess. The Trickster King annihilated the Arcanist and all his work, yet he remained as a pure essence of thought, a phantosmological memory of rebellion. The Trickster King could never claim his soul, but his soon-to-be bride was forever broken. And so she left for Reekwater to drown in her torment and become the Siren Queen.
ui_poi_elite_island_40065_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nSome say it floated into the channel, or materialized out of thin air. Some say it rose from the ocean like a tidal wave. Some even say the Isle is really the exposed shell of a chelonian Beast Lord not seen since beginning-less Time.
ui_poi_elite_spider_20215_description:
Elite Overlord

A shadow of Elysian Wilds has stalked these lands. A ghost of troubled past, and a sorrowed memory of Artemis. Shed no tears, for Arachne has no need for them.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_empress_retreat_30259_description: Even supreme rulers need a vacation.
ui_poi_empressfortress_20201_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nIn the absence of the Empress, the Palace is guarded by her most trusted and loyal attendants.
ui_poi_empresstrial_20223_description: Soul Trial\n\nA royal pier, once the launching point for new vessels. Now it is the staging ground for tragedy and a desperate attempt to breach the Stormwall.
ui_poi_festeringflotsam_60212_descriptio: The horrible wreckage that litters these shores is not of ship's hulls, but of lost souls.
ui_poi_fire_plant_40073_description: Elite Overlord\n\nWith the glory of fire in hand, let the Sun-blessed soiree commence.
ui_poi_fish_hotspot_broad_description: The fish are jumping out of the water!
ui_poi_fish_hotspot_rare_description: Rumors say rare fish swim here.
ui_poi_fish_hotspot_secret_description: Extraordinary things lurk in Aeternian waters.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30002_description: The fish never knew what was coming. Sadly, the same was true of the inhabitants.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30003_description: The waters only ran red with the blood of fish, until that fateful day the pirates came through.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30007_description: The fish it was named for have long since fled to safer waters.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30015_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Spectral Armada found a foothold here. They seem unbothered by the stench.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30018_description: The village is a checkpoint for Spectral Armada gold and riches passing to Unbound Island.
ui_poi_fishing_village_30021_description: The Spectral Armada has summoned a storm here to keep the Sable Fleet's forces away from their treasures.
ui_poi_fishingvillage_30049_description: This new port became the focus of the conflict between its Sable Fleet defenders looking for sea access and the Spectral Armada nightly raids.
ui_poi_fishingvillage_30062_description: This key crossing’s riverbanks run deep with blood. No matter what headway the Sable Fleet gain during the day, the Nightraider Forces reclaim the crossing at night.
ui_poi_fishingvillage_30063_description: Standing tall amidst the war torn marshlands, here the strongest of the Sable Fleet and Nightraider Forces vie for this strategic lookout over the course of the day in this endless fight.
ui_poi_flooded_ruins_50125_description: An Ancient fort of untold age, slowly succumbing to time and nature's pull.
ui_poi_fortdamnation_60221_description: Old stories say the fort was constructed by a Corrupted Legion that later vanished into thin air.
ui_poi_fortunes_folly_30083_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nHer fortune faltered and fell afoul to find her final fate fixed here.
ui_poi_front_lines_20301_description: From here, the Legion marches forward on the Ancients' Rise.
ui_poi_gatehouse_10212_description: Honor is never rewarded. It is earned, and kept, by trust. There is still honor here hanging on the walls.
ui_poi_gatehouse_10213_description: The rats own this land. The smell of petrichor reigns. Fleas and ticks and bed bugs are the citizenry. There is no hope below the crust of aristocratic greed.
ui_poi_gatehouse_10214_description: The Great Houses of Upyr congregate, and celebrate, in mockery and shadowed dances beneath a twisted Moon. Cavalier officers and mind-numbed lieutenants protect the vestibules from nothing, nothing, nothing ever again. Tick-tock tick-tock. Our time is up.
ui_poi_gatehouse_10215_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nWords have always been dangerous, especially when silenced. In Nighthaven, words are lethal.
ui_poi_gator_island_30023_description: Here it is possible to feel time slipping away, drop by drop.
ui_poi_ghost_forest_30055_description: The souls of warriors past drift through these ancient woods. One could go mad from their incessant whispering.
ui_poi_ghost_island_30025_description: Care must be taken amongst the Lightning towers that were found and activated by the Spectral Armada, as the spirits of the land are not the only hazard.
ui_poi_ghost_town_50122_description: Ships shouldn't fly. But when they do, it is majestic.
ui_poi_glowing_swamp_50124_description: Flickering lights upon gently flowing waters. Peaceful breezes ripple through the hanging branches, as nature persists her dance.
ui_poi_glowing_swamp_50132_description: Though lit by the inner fire of hundreds of sparkling plants, this swamp holds its darkest secrets close.
ui_poi_googlywreck_60218_description: Only the most nasty of pirates prey on other pirates. These are the true sharks of the sea.
ui_poi_gracewatercave_50233_description: The scents of healing herbs fill the air.
ui_poi_graveyard_10313_description: You will only find sadness. Leave.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Grave Dirt</font>
ui_poi_graveyard_10314_description:
Elite Stronghold

Trapped on an elemental leyline of impossible melancholy. All who tread this path, be warned, for cruel ideations may steal your present conscience and years of your life suddenly mean nothing.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Grave Dirt</font>
ui_poi_graveyard_20212_description: Never overwork in a boneyard past the fourth bell. A financial curse will stick to you and your kin.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Grave Dirt</font>
ui_poi_graveyard_40320_description: The dead do not sleep peacefully here.
ui_poi_graveyard_40327_description:
In the hollows you will find me,
Resting under the old tree.
Do not try to break my slumber,
I shall ne'er be free.
ui_poi_greatcleavesouthwall_40301_descri: Seized through betrayal, this fort is a luckless place for all without glowing red eyes.
ui_poi_green_defile_40268_description: A splash of color cut through the land, like paint spilled on the floor.
ui_poi_grey_wolf_den_30111_description: A story is no sadder than that of our feathered friends who must submit to the eternal cycle of something else's appetite.
ui_poi_greywolf_den_30131_description: A lone wolf dies, and is reborn again.
ui_poi_greywolf_den_30132_description: Swiftly now, before the hunt begins.
ui_poi_grizzly_den_ridgepeak_60321_descr: Unlike the rest of Mourningdale, this is one of the few locations free from Ancient ruins.
ui_poi_hatchery_solo_trial_30336_dailyso: Soul Trial\n\nStop Malek's plans to hatch the eggs of the Devourers.
ui_poi_hatchery_trial_30339_description: Seasonal Trial\n\nGather your allies and stop Hadish Azar and the plan to hatch the eggs of the Devourers.
ui_poi_haunted_church_40259_description: The pastor came to answer for his sins, but the price of their disappointment allowed for no amends.
ui_poi_haunted_church_40260_description: Ballard once claimed that the hard work and discipline of humankind could withstand any force of nature.
ui_poi_haunted_church_40328_description: Thus did the shepherd lay down his rod and staff; the will of the flock had overcome.
ui_poi_haunted_farm_40251_description: All they wanted was a modest patch of land to grow their crops.
ui_poi_haunted_farm_40255_description: Holm often despaired about the fish caught here. Something about them always tasted off.
ui_poi_haunted_graveyard_40252_descripti: Rest in peace, dear kindred. May your journey take you at last to silenced oblivion, or at least the next town over.
ui_poi_haunted_graveyard_40258_descripti: Hands and feet bound, they went into the boxes with mindless moans, soon muffled by the earth.
ui_poi_haunted_graveyard_40264_descripti: Built between two rivers, the location seemed too good to be true.
ui_poi_haunted_town_50201_description: A place of once-believed promise, now lost to the raving-mad scourge of undeath.
ui_poi_haunted_town_50216_description: Something terrible happened here. Something only the revenants remember.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40012_description: Everything seems scarier by candlelight. Especially here.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40047_description: When Artemis changed the land, her terraforming power collided with the Lost souls trapped at Sleepy Tallow, and gave birth to this strange new fungalopolis.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40210_description: Something about this place does not seem right.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40249_description: Who would build in a bog? Only the very desperate…or the very paranoid.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40250_description: A close-knit community some would consider too close for comfort.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40254_description: "There is a place beyond suffering," she said. "Come with me down by the river."
ui_poi_haunted_village_40256_description: They thought they could avoid Walsham's fate. How wrong they were.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40257_description:
Whither lies Walsham
Lost in the brightwood
Turn in a circle
There is no way out
ui_poi_haunted_village_40261_description: And yea, did the entire region shudder in fear when the riders of Deggendorf were on patrol.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40262_description: Too many regrets haunt this place.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40263_description: A town divided in the good times, now united in soulless regret.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40266_description: Stories of the past rest midst these haunted lands.
ui_poi_haunted_village_40310_description: Nothing sleeps here. Nor will again.
ui_poi_hauntedcrypt_40338_description: The last thing they saw was a swelling wave, their watery grave.
ui_poi_hauntedwoods_30068_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe disruption in the briny deep around the Keys sent jagged spires of stone tearing up through the forest's floor.
ui_poi_hilltop_ruins_50118_description: High atop the windswept stone, the Ancients raised a rocky home. Horizon to horizon view, unlucky mortals turned askew.
ui_poi_homestead_waterrun_60304_descript: The water here goes round and round, like porridge stirred in a pot.
ui_poi_ice_plant_40074_description: Elite Overlord\n\nOnce lost this past-faded Day, might midnight moonflowers come out and play.
ui_poi_infested_village_40160_descriptio: Nothing left, but scars and bad memories.
ui_poi_infested_village_40160_msq2_descr: Nothing left, but scars and bad memories.
ui_poi_inquisition_hq_20219_description: The corrupted seat of divine power for the Inquisition. The halls still echo with the mistakes of the righteous.
ui_poi_inquisitor_camp_20332_description: The watchful eye of the Inquisition surveys the valley below from this outpost. Despite its name, there is little mercy to be found here.
ui_poi_inquisitor_hall_20323_description: Howls of pain echo over the quiet battle planning of the Inquisition in this oppressive fortress ruin.
ui_poi_inquisitor_village_20324_descript: This camp serves as both a warning and a barrier against the dark forces that plague these territories.
ui_poi_jetsamisle_60224_description: It is amazing what washes up here, after a good storm.
ui_poi_keep_40283_description: Crumbled ruins, a life restarted\nThe veil of sanctuary is quickly parted
ui_poi_keep_40287_description: A grim fortress rises, a sentinel hungry for conquest.
ui_poi_khepri_16bs05_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_kirin_08qp04_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_legion_barracks_20304_description: Legion warhounds are subject to arduous training, as are the Corrupted soldiers who keep them.
ui_poi_legion_burial_site_20406_descript: These Legionnaries rebelled. Crassus crushed them, and left them to be forgotten.
ui_poi_legion_courier_camp_20407_descrip: A place between places, for important messages to be sent and received.
ui_poi_legion_fort_20308_description: As above, so below are all living things doomed to join together by that similar dark design.
ui_poi_legion_highland_fort_20405_descri: This northern Legion base ensures the army's control of the highlands.
ui_poi_legion_hq_20303_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nCrassus's trusted commanders rule the Legion from this stronghold.
ui_poi_legion_siege_camp_20302_descripti: A place for dark experiments and foul rituals.
ui_poi_legion_supply_train_20305_descrip: An army moves on its stomach. Here, those stomachs are fed.
ui_poi_legion_warcamp_20316_description: Drusilla's enclave guards the gate to the 19th Legion's headquarters.
ui_poi_lighthouse_30324_description: We came to Aaru, the Field of Reeds, and anchored at the home of the Gods.
ui_poi_lion_den_50117_description: Humidity is not a friend to a lion's mane.
ui_poi_lion_den_50134_description: Wildcat wounds are reluctant to heal, and the pain is a walk through perdition.
ui_poi_lion_den_50135_description: Do ye yearn for betimes the howls of wolves, stead the echoing roars of lions?
ui_poi_lionrock_30402_description: Aeternum's beasts are no less mighty than in the rest of the world.
ui_poi_lookouteast_60220_description: There are those who watch the sea, not for escape, but for new victims.
ui_poi_lookoutwest_60219_description: They knew the true threat came from the land, so they made sure to never miss a watch.
ui_poi_lost_beach_30057_description: Marked by the distinct shipwreck remains of a fight with great beast, the very souls that brought about the monster's end still roam these sands.
ui_poi_lost_beach_30081_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Sable Fleet suffer none to dispute their claim on this pirate-infested stretch of sand.
ui_poi_lost_cave_50121_description: Digging into the bones of the island, unearthing new and old treasures.
ui_poi_lost_elite_city_50130_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Siren Queen instructed her thralls to build a grand settlement on the marshlands of Reekwater. And so they did.
ui_poi_lost_elite_fort_50131_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nHere, at the venerated home of the Siren Queen, lies the seat of her empire, and the source of her army.
ui_poi_lost_ruins_30150_description: The revered place where King Artorius first arrived on Aeternum.
ui_poi_lostvillage_30307_description: Alas, the village's feud with its neighbor eventually spelled doom for both communities.
ui_poi_lowermine_40419_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nDroning, drilling, mining, and milling do the Corrupted souls toil through eternity.
ui_poi_lowermine_40438_description: Droning, drilling, mining, and milling do the Corrupted souls toil through eternity.
ui_poi_lumbermill_40202_description: An ongoing effort to make Brightwood merely bright.
ui_poi_malek_solo_trial_30435_descriptio: Soul Trial\n\nConfront Malek and put an end to his plans.
ui_poi_malekscamp_30337_description: A makeshift encampment for the adherents of the Blood of the Sands.
ui_poi_malevarena_53016_description: Elite Overlord\n\nLooking for treasure? Seek a monster.
ui_poi_mammothgiant_09fl12_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_mammothtrial_40069_dailysolotrial: Soul Trial\n\nMahantaram, Eldest of the Beast Lords, and Holder of the Tear of Gaea, dwells in these depths.
ui_poi_mammothtrial_40069_description: Soul Trial\n\nMahantaram, Eldest of the Beast Lords, and Holder of the Tear of Gaea, dwells in these depths.
ui_poi_marauderenclave_40292_description: Ascending high above the thick forests of Everfall, the Marauder Enclave stands vigilant against those who would wish their cohort harm, though few who hear the raucous denizens dare to risk incursion.
ui_poi_medusatrial_40070_dailysolotrials: Soul Trial\n\nAll that approach this throne turn to stone.
ui_poi_medusatrial_40070_description: Soul Trial\n\nAll that approach this throne turn to stone.
ui_poi_military_camp_40405_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nAn ancient battlefield where the hordes of Corruption overwhelmed General Svikin and his valiant Defenders.
ui_poi_mine_40203_description: A canary was never found useful in the mines of Aeternum, because a canary just won't stay dead.
ui_poi_mine_40305_description: A mine as dark and foreboding as a witch's cauldron.
ui_poi_mine_60401_description: It is a terrible thing when the roots of the mountain are Corrupted.
ui_poi_mine_haunted_whispering_60301_des:
Brothers three, did prospect'd to-day,
Big Stephen claim'd Gold,
Clev'r Jason think'd, "Nay."
Li'l Alec did bargain'd fer a split,
When Stephen'n Jason tell'd Alec to sit,
Alec sat with a great sigh'n'frown,
And was that but th' moment
When yon cave ceiling fell'd down.
ui_poi_mode_catacombs_10234_description: Continue deeper into the darkest halls below Nighthaven.
ui_poi_motherwell_53009_description: Soul Trial\n\nThe heart of the sacred forest and a wellspring of ancient power, the Motherwell is hidden away in deepest Edengrove. Legends speak of a powerful Champion of the Wood that defends the site with tireless vigilance.
ui_poi_mountainhome_cliff_40440_descript: With such a view, one might wonder the distant past of this wretched place, and if any life could ever hope to survive here.
ui_poi_msq_hub_hermit_description: The Hermit makes his home here.
ui_poi_myrddin_53011_description: What arcane powers sustain this floating island, and what secrets are locked within?
ui_poi_myrkgardchurch_40412_description: The loathsome crown jewel of Myrkgard, once heralded pure, now sullied by Corruption's embrace.
ui_poi_myrkgardeast_40410_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe towering manifestation of the Corrupted Clergy's quest for dominion by unconvenanted powers.
ui_poi_myrkgardnorth_40411_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nBuried in the heart of the city, the highest echelons of Corruption prosper.
ui_poi_myrkgardsouth_40409_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe market stalls decay, and the spillway is choked with ash. The gate is open. And all manner of dark things stare back from the abyss.
ui_poi_myrkgardwest_40407_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nBeyond this vestibule of anguish, no hope may tarry.
ui_poi_myrkgardwest_40437_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe people of Old Myrkgard knew only sorrow at first, yet nothing of the dreadful fate they would soon come to suffer.
ui_poi_nature_cave_smugglerscove_60320_d: It still stores goods that have never been claimed, at least not by the living.
ui_poi_necropolis_20425_dailysolotrials_: Soul Trial\n\nA tomb is a memorial to the dead. On Aeternum, it is a prison where death merely slumbers.
ui_poi_necropolis_20425_description: Soul Trial\n\nA tomb is a memorial to the dead. On Aeternum, it is a prison where death merely slumbers.
ui_poi_nettlerest_graveyard_40151_descri: Lore has it that planting nettles on graves binds the restless spirits within.
ui_poi_npchub_50428_description: One being's poison is another being's pleasure.
ui_poi_npchub_53012_description: The safety of a nest within the thicket of grasping vines and branches.
