ui_poi_overgrown_village_50133_descripti: There is glory in silence and patience, for both are needed to catch the big one.
ui_poi_overlook_40152_description: The location wasn't chosen so much for the view, as to keep an eye on the pirates.
ui_poi_phantomtree_30310_description: Down in the roots are old stones, angry spirits, and lost heroes.
ui_poi_phantomtree_30325_description: <font color="#b2aea1">Monument</font>\n\nA sacred tree, long-lived, and the most willful dissident to the desert sun.
ui_poi_pirate_camp_30085_description: The pirate's took over these camps during the gold rush caused by the newly exposed islands to the West, all demanding a cut of your purse.
ui_poi_pirate_fort_30016_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Sable Fleet ousted the Skullworms from their court. Their Goldcursed commanders now make it their treasury and count their coin with unquelled obsession.
ui_poi_pirate_fort_30017_description: It's not just the pond that is filled with the scum, now the Black Flag Pirates also move their gold through the Fort.
ui_poi_pirate_fort_30056_description: A former place of parley for all factions of the Keys before the gold curse took over, now it’s safe for no one.
ui_poi_pirate_fort_40017_description: From the high walls did hope plummet, following faith down to the sea.
ui_poi_pirate_fort_40052_description: Shirzad and his lions lay claim to the snaking caverns of this pirate fort, with plenty of corners and high spots to ambush prey.
ui_poi_pirate_harbor_30239_description: The thunder rolls above the ramshackle harbor like the drums of war.
ui_poi_pirate_shipwreck_30226_descriptio: Scrolls and tomes lie upon broken shores, their words left to the sand.
ui_poi_pirate_stronghold_30238_descripti: Crashing upon the Ebonscale shores, the library aboard was all but washed away.
ui_poi_pirate_town_40016_description: The bay is well protected from storms, but not from what roams Aeternum.
ui_poi_pirate_town_40051_description: The apes under Kurok's command have claimed this area and just about every banana in the territory.
ui_poi_pirate_village_30022_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe Sable Fleet have dug in, and the Abanoz siblings have taken command to push back the advance of the Spectral Armada.
ui_poi_piratespass_30070_description: True to their nature, the Sable Fleet pirates seized this collection of ruins from the Ancients and fortified it from the rest of Aeternum.
ui_poi_poseidonsplunder_60226_descriptio: A ship that once carried the bounty of the ocean, now it holds nothing but regrets.
ui_poi_proving_grounds_30034_description: From their last remaining bastion, the Corrupted plan a resurgence. Strike down these vengeful foes and extinguish their plans of accession.
ui_poi_questgiver_20306_description: From here, New Corsica's finest secretly monitor the Legion.
ui_poi_questgiver_20408_description: A center of operations for clandestine maneuvers.
ui_poi_questgiver_30311_description: A place for the last survivor to kick up their heels.
ui_poi_questgiver_30315_description: Underpaid escorts and bumpy Aeternum roads are two things enough, but scorpions are a recipe for disaster.
ui_poi_questgiver_30405_description: A place to experiment on Ancient technology.
ui_poi_raid_boat_30072_description: Raid\n\nJames Oxen's crew has reported sightings of Gorgons. Board the Aegis, a battered yet unfaltering vessel, to slay Medusa and bring glory to Aeternum!
ui_poi_raid_ion_10233_description: Raid\n\nA familiar face has returned from the grave and seeks to control a powerful relic. Stop him before he becomes a threat to all of Aeternum once again!
ui_poi_raid_isleofnight_30165_descriptio: Raid\n\nA familiar face has returned from the grave and seeks to control a powerful relic. Stop him before he becomes a threat to all of Aeternum once again!
ui_poi_raid_port_30082_description:
"Last boat is leaving
Into the western sea
Black shores are calling
Calling for you and me
Time's up and time again
Time will always win
Time was always Death
Death in the very end
We will never meet again"

-Nighthaven children's rhyme
Author unknown
ui_poi_ravagedwreck_60211_description: The wreck lies untouched, a perfect warning of what happens to those who reach Aeternum's shore.
ui_poi_re_spyglass_vista_complete_descri: Peek through the looking glass and spot another grand sight of Aeternum!\n\nReward Claimed: 5000 Territory Standing (Nighthaven)
ui_poi_re_spyglass_vista_description: Peek through the looking glass and spot another grand sight of Aeternum!\n\nReward: 5000 Territory Standing (Nighthaven)
ui_poi_rifteast_40413_description: A scar cut towards the east, and demons soon roosted in its folds.
ui_poi_riftwest_40414_description: Thunder broke the earth, ripped the realm asunder, and spawned terror in its wake.
ui_poi_ritualsite_53013_description: In the forest darkness you find yourself, or something find you.
ui_poi_romanruins_lg_30327_description: We buried the dead, and left them with our gods. Now their burnt souls haunt the desert in service to the sun.
ui_poi_romanruins_med_30429_description: Sunbaked sarcophagi and unmarked tombs make suitable gatekeepers to the desert below.
ui_poi_roots_of_pain_40253_description: Goodbye does not mean forever. Especially in this place.
ui_poi_ruined_castle_20216_description: Long since abandoned, the walls and towers of this castle weep as if melting in the perpetual rain. Though dead, there still remains a horde of fur, wing, and claw which stalk the ruins, as if yet still picking fresh meat off the castle's bones.
ui_poi_ruined_castle_20321_description: A forsaken bastion of healing now decays under the corruption of the Inquisition as they find new ways to destroy the creatures of this land.
ui_poi_ruinedstraights_50432_description: A thousand steps for a thousand threats.
ui_poi_ruins_60201_description: Legend has it that those who hold Fornax have the power to forge their own fate.
ui_poi_runeforge_solo_trial_53021_descri: Soul Trial\n\nEnter the Winter Rune Forge and face its awakened guardians.
ui_poi_runeforge_trial_53019_description: Seasonal Trial\n\nEnter the Winter Rune Forge and face its awakened guardians.
ui_poi_sableprison_30071_description: The ancestral connection the Ancients have to their land withstood even the Sable Fleet's might. Commingling wasn't an option so imprisoning the Ancients seemed like the next logical solution.
ui_poi_sandworm_arena_20317_description: Elite Trial\n\nEnter the Ambuscade, where the drum calls forth Shah Neshen. The chains of Apophis are severed, and so the great ordeal, World-Encircler, can answer. The leviathan has awakened.
ui_poi_scorpionnest_30305_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nChittering, chittering, chittering, all through the dark caves.
ui_poi_scorpius_16bs08_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_season_4_ice_castle_description: Amidst the vast seas, the grand ice castle casts shadows over a once-vibrant kingdom. The denizens of this kingdom now wander as lost souls, their memories clouded by an eternal chill.
ui_poi_serpent_pass_20415_description: Only the most daring of explorers use this shortcut through the mountains.
ui_poi_shanty_30061_description: The last relief before the horrors of Unbound Island. The Sable Fleet pushed to control the gate but were stopped by the Spectral Armada’s full strength.
ui_poi_shattered_dungeon_description: Expedition\n\nThe stars hide the answers like secret whispers clutched to the heart.
ui_poi_shattered_obelisk_40116_descripti: Perceptions manifest as patterns in nature, as consequences and chaos.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30001_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nTime and tide have worn away the name from Clearmon's Redoubt along with its defenses. The Spectral Armada press forward to erase it completely.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30101_description: Montore set out to discover a new world. He could not be any happier.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30102_description: Captain Abidier's fury was not for the loss of ship, but the destination itself.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30102_msq2_description: Once the castle of the High King's second-in-command.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30222_description: Ripe with activity, a port ever preparing to lay siege upon settlements both near and far.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30223_description: It cut cleanly through the ocean, dispatching ships to the depths. But like any good blade, in time it lost its edge.
ui_poi_shipwreck_30318_description: A gift left waiting is a gift ungiven, and ripe for the taking.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40003_description: It is no surprise there is a shipwreck here. The shallows start much sooner than expected.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40004_description: Sal crashed a ship here long before all the others. He just wanted you to know.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40005_description: It's not the knot that makes the sailor, but the knot you knew naught about.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40006_description: That vast and great mistake of venturing towards what one will never understand.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40007_description: Three things are certain on Aeternum: death, undeath, and taxes.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40018_description: A single grounded ship, the irony of the name escapes no one on this isle.
ui_poi_shipwreck_40045_description: The power of Elafry Pyrgo has thrust this proto-Anubian fortress aground once more. Ancient relics of all kinds have been unearthed, and none of them pleasant.
ui_poi_shipwreck_50101_description: The sunbleached planks of dozens of ships lay buried in the sands.
ui_poi_shipwreck_50102_description: A bevy of ships dragged into the swamps by rotten, broken hands.
ui_poi_shipwreck_50104_description: May yonder vessel rest in peace, and its sailors pillage life everlasting.
ui_poi_shipwreck_50210_description: The mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of La Escamilla is still talked about outside Aeternum.
ui_poi_shipwreck_60208_description: Great and lofty ideas of humankind cannot attest to the deep and troubling enormity of the briny sea.
ui_poi_shipwreck_eastbayshipwreck_60302_: Take what you want, always want more, and never leave survivors.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_01_30123_description: The sea rose up to claim his crown, and his life.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_01_30123_msq2_descri: A terror on the tide, and a corrupted horror on the land.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_02_30125_description: What deity, can we all but hope, may save us now?
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_02_30125_msq2_descri: Hope fades not when humanity has a say.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_03_30129_description: Hope fades not when humanity has a say.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_03_30129_msq2_descri: The wreck alone would fetch a fortune at auction.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_04_30130_description: A sacred bounty all but claimed by the sea.
ui_poi_shipwreck_mb_04_30130_msq2_descri: The captain of the Satisfaction grew to be wholly unsatisfied with the vessel in the end.
ui_poi_shrine_60202_description: Once part of a much larger structure, only one Ancient arch still stands.
ui_poi_small_outpost_60340_description: If only they had listened to the warnings. They never should have made camp here.
ui_poi_sobek_16bs02_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_solitudecemetery_60216_descriptio: Do not expect to find peace here. No one else has.
ui_poi_soulwarden_camp_50392_description: A bulwark against the darkness, where allies plot and plan.
ui_poi_soulwarden_refuge_40361_descripti: A place to regroup, repair, and take a breath.
ui_poi_spider_castle_20331_description:
Ésagila stands as a testament to arachnid horror, where thick sheets of webbing drape from every archway and corner like macabre tapestries. This abandoned castle serves as the seat of power for Uttu, the Spider Beast Lord, and the birthplace of all spiders that plague Nighthaven. Cast your phobias aside; for Uttu is not a jealous queen.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_10301_description:
Deep within the darkest reaches of Nighthaven lies a vast network of spider-infested caverns. The walls pulse with countless arachnids, their webs forming thick, sticky curtains that trap both prey and unwary travelers. The cave system serves as a breeding ground for the spider hordes, with egg sacs dangling from every surface and newly hatched spiderlings skittering through the shadows.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_10315_description:
A treacherous network of narrow tunnels and false passages where every shadow conceals a waiting predator. These cunning spiders have mastered the art of ambush, creating an intricate hunting ground filled with trapdoor burrows and overhead stalking perches. The walls themselves seem alive with hidden hunters, their camouflaged burrow doors blending perfectly with the surrounding stone.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_20210_description:
There is no hope found here. Move on and find peace elsewhere.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_20213_description:
Deep beneath the terrain lies an empire of unknown size and dimension. The caves spread for miles, endless and twisted, like a ball of Baba's yarn.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_20217_description:
Light cannot pierce the veil anymore.
All hope is lost.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_20319_description:
Unlike the dark and web-choked lairs of other spider nests, this cave system sparkles with crystalline formations that have been transformed by the unique species of spiders dwelling within. Deep in the cave, the spiders cultivate crystal gardens where they breed deadly shimmering shadows that crawl from every crevice.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spider_cave_20330_description:
Skittering, creeping, the spiders protect their clutch with frightening determination. Take care midst the eggs, for young spiderlings are waiting to hatch.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Spider Silk</font>
<font color="#E25822">Requires Fire Damage</font>
ui_poi_spiritshrine_05_40072_description: A respite for those souls who dare to venture within the Tribunal Highmound or the Savage Divide.
ui_poi_springvillage_30156_description: "Another blessed Springtide has arrived! Join the rest of the Children of Bloom in celebrating this most glorious occasion!" - Bloom Herald
ui_poi_springvillage_40350_description: "Another blessed Springtide has arrived! Join the rest of the Children of Bloom in celebrating this most glorious occasion!" - Bloom Herald
ui_poi_springvillage_50256_description: "Another blessed Springtide has arrived! Join the rest of the Children of Bloom in celebrating this most glorious occasion!" - Bloom Herald
ui_poi_springvillage_53000_description: "Another blessed Springtide has arrived! Join the rest of the Children of Bloom in celebrating this most glorious occasion!" - Bloom Herald
ui_poi_stinky_50251_description: Abandoned by his friends, the Huntsman begins a new life.
ui_poi_stockpile_40288_description: The Lost of Greedfall tire endlessly to hoard the loot from shipwrecked shores. Only to draw the endless attention of Oxboro’s adventurers.
ui_poi_strangers_campsite_40439_descript: A meager meal and a warm fire are oft-overlooked and underappreciated.
ui_poi_sulfurpool_20307_description: As water draws the animals of the desert, boiling sulfur pools attract only monsters.
ui_poi_sulfurpool_20315_description: Once a great civilization, reduced now to a narrow highway of rubble, 'cross veritable lakes of sulfureous fire.
ui_poi_sulfurpool_20424_description: A traveler's most cherished gift is often an overdue bar of soap, but the desert has a cynical sense of humor.
ui_poi_sulfurpool_30424_description:
"Mistress of Anger,
Blessed is your Fury,
Lest we forever stand still."
- the Traveler's Prayer
ui_poi_sulfurpool_30425_description: A burning oasis of calamity where monsters thrive.
ui_poi_summervillage_30149_description: "Come one, come all to the greatest party in all Aeternum! The Summer Medleyfaire has begun!" - Medleyfaire Maestro
ui_poi_summervillage_40349_description: "Come one, come all to the greatest party in all Aeternum! The Summer Medleyfaire has begun!" - Medleyfaire Maestro
ui_poi_summervillage_50252_description: "Come one, come all to the greatest party in all Aeternum! The Summer Medleyfaire has begun!" - Medleyfaire Maestro
ui_poi_summervillage_50304_description: "Come one, come all to the greatest party in all Aeternum! The Summer Medleyfaire has begun!" - Medleyfaire Maestro
ui_poi_syndicateenclave_40294_descriptio: Ever the secretive sort, the Syndicate Enclave hides sequestered within Ancient stones, as its members studiously toil away in their labs to unravel the arcane mysteries of Aeternum.
ui_poi_tauros_06sw09_description: A legendary beast was spotted here.
ui_poi_templeofsands_20334_description: An ancient temple built by the Blood of the Sands. While it was once the living center of their order, it has been abandoned for hundreds of years.
ui_poi_tiger_cave_30236_description: Mighty beasts make mighty foes, but the tigers of the mountain are mightier indeed.
ui_poi_tomb_40291_description: Blue fire crackles and lights the way to battles and secrets long forgotten.
ui_poi_tree_offering_60319_description: So much of this ruin is still intact, jealously guarded by the bones of the past.
ui_poi_treetopterror_60227_description: Whether swinging from the ropes or rigging up boardwalks on branches, these pirates are equally at home.
ui_poi_trial_isabella_40443_description: Soul Trial\n\nVenture within the mind cathedral of Isabella, Corruption's champion, and seek absolution of her memories, her dreams, and this shared nightmare.
ui_poi_trial_mordred_40364_description: Soul Trial\n\nA ritual chamber frozen in ice.
ui_poi_trial_questnihilo_40365_descripti: Soul Trial\n\nIt is a place of horror and beauty intertwined. A realm that we cannot comprehend. Leap, and know the unknowable beyond the gates.
ui_poi_trial_questyonas_40363_descriptio: Soul Trial\n\nWhispers entwined with corruption have found this faithful heart.
ui_poi_trialgawain_30162_description: Soul Trial\n\nOnce the castle of the High King's second-in-command.
ui_poi_trialheartforge_40197_description: Soul Trial\n\nThis Guardian has stood stoically as the sole protector of a forgotten tool against Corruption.
ui_poi_trialliang_30264_description: Soul Trial\n\nStill imprisoned for his own protection and the protection of others. The Prince is subdued in the depths of the Wood Shrine… with no hope of ever seeing sunlight again.
ui_poi_trialmedea_40196_description: Soul Trial\n\nA holy site for Windsward's druids.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_1_40137_description: They say pride goeth before the fall, or in this case, the crash.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_1_40137_msq2_descri: They say pride goeth before the fall, or in this case, the crash.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_2_40122_description: Any port in a storm, any haven to revive hope.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_2_40122_msq2_descri: Any port in a storm, any haven to revive hope.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_30126_description: Undead pirates tell no lies, or do they?
ui_poi_undeadbastion_30127_description: A private lake, a massive wall, and easy access to ambush the road. What more does anybody need?
ui_poi_undeadbastion_3_40124_description: Those who came with dreams of fortune were the ones who fell fastest to deathless despair.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_3_40124_msq2_descri: Those who came with dreams of fortune were the ones who fell fastest to deathless despair.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_40158_description: If it wasn't for all the pirates, this place would be quite pleasant.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_40207_description: Legend says, the Longshadow landed here after riding an enormous wave. To honor it, the crew used the hull as lumber for construction of the fortress.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_40227_description: The creak of the boards will give your position away to the whole crew if you do not tread lightly.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_50232_description: Landlocked pirates can be feral when cornered.
ui_poi_undeadbastion_description: For that which traitors' hold, they do not so easily give up.
ui_poi_undeadclearing_30069_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThis island's graveyard was an attempt to cull the wrath of the wandering spirits. The effort was in vain, as these spirits had no intention of resting in peace.
ui_poi_underworld_01_description:
Each step, another push closer to hell on earth. Another soul vanished, another voice disappeared. The builder king's own creation was also his destination.
What's in the Dark?

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_underworld_06_description: Baba said the architect of this underworld was not given due process. Built to honor the earthen deities, its architects suffered under the aristocracy's neglect, until everything collapsed into a swarm of blight.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_underworld_07a_description: The desire of greater knowledge is a double-edge sword, Baba once told me. Hundreds of scholars gathered here to discover the ocean's truth, until all who involved drowned in the monarch's greed.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_underworld_09a_description: Baba told me bedtime stories of the legend of the Builder-King. She said it is oft-whispered between the smallfolk. Baba said that like Atlas he held up the world. For all his miracles, a final reward was the taste of blood in his mouth and the smell of ash in his hair, and a brave soul forever trapped in mercury down below.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_underworld_10_description: The legend of the Builder-King and the giant architects is forbidden by proclamation of the ruling class. Baba said that he was promised a Crown, and yet on coronation day, it was a folded crown of paper. He was burned alive instead. All that legend turned into dust, and the giants were left with eternal silence.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Anima Quartz</font>
ui_poi_uppermine_40420_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nWhat darkness has Corruption wrought? What evils are yet to be unearthed?
ui_poi_upyr_archives_10202_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe records, archives, libraries, and museums of the Upyr Royalty, where treasures, priceless art, memories, and dreams are kept.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10205_description: “...I had gazed upon the fortifications and ramparts of the castle of my own imagination, but this night, the lightning flashed across the sky, and the castle seemed to burst into a blaze of light.”\n\n- Mary Shelley
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10218_description: A magical place, where purple lights shimmer and swirl around the mystical hold. Legends speak of a great Warlock who roosts here, forever spellbound in the silent remembrance of a painful memory.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10219_description: The walls have ears, and the knives have poison.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10220_description: A thick, impermeable sadness chokes the life out of all hopeful people here.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10221_description: A forgotten Great House lies cursed beneath Understone, destroyed by the King.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10222_description: Pay no attention to the screams. Everyone does eventually, once inside.
ui_poi_upyr_castle_10303_description: The Fourth House has been found. Like all things once believed as truth, rotted to the core and drenched in betrayal. An eternity of secrets and lies is buried below the facade.
ui_poi_upyr_village_10302_description: A castle village bound in service to the City-State of Durevos. The village has suddenly been abandoned. Carts are toppled, and red banners litter the mud-soaked ground, and no sign of life can be found.\n\n But the rats..
ui_poi_varangian_convoy_53001_descriptio: Waiting for a message that will never come.
ui_poi_varangian_elite_30335_description: Elite Stronghold\n\nThe forges work tirelessly through the night, black smoke in perpetuity, for the Varangian Lord Commander.
ui_poi_varangian_keep_53002_description: A stronghold erected by the Varikulaki, the brutal vassals of the Varangian warlord determined to conquer Aeternum.
ui_poi_vikingshipwreck_40039_description: Ships from the north, and with them, the ghosts of their cursed crew.
ui_poi_village_40418_description: A miserable hamlet on the outskirts of a doomed land.
ui_poi_watchtower_32_30220_description: Many residents of Everfall made landing here, never to stray far from their newfound home.
ui_poi_watchtower_mb_01_30117_descriptio: They watched the approach of the high king and wondered what he would bring.
ui_poi_weaversfen_temple_50338_descripti: From water is all life given, and from Azoth all life preserved.
ui_poi_werebear_20339_description: Nothing here matters. Ursa has forsaken us. Her children have lost their sentience, and now live as beasts of burden for the overseers. Nothing matters anymore.
ui_poi_werebear_20340_description: Her dying words, Baba said that Ursa has abandoned us. That the Bear Beast Lord has receded into myth. There is no hope.
ui_poi_werebeast_den_20327_description:
Elite Stronghold

Surrounded by a natural barrier of sorrowthorn briar, and perched out of reach, it was only a matter of time before the Ravenfolk claimed it.

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Black Feathers</font>
ui_poi_werebeast_den_20328_description: Baba always warned to stay away from the woods and the Big Bad Wolf.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Golden Azoth Sap</font>
ui_poi_werebeast_den_20329_description: The howls of a den moot in session are enough to scare off the most stalwart hunters.
ui_poi_werebeast_warren_20211_descriptio:
A thorn for joy
a thorn for sorrow
a feather for luck
all lost tomorrow

<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Sorrowthorn</font>
ui_poi_werecrow_20322_description: The name began as a joke 'mongst peers, but the real joke is that the name could never be unstuck.\n\n<font color="#EDC63E">Source of Black Feathers</font>
ui_poi_wintervillage_30145_description: A mysterious village, as snowy as it is jovial, has appeared in Aeternum. Welcome to Winter Convergence!
ui_poi_wintervillage_50151_description: A mysterious village, as snowy as it is jovial, has appeared in Aeternum. Welcome to Winter Convergence!
ui_poi_witherd_mines_30112_description: All things erode, but the mines and those who work them are forever.
ui_poi_withered_camp_40101_description: What purpose do the spheres serve?
ui_poi_withered_camp_40157_description: Anything good that used to be here withered under the weight of Aeternum.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_1_30104_description: A place of silence, and a humbling reminder to those yet unclaimed by Aeternum's cruel hand.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_1_30105_description: A boarded up keep, a bloody battle, and a grand abundance of vegetables, livestock, and ghouls.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_1_40102_description: They ran through the forest, they ran through the trees. Free at last, no fences or farmhands.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_1_40102_msq2_descrip: They ran through the forest, they ran through the trees. Free at last, no fences or farmhands.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_2_30114_description: The Fong Family was once well-known for their sweet fruits, and now only for their bitter violence.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_2_30115_description: The old keep and church had fallen, long ago. Now its walls only let the vines creep through unscathed.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_2_40103_description: As the seasons turn from Spring to Fall, the workers decided to reap all.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_2_40103_msq2_descrip: Not even a well-placed garrison could prevent the tragedy that happened here.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_30116_description: Through late year's freeze and Midsummer's heat, the rancher works and the people eat.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_30118_description: The most plentiful thing you'll catch here are scavengers.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_3_30113_description: Travelers will never be denied a meal at a farmer's table.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_3_40104_description: Willette's musket defended his prized carrots from all manner of pest and beast, but every day the wildlife returned like clockwork.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_3_40104_msq2_descrip: The strength of iron surrounds the Iron Rose Mercenaries.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_3_40149_description: Blessed with a greenthumb were the hands of the Olcotts. Now, simply rotted green in death.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_40159_description: Hard to imagine how someplace so nice went so wrong. But that's Moe for you.
ui_poi_witheredfarm_40159_msq2_descripti: Hard to imagine how someplace so nice went so wrong. But that's Moe for you.
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40331_description: The pain of a wolfbite cuts, yet finds relief in the numbness of a winter wind.
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40332_description: A flash of glacial blue. Was it ice, or eyes, shining from within?
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40333_description: Even before war came to Great Cleave, it was always a ravaged land.
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40334_description: Cold eyes searching for a warm meal.
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40432_description: Travelers have been disappearing in these parts of the Cleave.
ui_poi_wolf_cave_40433_description: Even General Svikin feared the insatiable appetites of wolves in the Cleave.
ui_poi_wolf_den_20326_description: In the overgrown ruins, Werewolves have made their den in the shadow of rotten stone arches, mossy staircases, and fallen rubble.
ui_poi_wolf_den_30006_description: Here on Aeternum, the predators of the land can make a true territorial claim.
ui_poi_wolf_den_30009_description: Here there are no rules, but those of tooth and claw.
ui_poi_wolf_den_40010_description: Listen closely. Do you hear the roar of the falls or the howls of the wolves?
ui_poi_wolf_den_40011_description: To the Syndicate, the answer of how Aeternum's wolves arrived here in the first place, is still a titillating scientific mystery.
ui_poi_wolf_den_40023_description:
"I see the moon, and the moon sees me.
Gods keep me safe.
So mote it be."
- the Traveler's Prayer
ui_poi_wolf_den_40056_description: Once a den for wolves, this rocky outcropping is now a hidden sanctuary
ui_poi_wolf_den_40226_description: Stay on the roads, and keep keen for wolfsign.
ui_poi_wolf_den_40228_description: A lonesome howl is a warning. A second howl means dinner.
ui_poi_wolf_den_40230_description: Stay on the roads, and keep keen for wolfsign.
ui_poi_wolf_den_50303_description: 'Pitt-patt' go dusty paws.\n'Slish-slash' go lethal claws.
ui_poi_wolf_den_forestnorth_60324_descri: Never alone, a pack is always stronger when together.
ui_poi_wolf_den_forestsouth_60322_descri: The whines mean they are happy. It isn't everyday lunch appears without effort.
ui_poi_wolf_den_highpoint_60323_descript: Many have wondered, is the grizzly's throat called bronze from the color of their fur, or the strength of the bellows that emit from it?
ui_poi_wolfden1_30065_description: A mound of gold awaits at the back of this cavern; one must only survive its many defenders to claim it as their own.
ui_poi_wolfden2_30066_description: Guarded by the vicious Nogul, only the bravest of souls would dare to venture here in search of plunder.
ui_poi_wrecked_galleon_60339_description: The pirate's promise is the only thing that holds them together. But Aeternum has other plans.
ui_poi_yeti_30144_description: It is said that when one shouts into the hollow, the echo that comes back carries the voices of all who perished here.
ui_poi_yeti_30252_description: Serenity is just the space between calamities, so enjoy your respites where you find them.
ui_poi_yeti_40041_description: Cookie found an interesting use for an ice cave and hoards meat in his butcher shop.
ui_poi_yeti_40172_description: The sluicing flow of frigid waters makes for a soothing lullaby.
ui_poi_yeti_40173_description: Often, it is not until one is huddled in this cave, teeth chattering, that one’s mind conjures up questions like: Who was Rames? And what the Hell were they hiding from?
ui_poi_yeti_40346_description: There is a stark beauty to these caverns, carved by water and inconceivable time.
ui_poi_yeti_40347_description: The cold here penetrates all the way to your marrow.
ui_poi_yeti_40426_description: Is that howling merely the wind blowing through the cave mouth, or perhaps something with more teeth?
ui_poi_yeti_40427_description: The base of the mountain, where a cataclysm stretches out over eons.
ui_poi_yeti_50399_description: Even though the ancient rituals have long since ceased, their insidious presence yet lingers here.
ui_poi_yeti_50424_description: What some call loneliness is nothing more than an opportunity for contemplation.
ui_poi_yeti_60352_description: Are the stories of hidden treasures true, or are they a lure to tempt the greedy and the unwary?

ui_preddieu_farm_attack_description: Farmer Sneed still thinks this land is his and will stop at nothing to reclaim it. Protect the farms and drive him away.

ui_pvp_guide_1_body: Once you are in a faction, you can choose to enable your PvP Flag while in a Settlement or any other sanctuary. Enabling your PvP Flag allows you to participate in open world player vs. player combat. While your flag is enabled, you can attack and be attacked by other flagged players from the other factions.
ui_pvp_guide_2_body:
Flagged players can battle at each Fort for its control.

To take part, flag for PvP then go to the Fort you wish to compete for and enter through any of the gates. Once inside, claim and hold your ground against players from the other factions.

The faction that holds the Fort gains bonuses in the territory like increased influence and XP gains for faction members. Owning a Fort does not affect overall control of the territory, but may be instrumental in declaring a war for ownership.
ui_pvp_guide_3_body:
Capture Influence Towers and strike down enemy Factions in open world combat for territorial supremacy. Each Faction will compete for Influence in specific zones during scheduled times. 

If an attacking Faction earns enough Influence through PvP Missions, Influence Towers, and Forts before the race ends, they’ll receive bonus rewards, plus the opportunity to declare War. 

If the defending Faction prevents the attackers from scoring enough Influence within the time limit, they’ll earn bonus rewards for both the Influence Race and the next War. 

Regardless of who wins, the attacking Faction with the most influence can escalate the conflict into War.
ui_pvp_guide_4_body:
Players may sign up to participate in a scheduled Siege battle at the War Board in the territory's Settlement or outside its Fort.

The Governors of the two leading companies may choose from the players that have signed up for their side to build their 50 player armies.

If chosen to participate, an invite banner will appear shortly before the Siege battle is scheduled to begin. If you accept, you will be teleported to you army's spawn area for the battle to prepare. If you decline, your spot will open for a player assigned to the army's backfill list.

Players from the attacking or defending faction may only sign up for their faction's side of the War. Players from the third faction may sign up for either side. Players without a faction may not join Wars.
ui_pvp_guide_5_body:
During a Siege battle, the two teams first battle for control of three points outside the Fort.

Defenders start in control of all three points. Attackers claim points by keeping players within the claim ring.

Once all three claim points are taken, the Attackers must destroy the Fort's gates to access a final claim point in the central yard.

The Attackers win the War if they can claim the final point before the battle's time limit expires.
ui_pvp_modes_guide_1_body: Any qualifying player can join the instanced player vs. player game modes regardless of faction alignment. These modes are found in the Modes screen from the main navigation menu.
ui_pvp_modes_guide_2_body:
Outpost Rush is a 20 vs. 20 match that takes place on a large island with three Outposts.

Teams score points by capturing and holding outposts.

The first team to 1,000 points wins the match.

The island features special resources and creatures that can be harnessed by the teams to swing the battle in their favor.
ui_pvp_modes_guide_3_body:
In 3v3 Arenas, two teams battle to eliminate each other. The match takes place in a best of five format.

Eliminate the entire opposing team to win a round.

Win three rounds to win the match.

Consumables are not allowed. The longer a round continues, the weaker healing abilities become. And If the round lasts too long, a ring of fire will begin to close until one side has won.

ui_seasonal_worlds_about_popup_descripti:
Seasonal Worlds provide a new way to experience Aeternum and earn unique rewards for a limited time each Season.

In Season 8’s Seasonal World, power is the name of the game. Characters on this server can equip as many artifacts as they like, and every time they die, the character gets extra attribute points. Grow stronger faster, and take on challenges you've never been able to attempt before.

A new Seasonal Journey can be progressed on this server focused around how many times your character has died. Completing these goals will give you some new crafting materials as well for non-seasonal worlds. Use these to craft any artifact or T3 trophy of your choosing on a non-seasonal character (up to those released in Season 8). Note: Some of the rewards on the seasonal world journey require purchasing a Premium Battle Pass in the store.

ui_seasonal_worlds_server_description: For this seasonal server, players will experience an expedited main story questline and a unique seasonal world journey with special rewards for completing difficult content without dying. Each time a character on this world dies, they gain a stack of the Fallen status effect, which increases attributes with each stack, to a maximum of 5 stacks. Characters on this world can equip an artifact in each equipment slot. Crossworld matchmaking and activity finder are disabled on {worldName}. Players will need to use group finder for expeditions. Characters cannot transfer to or from this world. Characters on this world will need to be deleted at the end of the season.

ui_war_tutorial_desc_4: Players earn Battle Tokens by damaging their enemies. Use Battle Tokens to purchase various items from Armory.

by initiating a <font color={counterAttackColor}>counter attack</font> in <font color={resolutionPhaseColor}>Resolution phase</font>.

If a counter attack is initiated, the <font color={situationReversedColor}>situation will be reversed</font>.
Your company will have to defend your claim, and the enemy will attack!
ui_wardeclarationpopup_confirmation_mess: A war camp is placed near the fortress.\nYour company will be able to use the camp when the war starts!
ui_wardeclarationpopup_declare_message: When a war is declared, your company can attack the fortress for 30 minutes with up to {maxRosterMembers} players.\nWhen your company successfully takes down the claim marker in the fortress, your company becomes the governor of the territory.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_extendmessage: Are you sure you want to counter attack {guildName}?\nBoth Companies will be able to attack each other without being flagged as a criminal for:
ui_wardeclarationpopup_message: During a war, the attacking company tries to claim the defending company's territory by capturing its fort within the Siege window.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_nopermission: \nYour rank ({rank}) does not have permission to declare war or counter attack.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_noterritorytext: This Company has no territory to war over.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_permission: \nYour Company permissions allow you to declare war and counter attack.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_siege_message: You can only attack the territory in the designated siege time window.\nReview the siege window below.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_siegewindow_and_w: The cost to declare war and the siege window have changed. Please retry.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_siegewindow_chang: The target company's siege window has changed. Please retry.
ui_wardeclarationpopup_warcost_changed: The cost to declare war has changed. Please retry.
ui_wardeclared_message_attack: Prepare the war!\nThe battle starts in 24 hours.
ui_wardeclared_message_defend: You are going to be attacked.\nBe sure to save enough coin to <font color="#cfc2a2">counter attack!</font>

ui_warguildsamefactionerrormessage: Cannot declare war on a Company of the same Faction.

ui_warnotificationconquest_message: You have <font color={colorHex}>{numHours} hours</font> left to do so.

ui_warpermissionpromoted_text: You have been promoted to {rank} in the war on {territoryName}.
ui_warphase_battledesc: <font color={phaseColorHex}><font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">BATTLE PHASE</font></font>\n\nThis phase has been deprecated and should not appear.
ui_warphase_resolutiondesc: <font color={phaseColorHex}><font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">RESOLUTION PHASE</font></font>\n\nWar wrap-up. Review the war results, and all fighters will be teleported to the territory's Settlement.
ui_warphase_scoutingdesc: <font color={phaseColorHex}><font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">PRE-WAR PHASE</font></font>\n\nAll fighters must sign up at the War Board in the territory, and the governor must assign them into the {maxRosterMembers} available slots.
ui_warphase_siegedesc: <font color={phaseColorHex}><font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold.font">SIEGE WINDOW</font></font>\n\nInvites go out to the army 15 minutes before the war, and all will be teleported to the Fort. The winner takes the territory.
ui_warringguildofonecannotacceptinviteme: You cannot join another Company while commanding a warring Company with only one member.
ui_warselected_text: You have been selected to join the war at {territoryName} from {startTime} to {endTime}.
ui_warunselected_text: You have been removed from the {territoryName} war roster.
ui_watchtower_recall_from_esc_popup_conf: Would you like to recall to the watchtower located in {territoryName}?

ui_worldboss_admiral_description: The infamous Admiral Blackpowder has set his sights on the open coast, seeking to reclaim lost treasures and expand his dominion. With his crew at his side, he dares any who oppose him to face his wrath on the sands.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards.
ui_worldboss_empress_description: Empress Zhou channels her corrupted power to wreak havoc on the land. Confront her loyal warriors and face Zhou's might before she consumes all.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards.
ui_worldboss_firenaga_description: Ifrit has risen from the forge to unleash a tide of fire and destruction. Survive his relentless flames to extinguish his infernal wrath once and for all.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards.
ui_worldboss_legacyofcrassus_description: The might of Rome threatens Aeternum! Hunt down Crassus's monstrous captains, Decimus and Lucanus, and banish the shadow of Roman tyranny. Collect daily rewards in addition to rewards for striking down these vicious brutes in Brightwood, Weavers Fen, Mourningdale, and Ebonscale Reach.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards. Resets at {time}
ui_worldboss_lotusscarab_description: Godling Khepri Supernal, has abandoned the seat of the adjudicator to spread its influence far and wide. Fight through its defenses to reclaim the land from this ancient threat.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards.
ui_worldboss_mammoth_description: The colossal Mahantaram thunders over the lands, shattering the earth with every step. Protect the land from his rampage and confront the titan before his fury leaves the lands in ruin.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards.
ui_worldboss_season_01_event_description: The earth rises up against us, subdue the Dryads and the weapon they seek to summon.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards. Resets at {time}
ui_worldboss_season_02_event_description: Help an injured Dunewalker defend Royal Eggs from attacking Sulfur Elementals.\n\nContains <font color="#edc63e">3</font> Daily Rewards. Resets at {time}
