ultimate_bow_hunter_description: When you land a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">headshot</font>, deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> more damage.
ultimate_bow_skirmish_dodgedmg_descripti: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> and deal <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more damage for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> after dodging.
ultimate_dagger_assassin_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">+{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> increased base damage to targets affected by a dagger's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">root</font> or <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">slow</font>. For <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5000.000000 / 1000]}s</font> after using an ability, gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% haste</font> when facing an enemy.
ultimate_dagger_blade_description: Critical hits apply a stack of Scoundrel's Venom that does {[-0.050000 * -100]}%weapon damage per second for {[6.000000]} seconds. (Max {[6.000000]} stacks). \n\nHeal {[0.025000 * 100]}% of your base health when hitting an enemy with an attack that would apply Scoundrel's Venom.
ultimate_flail_crusader_description:
Hitting a target with an <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">ability</font> while within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}m</font> of an ally, applies a status effect linking yourself and a single ally to each other for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. While the effect is active the ally will only take <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.500000 * 100]}%</font> of the incoming damage and causing you to inherit <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.350000 * 100]}%</font> of the incoming damage they didn't take. 
	\n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cannot be applied to targets that already have this effect, or self if you already have the effect applied to an ally.)</font>
ultimate_flail_eldritch_description:
While near <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}</font> or more allies, grant passive <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">healing</font> to self and all allies that heals for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.160000 * 100]}%</font> weapon damage every <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}</font> seconds. 
	

Range of heal aura varies based on what <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">equip load</font> the player is:
	
•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Light</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}m</font> radius area of effect. 
	
•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Medium</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font> radius area of effect. 
	
•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Heavy</font> - <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}m</font> radius area of effect. 
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Healing scales exclusively with Focus.)</font>
ultimate_greataxe_mauler_description: Great axe attacks grant a stacking <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> granting a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.030000 * 100]}%</font> damage increase for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[10.000000]} stacks.)</font>
ultimate_greataxe_reaper_description: When looking at a foe within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[7.000000 * 2]}m</font>, you move <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> faster and gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font>, dealing <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more damage.
ultimate_greatsword_defense_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Heal</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> of the damage from attacks.\n\nAttacking within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font> of blocking an attack <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heals</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> of the damage dealt instead.
ultimate_greatsword_offense_description:
Hitting foes reduces greatsword <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">cooldowns</font>:
•Light attack: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.020000 * -100]}%</font>
•Charged heavy attack: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">

(Cooldown reduction only occurs once per attack.)</font>
ultimate_lifestaff_healing_description: When you <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heal</font> an ally below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font> health, they are <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">healed</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font> more.
ultimate_lifestaff_protection_descriptio: When you <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">heal</font> a target with Light's Embrace, extend the duration of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">buffs</font> on that target by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>.
ultimate_sword_defender_description: While blocking, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">reduce damage</font> to all allies within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}m</font> by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Cooldown 1s.)</font><font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(This effect cannot be dispelled.)</font>
ultimate_sword_swordmaster_description: While holding a sword, grant <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Empower</font> to all group members, increasing their <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">damage</font> by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font>.
umbralcrystalt1_description: A full-sized Azoth Crystal, but the light is gone from this one. Instead, it seems to absorb the life around it. Used for empowering weapons and armor.
umbralgeodet1_description: Open this Geode to receive the powerful contents within.
umbralshardt1_description: A depleted shard that lies inert in your hand. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Bold_Italic.font">This item can be salvaged for coin.</font>
undeadbrute_consume_description: Increases base damage by {[0.350000]} for {[10.000000]} seconds.
undeadburn_description: Deals {[-0.110000 * -100]}% base Fire damage every {[0.500000]} seconds for {[1.500000]}.
undeadhunter_burn_description: Deals {[-0.050000 * -100]}% base Fire damage every {[0.500000]} seconds for {[3.000000]} seconds.
underworld_gate_locked_desc: This gate needs a blue energy orb to be unlocked.
underworld_tunnel_desc: Travel through the Underworld mine tunnel.
uniquedungeonreps11_groupname: Unique Barnacles and Black Powder Replicas
unpetrifiedflesht1_description: Cooking ingredient.\n\nGathered from Wolf and Bear Statues in Elysian Wilds.
upgrade_bow_evasiveknockback_knockback_d: Evade Shot <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">staggers</font> and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">pushes</font> the target back <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}m</font>.
upgrade_bow_evasiveshot_haste_descriptio: Successfully hitting with Evade Shot grants you a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.120000 * 100]}% haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Haste increases movement speed.)</font>
upgrade_bow_penetratingshot_dmgperdist_d: Penetrating Shot deals <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to targets <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[20.000000]}m</font> or more away.
upgrade_bow_penetratingshot_dmgperhit_de: Penetrating Shot deals <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> increased damage after each hit. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[0.500000 * 100]}% damage.)</font>
upgrade_bow_poisonshot_directdmg_descrip: Direct hits against targets are more powerful and now deal {[1.000000 * 100]}% weapon damage.
upgrade_bow_poisonshot_poisondmg_descrip: Poison Shot's poison now does {[-0.240000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second for {[7.000000]}s.
upgrade_bow_rainofarrows_bleed_descripti: Rain of Arrows causes bleed, dealing {[-0.090000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second for {[12.000000]}s.
upgrade_bow_rainofarrows_slow_descriptio: Rain of Arrows causes a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}% slow</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Slow reduces target's movement speed.)</font>
upgrade_bow_rapidaccuracy_cdronlast_desc: If all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> arrows hit the same target, Rapid Shot's cooldown is reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.500000 * -100]}%</font>.
upgrade_bow_rapidaccuracy_dmgonlast_desc: The third arrow of Rapid Shot deals <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage.
upgrade_bow_splintershot_cdrperhit_descr: Explosive Arrow direct hits inflict burn, dealing {[-0.080000 * -100]}% weapon damage every second for {[10.000000]}s.
upgrade_bow_splintershot_fivea_descripti: Explosion damage increased to {[1.700000 * 100]}% weapon damage, but decreases the explosion radius to {[1.250000]}m.
upgrade_dagger_ambush_1_description: Ambush inflicts <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">disease</font>, reducing incoming healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.300000 * -100]}%</font>, and outgoing healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_dagger_ambush_2_description: Hitting enemies rooted by ambush or that already have rend stacks from this upgrade will add a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">rend</font> stack that lasts <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. Each stack lowers armor by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.020000 * -100]}%</font> (Refreshes on hit, max <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}</font> stacks)
upgrade_dagger_ambush_3_description: After ambush's <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">root</font> expires, the target is inflicted with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.300000 * -100]}%</font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">slow</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_dagger_dashslice_1_description: Hitting an enemy lowers the cooldowns of other abilities by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font>. Limit 1 time per activation.
upgrade_dagger_dashslice_2_description: Reduce combo points consumed per extra activation from <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2</font>.
upgrade_dagger_doublestab_1_description: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage per combo point consumed.
upgrade_dagger_doublestab_2_description: Inflicts <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">weaken</font>, reducing your target's base damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}%</font>.
upgrade_dagger_doublestab_3_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> cooldown reduction per combo point consumed.
upgrade_dagger_flurry_1_description: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}%</font> move speed after Frenzied Slashes ends.
upgrade_dagger_flurry_2_description: If you hit a target with Frenzied Slashes <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">5</font> or more times, your next ability within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[10.000000]}s</font> does <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage.
upgrade_dagger_stealth_1_description: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100% critical hit chance</font> when attacking from <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stealth</font> and hitting a surprised target with dagger attacks applies <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}%</font> slow for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_dagger_stealth_2_description: Surprise status lasts <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}s</font>	longer.	Basic attacks do <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> more base damage to surprised targets.
upgrade_dagger_stealth_3_description: Dagger attacks that hit a surprised target apply a stack of	<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">disease</font>, reducing incoming healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.030000 * -100]}%</font> that lasts for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. (Max <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}</font> stacks).\n\nIn combat <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stealth</font> speed penalty no longer applies when within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}m</font> of an enemy.
upgrade_dagger_throw_1_description: Reduce combo points consumed per extra use from <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">3</font> to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">2</font>.
upgrade_dagger_throw_2_description: Increase the duration of Crippling Sling's slow by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_dagger_throw_3_description: Crippling Sling now inflicts Scoundrel's Venom to targets, dealing {[-0.050000 * -100]}%weapon damage per second for {[6.000000]}s.
upgrade_dagger_thrustingslice_test1_desc: Enable homing for thrust slice. This is temporary for test purposes during prototype.
upgrade_dagger_thrustingslice_test2_desc: Disable collision for thrusing slice. This is temporary for test purposes during prototype.
upgrade_firestaff_burnout_aoe_descriptio: Burnout now triggers an explosion right as it ends dealing {[1.000000 * 100]}% damage to all targets in a 2.5m radius.
upgrade_firestaff_burnout_cdr_descriptio: Fire staff cooldowns are reduced by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> for each foe hit by Burnout. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} reductions per ability use.)</font>
upgrade_firestaff_fireball_dur_descripti: Fireball hits now apply a stack of smolder on targets, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage every half second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)
upgrade_firestaff_fireball_mana_descript: Direct hits with Fireball restore <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}% </font>of your max mana and reduce your fire staff ability cooldowns by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.070000 * -100]}%</font>.
upgrade_firestaff_flamethrower_dmg_descr: Increase the base damage of Flamethrower by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.250000 * 100]}%</font>.
upgrade_firestaff_flamethrower_nocooldow: Flamethrower has no <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">cooldown</font> when cancelled. While Flamethrower is active, being staggered will activate a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">6s</font> cooldown and can only be reduced by conditional cooldown reduction.
upgrade_firestaff_flamethrower_rng_descr: Increase the range of Flamethrower by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font>.
upgrade_firestaff_incinerate_burn_descri: Incinerate hit inflict the target with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.120000 * -100]}% Weaken</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.\n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Weaken reduces target's outgoing damage.)</font>
upgrade_firestaff_incinerate_double_desc: Gain a stack of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.030000 * 100]}%</font> empower for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[7.000000]}s</font> for each target hit with incinerate. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} stacks.)</font>
upgrade_firestaff_incinerate_heal_descri: Cleanse <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]} </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">debuffs</font> when hitting a target with incinerate. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Limit 1 activation per ability use.)</font>
upgrade_firestaff_meteorshower_extra_des: Adds <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> while casting Meteor Shower.<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)</font>
upgrade_firestaff_meteorshower_mana_desc: Meteor Shower now applies <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Disease</font>, reducing the incoming healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.100000 * -100]}%</font> and outgoing healing by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> of all targets inside the area of effect.
upgrade_firestaff_meteorshower_more_desc: Hitting a target that is inside meteor shower with a light or heavy attack will inflict smolder on targets, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage every half second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)
upgrade_firestaff_pillaroffire_dmg_descr: Pillar of Fire deals {[0.050000 * 100]}% more base damage for each stack of smolder on the target, dealing {[-0.045000 * -100]}% weapon damage each second for {[6.000000]}s. (Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)
upgrade_firestaff_pillaroffire_mana_desc: Gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> of your max mana per enemy hit by Pillar of Fire.
upgrade_flail_blast_upgrade1_description: Hitting targets <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}</font> times with Arcane Vortex will inflict them with <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">root</font>, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">immobilizing</font> them for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_flail_blast_upgrade2_description:
Hitting a target with Arcane Vortex grants a stacking <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">haste</font> on self, increasing movement speed by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.050000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[7.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[4.000000]} stacks.)</font> 
	\n\nAllies within the radius of the attack are granted a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.200000 * 100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">haste</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_flail_blast_upgrade3_description:
All allies within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}m</font> of player during the Arcane Vortex are <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">cleansed</font> of crowd control status effects (Root, Stun, Slow) and are immune to them for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000]}</font> seconds. 
	

All allies inside are also <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">healed</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.650000 * 100]}%</font> weapon damage. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Healing scales exclusively with Focus.)</font> 

(Crowd Control Immunity scales with Focus, increasing its duration to up to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}</font> seconds.)
upgrade_flail_burst_upgrade1_description: Targets hit with the first attack of burst are <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">slowed</font>, reducing their movement speed by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.400000 * -100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>.
upgrade_flail_burst_upgrade2_description: The follow up attack extends the duration of all debilitate status effects (Rend, Weaken, Exhaust, Disease) on the target by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font>.
upgrade_flail_burst_upgrade3_description: The follow up attack triggers a chain that will bounce up to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[4.000000]}</font> times to allies within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}m</font> of player, granting <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.300000 * 100]}%</font> of its total damage as <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">health</font> to each ally it chains to, and <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.350000 * 100]}%</font> of its total damage to self. \n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Healing scales exclusively with Focus.)</font>
upgrade_flail_charge_upgrade1_descriptio:
Hitting a target with any of barrage's hits will grant a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}% fortify</font>. The fortify has a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font> duration, and every hit extends the duration of the status effect by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[2.000000]}s</font> to a max of <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}s</font>.
	\n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Moving through targets with the Bulldoze upgrade will also extend the duration of the effect.)</font>
upgrade_flail_charge_upgrade2_descriptio:
Grants a bonus to Barrage based on what <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">shield type</font> is equipped:
	

•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Round Shield</font> - Barrage hits for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font> more base weapon damage.
	
•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Kite Shield</font> - Barrage hits inflict <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.200000 * -100]}%</font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e"> slow</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">
	{[4.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This will also slow targets moved through with the Bulldoze upgrade.)</font>
	
•<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Tower Shield</font> - Barrage gains <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> while active.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Slow reduces movement speed.)</font> 
	
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)</font>
upgrade_flail_charge_upgrade3_descriptio: Barrage can now <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">block</font> attacks while charging forward without consuming stamina, and will <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">push</font> all enemies moved through to the side. \n\n<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(This will also cause the targets moved through to be taunted if using a carnelian gem.)</font>
upgrade_flail_charge_upgrade4_descriptio: Barrage's attack now triggers a {[2.500000]}m blast of energy around the target on hit, dealing {[0.350000 * 100]}% weapon damage to all nearby targets, and granting fortify to all allies within the radius, increasing armor by {[0.200000 * 100]}% for {[8.000000]}s.
upgrade_flail_defensivestrike_upgrade1_d: Stamina damage taken is reduced by {[0.250000 * 100]}% for {[0.500000]}s after activating block. \n\nAdditionally, blocking hits while the reinforced fortify from Warding Bludgeon is active will Inflict a stack of Impairment for {[6.000000]}s on the attacker, dealing {[-0.100000 * -100]}% weapon damage per second and weakening them, reducing their base damage by {[-0.100000 * -100]}%. (Max {[3.000000]} stacks.)
upgrade_flail_defensivestrike_upgrade2_d: Upon hitting an enemy target, a nearby ally within <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}m</font> is selected and you become linked to them. While the connection is active, they gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">empower</font>, increasing their base damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font>, and you both gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">damage absorption</font>, reducing damage taken by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[8.000000]}s</font>, or until players are more than <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[6.000000]}m</font> apart from each other.<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(This effect cannot be dispelled.)</font>
upgrade_flail_slam_upgrade1_description: Smite hits reduce its own cooldown by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> per target hit. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} targets.)</font>
upgrade_flail_slam_upgrade2_description: Grants a bonus based on what shield type is equipped: •Round Shield - Smite deals {[0.200000 * 100]}% more base weapon damage. •Kite Shield - Smite will now stagger targets hit, but damage is reduced to {[0.900000 * 100]}% weapon damage. •Tower Shield - Gain {[0.300000 * 100]}% fortify for {[6.000000]}s when smite is activated. (Fortify increases armor.)
upgrade_flail_slam_upgrade3_description:
Allies that enter the hazardous area gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Deflecting Frailty</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Deflecting Frailty</font> is a buff which, when receiving an attack, will inflict a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">stackable weakening effect</font> to enemy attackers, reducing the enemy's damage dealt by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.050000 * -100]}%</font> per stack for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} stacks.)</font>
	

Additionally while the effect is active, when allies are hit, they gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}% lifesteal for </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. 

(Deflecting Frailty scales with Focus, increasing its duration to up to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[12.000000]}</font> seconds.)
upgrade_flail_trip_upgrade1_description: Tripping a target applies a special debuff to the target lasting <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}s</font>. Allies that hit the affected enemy will reduce the duration of all damage over time effects on themselves by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">10%</font> per hit while active. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">({[1.000000]}s cooldown.)</font>
upgrade_flail_trip_upgrade2_description:
Hitting weakened targets with trip will inflict <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[-0.150000 * -100]}% rend</font> for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font> on the target, and granting <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}% </font> <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">fortify</font> on self for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[5.000000]}s</font>.
	

<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Rend reduces target's armor.)</font> 
	
<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Fortify increases your armor.)</font>
upgrade_flail_trip_upgrade3_description: Reactivate this ability or use basic attack to add a follow up heavy attack that deals {[1.450000 * 100]}% weapon damage.
upgrade_greataxe_charge_dmgperdistance_d: Charge now deals {[1.200000 * 100]}% / {[1.300000 * 100]}% / {[1.400000 * 100]}% weapon damage based on time spent charging.
upgrade_greataxe_charge_swingattack_desc: During Charge you may press block to execute a swing attack, dealing {[1.400000 * 100]}% / {[1.500000 * 100]}% / {[1.650000 * 100]}% weapon damage based on time spent charging.
upgrade_greataxe_executioner_addgrit_des: Execute gains <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">grit</font> during its attack.<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">\n\n(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)</font>
upgrade_greataxe_executioner_critvslowhp: Execute has a <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[1.000000 * 100]}%</font> critical chance against foes below <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[30.000000]}%</font> health.
upgrade_greataxe_gravitywell_armorinwell: Allies gain <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}% fortify</font> while standing in your well. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Fortify increases armor.)</font>
upgrade_greataxe_gravitywell_dmgperfoe_d: Increase burst damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.100000 * 100]}%</font> for each foe caught in the vortex. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} targets.)</font>
upgrade_greataxe_maelstorm_absorbproject: Consumes all <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">projectiles</font> while Maelstrom is active.
upgrade_greataxe_maelstorm_rng_descripti: Extends Maelstrom's pull range by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">50%</font>.
upgrade_greataxe_maelstorm_spinattack_de: Maelstrom does an extra spin attack, pulling in foes and dealing {[1.100000 * 100]}% weapon damage. Additionally it gains grit during its startup.\n\n(Grit prevents you from being staggered by incoming attacks.)
upgrade_greataxe_reap_lifesteal_descript: <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">Heal</font> yourself for <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.300000 * 100]}%</font> of damage done by Reap.
upgrade_greataxe_reap_spingattack_descri: After pulling, perform a spin attack dealing {[1.150000 * 100]}% weapon damage.
upgrade_greataxe_whirlwind_dmgwhenfoesne: If you have <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[3.000000]}</font> or more foes around you, increase base weapon damage by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">{[0.150000 * 100]}%</font> for each nearby target. <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_Regular_Italic.font" color="#828282">(Max {[5.000000]} targets.)</font>
upgrade_greataxe_whirlwind_morespins_des: If you hit a foe, <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">gain an additional spin</font>. Whirlwind's maximum number of spins is increased to <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">7</font>.
upgrade_greataxe_whirlwind_speed_descrip: Whirlwind's movement speed is increased by <font face="lyshineui/fonts/Nimbus_SemiBold.font" color="#edc63e">100%</font>.

varangianknights_body_01_01:
Sir Ulfar,

I gift you with orders and tidings of glory grim. You are hereby tasked to take Stonereach Keep at all costs. Establish a base to stage further campaigns.

Sir Rulav is to remain at the beach camp to coordinate the arrivals of new forces. He is the key to this entire initiative, though only he is entrusted with the finer points of this.

I will arrive shortly. I expect a well-garrisoned keep waiting. Failure is the only sin, and I will be your most devoted confessor on some soon morrow. We are the Varikulaki. We are His fists.

For the glory of Iznovgorod!

Lord Commander Attalus
varangianknights_body_02_01:
Survivalist Lee,

They give chase. Barely escaped.

Your visions of ships and dark riders prove wise. Armor-clad warriors infest these lands for some dread purpose at the behest of some Lord Commander.

These ‘Varangians’ are brutality incarnate. I was captured and tortured. Their methods were... dear God...

The hulking fiend named Sir Rulav was worst of all. His laughter will haunt me like a wraith.

The violence to my flesh tore a hole in my soul. I feel all that is me spilling out an ounce at a time. It will not be long before I join the Lost.

I tried to speak familiar names, and all I heard were moans...

If indeed my fate is to enter the damnation of purgatory, I hope some figment of my life in your service echoes in my cold mind and heart.

Faithfully,

Scout Desdemona
varangianknights_body_03_01:
My Bright One,

The warriors in these lands have grown soft since last we walked here. These cowards are no true knights. Their weapons are brittle, their armor inferior, and their skill at arms laughable. We will have little trouble claiming these lands from the men who hold them. 

The Crimson Sickness still persists, however, and the restless shades of the dead exist in vast numbers. Myrddin’s secrets must be found and secured if we are to meet these challenges effectively. The Lord Commander assures me we are close to discovering the old sorcerer’s lair. Kari’s wisdom has been most beneficial in this regard.

Soon we shall be reunited, my beloved. I long to hold you in my arms and feel your warm breath on my face. We shall have a new home here. I have my eye on a few keeps. We shall decide which shall be ours together. 

Until then, I shall dream of you and remember the intoxicating taste of your lips.

Sir Rulav
varangianknights_body_03_02:
The Lord Commander has been very clear about the treatment of prisoners. Anyone captured by our troops is to be interrogated using the most extreme methods available. There is to be no regard for the prisoner’s age, sex, or trade. If after interrogation the prisoner has revealed nothing, they are to be immediately executed and their bodies burned.

These measures may seem cruel but the urgency of our task demands no less. There will be peace once we have fulfilled the wishes of our Great Lord. It is He who dispenses mercy, He who heals and unites. 

We are Varikulaki and we obey His will in all things.

Sir Rulav

varangianknights_body_04_01:
To my right worshipful and well-beloved mother,

I am grateful for your guidance and have taken your wise words to heart. But I fear my current circumstances do no allow me to act upon your counsel. For the moment, our Lord Commander has given his favor to Sir Rulav. A strong bond exists between the two as a result of their parts in securing the rise of Iznovgorod. Such a bond would make my petition for advancement fall on deaf ears.

Fortune, however, has smiled upon your son. I have been given command of a fortress vital to establishing our position here. It is my belief that such an appointment shows that my time may come soon. Rulav is a formidable opponent on the field so a direct challenge would be foolhardy. I will instead do as my right noble and valorous father always advised and bide my time. I will know when the iron is hot.

I remain your devoted and loving son.

Sir Ulfar
varangianknights_body_04_02: I beseech you, Mother of Night, to keep me from harm and grant me victory on the field. I ask you to shatter the blades of my foes, split their shields, weaken their limbs, and blind their eyes. \n\nFor the sake of this request, Dark Lady, I offer you the blood of my enemies as your sacred libation. Be benevolent and propitious and shield me in your eternal shadow.
varangianknights_body_04_03:
How my talents are wasted on such base, brute butcher work! Mine is the grace of subtle swordsmanship, not heavy-handed cleaving. Mine is the ecstasy of penmanship, not this rote boorish torture. Ah well. All to the greater glory.

I am a warrior, it is true, but I fancy myself part of the ancient tradition of the troubadour knight. I therefore must scriven to keep my mind sharp during these bloody doldrums.

In a half hour, I must rend a knave’s flesh until he offers up the truth. But for now, I will try my hand at romantic verse.

MY GARDEN
Before you, my passion was a root-bound garden choked with weed.
Before you, love was a cemetery devoid of seed.
But now your name bestows joy to the gloom.
Your name, once uttered, brings my garden to bloom.
For you, O celestial daughter
I water my garden with the wine of slaughter.
Romance by the blade,
My enemies unmade.
In every cold ear, I whisper your name.
And so you haunt the hearing canals of the dead.
Like the sea in a shell in a sandy bed.

I do believe this is my finest verse yet.

Sir Ozur
varangianknights_body_05_01:
Requisitioned a new spade. Again. Soon I’ll be digging with just a stick. That’s my lot now, digging up worm-eaten things or digging a hole to put in things for the worms to eat.

A soul needs a good confessor, whether the ear of a trusted comrade or a good barkeep. Lacking both, I’m practicing my letters to keep my head straight. Used to be mocked for being decent with my letters, back in the village. I caved their heads in but good.

All the wealthy knights keep playing their chess games up above. Rulav and Ulfar circle each other for a drop of Attalus’s love. He in turn pines for our Lord and Master. But all the toil comes trickling down to us common foot soldiers.

It’s all about finding damned relics and mystical baubles now. These quarrelsome knights slaver over the prospect of finding such things like starving hounds. We chase rumors of the comings and goings of magicians and conjurers.

I’ve dug up things that could plant a madness in your skull. But I don’t got time for that rot. I just keep digging. I’m the conqueror of mud.
varangianknights_body_05_02:
We came to this land to conquer, but it is wise to observe those we conquer. The customs, fashions, and speech are a strange mix. Some are alien. Others are familiar. Rumors among the lower ranks have gone so far as to posit that this was once our home. The Lord Commander has ordered that such talk be silenced.

Where others find disquiet, I myself find opportunity. With such a bounty of variety around us, we might pick and choose that which we might bring into our own culture and thereby be strengthened. In fact, I took this notion from a soldier whom I bested in combat. He wielded an arquebus of magnificent design. I daresay it was superior to our own firearms. There is much we can learn here.

Sir Yasen
varangianknights_body_05_03:
Sir Vadislav,

By Varangian law and the rites of Lord Varik, I hereby formally challenge you to ritual combat.

Long I have borne your thousand tiny injuries, but now you have ventured upon insult, and I will have satisfaction. If there is courage in your heart to match the venom in your words, you will arrive at the site of our landing within three days to answer this challenge. If not, you forfeit your valor and your place in our order, under Lord Varik’s Law.

By blood, by stone, by marrow and bone, I challenge you. Steel is the only sacrament. Victory is the only god. 

Ever the praises to Iznovgorod. Ever the praises to the Hammer.

Awaiting at your pleasure,

Sir Anton
varangianknights_body_06_01:
Day 78
The men found some sort of scavenger skulking around the camp, and brought him to me for questioning. Not one for talking, but with a bit of... convincing... he gave us enough. Some kind of treasure hunter, one of those mongrels who searches through ruins to find anything worth selling. One of the guards saw where he dumped his pack in his escape, and is bringing it to me now. Given his appearance, I expect nothing more than a few shiny rocks and some polished wood.

Day 79
Either this fool is lucky beyond belief, or knows far more than he is telling! In that rat's pack, he actually carried one of Myrddin's relics... I can hardly believe it. I never would have known if I hadn't brought it close to the barrier! It started sparkling and twinkling, some kind of sympathetic magical reaction. From that scavenger's notes, he found it somewhere far to the north. Perhaps...
The relic is to be sent away for further study, but Sir Vladislav has plans for the notebook. Messages have come in from Sir Anton in the southlands, and our Lord is preparing to take his retinue south in response, along with the notebook. I believe he may try to win Sir Anton over to the cause, and form an alliance of our two banners. He may be brutish at times, but Sir Vladislav understands how to seize an opportunity. I can only hope that Sir Anton is equally intelligent.

Day 82
Damnation! That stupid rat tried to escape again, tried to get the guards to kill him outright. This island's power makes imprisonment difficult... but not impossible. I'm sending him north to Riverside Keep under heavy guard. Sir Inegeld knows how to handle problematic cases like this one. Our little friend will be begging to spill his guts. If not, the Dark Lady's ways will bring me the information I need.
varangianknights_body_06_02:
Given the proximity of this site to the nearby ruins, I am certain that Myrddin conducted at least some part of his research here. This barrier was obviously created by him, and must be protecting something of great importance. We will not be abandoning this site because of the incompetence of the work crews you have assigned me.

So no, I do not care how difficult it may be! Too much time has been wasted attempting to breach this barrier. Find some of the powder the others on this island use for their weapons, I will pack it into the rock surrounding the barrier and light the fuse myself! Better yet, have Inegeld bring down one of those cannons he is so proud of capturing and I'll put it to proper use!

Sonechka the Pale,
Magister Magica, Vorongard
varangianknights_body_07_01:
To the one who finds this:
I have been taken by the Varangians, those cretins who seek to unlock the mysteries of Myrddin's experiments. Given my treatment at their hands, they won't use them for anything good.

I overheard the guards when they thought I was asleep, and they intend to move me north to someplace called Riverside Keep. The leader here, Anton, is leaving tomorrow to go south, along with the notes of my travels. Damn me for a fool, but if they follow the trail back, they may locate what I think is Myrddin's true workshop.

You must head south. There is a woman there, Caoimhe, an apprentice to an Antiquarian. She is an ally, and familiar with the magics of the island. If these bastards have passed anywhere near her, she will know about it and be able to guide you. You must recover my notebook and give it to her.
varangianknights_body_07_02:
Bah, Vladislav thinks he will be able to cow me into joining his little band, searching for trinkets and magic words in the rocks! There is no honor, no glory, no victory in that. We, the Kinjalgard, will take his baubles and mount them on our walls as trophies.

I will not strike down one of our own in cold blood. I have prepared a challenge in the ways both old and new. Vladislav will accept. To do less would require his own men to strike him down as a coward. Then the Kinjalgard will be the blade that splits the ribs of these soft islanders, to prepare for the coming of the Lord Commander, and the rivers of blood will dye his boots red as he touches the sands.

For the Kinjalgard! For the glory of Iznovgorod!
varangianknights_body_07_03:
I've followed the clues, these scraps of knowledge and rumor and folklore, as far north as I dare go. Over the rocky spires ahead of me, I see the dusky smudge of Corruption that persists above the broken mountain.
Vine and stone and branch move here, some strange power binding their forms together - I've heard tell of them, but this is my first time seeing them for myself. Wonderous. A traveler stepped from the path and passed some invisible boundary to cause offense - these creatures appeared to tear that poor fool asunder. Deadly.
I shall be careful where I place my feet.
To the east, a pristine lake shimmers as the sun rises, and the light warms my back as I enter the cave.

---

A rockslide. Of all things to be stopped by, a damnable rockslide should be the least of my worries. A small chamber, no more than a half dozen paces deep, illuminated by the light of glowing crystals. This must be the place... at least, behind these rocks. Unless I reveal the location to others, I fear I shall never see what secrets await. Myrddin's workshop has been sealed by the island itself.

I did not come away emptyhanded. Buried in the dust at my feet, I found a... I'm not certain what it actually is. When I picked it up, it sparked and tingled with energy. It is small, possibly stone, fist-sized. Carved on every surface appear to be runes, words, symbols of some fashion. Some of the ancient tales of Myrddin mentioned magical stones, granted to individuals to allow safe passage into dangerous areas. I wonder if this may be one of those keystones?

It is time to return to safer pastures. I feel the eyes of the trees watching me far too closely here.
varangianknights_body_08_01:
Ulfgar, 

The campaign opened satisfyingly enough. We routed those squatters foolish enough to slither back into territories once held by the Crimson Sorcerer. Most put up no resistance at all, scattering to the four winds like sheep without a shepherd. The plunder was meager, but we were in good spirits. After all, we were closer than ever to what remained of the High Kingdom. Gold and glimmer still abound within the old cities. 

Attalus, unfortunately, had other plans. He’s had us sack the old keeps and mines in search of trinkets and baubles, hoping he can somehow harness the power of the Crimson Sorcerer. He has his own men – warriors of Varangian stock – cracking rocks with pick and shovel. Can you imagine the shame? Rus crawling beneath the earth like insects. We do not toil in the ground like rabble. What we want, we take! 

The Lord Commander has ordered me to whip the new recruits into shape while we fortify our position. A bunch of impudent mutts – I’d sooner trust an invasion to my hounds. If he thinks I’ll waste my time hardening them into real warriors just so he can dig for crystals, he’s sorely mistaken. If Attalus continues to deny our requests to search for new spoils, he will hear my challenge. Blood will determine who truly has a right to lead these knights! 

-Olga
varangianknights_body_09_01: This reek of the Ancients hangs over this place. The foul stench of a site, once natural, unmade by their perversions. Gods know what marvels the natural world might have wrought here before their tampering. The essence of all things pulses through these crystalline halls, and with it, the power of the cosmos. And then there is… him. The Crimson One sought to command this fel power for his whim, believing in his arrogance that he would be spared the awful fate of those who came before. I can only assume death was the cost of such terrible hubris, but… I cannot shake the feeling he remains, in some form or another. The veil between worlds is thin here, and somewhere, on the other side, an umbral entity shadows my footsteps. I can feel it, lurking, just beyond my perceptions; like hot breath on the nape of my neck, making my skin crawl. Varik is determined to be king, and will stop at nothing to achieve the crown of his desire. Attalus, blindly loyal and ambitious, will follow wherever the Warlord leads him, and Halfdan’s thirst for the knowledge of the forge will push him ever-further toward the abyss. Perhaps we shall meet the same doom as those who came before us. I shall pray that Varik will heed my warnings of restraint, for we marshal these powers at the greatest of peril.
varangianknights_body_10_01:
Lord Commander, 

I need more! 

The crystals and gemstones you have hauled from within the caverns hold phenomenal power. Each stroke of the hammer and pull of the bellows unlocks strange, new mysteries, infusing our warlord’s arsenal with frightful capabilities. Bring me this bounty, and I will deliver to you the most powerful army to ever scour these lands. The secrets once known only to the High King and his sages will unravel before me, and I will birth upon my anvil a weapon of such unfettered power it will eclipse even the legendary blade of Artorious’ himself: Excalibur! 

I need more! Bring me more! 

Your servant,

Halfdan the Smith
varangianknights_body_11_01:
My Lord, 

We have crushed the enemy and driven them from the land once occupied by the Crimson Sorcerer. Whatever secrets he once held in his caves and bastions belong to you now. We shall batter down every door, smash every chest, and tear open every bolthole until they spill forth their secrets to the servants of the mighty Warlord Varik. 

Our warriors and their servants now toil beneath the earth, pillaging the crystals and gemstones our insolent enemy used to such destructive force in the War of the Crimson Madness. Your mighty smith, Halfdan, toils night and day to unlock their knowledge. The fires of the forge burn endlessly, fashioning new and deadly weapons for the soldiers of your host. Soon your army shall wield the most formidable arsenal that Aeternum has seen since the fall of the High King. And once it is so, who would dare stand against you? 

Your servants have taken great pains to fortify these new territories, amassing a multitude of siege engines and cannon. Any foe who dares challenge your authority within these mines shall face certain destruction. 

All glory to the Varangian Rus, and to Varik, our anointed warlord, 

-Lord Commander Attalus

weavers_body_01_01: This place is CURSED – bridges and roads that lead nowhere – tracks that stop abruptly at marshland eager to swallow you, boots and all – even the ancient road seems washed out after barely an hour's rain, as if it can't stand any of the constructions here, now or in the past. Weaver's Fen – ha! The Marsh is naught else but a great spider, its web the swamp itself – no wonder we've lost so many caravans to this place, and we're likely to lose dozens more.\n\nIf not for the oil, one would not care at all – and to us, it hardly seems worth it to suffer the Fen's dangers if we're unlikely to ever have a home here.
weavers_body_01_02: Jacoby asked about the red swirls in the marsh, and we enlightened the fool – it's where the Corrupted got riddled with rifles or felled by axes, and their blood soaked the marsh. Not all of it, to be sure, there's settler blood, too, and the Fen was thick with it - we told him be on his guard or the Fen would drink deep of his blood as well.\n\nIt didn't seem to kill the gleam in his eye, though – he'll see different if we get close to the Corrupted's old fort, and see if he likes wearing boots dyed with blood of the marsh. It's a small blessing that settlers older than us pushed the bastards back to the Cleave, for I doubt we'd have the soldiers to do it today, especially now that the Queensport Union got struck by the Cleave's heel when they got too bold. There's a lesson there, and Jacoby had best heed it before he gets ideas of claiming land that isn't his.
weavers_body_01_03:
We came upon a leather sack off the road, and Jacoby eagerly searched it, becoming quite disappointed when all within was herbs and food. He asked who might have dropped it - and when we made mention of the witch, Jacoby's eyes grew wide – he cast the herbs into the muck and became agitated, stomping about, urging us to leave until I finally cuffed him.

“Our Hazel's not to be feared,” I told him once his ears stopped ringing. “Been at the isle longer than us, and that good woman's done more to help us than any.” I nodded at the sack. “She leaves those, not as warnings, not as curses, but supplies for those in need of food or healing, as it's easy to get lost in the Fen.”

I let that sink in, and when he grumbled that he wouldn't accept ‘any witch's poison', I nodded at the herbs in the muck. “Now, now – put those in your mouth and chew it. Might be poison, as you say. Or it might taste like your pride. Either one might cure that lack of sense of yours.”
weavers_body_01_04:
An uneasy peace governs the Fen, some say – as if we had a choice.

The Corrupted continue to infest the marsh, and grow bolder by the day. We hack at them like stubborn roots, and for what? They will soon outnumber us – and then harvest us as we harvest the Fen.

What use is a trading company, or any company at all, if we cannot protect ourselves and those in our charge? Yet still we go about our shallow business – we fish, trade oil and linen from our stores, a clockwork life while a hammer waits to fall on us.

The glorious “Weaver's Fen Company” indeed! Fish scales and fish guts shall be a poor shield against the evils of this isle.
weavers_body_01_05: “Leave them be and they shall leave us be,” is the prayer of the fools in the forts. They ignore the empty homes in the Fen, and focus on the ease of life on the peninsula as if the Fen is not a stone's throw away. Other prayers are more foolish, “the Witch has lived here ages,” they say, “and she survived.” Yet when I ask the same fools to draw a map to her home and how anything or anyone might find it, let alone attack it, they grow quiet and return to their cups.\n\nIf we will not help ourselves, we must find others who will. I have heard tales of a union at Queensport, a collection of companies who have banded together to protect the isle. It will be a hard task to convince those of the Fen to welcome any government or army, but I fear if we wait for the Corrupted to convince us, there will be little left to protect.
weavers_body_01_06:
A Queensport Officer was in the Fen outpost. I took this opportunity to test his convictions, though in a circular fashion. He answered honestly, even disagreed with me when I claimed the Corrupted in the Fen did not trouble us overmuch.

“I do not want to tell others how to live their lives, but the Corrupted do not let others live – they prey on them, and descend like locusts. Where there is one, you can be sure there are others. It is for this reason we have decided to form the union at Queensport.”

I asked if Queensport might “lower” themselves to help the simple people of the Fen, and he grew even more serious. “We must help each other. Even if I were not of the Queensport union, it is the duty of every living soul on Aeternum. The isle a gift, but that does not mean we must not fight for it.”

The man's name was Rutherford. I asked if he would speak to the Weaver's Company, and he agreed. What comes of it, I do not know.
weavers_body_01_07:
Rutherford's inquiry fell upon deaf ears. As expected, the Weaver's Company – or their drunk representatives, more like - did not wish to stir up trouble with the Corrupted. “What gain is had in antagonizing them? They do not harm us if we leave them be.”

“Have you seen a brother… a sister… a mother, a wife, among the Corrupted?” Rutherford asked. He was calm, but his tone was sharpest at ‘wife'. “I have. I am certain even in Weaver's Fen you have seen it, fellow countrymen who now walk hunched, their skin shriveled, yet a devil's light in their eyes.” Many of the representatives fell silent at this – yet one became angry. “What of it? They were weak – what little faith they had, failed them.”

“No,” Rutherford responded quietly. “You did.”
weavers_body_01_08:
The talks persisted, angrily and uselessly. The representatives wanted nothing to do with Queensport, but their arguments bore little reason. Every helping hand, every calm word was slapped away or scorned.

“And what price is your ‘Queensport assistance'?” The representatives demanded of Rutherford. “A tithe? Taxes? All we left the mainland to put behind us?!”

“There is a tax, yes, for maintenance of the roads, to assist in trade… and to assist each other. But most of all, I offer you our swords, our rifles, and our friendship. That is what will keep the Corrupted from the door.”

“You think we cannot protect our own,” the representatives challenged.

“No single company can,” Rutherford replied. “Even us. And that is why I am here now. You are not asking for our help, we are asking for yours.”

wildhuntress01: Apophis is returned to the sands and Sutekh remains at rest. But the hunt has only just begun.
wildhuntress02: This hunt will be my greatest yet, the wretched mass of humanity my ultimate prey.
wildhuntress03: When we first appeared before them, humans were eager to learn, hungry for guidance.
wildhuntress04: We approached them in forms that were familiar and showered them with blessings.
wildhuntress05: But they lacked the purity shared by other creatures of these lands.
wildhuntress06: I warned my brethren, these beings were not worthy of eternal life. But the gift was bestowed nonetheless.
wildhuntress07: And what thanks did we receive? The fools turned against us.
wildhuntress08: I knew then, annihilation of the species was our only option.
wildhuntress09: But greater threats emerged, requiring our attention.
wildhuntress10: Years passed, we tried to live here in peace and harmony.
wildhuntress11: But the twisted ambitions of humanity have reinvited disaster time and again.
wildhuntress12: Now, however, the power of the Ennead flows through the veins of Aeternum, fuel for my grim task.
wildhuntress13: I will undo the mistake my brethren made so long ago.
wildhuntress14: I will revoke the gift, and restore your mortal birthright to a final and inevitable death.
wildmancutlasskeys_body_01_01:
My trade as a trapper has taken me over every foot of Windsward, from the salty marshes to the balmy veldt. I’ve seen many a thing, but never once reckoned the stories of the Wild Man to be true.

It started with the pitiful cries of a bear caught in a trap. I was creeping up on the keening beast when I saw him. A man of great and powerful stature, wild of hair and beard, with eyes that pierced his surroundings. He moved as an animal moves, approaching the angry bear with no fear.

He pulled the trap open, stroked the thankful beast, and sent it on its way.

I am hardened by the years, yet I feared this man. I believe he heard my heart beating in my chest, for his head snapped in my direction, and then he ran up a tree and fled along the branches of the forest.

As for the trap, it was twisted and bent as if made of the thinnest copper wire.
wildmancutlasskeys_body_01_02:
It’s something like an obsession or maybe an itch I can’t scratch. I keep seeking out the Wild Man. I’ve caught glimpses. Always fleeting. He moves like a panther, runs faster than the deer on all fours. The beasts and the birds, they show no fear of the Wild Man. Even the Angry Earth beasts seem to pay him no mind.

I never get more than a glimpse. He always knows I’m there. He hears every snap of a twig, every brush of a leaf. I suspect he can smell my breath and knows what I’ve supped on the night before.
wildmancutlasskeys_body_01_03:
Of all the damndest things! It was a flute that did it. Purchased the fool thing from a traveling merchant. I’m no good on it, but I play to pass the time. 

My clumsy music brought the Wild Man down from out of a tree. We watched each other, by and by. It was a good, long while. Then he loped off. Maybe I can tempt him again.
wildmancutlasskeys_body_01_04:
He talks! 

It has taken months, slow gains by tiny degrees, until finally the Wild Man shared a meager meal with me. And then another. It became a near weekly occurrence. 

Last night, before he left, he turned back to me and said, “My thanks, a thousand times, my thanks,” in an accent I cannot place.
wildmancutlasskeys_body_01_05:
Tonight, the Wild Man waxed poetic, spoke in verse, told me a tale the likes of which I have never heard. 

He told me of great cedar forests. He told me of a city that surpasses all others in splendor, that shines like brass in the sun. He told me of a companion, a brother in battle, a second self. He told me of epic battles, fantastic journeys, and the hunt for a terrible monster. He told me of tragedy and of death. He told me of an ancient flood and the search for immortality across the furthest reaches of the world.

He told me all of these things and more. I sat in awe.

We lingered in silence for a full hour after he finished. Then he turned to me and said, “Of course, the details changed somewhat when they carved it into the stone.”

That’s exactly how he said it, too. Not “written on the page” but “carved into the stone”.
I’ll never forget it.

winterconvergence_body_01_01: It is time to make merry. Best not to tarry! Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho! When the crisped air makes ghosts of your breath and the trees all dream in death, look for the signs of the Wanderer. When the stars burn brighter, when bleeding colors paint the sky in awe, when the Gleamite stars fall, look for Winter’s Father. When the Frigid Folk chuckle and the Ice Trolls cackle, huddle closer to the flames and the crackle, and look for the Frost Lord. O, darling. O, deario. It is time to make merry. Best not to tarry! Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_01_02: Sing a carol, now, to the Winter Wanderer. When the sky fills with celestial light and winter blankets the earth, the Wanderer comes forth! Know him by his First Aspect. Call him Yulnir. Call him Father Winter. He comes with a benevolent twinkle in his eye. He comes wrapped in a cloak made from the multi-colored sky. Every home he visits. Every hearth he blesses. On the coldest nights, he brings feast and bounty. He feeds body and soul with a warmth that lasts from season to season. The hearth of the heart! But Father Winter only gifts those who have offered love and warmth to their fellows all the year round. O, darling. O, deario. It is time to make merry. Pray do not tarry! Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_01_03: Sing a carol, now, to the Winter Wanderer. When the days shrivel to nothing, and you fathom the bottom of your bowl, and you enter the long night of the soul, the Wanderer comes forth! Know him by his Second Aspect. Call him Jotunir. Call him Lord Frost. Call him the Winter Warrior! He comes cloaked in a patchwork coat stitched from all of our nightmares. He comes with a prerogative of vengeance. The hearts of the selfish and vain are his food. Merrily, merrily he goes about his terrible business. He stalks the wild places, stands in shadows, and you may not even notice when he drinks your misty breath. O, darling. O, deario! It’s past time to make merry. Did you dare tarry? It may already be too late. Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_01_04: Sing a carol, now, to the Frigid Folk. Call them the children of the Frost Lord. Call them holy mischief. Call them merry mayhem. They all grin with demented joy. They know the names of every child who fell through the ice. They bring gifts of festive chaos. They gather souls for the army of their lord. Best to leave out something sweet, lest they find something else to nibble and eat. O, darling. O, deario! You better make merry. The alternative’s quite scary. Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_01_05: Sing a carol, now, to the Ice Trolls. Call them minions of the Winter Warrior. Call them the grunts of the army of Forever Winter. The Frigid Folk caught these unfortunate souls and ate their names. That is alright. They won’t need their names anymore. O, darling. O, deario! You better make merry. Make merry! Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_01_06: Sing a carol, now… No. There are no carols now. There is only silence and the wind and the groan of ice. Call it Lord Frost’s victory. Call it Winter Warrior triumphant. Call it Forever Winter. Everything rests in the belly of a blizzard, and the Winter Warrior holds illimitable dominion for all eternity. O, darling. O, deario! It was time to make merry. You wretches did tarry. It is far, far too late. Roh-de-lay-ho-ho-ho!
winterconvergence_body_02_01: It’s that time. I tend to know it before just before the graying skies and snowfall. Old war wounds ache just a little more. \n\nMany folk are already setting up their decorations, dashes of color in the winter gloom. I’ll be joining them. The way the stories go, we do this to appease the Winter Wanderer, keep him in his jolly aspect. We avoid the punishment of the second aspect. Is all that true? I don’t rightly know. I do know that to get through a hard winter, we need to make warmth and cheer. Why not drink? Why not dance? Why not set up festive decor?
winterconvergence_body_02_02:
Come one, come all! 

It is the time of the Celestial Binding. The Winter Convergence is here! 

Tonight begins the great Gleamite hunt. 

Track the glowing stones as they fall from the heavens. 

Decorate everything with their cheer. 

Prizes to the most Gleamite stones found!
winterconvergence_body_03_01: A Scholarly Note on the True Meaning of the Holidays I say, but we have lost the thread of the true importance of the Winter Convergence. Now those two words drown in association with every possible holiday tradition brought from every corner of the world by the sailors who now call Aeternum home. The true import of the Convergence is lost on the layperson, jolly red noses festooned with exploding capillaries, betraying one too many imbibed cups of good cheer. What is important is that this is a celestial convergence, a very particular alignment of heavenly bodies. Ancient texts speak of this Celestial Binding. Understanding of these awesome forces could have profound impact on our sciences and esoteric arts. The true person of learning must study the wonders that bend above us and say “Humbug!” to the slack-jawed revelers who would distract them.
winterconvergence_body_03_02: A Scholarly Note on This Festive Apocalypse Ancient texts and drunken gossip seem to intersect on matters concerning the so called “Forever Winter”. Details vary, but both agree on some species of apocalyptic cycle, a catastrophic blizzard that either never ends or lasts so long as to bury living memory in frost. The more colorful yarns tell of this being an age ruled by some demoniacal aspect of the Winter Wanderer — a Winter Warrior, Lord of Frost, or holiday devil. I’ve come to no definitive conclusion on any of these claims. However, the power of the Celestial Binding, at this time of year, in this place, could potentially have an awful (and I do stress the word “awe”) on both the stratosphere and the climate.
winterconvergence_body_03_03: A Scholarly Note on Jolly Customs Born of an Evil Tree Let the record show that I do not, at this time, subscribe to the following story. However, it was relayed to me, and I trap it on the page now, like a pinned moth, so that I might dissect it later. In the Long Ago of Aeternum, a dark sect worshiped the terrible Second Aspect of the Winter Wanderer. They performed profane rituals before a blessed tree. They danced naked in the dark with the Frigid Folk, yet frostbite touched neither their limbs nor their nethers. One day, a group of brave Aeternumites confronted these holiday diabolists and chopped down the wicked tree. They promptly displayed their arboreal trophy in town. The tradition became a mainstay of the holiday, symbolizing a triumph over evil. Over time, the particulars of the symbolism of this act was absorbed into every aspect of the holiday.

wisemanscounsel01: Your battle against the physical forces of evil has honor.
wisemanscounsel02: But the real struggle is the battle of the mind.
wisemanscounsel03: Consider the burdens weighing on your companions.
wisemanscounsel04: The internal assault this island wages against them.
wisemanscounsel05: Aeternum is not just a place, you see. It is a state of being.
wisemanscounsel06: And it will scar your soul, unless you choose to change.
wisemanscounsel07: Attachments to the past become a prison.
wisemanscounsel08: Only balance can transform that prison into a refuge.
wisemanscounsel09: As Warden to the souls caught in your sphere...
wisemanscounsel10: You must defend against the shadows darkening their hearts.
wisemanscounsel11: Create the island of calm within their storm...
wisemanscounsel12: Because on this island, where time stretches thin to no horizon...
wisemanscounsel13: Your soul too will be stretched thin: a shadow in the dark.
wisemanscounsel14: Become the light you have inside.
wisemanscounsel15: For you are not just in Aeternum; Aeternum is in you.
