yonas_00_00_init: New face, old story. The wheel grinds on, grinds us down, doesn't it?
yonas_00_01_offer_learnsoulwarden_a: I offer you nothing, but you remain. I can give you a name, if that would help.
yonas_00_01_offer_learnsoulwarden_b: Some have called me Yonas. There are other names, but they will not speak themselves. One is enough, I think.
yonas_00_a_00_init: That was an invigorating climb. My body is so much younger than my head.
yonas_00_a_01_tasktopic_bearcave_a: <g id="litearmor_think" />Hmm. This place is familiar. My feet remember what my mind does not. <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />Have you found any new voices, haunted one?
yonas_00_a_01_tasktopic_bearcave_a_old: Hmm. This place is familiar. My feet remember what my mind does not.
yonas_00_a_01_tasktopic_bearcave_b: Have you found any new voices, haunted one?
yonas_00_a_02_tasktopic_alioth_a: <g id="litearmor_lookuparound" priority="high"/>The ghosts are loud here... this place remembers sorrow. My bones rattle with it. <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />You went into the cave. What did you find?
yonas_00_a_02_tasktopic_alioth_a_old: The ghosts are loud here... this place remembers sorrow. My bones rattle with it.
yonas_00_a_02_tasktopic_alioth_b: You went into the cave. What did you find?
yonas_00_a_03_comment_alioth_a: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Something ended here. <g id="litearmor_lookdownguilty" priority= "high"/>Grief soaks this garment. My own, somehow. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />It is mine and not mine.
yonas_00_a_03_comment_alioth_b: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />The flesh forgets, but the cloth remembers.
yonas_00_b_00_init_a: <g id="litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Carts and wanderers, adventurers and fortune-seekers. <g id="litearmor_agree1" />They pass these ruins thinking only of safety, riches, and dust.
yonas_00_b_00_init_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />How could they know what this place was? Sacred for some, <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />hopelessly tragic for others.
yonas_00_b_01_offer_learnsoulwardenb_a: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />But there are answers here, a path that leads where many have sought to go, those who would stand against the Corruption.
yonas_00_b_01_offer_learnsoulwardenb_b: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />You speak of that voice that assaults your mind... this path may be the only way to see it silenced.
yonas_01_00_init_a: These fish and I, we have a history. My lure doesn't attract their attention much, but I enjoy spending time with them all the same.
yonas_01_00_init_b: If I really want to catch fish, there are other spots not far.
yonas_01_01_offer_arcturus_a: Continue your journey, traveler. The fish have grown clever here.
yonas_01_01_offer_arcturus_b: Ah, but you are familiar. Two voices, one mind. Yes, we've spoken before. What brings you to my hovel?
yonas_01_02_offer_toadiana_a: <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />I truly am the last. All that the Order was, <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />all that it will be, <g id="sit_headshakeno" />in this decaying mind of mine.
yonas_01_02_offer_toadiana_b: You've rested your faith in me, but it is unfounded, and there is nowhere else you will find the strength you seek to leverage.
yonas_01_02_offer_toadiana_b_new: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />I am sorry. You have come to me seeking a way to fight the darkness within, <g id="sit_dismissLeft" />but I have nothing to offer.
yonas_01_03_comment_adiana: I remember that she was beautiful, and terrifying, and ancient, even when I was young…
yonas_01_04_offer_canishaft_a: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />We have but one component of our conduit. Vital though it may be, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />we must now craft the Staff that will contain it.
yonas_01_04_offer_canishaft_b: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Through it, you will draw on the power of your own soul to destroy Corruption where it stands.
yonas_01_05_offer_forgemaster_a: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />For the next component of the Azoth staff, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />you must acquire one of our consecrated crosspieces.
yonas_01_05_offer_forgemaster_b: <g id="litearmor_worry" priority="high" />It will be tricky, however, as there are certainly none of these <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />just lying about in an old chest.
yonas_01_06_offer_forgestaff_a: <g id="litearmor_concerns" priority="high" />I fear there is little time to prepare you for what approaches.
yonas_01_06_offer_forgestaff_b: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />While you were away, I met a traveler who spoke of Corrupted coming down from the north. <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />I suspect they are driven on by the same voice that plagues your mind.
yonas_01_07_offer_returnsettlement_a: <g id="litearmor_think" />I have had time to give our predicament some thought.
yonas_01_07_offer_returnsettlement_b: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />While we now possess an Azoth Staff, it is but a beginning, <g id="litearmor_youknow" />and even armed with such an implement, <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />we two are no bulwark against Corruption.
yonas_01_08_comment_returnsettlement: <g id="litearmor_agree1" />Seeing is believing. They may not understand what you hold in your hand, <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />but you can teach them with your deeds.
yonas_01_09_offer_heartgem_a: Don't say I didn't warn you now, but you get used to it, sort of.
yonas_01_09_offer_heartgem_b: There is just one more thing you need before you can be anointed as a Soulwarden.
yonas_01_09_offer_heartgem_new: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Your success with the staff you forged proves your readiness. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />It is now time for you to face this final step <g id="male_nodunderstand" />to becoming a true Soulwarden.
yonas_02_00_init_a: I wish they had not delved into this sacred place, but it is serendipitous in a way.
yonas_02_00_init_b: It is much harder to create a Heartgem than it is to find one.
yonas_02_00_init_new: <g id="female_gestureAroundRoom" priority="high" />These ruins are among the most elaborate in all Aeternum. <g id="male_nodunderstand" />There is much here that is sacred, and much that is very dangerous, too.
yonas_02_01_offer_ritual_a: <g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />A Soulwarden's power comes from creating distance in your soul, <g id="female_explains" />like a firebreak in the forest.
yonas_02_01_offer_ritual_b: <g id="male_handheart" />The Heartgem provides that barrier, inuring your soul against Corruption.
yonas_02_02_offer_toemile_a: Once upon a time, the initiation of a new Soulwarden was cause to party for three days and nights.
yonas_02_02_offer_toemile_b: But there's only two of us now. It would be a very subdued affair.
